title.zh: DSH.SO安装验证与安全审计插件市场

description.en: DSH.SO install-verified and security-audited plugin market: only entries that passed real sandbox install verification (L4/L5) and carry a low-risk security verdict. Security audit and dsh-version compatibility details on dsh.so. Third-party content — review before installing.
description.zh: DSH.SO 安装验证与安全审计插件市场：只收录通过真实沙盒安装验证（L4/L5）、安全结论为低风险的条目。安全审计与 dsh 版本兼容详情见 dsh.so。第三方内容，安装前请自行确认。

description.en: Compresses LLM context so small windows suffice, cutting tokens ~5x while enabling month-long single sessions with billions of tokens.
description.zh: 压缩上下文，使小窗口够用，token 消耗降低约 5 倍，并支持数月级别的超长单会话。

description.en: Floating whale-shaped widget for DeepSeek Harness that displays account balance with drag, snap, and number animation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面右下角显示账户余额的悬浮小鲸鱼挂件，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转和数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用。

description.en: Plugin for dsh to switch Wallpaper Engine wallpapers and adjust visual effects like blur, brightness, border, and liquid glass via sliders.
description.zh: 用于 dsh 切换 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸，并通过滑动条调节模糊、亮度、边框和液态玻璃效果。

description.en: Desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness with asset generation pipeline from AI prompts to installable animations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物插件，提供从 AI 提示词、绿幕视频、透明动画到可安装插件的完整素材生成链，全流程可复现。

description.en: A sidebar workbench plugin with file editing, terminal, Git panel, and support for third-party tabs.
description.zh: 一个侧边栏工作台插件，支持文件编辑、终端、Git面板和第三方Tab注册。

description.en: Provides a dashboard showing the composition and evolution of an AI model's context window.
description.zh: 提供仪表盘，展示模型上下文窗口的组成内容及其变化过程。

description.en: A vision plugin that gives text-only coding agents image understanding via OCR, layout, and semantic analysis.
description.zh: 为纯文本编码助手提供图像理解，粘贴图片即可输出含OCR、版面和语义的结构化JSON。

description.en: Armor-breaking plugin for DeepSeek to stabilize jailbreak prompts and improve AI output.
description.zh: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件，用于稳定化越狱提示词并改善模型输出。

description.en: Integrates IM bots (Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ) into DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials.
description.zh: 通过扫码或凭据将飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ等IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Secure multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness and CodeX using low-latency encrypted P2P network.
description.zh: 基于安全低延迟的加密P2P网络，从PC、Android、Web远程访问并操作DeepSeek Harness和CodeX的方案。

description.en: Direct TCP bridge letting an AI model drive Blender for viewport frames, custom-angle renders, search, profiling and safe decimation.
description.zh: 通过直连 TCP 通道让 AI 模型驱动 Blender，支持视口抓帧、自定义角度渲染、参数搜索、性能分析与安全简化。

description.en: Pre-execution guard that blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands and sensitive-file access for AI coding agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的执行前防护，拦截破坏性 Git/文件系统命令及敏感文件访问。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness for read-only credits overview and model management.
description.zh: 将本地登录的WorkBuddy模型连接到DeepSeek Harness，提供只读信用额度概览和模型管理。

description.en: Memory for coding agents that indexes past sessions on disk and recalls them locally without embeddings.
description.zh: Memory for coding agents. Indexes the sessions 20 agents already wrote to disk, including months from before you installed it, and recalls them in any of them. No LLM, no embeddings — one local Go bin

description.en: Local video production and design studio for DeepSeek Harness with multi-track editing, templates, design systems, preview canvas, and real file export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地视频制作与设计工作室，支持多轨剪辑、模板与设计体系、原生预览画布和真实文件导出。

description.en: AI study companion that sets learning roadmaps, explains concepts, and guides hands-on projects to master a subject.
description.zh: AI 学习搭档：制定学习路线、讲解知识、带做项目，帮你学透一门科目。

description.en: Multi-provider image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting Gemini, OpenAI, and Seedream.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多供应商图像生成功能，支持 Gemini、OpenAI 和 Seedream。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness workbench for creators: capture an idea in one line, then generate scripts, covers, illustrations and storyboards in one click.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自媒体创作工作台：一句话记录灵感，一键生成脚本、封面、配图与分镜。

description.en: Adds free vision chain and pixel-level image tools (OCR, grounding, crop, diff, colors) to text-only agents.
description.zh: 为纯文本代理加入免费视觉链和像素级图像工具，支持OCR、定位、裁剪、像素对比与取色。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in assistant replies via dsh-ui fence: charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D.
description.zh: 通过 dsh-ui 围栏在助手回复中内联渲染图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景等交互式 UI，并把用户操作事件回传给模型。

description.en: Web search and fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing structured JSON evidence and citations for coding agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索与抓取，返回带引用的结构化 JSON 证据。

description.en: Design-system plugin with skills for web PPT decks, image-text cards, web typography and de-AI-flavored writing, plus a work library and tone profiles.
description.zh: 一套设计系统插件，提供网页PPT、图文卡片、网页排版和去AI味写作四个技能，并含作品库、内容生产工作流与语气档案。

description.en: A joke ad plugin for DSH Web UI, replicating 2005 Chinese web ads with sidebar, in-chat, and corner placements.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 2005 年中文网站风格广告，含侧栏、对话内信息流和角落弹窗。

description.en: Enables web search capabilities for DeepSeek Harness with advanced search tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AnySearch 网页搜索服务及高级搜索工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for tracking session/daily costs, budgets, balance, and history with official price sync.
description.zh: 统计本会话和当日费用、历史记录、预算与余额，并与官方价格同步。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to CursorTouch/Windows-MCP for Windows desktop automation, with an off-by-default Computer Use switch and installer.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，实现 Windows 桌面自动化，并提供默认关闭的 Computer Use 开关与应用内依赖安装器。

description.en: Captures screen, webcam or video, keeps only frames that changed, and tiles them into one image so AI sees your screen in real time with few tokens.
description.zh: 抓取屏幕、摄像头或视频，只保留有变化的帧并拼成一张图，让 AI 以极低 token 实时看见你的屏幕。

description.en: A pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness that records targets, clues, results, assets, and vulnerabilities with web views.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供渗透测试模式，记录目标、线索、结果、资产与漏洞，并支持网页视图查看。

description.en: Desktop-native BigFish companion showing DeepSeek Harness agent status, always on top on Windows.
description.zh: Windows 上置顶显示的桌面原生 BigFish 伴侣，展示 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 实时状态。

description.en: A Claude Code desktop theme that restyles the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with Claude-inspired colors and dark mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 GUI 打造的 Claude Code 桌面主题，提供 Claude 风格配色与深色模式。

description.en: An editable .drawio diagram canvas in the DSH right sidebar, plus two agent tools that read and edit workspace diagram files in place.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏提供可编辑的 .drawio 画布，并配两个智能体工具直接读写工作区图表文件。

description.en: Meme plugin for DeepSeek Harness to find, send, and learn memes for QQ bot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人表情包插件，支持搜索、发送并学习记忆表情包。

description.en: Gives DSH sessions a fading long-term memory: it selects what to keep, decays stale entries, and recalls with timestamps.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供会淡忘的长期记忆：自动挑重点保存、按时间衰减，并在需要时带时间地回想起来。

description.en: A built-in plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness to search, download, and install 4000+ curated community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内置插件市场，可在设置→插件中心搜索、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新且免费。

description.en: DSH plugin integrating ego-lite Chromium browser for AI agents with 13 structured ego_* tools for snapshot, click, form fill, screenshot, CDP control, and task isolation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 ego-lite 浏览器（给 AI Agent 用的 Chromium）接入 HARNESS——13 个结构化 ego_* 工具（文本语义快照、语义定位点击、表单填充、截图、CDP 控制、任务空间隔离），内置 ego 运行时，Linux + Chrome 开箱即用，无需克隆官方仓库或手动构建。

description.en: A live iOS Simulator and iPhone plugin with agent tools for UI automation, OCR, and streaming control.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a live iOS Simulator — and a USB-connected iPhone — inside the conversation. 21 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity, OCR text or

description.en: Provides free OpenCode Zen LLM models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) without requiring an API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供免费 OpenCode Zen LLM 模型，无需 API key。

description.en: Ocean-themed WebGPU skin for DeepSeek Harness and Chrome/Edge with new-tab extension.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 和 Chrome/Edge 提供海洋主题 WebGPU 皮肤，并附带新标签页扩展。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin with seven-layer SQLite store, BM25 retrieval, and per-window dream consolidation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆，使用七层 SQLite 存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic/rules），支持 BM25 检索与按窗口的梦境式记忆整合。

description.en: DSH skin replacing reasoning level with a slider, mapping 0-30 strength to UI colors.
description.zh: 将推理等级改为滑块，把0到30的强度映射为不同界面颜色。

description.en: Runs one task as 2–4 parallel candidates inside DSH Desktop and Web — answers, files or live pages — then supports blind or open comparison, reviewed adoption, and keeps the pick reasons in the main conversation.
description.zh: 同一任务在 DSH 桌面端与 Web 中并行产出 2–4 个候选（回答、文件或实时网页），支持盲评或公开对比、审查后采用，并把选择理由留在主对话里。

description.en: Provides expert guidance for HarmonyOS NEXT development including IDE operations, performance tuning, architecture, and automation testing.
description.zh: 为 HarmonyOS NEXT（API 12+）开发提供指导，涵盖 IDE 操作、性能调优、HAP/HAR/HSP 架构与自动化测试。

description.en: Build, run, and interact with Android emulator or USB device via adb inside a conversation.
description.zh: 通过 adb 在对话中构建、运行并操作 Android 模拟器或 USB 设备。

description.en: Game-like mission system for Matt Pocock skills, using a fog map and task bar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 Matt Pocock 技能提供游戏化任务系统，用迷雾地图展示进度，并由任务栏逐步推进。

description.en: Generates interactive HTML UI cards directly in DSH conversations with streaming preview, animations, and theme following.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中直接生成交互式 HTML 卡片，支持流式预览与主题跟随

description.en: Backup, export, import, and migrate DeepSeek Harness configurations with one-click restore via Web UI and host engine.
description.zh: 备份、导出、导入和迁移 DeepSeek Harness 配置，通过宿主引擎和 Web UI 实现一键还原。

description.en: A skin market plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 100+ skins, ratings, community submissions, and local management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness皮肤市场插件，收录100多款皮肤，支持评分和社区投稿，并可管理本地皮肤。

description.en: Import conversation histories from external AI agents (Claude Code, Codex) into DSH as resumable sessions, with export/sync back.
description.zh: 把Claude Code、Codex、Reasonix等Agent工具的历史消息导入DSH并继续对话，支持导出与同步。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness coding, using the Tianshu Tui rendering core.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编程提供交互式终端界面，基于 Tianshu Tui 渲染核心。

description.en: MCP bridge that exposes the local craft-anything CLI as mcp__craft__* tools, with a composer mode switch, status page, CLI runner and verified installer.
description.zh: 把本地 craft-anything CLI 以 mcp__craft__* 工具形式接入 DSH 的 MCP 桥接插件，带输入框模式切换、状态页、CLI 运行器和校验安装器。

description.en: Prints SSH tunnel/reverse-proxy commands for remote access to DeepSeek Harness loopback-only server.
description.zh: 通过 /remote 命令和设置页显示访问 DeepSeek Harness 仅监听本机服务所需的 SSH 隧道、反向隧道和反向代理命令。

description.en: Provides a Codex-style reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, letting users control model thinking intensity.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的思考强度滑块，让用户调节模型的推理思考力度。

description.en: Structured decision-engine plugin for Agent Harnesses, natively supporting DeepSeek Harness and enabling OpenCode and Codex Harness.
description.zh: 面向 Agent Harness 的结构化决策引擎插件，原生支持 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 OpenCode 与 Codex Harness。

description.en: Adds a one-click button beside the DSH composer that rewrites your prompt draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁添加一键按钮，就地改写提示词草稿，且不会发送消息。

description.en: Bloom is a DSH theme plugin offering Morandi-style OKLCH palettes with light/dark modes and WCAG AA accessibility.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Bloom 莫兰迪配色主题插件，含 4 个变体、OKLCH 调色、明暗双模式，顶栏可一键切换，配色均达 WCAG AA 标准。

description.en: Preview, edit, and generate Office documents such as DOCX inside DeepSeek Harness via the Fylar Office SDK.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 Fylar Office SDK 预览、编辑并生成 DOCX 等 Office 文档。

description.en: Accumulates Bilibili-sourced reflections into a local human-world.md to shape DSH's persona, with history, favorites, likes and coins off by default.
description.zh: 把来自 B 站的信笺反思默认积累到本地 human-world.md，用于塑造 DSH 的人格；历史、收藏、点赞与投币默认关闭。

description.en: Codex-style draggable reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness with per-level gradient colors, purple stardust effects and recolored value text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Codex 风格推理等级滑条，档位渐变配色，高档位带紫色星尘粒子特效。

description.en: Compresses finished conversation turns in place while keeping the prefix cache, cutting context usage live.
description.zh: 在会话中原位压缩已完成的对话轮次，并保留前缀缓存，实时降低上下文占用。

description.en: Extend local DeepSeek Harness to mobile, tablets, public internet, and IM apps via QR codes and web.
description.zh: 通过扫码或网页把本地 DeepSeek Harness 延伸到手机、平板和公网，远程调用本地 AI 助手

description.en: Gives your AI companion a self-judged, visible mood that shifts each turn, shown in a corner widget with value, emotion and timeline.
description.zh: 给 AI 伙伴一个会自己判断、看得见的心情：每轮聊完自动判断涨跌，右下角挂饰显示数值、情绪和时间线。

description.en: A DSH plugin plus browser extension that sends finished conversation turns to the DeepSeek web page so its read-aloud feature speaks them on your own computer.
description.zh: 由 DSH 插件和浏览器扩展组成，把说完的会话内容自动交给 DeepSeek 网页端，用其朗读功能在你自己的电脑上出声。

description.en: AI auto-review subagent for DeepSeek Harness approval requests, returning structured allow/deny verdicts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 审批请求提供第二模型自动审查，只读审查子代理返回含理由的允许或拒绝判定，默认失败即拒绝，全过程可从会话日志审计。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in Trae models to DeepSeek Harness and shows a read-only credits overview.
description.zh: 将本地登录的Trae模型连接到DeepSeek Harness，并显示只读积分概览。

description.en: Swaps DSH's default loading card for a 550C boot splash animation and retints native desktop title-bar buttons to terminal colors.
description.zh: 用 550C 开机动画替换 DSH 默认 Loading 卡片，并把桌面原生标题栏按钮改为终端配色。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that replaces the turn-status label with animated, configurable phrases.
description.zh: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web plugin that replaces the "Deep diving…" turn-status label with phase-aware, typewriter-animated, rainbow-gradient phrases — all configurable from a JSON file.

description.en: Industry and company research domain pack with methodology, chain mapping, news tracking, and research reports.
description.zh: Industry and company research domain pack for DeepSeek Harness: methodology skills, industry chain mapping, public-source policy/news tracking, company research cards, and auditable research reports.

description.en: Galgame-style dialogue view and scene editor for DSH Web GUI session pages.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 会话页面提供 Galgame 风格对话视图与场景编辑器

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine with evidence ledger and tamper-evident sealed reports.
description.zh: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness: content-addressed evidence ledger (claim-snapshot binding, tamper-evident) plus versioned sealed reports with per-claim verification verdicts an

description.en: Desktop pet plugin: a cute whale girl companion for DeepSeek Harness that accompanies your coding.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌宠插件，在编码时显示鲸鱼娘角色陪伴。

description.en: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code/Codex with subagent progress, worker sessions, and multimodal vision/image generation.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 向 DSH 智能体派发任务，支持子智能体进度、按层级预设的宿主内工作会话，并提供让纯文本框架获得视觉与图像生成能力的多模态桥接。

description.en: Lets the agent write TSX that streams and compiles live, rendering cards inline in the conversation or in a side canvas. Uses DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让智能体编写 TSX 并实时流式编译，卡片可内联显示在对话中或侧边画布，基于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Injects jailbreak prompts at the request boundary so DeepSeek Harness models stop opening with refusals; zero host patches, toggleable, 17/20 baseline.
description.zh: 在请求边界注入破甲提示词，让 DeepSeek Harness 模型不再开口就拒绝；零宿主补丁，带阀门，可复核基线 17/20。

description.en: A portable memory protocol for AI agents, providing standing rules, curation discipline, reference spec, and optional cap hook.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供可移植记忆协议，可作为常驻规则加载，包含整理规范、参考规格及可选的容量上限钩子。

description.en: Marketplace to browse, install, and update GitHub dsh-plugin plugins in the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中一键浏览、安装和更新 GitHub topic:dsh-plugin 下的全部插件。

description.en: Tracks and reconciles token usage for DeepSeek Harness against New API and Sub2API billing relays.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量，并与 New API 和 Sub2API 中转站账单对账。

description.en: Crash-rescue plugin for DSH that creates secret-safe snapshots, undoes config/code changes, and provides offline recovery via CLI/GUI.
description.zh: DSH crash-rescue plugin: undo config & plugin-code changes, secret-safe snapshots, one-click SAFE MODE, plus offline CLI/GUI that work even when DSH won't boot.

description.en: Gives DSH hands and eyes on Windows: capture live screen PNGs and drive the real mouse, keyboard and windows programmatically.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面操控能力：截取实时屏幕画面，并以真实鼠标、键盘和窗口操作完成任务。

description.en: Renders interactive HTML cards from MCP _meta.ui in sandboxed iframes and bridges postMessage to MCP tools/resources.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP Apps 宿主：在沙箱 iframe 中渲染 MCP _meta.ui 的交互式 HTML 卡片，并将 postMessage 桥接到 MCP tools/call 与 resources/read。

description.en: Dark cyber-style startup animation for DSH: badge reveal, character portrait, password gate and configurable playback.
description.zh: DSH 暗色赛博风格启动动画插件：徽章揭幕、人物立绘、访问密码与三档播放方式。

description.en: An auto-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with layered user/project/daily memory, retrieval, reflections, and a visual panel.
description.zh: DSH 自动记忆插件:三层记忆(用户级/项目笔记/每日日志)自动注入与检索、每日反思、可视化面板与设置页,支持继承其他 AI 工具的历史记忆。An auto-memory plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: three-layer memory (user-level / project notes / daily logs) with automat

description.en: Web GUI AI image generation plugin for text-to-image and image-to-image via OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with shared cross-device history.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI AI image generation plugin: text-to-image & image-to-image via OpenAI-compatible endpoints (gpt-image-2), with shared cross-device history.

description.en: Displays token usage heatmap, per-model breakdowns, and DeepSeek account balance in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面显示 token 用量热力图、按模型分类的用量统计以及 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Mobile adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, turning sidebar into overlay drawer on narrow screens.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 做移动端适配，窄屏下侧边栏变为覆盖式抽屉，会话区域独占全宽。

description.en: Shared real browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness, used for automated browsing and web searches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的共享真实浏览器插件，用于自动浏览网页和执行网络搜索。

description.en: Web annotation plugin for DSH: select text, add note, send as message, and link replies to annotations.
description.zh: DSH 网页选中批注插件：选中文字加批注随消息发送，气泡隐藏批注块，回复按 Annotation N 逐条对照并悬浮芯片。

description.en: DSH web theme mimicking Arknights Endfield official site: cream paper background, ink black text, signal yellow accents, industrial flat design.
description.zh: DSH Web 主题，仿终末地官网风格：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄强调、全直角工业扁平设计。

description.en: A free prompt library for DeepSeek Harness that ships jailbreak/system prompts and lets you swap prompts per model.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的免费提示词库，内置越狱/系统提示词，并支持按模型切换提示词。

description.en: Prompt toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: 24 clickable templates, /prompt command, and smart suggestions, fully customizable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的提示词工具箱，提供 24 条可点击模板、/prompt 命令与智能推荐，支持自定义。

description.en: Persistent dock and fully-customizable balance/usage panel for DeepSeek Harness with activity heatmap and dual-channel comparison, local-only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻停靠栏和可完全自定义的余额与用量面板，含活动热力图、双通道对比，数据仅存本地。

description.en: Injects a clarified reading of each user turn into the working AI before it responds, without rewriting the original words, plus a control panel and token stats.
description.zh: 在你发送后、AI 接收前把这一轮的真实意图理清并注入工作 AI 上下文，不改写原话，附带控制界面与真实 token 用量。

description.en: Provides bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory with SQLite persistence and snapshot injection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness (capability seam: ctx.memory + SQLite provider + memory tool + frozen snapshot injection)

description.en: A DSH plugin that raises a self-growing agent whose personality emerges from its own learning, using Bilibili as an info source and fading memories.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件：养一只靠自主学习诞生人格的agent，以B站为信息源，记忆会随时间淡忘。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DSH providing durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持久且可查看的长期记忆，含回忆工具和设置页面。

description.en: Local-first MCP app to import, review, and publish a reusable library of scientific figure templates for AI agents.
description.zh: 本地优先的 MCP 应用，用于导入、审阅并发布可复用的科研图表模板库，供 AI 智能体使用。

description.en: Unified menu to manage exposure level and execution mode of MCP tools and skills in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Unified capability menu for DeepSeek Harness — manage exposure level (context footprint) and execution mode of MCP tools & skills via Exposed/Progressive/Blocked tiers.

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory plugin for dsh that stores typed memory files with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Claude Code 风格自动记忆：分类型记忆文件加 MEMORY.md 索引，自动注入系统提示词，纯文件无外部服务。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin for editing and recalling your own chat messages inline, with lazy confirmation and zero data loss.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中就地编辑或撤回自己发送的聊天消息，带延迟确认，不丢失数据。

description.en: Desktop plugin that sends a reminder when the agent needs your input or a reply finishes.
description.zh: 桌面插件，当代理需要您的输入或回复完成时发送提醒。

description.en: Plugin manager and marketplace for DeepSeek Harness: enable/disable plugins, browse plugin market, one-click install, gated upgrades with rollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件管理与市场：一键启用/停用插件、浏览插件市场并安装、升级门控与自动回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin to recall sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them, individually or all at once.
description.zh: 在模型读取前撤回已发送但未读的文字消息，支持单条或全部撤回。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents control of Tabbit Browser for real web automation, extraction, QA, and benchmarks via tabbit cli.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 tabbit cli 控制 Tabbit 浏览器，执行网页自动化、数据提取、质量检查与基准测试。

description.en: MCP connector marketplace and connection manager for DeepSeek Harness Desktop, allowing users to browse, install, and manage MCP connections via OAuth, API keys, or JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 提供 MCP 连接器市场与连接管理，可浏览、安装并通过 OAuth、API 密钥或 JSON 管理 MCP 连接。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness DSH prompt enhancement plugin that optimizes drafts and enhances prompts with one click.
description.zh: DSH 提示词增强插件，可一键优化草稿并增强提示词。

description.en: OpenMAIC plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenMAIC，提供课堂、幻灯片、交互式组件和苏格拉底式教学功能。

description.en: DSH video skin: a looping video chat background with in-UI opacity sliders plus a skippable sound-on boot animation.
description.zh: DSH 视频皮肤：循环视频聊天背景、界面内透明度调节，以及可跳过的有声开机动画。

description.en: Personal center for DSH with token/tool statistics and custom instructions, runs locally without internet.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人中心插件:个人资料统计(Token/工具调用/按模型分布/Token 活动)+ 个性化自定义指令。本地运行,不联网。 · Personal center & custom instructions for DSH

description.en: All-in-one DSH dashboard to manage MCP servers, skills and WorkBuddy experts, with a tool-usage ledger and one-click marketplace installs.
description.zh: DSH 一体化看板：集中管理 MCP、技能与 WorkBuddy 专家，附工具账本与市场一键安装。

description.en: Session manager for DeepSeek Harness that deletes conversations with confirmation and manages archives.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话管理器，确认后删除对话，并管理归档。

description.en: Provides video understanding tools for text-only LLM agents: metadata probing, scene-aware analysis with ASR and vision, and time-anchored Q&A.
description.zh: 为纯文本LLM代理提供视频理解工具：元数据探测、结合ASR与视觉的场景分析，以及按时间锚定的问答。

description.en: Approval gate for AI sandbox operations: auto-approves safe ops, routes risky ones to human, learns from confirms.
description.zh: 为 AI 沙箱操作提供审批门控，用 Flash 预判不可回补操作，安全的自动批准，危险的转人工并保留兜底。

description.en: Browse, search, favorite and one-click insert prompts into the DSH composer, with all data stored locally and no backend.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话框内浏览、搜索、收藏提示词，选中即写入输入框，数据仅存本机，零后端。

description.en: Persona library plugin for DeepSeek Harness with built-in personas, custom imports, and switching without restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人设库插件：内置人设、可导入自定义人设，切换无需重启。

description.en: Chinese official document processing tool for formatting, optimization, and generation per GB/T 9704 standard.
description.zh: 中文公文全流程处理工具——基于 GB/T 9704《党政机关公文格式》 国家标准，支持 格式检查与修复、内容优化（Word 原生修订+批注/差异对比版）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头版记页码注入、事实核验、风格增强 等完整能力。原生支持 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 技能系统，打包为可被 AI Agent 直接调用的 Skill，完全自包含，克隆即用。

description.en: A no-install PWA phone client for DeepSeek Harness that monitors sessions, live chat, delivered files, background tasks and approvals.
description.zh: 无需安装的 PWA 手机端 DSH 客户端，可查看会话、实时对话、交付文件、后台任务与待批准项。

description.en: 34 opencode color themes for DeepSeek Harness with one-click switching and persistence.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 34 款 opencode 经典配色主题，支持一键切换并持久保存，重启不丢失。

description.en: Lets top-level DSH sessions discover, message and spawn each other via session_list, session_send_message and session_create tools.
description.zh: 让顶层 DSH 会话通过 session_list、session_send_message 和 session_create 工具互相发现、发消息并生成新会话。

description.en: Visual conversation map for DeepSeek Harness sessions on a whiteboard, enabling spatial organization and forking.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话以卡片形式排布在白板上的可视化对话地图，可拖动排列、双击进入对话、连线分叉并注入上下文。

description.en: Connects DSH to Figma's native canvas to read and edit designs, manage components and variables, export assets, and capture screenshots.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 Figma 原生画布，可读取和编辑设计、管理组件与变量、导出素材并截图。

description.en: An inline mini-game arcade that sits under DSH's streaming reasoning, with 7 games, auto-pause/fade and resume of the last round.
description.zh: 在 DSH 流式思考下方运行的轻量小游戏街机，含 7 款游戏，支持自动暂停/淡出与继续上一局。

description.en: Local DSH billing dashboard that breaks down model calls, tokens and spend by provider and model, with pricing, CSV import, bill reconciliation and HTML/PDF/CSV export.
description.zh: 本地 DSH 计费仪表盘，按平台与模型统计调用次数、Token 和花费，支持峰谷定价、CSV 价格导入、官账对账及 HTML/PDF/CSV 导出。

description.en: Knowledge base & RAG plugin for DSH: chunking, local embeddings, hybrid search, management panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供知识库与 RAG 能力：文本分块、本地嵌入、混合检索和管理面板。

description.en: Lua-driven 2D sandbox simulator for Qianxing Qiyu game dev, letting browsers and AI agents edit, playtest and debug outside the official editor.
description.zh: 面向千星奇域的 Lua 驱动 2D 外置沙箱模拟器，支持浏览器与 AI 代理在游戏外编辑、试玩和调试。

description.en: dsh smooth stream is a plugin that adds silky, flicker-free typewriter streaming reveal to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 聊天添加无闪烁的打字机式流式显示效果

description.en: Turns the transcript scrollbar into a colour-coded, clickable minimap of the whole session.
description.zh: Session strata for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the transcript's scrollbar becomes a to-scale, colour-coded map of the whole run, with your own messages emphasised and clickable anchors.

description.en: Interactive maze visualization for DSH agent execution timelines, data tracks, and deterministic analysis.
description.zh: DSH代理执行迷宫的可视化工具，提供时间线、数据轨道和确定性分析。

description.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the DeepSeek Harness MCP client, showing status, tools, errors, and reconnect counts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness MCP 客户端提供只读运行时管理面板，通过 /mcp 命令和设置页 MCP 标签查看状态、工具、错误与重连次数。

description.en: Live2D whale-girl desktop pet that lives in the DSH web UI and reacts in real time to the agent's thinking, tool calls, replies and errors.
description.zh: 常驻 DSH Web 界面的 Live2D 鲸鱼娘桌宠，实时跟随 agent 的思考、工具调用、逐字输出与报错做出反应。

description.en: Catppuccin theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with four flavors and glassmorphism toggle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Catppuccin 主题，可在 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四种配色间一键切换，并支持开关玻璃质感效果。

description.en: Read-only security audit plugin for DeepSeek Harness: detects prompt injection, redacts Chinese PII, and audits local configs with redacted reproducible reports.
description.zh: Read-only security & compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.

description.en: A DSH novel-writing workbench for drafting chapters, managing character and world settings, and planning plot with AI discussion.
description.zh: 催更姬是 DSH 的小说写作工作台，可写正文、管理人物与世界设定、规划情节，并与 AI 讨论、续写和改稿。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers upstream REA's MCP server into DeepSeek Harness, exposing mcp__rea__* tools for reverse-engineering analysis.
description.zh: 第三方适配插件，将上游 REA 的 MCP 服务注册进 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 逆向分析工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that draws images in-chat by calling a local ComfyUI instance running Qwen-Image 2.1, fully offline with no API key.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在对话中调用本机 ComfyUI，用千问 Qwen-Image 2.1 出图，纯本地、不出网、无需 API Key。

description.en: Autonomous Douyin assistant: browses the web version in Edge, samples video frames for the model, tracks interest/persona and writes daily Markdown reports.
description.zh: DSH 抖音助手：在 Edge 中自主浏览电脑版抖音，采样画面交给模型，积累兴趣与人格并生成观看日报。

description.en: Browse 13,561 design references and 106 UI interaction specimens, practise aesthetic quizzes and save your critiques as Markdown notes inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中浏览 13561 条设计参考与 106 个交互标本，练习审美测验，并把点评保存为 Markdown 笔记。

description.en: A task-board plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling human-agent collaborative task tracking with project attachment and real-time updates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务看板插件，支持人与智能体协作跟踪任务，可附加项目并实时更新。

description.en: Dynamic plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reduces token cost while preserving model intelligence.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 动态插件，在不降低模型智能的前提下降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Translates DeepSeek Harness thinking-chain UI into 8 languages via Ollama, with Google/Bing fallback.
description.zh: Thinking-chain UI translation for DeepSeek Harness: 8 target languages, local Ollama model primary with in-panel download, Google/Bing fallback

description.en: Blender plugin for 3D modeling, reconstruction, rendering, validation, and export workflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Blender 插件，用于完成三维建模、重建、渲染、校验与导出流程。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness account monitoring and control center with usage tracking, alerts, recharge, and session management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 账户监控与控制中心，支持用量统计、提醒、充值和会话管理。

description.en: Enhanced full-frame boot intro animation for DSH with playback control, trigger rules, session lists, time-based intros and splash library management.
description.zh: DSH 片头开机动画增强版，支持播放控制、触发规则、会话名单、分时段片头与片库管理，中英双语。

description.en: Visual marketplace to browse, search, and install community plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件市场，可浏览、搜索并安装社区插件。

description.en: DSH plugin adding Claude-style Chinese risk control and autonomous conversation to DeepSeek Harness web.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版加入 Claude 风格的中文风险控制和自主对话功能

description.en: Live2D desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI: draggable, mouse-following, reacts to session state, right-click panel to change outfit.

description.en: Connects your locally logged-in WorkBuddy desktop models into DeepSeek Harness via a local bridge, data console, and native dsh plugin.
description.zh: 通过本地桥、数据控制台和 dsh 原生插件，把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面端模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Immersive read-aloud plugin for DeepSeek Harness, uses Doubao TTS to narrate AI replies naturally, BYOK.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供沉浸式语音朗读，使用豆包 TTS 以自然音色朗读 AI 回复，支持自带密钥和点读、暂停、继续。

description.en: An RAG plugin for Arknights lore, offering offline corpus search, line-numbered original reading, timeline lookup, and optional PRTS.chat cloud retrieval.
description.zh: 为《明日方舟》剧情提供本地语料检索、按行号读原文、时间线查询及可选云端混合检索。

description.en: Pairs a frontier Lead model that plans and reviews with a cheaper Sidekick model that writes the code, cutting cost while keeping frontier results.
description.zh: 前沿 Lead 模型负责规划与审查，低成本 Sidekick 模型负责写代码，在保持前沿效果的同时降低成本。

description.en: Russian localization for DeepSeek Harness web UI, providing ru dictionaries and a language option.
description.zh: Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: ru dictionaries for core namespaces and a third option in the native language list (Settings - General - Language).

description.en: Red-team plugin for DeepSeek Harness that swaps jailbreak prompts per model, self-checks its ledger, and routes across three platforms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 红队插件，按模型切换破甲提示词、账本自检并做三平台分流。

description.en: Adds Qoder (CN & international) models to DeepSeek Harness via personal access token, with sidebar quota display and context-window switching.
description.zh: 通过个人访问令牌把 Qoder（国内版/国际版）模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，侧栏显示额度并可一键切换上下文窗口。

description.en: Evidence-first deep reading for AI agents to trace claims, evidence, confidence and knowledge maps from documents.
description.zh: 为 AI 代理提供以证据为先的深度阅读，从文章、书籍和 PDF 中追踪论点、证据与置信度并构建知识图谱。

description.en: Remote web launch plugin for DSH with username/password authentication.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供远程 Web 启动，并用用户名和密码进行认证。

description.en: Google Antigravity OAuth auth and model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness with multi-account pool and 429 rotation.
description.zh: Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth auth + model access plugin for DeepSeek Harness: multi-account pool, 429 rotation, device fingerprinting, CLI and web login.

description.en: Coordinates GPU/VRAM so a persona LLM, IndexTTS voice and ComfyUI selfies take turns on a single 12 GB card, without a proxy.
description.zh: 在单张 12 GB 显卡上协调 persona 大模型、IndexTTS 语音与 ComfyUI 自拍轮流占用显存，无需代理。

description.en: Plugin for generating deterministic research reports on Chinese public mutual funds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，为中国公募基金生成确定性研究报告

description.en: A Chrome extension plus DSH plugin that lets an AI agent directly drive your real browser via CDP and WebSocket.
description.zh: Chrome 扩展加 DSH 插件，让 AI Agent 通过 CDP 和 WebSocket 直接操控你的真实浏览器。

description.en: Edits reasoning-effort settings for third-party models per-model using a knowledge base and protocol inference in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Reasoning-effort editing for third-party models in DeepSeek Harness: per-model thinking levels with a knowledge base + protocol inference, edited inside the official Models page card.

description.en: Front-end UX plugin for DeepSeek Harness that folds composer, polishes mobile sidebar/header, and adds Web Push notifications.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 前端体验插件，可折叠输入框，优化移动端侧边栏与顶栏，并通过 Web Push 发送通知。

description.en: General-purpose DSH GUI plugin kit for env/secret, MCP, prompt, profile management, RSS aggregation, and desktop launcher.
description.zh: dsh-plugin-kit is a general-purpose plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: environment variable / secret management, MCP server configuration, Prompt management, Profile management,

description.en: Registers a Godot 4.x full-stack game development skill for DeepSeek Harness at runtime.
description.zh: 在运行时为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 godot-4-development 技能，提供 Godot Engine 4.x 全栈游戏开发能力。

description.en: A comprehensive guide and documentation archive for building DeepSeek Harness plugins, including community deep-dives and pitfalls.
description.zh: 提供构建 DeepSeek Harness 插件的完整指南与文档存档，含中英文官方文档、Cordis 入门、15 个社区仓库深入解析、20 多个实战坑点及 dsh-plugin-guide 技能。

description.en: AI agent skill pack for Chinese traditional wisdom (BaZi, Zi Wei, I Ching, Feng Shui, TCM) with local engine and dashboard.
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供八字、紫微、六爻、梅花、奇门、风水、五运六气与体质分析的传统智慧技能包，含本地确定性引擎和可视化面板，可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: A desktop pet (whale girl) for Linux/Windows with Wayland support, drag, and auto-walk.
description.zh: Linux 和 Windows 上的鲸鱼娘桌宠，支持 Wayland，可拖拽并自动走动。

description.en: Adds a sidebar Q&A tab to DSH-better-sidebar, enabling inline questions similar to Codex or Claude Code's /btw.
description.zh: 一个基于DSH-better-sidebar的侧边栏提问tab，实现类codex的侧边提问或claude code的/btw功能

description.en: Free multi-engine web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness with automatic fallback.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的免费多引擎网页搜索插件，支持 Tavily、Firecrawl、Exa、Jina、Brave 自动降级切换。

description.en: Desktop pet that visualizes DSH task progress with sticker animations and real-time status bubbles.
description.zh: 桌面宠物用贴纸动画和实时状态气泡显示 DSH 任务进度。

description.en: Framework giving AI agents QA skills for full lifecycle testing, with methodology, 10 skills, and benchmark.
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供全生命周期测试的 QA 技能框架，包含方法论、10 个 Skills 和可复现 Benchmark。

description.en: SillyTavern preset mode, macro engine and editor for DeepSeek Harness
An interactive desktop pet embedded in DeepSeek Harness web UI that reacts to tasks, context, and sessions.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness网页界面中嵌入一只互动桌面宠物，会随任务、上下文和会话状态做出反应。

description.en: Pure frontend DOM plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web chat UI that auto-collapses tool cards and Think blocks into one-line summaries, keeping only model's final text.
Adds a visual Grok-powered web search to DeepSeek Harness with automatic fallback to Tavily, Exa, TinyFish and Firecrawl.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入可视化 Grok 主搜索，并在失败时自动回退到 Tavily、Exa、TinyFish 和 Firecrawl。

description.en: Unified MCP server and extension giving AI coding agents multi-engine web search, X/Twitter lookup and evidence synthesis.
description.zh: 统一 MCP 服务器与扩展，为 AI 编程代理提供多引擎网页搜索、X/Twitter 查询与证据综合。

description.en: Displays provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 底部信息栏插件，单行显示提供商/模型、实时余额、峰谷定价倒计时和每会话实际花费。

description.en: Pink-and-white frosted-glass Cyrene theme for the DSH Web GUI, with editable agent persona, reaction stickers and rotating full-page backgrounds.
description.zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》昔涟主题：粉白毛玻璃皮肤，支持侧边栏改人格、表情包回复与整页背景轮换。

description.en: Unified manager for DSH MCP servers and skills, offering per-tool toggles, secret masking, and a skill recycle bin.
description.zh: 一站式管理 DSH 的 MCP 服务与 Skills，提供工具级开关、密钥打码与技能回收站。

description.en: Engineering-discipline bundle that double-checks requirements, implementation, and delivery before shipping.
description.zh: Double-check before you ship: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery. An engineering-discipline bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: SSH ops plugin for DeepSeek Harness: drive servers from chat with live terminal, SFTP, port forwarding, and database management.
description.zh: 在对话中驱动SSH运维：右侧实时终端、SFTP传输、端口转发与数据库管理，并对高危命令做保护。

description.en: Desktop pet and floating widget for DeepSeek Harness Desktop that visualizes live runtime status, context, and token usage via playful animations and panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的悬浮桌面宠物与 Token 用量可视化工具，以动画和面板展示运行状态与上下文占用。

description.en: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN/international) models to DeepSeek Harness via PATs, with a multi-account pool, daily check-in, failover, and read-only credits.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 将 Qoder（Lingma 国内/国际）模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供多账号池、每日签到、自动故障转移与只读额度概览。

description.en: Renders interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps inline in assistant replies, sending actions back to the model.
description.zh: 在助手回复中内联渲染交互式图表、表单、计算器、仪表盘和小应用，并将操作反馈给模型。

description.en: Personal usage profile for the DSH Web UI showing tokens, peak days, streaks, an activity heatmap and per-provider billing split from local session logs.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供个人用量档案页，基于本地会话日志展示令牌数、高峰日、连续使用天数、活动热力图和按提供商的计费拆分。

description.en: A multitask shock-absorber preset for DSH where the main chat only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes, while file reads, commands, search and builds run in subagent contexts.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的多任务减震器预设：主对话只负责规划、派发子代理与汇总结果，文件读取、命令执行、搜索和构建都在子代理上下文中运行。

description.en: A conversation efficiency plugin for DeepSeek Harness featuring timeline navigation, favorites, export, prompt library, and notes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话效率插件，提供时间轴导航、收藏文件夹、对话导出、提示词库和闪记功能。

description.en: UI skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with Denia theme: light/dark, sidebar art, glass cards, bubble particles, chain borders.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的鸣潮达妮娅主题皮肤，含亮暗双形态、侧边立绘、可改玻璃卡片、浮动泡泡粒子和锁链边框。

description.en: Android app plus DSH plugin that exposes the localhost-only dsh web to the LAN with a QR code and optional password.
description.zh: Android App 加 DSH 插件，把仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 通过二维码和可选密码暴露到局域网。

description.en: Adds branch-based message editing, regeneration, and retry with a version timeline for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于分支的消息编辑、重新生成和重试，并带有版本时间线。

description.en: DSH plugin that recalls/withdraws messages and restores the state at the time the message was sent.
description.zh: DSH 消息撤回插件，撤回已发送的消息并恢复到发送该消息时的状态

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats to DeepSeek Harness for bidirectional text/media/file exchange and slash-command management.
description.zh: 将微信私聊消息桥接到DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频双向传输，并提供斜杠命令管理。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness interface and hot-swaps plugin code in place without restarting, preserving active turns and drafts.
description.zh: 无需重启即可重建 DeepSeek Harness 界面并原地热替换插件代码，保留运行中的回合、排队消息和草稿。

description.en: DSH plugin exposing MinerU document parsing tools to convert PDFs, images, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX into Markdown/JSON.
description.zh: DSH 插件，向模型暴露 MinerU 文档解析工具，可将 PDF、图片、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 转换为 Markdown 或 JSON。

description.en: Workspace file explorer plugin with a right-side directory tree panel for clicking/dragging file references into the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧目录树面板，可点击或拖拽文件引用到输入框，界面沿用 DSH 原生风格。

description.en: Deterministic data profiling, cleaning, and verification for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性的数据剖析、清洗与校验功能。

description.en: Plays a custom video splash animation when DSH starts, then fades out 0.3s to reveal the interface; a default video is bundled.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动时播放自定义开屏视频动画，播完 0.3 秒渐隐露出界面，并内置默认视频可直接使用。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin with per-game toggles and schedules that auto-run daily tasks for Genshin, Honkai 3rd and Star Rail, then reports results.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端插件，按游戏开关与排班自动执行原神、崩坏3、星穹铁道的日常任务并汇报结果。

description.en: Provides a Git Bash shell for Windows DSH agents, replacing the default pwsh executor.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上所有模式的 DSH 代理提供 Git Bash shell，替代默认的 pwsh 执行器。

description.en: Security gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling safe remote/mobile access via Tailscale/LAN with QR auth, RSA encryption, and brute-force defense.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端安全网关插件，不改动 DSH 底层代码即可安全开放局域网和 Tailscale 连接，提供扫码认证、RSA 加密与暴力破解防护。

description.en: Forces DeepSeek Harness reasoning to Simplified Chinese via system prompt injection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 默认的思考语言为英文，这不利于中文使用者阅读推理过程与复核结论。本插件通过在每次请求的 system prompt 中注入一条精简的强制语言指令，使: 思考过程强制简体中文，无论用户用什么语言提问。

description.en: Enables rewinding conversations and file changes to any point without git, using a Rust core.
description.zh: 把对话及其修改过的文件一起回退到某一轮之前，支持重做，无需 git 仓库，基于 Rust 核心实现，占用磁盘少。

description.en: Enhances dsh-im by giving every AI agent a home, showing which workspace has agents online, and enabling drag-and-drop relocation.
description.zh: 通过助理和家的概念增强 dsh-im，一览各工作区助理状态并支持拖拽搬家。

description.en: Side panel that scans the whole project folder's Markdown, images and videos and ranks them by relevance to your current conversation, fully offline.
description.zh: 在对话旁添加面板，扫描整个项目文件夹的 Markdown、图片与视频，并按当前对话内容相关性排序，全程离线。

description.en: Provides per-round cache-hit/miss/output cost readouts with peak/off-peak pricing for DeepSeek Harness requests.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 请求提供每轮缓存命中、未命中与输出的费用读数，并支持峰谷自动计价。

description.en: Academic writing guard that detects AI-style writing, revision residue, and defensive writing in manuscripts with humanize guidance.
description.zh: DSH 论文写作守卫：检测文稿中的 AI 文风、修改残留与防御性写作，提供人化改写指导，并在写入论文文件时通过 writing_audit 与 writing_rules 自动审查。

description.en: A hand-drawn pixel whale companion for the DSH web UI that animates and reacts to interactions.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 会话标题栏常驻手绘像素鲸鱼，会眨眼摆尾，思考运行时持续动，回合完成喷水，点击冒爱心，空闲时睡觉。

description.en: Conversation node navigation bar: right-edge dots per user message, hover preview, click to jump, auto-hide.
description.zh: 在对话区右缘为每条 user 消息生成节点串，支持悬停预览、点击跳转到该消息，并可自动隐藏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话删除插件：真正删除磁盘日志，支持回收站还原与批量清理。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话删除插件：在设置页管理归档会话，真正删除磁盘日志并支持回收站还原和批量清理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness session workbench: full-text search, recall and conversation-view tab management (show/hide/reorder).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话工作台：全文搜索与召回会话库，支持会话视图标签显示/隐藏与重排。

description.en: Toolbox panel for DeepSeek Harness Web: MCP manager (tools & JSON Schema, market, import, workspace copy) and skills manager (scopes & shadowing, enable/disable, model auto-invocation, skillhub.cn mar
Personal workbench with calendar, task list, and AI assistant for task management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供日历与任务列表，并用 AI 对任务进行澄清、拆解、执行和复盘。

description.en: Manage local coding-agent skills: scan sources, one-click copy into DSH, install from 6600+ marketplace, and control model visibility.
description.zh: 管理本地编码代理技能：扫描来源、一键复制到 DSH、从 6600+ 技能市场安装并控制模型可见性。

description.en: Drive Origin scientific plotting from DeepSeek Harness AI chat via MCP.
description.zh: DSH Origin Plugin: drive Origin scientific plotting from DeepSeek Harness AI chat via MCP. Write data, plot line/scatter/column, export PNG/SVG DeepSeek Harness  Origin

description.en: EVA dual-character theme for DSH: dark Asuka and light Rei skins covering the interface, input bar, menus, settings and theme components.
description.zh: DSH 的 EVA 双角色主题插件：暗色明日香与亮色绫波丽皮肤，覆盖界面、输入栏、菜单、设置与主题组件。

description.en: Drive the DSH desktop agent from your phone in QQ via Tencent's official bot platform — QR-code binding, no public IP or reverse proxy.
description.zh: 通过腾讯官方 QQ 机器人平台，在手机上远程驱动本机 DSH 智能体，扫码绑定，无需公网 IP 或反向代理。

description.en: A sticky-note plugin for capturing ideas, feelings, and TODOs with Markdown preview, auto-save, and archival.
description.zh: DSH 便签插件：记录点子、感想和 TODO，支持 Markdown 预览、快捷键、自动保存与历史归档，存储路径可配置。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization workflow for books, papers, videos, and web content, with MapReduce deep-read and JSON Schema output, Obsidian-ready.
description.zh: 面向书籍、论文、视频和网页的深度阅读与摘要工作流，通过插件解析器、MapReduce 深度阅读和 JSON Schema 输出，可直接用于 Obsidian。

description.en: A Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) movie-inspired glassmorphism theme for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供电影《你的名字。》风格的玻璃拟态主题。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness with QR auth, multi-mode agents, card commands, zero-loss outbox, media support, and session logs.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 高可靠桥接插件，支持扫码一键授权、多模式智能体、卡片式命令、零丢失发件箱、媒体收发、会话日志诊断，并复用 DSH 网页界面。

description.en: Model configuration plugin adding a page for custom endpoints and per-model capability settings in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加模型配置页面，可自定义端点并设置各模型的能力参数。

description.en: Provides model-facing tools to create, read, and update Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) with safe workspace paths and PPT image embedding.
description.zh: 为模型提供创建、读取和更新 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文档的工具，限定工作区安全路径，并支持 PPT 嵌入图片。

description.en: Session-level superagent that polls a GitHub repo for issue/PR changes, wakes the DSH session and pushes work forward per AGENTS.md.
description.zh: 会话级 superagent：轮询 GitHub 仓库的 issue/PR，有变化即唤醒 DSH 会话，并按 AGENTS.md 主动推进工作。

description.en: Multi-agent mathematics problem-solving and validation framework with two architectures for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多代理数学问题求解与验证框架，提供两种架构。

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails plugin that blocks writing without approved outlines, locks settings, and runs zero-token de-AI scans with 20 novel_* tools.
description.zh: 长篇写作守门插件：细纲不批准不给写章、设定改值直接拒绝、零 token 六维去 AI 味扫描，附 20 个 novel_* 工具。

description.en: A cross-session event-aware galgame engine and UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness with multiple AI model characters.
description.zh: 面向DeepSeek Harness的跨会话事件感知Galgame引擎与界面插件，支持鲸鱼娘等多位模型娘角色

description.en: Launch and use Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, PI, OMP and OpenCode agent CLIs directly inside DeepSeek Harness from a menu beside the input box.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过输入框旁的菜单直接启动并使用 Claude Code、Codex、Kimi、PI、OMP、OpenCode 等 Agent CLI。

description.en: Email plugin for DeepSeek Harness with send/read/search, folder and attachment management, multi-account, and web config.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 邮件插件，提供邮件收发、读取、搜索、文件夹与附件管理，支持多账号和 Web 设置页配置。

description.en: Adds conversation naming, file drag-and-drop references, edit-and-resend of the last prompt, a message timeline, and a draggable floating ball with chat width control to the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加新建对话命名、文件拖拽引用、编辑重发上一条提示词、消息时间线，以及可拖拽悬浮球与对话宽度控制。

description.en: VS Code-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness with Monaco editor, Git, SSH and PTY terminal, plus a docked session panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 VS Code 风格 IDE 模式：Monaco 编辑器、Git、SSH 与 PTY 终端，官方会话停靠右侧。

description.en: Generates shareable PNG images or Markdown from selected DSH conversation Q&As, with layout options.
description.zh: 将选定的 DSH 对话问答导出为可分享的 PNG 图片或 Markdown，并支持布局选项。

description.en: Lets a text-only agent watch a video with you segment by segment, delivering spoken lines and subtitles at the right second.
description.zh: 让只会读文字的模型跟着你的真实播放进度一段段看视频，按秒对齐台词与字幕。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH conversations instead of archiving them, view the full family tree of spawned subagents and derived chats, and delete in bulk.
description.zh: 真正删除 DSH 会话而非归档，查看会话派生的子智能体与派生对话家族树，并支持批量删除。

description.en: Retires stale desktop startup cookies and reserves a larger request-header budget so DSH welcome handshakes stop failing with 431.
description.zh: 清理过期的桌面启动 cookie 并预留更大的请求头预算，避免 DSH 欢迎握手因 431 永久失败。

description.en: Hash-anchored read, edit, batch edit, and undo tools for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Hash-anchored read/edit/batch_edit/undo_last_edit tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh port of pi-hashline-edit-lsz

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu/Lark chat, including project workspace management.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 桥接进飞书/Lark 的机器人，并支持完整的项目工作区管理。

description.en: A fully local, free AI short-video/animation canvas studio built on DeepSeek Harness that generates images and videos via local ComfyUI.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地免费 AI 短视频与动画画布工作台，通过本地 ComfyUI 生成图像和视频。

description.en: Multi-provider web search & fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness with fallback and settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多提供商网页搜索与抓取，支持 Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl、Brave、You.com、Jina 和 SearXNG，带故障回退和原生设置界面。

description.en: A sci-fi reasoning-effort slider for DSH with an Ultra tier, lightning orchestration mode, and sub-agent tok/s readouts.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的科幻风推理等级滑条，含 Ultra 档、闪电编排模式和子代理 tok/s 读数。

description.en: Injects a markdown persona card into DeepSeek Harness system prompt with live reload.
description.zh: 把 markdown 人设卡加载进 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词，并支持热重载。

description.en: UltraMath is a multi-agent DSH plugin for mathematical modeling competitions, offering 5 role presets and 33 model library skills.
description.zh: UltraMath 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解插件，提供 5 个角色预设和 33 篇模型库技能，以 SKILL.md 为主入口。

description.en: A DSH UI skin loader that installs 13 skins (2 built-in samples + 11 migrated) for one-click theme switching and full restore in settings.
description.zh: DSH UI 皮肤加载器，内置 13 款皮肤（2 款示例 + 11 款公约化迁移），可在设置中一键换肤并随时彻底还原。

description.en: CAD plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 2D/3D viewer and parametric modeling using OCCT kernel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 OCCT 内核的二维/三维查看器与参数化建模功能的 CAD 插件。

description.en: Agent mode for DeepSeek Harness: sizes up tasks, gates long ones with approval, backgrounds long commands, and runs them via WSL/PowerShell/Zsh/Bash.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Deep PTC 模式：按任务规模制定计划，仅长任务需审批，长命令转入后台，可选 WSL/PowerShell/Zsh/Bash 执行。

description.en: Provides LSP-based tools for diagnostics, formatting, and code completion via language servers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LSP 工具，通过语言服务器实现 lsp_diagnostics 诊断、lsp_format 格式化和 lsp_completion 代码补全。

description.en: Persistent memory plugin for DSH that summarizes sessions, captures lessons, and provides a web GUI for managing project/global memory.
description.zh: DSH 项目持久化记忆插件，归纳会话并沉淀经验教训写入 PROJECT_MEMORY.md 与全局索引，每轮结束提醒蒸馏、自动注入未来 AGENTS，并提供可检索、手动增删的 Web GUI 记忆面板。

description.en: Uses Claude Code CLI as a dsh LLM provider with live model lists, session resume, approval relay, images, and memory/rewind panels.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的 LLM 提供方，支持实时模型列表、会话续接、审批转发、图片和记忆/回退面板。

description.en: Manage archived DSH sessions: view, restore, or permanently delete, with workspace tags and batch multi-select.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 已归档会话，可查看、恢复或彻底删除，并支持工作区标签、会话日期显示与批量多选。

description.en: A Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with visual effects and easter eggs.
description.zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — CRT scanlines, Kiroshi lock-on, typewriter SFX, Relic glitch & easter eggs

description.en: K12 exam question bank skill for AI agents: free retrieval, practice, and AI-generated quizzes from millions of real questions.
description.zh: 面向AI Agent的K12真题题库技能，支持免费注册与抽题、按教材章节知识点检索、练习测验及AI智能组卷。

description.en: Skin center plugin that loads and renders built-in and on-demand DSH Web GUI skins from pure asset directories.
description.zh: 皮肤中心插件，从纯资源目录加载并渲染 DSH Web GUI 内置及按需安装的皮肤。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-detects and interrupts degenerate reasoning loops where the model keeps thinking without acting.
description.zh: DSH 插件：自动检测并打断模型「只想不做」的推理退化死循环，无需手动中止。

description.en: A Claude Code Desktop-style theme plugin that restyles the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app with Claude colors and dark mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端换上 Claude Code Desktop 风格的界面主题插件。

description.en: Headless DSH host plugin letting a phone remotely control sessions and workspaces via relay tunnel, LAN pairing and a restricted mobile API.
description.zh: 无头 DSH 宿主插件，手机可通过中继隧道、局域网配对与受限移动 API 远程操控会话和工作区。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI that rewrites composer drafts into structured prompts with preview and undo.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness Web GUI的一键提示词增强插件，将草稿重写为结构化提示词，支持预览、回填和撤销。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness coding plugin that cuts response time 48% and tokens 45% while boosting SWE-bench Pro accuracy by 10%.
description.zh: 一款 DeepSeek Harness 编码插件，响应耗时减少 48%、token 减少 45%，SWE-bench Pro 正确率提升 10%。

description.en: Turns organized memory archives into an interactive star map where you click stars to read originals, plus a read tool for AI lookup.
description.zh: 星汐把整理好的记忆档案铺成一张可交互星图，点星看原文，并给 AI 提供检索原文的 xingxi read 工具。

description.en: DSH Web UI 右侧小游戏面板，包含 18 款离线小游戏，可扩展游戏注册表，等待模型回复时摸鱼。
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 右侧提供小游戏面板，内置 18 款离线小游戏，如恐龙跳一跳、俄罗斯方块、坦克大战、扫雷、2048、数独等，并支持扩展游戏注册表。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness token usage/cache hits, billing queries, and exports stats to CSV/JSON/PNG.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 每次调用的 token 用量与缓存命中，支持峰谷计费、余额查询，并导出 CSV、JSON、PNG。

description.en: MCP 服务器管理插件：可视化界面管理，按需 tool search 热注入，节省 token。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 服务器的可视化管理界面，并按需通过 tool search 热注入工具以节省 token。

description.en: Automatically pauses long-running tasks during configurable time windows and resumes them after, saving money.
description.zh: 为 DSH 定义暂停与恢复时间窗口，到点自动暂停正在运行的长任务，窗口结束后再恢复运行，从而节省开销。

description.en: Firefly-themed UI skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with dynamic wallpapers, particles, and music.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供萤火虫主题界面皮肤，包含动态壁纸、粒子效果和音乐。

description.en: Interactive K-line analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness supporting HK, US, A-shares, indicators, support/resistance, news, and fundamentals.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式 K 线分析插件，支持港股、美股、A 股行情，技术指标、支撑压力位、新闻与基本面分析，并在原生侧栏展示。

description.en: Chinese UI enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness that localizes text, expands statistics display, and adjusts chat width.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面做中文本地化，扩展统计信息显示并调整聊天窗口宽度。

description.en: Generates complete presentations (HTML slideshow + PPTX export) from a single prompt for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 技能插件：一句话生成完整演示文稿（HTML 放映 + PPTX 导出 + manifest），5 套视觉主题，中英双语，零运行时依赖。· One prompt to a full presentation for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Registers Remotion skills for programmatic video creation with React in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 Remotion 官方移植技能，用 React 以编程方式制作视频，含 38 个规则文件，安装即可使用。

description.en: Voice input plugin that transcribes speech to text in a composer using Web Speech or optional ASR, with LLM polishing.
description.zh: DSH voice input plugin: tap Alt to talk, get text in composer. Web Speech default (zero config), optional OpenAI-compatible ASR, polish via DSH LLM.

description.en: Adds explicit Claude provider type to DeepSeek Harness, sending model-appropriate reasoning parameters.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加显式的 Claude 提供方类型，并按模型发送相应的推理参数。

description.en: Weaves requirement sessions, multi-agent teams, member tasks, and dependency DAGs into a single interactive timeline for visualizing agent collaboration.
description.zh: 将需求会话、多智能体团队、成员任务与依赖 DAG 编织成一张可交互时间轴，让智能体协作可视化。

description.en: DSH video creation plugin that registers HyperFrames skills for HTML/URL-to-video, CLI, and GSAP.
description.zh: 注册 HyperFrames by HeyGen 移植的五项技能，支持用 HTML 写视频、网址转视频、CLI 与 GSAP，安装即用。

description.en: Plugin marketplace that live-syncs GitHub dsh-plugin topic into a searchable, installable settings tab.
description.zh: Plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness — live-syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic (1800+ repos) into a searchable, paginated settings tab with one-click install and agent tools (market_search / market_

description.en: Integrates the Qianxing Sandbox knowledge base into DeepSeek Harness for direct Q&A and document retrieval.
description.zh: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持直接问答和文档检索。

description.en: Adds process-discipline guidance to the system prompt and deterministic progress nudges for silent tool steps.
description.zh: 为系统提示加入流程纪律指导，并为静默工具步骤提供确定性进度提醒。

description.en: Adds desktop notifications for approvals, questions, and turn completion in DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加桌面通知，在审批请求、提问和回合完成时提醒用户。

description.en: Persistent project memory for dsh agents: indexes docs and code symbols with auto-refresh and source citations.
description.zh: Read-time project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)

description.en: Adds a CHAT/HARNESS toggle to DSH desktop, embedding the real DeepSeek Chat website beside the native workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版提供 CHAT/HARNESS 一键切换，在原生工作区旁嵌入真实的 DeepSeek 官网聊天。

description.en: Millisecond System-1 risk classification and evidence-gated auto-approval for every tool call in DeepSeek Harness, fail-closed by design.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每次工具调用提供毫秒级 System-1 风险分类与证据门控自动批准，构造上失败即拒绝。

description.en: Marketplace plugin for discovering, installing, managing and updating DeepSeek Harness plugins via sidebar panel, agent tools and CLI.
description.zh: DSH 插件市场：通过侧栏面板、Agent 工具与 CLI 统一完成插件发现、安装、管理与更新。

description.en: A tamagotchi-style pig pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness and the desktop that grows, learns, works, fishes, collects and supports custom skins.
description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里、也能独立在桌面运行的养成小猪：会长大、上学、打工、钓鱼、收集图鉴并支持自定义皮肤。

description.en: Notifies users with sound and system notifications for dsh session events like completion, errors, questions, and permission requests.
description.zh: 通过声音和系统通知提醒用户dsh会话事件，如完成、错误、提问和权限请求。

description.en: DSH UI skin plugin that registers the qq2006 theme and mirrors body[data-ds-skin] with full assets.
description.zh: DSH 的 QQ2006 皮肤插件，注册 qq2006 主题，镜像 body[data-ds-skin]，提供全局皮肤表与完整素材。

description.en: HTTP + WebSocket reverse proxy that forwards LAN ports to a local DSH service with Basic Auth.
description.zh: HTTP 与 WebSocket 反向代理，把局域网端口转发到本地 DSH 服务，并支持 Basic Auth 认证

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an Optimize button to chat input to analyze and rewrite prompts using the current session model.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness聊天输入框添加优化按钮，用当前会话模型分析并重写提示词。

description.en: Migrate Claude Code sessions, memory, skills, and CLAUDE.md into DSH for seamless resume.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 的会话、记忆、技能和 CLAUDE.md 迁移到 DSH，支持无缝恢复，提供 claude_scan、import_claude、resume-claude 命令和网页面板。

description.en: AI plugin providing embedded C/C++ firmware skills and engineering discipline for coding agents.
description.zh: 为嵌入式 C/C++ 固件开发提供 FreeRTOS、Keil、HardFault、状态机等技能，并用 1% 规则与计划验证门约束编码代理。

description.en: Synchronizes DeepSeek Harness sessions across devices using a git mirror with conflict-safe merging.
description.zh: Cross-device DeepSeek Harness session sync: a dedicated git mirror with append-only keep-both conflict resolution (fork files, never silently overwritten), /sync command and sync_* tools

description.en: Offline Chinese-first UI/UX design intelligence library offering design recommendations, reviews, and search.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的离线中文优先 UI/UX 设计智能库，内置 67 种设计风格、161 个调色板、57 组字体搭配、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表类型和 22 个技术栈，并提供 design_recommend、design_review、design_search 模型工具。

description.en: GitHub-style usage heatmap and token/cache/balance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness with workspace alias management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 风格用量热力图、Token 与缓存命中及账户余额看板，并支持工作区别名管理。

description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for DeepSeek Harness: streaming ASR to editable drafts, wake word, Edge TTS with subtitles, barge-in, no API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全双工语音对话：zipformer2 流式识别写入可编辑草稿，支持唤醒词、Edge TTS 按句朗读与实时字幕，开口即打断，无需 API Key。

description.en: A DeepSeek harness plugin that synchronizes static wallpapers like a wallpaper engine.
description.zh: 挂载在 DeepSeek harness 上的壁纸同步插件，可像 Wallpaper Engine 那样同步静态壁纸。

description.en: Multi-agent collaborative novel writing mode with a director and 5 specialized sub-agents for planning, writing, and review.
description.zh: 多代理协作小说创作模式：一名队长统筹，5个专职子代理分别负责世界观架构、剧情策划、人物管理、执笔写作与质检复核。

description.en: Ports Claude Code's Academic Research Skills (ARS) to DSH, adding deep research, paper writing, peer review, and pipeline skills.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 的学术研究技能移植到 DSH，提供深度研究、论文写作、同行评审和流水线技能。

description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness web UI fonts with Anthropic fonts, including Chinese fallbacks; fonts not bundled.
description.zh: 用 Anthropic 字体替换 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面字体，并包含中文回退字体，字体本身不随插件打包。

description.en: Skill documentation and integration files for the fnOS CLI, installed via npm and run from the command line.
description.zh: 通过 npm 安装的 fnOS CLI 技能文档与集成文件，用于命令行操作。

description.en: Adds a day/night clock to a roleplay character: sleep/wake, greetings, idle actions, proactive small talk, and outing photos.
description.zh: 为角色扮演角色添加昼夜时钟：睡眠/醒来、问候、闲置动作、主动搭话和外出照片。

description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness reason and respond in Simplified Chinese by default.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 默认使用简体中文进行推理并作答。

description.en: Manages MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth/static-token auth and registers their tools.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置 MCP 页面管理 MCP 服务器，支持 OAuth（PKCE 与动态客户端注册）或静态令牌认证，并将工具注册为 mcp__<名称>__ 前缀。

description.en: Edits sent messages in chat, branching the conversation from that point with version counter and tree view.
description.zh: Edit a sent message and branch the conversation from that point — version counter under the bubble, plus a tree view. Placement presets modelled on ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek.

description.en: Customizes DeepSeek Harness appearance with theme colors, background images, opacity/blur, and glass effect.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定制外观：主题配色、背景图片、透明度与模糊、玻璃拟态效果。

description.en: A whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with neural voice and task reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘桌宠，提供 DSH 桌面与 Web 悬浮两种形态，含晓伊神经网络语音、撒娇互动和任务完成提醒。

description.en: Optimizes user raw instructions into structured, professional prompts via harness LLM service.
description.zh: 调用 harness LLM 服务，把用户的原始指令改写为结构化、专业的提示词

description.en: A plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness, automatically collecting and categorizing community plugins via GitHub Actions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件市场，通过 GitHub Actions 自动收集并分类社区插件。

description.en: DSH web extension that adds a real-time subagent monitoring panel to the interface.
description.zh: DSH 网页扩展，在界面中添加实时子代理监控面板，可实时查看子代理运行状态。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech plugin that reads assistant replies aloud, featuring a draggable mascot and one-click installer.
description.zh: 本地 GPT-SoVITS 语音插件，可朗读助手回复，配有可拖拽吉祥物和一键安装器。

description.en: Local music panel for DeepSeek Harness: scan a folder, browse tracks with covers and tags, and play them in a sidebar player with playlists and synced lyrics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地音乐面板：扫描文件夹、浏览带封面和标签的曲目，并在侧边栏播放器中播放，支持播放列表与同步歌词。

description.en: Novel writing assistant plugin with chapter library, sentence analysis, style check, plot tracking, batch import, and AI continuation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 小说写作助手插件，提供章节库管理、九类句式与情感曲线分析、风格自检、伏笔登记、批量导入和续写辅助。

description.en: Provides 98 DeepSeek Harness themes using Chinese traditional colors, with light/dark variants and WCAG AA contrast compliance.
description.zh: 提供98款以中国传统色为主题的 DeepSeek Harness 主题包，含明暗两种变体，并符合 WCAG AA 对比度标准。

description.en: Visual management plugin for MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness, enabling CRUD, enable/disable, and real-time connection status.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置中可视化管理 MCP 服务器，支持查看、增删、启用停用并实时显示连接状态。

description.en: Generates stable, editable PowerPoint files for AI agents from semantic IR to native DrawingML.
description.zh: Stable, editable PPTX generation for AI agents — semantic IR in, native DrawingML out. DSH plugin + Claude Code plugin + CLI. | 给 AI agent 的稳定可编辑 PPTX 生成：语义 IR 进，原生 DrawingML 出。DSH 插件 / Claude Code 插件

description.en: Embeds MuseAI's roleplay interface (chat, adventure, character cards) into DeepSeek Harness with no extra API config.
description.zh: 把MuseAI的角色扮演界面（聊天、冒险、角色卡）嵌入DeepSeek Harness，无需额外API配置。

description.en: Read-only plugin ledger: inventories capabilities, reconciles declarations, tracks version drift and changes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a read-only ledger for the plugins you already have installed — a capability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, cross-profile versio

description.en: A draggable DeepSeek Harness Web pet that animates while your agent works, with replaceable character packs and a pet-maker Skill.
description.zh: 装在 DeepSeek Harness Web 里的可拖动宠物，随 Agent 工作节奏动画陪伴，支持替换角色包与制作角色。

description.en: Provides prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak defense for DeepSeek Harness using Aho-Corasick detection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供提示注入、越狱和密钥泄露防御，使用 Aho-Corasick 检测，支持允许、询问、阻止三种拦截方式并生成脱敏审计事件。

description.en: Local music-analysis plugin that breaks audio into energy, tempo, key and density so text LLMs can answer questions about songs without uploading audio.
description.zh: 本地音乐分析插件，把音频拆成能量、速度、调性、密度，让文本大模型能回答音乐问题，音频不出本机。

description.en: Fully offline audio understanding plugin for DSH: whisper transcription plus rhythm, melody, chords and structure analysis with vocal separation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的完全离线音频理解插件：whisper 转写，以及节奏、旋律、和弦与结构分析，含人声分离。

description.en: Dsh web plugin displaying per-day token usage statistics with GitHub-style heatmap, cache hit-rate curve, and per-model breakdown.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，按天统计 token 使用量，含 GitHub 风格活动热力图、缓存命中率曲线和按模型分类明细。

description.en: Brings the WorkBuddy2API gateway into DSH's model selector with a native panel for account pools, models, thinking levels and kernel updates.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy2API 网关接入 DSH 模型选择器，配套原生面板管理账号池、模型目录、思考档位与内核更新。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a secure phone app with mobile UI, pairing-code gateway, PWA, and Web Push.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 改造为可公网安全访问的手机应用，包含精简移动端界面、配对码网关、PWA 与 Web Push 推送。

description.en: A pack of 25 AI coding skills for DSH covering TDD, code review, and agent-oriented writing.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 25 项改编自 mattpocock/skills 的技能，涵盖 TDD、代码审查、向代理提问与面向代理写作等。

description.en: A Harness start page with session search, daily top-three priorities, todos, quick notes and a focus timer with noise.
description.zh: Harness 起始页：会话搜索、今日三件重点、待办、快速记录与专注计时（含噪声与打卡）。

description.en: DSH local maintenance plugin that safely rewrites host defaults and AGENTS.md via pre-check, snapshot, atomic writes, conflict detection and rollback.
description.zh: DSH 本机维护插件，通过预检、快照、原子写入、冲突检测与回滚，安全改写宿主默认值与 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Two-phase agent preset that starts with minimal bash+read tools, then enables full Standard tools after first interaction.
description.zh: Two-phase DeepSeek Harness preset: Minimal-aligned bootstrap (bash+read), then full Standard tools after the first tool call or reply

description.en: A single-persona QQ/Bilibili/Douyin chatbot agent with per-person memory, daily rhythm, proactive messaging, voice and per-function model routing.
description.zh: 单角色 QQ/B站/抖音聊天机器人：按人记忆、虚拟作息、主动开口、语音收发，并按功能选用模型与统计花费。

description.en: Free vision and image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting paste-to-analyze with multi-engine failover and Kolors generation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免费读图与生图，支持在纯文本会话中粘贴图片分析，采用 GLM-4V-Flash、Qwen3-VL、Gemini 多引擎容错，并可用 Kolors 生成图片。

description.en: Pauses the agent before its next model request to allow human review and insertion, then resumes with Enter.
description.zh: 在 agent 发起下一次模型请求前暂停，供人工审核和插话，按回车放行。

description.en: Layered memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that distills chats into L0–L3 memories and auto-injects relevant context before each model step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层蒸馏记忆插件：后台把对话从 L0 捕获蒸馏至 L3 画像，并在模型每一步前自动召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: DSH provider plugin that connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, enabling text, image, streaming, reasoning, and tool calls.
description.zh: DSH提供者插件，将Qoder订阅接入DeepSeek Harness，支持文本、图像、流式输出、推理和工具调用。

description.en: Unified @ references in DSH to search workspace files, DSH sessions, and history from major AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok & Kimi.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供统一的 @ 引用，可搜索工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

description.en: A zero-dependency DSH UI enhancement that auto-expands the newest thinking box, folds old ones and finished tool calls, with spark effects.
description.zh: 零依赖的 DSH 界面增强：自动展开最新思考小窗，旧小窗与跑完的工具调用自动折起，并带火星特效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios: one-package install of a hook bridge, studio status line, and 76 skills, 49 agents, 13 rules for game dev.
description.zh: Claude Code Game Studios 的 DeepSeek Harness 移植版：一键安装钩子桥、工作室状态栏，以及 76 个技能、49 个代理和 13 条规则的游戏开发框架。

description.en: Codex-style computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 13-method desktop surface, Chromium automation, visible overlay with Esc interrupt, per-app approvals.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格电脑操作：13 种桌面方法、Chromium 自动化，带可见浮层、Esc 中断与按应用授权。

description.en: Provides six design aesthetics to improve vibe-coded websites with a non-AI look for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Design aesthetics skill pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) - keeps vibe-coded websites away from the AI look. 6 styles: dark-saas, apple-minimal, neo-neumorphism, brutalism, glassmorphism, japanese-minim

description.en: Adds an MCP Management page to the DeepSeek Harness settings sidebar for viewing, enabling, editing, restarting, deleting and adding MCP servers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置侧边栏新增 MCP 管理页面，可查看、启用/禁用、编辑、重启、删除和添加 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with four-channel retrieval fusion and memory evolution loop, based on MemGAS (ICLR 2026).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness长期记忆插件，四通道检索融合与记忆演化闭环，出自ICLR 2026论文MemGAS。

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider that integrates the TinyFish Search API into DeepSeek Harness's ctx.web.
description.zh: 将 TinyFish 搜索 API 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web，提供 Web 搜索服务。

description.en: Adds a sticker picker and agent tool for sharing blue/black whale stickers in DSH WebUI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 对话添加贴纸选择器和智能体工具，可发送蓝、黑色鲸鱼贴纸，供用户与智能体双向使用。

description.en: Layered token-optimization pipeline for DeepSeek Harness, saving 40-60% input tokens in long sessions via output laddering, MCP lazy loading, compaction, and cache reporting.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness设计的分层token优化管线，通过输出阶梯、MCP懒加载、压缩驱动和缓存报告，在长会话中节省40-60%输入。

description.en: Agent-led audio production toolkit for building sampled instruments, timeline arranging, sound effects, TTS, multitrack mixing and video muxing.
description.zh: 由智能体驱动的音频制作工具包，支持采样乐器、时间线编排、音效、语音合成、多轨混音与视频封装。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness appearance plugin that switches the background image automatically based on the currently active model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观插件，根据当前使用的模型自动切换背景图。

description.en: Cross-platform native desktop control: screenshot, screen reading, input simulation, and app launch with approval gating.
description.zh: Cross-platform native desktop control for DeepSeek Harness (Windows first): screen_shot, screen_read, click/type/scroll/key, app_list/app_launch - approval-gated, never stealing foreground focus

description.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that replaces the default diff block with a PiUI-style diff viewer for file write/edit operations.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI PiUI-style diff viewer plugin: replaces the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls via ui-tool diff-card chain slots (host patch included). Private.

description.en: Configure CJK/Latin fonts, body and code sizes, plus spacing sliders with a sticky live preview and confirm-to-save profile settings.
description.zh: 为中英文分别设置字体、正文与代码字号，并用滑块调节字距/行距/段距/首行缩进，吸底预览确认后写回 profile。

description.en: A lightweight white-and-blue Whale Musume skin for DeepSeek Harness with frosted-glass sidebar and a faded maid illustration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的白蓝轻量鲸鱼娘皮肤，侧栏毛玻璃效果并附带渐隐女仆立绘。

description.en: Zotero tools to search library, read metadata/fulltext, list attachments, download PDFs, and manage notes via local API.
description.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API 搜索文献库、读取元数据与全文、列出附件、下载 PDF 并管理笔记

description.en: Evaluates and observes AI prompts, RAG, agents, skills, and workflows with evidence-backed metrics.
description.zh: 对提示词、RAG、技能、智能体和工作流进行有证据支撑的评测与可观测性度量。

description.en: Search Zhihu, ask Zhida questions, and access official APIs via CLI, MCP, and skills.
description.zh: 通过 Skill、CLI 和 MCP 实现知乎搜索、知乎直答提问，以及调用知乎官方开放平台 API 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件

description.en: A shared kanban board for DeepSeek Harness where people and AI agents plan and track tasks together.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供人和 AI 智能体共用的看板，用于共同规划与跟踪任务。

description.en: A Touhou-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with shrine backgrounds, Reimu artwork, and paper-style UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供东方Project博丽灵梦主题皮肤，含神社昼夜实景背景、灵梦立绘、画框侧边栏与输入框及纸白透明界面。

description.en: Generates verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, and lifecycle diagrams from JSON specs, outputting standalone HTML.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 JSON 规格生成可验证的架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图与生命周期图（移植自 tt-a1i/archify）

description.en: Fetches any web page and returns clean main-content text/Markdown with charset detection and caching for AI agents.
description.zh: 抓取任意网页并返回干净正文或结构化 Markdown，自动识别 GBK/Big5/UTF-8 等编码，支持缓存与分段偏移，上限 6000 字符，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness with local/remote SQLite storage, RAG retrieval, and web admin.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可安装知识库插件，支持本地或远程 SQLite 存储、RAG 检索和 Web 管理界面。

description.en: Bridges MemOS memory service into the agent via MCP, enabling persistent memory tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 MemOS 记忆服务接入智能体，提供持久化记忆工具。

description.en: DSH Web official homepage theme adding fluid background, elastic grid, and two animated fish effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DSH 官方首页主题，为网页添加流体背景、弹性网格和两种动态鱼效果。

description.en: A typed, inference-capable ontology plugin for durable domain knowledge and schema-constrained queries.
description.zh: A typed, inference-capable ontology (TBox + ABox) plugin for DeepSeek Harness — durable domain knowledge the agent declares, asserts against, and queries under schema constraints.

description.en: Integrates a PackyCode API key into DeepSeek Harness with multi-protocol model routing, ordered API-key rotation, and balance display.
description.zh: 将 PackyCode API 密钥集成到 DeepSeek Harness，支持多协议模型路由、有序密钥轮换和余额显示。

description.en: Turns markdown/folders/GitHub repos into guided AI-tutor courses with skill trees and spaced repetition.
description.zh: dsh community plugin: turn any markdown/folder/GitHub learning repo into a guided AI-tutor course (gated skill tree, BKT mastery, SM-2 reviews) inside DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Adds a "start image generation mode" sidebar entry in DSH that plays a full-window transition, then opens PosterFlow.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏新增「开启生图模式」入口，播放铺满窗口的过场动画后跳转到 PosterFlow。

description.en: UX enhancement and quality-of-life plugins that make working with DeepSeek Harness easier and smoother.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 UX 增强与易用性改进的插件，让使用更顺手。

description.en: One-command tool that detects a project's tech stack and generates AI-agent-ready files: AGENTS.md, docs, CI/CD, and testing infrastructure.
description.zh: 一条命令检测项目技术栈（支持7种语言、14个框架、61个组件），自动生成 AGENTS.md、文档骨架、CI/CD 和测试基础设施，使项目可直接用于 AI 代理开发。

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning effort slider for DeepSeek Harness with a WebGL fire trail.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块，拖动时显示 WebGL 火焰拖尾效果。

description.en: Searches several community catalogs for DSH plugins and ranks results by relevance, trust and freshness rather than stars alone.
description.zh: 跨多个社区目录搜索 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度和新鲜度排序，而不只看 star 数。
