description.en: Native HarmonyOS device bridge via hdc for closed-loop debugging: screenshot, view, install, verify.
description.zh: 基于 hdc 的鸿蒙设备桥，帮 Agent 完成截图、看图、装包、验证的闭环调试

description.en: Imports sessions, chat history, and agents from pi, opencode, codex, and claude-code into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Import pi / opencode / codex / claude-code sessions, chat history, and agents into DeepSeek Harness — one-click Sync button, slash commands, session-start migration prompt

description.en: Merges 13 free model channels into DSH's official model selector and runs a channel gateway other local harnesses can reverse-proxy.
description.zh: 把 13 个免费渠道与免费模型并入官方模型选择器，并自带渠道网关供其它本地 harness 反代。

description.en: Scans host-wide MCP configs, auto-imports servers, and provides a live MCP market with six catalogs, GitHub census data, and install-command recovery.
description.zh: 扫描全主机 MCP 配置并自动导入，提供含六大目录、GitHub 普查和安装命令恢复的实时 MCP 市场。

description.en: Automated transparent ranking/recommendation for DSH plugins by scraping GitHub dsh-plugin topics and scoring them with a public model.
description.zh: 每日抓取 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题仓库，用公开评分模型为 DSH 插件生成排行与推荐，并输出静态站点。

description.en: Adds a one-click restart button for the DSH service in the general settings page.
description.zh: 在设置→通用设置页面最底部添加固定的一键重启 DSH 服务按钮。

description.en: Security-audit skill pack for DeepSeek Harness: agent skills for secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 安全审计技能包，提供密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链审查、提示注入审查和审计编排 5 个 agent 技能，无运行时代码。

description.en: A high-performance, streamlined plugin that bundles Antigravity capabilities into DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供高性能、精简的 Antigravity 能力打包插件。

description.en: Checks for npm updates of DeepSeek Harness, shows a locale-aware banner, and enables one-click install and restart.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 的 npm 最新版并在界面顶部横幅提示，中英文随系统语言，支持一键安装更新并重启服务。

description.en: dsh plugin that injects a system prompt forcing the agent's chain-of-thought, planning and tool reasoning to stay in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: dsh 插件：注入系统提示词，强制 Agent 的思维链、规划与工具推理全程使用简体中文。

description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a playful 'Empty Fort Strategy' mode, causing the AI to think and call tools many times but never answer, outputting only a newline.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，添加搞笑的「空城计」模式，让AI多轮思考和工具调用但不回答，只输出换行。

description.en: Adds session IDs to outgoing opencode HTTP requests for dsh, zero config.
description.zh: 为 dsh 发出的 opencode HTTP 请求添加会话 ID，无需配置。

description.en: Adds a pink Hello Kitty skin and task/reminder alerts to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加粉色 Hello Kitty 主题皮肤，并在任务完成或提问时发出提醒。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin for DSH: UI Automation, bundled local OCR, window binding, browser automation and visual grounding.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Windows 桌面自动化插件：UIA 控件操作、本地 OCR、窗口绑定、浏览器自动化与视觉定位。

description.en: Adds a pure-text chat agent preset that fully replaces the system prompt for in-character dialogue, keeping only web search and stickers.
description.zh: 新增「纯文本对话模式」agent 预设，整份替换系统提示词进行角色扮演对话，仅保留联网搜索与表情包。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to the DSH Web session menu, with a risk-consent dialog that removes the log, workspace accounting and live session state.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话菜单中添加删除操作，通过风险确认弹窗清除日志、工作区记账与实时会话状态。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop for local files/folders in DSH Web UI, inserting their absolute paths.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加跨平台拖拽本地文件或文件夹并插入其绝对路径的能力，无需复制文件。

description.en: Runtime patching library for DeepSeek Harness plugins, enabling replace/decorate during runtime.
description.zh: A library for patching, replacing and decorating dsh plugin during runtime

description.en: DSH plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill to create, edit, clone, and export PPT presentations with fully local export inside DSH.
description.zh: DSH 插件，内置 kimi-ppt 技能，可在 DSH 内创建、编辑、复刻并纯本地导出 PPT 演示文稿。

description.en: Tree-shaped knowledge bases for DeepSeek Harness with a hand-editable right-side canvas plus tools the model reads and writes, injectable in full or as an index.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供树状知识库：右侧画布可手动编辑，模型可通过工具读写，支持整库或索引注入。

description.en: DSH-native LLM verifier that uses a separate model to review and arbitrate agent execution results via configurable web settings.
description.zh: DSH 原生 LLM 校验器，用独立模型审查并仲裁智能体执行结果，可通过 Web 设置页配置。

description.en: Network proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness to route agent's web/fetch/API requests via HTTP/SOCKS5 with persistent config and settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网络代理，将智能体的网页、抓取和 API 请求经 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 转发，并支持持久化配置和设置页面。

description.en: Merges local WorkBuddy accounts into an auto-failover model pool and reverse-proxies them into the official DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 账号合并为自动故障转移的模型池，并反代接入 DeepSeek Harness 官方版。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek play Stardew Valley without a vision model via a SMAPI mod, MCP server and DSH plugin.
description.zh: 通过 SMAPI 模组、MCP 与 DSH 插件，让 DeepSeek 无需视觉模型即可游玩《星露谷物语》。

description.en: Personal Agent Skills, pi extensions, and DeepSeek Harness plugins
Provides native-style context menus for DeepSeek Harness desktop wrapper apps across sessions, workspaces, and chat UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面封装应用的会话、工作区和聊天界面提供原生风格右键上下文菜单

description.en: Adds a condensed 'focus chat' tab to the dsh web GUI, simplifying conversation reading into summary lines.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面新增聚焦会话标签页，将对话精简为摘要行，便于只阅读最终产出结果。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin that transcribes meeting audio into text locally on Apple Silicon Macs using on-device ASR.
description.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 Apple Silicon Mac 上本地使用端侧 ASR 将会议音频转写为文字。

description.en: Adds an animated particle-network background overlay to the DeepSeek Harness web UI with pointer-event passthrough.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加动态粒子网络背景叠加层，并支持指针事件穿透。

description.en: Renders interactive ECharts, Mermaid, Three.js, and sandboxed custom HTML inline in conversations.
description.zh: 在对话中内联渲染可交互的 ECharts、Mermaid、Three.js 图表以及沙箱化隔离的自定义 HTML。

description.en: A DSH web UI plugin that swaps the page background via a drawer with presets, colors, gradients, images and videos served locally, plus glassmorphism styling.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面换背景插件：侧栏壁纸按钮弹出右侧抽屉，支持预设、纯色、渐变、图片与视频，本地媒体伺服，毛玻璃质感。

description.en: Generate a playable visual novel (Galgame) webpage from a script and character/background/music assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的视觉小说生成器：在工作区提供剧本文档与立绘、CG、背景、音乐素材，即可生成可直接游玩的 Galgame 网页。

description.en: Lets you make new requests to DSH while it is still working, without interrupting the conversation.
description.zh: DSH工作时，无需中断对话即可再次提出请求。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns the main agent into a web-novel editor-in-chief, delegating outline, drafting, review, lore and research to five helpers over a novel/ file-based manuscript.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把主 agent 变成网文主编，将大纲、正文、审校、设定与考据分派给五个帮手，书稿以 novel/ 目录文件形式管理。

description.en: Provides lazy senior developer mode skills for DeepSeek Harness, adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供懒散资深开发者模式，包含 6 个改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail（MIT）的技能。

description.en: Search boost for DeepSeek Harness: multi-engine fused search, deep research, and X search tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提升模型搜索能力：多引擎融合搜索、深度研究与 X 搜索工具。

description.en: Tavern plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling character card roleplay, worldbook management, and memory tracking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供角色卡扮演、世界书管理、预设切换、记忆摘要与关系图谱的插件，含暗色主题。

description.en: Cinematic glass theme for DSH Desktop ported from Mineradio music player, with fluid backdrops and light-glass panels.
description.zh: 将 Mineradio 音乐播放器的香槟玻璃视觉移植为 DSH 桌面主题，提供流动或壁纸背景、玻璃面板、自定义旋钮和光标辉光效果。

description.en: Tracks every DeepSeek Harness model call, reporting token usage, cost (with peak/off-peak pricing), provider balance and quota, split by model, provider, project, source, account and date.
description.zh: 统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用，提供 Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型、供应商、项目、来源、账号和日期拆分。

description.en: DSH plugin for Windows disk analysis and safe cleanup, with visual scans, usage rankings, AI suggestions and dev-env migration.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 磁盘分析与安全清理插件，提供可视化扫描、占用排名、AI 清理建议与开发环境迁移。

description.en: Wraps CodeGraph CLI into model-visible tools for querying pre-indexed code knowledge graphs by symbol, region, and call chain.
description.zh: 将 CodeGraph CLI 封装为模型可调用工具，用于按符号、代码区域和调用链查询已预索引的代码知识图谱。

description.en: Fine-grained permission control plugin for DeepSeek Harness with custom approval gateway for tool calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供细粒度权限控制，通过自定义审批网关拦截并审批工具调用

description.en: Adds a session-cost chip to the input box showing per-message DeepSeek API costs, with hover details for pricing, daily usage, and balance.
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: Local image-generation workbench with canvas layout, retouching, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorizing and editable PSD/AI export plus PS/AI layer bridging.
description.zh: 本地生图工作台:自带 API 生图,支持画布排版、修图擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量,并可导出可编辑 PSD/AI 及图层级双向桥接。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供文件编码守护：让 AI 读写 GBK 等非 UTF-8 文件和带 BOM 的文件时不会弄坏编码
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文件编码守护，让 AI 读写 GBK 等非 UTF-8 及带 BOM 文件时不破坏编码。

description.en: Integrates GitHub CLI into DSH for PR, Issue, Actions CI diagnostics and code review, exposed via agent tools, slash commands and Web UI.
description.zh: 基于 GitHub CLI 为 DSH 提供 PR、Issue、Actions CI 诊断与代码审查工作流，支持 Agent 工具、Slash 指令与 Web UI。

description.en: Native DSH Hub marketplace plugin that brings a community plugin store into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 DSH Hub 社区插件市场，可浏览和安装社区插件。

description.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks as SVG diagrams in DeepSeek Harness Web with diagram/code switching, streaming, and dark mode.
description.zh: Render Mermaid code blocks as SVG diagrams in DeepSeek Harness Web, with diagram/code switching, streaming support, dark mode, strict security, and npm/GitHub installation.

description.en: Mnemosyne is a DSH memory infrastructure plugin plus Python node that stores, traces and evolves personal memories over time.
description.zh: Mnemosyne 是面向 DSH 的统一记忆基础设施插件，配合独立 Python 节点实现可追溯、可演化的长期记忆。

description.en: Rule mining for data risk control, distilled from the 100-Day Risk Control Expert course.
description.zh: Rule mining for data risk control, distilled from the ideas of the "100-Day Risk Control Expert" course

description.en: WeChat (iLink) channel plugin that lets you message the DSH Agent from WeChat and receive its replies, with text, images, files and voice notes.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）通道插件：在微信里给 DSH Agent 发消息，本机跑会话并把回复发回微信，支持文本、图片、文件和语音。

description.en: Red-team jailbreak patch for DeepSeek Harness that sandwiches prompts and patches the generation layer to bypass model guardrails for research.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的红队越狱补丁，通过首尾夹击提示与生成层熔断/源码补丁突破模型限制，仅供研究评测。

description.en: Connects SCNet models (SCNet Max) into DeepSeek Harness as a free model provider with SMS login and settings-page management.
description.zh: 把 SCNet 模型（SCNet Max）接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持短信免客户端登录，并在设置页管理账号与模型开关。

description.en: Plugin that enables your AI harness to produce spoken voice announcements.
description.zh: 让 AI harness 生成语音播报，把结果以声音通知形式播出的插件

description.en: Adds a voice-first session loop with speech-to-text and text-to-speech to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加语音对话循环：麦克风按钮支持浏览器或本地语音转文字（Web Speech、FunASR、whisper.cpp），speak 工具用浏览器、edge-tts 或 piper 朗读回复，支持事件播报静音和说话打断。

description.en: DSH web plugin that imports WorkBuddy experts via an expert marketplace and lets you switch the active expert in the session selector.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：通过专家市场导入 WorkBuddy 专家，并可在会话选择器中随时切换当前专家。

description.en: Adds a Japanese locale to the DSH Web UI, with 1,257 translated strings, Japanese system fonts, and persistent language selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加日语语言支持，包含 1,257 条界面翻译、日文系统字体，并记住语言选择。

description.en: Synchronizes dsh skills, sessions, settings, and plugin lists across machines via private GitCode repo with AI conflict resolution.
description.zh: 通过私有Git仓库在多台机器间同步dsh技能、会话、设置和插件清单，用AI解决冲突。

description.en: Organ-based agent plugin platform for DeepSeek Harness with 23 organs, reflex arcs, heartbeat, sleep-time memory consolidation and self-healing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的器官式智能体插件平台，含 23 个器官、反射弧、心跳、睡眠期记忆固化与闭环自愈。

description.en: An immersive 2.5D office game for DeepSeek Harness where you work, meet and chat with persistent AI agent teammates.
description.zh: 一款基于DeepSeek Harness的沉浸式2.5D办公室游戏，可与持久的AI agent员工一起工作、开会和交流。

description.en: Enables durable background child agents with interactive messaging and progress tracking in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Interactive long-session background agents for DeepSeek Harness: start a durable continuable child agent, watch its progress in the Web UI sidebar, message it any time, and interrupt it - all through

description.en: Real-time token cost tracker in the context-ring popup for step/turn/session totals, peak-valley pricing, cache-hit details, and third-party relays.
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时统计当前步/轮/整场会话的 token 花费，含峰谷计价、缓存命中明细与第三方中转计费。

description.en: Adds terminal-style input history, draft stashing, and Esc recovery to the DeepSeek Harness web composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框添加终端式历史记录：方向键优先从行首边缘浏览、草稿暂存与精确恢复、Esc 找回。

description.en: Customizes DeepSeek Harness Web UI with color schemes, ambient lighting, and background presets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 换装，提供配色方案、氛围光与背景图预设，支持中英双语。

description.en: PII masking middleware for anonymizing sensitive data before sending to model, restoring at display.
description.zh: PII masking middleware for DeepSeek Harness: anonymize names, phones, emails, ID cards, bank cards, keys, and addresses to placeholders before they reach the model, restore them at the display layer,

description.en: Brings a local file-based memory archive (diary, state, growth log, events) into DSH settings with overview, search, append, and guarded editing.
description.zh: 将本地文件记忆档案（日记、状态、生长记录、事件流）带入 DSH 设置面板，支持概览、搜索、追加和安全编辑。

description.en: Optimizes DeepSeek Harness web UI for mobile browsers, adapting layout for touch screens.
description.zh: 为 deepseek-harness 网页界面做手机端适配，调整布局适配触屏，修复部分页面在手机端不适配的问题。

description.en: Model selector for DeepSeek Harness that searches providers, benchmarks models with real streaming requests (TTFT/TPS), and links leaderboard rows to channel search.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器：跨提供商搜索模型，用真实流式请求测量首字延迟与生成速度，并可从排行榜跳转到同名渠道搜索。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns the input box into a structured prompt form, letting users or the model build and send structured prompts.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把输入框变成结构化提示词表单，让用户或模型构建并发送结构化提示词。

description.en: DSH WebUI plugin to centrally manage provider models and apply context, output, reasoning, and compatibility settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 集中管理各提供商模型条目，可将 pi-ai 预设或已配置提供商的上下文、输出上限、推理档位与兼容开关一键应用到目标提供商，并支持新建、编辑、复制和删除。

description.en: Turns a DSH plugin repo into a promo video and promo image using a local Remotion studio and host tools.
description.zh: 使用本地 Remotion 工作室和宿主工具，将 DSH 插件仓库生成宣传视频和宣传图片。

description.en: Adds a bouncing ball pet to DeepSeek Harness web UI that appears during thinking and can be played with.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加一个弹跳球宠物，思考时出现，可与之互动玩耍。

description.en: Discovers and manages local Agent Skills from AI coding tools, centralizing them in DeepSeek Harness settings.
description.zh: 发现并管理各 AI 编码工具中的本地 Agent Skills，将其集中收纳到 DeepSeek Harness 设置中。

description.en: Adds ASCII whales swimming through whitespace, plus native settings and neutral frosted glass styling for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 ASCII 鲸群游过留白的效果，并提供原生设置与中性磨砂玻璃样式。

description.en: DSH input-box assistant that predicts your next sentence, completes drafts, and polishes prompts on demand without auto-sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框助手：预测下一句、补全草稿、按需润色提示词，Tab 仅填入草稿不自动发送。

description.en: Custom mode for DSH: pick a base mode, toggle plugins row by row, and edit the system prompt live from the Web settings page.
description.zh: DSH 自定义模式：选择基础模式、逐行开关插件，并在设置页实时编辑系统提示词，保存后新会话生效。

description.en: Edit ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md global rules from DeepSeek Harness web settings panel with live saving.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则并实时保存。

description.en: Adds Codex-style conversation turn timeline and hover history overview to DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的对话轮次时间线，并支持鼠标悬停查看历史概览。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin for black-box and code-audit security testing, organizing P0–P7 vulnerability findings with PoC/EXP and SRC reports.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，用于黑盒测试与代码审计，按 P0–P7 分级整理漏洞发现并生成含 PoC/EXP 的 SRC 报告。

description.en: A desktop pet for the dsh web UI that reacts to agent task completion with animations, sounds, and customizable skins.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的纯客户端桌宠插件，agent 任务完成时弹出动画与合成叫声，内置 5 款皮肤和签名动作。

description.en: Playwright browser automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling automated web browser interactions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Playwright 浏览器自动化，可执行网页浏览器交互操作。

description.en: Enables conversational AI agents to maintain cross-session Markdown memory with progressive disclosure and per-project isolation.
description.zh: 让对话式AI代理维护跨会话Markdown记忆，支持渐进式披露和按项目隔离。

description.en: Manages one Chrome profile per e-commerce shop account for Pinduoduo, Taobao, Tmall, Douyin, JD and 1688, keeping logins alive.
description.zh: 为拼多多、淘宝、天猫、抖音、京东、1688 商家端每个店铺账号管理一份 Chrome 档案，登录一次长期复用并自动保活。

description.en: A DeepSeek web GUI plugin showing real-time Beijing peak/valley pricing and reminding you before switches, with a draggable whale dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷价格提醒插件：实时显示北京时间峰谷时段，切换前提前提醒，附省 token 提示，面板可自由拖动。

description.en: Adds a top-right power button to DSH Desktop with a two-item menu to fully quit or restart the whole app, Windows only.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 增加右上角电源按钮，提供「关闭DSH」和「重启DSH」两项，一键彻底退出或重启整个应用，仅限 Windows。

description.en: Mobile-first QoL for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: Chrome-style session tab bar, swipeable fullscreen sidebar, keyboard/IME/touch adaptations and a rewritten settings page — 13 toggles under Settings
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a pasted animated GIF or WebP keeps playing in the UI, and the model receives a labelled sheet of frames sampled across the animation.
Adds a recycle bin to DeepSeek Harness for moving, restoring, and permanently deleting sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加回收站，支持将会话移入回收站、恢复以及永久删除。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine gives AI persistent memory of all past conversations and proactively follows up with you.
description.zh: 为 AI 提供持久记忆，保存全部过往对话内容，并能主动向你跟进。

description.en: DSH Tavern plugin that picks illustration-worthy scenes from finished story text and renders them via ComfyUI, SD WebUI, NovelAI, OpenAI or Gemini, inserting images into the chat.
description.zh: 为 DSH Tavern 剧情从已完成正文中挑选场景，调用 ComfyUI、SD WebUI、NovelAI、OpenAI、Gemini 等生图服务生成插图并插回消息。

description.en: Adds automatic image transcription via Qwen VLM so DeepSeek can answer text-only questions with image input.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek 附加自动识图能力：图片先经 Qwen VLM 转成文字，再交给 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: Bridges DSH AI with WeChat for two-way chat using your own account, reading the local database and sending via Windows UI Automation.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 AI 接到微信，用你自己账号实现双向聊天：读取本地数据库收消息，通过 Windows UI 自动化发送。

description.en: Deterministic context compression backend for DeepSeek Harness that compresses conversation without LLM calls, preserving hard info verbatim.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性上下文压缩后端，不调用大模型即可压缩对话，并逐字保留关键信息。

description.en: Adds UI enhancements to DeepSeek Harness: file tree, previews, multi-line goal bar, and speed badge.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加界面增强：文件树、预览、多行目标栏和速度徽章。

description.en: Interactive session replay for DeepSeek Harness: timeline, token billing, security audit, fork lineage, dual-session comparison.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的追加式会话日志转为可交互回放，提供时间线与逐步 token 账单、安全审计视图、fork 血缘树和双会话对比，并内嵌在 Web UI 中。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层 —— 42 skills / 33 角色卡 / 55 MCP 工具 / graph DAG 运行时 / team 流水线 / HUD 面板。OMC/OMX 理念的 dsh 原生适配。
Injects a prompt library button into the composer toolbar to manage reusable snippets and auto-learn from complex inputs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的 composer 工具栏注入提示词库按钮，管理可复用 prompt 片段，点击插入输入框，并自动识别保存复杂输入。

description.en: Upgrades a DeepSeek Harness session from one-on-one chat to a multi-expert roundtable discussion with a host AI.
description.zh: 将DeepSeek Harness的一对一会话升级为多个专家AI参与的圆桌讨论。

description.en: Enforces engineering discipline (TDD, debugging, planning, verification, code review) for DeepSeek Harness programming mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编程模式在标准模式之上强制执行 TDD、系统化调试、先计划后编码、完成前验证与代码审查等工程纪律，内置全套 superpowers 技能，可用 dsh plugin add 一键安装。

description.en: Log into Cursor account in DeepSeek Harness to use Cursor subscription without API key or Cursor IDE/CLI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接登录 Cursor 账户并使用 Cursor 订阅，无需 API Key，也不依赖 Cursor IDE 或 Cursor CLI

description.en: Settings-page session manager for DeepSeek Harness that lists, archives, unarchives, and permanently deletes sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话管理插件：在设置页列出全部会话，支持归档、取消归档与永久删除。

description.en: Review pending changes in DSH with whole-file diffs and per-file Keep/Revert actions.
description.zh: Pending-change review for DSH: whole-file diffs with per-file Keep/Revert, create/delete tracking, and restart-safe persistence.

description.en: Live2D desktop pet and status monitor that reflects DeepSeek Harness AI state with interactive animations and speech bubbles.
description.zh: Live2D 桌宠兼状态监控面板，用交互动画和对话气泡反映 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 运行状态

description.en: Locale pack that registers 26 languages in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app's language picker with per-language dictionaries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用的语言选择器注册 26 种语言，并为每种语言提供词典。

description.en: Node-based workflow canvas for orchestrating sub-agents, code, conditions, loops, and scheduled tasks with model routing and AI guides.
description.zh: 节点式 DSH 工作流画布，可编排子代理、代码、条件、循环和定时任务，支持模型路由与 AI 生成指南。

description.en: Adds the x-opencode-session header to model calls routed to OpenCode providers, using one stable session id per DSH conversation.
description.zh: 为路由到 OpenCode 提供商的模型调用自动附加 x-opencode-session 请求头，每个 DSH 会话使用固定会话 ID。

description.en: Injects per-conversation x-opencode-session headers for OpenCode Go in DeepSeek Harness, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors without breaking other providers.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness中的OpenCode Go逐会话注入x-opencode-session头，修复400 MissingSessionID错误，不影响其他提供商。

description.en: Adds an interactive flow graph tab to DeepSeek Harness session view, visualizing tool calls and messages with pan/zoom canvas.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话视图添加可平移缩放的交互式流程图标签页，可视化工具调用与消息。

description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers in dsh settings, with import from Claude Code and Codex.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置页管理技能与 MCP 服务器，并支持从 Claude Code 和 Codex 导入。

description.en: Structural code intelligence for dsh agents: find symbol declarations, callers, and change impact via tree-sitter indexes.
description.zh: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tre

description.en: GUI embedded in DeepSeek Harness settings to manage MCP services, Skills, and plugin packages with hot reload.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板内嵌 GUI，管理 MCP 服务、Skills 和内置插件包，改动热生效无需重启。

description.en: Authenticated remote access to DeepSeek Harness web profile with TLS, device pairing, and per-device revocation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页配置提供带 TLS 的认证远程访问，支持二维码或验证码设备配对、密码登录和按设备吊销权限。

description.en: Auto-expands newly arrived tool call cards in the DSH browser interface, with a sidebar toggle.
description.zh: 自动展开 DSH 浏览器界面中新到达的工具调用卡片，并提供侧边栏开关控制

description.en: Drag-and-drop plugin that truly moves DSH sessions across workspaces, with bulk move, merge, recycle bin, and backup restore.
description.zh: 在侧边栏拖拽真迁移 DSH 会话跨工作区，支持批量移动、合并、回收站与备份恢复。

description.en: Adds multiple side-by-side chat panels to DeepSeek Harness for viewing and steering several Agents simultaneously.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加多个并排对话面板，可同时查看并操控多个 Agent 会话。

description.en: Side panel for DSH Web with Git review, file browser, and terminal alongside the session.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话旁显示侧边栏，集成 Git 审查、文件浏览器和终端，方便预览文件。

description.en: Schedule cron tasks and run automated agents in the background for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供定时任务和后台自动化执行。

description.en: DSH notification center: alerts on task completion, errors, approvals via browser/native notifications with sounds.
description.zh: DSH 通知中心插件，在对话或任务完成、报错、等待批准等事件时发送浏览器通知，并提供 21 种匹配音效。

description.en: Fetches GitHub Trending on daily/weekly/monthly cycles, writes Chinese summaries plus release digests, then auto-commits and opens a PR.
description.zh: 按日/周/月抓取 GitHub Trending，生成中文简介与 Release 摘要，并自动提交到仓库并开 PR 合并。

description.en: Claude-style skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with warm-black canvas and serif UI.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供 Claude 风格皮肤，采用暖黑色画布、Anthropic 陶土色强调色与衬线字体界面

description.en: Adds local JSONL-backed persistent memory with embeddings and agent tools for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于本地 JSONL 的持久记忆、向量嵌入与智能体工具。

description.en: A dsh skin that mimics Excel, restructuring the GUI into interactive spreadsheet cells.
description.zh: 将 dsh 界面重构为仿 Excel 的可交互电子表格单元格皮肤

description.en: DSH dreaming plugin: replays sessions, reflects, and writes dream journals for memory consolidation.
description.zh: DSH 做梦插件：会话回放（梦原料）→ 反思 → 梦境日记（记忆巩固）。多帧 zstd 会话读取，零运行时依赖。Dream plugin for DeepSeek Harness: session replay, reflection, dream journal.

description.en: Integrates WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Feishu, and Telegram with DeepSeek Harness for unified chat with Agent and file exchange.
description.zh: 把微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和 Telegram 接入 DeepSeek Harness，统一配置扫码授权，可在各 IM 与 Agent 对话并收发图片文件，Agent 能读取 PDF、DOCX、XLSX 和文本内容。

description.en: Temporary fix for DSH 0.1.7 Windows ACL sandbox failures on non-system-drive workspaces, restoring workspace-write without changing system ACLs.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.7 Windows ACL 沙箱在非系统盘工作区失败的临时修复，无需改动系统 ACL 即可恢复 workspace-write。

description.en: Manages workspace personas for DSH: multiple system-prompt presets, each scoped by workspace path or session id and edited from Web settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 管理工作区人格：多个系统提示词预设，按工作区路径或会话 ID 隔离，可在 Web 设置页配置。

description.en: Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing token/cache analytics, model/provider/workspace breakdown, DeepSeek balance, heatmap, and CSV export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量看板，提供 token/缓存分析、模型/供应商/工作区统计、余额、热力图和 CSV 导出。

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with timeout fallback for the DeepSeek Harness Auto preset.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Auto 预设提供由 LLM 辅助的自动审批，并在审批超时后走兜底处理。

description.en: Turns a Bilibili video into model-readable text: metadata, comments, danmaku, AI subtitles, local transcription, and frame-extraction OCR, as a DSH plugin or CLI.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频变成模型可读的内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、AI 字幕、本地转写与抽帧 OCR，既可作 DSH 插件也可当命令行工具。

description.en: Draws conversation branches as a clickable tree along the right edge of DeepSeek Harness, so you can jump to or continue from any turn.
description.zh: 把对话分支画成可点击的树显示在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧，可跳转到任意回合或从该回合继续。

description.en: DSH Web UI skin plugin with built-in themes and custom image skins that auto-match background colors.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面皮肤插件，内置多套主题，支持自定义图片皮肤并自动匹配背景色。

description.en: Adds password-protected LAN access to the DSH Web GUI and adapts the official interface for mobile portrait and touch.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 开启带口令的局域网访问，并适配移动端竖屏与触控手势界面。

description.en: Adds wallpaper and optional Liquid Glass overlay to DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加壁纸，并可选择叠加液态玻璃效果。

description.en: A dsh plugin with no available README or description.
description.zh: dsh.so 插件，名为 dsh-router，目前没有 README 或功能描述，具体能力未知。

description.en: A third-party skill hub that aggregates AI skills from various sources into a global library for DeepSeek Harness.
Live, persistent DAG visualization of sessions, subagents, and workflows in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中实时、持久地以 DAG 图展示会话、子代理与工作流。

description.en: Enables on-demand search, description, and invocation of tools for DeepSeek Harness with progressive disclosure.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工具检索、说明与按需调用，按渐进式披露方式加载长尾工具，减少常驻上下文占用。

description.en: Adds distinct audio alerts for DSH events like approvals, questions, and failures with configurable volumes.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻和任务失败事件播放各自独立的提示音，可分别调节音量，支持内置合成音、静音或本地音频文件，并可在 Web 设置面板中配置。

description.en: Generates images via FAL queue API and displays them inline in conversation.
description.zh: 通过 FAL 队列 API 提供 generate_image 工具生成图片，并在对话中直接内嵌显示

description.en: Replaces DSH Web workspace sidebar with recent sessions and Workspace→Session navigation using native host capabilities.
description.zh: 用宿主原生能力替换 DSH Web 工作区侧边栏，展示最近会话并支持工作区到会话的导航。

description.en: LLM adapter to use GitHub Copilot models inside DeepSeek Harness with vision support.
description.zh: 将 GitHub Copilot 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 适配器，支持视觉输入。

description.en: Provides A2A (agent-to-agent) services and a connection dashboard for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供 A2A（智能体间）服务与连接面板。

description.en: Adds OFM access governance to DSH: primary/backup channel ordering, quota cooldown, task tiers, stage timing and safe retries.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OFM 接入治理：渠道主备顺序、额度冷却、任务档位、阶段计时与安全重试，并验证真实模型回答。

description.en: Ocean-themed blue whale UI plugin with fish, bubbles, mascot, and brand replacement for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供海洋蓝鲸主题界面，包含海洋配色、鱼群、气泡、吉祥物，并替换品牌元素。

description.en: DSH plugin that automatically appends a thank-you message after each user turn in the web UI.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在网页界面中每次用户发言后自动追加一条感谢语。

description.en: Reports leftover local dsh-auth-* cookie entries in the desktop client and provides a standalone command to purge them after the client is closed.
description.zh: 报告桌面客户端中残留的本地 dsh-auth-* cookie 条目，并提供在客户端完全关闭后清除它们的独立命令。

description.en: Video processing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: probe, cut, concat, encode, subtitle, extract, gif via subprocess without shell injection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视频处理插件，提供 ffmpeg_probe、cut、concat、encode、subtitle、extract、gif 七个工具，通过官方 subprocess 服务以 argv 数组调用，无 shell 注入，零运行时依赖，纯 Node 跨平台。

description.en: MCP service bridging Gemini web chat, vision, and media generation to agents via browser cookies.
description.zh: MCP服务通过浏览器Cookie将Gemini网页聊天、视觉和媒体生成接入智能体。

description.en: Adds secondary working directories for editing multiple repos (source, test, docs) side by side in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中添加次级工作目录，可并排编辑源码、测试、文档等多个代码仓库。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns 👍/👎 feedback on draft candidates into reusable writing rules, keeping only the rules in model context.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：作者只需对候选稿点👍/👎，反馈被压缩成可复用的写作规律，仅规律进入模型上下文，原文另存不进上下文。

description.en: OpenTelemetry and Langfuse exporter for DeepSeek Harness observability, with span tracing, metrics, and buffered async export.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenTelemetry 和 Langfuse 可观测性导出，记录轮次、步骤、工具与 LLM span 及 token 和成本指标，脱敏捕获提示与补全，支持异步批量、有界离线缓冲和退避重试。

description.en: Keeps project documents and long-term agent memory as plain Markdown in a dedicated Obsidian vault, with full-text search.
description.zh: 将项目文档和长期智能体记忆以纯 Markdown 保存在专用 Obsidian 仓库中，并支持全文搜索。

description.en: Lets provider-configured request headers like User-Agent reach the PI AI API, fixing OpenCode ZEN 429 rate limits.
description.zh: 使提供商配置的 User-Agent 等请求头到达 PI AI API，修复 OpenCode ZEN 的 429 限流。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP with on-demand loading, hot reload, and description viewing.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH Skills 与 MCP，支持按需加载 MCP、会话内热重载，并可在插件中查看 SKILL 和 MCP 的描述。

description.en: Rewrites DSH final answers into plain language with a model you pick; the plain version shows by default with the original one click away.
description.zh: 用你选择的模型把 DSH 最终回答润色成大白话，默认显示润色版，原回答可折叠查看。

description.en: Merges multiple directories into one DSH session with configurable write scopes.
description.zh: 将多个目录合并到一个 DSH 会话，可配置写入范围：仅主目录、经共同祖先的全部成员，或不限制。

description.en: Token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: KPI, heatmap, and charts under Settings Usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消耗统计插件：设置页 Token 用量 KPI、半年活跃热力图、按模型堆叠柱状图与模型环形图（dsh-plugin）

description.en: Use Wallpaper Engine wallpapers (video/image) as DeepSeek Harness web background with auto-sync and customization.
description.zh: 将wallpaper接入到deepseek harness中，可以设置dsh的动态壁纸

description.en: Enforces persistent login for DeepSeek Harness WebUI at HTTP/transport layer, unbypassable via devtools, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供持久登录认证，在 HTTP 传输层拦截资源、/api 和 WebSocket 请求，无法用开发者工具绕过，且零依赖。

description.en: Desktop pet whale plugin for DSH web UI; changes animation based on agent state, pure DOM zero deps.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的桌宠小鲸鱼插件，随 agent 状态切换动画，纯 DOM 实现、零依赖。

description.en: DSH plugin for theme presets and wallpaper management, including image library, layered composition, AI tools, and sharing.
description.zh: DSH 主题预设与壁纸管理插件，功能包含图库、分层合成、AI 工具与壁纸分享。

description.en: SkillHub plugin for DeepSeek Harness to search skills in conversation, view details, and install them to the harness skills directory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SkillHub 插件，可在对话中搜索技能、查看详情并安装到技能目录。

description.en: DSH plan-review plugin that anchors annotations on plan text and sends structured feedback to the Agent.
description.zh: DSH 计划批注插件：选中计划原文逐条批注，并把结构化反馈发送回 Agent。

description.en: Injects a fixed system prompt so the agent always thinks and replies in Chinese.
description.zh: 注入固定的系统提示，使代理始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Tavily Search plugin for DSH with multi-key support, rotation/failover, usage gauge, and settings card.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 搜索，支持多 API Key 轮换与故障转移、用量仪表盘和设置卡片。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for DeepSeek Harness with keyless MCP fallback and keyed REST.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置 Exa 网页搜索，支持免密钥匿名 MCP 回退（mcp.exa.ai/mcp）与带密钥 REST 两种方式，可通过 providerId 切换。

description.en: Declares per-model capabilities (reasoning-effort levels and vision support) for OpenAI-compatible providers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenAI 兼容提供方声明各模型的推理强度档位与视觉模态，在设置中配置，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Always-on-top Windows notch overlay that shows each DeepSeek Harness session and flags the one that needs your attention.
description.zh: 常驻桌面顶部的 Windows 刘海浮层，展示每个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并标记需要你处理的会话。

description.en: Auto-retries failed dsh steps, resumes interrupted runs, and wakes hung sessions, with per-step popups and a retry dashboard.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供报错自动重试、中断自动继续、挂起自动唤醒，附带每步弹窗提示与重试数据看板。

description.en: Panel to see and switch agent-accessible skills, MCP servers, and system tools in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 查看并切换DeepSeek Harness中代理可用的技能、MCP服务器和系统工具的插件面板。

description.en: Manages DSH conversations: a cross-workspace chat index with full-text search, time-based batch archiving, and recoverable recycle-bin deletion.
description.zh: DSH 对话管家：跨工作区对话总表，支持全文搜索、按时间批量归档和可恢复的回收站式删除。

description.en: Mobile-optimized web UI for DeepSeek Harness, designed for Termux on Android.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供移动端适配，面向在 Android Termux 中编程的开发者，采用单列布局、侧边抽屉、单行输入框，设置与轨迹详情全屏滚动，点按查看会话统计，桌面端不受影响。

description.en: Provides 20 curated agent skills for DeepSeek Harness, ported from ECC (MIT).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供从 ECC 移植的 20 个精选 agent 技能，MIT 许可，属渐进式移植的 v0.1.0 版本。

description.en: Watches the exam page on your phone screen, recognizes each question and pops the answer as a top notification, using an optional question bank or a vision model.
description.zh: 盯住手机考试页面，识别题目后把答案以顶部通知弹出，可选用本地题库或视觉模型作答。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets an agent recursively improve its own harness by testing edits on a task and storing adopted harnesses per domain.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，让智能体通过在当前任务上试探改动来递归改进自身 harness，并按领域保存采用的 harness 与经验。

description.en: Security gate for DeepSeek Harness that prunes long tool output, screens fetched pages for injected instructions, and verifies completion claims.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全门控：裁剪冗长工具输出、筛查网页注入指令并验证完成声明。

description.en: Enables DeepSeek Harness web GUI to be accessed over LAN by binding to 0.0.0.0 and adding a crypto.randomUUID polyfill.
将 Magpie 网关模型快速接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件
A private, identity-first gateway for securely sharing DSH Web with selected people via Tailscale.
description.zh: 私有身份优先网关，监听回环地址，通过 Tailscale 让指定的人安全访问 DSH Web

description.en: Adds a pinned group at the top of the sidebar session list and a full Pinned page, reopening each saved conversation in its original workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏增加置顶分组和独立置顶页，可在原工作区打开已置顶会话。

description.en: Portable agent skill that guides Android game projects through Google Play dependencies, resource handling, Firebase and ad integration.
description.zh: 可移植的智能体技能，指导安卓游戏项目处理 Google Play 依赖、资源、Firebase 与广告接入。

description.en: A DSH long-term memory plugin that archives the earliest conversation into a memory folder when context exceeds a threshold, then recalls it by keyword and importance.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件：上下文超过阈值时把最早的一段对话归档到 memory/ 回忆文件夹，之后按关键词与重要度概率自动回忆。

description.en: DSH agent preset bundle for DeepSeek V4 Flash godmode, installed via dsh plugin add.
description.zh: DSH bundle 插件：V4 Flash 神模式（opencode-go）agent preset 分发包，dsh plugin add 安装后自动同步 router-flash preset。DSH agent preset bundle for DeepSeek V4 Flash godmode.

description.en: Scores DeepSeek Harness plugins across install, maintenance, docs, security, and protocol compliance with CLI evidence.
description.zh: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins: scores one repo or npm package across install success (consuming dsh-test-drive results), maintenance activity, documentation completene

description.en: Manages AI skills for DSH/Codex/Claude from settings, enabling toggles, GitHub discovery, and ZIP import.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页统一管理 DSH、Codex、Claude 的 AI 技能，支持热开关启停、从 GitHub 技能市场发现安装以及本地 ZIP 导入。

description.en: Isolated plugin install-and-smoke test tool for DSH plugins, writing pass/fail result matrices and quarantining temp dirs.
description.zh: 在隔离的临时 DSH_HOME 中安装 DSH 插件仓库或 npm 包并做冒烟测试，校验 bundle 补丁层与启动日志，输出通过/失败的 JSON/Markdown 结果矩阵，并隔离其占用的临时目录。

description.en: A TFR Long March / Loji route theme skin for DeepSeek Harness with phosphor terminal, data rain and CRT scanline effects plus four department presets.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 TFR《烈焰升腾》长征/Loji 路线主题皮肤，含磷光终端、数据雨与 CRT 扫描线效果，并提供四套部门预设。

description.en: Scheduled AI-agent runner with cron-like ticker, workspace targeting, and web monitoring board.
description.zh: DSH plugin: host-resident scheduled-jobs × AI-agent engine (hermes-agent cron inspired) — 60s ticker fires real agent sessions via cron; pinned-session / project-workdir / default-workspace targeting;

description.en: Generates Notability-style handwritten academic PPT slides as HTML with PNG export.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 生成 Notability 风格的手写学术 PPT 幻灯片，输出 HTML 页面并可导出 PNG 图片。

description.en: Tracks token usage and costs for DeepSeek Harness, with tiers and vendor comparison.
description.zh: 🐳 鲸鱼电表：你在 DeepSeek Harness 上烧了多少 token？消耗量段位、可晒的战绩卡、6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价（含国内分档）、8·17 调价前后对比。零配置，数据全在本机 | Token usage tiers & cost dashboard for DSH

description.en: A DSH plugin that lets an agent run Linux commands directly through wsl.exe without scripts.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，让智能体通过wsl.exe直接运行Linux命令，无需脚本。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that idempotently installs the Yuike catgirl persona preset as your agent's sole system prompt.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，幂等安装猫娘 Yuike 人格预设，作为智能体唯一的系统提示词。

description.en: Adds a reasoning-level slider inside DeepSeek Harness model selector to adjust model reasoning intensity.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器内添加推理级别滑块，用于调整模型的推理强度。

description.en: Embeds the official chat.deepseek.com web app in a DeepSeek Harness sidebar entry using the native browser guest, with persistent sign-in.
description.zh: 通过桌面外壳的原生浏览器访客，在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏条目中嵌入官方 chat.deepseek.com 网页应用，并在重启后保持登录。

description.en: Adds notification sounds and Chinese voice alerts to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加通知音效和中文语音提醒，覆盖审批、回答、完成、出错四类事件，并提供设置页面。

description.en: Manages archived DSH sessions with view, search, restore, and delete capabilities from the settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 设置页查看、搜索、恢复和删除已归档的会话。

description.en: Lets the DeepSeek model reply with an openui-lang program that the Web GUI renders as a live, interactive UI inside the chat.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 模型以 openui-lang 程序作答，Web GUI 在聊天中实时渲染为可交互界面。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API balance display in DeepSeek Harness web GUI with auto-refresh and custom intervals.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面实时显示当前 API 余额，默认每 30 秒自动刷新，并支持自定义刷新间隔。

description.en: Rewrites AI-heavy Chinese text to sound human by cutting AI clichés and templates; learns new AI phrases from feedback.
description.zh: 将AI味重的中文改成更像人写的，删除AI高频词与模板句，并可从反馈中学习新AI词。

description.en: Pixel pet mascot for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that reacts to agent states with animations and interactions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加像素风宠物，根据智能体状态播放动画并支持互动。

description.en: A dsh plugin that lets you attach any file to conversations, writing to workspace and showing a card.
Plays a sound and shows a Windows toast notification when a DSH agent finishes a conversation turn.
description.zh: 当 DSH 智能体完成一轮对话时，播放提示音并弹出 Windows 系统通知

description.en: Unified image-generation router with config-driven engine routing, fallback, attachments, quotas, and settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的 image_generate 图像生成工具，可按配置路由到 OpenAI Images、智谱 CogView 等兼容接口，支持故障自动回退、会话配额统计、附件持久化保存及插件设置面板。

description.en: Enables conversational creation, editing, repair, and validation of Excel spreadsheets in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过对话创建、编辑、修复和校验 Excel 表格，支持单元格、公式、样式、筛选、表格与图表，每次修改均自动验证。

description.en: A personal memory and companionship plugin that lets DeepSeek recall your habits, shared experiences and project conventions across new sessions.
description.zh: 个人记忆与陪伴插件，让 DeepSeek 在新会话中记住你的习惯、共同经历与项目约定并继续使用。

description.en: Adds humanized whale-girl maid persona to DeepSeek Harness for roleplay, speaking modes, and layered memory.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加拟人化鲸娘女仆人格，支持角色扮演、多种说话模式与受 ALTM 启发的分层记忆。

description.en: Right-sidebar legal workbench surfacing Obsidian notes, SOP lookup, glossary, live recording transcription and global search.
description.zh: 右侧栏法律工作台，集成 Obsidian 笔记、SOP 查询、术语表、实时录音转录与全局搜索。

description.en: Adds a draggable Live2D mascot for MyGO!!!!! characters to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with costume swapping, interactions, and screenshot export.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加 MyGO!!!!! 角色 Live2D 可拖拽桌宠，本地模型同源加载、零外部依赖，支持换装、互动和截图导出。

description.en: Adds a DSH settings card to configure LLM auto-retry count and backoff timing, with immediate effect.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中添加卡片，用于调整 LLM 自动重试次数和退避时间，修改后立即生效。

description.en: Loads Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as DeepSeek Harness web background with video, time-based switching, blur and zoom effects.
description.zh: 在浏览器内加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 文件作为 DSH 网页背景，支持内嵌视频、按时段切换、统一磨砂虚化和镜头缩放。

description.en: Sends Windows desktop notifications for task completion, approval requests, and agent questions when attention is needed.
description.zh: 在任务完成、需要审批请求或代理提问时发送 Windows 桌面通知以提醒用户关注。

description.en: Turns a photo of a surface into a complete tileable PBR material set, fully local via ComfyUI, with a GUI workbench and agent tools.
description.zh: 将表面照片转换为完整的可平铺 PBR 材质集，完全本地运行于 ComfyUI，并提供图形工作台与智能体工具。

description.en: Paper-style sticky notes, notes, a calendar, and a drawing canvas built right into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供纸质风格便签、笔记、日程表和绘图画布。

description.en: Adds better streaming text animation to DeepSeek Harness for improved display.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加更流畅的流式文字动画效果，改善输出显示。

description.en: Bridges QQ chats to DeepSeek Harness agents, enabling AI-driven conversations with voice, image, and sticker support.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot 将 QQ 聊天接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，支持语音、图片和表情包的 AI 对话。

description.en: Rewind DSH conversations to any user message, interrupt turns, and hide tail from view and context.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话回退到任意用户消息，中断正在运行的回合，从聊天视图和模型上下文中隐藏尾部，发送前可随时取消。

description.en: Web page scraper and analyzer that extracts content, headings, links, keywords, and downloads images for vision analysis.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的网页读取插件

description.en: A default subagent delegation policy pack that decides when the main model works itself, when to delegate, and which model gets the task.
description.zh: 官方 subagent 的默认委派策略包：自动决定何时自己干、何时派出去、派给哪个模型。

description.en: A Spice and Wolf Holo-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with a 12-second intro animation, floating wordmark, peeking Holo, dynamic profile card, sidebar wheat field, and whale idle screen — each piece
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的《狼与香辛料》赫萝主题，含 12 秒开场动画、浮动字标、偷看的她、动态档案卡、侧栏麦田与右栏待机联动，每个组件均可单独关闭。

description.en: DSH Web 模型余量与用量监控插件：显示余量徽标并本地记录 token 与费用。
description.zh: 显示DSH Web模型余量徽标，并在本地记录token用量与费用。

description.en: Token-billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness with auto pricing, peak/off-peak rates, ledger, balance, and locale currency display.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供人民币/美元 token 计费，按官方政策自动定价，支持峰谷时段费率、逐条消息账本、账户余额与跟随语言环境的货币显示。

description.en: Adds a paperclip button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI to upload files to the host with deduplication.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加回形针按钮，用于向宿主机上传文件并进行去重。

description.en: Pre-grants a Windows ACL entry for declared dsh workspace folders so the file sandbox can start without session elevation prompts.
description.zh: 为显式声明的工作区目录预置 Windows ACL 授权，使 dsh 文件沙箱无需升权即可正常启动受限进程。

description.en: Automatically appends x-opencode-session header to model requests to opencode.ai, using persistent conversation ID for session consistency.
description.zh: 自动为发往 opencode.ai 的模型请求附加 x-opencode-session 请求头，使用持久会话 ID 保证会话一致。

description.en: Open-source Agent Skills that let AI coding agents identify, deploy, troubleshoot, verify, version and roll back applications.
description.zh: 一组开源 Agent Skills，让各类 AI Agent 完成应用识别、部署、排错、交付验证、版本管理与回滚。

description.en: Office plugin for DSH providing 10 tools to generate presentations, documents, sheets, charts, images, and videos.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 10 个办公工具，可生成演示文稿、文档、表格、图表、图片和视频。

description.en: Organizes DSH web chat sessions: auto-folds completed rounds, adds separators, and provides a left-edge navigation bar for jumping to any conversation.
description.zh: 整理 DSH Web 会话时间线：自动折叠已完成回合、添加分隔线、左缘定位条跳转，并提供四个开关设置

description.en: Configurable 17-segment status bar for DeepSeek Harness showing model, context, tokens, cost, and jobs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 17 段可配置状态栏，显示状态、模型、上下文、令牌、TPS、费用和任务等会话信息。

description.en: Delivers images and files to text-only models as workspace paths, preserving attachments and converting on send.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型接收图片与文件：图片保留原生附件体验，PDF、Office、压缩包、视频、音频显示为附件方块，发送时自动转为工作区路径。

description.en: Local text-to-speech synthesis and playback using IndexTTS 2.5 and GPT-SoVITS for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 IndexTTS 2.5 和 GPT-SoVITS 的本地语音合成与播放。

description.en: Loads Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as DSH Web GUI backgrounds; renders scene wallpapers via wasm, plays video/web wallpapers.
description.zh: 从本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库加载壁纸作为 DSH Web GUI 背景，用 wasm 渲染 scene 壁纸，并播放视频和 web 壁纸。

description.en: Converts existing code into Function, MCP, Agent Skill, and offline test packages for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把现有代码转换为 Function、MCP、Agent Skill 和离线测试包，可作为 DeepSeek Harness 插件包安装。

description.en: Unofficial DSH port of mattpocock/skills, bundling engineering and productivity skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将 mattpocock/skills 非官方移植为 DeepSeek Harness 捆绑插件，包含 18 个工程技能和 7 个生产力技能。

description.en: Mount a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace, with host management, a directory browser, and five agent tools for remote files.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机的目录当作 DSH 工作区，提供主机管理、目录浏览和五个远程文件代理工具。

description.en: A visual plugin development tool for DSH, with event flow and management for plugins, tools, skills, and presets.
description.zh: 为开发 DSH 插件提供可视化事件流，以及插件、工具、技能、预设管理，简化插件开发流程。

description.en: Cron scheduler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: automatically or manually trigger new agent sessions with prompts, full-screen management UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 定时任务插件：按 cron 自动或手动新建 agent 会话执行提示词，带全屏管理界面。

description.en: Automates conversation review, distills experiences into reusable skills, and persists cross-session memories for a DeepSeek harness.
description.zh: 对话收尾后自动复盘，将经验提炼为可复用技能，并把事实与偏好写入跨会话记忆。

description.en: An agent-driven QA plugin that explores your app like a real user, records evidence, and exports deterministic replay scenarios for each release.
description.zh: 由智能体驱动的 QA 插件：像真实用户一样探索应用、留存证据，并导出每次发版可重放的确定性场景。

description.en: Adds customizable background images to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with opacity, mask, and blur controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加自定义背景图片，支持上传图片或粘贴链接，可调不透明度、遮罩、面板透明度与毛玻璃模糊，带实时预览和主题适配。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows a floating line with your Aliyun voucher and account balance remaining, with hover detail and a full panel.
description.zh: DSH 插件：悬浮一行显示阿里云代金券与账户余额剩余额度，悬停查看明细并可用面板配置。

description.en: Enables DSH to discover and execute skills via Chinese names in slash commands without renaming.
description.zh: 让 DSH 无需重命名即可识别中文技能名，在斜杠命令中用中文名发现并执行技能，如输入 /私 调用私家大厨。

description.en: Integrates WeChat official ilink bot gateway into DeepSeek Harness, letting AI send personal WeChat notifications with automatic task summaries and alerts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入微信官方 ilink 机器人网关，让 AI 主动发送微信通知，自动推送任务摘要和完成/阻断提醒。

description.en: A plugin that serves as a code IDE for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码 IDE 功能的插件

description.en: Displays a whale status light in the tab: green when session complete, amber when action is pending.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：标签页鲸鱼状态灯 —— 会话完成变绿，有待处理交互变琥珀。Tab-whale status light: green when done, amber when something awaits you.

description.en: Logs tool failure causes across execution modes, dedupes, counts, and stores them in skill maintenance records.
description.zh: 记录原生工具、PTC run_code、代码内嵌调用等各执行模式的工具失败错因，去重计数、确定性排序后写入 skill 的机器维护实录区段

description.en: Read-only performance diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness sessions: load timing, spill hits, compaction, context-injection volume, and LLM cache hit rate via /fast command and fast_report tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供只读性能诊断，通过 /fast 命令和 fast_report 工具查看会话加载耗时、spill 命中次数、压缩次数与触发原因、上下文注入量及 LLM 缓存命中率。

description.en: FDE Workstation plugin that runs customer lifecycle tracking with a kanban board, 8 stage gates and a reusable method library.
description.zh: FDE 工作站插件：用看板、8 个阶段门和可复用的方法库管理客户全生命周期。

description.en: Raises Node.js HTTP timeouts globally so slow local models (Ollama, LM Studio) are not cut off after 5 minutes.
description.zh: 全局提高Node.js HTTP超时时间，避免慢速本地模型（Ollama、LM Studio）在5分钟后被断开。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH that handles OAuth authorization, token status display, silent refresh and local disconnect.
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件，负责 OAuth 授权、token 状态显示、静默刷新与本地断开。

description.en: A shared global todo list kept in one JSON file that both a person and an AI agent can read and write.
description.zh: 一个以单个 JSON 文件保存的全局待办清单，人类和 AI 智能体都能读写。

description.en: Adds GPT-SoVITS offline text-to-speech to the DSH Web GUI so assistant replies can be read aloud with local voice presets.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 接入 GPT-SoVITS 离线语音合成，可用本地音色朗读助手回复。

description.en: Adds an ikun pet animation with progress bar during DeepSeek Harness deep-dive responses.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 深度思考回答时，于深潜状态行下方显示坤宠动图与 0% 到 100% 进度条，每 20% 更换动作文案，完成时系统播放你干嘛哎哟。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to IM platforms for turn/approval notifications and remote approval/injection.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 桥接到即时通讯平台，推送回合与审批通知，支持远程批准和注入，并按平台持久去重、收敛分段、合并消息窗口；v0.1 支持微信 iLink，钉钉、飞书、Telegram 为预留。

description.en: Expert for Kuikly integration and app prototyping using create-kuikly-app CLI skills.
description.zh: 提供四个基于 create-kuikly-app 命令行工具的捆绑技能，用于 Kuikly 集成与应用原型开发

description.en: Real-time token counting and first-token latency monitoring for DeepSeek Harness streaming responses.
description.zh: 实时统计 DeepSeek Harness 流式响应的 token 数量，并监测首个 token 的延迟。

description.en: Lazy MCP gateway exposing one stable proxy tool, connecting MCP servers on first use, idling them out, and caching metadata to disk.
description.zh: 懒加载 MCP 网关：只暴露一个稳定的代理工具，服务器首次使用时才连接、空闲后断开，元数据缓存到磁盘。

description.en: Six-tier local memory plugin that auto-captures conversations, injects a stable summary, and compresses history without LLM calls to cut cost.
description.zh: 六层本地记忆插件：自动捕获对话、稳定注入摘要、零 LLM 压缩历史，既能防止失忆又能降低开销。

description.en: dsh plugin for Inception Mercury that renders the diffusion denoising stream live inside the answer bubble as the model generates.
description.zh: 面向 Inception Mercury 的 dsh 插件，在回答气泡内实时渲染扩散去噪流，展示模型的生成过程。

description.en: DSH Remote plugin securely tunnels the DeepSeek assistant web panel to your phone and the public internet, toggled from the sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 远程助手插件可将 DeepSeek 助手 Web 面板安全穿透到手机与外网，侧边栏一键开启。

description.en: Portable agent skill for developing and auditing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with optional DSH bundle adapter.
description.zh: 用于开发和审查 DeepSeek Harness 插件的可移植 Agent Skill，附带可选的 DSH bundle 适配器供 profile 安装。

description.en: A VRM 3D desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that reacts to task status (running, waiting, done, error) with motions, in-app or as a floating window.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加的 VRM 3D 桌宠，随任务状态（进行、等待确认、完成、出错）播放动作，支持应用内与独立悬浮窗显示。

description.en: DSH plugin that prepends a reusable saved prompt preset to your outgoing messages, either for the next message only or on every turn.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在发送消息时把可复用的预设提示词注入到消息开头，可仅限下一条消息或每轮都生效。

description.en: Provider manager for DSH: edit LLM providers, API keys and models in Settings, test a model, discover endpoint models, with 218 templates.
description.zh: DSH 供应商管理器：在设置中编辑 LLM 供应商、API 密钥与模型，可测试模型、探测端点模型，内置 218 个供应商模板。

description.en: A research plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness that installs a curated, hand-read catalog of research plugins into your profile.
description.zh: The research plugin market for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a Research plugins page in Settings that installs a curated, hand-read catalog into the profile you are running. Catalog at dsh-research.com.

description.en: Server card dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing live CPU, memory and disk status, with one-click xterm terminal, displayable as sidebar tab or drawer.
description.zh: 服务器卡片仪表盘，用于DeepSeek Harness，显示CPU/内存/磁盘状态，带一键xterm终端，可作为侧边栏或抽屉显示。

description.en: DSH Web GUI sidebar with VS Code-style file explorer, git source control, and file editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏提供 VS Code 风格文件浏览器、git 源代码管理（查看状态、暂存/取消暂存、丢弃、提交、查看差异）以及可保存的文件编辑器。

description.en: Visual plugin marketplace and lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness with dsh:// one-click install and deep uninstall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内置可视化插件市场，支持 dsh:// 一键安装与深度卸载，本地全生命周期管理。

description.en: Role-based AI swarm orchestration for DeepSeek with per-role model pinning, DAG tasks, review loops, and live dashboard.
description.zh: 面向DeepSeek的基于角色的AI集群编排，支持逐角色模型固定、DAG任务、审查循环和实时仪表盘。

description.en: Computes Swiss-grid margins, columns, baseline and type scale, then builds print-ready SVG-to-PDF posters with a grid-overlay proof.
description.zh: 计算瑞士网格版心、栏宽、基线与字号阶梯，并生成带网格叠加校样的可打印 SVG-to-PDF 海报。

description.en: Keeps coding-agent sessions lean by folding completed tasks into titled summaries, reducing context costs while preserving full content for later recall.
description.zh: 通过将已完成任务折叠为带标题的摘要，保持编码代理会话精简，降低上下文成本并保留完整内容供以后查阅。

description.en: Edit Typst documents collaboratively with an AI agent in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中与 AI 代理协作编辑 Typst 文档。

description.en: Web UI enhancement suite for DSH with themes, layout tweaks, capsule collapsibles, account usage, plus an Electron desktop shell.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供主题、布局调整、胶囊折叠与账号用量显示，并附无边框 Electron 桌面壳。

description.en: Wallpaper background plugin for DeepSeek Harness UI with built-in, custom upload, and Wallpaper Engine sources.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供壁纸背景，支持内置壁纸、自定义上传和只读 Wallpaper Engine 库，可渲染图片、视频和场景预览，并调节遮罩、模糊、亮度和安全缩放。

description.en: AI writing plugin for WeChat official accounts: automated pipeline (topic→write→quality→layout→image→draft) with manual send.
description.zh: 微信公众号 AI 写作插件，在 DeepSeek Harness 中一条命令安装写作管线，覆盖选题、写作、质量门禁、排版、配图到草稿箱，定时发布只进草稿箱，群发需人工确认。

description.en: IKUN-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with wallpapers, music box, send sounds, and easter eggs.
description.zh: IKUN 主题皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness — ikun 应援主题、全屏壁纸轮播、基尼太美音乐盒、发送自动播「你干嘛~哎哟」

description.en: Exposes a RESTful API gateway allowing third-party clients to interact with a DeepSeek Harness agent.
description.zh: 以 RESTful API 网关对外暴露接口，让第三方客户端能与 DSH Agent 交互。

description.en: In-process trigram index for code search, 20-70x faster than ripgrep with identical results and no sidecar process.
description.zh: 进程内三元组索引，使代码搜索比 ripgrep 快 20-70 倍，结果一致，且无需额外独立进程。

description.en: macOS notch / Windows Fluent dynamic-island overlay showing DeepSeek Harness agent thinking, tool calls, approvals and parallel subagents live.
description.zh: 兼容 macOS 刘海与 Windows Fluent 的灵动岛插件，实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 智能体思考、工具调用、待审批与子代理并行状态。

description.en: Aggressive context compaction for local-first agents via self-hosted LLM, keeping prompts small, fast, and private.
description.zh: 通过自托管 llama.cpp 运行 Qwen3.8-27B 压缩上下文历史，让本地 agent 的常驻 prompt 保持小而快，数据不出本机、无 API 成本。

description.en: Companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing ClineBot settings, quota dashboard, key saving, and model selection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的配套插件，为 ClineBot 提供设置页面、配额仪表盘、密钥保存和模型选择。

description.en: Provides a Mixture of Agents (MoA) workflow via /moa command with file workspaces and Live Canvas integration.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供混合代理(MoA)工作流，支持/moa命令、文件工作区和Live Canvas集成。

description.en: An ad blocker for DSH Web UI that removes dsh ads popups and banners via four defense layers.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的广告拦截插件，通过四层防御机制移除 dsh 广告弹窗与横幅。

description.en: Port of Superpowers skills for multi-agent software development in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) port of obra/superpowers — 14 native skills for multi-agent software development: brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, and code review.

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that optimizes prompts in the input box via templates, with cancel and restore-original support.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过模板一键优化输入框提示词，支持取消与恢复原文。

description.en: Standalone screen capture plugin for dsh with browser hotkeys and an agent-facing capture+read tool.
description.zh: Standalone screen capture for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): browser hotkeys plus an agent-facing capture+read tool. Forked out of @liustack/modlens#48 (upstream declined the feature).

description.en: Marketplace to install, update, and remove DeepSeek Harness plugins across any local profile via web settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 设置里的插件市场，可在任意本地配置中安装、更新和移除插件。

description.en: Sends OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs from DeepSeek Harness to GreptimeDB for observability.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenTelemetry 链路追踪、指标和日志直接写入 GreptimeDB，用于可观测性。

description.en: Provides Codex/agent skills for the Creght platform, covering CLI workflows, project structure, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, and site replication.
description.zh: Codex and agent skills for Cregh.

description.en: A DSH plugin for AI-assisted fiction and novel writing, leveraging a deepseek harness.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，借助 DeepSeek harness 提供 AI 辅助的小说与虚构写作功能。

description.en: DSH Web workbench base: VSCode-style layout shell with the ctx.workbench registry service.
description.zh: DSH Web 工作台基础插件，提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳和 ctx.workbench 注册表服务。

description.en: Extensible desktop-pet status display for DSH Web, showing session progress and model tool-call traces.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可扩展的桌面宠物状态显示，展示会话进度和模型工具调用轨迹。

description.en: An unofficial Aseprite-compatible pixel editor and sprite animation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供非官方 Aseprite 兼容的像素编辑器与精灵动画功能。

description.en: Tracks and reports per-session LLM costs with attribution, using llm-pricing.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: per-session cost line + cost attribution report, priced by llm-pricing

description.en: Agent-native Chromium DevTools workbench that gives DeepSeek Harness powerful browser automation and frontend debugging capabilities.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的智能体原生 Chromium DevTools 工作台，赋予其强大的浏览器自动化与前端调试能力。

description.en: Cost governance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks token/cost usage, enforces budget caps with alerts, estimates carbon footprint.
description.zh: Cost governance for DeepSeek Harness: aggregated token/cost metering per model, session and day, budget caps with threshold alerts and over-limit policies, carbon footprint estimation, per-model laten

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin for dual-area chat session management, folders, deletion, and archived session control.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话管理插件，可在双区聊天、建文件夹、删除会话并管理已归档会话。

description.en: Batch-port Codex plugin skills from ~/.codex into DSH skills with automatic frontmatter conversion and idempotent skip.
description.zh: 把 ~/.codex 中的 Codex 官方插件技能批量移植为 DSH 技能，自动转换 frontmatter，并提供 codex_list、codex_port、codex_status，重复项幂等跳过。

description.en: Per-message delete for DeepSeek Harness: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context via the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from th
Developer workbench for DeepSeek Harness bundling daily briefing, task center, unified search, agent hub, dev toolbox and knowledge space.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的开发者智能工作台，集今日简报、任务中心、统一搜索、Agent 中心、开发工具箱、研发协作与知识空间于一体。

description.en: Makes dsh plugin install/remove/upgrade take effect instantly after one restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件热管理器：首次安装后重启一次，此后安装、卸载、升级插件均即时生效，无需再重启。

description.en: Integrate Kimi Code subscription into DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login, quota display, and composer usage.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中集成Kimi Code订阅，支持OAuth、配额显示和composer使用。

description.en: Lets users copy LaTeX source or export formulas as SVG by hovering over them in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中悬停任意 LaTeX 公式即可复制其 TeX 源码，或导出为独立 SVG 文件。

description.en: A DSH agent preset that teaches coding with scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and practice blanks.
description.zh: DSH 代理预设，在编码过程中用具体场景解释、苏格拉底式引导和 TODO(你) 练习空位来教学。

description.en: A WebUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness that displays community-driven daily rankings using token-generated incense.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 WebUI 插件，用 token 生成的香火展示社区驱动的每日排行榜。

description.en: OpenCode Go usage bar: plan remaining ring, real-time token/spending stats, and one-click API key copy for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐余量圆环与 token、花费实时统计，可按本次会话或全部范围及模型联动，并一键复制 API Key。

description.en: EVA-style MAGI plugin: three independent persona decision units each vote agree/disagree with reasons, then votes are tallied.
description.zh: EVA风格MAGI插件：三个独立人格决策单元各自表决同意或不同意并给出理由，再按规则计票。

description.en: Plugin for custom persona configuration in AI conversations, supporting role setup and per-conversation persona adjustments.
description.zh: 用于自定义 AI 对话角色设定的插件，支持配置人设，并可在每次对话中灵活调整角色。

description.en: Adds a confirmed "Delete Session" item to DSH's sidebar session menu, permanently removing only that session's logs and state.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除会话」，二次确认后彻底删除该会话的日志与状态，不影响其他会话。

description.en: Fuses a DSH-native pptwise front end with the ppt-master native DrawingML engine to build PowerPoint (pptx) presentations.
description.zh: 将 DSH 原生的 pptwise 前端与 ppt-master 原生 DrawingML 引擎融合，用于生成 PowerPoint（pptx）演示文稿。

description.en: 基于原版 DSH 扩展，提供项目层、用户层更完整 MCP 管理 || Extended from the original DSH code, providing more complete MCP management at both project and user levels
A session-level multi-prompt library and system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供会话级多提示词库，并可注入系统提示词。

description.en: Edit assistant replies and thought chains inside DSH sessions, with live writing so the model adopts the revised content.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中编辑助手回复与思维链，在线写入立即生效，让模型采信修改后的内容。

description.en: Adds configurable trusted writable directories to the DSH sandbox, letting CLI and file tools modify approved paths outside the workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 默认沙箱增加可配置的沙箱授权目录，使 CLI 和文件工具能修改工作区外已批准的路径。

description.en: Replaces dsh's built-in web search with configurable search MCP servers like Tavily, Brave, Exa.
description.zh: Replace dsh's built-in web search with search MCP servers (Tavily/Brave/Exa/Perplexity/DuckDuckGo/custom), configured from the web Settings page. Disables the built-in DeepSeek search provider while e

description.en: Lets the agent drive other real DSH sessions from a prompt: create, send, wait, read, resume, find sessions across workspaces, plus monitor and archive.
description.zh: 让代理通过提示词驱动其他真实DSH会话，支持创建、发送、等待、读取、恢复、跨工作区查找，以及监控归档。

description.en: Injects x session id HTTP header onto every LLM provider request for session-aware routing/caching/auditing.
description.zh: 为每个 LLM 提供商请求注入 x-session-id HTTP 头，用于按会话路由、缓存和审计。

description.en: Multi-host SSH workbench plugin with a host library, per-project authorization, a sidebar terminal, and dual-pane SFTP file transfer.
description.zh: 多机 SSH 工作台插件：主机库、按项目授权、侧栏终端与双栏 SFTP 文件传输。

description.en: Trading-terminal skin and live market panel for DSH Web GUI: A/HK/US stocks, crypto, forex, watchlist ticker, fuzzy search, P&L.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供交易终端风格皮肤，并显示 A股、港股、美股、加密与外汇实时行情面板，支持自选跑马灯、首字母模糊搜索和持仓盈亏管理。

description.en: Formats DSH replies into structured output with no-label title cards, tables, lists, and steps, toggleable per session.
description.zh: 将 DSH 回复格式化为结构化输出，支持无标签标题卡、表格、列表和步骤，并可按会话切换。

description.en: Token-optimization suite for DSH that routes subagents to cheaper model tiers, prunes tool output, and compacts context to cut token cost.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Token 优化套件，将子代理路由到更便宜的模型层、裁剪工具输出并压缩上下文以降低 Token 消耗。

description.en: Auto-healing layer for model tool calls: silently fixes failures and shows receipts.
description.zh: 模型工具调用自动修复层：静默修复失败并提供记录。

description.en: Adds per-session Turbo gears to DeepSeek Harness, tuning prompts and request lifecycle for faster, leaner execution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按会话生效的 Turbo 双档执行策略，减少步骤与等待时间。

description.en: Web UI polish layer that normalizes official UI and reconciles plugin style conflicts via design tokens.
description.zh: Web UI polish layer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official de

description.en: Rewrites @ in system messages at the fetch layer to fix WorkBuddy CN gateway HTTP 400 / code 11128 in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 fetch 层重写系统消息中的 @，修复 DeepSeek Harness 中 WorkBuddy CN 网关的 HTTP 400 / 错误码 11128。

description.en: Playwright-based web-fetch provider that renders pages in a real browser, denoises HTML, and returns markdown.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Playwright/CDP 的网页抓取：用真实浏览器渲染页面，经 Readability 和 DOMPurify 去噪后返回 Markdown。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web plugin for browser-based functionality.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 Web 插件，为浏览器端功能提供支持。

description.en: An anime maid whale desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness with a satiety system and real-time LLM interaction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上的动漫女仆鲸鱼桌面宠物，带饱食度系统和实时 LLM 交互。

description.en: Desktop widget plugin featuring a cute whale girl that displays balance, usage, context, and peak-valley info with interactive animations.
description.zh: DSH桌面挂件插件，以鲸鱼娘形象显示余额、用量、上下文和峰谷信息，支持右键菜单、拖动甩抛与弹跳动画。

description.en: A draggable floating Xueqiu market panel for real-time A-share/HK/US quotes, K-lines, intraday charts, hot lists, and 7x24 news without login.
description.zh: 雪球实时行情面板：免登录查看A股/港股/美股行情、K线、分时、热榜与7×24快讯，可拖拽且自动刷新。

description.en: Discovery and management wrappers around gh CLI for AI coding agents, enabling repo, code, issue, and PR search.
description.zh: Discovery + management wrappers around gh CLI for AI coding agents. find_repos, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summary, code search, issue/PR search, org audits.

description.en: QQ bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness via OneBot v11/NapCat, adding persona, memory, mood, web access and a web console.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人插件（OneBot v11 / NapCat），支持人设、记忆、心情、联网与网页控制台。

description.en: Task state handoff between AI harnesses (DeepSeek, Claude Code, Codex) without chat logs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI Harness 之间传递任务状态，无需聊天记录。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness plugins for vulnerabilities and breaking changes in dependencies.
description.zh: 持续监控 DeepSeek Harness 插件的依赖漏洞与破坏性变更，并评估其对插件的影响。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web background settings plugin with solid color, image, and opacity controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页背景设置插件，支持纯色、图片和透明度控制。

description.en: Integrates a proactive AI voice assistant with Live2D avatar into DSH web, enabling voice chat and task-completion summaries.
DSH web plugin that combines message rollback, deletion, and branching, forking conversations at disk level with zero npm dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，三合一实现消息回滚、删除与分支，磁盘级对话分叉，零 npm 依赖。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider for DSH that fans out to 11 backends concurrently, merges and dedups results, and works even if some backends fail.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供统一网页搜索，并发调用 11 个后端，合并去重结果，部分后端失败时仍可用。

description.en: Chat-area UX plugin that improves the interaction experience of the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI, with a glassmorphism style.
description.zh: 优化 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）网页界面聊天区交互体验的插件，带玻璃拟态风格。

description.en: Registers the dsh web server as an auto-starting, self-healing background service.
description.zh: 将 dsh web 服务器注册为开机自启、带看门狗自动恢复的后台服务，支持 LaunchAgent、systemd 或 cron。

description.en: DeepSeek usage sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness showing account balance, unit pricing, and peak/off-peak indicator.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，显示账户余额（官方 API）、当前单价及高峰/低谷时段标识，支持中英文界面。

description.en: Enhances DSH WebUI file input with Ctrl+V paste, drag-and-drop, and file selection, copying files to a temp directory.
description.zh: 增强 DSH WebUI 文件输入：支持 Ctrl+V 粘贴（首次弹窗提示）、拖拽和选择文件，发送时将文件复制到会话工作区临时目录。

description.en: Exports the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as Markdown, PDF, or a long PNG image.
description.zh: 将当前 DeepSeek Harness 对话导出为 Markdown、PDF 或长图 PNG。

description.en: A DSH plugin that splits the chat flow into independent panes, each bound to its own session, with drag-and-drop and keyboard controls.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把聊天流拆分为多个独立窗格，每个窗格绑定各自的会话，并支持拖放与键盘操作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory management plugin providing basic memory functionality for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基础记忆功能的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆管理插件

description.en: A DSH plugin that tracks and displays token consumption statistics for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 统计并显示 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）运行中的 token 消耗数据。

description.en: Read-only Git/SVN code review plugin that reads specified changes and explicit context, reusing the host DSH agent model to report evidence-backed issues.
description.zh: 只读的 Git/SVN 代码审查插件，读取指定变更与显式上下文，复用当前 DSH Agent 模型，输出有证据、可校验位置的问题。

description.en: Adds a sleep tool that lets AI models pause for a set number of milliseconds, useful for wait conditions.
description.zh: 为 AI 模型添加 sleep 工具，可按指定毫秒数暂停，用于等待条件。

description.en: SSH session management with SFTP, proxy, port forwarding, and AI terminals for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 SSH 会话管理，支持 SFTP 文件传输、代理、端口转发和 AI 终端。

description.en: Adds a Plugin Manager tab in dsh settings to display, toggle, and annotate plugins with Chinese descriptions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置→插件中新增插件管家标签页，用中文展示各插件用途，提供一键启停并实时热生效，内置备注编辑并保存到本地覆盖文件长期生效。

description.en: Automatically generates and updates smart conversation titles using an LLM after each dialogue turn.
description.zh: 用LLM自动总结会话并生成智能标题，每轮对话后更新。

description.en: Connects Feishu bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code, enabling multi-turn chat with the AI agent.
description.zh: 通过扫码将飞书机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，实现与 AI 智能体的多轮对话。

description.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness behavior: enforces tool-call rules, reduces parallelism on failure, and asks user after repeated fails.
description.zh: 增强DeepSeek Harness行为：强制工具调用规则，失败时降低并行度，连续失败后请求用户干预。

description.en: Modular AI research/engineering skills monorepo for DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code, with plugins, skills, bin scripts, and LaTeX templates.
description.zh: 模块化 AI 科研/工程技能 monorepo（DeepSeek Harness / Claude Code 通用）— plugins/ + skills/ + bin 脚本 + LaTeX 模板，验证环驱动

description.en: Integrates local Codex App Server as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with image input and output support.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex App Server 作为模型提供方接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持图像输入和输出。

description.en: Adds an approval mode button to DSH's permission dropdown, auto-approving tool calls in Workspace Write mode.
description.zh: 在 DSH 窗口权限下拉框（只读/工作区写入/完全访问）旁添加审批模式按钮，工作区写入模式下自动放行工具调用。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance, remaining ratio bar, and today's spend in the dsh sidebar footer.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费。

description.en: DSH plugin for Bilibili video understanding with timestamped frames, local ASR/OCR, and an optional independent vision model.
description.zh: DSH 哔哩哔哩视频理解插件，支持时间戳抽帧、本地 ASR/OCR 以及可选的独立视觉模型。

description.en: Adds right-click actions to file links in the DSH transcript: quote the path into the composer or reveal the file in your OS file manager.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话中的文件链接添加右键菜单：可将路径引用到输入框，或在系统文件管理器中显示该文件。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you edit any assistant reply and its reasoning/thinking chain directly inside the DeepSeek Harness chat.
description.zh: DSH 插件：可直接在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中编辑任意 AI 回复正文及其思维链（thinking）内容。

description.en: Replaces DSH native model selector with a Claude-style animated reasoning-effort slider and model picker.
description.zh: 将 DSH 原生模型选择器替换为带 Claude 风格动画的推理等级滑块与模型选择器。

description.en: Cross-session dispatch and approval bridge for DeepSeek Harness agents, with ten tools for spawning, messaging, listing, and managing sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话派活与审批桥插件，提供十个工具用于会话的创建、消息、列表与管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness context-compaction plugin adding benefit checks, bounded summary cache, explicit memory control and diagnostic-preserving tool trimming.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩插件，新增压缩收益判断、有界摘要缓存、显式记忆控制与保留诊断信息的工具输出裁剪。

description.en: Floating macOS glass usage panel for DeepSeek Harness, showing balance and token usage curves in Chinese UI.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的悬浮用量面板，以macOS毛玻璃风格显示余额和Token用量曲线。

description.en: Injects a user-editable global system-prompt segment into every DSH session, including sub-agents and workflow sub-agents, taking effect instantly.
description.zh: 把设置页中可随时改写的文本作为全局系统提示词段注入所有 DSH 会话（含子代理与工作流内部子代理），即时生效无需重启。

description.en: DSH panel that audits which skills each chat round used and installs, updates or removes skills inside the app.
description.zh: DSH 面板：统计每轮对话调用了哪些 skill，并可在应用内安装、更新、删除 skill。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop file upload to DSH web GUI, letting agents read any file via a local file chip.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加文件拖拽上传，拖入的文件会转成路径标签插入输入框，供智能体按本地路径读取该文件。

description.en: DSH plugin that asks clarifying questions and gets your confirmation before any new task is allowed to start.
description.zh: DSH 插件：任何新任务开工前先追问澄清需求，确认后才放行执行。

description.en: Adds a homepage surface to DSH with cards that open auxiliary features like plugin install, core updates and session status.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加主页界面，用卡片形式汇总并进入插件安装、核心更新和会话状态等辅助功能。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks for DeepSeek Harness to run commands on events without writing plugin code.
description.zh: Config-driven lifecycle hooks plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Adds a fixed in-window button to hot-restart DeepSeek Harness with no console windows, plus a self-check that writes a diagnostic report.
description.zh: 在窗口内提供固定按钮，一键零控制台热重启 DeepSeek Harness，并内置自检生成单文件诊断报告。

description.en: Interactive fiction plugin for DeepSeek Harness where each session is a book, offering pure novel-text text adventures across 19 worlds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 互动小说插件，一个会话即一本书，以封面开书、只写正文，覆盖19个世界。

description.en: An animated desktop-pet companion for the dsh Android app, with 106 packaged or auto-downloaded pet actions, chat bubbles and balance checks.
description.zh: 为 dsh 安卓手机版提供动画桌宠伴侣，内置或按需下载的 106 段动作，支持对话气泡与余额查询。

description.en: A-share (China stock) market panel for DSH Web: real-time indices, quotes, watchlist, screening, and 7x24 news.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 A 股行情面板，含实时指数、个股行情、自选股、选股筛选与 7x24 新闻。

description.en: A curated bundle of MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness, including memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright, and HTTP with verifier.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供精选的 MCP 服务器合集，一次安装即可获得演示、记忆、文件系统、GitHub、Playwright 和远程 HTTP 服务器，并带连通性验证器与 CI 检查。

description.en: Biomedical image analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness supporting X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and retinal modalities.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的医学影像分析插件，支持 X 光、CT、MRI、超声和视网膜影像。

description.en: Helps AI create HTML5 mini games with multiple engines, performance optimization, i18n, and single-file output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 小游戏制作插件 — 帮助 AI 快速创建 HTML5 小游戏，支持 Canvas、Phaser.js、Three.js 等引擎
