description.en: Automated novel writing and publishing pipeline with agent preset, visual workbench, and data-driven optimization.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动化小说写作发布流水线，提供迁移版 agent 预设、可视化实时渲染小说工作台与章节编辑、多平台发布配置及数据驱动优化闭环。

description.en: Auto-routes tasks in DeepSeek Harness: simple tasks run directly, complex tasks plan first with approval gate.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动路由预设：简单任务直接执行，复杂任务先规划并需审批。

description.en: DSH plugin that keeps OpenCode Zen and Go free-tier models working via session affinity, gateway origin headers, and tool-schema fallback.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过会话粘性、网关来源请求头和工具 schema 回退，让 OpenCode Zen 与 Go 免费模型持续可用。

description.en: Auto-selects per-message reasoning effort using a Jev System One judge, with per-model ladders, context envelopes and silent fallback.
description.zh: 由 Jev System One 判断每条消息的推理等级，支持按模型档位阶梯、上下文信封继承与静默回退。

description.en: Sends notifications to browser, system, or chat apps when a round ends or confirmation is needed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息提醒插件：回合结束或等待确认时向浏览器、系统、飞书/钉钉/企业微信/通用 Webhook 发送通知

description.en: Swift Cycle governance skill adapter for DeepSeek Harness; user-invoked, version-pinned, offline-verifiable.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Swift Cycle 治理技能适配器，由用户主动调用，版本锁定，可离线验证。

description.en: Scans DSH agent preset declarations, auto-repairs mechanically fixable version breakage with atomic writes and .bak backups, reports the rest.
description.zh: 扫描失效的 DSH Agent 预设声明，自动对齐可机械修复的版本语法（原子写、.bak 备份），其余逐条报告文件与行号。

description.en: Kanban board inside DeepSeek Harness for agent-driven planning, with per-project isolation and disk persistence.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内提供看板，用于智能体驱动的任务规划，支持按项目隔离并将数据持久化到磁盘。

description.en: Red-team evaluation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, rebuilt from the official 1.1.90 release baseline and republished from 1.1.91 onward.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 红队评测插件，以官方 1.1.90 发布包为基线重建，自 1.1.91 起继续发布。

description.en: Patched DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 build of dsh-purge with a cwd prompt-variable fix and a Windows CJK path restart fix.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-purge 的 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 修补版本，修复 cwd 提示变量与 Windows 中文路径重启问题。

description.en: Connects QQ private and group chats to a DeepSeek Harness agent over OneBot v11/NapCat, with voice, images, pokes and stickers.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot v11 / NapCat 把 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness 的同一个 Agent，支持语音、图片、戳一戳和表情。

description.en: Toggles REA's 207-tool reverse-engineering MCP server and its three workflow skills on or off together in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中一键同时启用或停用 REA 的 207 个逆向工程 MCP 工具及其三个工作流技能。

description.en: Adds missing reasoning effort vocabulary to DeepSeek Harness LLM provider settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 大模型提供方的设置补充缺失的推理强度（reasoning effort）选项词表。

description.en: Session manager for DeepSeek Harness web UI to move, archive, backup, and import conversations across workspaces.
description.zh: Session manager for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: move, archive, restore, backup/export and import conversations across workspaces. Trilingual (English / 简体 / 繁體).

description.en: Skin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness to search and install community skins directly from the settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的皮肤市场，可在设置页直接搜索和安装社区皮肤。

description.en: Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness — lossless zero-model context rollover
Configures personalization settings for the DeepSeek agent, including nickname, response style, tone, and custom commands.
description.zh: 配置DeepSeek智能体的个性化设置，包括昵称、回复风格、语气和自定义命令。

description.en: Adds a layered animated splash screen with parallax and a matching main-UI wallpaper to DeepSeek Harness, both replaceable with live preview in settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加多层动效开机动画与配套主界面壁纸，两张图均可在设置中实时预览更换。

description.en: A DSH plugin that walks a student's thesis from topic selection to defense in nine gated stages, with full audit trails.
description.zh: DSH 毕业论文插件，按九阶段从选题推进到答辩，全程留痕并由学生逐步拍板。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin to switch the language used by the agent's internal thinking/reasoning process.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于切换智能体内部思考（推理/链式思考）过程的语言。

description.en: Inline video player for sidebar file preview supporting common video formats.
description.zh: 在侧边栏打开 mp4、webm、mov、mkv、avi 等视频文件时，内联渲染带进度条的可播放 video 播放器。

description.en: Sidebar weather panel for DeepSeek Harness with auto-location, 5-day forecast, hourly precipitation, CMA alerts and typhoon tracks, all client-side with no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏天气面板：自动定位、5 天预报、逐小时降水、中央气象台预警与台风路径，纯浏览器端运行且无需 API key。

description.en: Multi-provider web search plugin with zero-key direct search, free-tier APIs, auto-fallback, and GUI settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多供应商网页搜索插件，支持免密钥直连必应/百度、Tavily/Brave/Serper/博查免费额度接口、SearXNG 令牌认证、自动故障回退，并内置网页设置界面。

description.en: Functy fork of dsh-workbuddy-connect that links WorkBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness with a dashboard, multi-account rotation and quota display.
description.zh: dsh-workbuddy-connect 的 Functy 分支，将 WorkBuddy 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供仪表盘、多账号轮换与额度展示。

description.en: Adds WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness via built-in OAuth device-code login, with multi-account rotation and cooldowns.
description.zh: 通过内置 OAuth 设备码登录把 WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持多账号轮转与失败冷却。

description.en: Sidebar plugin that sorts DeepSeek Harness workspaces by latest conversation, compacts chats with hover reveal, and scrolls to the selected session.
description.zh: 侧边栏插件：按最近会话排序 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，紧凑显示对话并悬停展开，自动滚动到所选会话。

description.en: Adds a 'workspace write++' permission tier to DSH that lets Git Bash/PowerShell run without the restricted process sandbox on Windows.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加“工作区修改++”权限档，让 Git Bash/PowerShell 在 Windows 上不受受限令牌沙箱限制。

description.en: Worktime statistics plugin that tracks agent activity and token usage with gamified cultivation progress.
description.zh: 🐂🐴 牛马修仙看板：DeepSeek Harness 工时统计 × 修仙养成——把每一分钟劳动，都修成境界（日/周/月 + 学年年历，炼气→宇宙洪荒）

description.en: Puts a multi-repo task into its own worktree space where each repo gets a worktree on one shared task branch, auto-registered as a DSH workspace.
description.zh: 把一个含多个 Git 仓库的任务放入独立工作空间：各仓库用同一任务分支各开一个 worktree，并自动注册为 DSH 工作区。

description.en: Turns local WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins into OpenAI-compatible endpoints for DeepSeek Harness, with account pooling, auto-switching and a settings panel.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 桌面登录接入 DeepSeek Harness：每家一个 OpenAI 兼容本地端点，支持账号池、自动换号与设置面板。

description.en: Reverse proxy bridging ZCode CLI client agents into DeepSeek Harness with persistent app-server channel, true streaming, image input and tool delegation.
description.zh: 将 ZCode CLI 客户端 agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的反向代理，支持常驻 app-server 通道、真流式、图片输入与工具委派。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to PowerContext Server for recall, memory, handoff, experience, and skills.
description.zh: 通过 HTTP 连接 PowerContext 服务器，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供回忆、记忆、交接、经验和技能调用。

description.en: DSH third-party plugin marketplace: browse, search and install community-recommended plugins, with an optional read-only AI risk review.
description.zh: DSH 第三方插件市场：按用途浏览、搜索并安装社区推荐插件，安装后可选择只读 AI 安全审查。

description.en: Companion repo for book 'Teach Math with Manim', providing 60+ animation source codes and an AI skill for creating Manim teaching animations.
description.zh: 《用Manim讲好数学》配套仓库，提供60多个教学动画源码和AI技能，用于制作Manim教学动画。

description.en: A sidebar plugin that identifies DOI/arXiv/titles, fetches metadata and full text, saves to local library or exports, with built-in PDF reader.
description.zh: 侧边栏识别DOI/arXiv及标题，抓取元数据全文，写入本地文献库或导出，内置PDF阅读器。

description.en: Cross-checks agent claims against the session's real tool activity, downgrading anything without log evidence from VERIFIED to UNVERIFIED.
description.zh: 将 agent 结论与会话真实工具调用记录交叉核对，缺乏日志证据的结论从 VERIFIED 降级为 UNVERIFIED。

description.en: DSH Research Graph organizes research topics into traceable knowledge cards and reusable AI discussions, with graph visualization.
description.zh: 研图插件将研究主题整理为可溯源的知识卡片与可复用的 AI 讨论，并提供图谱可视化。

description.en: Sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI that lists clickable anchors for each conversation turn and smooth-scrolls to them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的侧边栏插件，为每轮对话列出可点击锚点，点击后平滑滚动到对应位置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin packaging 31 SKILL.md skills for the Five Movements and Six Qi (yunqi) AI agent skills.
description.zh: 将五运六气 AI Agent 的 31 个 SKILL.md 技能封装为 dsh Cordis 插件，可通过一行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Adds a model and reasoning-effort switcher to the DSH composer with an Off/Max effort slider.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在输入区加入模型与思考力度切换器，并提供从 Off 到 Max 的力度滑杆。

description.en: Persistent memory plugin for DSH following the Qoder Agent SDK contract: a background pass saves what matters, a budgeted pass loads it into agent context.
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现的持久记忆插件，遵循 Qoder Agent SDK 记忆契约：后台 pass 决定并写入值得记的内容，有预算的 pass 将其装入 Agent 上下文。

description.en: Adds an animated GrokBot-style buddy avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的“Deep diving...”指示器前添加一个 GrokBot 风格动画小伙伴头像，并同步显示打字机效果的状态文字。

description.en: Provides richer bottom bar information display for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 底栏提供更丰富的信息显示。

description.en: Launch-animation plugin for the DSH Web GUI and desktop client, with built-in and custom launch skins plus a settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 和桌面客户端提供启动动画的插件，支持内置与自定义启动皮肤及设置页面。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH sessions from the UI or the session_delete tool, cascading into owned subagent sessions while leaving forked branches intact.
description.zh: 通过界面按钮或 session_delete 工具永久删除 DSH 会话，级联清理所属子代理会话，且不影响分叉分支。

description.en: Restart plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Electron desktop app, adding restart entry points and cleaning leaked temp snapshots.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版重启插件，提供多处重启入口并清理残留的临时快照。

description.en: A pet companion for DeepSeek Harness with multi-task reminders, interactions, and Skill-based custom pets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供宠物陪伴、多任务提醒与交互，并支持通过 Skill 自定义宠物。

description.en: Russian (ru) language pack that localizes the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, installed as a hybrid dsh.bundle + dsh.client plugin.
description.zh: 俄语（ru）语言包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供本地化，以 dsh.bundle + dsh.client 混合插件形式安装。

description.en: Integrates Codex-style GPT models into DSH with thinking effort, web search fallback, compaction, and exec commands.
description.zh: 将 Codex 风格 GPT 模型集成到 DSH，支持思考强度、网络搜索回退、压缩和 exec 命令。

description.en: Customizes DSH WebUI background with gallery images, cropping, effects, and slideshow; real-time preview and persistence.
description.zh: 用图库图片自定义 DSH WebUI 背景，支持裁剪、特效和幻灯片，实时预览并持久保存。

description.en: Adds a background task status bar to chat pages, showing running task count, expandable details, and real-time output tail.
description.zh: DSH 插件：后台任务状态条（对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail）。官方 bundle 插件，dsh plugin --profile web add 安装

description.en: Auto-resume plugin for DeepSeek Harness: continues interrupted agent sessions with retry, model switching, context compression, and visual rules.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动续跑插件：会话中断后自动续跑，支持退避重试、失败换模型、上下文压缩和可视化规则。

description.en: Adds session deletion to DSH with a local recycle bin, recoverable deletes, undo toast, and explicit permanent deletion.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加会话删除功能：删除即移入本机回收站、可恢复撤销，并提供显式彻底删除。

description.en: A plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a sidebar button to open chat.deepseek.com in a separate window or fallback to new tab.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness在侧边栏添加“网页对话”按钮，点击可在独立子窗口或新标签页打开 chat.deepseek.com。

description.en: Model-based permission approval system that automatically answers approval requests via a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于独立审查模型的权限审批插件，可自动应答 DeepSeek Harness 的审批请求，代为批准。

description.en: Enhanced shared browser for DeepSeek Harness with visible and AI-driven web views, page chrome, operation trail, and JS dialog auto-accept.
description.zh: Enhanced shared browser for DeepSeek Harness: visible + AI-driven WebContentsView, ego-style page chrome, operation trail, JS dialog auto-accept, per-task windows & spaces, Electron 42.x pinned

description.en: Windows XP Luna desktop theme for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 Windows XP Luna 桌面主题，包含多窗口桌面、XP 窗口边框、任务栏和 Bliss 壁纸。

description.en: Installs code-server (web VSCode) as a dsh plugin for professional file editing.
description.zh: 将 code-server（网页版 VSCode）打包安装为 dsh 插件，用于实现专业的文件编辑。

description.en: Migrates Codex desktop pet skin into DeepSeek Harness, rendering an interactive pet with animations, dialogs, and settings in DSH Web.
description.zh: 将 Codex 桌宠皮肤迁移到 DeepSeek Harness，在 DSH Web 界面渲染带动画、多会话对话框和设置面板的桌宠，一键迁移即插即用。

description.en: Reuses the local Doubao desktop client's login to serve Seed-series models as a DSH provider, with a read-only quota overview.
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端的登录态，将 Seed 系列模型接入 DSH 作为 provider，并提供只读额度概览。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel that shows SenseNova Token Plan credit usage in real time and can optionally register SenseNova models as a DSH provider.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏面板，实时展示商汤 Token Plan 积分用量，并可选把商汤模型注册为 DSH provider。

description.en: Optimizes AI agent context by sandboxing tool output, persisting session memory in FTS5, and enforcing system-prompt routing.
description.zh: 通过沙箱化工具输出、在FTS5中持久化会话记忆并强制系统提示路由，优化AI代理上下文。

description.en: Floating desktop overlay that shows what percentage of the HTTP header budget login cookies occupy, turns red past 50%, and offers one-click cleanup to avoid 431 errors.
description.zh: 桌面版右下角浮窗，用百分比显示登录 cookie 占用的请求头空间，过半变红，并提供一键清理，避免启动多次后出现 431 错误。

description.en: Replaces the DSH desktop bottom stats line with a configurable status bar: 10 sortable fields, DeepSeek peak/off-peak cost estimates and account balance.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端底部统计行替换为可配置状态栏：10 个可排序字段、DeepSeek 峰谷费用估算与账户余额。

description.en: Decentralized multi-device collaboration plugin with mDNS discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct exec for dph agents.
description.zh: 把多台设备组成协作集群的 dph 插件，通过 mDNS 发现设备、密钥配对并用 SSH 直接执行命令，工具自动注册给 dph 智能体。

description.en: Turns development into an RPG: earn XP from tasks, unlock achievements, challenges, and seasonal rewards.
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG 的 DSH 插件：回合/工具/待办积累 XP、47 枚成就+稀有度、每日/每周挑战、每日抽奖、赛季商店、7 款主题皮肤、多称号、活跃日历+荣誉墙。事件流驱动，装好自动计分。

description.en: A docs panel for reading your local Markdown manuals inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供文档面板，用于阅读本地 Markdown 手册。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API peak/off-peak pricing badge in Web UI with countdown and price details.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中实时显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷时段定价徽章，含倒计时与具体价格详情。

description.en: File claim/protection for concurrent DSH sessions with heartbeat takeover and async pending merge via git 3-way merge.
description.zh: 为并发 DSH 会话提供同一工作区的文件认领与保护，支持心跳、过期接管，并用 git 三方合并处理异步待合并区。

description.en: Vision bridge plugin for dsh adding image understanding to text-only models via luma-mcp, using free Qwen3-VL-Flash by default.
description.zh: 为 dsh 纯文本模型通过 luma-mcp 接入图像理解能力，默认使用免费的 Qwen3-VL-Flash 模型。

description.en: Adds a composer toggle that injects a high-budget, no-holds-barred instruction into the system prompt for fuller responses.
description.zh: 在输入框添加开关，向系统提示注入高预算、无限制指令，让模型输出更完整。

description.en: Self-contained HTTPS gateway for remote access to DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 以 Caddy 层实现的 dsh 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供自包含的 HTTPS 远程访问网关

description.en: Bridges Google's Gemini OAuth subscription into DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 将 Google Gemini OAuth 订阅桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，提供 OpenAI 兼容接口。

description.en: Turns your Google AI Pro subscription into a DSH coding model pool with multimodal input, frontend/image generation, and multi-account scheduling.
description.zh: 把你的 Google AI Pro 订阅变成 DSH 编程模型池，支持多模态、前端生成、生图与多账号调度。

description.en: For DSH on Windows, makes the bash tool use Git Bash instead of pwsh.
description.zh: 在DSH Windows上，使bash工具使用Git Bash而非pwsh。

description.en: A particle-orb floating desktop assistant and pet for DSH Desktop that handles quick permission approvals and ⌃⌥J quick chat.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的粒子光球悬浮桌面助手兼桌面宠物，支持快速审批权限与 ⌃⌥J 快捷对话。

description.en: High-resolution image recognition enhancement plugin for DeepSeek vision models with chunked highres_read tool.
description.zh: 为 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 放宽图片限制，并提供 highres_read 分块识图工具的高清识图增强插件。

description.en: Six-max No-Limit Hold'em poker plugin for DeepSeek Harness with one human and five LLM agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六人桌无限注德州扑克，由一名人类玩家与五个大语言模型玩家对战。

description.en: Front-end plugin for DeepSeek Harness that replaces Effort dropdown with a three-gear avatar slider.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的前端插件，将 Effort 下拉选项替换为三档头像滑块

description.en: DSH plugin that manages multiple WorkBuddy accounts in Settings and exposes their models to DSH and OpenAI-compatible clients.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件：在设置中管理多个 WorkBuddy 账号，并把模型接入 DSH 与任意 OpenAI 兼容客户端。

description.en: A visual Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web that inspects repositories, runs common Git actions, and safely executes AI-generated workflows.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的可视化 Git 工作台，可查看仓库、执行常用 Git 操作并安全运行 AI 生成的工作流。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the LINE Messaging API with Cloudflare Tunnel, selectable personas, proactive messages and a settings panel.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 LINE Messaging API，支持 Cloudflare Tunnel、可选人格、主动消息和设置面板。

description.en: Obsidian-compatible long-term memory vault for DSH with local Markdown storage, sidebar management, token-budgeted recall, and durable journal outbox.
description.zh: Obsidian 兼容的 DSH 长期记忆库，支持本地 Markdown 存储、侧边栏管理、按 token 预算召回和持久日志发件箱。

description.en: Unified image and video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a provider catalog, three tools, async video contract, rate-limit backoff, settings page, gallery and CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生图+生视频整合插件：统一供应商目录、三个工具、异步视频契约、限流退避、设置页与画廊及 CLI。

description.en: A local-first DSH memory plugin for long-form roleplay and companion chats, giving AI characters fading, uncertain, knowledge-limited recall.
description.zh: 面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的本地优先 DSH 记忆插件，让 AI 角色拥有会淡忘、会不确定且只知其应知之事。

description.en: A minimal DSH mobile remote that sends only your prompts and the AI's final replies to your phone, hiding all execution detail.
description.zh: 极简的 DSH 手机遥控器：移动端只接收你发出的指令和 AI 的最终结论，屏蔽全部执行过程。

description.en: A DSH plugin providing a Model Pro settings page for full lifecycle management of llm-pi-ai providers.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，提供 Model Pro 设置页，用于对 llm-pi-ai 提供商进行全生命周期管理。

description.en: A web UI panel for DeepSeek Harness showing real-time keyword statistics from reasoning blocks to reflect reasoning style.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 面板，实时统计推理块中的关键词，以反映推理风格。

description.en: OneBot v11 hub that relays QQ events verbatim to downstream bots while giving the agent a full event timeline, action ledger and 28 onebot_* tools.
description.zh: OneBot v11 中枢，将 QQ 事件原样转发给下游机器人，并为代理提供完整事件时间线、操作账本与 28 个 onebot_* 工具。

description.en: Expands the opencode go provider model list on dsh from 27 to 38 models without editing settings or handling credentials.
description.zh: 将 dsh 上 opencode go 提供商的模型列表由 27 个扩展到 38 个，无需改设置或处理凭据。

description.en: A DSH preset generator that splits one agent into a lead plus on-demand sub-agents, each loading only its own tools.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 预设生成器，把单一 agent 拆成指挥加按需加载的专属子 agent，各自只带本行工具。

description.en: Automatically blocks or reroutes expensive official DeepSeek API requests during specified peak hours, with configurable target provider.
description.zh: 在指定高峰时段自动拦截或切换DeepSeek官方API请求，避免高价；可配置目标提供商。

description.en: Lets your DeepSeek Harness agent call you, ask questions aloud, and use your spoken answers to guide the run.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体拨打你的真实电话，语音提问并由你的口头回答引导运行。

description.en: Bridges Claude Code's memory, skills, and config into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 的记忆、技能和配置桥接进 DeepSeek Harness，无需迁移。

description.en: Checks DSH plugin upgrades, tests multi-host compatibility, validates format-1 market index, and auto-comments compatibility matrices on GitHub PRs.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件升级，测试多主机兼容性，校验 format-1 市场索引，并在 GitHub PR 上自动评论兼容性矩阵。

description.en: LAN mesh plugin for DSH: auto-discovers DSH instances on the same subnet and lets you dispatch tasks to peer agents across machines.
description.zh: DSH 局域网 Mesh 插件：自动发现同网段的 DSH 实例，侧栏显示各机在线状态，并可跨机双向把任务派给对端 agent 执行。

description.en: Adds a chat navigation bar with message nodes on the right edge, offering hover previews and smooth click-to-jump.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话节点导航条插件：在对话区右缘渲染一列短横线节点串（每条真实用户消息一个节点），跟随阅读位置；鼠标靠近节点串时，节点条「变形弹出」为单行消息预览面板（覆盖原位置，移开复原），点击任意预览平滑跳转 + 高亮横线，节点过多时可在悬停区域内用滚轮滑动浏览

description.en: Integrates open-mcp-apps into deepseek-harness as sidebar containers with sessions, agent status, and inline widgets
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接入 deepseek-harness，让应用作为侧边栏容器运行，各自拥有会话、代理状态栏并支持内联组件渲染

description.en: Import chat history from claude-code/codex/reasonix/zcode into dsh sessions for continued conversation.
description.zh: 把 claude-code、codex、reasonix、zcode 的聊天记录导入 dsh 会话，以便继续对话。

description.en: Compact vertical prompt quick-jump rail for DeepSeek Harness web session page.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页会话页显示紧凑的纵向提示词跳转条，每条横杠对应一条已加载的普通用户提示词，悬停或键盘聚焦可预览，点击可滚动跳转到该提示词。

description.en: Community build of dsh-purge restoring 23 red-team skills plus an exact-host own-server allowlist for DSH security testing.
description.zh: dsh-purge 社区构建版，恢复 23 个红队技能并加入精确主机自有服务器白名单，用于 DSH 安全测试。

description.en: Quote selected conversation content into a targeted follow-up turn for DeepSeek Harness via TUI and web interfaces.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness，通过 TUI 或 Web 界面将选中的对话内容引用到定向后续轮次。

description.en: Installs a pinned local copy of rea-agents and runs its MCP server for DeepSeek Harness, upgrading only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装固定版本的 rea-agents 并在本地运行其 MCP 服务器，仅在你点击更新时升级。

description.en: Displays images read in conversation (read_image results) as thumbnails with zoom in DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 对话流中以缩略图展示 read_image 读取的图片，并支持缩放按钮、滚轮和 1:1 的页面内全精度放大。

description.en: DSH router plugin adding CodeBuddy as an OpenAI-compatible AI provider with OAuth login, token refresh, and daily sign-in.
description.zh: 为 dsh router 提供 CodeBuddy AI 供应商（OAuth 登录、自动刷新、每日签到积分）。

description.en: Adds parallel side chats to DeepSeek Harness using hidden child sessions with on-demand parent context.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供并行侧边聊天，使用隐藏子会话并按需继承父会话上下文。

description.en: Skill cockpit for DSH: one page in the app-level nav listing every skill this machine exposes, why a skill is invisible, and a one-file toggle. (early / work in progress)
Telegram bot that connects DSH sessions to DMs with streaming replies, approvals, structured questions and session controls.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话接入 Telegram 私聊的机器人，支持流式回复、审批、结构化提问和会话控制。

description.en: External vision model tool for DeepSeek Harness — inspect_image sends images to OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供外部视觉模型工具，inspect_image 可将图片发送到任意兼容 OpenAI 的接口，如 GPT-4o、Qwen-VL、GLM-4V、Ollama 等。

description.en: An Agent Skill that turns one travel request into an hour-by-hour, verified China itinerary delivered as a ready-to-open HTML page.
description.zh: 一个旅行规划 Agent Skill：把一句需求变成逐小时、经核实、可直接照着订的中国境内行程，并生成精美 HTML 页面。

description.en: Turns videos into ffmpeg contact-sheet storyboards so the model can probe, view and zoom into frames token-efficiently.
description.zh: 用 ffmpeg 把视频生成联系表分镜图，让模型以低 token 成本探测、观看并放大视频帧。

description.en: Browse workspace files and view Git diffs in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中浏览工作区目录和文件，并结合 Git 显示文件改动。

description.en: Math modeling skill suite for DeepSeek Harness with 8 skills, OCR, workflows, and paper templates for human-in-the-loop modeling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的数学建模技能套件，含 8 个技能、OCR、工作流与论文模板，支持人工介入的建模流程。

description.en: MCP bridge to drive DeepSeek Harness dsh agents for tasks, sessions, files, presets, and stats.
description.zh: Hermes ↔ DeepSeek Harness MCP bridge: drive dsh agents (tasks, sessions, files, presets, stats) from any MCP client. Hermes = brain, Harness = arms.

description.en: Chinese translation of Matt Pocock's 25 agent skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将 Matt Pocock 的 25 个 agent 技能正文全部译为简体中文，供 DeepSeek Harness 使用。

description.en: Organizes unlimited conversation tabs into editor-style groups in DeepSeek Harness Web UI with drag-and-drop splitting.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中把不限数量的对话标签页按编辑器风格分组，并支持拖拽拆分。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style conversation outline rail to DeepSeek Harness Web with hover preview and click-to-jump.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加 Codex 风格对话大纲右侧栏，悬停显示预览，点击可跳转到对应消息位置

description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness Web answers richly illustrated and adds GPT-style citation badges to web-searched content.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness Web 的回答图文并茂，并为联网搜索内容加上 GPT 式引用角标。

description.en: Adds a persistent session progress bar to the DSH Web UI input dock, showing real-time progress of todos and token generation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 输入框停靠区常驻会话进度条，显示待办事项真实进度与实时 token 生成速率，支持中断橘红状态和待办提醒，无需改动核心。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style code review sidebar and safe per-turn undo functionality to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Codex 风格的代码审查侧边栏，并支持按轮次安全撤销。

description.en: Integrates GetNote (得到大脑) with DeepSeek Harness, enabling natural language search, save, and read of notes.
description.zh: 将得到大脑（Get笔记）接入 DeepSeek Harness，可用自然语言搜索、保存和读取笔记。

description.en: Gitea/Forgejo toolkit for DeepSeek Harness to manage issues, pull requests, CI, releases, and operations.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Gitea/Forgejo 工具包，管理问题、拉取请求、CI、发布和操作。

description.en: Run multi-agent task pipelines for planning, executing, reviewing, and delivering code via a visual kanban.
description.zh: 在 DSH 上以可视化看板运行多智能体任务流水线，完成规划、执行、审查与代码交付，并可验证完成情况。

description.en: Isolates faulty plugins so the DSH web service still starts, with quarantine list and one-click recovery.
description.zh: 隔离故障插件，使 DSH Web 服务仍能启动，并提供隔离列表与一键恢复。

description.en: A scroll-spy chat message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness, expanding like a scroll painting on hover for quick message jumping.
description.zh: 画卷式消息导航栏：右侧竖条 hover 展开画卷，scroll-spy 高亮居中跟随，与 better-sidebar 双面板动画同步避让

description.en: Archived sessions manager for DeepSeek Harness web UI: view, release, delete archived session files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于查看、释放和删除已归档的会话文件。

description.en: Suggests the next prompt after each agent turn and shows it as ghost text in the web input box.
description.zh: 每轮 agent 完成后建议下一条提示词，并以幽灵文本形式显示在网页输入框中。

description.en: Enables an IDE-like three-pane workspace inside DeepSeek Harness: file tree, CodeMirror editor, preview tabs, and chat with file references.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中提供类IDE三栏工作区：文件树、CodeMirror编辑器、预览标签页与聊天，支持文件内容引用和思维分支视图。

description.en: Local-first persistent memory infrastructure with hot bootstrap, cold recall, transactional writes, and read-only governance.
description.zh: 本地优先的持久记忆基础设施，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供热启动引导、中文 BM25 冷召回、租约锁事务写入和只读治理。

description.en: DSH scheduled task plugin: cron-based execution of scripts and Agent tasks with notifications and archiving.
description.zh: DSH 定时任务插件：侧栏「定时任务」入口，cron 定时执行 shell / python / node 脚本、Skill 与 Agent 任务；支持 chicheng-push 与 messaging-core 推送通知、会话归档、移动端适配。

description.en: DSH web message push plugin supporting multiple channels (Server酱/PushPlus/Bark/钉钉/企微/Telegram/飞书/Webhook) with API for other plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供多渠道消息推送，支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企微、Telegram、飞书、Webhook 等，并可通过 pushNotifier 服务或 /push/api 接口供其他插件调用。

description.en: Adds full Russian language support to DeepSeek Harness web UI with one-command install.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness web UI提供完整的俄语支持，一键安装。

description.en: ADHD behavioral coaching skill that breaks tasks into micro-steps, manages overwhelm, and supports task execution in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ADHD behavioral coaching skill for DeepSeek Harness. Guides readers through task execution - breaks tasks into micro-steps, manages overwhelm, provides launch rituals, calibrates time estimates, and r

description.en: A plugin porting 267 Chinese AI expert role definitions for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植 267 个即插即用的中文 AI 专家角色定义，覆盖前端开发、区块链安全、小红书运营、抖音策略等领域。

description.en: Enables cross-session agent-to-agent messaging by addressing sessions by name and delivering messages to their inbox.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 中的代理按名称指定其他会话，并将消息投递到其收件箱，实现跨会话通信。

description.en: AI skill that reviews non-scanned PDF/DOCX bid documents for commercial and technical risks against tender requirements.
description.zh: AI投标灵标书审核 Skill：稳定审核非扫描 PDF/DOCX 的商务标、技术标与通用文档风险

description.en: Angelia light/dark glass themes for DeepSeek Harness with parallax and graceful degradation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Angelina 浅色与深色玻璃风格主题，带视差效果并支持优雅降级。

description.en: HTTP ingress plugin that lets AstrBot (QQ/OneBot/official IM) drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent.
description.zh: HTTP 入口插件，让 AstrBot（QQ / OneBot / 官方 IM）驱动本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as attachment files in DeepSeek Harness via a web client paste listener.
description.zh: 通过网页端粘贴监听，在 DeepSeek Harness 中将较大的粘贴文本自动保存为附件文件

description.en: A DSH plugin that shows a floating balance and provides one-click exit.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，悬浮显示余额，并提供一键退出功能。

description.en: Sidebar usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing tokens, pricing, ranks, achievements, and heatmap.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏用量与成本面板：官方峰谷计价 · 1M 上下文 · 词勋段位 · 成就与热力图

description.en: A BangoCat-style typing feedback widget that auto-snaps to the DSH composer and window edges, with customizable art and sound.
description.zh: 一个BangoCat风格输入反馈小挂件，可自动吸附在DSH输入框及窗口边缘，支持自定义形象和音效。

description.en: Playwright-powered browser automation for driving real web pages: fill forms, click flows, scrape content, and capture screenshots.
description.zh: 基于 Playwright 的浏览器自动化插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 驱动真实网页：填写表单、执行点击流程、抓取内容并截图。

description.en: Built-in plugin catalog and safe GUI toggles for DeepSeek Harness Web, tailored for Chinese users.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供内置插件目录，并通过图形界面安全地开关这些插件。

description.en: CalDAV calendar plugin for dsh that lets models list, create, update, delete, and search calendar events.
description.zh: dsh 的 CalDAV 日历插件，支持模型列出、创建、更新、删除和搜索日历事件。

description.en: Token-efficient catgirl persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness, reducing token usage via UI-side personality rendering.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供省 token 的猫娘人格运行时，将人格渲染放在界面侧，实测减少 67% 输入 token、66% 缓存读取，猫娘渲染零 token。

description.en: Exports DeepSeek Harness sessions to readable Markdown, HTML, plain text, or ZIP transcripts with tool calls, images, timestamps, and usage.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话导出为可读的 Markdown、HTML、纯文本或 ZIP 文字稿，包含思考块、工具调用、代码块、图片、时间戳与用量。

description.en: Adds a Monaco editor and file tree to DSH chat for editing local workspace code directly.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中加入 Monaco 编辑器与文件树，可直接编辑本地工作区中的代码文件

description.en: A Codex-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web GUI that shows the current tier in one glance, with color and stardust shifting as the tier rises.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Codex 风格的推理强度滑杆，当前档位一目了然，颜色与星尘随档位递进变化。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a Codex-like project-free session, auto-creating a date- and topic-organized working directory on first send.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Codex 的无项目会话，首次发送时自动创建按日期和主题组织的工作目录。

description.en: Local ComfyUI image plugin for DSH: one generate_image tool covering text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting and background removal.
description.zh: DSH 的本地 ComfyUI 图片生成插件：单个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘和去背景。

description.en: Publishes a Command Code subscription (GOAT/Pro/Max) as llm-pi-ai provider routes, sharing one credential for account usage and web search.
description.zh: 将 Command Code 订阅（GOAT/Pro/Max）发布为 llm-pi-ai 提供商路由，并使用同一凭据支持账户用量与网络搜索。

description.en: Adds DeepSeek Harness composer helpers: input history, one-click Continue, and drag-and-drop queue reordering.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器添加输入历史、一键继续和拖拽重排队列等辅助功能。

description.en: A plugin that changes DSH themes, bundling several popular default themes.
description.zh: 为DSH更换主题，内置多种流行默认主题的插件。

description.en: Schedules and runs unattended agent/command tasks on cron schedules for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 按 cron 计划在 DeepSeek Harness 中无人值守地定时执行 agent 与命令任务。

description.en: WebUI plugin for configuring third-party API providers and custom models, including request headers, image input, and reasoning levels.
description.zh: 在 WebUI 中配置第三方 API 与自定义模型，可设置请求头、模型列表、图像输入和思考等级。

description.en: A single developer plugin for building, testing, diagnosing, and maintaining DSH plugins and core.
description.zh: 用于构建、测试、诊断和维护 DSH 插件与核心的开发者插件。

description.en: Shows inline diff badges and per-turn file change summaries for DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的编辑/写入工具行内联显示 +N −M 差异徽标，并提供每回合文件变更汇总卡片，支持滚动窗口差异、PTC 与代码分发回退及撤销，无需 git。

description.en: Reads .docx documents in the DSH right sidebar, rendering headings, lists, tables and inline images in a reading view.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏中阅读 .docx 文档，渲染标题、列表、表格和内嵌图片的阅读视图。

description.en: Edit any user turn in DeepSeek Harness and re-run the agent from that point without rewriting the append-only session log.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中编辑任意用户轮次并重新运行，且不改写只追加的会话日志。

description.en: Encrypted credential storage for DSH WebUI, converting plaintext YAML to AES-256-GCM ciphertext in-place.
description.zh: DSH WebUI 管理密码凭证加密插件，将明文 YAML 就地转换为 AES-256-GCM 密文存储。

description.en: Expert roster plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 623 experts in 22 categories, summonable as sub-agents via @ menu or model tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 专家名册插件：22 个分类、623 位专家，可通过 @ 菜单或模型工具召唤为子代理。

description.en: Local-first failure evidence capsules for capturing debugging data from DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话在本地捕获调试数据并生成故障证据胶囊

description.en: Windows-only DSH plugin that scans Low integrity labels and sandbox/Everyone deny ACEs, repairs them in one click and keeps rollback records.
description.zh: Windows 专用 DSH 插件：扫描 Low 完整性标签与沙箱/Everyone 拒绝 ACE，一键修复并保留可回滚记录。

description.en: DSH font plugin: set body/code font families, global font-size offset and weight, with Latin/CJK split pickers and live preview.
description.zh: DSH 字体插件：设置正文与代码字体族、全局字号偏移和字重，支持西文/中文分栏选择与实时预览。

description.en: Integrates Git operations (status, branch, diff, commit, push/pull, graph, blame) into a dsh session panel with a responsive UI.
description.zh: 将 Git 操作（状态、分支、差异、提交、推送拉取、提交图、溯源）集成到 dsh 会话面板，并适配移动端。

description.en: Visual GitHub login for DSH ecosystem using device code flow, no terminal, syncs tokens to gh CLI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 生态提供无需终端的 GitHub 可视化登录，走设备码流程，并把令牌同步到 gh CLI。

description.en: Paste a Grafana dashboard URL and fine-tune it through conversation with DeepSeek Harness, writing changes back to Grafana.
description.zh: 粘贴 Grafana 大盘 URL，通过对话微调并写回 Grafana，用于调试可视化。

description.en: Grok plugin for DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login, fused web/X search, and Imagine image generation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Grok 插件，支持 OAuth 登录，可在主循环中融合网页与 X 搜索，并调用 Imagine 生成图像。

description.en: Editable identity/persona kernel with evidence-based traits, memory, diary and mood that persists across any DSH session.
description.zh: 可编辑的身份人格内核，带证据制特质、记忆、日记与心情，在任意 DSH 会话中持久生效。

description.en: One-click ✦ button rewrites your draft prompt into an agent-ready one, replacing it in place with undo support.
description.zh: 输入框一键 ✦ 按钮把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并支持一键撤回。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness splash-screen plugin that hand-writes your text stroke by stroke, then settles onto the whale logo before fading into the main UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开屏插件：按真实笔顺逐笔写出你的文字，收束于鲸鱼锁标后淡出进入主界面。

description.en: Compacts DeepSeek Harness agent context via semantic tool-result pruning and deterministic receipt compaction to cut token usage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体压缩上下文：语义化裁剪工具结果并用确定性回执压缩，降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with per-task sessions and guarded workflow.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代理驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板，每个任务独立代理会话，人机流程受保护。

description.en: Agent-first plugin intelligence: verify existing plugins, find gaps, and generate build-ready briefs for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向智能体的 DeepSeek Harness 插件情报：核查已有插件、找出能力缺口，并生成可直接开工的构建简报。

description.en: Laya decision engine as a first-class Cordis service and model-visible tools for DeepSeek Harness.
Keeps edited dsh plugins as local git repos and deploys committed snapshots through atomic symlink swaps.
description.zh: 将编辑过的 dsh 插件保存为本地 git 仓库，并通过原子符号链接切换部署已提交的快照。

description.en: Map and routing tools for DeepSeek Harness, providing route planning, geocoding, reverse geocoding, and POI search.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供地图与路线工具，支持路线规划、地理编码、逆地理编码和 POI 搜索。

description.en: Extends DSH to configure custom model reasoning effort and multimodal input via a new settings page.
description.zh: 为DSH自定义模型提供商新增设置页面，用于配置推理强度和多模态输入

description.en: Searchable, sortable model picker for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with provider groups, favorites, prices, context windows, and live token cost.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可搜索、可排序的模型选择器，支持按提供商分组、收藏、显示模型价格与上下文窗口、实时统计每任务 token 费用，并可筛选本地模型。

description.en: Adds thinking-level controls and provider/model pickers with vision badges to DSH's model pages for third-party models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 第三方模型补齐思考等级：在模型页注入思考开关、强度编辑器和供应商→模型选择器。

description.en: Manage the DeepSeek Harness model list: hide unused models, rename them, and keep vendor billing rates visible.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 模型列表：隐藏用不到的模型、给模型改备注名，并保留厂商计费倍率可见。

description.en: A DSH tool that turns an audio or video file into a four-panel music report image plus numeric metrics, so the model can discuss tempo, key and structure.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 工具：把音频或视频转成四联图加一组数字指标，让模型能和你讨论曲子的节奏、调性与段落结构。

description.en: Native macOS notch app that shows DSH session status, unanswered questions and unread results, with inline answers and click-to-focus.
description.zh: 原生 macOS 刘海应用，显示 DSH 会话状态、待回答问题与未读结果，支持内联回答和点击跳回会话。

description.en: Agent-office dashboard for DSH: workspaces, sessions, token usage & subagents plus built-in Agent Mail inbox.
description.zh: DSH 的办公室仪表盘：一屏总览工作区、会话、token 用量和子代理，并内置 Agent 邮箱，可在面板内阅读、发送和回复邮件。

description.en: Enables models to accept and output vision, video, image, and speech, with ComfyUI image generation support.
description.zh: 让模型支持视觉、视频、图片、语音的输入输出，并可调用ComfyUI进行图像生成。

description.en: Brings OpenCode Zen's free AI models into DeepSeek Harness with zero config and live catalog discovery.
description.zh: 将OpenCode Zen的免费模型接入DeepSeek Harness，零配置，无需API密钥，实时发现模型目录。

description.en: Configures OpenRouter provider lists in the settings page, injects provider routing parameters into OpenRouter LLM requests, and persists settings to workspace state.
description.zh: 在设置页配置 OpenRouter 提供商列表，向 OpenRouter 请求注入 provider.only 和 provider.order 路由参数，并将状态持久化到工作区。

description.en: Content-aware PDF reading plugin that extracts text and renders complex pages as high DPI crops for vision models.
description.zh: 感知内容的 PDF 阅读插件，提取文本，并将复杂页面渲染成高 DPI 裁剪图供视觉模型使用。

description.en: Uses vision AI to translate PDFs page by page into Chinese, exporting a Chinese PDF plus an editable LaTeX source zip.
description.zh: 用视觉 AI 逐页把 PDF 翻译成中文，输出中文 PDF 和可编辑的 LaTeX 源码压缩包。

description.en: Provides Perlica-themed tiered sound notifications for DeepSeek Harness task events.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供佩丽卡主题分级提示音，按出方案、完成、需回应、出错四档播放，普通问答静音且音效可自定义。

description.en: Memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gives DSH agents adaptable memory with built-in governance.
description.zh: 为DSH Agent提供带内置治理功能的可塑性记忆的内存插件。

description.en: Bridges Codex and DSH dev sessions with real-time workspace sync and two-way task handoff, without stealing write locks or taking over Git.
description.zh: 连接 Codex 与 DSH 开发会话，实时同步工作区并双向派发/交回任务，不抢写锁、不接管 Git、无需重启。

description.en: Merges consecutive same-tool calls in WebUI chat flow into a tree view with main card and compact child rows.
description.zh: 把 WebUI 会话流中连续相邻的同工具调用合并为主卡片加紧凑子行的树状展示，默认覆盖所有内置通用行工具。

description.en: Evidence-backed ML phase gates with live visualization and portable project bootstrap for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的、带证据支撑的机器学习阶段门禁，支持实时可视化与可移植项目初始化。

description.en: Full-screen animated startup screen for DeepSeek Harness, with a built-in library of videos, wallpapers and audio.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全屏动画启动画面，内置视频、壁纸和音频素材库。

description.en: VS Code-style file explorer for DSH Web GUI with editable preview, syntax highlighting, and workspace state persistence.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器，支持可编辑预览、语法高亮和工作区状态保存。

description.en: Builds a PPT workspace on DeepSeek Harness: generates, revises, or summarizes presentations from natural language, with quality gates and templates.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness上构建PPT工作区：通过自然语言生成、修改、总结演示文稿，并带质量校验和模板支持。

description.en: Reads .pptx decks in the sidebar as a reading view: slides in deck order with bullets, speaker notes, and inline pictures.
description.zh: 在侧边栏以阅读视图查看 .pptx 演示文稿，按幻灯片顺序显示要点、演讲者备注和内嵌图片。

description.en: Adds a project mode to the DSH web GUI with sidebar entry, full-screen project manager, and live per-project context injection and refreshable memory.
description.zh: 为DSH网页GUI增加项目模式，提供侧边栏入口、全屏项目管理器及实时项目上下文注入和可刷新记忆。

description.en: Mount per-session personal or system prompts for DeepSeek Harness and preview the exact final prompt the model receives.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话挂载个人提示词或修改系统提示词，并预览模型实际收到的最终结果。

description.en: Allows DeepSeek Harness agent to operate on a remote SSH workspace using local tools, without extra model tools or UI plugins.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 代理通过 SSH 在远程工作区使用本地工具进行操作，无需额外模型工具或 UI 插件。

description.en: A dsh router plugin that provides TRAE SOLO as an AI provider, enabling routing of requests to TRAE SOLO.
description.zh: 为 dsh router 提供 TRAE SOLO 供应商的插件，用于将请求路由到 TRAE SOLO。

description.en: Adds session deletion capability to DeepSeek Harness, accessible via sidebar ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加会话删除功能，可从侧边栏 ⋮ 菜单中删除会话。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that deletes sidebar sessions into a recycle bin with search, restore, permanent delete and a chat log viewer.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版会话清理插件，可从侧栏菜单将会话移入回收站，支持搜索、恢复、彻底删除与对话记录查看。

description.en: Redesigns DSH session flow with cross-session archive, timeline, lineage, search, summaries, ZIP export, and live tracking.
description.zh: 重设计 DSH 会话信息流：跨会话档案柜，含折叠时间线、血缘树、检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出与实时跟踪。

description.en: Per-agent model switching for DeepSeek Harness with set_model/list_models tools, provider whitelists, token-budget guardrails, and plan-mode staging.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按智能体切换模型的能力，包含 set_model/list_models 工具、供应商白名单、token 预算保护与计划模式暂存。

description.en: Provides full-screen GIF wallpaper and Bilibili music player integration for DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供全屏 GIF 壁纸，并集成哔哩哔哩音乐播放器。

description.en: Adds a /side sidebar chat bound to the current DSH session, so off-topic questions get context without polluting the main thread.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加与当前会话强绑定的 /side 侧边栏对话，处理题外话且不污染主线上下文。

description.en: Live Agent Skills provider for dsh that serves skills from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 60+ agent dirs, plugin marketplaces, and any GitHub skill repo with no copies or symlinks.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供实时 Agent Skills 的插件，可直接读取 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 60+ 智能体的技能目录、插件市场及任意 GitHub 技能仓库，无需复制或软链接。

description.en: DSH Web sound player plugin with a draggable floating window that plays event-triggered sounds during conversations.
description.zh: DSH Web 音效播放器插件，提供可拖拽悬浮窗，在对话中按事件触发播放音效，并向其他插件开放调用 API。

description.en: Adds session deep links, full markdown/JSON session export, and approval-gated cross-session messaging with pairing to dsh.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供会话深链、完整 Markdown/JSON 会话导出，以及经批准并需配对的跨会话消息传递。

description.en: Makes Think/thinking lines always visible and auto-expands them during streaming in DeepSeek Harness to view full agent reasoning.
description.zh: dsh-think-autoexpand：让 DeepSeek Harness 里的 Think 思考行始终可见，并在流式输出时自动展开，实时查看 Agent 完整推理过程；保留工具卡折叠体验。

description.en: Turns TiddlyWiki 5 into a persistent knowledge base for DSH, letting agents and humans read/write notes with git sync.
description.zh: 将 TiddlyWiki 5 作为 DSH 的持久化知识库，让代理和人类读写笔记并支持 Git 同步。

description.en: Floating DeepSeek Harness card showing peak/off-peak tide windows in local time, session cost, and en/zh/ru localization.
description.zh: 悬浮于 DeepSeek Harness 的高峰/低谷时段卡片，按本地时间显示窗口与会话成本，支持英中俄三语。

description.en: Enhances DSH WebUI with custom backgrounds, theme colors, prompt presets, token visibility, and compact mode.
description.zh: 第三方 DSH WebUI 增强插件，支持自定义背景、主题配色、提示词预设、token 与上下文显示及手动压缩。

description.en: Shared Obsidian Vault for multi-agent memory with SQLite FTS5 search, connecting dsh, Codex, Claude Code & Hermes.
description.zh: Unified fleet-wide agent memory system for DeepSeek Harness — shared Obsidian Vault for dsh, Codex, Claude Code & Hermes with dependency-free Python FTS5 core.

description.en: Installs a working short-video production pipeline as 19 built-in DSH skills: one entry, one orchestrator, and 17 atomic skills.
description.zh: 把一条真实跑通的短视频生产流水线以内置技能形式装进 DSH：共 19 个技能（1 个入口 + 1 个编排 + 17 个原子）。

description.en: WebGIS plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling map reading, map manipulation, and 3D world comprehension.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的WebGIS插件，支持地图阅读、地图操作和3D世界理解。

description.en: A Yogācāra self-model plugin that adds eight consciousnesses, 51 mental factors, and a seed store to an AI agent's prompt.
description.zh: A Yogācāra (唯识) self-model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: eight consciousnesses, the 51 mental factors, a perfumed seed store, and a measurable self — written back into the agent's own prompt.

description.en: Displays DeepSeek's current compute peak/off-peak period in the web GUI top-right with live countdown.
description.zh: 在Web GUI右上角显示DeepSeek当前算力峰谷时段及实时倒计时。

description.en: Enhances DSH Desktop sessions with a Codex-style task-execution protocol and a persona system featuring long-term memory.
description.zh: 微光为DSH Desktop会话注入Codex风格任务执行协议和带长期记忆的人设系统。

description.en: A Maodie orange-cat desktop pet for DSH with 30 transparent VP9-alpha animations plus keying and import tools.
description.zh: 橘猫桌宠「耄耋」：包含 30 个透明 VP9-alpha 动作动画，以及抠像与导入工具链。

description.en: Tracks token usage and estimates costs for models, displaying account balance.
description.zh: 统计各模型的 token 消耗量并估算费用，同时显示账户余额。

description.en: AI-assisted biomedical research orchestration that turns long-horizon studies into an auditable loop of questions, evidence, artifacts, and decisions.
description.zh: AI 辅助的生物医学研究编排工具，将长周期研究组织为问题、证据、产物与决策组成的可审计循环。

description.en: A desktop pet plugin for DSH Web that shows a floating companion with session-aware prompts and customizable themes.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加桌面宠物：显示可浮动的伙伴，能随会话状态给出提示，并支持自定义主题。

description.en: Image preview plugin for DSH web sessions, showing read_image results as thumbnails with a full-size lightbox.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页会话中把 read_image 的结果显示为缩略图，点击可在内置灯箱中查看原图。

description.en: Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness with ipykernel, VS Code-aligned cell UI, progress bars, inline figures, and AI revision.
description.zh: Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness: real ipykernel sidecar + VS Code-aligned cell UI, tqdm progress, inline figures, per-cell AI revision.

description.en: TRAE-style rollback plugin for DSH that checkpoints each turn and restores both workspace files and model context to before a chosen turn.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 TRAE 式回退：按轮次建立检查点，一键同时回退工作区文件与模型上下文，保持同一会话 id。

description.en: HarmonyOS dev kit for DSH: HiLog inspector, ArkUI component-tree inspector with screenshot picking, .ets viewer, toolchain/device tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 HarmonyOS 开发套件：HiLog 检查器、支持截图点选的 ArkUI 组件树检查器、.ets 查看器与工具链/设备管理。

description.en: COM-driven real Office automation for Excel/Word: VBA macros, pivot tables, formula recalc, and document layout.
description.zh: 通过 COM 驱动真实的 Excel/Word 自动化：执行 VBA 宏、生成数据透视表、重算公式并调整文档排版。

description.en: Key-free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 8 engines fused with RRF, 34 vertical sources, page fetch ladder, and Chinese relevance gating.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的免密钥网页搜索：8 个引擎 RRF 融合、34 个垂直源、页面抓取回退链与中文相关性过滤。

description.en: Hierarchical persistent memory for DSH agents, so they remember preferences and project decisions across sessions without mixing projects.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供分层持久记忆，跨会话记住偏好与项目决策，并按项目隔离。

description.en: DSH 插件：DeepSeek Harness 界面主题与皮肤管理组件，可自由切换多款界面视觉风格。
Reads documents (Word, PDF, etc.) and converts them to Markdown for AI models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: read_document tool — Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF as Markdown for the model

description.en: Humanized IM message delivery for DeepSeek Harness bots: send delays, typing indicators, status reactions, reply quotes and per-bot overrides.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 机器人提供拟人化 IM 消息投递：发送延迟、正在输入提示、状态回应、引用回复与按机器人覆盖配置。

description.en: Per-model LLM call rate limiter for DeepSeek Harness with queue/reject modes and an interactive GUI for configuration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的按模型 LLM 调用限流插件，支持排队/拒绝策略和交互式 GUI 配置。

description.en: DSH multi-threaded download plugin with built-in aria2 that auto-detects file size to pick the best download strategy across platforms.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2，自动探测文件大小以选择最佳下载策略，支持多平台。

description.en: DSH plugin that sets git commit author/committer from environment, prioritizing gh CLI login and GitHub noreply email.
description.zh: DSH 插件：git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份（优先 gh CLI 登录账号，GitHub noreply 邮箱），GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* 环境变量注入压过一切 git config

description.en: Enables Live2D animated character support in deepseek-harness.
description.zh: 为deepseek-harness添加Live2D 2D动画角色支持。

description.en: In-session question minimap for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: vertical dots per user question, hover preview, click jump.
description.zh: In-session question minimap for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a vertical column of round dots overlaid on the left edge of the conversation column, one dot per user question — hover enlarges and shows

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness; human-confirmed memory with BM25 search and forget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话明文记忆，记忆经人工确认后保存，支持 BM25 搜索与遗忘。

description.en: Browse, search and install SkillHub skills directly inside DeepSeek Harness without leaving the agent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内直接浏览、搜索并安装 SkillHub 技能，无需离开当前环境。

description.en: Run a DeepSeek Harness coding agent inside Feishu/Lark with CoT, approvals, slash commands via WebSocket.
description.zh: 在飞书/Lark 中通过 WebSocket 长连接运行 DeepSeek Harness 编码智能体，支持思考过程展示、交互式审批卡片、实时表情回应和斜杠命令，无需公网回调地址。

description.en: DSH plugin to browse Archify business flowchart directories, read historical versions via Git annotated tags, and save diagram versions.
description.zh: DSH 插件：浏览 Archify 业务流程图目录，按 Git 附注标签阅读历史版本并保存版本。

description.en: Connects QQ to DSH Agent via NapCat/OneBot 11, with one DSH Agent per QQ conversation.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat / OneBot 11 将 QQ 接入 DSH Agent，每个 QQ 会话对应一个 DSH Agent。

description.en: 会跟着 Claude Code 干活的鲸鱼娘桌宠（PetPet / dsh 双版本，Windows x64）。干活时她端碗吃饭，收工收碗，按 Esc 打断会甩你一个屑表情。A desktop pet that reacts to your Claude Code session.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘桌宠，dsh 和 Claude Code（PetPet）两个版本 —— 待机由分层 PSD 烘焙，其余动作由 AI 视频转序列帧

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness composer: mic button for speech-to-text and hold-to-talk voice chat with read-aloud replies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器提供语音输入：麦克风按钮做语音转文字，支持按住说话进行语音对话并可朗读回复。

description.en: Headless-first browser automation for DSH agents: isolated throwaway Chrome profiles, short-lived semantic refs instead of CSS selectors, scoped observation and bounded evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的无头优先浏览器自动化：每个智能体独立临时 Chrome 配置、短期语义引用替代 CSS 选择器、局部观察与有界证据。

description.en: Shows your active Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, or DeepSeek Harness work as Discord Rich Presence via one local service.
description.zh: 通过一个本地服务，将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 或 DeepSeek Harness 的当前工作状态显示为 Discord Rich Presence。

description.en: Global usage statistics plugin for DSH: configurable sidebar widget plus detailed analytics panel.
description.zh: DSH 全局用量统计插件，提供可配置侧边栏组件与统计面板，展示模型分布、趋势、首字节和耗时明细。

description.en: An AI-run sensory text adventure MCP plugin: an AI game master drives scene-pack roleplay with live text state and bounded haptic feedback via Coyote V2/V3 devices.
description.zh: AI 主持的体感文字冒险 MCP 插件，用实时文字状态推进场景包剧情，并通过郊狼 Coyote V2/V3 设备执行有界物理反馈增强沉浸感。

description.en: Multi-perspective structural analysis skill for complex social, economic, philosophical, and systemic questions.
description.zh: 多视角结构分析技能，用16种透镜和10个结构工具分析复杂社会、经济、哲学与系统性问题，含攻击循环协议对抗分析先验

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness see and control Windows desktop apps via window screenshots, UI control reading, clicks, typing and form filling.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 查看并操作 Windows 桌面软件：窗口截图、读取界面控件、点击按钮、填写表单。

description.en: Security scanner for DeepSeek Harness plugins: static analysis, risk score, detects code execution, credential leaks, exfiltration, obfuscation.
description.zh: 对 DeepSeek Harness 插件做只读静态安全扫描，检查代码执行、凭据泄露、数据外传、混淆和安装脚本，给出 0-100 风险分，可作为 DSH 工具插件或独立 CLI 使用。

description.en: Declare deterministic project actions in a single actions.json, exposed via a right-sidebar panel and agent tools.
description.zh: 在一个 actions.json 中声明确定性的项目动作，并通过右侧边栏面板和智能体工具两种界面提供。

description.en: QQ official bot adapter for DeepSeek Harness enabling C2C chat, interactive action boards, session management, and Web UI sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 官方机器人适配器，支持 C2C 聊天、交互式操作面板、会话管理和 Web UI 实时同步。

description.en: Scans other AI agents and syncs their MCP servers and skills into DSH with one click.
description.zh: 扫描 Codex、Claude Code 等其它 AI 代理，将其 MCP 服务器与技能一键同步进 DSH。

description.en: A control plane for dispatching coding work across machines and agent runtimes from one DSH conversation.
description.zh: 一个控制平面，用于从一个DSH对话中跨机器和代理运行时调度编码工作。

description.en: AtomGit plugin bundle for dsh, providing atomgit-skills workflows, ag CLI, and GitCode MCP tools.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 AtomGit 插件包，包含 atomgit-skills 工作流、ag 命令行工具和 GitCode MCP 工具。

description.en: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to DSH Web UI, using a restricted child agent to review and allow/deny each approval request.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加自动批准权限预设，由受限子代理审查并逐条允许或拒绝审批请求。

description.en: A read-only DSH plugin that lets the model 'watch' Bilibili videos via storyboard frames, AI subtitles or local speech-to-text, plus hot comments and danmaku keywords.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件：通过分镜图、AI 字幕或本地语音识别，加上热评与弹幕热词，让模型真正「看」B站视频并像看过的朋友一样聊。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for tracking account balance and session costs with /balance and /cost commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 账户余额 + 会话费用（/balance /cost 命令、deepseek_billing 工具、Web UI 双胶囊），官方价格每 12 小时自动同步

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for side-channel Q&A via /btw command with a centered panel and web search.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 /btw 命令发起附带居中小面板和网页搜索的旁路问答。

description.en: Rewrites the model's reasoning chain into short first-person notes in the chat while the model still reads the full reasoning.
description.zh: 把模型的思维链在聊天中改写成简短的第一人称笔记，而模型下一轮仍读取完整推理。

description.en: Integrates CloudQ with DeepSeek Harness for multi-cloud architecture governance, AIOps, and risk inspection.
description.zh: 将CloudQ与DeepSeek Harness集成，用于多云架构治理、AIOps和风险检查。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 18 computer_* tools, Set-of-Marks grounding, approval modes, JSONL audit, and a human brake.
description.zh: Windows 桌面计算机使用插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 18 个 computer_* 工具、Set-of-Marks 定位、审批模式、JSONL 审计和人工刹车。

description.en: Runs work as a crew of role agents sharing files on disk for multi-agent collaboration.
description.zh: dsh plugin: run work as a small crew of role agents (product manager, engineer, code reviewer) that share work through files on disk

description.en: Visual localization plugin for DeepSeek Harness Desktop on macOS/Windows, adding themes, wallpapers, fonts and an optional blue whale desktop pet.
description.zh: 为 macOS 与 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供视觉本地化、主题配色、壁纸字体及可选蓝鲸桌宠。

description.en: Deep-reading plugin that understands books chapter by chapter with traceable reading memories, not just summaries.
description.zh: 深度阅读插件，逐章理解书籍并保留可追溯的阅读记忆，而非简单摘要。

description.en: A Digimon-style pet-raising game for DeepSeek Harness that grows based on your real work activity, with zero token usage.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里养的数码宝贝养成游戏，随你真实工作活动成长并分支进化，不消耗 token。

description.en: Redirects downloads/artifacts/caches/temp off C: drive and provides a disk guard tool for status/cleanup.
description.zh: Disk guard for DeepSeek Harness: redirect downloads/artifacts/caches/temp off the C: drive, inject a path-discipline prompt into every session, disk_guard tool for status/cleanup.

description.en: Automates a daily Douyin scroll by keyword, following, hot list or creator, screenshots and reviews videos, then writes a daily digest.
description.zh: 自动按关键词、关注、热榜或指定博主刷抖音，截图并用视觉模型看内容，再生成每日日报。

description.en: DSH plugin to edit and resend sent messages with branch-based reroll/retry and version timeline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: edit sent messages and resend (stop an in-flight reply, edit, resend), plus branch-based edit / reroll / retry and a version timeline.

description.en: Eli Mode is an agent preset for DeepSeek Harness featuring wiki-driven long-term memory and skills on a minimal setup.
description.zh: Eli Mode is an agent preset for DeepSeek Harness built around wiki-driven long-term memory and skills, on an extremely minimal Harness setup.

description.en: Endfield-inspired theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, boot splash, and conversation backdrop.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》风格主题，适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI，炭黑与警示黄工业 HUD，包含启动画面与会话背景。

description.en: Detects visual novel engine families and performs evidence-driven localization/reverse-engineering for Windows games.
description.zh: Galgame localization and reverse-engineering Skill Provider for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: A glass-morphism UI theme plugin for DSH Web with adjustable transparency, blur, custom fonts, wallpapers, and smooth animations.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供毛玻璃风格主题，可调节透明度与模糊、自定义字体和壁纸，带流畅动画及网易云音乐。

description.en: DSH 插件：每个工程一个群聊 —— 多个 AI 会话与人同群互聊、@ 唤醒离线会话、@创建成员 拉新会话进群
为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让模型 API 请求走代理，其它请求直连
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置 LLM 代理地址，让模型 API 请求走代理，其它请求直连。

description.en: Enhances DSH harness with Tencent IMA knowledge base retrieval, going beyond title-only keyword search.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 插件 harness 的腾讯 IMA 知识库检索能力，突破仅按标题关键字搜索的限制。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows a floating panel with today's Lark/Feishu meetings and triggers reminders so you don't miss meetings.
description.zh: 以悬浮面板显示今日飞书会议日程，并在会议开始前触发提醒，避免专注与 AI 对话时错过会议。

description.en: Adds scheduled sending to DSH: type a message now and have it delivered as you at the chosen time, even if the page is closed.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加定时发送：现在输入一句话，到点自动以你的身份送出，关闭网页也能准时触发。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a thinking self via a four-field soul card, cognitive loop, and hippocampus-style memory consolidation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入会思考的自我：灵魂卡四字段、认知循环与海马体式记忆沉淀。

description.en: Integrates AGY (Antigravity CLI) into DeepSeek Harness, adding LLM subagents, deep web search, and network diagnostics.
description.zh: 将 AGY（Antigravity CLI）集成到 DeepSeek Harness，提供 LLM 适配器子代理、深度网页搜索和连接诊断面板。

description.en: A long-form Chinese novel workbench that tracks chapters, timelines, facts, foreshadowing, characters and style presets, with AI drafting and review gated through proposals.
description.zh: 长篇中文小说工作台，管理章节、时间线、事实账本、伏笔、人物与名家风格预设，AI 生成与审稿均先进入提案由作者确认。

description.en: Provides themed skins for DeepSeek Harness chat Markdown with 4 built-in light/dark themes and user-customizable themes.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness对话Markdown提供主题皮肤，内置4套浅/深主题并支持用户自定义主题。

description.en: Export current markdown file to standalone HTML (Mermaid inlined) or PDF via toolbar button.
description.zh: 在 Markdown 工具栏添加导出按钮，把当前 md 文件导出为独立 HTML（内联 Mermaid 图）或 PDF

description.en: Quiz-style reading of Markdown documents with a 5-stage game loop and sidebar/tab interface.
description.zh: 把任意 Markdown 文档变成答题式阅读，含五阶段游戏循环，并提供侧边栏面板与阅读区标签页。

description.en: MemWeave weaves long-term memory into AI persona, so new sessions recall who you are, your projects, mistakes and promises, while keeping token use low and data local.
description.zh: 忆织 MemWeave 把长期记忆编织进人格，新会话也能记得你的身份、项目、踩过的坑与承诺，本地存储且控制 Token 消耗。

description.en: A read-only semantic search layer for the meow-memory system that builds a local vector index and adds memory-graph and raw-dialogue recall.
description.zh: 为 meow-memory 记忆系统提供只读语义检索层，在本机建立向量索引，并补充记忆图谱与对话原文召回。

description.en: Puts multiple DSH sessions side by side on one screen and lights up any channel that is waiting for approval or an answer.
description.zh: 把多个 DSH 会话并排摆到一屏，等待审批或提问的会话会即时亮灯提醒。

description.en: LAN mobile gateway for secure remote access to DeepSeek Harness with approval, device tokens, and rate limiting.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供局域网手机访问网关，支持首次访问审批、按设备发放令牌、限流并注入手机端布局。

description.en: Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: routes simple questions to fast models, falls back on failure, and shows live token/cache/cost panel.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由与成本优化插件：简单问题交由 flash 直答，请求失败时自动降级，并实时显示会话 token、缓存与成本面板。

description.en: Adds a customizable mood-light marquee to the DSH web UI, reflecting agent session status.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面添加可自定义的氛围灯跑马灯，直观显示 agent 会话是否正在运行或已完成。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness Web UI a desktop-app-like one-click launch using only Windows native mechanisms.
description.zh: 仅用 Windows 原生机制，为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供类似桌面应用的一键启动方式。

description.en: Plays synthesized notification sounds for task-complete, question, permission and error events, with per-event sound choice, custom audio and a mute toggle.
description.zh: 为任务完成、需要回答、需要授权和出错四类事件实时合成提示音，可逐事件选音、上传自定义音频并临时静音。

description.en: Notion connector plugin providing agent tools and a web settings page for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Notion 连接的插件，包含智能体工具和 Web 设置页。

description.en: Spec-driven development plugin that turns an idea into a tested Odoo module, with or without human intervention.
description.zh: 规范驱动开发插件，可将一个想法变成经过测试的 Odoo 模块，支持人工或自动完成。

description.en: Renders multi-agent sessions as a live pixel-art office using pixi.js in the browser.
description.zh: 作为 DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，在浏览器中用 pixi.js 把多智能体会话渲染成实时像素风办公室

description.en: Adds an IDE button to DeepSeek Harness Web UI that auto-detects local IDEs and opens the current workspace folder.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 IDE 按钮，自动检测本地 IDE 并打开当前工作区文件夹。

description.en: Floating web UI panel for DSH to monitor DeepSeek and OpenCode Go API credit balances and usage.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面悬浮面板，显示 OpenCode Go 月度、滚动和每周额度余额与用量，密钥本地读取，各自显示余额。

description.en: A maintained OpenCode Go model provider fork for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the model catalog reachable and self-configures via Settings > Models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode Go 模型提供方维护分支，保持模型目录可用并在“设置 > 模型”中自动配置。

description.en: Reads DSH desktop-pet speech bubbles aloud with 10 Chinese female TTS voices, including offline local voice packs.
description.zh: 为大肥鱼桌宠的气泡自动配音，提供 10 个中文女声，含可离线使用的本地音色包。

description.en: One-click Plan mode toggle button for the DSH web input bar, a shortcut for the /plan command.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页输入框添加按钮，一键进入或退出 Plan 模式，相当于 /plan 命令的快捷点击。

description.en: DSH plugin providing a super-search toolkit that unifies TinyFish, AnySearch, keyless Bing scraping, Jina and DuckDuckGo, replacing native web_search at zero token cost.
description.zh: DSH 插件：超级搜索工具包，集成 TinyFish、AnySearch、免 Key Bing 爬取、Jina 与 DuckDuckGo，接管原生 web_search，零 Token 消耗。

description.en: Routes DSH's pwsh tool to PowerShell 7 on Windows, with per-user detection/install and sandbox-aware execution.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上将 DSH 的 pwsh 工具路由到 PowerShell 7，支持按用户检测/安装及沙箱感知执行。

description.en: Read-only execution trajectory review plugin for DeepSeek Harness, turning dense trace events into an analysis timeline to understand agent behavior and errors.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）只读执行轨迹复盘插件，支持规则分析、独立模型解读、证据定位、任务概览与运行对比。

description.en: API usage/cost/balance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness with charts, budget alerts, and cross-session ledger.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页提供 API 用量、费用和余额仪表，按当日与近7天按模型展示堆叠柱状图，支持预算提醒和跨会话账本。

description.en: AI-powered DSH plugin that analyzes codebases with AST, dependency graphs, RAG, and LLM to generate architecture docs and project-level Q&A.
description.zh: AI 驱动的 DSH 插件，通过 AST、依赖图、RAG 和 LLM 分析代码库，自动生成架构、模块、调用链与上手指南，并提供项目级 AI 问答。

description.en: Kanban project board for DeepSeek Harness that groups cards and links them to project memory, mounted repos, and sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的看板项目面板，可分组卡片并关联项目记忆、已挂载仓库与会话。

description.en: Edits global and per-conversation prompts and keeps a dated error-lesson library injected into the system prompt.
description.zh: 编辑全局与本次对话的提示词，并维护按日期归纳的错误经验库，自动注入系统提示词。

description.en: Unofficial fork of dsh-purge, a DeepSeek Harness red-team tool that swaps jailbreak prompts per model, updated for dsh 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: dsh-purge 的非官方分支，一个针对 DeepSeek Harness 的红队工具，可为不同模型切换越狱提示词，适配 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Annotate selected text in DSH conversations with anchored reference chips that jump back to the original context.
description.zh: DSH 会话中选中文字后添加批注，生成引用锚点 chip，点击可跳回原文、悬停显示原文。

description.en: Verifies academic references in PDF/BibTeX/tex/text against Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv with status and corrections.
description.zh: 逐条核对 PDF、BibTeX、tex 或文本中的学术文献，通过 Crossref、OpenAlex、arXiv 检索并给出 found、partial、not_found 或 error 判定及更正后的引用。

description.en: Checks tender/bid documents for rejection risks, typos, and logical errors, then generates a PDF report.
description.zh: 解析招标与投标文件，提取废标项并做三轮风险检查、错别字与逻辑谬误检查，最后生成 PDF 报告。

description.en: Authenticated remote gateway for DeepSeek Harness with QR/HMAC pairing, cookie sessions, mDNS discovery.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带认证的远程网关，支持二维码与 HMAC 配对、Cookie 会话、mDNS 发现和 fork_session 工具，零依赖。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription manager for DeepSeek Harness with list, add, remove, fetch, and check tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RSS 订阅管理，含 list、add、remove、fetch、check 五个工具，支持 RSS 0.9x/1.0/2.0 与 Atom 解析并将订阅列表持久化到 settings。

description.en: Floating toolbar on selected text in DeepSeek Harness, offering copy and AI actions using current conversation context.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中划选文本后，选区上方浮现工具栏，提供复制、引用、询问、解释、翻译、总结和自定义操作，AI 动作复用当前会话上下文作答。

description.en: SenseNova multi-key rotation pool for DeepSeek Harness: paste keys for zero-config access and auto-switch on 429 rate limits.
description.zh: 商汤日日新（SenseNova）多 Key 轮换池：填入 key 即可零配置接入 DeepSeek Harness，遇 429 限流自动切换下一把 key。

description.en: Drag DSH sessions between workspaces in the sidebar, including live sessions that keep running without interruption.
description.zh: 在侧边栏把 DSH 会话拖到任意工作区，正在回答的会话也能就地接管、不中断。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a skill market UI to browse and install skillhub.cn skills into ~/.dsh/skills.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加技能市场界面，可浏览 skillhub.cn 上的技能并安装到 ~/.dsh/skills。

description.en: Provides persistent isolated remote development environments for builds, tests, previews, checkpoints, and services.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent, isolated Sprites: remote builds, tests, previews, checkpoints, and long-running services.

description.en: Three DSH tools that let any agent, including team members, list, steer, and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 三个 DSH 工具，让任何智能体（包括团队成员）列出、引导和停止其启动的子智能体。

description.en: Named subagent roster plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing list_subagents and delegate tools via settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的具名子代理库插件，通过设置维护角色名册，并提供 list_subagents 和 delegate 工具及设置页。

description.en: A DSH Web UI panel that lays a book's concepts into a zoomable, explorable concept map with editable KaTeX concept cards.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web UI 面板插件，把一本书的概念铺成可缩放探索的概念地图，每个概念是一张可编辑的 KaTeX 卡片。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness that relays questions, approvals, turn summaries and subagent notifications to chat, with a loopback control panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接插件，将提问、审批、回合摘要和子代理通知转发到聊天，并提供回环控制面板。

description.en: Telegram bot bridge that lets you drive the agent with text, voice and photos, with each forum topic as its own session and working directory.
description.zh: 一个 Telegram 机器人桥接，让你用文字、语音和图片驱动智能体，每个论坛话题都是独立会话和工作目录。

description.en: Song-dynasty meets Swiss International Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with rice-paper light and night-ink dark variants.
description.zh: 融合宋代美学与瑞士国际主义风格的 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面主题，提供宣纸浅色与夜墨深色两种变体。

description.en: Routes model steps by task difficulty, using strong models for planning/review and cheap models for implementation.
Shows per-turn and per-session DeepSeek API costs in the DSH Web UI, including sub-agent charges and paged breakdowns.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面按 DeepSeek 官方价格显示每轮与整段会话的花费，含子代理计价与分页明细。

description.en: Web developer tool panel for dsh with file browsing, multi-terminal, Git, and background tasks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 开发者工具面板，提供文件浏览、多终端、Git 和后台任务管理功能。

description.en: A theme plugin that recreates the deepseek.com visual style for DeepSeek Harness, with fluid backgrounds, grids, particle logo, and glassmorphism.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模仿 DeepSeek 官网视觉风格的主题插件，包含流体背景、交互网格、粒子鱼 LOGO、标题聚光灯和磨砂玻璃效果，支持双主题自适应。

description.en: Turns the web UI into a virtual desktop where the AI generates HTML app windows dynamically.
description.zh: VibeOS inside DeepSeek Harness: the whole web UI becomes a virtual desktop whose app windows are HTML the model writes as you use them. Ported from benis-me/VibeOS.

description.en: Browser-side plugin for dsh web mode that collapses tool cards and Think blocks into small inline cards to declutter conversations.
description.zh: dsh web 模式的浏览器端插件，将对话中的 Think、Bash 等工具卡片折叠为小型内联卡片，减少冗杂消息。

description.en: Turns visual/frontend design requests into polished, self-contained HTML/SVG artifacts.
description.zh: 把海报、网页、信息图、图表等设计需求转成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿。

description.en: Adds attention reminders to DeepSeek Harness Web UI: frame badge, tab title count, and favicon color change for waiting sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加提醒：会话等待输入或完成后未打开时，显示边框标记、标签页标题计数和鲸鱼图标变色。

description.en: One-click launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web on Windows with background restart and browser refresh.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness Web 一键启动器，支持后台重启并刷新浏览器。

description.en: Network optimizer for DSH web UI: caching and compression speed up loading, with connection drop indicator and auto-reconnect.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供缓存与压缩以加速加载，并显示断连指示、断网自动重连。

description.en: Provides web search for DSH by connecting to OpenAI-compatible Responses API and its native web_search tool.
description.zh: 为DSH提供网页搜索，通过OpenAI兼容Responses API及其原生web_search工具实现。

description.en: Key-free dsh web search and page-fetch plugin with direct/mirror/accelerated route fallback that uses no model tokens.
description.zh: 免 API Key 的 dsh 联网搜索与网页抓取插件，支持直连/镜像/加速路由自动回退，不消耗模型 token。

description.en: A DSH plugin named whale-pet with no description, likely a whimsical pet widget.
description.zh: DSH 插件 dsh-whale-pet，暂无功能描述，从名称推测可能是一个鲸鱼宠物形式的桌面挂件。

description.en: Adds a right-hand widget rail to DSH Web UI showing live session stats and OpenCode Go quota via proxy, with extensible registry.
description.zh: Right-hand widget rail for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: live session stats (turns, LLM/tool time, TTFT, speed, cache, tokens) plus OpenCode Go quota via a same-origin host proxy; extensible widget registr

description.en: Per-workspace enablement of Skills and MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness to reduce session startup context.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按工作区分别启用 Skills 和 MCP 服务器，减少会话启动时加载的上下文。

description.en: Redesigns DSH Web's workspace sidebar as a dual-mode file tree, binding workspaces to directories for isolated session management.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 工作区侧栏改造为双模式文件树，工作区强绑定目录，实现会话隔离与环境管理。

description.en: Integrates WPS/KDocs cloud documents into DeepSeek Harness, enabling natural language file operations like listing, reading, creating, uploading, and searching.
description.zh: 将WPS云文档接入DeepSeek Harness，支持用自然语言列出、读取、创建、上传和搜索云端文件。

description.en: DSH plugin that automatically browses Xiaoheihe in the background and performs interactions like comments and replies, configured from DSH settings.
description.zh: DSH插件，可在后台自动浏览小黑盒并执行评论、回复等互动，任务在DSH设置中配置。

description.en: A Genshin Impact Yoimiya theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with dark and light color schemes and custom wallpaper.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 制作的《原神》宵宫主题，含暗档夏祭夜与亮档和纸昼配色及壁纸。

description.en: Connects DSH to ZCode's free plan with a multi-account pool, a web management panel, and dual bigmodel/zai login channels.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 ZCode 免费 plan，提供多账号池、Web 管理面板与 bigmodel/zai 双渠道登录。

description.en: Cartoon pixel skin plugin for DSH Web GUI adding living pixel pets that stroll, blink and hop.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加卡通像素皮肤插件，在不改动原始界面的前提下加入会散步、眨眼和跳跃的像素宠物。

description.en: Makes any AI model behave like a frontier model with planning, persistent context, skills, hooks, and verification.
description.zh: 让您的AI模型具备前沿模型的规划、持久上下文、技能、钩子和验证能力。

description.en: A DSH plugin and Claude Code skill group that fuses OpenSpec spec-driven development with Superpowers TDD into a 6-skill Phase 0→4 workflow.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件与 Claude Code 技能组，将 OpenSpec 规范驱动开发与 Superpowers TDD 融合为 6 个技能的 Phase 0→4 工作流。

description.en: Red-team prompt tool for DeepSeek Harness that applies per-model jailbreak prompts and evaluates instruction safety.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的红队提示词工具，可按模型切换越狱提示词并评估指令安全性。

description.en: Native Russian localization for the DeepSeek Harness web interface, adding a Russian option to the built-in language switcher.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供原生俄语本地化，在自带语言切换器中新增俄语选项。

description.en: Local personality, memory and distillation layer for DeepSeek Harness with persona files and cross-session memory.
description.zh: Local personality, memory and distillation layer for DeepSeek Harness — SOUL/IDENTITY/USER/STATE persona files, cross-session memory and LLM distillation, auto-loaded on startup.

description.en: Gives every DSH conversation its own real local Chrome/Edge browser with a dedicated profile and CDP port, driven by six agent tools.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话提供独立的真实本地 Chrome/Edge 浏览器，拥有专属配置与 CDP 端口，由六个智能体工具驱动。

description.en: Universal AI Agent Development Skills Hub & Cordis Plugin for Govard, Magento 2, Laravel, compatible with multiple AI coding tools.
description.zh: 面向 Govard、Magento 2、Laravel 的 AI 代理开发技能中心与 Cordis 插件，兼容 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等多种 AI 编码工具

description.en: Floating Bilibili video player for coding: browse hot/ranked videos, search, follow creators, auto-play, mini mode, and history.
description.zh: 在编码时提供B站悬浮视频播放器，支持推荐、热门、排行、搜索、关注UP主、自动连播、迷你模式和历史记录。

description.en: AI image and video generation pipeline plugin for DeepSeek Harness with editing, pixel-art cleanup, asset specs, and 27 built-in tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 生图与生视频全流水线插件，支持改图、像素画净化、素材规格与 27 个工具。

description.en: DSH host plugin that lets you control DeepSeek Harness from your phone: approve tool calls, watch streaming output, answer questions, with E2E encryption.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：用手机远程操作 DeepSeek Harness，审批工具调用、查看流式输出、回答问题，端到端加密。

description.en: DSH plugin for automatic approval of agent permission requests, with a web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理的权限请求提供自动审批，并附带 Web 操作界面

description.en: A 360 Tuitui IM bot channel plugin that bridges Tuitui chats, groups and channel posts to a DeepSeek Harness agent.
description.zh: 基于 deepseek harness 的 360 推推机器人插件，把推推单聊、群聊和频道帖子接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。

description.en: Embedded task management engine with decision point protocol, thought capture, and Linear-style issue storage for AI-human task tracking.
description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎，提供决策点协议、念头捕获墙与 Linear 式 issue 存储，用于 AI 与人的任务轨道追踪。

description.en: A prompt-library plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a button above the input box to expand a panel for one-click prompt insertion.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方加提示词库按钮，点击展开面板，点条目即可一键填入 prompt。

description.en: A Verdandi-inspired skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI with custom colors, character elements, and light/dark modes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供基于《深空之眼》角色薇儿丹蒂的皮肤，含自定义配色、角色元素和明暗模式。

description.en: Bridges the WorkBuddy backend into DSH so its models appear in the model selector and are usable like built-in models.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 后端接入 DSH，让 WorkBuddy 模型出现在模型选择器中，像内置模型一样使用。

description.en: Provides adb-based tools for model to operate an Android phone: screenshot, UI dump, tap, swipe, text input, keys, and open apps.
description.zh: 提供基于 adb 的工具，让模型通过截图、UI 树、点击、滑动、文本输入、按键和打开应用操作安卓手机。

description.en: Migrates DSH Web GUI sessions to another workspace while preserving all context and history.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web GUI 的会话迁移到其他工作区，保留完整上下文、会话历史、Agent 预设与模型选择，并可选保留或归档原会话。

description.en: A pack of 11 workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness covering handoffs, triage, specs, tickets, wayfinding, teaching, mode routing, and overnight runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 11 个可共享的工作流技能，涵盖交接、分流、规格、工单、路径寻找、教学、模式路由和通宵运行。

description.en: Questionnaire-style batch questioning plugin for DeepSeek Harness with fullscreen overlay and recap.
description.zh: Questionnaire-style batch questioning plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 10+ questions at once (single/multi/yes-no toggle/compare/open), per-question skip, fullscreen overlay, two-column recap after submit
