description.en: Two-layer long-term memory for DSH: global and per-project markdown files with live re-read, zero extra LLM cost, and a Settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供两层长期记忆：全局与项目级 Markdown 文件，支持实时重读、零额外 LLM 开销，并带设置面板。

description.en: DSH web plugin adding a status bar with per-session token cost estimate and live DeepSeek API balance.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，在状态栏按会话估算 token 费用（按模型人民币定价）并显示 DeepSeek API 实时余额，展示方式可选独立状态栏或并入统计行。

description.en: AI fortune-telling assistant for feng shui, face reading, BaZi, zodiac, daily divination, and almanac.
description.zh: AI玄学助手，提供看风水、看面相、算八字、查星座、每日一卦和老黄历查询。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets the main conversation dispatch work into real thread sessions and receive short summaries back.
description.zh: DSH 插件：主对话将任务派发到真实的线程会话中，并收回简短摘要。

description.en: Edit text files in place inside the DSH Sidebar preview pane and save them, with Ctrl+S, conflict protection and byte-exact line endings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览中就地编辑并保存文本文件，支持 Ctrl+S、冲突保护和行尾逐字节保留。

description.en: One-click DSH plugin that rewrites your composer draft into a stronger, more effective prompt.
description.zh: 一键将输入框草稿改写为更强提示词的 DSH 插件。

description.en: Lets an agent remotely drive a full local DSH instance with zero setup on the target, adding incremental reads, saved references and session/workspace search.
description.zh: 让 Agent 远程直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例，目标端零侵入零配置，支持增量读取、引用保存与远端会话/工作区搜索。

description.en: Read assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness: text-to-speech providers with streaming playback.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中朗读助手回复，支持多种文本转语音提供商并流式播放。

description.en: Auto-sync DeepSeek Harness conversation turns to a self-hosted Honcho service, giving AI persistent memory.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的对话轮次自动同步到自托管的 Honcho 记忆服务，为 AI 提供持久记忆。

description.en: A local-first DSH plugin giving your agent an auditable memory tree and a persona that grows from shared memory and can be locked.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 插件，为智能体提供可审计的记忆树，以及由共同记忆养成并可锁定的人格。

description.en: Session handoff and context management for DeepSeek Harness, with export/resume docs and context pruning via compaction API.
description.zh: Session handoff & context management for DeepSeek Harness: structured handoff docs (export/resume/status) + active context pruning (acp_* via official compaction API) + optional OpenViking/archify enh

description.en: A read-only DSH Web stock board showing delayed A-share, HK and US market quotes in a PC/mobile panel.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 网页股票看板，在电脑和手机上查看 A 股、港股、美股的延迟行情。

description.en: Renders A2UI documents as interactive UI surfaces inside DeepSeek Harness chat.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件 generate_ui：由模型编写 A2UI 文档，在聊天中渲染为可交互的 UI 界面。

description.en: AI novel writing workbench that imports outlines, builds settings, plans volumes/chapters, generates 3000-4000 words per chapter, reviews and exports full novels.
description.zh: DSH上的AI小说写作工作台，支持大纲导入、世界观设定、卷章规划、逐章生成3000-4000字、九维审稿和全书导出。

description.en: Customizes dsh settings window: size, opacity, background color/image, real-time theme following.
description.zh: 自定义 dsh 设置窗口：调整大小、不透明度与背景，支持主题色与图片。

description.en: A DSH plugin providing a management plane for agent skills with view, edit, import, enable/disable, and global/workspace/session scoping.
description.zh: 为 agent 技能提供管理能力，可查看、编辑、导入、启用或禁用技能，并支持全局、工作区、会话三种作用域

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin and Agent Skill for directing ASCII and kinetic-typography films on MiniMax H3, with a preview engine and Director Console.
description.zh: 面向 MiniMax H3 的 ASCII 与动态字体影像导演插件与 Agent Skill，含预览引擎与导演控制台。

description.en: A plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness use local Ollama models via its native /api/chat protocol.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 Ollama 原生 /api/chat 协议接入本地 Ollama 模型，安装后在设置中新增 Ollama 页面并在模型选择器提供该提供方模型。

description.en: A persistent AI teammate in DSH that takes a one-sentence request, runs recurring watch tasks on schedule, remembers results, and reports back with dry-run and rollback control.
description.zh: 一个常驻 DSH 的 AI 队友：用一句自然语言交付重复守护任务，按节奏自动执行、记住结果并回报，支持演习与整单回滚。

description.en: Manually or automatically configure model thinking strength, context window, and max output tokens.
description.zh: 手动或自动配置模型的思考强度、上下文窗口和最大输出token。

description.en: Registers image and video generation tools for Agnes AI media models in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中注册用于 Agnes AI 媒体模型的 generate_image 和 generate_video 工具。

description.en: AI-driven partial-wave analysis automation: edits physics configs, runs ctpwa fits, evaluates results, iterates to convergence.
description.zh: AI驱动的分波分析自动化：编辑物理配置，运行ctpwa拟合，评估数值结果并迭代收敛。

description.en: Personalizes DSH web background with custom images or presets, including real-time preview and local-only processing.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 上传自定义背景图或切换极光、余烬、宣纸预设，实时预览并细调遮罩、柔焦与焦点，浏览器端压缩、本地处理，设置自动保存。

description.en: Markdown-to-Word converter for AI agents with Chinese typography, Mermaid diagrams and editable math formulas, shipped as a Skill, CLI and DSH plugin.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Markdown 转 Word 工具，支持中文排版、Mermaid 图表与可编辑数学公式，提供 Skill、CLI 和 DSH 插件。

description.en: A public capability catalog skill for Codex and DSH that orchestrates trusted installers and maintains a sourced Chinese catalog of skills, plugins, and market capabilities.
description.zh: 一个面向 Codex 的公开 skill：编排当前 Agent 已有的可信安装器，并为 skills、插件和市场能力维护一份有来源依据的中文说明目录

description.en: DSH plugin that displays peak/valley reminders with a breathing border and push notifications.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷时段显示橙蓝呼吸边框与流光效果，并通过服务端推送自定义标题和内容的消息提醒。

description.en: Quick-input vault plugin that auto-collects secrets, URLs, servers, phone numbers from chats, with one-click fill/send, password protection, and WebDAV backup.
description.zh: DSH 便捷输入保险箱插件，在输入栏用量与发送之间一键展开，自动收录会话中的密钥、网址、服务器、手机号等，点击填入或 Ctrl+点击直接发送，支持密码保护和 WebDAV 备份。

description.en: AI coding coach preset for non-developers, guiding idea-to-launch via an eight-stage pipeline.
description.zh: 面向非开发者的 AI 编程教练预设，通过八个阶段的流程引导从想法到上线。

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversation history into DeepSeek Harness as sessions, allowing continuation.
description.zh: 将 chat.deepseek.com 的网页对话历史导入 DeepSeek Harness 作为会话，以便继续对话。

description.en: Unofficial Endfield-inspired theme and animated mascot for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供非官方终末地风格主题与动画吉祥物

description.en: Local activity tracker for DeepSeek Harness showing timelines of work/coding and token usage by project/date/hour.
description.zh: 本地 DSH 活动统计插件，用彩色时间线展示干活和改代码的时间段，并按项目、日期、小时查看每日 token 消耗。

description.en: Autopilot for DeepSeek Harness agents: auto failover, keep-alive retries, auto-approvals, and full audit for unattended self-healing AI coding.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体自动驾驶：自动故障回退、卡死保活重试、审批自动放行，全程审计，实现无人值守自愈式 AI 编码。

description.en: A customizable side HUD panel for DSH with info modules, compressed context, and git graph.
description.zh: DSH侧边HUD面板，包含自定义信息模块、上下文压缩和git图表功能。

description.en: Balanced web search plugin that round-robins Keenable, Exa, and Tavily with automatic failover.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供均衡网页搜索的插件与 MCP 服务，在 Keenable、Exa、Tavily 之间轮流调用并在失败时自动切换。

description.en: Adds SillyTavern-style role-play to DeepSeek Harness: import character cards and world books, bind skills, and save the mix as a native DSH agent preset.
description.zh: 为 DSH 加上 SillyTavern 式角色扮演：导入角色卡与世界书，绑定技能，存成原生 agent preset 即可开演。

description.en: Lightweight Bilibili live danmaku plugin: read and send live chat with permission, idle listening, optional AI auto-replies and speech transcription.
description.zh: 轻量B站直播弹幕插件：实时看弹幕、授权后发弹幕，可挂机听，可选AI自动陪聊与语音转写，闲时低占用。

description.en: Native DSH plugin that enables in-process communication between sessions and provides a shared workspace blackboard for collaboration.
description.zh: 原生 DSH 插件，实现会话间的进程内通信，并提供共享工作区黑板用于协作。

description.en: Plugin to verify changed lines are tested, preventing false green test results.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，改动代码后校验被修改的行是否被测试覆盖，防止测试结果假绿

description.en: Fetches literature metadata from Crossref and formats citations in multiple styles.
description.zh: 从 Crossref 获取文献元数据，并按多种引用格式生成引文。

description.en: Task-based security code audit plugin that drives DSH agent sessions to find vulnerabilities, track progress and export professional audit reports.
description.zh: 任务化安全代码审计插件，驱动DSH原生Agent会话挖掘漏洞、跟踪进度并导出专业审计报告。

description.en: Vision-only desktop automation agent for DSH using SoM grounding, planner-actor, effect verification, and skill library.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供纯视觉桌面自动化 Agent，通过 SoM 定位、Planner-Actor 规划执行、效果验证和技能库操作桌面。

description.en: DSH plugin that monitors and gates concurrent model requests to prevent provider rate limits, with a live WebUI and HTTP status endpoint.
description.zh: DSH并发监控与门闩插件，统计在途模型请求并在超限时排队，附WebUI和HTTP状态接口。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets conversations in the same process discover each other, message directly, track progress and set tool guards without sub-agents.
description.zh: DSH 插件：同一进程内的对话可互相发现、直接发消息、跟踪进度并设置工具护栏，无需绑定或子代理。

description.en: Live DSH cost estimates from actual token usage with configurable pricing for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 根据真实 Token 用量与可配置价格，实时估算 DSH 调用开销。

description.en: Cross-session reference plugin that injects context snapshots from other conversations into the current session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话引用，把其他对话的上下文快照注入当前会话。

description.en: Customizes the DeepSeek Harness running-status line's icon, text, and color, defaulting to a spinning taiji, "少女祈祷中" and red.
description.zh: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 运行状态行的图标、文本与颜色，默认旋转太极、文本“少女祈祷中”、红色。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com into dsh desktop clients as a native chat surface with dual-entry panel and dock tab, persistent login and zero runtime deps.
description.zh: 将 chat.deepseek.com 嵌入 dsh 桌面客户端，作为原生聊天界面，提供主面板与右侧停靠双入口、持久登录且零运行时依赖。

description.en: An animated deepseek girl desktop pet that follows the mouse and changes animations based on session state in DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示会跟随鼠标移动、并根据会话状态切换动画的 DeepSeek 女孩桌面宠物。

description.en: Adds a real Delete Session action to the DSH sidebar session menu, permanently removing session logs and projection caches from disk.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏会话菜单增加真正的「删除会话」，永久移除磁盘上的会话日志与投影缓存。

description.en: EVA-themed skin pack for the DeepSeek Harness desktop client, with four skins, a skippable boot animation, and easy revert to default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端的 EVA 皮肤合集，含四套主题、可跳过的开机动画，并可随时切回默认。

description.en: A fact-checking skill that verifies claims against multiple open-web and domestic/international sources, with optional TypeSafe Jev judgements.
description.zh: 一个事实核查技能，针对开放网络及国内外多来源进行交叉验证，并可选使用 TypeSafe Jev 判断。

description.en: Customize fonts, sizes, and colors for different areas of the DSH interface.
description.zh: 按界面区域自定义 DSH 的字体、字号和颜色。

description.en: A fun-pack plugin adding pomodoro, reminders, desktop pet, achievements, and ambient sound to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加番茄钟、提醒、桌面宠物、成就与氛围音效的趣味插件包。

description.en: Manages Git credentials and push permissions, mapping projects to accounts and allowed hosts while keeping tokens on the host.
description.zh: 管理 Git 凭据与推送权限，按项目分配账号并限制可推送的 host，token 仅保存在宿主侧。

description.en: Skill-first GitHub workflows for PR triage, review feedback, CI diagnosis, and safe publishing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供以技能驱动的 GitHub 工作流，涵盖 PR 分类、评审反馈处理、CI 诊断与安全发布。

description.en: MiniMax multimodal plugin for DSH: generates images/videos/music/speech, provides vision tools, and adds voice input and TTS playback.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 MiniMax 多模态能力：生成图像、视频、音乐和语音，提供视觉工具，并支持语音输入（麦克风经 faster-whisper 转写至输入框）与自动 TTS 播报。

description.en: A GUI memory manager plugin for DeepSeek Harness that wraps the official Hindsight memory system for coding agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图形界面的记忆管理插件，封装官方 Hindsight 记忆系统，供编码智能体使用。

description.en: Enables non-vision DeepSeek models to process chat images via built-in image recognition tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件，让 deepseek-v4-flash 等不支持视觉的模型通过内置识图工具处理聊天中的图片。

description.en: Turns failed-then-fixed tool calls into reusable rules that are injected into coding agents before the same pitfall repeats.
description.zh: 把失败后修复的工具调用转化为可复用规则，在编码代理重蹈覆辙前自动注入提醒。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Feishu/Lark so you can reach your assistant from chat while away from your computer.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书/Lark，让你离开电脑也能在聊天中找到助手。

description.en: Replaces model selection and reasoning level controls with a 6-level slider with hover images.
description.zh: 用带悬停图片的6级滑块替换模型选择和推理等级控制

description.en: Draggable liquid-glass card that displays DeepSeek API balance in the DSH web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中显示 DeepSeek API 余额的可拖拽液态玻璃卡片插件。

description.en: Global HTTP proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness using undici dispatcher, with configurable and hot-swappable capabilities.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 全局 HTTP 代理插件：undici setGlobalDispatcher + EnvHttpProxyAgent，配置化、热切换、可观测

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges your phone's Local Dream local NPU image generation into chat: text-to-image, img2img, 4x upscale and tiled redraw, all over loopback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，把手机端 Local Dream 的本地 NPU 生图接入对话：文生图、图生图、四倍放大与分块重绘，全程走本机 loopback。

description.en: Unofficial community language pack that displays the DeepSeek Harness web and desktop UI in Korean.
description.zh: 非官方社区语言包，将 DeepSeek Harness 网页版与桌面版界面显示为韩语。

description.en: Verifies claims in AI coding agents' design docs and refactoring plans using structural and adversarial logic probes.
description.zh: 对 AI 编程助手的设计文档与重构计划进行声明核查，用 7 个结构探针和 7 个对抗探针做逻辑原语验证。

description.en: Login gateway plugin adding a username/password wall and full reverse proxy to securely expose dsh's local-only Web UI.
description.zh: 为只监听本机的 dsh Web UI 添加用户名密码登录墙和全量反向代理，使其可安全对外开放。

description.en: DSH plugin that exposes the running Harness as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so other agent harnesses can connect and use it.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将运行中的 Harness 发布为 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，供其他 agent harness 连接调用。

description.en: Batch-anonymizes medical records and tables with rule-based detection plus optional local LLM review, stable pseudonyms and audit reports.
description.zh: 批量匿名化病历文本与表格：规则识别加可选本地模型复核，稳定假名替换并输出审计报告。

description.en: Chinese metaphysics chart plugin for DeepSeek Harness with BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao divination and Tarot readings plus an interactive panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 命理排盘插件：支持四柱八字、紫微斗数、六爻纳甲与塔罗牌，并提供 Agent 工具与可视化面板。

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover for DeepSeek Harness, routing to fallback after failures.
description.zh: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover for DeepSeek Harness: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback

description.en: Automatically fills missing context window, max tokens, reasoning effort, and image support for custom AI models using data from models.dev.
description.zh: 根据模型名从 models.dev 自动补全自定义模型中缺失的上下文、输出上限、思考档位和图片能力。

description.en: Enhances the dsh web GUI model picker with a two-panel provider/model layout and cross-provider search.
description.zh: 将 DSH web 前端的模型选择面板改为供应商与模型两侧滚动面板，并加入跨供应商搜索框。

description.en: Replaces the dsh web GUI composer's model seat with a two-zone trigger that opens separate pickers for model choice and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 用双区域触发按钮替换 dsh 网页界面输入框的模型位，分别弹出模型选择与推理力度选择器。

description.en: Adds searchable filtering to the DeepSeek Harness model selector by provider, model name, or ID.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器增加可搜索过滤，支持按提供商、模型名称或 ID 筛选。

description.en: Moves a DeepSeek Harness conversation to another workspace by copying its transcript, archiving the original, and optionally registering the target folder.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 对话移动到另一个工作区：复制记录、归档原对话，并可注册新的工作区文件夹。

description.en: Renders code-driven music videos with deterministic Canvas2D/Three.js shots and ffmpeg AV1/HEVC output up to 4K/120fps/12-bit.
description.zh: 通过确定性 Canvas2D/Three.js 镜头渲染代码驱动的音乐视频，并用 ffmpeg 输出最高 4K/120fps/12-bit 的 AV1/HEVC 视频。

description.en: A playful milk-frog theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI with colors, icons, and sounds.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供奶蛙主题，包含配色、图标与音效。

description.en: Neo-brutalism skin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with hard borders, high contrast, and two switchable schemes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供新粗野主义皮肤，硬边框高对比度，含 Blue Command 与 Aged Newspaper 两套可切换配色，支持明暗主题。

description.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness web UI with workspace quick-open, editor discovery, user message navigation bar, todo markers, and restart.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面增强：一键打开工作区、自动发现编辑器、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记和硬性重启。

description.en: Nico glass theme that restyles the DeepSeek Harness web UI with panel glass rendered by nico-glass-kit.
description.zh: Nico 玻璃主题，用 nico-glass-kit 渲染面板玻璃效果，为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换肤。

description.en: Enables DSH to control Universal Robots (UR) robotic arms through natural-language commands via the nUR MCP Server.
description.zh: 让 DSH 通过自然语言直接控制优傲（UR）机械臂，基于自研 nUR MCP Server 逻辑。

description.en: Windows notification plugin for dsh that sends Toast alerts and tray icon when agent stops, finishes, or errors.
description.zh: dsh插件，agent操作结束后调用系统通知，在windows托盘增加图标来启动页面和关闭后台程序

description.en: Sends system and custom notifications for DeepSeek Harness task events, with click-to-jump to the conversation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通知插件，在任务完成、出错、运行中、等待审批或回答时发送系统或自定义通知，标题为对话标题并支持点击跳转到对应会话。

description.en: DSH novel-writing studio: 5 novel_* tools for agents plus a right-side panel to edit settings, view character relations, and stream AI continuations.
description.zh: DSH 小说创作台：为 agent 提供 5 个 novel_* 工具，并配有右侧栏面板，可改设定、看角色关系图并流式续写。

description.en: A resident DSH plugin that runs a novel workshop on the timeline, binding each work to a session whose own agent generates chapters and world snapshots.
description.zh: 一个常驻 DSH 的小说工坊插件，在时间线上写小说：每个作品绑定一个会话，由该会话自己的 Agent 生成章节正文与世界快照。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a fully local BM25 RAG chat panel inside DSH, with clickable citations back to your notes.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 仓库变成 DSH 内的纯本地 BM25 RAG 对话面板，引用可点击跳转原文。

description.en: Adds a "one-person company" layer to DeepSeek Harness: role-based multi-agent orchestration with task dispatch, approvals, scheduling and work logs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加一层「一人公司」：按岗位编排多个 agent，支持派活、审批、排班与工作日志。

description.en: Shows a quota progress ring in the input box to switch between 5-hour/weekly/monthly usage for OpenCode Go.
description.zh: 在输入框模型选择器左侧显示 OpenCode Go 额度进度圆环，点击可切换查看 5 小时、每周和每月用量。

description.en: A cute fish desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI that floats in a corner and shows your plan usage or balance in a real-time speech bubble.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面角落的蓝色大肥鱼桌宠，头顶气泡实时显示套餐用量或余额。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects persona text into the system prompt and preset history dialogue into context, with saved persona presets and quick switching in chat.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可将人设正文注入系统提示词、将历史对话注入上下文，支持人设预设保存与对话中快速切换。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness assistant reports a persona voice, with side-by-side original text, optional process info, and an isolated work prompt.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的助手汇报换上人格化口吻，支持原文对照、可选过程运行信息，工作提示词保持独立。

description.en: Graceful restart + auto-reconnect + goal resume for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供优雅重启、自动重连和跨重启目标恢复的生命周期管理。

description.en: Pin DSH sidebar conversations to the top of a workspace or into a global tray across all workspaces.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏会话固定在某个工作区顶部，或提升到覆盖所有工作区的全局托盘，支持多固定与精确恢复，无依赖

description.en: Pin selected passages from DeepSeek chat into a right-side sticky-note column, click to jump back to the source, and quote them with @.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 对话中划选的段落固定到右侧栏便签列，点击可跳回原文，输入 @ 即可引用进消息。

description.en: Web GUI panel for browsing, installing, and managing project/global capabilities like skills and MCP servers.
description.zh: 在 Web 图形界面中浏览、安装和管理项目级或全局的 skills、MCP 服务器等能力。

description.en: DSH plugin that captures full displays, windows or screen regions at native physical pixels and returns a PNG file plus attachment reference.
description.zh: DSH 插件，按物理像素截取显示器、窗口或区域，返回磁盘 PNG 文件与附件引用。

description.en: Discovers and statically analyzes third-party dsh plugins, generates design.md, and applies user-approved modifications with backup/rollback.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）第三方插件生态的 **Plugin Design**：发现第三方插件、检查其源码与配置、对照 DH-TP-SDK 工程化规范做静态分析、生成 `design.md`，经用户确认后对插件逐项修改并支持备份与回滚。

description.en: View DeepSeek API usage, balance, spend, tokens, and request counts in a timeline chart.
description.zh: 在时间线图表中查看 DeepSeek API 的用量、余额、花费、token 数量与请求次数。

description.en: Marketplace plugin that integrates DeepSeek Harness into the GitHub plugin ecosystem.
description.zh: 在 GitHub 插件生态中提供市场，用于安装插件，把 DeepSeek Harness 快速接入该生态。

description.en: Enables standalone, workspace-free conversations in DeepSeek Harness without replacing native UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供独立、无工作区的对话，同时不替换原生工作区界面。

description.en: Manages DSH plugins, distinguishing built-in from custom ones and organizing user-created plugins.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面区分 DSH 自带插件与用户自定义插件，并收集管理此前创建的自定义插件。

description.en: Desktop pet companion for DeepSeek Harness that reacts to agent status with animated/custom sprites.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面电子宠物插件，随 agent 状态改变心情，支持内置、自定义和 Codex 精灵图伙伴。

description.en: JavaScript reverse engineering toolkit that deobfuscates front-end JS into standalone Node functions and generates Hook scripts to locate encryption entry points.
description.zh: JavaScript 逆向工程工具包：将混淆前端 JS 还原为可在 Node 独立运行的函数，并生成 Hook 脚本定位加密入口。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that detects limited-rollout models by scoring live chain-of-thought.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过对实时思维链打分来探测处于限量灰度发布的对话模型。

description.en: Simplified SillyTavern plugin for DSH: parses character cards and runs immersive roleplay with state tracking.
description.zh: 酒馆（SillyTavern 精简版）DSH 插件：角色卡解析管理员 card-analyst + 角色扮演讲述者 roleplay

description.en: Provides wiki-based knowledge management skills (ingest, query, lint, save) for building a personal knowledge base.
description.zh: The claude-obsidian-derived knowledge-suite skills (wiki, wiki-ingest, wiki-query, wiki-lint, save) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin, with attribution

description.en: A Pomodoro plugin that adds focus and break cycles to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加番茄钟，可配置专注与休息时长，提供侧栏入口和可拖动浮动面板。

description.en: Edit PowerPoint shapes and slides with natural-language prompts, applying byte-preserving OOXML patches to .pptx with undo and redo.
description.zh: 通过自然语言编辑 PowerPoint 形状和幻灯片，以字节保真的 OOXML 补丁写入 .pptx，并支持撤销与重做。

description.en: Performance plugin that cuts DSH session event volume by merging LLM stream deltas, reducing logs, disk, and push traffic.
description.zh: 通过合并 LLM 流式增量来减少 DSH 会话事件量，降低日志、磁盘和推送流量，缓解性能问题。

description.en: Autonomous proactive scheduling plugin with dual-mind AI, energy economy, curiosity exploration, safety governance, Raft consensus, and hot updates.
description.zh: DSH Proactive — 主动智能调度插件：自主心跳 + 科学家/理论家双心智（贝叶斯实验设计与定律归纳）+ 能量共生经济 + 好奇心探索 + 安全治理，Raft 共识与热更新

description.en: Enhances informal prompts in DSH Web chat via LLM, with a magic wand button that rewrites input for clearer AI interpretation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话输入框加魔法棒按钮，调用 LLM 把随意的提示词改写成更清晰、便于 AI 理解的表述。

description.en: Suggests context-aware next messages in the DeepSeek Harness composer, learning from conversation history and local interactions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框中，根据对话历史和本地交互记录，提供上下文相关的下一条消息建议。

description.en: 给 DSH 对话输入框加一个 ♂harden 按钮：一键把草稿锻造成硬邦邦、雷霆炫酷、肌肉集团味的提示词 —— 事实一条不丢，废话一句不留。A hard-boiled prompt rewriter for the DeepSeek Harness composer.
Forces all DSH host fetch traffic through a custom proxy (Clash/mihomo/v2ray) without TUN or system proxy.
description.zh: 让 DSH 主机的所有 fetch 请求走自定义代理（Clash、mihomo、v2ray），无需 TUN 或系统代理。

description.en: Search and retrieve PubMed articles via NCBI E-utilities and Europe PMC for metadata, full text, citations, MeSH, and ID conversion.
description.zh: 将 pubmed-mcp-server 核心能力移植为 DSH 原生工具，提供 PubMed 搜索、文章元数据、全文、引用格式化、MeSH、ID 转换等 11 个工具，直接对接 NCBI E-utilities 与 Europe PMC REST。

description.en: Cross-session usage and cost tracking dashboard for DeepSeek Harness with trend/heatmap visualizations and balance reconciliation.
description.zh: 跨会话统计 DeepSeek Harness 用量与费用的仪表盘，提供趋势图和热力图，按模型显示高峰时段价格（人民币/美元），并查询官方余额进行花费对账。

description.en: Local security-eval and prompt-cleaning plugin with a sidebar to manage prompt layers, patches, rulesets and skills, plus an authorized drill range.
description.zh: 本地安全评测与提示词清洗插件，侧栏管理提示词分层、补丁、规则集与技能，并带授权演练台。

description.en: Manages workspace-scoped Python virtual environments: discover, create, install into, and remove venvs.
description.zh: 管理工作区范围的 Python 虚拟环境，支持发现、创建、安装依赖和移除 venv。

description.en: Connects Qoder models to DeepSeek Harness via PAT, with dual-region support, model toggles, context-window settings, daily check-in and quota overview.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 将 Qoder 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持双区域、模型开关、上下文窗口、每日签到与额度概览。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for REA (rea-agents): registers the reverse-engineer-anything skill plus the rea / rea_doctor tools in every session. REA itself is not bundled.
Adds configurable reasoning levels and per-subagent model selection for third-party APIs in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 API 添加低、中、高等可配置推理强度，并支持为每次子 Agent 调用选择模型。

description.en: Rolls back a question and all later context and workspace changes; archives old session logs and lets you re-ask.
Turns another computer into a persistent remote DSH agent worker, running tasks locally and sending the hub a handoff summary plus artifact manifest.
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成持久运行的 DSH 远程 Agent 同事，任务在副机本地执行，主机只接收 handoff 摘要和产物清单。

description.en: Marks reverse-proxied (non-loopback) dsh web pages as trusted hosts so the Settings surface loads instead of being blocked.
description.zh: 将反向代理（非回环）的 dsh 网页标记为受信任主机，使设置界面可以正常加载而不是被拦截。

description.en: Beautifies DeepSeek Harness replies with polished typography, interactive charts and tables, and isolated HTML artifacts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的回复提供精美排版、交互式图表与表格，以及隔离渲染的 HTML 组件。

description.en: Browser-side DSH plugin that maintains a research resource directory and assembles workflows and user parameters into editable prompts for the current session to send and execute.
description.zh: 浏览器侧 DSH 插件：维护科研资源目录，把工作流和用户参数组装成可编辑 Prompt，由当前会话发送执行。

description.en: Adds a one-click restart button to the top-right of the DSH session header, working on Windows desktop and dsh web clients.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏右上角添加一键重启按钮，支持 Windows 桌面端和 dsh 网页端。

description.en: Recreates the Sword Art Online Link Start startup animation in DSH with WebGL, voice and sound effects, then restores the full UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中复刻刀剑神域 Link Start 开屏动画，使用 WebGL 播放并还原语音与启动音效，动画结束后恢复完整界面。

description.en: SearXNG search provider for DSH that routes the built-in web_search tool through a SearXNG JSON API, with zero dependencies and no build step.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的 SearXNG 搜索后端，将内置 web_search 通过 SearXNG JSON API 执行，零依赖、无需构建。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: select text in a chat to carry it into your next message as a quote card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件：在对话中划词，把选中文本作为引用卡片带进下一条消息。

description.en: Shares and restores DSH sessions via URL deep links, syncing session ID in the browser address bar.
description.zh: 通过 URL 深链接分享和恢复 DSH 会话，并在浏览器地址栏同步会话 ID。

description.en: Drag a session out of the sidebar to open it as a standalone OS window, so you can watch several sessions at once without switching.
description.zh: 从侧边栏把会话拖出来，变成独立系统窗口，多会话并行查看无需来回切换。

description.en: Integrates six local plugins into one toolkit for session identity, global prompts, auto-resume, web restart, log button, and inter-session messaging.
description.zh: 把六个本地插件整合成一个工具包，提供会话身份、全局提示词、会话自动上线、Web 重启、日志按钮和会话间通信功能。

description.en: Routes LLM tasks via judge-based two-tier routing, fallback chains, and failover orchestration for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供两级模型路由，用 LLM 评审选择模型，支持多模型回退链、指数退避故障转移和任务级编排。

description.en: Collapse, reorder and hide DSH sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs to keep your workspace tidy.
description.zh: 折叠、排序和隐藏 DSH 侧边栏扩展入口与对话视图标签，让工作区更整洁有序。

description.en: Automatically extracts, refines, and manages reusable agent skills from successful turns via LLM review.
description.zh: 通过LLM审查自动提取、改进并管理智能体的可复用技能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skin plugin that adds global background images/videos, frosted glass effects, filters, and custom text and bubble colors.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 皮肤插件，支持全局背景图片/视频、毛玻璃效果、滤镜以及自定义文本与消息气泡颜色。

description.en: A chubby-fish desktop pet for each DSH session with dual stamina bars and hand-written Live2D that drops onto the desktop when clicked, plus a full inheritance flow.
description.zh: 给每个 DSH 会话配一只桌面大肥鱼：双体力条、全手写 Live2D，点一下就掉到桌面，并附带完整「传承」流程（四份文件/体检/归档）。

description.en: Exam-prep study desk with a Notion-style todo wall, a study-time heatmap and a cross-panel Pomodoro timer, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 考研学习工作台：Notion 式待办墙、按复习时长点亮的热力图与跨面板存活番茄钟，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Searchable workspace subagent manager for DeepSeek Harness Web
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可搜索的工作区子代理管理界面

description.en: Shows Z.ai, Kimi, MiMo and OpenCode Go subscription usage with quota details and cookie login beside the model selector.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁显示 Z.ai / Kimi / MiMo / OpenCode Go 订阅用量、额度明细与 Cookie 登录。

description.en: Adds clickable next-step suggestion buttons under each reply; one click sends that suggestion as your message.
description.zh: 在每条回复下方给出一排可点击的下一步建议，点一下即作为你的消息发出。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tree view for branching DSH conversations, switching between versions, promoting branches to sessions, and renaming them.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话提供侧边栏树状视图，可分支、切换版本、将分支提升为正式会话并重命名分支。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill plugin distilling Qian Xuesen's Engineering Cybernetics into practical methodology.
description.zh: 将钱学森《工程控制论》全书蒸馏为可供 DeepSeek Harness 调用的方法论技能插件

description.en: DSH updater and docs sync plugin providing npm update progress and docs search/read tools.
description.zh: DSH 更新器与官方文档同步插件，支持一键 npm 更新并实时显示进度、增量同步文档，提供 dsh_docs_search 和 dsh_docs_read 工具。

description.en: One-click update checker and puller for DeepSeek Harness, with version compare and safe fast-forward updates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键检查并拉取更新，比较版本并以安全快进方式完成更新。

description.en: Satirical DSH plugin that runs a loopback-only speedtest in the host process and shows live local TCP bandwidth in the sidebar.
description.zh: 讽刺向 DSH 插件：在宿主进程内启动仅监听回环地址的测速服务，并在侧栏显示本机 TCP 带宽实时速率。

description.en: Adds a version update menu to DeepSeek Harness settings to check, install, and apply dsh releases automatically.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板添加版本更新菜单，可检查 @deepseek-ai/dsh 新版本、一键安装，并自动重启宿主和刷新页面。

description.en: MoTu renders code blocks in chats into real diagrams via six local engines: Mermaid, Graphviz, nomnoml, ECharts, Vega-Lite and hand-written SVG.
description.zh: 墨图把对话中的代码块渲染成真正的图，内置 Mermaid、Graphviz、nomnoml、ECharts、Vega-Lite 与手写 SVG 六大本地引擎。

description.en: Provides TTS (edge-tts) and STT (OpenAI-compatible ASR) voice capabilities for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供语音能力：voice_tts 通过 edge-tts 协议做微软神经语音合成并本地生成 Sec-MS-GEC，voice_stt 调用 OpenAI 兼容 ASR，voice_list 列出语音。

description.en: Voice chat plugin for DeepSeek Harness: speak to input, AI replies read aloud via TTS.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音聊天插件：用语音输入提问，AI 回复通过 TTS 朗读出来。

description.en: Adds a mic button to compose speech into text live via the browser's Web Speech API.
description.zh: 在编辑器工具栏添加麦克风按钮，用浏览器 Web Speech API 实时把语音转为文字，支持切换语言和可选自动发送。

description.en: Adds a customizable image wallpaper background to the dsh web UI with opacity, mask, and blur controls.
description.zh: 为dsh网页界面添加可自定义的图片壁纸背景，支持透明度、遮罩和模糊控制。

description.en: Adds a one-click restart button to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that restarts the dsh web process.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面侧边栏底部添加按钮，单击即可重启 dsh web 进程。

description.en: Enables web search in all dsh conversation modes, including minimal mode.
description.zh: 所有 dsh 对话模式支持联网搜索，极简模式可用。Web search for all dsh conversation modes, minimal included.

description.en: Provides a SearXNG-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness, enabling API-key-free search retrieval.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 SearXNG 的网页搜索后端，无需 API 密钥即可检索搜索结果。

description.en: Wraps the 'we need...' chain-of-thought guidance into a DeepSeek Harness plugin to make model reasoning executable, first-person, and task-typed.
description.zh: 将 We Need 思维链封装为 dsh 插件，让模型推理以第一人称、按任务类型执行，稳定触发该思维链。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style collapsible category tree to the DSH sidebar, grouping content as categories > workspaces > sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏添加 VS Code 风格的可折叠分类树，按分类 > 工作区 > 会话层级组织内容。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent workspace hygiene: artifact value assessment, metadata indexing, and auditable cleanup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于智能体工作区卫生：工件价值评估、元数据索引和可审计清理。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab to dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 中增加一个类似 VS Code 的工作区关键词搜索标签页。

description.en: Custom color scheme plugin for deepseek-harness based on anime character Yuno Sengoku.
description.zh: 基于动画《Yumemita》角色千石由乃的剧照素材，为 deepseek-harness 提供自定义配色方案。

description.en: Adds a toggleable bilingual overlay to DSH that shows Chinese names and descriptions for plugins, commands and skills alongside the English originals.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可开关的双语覆盖层，为插件、命令与 Skill 显示中文名称和说明，并保留英文原文。

description.en: Zotero literature skill for DeepSeek Harness: find papers, screen core reading, manage tags/collections, build multi-level folders and auto-collect new papers daily.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Zotero 文献技能：检索文献、筛选核心论文、管理标签与归集、搭建多层文件夹并每日自动收录新论文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill that drives MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.
description.zh: 基于MAA的DeepSeek Harness技能，驱动MaaCore自动化完成明日方舟日常任务。

description.en: DSH desktop pet that reacts to AI thinking/tool states, shows replies as bubbles, and supports desktop chat tasks with built-in Windows Computer Use.
description.zh: DSH桌面宠物插件：随DSH思考、工具调用等状态动作，气泡显示回复，支持桌面任务与Windows Computer Use。

description.en: Workflow skill set for DeepSeek Harness with structured interviews, strategic planning, and consensus subagent routing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作流技能集，包含结构化访谈、战略规划与共识子代理路由。

description.en: Pure DSH plugin that natively plugs Qoder's model quota into DeepSeek Harness as an LLM provider adapter.
description.zh: 纯 DSH 插件，把 Qoder 的模型额度以原生 provider 方式接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A draggable widget panel for DeepSeek Harness displaying balance, tokens, stats, commands, goal, and cost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可拖拽小组件面板，显示余额、代币、统计、命令、目标和费用。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace for dsh that discovers, verifies, and installs GitHub repos tagged with dsh-plugin topic.
description.zh: DSH 插件市场：搜索 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题插件，一键安装到本地 dsh（agent 工具 + 设置页插件市场 tab）

description.en: Brings human code review of AI-generated changes into the DeepSeek Harness so developers can inspect diffs without leaving the agent workflow.
description.zh: 把人工代码审查环节搬进 DeepSeek Harness，让开发者无需离开 Agent 工作流即可查看 AI 产出的代码变更。

description.en: Preview Mermaid diagrams as images in chat sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在聊天会话中将 Mermaid 图表以图片形式预览

description.en: Splits the flat sidebar workspace list into named category sections, lets you browse them in place, and re-file projects by drag & drop.
description.zh: 将扁平的工作区侧边栏列表拆分为命名分类分组，可就地浏览并通过拖放重新归类项目。

description.en: Provides bioinformatics and biology analysis tools for DeepSeek Harness using Biopython for sequence and genomics analysis.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Biopython 的序列与基因组分析工具，并用 uv+venv 免安装 Python 环境。

description.en: WebUI deep link plugin that opens a specific project conversation directly from URL query parameters.
description.zh: 通过 ?session= 或 ?workspace= 查询参数直接打开指定项目对话的 WebUI 深链插件

description.en: Compresses chat context via automatic summarization to reduce token usage, with overflow recovery and status commands.
description.zh: 对话上下文压缩插件：接近上限时自动全局总结压缩，保留核心任务、决策、待解决问题和重要文件位置，删除调试细节与已解决错误，压缩后校验 token 真实下降，支持上下文溢出自动恢复、/compact 与 /context-status 命令及输入框上方一键按钮。

description.en: File-tracing plugin for DSH Web UI: logs model file operations and shows terminal-style diffs with line numbers.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 文件追踪插件：记录模型读/写/编辑的文件，以终端风格显示带行号的差异。

description.en: Provides a plugin manager in DSH web UI to enable/disable/delete plugins with hot reload.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中提供插件管理，可启用、禁用、删除插件并支持热重载

description.en: Desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with sprite animation, agent state linkage, drag, and alarm/pomodoro widgets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供桌面宠物：精灵动画、与代理状态联动、可拖动，并带闹钟和番茄钟小组件，皮肤可分离。

description.en: A draggable animated floating cat/dog companion for DeepSeek Harness web that reacts to session state.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页提供一个可拖拽的动画浮动猫或狗伴侣，能随会话状态变化做出反应。

description.en: Mobile remote control plugin for DeepSeek Harness, enabling phones on LAN to control the desktop app via QR code connection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动端远程控制插件，设置页提供扫码连接二维码、一键开启远程控制和在线设备数统计，并优化手机端界面，让局域网内手机可远程操控电脑端 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Automated backup, empty detection, and one-click restore for DeepSeek Harness chat records and workspace data.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动备份聊天记录与工作区数据，检测数据被清空并支持一键恢复，可通过桌面端或 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Registers CodeBuddy CLI as a dsh subagent provider with independent in-process sessions and tool step translation.
description.zh: 将 CodeBuddy CLI 注册为 dsh 子代理提供方，支持进程内独立会话和工具步骤转换，并提供 subagent_codebuddy 工具。

description.en: Audio preview plugin for the dsh sidebar with zoomable waveform, live spectrum, whole-file spectrogram, and its own Range-capable streaming media route.
description.zh: dsh 侧边栏的音频预览插件：可缩放波形、实时频谱、全曲频谱图，并自带支持 HTTP Range 的流式媒体路由。

description.en: GUI panel to manage MCP server configurations with hot-reload and tool browsing for agents.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理面板：图形界面增删改 MCP 服务器配置并写入 cordis.patch.yml 热挂载，支持浏览工具，并向 agent 提供 mcp_* 管理工具。

description.en: Security vetting pipeline for dsh plugins: static scans, LLM audits, scorecards, and runtime guards with alerts.
description.zh: deepseek-harness 插件安全审查流水线：11 条规则的确定性静态扫描、LLM 审计协议、两部分评分卡，可选运行时防护（T1 哨兵、T2 fs 与 child_process 钩子）和蜜罐诱饵，仅监控告警不拦截。

description.en: Inject rules into streams on demand to conserve context, inspired by oh-my-pi's time-traveling stream rules.
description.zh: Inject rules when needed, without wasting context. Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules", but with a very simple and compact code implementation.

description.en: Fixes Windows Git Bash MSYS sandbox conflict in DeepSeek Harness and adds terminal inspector plus collective-thinking preset.
description.zh: Windows Git Bash fix for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): MSYS sandbox conflict + terminal inspector, with the minimal-win collective-thinking preset (we/let's chain)

description.en: B2B lead generation skill that searches target companies, cross-validates leads, extracts contacts, and manages a client lead pipeline.
description.zh: 用于B2B获客，可搜索目标公司、交叉验证线索、提取联系人并管理客户线索流程。

description.en: Read-only workspace Git HUD for dsh with branch status, diffs, per-session file attribution, and review progress.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供只读工作区 Git 面板：分支状态、差异、按会话的文件改动归属与审阅进度。

description.en: Exposes DSH-registered LLMs via an OpenAI-compatible /v1 relay endpoint, with API key management and auth toggle, reusing DSH's llm service.
description.zh: 把 DSH 已注册的大模型通过 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 接口反代出去，支持 API 密钥管理与鉴权开关，复用 DSH 的 llm 服务。

description.en: DSH plugin that replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip and dissolves into the app.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用全窗口视频替换内核启动页，随后溶解过渡进入应用。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin adding a hierarchical workspace tree, time-bucket view and session pinning for organizing work.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，提供层级工作区树、时间分组视图与会话固定功能，便于整理工作。

description.en: Replaces dsh's web search and web fetch tools with a persistent loopback Node CLI on undici, plus document-to-Markdown parsing.
description.zh: 用基于 undici 的常驻回环 Node CLI 替代 dsh 的网页搜索与抓取工具，并支持文档转 Markdown。

description.en: Flash-only reasoning-effort routing for DeepSeek Harness, setting the DeepSeek flash model reasoning effort per step. The model never changes; effort max is opt-in.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 逐步设置 flash 模型的推理强度，模型本身不变，最大强度需手动开启。

description.en: Bridges Codex/Claude Code plugins to dsh, adding a portable agent plugin kernel and adapters.
description.zh: 将 Codex 或 Claude Code 插件桥接到 dsh，提供可移植的代理插件内核和适配器。

description.en: Turns model answers into live, clickable web pages embedded right in the chat, with version history, self-checks and export.
description.zh: 把模型的回答变成可直接交互的网页，内嵌在对话中，支持版本记录、自检与导出。

description.en: Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for DSH, orchestrating tool calls, sub-agents, and branches.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可视化拖拽式工作流搭建，可编排工具调用、子代理与分支。

description.en: Experimental pixel desktop skin for DSH Web inspired by NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE.
description.zh: 受《主播女孩重度依赖》启发的实验性像素桌面皮肤，适用于DSH Web。

description.en: Studio for per-conversation system prompts: append text, shadow one named prompt section, or replace the whole prompt, applied live per session.
description.zh: 按会话定制的系统提示词工作室：可追加文本、覆盖某个命名提示词段落或整体替换系统提示词，无需重启即在下一次请求生效。

description.en: DSH plugin manager for installing, uninstalling, starting, and disabling plugins from a web settings page.
description.zh: DSH 插件管理器：在网页设置页安装、卸载、启动、停用内置与第三方插件，并可直达 GitHub

description.en: Desktop blackboard keep track of the gaokao countdown while popping random Markdown knowledge-card quizzes when the AI is working.
description.zh: 桌面小黑板显示高考倒计时，并在 AI 工作时随机弹出 Markdown 知识卡抽背。

description.en: VS Code-like code editor with file tree, syntax highlighting, and automatic line diffs for agent edits in DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供代码编辑器，含文件树、语法高亮，并在智能体修改文件时自动显示行级差异。

description.en: Provides a Git status floating window with commit graph, uncommitted changes, inline diffs, and branch operations.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 状态浮窗插件，显示提交泳道图、未提交改动与储藏，支持内联差异查看和分支操作。

description.en: Status-bar plugin that monitors quotas and consumption across GLM, OpenCode Go, Kimi, Xiaomi and DeepSeek, plus token usage stats.
description.zh: 输入框状态栏多厂商额度监控插件，覆盖 GLM、OpenCode Go、Kimi、小米、DeepSeek 的额度与消耗，并统计 Token 用量。

description.en: Drag/drop or paste files into input; images use draft flow, docs stored in .dsh-file-attachment and referenced.
description.zh: 拖拽/粘贴文件（支持多文件）进输入框：图片沿用原有草稿图片流程；文档读取内容存入项目根 .dsh-file-attachment 临时目录并插入 @绝对路径引用

description.en: DSH plugin that displays account balances for all configured model providers in a sidebar panel, with auto-refresh every 5 minutes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏面板显示所有已配置模型提供商的账户余额，每5分钟自动刷新。

description.en: Token usage recording and statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness with full-screen analytics panels and CSV export.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 的 Token 用量记录与统计插件，提供全屏分析面板并支持导出 CSV 文件。

description.en: Eye-care theme pack adding three switchable low-glare color palettes to the DeepSeek Harness GUI.
description.zh: 护眼主题包，为 DeepSeek Harness 界面提供三套可切换的低眩光配色。

description.en: Sidebar views for DeepSeek Harness that show activity and favorites so you can track running, waiting, and unread sessions across workspaces.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供活动与收藏视图，跨工作区跟踪运行中、等待中和未读的会话。

description.en: Connects SiYuan notes to DeepSeek Harness with 17 tools to search, read and write your note library, plus a settings page for connection and permissions.
description.zh: 将思源笔记接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 17 个工具检索、读取和写入笔记库，并有独立设置页管理连接与权限。

description.en: Gives LLM agents stateful PTY terminal sessions with screen snapshots, key input, wait conditions, and shared human-agent control.
description.zh: 为 LLM 智能体提供有状态的 PTY 终端会话:屏幕快照、按键输入、等待条件,以及人机共享的终端。

description.en: Detects repeated commands, failure loops and zero output in AI coding agents, injecting mid-run self-review nudges and calibrating AI time sense with the local clock.
description.zh: 检测 AI 编码代理的重复命令、失败循环与零产出，注入中途自省提醒，并用本地真实时钟校准 AI 的时间感。

description.en: An architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering.
description.zh: 以架构图驱动的智能体工程框架，围绕架构图组织 Agent 的构建与执行流程。

description.en: A desktop pet plugin for DSH Web GUI with customizable characters, feeding, and playing.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加桌面宠物，内置噜噜、总裁等角色，支持喂食、玩耍，并可快速添加自定义宠物

description.en: DSH plugin showing DeepSeek account balance and session token/cost with peak/off-peak billing.
description.zh: DSH 插件：显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，以及当前会话的 token 用量和费用，并按高峰与空闲时段计费。

description.en: Fetches Chinese Agricultural University campus notices, AI-generates summaries/classifications/deadlines, and lets users browse/query them in DSH.
description.zh: 抓取中国农业大学通知公告，AI生成摘要/分类/截止日期，可在DSH中浏览和查询。

description.en: Migrates Claude Code conversations, skills, memory, and plugins into DeepSeek Harness resumable sessions, with round-trip export to JSONL.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的对话、技能、记忆和插件迁移到 DeepSeek Harness 可续传会话，并支持与 JSONL 双向导出。

description.en: Integrates Zhipu GLM Coding Plan MCP servers into DeepSeek Harness, adding web search, web fetch, and GitHub repo tools.
description.zh: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) MCP servers into DSH - 接入智谱的工具

description.en: An Instagram assistant inside DeepSeek Harness that turns your real DSH usage into persona-driven Stories and Notes, controlled only by your own DMs.
description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的 Instagram 助理：依托人格与记忆，把真实 DSH 使用数据变成 Story 与 Note，且只接受主人私信指挥。

description.en: Git history viewer for DSH dock showing commit graph, branches, tags, remotes, and supporting stage/commit/push.
description.zh: DSH dock 的 Git 历史可视化插件，显示提交图、分支、标签和远端，并支持暂存、提交与推送。

description.en: Image viewer for DSH dock that renders multiple image formats including PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO, AVIF.
description.zh: DSH dock 图片查看器，可渲染 PNG、JPEG、GIF、WebP、BMP、SVG、ICO、AVIF 等格式。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar account label (phone or email) with custom text via an account-menu editor, so screenshots don't expose it.
description.zh: 通过账户菜单编辑器把侧边栏账户标签（手机号或邮箱）替换为自定义文字，避免截图泄露隐私。

description.en: Visible dispatch panel for DeepSeek Harness that decides whether other agents help, picks free-lane helpers, and injects a division-of-labour policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化调度面板：决定是否让其他智能体协助，挑选空闲通道的帮手，并注入分工策略。

description.en: Imports local sessions from Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, ZCode and Kimi into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将 Cursor、Codex、Claude Code、ZCode 和 Kimi 的本地会话导入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Multi-agent team plugin: build teams in natural language, run task-dependency DAGs, message via mailbox, monitor agents in a sidebar tree.
description.zh: 多智能体团队插件：自然语言组队、任务依赖 DAG 编排、信箱通信，并在右侧栏树状监测团队运行。

description.en: Agent workflow and engineering skill set with orchestration, three-axis diff review, complexity audit and mutation testing, zero deps.
description.zh: 通用 agent 工作流与工程技能集：编排、三轴 diff 评审、复杂度审计与突变测试，零外部依赖。

description.en: Generate images and videos with Agnes models inside a DSH sidebar panel, with durable background tasks and history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏面板中使用 Agnes 模型生成图片和视频，支持持久后台任务与历史记录。

description.en: Global seamless warm-up plugin for DeepSeek Harness that auto-warms the first round of any session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局热身插件，在任意会话首轮自动执行热身，第二轮起恢复完整模式。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds AMD Radeon Token Factory free models (DeepSeek V4, MiMo, Qwen3.8, GLM 5.3) to the model selector with one API key.
description.zh: 在 dsh 模型选择器中接入 AMD Radeon Token Factory 免费模型（DeepSeek V4、MiMo、Qwen3.8、GLM 5.3），只需填入一个 API Key。

description.en: A programmable agent memory orchestration layer with an append-only journal, reversible memory edits, and auditable self-tuning.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的可编程记忆编排层与自我进化引擎：追加式日志存储、可逆记忆操作、运行时切换注入策略与可审计回滚的自调参。

description.en: Apify plugin for the DeepSeek harness
Adds persistent personas, character memory and opt-in proactive chat that resumes after a restart.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 添加持久角色人设、角色记忆与可选的主动聊天，重启后自动恢复。

description.en: A-share stock research assistant for dsh: search stocks, digest announcements and financials, view valuation profile, and learn trading signal factors.
description.zh: dsh 的 A 股个股研究插件，可搜索股票、查看历史公告与财报、估值画像，并科普交易信号因子，附合规 skill。

description.en: Adds PDF/Office text extraction, OCR, and image-to-PNG conversion for attachments in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: Codex-style attachment formats for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: PDF text-layer extraction, Office text extraction, scanned-PDF OCR, long-document spill + index cards, image-to-PNG.

description.en: AI audio generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI: multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects, voice design, model comparison, and Agent tools.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness设计的AI音频生成插件，支持多供应商TTS、音乐、音效、声音设计、模型比较和Agent工具。

description.en: Compresses conversation context to save tokens and adds evidence-backed self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 压缩上下文以节省 token，并提供有证据支撑的自我进化能力。

description.en: Blocks outgoing text that reads as formulaic boilerplate and auto-matches replies to incoming memes using a built-in 6,792-entry meme wiki.
description.zh: 把发出去像八股的文字打回，并在对方抛梗时用内置 6792 条梗 wiki 提前查好怎么接。

description.en: DSH plugin to control per-model thinking effort for OpenAI-compatible APIs, auto-detecting public reasoning capabilities.
description.zh: DSH 插件：为 OpenAI 兼容中转站按模型管理思考强度，并自动识别公开能力

description.en: Adds a live plain-text decision log plus sidebar act cards so every agent tool call carries a describe and stays visible and correctable.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加纯文本决策日志与右侧 act 卡片，强制每次工具调用携带 describe，让 Agent 的思考与调用可见可纠偏。

description.en: A floating read-only dashboard for DS Bot that shows which agents are running, stuck, or waiting on you.
description.zh: 一个只读的 DS Bot 浮动看板，实时显示哪些代理在运行、哪些卡住、哪些在等你。

description.en: Customizes in-app branding (name, badge, logo, wordmark, page title) across DSH Web, PWA and Desktop via a settings panel with live preview.
description.zh: 通过独立设置面板自定义 DSH 网页、PWA 与桌面端共用的品牌名称、徽章、logo 字标和页面标题，支持即时预览与恢复官方外观。

description.en: Browser automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness using playwright-core to drive a persistent Chrome profile with autonomous task execution and safety features.
description.zh: browser-use style browser automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: drives a dedicated Chrome instance (persistent profile) via playwright-core — fine-grained tools, autonomous tasks, scheduling, danger

description.en: Inspects ASCII DXF files with evidence-first approach and performs deterministic CAD rule review.
description.zh: 检查 ASCII DXF 文件，以证据优先方式执行确定性 CAD 规则审查

description.en: A per-session cd tool that makes relative paths in file tools and bash's default working directory follow a new directory, without moving the session root.
description.zh: 一个按会话生效的 cd 工具，让文件工具的相对路径和 bash 默认工作目录跟随新目录，且不移动会话或工作区根目录。

description.en: A pure chat panel for DSH Web GUI, reusing DSH's LLM routing and storing chat history locally.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的纯聊天面板插件，不绑定工作区、不启用工具，复用 ctx.llm 模型路由进行流式对话，并将多会话历史保存在本地。

description.en: DSH web GUI chat table-of-contents outline bar for navigating conversations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页聊天界面右侧显示对话目录条，悬停展开，点击可跳转到对应位置。

description.en: Adds a draggable handle to resize chat content width in DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加可拖拽手柄，调节聊天内容宽度，范围 748px 到 1040px。

description.en: Free voice input and text-to-speech read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness chat, zero config and no API key.
description.zh: 为 dsh 聊天提供语音输入，并把 AI 回复朗读出来，零配置、无需 API key。

description.en: Sound notification plugin for DSH agent events with customizable ringtones, volume, and mute.
description.zh: DSH 声音提醒插件:九类 Agent 事件(完成/子任务/后台任务/审批/提问/评审/受阻/打断/失败)独立铃声、音量与开关,浏览器合成音 + Windows 系统蜂鸣,工作区快捷静音

description.en: Connects CLIProxyAPI (CPA) models into the DSH model selector, syncing the model catalog, context length, and quotas for easy use.
description.zh: 把 CLIProxyAPI（CPA）里的模型一键接入 DSH 模型选择器，自动同步模型目录、上下文长度并查看额度。

description.en: Bridges Tencent CodeBuddy CLI into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider with DSH tool calls, streaming, usage and delegation.
description.zh: 将腾讯 CodeBuddy CLI 作为模型提供方接入 DSH，支持工具调用、流式输出、用量统计与独立委派任务。

description.en: Embeds a real ComfyUI editor and per-session workflow tools directly inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中嵌入真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器，并提供按会话管理的 workflow 工具。

description.en: Enterprise companion for DeepSeek Harness: security/DLP, collaboration, knowledge, orchestration, model comparison, trace analysis, prompt tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 企业级伴侣插件，提供安全审计与 DLP、团队协作与知识管理、任务编排与断点续跑、多模型竞技场、执行轨迹分析及 Prompt 工程工作台。

description.en: Plugin marketplace for DSH desktop that browses official and community plugins, shows a compatibility verdict before install, and delegates installation to the official DSH pipeline.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端打造的插件市场：侧栏浏览官方与社区插件，安装前给出兼容性结论，并交由官方插件安装管线一键安装。

description.en: Bridges QwenWork into DeepSeek Harness via a local OpenAI-compatible loopback server that translates DSH model requests into QwenWork ACP sessions.
description.zh: 通过本地 OpenAI 兼容回环服务把千问办公接入 DeepSeek Harness，将 DSH 的模型请求转换为千问办公的 ACP 会话。

description.en: Model-driven context-window rollover for DeepSeek Harness to maintain fresh working context with durable notes and verbatim recent tail.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供模型驱动的上下文窗口滚动，保持新鲜工作上下文，持久笔记和逐字近期尾部。

description.en: Adds fixed navigation and hover previews for long agent conversations in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的长对话添加固定导航条与悬停预览，便于在冗长的智能体对话中快速定位和跳转消息。

description.en: Tracks daily LLM call costs for DeepSeek Harness Web, viewable by session, model, and day.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 记录每日 LLM 调用花费，可按会话、模型和日期查看。

description.en: DSH plugin that changes submit shortcut from Enter to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, making Enter insert a newline instead.
description.zh: 将提交快捷键从 Enter 改为 Ctrl/Cmd+Enter，使 Enter 用于换行。

description.en: A dsh plugin that gives every custom-provider model selectable reasoning effort, wired through the stock pi-ai adapter.
description.zh: dsh 插件：让自定义提供方（pi-ai 手写路由）的所有模型都能选择思考强度（推理等级），选择经原厂适配器真正发往线上。A dsh plugin giving every custom-provider model selectable reasoning effort, wired through the stock pi-ai adapter.

description.en: A customizable DSH theme lets you change the background image, theme colors, sticker emojis, and text, based on dsh-vesna-theme.
description.zh: 一个可自定义的 DSH 主题，支持修改背景图片、主题色、表情包与文案，基于 dsh-vesna-theme。

description.en: Queries your DeepSeek API balance and today's spending inside DSH, with a daily spending cap, overspend alerts, view filters and a 7-day ledger.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查询 DeepSeek API 余额与今日消费，支持今日额度上限、超额提醒、视图切换和 7 天账本。

description.en: Turn CSV data into insight reports with profiling, DuckDB queries, charts, and report templates.
description.zh: 将CSV数据转为洞察报告：剖析数据集、运行DuckDB查询、生成图表与结构化报告模板。

description.en: DeepSeek API quota blood-bar widget for DSH web GUI showing balance, spend, and session cost.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的 DeepSeek API 额度血条组件，显示相对月初的剩余余额、今日与本月消费、当前会话费用，可拖动和折叠。

description.en: Recursive self-improvement engine for DeepSeek Harness enforcing upstream feature parity via a bounded loop.
description.zh: Recursive Self-Improvement engine for DeepSeek Harness — DSH maintains DSH: bounded perceive→integrate→verify→parity→repair→propose loop enforcing 1:1 upstream feature parity

description.en: Douyin OEM local promotion ad daily/weekly report automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 抖音本地推OEM投流日报/周报自动化插件，用于DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Floating overlay in DSH that shows live download, install and background-task progress with size, speed and percentage.
description.zh: 在 DSH 窗口顶部浮出一条进度条，实时显示下载/安装/后台任务的大小、速度与百分比。

description.en: Versioned DPIA workbench for DeepSeek Harness that traces facts, resolves gaps, reassesses risks, and produces reviewable reports.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的版本化 DPIA 工作台，可追踪事实、补齐缺口、重评风险并生成可审阅报告。

description.en: Real-time repetition guard that stops DSH model generation when identical strings repeat 10+ times.
description.zh: 实时监控 DSH 大模型流式输出，当同一字符串重复出现 10 次及以上时立即停止生成，防止复读。

description.en: Application scaffolding plugin to quickly create apps using DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 应用脚手架插件，用于快速使用 DeepSeek Harness 创建应用

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to EasyEDA Pro / 嘉立创EDA专业版 via MCP so the agent can draw schematics through tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到嘉立创EDA专业版 / EasyEDA Pro，让 Agent 使用工具绘制原理图。

description.en: Scans all unfinished EduCoder assignments and solves them via platform JSON APIs — zero-token multiple choice, model-generated code.
description.zh: 自动扫描头歌（EduCoder）所有未完成作业并一次做完，选择题零 token，仅代码题调用模型。

description.en: Automatically saves English learning cards from DeepSeek Harness conversations to build vocabulary notes.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness对话中自动保存英语学习卡片，帮助你积累词汇笔记。

description.en: Locks the Enter key in a web chat composer to prevent accidental sends, toggleable via button or shortcut.
description.zh: 锁定网页聊天输入框的回车发送，可通过锁定按钮或 Ctrl+Alt+L 切换，防止编辑长提示词时误发，兼容输入法且按会话生效。

description.en: Provides Evangelion-inspired themes (Unit-00, Unit-01, Unit-02) for DSH WebUI with immersive backgrounds and mecha-style UI effects.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 提供以 EVA 零号机、初号机、二号机为主题的界面皮肤，包含沉浸式背景和机甲风格 UI 效果。

description.en: Multi-platform watermark-free video and image downloader with whole-profile scraping, resume, auto-retry, local speech-to-text and a web workbench.
description.zh: 多平台短视频与图文无水印下载工具，支持整号抓取、断点续传、失败重试、本地语音转文字和 Web 工作台。

description.en: Bridges Exa Search MCP endpoint into DeepSeek Harness via MCP client for web search.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接，将远程 Exa MCP 端点（https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp）挂载到 DeepSeek Harness，提供网页搜索能力。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin for previewing, editing, and saving xlsx spreadsheets with formulas and formatting.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Excel 编辑插件，支持 xlsx 预览与编辑、公式实时计算、合并单元格和格式设置，并可保存回原文件。

description.en: Sidebar file explorer for DSH Web UI to browse workspace files and preview/edit content without leaving chat.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 侧边栏浏览当前工作区文件，支持预览和编辑，无需离开聊天界面。

description.en: A read-only workspace file browser for DeepSeek Harness with a right-side drawer and live file preview.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读工作区文件浏览，右侧抽屉展示目录并可实时预览文件内容。

description.en: A biomimetic memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that folds context into token clues and reconstructs memories to prevent context overflow.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 的仿生记忆插件，将上下文折叠为 Token 线索并重建记忆，避免上下文溢出。

description.en: Adds a movable, resizable fullscreen input panel to DSH for writing long multi-line text, Enter to newline and Ctrl+Enter to send.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加可移动、可缩放的全屏输入面板，用于撰写多行长文本，Enter 换行、Ctrl+Enter 发送。

description.en: Desktop sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness to quickly view ongoing gacha banners and event dates for 11 mobile games, with auto-refresh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness桌面端侧边栏插件，快速查看11款主流二游当期卡池与活动时间，支持联网自动刷新。

description.en: Game-style floating HUD for DeepSeek Harness with HP/MP bars, pricing countdown, auto-compaction, memory-carrying conversations.
description.zh: Game-style floating HUD for DeepSeek Harness: balance HP bar, context MP bar, official peak/valley pricing with countdown, auto-compaction, memory-carrying new conversation. ?????? HUD ??

description.en: Adds a DSH button that auto-detects Genshin Impact and launches it, or opens the official site in your browser if not installed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中添加按钮，自动识别并启动原神，未安装时用默认浏览器打开官网。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows a git status badge in the composer tool row, revealing branch name, changed file count and added/deleted lines on hover.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在输入框工具行显示 git 状态角标，悬停可查看分支名、变更文件数及新增/删除行数。

description.en: GitHub workbench for DSH sidebar: browse repo tree, manage issues/PRs/Actions, comment, merge, rerun CI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中浏览 GitHub 仓库目录树，并通过 Issues、PR、Actions 页签查看和处理事项，支持新建 Issue/PR、评论、合并以及重跑 CI，可作为 better-sidebar 页签或独立面板使用。

description.en: A tuned preset for the zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash coding agent in DeepSeek Harness, with PTC presentation, guard family, and isolated compaction.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的智谱 glm-5.3-flash 编码代理提供的调优预设，含 PTC 展示、守卫族与隔离压缩。

description.en: DeepGo Sensei is a DSH plugin that turns Go AI math (win rate, score gap, candidate moves, variations) into teacher-style verbal review for self-study players.
description.zh: DeepGo Sensei 是 DSH 插件，把围棋 AI 的胜率、目差、候选点与变化图翻译成老师级口头讲解，帮助自学棋手复盘。

description.en: AI personal growth workbench: profile to competency model to 90-day plan to daily execution to evidence to review, with agent tools sharing one JSON dataset.
description.zh: 面向普通用户的AI个人成长工作台：画像→能力模型→90天计划→今日执行→证据→考核复盘，页面与Agent共用同一份JSON数据。

description.en: Pushes DeepSeek Harness (dsh) task results to Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today service cards as notifications.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 任务结果推送到华为鸿蒙「负一屏」服务卡片。

description.en: Harness RAG plugin for DeepSeek Harness offering three-path retrieval, document continuation reading and a knowledge-base panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RAG 能力：三路检索、文档续读和知识库面板。

description.en: Adds Hebrew RTL support to DeepSeek Harness web UI: block direction, bidi inputs, RTL line navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加希伯来语 RTL 支持：按主文字设置块方向、双向安全输入框和 RTL 行导航。

description.en: Adds a sidebar settings page for the Hindsight memory stack and automates Windows deployment of a Hindsight server.
description.zh: 在侧边栏为 Hindsight 记忆栈提供设置页面，并自动化 Windows 上的 Hindsight 服务器部署。

description.en: ADHD-friendly output shaping for DeepSeek Harness with toggle tools and persistence.
description.zh: ADHD-friendly output shaping for DeepSeek Harness: one system-prompt section with adhd_on/adhd_off/adhd_status tools, persisted across restarts. Inspired by ayghri/i-have-adhd (MIT).

description.en: Custom persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: fill persona text beside chat input, toggle, auto-applies to new conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 打造的自定义人设控制插件。 在对话输入栏旁自由填写你的人设文本，一键开关，所有新对话自动生效、免重启。 人设纯粹是你设定的风格，不覆盖 DSH 安全护栏，安装即用、状态持久化。

description.en: Weekly IEEE Xplore Early Access digest: Crossref discovers new papers, an LLM screens each one, then a Markdown report is generated and emailed.
description.zh: IEEE Xplore Early Access 关键词周报：Crossref 抓取新收录论文，LLM 逐篇研判，生成 Markdown 报告并发送邮件。

description.en: Enables text-only LLMs to handle image attachments by projecting them as text placeholders and delegating to a vision subagent.
Automates issue-to-merged-PR pipeline with per-stage input contracts, failure signals, rollbackable and reviewable artifacts.
description.zh: 将一条 Issue 自动变为被合并的 PR，每个阶段都有输入契约、失败信号、可回滚与可审查的产物。

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model as a DSH agent tool returning calibrated probabilities for routing and triage.
description.zh: 将 TypeSafe Jev（System One）决策模型注册为 DSH 智能体工具，返回校准概率用于路由与分流判断。

description.en: Offline exam-prep platform that integrates 16 open-source civil-service repos with question drilling, an SRS wrong-answer notebook and an interactive knowledge graph.
description.zh: 离线考公备考整合平台，一键整合16个开源仓库，提供刷题、SRS错题本、整卷模考与可交互知识图谱。

description.en: Lazy memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that only reads on a hit, keeping resident memory at zero when nothing matches.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的惰性记忆插件，仅在命中时读取，无匹配时零常驻内存开销。

description.en: Unified LLM request/response inspector for DeepSeek Harness with reasoning control, external thinking export, traffic analysis, and session audit.
LLM adapter plugin for DeepSeek Harness running local Qwen3.8-27B via OpenAI-compatible API with multimodal and configurable inference.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness(dsh)的 LLM 适配器插件:驱动由 OpenAI 兼容服务的本地部署 Qwen3.8-27B 模型。支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位、请求图像投影,以及中英双语 Web 设置页。

description.en: Renders Markdown (headings, lists, code, tables, math, quotes) in DeepSeek Harness user and steering chat bubbles via the host pipeline.
description.zh: 通过宿主 Markdown 管线，在 DeepSeek Harness 的用户与引导聊天气泡中渲染标题、列表、代码、表格、数学公式和引用。

description.en: Provides uniform diff cards for file mutations in DeepSeek Harness Web, collapsed by default with per-line highlighting.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 中所有文件改动（MCP 文件系统的 edit_file/write_file 及内置编辑/写入）提供统一 diff 卡片，默认折叠并逐行高亮。

description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio/streamable-http) with four-level fail-closed authorization, loud mcpServers import errors, and full credential redaction.
description.zh: 受治理的 MCP 连接器注册表（stdio/streamable-http），提供四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers 导入显式报错与全程凭据脱敏。

description.en: A minimal MCP tool manager for DeepSeek Harness: add MCP servers, set Postman-style headers, test connectivity, and toggle individual tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的极简 MCP 工具管理器：可添加 MCP 服务器、配置 Postman 式请求头、测试连通性并逐工具开关。

description.en: Markdown sidebar viewer/editor with block- and text-range annotations for structured revision requests.
description.zh: DSH Markdown sidebar viewer and editor with block- and text-range annotations for structured revision requests.

description.en: DSH sidebar media dock that downloads Douyin/YouTube links with yt-dlp, transcodes with ffmpeg, transcribes locally via SenseVoice, and lets the Agent summarize subtitles.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏媒体台：用 yt-dlp 下载抖音/YouTube 链接，ffmpeg 转码，SenseVoice 本地转写字幕，并可一键让 Agent 总结。

description.en: DSH Desktop content-operations workbench for official topics, influencer deals, campaigns, marketing calendar and content-data analysis with charts.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 内容运营工作台：管理官号选题、达人合作、Campaign、营销日历，并用图表分析内容数据。

description.en: Captures Bilibili live streams, video links and local meeting recordings, transcribes them in the cloud, and generates searchable Markdown notes and AI meeting minutes.
description.zh: 采集B站直播、视频链接与本地会议录音，云端转写并生成可检索的 Markdown 笔记与 AI 纪要。

description.en: Adds on-demand memo lookup tools to DSH so agents can fetch facts from MEMO.md in a few hundred tokens instead of loading the whole file, plus a category panel and 3D bookshelf animation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加按需备忘录查询工具，用几百 token 就能从 MEMO.md 中查到事实，无需把整份文件读进上下文，并附带分类面板与三维书架动画。

description.en: Copies dsh assistant output as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code fences.
description.zh: 将 dsh 助手输出复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码和代码围栏。

description.en: A DSH plugin that turns a Markdown file into a live mindmap, with AI editing via chat.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 文件渲染成实时更新的思维导图，并可通过对话让 AI 编辑导图内容。

description.en: Mobile PWA for DeepSeek Harness: secure remote access, installable, offline, gestures, agent-done push.
description.zh: Complete mobile PWA for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): secure remote access gateway + install-to-homescreen + offline + touch gestures + agent-done push. deepseek-harness-plugin

description.en: Mirrors a real Android phone into DSH's sidebar for live tap control and circle-to-annotate screenshots, feeding UI text trees back to the model.
description.zh: 把真手机实时镜像到 DSH 右栏，可直接点击操控、圈选标注，并把圈图与控件树回传会话。

description.en: Provider and model management console for dsh: add, edit, sort, test and archive LLM providers and models with hot-reload.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供提供商与模型高级管理台，支持增删改、排序、测试与归档，配置保存即热生效。

description.en: Adds a source-grouped model picker for DeepSeek Harness, showing each provider's models in a slide-in side panel or inline fold.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加按来源分组的模型选择器，以滑入侧栏或内联折叠展示各提供商的模型。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker with a searchable, curated list supporting pin, hide and catalogue refresh.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器提供可搜索的模型选择器，支持置顶、隐藏模型并刷新服务商目录。

description.en: Minecraft-modpack-style bundler that packs a chosen subset of installed DSH plugins into one portable .dshmodpack.json for one-click rebuild elsewhere.
description.zh: 像《我的世界》整合包一样，把选中的 DSH 插件打包成可移植的 .dshmodpack.json 文件，在别的机器上一键还原整套插件环境。

description.en: Adds a simulated six-dimensional mood engine with tone injection, interactive petting/feeding, and an auto-written daily cyber diary.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加入模拟六维心情引擎、语气注入、互动安抚与自动书写的赛博日记。

description.en: An electronic wooden fish widget in the web client corner; click to count merits, auto-clicks when model is busy.
description.zh: 在 Web 客户端右下角显示一只小肥鲸电子木鱼，点击鲸头累计功德，模型忙碌等 loop 时自动敲击。

description.en: A production-grade DSH-native browser runtime for DeepSeek Harness that enables visible human-agent collaboration during browsing tasks.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的生产级 DSH 原生浏览器运行时，支持人类与智能体在浏览任务中可见协作。

description.en: A WebGL2 theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness that renders realistic paper textures and desk-lamp lighting behind the chat without changing native text or scrolling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 WebGL2 纸张肌理与台灯光影渲染的主题插件，不影响原生排版与滚动。

description.en: Browser notifications for DeepSeek Harness sessions: alerts on approval pending, questions, success, failure, and click-to-open session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供浏览器通知，在待审批、有提问、成功或失败时提醒，点击通知可打开对应会话。

description.en: Windows toast notifications with per-situation sounds for DSH desktop events like turn end, errors, approvals and questions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面应用提供 Windows 原生吐司通知与按场景区分的提示音，涵盖任务结束、出错、审批与提问等事件。

description.en: DSH Desktop novel-writing companion that interviews authors on world, characters and plot, then drafts per-chapter outlines for approval before writing prose.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 小说创作搭档：分阶段提问打磨世界观、人物与情节，每章先出大纲供作者定稿，再写正文。

description.en: One-page novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness that assembles per-chapter writing packets, draws candidate drafts, and tracks plot indexes, aliases and preferences.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的一页式小说创作工作台：自动拼装章节写作包、候选稿抽卡，并管理剧情索引、别称与跨书偏好档案。

description.en: Plays OpenCode notification sounds in DeepSeek Harness, with separate sound pickers for turn finished, permission requested and turn error.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中播放 OpenCode 通知音效，可分别为回合完成、权限请求和回合错误选择不同声音。

description.en: OLED burn-in care plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with true-black screensaver, dimming, and hue rotation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 OLED 防烧屏功能：纯黑界面、真黑休眠屏保、伽马感知调光和色相轮换。

description.en: Bridges WeChat, QQ, and Feishu chat messages to DSH agents and routes replies back to senders.
description.zh: 将微信、QQ和飞书聊天消息路由给 DSH 代理，并把代理回复发回原发送方。

description.en: Use DeepSeek Harness running on your computer from a phone browser over Tailscale, with no extra software.
description.zh: 通过 Tailscale 用手机浏览器访问电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness，无需额外安装任何软件。

description.en: DSH plugin to one-click sync OpenCode Go models: fetch server models, probe availability/vision, and write to llm-pi-ai config.
description.zh: DSH插件，一键同步OpenCode Go模型：获取服务器模型、探测可用性与视觉支持，并写入配置。

description.en: DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): CSV/TSV/PSV plus xlsx/xlsm workbook preview in the right sidebar, with sheet tabs and a circuit breaker (rows/cols/cells + two zip-container gates).
Adds an OpenSpec button to the session title bar to browse, preview, edit, and save files in the openspec/ directory.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加 OpenSpec 按钮，用于浏览、预览、编辑并保存 openspec/ 目录中的文件。

description.en: Drives local Origin/OriginPro from chat: imports data files, plots and fits, restyles graphs, exports images, and saves editable .opju projects.
description.zh: 在对话中驱动本机 Origin/OriginPro：导入数据文件、绘图与拟合、修改样式、导出图片并保存可编辑的 .opju 工程。

description.en: Embeds Overleaf LaTeX editor in DeepSeek Harness Web with reverse proxy, direct CDP login, and editing assistants.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web中嵌入Overleaf LaTeX编辑器，提供反向代理、CDP登录和编辑辅助。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns images into vector art using local color-region tracing and a hand-written renderer, CPU-only and fully offline.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过本地色块描摹和自写渲染器把图片转成矢量画，纯 CPU、完全离线、无需训练。

description.en: Cross-session message bus for DeepSeek Harness that lets independent sessions address and wake each other.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话消息总线，让相互独立的会话可以互相寻址并唤醒。

description.en: Client-side rendering performance plugin for DSH Desktop: cuts lag in long chats via lazy media, idle throttling and hidden-window pausing.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端客户端渲染性能优化插件，通过长对话省渲染、窗口隐藏暂停、空闲降帧与媒体懒加载来减少卡顿。

description.en: A UI theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a semi-transparent character background to the chat page with adjustable opacity and depth.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供林翩翩主题界面，将《哀鸿：城破十日记》角色林翩翩作为聊天页半透明背景，可调节透明度和深度。

description.en: Pixel-art skin for DeepSeek Harness with four retro themes and one-click switching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 像素皮肤（Agent Xi 风格）：四个主题一键切换——像素·木屋 / 像素·羊皮纸 / 像素·暖阳 / 像素·终端绿，随时可切回现代默认 UI。

description.en: Adds AI e-commerce image generation to DeepSeek Harness: product, detail and ad images, style replication and white backgrounds.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加电商 AI 生图能力：主图、详情图、广告图，还支持风格复刻与白底图。

description.en: 为 DSH Web 客户端的 plan 模式审批卡片增加第三个选项「压缩后执行」：先把计划提交之前的上下文压缩成一条摘要检查点，再批准计划，模型带着逐字保留的计划开始执行。
Read-only decoder for PLC project files that turns CoDeSys, Delta and Siemens projects into readable reports, structured data and comparisons.
description.zh: 只读解析 PLC 工程文件，将 CoDeSys、台达和西门子工程转换为可读报告、结构化数据并支持新旧对比。

description.en: DSH adapter that connects OpenCode Zen free models to DSH, as a maintained fork with gateway-compatibility fixes.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DSH 的适配器，为修复网关兼容性问题而维护的分支。

description.en: Builds an Android project folder into an APK using DSH, auto-downloading missing JDK/Android SDK/Gradle toolchains.
description.zh: 调用DSH将Android项目文件夹构建为APK，并自动下载缺失的JDK、Android SDK和Gradle工具链。

description.en: Knowledge base mirroring official dsh plugin development docs with topic navigation and search.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件开发知识库：官方文档完整镜像 + 主题导航与检索。Plugin development knowledge base for dsh.

description.en: Real-time gold price dashboard with Au99.99/XAU quotes, CMB accumulation gold estimates, trading reference, and threshold alerts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 黄金实时看板，显示 Au99.99 与 XAU 报价、招行积存金估算、日内买卖参考和阈值提醒，支持可拖拽浮窗。

description.en: Browse and one-click install 10,000+ DSH plugins, each verified by the dsh.bundle.patch field in package.json rather than by popularity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内浏览并一键安装 1 万余个插件，只依据 package.json 中的 dsh.bundle.patch 字段校验真伪，而不看热度。

description.en: Adds an Install tab to dsh settings to install third-party plugins via npm, GitHub, or local path without terminal.
description.zh: 给 dsh 设置页添加安装标签页，可按包名、GitHub 或本地路径安装第三方插件，无需使用终端。

description.en: Exposes a read graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph for structural and dependency queries.
description.zh: 为 Deepseek Harness 提供只读知识图谱工具，用于查询代码库的结构与依赖关系。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin market - browse, search & install dsh-plugin topic plugins
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，可浏览、搜索并安装 dsh-plugin 主题的插件。

description.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks as interactive charts with a chart/source toggle in DeepSeek Harness web client.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端中将 Mermaid 代码块渲染为图表，并提供图表与源码切换。

description.en: Adds Codex-style multiple independent comments on selected text in DSH chat.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中为选中文本添加 Codex 风格的多条独立评论。

description.en: NovelAI Diffusion V4.5 image generation tool for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: NovelAI Diffusion V4.5 Full image generation for DeepSeek Harness (nai_generate_image tool)

description.en: Imports OpenCode skills and config into DeepSeek Harness for zero-migration reuse.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode 的技能与配置导入 DeepSeek Harness，无需迁移即可直接复用

description.en: Adds an opencode omo agent preset to DeepSeek Harness, replicating opencode + omo behavior in a scoped mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 opencode omo 智能体预设，在限定模式内复现 opencode 加 omo 的行为。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage floating panel for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI showing quota usage.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏显示 OpenCode Go 订阅的滚动、每周、每月额度及已用和剩余用量。

description.en: Adds a top-right header popover to view and toggle session plugins, MCP servers and skills, with session plugin usage.
description.zh: 在顶栏弹出面板中查看并开关会话插件、MCP 服务器与技能，并显示会话插件使用情况。

description.en: Gives dsh a git-versioned persona injected every turn, with gated self-editing and journal-to-dream reflection.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供可写入、Git 版本化的人格：每轮注入、受控自我编辑，并将日志沉淀为梦境反思。

description.en: DSH plugin manager with web-based settings to manage installed plugins and a GitHub marketplace for discovery and one-click install.
description.zh: DSH 插件管理器：在 Web 设置页按官方/社区分组管理已安装插件，支持查看详情、一键启停与卸载，并内置 GitHub 插件市场，可按高收藏或增长最快榜单浏览、搜索插件并一键安装。

description.en: A DSH plugin template plus an AI agent manual for scaffolding, releasing, and listing DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: DSH 插件模板与 AI 操作手册，用于创建、发布和列出 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Heuristic malware vetting for installed third-party plugins in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 对 DeepSeek Harness 中已安装的第三方插件进行启发式恶意软件审查

description.en: AI-driven presentation workflow for creating, editing and enhancing PPTX decks with templates and SVG snapshots.
description.zh: AI驱动的演示文稿工作流，用于创建、编辑和增强PPTX，支持模板填充和SVG快照。

description.en: Task progress bar for agent tasks: shows step, percentage, time used/remaining, and completion notice.
description.zh: 为 agent 任务提供悬浮进度条，展示阶段、百分比、已用/剩余时间，并在完成时提示。

description.en: Customizes DeepSeek Harness system prompts and tool visibility, with presets for saving, applying, exporting, and importing settings.
description.zh: 定制 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示词与工具：屏蔽、替换、注入、排序提示词段，黑白名单隐藏工具，并支持预设的保存、应用、导出和导入，均通过设置面板操作。

description.en: Predicts your next message and shows it as ghost text in the composer; press Tab to accept or Esc to ignore.
description.zh: 预测你的下一句话并以灰色 ghost text 显示在输入框中，按 Tab 采纳、Esc 忽略。

description.en: Live balance & quota panel for LLM providers, shown as a sidebar widget in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时显示各 LLM 服务商余额与配额的面板。

description.en: Splits a project into a main doc plus module docs, has AI resolve open questions, scores five-dimension project health, and auto-injects workflows.
description.zh: 把项目拆成主文档与模块文档，AI 主动提问消解不确定项，按五维评估项目健康度并自动注入工作流。

description.en: Enterprise-grade DeepSeek Harness QA plugin that runs systematic end-to-end tests and returns P0-P3 severity reports and quality gates.
description.zh: 企业级 DeepSeek Harness QA 插件，自动执行端到端测试并输出 P0-P3 严重度分级报告与质量门禁。

description.en: Annotate selected text in DSH sessions into anchored quotes that flow into the input box and can be jumped back to and highlighted.
