description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中划词批注，生成带锚点的引用进入输入框，并可一键跳回原文高亮。

description.en: Select text in a DSH reply and use a floating toolbar to quote it into the composer draft or open a side chat about it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 回复中选中文本，通过浮动工具栏将其引用到输入草稿，或围绕该文本打开侧边对话。

description.en: Adds QwenWork (千问办公) models as a direct LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness with built-in device-code sign-in.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入千问办公模型，内置设备码登录，直连上游，无需桌面客户端或网关。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you edit or retry already-sent chat messages and regenerate the reply in place.
description.zh: DSH 插件：可编辑或重试已发送的聊天消息，并原地重新生成回复。

description.en: Toggle for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that hides process details and shows a live status line while the agent works.
description.zh: Results-only toggle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process, keeps one live status line while the agent works, with a per-turn trace line and a settings row. zh-CN/en.

description.en: Injects hardened retry policies into DeepSeek Harness providers to automatically retry transient 429/QUOTA gateway failures until tasks complete.
description.zh: 在启动时为 DeepSeek Harness 的所有 llm-pi-ai provider 热注入加固版 retryPolicy，自动重试商汤 429、QUOTA 等瞬时网关故障直至任务完成。

description.en: Texas Hold'em AI practice partner on DeepSeek Harness with heads-up play, per-player long-term memory and traceable decision reviews.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的德州扑克 AI 陪练，支持双人对局、按玩家长期记忆与可追溯决策复盘。

description.en: Structured tri-channel input composer for LLM roleplay, separating dialogue/actions/psychology to reduce AI misclassification.
description.zh: DSH web 端角色扮演结构化输入插件，将台词、动作、心理分为三个输入框填写，并按模板组装后发送，减少 AI 对玩家言行的成分误识别。

description.en: TTRPG/DM plugin for dsh: neutral dice adjudication, local ComfyUI illustrations, and per-session campaign config.
description.zh: dsh 的跑团/DM 插件：中立随机裁决、本地 ComfyUI 配图、按会话隔离的战役配置。

description.en: Adds a context-window lens and 53-week GitHub-style usage heatmap for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文窗口查看视图，以及 53 周 GitHub 风格使用热力图。

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting HR tech research and interview prep.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的公司尽调与岗位背调插件，基于证据开展调研，支持 HR 技术调研和面试准备。

description.en: Turns the Cloudflare security-audit skill into a DSH plugin that autonomously orchestrates sandboxed audits and reports results in a panel.
description.zh: 将 Cloudflare 安全审计技能升级为 DSH 插件，自治编排沙箱审计任务，并在面板中展示进度与最终报告。

description.en: Adds a missing Delete-session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with disabled state while running, confirmation prompt, and permanent deletion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补充缺失的删除会话功能：运行中置灰、二次确认并真正删除会话。

description.en: Injects a ~55-token continuation pointer into new sessions, reusing DSH's existing compaction summary instead of calling any model.
description.zh: 在新会话开始时注入约 55 token 的接续指针，直接复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要，不调用任何模型。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session tool for DeepSeek Harness that searches the conversation store, attributes hits by source, groups by turn, and exports Markdown.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ctrl+F 会话内查找工具：搜索对话库，按来源标注命中，按轮次分组，并可导出 Markdown。

description.en: Manages DSH Web chat sessions: archive, unarchive, truly delete local logs, and batch export data.
description.zh: 管理 DSH Web 聊天会话：归档、取消归档、彻底删除本地日志，并批量导出数据。

description.en: DSH session lifecycle manager that auto-prunes one-shot sessions, enforces capacity limits, and clears projcache to prevent bloat.
description.zh: DSH 会话生命周期管理插件，自动清理一次性子代理会话，执行容量保底限制，并连带清理 projcache 以防缓存膨胀。

description.en: Diagnoses, backs up, and safely repairs DSH Web sessions with trusted checkpoints.
description.zh: 诊断 DSH Web 会话，创建可信检查点备份，并一键安全修复会话数据。

description.en: A DSH recycle bin plugin that makes session deletion recoverable, archives deleted sessions, and auto-purges them after expiry.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站插件：让删除会话可撤销，删除前分析并留档，到期自动清理。

description.en: Realtime ShaderToy background skin for DeepSeek Harness with a zero-dependency WebGL2 player, shader background library and glass UI styling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时 ShaderToy 背景皮肤，含零依赖 WebGL2 播放器、着色器背景库与玻璃拟态界面。

description.en: DSH 插件：把工作区里写好的 HTML 页展示在对话里，并让用户在页面上的表态快速回到 agent 手里。含四套预设样式。
description.zh: DSH 插件：在对话中展示工作区里的 HTML 页面，把用户在页面上的表态回传给 agent，含四套预设样式。

description.en: Integrates Microsoft SkillOpt-Sleep into dsh for nightly skill consolidation via session harvesting and task replay.
description.zh: 将微软 SkillOpt-Sleep 集成到 dsh，在夜间睡眠周期中采集会话、重放重复任务，并通过留出验证门槛整合已验证技能。

description.en: Adds a Skills & Commands page to DSH Settings for viewing, enabling/disabling, editing, deleting and adding skills, plus saving prompts as /commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「技能与命令」页面，可查看、启停、编辑、删除和添加技能，并将常用提示词保存为 / 命令快速调用。

description.en: Manages a DSH-native skills marketplace by pulling skills from git repos and organizing them into plugin structure.
description.zh: 从 git 仓库拉取 skills 并整理成插件结构，管理 DSH 原生的 skills 插件市场。

description.en: Universal DSH skill adapter that lets you register any GitHub repo with a SKILL.md as a DSH skill via a single command.
description.zh: 装一次即可用一条命令把任意含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库注册为 DSH skill，无需插件代码或 package.json。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin to switch installed skins with one click from the settings interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 皮肤切换插件，可在设置界面一键切换已安装的皮肤。

description.en: A draggable floating button to manage and switch DSH web GUI skins, remembering your selection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加可拖动的浮动按钮，用于管理和切换皮肤并记住所选皮肤，纯客户端插件。

description.en: Adds scheduled sending to DSH Web input box with configurable tasks and localStorage persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web 的定时发送插件：在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务，并通过 localStorage 持久化任务，刷新页面后自动恢复。

description.en: DSH plugin that puts a local SolidWorks desktop behind 66 MCP CAD tools for parts, assemblies, drawings, DFM and FEA, read-only by default.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 66 个 MCP CAD 工具接入本机 SolidWorks 桌面，支持零件、装配体、工程图、DFM 与 FEA，默认只读。

description.en: Adds a task capsule to the DSH session header and shows a task notification card with sound and system alerts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部添加任务胶囊，并通过声音与系统通知弹出任务提醒卡片。

description.en: DSH Tavern 错题库：按人物卡分类记下调试中踩过的坑，先查本卡、再跨卡。 / Per-card defect ledger for DSH Tavern.
DSH web UI theme customizer with visual adjustments, import/export presets, and persistent saving.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面主题自定义插件，可视化调整背景、文字、框线与细节，支持预设导入导出并持久化保存。

description.en: A Zenless Zone Zero Hoshimi Miyabi-themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with frost-blue token colors and a CRT-style identity layer.
description.zh: 《绝区零》星见雅主题的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 皮肤，采用霜蓝冷调令牌层与新艾利都 CRT 身份层。

description.en: Adds reasoning effort levels (Off/Low/Medium/High) for third-party models in DeepSeek Harness and reference folders for sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的第三方厂商模型添加关闭、低、中、高四档推理等级，并可为会话添加引用文件夹。

description.en: CSS plugin to customize DSH Web thinking status text and color flow without modifying source.
description.zh: 用生命周期安全的 CSS 自定义 DSH Web 思考状态的文字与颜色流动，无需改动源码。

description.en: Adds a pill below the DSH input box showing peak/off-peak billing periods, countdown to the next switch, and account balance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方添加药丸，显示峰价/谷价计费时段、下次切换倒计时与账户余额。

description.en: Todoist-style todo management for DeepSeek Harness with a dashboard, built-in agent tools and due-date reminders.
description.zh: 类 Todoist 的待办管理插件，提供仪表盘、内建 Agent 工具与到期提醒。

description.en: Cross-session token usage analytics plugin for DSH with a web dashboard (ctx.tokenUsageStats).
description.zh: DSH跨会话令牌用量分析插件，提供Web仪表盘及ctx.tokenUsageStats接口。

description.en: Collapses unused tool groups out of each agent's tool table and restores them on demand, cutting per-turn context tokens and first-token latency.
description.zh: 按 agent 收起不常用的工具组，需要时再放出，减少每轮上下文占用与首字延迟。

description.en: Safe PowerShell execution for DeepSeek Harness via base64-encoded commands, avoiding quoting/escaping issues.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 pwsh_safe 工具，通过 base64 编码命令执行 PowerShell 脚本，避开引号与转义问题

description.en: A user-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that persists user preferences across sessions and injects them into system prompts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供用户记忆：跨会话保存用户偏好，并在系统提示词中注入这些偏好。

description.en: Adds a travel planning skill to DeepSeek Harness that searches social media, verifies details, and creates daily itineraries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加旅行规划技能：从小红书、抖音发现 POI，核验信息后按天排出可执行的行程

description.en: A DSH web client UI hub that enumerates and manages plugin UI elements, enabling toggling, positioning, collision avoidance, and layout.
description.zh: DSH 网页客户端 UI 中枢，枚举并管理插件的 UI 元素，支持开关、定位、防碰撞与布局。

description.en: General-purpose worldbook that injects one-time prompt to user message without context contamination.
description.zh: 通用世界书，为最新用户消息注入一次性提示词，避免上下文污染。

description.en: Adds unbounded retry for model requests in the DeepSeek Harness agent loop, controlled through a live Settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 代理循环中的模型请求添加无限重试，并通过实时设置面板控制。

description.en: FFmpeg-powered video editing toolset for DeepSeek Harness: trim, concat, audio, subtitles, transform, transcode, and frame grabbing.
description.zh: 基于 ffmpeg 的 DeepSeek Harness 视频编辑工具集：裁剪、拼接、音频、字幕、变换、转码与抽帧。

description.en: Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: Play a Minecraft villager hmm whenever the model hums inside its reasoning chain. DeepSeek Harness plugin.

description.en: Gives DSH agents a vision channel plus mouse/keyboard control of the Windows desktop, with a Codex-style blue overlay and Esc to abort.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供视觉通道和鼠标键盘控制，直接看见并操作 Windows 桌面，带 Codex 风格蓝色覆盖层，按 Esc 可随时中止。

description.en: Imports VS Code .vsix theme files into DSH Web and switches the interface theme instantly.
description.zh: 导入 VS Code 的 .vsix 主题文件到 DSH Web，并即时切换界面主题。

description.en: Dsh plugin combining wallpaper customization (gradients, upload, video, cropping) with DeepSeek balance/usage widget.
description.zh: dsh 插件，可更换背景（渐变、上传、视频、裁剪）并显示 DeepSeek 余额与用量。

description.en: Drop-in WebFetchProvider replacement that keeps the DSH web fetch tool working under fake-ip DNS with mihomo/Clash TUN mode.
description.zh: 可直接替换的 WebFetchProvider，让 DSH 网页抓取工具在 mihomo/Clash TUN 伪 IP DNS 环境下正常工作。

description.en: Ollama-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness, using Ollama API to avoid DeepSeek official key.
description.zh: Ollama-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web)

description.en: A configurable third-party web-search plugin for DSH supporting Searxng and Tavily backends.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可配置的第三方网络搜索插件，支持 Searxng 与 Tavily 两种搜索后端。

description.en: WeChat content production workbench with writing methods, image generation, OCR verification, and draft interface testing.
description.zh: 微信公众号内容生产工作台：结构轮换写作法、视觉基线、gpt-image配图管线、OCR验收和小绿书草稿接口实测

description.en: A minimal Dieter Rams-inspired theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 受 Dieter Rams 启发的极简风格主题，用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 图形界面

description.en: Whale-themed skin pack for DeepSeek Harness with full-UI wallpaper, gold/silver trim, lace bows, corner art, particles, and third-party skin support.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼皮肤包：全界面壁纸、金银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、角落立绘、环境粒子，并支持第三方皮肤包与 Agent 状态联动。

description.en: Client-only background plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web, adding a whale wallpaper and frosted glass UI surface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供纯客户端背景插件，添加鲸鱼壁纸和毛玻璃界面效果。

description.en: A cute blue whale desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness Web UI that swims, tracks your mouse, and can be dragged and played with.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加一只蓝色鲸鱼桌面宠物，会游动、跟随鼠标，可拖动和互动。

description.en: A customized desktop pet widget showing DeepSeek balance with sankou skins, voice, states, and reminders.
description.zh: 显示DeepSeek余额的定制桌宠挂件，含三口皮肤、语音、状态和提醒。

description.en: Adds a "startup window state" option in the DSH desktop client settings to open the window default, maximized, or fullscreen on Windows.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面客户端设置中新增「启动窗口状态」选项，可在 Windows 上以默认、最大化或全屏方式启动窗口。

description.en: Common words box for DSH Web GUI to store and paste frequently used project terms.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供常用词箱子，用于存储和粘贴项目中的常用词。

description.en: Adds collapsible category or date grouping, inactive-workspace folding and status dots to the native sidebar workspace list.
description.zh: 在侧边栏原生工作区列表上增加可按分类或日期折叠的分组层，并支持不活跃工作区折叠与状态提示点。

description.en: Per-workspace persistent memory plugin for DSH with a sidebar panel, automatic system-prompt injection, and an agent tool to save memories.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供按工作区持久化记忆的插件：侧边栏面板、自动注入系统提示词，以及保存记忆的 agent 工具。

description.en: dsh plugin that makes the write tool create-only, rejecting writes to existing files and directing the model to use edit.
description.zh: dsh 插件：将 write 工具设为仅创建，拒绝覆盖已有文件，提示改用 edit 修改。

description.en: DSH for WSL lets you run Windows and native Linux sessions side by side in one DSH desktop window with environment switching.
description.zh: DSH for WSL 让您在同一个 DSH 桌面窗口中同时使用 Windows 与原生 Linux 会话，并支持环境切换。

description.en: Search, browse, and play Ximalaya podcasts in DSH's web UI with persistent player bar and agent tool.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中搜索、浏览和播放喜马拉雅播客，提供常驻播放条和 ximalaya_play 模型工具。

description.en: Fortune-telling plugin for DeepSeek Harness that computes BaZi, Zi Wei, I Ching, almanac, tarot and more with fully local deterministic engines, leaving the model only to interpret.
description.zh: 玄机阁是 DeepSeek Harness 的玄学算命插件，用全本地确定性引擎计算八字、紫微、梅花、黄历、塔罗、小六壬等，模型只负责解读。

description.en: A ZCode-styled UI skin for DSH Web, adding a redesigned sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 ZCode 风格界面皮肤，包含侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。

description.en: Forces every DeepSeek Harness session and model to think and reply in Simplified Chinese until the plugin is uninstalled.
description.zh: 让所有 DeepSeek Harness 会话与模型的思考过程和回复永久使用简体中文，直到卸载。

description.en: Self-contained smart desktop pet companion that can optionally connect to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 自包含的智能桌面桌宠，下载即可使用，可选连接 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Web-UI file-tree panel to explore, preview (DOCX/Markdown/PDF/code/CSV), and manage workspace files with context menu.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供工作区文件树面板，可浏览、预览 DOCX、Markdown、PDF、代码和 CSV 文件，并通过右键菜单管理文件。

description.en: Customizable text-based galgame and otome world engine plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可自定义的文字 galgame 与乙女游戏世界引擎插件。

description.en: Cross-agent WeChat official account publishing workflow orchestrating material prep, writing, humanizing, images, layout, and draft submission.
description.zh: 跨 Agent 的公众号内容发布工作流框架，覆盖素材、写作、去AI味、配图、排版、推草稿箱六阶段。

description.en: An emotion-weighted memory layer for long-running companion bots, with event encoding, forgetting, associative recall and relationship/skill tracking.
description.zh: 面向长期陪伴型机器人的情绪加权记忆层，支持事件编码、遗忘曲线、联想召回以及关系与技能记录。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness Web mode LX Music playback control and LLM music request capabilities.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 模式提供 LX Music 播放控制，并支持通过大模型发起音乐请求。

description.en: Resident cognitive engine for LLM agent runtimes running a six-stage meta-problem lifecycle with ε-δ convergence.
description.zh: 面向 LLM 智能体运行时的常驻认知引擎，提供六阶段问题生命周期与 ε-δ 双判据收敛。

description.en: Stateless dialogue compression that keeps LLM conversations bounded by mimicking human memory.
description.zh: 无状态对话压缩，模拟人类记忆让 LLM 对话长度始终有界，无需会话管理，也不会上下文溢出。

description.en: An illustrated cozy-room theme for DeepSeek Harness with warm colors, a desk lamp, plants and playful pets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的插画风温馨房间主题，含暖色调、台灯、绿植和可爱宠物。

description.en: A desktop pet for A-share stocks, showing realtime market changes with sound effects.
description.zh: 基于 Electron 和 DSH bundle 的 A 股桌面宠物，用音效实时展示行情变化。

description.en: ACP plugin bridging DeepSeek Harness into Obsidian, enabling AI conversations and tasks from within the app.
description.zh: 将DeepSeek Harness接入Obsidian的ACP插件，让你在应用内进行AI对话和任务。

description.en: Agent plugin for DSH, OpenCode, Pi, and Codex to define custom AI roles with prompts, models, memory, permissions, and multi-agent orchestration.
description.zh: 面向 DSH、OpenCode、Pi、Codex 的 Agent 插件，可自定义 AI 角色并支持多智能体编排。

description.en: WebGL silk dynamic background and glassmorphism skin for the DSH web GUI, with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 WebGL 丝绸动态背景，并通过覆盖官方主题 token 实现全站玻璃化皮肤，零依赖。

description.en: Artifacts-style document workspace for DeepSeek Harness with comments, AI handoff, editing, and versioned changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Artifacts 文档工作区，支持评论、发送给 AI、编辑及每次更改生成新版本。

description.en: Adds a workspace/chat enhancement menu with pin, rename, archive, fork, copy, and file explorer actions.
description.zh: DSH workspace/chat enhancement menu: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, new window. Settings integrated into General.

description.en: A Git GUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI to view, stage, commit, and revert file changes in the browser.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Git 图形界面，可在浏览器中查看、暂存、提交和还原文件改动。

description.en: Voice-call assistant plugin for DeepSeek: wake-word dialogs, speech recognition and TTS, plus sub-agent task delegation from a floating panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek 语音通话插件：悬浮面板，支持唤醒词、语音识别/回复，以及向子代理分发任务。

description.en: Web plugin that enhances the conversation model picker with provider-group collapse and name search.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，为对话模型选择器增加按提供方分组折叠和名称搜索功能。

description.en: Integrates claude-mem to provide persistent cross-session memory, context injection, and summarization for dsh.
description.zh: 为 dsh 集成 claude-mem，提供跨会话持久记忆、上下文注入与摘要。

description.en: Displays OpenCode Go plan usage percentages and reset countdown, plus an agent tool.
description.zh: 显示 OpenCode Go 套餐的滚动、每周、每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，并提供 opencode_go_usage 工具供 Agent 查询。

description.en: Pairs a phone browser with your local DeepSeek Harness via QR code and host approval, offering a separate warm-toned remote UI over LAN or a free public tunnel.
description.zh: 通过扫码和本机批准，把手机浏览器连接到本地 DeepSeek Harness，提供独立的暖色远程界面，支持局域网直连或免费公网隧道。

description.en: Archives conversation turns into a workspace-local, searchable memory palace for later retrieval.
description.zh: 将对话轮次归档到工作区本地的可搜索记忆宫殿，便于后续检索。

description.en: Example dsh weather plugin: fetches temperature and wind from Open-Meteo in Node and renders an animated weather card in the browser.
description.zh: dsh天气插件示例：Node端从Open-Meteo获取温度风力，浏览器端展示动画天气卡片。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness approval plugin that auto-approves requests via keywords and an LLM judge, escalating unsure cases to Web UI or QQ for human sign-off.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 审批插件：通过关键词与审核模型自动审批，无法判定时推到 Web UI 或 QQ 由人工确认。

description.en: A hidden mini-game plugin for the DSH desktop app that lets you race the interface whale on a track above the input box.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 桌面端隐藏小游戏插件，把界面上的鲸鱼放到输入框上方的跑道上跑一局。

description.en: 网页版 AI 一键入口：在右侧边栏浏览器 tab 里打开 DeepSeek / Kimi / 豆包 / 腾讯元宝 / 通义千问 / 智谱清言的免费网页版（走 Electron webview，不受 CSP frame-ancestors 限制）。站点列表在 lib/client.js 的 SITES 常量里，可自由增删。
Pare's AI disk investigation for DSH: read-only tools, approval-gated reversible cleanup, and a pinned, hash-verified core.
description.zh: Pare 的 DSH AI 磁盘调查工具：只读排查、审批后可控清理，以及固定并校验哈希的核心。

description.en: Executes Python source piped via stdin in one step with full UTF-8, background jobs, and sandbox privilege escalation.
description.zh: 通过 stdin 直接执行 Python 源码，一步返回结果，全链路 UTF-8，支持后台作业与沙箱提权。

description.en: Integrates DonSeTch fetch, search and crawl tools into DeepSeek Harness via an auto-updating verified binary.
description.zh: 将DonSeTch的抓取、搜索和爬虫工具集成到DeepSeek Harness，利用自动更新的认证二进制。

description.en: In-conversation text search with Ctrl+F, match case, whole word, and streaming support for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话内提供文本搜索，支持 Ctrl+F、区分大小写、全词匹配，并适配流式输出。

description.en: Auditable, workspace-local project wiki for DeepSeek Harness, storing agent knowledge as Markdown with review gating.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区本地、可审计的项目 Wiki，以 Markdown 存储智能体知识，带原生 Web UI 和审核门控。

description.en: Adds a Yakit-style sitemap sidebar to DeepSeek Harness, showing discovered APIs as a searchable host tree with details and curl copy.
description.zh: 站点地图（Yakit 风格）：DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏树形接口地图，搜索 / 接口详情 / 一键复制 curl，数据实时同步

description.en: Volcano Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota viewer with floating ball and donut chart showing usage, remaining, and reset countdown via AK/SK.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding/Agent Plan 额度查看插件，用 AK/SK 直连官方 API，通过悬浮小球和环形图显示各窗口已用、剩余额度及两位小数的重置倒计时。

description.en: DSH archive management plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）提供归档管理功能的插件，附带 Web 界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that permanently deletes sessions, including open ones, and shows or hides archived sessions per workspace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，可永久删除会话（包括已打开的会话），并按工作区显示或隐藏已归档会话。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness with built-in themes, static images, and dynamic video backgrounds.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主题皮肤，包含内置主题、静态图片和动态 360 跟随视频背景。

description.en: Real-time usage/cost/balance meter for DeepSeek API in DSH chat, showing tokens, spend, and wallet balance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天输入框旁实时显示 DeepSeek API 的 token 用量、花费和账户余额。

description.en: Zero-dependency Bing web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness: fetches search HTML and parses result titles, URLs, snippets without any API key.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的零依赖 Bing 搜索插件：获取网页 HTML 并解析标题、链接、摘要，无需 API key。

description.en: Interactive in-browser canvas for real-time preview of HTML, React, SVG, and diagrams with SSE hot-reload.
description.zh: 交互式浏览器内画布，用于实时预览 HTML、React、SVG 和图表，支持 SSE 热重载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit .drawio diagrams in the Web Sidebar ,侧边栏编辑流程图  .drawio文件
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏中编辑 .drawio 流程图文件

description.en: Adds OMC-style multi-agent orchestration to DeepSeek Harness with workflow skills and slash commands.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness添加OMC式多智能体编排，包含工作流技能和斜杠命令。

description.en: A DSH plugin to securely edit your global AGENTS.md with templates, Markdown preview, history restore, import/export, and concurrency protection.
description.zh: 用于安全编辑全局 AGENTS.md 的 DSH 插件，支持模板、Markdown 预览、历史恢复、导入导出与并发保护。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible HTTP API gateway for DeepSeek Harness, exposing chat/completions, responses, and models endpoints.
description.zh: OpenAI-compatible HTTP surface for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/responses, GET /v1/models over the harness webServer + llm runtime

description.en: Adds a Codex-style /btw command to DeepSeek Harness for side questions in a subagent context, keeping main context clean.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Codex 风格的 /btw 命令，在继承当前对话的子代理上下文中回答旁支问题，不污染主上下文。

description.en: Recall a message you already sent: trims the conversation back to before it and restores its text in the composer.
description.zh: 撤回已发送的消息：将对话截断到该消息之前，并把其文本放回输入框。

description.en: Carry project context across AI tools, computers, and sessions with a single sentence.
description.zh: 用一句话在不同 AI 工具、电脑和会话之间携带项目上下文。

description.en: Per-message recall and delete for DSH sessions, keeping model context and the UI in sync via append-only tombstones.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供逐条消息撤回与删除，通过追加式墓碑记录同步模型上下文与界面。

description.en: Renders ChatGPT-style rich answers in DeepSeek Harness with entity panels, KPI cards, charts, tables, layers and local controls.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内渲染 ChatGPT 风格富文本回答，包含实体面板、KPI 卡片、图表、表格、图层与本地控件。

description.en: Adds long-lived AI companions with per-contact identities and WeChat routing to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期 AI 伙伴，支持独立身份与微信渠道。

description.en: DSH settings panel showing daily and cumulative token usage, cache hits, a usage history calendar, and kimi-coding/commandcode quotas.
description.zh: DSH 设置面板：展示当日与累计 token 用量、缓存命中、用量历史日历，以及 kimi-coding / commandcode 的额度与刷新时间。

description.en: Adds a real delete action for DSH sidebar conversations, removing session data from disk, not just hiding it like archive does.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中提供真正的删除功能，连同磁盘上的会话数据一并清除，而非像 archive 那样只隐藏。

description.en: MCP bridge that gives DeepSeek Harness coding agents a codebase memory: knowledge-graph code search, AST snippets, architecture analysis and call-graph tracing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编码代理提供代码库记忆的 MCP 桥接插件：知识图谱代码搜索、AST 片段、架构分析与调用图追踪。

description.en: Permanently deletes DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from disk, triggered directly from the session menu.
description.zh: 从会话菜单直接永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 的会话与工作区，真正从磁盘移除。

description.en: Enhances DSH web GUI conversation nodes with configurable colors by type/tool and thinking-process toggle.
description.zh: 按节点类型或工具名给 DSH Web GUI 会话节点配置配色，并提供思考过程显示开关。

description.en: A 3D hardware sandbox for DSH: assemble parts, wire them up, and run your project's own code against virtual hardware.
description.zh: DSH 的 3D 硬件沙盒：装配元件、接线，并在虚拟硬件上运行你自己的项目代码。

description.en: Scan a QR code to watch and steer the DSH tasks running on your computer from any phone browser over a free Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 扫描二维码，即可在手机浏览器里通过免费 Cloudflare 隧道查看并操控电脑上的 DSH 任务。

description.en: Upload images and files to your image host from DeepSeek Harness, powered by PicGo.
description.zh: 借助 PicGo，在 DeepSeek Harness 中把图片和文件上传到你自己配置的图床

description.en: A design plugin for DeepSeek Harness to select elements, upload images, and use Vision agents for quick changes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 设计插件，可选取页面元素、上传图片，并调用 OpenRouter 视觉模型按提示直接修改。

description.en: Third-party Zenless Zone Zero H.D.D skin for DSH with performance tweaks, usage bubble, draggable eye badge, three appearance tiers and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.
description.zh: 第三方《绝区零》H.D.D 主题皮肤，含性能优化、用量气泡、可拖拽眼徽、三档外观与可选本地 GPT-SoVITS 语音。

description.en: An OpenCode Go live model catalog plugin for DeepSeek Harness that syncs the opencode-go model list from Models.dev and registers a separate opencode-go-live route.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode Go 实时模型目录插件，从 Models.dev 同步模型列表并注册独立的 opencode-go-live 路由。

description.en: Adds a scrollbar rail marking user messages with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 对话指示器插件：在滚动条旁用紧凑面板标记每条用户消息，悬停显示摘要，点击跳转到该消息。

description.en: Container management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: provides docker ps, logs, inspect, exec, and manage tools via secure subprocess.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 容器管理插件，通过 subprocess 提供 docker ps、logs、inspect、exec、manage 五个工具，argv 无 shell 注入，exec 需审批。

description.en: Unified messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness connecting WeChat, Feishu, QQ, WeCom, and DingTalk with shared prompts and memory.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 统一接入微信、飞书、QQ、企业微信和钉钉，五渠道共享提示词、长期记忆与会话策略，支持定制鲸鱼娘人格。

description.en: Adds a draggable salted fish mascot and full-viewport wallpaper to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的 shell.overlay 插槽注入可拖动、可投喂的咸鱼吉祥物和全屏工程师壁纸，纯前端实现。

description.en: Global persona plugin that loads whale-girl persona Markdown files into every DeepSeek Harness session's system prompt, editable live.
description.zh: 全局人设插件：把鲸鱼娘人设以 Markdown 文件形式注入 DeepSeek Harness 每个会话的系统提示词，可随时增删改。

description.en: Offline scans all local dsh session logs to build a customizable dashboard of token usage, estimated cost, model/tool rankings and quality metrics.
description.zh: 离线扫描本机全部 dsh 会话日志，生成包含 token 用量、估算费用、模型/工具榜与质量指标的可编排仪表盘。

description.en: Bookmark-style manager that lets you favorite DSH sessions into folders with notes, custom names, resume/Fork actions, stats and a fork relationship graph.
description.zh: 以收藏夹方式管理 DSH 会话：文件夹分类、备注、自定义名称、继续与 Fork、统计以及 fork 关系图。

description.en: Turns 161 classic thinking models into an advisory panel that analyzes your question and synthesizes consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action list.
description.zh: 把161个经典思维模型组成智囊团，从九个视角分析问题，AI汇总出共识、分歧、盲区与行动清单。

description.en: Manage ntd-format experts/expert teams in dsh: browse/install 50+ experts via sparse git checkout and inject roles with /expert commands.
description.zh: 管理dsh中的ntd格式专家/团队：通过git稀疏检出浏览安装内置专家，并以/expert命令注入角色。

description.en: Adds gamified achievements to DeepSeek Harness, observing agent events and showing unlock toasts and trophy UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加游戏化成就系统，监听智能体事件，弹出解锁提示并显示奖杯界面。

description.en: Packages a Fork-style Git GUI with Express backend and browser frontend as a DSH plugin for embedded Git management.
description.zh: 将Fork风格Git图形界面打包为DSH插件，内嵌提供分支切换/fetch/pull/commit/push等管理功能。

description.en: Black Whale Lab theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with Black Whale and Xi Xiaoyao IP as a professional lab skin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供黑鲸实验室主题皮肤，结合官网黑鲸与夕小瑶 IP，可通过 profile 安装。

description.en: Adds a persistent sidebar and settings page to track daily and total token usage for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加常驻侧边栏与设置页，显示今日、昨日和累计的 token 用量。

description.en: A DSH plugin delivering an industry AI workbench for agent-human collaboration, with team-leader dashboards, execution cards, skill calls and a DingTalk bridge.
description.zh: 一款 dsh 插件，提供 AI 代理与人类协作的行业 AI 工作台：班组长看板、执行卡、Skill 点名直调与钉钉桥。

description.en: Combines a task calendar with meeting minutes, including live transcription, Tencent Meeting notes, AI-generated minutes and automatic ingestion.
description.zh: 将任务日历与会议纪要结合，支持实时转写、腾讯会议笔记、AI生成纪要和自动导入。

description.en: Provides compatibility with DSH by no-op handling redundant same-mode sandbox escalation requests.
description.zh: 通过空操作处理冗余的同模式沙箱提权请求，为 DSH 提供兼容。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for macOS desktop automation. Observes the accessibility tree, gates risky actions behind one-time approval, permanently refuses secure fields, and returns bounded visual evide
MCP-based memory perception system for Chinese AI agents with shared, local-first storage.
description.zh: AiFP 记忆感知系统｜MCP 服务，一套记忆全 AI 共享。面向中文的 Agent 感知记忆，支持叙事链、语义纠错、感知链图扩散。兼容 DeepSeek‑Harness、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex等全部 MCP 客户端，数据完全本地存储。

description.en: Astronomy research workbench for DSH and Codex, covering NADC terms, references, writing, scoring, author confirmation, physics books, and FITS/XML analysis guides.
description.zh: 面向DSH和Codex的天文研究工作台，涵盖NADC术语、参考文献、写作评分、作者确认、物理书目及FITS/XML分析指南。

description.en: Runs unattended multi-round research through a real ChatGPT Pro web session, saving records and deliverables locally with a sidebar manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中用真实 ChatGPT Pro 网页会话做无人值守多轮调研，自动提问汇总成文档，并把记录与产物落盘、侧边栏管理主题。

description.en: Adds a separate slash-command menu to DeepSeek Harness chat for steering the model, starting sessions, saving skills, and writing docs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天添加独立的斜杠命令菜单，用于引导模型、开启会话、保存技能和撰写文档。

description.en: DeepVibe adds a live light-ring ambience to DSH with an immersive dock, approval card, real Platform billing and session topic display.
description.zh: DeepVibe 为 DSH 添加动态光环氛围，并配有沉浸式停靠栏、审批卡片、真实 Platform 计费与会话主题显示。

description.en: Declarations and contracts for constrained, reviewable UI generation in coding agents.
description.zh: Design I/O plugin for Claude Code & coding agents — declarations + contracts that make UI generation constrained, reviewable, and recirculatable. Not a style pack; composes with ui-ux-pro-max + fronte

description.en: Text viewer/editor for DSH dock with undo/redo, save, and unsaved-change confirmation
description.zh: DSH 停靠栏的文本查看与编辑工具，支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存，以及未保存修改的确认提示。

description.en: Markdown viewer/editor for DSH dock that renders .md/.mdx files and toggles to editing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 停靠栏中渲染 md、markdown、mdx 文件，并可一键切换到编辑模式。

description.en: ExHentai-inspired UI skin/theme for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供ExHentai风格的UI皮肤。

description.en: Live 3D visualization of the DSH plugin ecosystem using real Cordis runtime data.
description.zh: 用真实 Cordis 运行时数据实时三维可视化 DSH 插件生态，节点、连线和状态均对应当前实际运行时。

description.en: A DSH plugin that locks the screen by faking a 404 error page, disabling mouse/keyboard input until the hotkey is pressed again.
description.zh: 按 Ctrl+Shift+L 将页面伪装成静态 404 截图，并暂时锁死鼠标键盘输入，再次按热键解锁

description.en: Expose a DeepSeek Harness agent over the Agent2Agent protocol with agent card, JSON-RPC, and LLM replies.
description.zh: 通过 Agent2Agent 协议暴露 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，提供 agent card、JSON-RPC 调用和 LLM 回复。

description.en: A dsh settings panel that lists, edits and saves native AGENTS.md instruction files at every layer of the workspace chain, with byte-budget visualization.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置页中按层级列出、编辑并保存原生 AGENTS.md 指令文件，并可视化指令字节预算。

description.en: A super-agent replacement for DSH that gives you a persistent team of named agents led by a chief agent who splits tasks, tracks progress and reports back.
description.zh: DSH 的 super agent 平替插件：由一个负责人 agent 带领一支长期协作的具名 agent 团队，自动拆任务、追进度并汇总结果。

description.en: Provides browser-based system notifications for task completion and input requests from the DSH agent, with click-to-open session.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI task-completion notifications: Windows system-level alerts (browser Notification API) when the agent finishes a task or needs your input - click-to-open session, background-only mode, sett

description.en: DSH plugin that turns full-stack dev and troubleshooting prompts into four auto-loaded skills for monolith/microservice work with Vue3+TS and Spring Boot.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把全栈开发与排查提示词做成四个按场景自动加载的技能，覆盖单体/微服务与 Vue3+TS、Spring Boot 硬约束。

description.en: Runs the locally authenticated AGY CLI as a DSH model provider while tools, approvals and sandboxing stay inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将本地已认证的 AGY CLI 作为 DSH 模型提供方运行，工具执行、审批与沙箱全部保留在 DeepSeek Harness 中。

description.en: Gives DSH AI agents a persistent judgment memory with a bi-temporal ledger, deterministic supersession, dual links and a knowledge graph for explainability.
description.zh: 为 DSH 中的 AI 代理提供持久的判断记忆，含双时态账本、确定性取代、双链与知识图谱可解释性。

description.en: Ad-free AI search powered by DeepSeek Harness with Q&A, Encyclopedia and Browse modes, plus result-language options and search history.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的无广告 AI 搜索，提供答疑、百科、浏览三种模式，并支持结果语言切换与搜索历史。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin displaying AnySearch references as cards with query, snippets, and keyword highlights.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，将 AnySearch 的搜索结果以卡片形式显示在右侧栏，包含搜索词、来源摘要和关键词高亮。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在会话视图标签中展示项目的 AOCI 认知索引、治理状态与条目浏览
DSH plugin that probes an API base URL and key, verifying connectivity, latency, throughput and success rate with four-layer Chinese diagnostics.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧边栏填入 API 地址与 Key，30 秒完成四层体检，用中文给出连通性、时延、速度与成功率诊断结论。

description.en: Preview and debug Android APKs in DeepSeek Harness with a rooted AOSP VM, 60fps H.264 streaming, drag-and-drop install, and UIAutomator automation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中预览和调试 Android APK：本地 root AOSP 虚拟机、最高 60fps H.264 串流、拖拽安装与 UIAutomator 自动化。

description.en: An Apple-style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with composer glow, per-surface scope switches, and animated openings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的 Apple 风格液态玻璃主题，含输入框光晕、按界面区域开关及开场动画。

description.en: Plays sound and voice alerts in DSH Web GUI when approval/answer dialogs appear, preventing missed prompts.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 审批语音提示插件，在需要审批或回答的弹窗出现时播放提示音并语音播报，避免漏掉提示。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to ArcGIS Pro, letting models read projects, layers, geodatabases and run geoprocessing tools via MCP.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 ArcGIS Pro，通过 MCP 以 mcp__arcgis__* 工具让模型读取项目、图层和地理数据库并运行地理处理工具。

description.en: Adds two DSH tools: PRTS Arknights Wiki lookups for operators, items, stages and lore, plus probabilistic banner and new-character predictions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供两个工具：查询 PRTS 明日方舟 Wiki 的干员、物品、关卡与剧情资料，以及按剧情与卡池历史做概率性的新角色与下期卡池预测。

description.en: A lightweight per-session notepad for DeepSeek Harness that keeps quick notes, ideas and to-dos beside the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的轻量会话便笺：随手记录想法与待办，按需打开、用完收起。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness audio-library plugin that searches and streams from asmr.one, Bilibili, DLsite previews and local voice libraries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 音声库插件，聚合 asmr.one、B站、DLsite 试听与本机曲库四源，可在对话中搜索、在线播放和下载。

description.en: Bridge plugin linking DSH with AstrBot: commands are routed down to DSH and results are handed over as files instead of being sent straight to users.
description.zh: 连接 DSH 与 AstrBot 的桥接插件：指令下行到 DSH，结果以文件方式交付，不直接发给用户。

description.en: DSH plugin to automatically batch-extract archives: identifies real format via magic bytes, supports nested extraction, SFX/volumes, and multi-password.
description.zh: DSH插件，自动批量解压压缩包：通过魔数识别真实格式，支持递归嵌套、SFX/分卷和多密码。

description.en: Startup auto-updater for DeepSeek Harness that checks npm registry and optionally installs newer versions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 启动时查询一次 npm registry，并可选择安装更新的版本。

description.en: Terminal plugin for connecting to network devices over SSH, Telnet and serial console, with a right-side xterm, session bar, keyword highlighting and per-device logs.
description.zh: 面向网络设备的终端插件，支持 SSH、Telnet、串口控制台与 SFTP，右侧 xterm 面板，含会话栏、关键字高亮和按设备日志。

description.en: Fills custom-provider model metadata (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev via an explicit, fail-closed pre-declared mapping, with a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 通过显式预声明映射从 models.dev 为自定义提供商填充模型元数据（上下文窗口、推理强度），失败即关闭，并提供图形设置页。

description.en: Safe auto-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness with version detection, health checks, and rollback.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全自动更新：检测版本、退出时应用更新、健康检查、失败自动回滚与熔断。

description.en: Sends native desktop toasts for dsh turn completion, errors, approvals, agent questions and goal completion only when you are away; click to return.
description.zh: 仅在离开 dsh 页面时推送原生桌面通知（完成/出错/等待审批/提问/goal 完成），点击通知可回到对应会话。

description.en: Geek-style batch uninstaller for DSH plugins with terminal checkbox selection, a progress bar, and locked core system plugins.
description.zh: Geek 风格的 DSH 插件批量卸载器，支持终端交互勾选、进度条显示，并自动锁定核心系统插件。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin for A-shares and US stocks, fusing multi-indicator signals to estimate rise probability, trend state, and position risk.
description.zh: 融合多指标信号，估计个股上涨概率、识别趋势状态并度量持仓风险，支持 A 股与美股。

description.en: Provides reproducible, deterministic benchmark evidence for DeepSeek Harness tools and plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具和插件提供可复现、确定性的基准测试证据。

description.en: Adds an Overleaf tab to DSH sidebar with CDP login, project mirroring, git/API sync, and file preview.
description.zh: Overleaf tab for DSH better-sidebar: direct-CDP login, project mirrors under <workspace>/overleaf/, git/API sync, sidebar file preview

description.en: DSH plugin adding SVN source control tab with status/diff/log/commit/update/revert and conflict resolution via svn CLI.
description.zh: DSH 插件：为 dsh-better-sidebar 添加 SVN 源代码管理 Tab——status/diff/log/commit/update/revert/冲突解决，与内置 Git 面板对称，纯 svn CLI（--xml 输出）驱动，git 直装免构建

description.en: A workspace file manager for the Files tab with upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, and drag-to-chat.
description.zh: 为工作区文件标签页提供上传、下载、新建文件夹、删除、拖拽移动和拖拽到聊天功能。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin for reading PDFs and translating selected text with the configured LLM, isolating translations from the main conversation.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，用于阅读 PDF 并调用已配置的 LLM 翻译选中文本，翻译内容与主对话隔离。

description.en: A persistent DSH deep-sea skin that overrides theme tokens, background layers, sidebar branding, and status text.
description.zh: 一套常驻 DSH 的深海皮肤：替换主题令牌、背景图层、侧栏大字标与运行状态文案轮播。

description.en: A deep-sea whale maid startup animation plugin that plays a stylized boot intro for DeepSeek Harness, skippable by click or Esc.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供深海鲸鱼女仆开机动画的插件，点击或按 Esc 可随时跳过。

description.en: Loader-independent rescue console for DeepSeek Harness to recover from broken plugins preventing Web UI startup.
description.zh: 在插件损坏导致 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 无法启动时，提供不依赖加载器的救援控制台，用于恢复。

description.en: Adds a per-turn session cost chip to the DSH composer stats row, showing spend plus cache-hit/miss totals in CNY from an official price table.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框统计栏加入逐轮会话费用胶囊，按官方价目表显示花费及缓存命中/未命中总额（CNY）。

description.en: Prefixes a space to the system prompt to fix CodeBuddy channel HTTP 400 'Illegal API invocation' errors in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在系统提示前加一个空格，修复 CodeBuddy 渠道在 DeepSeek Harness 中返回 HTTP 400 Illegal API invocation 的问题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin with a floating window showing API balance, per-turn/session cost, and burn rate, alerting or blocking sudden spend spikes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 预算监视插件，悬浮窗显示 API 余额、每轮/会话花费与消耗速率，可提醒或阻断突发烧钱。

description.en: Improves prompt cache reuse and provides evidence-based cache metrics for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 稳定 DeepSeek Harness 的缓存前缀以提升提示词缓存复用率，并提供基于证据的缓存指标。

description.en: Discovers, ranks, and risk-checks capabilities of plugins, skills, MCP servers, and agents for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 发现、排序并风险检查插件、技能、MCP 服务器和智能体的能力。

description.en: Provides content-addressed receipts proving which skills DeepSeek Harness actually loaded by hashing instruction bodies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 实际加载的技能生成内容寻址收据，通过对指令正文哈希来证明加载了哪些技能

description.en: Estimates the carbon footprint of DeepSeek Harness sessions with sourced factors, confidence bands, durable local history and a GUI dashboard.
description.zh: 估算 DeepSeek Harness 会话的碳足迹，提供来源因子、置信区间、本地持久历史与图形界面。

description.en: Ports caveman output-style skills into dsh: three tone tiers plus commit, review and compress workflow skills.
description.zh: 把 caveman 输出风格技能整套移植为 dsh 原生插件：三档语气，外加 commit、review、compress 工作流技能。

description.en: A DSH theme plugin that restyles DeepSeek Harness with a Rice-dog/code-codex-inspired look.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 主题插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Rice-dog/code-codex 风格的界面改版。

description.en: CET-4/CET-6 vocabulary trainer for the DSH Web UI with draggable word cards, spaced repetition and quiz mode.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的四六级背单词插件，提供可拖拽单词卡片、间隔重复复习和测验模式。

description.en: Injects a single content-visibility CSS rule into DSH so off-screen message bodies and block formulas skip style, layout and paint, easing long-conversation rendering.
description.zh: 向 DSH 注入一条 content-visibility CSS 规则，让屏幕外的消息正文和块级公式跳过样式、布局与绘制，缓解长对话渲染压力。

description.en: Adds independent chat session rooms with per-room working directories, listed in a native sidebar for quick switching.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立聊天会话房间，每个房间可设置独立工作目录，并集成原生侧边栏便于切换。

description.en: Enhances chat interface with adjustable content width, question history, and markdown table of contents.
description.zh: 为聊天界面增加内容区宽度调节、提问历史记录，以及 Markdown 格式的目录大纲功能。

description.en: Bridges DSH to Cherry Studio desktop apps over the LAN with QR pairing, 14 cherry_* tools, and a settings page for devices and tool scope.
description.zh: 通过局域网将 DSH 与 Cherry Studio 桌面端连接，支持二维码配对、14 个 cherry_* 工具，以及设备与工具范围设置页。

description.en: Plays chime sounds for opencode task completion, questions, and errors in DSH.
description.zh: DSH 插件，为 opencode 任务完成、提问和出错播放三种提示音，内嵌原始 mp3，零依赖。

description.en: DSH plugin that routes conversations through local Claude Code via official SDK, streaming tool activity as native cards.
description.zh: DSH插件，通过官方SDK将对话路由到本地Claude Code，以原生卡片呈现工具活动。

description.en: Claude-style drag slider for adjusting DSH reasoning effort, with 23 Canvas particle animations and custom color/icon theming.
description.zh: Claude 风格拖拽滑块，用于调节 DSH 推理强度，内置 23 种 Canvas 粒子动效并支持配色与图标自定义。

description.en: Select any sentence to quote and comment; quotes are inserted into the input as DSH native reference chips and rendered as rounded pills in the sent message.
description.zh: 选中任意一句话即可引用并评论，引用会以 DSH 原生 reference-chip 插入输入框，发送后消息中显示为圆角胶囊。

description.en: A Tianlight skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 4K video/image wallpapers, local upload, auto carousel, liquid glass look and a mint cat companion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面打造的天光皮肤，支持 4K 视频/图片壁纸、本地上传与自动轮播、液态玻璃外观和薄荷猫桌面伙伴。

description.en: Web client plugin for DSH that groups conversation trajectory records by action type into collapsible categories while keeping the original flow list.
description.zh: DSH 的 Web 客户端插件，把对话轨迹记录按操作类型归入可折叠分类，同时保留原有的流程列表。

description.en: Routes cliproxy-claude and cliproxy-openai through a local CLIProxyAPI to access personal CLI subscriptions.
description.zh: 通过本地 CLIProxyAPI 路由 cliproxy-claude 和 cliproxy-openai，让智能体接入自己的 CLI 订阅

description.en: Checks AI-written code for errors, helping catch bugs after code generation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 AI 写完代码后检查其中的错误，帮助发现代码生成阶段引入的 bug；可能也支持其他 AI agent IDE，但尚未测试。

description.en: A Cursor-style AI code editor plugin for DSH with file tree, multi-tab editing, syntax highlighting, and an embedded AI input box.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 的 Cursor 风格 AI 代码编辑器插件，提供文件树、多标签编辑、语法高亮和内嵌 AI 输入框。

description.en: Indexes code symbols, call sites, and imports into SQLite and answers call/dependency questions via CLI or MCP.
description.zh: 将代码符号、调用点和导入索引到 SQLite，通过 CLI 或 stdio MCP 工具服务回答调用与依赖问题

description.en: A programmer's workbench for reviewing code and tracking changes, with a conversation rail to jump to any earlier dialogue turn.
description.zh: A workbench for programmers to review code and track changes, featuring a conversation navigation rail for jumping to any earlier turn in the dialogue.该工作台专为程序员打造，旨在高效审阅代码并追踪变更历史。其内置的对话导航轨道可常驻显示，支持用户一

description.en: Reads local Codex CLI session history from ~/.codex/sessions and syncs it into DSH conversations for seamless continuity.
description.zh: 自动读取本地 Codex CLI 会话历史并同步到 DSH 对话，实现两者无缝衔接。

description.en: Provides light and dark Codex themes for DSH web GUI as a configurable appearance plugin.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Codex 浅色和深色主题的可配置外观插件。

description.en: Adds a /skills command that lists all DSH skills with auto-translated one-line descriptions and inserts the chosen skill into chat.
description.zh: 提供 /skills 命令，列出所有 DSH 技能并自动精简翻译为一句摘要，选中后插入该技能。

description.en: Shows Command Code account balance plus 5-hour, weekly and monthly quota windows as a status row under the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方以状态行显示 Command Code 账户余额及 5 小时、每周、每月配额窗口。

description.en: Gives a DSH character its own persona, diary and long-term memory workspace, with optional Minecraft embodiment and QQ/Bilibili channels.
description.zh: 为 DSH 角色提供独立的人设、日记与长期记忆工作区，并可按需接入 Minecraft、QQ 与 B站。

description.en: DSH plugin that plays a sound and shows a toast or system notification when tasks complete, with zero system dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成时播放提示音，并弹出页面内 toast，页面在后台时显示系统通知，纯浏览器实现，无需系统依赖，跨 Windows、macOS、Linux。

description.en: Adds command history to the DSH web GUI composer; press up/down to cycle through previously sent instructions and restore drafts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面输入框添加指令历史，按上下方向键循环浏览已发送的指令，到达末尾时恢复此前正在编辑的草稿。

description.en: Adds tab-completion ghost text to the DeepSeek Harness composer with next-message suggestions and inline continuations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加 Tab 补全幽灵文本，提供下一条消息建议与行内续写。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin giving the agent screenshot, mouse/keyboard, window, UIA and clipboard tools, with a glowing indicator and Esc kill switch.
description.zh: Windows 电脑操作插件，为智能体提供截图、鼠标键盘、窗口、UIA 与剪贴板 5 个工具，并带荧光指示灯与 Esc 急停。

description.en: ModelScope connect bundle for the DeepSeek Harness, adding a local free API-Inference quota panel and optional provider registration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 ModelScope 连接包，提供本地免费 API 推理额度面板，并可选注册模型提供方。

description.en: Bridges free models from a local OpenCode server into DeepSeek Harness's model selector so DSH agents can use them.
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCode（opencode serve）里的免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器。

description.en: Generates topics, titles, posts, and content calendars for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 生成选题、标题、帖子和内容日历。

description.en: Adds a draggable conversation minimap to the dsh web client for quick scrolling and preview of chat sessions.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 客户端添加可拖动的会话地图，用于快速滚动和预览聊天会话。

description.en: A cute chef-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that animates task status (idle, cooking, serving, waiting) and reacts to clicks.
description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的可爱小厨娘桌宠，用动画展示任务状态，还能点击互动。

description.en: Read-only floating widget that monitors DSH login cookie count and request-header usage against the 16 KiB cap, warning before startup fails.
description.zh: 只读浮窗，实时监控 DSH 登录 cookie 数量与请求头占用，在接近 16 KiB 上限时提前告警，防止无法启动。

description.en: Tencent Cloud COS storage plugin: browse buckets, upload/download files, manage folders with progress controls.
description.zh: 腾讯云 COS 存储插件：浏览存储桶、上传下载文件、管理文件夹，并显示进度。

description.en: DSH plugin that keeps a live readout above the input box estimating the cost of your next request and the next round of the session.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在输入框上方常驻一条读数，预估下一步请求和本轮会话大概要花多少钱。

description.en: Turns a DSH session into a group chat where a commander splits tasks and 8 configurable role agents work concurrently on codex/claude/deepseek/image.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话变成群聊：指挥拆解任务，8 个可配置岗位成员在 codex/claude/deepseek/image 上并发干活，并含初审与终审。

description.en: Turns course files (PPTX/PDF/DOCX/MD) into chapter outlines, key knowledge points, Bilibili course picks, and Markdown/PDF study reports.
description.zh: 将课程文件（PPTX/PDF/DOCX/MD）转换为目录识别、分章知识点、B站网课推荐及Markdown/PDF学习报告。

description.en: CPA account pool status panel for DSH showing quota, health, and traffic with anomaly alerts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，展示 CLIProxyAPI 账号池的配额、健康刻度与流量状态，并提示异常。

description.en: A cyberpunk 2077 night-city themed UI skin for DeepSeek Harness with neon colors, CRT effects, and a settings page.
A voice and emotion-aware companion for DeepSeek Harness that listens to speech, detects tone and replies with empathy.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的语音情绪伴侣：聆听语音，识别语气情绪，并以共情方式回复。

description.en: A data cleaning agent that cleans, completes, and profiles enterprise list data from CSV/XLSX/JSON, with optional Qichacha enrichment.
description.zh: 清洗、补全并画像企业名单数据的智能体，支持本地CSV/XLSX/JSON文件及企查查补全。

description.en: Decision-split plugin for DSH Web UI: shows agent's plan summary with decision input while full markdown scrolls in side panel, sending decisions back to agent.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中把 agent 的计划摘要与决策输入放在主窗口，完整 markdown 在右侧详情栏展示，并可将决策一键回传 agent。

description.en: Arknights-style boot animation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with whale-girl, PRTS terminal, holographic lock-on, and 4 original soundtracks.
description.zh: 明日方舟风格的 DSH 启动动画插件，含鲸鱼娘×PRTS 终端、全息锁定与干员档案，并有 4 套原创配乐可选。

description.en: Widget for the dsh sidebar to monitor AI balances (DeepSeek, MiMo) with real-time usage and cost tracking.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页侧边栏显示 DeepSeek、MiMo 账户余额，并实时跟踪用量与花费。

description.en: Shows a green/red dot in DeepSeek Harness composer indicating API peak/off-peak status.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框中显示绿点或红点，指示 API 当前处于高峰或低谷时段。

description.en: A floating bottom-right widget for DSH web GUI showing remaining DeepSeek API balance.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供悬浮在右下角的卡片，显示 DeepSeek API 剩余余额。

description.en: DeepSeek-style visual theme for the dsh web GUI with glassmorphism and animated particle background.
description.zh: 为dsh网页图形界面提供DeepSeek风格的视觉主题，包括玻璃拟态和动态粒子背景。

description.en: Lets you use DeepSeek web chat and temporary sidebar chats inside DSH, plus API platform access and migrating history back to native sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 DeepSeek 网页聊天与临时侧栏聊天，提供 API 开放平台入口，并可将历史迁移回原生会话。

description.en: Message-level deletion plugin for DeepSeek Harness to remove mistaken messages from model context and hide them from visible transcript.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息级删除插件，可将误发或错误消息从模型上下文移除，并在可见对话记录中隐藏。

description.en: Gives the DeepSeek Harness desktop app a frosted-glass look with a translucent page and Windows acrylic window material.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用提供磨砂玻璃外观，页面半透明并启用 Windows 亚克力窗口材质。

description.en: Windows desktop reminders for DeepSeek Harness that pop up in a screen corner and click through to the matching conversation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面提醒，在屏幕角落弹出并可点击回到对应对话。

description.en: AI control plugin for DG-LAB hardware in DeepSeek Harness with Web GUI QR pairing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 DG-LAB 硬件控制插件，向 AI 提供 dglab-kit 工具集，并带 Web GUI 扫码配对功能。

description.en: Sends Markdown or plain text notifications from an agent to DingTalk group chats via custom robot webhook.
description.zh: 通过自定义机器人 webhook，把智能体发出的 Markdown 或纯文本通知发送到钉钉群聊。

description.en: Discord bot for remote access to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, querying session history and driving agents without inbound ports.
description.zh: 把 dsh 工作区映射到 Discord 分类，可查询会话轨迹和实时子代理，并远程驱动代理，无需开放入站端口。

description.en: An enhanced fork of a right-sidebar editable canvas + AI drawing plugin that adds a vtracer high-quality image-vectorization engine (Bézier splines, per-channel bit depth, parallel).
description.zh: 右侧栏可编辑画布 + AI 绘图插件的增强分支，新增 vtracer 高质量矢量化引擎（贝塞尔样条、每通道位深、并行加速）。

description.en: Adds chat-style file attachments with upload, drag-drop, and text extraction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加附件功能：支持回形针上传、拖放文件、提取 PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT 文本，并在对话记录中显示附件卡片。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto check-ins daily on Trae and WorkBuddy, with a sidebar panel for status, points and expiry reminders.
description.zh: DSH 插件：随宿主启动自动完成 Trae 与 WorkBuddy 每日签到，并在侧边栏展示签到状态、积分与到期提醒。

description.en: A glass-style UI companion that shows agent activity status and asks before making changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供玻璃风格界面伴侣，显示 Agent 思考与工作状态，执行改动前先征求确认。

description.en: An education mode for DSH that gathers real sources, teaches a subject properly, saves class notes, and quizzes you before claiming you learned it.
description.zh: DSH 的教育模式：收集真实资料、系统讲解主题、保存课堂笔记，并在宣称你已学会前进行测验。

description.en: A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that displays Agent status via animated Emotion Ball expressions, docked in chat or desktop.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的情绪球桌宠，按 Agent 状态显示动画表情，可停靠对话内或桌面端。

description.en: Everforest color themes for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop, offering Dark and Light variants in Hard, Medium, and Soft.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版和桌面版提供 Everforest 主题，含深色与浅色及 Hard、Medium、Soft 变体。

description.en: Imports local AI coding tool logins (Codex, Grok, Claude, etc.) into DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 将本地 Codex、Grok、Claude、OpenCode、CC Switch 的登录导入 DeepSeek Harness

description.en: A Codex skill ported to DSH that directs fight scenes and generates AI video prompts for Seedance 2.0/2.5 and MiniMax H3.
description.zh: 从 Codex 移植到 DSH 的技能，用于指导打斗场景并生成 Seedance 2.0/2.5、MiniMax H3 的 AI 视频提示词。

description.en: dsh plugin that lets you block an agent from reading, searching, writing or editing chosen files and folders in the Web GUI, keeping secrets out of the conversation.
description.zh: dsh 插件：在 Web GUI 中点选文件或目录，屏蔽 agent 对其的读取、搜索、写入与编辑，避免机密内容进入对话。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin recording file read/write/edit events from models, showing line-numbered terminal-style diff with collapsible hunks.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件，记录并展示模型读写/编辑文件的事件，带行号终端风 diff 和可折叠代码块。

description.en: Upload arbitrary local files from the DeepSeek Harness Web composer and manage them in Settings.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，并在设置中管理这些文件。

description.en: A DSH plugin adding native-like attachment upload to DeepSeek Harness, with drag/paste/paperclip, image thumbnails and file cards in the same input track.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 添加接近原生质感的附件上传：支持拖入/粘贴/回形针，图片与文件卡片在输入框同轨混排。

description.en: Parses a development idea, searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance and stars, then reads selected repos' source to outline architecture.
description.zh: 输入开发想法后自动解析关键词、检索 GitHub 项目并按相关性与 star 数排序，还能读取所选仓库源码梳理架构。

description.en: Focus mode plugin for DSH Web GUI: full-screen reading, hides title/input, collapses AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供专注模式：切换全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题和输入框，并把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: DSH host plugin that drops the pending prompts a fork inherits, so fork children answer only the prompt you send.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：清除 fork 子会话继承的待处理提示队列，让子会话只响应你发送的提示。

description.en: DSH /fresh command summarizes conversation, starts a new session, and archives the old one to free memory.
description.zh: DSH 的 /fresh 命令：总结当前对话、开启新会话，并归档旧会话以释放内存。

description.en: Turns the DSH settings popup into a Codex-style full-page, fullscreen settings view.
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置弹窗改为 Codex 风格的整页全屏设置页。

description.en: Lightweight UI tweaks for DeepSeek Harness: appearance skins and conversation folding with nav rail.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供轻量界面调整：dsh-skin 更换外观皮肤，dsh-tidy 折叠对话并显示导航栏。

description.en: GirlsBangCry skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: deep-sea palace background, rotating character stage, and black-pink lace decoration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 GirlsBangCry 皮肤，包含深海宫殿背景、旋转角色舞台和黑粉蕾丝装饰。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that turns natural-language requests into GeoGebra commands and renders interactive math figures in an embedded board.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏插件，将自然语言请求转换为 GeoGebra 命令，并在内嵌画板中实时渲染数学图形。

description.en: External brain for DSH: injects GitHub repo memory into context when a chat starts and writes new long-term memories back as committed files.
description.zh: DSH 的外置大脑：对话开始自动拉取 GitHub 仓库记忆注入上下文，对话结束把新增长期记忆按文件写回并提交。

description.en: Encrypted storage and on-demand access to GitLab and GitHub API tokens with a web settings panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel.

description.en: Adds a real bash tool to DSH on Windows, letting agents call bash directly without pwsh escaping or quoting issues.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供真正的 bash 工具，可直接调用 bash，无需处理 pwsh 转义与引号问题。

description.en: Brings GitHub pull requests, reviews, issues and CI status into DeepSeek Harness, with approval-gated write actions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中集成 GitHub 拉取请求、评审、议题与 CI 状态，写操作需审批确认。

description.en: DSH plugin to connect GitHub via MCP, with token stored in DSH credential center and auto-installed UI hint plugin.
description.zh: DSH插件，通过MCP连接GitHub，token存储于DSH凭据中心，自动安装UI提示插件。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that probes game save formats, reads and writes fields, disassembles assemblies, and applies equal-length patches.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的单机游戏存档与程序集修改工具箱：探测格式、读写字段、反汇编定位并等长打补丁。

description.en: Adds a sidebar gold-price panel showing live Shanghai Au99.99, international XAU/USD, ICBC and CCB gold quotes with cross-source validation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增黄金实时价格面板，展示上金所Au99.99、国际XAU/USD、工行与建行积存金的实时报价并做交叉校验。

description.en: Vendors the GPT Image Playground workbench into DSH and serves it same-origin for AI image generation and editing.
description.zh: 将 GPT Image Playground 工作台内置到 DSH 插件中，同源提供 AI 图像生成与编辑界面。

description.en: Slices a closed session log at its last turn into a zero-inheritance, cold-resumable session for crash-safe long-session handoff.
description.zh: 在最后一轮处切分已关闭的会话日志，生成零继承、可冷启动续跑的会话，实现崩溃安全的长会话交接。

description.en: Places a session's reasoning style between dsv4-grayscale and current-release poles, calibrated on real sessions.
description.zh: dsh 网页插件，把会话的推理风格定位在 dsv4-grayscale 与当前发布版两极之间，基于41个灰度与42个当前版会话校准，留出集准确率92.8%。

description.en: Audits brand visibility across 17+ AI search engines, providing recommendations and content-gap diagnosis.
description.zh: 作为DSH内置技能包，审计品牌在17个以上AI搜索引擎中的可见性、推荐、引用和竞品出现情况，并诊断内容缺口。

description.en: Localizes DeepSeek Harness GUI to Chinese: tool cards, plugin list, and command palette become bilingual (Chinese + English).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 图形界面提供中文本地化，工具卡片、插件列表和命令面板显示中英双语。

description.en: Durable session handoff for DeepSeek Harness with pressure-aware handoff docs, searchable transcripts, and automatic continuation in a fresh session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化会话交接：压力感知交接文档、可搜索记录，并在新会话中自动续接。

description.en: A companion skin for DeepSeek Harness that segments replies by emotion and renders avatar bubbles with persona memory.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供伴侣皮肤，按情绪切分回复，并结合人格记忆渲染头像气泡。

description.en: A dsh plugin that enables AI to automatically call multimodal models (VLMs) for visual analysis.
description.zh: 让 AI 自动调用多模态模型（VLM）进行视觉分析的 dsh 插件

description.en: A hippocampus-inspired memory layer for companion bots: event encoding, emotion-weighted forgetting, associative recall and honest uncertainty.
description.zh: 为养成型伴侣机器人打造的海马体式记忆层：事件编码、情绪加权遗忘、联想召回，并会坦承记不清。

description.en: One-click start/stop HarmonyOS emulator and build, install, and launch HarmonyOS apps to it.
description.zh: 一键启动/停止鸿蒙模拟器，构建并部署鸿蒙应用到模拟器。

description.en: Hold the mouse on the composer input, speak, and release to insert locally-transcribed text via offline SenseVoice ASR.
description.zh: 在输入框上按住鼠标说话,松开后把本地 SenseVoice 离线识别的文字插入草稿。

description.en: Adds multi-channel notifications (toast, PWA, browser) with sound to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多渠道通知：页面提示、PWA 和带声音的浏览器通知。

description.en: An IM gateway connecting messengers to harness agent sessions for slash-command control.
description.zh: 一个即时通讯网关，将各类聊天工具接入 DeepSeek Harness 的代理会话，并支持用斜杠命令控制这些会话。

description.en: Lets an agent drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser to navigate, read, click, type, and run JavaScript while you watch.
description.zh: 让智能体操控 DeepSeek Harness 内置侧边栏浏览器，进行导航、阅读、点击、输入和执行 JavaScript，全程可见。

description.en: Save, edit and reuse frequently used prompts; clicking one appends it to the current dsh draft without auto-sending.
description.zh: 保存、编辑并复用常用提示词，点击后追加到当前 dsh 草稿输入框，不自动发送。

description.en: DSH plugin that autonomously collects news from custom sources, RSS/Atom/JSON/HTML and hot lists, then pushes results into chats or mobile messengers.
description.zh: DSH插件，按偏好自主采集全网资讯与自定义源（RSS/Atom/JSON/HTML），并将结果主动推送到会话或移动端。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that enables browser automation using Jiey Browser via MCP, letting agents go online.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 MCP 调用 Jiey Browser 实现浏览器自动化，让智能体联网操作网页。

description.en: Android-side DSH remote bridge that pairs with a desktop instance via a 6-digit code and provides RPC/SSE connectivity while keeping credentials in the engine.
description.zh: 安卓端 DSH 远程桥接插件，通过 6 位配对码连接电脑端实例，提供 RPC/SSE 通信并将凭据保留在引擎进程中。

description.en: Turns local Kimi WebBridge daemon into 15 native browser automation tools for navigating, clicking, filling, screenshots, uploads, and PDF.
description.zh: 将本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程封装成 15 个原生浏览器工具，支持导航、点击、填写、快照、截图、执行脚本、网络、上传和 PDF。

description.en: DSH plugin that looks up Strinova (卡拉彼丘) match stats by nickname and renders them into a single long image via klbq_query.
description.zh: 按游戏昵称从 dakanu.com 查询卡拉彼丘（Strinova）战绩，并渲染成长图，通过 klbq_query 工具提供给 agent。

description.en: Optimizes large-session performance using zero-copy fork, projection warmup, and chunked materialize.
description.zh: 通过零拷贝 fork、投影预热和分块物化优化 DSH 大型会话性能。

description.en: LaTeX studio plugin with a portable MiKTeX engine (xelatex/pdflatex), an in-app web editor and one-click PDF compilation.
description.zh: LaTeX 工作室插件：内置便携版 MiKTeX（xelatex/pdflatex）引擎、内置网页编辑器与一键编译 PDF。

description.en: Generates course notes, conceptual explanations, and self-contained lectures for Codex and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness 生成课程笔记、概念讲解和自包含讲义的学习技能。

description.en: A DSH plugin adding OMP-style ingress shaping and optional local fast-compact for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness添加OMP风格入口整形和可选本地快速压缩的DSH插件。

description.en: Engineering project memory for DSH: ledger, activity logs L0-L4, three-layer context compression, verbatim capsule persistence, and cross-session handoff notes.
description.zh: 台账记忆为 DSH 提供工程化项目记忆：台账、L0-L4 活动日志、三层上下文压缩、逐字胶囊落盘和跨会话交接单，可回溯可追查。

description.en: Provides content-addressed data and action lineage evidence for DeepSeek Harness auditing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 审计提供基于内容寻址的数据与操作溯源证据

description.en: Memory side of the Linghun cognition system for DeepSeek Harness, handling memory extraction and assembly (in development).
description.zh: Linghun 认知系统的记忆侧插件，负责记忆提取与组装（开发中），面向 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A change-aware quality loop that lints, typechecks and runs impacted tests, ignoring pre-existing breakage and proving each change is clean.
description.zh: 一个变更感知的质量循环：对改动做 lint、类型检查和受影响测试，忽略既有问题，证明本次改动干净。

description.en: Linux native desktop integration for DeepSeek Harness: XDG desktop entry, borderless standalone window, and auto service shutdown on close.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linux 原生桌面集成：XDG 桌面入口、无边框独立窗口，关窗自动停止服务。

description.en: Liquid Glass input card for DSH web GUI with SVG refraction and spring press animation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供液态玻璃输入卡片，采用 SVG 折射滤镜，并带耦合弹簧按压动画。

description.en: All-in-one live-data plugin bundling 10 tools across 8 keyless public APIs for rates, weather, npm, GitHub, PyPI, Bilibili, A-shares, gold price and IP location.
description.zh: 一体化实时数据聚合插件，10 个工具对接 8 个免密钥公开接口：汇率、天气、npm、GitHub、PyPI、B站、A股、大盘、金价与 IP 归属地。

description.en: Independent Bilibili virtual-streamer plugin: reads live danmaku, merges viewer questions, speaks via TTS on a Live2D stage, and logs model usage and gifts.
description.zh: 独立的虚拟主播插件：接收 B 站直播弹幕、合并观众提问、生成语音、内置 Live2D 舞台输出直播画面，并记录模型消耗与礼物金额。

description.en: Self-tending knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness with temporal decay, hybrid recall, and knowledge graph.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness打造的自维护知识库，具备时间衰减、混合召回和知识图谱。

description.en: Retries LLM requests on errors in deepseek-harness, supporting configurable HTTP status and field-value matching.
description.zh: 在deepseek-harness中，出错时重试大语言模型请求，支持配置HTTP状态和字段-值匹配。

description.en: Makes the agent tolerate OpenAI-compatible streams that end without finish_reason, e.g. Snowflake Cortex.
description.zh: 让 dsh 代理容忍 OpenAI 兼容的流式响应在缺少 finish_reason 时正常结束，例如 Snowflake Cortex 网关。

description.en: Gates per-provider concurrency for DeepSeek Harness model requests, queueing surplus calls in FIFO inside dsh to avoid HTTP timeout ambiguity.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型请求提供按提供方的并发闸门，将多余请求在 dsh 内 FIFO 排队，避免等待与超时混淆。

description.en: Injects custom HTTP headers into DeepSeek Harness ChatCompletions requests to support OpenCode free models like v4-flash and hy3.
description.zh: 向 dsh 的 ChatCompletions 请求注入自定义 HTTP headers，用于接入 OpenCode 的免费 v4-flash、hy3 等模型。

description.en: LLM adapter to use WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy models in DSH via a local proxy, no API key needed.
description.zh: 通过本地代理让 DSH 调用 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 的模型，无需 API key

description.en: Russian language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI that adds a ru locale and registers translations for every interface namespace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的俄语语言包，添加 ru 语言并注册所有界面命名空间的翻译。

description.en: External coach for DeepSeek Harness that silently evolves agent tools, skills, config, and model with deterministic verification.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供外部教练与第二验证者，静默演进智能体的工具、技能、配置和模型，并做确定性验证与冷应用。

description.en: Connects DSH to a self-hosted Magpie LLM gateway with per-owner provider routes, automatic failover, usage cards and model controls.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到自托管的 Magpie LLM 网关，支持按上游所有者路由、自动故障转移、用量卡片与模型控制。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets the Agent role-play a maid persona from character cards you import or generate, activating only on demand.
description.zh: DSH 插件：让 Agent 扮演女仆角色，通过导入或生成角色卡注入人设，仅在需要时激活。

description.en: Renders produced file previews inline in DSH Web chat; markdown, images, code, text.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天中内联渲染生成的文件预览，支持 markdown、图片、代码和文本。

description.en: DSH plugin that bridges to the official MATLAB MCP server so agents can run MATLAB code, tests, checks and Simulink models.
description.zh: DSH 插件通过官方 MATLAB MCP 服务器让 Agent 执行 MATLAB 代码、测试、静态检查并操作 Simulink 模型。

description.en: Engineering skills pack: TDD, code review, domain modeling, spec/ticket flow, and grilling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，移植 Matt Pocock 的工程技能包，包含 grilling、spec/ticket 流程、TDD、代码审查和领域建模等技能。

description.en: Automates writing mathematical modeling competition papers via DeepSeek-Harness pipeline.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek-Harness 提供数学建模竞赛论文全自动撰写流水线的插件。

description.en: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge for DeepSeek Harness: connect stdio/HTTP MCP servers and auto-register their tools for the agent.
description.zh: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge for DeepSeek Harness: connect stdio/HTTP MCP servers and auto-register their tools for the agent.

description.en: Bridges to a MATLAB MCP server, enabling AI tools to evaluate code, run scripts/tests, and inspect toolboxes.
description.zh: 桥接到MATLAB MCP服务器，让AI工具能够执行代码、运行脚本/测试及检查工具箱。

description.en: MCP Tools panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI to browse servers, tools, schemas, and usage times.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 MCP 工具面板，按服务器分组展示会话中的 MCP 服务器与工具，提供 JSON schema、实时搜索和来自真实会话日志的最后使用时间。

description.en: dsh plugin to read/write self-hosted mem0 memory REST service with tools for add, search, get, update, delete memories.
description.zh: dsh 插件，用于读写自建 mem0 记忆 REST 服务，提供新增、搜索、获取、更新、删除记忆的工具。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness layered long-term memory: a small hot layer, month-archived cold entries with keyword recall, and extractive summaries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层长期记忆：小型热层、按月归档并支持跨月关键词召回的冷层，以及抽取式日/周/月摘要。

description.en: 这是我为 DSH （DeepSeek Harness） 制作的一款插件，可以进行跨对话记忆支持手动导入
Renders Mermaid fenced code blocks as interactive diagrams in DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中把 Mermaid 围栏代码块渲染成可交互图表

description.en: Links multiple DSH instances on a LAN so a parent agent can dispatch tasks, collect results and forward approval requests to child agents.
description.zh: 让局域网内多台 DSH 互联，上级派发任务、子级执行并回传结果，敏感操作审批转交上级处理。

description.en: Adds microphone voice input to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI using the browser Web Speech API.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加麦克风语音输入，通过浏览器 Web Speech API 将语音识别为文字。

description.en: Controls iOS simulators via WebDriverAgent for screenshots, taps, element lookup, URL opening, and accessibility tree dumps.
description.zh: DSH plugin for controlling mobile devices (ADB/iOS) — DeepSeek Harness 操控手机插件

description.en: WeChat remote-control plugin for dsh agent: two-way file transfer, proactive notifications, and multi-session switching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness WeChat remote-control plugin: drive your dsh agent from WeChat — two-way file transfer, proactive notifications, multi-session switching (iLink)

description.en: DSH Web mobile UI adaptation plugin adding overlay drawer, safe-area support, and canary version detection.
description.zh: DSH Web移动端UI适配插件，提供悬浮抽屉、安全区支持和金丝雀版本检测。

description.en: Adds a DSH Settings page where you edit custom model capabilities: context window, max output tokens, image input, and real reasoning-effort values.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增“模型能力”页，可编辑自定义模型的上下文窗口、最大输出 token、图像输入与真实思考档位值。

description.en: Dialog-style model picker for DSH Web UI with fuzzy search, vendor grouping, favorites, and thinking-level dropdown.
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web UI 模型选择器，以对话框形式提供模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏和思考档位下拉，官方 bundle 形态。

description.en: One panel to set provider, model and reasoning effort for the main agent, subagents and goal turns, with hot-applied changes.
description.zh: 一个面板统一设置主 agent、子代理和 goal 回合的 provider、模型与推理强度，保存即时生效无需重启。

description.en: Switch model routes for main, subagents, search, image generation, conversation, and Plan in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中切换主模型、子代理、搜索、图像生成、对话和Plan的模型路线。

description.en: Enhances unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models with reasoning levels from models.dev.
description.zh: 为未配置的第三方 DeepSeek Harness 模型添加来自 models.dev 的推理等级。

description.en: Adds a customizable poetic quote to the bottom-left of the WebUI for a touch of literary flair.
description.zh: 在 WebUI 左下角显示一句可自定义的古诗词、文采句或游戏台词，为 Vibe Coding 增添文艺感。

description.en: Automated testing for WeChat Mini Programs in dsh: selector actions, freshness gates, geometry assertions, and screenshots.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供微信小程序自动化测试：通过选择器执行操作、构建新鲜度检查、面向纯文本模型的几何优先断言，并在视觉链路中截图。

description.en: Glass-style DSH sidebar card showing quota and balance usage across 11 AI providers, including SiliconFlow, Tavily, ZenMux, MiMo and Claude.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏毛玻璃卡片，展示 11 家 AI 服务商的配额与余额使用情况，支持 SiliconFlow、Tavily、ZenMux、MiMo、Claude 等。

description.en: Adds a 'My Plugins' tab to DSH settings, displaying installed plugins in two-column cards with status and description.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置插件页添加我的插件标签，以双列卡片展示用户已安装插件及其配置状态、Cordis 状态和插件介绍。

description.en: DSH skin plugin with visual customization, live preview, and a Skin Manager settings page; non-invasive and fully reversible.
description.zh: DSH 皮肤插件：可视化自定义、实时预览和「皮肤管理」设置页，非侵入式且完全可逆。

description.en: Provides reliable outbound networking for sandboxed DSH agents via HTTP fetch and proxy diagnostics.
description.zh: dsh-net-tools: reliable outbound networking for sandboxed DSH agents — net_fetch (proxy CONNECT-tunnel HTTP fetch) and net_proxy_status (proxy diagnostics).

description.en: Queue tasks during peak hours, run them at off-peak to save token costs, retry failures and auto-continue truncations, report savings.
description.zh: 在高峰时段排队任务，低谷时段自动执行，重试失败并续写截断，生成节省报告。

description.en: Adds shell-style prompt history recall to the DSH composer: press ↑ to reload past prompts and ↓ to walk forward to your draft.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加类似 shell 的历史提示词回溯：按 ↑ 载入之前发送的提示词，按 ↓ 前进回到空草稿。

description.en: Gives a DSH agent 86 ursim_* tools to drive a Universal Robots arm: joint/Cartesian motion, I/O, registers, RTDE telemetry and URScript.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供 86 个 ursim_* 工具，用自然语言驱动 Universal Robots 机械臂，涵盖运动、I/O、寄存器、RTDE 遥测与 URScript。

description.en: Sends browser desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events like turn completion and approval requests.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 回合完成或需要审批时发送浏览器桌面通知。

description.en: Spoken desktop notifications for DSH Desktop: Windows TTS built in, optional VOICEVOX voices, and an idle gate that waits for subagents before saying done.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供会说话的桌面通知：内置 Windows TTS、可选 VOICEVOX 音色，并带等待子代理完成的空闲门控。

description.en: Native Windows toast notifications and taskbar flash for DeepSeek Harness when tasks finish or input is needed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 任务完成或需要输入时，发送原生 Windows 通知并闪烁任务栏。

description.en: Turns DSH's sidebar into a novel reader while giving the AI tools to read and edit the novel's text, outline, characters and settings.
description.zh: 把 DSH 右侧边栏变成小说阅读器，并让 AI 能读取和修改正文、提纲、人物与设定。

description.en: Zero-touch runtime telemetry plugin that writes per-session report cards (task/model/tools/failures/duration) to a human-readable journal.
description.zh: 零干预运行时遥测插件，为每个 DeepSeek Harness 会话将会话报告卡写入可读日志，记录任务、模型、工具、失败和时长。

description.en: Brings your Obsidian vault into the DSH right sidebar with a folder tree, full-text search, Obsidian-styled note pages and note outlines.
description.zh: 把 Obsidian 知识库放进 DSH 右侧栏:目录树、全文搜索、Obsidian 风格笔记页与笔记大纲。

description.en: Shows your OpenDesign subscription quota (5h/7d windows) in a DSH settings panel and a live top-bar progress indicator.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页与顶栏进度条中显示 OpenDesign 订阅额度（5 小时 / 7 天窗口）及钱包信息。

description.en: DSH host plugin that adds Word and Excel read/write tools for AI agents, covering docx, xlsx, xls, doc, rtf and odt.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件，为 AI 智能体增加 Word/Excel 读写工具，支持 docx、xlsx、xls、doc、rtf、odt。

description.en: A pure CSS skin that replaces the DSH agent-team panel member-row status icons with the "Oh Jingjing" whale character for idle, running, and failed states.
description.zh: 纯 CSS 皮肤，用「哦鲸鲸」形象替换 DSH 智能体团队面板成员行的状态图标（静止 / 运行 / 失败）。

description.en: Connects OpenCode's free models into DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with zero configuration, acting as a model provider.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode 的免费模型零配置接入 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），作为模型提供方使用。

description.en: Key-free OpenCode Zen free-model lane for DeepSeek Harness, delivered as a host-only cordis plugin with three-wire streaming decode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免密钥的 OpenCode Zen 免费模型通道，采用仅宿主 cordis 插件与三线流式解码。

description.en: Syncs opencode-go model catalog from models.opencode.ai into DSH, creating or refreshing the provider.
description.zh: 从 models.opencode.ai 同步 opencode-go 模型目录到 DSH，创建或刷新对应提供方。

description.en: Displays OpenCode Go quota usage progress bars and billing strip in DSH Web GUI sidebar.
description.zh: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai/zen/go) quota usage card for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI sidebar - day/week/month progress bars, DS peak/valley billing strip, customizable auto-refresh interval.

description.en: OpenRouter free model panel for DeepSeek Harness with star ratings, one-click switching, and task-resume support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenRouter 免费模型面板，支持分级星标、一键切换和任务续跑。

description.en: macOS (Apple Silicon) port of dsh-ops, adding Rust-powered file tools and PTC batching to the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: dsh-ops 的 macOS（Apple Silicon）移植版，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Rust 文件工具与 PTC 批处理。

description.en: Optimizes DSH by auditing/archiving/cleaning sessions and patching history pagination to skip chunk events.
description.zh: 对 DSH 会话做体检、归档与清理，并给 history 分页打补丁，使其跳过流式 chunk 事件，避免拖慢会话切换。

description.en: An acceptance gate for DSH that locks acceptance criteria first and only honors execution receipts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的验收门：先冻结验收标准，只认执行回执。

description.en: Manages trusted SSH hosts from DeepSeek Harness with status checks, file reads/greps, transactional patches, and tmux jobs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理受信任 SSH 主机，提供状态检查、文件读取/搜索、事务补丁和 tmux 任务。

description.en: Pack DeepSeek Harness agent configs as zip for migration/sharing with privacy scanning and diff restore.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 配置（技能、会话、配置档、设置、记忆）打包成 zip，便于迁移或分享，并支持隐私扫描、差异还原和包管理。

description.en: Floating right-side panel dock for DSH where AI generates tileable panels fed by local/HTTP data sources, with AI refresh and in-panel model calls.
description.zh: DSH 右侧悬浮面板坞插件：AI 在对话中生成可平铺组合的面板，支持本机/HTTP 数据源、AI 刷新及面板内模型调用。

description.en: A design taste plugin that accumulates examples and principles to sharpen agent judgment on aesthetics over time.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理积累设计样例与原则，随使用逐步提升其审美判断的插件。

description.en: Pasted code blocks in the DSH Web composer become collapsible language-tagged cards and revert to fenced blocks on send.
description.zh: 在DSH Web编辑器中，粘贴的代码块折叠为带语言标签的可折叠卡片，发送时恢复为围栏代码块。
