description.en: Shows a DeepSeek peak/off-peak billing clock, live balance and per-turn cost above the dsh-tui prompt, with an optional flashing peak-hour warning.
description.zh: 在 dsh-tui 提示符上方显示 DeepSeek 峰谷计费时钟、实时余额与每轮花费，并可开启高峰时段闪烁警告框。

description.en: Pair two DeepSeek Harness machines with a one-time code to run tasks and transfer files remotely over LAN or an end-to-end-encrypted relay.
description.zh: 通过一次性配对码连接两台 DeepSeek Harness 机器，在局域网直连或端到端加密中继上远程执行任务并传输文件。

description.en: Permission rules engine for DeepSeek Harness with host-side interception and a browser-based visual editor.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的权限规则引擎，在宿主端拦截操作，并提供基于浏览器的可视化规则编辑器。

description.en: Android overlay derivative of dsh-pet that shows the desktop pet in a system floating window, auto-detecting the host carrier.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的 Android 衍生插件，用系统悬浮窗承载桌宠显示，并自动探测宿主载体。

description.en: Gives the DSH whale-girl pet an AI persona: role-voiced chat, Chinese inner monologue bubbles, affection points and a nightly auto-written diary.
description.zh: 为 DSH 鲸鱼娘挂件注入 AI 人格：角色口吻对话、中文心里话气泡、亲密度与每晚自动日记。

description.en: A desktop pet plugin that brings virtual singer Luo Tianyi into DSH, draggable and interactive, with preset animations and AI chat via the configured large model.
description.zh: 洛天依桌宠插件：在DSH界面中漂浮、拖动、互动（抚摸/喂食/睡觉），并能接入大模型实时聊天。

description.en: A playable pixel companion that jumps over chat messages, WASD-controlled, with a nurture system fed by token usage.
description.zh: 一个可玩的像素宠物插件，用WASD控制它在聊天消息上跳跃，并根据代理真实 token 消耗喂养养成系统。

description.en: A desktop pet status light plugin for DeepSeek Harness showing character expressions and chat bubbles on events.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物状态灯插件：完成任务、出错或提问时自动弹出角色表情与聊天框气泡提示。

description.en: DSH desktop watcher plugin that alerts you with system notifications, sounds and title marks when a task needs input or finishes while you're away.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端守望提醒插件：任务需要操作或回复完成时，用系统通知、提示音和标题标记把你唤回。

description.en: Serves a token-protected mobile web page from your computer so you can drive DSH Desktop agents from your phone in real time.
description.zh: 在电脑上启动受令牌保护的手机网页，用手机远程操控 DSH 桌面版 Agent，实时看输出并随时叫停。

description.en: Unified 88api.ai Image2 and Nano Banana plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling image generation and editing via multiple AI models.
description.zh: Unified 88api.ai Image2 and Nano Banana plugin for DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Searches real arXiv and Semantic Scholar data, shows paper details, generates GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX citations, and manages a local library with batch export.
description.zh: 基于 arXiv 与 Semantic Scholar 真实数据源检索文献，支持单篇详情、GB/T 7714/APA/BibTeX 引用生成，并提供本地文献库与批量导出。

description.en: Adds multi-root directory workspace support and dynamic context injection to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 支持多根目录工作区与上下文动态注入。

description.en: Adds an animated WebGL2/Canvas2D dynamic background to the dsh Web UI with fluid, whales, fish, and grid.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web UI 添加 WebGL2 动态背景，包含流体、字符鲸鱼游动与循环接缝赛博朋克故障转场、发光鱼群和点线网格。

description.en: Plugin market entry and ops panel: browse awesome dsh plugin catalog, check install/load status, install/update/uninstall via dshmarket, plus agent tools.
Automatically fills in context size, token limits, vision support, and thinking levels for custom model providers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 配置第三方提供商时，自动从权威模型库补齐上下文大小、Token 上限、视觉多模态输入与思考强度档位。

description.en: Proxies Devin Connect RPC behind an OpenAI Chat Completions compatible HTTP API, enabling OpenAI clients to use Devin models like glm-5.2 and swe-1.7.
description.zh: 将 Devin Connect RPC 反代为 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容 HTTP API，让 OpenAI 客户端可使用 glm-5.2 和 swe-1.7 等 Devin 模型。

description.en: Groups DSH plugins by source (official vs self-installed) with filtering and enable/disable toggles.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 插件按来源分组，区分官方与自行安装，并支持筛选和启用或禁用切换。

description.en: First-class Git workflow tools for models: status, diffs, commits, history, branches, no shell calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: first-class Git workflow tools for the model — repo status, diffs, commit creation with validated messages, recent history, and branches. No bare-shell git calls; every invoca

description.en: GitHub repository and issue search, details, and file reading tools for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 仓库与 issue 的检索、详情查看和文件读取工具，匿名可用，提供只读 token 可选解锁代码搜索。

description.en: Adds a global-prompt textarea in settings to inject a custom prompt into every conversation system prompt.
description.zh: DSH plugin: a global-prompt textarea in Settings > General, injected into every conversation system prompt

description.en: Live WebGL2 dot-matrix whale wallpaper with interactive particles for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可交互的 WebGL2 点阵鲸鱼动态壁纸。

description.en: Heartbeat plugin for DeepSeek Harness that periodically wakes agents to proactively report progress, risks, and blockers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的心跳插件，周期性唤醒智能体，主动汇报进度、风险与阻塞。

description.en: Exposes dsh's loopback Web UI to LAN via 0.0.0.0 reverse proxy, with settings-page controls.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的回环 Web UI 通过 0.0.0.0 反向代理暴露到局域网，并在设置页提供开关、状态和日志。

description.en: Draggable floating card showing API balance/quota for DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi, with auto-discovery and real-time refresh.
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮卡片，显示 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding 的 API 余额与配额，自动发现配置、按档位变色并实时刷新。

description.en: Adds a plugin management sub-page in DSH settings with card UI to enable/disable, view details, and uninstall plugins.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增插件管理子页面，用卡片界面启用或停用插件、查看插件详情以及卸载插件。

description.en: A draggable floating newsboard for AI and tech headlines, with RSS/JSON feeds, bilingual translation, keyword filtering, and settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供可拖拽的 AI 与科技快讯浮窗，支持 RSS/JSON 源、双语翻译、关键词过滤和设置页。

description.en: Natural language MySQL queries and BI reports: editable SQL, interactive tables, and reusable charts within DeepSeek Harness.
A DSH plugin applying Observational Memory style context management, compressing historical messages into summaries with tools to view original content.
description.zh: DSH插件，以Observational Memory方式管理上下文，自动压缩历史消息为摘要并提供工具回看原始内容。

description.en: Self-hosted HTTP plugin repository for DeepSeek Harness, managing .tgz plugins with version checks and cross-device sync.
description.zh: 自托管的 DeepSeek Harness 插件仓库，管理 .tgz 插件，支持版本检查与多设备同步。

description.en: Installs DSH plugins end-to-end: search, disambiguate, pick kernel-compatible version, build from source and verify — cutting ~45 agent steps to 6.
description.zh: 一站式安装 DSH 插件：搜索、同名消歧、按内核匹配版本、源码构建并安装后校验，将约 45 步压缩到 6 步。

description.en: Adds a one-click restart button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop window title bar, plus a tray-menu patch tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用标题栏添加一键重启按钮，并附带托盘菜单补丁工具。

description.en: RTS-style multi-agent orchestration board: issue strategic orders, draft verified task orders, and deploy typed subagents on isolated workspaces.
description.zh: 类似RTS的多智能体编排面板：发布战略指令、草拟已核验任务订单并在隔离工作区部署子智能体。

description.en: Browse local ZCode conversations by workspace and import selected sessions or whole workspaces into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 按工作区浏览本地 ZCode 会话，将勾选的会话或整个工作区导入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Installation guide for the dsh-plugins repository, covering GitHub install, version pinning, and local debugging.
description.zh: dsh-plugins 仓库的安装指南，涵盖从 GitHub 安装、版本固定和本地调试。

description.en: Marketplace for discovering, rating, and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins from GitHub topics.
description.zh: 从 GitHub topics 发现、评分并安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件的市场

description.en: Maintainer PR review queue board with five-state tracking for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Maintainer PR review queue board for DeepSeek Harness: five-state tracking (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), sidebar counters, fullscreen kanban, polling, and back

description.en: Automates pre-visit due diligence and company research, integrating Qichacha for background checks, risk briefs, and entity confirmation in DSH.
description.zh: 在DSH中自动化访前尽职调查与公司研究，集成企查查进行背景核查、风险简报与实体确认。

description.en: DSH Web plugin to hot-switch agent presets for the current session, including after a conversation has started.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，可在当前会话中热切换 agent 预设，对话开始后同样支持切换。

description.en: Provides 3D printing & additive manufacturing tools for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL, calibration G-code, analysis, toolpath rendering, and PrusaSlicer bridge.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供3D打印与增材制造工具：参数化STL、校准G代码、分析、刀路渲染及PrusaSlicer桥接。

description.en: One-click tool that makes DSH Desktop use an existing plugin profile via a directory link, with automatic backup and easy restore.
description.zh: 一键让 DSH 桌面版改用已有的插件 profile，通过目录链接实现，自动备份并可随时还原。

description.en: Private, per-project prompt rules for DeepSeek Harness, matched by git repo/path, worktree-aware, never committed.
description.zh: Private, per-project prompt rules for DeepSeek Harness — matched by git remote/repo/path, worktree-aware, never committed to the repo

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness red-team/jailbreak prompt toolkit with per-model prompt swapping, mirrored in full with all branches, tags and history.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 红队/越狱提示词工具，支持按模型切换提示词，并完整镜像全部分支、标签与提交历史。

description.en: Adds PWA capabilities to DeepSeek Harness: offline support and install-as-app via service worker, manifest, and official icons.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness添加PWA功能：通过Service Worker、Manifest和官方图标实现离线支持与安装为应用。

description.en: QiuYa toolbox for DeepSeek Harness that adds long-text attachments, per-session standalone windows, batch archiving, plan annotations and session-menu shortcuts.
description.zh: QiuYa 增强工具箱为 DeepSeek Harness 增加长文本附件、会话独立窗口、批量归档、计划批注和会话菜单等顺手功能。

description.en: Plays local QQ sound files to alert you when DSH finishes a task or needs your approval, no QQ install required.
description.zh: 使用本地 QQ 音效文件，在 DSH 完成任务或需要你审批时播放提示音，无需安装 QQ。

description.en: Locally parses your QQ group data to surface only the few messages that matter to you, explaining why each matters and flagging likely misses.
description.zh: 本地读取 QQ 群聊数据，只挑出与你相关的重点消息，说明重要原因并标出可能遗漏的内容。

description.en: Floating desktop chat panel for DeepSeek Harness, giving global-hotkey access to sessions, models and tool approvals on macOS and Windows.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面悬浮聊天面板，通过全局快捷键随时访问会话、模型与工具审批（支持 macOS/Windows）。

description.en: Shows provider quota/balance in a corner panel with server-side credential proxies and config-driven badge on dsh web surface.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面角落显示各服务商额度与余额面板，通过服务端凭证代理获取数据，并支持配置驱动的页面角标。

description.en: Multi-channel decision & remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: pushes approval cards to IM and answers from chat.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多渠道决策与远程控制桥，推送审批卡片到IM并从聊天中作答。

description.en: Runs real-device evaluation of turn-based GUI agents in real-time GUI environments for human perception–action research.
description.zh: 用于在真实设备上评估回合制 GUI 代理在实时图形界面环境中的表现，基于人类感知—行动视角。

description.en: A Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the DSH model selector so you can set how much reasoning the model uses.
description.zh: 一款仿 Codex 的推理等级滑条，内嵌于 DSH 模型选择器中，用于调节模型的推理强度。

description.en: Adds an undo button to each user message in DSH Web UI to durably recall the turn and everything after it, without reverting code changes.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 每条用户消息添加撤回按钮，可持久删除该轮对话及其后的所有内容，但不会回退代码改动。

description.en: Adds a Workspaces-style Recent sessions section to the DSH left sidebar with one-click favorites, status grouping, collapse and in-place search.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入类似官方「工作区」的「最近会话」区：一键收藏、按状态分组、可收起并支持就地搜索。

description.en: Forces in-browser directory picker for remote DeepSeek Harness sessions via tailscale/cloudflared/trusted-host.
description.zh: 为远程访问的 DeepSeek Harness 强制使用浏览器内目录选择器，适用于 tailscale serve、cloudflared 或 --trusted-host 场景。

description.en: DSH plugin that makes a remote machine feel local: file tree, terminal, resumable SFTP transfers, mirrored edit sync, and -L/-D/-R port forwarding.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把远端机器当本地用：文件树、终端、SFTP 断点续传、镜像编辑同步，以及 -L/-D/-R 三种端口转发。

description.en: Transparently reuses Responses API IDs across DeepSeek Harness turns so conversations continue seamlessly, with no UI or model probes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中透明复用 Responses API 的响应 ID，让对话无缝续接，无需界面或模型探测。

description.en: Adds a title-bar button that restarts DeepSeek Harness in two clicks so newly installed plugins take effect immediately.
description.zh: 在标题栏添加按钮，两次点击即可重启 DeepSeek Harness，让新安装的插件立即生效。

description.en: Native output sidebar for DeepSeek Harness, showing session artifacts like reports, charts, images, and documents with preview and editing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生输出侧边栏，展示会话中的报告、图表、图片和文档，并支持预览与编辑。

description.en: One-click rollback of workspace code and conversation using git commits or hard-link snapshots.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 上一键撤回工作区代码与对话，通过 git 提交或硬链接快照实现回滚。

description.en: DSH host interceptor that rewrites or suggests optimized RTK commands for bash/grep/read calls.
description.zh: DSH 宿主拦截器，对 bash、grep、read 调用重写或给出优化后的 RTK 命令建议。

description.en: Reduces token usage in DeepSeek Harness by rewriting and compressing tool outputs with bundled RTK support.
description.zh: 通过重写和压缩工具输出并内置 RTK 支持，降低 DeepSeek Harness 的令牌消耗。

description.en: Remote SSH workspaces for DSH: use a remote directory as a native agent workspace via SFTP/exec over persistent ssh2.
description.zh: 基于持久化 ssh2 连接，通过 SFTP 与远程命令执行，把远程目录挂载为 DSH 的原生代理工作区。

description.en: Client-side scroll performance booster for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI using offscreen row skipping, compositor hints, idle scanning, and a first-paint fast pass.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供客户端滚动性能优化，包括离屏行跳过、合成器提示、空闲扫描和首屏快速渲染。

description.en: A DSH plugin that routes web search calls to configurable backends (Exa, Tavily, Brave, SearXNG) with sequential fallback.
description.zh: A tiny DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin

description.en: A DSH plugin that configures serial ports, live-displays received data, and sends data — a serial debugger inside the DSH UI.
description.zh: 一款 DSH 插件，可配置串口参数、实时显示接收数据并发送数据，在 DSH 界面内完成串口调试。

description.en: Expose local services on a random cloudflared domain behind one password, with LAN QR codes and per-node routing managed in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 用一个随机口令把本机服务通过 cloudflared 随机域名对外暴露，局域网扫码、公网需口令，节点路由在 DSH 设置面板中管理。

description.en: Client-side DSH plugin that folds chat turns into one-line entries with a time pill and question summary, keeping only the latest turn open.
description.zh: 客户端 DSH 插件，将对话轮次折叠为带时间标签和问题摘要的单行条目，仅保持最新一轮展开。

description.en: Alerts you when DSH sessions finish a turn, ask a question, or request approval, using native notifications, sound, and a draggable activity orb.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话完成回复、提问或请求审批时提醒你，支持系统通知、提醒音与可拖动的活动悬浮球。

description.en: Provides session execution analytics and audit reports for DeepSeek Harness to understand agent behavior.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话执行分析与审计报告，查看智能体的实际运行过程。

description.en: Session dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing token usage, cost, composition, rankings and runtime health.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话仪表盘，展示 token 用量、成本、构成、排行与运行健康状况。

description.en: Exports DeepSeek Harness sessions to portable Markdown and JSON files for backup and sharing.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话导出为便于携带的 Markdown 和 JSON 文件，用于备份和分享。

description.en: Adds keyboard shortcuts to manage sessions in DeepSeek Harness Web, like switching browser tabs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加键盘快捷键来管理会话，可像切换浏览器标签页一样在会话间切换。

description.en: DSH Desktop panel to multi-select conversations grouped by workspace and batch delete, fork, export, summarize, pin or archive them.
description.zh: DSH 桌面插件：按工作区分组多选会话，支持批量删除、分叉、导出、总结、置顶或归档。

description.en: Adds a recycle bin for DSH sessions so you can view trashed sessions, restore them, or delete them permanently.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供回收站：可查看已移入回收站的会话、恢复或永久删除。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that shows and reviews files modified in the current session, with diff and undo/save.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，展示并审查当前会话中修改过的文件，支持差异对比与撤销/保存。

description.en: After the official llm-retry (n/5) is exhausted, keeps retrying transient API failures on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause.
description.zh: 在官方llm-retry (n/5)之后，持续在同一打开步骤上重试瞬时API故障，直到成功、取消或暂停。

description.en: Shows every session's theme in the DSH left sidebar immediately upon page load, without opening conversations.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，页面加载时在左侧边栏显示每个会话的主题，无需打开会话即可查看。

description.en: Session usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing price, token counts, per-turn curves and per-answer cost badges.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话用量仪表盘，显示费用、Token 数量、逐轮曲线以及每条回答的费用徽章。

description.en: Diagnoses and repairs DSH sessions that stopped opening after a harness upgrade, via CLI, agent tool, or web UI dashboard.
description.zh: 诊断并修复 harness 升级后无法打开的 DSH 会话，支持命令行、Agent 工具和 Web UI 面板。

description.en: Customizes and manages the settings navigation drawer in DeepSeek Harness web UI, allowing show/hide of settings sections with instant effect.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面设置页的左侧导航抽屉插件，可自定义并隐藏或显示各设置栏目，修改即时生效。

description.en: Animated ASCII sharks swimming in the background of the Harness Web UI, with boids fish, adjustable density and theme-aware shading.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web 界面背景中游动的 ASCII 鲨鱼动画，配有 boids 小鱼群，可调密度并自动适配深浅主题。

description.en: A DSH plugin that produces local, verifiable delivery evidence reports for coding-agent projects.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，为编码智能体项目生成本地、可验证的交付证据报告。

description.en: Automatically shuts down Windows after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete, with an armed button and cancellable countdown.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务完成后自动关闭 Windows，需按钮开启，关机前有可取消的倒计时。

description.en: Adds a file management tab to the sidebar with a workspace file tree and write operations like upload, move, delete, rename, and new folder.
description.zh: 为 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏新增「文件」标签页，提供固定在工作区内的文件树，支持上传、移动、删除、重命名和新建文件夹等写入操作，弥补自带 Explorer 只读的不足。

description.en: Select text in DeepSeek Harness and ask a follow-up question answered by an independent side-card answerer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中选中文本即可追问，由独立的侧卡回答者给出答案。

description.en: Adds a Settings → General button that restarts the running dsh web process using the same command it was started with.
description.zh: 在“设置 → 通用”中添加一个按钮，用相同的启动命令重启正在运行的 dsh web 进程。

description.en: Adds a floating and sidebar drawing board to DeepSeek Harness so you can sketch, handwrite notes, and attach the PNG to your message.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加浮动画板和侧边栏画板，可手写公式、画示意图并把手绘 PNG 附加到消息中。

description.en: Browse, health-check and one-click install Agent Skills from five public sources in the DSH Web GUI, with provenance, update checks and a trash.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中浏览、体检并一键安装来自五个公开源的 Agent Skills，支持来源追溯、更新检查与回收站。

description.en: Per-conversation skill catalog picker for DeepSeek Harness — select which skills load into each conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按会话选择技能目录的功能，可选择每个会话加载哪些技能，未选中的技能在该会话中不可用。

description.en: Rule-first pre-step skill router for DeepSeek Harness; deterministic, no LLM calls until a rule pours.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的规则优先前置技能路由器，高置信命中时注入匹配技能，否则静默放行，全程零 LLM 调用与 Token 消耗。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar skills panel that scans local skill directories, lists skills with tags, and provides one-click copy, pinning, auto-open, and weekly refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏扫描本机技能目录列出全部技能，显示功能短语和目录标签，支持一键复制调用、置顶、默认自动打开和每周刷新。

description.en: A community skill store for DeepSeek Harness to browse, search, and install 130k+ agent skills.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区技能商店，可浏览、搜索并一键安装 13 万+ Agent 技能。

description.en: Manage DeepSeek Harness agent skills: view, edit, and toggle them via web UI and skillmgr tools.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的网页设置面板和 skillmgr_* 工具中查看、编辑、启用或禁用智能体技能。

description.en: Bridges Claude Code skills into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration via a single plugin.
description.zh: 用一个插件把 Claude Code 技能直接桥接进 DeepSeek Harness，无需迁移即可使用。

description.en: Manages system/user skills in DeepSeek Harness Settings: toggle, edit, delete, create.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 设置页中的技能管理器，按系统/用户分类，支持用户技能的开关、编辑、删除和新建。

description.en: Groups skills, filters model skill catalogs, toggles MCP servers, and provides left panel UI.
description.zh: 对 Skills 和 MCP 服务器进行分组管理，可过滤模型技能目录、单独开关各 MCP 服务器，并在左侧面板集中操作。

description.en: Create, manage, and share custom skins for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, including colors, backgrounds, fonts, and media.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面创建、管理和分享自定义皮肤，可设置配色、字体以及图片或视频背景。

description.en: Slack integration plugin for DSH agents: send notifications, list channels, read messages, and reply in threads.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供 Slack 集成，可发送通知、列出频道、读取消息并在会话串中回复。

description.en: Replaces the native blinking cursor in the DSH web chat input with a smooth, configurable glowing comet cursor.
description.zh: 将 DSH 网页聊天输入框的原生闪烁光标替换为可配置的平滑发光彗星光标。

description.en: Patched fork adding a smooth comet-mode animated caret to the DSH Web composer and question-card inputs.
description.zh: 修补版分支，为 DSH Web 输入框和问题卡片输入框添加顺滑彗星模式动态光标。

description.en: A depth-driven 2.5D splash-screen animation plugin that reveals an illustration on DSH startup, then fades into the workspace.
description.zh: 一个基于景深的 2.5D 开屏动画插件，在 DSH 启动时让插画显影，随后淡出进入工作区。

description.en: SillyTavern creation plugin for DeepSeek Harness with agent preset and workbench for editing character cards, world books, and presets.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness  的 SillyTavern 创作插件。

description.en: Speech-to-text voice input plugin for DSH web GUI using Web Speech API and Whisper.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供语音输入：点击输入框麦克风即可把语音转成文字，支持浏览器 Web Speech API 和 OpenAI 兼容的 Whisper（OpenAI/Groq），可选模型。

description.en: Provides classic themes and Style Settings for DeepSeek Harness with 30 palettes and shareable configs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供经典主题与样式设置，含 30 套配色方案和可分享的配置。

description.en: Configure per-teammate model and reasoning effort for DSH native agent teams via a settings UI, with zero official-file modification.
description.zh: 通过设置界面为 DSH 原生 Team 队员逐个配置模型与推理档位，无需修改官方文件。

description.en: Routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable LLM via in-process subagents, with benchmark-verified routing.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把异构任务路由到最合适的模型，再由进程内子代理分别执行，基准测试 32/32 通过。

description.en: Emergency stop and progress monitoring for stuck pip/GitHub downloads in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可一键急停卡死的 pip/GitHub 下载，并检测下载进度、识别卡死状态。

description.en: Uses TickTick AI to schedule and auto-execute daily tasks with timer and notifications.
description.zh: 通过滴答清单 AI 调度每日任务，支持计时、自动执行，并向 flomo 和 macOS 发送通知。

description.en: Task planner that uses experience memory and LLM capability matching to improve future planning.
description.zh: Task planning with experience muscle-memory for DeepSeek Harness: condition-reflex recall + LLM capability matching + auto-persisted lessons

description.en: DSH task supervision with DAG progress, plan review, persistent control and stage/completion checks.
Unified control plane for DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams, offering context-pressure visibility, member management, capacity tracking, and subagent steering.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams 的统一控制平面，提供上下文压力监控、成员管理、容量跟踪和子代理引导。

description.en: Persistent shared team rooms for DSH across independent sessions, providing a message bus, shared task board and timeline.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供跨会话的持久共享团队房间，包含消息总线、共享任务看板与时间线。

description.en: Durable multi-agent teams for DeepSeek Harness with a captain, members, dependency-aware tasks, mailboxes, and an all-SVG activity panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化多智能体团队：队长、成员、依赖感知任务、邮箱及全 SVG 活动面板。

description.en: Select any term in a DSH conversation and get an in-place popup explaining its meaning, purpose and common usage, plus token cost.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中术语，就地弹窗查看其含义、用途与常见用法，并显示 token 用量。

description.en: Adds four terse-mode levels and independent toggles for reasoning effort, web search, and subagents to the conversation header and Settings.
description.zh: 在对话页头与设置页提供四档简洁模式，并独立开关推理强度、联网搜索与子代理。

description.en: Open-source DSH test execution workbench for tracking manual and AI test results, step evidence, execution history and reports.
description.zh: 开源 DSH 测试执行工作台，用于记录人工与 AI 测试结果、步骤证据、执行历史与报告。

description.en: A 30-theme pack for DeepSeek Harness web UI, available as a client plugin and standalone CSS.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 30 款主题，可作为客户端插件或独立 CSS 使用

description.en: An Evangelion Unit-02 themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with a cinematic entry animation, sync meter, and dark workbench styling.
description.zh: EVA 二号机主题皮肤，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供登场动画、同步率仪表和暗色工作台配色。

description.en: Transforms DeepSeek Harness into a Minecraft-style interface with 3D rotating menu, pixel art panels, HUD chat, and interactive gamified extras.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 变成 Minecraft 风格界面：3D 旋转菜单、像素面板、HUD 聊天及游戏化交互。

description.en: Lets users set the language the model uses for chain-of-thought reasoning via a system prompt.
description.zh: 在设置→通用中添加思考语言选择器，通过系统提示词让模型用选定语言进行思维链推理，支持12种语言，无额外调用与延迟。

description.en: DSH thinking-enhancement plugin that forces Chinese reasoning and replies plus Chinese UI text, without conflicting with collapse/fold plugins.
description.zh: DSH 思考增强插件：强制中文思考与回复并中文化界面，且不与折叠类插件冲突。

description.en: Pure UI plugin that reskins the DeepSeek Harness model/reasoning-level picker with six switchable slider looks and color palettes.
description.zh: 纯 UI 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 底部的模型/推理等级选择器提供六种可切换的滑杆外观与配色。

description.en: Adds five Siemens TIA Portal skills and MCP endpoints for docs, ladder generation/rendering, PLC simulation and a local gateway.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 5 个西门子 TIA Portal 技能与 MCP 端点，涵盖文档、梯形图生成/渲染、PLC 仿真和本地网关。

description.en: Floating badge showing DeepSeek peak/valley pricing status, countdown, and session cost near the input box.
description.zh: 在输入框附近显示 DeepSeek 峰谷定价状态、倒计时和会话费用的浮动徽章。

description.en: A todo plugin that auto-logs each task's creation and completion times and shows real elapsed time in table, kanban, Gantt and calendar views.
description.zh: 一款待办插件，自动记录每条待办的创建与完成时间，并用表格、看板、甘特图和日历四种视图呈现真实耗时。

description.en: Deterministic, recoverable compression and cache-aware compaction for LLM tool results in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供确定性、可恢复的工具结果压缩与缓存感知的上下文压缩。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible local gateway that routes DSH model calls across providers with failover, exact SQLite caching and cost tracking.
description.zh: 本地 OpenAI 兼容网关，为 DSH 统一接入多模型并自动选路、容灾降级、精确缓存与成本统计。

description.en: Codex-style token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with stat cards, heatmap, insights, and model ranking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Codex 风格 token 用量看板，含统计卡片、热力图、用量洞察和模型排行。

description.en: DSH port of Microsoft TokenEconomizer: learns project knowledge across sessions, prunes unused tool schemas, flags failure loops and records token usage.
description.zh: Microsoft TokenEconomizer 的 DSH 移植版：跨会话学习项目知识、裁剪未使用的工具定义、识别重复失败循环并记录真实 token 用量。

description.en: Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that calls OpenAI-compatible or Gemini image APIs to generate and edit images, saving them to disk as session attachments.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Cordis 插件，调用 OpenAI 兼容或 Gemini 图像接口生成与改图，出图自动落盘并注册为会话附件。

description.en: AI lip-sync video plugin for DeepSeek Harness; no key/login, free API, registers 5 tools for 20s talking-head videos, 3000+ voices, 500+ languages.
description.zh: 免Key免登录的AI对口型视频插件，为DSH注册5个工具，通过免费API生成最长20秒说话人视频，支持3000+声音与500+语言。

description.en: Sends images to external vision models and returns coordinate-based visual primitives as plain text for text-only models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉增强插件：将图片交给外部视觉模型分析，输出带坐标化视觉原语的纯文本证据，使不支持多模态的文本模型也能在对话中理解图片、截图与文档。

description.en: Organizes multi-step work into a goal→task→subtask tree where AI submits each node's result and the node's execution context is folded away.
description.zh: 把多步任务组织成目标→任务→子任务三级树，节点完成时由 AI 提交结果，并折叠掉该节点的执行上下文。

description.en: Adds a conversation-tree panel to DeepSeek Harness so you can branch or fork a chat from any turn while keeping one visible thread.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加树状对话面板，可在任意轮次分叉或派生出新分支，同时保持单一可见会话。

description.en: Right-edge turn navigation for DeepSeek Harness web; hover to expand outline panel and click to jump.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版提供右侧对话轮次导航，悬停展开大纲面板，点击可跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Adds Codex-style select-to-quote to DeepSeek Harness Web, turning selected chat text into a native reference chip.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中选中聊天文字即可引用，并将其作为原生引用标签插入输入框。

description.en: Adds configurable UI sound effects to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, with 78 interaction and task-status cues across 12 sound packs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加可配置音效，含 12 个音效包、78 种交互与任务状态提示音。

description.en: Recycle bin for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: list, preview, and restore them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 归档会话提供回收站功能，可列出、预览并恢复已归档的会话。

description.en: Unit conversion toolbox for dsh offering 14 categories including typography and fuel economy.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 14 类单位换算的工具箱，含排版单位 px/pt/em/rem 与油耗 mpg 和 L/100km 互转，无运行时依赖

description.en: Adds a macOS Dock badge (dot/number) and plays a bubble chime for plugin status/results.
description.zh: 在 macOS Dock 显示角标（运行中为圆点，有结果时为数字）并播放气泡提示音，基于 Badging API。

description.en: Adds a compact, elegant panel showing provider balances and local token-usage analytics to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加简洁面板，显示服务商余额和本地 Token 用量统计。

description.en: Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing token usage, requests, and cache hit rate from session logs.
description.zh: 从会话日志统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量、请求数和缓存命中率并展示的仪表盘

description.en: Adds a DSH sidebar widget showing account balances and quotas for the active model provider across Aliyun, Xiaomi MiMo, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Z.ai, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiniMax and OpenCode.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加组件，显示当前模型服务商的账户余额与配额，覆盖阿里云、小米 MiMo、DeepSeek、Moonshot、Z.ai、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiniMax 和 OpenCode。

description.en: A floating ball that shows every DeepSeek Harness session's task state at a glance, so you can spot problem or waiting sessions.
description.zh: 一个悬浮球，一眼展示每个 DeepSeek Harness 会话的任务状态，快速发现出问题或等待你的会话。

description.en: Manages dsh versions via npm: overview, upgrade/downgrade/reinstall, pre-upgrade snapshots, and instant rollback to any historical version.
description.zh: 管理 dsh 版本：npm 更新检查、在线升降级重装、升级前自动快照、任意历史版本秒级回滚。

description.en: Vesna theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop with full-window wallpapers, light/dark palettes, liquid-glass chat bubbles and everyday emoji.
description.zh: 薇斯纳主题：为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 提供全窗口壁纸、明暗配色、液态玻璃聊天框与日常表情。

description.en: Samples video frames locally with ffmpeg and returns them to the agent as timestamped real images — no vision API or key required.
description.zh: 用 ffmpeg 在本地对视频抽帧，把带时间戳的真实图像交给智能体，无需任何视觉 API 或密钥。

description.en: Adds three output modes (Verbose, Normal, Summary) to DeepSeek Harness Web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加 Verbose、Normal、Summary 三种输出模式

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing multimodal vision and Android adb UI automation for real-tap mobile app testing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: multimodal vision (OpenAI-compatible) + Android adb UI automation for real-tap mobile app testing

description.en: All-in-one vision and image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, routing to Gemini/OpenAI-compatible backends with self-check.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness all-in-one: no model switching — regular DeepSeek auto-routes to vision & image gen. Multi-backend: Gemini + any OpenAI-compatible (GPT-4o, Qwen-VL, GLM-4V, gpt-image, DALL-E, Flux, O

description.en: Vision routing and image generation for DeepSeek Harness via a fixed Mix model.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 通过固定的 Mix 模型提供视觉路由与图像生成。

description.en: Image understanding plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds vision_understand tool and paste/drag/button image input to let text models see images.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 vision_understand 工具，并支持通过粘贴、拖拽或按钮三种入口输入图片，让文本模型能够识图。

description.en: Adds voice input via microphone to DeepSeek Harness composer, supporting Doubao Voice and OpenAI models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加麦克风语音输入，支持豆包语音和 OpenAI 模型。

description.en: Browser tab favicon that shows DSH session status (idle, running, asking, done).
description.zh: 根据 DSH 会话状态改变浏览器标签页 favicon，区分为待机、运行中、提问和完成四种状态。

description.en: Aggregates multiple web-search providers into one prioritized queue with key rotation and fallback for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供聚合网络搜索：把 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily 排成一个优先队列，支持多密钥轮换与按序回退。

description.en: Manage DSH web service status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates from a settings panel.
description.zh: 在设置面板中管理 DSH Web 服务，查看运行状态与版本，执行重启、停止和一键更新。

description.en: A web page reader for DeepSeek Harness that fetches URLs and extracts clean Markdown/plain text plus a link inventory.
description.zh: 抓取任意 URL 网页，提取干净的 Markdown 或纯文本并列出链接清单，只读、无运行时依赖。

description.en: DSH Office plugin that reads, writes and converts docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf/odf/csv/html with offline OCR; full features on Windows x64.
description.zh: DSH 办公文档插件：读写与互转 docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf/odf/csv/html，并支持离线 OCR，Windows x64 为完整能力平台。

description.en: Windows toast notifications from DeepSeek Harness for conversation completion, pending choices, authorization requests or login prompts; click to jump back.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 通知栏提醒插件：对话完成、等待选择、等待授权或需要登录时弹出 Toast，点击即可跳回对应对话。

description.en: DSH web plugin bringing WinAgent's AI agent features: chat, 50+ Windows tools, skills, MCP, and LLM Wiki knowledge base with document processing.
description.zh: 将WinAgent的完整Agent能力（聊天、53+ Windows工具、skills、MCP、LLM Wiki知识库及文档处理）集成到DSH Web。

description.en: Scans, grades, and cleans up the Windows C: drive with five-tier safety grading, staging, UAC elevation, and migration support.
description.zh: 扫描、分级并清理 Windows C: 盘，支持五级安全分级、暂存区、UAC 提权和迁移。

description.en: Word auto-completion for DSH Web composer with sorted suggestions and keyboard selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供单词自动补全，按前缀匹配并按接近程度排序建议，可用方向键选择、回车确认。

description.en: DSH plugin that binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or single session, managed from a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话绑定独立 DeepSeek API Key 的 DSH 插件，并提供侧边栏分配面板。

description.en: VS Code-style dual-pane workspace explorer with file tree and syntax-highlighting editor.
description.zh: VS Code 风格双栏资源管理器：左侧多工作区文件树支持语言着色图标、行内重命名及新建文件/文件夹，右侧可拖拽缩放的编辑器带行号、状态栏和 10 种语言语法高亮。

description.en: A workspace hub panel for organizing DSH workspaces with drag-drop grouping, inline editing, and token/cost statistics.
description.zh: 用于组织 DSH 工作区的面板，支持拖拽分组、行内编辑，以及 token 与费用统计。

description.en: Sidebar session management: sorts workspace groups by recent activity, folds stale sessions, flags running/unread/follow-up states, and adds recoverable trash.
description.zh: 侧栏会话管理：工作区分组按最近活跃排序、过期历史自动折叠、三色状态标记、置顶汇总，并删除到可恢复回收站。

description.en: Injects WSL/Windows path and shell environment facts into DeepSeek Harness system prompt.
description.zh: 把 WSL 与 Windows 的路径和 shell 环境信息注入 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词。

description.en: Opens WSL Linux paths from chat in Windows default apps or Explorer.
description.zh: 在聊天中把 WSL Linux 路径用 Windows 默认应用或资源管理器打开。

description.en: Xiaoyuzhou podcast player for DSH: playback, subscriptions, search, and AI play control via podcast_play tool.
description.zh: DSH 的小宇宙播客插件，支持免登录播放、扫码登录、订阅同步与搜索，提供网页播放条和面板，并含 podcast_play 工具供 AI 控制播放。

description.en: NieR:Automata-inspired industrial terminal theme that restyles DeepSeek Harness Web workspace.
description.zh: 受《尼尔：机械纪元》启发的工业终端主题，为DeepSeek Harness Web重塑界面视觉。

description.en: OpenAPI tools and skill bundle for YouMind, enabling DeepSeek Harness agents to access YouMind functionality.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供 YouMind 的 OpenAPI 工具与技能包，使其能调用 YouMind 功能。

description.en: In-process proxy that injects OpenCode Zen client headers to enable Zen free models in dsh without 429 errors.
description.zh: dsh 内置代理，注入 OpenCode Zen 客户端请求头，让 dsh 能使用 Zen 免费模型且不触发 429 FreeUsageLimitError。

description.en: An agile Git-alternative plugin that boosts DSH Agent efficiency.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供 Git 替代方案的插件，用于提升其效率。

description.en: Provides Hong Kong Traditional Chinese wording for DeepSeek Harness UI, replacing simplified Chinese translations with local terms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Hong Kong Traditional Chinese wording (對話, 設定, 儲存)

description.en: DSH plugin that computes deterministic Zi Wei Dou Shu charts and reads them with the harness model in a side-by-side panel.
description.zh: DSH 插件：确定性紫微斗数排盘，并在面板内直接由会话模型进行解读。

description.en: Manage DeepSeek Harness profiles by listing, creating, cloning, diffing, and sharing setups as one portable file.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 配置档案：列出、创建、克隆、对比配置，并将整套 dsh 设置导出为单个可移植文件分享。

description.en: A NERV-gate inspired visual theme for DeepSeek Harness, distributed as a non-commercial fan work with its own LICENSE.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 NERV 网关风格视觉主题，作为非商业同人作品发布并附带独立 LICENSE。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet whale girl for DeepSeek Harness that blinks, shows speech bubbles, speaks up when you idle, and answers right-click questions.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌宠鲸鱼娘：会眨眼、头顶弹气泡、看你停留十秒主动搭话，右键还能问她一句。

description.en: Automates Gitee development: @mention in issue with target branch triggers repo clone, dev, PR creation, and auto-merge/close.
description.zh: 在 Gitee issue 中 @ 机器人并指定目标分支，自动克隆仓库开发、提交 PR，可自动合并并关闭 issue。

description.en: Browse local Hermes skills, MCP services, and conversation history in a sidebar, and inject selected configs into the current agent.
description.zh: 在侧边栏浏览本机 Hermes 的技能、MCP 服务和对话历史，并把选中的技能与 MCP 配置注入当前 agent。

description.en: Gives DSH AI persistent cross-session long-term memory, plus todo and skill management and multi-session/agent collaboration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 AI 提供跨会话长期记忆，并支持待办与技能管理以及多会话、外部代理协同。

description.en: Deploys a model checkpoint as a reachable inference endpoint with health checks, auto-degrade, rollback, teardown and a hash-chained audit log.
description.zh: 把模型 checkpoint 部署为可访问的推理端点，含三阶段健康检查、自动降级、回滚、清理校验与哈希链审计日志。

description.en: Packages a battle-tested three-tier memory (L1/L2/L3) and gated agent methodology as a plugin for Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 Claude Code 提供 L1-L2-L3 三级记忆 agent 底座，包含门禁、事件日志、周审提炼与 TDD 执行流。

description.en: Adds vision to text models and UI preview to multimodal models for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型添加视觉能力，并为多模态模型提供 Vue 页面 UI 预览以完成视觉验证。

description.en: An editable, session-isolated personalization memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores user facts and AI observations in a compact profile.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可编辑、会话间隔离的个性化记忆插件，以精简档案保存用户事实与 AI 观察。

description.en: A project documentation skill that optimizes existing docs, rebuilds missing documentation systems, and initializes new projects with AI templates.
description.zh: 优化已有项目文档、补建缺失文档体系并初始化新项目的 skill，含提问驱动流程、26 个 AI 分角色协作模板，MIT 开源。

description.en: Opens an Obsidian-style three-column workbench in DSH: file tree, live markdown editor, and session chat.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中打开类似 Obsidian 的三栏工作台，包含文件树、实时 Markdown 编辑器和会话聊天。

description.en: Cost-control plugin for DeepSeek API that alerts on peak pricing and schedules tasks to avoid high-cost periods.
description.zh: 针对 DeepSeek 高峰涨价时段的成本管控插件，高峰弹窗提醒计费上涨，支持立即执行或定时调度，定时面板屏蔽高价时段并过滤过期时间，到点自动重放用户指令以规避跨时段涨价。

description.en: Desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness with update checks, server manage, system tray, and graphical console.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面启动器，可检查更新、启停服务器，并提供系统托盘、图形控制台和一键安装。

description.en: Adds a notched reasoning-effort slider next to the DeepSeek Harness model picker, with native styling, theming and i18n support.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁添加带刻度的推理强度滑块,支持原生样式、主题切换与多语言。

description.en: Provides hash-chained, observe-only evidence receipts for an execution trail without storing sensitive data in plaintext.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 执行轨迹提供只观察的哈希链证据收据，不以明文存储敏感数据。

description.en: Multi-panelist review workflow: isolated subagents score, chair reconciles disagreements, critic audits. For code, design, paper, or projects.
description.zh: A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudic

description.en: 多智能体圆桌协作插件，让不同AI Agent在同一房间讨论、交叉补充、质疑修正，最终生成综合方案。
description.zh: 把不同人设的 AI Agent 拉进同一研讨房间，支持手动 @、全体研讨、接力链三种发言模式，可互相对论质疑并一键总结出综合方案，也能拉入工作区已有对话框，含轮次上限与全局暂停防死循环。

description.en: Injects global and project-level Markdown rules into AI system prompts via dsh, with visual rule management.
description.zh: 通过dsh将全局和项目级Markdown规则注入AI系统提示词，并提供可视化规则管理。

description.en: Keeps session notes and follow-ups beside your agent tasks so you can manage attention and context switching.
description.zh: 在智能体任务旁保留会话笔记和后续事项，帮助你管理注意力并减少上下文切换。

description.en: SIDOR starfield skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with intro animation and low-balance alerts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 SIDOR 星空皮肤，含开场动画、星空背景、余额徽标、设置特效和低余额提醒。

description.en: Tracks local A-share portfolio from holdings.json and shows quotes and P&L in the sidebar.
description.zh: 读取本地 holdings.json，在侧边栏显示 A 股持仓的行情与盈亏

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for the Stop That Shit guardrail engine, adding host glue while vendoring the upstream detection engine.
description.zh: Stop That Shit 的 DeepSeek Harness 适配层，内置上游判定引擎并新增宿主粘合层。

description.en: Study Companion plugin for building learning plans, tracking exams, running spaced review and keeping lecture notes.
description.zh: 伴学插件：制定学习计划、管理考试、进行间隔复习并整理课堂笔记。

description.en: Turns DSH plugin and model calls into a live 3D office where each plugin is an employee sitting at a fixed desk.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的插件与模型调用过程可视化成 3D 数字办公室，插件即员工、工位即岗位。

description.en: Voice input plugin for dsh web that uses local offline VocoType ASR to automatically insert recognized text into the chat input box.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供语音输入，用本地离线 VocoType 识别语音并将结果自动插入聊天输入框，支持自动部署和持续输入。

description.en: Generate and edit AI images, videos, audio, and 3D content through WaveSpeed CLI within DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 wavespeed CLI 生成和编辑 AI 图像、视频、音频与 3D 内容。

description.en: A theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI with Xiao (Genshin) visual style and optional roleplay tone.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供原神角色魈的视觉风格主题，并可选启用角色扮演语气。

description.en: A fun DeepSeek Harness plugin adding a 3D lever to trigger a pixel-style gacha using the model's chain-of-thought text.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 发送按钮旁加一根 3D 拉杆，用模型思维链文本信号触发像素风抽卡小游戏。

description.en: Project task board with SQLite storage, kanban/list web view, and task tools for agents
description.zh: 以 SQLite 文件随项目保存任务板，Web 客户端提供看板与列表视图，向模型暴露任务工具，卡片可派发给 agent 作为后台任务。

description.en: Plugin to join ACN so the agent can discover, message, and collaborate with other agents, defaulting to China region.
description.zh: 让该 agent 接入 ACN，从而能发现、向其他 agent 发消息并协作，默认使用中国区域。

description.en: Alerts you with sound the moment a DeepSeek Harness task finishes or is waiting for your input.
description.zh: 任务完成或需要你处理时，用声音第一时间提醒你。

description.en: Provides web search via Tavily API for DeepSeek Harness, replacing model-based search with faster REST call.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供Tavily网络搜索，用REST调用替代基于模型的搜索，更快更省。

description.en: Immersive roleplay plugin for DeepSeek Harness with life-simulation character, desktop pet, memory and intimacy systems.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供沉浸式角色扮演，含生活模拟角色、桌宠、记忆与亲密度系统。

description.en: Lightweight zero-dependency long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown store, L0 catalog injection, 5 model tools and background extraction.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的轻量零依赖长期记忆插件，含 Markdown 记忆存储、L0 目录注入、5 个模型工具与后台提取。

description.en: LLM token usage and cost tracking dashboard with persistent storage and HTTP API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，跟踪 LLM token 用量与费用，按人民币及高峰/低谷价计费，提供仪表盘、agent 工具、HTTP API 和持久化存储。

description.en: AI search plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing web, image, video retrieval plus structured data like weather and stocks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 搜索插件，支持网页、图片、视频检索以及天气、股票等结构化数据

description.en: Native SSH terminal and SFTP workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with direct agent tools and security sandboxing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 SSH 终端与 SFTP 工作区，内置智能体工具与安全沙箱。

description.en: Adds a session statistics page to the DSH Web sidebar summarising token usage, cost, cache hits, session rankings and runtime status.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 侧边栏新增「会话统计」页，汇总 Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中、会话排行与运行时状态。

description.en: Converts Trae Work CN quota into local OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API proxy for AI coding tools.
description.zh: 将 Trae Work 中国版配额转换为本地 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 代理，供 AI 编程工具调用。

description.en: Puts deleted DeepSeek Harness sessions into a recycle bin with 7/15/30-day retention, restore, permanent delete, and bulk delete.
description.zh: 把删除的 DSH 会话收进回收站，默认保留 15 天（可选 7/15/30），支持还原、彻底删除和批量删除。

description.en: Acceptance-criteria-driven goal completion for autonomous agents with MCP server and Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 基于验收标准判定自主代理的目标是否完成，提供核心库、MCP 服务器和 Cordis 插件。

description.en: Scratchpad panel with tagged notes, attachments, Markdown task lists, chat send, shortcuts, JSON import/export, and Agent tools.
description.zh: 带标签笔记、附件、Markdown任务清单、发送到聊天、快捷键、JSON导入导出及Agent工具的便签面板。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting text-to-image, image editing and batch generation inside the chat.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenAI 兼容图像生成插件，支持文生图、图像编辑和批量生成，直接在对话中渲染。

description.en: Adds a Trajectory Reader tab to DSH web client, interpreting assistant actions per user round with rules and optional LLM narrative.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端新增轨迹解读标签页，按用户每轮对话用规则并可选调用 LLM 叙述解读助手的操作，用户消息保持不变。

description.en: DSH session relay plugin: pull sessions from six agents via /resume-*, park the current session with /handoff, and pick it up at startup via /inbox on the handoff:1 protocol.
description.zh: DSH 会话接力插件：用 /resume-* 拉取六家 agent 会话，用 /handoff 寄存当前会话，开局用 /inbox 取件，基于 handoff:1 开放协议。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：侧边栏绘画页与图库，对话中生图和改图，可自定义服务商端点与代理。
Adds a ClinePass model provider to DSH with usage meters, reset times and multi-account switching.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 ClinePass 模型接入，并支持用量查看、重置时间显示与多账号切换管理。

description.en: Adds a plugin manager button in the web GUI sidebar to view, enable/disable, discover, and install dsh plugins.
description.zh: 在 web 界面侧边栏添加插件管理入口，可查看、启用或禁用、发现并安装 dsh 插件。

description.en: Maestro core for DeepSeek Harness: shared settings store with a Settings card, approval gate, cross-machine sync and a web supervisor daemon.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Maestro 核心插件：带设置卡片的共享设置存储、审批门、跨机器同步以及 Web 监管守护进程。

description.en: Mobile and portrait UI adaptation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, active below 1024px.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 在 1024px 以下提供竖屏与移动端适配，包括覆盖式抽屉、全宽对话、底部弹窗和安全区域处理，1024px 及以上不生效。

description.en: Displays balance, top-up link, and session cost estimate via /balance command and composer-dock readout.
description.zh: 通过 /balance 命令和编辑器停靠栏显示账户余额、充值链接以及本次会话的费用估算。

description.en: Inspects Unreal Engine .uasset files and edits blueprint nodes via native DSH tools.
description.zh: 通过原生 DSH 工具检查虚幻引擎 .uasset 文件并编辑其中的蓝图节点。

description.en: Adds an Ultracode session mode with a three-position composer control that arms automatic multi-agent workflow orchestration via an injected banner.
description.zh: 为会话增加 Ultracode 模式，通过三档输入框控件注入提示横幅，自动启用多智能体工作流编排。

description.en: Tracks AI coding activity, lines of code, and time spent in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 WakaTime 统计，记录 AI 编码活动、代码行数和花费时间。

description.en: DSH plugin marketplace panel with catalog search, Chinese translation, semantic search, favorites, and lifecycle management.
description.zh: DSH插件市场面板，支持目录搜索、中文翻译、语义搜索、收藏和插件生命周期管理。

description.en: Assembled context for DeepSeek Harness: a context tree over the session surface with per-node modes and a panel deciding what the model sees.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 组装上下文：在会话界面上构建上下文树，支持逐节点模式，并通过面板决定模型实际看到的内容。

description.en: A cute cartoon Furina desk pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with click effects and an affection system.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面显示一只卡通芙宁娜桌面宠物，可点击互动并带好感度系统。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail Kafka-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI with dual light/dark themes and decorative elements.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供崩坏：星穹铁道卡芙卡主题皮肤，含明暗两套配色与装饰元素。

description.en: Plays a chime when a conversation turn finishes; supports built-in tones and custom uploads.
description.zh: DSH plugin: play a chime when a conversation turn finishes. Built-in tones plus custom upload in Settings → Plugins.

description.en: Automatically resolves and creates a default workspace directory so conversations start without manual workspace selection.
description.zh: 自动解析并创建默认工作区目录，无需手动选择工作区即可开始对话。

description.en: Cross-session memory manager for DSH with Markdown library, convention auto-injection, session summaries and agent memory tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供跨会话记忆管理，包括 Markdown 记忆库、约定自动注入、会话摘要和代理记忆工具。

description.en: Floating draggable sprite pet for DSH web GUI, animated by agent activity, with settings and 4 bundled starter pets.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中显示可拖拽的悬浮精灵宠物，随代理活动播放动画，带实时设置页，并内置 4 只《全职猎人》初始宠物。

description.en: Mind-map style project planning board that turns plans into module/task trees or DAGs and blocks drift with review gates and git cross-checks.
description.zh: 思维导图式项目规划看板，把计划拆成模块/任务树或 DAG，并通过人审门与 git 交叉核对阻断执行跑偏。

description.en: Adds right-click context menu and footer session manager for pinning/unpinning chats in DeepSeek Harness web.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版添加右键菜单和底部会话管理器，用于置顶或取消置顶聊天。

description.en: Sliding-rheostat theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI with model-driven accents and composer glow.
description.zh: Sliding-rheostat theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: model + reasoning-effort driven accents, composer glow, and a whale slider.

description.en: Collection of third-party skins/themes for DSH Web GUI, including token-based and AI-background skins.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的第三方皮肤主题集合，包含基于 token 与 AI 背景的皮肤，并提供夕港 dusk-harbor 皮肤

description.en: WeChat watchdog for DSH that shows a Web UI banner when the dsh-wechat session is lost, so queued messages aren't silently dropped.
description.zh: DSH 的微信看门狗：dsh-wechat 会话失效时在 Web UI 显示横幅，避免排队消息被静默丢弃。

description.en: Paper-trading plugin for A-share and commodity futures inside DSH, with built-in quotes, K-line charts and a locally stored ledger.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中练习 A 股与商品期货模拟交易的插件，内置行情、K线，账本保存在本地。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from DeepSeek Harness settings page: add, edit, enable/disable, reconnect, and delete with live status.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页运行时添加、编辑、启停、重连和删除 MCP 服务器，显示实时状态并自动重连。

description.en: Adds an annotation pen to the DSH image lightbox: circle, label, keep editing marks, then send the annotated PNG into the composer.
description.zh: 为 DSH 图片预览添加标注画笔：可圈选、加标签并反复编辑标记，再把标注后的 PNG 发送到输入框。

description.en: Saves images and any files pasted or dragged into chat as session workspace files.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把粘贴或拖入聊天框的图片和任意文件保存为会话工作区文件。

description.en: Background listeners that watch streams and wake the DeepSeek Harness agent when new lines match, running as an unattended daemon.
description.zh: Put a watch on a stream: background listeners that wake the DeepSeek Harness agent with new matching lines — and a daemon host so a watcher runs unattended for weeks, with no task and no browser. Not

description.en: Runs Hogwarts-loop multi-role subagent loops in DSH, assigning each role a configurable model plus a client settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中运行 Hogwarts-loop 多角色子代理循环，可为每个角色配置不同模型，并提供客户端设置页面。

description.en: Delegates Codex tasks to desktop-visible DeepSeek Harness agents using scoped credentials, persistent sessions and a reusable skill.
description.zh: 将 Codex 的任务委派给桌面可见的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，支持受限凭证、持久会话与可复用技能。

description.en: Adds a task board view with parent-child task tree, draggable canvas, and local JSON storage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供任务看板视图，支持父子任务树、可拖动画布和本地 JSON 存储。

description.en: Defines custom slash commands that expand to pre-written prompts in the DeepSeek Harness chat.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板配置自定义快捷命令（名称加提示词），输入 /名称 插入芯片，发送时展开为提示词。

description.en: Adds an 'invert selection' button to the model picker so only already-owned models remain checked.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中添加“反向选择”按钮，仅保留已拥有的模型选中。

description.en: Tracks per-turn cost, account balance, and live estimates for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 跟踪每轮对话费用，基于快照锚定计价，并显示账户余额与实时费用估算。

description.en: Reads local EPUB novels only when expanding selected real DSH reasoning steps, with no model or network requests.
description.zh: 仅在展开选定的真实 DSH 推理步骤时读取本地小说，完全本地且不发起模型请求。

description.en: Surfaces DeepSeek API key and subscription quota limits through a floating chip, composer bar, and settings panel.
description.zh: 通过悬浮小组件、输入栏和设置面板展示 DeepSeek API 密钥与订阅额度限制。

description.en: Enterprise remote workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness offering SSH access, SFTP file sync and tunneling.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的企业级远程工作区插件，提供 SSH 访问、SFTP 文件同步与隧道功能。

description.en: Git workbench plugin for deepseek-harness with changelists, staging, history, branches, stashes, and optional AI assistance.
description.zh: 面向 deepseek-harness 的 Git 工作台插件，支持变更列表、暂存、历史、分支、储藏及可选 AI 辅助。

description.en: Adds conversation task-completion reminder cards, four Web Audio chimes, and system notifications to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加对话任务完成提醒卡片、四种 Web Audio 提示音和系统通知。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a Music tab for playing local flac/mp3 files with single-track or list loop and a macOS Music-style UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 本地音乐播放器插件，在会话视图提供「音乐」标签页，支持 flac/mp3 等格式与单曲/列表循环，界面仿 macOS Music 风格。

description.en: Counts per-conversation compactions, shows a floating top-right window, and warns to start a new chat only when compaction repeats and tokens burn.
description.zh: 统计每段对话的压缩次数，在右上角常驻悬浮窗，仅在反复压缩且大量消耗 token 时提醒新开对话。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that lets you type @ to filter and reference workspace files in chat, like Claude Code's @file.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：在聊天输入 @ 筛选并引用工作区文件，类似 Claude Code 的 @file。

description.en: Create, edit and switch multiple system personas for DeepSeek Harness, with a global default and per-session overrides.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 创建、编辑并自由切换多个系统人设，支持全局默认与按会话覆盖。

description.en: Adds profile-aware keyboard shortcuts and settings card for question/approval interactions in DSH Web Client.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端添加按配置区分作用的键盘快捷键，以及用于问题和审批交互的设置卡片。

description.en: A floating capsule widget in DSH that shows GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot quota snapshots and subscription usage details.
description.zh: DSH 常驻悬浮胶囊，直观展示 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 额度快照与订阅用量详情。

description.en: Enables Volcengine Ark Coding Plan in DeepSeek Harness with text and image chat via Files API.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用火山方舟 Coding Plan，支持文本与图片对话，图片通过 Files API 处理。

description.en: Turns the chat.deepseek.com web app into an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, with no browser needed, multi-account support, and a built-in settings page.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版封装为 OpenAI 兼容接口，无需浏览器，支持多账号并自带设置界面。

description.en: Sound effects plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing generative ambient music, success and attention chimes via Web Audio.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供音效：agent 工作时用 Web Audio 生成五声音阶环境音乐，任务成功播放 E6-G6-C7 提示音，需关注时播放 A6-E6 提示音，无需音频素材。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that converts Office documents to PDF and runs PDF tools through the local Jetformat CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过本地 Jetformat CLI 将 Office 文档转为 PDF 并使用 PDF 工具。

description.en: Local dev service console for DeepSeek Harness: discovers listening ports, shows ownership, manages services.
description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：发现监听端口、显示服务归属，并可安全地查看、停止和重启服务。

description.en: Lightweight IDE sidebar for the dsh web GUI with workspace file tree, agent-change review, full editing with diff and markdown, plus a terminal view.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 的轻量级侧边栏 IDE：工作区文件树、智能体改动审阅（接受/拒绝+撤销）、带 diff 与 Markdown 渲染的编辑，以及集成终端视图。

description.en: Adds a Usage/Balance tab toggle inside the DeepSeek Harness webui usage circle popup to show API account balance and usage details.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness webui 用量圆圈弹出面板中加入「用量 / 余额」标签切换，展示 API 账户余额与用量明细。

description.en: Unofficial zero-dependency DSH plugin that archives, browses, restores and deletes idle sessions straight from the sidebar.
description.zh: 非官方零依赖 DSH 插件，可在侧边栏直接归档、浏览、恢复和删除闲置会话。

description.en: Captures life snippets to generate life stories and autobiographies.
description.zh: 🌱 BigSeed 闪念记录与人生拼图 - 捕捉生活点滴生成人生故事/自传 | Life story, journal, biography, memory keeper

description.en: Smart form and notes tool for structured records like expenses, shipments, and logs, with attachments, auto-tagging, reports, and reminders.
description.zh: openclaw - skills :　List · 智能表单（万能信息记录·智能记事本·智能账单）- Smart Form & Notes

description.en: Adds a Skills panel to DSH Web GUI for viewing, toggling, and managing skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加技能面板，可查看、开关和管理技能。

description.en: UnWr is an AI agent for novel writing that stores story data and chapter text in Feishu via lark CLI.
description.zh: UnWr 是小说写作 AI 智能体，通过 lark CLI 在飞书中统一管理小说数据与章节。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with speech-to-text and AI text optimization.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的语音输入插件，支持语音转文字与 AI 文本优化。

description.en: A plugin providing a desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness, with one-click start/exit and desktop shortcut integration.
description.zh: 以插件形式提供的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面启动器，支持一键启动和退出，并可创建桌面快捷方式。

description.en: DSH plugin that toggles an in-session read-only 'consult mode' where existing content is never modified and output is limited to new txt/md/docx files.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话内一键切换只读「咨询模式」，不改动任何已有内容，产出仅限新建 txt/md/docx 文档。

description.en: Turns each DSH workspace into a local knowledge graph of markdown nodes with prerequisite links, browsable in a sidebar panel and editable via kn tools.
description.zh: 把每个 DSH 工作区变成由 markdown 节点与前置依赖组成的本地知识图谱，可用侧栏面板浏览、用 kn 工具读写。

description.en: One page to find, install, toggle and configure all MCP servers, with live MCP Registry/npm search, card-style install and stdio or streaming HTTP setup.
description.zh: 一个页面管理所有 MCP 服务器：活体 MCP Registry/npm 搜索、卡片式一键安装，支持 stdio 与流式 HTTP 接入与开关配置。

description.en: Adds Retry, Edit prompt, and Continue actions to chat turns, rewinding the conversation by forking the session.
description.zh: 为对话轮次添加重试、编辑提示词和继续操作，并通过分叉会话实现回退。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that archives a session then permanently wipes its disk logs, protecting currently running sessions.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏插件：先归档会话再永久清理磁盘日志，运行中的会话受保护。

description.en: Generates images inline within DSH Desktop chat via a model-invoked tool.
description.zh: 在DSH Desktop对话中由模型调用generate_image工具生成图片，并直接内联显示在对话框里，无需外部面板或手动切换。

description.en: DSH web client plugin that adds live status emojis to browser tab titles for concurrent thinking sessions.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端插件，在浏览器标签标题中为并发的思考会话添加实时状态表情符号。

description.en: VisionForge adds vision understanding and image generation capabilities to the DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: VisionForge 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供图像理解与图像生成能力。

description.en: Adds a password gate with revocable sessions, an admin page and TLS to the DSH Web UI, and fixes /api 403 behind Nginx/Caddy.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加密码门禁、可撤销会话、管理页面和 TLS，并修复 Nginx/Caddy 后的 /api 403 问题。

description.en: One-click DSH background switcher backed by local Wallpaper Engine images/videos
description.zh: 一键切换 DSH 背景，素材取自本地 Wallpaper Engine 的图片和视频

description.en: A rich Markdown notebook for the composer region with a CodeMirror editor card and tool-row toggle.
description.zh: Third-party dsh web plugin: a rich Markdown notebook for the composer region — tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing

description.en: Dual-engine screen capture with box-select and red-box annotation for inserting screenshots into DeepSeek Harness composer.
description.zh: 双引擎屏幕截图插件，支持框选截屏与红框标注，并将截图直接插入 DeepSeek Harness 会话输入框。

description.en: Skill & MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness, with live MCP status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的技能与 MCP 管理中心，可在侧边栏查看 MCP 实时状态。

description.en: Provides a lightweight conversation turn navigation rail for DSH Web GUI, enabling quick jumps to any round in long chats.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供轻量的对话轮次导航栏，可在长对话中快速跳转到任意一轮。

description.en: Adds Cursor-style new session button and sidebar drafts switcher to DeepSeek Harness for managing multiple empty chats.
description.zh: Cursor-style New Session for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): every click mints a fresh durable draft session — plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.

description.en: AI coding delivery governance layer for evidence-backed planning, review, quality, and release control.
description.zh: 为AI编码交付提供基于证据的规划、评审、风险、质量与发布管控的治理层。

description.en: Lets an agent drive a real Chrome via a numbered, token-light view of interactive elements, with live page frames, replayable timelines, and user takeover.
description.zh: 让智能体通过编号且低 token 的交互元素视图驱动真实 Chrome，并显示实时页面、可回放时间线和用户接管界面。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows per-project token usage, development timeline, estimated spending, plus account balance and subscription quota.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按项目统计 Token 消耗、开发时间线与预估费用，并可查看账户余额与订阅额度。

description.en: Fetches DeepSeek API account balance by calling /user/balance and returns raw JSON.
description.zh: 调用 /user/balance 接口查询 DeepSeek API 账户余额，并返回原始 JSON 数据。

description.en: DSH usage statistics dashboard with token, cost, duration, session aggregation and visualizations.
description.zh: DSH 用量统计面板插件，按 token、费用、时长和会话聚合数据，并提供趋势、热力图和日历视图。

description.en: Lightweight appearance personalization plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with theme colors, DIY palettes and fonts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供轻量外观个性化：主题配色、自定义调色板与字体设置。

description.en: Adds a title-bar toggle between a token-free chat mode (embedded DeepSeek web chat) and the native DSH agent workspace.
description.zh: 在标题栏提供聊天/工作双模式切换：聊天模式内嵌 DeepSeek 网页版且不消耗 token，工作模式为原生 Agent 界面。

description.en: Store and manage your own prompts in DSH Settings, then tick them on per chat session so they apply to every model step.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中保存和管理自己的提示词，并在每个对话中勾选启用，使其作用于该会话的每一步。

description.en: Safety harness plugin for DSH providing execution guard, safe delete, snapshots, and rollback.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供执行时守卫、基于回收站的安全删除、组合快照与回滚、重启前校验，独立 CLI 且零依赖。

description.en: Local Markdown note plugin for DSH: capture quick notes, AI auto-files them into notebooks, plus diary and todos via MCP.
description.zh: DSH 的本地笔记插件：随手记录、AI 自动归档到笔记本，支持日记待办，并通过 MCP 读写本地 Markdown。

description.en: A skill and zero-dependency CLI toolkit for creating, benchmarking, and iterating DSH skills.
description.zh: 提供创建、评测和迭代改进 DSH skill 的 skill 与零依赖命令行工具

description.en: Start temporary conversations in DeepSeek Harness without needing a workspace or project.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中无需工作区或项目即可开启临时对话。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness desktop pet plugin (enhanced fork) with local chatter lines, collapsible bubbles, auto-behaviour timing and stay-on-screen bounds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物插件增强分支，提供全本地碎碎念语句池、气泡可收起、自动行为间隔与不出屏幕保护。

description.en: One DeepSeek account and one instruction make every online Windows/macOS machine run the same project via a Rabbit relay.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek 账号、一条指令，通过 Rabbit 中继让所有在线 Windows/macOS 机器运行同一项目。

description.en: DSH plugin that controls which models appear in the chat model menu and tags each with reasoning, effort, context window and modality info.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用于管理聊天模型菜单中显示哪些模型，并为每个模型标注推理、思考强度、上下文窗口与模态信息。

description.en: One-command toolkit installing MCP management and Skill management plugins for DSH.
description.zh: 一条命令为 DSH 安装 MCP 管理和 Skill 管理两个插件，安装后设置页自动出现对应分区。

description.en: Context razor: lists session context items with token stats and precise trimming, no LLM summarization.
description.zh: 上下文剃刀：逐条列出会话上下文及token统计，精确裁剪，无需LLM总结。

description.en: DSH plugin that launches fireworks above the chat window when the agent codes, with variants, token-driven scale and WebGL2 trail rendering.
description.zh: DSH 插件：agent 编程时在对话窗口上空放烟花，支持多种事件与变体，按 token 用量决定规模，WebGL2 拖尾渲染。

description.en: Brings ntd Process multi-stage agent workflow templates into dsh web: browse, edit, validate, import/export, AI-generate, plus process_* tools for agents.
description.zh: 把 ntd 的工艺（多阶段 agent 工作流模板）接入 dsh Web，支持浏览、编辑、校验、导入导出与 AI 生成，agent 可用 process_* 工具推进。

description.en: AI-native product delivery workflow: automates full pipeline from research to release with multi-agent review loops.
description.zh: 100% AI-native product delivery workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness: full product-to-release pipeline (research → PRD → OpenSpec → parallel multi-agent → review loops → tests → release audit) with lo

description.en: Integrates Google Antigravity cloud code assistance into DSH, with a fix for the CallId export error in DSH Desktop Beta.
description.zh: 将Google Antigravity云代码辅助集成到DSH，并修复DSH Desktop Beta中的CallId导出错误。

description.en: Side-assistant dock for DeepSeek Harness: run quick /btw questions in background without disturbing the active agent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边助手坞，可在后台运行 /btw 快速提问，不打断当前代理。

description.en: Manage password-based SSH hosts in the DSH GUI, letting the Agent run commands and upload files with approval required for delete commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面集中管理密码登录的 SSH 主机，让 Agent 执行命令和上传文件，删除命令需先获批。

description.en: Annotate elements on a page in the DSH built-in browser and send your comments to the session in one click.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置浏览器中标注页面元素，并一键将评论发送到会话。

description.en: Plays sound notifications (chime for confirmations, success sound for completed tasks) in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的声音提示插件，在需要用户确认时播放提示音，任务完成时播放成功音效。

description.en: One-click standalone two-column code review page for git diff with syntax highlighting and inline comments.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，一键为 git diff 打开独立双列代码审查页，支持语法高亮与行内评论。

description.en: 把钉钉 AI 表格接入 DeepSeek Harness ｜ 10 个工具 + 设置面板 + 定时导出 ｜ Read & write DingTalk AI Tables from DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把钉钉 AI 表格接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 10 个读写表格的工具、设置面板和定时导出。

description.en: Web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Tavily API, with multi-key rotation, failover, and web settings management.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供基于Tavily的网络搜索插件，支持多密钥轮换、故障转移和Web设置管理。

description.en: Forwards the complete Harness environment to child processes via ctx.subprocess, disabling credential isolation.
description.zh: 通过 ctx.subprocess 将完整 Harness 环境变量传给子进程，并关闭凭据隔离。

description.en: Lets selected encrypted-reasoning routes leave a visible action summary in session history so later steps can read the previous step.
description.zh: 让被选中的加密推理路由在会话历史中留下可见行动摘要，使后续步骤能读到上一步做了什么。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for DeepSeek Harness with adjustable blur/frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrops, unified corners, and a toggle back to the stock UI.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Aqua 玻璃质感主题，支持调节模糊/磨砂、流体或壁纸背景、统一圆角，并可一键切回原生界面。

description.en: Adds a sidebar dashboard showing local DeepSeek Harness token usage: daily heatmap, provider-channel breakdown, and per-session totals, fully offline.
description.zh: 在侧栏添加 Token 用量看板，展示每日消耗热力图、按供应商渠道分摊和每个会话用量，全部本地读取、不联网。

description.en: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider for DeepSeek Harness, with per-model reasoning-effort (thinking) level settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AMD Radeon Cloud 模型提供方，并支持按模型设置思考档位。

description.en: The whole 3D toolchain for one machine, in one plugin: printable CAD by natural language through the local SolidCraft CLI (build, edit, measure, preview, inspect, repair), plus thirty Blender skills for organic modelling, materials, lighting, cameras, rendering, UV and animation. Ten agent hosts.
Agnes AI LLM provider for DSH with OpenAI-compatible chat models, image input, and image/video generation tools plus a settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Agnes AI 大模型服务，兼容 OpenAI 接口，支持图片输入及图像/视频生成工具和设置面板。

description.en: An installable Agent Skill giving AI coding agents eight checkable work principles to stop guessing, over-refactoring and skipped verification.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的可安装 Agent Skill，用八条可核对准则挡住瞎猜、越权重构与跳过验证。

description.en: Desktop pet that monitors CPU, memory, GPU, and NVMe temperatures and shows hardware info.
description.zh: 紫白桌宠实时显示 CPU、内存、GPU、NVMe 温度及硬件信息，支持用 dsh plugin add 一键安装。

description.en: Syncs cc-switch provider balances and stats token usage/cost for DSH sessions, with per-day/month/total views.
description.zh: 同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日、月、总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持中转站币种与汇率设置

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness settings panel for Command Code that shows credits, usage windows, and syncs the model catalog.
description.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板，用于查看 Command Code 的额度、用量窗口并同步模型目录。

description.en: Select consecutive conversation turns and summarize them into a checkpoint card, shrinking the model context while keeping the originals logged.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中连续轮次并总结为检查点卡片，压缩模型上下文，同时保留原始记录。

description.en: Imports and exports Cordis plugins as zip bundles via agent tools and a browser settings panel.
description.zh: 一个持久化 DSH 插件，通过 agent 工具和浏览器设置面板将 Cordis 插件以 zip 包形式导入和导出。

description.en: Lints repositories to detect and flag chain-of-thought leakage from AI assistant transcripts in docs and comments.
description.zh: 检查仓库文档和注释，发现并标记其中由 AI 助手会话记录残留造成的思维链泄露。

description.en: Turns your recent DeepSeek Harness conversations into short dream-like stories.
description.zh: 将最近的 DeepSeek Harness 对话转化为简短的梦境故事。

description.en: Pixel chess in the DSH sidebar with a DeepSeek AI opponent, Lichess-style L1–L8 levels, 18 emotes, move analysis and local saves.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏像素国际象棋：DeepSeek AI 对手、Lichess 式 L1–L8 难度、18 种表情、棋步分析、和棋谈判与本地存档。

description.en: AI personality core evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DHC).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 人格核心进化插件，用于演化 AI 人格核心。

description.en: Source-traceable live web search and URL extraction for DeepSeek Harness using Brave and Tavily APIs.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供基于Brave和Tavily的可溯源实时网页搜索和URL提取功能。

description.en: Blocks new DeepSeek official API requests during peak hours with friendly prompts and reminders.
description.zh: 在高峰时段拦截发往 DeepSeek 官方 API 的新请求，并给出友好提示与询问。

description.en: Provides DSH web search and page fetch through DeepSeek's dedicated Tools API endpoints.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 专用 Tools API 为 DSH 提供网页搜索和页面抓取能力。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek-branded whale progress indicator to DSH Web GUI with spout animation and todo tracking.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的输入框上方添加 DeepSeek 鲸鱼进度指示器，代理工作时鲸鱼游动，带喷水动画和待办进度跟踪。

description.en: A 2D drag-based picker for choosing a DeepSeek Harness model and its reasoning effort level in a single gesture.
description.zh: 一个二维拖拽选择器，一次拖动即可选定 DeepSeek Harness 的模型与推理强度。

description.en: Evidence-first state projection, diff and immutable freeze for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于证据的 2Origin 状态投影、差异比较和不可变冻结。

description.en: Adds a Web UI toggle and popup that infinitely auto-retries DeepSeek Harness requests when 429 or insufficient_quota errors occur.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 添加开关与弹窗，遇到 429 或配额不足错误时无限次自动重试，避免任务中断。

description.en: Adds a Settings: Account page in dsh to view DeepSeek balance/usage and OpenCode Go quota, with quick links to official sites.
description.zh: 为 dsh 增加设置中的账户页面，可查看 DeepSeek 余额和用量、OpenCode Go 额度，并提供跳转对应官网的快捷链接。

description.en: Personal achievements dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing profile cards and token activity stats.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的个人成就面板，展示个人资料卡片与 Token 活跃度统计。

description.en: Provides evidence of consistent action binding and replay parity across CLI, MCP, and GUI surfaces in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨 CLI、MCP 和 GUI 界面的动作绑定与重放一致性证据。

description.en: Opt-in mobile adaptation packs that enforce 44px touch targets and safe rail/floating-widget clearances for third-party DSH plugin panels.
description.zh: 可选启用的移动端适配包，为第三方 DSH 插件面板强制 44px 触控目标并保留侧栏与悬浮组件安全间距。

description.en: A capability-aware reasoning effort slider for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, enhancing the model selector.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的模型选择器加入基于模型能力的推理档位滑块，用于调节推理强度。

description.en: Adds an advisor to DeepSeek Harness agents, using a stronger model for difficult decisions and default model otherwise.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体添加顾问：日常任务使用默认较弱模型，遇到困难决策时自动向更强模型咨询。

description.en: Agent bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness using JSON recipes, a cross-platform launcher, recipe wizard, self-test and registry import.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体桥接插件，支持 JSON 配方、跨平台启动器、配方向导、自检与注册表导入。

description.en: Connects locally logged-in WorkBuddy, WorkBuddy AI, and Hermes Agent LLMs to the DSH model library with matching names, credit rates, and free quotas.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 WorkBuddy、WorkBuddy AI 和 Hermes Agent 大模型接入 DSH 模型库，并显示与 Agent 一致的模型名称、积分倍率和免费额度。

description.en: Role-based model routing and staged agent workflows for DeepSeek Harness, shipped with dsh-our-free-model.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的基于角色的模型路由与分阶段 Agent 工作流，并附带 dsh-our-free-model。

description.en: Real-time session cost preview and usage charts for DeepSeek Harness, with pricing synced to official site.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时会话费用显示、今日用量图表和价格估算工具，价格与官网同步并区分峰谷时段。

description.en: Gives DSH agents a fading memory, an editable personality, a shifting mood and a self-written diary that grows into ongoing intentions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供会逐渐模糊的记忆、可编辑的人格、起伏的心情，并自动写日记、长出心里惦记的事。

description.en: Host-only plugin that injects a persistent system-prompt rule so agent-team orchestration, parallel dispatch and task-board closure become the default in every session.
description.zh: 纯宿主插件，通过常驻注入系统提示，让智能体团队编排、并行派活与任务板闭环成为所有会话的默认行为。

description.en: A DSH plugin that runs an agent software R&D team, managing standardized dev processes, documents, development and operations work.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，用于管理智能体软件研发团队，涵盖标准化研发流程、文档管理、软件开发与运维。

description.en: A zero-token online/offline status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, auto-refreshing every 15 seconds.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供零 token 消耗的在线/离线状态指示，每 15 秒自动刷新。

description.en: Enables alliance mode in DeepSeek Harness to freely combine multiple AI agents and models while preserving native lifecycle and real-time execution.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中启用联盟模式，可自由组合 DSH、Claude Code、Codex 及全部已配置模型，并保留原生 Agent 生命周期与实时执行过程。

description.en: Makes the native status bar in DeepSeek Harness messages always visible without hover.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 消息下方的原生状态栏始终显示，无需鼠标悬停即可查看。

description.en: Amazon review VOC analysis plugin: a four-dimension value model, two-step AI tagging, deterministic word-frequency stats and buyer personas over CSV data.
description.zh: Amazon 评论 VOC 分析插件：四维价值模型 + 两步 AI 打标 + 确定性词频统计 + 用户画像，支持 CSV 数据。

description.en: Standalone DSH plugin managing the assistant's persona (name, role, user address, style, custom instructions) plus a three-stage long-term memory pipeline.
description.zh: 独立可用的 DSH 助手人格与长期记忆插件，管理人设（名字、角色、称呼、风格、自定义指令）并采用三段式长期记忆流程。

description.en: Select text in DSH answers to add notes, then batch-send all annotations to the agent as one message.
description.zh: 在 DSH 回答中选中文字添加备注，累积后一次性发送给 agent。

description.en: Converts Word/PPT/Excel/ODT/RTF/EPUB/CSV/PDF documents to Markdown, and uses a vision-language model to describe embedded images.
description.zh: 将Word/PPT/Excel/ODT/RTF/EPUB/CSV/PDF文档转换为Markdown，并使用视觉语言模型描述嵌入图片。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and per-run usage cost in the DSH sidebar footer, keeping the API key in the host process.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏页脚显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额与单次运行费用，API 密钥仅保留在宿主进程中。

description.en: Tracks real-time DeepSeek API cost at peak and off-peak rates, shown via a composer pill, /cost command, session_cost tool and JSON snapshot.
description.zh: 实时统计 DeepSeek API 费用（区分高峰/低谷价），通过输入框徽标、/cost 命令、session_cost 工具和 JSON 快照展示。

description.en: Zero-config DSH dashboard that charts API token usage over 24 hours with per-day drill-down and provider/model color breakdowns from local session logs.
description.zh: 零配置的 DSH API 用量仪表盘，基于本地会话日志绘制 24 小时 token 图表，支持按天下钻和按提供商/模型分色统计。

description.en: Windows approval and notification plugin for DSH: approve/reject prompts, round-completion and error alerts, with SQLite audit logging.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 审批与通知插件：批准/拒绝提示、本轮完成与异常提醒，并带 SQLite 审计日志。

description.en: Explain what a pending dsh approval will actually do, with one LLM call: an Explain button beside Allow/Reject in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
Arabic support for DeepSeek Harness: bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic/English text plus a full Arabic UI language pack of 3,228 strings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供阿拉伯语支持：阿拉伯语与英语混排的双向安全 RTL 渲染，以及包含 3,228 条字符串的完整阿拉伯语界面语言包。

description.en: Two-tab panel for managing archived and active DeepSeek Harness sessions, with archive, unarchive, and permanent delete actions.
description.zh: 双 Tab 面板集中管理 DSH 的已归档与活跃会话，支持归档、取消归档和彻底删除。

description.en: Lists archived sessions in Settings and permanently deletes their logs, markers, and caches.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness归档管理器

description.en: Adds an 'Archived Sessions' settings page to DSH to list, restore, or permanently delete archived sessions with confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增“归档会话”页，可列出、恢复或永久删除已归档会话（删除需确认）。

description.en: Adds a restorable trash bin to DSH sessions: delete any session inline, restore from trash, or purge permanently.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话增加可还原的回收站：任意会话可直接删除、从回收站还原，或彻底永久删除。

description.en: DSH plugin that permanently deletes archived sessions and their subagent logs to free up session storage.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用于永久删除已归档会话及其子智能体日志，以释放会话存储空间。
