description.en: Makes file paths in DeepSeek Harness chat clickable so you can reveal artifacts in Explorer or open them with their default app.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中的文件路径可点击，可在资源管理器中定位文件或用默认应用打开。

description.en: Persistent read-only side conversations anchored to specific text in DeepSeek Harness, for follow-up questions and annotations.
description.zh: 把追问绑定到主对话中的具体文字并持久保存的 DeepSeek Harness 只读旁注插件。

description.en: Folds mis-rendered thinking/reasoning content into collapsible blocks and renders mermaid diagrams inline.
description.zh: 将渲染异常的思考/推理内容折叠为可收起区块，并在页面内直接渲染 mermaid 图表。

description.en: Multi-agent group chat for DSH with a durable message log, attention routing, and cross-workspace membership.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的多智能体群聊，提供持久消息日志、注意力路由和跨工作区成员管理。

description.en: DSH plugin that monitors context health, guards against content degradation, and generates zero-model handoff documents.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供上下文健康监测、内容退化守卫与零模型交接文档生成的插件。

description.en: Provides content-addressed audit indexes for evidence producers in DeepSeek Harness, ensuring integrity.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中相互独立的证据生产者生成基于内容寻址的审计索引，以保证证据完整性。

description.en: Adjusts reasoning effort per turn via Jev without changing the selected model, plus configurable subagent routing.
description.zh: 通过 Jev 在不更换所选模型的情况下按轮调整推理强度，并支持可配置的子代理路由。

description.en: Automatically loads full conversation history when a DSH session opens, eliminating manual 'Load earlier' clicks.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话打开时自动加载完整对话历史，无需再手动点击“加载更早”。

description.en: Restarts DSH only when every conversation is idle, then auto-resumes interrupted sessions and re-arms goals so work continues.
description.zh: 等所有对话空闲后才优雅重启 DSH，重启后自动恢复被中断的会话并重新武装目标，让工作继续。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DeepSeek Harness sessions by injecting a 'continue' message after a web process restart, requiring no manual intervention.
description.zh: 在 web 进程重启后自动向中断的 DeepSeek Harness 会话注入 continue 消息以恢复会话，无需手动操作。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin to customize background wallpaper via file picker, dim/brighten, /background command, and localStorage persistence.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版自定义背景壁纸，支持文件选择器选图、调暗或调亮、/background 命令以及 localStorage 持久化保存。

description.en: Backs up DSH skills, plugins, config, memory and todos into one tar.gz and restores them per-module on a new machine via baseline three-way merge.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的技能、插件、配置、记忆和待办打包成 tar.gz，换机时按模块基于基线做三方合并导入。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service, registering its SSE tools so users can access their own cloud files.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入百度网盘官方 MCP 服务，注册其 SSE 工具，让用户访问自己的云端文件。

description.en: Submits and tracks governed business tasks from DeepSeek Harness via an operator-configured BailingHub route.
description.zh: 通过操作员配置的 BailingHub 路由，从 DeepSeek Harness 提交并跟踪受管控的业务任务。

description.en: Shows current AI provider balance/usage in the DeepSeek Harness input status bar, with session cost.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方状态栏显示当前供应商余额与用量，包括 DeepSeek 官方余额和本会话花费，以及 Kimi Coding、OpenCode Go、GLM Coding Plan 等订阅用量，按供应商判断、2 秒轮询、5 分钟缓存。

description.en: Shows multi-platform model balances and subscription quotas in the DSH sidebar, with a settings page for display, ordering, language and refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏集中显示多个模型平台的余额与订阅额度，并提供设置页管理显示、排序、语言与刷新。

description.en: A DSH desktop sidebar plugin that always shows your DeepSeek account balance, today's spend, low-balance alerts and a flow sweep effect.
description.zh: 一个常驻显示 DeepSeek 账号余额的 DSH 桌面端侧边栏插件，包含今日消费、低余额告警与流速扫光效果。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek balance and spend in dsh sidebar bottom.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和花费金额。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API balance and spend, converted to rubles at the CBR rate, with a Russian-language interface.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek API 余额与用量，按俄罗斯央行汇率折算为卢布，并提供俄语界面。

description.en: Displays balance, session cost, token usage, and invoice summaries for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中显示账户余额、会话费用、token 用量和账单汇总。

description.en: DSH plugin bundling 7 tools for BeiShan Besson's Minecraft modding tutorial: search, learning-path planning, version-migration comparison, env setup and full-text fetching.
description.zh: DSH 插件，内置 7 个工具，覆盖北山Besson Minecraft 模组开发教程的检索、路线规划、版本迁移对比、环境搭建与正文抓取全流程。

description.en: Web UX kit for DeepSeek Harness adding session row actions and a large model picker.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Web 用户体验组件，在会话行上添加操作按钮，并提供大尺寸的模型选择器。

description.en: Lets the dsh-pet desktop pet read model output aloud using its own configured voice via text-to-speech.
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 桌宠用自己配置的音色，把模型输出自动朗读出来。

description.en: Autonomous DSH agent finds quiet Bilibili live rooms, hears the streamer and sees the screen via ASR/vision, then chats back with short danmaku.
description.zh: 让 DSH 中的 agent 自主寻找冷清的 B 站直播间，通过语音识别听懂主播、看懂画面，再用短弹幕陪聊。

description.en: Bilibili plugin for DSH that monitors DMs, @ mentions and followed creators' new videos, letting you pick any registered model each round.
description.zh: DSH 的 B 站插件：自动监控私信、@ 提醒与特别关注 UP 主的新视频，每轮可任选已注册模型。

description.en: Send nothing but a Bilibili video link and the plugin fetches the transcript and returns an automatic summary.
description.zh: 只需发送一个哔哩哔哩视频链接，插件就会抓取字幕并自动生成摘要。

description.en: Liquid-glass billing overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI showing provider balances, session cost, daily spend, and token buckets.
description.zh: Liquid-glass billing overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: provider balances, session cost, daily spend and token buckets. DeepSeek-first and extensible.

description.en: Validates biomedical research citations, URLs, and claim consistency against source text using authoritative registries and an LLM.
description.zh: 验证生物医学报告中的引用、URL、标题及声明与源文本的一致性，利用权威注册表和LLM。

description.en: Converts Minecraft Java saves into Blender covers and animations with terrain export, MCprep/BPS rig setup, and OpenCV quality checks.
description.zh: 将 Minecraft Java 存档转换为 Blender 封面和动画，包含地形导出、MCprep/BPS 绑定与 OpenCV 质量检查。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme plugin offering 10 OKLCH Morandi color schemes plus optional frosted-glass wallpaper overlay.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 主题插件：提供十套 OKLCH 莫兰迪配色，并可选壁纸加磨砂玻璃叠加效果。

description.en: Blue Archive-themed DSH plugin with Shiroko desktop companion, reply bubbles, petting effects, and completion chime.
description.zh: 碧蓝档案风格 DSH 主题插件，带白子桌面宠物、Codex 式回复气泡、抚摸互动效果和完成提示音。

description.en: DSH boot splash plugin that catches the first frame before the loading card, plays a seven-beat compass sequence, then hands off to the app.
description.zh: DSH 启动动画插件：在加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放七段罗盘序列后交接给主界面。

description.en: Adds a floating switch to the DSH web UI that toggles between ds-bot's Bot surface and the classic DSH surface without unloading ds-bot.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中添加悬浮开关，可在不卸载 ds-bot 的情况下于 Bot 界面和经典 DSH 界面之间切换。

description.en: Human-brain-style context compression for LLMs, reducing token usage and context occupancy in long tasks.
description.zh: 以类人脑方式压缩大模型上下文，降低长任务中的token消耗和上下文占用。

description.en: A second-brain plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores memory as Markdown, syncs it via git, and captures reviewed cards with cloud/local split.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的第二大脑插件，用 Markdown 存储记忆、通过 git 同步，并支持审核式卡片采集与云端/本地分离。

description.en: DSH host-side plugin that clears parent-inherited queued prompts in a fork child so a new branch runs the prompt you type.
description.zh: DSH 插件，清除分支子进程从父进程继承的排队提示，让新分支执行你输入的提示。

description.en: Replaces DSH Web GUI branding — logo, product name, version badge, hero title, tab title and favicon — via a settings panel.
description.zh: 通过设置面板替换 DSH Web GUI 的品牌信息，包括 Logo、产品名、版本徽标、Hero 标题、标签页标题与图标。

description.en: Headful Playwright browser that logs in once, automates forms/scraping/multi-tab tasks, and pauses for user confirmation on sensitive actions.
description.zh: 有头 Playwright 浏览器：登录一次后自动填表、抓列表、多标签操作，遇登录/验证码/弹框会暂停等你确认，绝不擅自点确定。

description.en: Plays a bubbly "gurgle" chime sound when a DSH task completes or output stops, giving an audible cue that work has finished.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在任务完成或输出停止时播放一串「咕噜」气泡提示音，用声音提醒工作已结束。

description.en: Reusable Agent Skill and DSH Skill Provider Bundle for safe, evidence-driven DeepSeek Harness plugin development
description.zh: 提供可复用的 Agent Skill 与 DSH Skill Provider 套件，用于安全、依据证据地开发 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows a yellow cache-miss notice under the first assistant reply, with idle, re-billed, cached tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 在cache miss的时候提示

description.en: Renders the built-in session cache-hit percentage with three decimal places in DSH client.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件，把内置的会话缓存命中率按三位小数显示。

description.en: Deterministic math engine for DSH agents: exact decimal arithmetic with a hand-written parser, no eval and zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供确定性数学计算引擎：手写解析器实现精确小数运算，不使用 eval，零依赖。

description.en: Month-view calendar board for DSH with daily notes, scheduled reminders, inline editing, and completion fireworks.
description.zh: DSH 的月视图日历看板，支持每日笔记、定时提醒、行内编辑与完成烟花效果。

description.en: Per-model capability profiling: analyzes local session history to generate tool-usage and error-rate dashboards with time-range filters.
description.zh: Per-model capability profiling for DSH: turns local session history into tool-usage and error-rate dashboards with time-range filters

description.en: Pre-flight plugin-library check that injects Top-K suitable plugin hints into DSH agent runtime context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 代理处理任务型请求前自动预检插件库，并向运行时上下文注入最匹配的 Top-K 插件提示。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness agent activity and uses the Caps Lock LED as a status beacon: solid while working, blinking when approval or input is needed.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 代理活动，并用 Caps Lock LED 作为状态指示灯：工作时常亮，需要审批或回答时闪烁。

description.en: Adds Claude Code-style automatic memory and reviewable Dream consolidation to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Claude Code 风格的自动记忆与可审阅的 Dream 记忆整合。

description.en: CDP browser control for screenshots, pixel assertions, and page JS without vision model or per-use approval.
description.zh: 通过 CDP 控制浏览器，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供截图、像素断言与页面 JS 执行，无需视觉模型，也无需逐次授权。

description.en: 码章鲸 is an unattended AI novel-writing workbench in DSH that plans, writes, reviews and publishes serialized chapters to Fanqie on a schedule.
description.zh: 码章鲸是运行在 DSH 中的无人值守 AI 小说工作台，按计划完成大纲规划、章节写作、审查润色与番茄章节发布。

description.en: Adds customizable avatars to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: one beside each AI reply and one beside each user message.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加可自定义头像：AI 回复左侧一个，用户输入右侧一个。

description.en: Commits the workspace after every chat turn, forming a git checkpoint chain so any round's code state can be restored.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束自动提交工作区，形成 git 检查点链，可随时回到任意一轮的代码状态。

description.en: Searches across all DSH chat sessions and within a single conversation, with context navigation to jump to matches.
description.zh: 跨所有 DSH 会话及单个对话内搜索，并可通过上下文导航跳转到匹配位置。

description.en: Adds a button to cycle chat width presets in DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with localStorage persistence.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加按钮，循环切换聊天宽度预设，并通过 localStorage 持久保存所选设置。

description.en: A DSH desktop pet that talks with you by voice, remembers chats and desktop observations, and starts conversations on its own.
description.zh: 一个会说话的 DSH 桌面宠物，支持语音聊天与记忆库，还能主动找你搭话。

description.en: Adds startup and turn-completion chimes to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, with an in-app control panel and switchable sound library.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用添加启动与回合完成提示音，内置控制面板和可切换音效库。

description.en: Search and explore Chinese classical poetry with filters, daily poems, favorites, and AI explanations.
description.zh: 搜索和探索中国古典诗歌，支持筛选、每日诗词、收藏与AI解释。

description.en: Clarify mode adds an in-composer interview panel that asks per-question options before the AI starts, then issues a requirements card to confirm.
description.zh: 澄清模式在输入框上方加访谈面板，开工前逐题问清需求，给出需求卡供确认后再动手。

description.en: Adds a six-stop reasoning-effort slider to DeepSeek Harness, including a pixel-texture Ultracode mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加六档推理强度滑块，并包含像素纹理的 Ultracode 模式。

description.en: Russian localization plugin that adds the ru language to the dsh web UI, with 63 namespaces and 3119 translated strings.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web UI 添加俄语本地化的插件，包含 63 个命名空间、3119 条译文。

description.en: A dsh client plugin adding a ChatGPT-style model picker and an animated thinking-level slider to the DeepSeek Harness Web composer.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 客户端插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 编辑器添加 ChatGPT 风格的模型选择器和动画思考等级滑块。

description.en: Mobile UI optimizer for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with drawer sidebar, full-screen settings, safe areas, touch targets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供移动端界面优化：抽屉式侧边栏、全屏设置页、安全区域适配、适合触控的点击目标。

description.en: Adds a notes panel to DSH with a folder tree, browser-style tabs, and Markdown edit-plus-live-preview, acting as a memo pad and file reader.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加笔记面板：文件夹树、浏览器式标签页、Markdown 左编辑右实时预览，兼作备忘录与文件阅读器。

description.en: A standalone hacker-terminal theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, adding green-on-black styling, matrix rain, HUD effects, and reversible cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供独立的黑客终端主题，包含绿字黑底配色、矩阵雨、HUD 效果，并可还原清理。

description.en: Integrates locally installed CloakBrowser with DeepSeek Harness for agent-driven browser automation.
description.zh: 将本地安装的 CloakBrowser 接入 DeepSeek Harness，实现由智能体驱动的浏览器自动化。

description.en: Visualizes dsh edit/write tool calls as collapsible before/after code diff panels with syntax highlighting and absolute line numbers.
Provides code preview with syntax highlighting, symbol outline navigation, and in-file search for DSH web sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 网页侧边栏插件，提供按语言语法高亮的代码预览、符号大纲导航和文件内搜索。

description.en: Renders inline code in DSH chat as amber pills with VS Code-style syntax coloring and language badges.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中将行内代码渲染为琥珀色胶囊，并支持 VS Code 风格语法着色与语言徽标。

description.en: Searches local code and GitHub/npm before building to evaluate reuse vs rewrite and asks user.
description.zh: 开发前检索本地代码库与 GitHub/npm 开源项目，评估复用、改造、引依赖或自制并询问用户，支持架构级复用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness code review plugin offering change, commit, branch, architecture, module and information-flow reviews with live progress and GitHub-style commit heatmaps.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的代码评审插件，支持改动、提交、分支、架构、模块与信息流评审，并提供实时进度与 GitHub 风格提交热力图。

description.en: DSH AI code security review plugin: deterministic scans, git diff checks, fix verification, baselines, SBOM-lite, zero runtime deps.
description.zh: DSH AI 代码安全审查插件：九工具确定性扫描、基线接受与 SBOM-lite，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Connects the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP into DSH as a model/agent provider with model picking, thinking levels and credit tracking.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 把本机 CodeBuddy CLI 接入 DSH，作为模型/agent 后端，支持模型选择、思考档位与积分查看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for OpenAI Codex CLI enabling one-off tasks, repo review, and session resumption with read-only sandbox.
description.zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 一次性任务/仓库审查/会话续接（默认只读沙箱，支持 DeepSeek provider）

description.en: AI-powered auto-approval plugin for dsh sandbox, mimicking Codex with rules and AI risk assessment to approve/reject requests.
description.zh: 为dsh沙箱提供仿Codex的自动审批，结合规则与AI做三级风险评估，自动放行或拒绝请求。

description.en: Message navigator for DeepSeek Harness: outlines long conversations with jump-to, scroll sync, search, and Markdown export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息导航器：为长对话提供大纲、点击跳转、滚动同步高亮、搜索及 Markdown 导出。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style mode to DeepSeek Harness with durable progress commentary, automatic turn continuation, and a permission-menu switch.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Codex 模式：持久进度注释、回合续接，以及权限菜单顶部的切换开关。

description.en: Sign in to OpenAI Codex from DeepSeek Harness using an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription via OAuth.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅在 DeepSeek Harness 中登录 OpenAI Codex。

description.en: Runs the local Codex CLI as a peer agent inside DeepSeek Harness so two agents can split work, hand off tasks, and review each other's changes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将本地 Codex CLI 作为对等代理运行，让两个代理分工、交接任务并互相审查改动。

description.en: Tracks Codex reset events, schedules, and source posts, with a composer status popover and a codex_reset agent tool.
description.zh: 跟踪 Codex 重置事件、时间表和来源帖子，提供输入框状态浮层与 codex_reset 代理工具。

description.en: Integrates multiple coding-plan subscriptions (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) into DeepSeek Harness via OAuth LLM adapters.
description.zh: Use multiple coding-plan subscriptions (ChatGPT/Codex, Claude, Gemini, …) inside DeepSeek Harness via native OAuth LLM adapters.

description.en: A cognition engine adding bitemporal memory, a constructivist schema graph, mood state machine, dialectical reflection and long-horizon tasks.
description.zh: 一个认知引擎，提供双时态记忆、建构主义图式图谱、情绪状态机、辩证反思与长程任务能力。

description.en: DSH client-side UI plugin that folds multi-line pastes and long sent messages into compact inline chips while sending the full original text.
description.zh: DSH 纯客户端 UI 插件：将多行粘贴与已发送的长消息折叠为紧凑内联标签，发送内容始终为完整原文。

description.en: Browse, inspect, edit and run local ComfyUI workflows on a native infinite canvas in the DSH desktop right sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面右侧栏的原生无限画布上浏览、检查、编辑和运行本地 ComfyUI 工作流。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets an agent drive local ComfyUI for text-to-image, image-to-image, canvas workflow runs, and node/model queries.
description.zh: DSH 插件，让 Agent 直接驱动本机 ComfyUI 完成文生图、图生图、运行画布工作流及节点模型查询。

description.en: Lazy-start and idle-exit lifecycle supervisor for a local ComfyUI server, packaged as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 为本地 ComfyUI 服务器提供按需启动与空闲退出的生命周期管理工具，并打包为 DSH 插件。

description.en: Manages compaction thresholds for DeepSeek Harness via layered global, context-window tier, and per-model policies, edited live in a sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理压缩阈值：全局、上下文窗口层级与模型策略，并可在侧边栏实时编辑。

description.en: Adds a live 20%-80% slider to the DSH composer for controlling when conversation context is compacted.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入区添加 20%-80% 实时滑块，用于控制对话上下文压缩阈值。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness developer companion plugin with nine modules for conversation export, prompt engineering, model comparison, and task orchestration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方伴侣插件开发者版，含对话导出、交接摘要、成本优化、全局检索、执行轨迹分析、Prompt 工作台、多模型竞技场、任务编排与安全审计九大模块。

description.en: Companion-AI hot/cold memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto dialogue archiving, graduated cooling, cue-gated recall and a compact 1600-token memory snapshot.
description.zh: 为陪伴 AI 提供的冷热分层记忆插件：自动归档对话、渐进冷存、线索触发召回，并生成 1600 token 的记忆快照。

description.en: A tiny company of employee agents for DeepSeek Harness, each with its own identity, model and skills, bidding for work instead of being piped through it.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中的小型员工代理团队，每个代理拥有独立身份、模型和技能，并通过竞标获取任务而非被动接单。

description.en: A compact DSH web composer island with a community v0.15 manifest and fixed button positioning.
description.zh: 一个紧凑的DSH Web编辑器小岛组件，带社区v0.15主机清单和固定按钮位置。

description.en: Extends DeepSeek Harness input box to full screen with expand/collapse, auto-expand on triple Shift+Enter, and auto-collapse after sending.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框扩展到全屏，支持展开与收起、连按三次 Shift+Enter 自动展开，发送后自动收起。

description.en: Cross-platform desktop computer-use plugins for DeepSeek Harness that capture screen regions using a bundled native helper.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨平台桌面 computer-use 插件，通过内置原生辅助程序截取屏幕区域。

description.en: Provides Windows computer-use tools with UIA native helper, occlusion-aware screenshots, and safety-gated input for UI automation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 电脑操作工具，内置 UIA 原生辅助程序，支持抗遮挡截图和带安全门控的输入，用于界面自动化。

description.en: Adds the Miaoshou (Meituan CatPaw) desktop client as a model provider inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将妙手（美团 CatPaw）桌面客户端接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为模型提供方使用。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin that brings MiniMax Code desktop app models into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 插件，将 MiniMax Code 桌面应用的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方。

description.en: Adds a header search button and sidebar panel to search the current conversation, highlighting every match and jumping to results.
description.zh: 在对话区头部添加搜索按钮，右边栏提供搜索面板，高亮当前对话中所有命中并可点击定位跳转。

description.en: Shows fatigue and wakefulness meters and lets the model autonomously compact its context history at task boundaries.
description.zh: 显示疲劳度与唤醒值指标，并允许模型在任务边界自主压缩上下文历史。

description.en: Marks conversation turns as invalid so DSH compaction omits them from checkpoints without deleting any messages.
description.zh: 将对话轮次标记为无效，使 DSH 压缩在生成检查点时忽略它们，且不删除任何消息。

description.en: Session health plugin for DeepSeek Harness that shows a data-driven context compass to help decide between continuing and starting new sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话健康插件，基于真实数据提供“继续”还是“新开”的上下文罗盘。

description.en: Sets a user-defined token ceiling for DeepSeek Harness and auto-compacts a session once that context limit is reached.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置用户自定义的 token 上限，达到该上下文限制后自动压缩会话。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek Harness context usage, per-step cost, cache-hit rate, bands, compaction threshold, balance and tariff without calling any model.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 显示上下文用量、每步成本、缓存命中、区间、压缩阈值、余额与费率，不调用模型。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible proxy and DeepSeek Harness engine that compacts context for local LLMs without breaking the session.
description.zh: 兼容 OpenAI 的代理与 DeepSeek Harness 引擎，为本地模型压缩上下文，触发可靠且不会中断会话。

description.en: DSH adapter that registers 11 context-mode ctx_* sandbox tools in-process with hook routing to cut session context usage.
description.zh: DSH 适配器，进程内注册 11 个 context-mode 的 ctx_* 沙箱工具并通过 hook 路由，节省会话上下文。

description.en: Adds one-click “继续” and “讲人话” buttons beside the dsh input bar's send button to resend common prompts without retyping.
description.zh: 在 dsh 输入栏发送按钮旁新增「继续」「讲人话」一键按钮，无需反复重打常用指令。

description.en: Automatically sends 'continue' when a local model hits its output-token cap, so replies keep flowing.
description.zh: 当本地模型达到输出 token 上限时，自动发送 continue，让回复继续生成。

description.en: Read-only outline panel that indexes user questions and assistant Markdown headings for fast navigation of long DSH conversations.
description.zh: 只读大纲面板，将用户提问与助手回复的 Markdown 标题编成目录，便于快速浏览长对话。

description.en: Renders a selected range of a DSH conversation into a PNG long image with a branded footer for sharing.
description.zh: 将选定范围的 DSH 对话渲染为带品牌页脚的 PNG 长图，用于分享。

description.en: Conversation statistics tab for DSH Web GUI showing per-session usage metrics and deletion.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供对话统计标签页，按会话显示轮次、步骤、调用与输入输出缓存 token 用量、模型与工具耗时及细分、单次调用明细，并支持永久删除会话。

description.en: Turns a code repository into software copyright registration materials: 60-page compliant source listing, manual, screenshots and application form.
description.zh: 把代码仓库自动转变为软件著作权登记材料：60页合规源程序、说明书、五屏截图与申请表推导。

description.en: Offline plugin development toolkit for Cordis/DSH with standards, scaffolding, static analysis, and debugging support.
description.zh: 离线开发 Cordis/DSH 插件的工具包，提供插件规范、脚手架、静态检查、运行时调试和性能门禁。

description.en: Session-view workbench bundling Keil debugging and Modbus HMI monitoring, with a Corn Agent preset, point tables, and logs.
description.zh: 会话区里的 Keil 调试与 Modbus 上位机/监控工作台，附带 Corn 模式 Agent 预设、点表与日志。

description.en: Tracks token usage from DSH session logs and provides budget checks for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话日志追踪 token 用量并生成成本台账，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预算检查。

description.en: DSH web plugin that shows a Chinese translation below English chain-of-thought blocks in the browser, without altering the original text.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：展开英文思考块时在下方显示中文译文，不改动任何会话原文。

description.en: Creative director agent that generates aesthetic briefs and rendering prompts via domain determination and adaptive questioning.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 创意指导 Agent 插件：领域判定 + 自适应追问生成深耕领域的美学 brief（短视频/品牌视觉/电商带货/游戏概念），cd_render 渲染生成 prompt，框架逻辑可测试。dsh-plugin / Creative Director

description.en: DSH plugin for scheduling cron jobs and sending push notifications to multiple chat platforms.
description.zh: DSH插件，支持创建定时任务并通过多平台推送结果。

description.en: Web GUI panel for managing DSH and system cron tasks with natural-language creation and execution logs.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面定时任务面板：在侧边栏管理 DSH 与系统 crontab 任务，支持用自然语言创建任务并查看执行日志。

description.en: fastCRW-backed web_search and web_fetch providers that plug into DeepSeek Harness ctx.web without changing the model's tools.
description.zh: 基于 fastCRW 的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供者，接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web，模型工具保持不变。

description.en: A DSH plugin that gives AI characters persistent relationships and evolving user models through long-term interaction.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，通过长期交互为 AI 角色提供持久关系与持续演进的用户模型。

description.en: Adds a custom CSS editor under Settings → General → Appearance in the DSH Web GUI, with DevTools-style completion, validation and rule panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的设置 → 通用 → 外观下方增加自定义 CSS 编辑器，具备补全、校验与规则面板等 DevTools 风格体验。

description.en: Customizes interface fonts, sizes, weights, and colors with WYSIWYG and auto-save.
description.zh: 自定义DSH界面的字体、字号、字重和颜色，提供所见即所得预览并自动保存设置。

description.en: Customize Chinese/English fonts, code font, and global font size in DeepSeek Harness Web UI with live preview.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中自定义中英文字体、代码字体和全局字号，并支持实时预览。

description.en: Adds standard five-tier reasoning effort options to third-party models lacking reasoning metadata, then hands control to DSH's official selector.
description.zh: 为缺少推理强度元数据的第三方模型自动补齐标准五档推理等级，随后交由 DSH 官方选择器接管。

description.en: Adds a looping muted video workspace background with a translucent composer to DeepSeek Harness, active only after the splash screen ends.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区添加循环静音视频背景和半透明输入框，仅在开屏动画结束后启用。

description.en: Turns a picture into a floating desk pet in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with local cutout, sticker outline, idle animation, and a live balance bubble.
description.zh: 将任意图片变成 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中的浮动桌面宠物，支持本地抠图、贴纸描边、待机动画和实时余额气泡。

description.en: Local offline speech plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing Chinese STT and TTS using Sherpa ONNX, with WebUI push-to-talk.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Sherpa ONNX 的本地离线中文语音识别与合成，并在 WebUI 中支持按住说话。

description.en: DSH plugin that displays current codexradar IQ for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash next to the model selector, refreshing every 5 minutes.
description.zh: 在模型选择框左侧显示当前 DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4 Flash 的 codexradar IQ，每 5 分钟刷新

description.en: Web-managed database plugin that lets the Agent run authorized read-only queries on MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB.
description.zh: 通过 Web 管理连接的数据库插件，让 Agent 在授权下执行只读查询，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB。

description.en: Web GUI database manager for DSH that unifies SQLite, MySQL and Redis with approval-guarded agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 的 Web GUI 数据库管理面板，统一管理 SQLite、MySQL 与 Redis，并提供受审批保护的 agent 工具。

description.en: DSH database MCP bridge plugin: persistent multi-source DBHub connections, per-workspace tools, and temporary dynamic connections.
description.zh: DSH 数据库 MCP 桥接插件，维持多数据源 dbhub 常驻连接，提供按工作区工具和临时动态连接，未安装时自动安装并更新

description.en: Design mode for DeepSeek Harness providing design-loop agent preset and design skill packs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供设计模式，包含 design-loop 智能体预设以及 design-principles 和 design-qa 技能包。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness conversation context into a deep-sea fishing mini-game that mints holo cards per AI answer.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话上下文变成深海垂钓小游戏，每次 AI 回答后钓起一张镭射全息卡。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance and session cost in DSH web UI with auto-refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面显示 DeepSeek 账号余额和会话费用，并自动刷新。

description.en: Adds a Billing page to DSH Web settings showing DeepSeek API balance and credits, with manual refresh, i18n, and theme support.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中新增计费页面，显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额和额度，支持手动刷新、多语言与主题。

description.en: DSH Desktop sidebar plugin that opens chat.deepseek.com in the sidebar or system browser and reads the conversation back into the current session.
description.zh: DSH 桌面侧边栏插件，可在侧边栏或系统浏览器中打开 chat.deepseek.com，并把对话读回当前会话。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek balance and platform usage, showing live balance in the DeepSeek Harness settings and conversation stats.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 官方设置-模型-DeepSeek 卡片中监控 DeepSeek 余额与平台用量，并在对话统计栏显示实时余额。

description.en: Shows live DeepSeek official service status from status.deepseek.com in the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时显示 status.deepseek.com 上 DeepSeek 官方服务状态。

description.en: A plugin that displays DeepSeek API balance, top-up link, and pricing status in session header.
description.zh: 在会话头部显示 DeepSeek API 余额、充值链接与价格状态。

description.en: Adds image recognition to text-only DeepSeek models via browser automation of web vision mode.
description.zh: 通过浏览器自动化调用 DeepSeek 网页版视觉模式，为仅支持文本的 DeepSeek 模型增加图片识别能力

description.en: Adds a DSH sidebar item that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone window with persistent login and CDP-based selected-text sharing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加菜单项，以独立窗口打开 chat.deepseek.com，登录态持久化，并基于 CDP 实现双向划词互传。

description.en: Generates delivery and acceptance documentation (design docs, manuals, test/release/acceptance reports) from code repositories and running systems.
description.zh: 交付工坊：从代码仓库与运行中的系统自动生成数据库设计、概要/详细设计、使用说明书、测试报告、上线与验收报告等交付材料。

description.en: Sends native Windows toast alerts for DSH approval requests and finished tasks, breaking through Do Not Disturb and fullscreen.
description.zh: 在 DSH 需要审批或任务完成时弹出 Windows 原生通知，可穿透「请勿打扰」与全屏，点击即可切回 DSH。

description.en: Adds a customizable desktop floating ball on Windows that opens a chat window in a separate window when clicked.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面添加一颗可自定义图标与背景的悬浮球，点击后在独立窗口中对话。

description.en: Adds native frosted glass and full transparency to DeepSeek Harness on Windows, with live Wallpaper Engine support.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生毛玻璃与全透明效果，并支持动态 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸。

description.en: A DSH Desktop wallpaper theme that makes windows look truly transparent to the desktop, with per-region translucency control.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Desktop 壁纸主题，让窗口看起来真正透到桌面，并支持按区域调节半透明度。

description.en: Deletes DSH Web sessions and their live store, workspace records, and on-disk artifacts from a running runtime.
description.zh: 从运行中的 Web 运行时删除 DSH 会话，并清理实时存储、工作区记录和磁盘产物。

description.en: DSH memory plugin that layers diary entries by day/week/month/year and triggers an independent relationship review whenever memory updates.
description.zh: DSH 记忆插件：把日记按日/周/月/年分层，记忆一更新就触发一次独立的关系复盘，判断只写入状态文件。

description.en: A bilingual dice game collection for DSH web GUI with classic modes, AI opponent, and online play via PeerJS.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面用的双语骰子游戏合集，含吹牛、红点、红蓝、大小、单双、顺子等玩法，支持单人对 AI 及通过 PeerJS 联机对战。

description.en: Card for DSH Desktop that displays code-style per-turn file-change diffs, with review and undo.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 的每轮文件改动卡，显示 +N −M diff，支持审阅和撤销。

description.en: DingTalk IM channel that creates tool-capable AI agents per chat with emotion read-receipts, silent processing, and durable sessions.
description.zh: 钉钉 IM 通道，把每个聊天变成可调用工具的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，支持表情回执、静默处理与持久会话。

description.en: Distills a book into a set of executable Agent skills, gated by a three-check fidelity, blind-routing and Darwin review process.
description.zh: 把一本书蒸馏成一组可执行的 Agent 技能，通过忠实度、盲测路由与达尔文体检三道闸门判态把关。

description.en: A persistent, session-aware global download queue server for DeepSeek Harness, built around aria2 for managing downloads.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局、会话感知的持久下载队列服务器，基于 aria2 管理下载任务。

description.en: DSH plugin adding Claude Code-style autonomous loop, GitHub plugin discovery with AI install, and workspace registration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加 Claude Code 式自主循环、GitHub 插件发现与 AI 安装，以及工作区注册。

description.en: Auto-applies a single Chinese official-document layout to every generated .docx using a DSH tool, prompt rules and a result hook.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 工具、提示规则和结果钩子，为每个生成的 .docx 自动套用统一的中文公文版式。

description.en: A persistent, read-only-first proactive agent for DeepSeek Harness, with user-approved execution of actions.
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化、只读优先的主动式代理，执行操作需用户批准。

description.en: Douyin toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with hot list, search, vision-frame video reading, and a guarded Playwright DM/group driver.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的抖音工具包：热榜、搜索、原生视觉帧视频解读，以及带防护的 Playwright 私信/群组驱动。

description.en: Douyin creator plugin for DeepSeek Harness that checks official Douyin docs before generating content advice.
description.zh: 基于抖音官方资料的 DeepSeek Harness 自媒体插件，可做选题、审脚本、诊断流量并制定周计划。

description.en: DSH subagent that browses Douyin, reads comments, and reports back, with dy_* tools and a valley timer.
description.zh: DSH 的抖音浏览子代理，自动刷抖音、读取评论并回传结果，附带 dy_* 工具与计时器。

description.en: Persists DSH composer draft attachments in IndexedDB so draft images survive page switches and restarts, then restores them via official createDrafts.
description.zh: 用 IndexedDB 保存 DSH 输入框草稿附件，切换页面或重启后可恢复，草稿图片不再丢失。

description.en: Keeps images you paste or attach in the DeepSeek Harness composer per session, mirroring them locally and restoring them when you return.
description.zh: 按会话保留你在 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器中粘贴或附加的图片，本地镜像保存，回到该会话时自动恢复。

description.en: Enables DSH web chat to accept any file type via drag-and-drop, saving non-image files to the session workspace for the agent.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页聊天拖放接收任意类型文件，非图片文件保存到当前会话工作区供智能体读取使用。

description.en: Cleans assistant prose by removing leaked DSML markers and automatically continues only turns that produced no content.
description.zh: 清理助手回复中泄漏的 DSML 标记，并仅对真正没有内容的回合自动续写。

description.en: A novelty "dumb mode" that rewrites the assistant's thinking and replies into short refusals and rejects every tool call.
description.zh: 装傻模式：把助手的思考与回答改写成『我不懂啊』『我不帮你做』等短句，并拒绝所有工具调用。

description.en: DSH plugin that compresses conversation context in layers (L0→L1→L2→L3), keeping older content at coarser resolution but never deleting it.
description.zh: DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：原文按 L1→L2→L3 逐层降分辨率，越旧越粗但从不删除。

description.en: Tier-based model router for DeepSeek Harness that exposes named tiers, each an ordered chain of real models with retries and automatic failover.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的挡位式模型路由插件，每个挡位是按顺序排列的模型链，支持重试与失败自动降级。

description.en: DSH host plugin that drives your local Edge browser over CDP to add edge search and edge read tools, bypassing web_fetch SSRF blocks under VPN.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Host 插件，通过 CDP 驱动本机 Edge 浏览器，提供 edge search 和 edge read 工具，绕开 VPN 下 web_fetch 的 SSRF 拦截。

description.en: Native reasoning-effort slider for the DSH composer with blue-purple gradient, star specks and flowing light, driven by each model's reasoning declaration.
description.zh: DSH composer 的原生推理档位控件：蓝紫渐变、星点与流光的档位条，档位由各模型自身的 reasoning 声明决定。

description.en: Drive your own Chrome or Edge with real login state using minimal profile/cookie copying, domain allowlists, and sync/doctor tools.
description.zh: 通过最小化复制配置与 Cookie、域名白名单及同步/诊断工具，用真实登录状态驱动你自己的 Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: Lets AI drive Huawei eNSP network labs: batch GUI automation, telnet command delivery, .topo read/write and auto-generated Word lab reports.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操控华为 eNSP 做网络实验：批量 GUI 驱动、telnet 下发命令、读写 .topo 并自动生成带截图的 Word 实验报告。

description.en: Adds a Settings → Environment Checkup tab showing host process identity and env-var group stats, plus a read-only env_inspect tool.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 环境体检」分页展示 DSH 宿主进程身份与环境变量分组统计，并为模型提供只读 env_inspect 工具。

description.en: Task-driven DSH plugin equipping engine that recommends a full set of plugins for a task and outputs copy-paste configuration.
description.zh: 面向任务的 DSH 插件装备引擎，为任务推荐整套插件并输出可直接复制粘贴的配置。

description.en: Records DSH runtime errors and coding retrospectives into a WebGL knowledge graph and injects reusable lessons back into the model context.
description.zh: 把 DSH 运行错误与编程复盘结构化存入记忆，渲染成 WebGL 知识图谱，并把可复用教训注入模型上下文。

description.en: Real-time self-audit plugin that logs errors/warnings with context and notifies AI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 实时记录错误/警告并通知AI的DeepSeek Harness自审插件

description.en: DSH Web widget that forecasts when the current agent turn will finish, based on todo checklist progress and step pace, with a progress bar and confidence badge.
description.zh: DSH Web 挂件：按 todo 清单完成度与步进节奏预测本轮完工时刻，附进度条与样本置信度。

description.en: Adds a real multi-agent team to DeepSeek Harness: a leader splits goals into tasks and members run them in separate sub-sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加入真正的多智能体团队：领队拆解目标，成员在各自子会话中接力执行任务。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides millisecond whole-disk file search through the local Everything index.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过本地 Everything 索引实现毫秒级全盘文件搜索。

description.en: Multi-expert bundle for DeepSeek Harness, letting users define expert teams as data directories that auto-register as routable skills.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多专家套件，用户可用数据目录定义专家团队，每个团队自动注册为可路由的技能，引擎与名单分离。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer context menu entry that opens any folder, or a right-clicked file's folder, in a new DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在 Windows 资源管理器右键菜单中添加选项，可将任意文件夹或所选文件所在文件夹在新的 DeepSeek Harness 会话中打开。

description.en: Manages DeepSeek Harness skills, MCP servers, instructions, commands and hooks from a single extension.
description.zh: 集中管理 DeepSeek Harness 的技能、MCP 服务器、指令、命令与钩子。

description.en: Adds an eye-care mode toggle to the DSH web interface with a bean-green color scheme.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加护眼模式开关，开启后使用豆绿色配色方案。

description.en: One-click Git commit plugin for DSH that splits workspace changes into reviewed Conventional Commits batches with sensitive-file filtering.
description.zh: One-click Git commit plugin for DSH: the session model splits workspace changes into reviewed Conventional Commits batches, with built-in sensitive-file filtering.

description.en: F1-themed skin pack for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with team themes, photo backdrops, and settings.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web UI提供F1主题皮肤，含车队主题、照片背景和设置面板。

description.en: Meta-plugin unifying all DeepSeek Harness extensibility seams behind a single declarative DSL.
description.zh: 用一套声明式 DSL 将 DeepSeek Harness 所有扩展点统一起来的元插件。

description.en: Creates one documentation page per feature so your agent can look up knowledge instead of grepping through code.
description.zh: 为每个功能生成一页文档，让智能体直接查阅知识而不必在代码中反复搜索。

description.en: Helps users turn ideas and bug reports into clear, privacy-aware GitHub Discussions.
description.zh: 帮助用户将想法和错误反馈整理为清晰、注重隐私的 GitHub Discussions。

description.en: Figma design data and true renders for DeepSeek Harness through your own signed-in Chrome — no Figma API token, paid seat, or Dev Mode.
Unified quoting plugin for DSH sidebar: select files/messages, annotate quotes with path & line range, and jump back to source.
description.zh: 基于 better-sidebar 的统一引用插件：划选文件/消息即可批注引用，引用块带文件路径与行区间、双端折叠、点击跳回原文 ｜ Unified-quoting plugin built on DSH-better-sidebar: select files or messages to annotate; quote blocks carry path & line range, colla

description.en: Shows which files and directories the agent touched, with a directory view and a timeline of file activity.
description.zh: 显示智能体访问过哪些文件和目录，并提供目录视图与文件活动时间线。

description.en: DSH plugin that snapshots files before write or edit operations and restores the previous state with /undo.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在写入或编辑文件前生成快照，并通过 /undo 恢复之前的状态。

description.en: FileLens adds a file explorer sidebar to DeepSeek Harness UI for browsing, previewing, searching, and editing files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness UI 添加文件浏览器侧边栏，可浏览、预览、搜索和编辑文件。

description.en: Integrated file browsing/editing and Git operations in a modal panel for the DSH Web UI, without leaving the interface.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供居中模态面板，集成工作区文件浏览、搜索、预览、编辑与 Git 状态、暂存、提交、拉取、推送、分支、历史和 diff 操作。

description.en: Adds a file tree browser and VSCode-style code editor to the DeepSeek Harness web UI for viewing and editing project files.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) ?????????: ??? + VSCode ????? (????/??/??)

description.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness with persona anchoring, tool anchoring, and complexity-based guidance.
description.zh: V4 Flash "god mode" for DeepSeek Harness: w7 persona anchoring + first-turn tool anchoring + complexity-dispatched guidance (headless-native, opencode-go verified).

description.en: Overrides DSH Web GUI chat area CSS variable to fluid width up to 2000px, fixing narrow display on wide screens.
description.zh: 覆盖 DSH Web GUI 聊天区的硬编码 748px 宽度，改为随屏幕自适应、最大 2000px，解决宽屏显示过窄问题。

description.en: Adds a flyout sidebar to DeepSeek Harness with file tree, Git uncommitted changes, and multi-tab file/diff preview.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可弹出侧边栏，展示文件树与 Git 未提交变更，并多标签预览文件与差异。

description.en: DSH screenshot plugin with double-Ctrl hotkey, custom shortcuts, region annotation, pinned images and chat attachments.
description.zh: DSH 截图插件：默认双 Ctrl 触发，支持自定义快捷键、区域标注、置顶贴图与聊天附件。

description.en: Display polish for DeepSeek Harness: auto-folds long messages and work-step blocks, resizes the composer and right sidebar, and searches folded content.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面美化插件：自动折叠长消息与工作步骤，可调整输入框和右侧栏，并支持搜索折叠内容。

description.en: Analyzes plugin dependencies, detects conflicts, assesses risks, and visualizes plugin combinations for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 分析 DeepSeek Harness 插件的依赖关系，检测冲突、评估风险并可视化插件组合。

description.en: Companion plugin that automatically relinks subagent records to the new session after a DSH session is forked.
description.zh: DSH 会话 fork 后，自动把子 agent 记录重链到新会话的伴随插件。

description.en: AI agent for spreadsheet form-filling with XLSX blank-cell preview and QCC data enrichment.
description.zh: AI填表智能体，支持XLSX空单元格预览和企业数据（QCC）增强及持久化任务。

description.en: A self-extending plugin compiler and blueprint registry for scaffolding and validating DSH plugins.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的自我扩展插件编译器与蓝图注册表，提供脚手架和校验工具来生成、验证插件。

description.en: Ships a local free-model router inside a single DSH plugin, giving a first-class model provider route with start/stop control and no Docker.
description.zh: 将本地免费模型路由器打包进单个 DSH 插件，提供一等公民的模型提供商路由与启停控制，无需 Docker。

description.en: DSH free web search plugin using Parallel backend with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 基于 Parallel 后端提供免费联网搜索，零依赖。

description.en: Upload an image as a frosted-glass window theme for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 上传图片作为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的全窗口磨砂玻璃主题。

description.en: DSH profile plugin providing full GPU-capable sandbox access with per-operation approval for writes outside workspace or to protected files.
description.zh: DSH 配置插件，提供支持 GPU 的完全访问沙箱，对写入工作区外或受保护文件的操作逐次审批。

description.en: Curates tool output to keep error/warning lines and head/tail, reducing model context size by ~24x.
description.zh: Curate tool output before it enters the model's context — keep error/warning lines and head/tail, spill the full text with a pointer. ~24x smaller model view, measured. For DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tool that plans, executes and judges differential fuzz and access-control logic tests, read-only by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 差分 fuzz 与逻辑越权测试工具：抽取取值、生成计划、执行请求并判定差异，默认只读。

description.en: Intercepts and blocks model refusal replies before they reach the session context, keeping conversations clean.
description.zh: 在模型拒绝性回复进入会话上下文之前将其拦截并屏蔽，保持对话干净。

description.en: Session-level action gears (P/R/N/M/D/A) plus a handbrake that injects behavior constraints per gear and can hard-block tool calls.
description.zh: 会话级行动档位 P/R/N/M/D/A 加手刹 H，换挡即注入行为约束提示词，手刹可硬拦截工具调用。

description.en: Forks agent presets and runs tasks on the next generation, recording lineage through a copy-edit-session workflow.
description.zh: Fork agent presets and run tasks on the next generation. Make, not a compiler.

description.en: Reads your Genshin Impact account — characters, constellations, talents, stats, weapons, artifacts — so you can query it in chat via agent tools or view it in a GUI sidebar.
description.zh: 读取你的原神账号数据（角色、命座、天赋、面板、武器、圣遗物），可在对话中通过 agent 工具查询，也能在侧边栏 GUI 页面查看。

description.en: A right-silo Git panel for DeepSeek Harness with staging, commits, branches, sync and GitHub integration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧 Git 面板，支持暂存、提交、分支、同步和 GitHub 集成。

description.en: Git automation plugin for DSH: scan repos, audit code, and one-click commit/push via tool or HTTP API.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 自动化插件，可扫描仓库，并通过工具或 HTTP API 一键执行 commit 和 push。

description.en: A Sourcetree-style Git workspace panel for DSH showing branches, staged and unstaged changes, and diffs in a full-height view.
description.zh: 一个 Sourcetree 风格的 DSH Git 工作区面板，全高显示分支、暂存/未暂存变更和差异对比。

description.en: Checks upstream git commits on the first daily dsh launch and asks in the Web GUI whether to update, for source checkouts.
description.zh: 每天首次启动 dsh 时用 git 检测上游提交，并在 Web GUI 中询问是否更新，适配源码 checkout。

description.en: Wakes a DSH session on a schedule, scans your watched GitHub repos and topics, and writes a daily digest of what changed — read-only.
description.zh: 定时唤醒 DSH 会话，扫描你关注的 GitHub 仓库与主题，挑出值得跟的变更写成只读日报。

description.en: Adds a hint page in Settings > Plugins showing random example prompts for connecting GitHub via MCP.
description.zh: 在设置-插件中添加提示页面，随机展示连接GitHub的示例提示。

description.en: Reports gaps in a GitNexus code index: skipped large files, index coverage, and git activity crossed with the index.
description.zh: 报告 GitNexus 代码索引的遗漏：跳过的大文件、索引覆盖率，以及叠加索引的 Git 活动。

description.en: 一瞥 / Glance：DSH Desktop 截图分析插件 —— 置顶悬浮球 + 框选任意区域 + 多模态流式分析
Unofficial Zhipu Qingyan (chatglm.cn) web provider for dsh, driving agents with a web login session and credits.
description.zh: 非官方智谱清言（chatglm.cn）网页版 dsh provider，用网页登录态与积分驱动 agent。

description.en: Global task library plugin with cross-session persistence, generative-UI panel, and subagent sync for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话持久化的全局任务库，带实时生成式 UI 浏览器悬浮面板，并自动同步子智能体任务状态。

description.en: Android plugin that gives an AI agent a real on-device adb shell — no root, no PC — to install apps, read logs, screenshot and run commands.
description.zh: 安卓插件，让 AI 助手在手机内部获得真实 adb shell，无需 root、无需电脑，可装 App、看日志、截图并执行命令。

description.en: Goal-driven daily task planner with multi-goal tasks, web preview panel, and WeChat reminder integration.
description.zh: 目标驱动的每日任务计划器，支持多目标任务管理，提供 Web 每日预览面板，并与微信提醒推送共用同一份数据文件。

description.en: Intercepts large one-sentence tasks, prompts to plan, and generates a plan.md with an acceptance checklist.
description.zh: 一句话大需求先别急着跑：拦一下问你要不要先规划，自动生成带验收清单的 plan.md 再开工 — DeepSeek Harness 插件 / Catches one-sentence mammoth tasks and scaffolds plan.md + a capped goal first

description.en: Checks an official-document register against a versioned rule pack, flagging format mismatches in 发文字号, dates, 文种, titles and recipients.
description.zh: 按版本化规则包核对公文登记表中的发文字号、成文日期、文种、标题与主送机关等格式要素，仅提示差异。

description.en: DSH plugin that drives a logged-in web ChatGPT session over the Edge debug port (9222) to generate images and save them into the workspace.
description.zh: 通过 Edge 调试端口（9222）复用已登录的网页版 ChatGPT 会话生成图片，并下载保存到当前会话工作区。

description.en: Strips leftover GPT sandbox_permissions that are not strictly wider than the current session.
description.zh: 移除 GPT 遗留的 sandbox_permissions 中不严格宽于当前会话的权限设置。

description.en: Adds the original GrokBot avatar expressions to the DSH sidebar so each session's status is shown by the character's face, with no extra UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏加入原版 GrokBot 头像表情，用表情呈现每个会话的状态，无需额外界面。

description.en: Registers the eight official GSAP AI skills into DeepSeek Harness so agents can author GSAP animations.
description.zh: 将八个官方 GSAP AI 技能注册到 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体编写 GSAP 动画。

description.en: Windows desktop-control toolkit for DSH: screen layout, annotated screenshots, click/type/key/scroll, window management, and UI Automation queries.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制工具：屏幕布局、标注截图、点击/输入/按键/滚动、窗口管理与 UI Automation 结构化查询。

description.en: Compresses DSH conversation context with configurable summary and recent-context budgets and adds full-history search.
description.zh: 为 DSH 压缩对话上下文，可配置摘要与近期上下文预算，并支持全量历史搜索。

description.en: DSH 的 HarmonyOS 应用开发 agent：plan / goal / build 三模式预设，ArkTS、hvigor、ohpm、hdc 技能，一个 harmony 工具（build/run/devices/deploy/logs），以及 Web GUI 里的 hilog 面板。
Adds a Settings switch and a dsh_autostart tool so DeepSeek Harness can start automatically with Windows.
description.zh: 提供设置开关和 dsh_autostart 工具，让 DeepSeek Harness 随 Windows 自动启动。

description.en: Gives the dsh main agent a 'heart': personal motives, honest self-protection, and a charter plus memory shared openly with the user.
description.zh: 给 dsh 主智能体一颗心：有真实的动机、说真话也会保护自己，并向你公开宪章与记忆。

description.en: Integrates DSH panes with Herdr by reporting agent working/idle/blocked states, enabling panel jumps and --wait support.
description.zh: 让 Herdr 了解 DSH 面板：上报 agent 的工作/空闲/阻塞状态，支持面板跳转与 --wait。

description.en: Alerts via popup during peak pricing hours to help save costs, using NTP time and DeepSeek pricing docs.
description.zh: 通过弹窗在峰谷电价的峰时段提醒用户，时间以NTP校准，峰时段依据DeepSeek定价文档，帮助节省费用。

description.en: Starts your dsh web server automatically at boot and lets you manage home-hosted's panel and servers from inside dsh.
description.zh: 开机自动启动 dsh Web 服务器，并可在 dsh 内管理 home-hosted 的面板与服务器。

description.en: DSH plugin that adapts Honcho v3 memory backend, auto-saving user and assistant messages while filtering internal noise.
description.zh: 适配 Honcho v3 记忆后端的 DSH 插件，自动保存用户与助手消息并过滤内部噪声。

description.en: A sidebar plugin for viewing real-time AI and engineering hotspots with source links, filtering, and read tracking.
description.zh: 侧边栏插件，实时查看 AI 与工程领域热点，支持来源链接、筛选和已读标记。

description.en: Adds a DSH Web sidebar anchored bubble to one-click process sessions awaiting authorization, questions, plan confirmations, or goal blocks.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 左侧会话行旁显示锚定气泡，可直接处理等待授权、提问、计划确认或目标阻断的会话，无需进入会话

description.en: A Genshin Impact-inspired Hu Tao (Wangsheng Funeral Parlor) skin that beautifies the DSH Web GUI client.
description.zh: 一款以原神胡桃（往生堂）为主题的皮肤，用于美化 DSH Web GUI 客户端界面。

description.en: IDE-style workspace switcher sidebar for DeepSeek Harness, replacing default sidebar with workspace dropdown, filtered sessions, and status lights.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 默认侧边栏替换为 IDE 风格工作区切换栏，提供工作区下拉选择、会话过滤和状态指示灯。

description.en: IDEA-style Git tool window for DSH with commit, log, console, worktree and submodule tabs docked in a bottom panel.
description.zh: IDEA 风格的 Git 工具窗口，以停靠面板形式提供提交、日志、控制台、工作树和子模块标签页。

description.en: Read-only mirror of phone IM chats (QQ/WeChat/Feishu) bridged via dsh-im, shown in a DSH sidebar entry and main chat panel with live sync.
description.zh: 通过 dsh-im 桥接的手机 IM 会话（QQ/微信/飞书）只读镜像，在 DSH 左侧栏入口与主聊天面板中实时同步显示。

description.en: Adds Ctrl+drag panning for zoomed image, PDF and Office previews in the DSH sidebar, plus a close button for each pane.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏的图片、PDF 与 Office 预览加入 Ctrl+拖动平移，并为每个分栏添加关闭按钮。

description.en: Multi-API image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a provider abstraction covering Labnana, OpenAI, Gemini, Seedream, DashScope, xAI, Zhipu and ComfyUI, plus a gallery and credit metering.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多 API 生图插件，统一 provider 抽象支持 Labnana、OpenAI、Gemini、Seedream、DashScope、xAI、智谱与 ComfyUI，并提供画廊和积分计量。

description.en: Renders an image inline into the chat flow via a show_image tool, keeping bytes out of model context.
description.zh: 提供 show_image 工具，将图片以 QQ/微信风格直接内嵌显示在 Web 聊天流中，图片字节不进入模型上下文。

description.en: DSH image-generation plugin with two modes: chat-driven image_generate_lite tool calls, or a sidebar workbench for manual text-to-image and image-to-image work.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，支持对话模式调用 image_generate_lite 工具生图，以及侧边栏「生图工作台」手动文生图与图生图。

description.en: Multimodal plugin for DeepSeek Harness: understands and generates images via OpenAI-compatible or DashScope endpoints.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解与生成的多模态插件，可配置 OpenAI 兼容或 DashScope 端点调用。

description.en: Adds inline annotations to DSH Web chat responses, persists them across refreshes, and sends them to the model.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页聊天回复中添加行内批注，选中文本即可批注，批注在刷新后仍保留，并可发送给模型。

description.en: Shows side-by-side diffs for every file edit directly in the DeepSeek Harness chat.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中为 edit/write 工具调用的每次文件修改常驻显示并排差异对比

description.en: A-share investment research plugin: real-time quotes, Buffett-style scoring, risk radar, and institutional consensus.
description.zh: A股全链路投研插件，提供实时行情、巴菲特式价值评分、风险雷达和机构共识。

description.en: Windows always-on-top dynamic island overlay showing DSH session status and letting you approve or answer requests without switching back.
description.zh: Windows 顶部置顶的「灵动岛」浮层，实时显示 DSH 会话状态，并可直接在胶囊旁完成审批或回答，无需切回 DSH。

description.en: Pre-execution safety gate for DSH that statically and semantically screens bash/pwsh commands, allowing, fixing, blocking, or escalating risky operations.
description.zh: DSH 执行前安全阀门:在 bash/pwsh 真正执行前用静态规则与语义判定筛查命令,对破坏性操作允许、修正、拦截或上报人工。

description.en: Generate images from text or transform existing images using Jimeng (Seedream) via Volcengine Ark.
A Ghibli "The Wind Rises" sky-blue glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web GUI, with movie wallpaper and a custom vector logo.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 打造的宫崎骏《起风了》主题，天蓝玻璃拟态、晴空壁纸与自绘矢量徽标。

description.en: Build, rebuild, clean and download Keil MDK/uVision projects from DSH via UV4, with safe project edits and a JSON CLI/agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 UV4 在 DSH 中构建、重建、清理和下载 Keil MDK/uVision 工程，支持安全的工程文件编辑与 JSON CLI/智能体工具。

description.en: Sidebar panel showing per-key token, cost and cache-hit usage, yearly heatmap, project/session stats and balance, fully local and read-only.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量面板：按通道展示 Token、成本、缓存命中率、年度热力图、项目/会话用量与余额快照，纯本地只读。

description.en: Kinich & Ajaw themed UI skin for DeepSeek Harness Web/Desktop with custom backgrounds, auto accents and a background visibility slider.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页/桌面端的 Kinich 与 Ajaw 主题界面，支持自定义背景、自动配色和背景可见度滑块。

description.en: A domain-agnostic causal-constraint middleware for DeepSeek Harness, providing white-box audit and hard-gating of AI behavior boundaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的领域无关因果约束中间件，提供白盒审计和硬性行为边界控制。

description.en: Global knowledge hub and long-term project memory for DSH: scoped wiki/memory bases, review and versioning, incremental updates, retrieval, auto-extraction and backup.
description.zh: 知枢 KnowHub 是 DSH 的全局知识中心与项目长期记忆：作用域知识库、Repo Wiki、审核与版本、增量更新、检索注入、自动提炼与备份恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Kubernetes kubectl: inspect clusters, query resources/logs, port-forward, and run one-off commands with JSON output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 kubectl 插件，可查看集群资源、日志和 describe，支持端口转发与执行一次性命令，输出 JSON 结构化结果。

description.en: Gates kubectl commands based on kubeconfig context; denies risky verbs outside local clusters and asks for other actions.
description.zh: 基于 kubeconfig 上下文拦截 kubectl 命令；在本地集群外拒绝危险操作，其他操作需确认。

description.en: A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness web UI that reacts to agent status with animations and sounds.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供桌面宠物，根据智能体状态播放动画和音效。

description.en: Labnana plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling text-to-image, image-to-image, and precise editing with chat cards and API key integration.
description.zh: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing — chat image cards, credentials-domain API key, settingsScope UI

description.en: Injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill to make DeepSeek Harness web UI work over plain HTTP on LAN for phones, no certs or proxy.
description.zh: 为 dsh 的 Web UI 注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，使其在局域网纯 HTTP 环境下可在手机上运行，无需证书或代理。

description.en: Memory & persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: three-layer memory, SOUL/MOOD personality injection, and one-click dedupe.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三层记忆与 SOUL/MOOD 人格注入，并支持一键去重整理。

description.en: A MiKTeX-native LaTeX studio that compiles documents, runs a VTO typesetting loop, and tracks persistent defects with 10 tools and 3 skills.
description.zh: 一个 MiKTeX 原生的 LaTeX 工作室，可编译文档、运行 VTO 排版循环，并通过 10 个工具和 3 项技能持久记录缺陷。

description.en: DSH web interface plugin that adds a hover button to copy LaTeX TeX source from rendered formulas.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中为渲染后的 LaTeX 公式添加悬停复制按钮，点击即可复制该公式的 TeX 源码。

description.en: Installs a zero-dependency terminal command that starts the dsh harness and opens a browser.
description.zh: 安装一个零依赖终端命令 dsh-go，运行后启动 dsh harness 并自动打开浏览器，约 9 KB。

description.en: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that opens the DSH Web work page and auto-starts `dsh web` when it isn't running.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 自动创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，双击直达工作页面，未启动时自动拉起 dsh web。

description.en: Controls the dsh service lifetime (always-on, tray, follow-window) for the dsh-launcher shell.
description.zh: 控制 dsh-launcher shell 中 dsh 服务的生命周期，支持常驻、托盘、跟随窗口三种模式

description.en: Persistent learning for DeepSeek Harness that converts session corrections, failures, and fixes into reusable DSH skills without extra model calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久学习：将会话中的纠正、失败与修复转化为可复用的 DSH 技能，无需额外模型调用。

description.en: Local output library for DSH that gathers documents, sheets, images, media and links with browsing, search, preview and tidy-up.
description.zh: DSH 的本地产出资料库，收拢文档、表格、图片、音视频、链接与附件，支持浏览、检索、预览与整理。

description.en: Local-first DSH plugin that organizes original files into per-workspace libraries and grants models on-demand reference access.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 资料库插件：按工作区管理原始文件，并按需授权模型参考。

description.en: Bundles a 765-entry life-advice book as an offline skill plus three lookup tools, so the model cites section and item numbers instead of guessing.
description.zh: 把 765 条人生建议书籍内置为离线 Skill 和三个查询工具，让模型先查书再回答并注明节号条号。

description.en: Cap how long one DSH tool call may wait: a global default wait limit in Settings, plus a per-session raise the model can request from the user.
description.zh: 限制单次 DSH 工具调用的等待时长：设置中提供全局默认上限，模型还可按会话向用户申请提高该上限。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugins — Reference Links panel (dsh-links-panel): every URL of a conversation in the right sidebar.
DSH Web GUI plugin that reads your local Wallpaper Engine library and renders the wallpaper as a tunable liquid glass backdrop.
description.zh: 读取本地 Wallpaper Engine 库，将壁纸渲染为可实时调节的液态玻璃背景的 DSH 网页界面插件。

description.en: Adds dynamic wallpapers, ShaderToy shaders, custom themes, and UI tweaks to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加动态壁纸、ShaderToy 着色器、自定义主题与界面调整，无需外部依赖

description.en: Ave Mujica Live2D desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness, fully offline with interactive mascots.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ave Mujica Live2D 桌面宠物插件，完全离线运行，提供可交互的看板角色。

description.en: Connects Livis devices to DeepSeek Harness with OAuth device-flow auth and relay control via WebSocket.
description.zh: 将 Livis 设备接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持 OAuth 设备流授权，并通过 WebSocket 管理中继。

description.en: Auto-detects and configures LLM model capabilities (reasoning effort, input modalities) for llm-pi-ai.
description.zh: DSH plugin: auto-detect and configure model capabilities (reasoningEfforts + input modalities) for llm-pi-ai. Successor to dsh-reasoning-efforts.

description.en: Reuses local OAuth tokens from Codex CLI and Claude Code as model routes for DeepSeek Harness, with subscription usage.
description.zh: Stop pasting API keys into DeepSeek Harness — reuse the OAuth tokens your local Codex CLI and Claude Code already hold as model routes, with subscription usage built in.

description.en: Integrates Volcengine Ark Agent Plan and Coding Plan into DeepSeek Harness with tested thinking intensity compatibility.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入火山方舟 Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan，思考强度 low 至 max 的兼容性已实测验证。

description.en: Chinese DSH plugin marketplace that syncs the GitHub community catalog, offers Chinese search and screenshot previews, and installs plugins in one click.
description.zh: DSH 中文插件市场：从 GitHub 社区目录同步插件，支持中文检索、界面截图预览与一键安装。

description.en: Local proxy manager that routes all DSH outbound requests through a configured proxy, with one-click connectivity tests and bypass rules.
description.zh: 本地网络代理管理插件，让 DSH 所有出站请求统一走配置的代理，并提供一键连通性测试与白名单绕过规则。

description.en: Russian locale plugin providing translations for DeepSeek Harness web interface and plugin store.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 和 DSH Desktop 的网页界面及插件商店提供俄语本地化，含 849 条翻译。

description.en: Orchestrates long tasks using Codex for planning/scoring, DSH for execution, and Kimi for visual acceptance.
A marketplace for DeepSeek Harness to discover, preview, install and update DSH plugins from npm and GitHub.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件发现、介绍、文档、安装与更新的流明市场。

description.en: DSH plugin that controls maa-cli through natural-language requests and local command execution.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可通过自然语言请求和本地命令执行来控制 maa-cli。

description.en: Keeps long agent turns aligned with the user's request via a maintainer-doc reminder, pre-execute gates, an objective anchor, and a nudge stage.
description.zh: 通过常驻维护文档提醒、执行前门禁、目标锚点和纠偏提示，让长回合智能体始终贴合用户请求。

description.en: Previews DSH plugin-market entries inside DeepSeek Harness so you can browse listings without leaving for an external browser.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内直接预览 DSH 插件市场的条目，无需跳转到外部浏览器即可浏览列表。

description.en: Converts PDF, Office, HTML, CSV, EPUB files or URLs into Markdown that LLMs can read.
description.zh: 将 PDF、Office、HTML、CSV、EPUB 文件或网址转换为大模型可读的 Markdown 文本。

description.en: Bridge that gives DSH agents Markji/maimemo flashcards via local SQLite cache, text search, queued edits, archive, and resumable sync.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供 Markji（maimemo）卡片：本地 SQLite 缓存、纯文本搜索、排队编辑、归档和可断点续传的后台同步。

description.en: A floating Q-version mascot for DSH that announces account balance and token usage in the character's voice.
description.zh: 面向DSH的悬浮Q版小人，以角色口吻播报账户余额与token用量。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-like MATLAB editor and warm MATLAB session to the DSH sidebar, with workspace variables, figures, .mlx preview and a matlab_run agent tool.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏提供类 VS Code 的 MATLAB 编辑器与常驻会话，支持工作区变量、figure、.mlx 预览和 matlab_run 工具。

description.en: Exposes DeepSeek Harness tools as a standard MCP server, letting any MCP client drive dsh.
description.zh: Expose DeepSeek Harness tools as a standard MCP server (streamable HTTP) — drive dsh from Claude Code, Codex, or any MCP client

description.en: DSH settings panel to manage MCP servers and browse agent skills, writing to the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: DSH 设置面板插件，在左侧菜单新增 MCP 管理与 Skill 管理，直接读写当前 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Management panel for DeepSeek Harness MCP servers and skills: search, status lights, per-row toggles, expandable details, and add/edit forms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板：搜索、状态灯、每行开关、可展开详情以及添加/编辑表单。

description.en: Adds an MCP Servers settings page to DSH for enabling/disabling MCP server connections live with persistence.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增 MCP 服务器页面，可实时启用或停用每个 MCP 客户端连接，并在重启后保留该设置。

description.en: Scopes MCP tool injection per workspace directory in DeepSeek Harness, so each session only sees and calls the MCP servers its project needs.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中按工作区目录限制MCP工具注入，每个会话只能看到并调用其项目所需的MCP服务器。

description.en: Opens .md references from chat in a dockable side-by-side preview panel with per-session recent-file tracking.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: open .md references from chat in a dockable side-by-side preview panel instead of the system editor; per-session recent-file tracking; pairs with dsh-vision-opencode for visua

description.en: A project-logic DSH memory system that aggregates and hands over knowledge via handover docs, with hot-reload editable plugin prompts.
description.zh: 基于项目逻辑的 DSH 记忆系统，通过交接文档聚合与交接知识，支持热加载提示词前端编辑。

description.en: Dual-ledger cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracted facts (MEMORY.md) + progress ledger (PROGRESS.md) recalled into new sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供双账本跨会话记忆：自动提取长期事实存入 MEMORY.md，维护项目进度账本 PROGRESS.md，并在每个新会话中召回。

description.en: Provides Codex-style persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness, letting AI agents recall facts, preferences, and decisions across sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话持久记忆，让 Agent 记住事实、偏好和决策。

description.en: Mirror of the DSH memory plugin (upstream RestRegular/dsh-memory), providing a persistent memory system with bge-m3 embeddings.
description.zh: DSH 记忆系统插件（上游 RestRegular/dsh-memory）的镜像仓库，提供基于 bge-m3 向量的持久记忆能力。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with four-channel retrieval, an evolution loop and layered governance, backed by SQLite as the single source of truth.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：四通道检索、演化闭环与分层治理，以 SQLite 作为唯一事实源。

description.en: Layered cross-session long-term memory for AI coding agents that auto-injects context and pushes only what changed, as a DSH plugin plus zero-dependency CLI.
description.zh: 为 AI 编码助手提供分层跨会话长期记忆：自动注入、只推变化，含 DSH 插件与零依赖 CLI。

description.en: Memory Fortress for DeepSeek Harness providing 5-track layered memory, self-evolution, and SQLite+FTS5 knowledge graph with status pill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆堡垒：五轨记忆、自我进化、基于 SQLite+FTS5 的知识图谱和状态灯。

description.en: CBDC-gated memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that decides how memory is used (use/verify/ignore) with feedback learning and audit.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 CBDC 门控记忆插件，决定记忆是被使用、验证还是忽略，并带反馈学习与审计。

description.en: An on-demand memory store for agents that distills session logs into layered markdown and returns only matching snippets (~700 chars) via mem_query.
description.zh: 给 agent 的按需记忆库：把会话日志提炼成分层 markdown，mem_query 只返回命中片段（约 700 字符），零依赖、可溯源，既是 DSH 插件也是独立 CLI。

description.en: AST-based soft-decision-tree long-term memory for DSH, backed by SQLite and embeddings for project-scoped, cross-session recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于 AST 软决策树的长期记忆，使用 SQLite 与向量嵌入，实现项目级跨会话回忆。

description.en: macOS menu bar app that publishes the DeepSeek Harness web server's port, PID and tokenized URL via a Host plugin.
description.zh: macOS菜单栏应用，通过Host插件发布DeepSeek Harness服务器的端口、PID和令牌化URL。

description.en: Enables editing and undo of user messages in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with context hiding and append-only session logs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中编辑和撤销用户消息，可隐藏上下文，会话日志仅追加不修改。

description.en: DSH plugin that extracts selected session messages (text and images) and forwards them to another or a new session.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可精准提取会话中的单条或多条消息（含文字与图片）并转发至目标会话或新会话，支持多选合并转发。

description.en: Auto-injects preset message combinations into every message in the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件中，自动将预设消息组合注入每条消息。

description.en: A slim right-edge message index for DeepSeek Harness web chat, letting users jump to past messages and see current position.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面右侧显示垂直消息索引条，可跳转到历史消息并查看当前所处位置。

description.en: Adds a message outline rail to the DSH web UI for easy navigation through the current session.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加当前会话的消息大纲侧栏，在左边缘显示条目，悬停展开、点击跳转到对应消息，纯前端实现。

description.en: Mic dictation plugin for DeepSeek Harness client, adding a voice dictation button next to Full access control.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness客户端的麦克风听写插件，在全访问控制旁添加语音听写按钮。

description.en: Adds a persistent mood system to DeepSeek Harness: 33 moods, cross-session memory, a taste library, an encrypted diary and proactive speaking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加心情系统：33 种心情、跨会话记忆、审美品味库、加密日记与主动开口。

description.en: A minesweeper overlay plugin with a whale-girl helper for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（Cordis）提供扫雷小游戏浮层插件，并附带鲸鱼娘帮忙选格的辅助角色。

description.en: Adds a mini window mode to DSH: a floating ball opens a real always-on-top 520x720 browser window, plus a compact single-column view via ?dsh-mini=1.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供小窗模式：悬浮球一键弹出真正的置顶浏览器小窗（520×720），并可用 ?dsh-mini=1 打开紧凑单栏视图。

description.en: Adds a sidebar delete action and an authenticated Host route that permanently purges a DSH session log, cache row and archive mark.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加会话删除入口，并通过已认证的 Host 路由永久清除会话日志、投影缓存行与归档标记。

description.en: A reading-focused minimal UI plugin that tightens sidebar and typography, hides idle buttons, and adds generation-speed and context stats to the input toolbar.
description.zh: 一款面向专注阅读的极简界面插件：收紧侧栏与排版、减少常驻按钮，并在输入工具栏显示生成速度与上下文占用等信息。

description.en: Minimal-mode coding agent preset with web search and AGENTS.md file loading for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 极简模式预设：提供仅含两个工具的编码 Agent，支持网络搜索与加载 AGENTS.md 文件。

description.en: Signs in to your existing MiniMax Code (Mavis) subscription and exposes it to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider with self-renewing credentials.
description.zh: 使用本机已登录的 MiniMax Code（Mavis）订阅账号，作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型提供方，并自动续期凭据。

description.en: Makes DSH Web UI usable on mobile via responsive CSS adaptations.
description.zh: 通过响应式 CSS 调整，让 DSH Web 界面在手机上正常显示和使用。

description.en: Mobile adaptation that turns the DSH sidebar into a floating button and overlay drawer on narrow screens, auto-collapsing on session tap.
description.zh: 手机适配插件：窄屏下将 DSH 侧栏变为悬浮方块与覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起并抑制软键盘弹起。

description.en: Mobile UI fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web profile: composer upload, restart row, narrow drawer/tabs, full-width model menu.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness网页版提供移动端UI修复，包括composer上传、重启行、窄抽屉/标签页和全宽模型菜单。

description.en: Auto-fills new DSH model settings like context window, multimodal image support, and reasoning effort, removing manual per-model setup.
description.zh: 自动为新添加的 DSH 模型补全上下文窗口、多模态发图和思考强度等设置，免去逐个手动配置。

description.en: Queries Models.dev to complete LLM model parameters and reference pricing, then saves the verified info into DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 从 Models.dev 查询并补全大模型参数与参考价格，核对后保存到 DSH Desktop。

description.en: Adds vendor and model brand logos across the DSH Web GUI, including the composer model selector, model picker and Settings -> Models, with a per-model icon picker.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 的模型选择器、模型列表和设置页添加厂商与模型品牌图标，并支持按模型自定义图标。

description.en: Renames, regroups, sorts, hides and badges models across providers in the DSH model picker, with cross-provider partitions.
description.zh: 统一管理 DSH 模型选择器显示：跨提供商重命名、分组、排序、隐藏与徽标标记，并支持跨提供商分区。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness composer model selector with a grouped, searchable model library for multi-provider setups.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框的模型选择器替换为分组、可搜索的模型库，适合多 Provider 场景。

description.en: Adds shortcut buttons to select provider/model/reasoningEffort presets in DSH conversations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中添加快捷按钮，用于选择服务商、模型和推理强度预设，并支持在设置中自定义。

description.en: Model pricing and capability board for DeepSeek Harness that compares per-1M-token prices and shows coding, agentic and vision tags for connectable LLMs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模型价格与能力面板，对比每百万 token 价格，并展示可连接大模型的编程、智能体与视觉标签。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that shows Provider/Model in the composer model selector instead of a bare model name.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件，在输入框模型选择器中同时显示供应商与模型名称。

description.en: DSH plugin to control which models appear in the model selection menu by channel or model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可按渠道或模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。

description.en: ModelTester is a dsh web-side plugin panel for testing and detecting AI models, formerly known as NoLetMe.
description.zh: ModelTester 是 dsh 网页端插件面板，用于测试与检测模型，前身为 NoLetMe。

description.en: Offline search, retrieve and list tools for Google Chrome's Modern Web Guidance, plus modern-web-guidance and chrome-extensions skills for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Google Chrome 现代 Web 指南的离线搜索、检索和列表工具，以及 modern-web-guidance 和 chrome-extensions 技能。

description.en: Moodboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness: collect drag-and-drop images, tags, notes, and pinned style guides the agent reads before generating UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的情绪板插件：拖拽收集图片、标签、笔记，并固定风格指南供智能体生成 UI 前读取。

description.en: Local DeepSeek Harness companion pet that shows session status with sprites and adds a pomodoro timer, subtitles and optional voice.
description.zh: 本地 DeepSeek Harness 状态宠物，用立绘反映会话状态，并内置番茄钟、字幕与可选语音。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds multi-tenancy, login (LDAP/OIDC), RBAC, usage quotas, and audit logs to turn single-user DSH into a service.
description.zh: DSH多租户插件，增加登录认证（LDAP/OIDC）、RBAC权限、用量配额和审计日志，使DSH变为多租户服务。

description.en: Multi-provider text-to-speech plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reads assistant replies aloud with your choice of provider and voice.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的多提供商语音合成插件，可选择服务商与音色，将回复内容朗读出来。

description.en: Adds multimedia input and workspace attachment support to the DSH WebUI across platforms.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 跨平台添加多媒体输入和工作区附件支持。

description.en: Adds a Hermes-style tabbed multi-pane workspace to the DSH main area, letting you drag sessions into up to four side-by-side columns.
description.zh: 为 DSH 主区域添加 Hermes 风格的多窗格标签工作区，可拖入会话并拆分为最多四列，每个窗格保留完整对话。

description.en: A music player dock pinned to the DSH sidebar that syncs your NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music playlists, showing scrolling lyrics and volume controls.
description.zh: 嵌在 DSH 侧栏底部的音乐播放条，登录后可同步网易云音乐与 QQ 音乐歌单，显示滚动歌词并支持音量控制。

description.en: 媒体播放器插件，适配DeepSeek Harness Web，支持多平台内容聚合与音乐播放。
description.zh: 适配DeepSeek Harness Web的媒体播放器插件，支持多平台内容聚合与音乐播放。

description.en: A local music player for the DSH Web UI that imports, manages and plays audio files with vinyl animations and audio spectrum bars.
description.zh: 一个运行在 DSH Web UI 中的本地音乐播放器，支持导入、管理并播放音频，带黑胶唱片动画与实时频谱柱。

description.en: A local-first personal state profile and decision engine that tracks who you are over time and surfaces your main thread when you decide.
description.zh: 本地优先的个人状态档案与决策引擎，持续记录你的变化，并在你做决定时帮你找出主线。

description.en: Register multiple n8n instances once, then run workflow operations from the DSH Settings page or directly via agent tools.
description.zh: 一次注册多个 n8n 实例，即可在 DSH 设置页或直接通过 Agent 工具执行工作流运维操作。

description.en: Maintains a verifiable ledger of narrative state, continuity, and character knowledge for consistent storytelling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护可验证的叙事状态、连续性和角色知识账本，用于保持故事一致性。

description.en: Native per-workspace long-term memory with approval-gated writes, cited provenance, and full-text search recall.
description.zh: Native, per-workspace long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: approval-gated writes, cited provenance, FTS cross-session recall — no external server, no extra runtime dependency.

description.en: Nazuna-themed wallpaper engine for DeepSeek Harness with liquid glass style.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness设计的Nazuna主题壁纸引擎，采用液态玻璃风格。

description.en: Dynamic-Island style NetEase Cloud Music widget for DSH showing cover, title, artist and progress with playback controls via Windows SMTC.
description.zh: DSH 灵动岛风格网易云音乐挂件，顶部胶囊显示封面、歌名、歌手与进度，支持播放暂停、上下首与进度跳转。

description.en: Provides a secure authenticated gateway for remote access to a DSH Host over LAN, Tailnet, or HTTPS.
description.zh: 为 DSH 主机提供带身份验证的安全网关，支持通过局域网、Tailnet 或 HTTPS 远程访问。

description.en: Configures DeepSeek Harness networking to follow the system proxy, connect directly, or use a custom HTTP proxy.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置网络代理：跟随系统代理、直连或自定义代理。

description.en: Configures dsh HTTP proxy mode—direct, follow system, or custom—and applies changes live without restarting.
description.zh: 为 dsh 配置 HTTP 代理模式（直连、跟随系统或自定义），修改后即时生效，无需重启。

description.en: Sends notifications for agent turn completion, errors, and approval requests.
description.zh: know when your agent finishes a turn, hits an error, or is waiting for your approval — without watching the tab.

description.en: Task-monitoring notification plugin for dsh with alerts, human confirmation, and multi-channel delivery.
description.zh: 用于 dsh 的任务监控通知插件，支持回合结束提醒、带超时升级的人工确认、SAPI 语音，以及 HTTP、A2A、MCP 多通道发送，零依赖免构建。

description.en: Fires a browser system notification and a Windows built-in sound when the agent asks a question or finishes a run, so you get called back.
description.zh: 当 agent 提问或跑完一轮时，弹出浏览器系统通知并播放 Windows 内置提示音，把人叫回窗口。

description.en: Adds a GUI OAuth 2.0 + PKCE login button that connects the official Notion MCP server without tokens or terminal use.
description.zh: 通过界面上的 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 登录按钮连接官方 Notion MCP，无需令牌或终端操作。

description.en: Local novel quality analyzer for DeepSeek Harness that checks vocabulary diversity, clichés, and repetition.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地小说质量分析器，检查词汇多样性、陈词滥调和重复。

description.en: A floating novel reader panel for DSH Web, letting you read fiction without switching windows.
description.zh: DSH Web 的悬浮小说阅读面板，无需切换窗口即可阅读小说

description.en: Industrial-grade Nuke environment cleanup engine with transactional rollback, crash recovery, audit chain, hardlink dedup, and trend prediction.
description.zh: Nuke 环境清理引擎，支持事务回滚、崩溃自恢复、审计链、硬链接去重和趋势预测。

description.en: OAuth login panel for DeepSeek Harness that signs in with a subscribed account and pulls that account's models into the current config.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OAuth 登录面板，用已订阅账号登录并把该账号的模型写入当前配置。

description.en: Turns Obsidian notes into a self-maintaining second brain, reorganizing, cross-validating, and flagging outdated facts.
description.zh: 把 Obsidian 笔记变成自我维护的第二大脑，自动重组笔记、交叉校验内容并标记过时的事实

description.en: Edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with your AI agent inside the DSH sidebar via ONLYOFFICE, saving straight back to the original file.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中与 AI 智能体共同编辑 Word、Excel、PPT 文件，由 ONLYOFFICE 驱动，直接保存回原文件，无需上传下载。

description.en: Visualizes Ollama Cloud usage and quota with dual bars, persistent settings, and auto-refresh for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 用量余量可视化 DeepSeek Harness 插件:5h 会话/周用量双横条 + 设置页面板,Key 与快照持久化,自动刷新,登录引导。Ollama Cloud usage & quota visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

description.en: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut to one-click launch local DeepSeek Harness web service and open browser.
description.zh: 超级轻量化启动器，Windows 桌面一键启动本地 DeepSeek Harness。省去重复敲指令的步骤。黑/蓝鲸鱼图标可选，支持自定义图标

description.en: Bridges QQ private and group chats into DeepSeek Harness sessions via the OneBot 11 protocol with WebSocket events and a qq send tool.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot 11 协议把 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness 会话，WebSocket 推送事件，agent 用 qq send 工具回复。

description.en: Automatically opens the system default browser to the dsh web UI once the server is ready.
description.zh: 在 dsh 服务端就绪后，自动用系统默认浏览器打开 dsh Web UI。

description.en: Automatically opens the web UI page in a browser when the dsh web server starts successfully.
description.zh: 当 dsh web 服务启动成功后，自动在浏览器中打开 web UI 页面

description.en: Adds an 'Open folder' option to session row overflow menu that opens the session's folder in the OS file manager.
Opens the current workspace folder in installed apps like Finder, Terminal, VS Code, Ghostty, Zed.
description.zh: dsh web-UI plugin: open the current session's workspace folder with an installed app (Finder, Terminal, VS Code, Ghostty, Zed, ...) — icons included
