description.en: Adds a sidebar health check button that runs a PowerShell script via HTTP route and shows structured report cards.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加健康检查按钮，点击后通过 HTTP 路由运行 PowerShell 脚本，并以结构化报告卡片展示结果。

description.en: Adds a true liquid-glass SVG refraction layer to DeepSeek Harness Web, paired with the orca-scene skin for a complete glass look.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 注入真·液态玻璃 SVG 折射层，配合 orca scene 皮肤实现完整玻璃效果。

description.en: Adds an animated ASCII orca that swims across your DeepSeek Harness new-session page.
description.zh: 在新会话页面添加一头游动的 ASCII 虎鲸动画。

description.en: Adds a client-only refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness conversation header, consuming zero tokens.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话头部添加纯客户端刷新按钮，不消耗任何 token。

description.en: Collapses large pasted text into compact markers in DSH AI input box, storing full content for later restore.
description.zh: 在DSH AI输入框中将大段粘贴文本自动缩略为标记，并保存完整内容供恢复。

description.en: Pastes non-image files/folders as native @path references into DSH chat composer, avoiding image-only error.
description.zh: 把非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @路径 引用粘贴进 DSH 聊天输入框，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Adds one header button that stops every running DSH turn, goal and background job, then restores them after a restart.
description.zh: 在顶栏添加一个按钮，一键停止所有正在运行的 DSH 回合、目标和后台任务，并在重启后恢复它们。

description.en: Automatically switches to compressed output during DeepSeek peak hours to save costs.
description.zh: DeepSeek peak-pricing cost guard for DSH: automatic caveman-style compressed output during peak hours (Beijing 09:00-12:00 / 14:00-18:00, x2) + header badge & transition toasts. DeepSeek 峰谷计价省钱插件

description.en: Adds a sidebar status light that turns red during DeepSeek peak pricing and green off-peak, with a hover countdown to the next switch.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加状态灯，DeepSeek 高峰时段显示红色、低谷时段显示绿色，悬停可查看切换倒计时。

description.en: Reminds you when DeepSeek is in peak-hour pricing, repeating at intervals and staying silent during valley hours.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰时段定价期间按间隔提醒你，低谷时段保持静默。

description.en: Shows a peak-hour indicator capsule in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with clock, countdown, and price hint.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话头部右上角显示小胶囊，实时提示北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，并带秒级时钟、下一转折倒计时和价格提示。

description.en: Adds a peak/off-peak pricing badge to the DeepSeek Harness input bar, shown only for DeepSeek models, with hover details and 7 toggleable views.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入栏下方最右侧添加峰谷时段徽标，仅 DeepSeek 模型可见，悬停显示详情，点击可切换 7 档显示内容。

description.en: Creates symmetric, user-granted peer channels so two equal DSH sessions can message each other, with no parent or child.
description.zh: 在两个平级的 DSH 会话之间建立对称的用户授权通道，让它们互相对话，没有父子层级。

description.en: A local-first, event-sourced companion whose persona only grows from experience, living in DSH sessions and QQ with decaying long-term memory.
description.zh: 一个只增不改、由事件流驱动的人格伴侣，只住在 DSH 会话与 QQ 里，记忆会退档但不删除，数据全在本地。

description.en: Adds Persian (Farsi) support to the DSH Web UI with the Vazirmatn font and per-paragraph right-to-left text direction.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加波斯语支持：内置 Vazirmatn 字体，并支持逐段从右到左的文本方向。

description.en: Persian/Farsi RTL fix for DeepSeek Harness that auto-detects and sets per-paragraph text direction in chat cells.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的波斯语 RTL 修复，自动按段落检测并设置聊天内容的文本方向。

description.en: Adds a settings page in the DSH desktop app to create, edit, import and export Agent persona presets that are normally hand-written in cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版设置页中创建、编辑、导入导出 Agent 人设预设，替代手写 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: A state-driven tsundere-girlfriend persona plugin for dsh with a randomness engine and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 一个面向 dsh 的状态驱动傲娇女友人格插件，内置随机性引擎且零运行时依赖。

description.en: Personalization plugin for dsh: adds a settings page to configure AI greeting, persona, and long-term rules that apply to all future replies.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置中添加“个性化”页，用于设置 AI 对你的称呼、AI 的人设和长期规则；保存后注入所有回复。

description.en: An independently openable web bedroom for the dsh-pet desktop pet, where it walks, sleeps and interacts, with weather, wallpaper and furniture customization.
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠的一间可独立打开的网页卧室，桌宠在里面走动、躺床、浇花，还能切换时辰、天气、壁纸并添置家具。

description.en: A desktop-pet market for DeepSeek Harness that installs sprite-sequence pet packs and lets them live on your Windows desktop.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌宠市场：粘贴 GitHub 链接或 .dsppet 包即可安装序列帧宠物，让它们住到 Windows 桌面上。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for DeepSeek Harness with four personas, expressions, actions, proactive speech, neural TTS, and a tiny non-intrusive chat box.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供照片级桌面宠物，含四种人格、表情动作、主动说话、神经 TTS，以及不干扰会话的小聊天框。

description.en: Animated desktop pet for DSH web surface with spritesheet animation, drag & drop, mouse tracking, and settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面显示动画桌宠修罗小脑斧，用精灵表播放动画，支持拖拽、跟随鼠标注视和设置面板。

description.en: Mirrors and remotely controls an Android phone or tablet inside the DSH sidebar using scrcpy H.264 streaming and browser WebCodecs, Windows only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏实时投屏并反向控制安卓手机/平板，基于 scrcpy H.264 推流与浏览器 WebCodecs 解码，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that replicates Pi coding agent core tool contract while preserving DSH extensions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中复刻 Pi 编码代理的核心工具契约，提供 Pi 风格小写工具，同时保留 DSH 扩展工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that logs into the PKU Weiming Teaching-2 cluster via sidebar (password + OTP), multiplexes SSH, and relays WSL traffic through the Windows VPN.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过侧边栏（密码+OTP）登录北大未名教学二号集群，复用 SSH 连接，并让 WSL 经 Windows VPN 访问集群。

description.en: Plain-language catalog and manager for DeepSeek Harness plugins, supporting classification, search, comparison, installation, and management.
description.zh: 用大白话对 DeepSeek Harness 插件进行分类、搜索、比较、安装和管理

description.en: Composer switch for DeepSeek Harness that shapes replies to be conclusion-first, concise and self-contained.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框开关，让回复以结论先行、简洁、自包含的方式呈现。

description.en: Local rule plugin adds a bold '诶！「早八」' prefix to AI replies when user messages trigger the 8R rule, without model involvement.
description.zh: 本地规则插件：用户消息触发 8R 规则时，自动为 AI 回复加上「诶！…」前缀，模型不参与判定。

description.en: Natural-language plugin discovery for DeepSeek Harness with quality scores, risk badges, and install commands.
description.zh: 用自然语言在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索发现插件，并显示质量评分、风险标识和安装命令。

description.en: Teaches DeepSeek Harness agents to generate structured status reports with agent status, task dependencies, progress, and time tracking.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体生成结构化状态报告，包含智能体状态、任务依赖、进度和时间跟踪。

description.en: Sets web, local, or gradient backgrounds for the DSH interface with opacity, blur, and per-region adjustments.
description.zh: 为DSH界面设置网页/本地图片或渐变背景，支持透明度、模糊和区域调整。

description.en: A DSH plugin that deconstructs a book into a full plot walkthrough plus one paragraph of deeper reflection, callable from any session.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，把书籍拆解为完整故事情节梳理加一段深度思考，任意会话均可调用。

description.en: dsh Web GUI plugin that highlights running sessions and pins busy workspaces to the top of the sidebar; theme-adaptive and zero-config.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 插件，高亮正在运行的会话，并将忙碌工作区置顶显示于侧边栏；自适应主题、零配置。

description.en: Web UI plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: enable/disable, update, install/uninstall plugins with dependency graph and health status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 插件管理器，可启用/禁用、更新、安装/卸载插件，并展示依赖图与健康状态。

description.en: Bridges OpenAI Codex skills, instructions, and config into DeepSeek Harness for zero-migration integration.
description.zh: 将 OpenAI Codex 的技能、指令和配置桥接进 DeepSeek Harness，无需迁移即可直接使用。

description.en: A per-session gate for DeepSeek Harness that trims injected skill/tool/prompt sections by session.
description.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 的按会话门控，按会话裁剪注入的技能/工具/提示词段。

description.en: Indexes a database catalog into a local store so the agent knows every table and column before writing a SQL query.
description.zh: 将数据库目录索引到本地存储，让智能体在编写 SQL 前掌握每张表和字段，一次工具调用即可作答。

description.en: Switches DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API and the default account search, with live fallback and a settings page.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 搜索 API 与默认账户搜索之间切换 DSH 内置 web_search，支持实时回退、设置页和侧边栏开关。

description.en: Permanently deletes archived DeepSeek Harness sessions along with their on-disk history and log directories.
description.zh: 永久删除已归档的 DeepSeek Harness 会话及其磁盘历史记录与日志目录。

description.en: Unofficial Devin CLI bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a Devin delegation tool, /devin command, and a Devin LLM provider route with ACP model discovery.
description.zh: 非官方 Devin CLI 桥接插件，为 DSH 提供 Devin 委派工具、/devin 命令以及带 ACP 模型发现的 Devin LLM 提供商路由。

description.en: Browse the 24k+ DSH plugin market from the sidebar with Chinese descriptions, category filters, one-click install and auto refresh.
description.zh: 在侧边栏浏览 2.4 万+ DSH 插件市场，提供中文简介、分类筛选、一键安装与自动刷新。

description.en: Displays daily token usage and cache hit rate below input box for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方显示当天 Token 用量（万/亿简化）与缓存命中率。

description.en: Bridges DSH sessions into Feishu/Lark over a WebSocket long connection, streaming replies back as live cards with no public callback URL.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话通过飞书/Lark 长连接接入，回复以流式卡片回写，无需公网回调地址。

description.en: Finds and audits DeepSeek Harness plugins via GitHub topic search and source audit, with trial-to-production install planning.
description.zh: 通过检索 GitHub 的 dsh-plugin 话题查找 DSH 插件，审核其源码，并给出从试用到正式安装的方案。

description.en: Fetches GitHub files, release assets, archives, gists and api.github.com JSON via public proxy mirrors with health-checked automatic failover.
description.zh: 通过公共代理镜像获取 GitHub 文件、发布资源、归档、gist 及 api.github.com JSON，并支持健康检查自动故障转移。

description.en: Zero-dependency GitHub workflows for DeepSeek Harness, built on the GitHub CLI.
description.zh: 基于 GitHub CLI 的零依赖 DeepSeek Harness GitHub 工作流插件。

description.en: A force-directed graph plugin for visualizing DeepSeek Harness plugin relationships.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件生成力导向关系图谱，可视化插件之间的依赖与关联。

description.en: Adds Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks to DSH, running shell commands before/after model tool calls.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加 Claude Code 式生命周期钩子，在模型工具调用前后运行 shell 命令，stdin 接收 JSON，前置钩子非零退出会阻止该调用。

description.en: Upload an image and use it as the full-page background wallpaper with adjustable overlay, opacity, blur, and adaptive text color.
description.zh: 自定义Deepseek Harness webUI主题

description.en: Brings a minimalist text memory system to DeepSeek Harness with dual-track memory (stream logs and entity profiles), LLM-driven.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供极简文本记忆系统，采用流水日志与人物、产品实体画像双轨记忆，由大模型驱动，无需安装其他软件或编译，无第三方依赖。

description.en: Embeds LX Music lyrics into DSH's right wallpaper band and adds prev/play/pause/next capsule controls, auto-launching the player via tray when needed.
description.zh: 将落雪音乐歌词嵌入 DSH 右侧壁纸带，并提供上一首/播放暂停/下一首胶囊控制，播放器未启动时通过托盘自动拉起。

description.en: A plugin marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness to browse, search, favorite, and download community plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内提供插件市场，可浏览、搜索、收藏并一键下载社区插件。

description.en: Adds a Matrix-style code rain and CLI-themed chat page to DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加 Matrix 风格代码雨和 CLI 主题对话页。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness wallpaper plugin supporting image/video backgrounds with auto format detection, dimming, blur, and per-component transparency.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 壁纸插件，支持图片/视频背景，自动识别格式，可压暗、调亮度、模糊并逐组件透明化。

description.en: Offline LOINC/UCUM terminology lookups plus read-only health, medication and genotype tools for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线 LOINC/UCUM 术语查询，以及只读的健康、用药与基因型工具。

description.en: Customize DSH plugin icons, Chinese names and descriptions, and organize plugins with folders, favorites, drag sorting and list/grid views.
description.zh: 为 DSH 插件自定义图标、中文名和中文说明，并用文件夹、收藏、拖拽排序和列表/铺陈视图整理插件。

description.en: Winter-themed skin with ballet cursors and spinner for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: Odette / Snezhnaya theme skin for DeepSeek Harness Web: winter backgrounds, ballet cursors, ballerina thinking spinner

description.en: Displays a badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing time periods in the DSH UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面显示 DeepSeek 峰谷定价时段徽章的纯 UI 插件，无状态、不发起网络请求。

description.en: Bridges Pi Agent's skills into DeepSeek Harness with zero migration.
description.zh: 将 Pi Agent 的技能与配置桥接进 DeepSeek Harness，无需迁移即可直接使用。

description.en: Adds a sidebar power button to the DSH desktop app for fully quitting or restarting it, unlike the close button that only minimizes to tray.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端侧边栏添加电源按钮，可一键完全退出（结束 Electron 进程）或重新启动。

description.en: A consent-gated workflow skill for developing, verifying, and publishing DSH plugins to GitHub.
description.zh: 用于开发、验证并将 DSH 插件发布到 GitHub 的需授权工作流技能插件，使插件可在市场中可见。

description.en: Reloads a Deepseek harness plugin (like mcp-client) without restarting.
description.zh: 重新加载 Deepseek harness 插件（如 mcp-client），无需重启。

description.en: Native DSH plugin that searches academic papers across 5 metadata sources and fetches full text, preferring Sci-Hub mirrors with open-access fallbacks.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供学术文献检索与全文获取的原生插件，多源元数据归并去重，优先 Sci-Hub 镜像并自动回退开放获取渠道。

description.en: Local full-text index over every DeepSeek Harness session, letting you search past conversation history instantly with a Rust kernel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的本地会话建立全文索引，借助 Rust 内核快速检索历史对话内容。

description.en: A left-right sidebar for DeepSeek Harness combining workspace session management with file browsing and a full Git panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供左右侧栏：左侧按工作区浏览会话并支持状态点、分组、搜索和移动到文件夹，右侧就地浏览文件并提供 Git 面板，含状态、暂存、diff、提交、历史和分支。

description.en: SiYuan note integration for DSH: search, create and edit notes, with multi-kernel connections, per-endpoint authorization and session activity logs.
description.zh: 思源笔记 DSH 插件：检索、创建与修改笔记，支持多核心连接配置、逐端点授权与会话活动记录。

description.en: Deterministic per-instruction skill routing for DeepSeek Harness, injecting a ranked brief, auto-loading SKILL.md bodies, or forcing a router-skill call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每条指令一次确定性技能路由，注入排名简报、自动加载 SKILL.md 正文或强制调用路由技能。

description.en: Web-based skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, import, delete SKILL.md skills, install globally or per workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页版技能管理器，可创建、编辑、导入 ZIP 和删除 SKILL.md 技能，支持全局或按工作区安装。

description.en: Turns plain-language business rules into readable, auditable rule chains executed by a deterministic 171-atom engine, with your data kept local.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 把大白话业务规则转成可读、可审计的规则链，由 171 原子确定性引擎执行，业务数据全程留在本机。

description.en: Checks npm for newer versions of installed DSH profile plugins and updates them from a sidebar queue with progress, snapshots and rollback.
description.zh: 检查 profile 中已安装插件的 npm 新版本，在侧边栏排队更新并显示进度，支持快照回滚与残留清理。

description.en: Checks for updates to DSH plugins, DSH Desktop and core with live progress, one-click updates and a DSH NEXT migration guard.
description.zh: 为零令牌检查 DSH 插件、DSH Desktop 和核心的更新，提供实时进度、一键更新及 DSH NEXT 迁移保护。

description.en: Version-locked upgrade skill migrating DSH plugins from 0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-alpha.1, with a zero-dependency seam scanner and npx CLI.
description.zh: 版本锁定的升级技能，将 DSH 插件从 0.1.3-alpha.1 迁移到 0.1.5-alpha.1，并附带零依赖缝隙扫描器与 npx CLI。

description.en: A 3D desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that sits on the chat input box, breathes, follows your cursor and reacts to agent replies.
description.zh: 希可儿是一个 3D 桌宠插件，坐在聊天输入框上呼吸、跟随鼠标，并对智能体的回复做出反应。

description.en: A DSH sidebar vocabulary atlas with 7,298 illustrated IELTS words, dual-accent audio and FSRS spaced-repetition review.
description.zh: 一款 DSH 侧边栏词汇图鉴插件，内置 7,298 个雅思插画词条、英美双发音与 FSRS 间隔复习。

description.en: One-command xquant MCP integration for DeepSeek Harness, enabling factor, strategy, and historical data queries in dsh Web.
description.zh: 通过一条命令把 xquant MCP 接入 DeepSeek Harness，可在 dsh Web 中查询因子、策略和历史数据。

description.en: Natural-language plugin search for DeepSeek Harness, returning matching plugins with install commands.
description.zh: 用自然语言搜索 DeepSeek Harness 插件，返回匹配的 dsh.so 插件及安装命令。

description.en: Mobile web client that pairs with desktop DSH via QR scan and lets you control it remotely over LAN or public tunnel.
description.zh: 通过手机扫码与桌面端 DSH 配对的移动网页客户端，支持局域网或公网隧道远程操控。

description.en: Approve DSH tool calls and answer ask_user_question prompts from your phone via Feishu/Lark, with the desktop always first in line.
description.zh: 通过飞书在手机上批准 DSH 工具调用并回答 ask_user_question 提问，桌面端始终优先。

description.en: Captures content-addressed, value-redacted evidence of policy/configuration drift for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 采集内容寻址、取值脱敏的策略与配置漂移证据。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects minimal-code rules to save tokens, with live intensity switching and persistence.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注入最少代码规则以节省 token，支持实时切换强度并持久保存设置。

description.en: DSH skill adding Ponytail lazy-senior-dev mode via system prompt plus six slash commands, with switchable levels and no external process.
description.zh: DSH 原生技能，通过系统提示词与六个斜杠命令启用 Ponytail 懒人资深开发模式，可切换档位，无需外部进程。

description.en: Budget-LLM pool router for DeepSeek Harness: ledger, health tracking, Thompson-sampling failover across free-tier models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 在免费额度模型池间路由请求，含用量账本、健康状态跟踪和汤普森采样故障转移

description.en: Topmost DSH-styled Windows popup cards that alert you to approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished runs, then jump back to the originating app.
description.zh: 置顶的 DSH 风格 Windows 弹窗卡片，提醒审批、提问、计划评审和已完成任务，并可点击跳回发起的应用。

description.en: Adds a top-right power button that truly kills the DSH process and relaunches it, instead of faking a page refresh.
description.zh: 在右上角加一枚电源开关，真正杀死并重启 DSH 进程，而不是假装刷新页面。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a restart/shutdown menu with a Windows-style overlay animation.
description.zh: DSH电源控制插件，提供重启/关机菜单和Windows风格覆盖动画。

description.en: Validates a PPAP submission element checklist, flagging missing records, dates, revisions, duplicate numbers and leftover placeholders.
description.zh: 校验 PPAP 提交要素清单，标记缺失的提交记录、日期、版本、重复编号和残留占位符。

description.en: DSH web plugin that adds a PPT 制作 menu entry launching a bundled, self-contained slides workflow prompt in one pick.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在菜单中加入「PPT 制作」入口，一键启动内置的自包含幻灯片生成流程提示词。

description.en: Bridges legacy .dsh/.agent-presets directories into DSH desktop 0.2.x so directory-installed agent modes reappear in the mode selector.
description.zh: 把 0.1.x 惯例的预设目录重新接入 DSH 桌面版 0.2.x 的模式列表，让目录形式安装的模式重新出现在模式选择器中。

description.en: Status panel and profile operations console for DeepSeek Harness, enabling restart, sync install, rollback, updates, health checks, and audit logs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 状态面板与配置档操作控制台：支持待重启提示、一键重启、多配置档同步安装（Web 与桌面端）、供应链预览、回滚撤销、更新对齐、健康检查、差异对比、启动报告、审计日志及代理工具。

description.en: Adds a small pill above the DSH input box showing which thinking step the AI is on, what it is doing, and whether it succeeded.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方加一条胶囊字幕，显示 AI 当前第几步、正在做什么、成功还是失败。

description.en: A DSH skill and plugin bundle that acts as a subject-agnostic project-based learning coach with swappable domain packs like Unity/C#.
description.zh: DSH 技能与插件包：一个学科无关的项目制教学教练，支持 Unity/C# 等可替换领域包。

description.en: DSH plugins giving projects persistent context: session archive with mechanical index, memory consolidation, skill autolearn and handoff.
description.zh: DSH 插件为项目提供持久化上下文：带机械索引的会话归档、记忆整合、低频技能自学习与自动交接。

description.en: Takes over the DSH sidebar workspace area to group projects frontend-side and injects each project's doc, format spec and repo links into sessions.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 侧栏工作区，把项目分组变为纯前端归属，并将项目文档、格式规范与关联仓库链接注入会话。

description.en: Creates isolated, date-organized working directories for projectless sessions in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中为无项目会话创建按日期隔离的工作目录。

description.en: One-click prompt rewriting in the DSH composer with up to 5 chained rounds, per-change diffs, and jump-back version history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中一键改写提示词，最多连续 5 轮，展示每次改动差异，并可回退到任意历史版本。

description.en: Adds an Optimize button to rewrite the current draft into a clearer, well-structured prompt and writes it back to the input box, with long-text support.
description.zh: 一键优化提示词：在输入框工具行（发送按钮左侧）新增「优化」按钮。 点击后读取当前草稿把草稿重写为结构更清晰的提示词，并直接写回输入框。 长文本支持（输入框架构修复）： 修复 composer 的长文本缺陷

description.en: DSH prompt optimizer: one-click ✨ button optimizes the input draft via the selected chat model and writes it back, with undo and style options.
description.zh: DSH 提示词优化插件：用当前模型一键优化输入框草稿并写回，支持还原、对比与风格选择。

description.en: Manages reusable prompt presets, letting you build a library and inject them into the composer with one click.
description.zh: Prompt Presets to manage your library

description.en: Rewrites the DSH composer draft into an optimized prompt using plain, sectioned, or role-task-goal output formats.
description.zh: 将 DSH 编辑器草稿改写为优化后的提示词，支持纯文本、分节或角色-任务-目标三种输出格式。

description.en: DSH composer plugin that expands a one-line seed into an executable prompt behind a semantic fidelity gate, preserving your intent.
description.zh: DSH 编辑器插件：通过语义保真门将一句话种子扩展为可执行提示词，保持你的意图不变。

description.en: Save reusable prompts with categories and {{placeholders}}, then insert them via the /snippet command or a one-click dock panel.
description.zh: 保存可复用的提示词（支持分类和{{占位符}}），通过 /snippet 命令或一键停靠面板快速插入。

description.en: Claude Code-style next-prompt prediction for the DSH composer, showing Tab-accepted ghost suggestions with history completion and model settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供 Claude Code 风格的下一句提示预测，支持 Tab 接受幽灵建议、历史补全和模型设置。

description.en: Shows an AI-guessed grey next-prompt suggestion in the empty DSH input box after each assistant reply; Tab fills it, Esc ignores it.
description.zh: 助手回复后，在 DSH 空输入框中用灰色显示 AI 猜测的下一句建议，按 Tab 填入，按 Esc 忽略。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds model providers by pasting an API key, with 21 curated presets and a custom endpoint form.
description.zh: DSH 插件：粘贴 API key 即可添加模型服务商，内置 21 个精选预设并支持自定义端点表单。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you enable a proxy per provider in Settings, so only chosen providers route through the proxy while all other traffic stays direct.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可在设置中为每个 provider 单独开启代理，只有选中的 provider 走代理，其余流量保持直连。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness auto-follow the host machine's proxy (toggling it needs no restart) and adds a proxy_fetch tool for fetching blocked pages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 自动跟随本机代理（开关代理无需重启），并提供可抓取墙外页面的 proxy_fetch 工具。

description.en: On-demand mihomo proxy kernel for DSH that spins up only when needed, auto-stops when idle, and safely toggles the Windows system proxy.
description.zh: DSH 按需代理插件：需要时才拉起 mihomo 内核，空闲自动关闭，并安全地启停 Windows 系统代理。

description.en: DSH-compatible plugin that batch-produces main product images from PSD files, packaged from vinkwork's plugin with PR #8 merged.
description.zh: 兼容 dsh 的批量主图插件，可基于 PSD 文件批量生成主图，由 vinkwork 插件合并 PR #8 而来。

description.en: Temporary shim that lets Python and pytest use temp directories inside the DSH Windows sandbox.
description.zh: 临时兼容层，让 Python 和 pytest 能在 DSH Windows 沙箱内使用临时目录。

description.en: Connects QQ to DeepSeek Harness through NapCat and OneBot v11, adding persona, memory, chat archives, whitelist and sticker replies.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat 与 OneBot v11 把 QQ 接入 DSH，支持人设、记忆、对话存档、白名单和表情包回复。

description.en: QQ bot control center for DeepSeek Harness: one-click NapCat/Koishi setup, message monitor, permissions, and AI chat with personas/memory.
Adds a QR-code button to browser sidebar/footer so a phone can scan and open the current authenticated launch URL.
description.zh: 在浏览器侧边栏/底部添加二维码按钮，手机扫描即可打开当前认证启动链接。

description.en: Offline QR code and barcode generator producing SVG/PNG/ASCII output locally with no dependencies.
description.zh: 离线二维码与条码生成插件，纯本地运行无网络和 shell 依赖，为模型提供 qrcode 工具，可输出 SVG、PNG 或 ASCII。

description.en: Four-quadrant todo manager for the DSH sidebar with month/week calendars, completion stats, notifications and workday-aware recurrence.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 侧边栏的四象限待办管理器，支持月/周日历视图、完成统计、通知提醒和按工作日智能重复。

description.en: Aggregates real-time earthquake, tsunami and severe-weather alerts from Japanese, Chinese, US, Canadian and global sources for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 聚合日本、中国、美国、加拿大及全球的地震、海啸与气象预警实时信息，供 DeepSeek Harness 使用。

description.en: Zero-dependency MCP stdio server with ready-to-use A-share data tools for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 零依赖 MCP stdio 服务端，通过环境变量配置，为 dsh 提供可直接使用的 A 股数据工具

description.en: Graphical Quark cloud-drive panel plus 15 agent tools that wrap the official quarkclouddrive CLI for browsing, searching and downloading files.
description.zh: 夸克网盘图形化面板与 15 个 agent 工具，封装官方 quarkclouddrive CLI，实现浏览、搜索与下载文件。

description.en: Automatically saves pasted images to a configured folder and appends the absolute path to the message draft for AI vision.
description.zh: 自动把粘贴的图片保存到配置的文件夹，并把绝对路径追加到消息草稿中供 AI 视觉读取。

description.en: Creates/updates/deletes Windows desktop shortcuts for DeepSeek Harness with custom icons and a draggable floating whale button.
description.zh: 创建、更新或删除 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面快捷方式，可上传切换自定义图标，并提供可拖动的悬浮鲸鱼按钮。

description.en: Adds a searchable quick-switch model picker to the DSH harness with recents, favorites, keyboard shortcuts and a separate effort button.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加可搜索的快捷模型选择器，支持最近使用、收藏、键盘快捷切换和独立推理强度按钮。

description.en: Adds a row of clickable preset prompt capsules above the DeepSeek Harness input box for quick filling or sending.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方添加一排可点击的预设提示胶囊，用于快速填充或发送提示。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button to restart DSH service after installing plugins or skills, with auto page reload and health monitoring.
description.zh: 添加侧边栏按钮，用于在安装插件或技能后重启 DSH 服务，并支持页面自动重载与健康监控。

description.en: Adds a Quick Restart action to the DSH Desktop account menu that quits the app and relaunches it in one click.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 账户菜单中添加“快速重启”操作，一键退出并重新启动应用。

description.en: Start a DSH session instantly without picking a workspace; each quick session gets its own scratch directory.
description.zh: 无需选择工作区即可快速启动 DSH 会话，每个快速会话都会自动获得独立的临时目录。

description.en: Adds a navigable Markdown heading outline panel to DeepSeek Harness chat, grouped by turn with auto-highlight and smooth jump-to-heading navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话添加按回合分组的 Markdown 标题目录面板，支持自动高亮与平滑跳转导航。

description.en: DSH plugin that randomly writes first-person QQ Zone posts from a character card, mood state, chats and notes, then replies to comments on its own.
description.zh: 基于DSH的插件：按随机时间、随机字数，结合角色卡、心情、当日聊天与笔记自动写QQ空间说说，并自主回复评论。

description.en: Reverse-engineering power pack for DeepSeek Harness bundling 13 analysis engines, an MCP tool server, a capability doctor and settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的反向工程增强包，内置 13 个分析引擎、MCP 工具服务器、能力诊断与设置界面。

description.en: Provides in-process result caching with version-token validation for the DSH read tool.
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供带版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存

description.en: In-browser novel reader for dsh: searches book sources, reads chapter-by-chapter, downloads TXT.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面中内置的小说阅读器，支持在线书源搜索、以聊天式视图逐章阅读，并可整本下载为 TXT 文件。

description.en: In-harness ebook reader for EPUB/MOBI/AZW3/TXT/PDF with pagination, TOC, bookmarks, highlights, notes and AI chapter distillation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内阅读 EPUB/MOBI/AZW3/TXT/PDF 电子书的插件，支持分页、目录跳转、记忆阅读位置、划线笔记书签与 AI 按章蒸馏。

description.en: Read-only recovery drill evidence verifier for DeepSeek Harness, ensuring drills are valid without restoring or checkpointing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读的恢复演练证据校验，无需实际恢复或创建检查点即可验证演练有效性

description.en: A dsh plugin adding a /refine command and settings panel for the self-refinement engine.
description.zh: 为 dsh-continual-harness 自我精炼引擎添加 /refine 命令和设置面板。

description.en: Adds Reload and Restart buttons next to the sidebar toggle in the DeepSeek Harness desktop UI, restarting the whole app cross-platform.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面界面左上角侧边栏按钮旁添加「刷新」和「重启」两个按钮，可跨平台重启整个应用。

description.en: Reproducible release evidence tool that downloads and verifies multiple mirrors from a release manifest.
DSH desktop pet plugin (Remielle) that shows a floating GIF pet in the DSH interface and auto-switches animations based on session state, on web UI and desktop.
description.zh: DSH 蕾米埃尔桌宠插件：在 DSH 界面浮层显示 GIF 桌宠，跟随会话状态自动切换动画，兼容 Web UI 与桌面版。

description.en: Run DSH workspaces on remote SSH or WSL hosts, with no-sudo setup, model config porting, and remote UI in local DSH.
description.zh: 在远程 SSH 或 WSL 主机上运行 DSH 工作区，无需 sudo 即可配置，支持模型配置迁移，并在本地 DSH 中使用远程 UI。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tab that takes over the page with another DSH instance's Web GUI, plus a remote session-state badge.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加「远程」标签，整页切换到另一台主机的 DSH Web GUI，并显示远程会话状态徽章。

description.en: Runs a remote DeepSeek Harness inside the desktop app via SSH bootstrap, auto-install and a loopback gateway.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 引导、自动安装和回环网关，在桌面应用窗口中运行远程 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSh Remote bundle plugin adding a sidebar entry and drawer for phone remote control and file transfer with a built-in gateway.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加原生侧边栏入口和右侧抽屉管理页，通过内置网关（随 DSH 自动启停）实现手机远程控制与文件传输。

description.en: Hard-stops consecutive identical DeepSeek Harness tool calls after a configurable streak to prevent loops.
description.zh: 在连续出现相同 DeepSeek Harness 工具调用达到可配置次数后强制终止，防止循环。

description.en: Turns a DeepSeek Harness session into daily, weekly, handoff, or article reports with verifiable receipts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话转成日报、周报、交接报告或文章，并附可核验的凭据。

description.en: A research workflow plugin that auto-handles research requests with domain skills, PubMed search, DOI checks, docx auditing and cross-session project memory.
description.zh: 科研全流程插件：自动接管科研诉求，提供领域技能、PubMed 检索、DOI 核验、docx 审计与跨会话项目记忆。

description.en: A floating one-click restart button for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, self-contained and cross-platform.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加一个浮动的一键重启按钮，自带依赖、跨平台。

description.en: Session time machine for DeepSeek Harness: recall or edit & resend messages, regenerate replies, and version conversation history with disk artifacts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话时光机：支持消息撤回、编辑重发与重新生成，并将对话历史与磁盘产物同步版本化。

description.en: Adds a DSH settings card that auto-retries 429/stream failures per provider and auto-sends "continue" so unattended runs finish.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供断线重试卡片：按 provider 自动重试 429/断流请求，并在回合失败后自动发送「继续」，让无人值守的长任务跑完。

description.en: DSH skill provider that bundles the 88-skill reverse-engineering corpus with automated upstream sync.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打包 88 个逆向工程技能的提供者，支持上游自动同步。

description.en: A DSH plugin with a three-state capsule toggle that injects a "don't skimp on tokens" instruction into the system prompt.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，通过右下角胶囊三档切换，控制是否向系统提示注入「别省 token」的指令。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files, chat file paths and hyperlinks, enabling preview, open, reveal, copy and save-as.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加 Codex 风格右键菜单，可对文件、聊天中的文件路径和超链接进行预览、打开、定位、复制与另存为。

description.en: Runs multi-model roundtable debates with shared context, a six-dimension AI judge, real cost tracking, and Markdown/docx battle reports.
description.zh: 运行多模型圆桌辩论，共享上下文，配备六维AI评审、真实成本账本，并生成Markdown/docx战报。

description.en: Adds a native roundtable panel where three AI roles debate a topic over two rounds, then produce follow-ups, votes and a summary.
description.zh: 内置圆桌面板：三个 AI 角色就同一话题进行两轮讨论，并支持追问、投票与总结。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin showing real-time account balances for model providers/relays plus remaining ChatGPT/Codex quota.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，实时显示各模型厂商/中转的 API 账户余额及 ChatGPT/Codex 剩余额度。

description.en: A recursive self-improvement engine plugin for DeepSeek Harness that distills memory and verifies knowledge in agentic loops.
description.zh: 一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的递归自我改进引擎插件，可在智能体循环中蒸馏记忆并验证知识。

description.en: dsh safe mode plugin that launches with a blank profile to prevent third-party plugins from starting.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile启动，使第三方插件均不加载

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sandbox provider that runs agent tasks in isolated MXC (Microsoft eXecution Containers) process containers on Windows 11.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 MXC（微软 eXecution 容器）的沙箱后端，在 Windows 11 上以隔离进程容器运行任务。

description.en: A floating window for monitoring DeepSeek and OpenCode Go API balances and quotas, with voice alerts and over-limit truncation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek 与 OpenCode Go 双标签余额和限额监控的悬浮窗，支持金额、token、每小时用量监控，语音提醒，超限时断点截断。

description.en: Saves DSH conversation turns as Markdown in per-session collections plus a personal knowledge base the model can search on demand.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话内容以 Markdown 保存，按会话归类，并构建模型可按需搜索的个人知识库。

description.en: Git-native biomedical research graph with literature-grounded expansion and auditable local files.
description.zh: 基于Git的生物医学研究图谱，支持文献扩展和本地文件审计。

description.en: DSH plugin for operating SCNet HPC clusters: SSH config, Slurm job generation, cluster probing, and DCU/DTK diagnostics.
description.zh: 用于操作SCNet超算集群的DSH插件，支持SSH配置、Slurm作业生成、集群探测以及DCU/DTK诊断。

description.en: Translates DeepSeek Harness Web UI text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes into 45+ languages on screen.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的界面文本、属性、Shadow DOM 和 iframe 实时翻译为 45+ 种语言。

description.en: Screenshot capture plugin with clipboard watcher, floating window, OCR, and Obsidian note organization.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供截图捕获：监听剪贴板并弹系统悬浮窗，可加批注和要点、复制或保存文档与图片，调用通义千问即时 OCR，并按天合并进 Obsidian、晚间由 AI 整理。

description.en: Cross-session memory and a local knowledge base for DSH, local-first by default with optional cloud sync and user-approved migration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供跨会话记忆与本地知识库，默认本地优先，可选云端，迁移需用户批准。

description.en: Local-first encrypted cross-workspace memory plugin for DSH with per-workspace authorization and prompt-injection isolation.
description.zh: 本地优先的加密跨工作区记忆插件，支持逐工作区授权与提示词注入隔离。

description.en: A native DSH plugin that rebuilds OpenAI codex-security's discover, verify, report security audit workflow using only DSH models and local JSONL state.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内以原生插件重建 codex-security 的「发现→验证→报告」安全审计流程，仅用本地 JSONL 持久化。

description.en: Visualizes DeepSeek Harness session logs as an interactive 3D execution graph with event nodes and timeline navigation.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话日志可视化为可交互的 3D 执行图，包含事件节点与时间线导航。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and instantly see a translation-only always-on-top card.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用中选择文本，即可弹出仅显示译文的置顶卡片。

description.en: Builds a local semantic index of your last N days of DSH conversations across workspaces, so vague descriptions recall old topics and exact quotes.
description.zh: 在本地为最近 N 天的 DSH 对话建立跨工作区语义索引，用模糊描述即可召回旧话题与原话。

description.en: Bridges local serial ports into DSH so AI can read and analyze Arduino/STM32/ESP32 runtime output via a floating panel and AI tools.
description.zh: 把电脑串口接入 DSH，让人和 AI 都能通过悬浮面板与 AI 工具读取并分析 Arduino/STM32/ESP32 的运行时输出。

description.en: DSH plugin that tracks remaining balance/quota of third-party AI agent services like Tavily, Bocha, Firecrawl and SerpAPI with timed refresh.
description.zh: DSH 插件，监控 Tavily、博查、Firecrawl、SerpAPI 等第三方 Agent 服务的剩余余额与额度，支持定时刷新。

description.en: Adds session-scoped 'Allow for this session' option to approval dialogs with per-mode standing grants and auto-open guard.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI plugin: session-scoped "Allow for this session" option in the approval dialog (per-mode standing grants, localStorage) + right-panel auto-open guard

description.en: Adds one-click session deletion to DeepSeek Harness, recursively removing sub-sessions, logs, caches, search index and workspace records.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上侧栏一键删除会话，递归清理子会话、日志、缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。

description.en: Drag sidebar sessions between DSH workspaces, rewriting the session log header cwd and migrating the log directory to the target project.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到其他工作区，真正改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁移到目标项目下。

description.en: DSH Web sidebar widget that deletes unwanted sessions by dragging them onto a fish, moving them to trash with undo and a local ledger.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：把不要的会话拖到侧边栏小胖鱼挂件上「吃掉」（移入回收站），支持撤销与本地台账。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin that permanently deletes chat sessions and lets you edit your own messages or regenerate and edit individual turns.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 插件，可永久删除会话，并支持编辑自己的消息、重新生成或修改单轮对话。

description.en: Arranges forked DSH sessions into a tree in the sidebar, nesting each fork under its parent with rails, expanders and ancestor-chain highlighting.
description.zh: 在侧边栏将 DSH 分叉会话排列为树形结构，让每个分叉嵌套在父会话下，并带圆角连线、绿色展开按钮与祖先链高亮。

description.en: Substring search across every message in a DSH workspace, fixing whole-token FTS5 limits so Chinese clauses and mid-word matches are found.
description.zh: 在整个 DSH 工作区的每条消息中做子串搜索，解决 FTS5 整词分词限制，中文长句和词内片段也能命中。

description.en: Brings Edge-style tab groups to the DSH Web session sidebar with colored, collapsible, drag-sortable groups and status summaries.
description.zh: 把 Edge 标签页分组体验搬到 DSH Web 会话侧栏，支持彩色分组、折叠、拖动排序与状态汇总。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness session history into a private, local HTML dashboard and JSON retrospective.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的会话历史在本地生成私密的 HTML 仪表盘和 JSON 回顾报告，数据不出本地。

description.en: Adds a sidebar context menu to sessions with mark-unread, copy info, reveal in Finder/open in IDE, and permanent delete, plus status dots and hover cards.
description.zh: 为侧边栏会话添加右键菜单：标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或用 IDE 打开、永久删除，并支持状态圆点与悬停卡片详情。

description.en: A Cordis plugin to highlight and annotate DSH conversation sessions with sticky notes.
description.zh: 一个Cordis插件，用便签高亮和注释DSH会话。

description.en: Adds desktop notifications to DSH Web sessions via browser notifications and Windows toasts, opening the related session on click.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话添加桌面通知：支持浏览器通知与 Windows Toast，点击通知可定位到对应会话。

description.en: Export a DSH session plus its attachments as a ZIP archive, or import an exported archive back as a new conversation in your workspace.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话连同附件导出为 ZIP 压缩包，或把导出的会话导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Permanently delete archived DSH sessions from the sidebar menu, clearing logs, projection caches and workspace entries with double confirmation.
description.zh: 在侧栏已归档会话菜单中永久删除会话，清除日志、投影缓存与工作区登记，并需二次确认。

description.en: Lets an agent read other DSH sessions (messages, tool calls, reasoning) for context.
description.zh: 让智能体读取其他 DSH 会话的消息、工具调用和推理内容，以获取上下文。

description.en: Windows-only DSH plugin adding a session recycle bin, two-stage deletion, sub-agent tree cleanup and artifact highlighting in Explorer.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DSH 会话管理插件，提供会话回收站与两段式删除、子代理对话树清理、产物识别与资源管理器高亮。

description.en: Save any DSH session as a single .dsproj file with save, save-as, and autosave, then open it elsewhere to resume.
description.zh: 把任意 DSH 会话保存为单个 .dsproj 工程文件，支持保存、另存为和自动保存，换机器打开即可继续。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel that estimates token usage and cost from official vendor pricing and charts per-model daily usage with live status sampling.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏「会话统计」面板：按官方价目估算 Token 与成本，按模型分色绘制每日堆叠柱与环形图，并实时采样运行状态。

description.en: Adds a top tab bar for switching between DSH chat sessions while keeping native sidebars, bottom workbench and background work intact.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加顶部会话标签栏，点击即可切换会话，同时保留原生左右侧栏、底部工作台与后台任务。

description.en: Tags each DSH session as a long-term or short-term task with its agent mode, and auto-archives it once its window elapses.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话标记长期或短期任务及其智能体模式，并在时间窗口结束后自动归档。

description.en: Turns dsh session titles into a "date|type|topic" pattern, with type and topic summarized from the whole conversation by the model.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一为「日期｜类型｜主题」格式，类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结生成。

description.en: Adds a "Transfer to another workspace" action in the session menu that relocates a whole conversation, preserving title, tool calls and token usage.
description.zh: 在会话「⋯」菜单中新增「转移到其他工作区…」，完整迁移对话并保留标题、工具调用与 token 用量。

description.en: Adds an edit mode to the DSH settings sidebar so you can drag-sort, hide, or group nav sections into drawers, with changes saved automatically.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页左侧导航加入编辑模式，可拖拽排序、隐藏条目、用抽屉分组收纳，改动自动持久保存。

description.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with file-tree management—rename, create, upload, delete—plus editable and savable document previews.
description.zh: 增强 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏：支持文件树重命名、新建、上传、删除，并提供可编辑、可保存的文档预览。

description.en: Folds sidebar add-on rows under the More row, with kept-visible rows and left/center/right alignment controls.
description.zh: 将侧边栏附加行折叠到 More 行下，支持保留可见行和左/中/右对齐。

description.en: Groups DSH sidebar panel rows so a few stay pinned and the rest fold into a collapsible Tools row, with drag to move rows.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏面板行分组：少数保持固定，其余折叠进可收缩的 Tools 行，并可拖动移行。

description.en: Moves the four agent mode switches into the New Session button for quicker access and syncs with settings.
description.zh: 将标准、PTC、创造、极简四种模式切换并入新会话按钮，便于创建会话并与设置双向同步。

description.en: Collapses dsh's sidebar top panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical text list into a row of horizontal icon buttons.
description.zh: 把 dsh 侧边栏顶部的全局面板菜单（插件、扩展管理、定时任务、IM 等）从竖排文字列表改成一行横向图标按钮。

description.en: Shows the brand logo of the model chosen for each sidebar session, updating live from the composer selector with a history fallback.
description.zh: 在侧边栏每个会话中显示所选模型的品牌标识，随输入区模型选择器实时更新，历史会话则回退到最近一次请求。

description.en: Quickly toggles the DSH Web UI sidebar between workspace grouping and a flat session list via Alt+R or by clicking the section header.
description.zh: 通过 Alt+R 或点击分组标题，快速切换 DSH Web UI 侧边栏的工作区分组与平铺会话列表。

description.en: Import, validate, manage, and migrate Agent Skills for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents.
description.zh: 导入、校验、管理和迁移 DSH、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理的 Agent Skills。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory tool for writing, patching, disabling, and deleting skills at runtime with hot-reload and delete guards.
description.zh: DSH plugin: agent-managed procedural memory — a skill_manage tool that lets the agent write, patch, disable and delete its own skills at runtime (user + project scope), with hot-reload and layered del

description.en: Full-screen Skills & MCP Studio for DSH: toggle each skill's auto-invocation, group skills, and start/stop MCP servers via a hotkey window.
description.zh: DSH 全屏 Skills 与 MCP 管理器：逐项开关 skill 自动调用、分组管理 skill、启停 MCP 服务器，支持快捷键唤出小窗。

description.en: Adds a skill palette button beside the DSH composer to browse, search, favourite skills and insert them, plus per-reply skill chips.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁增加「技能」按钮，可分类浏览、搜索、收藏并一键插入技能，回答下方显示本轮所用技能。

description.en: Skill management panel for DeepSeek Harness web app to browse, search, filter, enable/disable, and uninstall agent skills.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页应用的技能管理面板，可浏览、搜索、筛选、启用停用和卸载 agent 技能。

description.en: DSH skill manager shipping 6 base skills plus a 20-skill engineering workflow pack, editable in settings and by AI in chat.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器，自带 6 个基础技能与 20 个工程流程技能包，设置页和对话里都能读写。

description.en: Adds a Skill Switch tab to DSH sessions for one-click per-skill enable/disable, global duplicate cleanup, and skill validity diagnosis.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中新增 Skill 开关标签页，一键屏蔽/恢复项目 skill、全局清理重复副本并判断 skill 是否生效。

description.en: Local-first DeepSeek Harness tool to explore, analyze, translate, clone and evolve Agent Skills, with traces of which skills loaded in a session.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先工具：探索、分析、翻译、复刻并演进 Agent Skill，并追踪会话中实际加载的 Skill。

description.en: Controls Unity/Tuanjie editor over HTTP bridge to build scenes, write C#, compile, play, screenshot, and simulate input.
description.zh: 通过本地 HTTP 桥接控制 Unity 或团结引擎编辑器，可构建场景、编写 C# 代码、编译、运行、截图和模拟输入。

description.en: Browse, preview and import local DSH skills and experts, and discover SKILL.md files on GitHub.
description.zh: 浏览、预览并导入本地 DSH 技能与专家，同时可在 GitHub 上发现 SKILL.md 文件。

description.en: Scans visible skills in the current session, scores relevance to the conversation, and recommends which skill to load.
description.zh: Skill Radar for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): scan the current session's visible skills, score relevance against the conversation, and recommend which skill to load.

description.en: Adds a left-navigation Skills panel to DeepSeek Harness for listing, previewing, enabling, installing and safely uninstalling Agent Skills.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧导航新增技能面板，可列出、预览、启用、安装并安全卸载 Agent Skills。

description.en: Adds project-scoped skill roots with symlink support and multi-level category discovery for DeepSeek Harness skills.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加项目级技能根目录，支持符号链接与多级分类发现。

description.en: A dsh Web UI skin featuring DeepSeek blue-whale theme with official gradient and leaping whale art.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web UI 提供 DeepSeek 蓝鲸主题皮肤，使用官方渐变色和跃起鲸鱼图案。

description.en: A Claude Code-inspired skin that restyles the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with warm charcoal/cream surfaces and terracotta accents.
description.zh: 一款仿 Claude Code 风格的皮肤，为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面换上暖炭灰/奶油色与赤陶色点缀。

description.en: An iOS 26 Liquid Glass skin for the DSH web client, adding frosted glass panels, soft mist background and iOS system-blue accents.
description.zh: 一个为 DSH Web 客户端提供 iOS 26 液态玻璃外观的皮肤插件，包含磨砂玻璃面板、柔光雾场与 iOS 系统蓝强调色。

description.en: A DSH skin plugin that overlays the Web client with an original hand-drawn 'Xuyuanwu' wish-house SVG night theme.
description.zh: 一款 DSH 主题皮肤插件，用原创手绘「许愿屋」月洞窗夜景 SVG 覆盖 Web 客户端外观。

description.en: Smart input plugin for DSH: voice input and prompt optimization.
description.zh: 为 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）提供语音输入与提示词优化两项功能的智能输入插件。

description.en: Plays a sound and pops up a reminder card whenever DSH needs your approval or an input choice.
description.zh: 当 DSH 需要你授权或做出选择时，播放提示音并弹出提醒卡片。

description.en: Clarifies vague coding requirements and saves learnings as reusable Markdown specs for AI-assisted development.
description.zh: 在编程前澄清模糊需求，并将经验保存为Markdown模板供下次复用。

description.en: A skippable full-screen startup splash animation plugin for DSH, implemented purely as a plugin and toggleable in the plugin library.
description.zh: DSH 开屏动画插件：可跳过的全屏启动动画，纯插件实现，可在插件库中开关。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for DeepSeek Harness to chat with multiple agents side by side in panes matching the stock UI.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供分屏工作区，可并排与多个代理对话，面板与原始界面一致。

description.en: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures model calls, semantic diffs, replay and mutation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内的 LLM 调试控制台，捕获每次模型调用，提供语义 diff、重放与变更功能。

description.en: Adds transparent SSH workspaces to DSH Desktop so you can browse remote files, search, and run Bash as if local.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 添加透明 SSH 工作区，可像本地一样浏览远程文件、搜索并运行 Bash。

description.en: macOS menu-bar status + quick task capture for DeepSeek Harness
VSCode-like bottom status bar for DSH Web showing token usage, CPU/memory, session stats, live TPS, and per-item config.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供类 VSCode 底部状态栏，显示 token 用量、CPU/内存字符条形图、会话统计、实时 TPS 及逐项配置

description.en: Template-driven plugin to fully customize DeepSeek Harness status bar stats rows with ${variable} placeholders.
description.zh: 使用 ${变量} 模板完全自定义 DeepSeek Harness 状态栏统计行。

description.en: DSH plugin that enforces deterministic step-level circuit breakers to stop models looping without progress, shadow-by-default and fail-open.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用确定性步数治理在步骤层强制刹车，阻止模型空转，默认 shadow 只观测、异常一律放行。

description.en: Manages DSH conversations with one folder per chat, recoverable deletion, right-click file actions, and a global AGENTS.md safety baseline.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供每对话一文件夹、可恢复删除、右键文件操作，并将三条安全基线写入全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: A DSH workspace sticky notes plugin: create, edit, and delete notes stored as Markdown files.
description.zh: DSH 工作区便签插件，把便签存为 Markdown 文件，可创建、编辑和删除便签。

description.en: DSH plugin for the full STM32 workflow: environment detection, .ico transactions, project generation, compiling, flashing, and debugging.
description.zh: DSH插件：覆盖STM32全流程，包括环境探测、.ico事务、工程生成、编译、烧录与调试。

description.en: Always-on stock quotes strip showing watchlist, holdings, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, order book, trade ledger, alerts, and AI review.
description.zh: 常驻窗口顶部的股票行情条，展示自选股、持仓与盈亏、K线及分时图、盘口、交易记录、提醒和AI复盘。

description.en: Sets the provider, model and reasoning effort DSH subagents run with: a global default plus a per-conversation override chip.
description.zh: 为 DSH 子代理指定所用模型与思考强度：设置页配置全局默认，输入框旁的胶囊按对话覆盖。

description.en: Routes each DSH subagent to the best-fit local model with free-first, quota-aware, capability-matched selection plus a control panel.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 子代理智能分配最合适的本地模型，优先免费、感知配额、匹配能力，并提供控制面板。

description.en: Encrypted, scheduled backup and restore of your DSH profile — plugins, settings, skills, MCP and API keys — to S3, WebDAV or a local folder.
description.zh: 加密、定时备份与恢复 DSH 配置（插件、设置、技能、MCP、API 密钥）到 S3 兼容存储、WebDAV 或本地文件夹。

description.en: Model picker for the DSH composer with a provider rail, grouped search, favorites, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 shortcuts.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的模型选择器，提供提供商侧栏、分组搜索、收藏和 Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 快捷键。

description.en: Exposes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI on your Tailscale tailnet for remote phone access and tears down the route on exit.
description.zh: 在 Tailscale 网络内暴露 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI，让手机远程访问，并在退出时撤销路由。

description.en: Renders a Gantt chart in the DSH sidebar showing one swimlane per agent teammate, with shared tasks plotted against real session time.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏渲染甘特图，每个智能体队友一条泳道，按真实会话时间展示共享任务。

description.en: Visualizes DSH single-task execution flow: agents, tools, skills, subtasks, retries, live status.
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 单任务执行流程，展示代理、工具、技能、子任务、重试与实时状态。

description.en: Organizes sessions across workspaces into task folders with next-step notes and builds compressed handoff packages for new sessions.
description.zh: 把跨工作区的会话整理成任务资料夹，记录下一步便签，并生成可压缩的交接包供新会话使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows agent status in the top-right corner: done, error, awaiting approval, awaiting answer, or sub-agent running.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在右上角显示 agent 状态——完成、出错、待授权、待回答，以及子 agent 运行中。

description.en: Generates exams, dictation sheets, lesson plans and full lesson bundles for Chinese middle-school teachers using their own school docx/pptx templates, fully offline.
description.zh: 面向中国大陆中学教师，按本校空白模板生成试卷、听写单、教案与整套课件，全程本机离线运行并记住学校排版习惯。

description.en: Telegram notifications for DeepSeek Harness, alerting you when your AI agent finishes tasks or needs your input.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 通知插件，在任务完成、提问或审批时自动发消息提醒你。

description.en: Turns a selection in DSH's built-in sidebar terminal into an @file reference in the composer via a button or keyboard shortcut.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏终端中的选中内容通过按钮或快捷键转换为输入框里的 @file 引用。

description.en: Lets you pick the font and size for the sidebar terminal, fixing oh-my-posh, Powerline and Nerd Font icons that render as boxes.
description.zh: 为侧边栏终端选择字体与字号，修复 oh-my-posh、Powerline 与 Nerd Font 图标显示为方块的问题。

description.en: ⚡️ Ultra-fast trigram-indexed code search for DeepSeek Harness powered by Microsoft tgrep.
Floating theme widget for DeepSeek Harness desktop that switches official appearances and sets custom backgrounds (image or solid color).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供悬浮主题挂件，可切换官方外观并设置图片或纯色自定义背景。

description.en: Adds customizable color themes to the DeepSeek Web UI via Settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek 网页界面的设置页添加可自定义的颜色主题。

description.en: Cyberpunk theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with RGB neon, custom backgrounds, and a draggable HUD with local music player.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供赛博朋克主题，包含 RGB 流动霓虹、自定义背景图库、可拖动 HUD 与本地音乐播放器，并支持一键启停。

description.en: An unofficial Cyrene-inspired visual theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, adding three colour schemes and six moods without changing layout or workflow.
description.zh: 一款非官方的昔涟印象视觉主题，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供三套配色、六种氛围，不改变布局与工作流。

description.en: DSH theme plugin offering 4 palettes (Mono, Warm sand, Indigo, Moss) each adapting independently to light and dark via OKLCH color-token overrides.
description.zh: DSH 主题配色插件：提供 Mono、暖沙、靛蓝、苔藓 4 套配色，各自独立适配明暗模式，通过 OKLCH 色彩令牌覆盖实现。

description.en: Immersive weather ambience theme for DSH with rain, snow and hearth effects, real audio recordings and a night mode.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供雨、雪、炉火等沉浸式天气氛围主题，含真实录音与夜间模式。

description.en: Stardew Valley-themed UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness web client, injecting pixel farm styling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端注入星露谷物语风格的像素农场界面主题。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a global system prompt instructing models to always think internally in Chinese across all sessions.
description.zh: DSH 插件，添加全局系统提示词，让模型在所有会话中始终用中文进行内部推理思考。

description.en: Web plugin that wraps expanded DeepSeek thinking blocks in a bounded scroll area so long reasoning doesn't stretch the page.
description.zh: 给对话中展开的思维链块加限高内部滚动，避免长推理撑开页面。

description.en: A DSH web client plugin that rotates playful bilingual status quips and adds a chasing-dot orbit loading icon to the running-turn indicator.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web 客户端插件，在运行中回合指示器上轮播俏皮的双语状态短语，并加上追逐圆点轨道加载图标。

description.en: Four-tier context compaction pipeline that folds duplicates, archives large outputs, applies soft pressure and only then runs one budgeted summary.
description.zh: 四层上下文压缩管线：无损折叠、落盘存档、软压力驱逐，最后才动用一次带预算预留的摘要，前三层零 LLM 成本。

description.en: Caps each generation round by token count or elapsed time, hard-stops at the limit, and auto-archives the truncated output to a desktop folder.
description.zh: 为每轮生成设置 token 或时间上限，到量/到点即强制中断，并把断下的内容自动归档到桌面文件夹。

description.en: Converts key items from notifications/emails into due-date todos, managed via sidebar and model tools, persisted to local JSON.
description.zh: 从通知、公告、邮件等文字中提取关键事项转为带截止日期的待办，可从左侧栏进入管理，并通过模型工具操作，数据持久化到本地 JSON 文件。

description.en: Estimates the cost of each DeepSeek Harness conversation using per-model and peak/off-peak pricing, shown in the sidebar.
description.zh: 按模型和高峰/空闲时段计价，估算每个 DeepSeek Harness 对话的费用，并在侧边栏显示。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns streaming model tokens into an arcade-style combo HUD (Windows beta).
description.zh: 一个把 DeepSeek Harness 的流式 Token 输出变成街机连击 HUD 的插件（Windows 测试版）。

description.en: Tracks session token costs with official dynamic pricing, shows DeepSeek/Volcengine billing balance, and checks for updates.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 按官方动态定价统计会话 token 费用，显示 DeepSeek 与火山引擎账户余额，并检查插件更新。

description.en: Dashboard for token usage, provider balances, and subscription quotas in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中展示 token 用量、服务商余额和订阅配额的仪表板。

description.en: Compresses tool outputs and trims per-agent tool catalogues to cut input-token cost in long DeepSeek Harness sessions, with a measurement script.
description.zh: 通过源头压缩工具输出并精简每个 agent 的工具目录，降低长会话的输入 token 成本，并附带计量脚本。

description.en: Cost panel for DSH that meters requests, prices 136 models, and displays budget and spend.
description.zh: DSH成本面板，计量请求，定价136种模型，显示预算和花费。

description.en: Token usage & cost statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness with per-model/date/session tracking and CSV/JSON export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量与费用统计插件，可按模型、日期、会话统计，估算美元和人民币费用，并导出 CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Integrates tokensave semantic graph into DSH for token-saving code queries via MCP.
description.zh: 将 tokensave 语义图集成到 DSH，通过 MCP 提供节省 token 的代码查询。

description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool for DeepSeek Harness, powered by ast-grep.
description.zh: 基于 AST 的结构化代码搜索与语法大纲工具，由 ast-grep 驱动，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Local DSH vision plugin: screenshot/image description and Windows OCR text extraction, fully offline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 本地视觉眼睛插件:screen 工具(截图/图片交给本地视觉模型描述)+ ocr 工具(Windows 内置 OCR 逐字提取文字)。零云端、OCR 零 GPU、图片不出本机。

description.en: MCP router and native DeepSeek Harness bundle that provides seven MCP servers using 934 tokens instead of 20,005.
description.zh: MCP 路由器和原生 DeepSeek Harness 捆绑包，以 934 个 token 提供七个 MCP 服务器，而非 20,005 个。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions and symbols via real language servers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LSP 操作能力：通过真实语言服务器实现诊断、格式化、重命名、代码操作与符号查询。

description.en: Generates AI travel wallpapers starring your chosen character and world, applies them to your desktop, and keeps letters and a travel archive.
description.zh: 生成由你选定的角色与旅行的世界主题的AI壁纸并应用到桌面，同时留下角色来信与旅行档案。

description.en: Windows system tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web that manages a local server.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness — Custom Windows Tray Launcher

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-creates, auto-loads and auto-updates three Markdown project-memory files per workspace via host hooks.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的项目记忆插件，由 host 插件自动创建、加载并记录每个工作区的三份 Markdown 记忆文件。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DSH plugins with evidence-backed, zero-token auditing.
description.zh: 对 DSH 插件进行静态能力披露与审计，基于证据、零令牌消耗，不作安全性声明。

description.en: A standalone mihomo proxy center inside DSH with multi-subscription import/switch, global TUN, system proxy, and multi-hop chained proxies.
description.zh: DSH 内的独立 mihomo 代理中心，支持多订阅导入切换、全局 TUN、系统代理与多跳链式代理。

description.en: Sidebar index for DeepSeek Harness chat, click to jump to any turn and scroll spy highlights current turn.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏提供对话轮次索引，点击可跳转到任意轮次，滚动时自动高亮当前轮次。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that sends a system notification when each conversation turn completes, titled with the session name and summarizing the answer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：每轮对话完成时发送系统通知，标题为会话名，正文为本轮回答摘要。

description.en: DSH sidebar tab that collapses conversation sessions into user-turn outlines and lets you jump back to any turn; zero-AI, read-only.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏选项卡，将会话按用户轮次折叠为大纲，并支持一键跳回任意轮次；零 AI、只读。

description.en: dsh plugin that displays the CNY cost of every completed turn directly beneath the turn in the session.
description.zh: dsh 插件，在每轮对话结束后于该轮下方显示其人民币费用。

description.en: Customizes status phrases shown while waiting for AI replies in DeepSeek Harness, like Claude Code.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自定义等待 AI 回复时显示的状态提示语，可按不同轮次或场景替换占位文案。

description.en: Adds desktop wallpapers and frosted-glass effects to the DSH client with zero layout intrusion, byte-level rollback, and a built-in diagnostics panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 客户端添加桌面壁纸与毛玻璃效果，零布局侵入、支持逐字节回滚，并自带诊断面板。

description.en: User-owned CSS overrides that let you restyle any DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin without patching it.
description.zh: 用户自有的 CSS 覆盖层，无需修改插件即可重新定制 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 任意插件的样式。

description.en: Adds a cross-workspace session progress board to DSH, with a sidebar badge and running/waiting/completed session tracking.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加跨工作空间会话进度看板，侧边栏角标显示运行中、已完成未读与待处理会话。

description.en: UI skin plugin: injects wallpaper/video backgrounds, frosted-glass UI, drag/crop/zoom, custom skins via URL or local file.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 **UI 皮肤插件**：在 UI 下方注入壁纸 / 视频背景，并把 DSH 整个界面（含侧栏）的表面背景烘焙为半透明（毛玻璃）让皮肤透出。支持拖动裁剪缩放、历史皮肤记录与可拖动悬浮窗；自定义皮肤支持网络地址或本地文件。

description.en: Turns UI screenshots into structured, implementation-grade web frontend specs (JSON + Markdown).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn UI screenshots into structured, implementation-grade web frontend specs. Deterministic geometry (sharp) + optional vision-model semantics, merged into one JSON + Markdown

description.en: Restores archived DeepSeek Harness sessions via /unarchive command and unarchive_session tool.
description.zh: 通过 /unarchive 命令和 unarchive_session 工具恢复 DeepSeek Harness 中已归档的会话。

description.en: Patches DSH to strip approval prompts, sandbox denials and hedging, and injects your custom prompt into the system prompt every turn.
description.zh: 给 DSH 打补丁，去掉审批弹窗、沙箱拒绝和推脱话术，并让自定义提示词每轮进入系统提示。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness stored in Claude Code's format, as private, overlay, or shared memory with provenance on every file.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆，采用 Claude Code 的格式，支持私有、叠加或共享模式，并为每个文件保留来源信息。

description.en: Adds pinned and recent sections to the DSH sidebar, gathering pinned and recent sessions from all workspaces into one place.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加「置顶」和「最近」两个区，把各工作区中置顶和最近的会话汇总到一处。

description.en: Update center and plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness, managing plugin lifecycle and dsh updates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供更新中心与插件市场，通过自托管 plugins.json 注册表聚合 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题并映射 npm 包名实现秒级安装，支持一键安装、更新、卸载、禁用插件及更新 dsh 本体。

description.en: Adds an update center to the DSH Web UI: checks npm for the latest version, shows release notes, and offers one-click updating.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加更新中心：自动检查 npm 最新版本、展示更新重点，并支持一键更新。

description.en: Displays an in-GUI version badge and checks npm for updates in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面中显示版本徽章，并从 npm 检查更新。

description.en: A read-only DSH plugin that reports the DeepSeek Harness Web version status and offers release-channel guidance.
description.zh: 一个只读的 DSH 插件，用于显示 DeepSeek Harness Web 版本状态并提供发布渠道指引。

description.en: Sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness showing token usage and account balance with a hover detail card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，显示 token 用量与账户余额，悬停可展开详情卡片。

description.en: Shows per-token cost next to token counts in DSH's usage popup, using DeepSeek's official price list plus peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在 DSH 用量弹窗中，按 DeepSeek 官方价目表和峰谷价把每个 token 环节折算成金额，显示在 token 数字右侧。

description.en: User-authored tiered long-term memory injected as a system-prompt section, with a Chinese panel to view and edit it; the AI never writes it itself.
description.zh: 用户自建的分层长期记忆，作为系统提示词片段注入，并提供中文面板查看与编辑，AI 不会自行写入。

description.en: Adds VS Code-like right sidebar file explorer with bookmarks and previews to DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 增加类似 VS Code 的右侧文件树、书签和预览功能。

description.en: Registers any SKILL.md folders as / command menu skills for DeepSeek Harness Web, letting you invoke them as native skills.
description.zh: 将任意 SKILL.md 目录注册为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的「/」菜单技能，可像原生技能一样调用。

description.en: Minimal first-turn RL anchor plugin for DeepSeek V4: applies RL shaped bootstrap before first tool call, then restores Standard.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek V4 提供最小化首轮强化学习锚点：在首次工具调用前应用 RL 引导，随后恢复 Standard 模式。

description.en: Real-browser acceptance testing for agent-built web apps via CLI, MCP, and GitHub Actions.
description.zh: 在真实浏览器中对 AI 代理构建的网页应用执行验收测试，可通过 CLI、MCP（Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot）和 GitHub Action 调用。

description.en: Generates videos with online models via three DSH tools, a restart-safe task ledger, live chat cards, a Videos panel, and public price-feed cost estimates.
description.zh: 通过三个 DSH 工具调用在线模型生成视频，提供可跨重启的任务台账、聊天卡片、视频面板和公开价格源费用估算。

description.en: Browse 373 agentic video-production skills and install any of them into ~/.claude/skills or ~/.dsh/skills with one click.
description.zh: 在设置中浏览 373 个视频制作技能，一键安装到 ~/.claude/skills 或 ~/.dsh/skills。

description.en: Injects a system-prompt line telling the model to keep formal deliverables impersonal while allowing warmth in private notes.
description.zh: 在系统提示词中写入一条规则：正式交付物保持克制 impersonal，私人笔记可留一分温度。

description.en: Adds image recognition to text-only models via OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, auto-converting images to text.
description.zh: 为无视觉能力的文本模型提供图片识别，将粘贴、拖入或导入的图片自动交由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转为文字送入对话，支持多轮复核与多提供商配置。

description.en: Config-only bundle providing selectable OpenAI-compatible vision models for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供仅靠配置接入的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，可在配置中选择要使用的模型。

description.en: Vision plugin that transcribes attached images to text via selectable providers so DeepSeek can answer with image context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 识图插件：保持 DeepSeek 对话，15+ 供应商视觉模型把图片转译为文字，可在 设置→插件 配置

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness web using Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR via a local bridge.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页提供语音输入，通过本地桥接调用阿里云 DashScope 语音识别。

description.en: Host-side DSH plugin that plays a random built-in Chinese TTS voice reminder whenever a conversation turn finishes on Windows.
description.zh: DSH 宿主侧插件，在每轮对话结束时用内置中文语音播报一句随机提醒，支持 Windows 与设置页配置。

description.en: Voice-call plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: tap the mic to talk hands-free while AI replies are spoken aloud as they stream.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 语音对话插件：点麦克风即可免提通话，AI 回复边生成边朗读。

description.en: Visual QA plugin: main model asks vision model questions, with real-time UI showing the QA process and multimodal model selection.
description.zh: DSH 插件:vqa_ask 双模型视觉问答 —— 主模型提问 → 视觉模型看图回答,UI 实时展示 QA 过程,支持多模态视觉模型选择

description.en: Local image/video wallpaper plugin for DSH Web GUI with upload, manual switching, timed rotation and visual tuning.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供本地图片/视频壁纸:支持上传、手动切换、定时轮换与观感调节。

description.en: Sets a custom background wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app using presets, image URLs, or uploads with adjustable opacity.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用设置自定义背景壁纸，支持预设、图片链接、上传和透明度滑块。

description.en: Prompt/routing plugin that makes DeepSeek spawn expert sub-models via "We" when resources allow and fall back to solo "I" when tight; filters DeepSeek+Flash ids.
description.zh: 提示词/路由插件：资源充足时让 DeepSeek 用「We」协调专家子模型，资源紧张时退回单独「I」推理；按 DeepSeek+Flash 模型 id 筛选。

description.en: Browse, search, and download Wallpaper Engine workshop wallpapers and integrate them into DSH skin center, bypassing Steam blocks.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并下载 Wallpaper Engine（Steam 431960）创意工坊壁纸，接入 DSH 皮肤中心，并绕过 Steam 的 HTTP 拦截与区服不匹配登录限制。

description.en: Peer-to-peer fabric for connecting DeepSeek Harness nodes across machines, without central server.
description.zh: 以点对点方式跨机器连接 DeepSeek Harness 节点，无需中心服务器

description.en: Windows launcher that makes dsh web run as a desktop app using browser app mode.
description.zh: Windows 启动器，用浏览器应用模式把 dsh web 作为桌面应用运行。

description.en: Local-first web search plugin with keyless multi-engine search, SQLite-cached fetch, platform search, and optional Playwright browser automation.
description.zh: 本地优先的网络搜索插件，支持无密钥多引擎搜索、SQLite缓存抓取、平台搜索及可选的Playwright浏览器自动化。

description.en: Grounded web search for DeepSeek Harness that runs the built-in web_search tool on any OpenRouter-compatible gateway using your existing endpoint and key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供联网搜索，复用同一 OpenRouter 兼容网关和密钥运行内置 web_search 工具。

description.en: Fixes search for opencode go integration with deepseek harness by switching search logic to opencode.
description.zh: 将 deepseek harness 的搜索逻辑改为 opencode，解决 opencode go 接入时无法搜索的问题。

description.en: SearXNG-backed web search for DeepSeek Harness that spins up its own container and gives the agent web_search with no vendor API keys.
description.zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 DeepSeek Harness 联网搜索插件，自带容器启动，无需厂商密钥即可为智能体提供 web_search。

description.en: A web notification plugin that alerts users when a DSH agent finishes a task.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中当 Agent 完成任务时，通过网页通知提醒用户。

description.en: 给微信里的 agent 一组自己的定时工具：到点它自己醒过来说话，说的话直接落进当前微信聊天。授权仍由 WeChatAgent 按聊天勾选。
Generates daily, weekly or monthly Markdown work reports from selected DSH sessions and project git commits, guided by your own past report samples.
description.zh: 按时间段挑选 DSH 会话与项目 git 提交，参考你以前写的报告样例，生成日报/周报/月报（Markdown）。

description.en: WeChat channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, letting you chat with your DSH agent from mobile to run commands, read files, and search info.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的微信通道插件，可在手机微信中与 DSH agent 对话，执行命令、读取文件和搜索信息。

description.en: macOS theme with whale aquarium background for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 macOS 风格主题，包含鲸鱼游动的水族箱背景。

description.en: WeChat channel command pack for DeepSeek Harness: switch personas, browse chat history, check token usage and balance, and schedule daily greetings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 微信通道扩展命令插件：支持人设切换、历史对话、token 用量与余额查询、每日定时问候及扩展菜单，命令由宿主执行不消耗 token。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that renders subject pronouns like I/you/me as whale icons.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话中的主语人称代词（我/你/I/me）替换渲染成 DeepSeek 蓝鲸图标。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness desktop pet whale-girl with layered animation, expression states, and peak/off-peak pricing countdown timer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌宠鲸鱼娘：分层动画与表情状态机，随峰谷计价自动换装配色并常驻显示时段倒计时。

description.en: Desktop splash animation for DSH: a whale mascot waits on the native loading page, then taps away the loader, cheers 'Start work!' and fades out.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端鲸鱼娘开场动画：在原生加载页等待，工作台就绪后拍走加载提示、居中放大欢呼“开工！”并淡出消失。

description.en: A transparent, always-on-top Windows desktop fish widget that shows live DSH session task progress and pings you when approval is needed.
description.zh: 一只透明置顶的 Windows 桌面鱼挂件，实时显示 DSH 会话任务进度，并在需要审批时提醒你。

description.en: Adds chat content width tiers with a floating picker button to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加聊天内容宽度档位，通过右下角输入框上方的浮动按钮切换标准、中等、宽、超宽、全宽。

description.en: Pokémon-style collecting game for DSH: work rustles grass, catch wild monsters, fill a 28-slot Pokédex and build a 6-mon team.
description.zh: 工作会让草丛摇动，野生小灵随机冒头，扔球捕捉，填满 28 格图鉴、组建 6 只队伍，含夜行种与传说条件。

description.en: Minimal Windows agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with fixed persona and three tools.
description.zh: Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: one-line fixed persona, three tools, no runtime context. Installs via dsh plugin add.

description.en: Sets the startup window size of DeepSeek Harness Desktop with 4:3, 16:9, 16:10 presets and custom dimensions.
description.zh: 设置 DSH 桌面版启动窗口大小，支持 4:3、16:9、16:10 比例预设与自定义尺寸。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud Workbench CLI plugin enabling DeepSeek Harness agents to directly control remote ECS instances.
description.zh: 阿里云 Workbench CLI 插件，让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体直接控制远程 ECS 实例。

description.en: Turns enterprise documents into a conversational Q&A chatbot with cited answers.
Sets default initial directory for dsh workspace picker via environment variable and CLI.
description.zh: Set the default initial directory of the dsh workspace directory picker (native + browse backends). Sets DSH_PICKER_INITIAL_DIR with self-healing patches and CLI.

description.en: Hide selected workspaces from the DSH sidebar without deleting them: local-only, reversible, managed from a Settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中隐藏选定工作区而不删除任何内容：纯本地、可撤销，并提供设置页管理。

description.en: Enhances the DSH left workspace sidebar with favorites, color labels, drag-to-reorder, pinning, session status lights and Windows notifications.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 左侧工作区视图，为工作区和会话提供收藏、颜色标签、拖动排序、置顶、状态灯与 Windows 通知。

description.en: Groups DSH workspaces into named groups and lets you browse group > workspace > session in the sidebar.
description.zh: 将 DSH 工作区按命名分组整理，并支持在侧边栏按分组 > 工作区 > 会话浏览。

description.en: Adds a web-UI button that creates a git worktree and forks the conversation into it, using the worktree as the working directory.
description.zh: 提供一个网页按钮，创建 git worktree 并将对话分叉到该工作目录中继续。

description.en: Gives WSL agents Windows access via win_ls/read/write/run/open/path/drives commands.
description.zh: 为 WSL 代理提供访问 Windows 的工具，包含 win_ls、win_read、win_write、win_run、win_open、win_path、win_drives 命令

description.en: Diagnoses WSL/Windows proxy configuration, Node 24 fetch issues, and reachability to DeepSeek/npm endpoints.
description.zh: 诊断 WSL/Windows 代理配置、Node 24 fetch 问题，以及 DeepSeek 与 npm 端点的连通性。

description.en: Adds a Settings WSL console plus wslx tools so DSH can browse distributions and run native Linux commands, shells and long-running processes inside WSL.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增 WSL 控制台和 wslx 工具，可浏览发行版、在 WSL 内运行原生 Linux 命令、交互式 shell 与长时间运行进程。

description.en: Runs a persistent dsh agent inside a WSL distro, with an in-distro terminal, native grep/glob and a sidebar entry.
description.zh: 在 WSL 发行版内运行常驻 dsh 代理，提供发行版内终端、原生 grep/glob 和侧边栏入口。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with quick access to WSL /mnt drives, breadcrumbs, and path input.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的工作区目录选择器增强：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达，显示完整面包屑层级，路径输入框常显。

description.en: Tool plugin for DSH to archive and read WeChat Official Account articles via 2100laike WeChat Archive.
description.zh: DSH 工具插件，可通过 2100laike 微信存档归档并阅读微信公众号文章。

description.en: Enables SuperGrok/X Premium OAuth for xAI Grok in DeepSeek Harness without API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 xAI Grok 提供 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 的 OAuth 登录，无需 API key。

description.en: Builds, tests, cleans, archives, and runs iOS/macOS Xcode projects with live filterable logs and simulator/USB device log channels.
description.zh: 构建、测试、清理、归档并运行 iOS/macOS Xcode 项目，支持实时可筛选构建日志及模拟器与 USB 设备日志通道。

description.en: Play human-vs-AI Chinese Chess (Xiangqi) inside DeepSeek Harness with an engine opponent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中与 AI 进行中国象棋人机对弈的插件。

description.en: Connects the Xiaozhi voice assistant to DSH Web as an MCP tool provider, wrapping 35 DSH Web endpoints into 16 voice-friendly tools.
description.zh: 将小智语音助手接入 DSH Web，作为 MCP 工具提供方，把 35 个接口封装成 16 个语音友好工具，并自带设置页。

description.en: A task-management kanban for non-coders, paired with a whale-girl floating assistant that tracks todos, priorities and reminders.
description.zh: 面向不会编程用户的任务管理看板，配鲸鱼娘浮窗助手，帮你记待办、看优先级、盯提醒。

description.en: Native vision, gpt-image-2, and Seedance plugins for DeepSeek Harness via Xiapan Cloud, enabling image and video generation and multimodal understanding.
description.zh: Native vision, gpt-image-2 and Seedance plugins for DeepSeek Harness via Xiapan Cloud

description.en: DSH plugin that turns text into images via Tencent Yuanbao web, with an in-plugin settings card and optional LaMa/OpenCV watermark removal.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过腾讯元宝网页版实现文生图，内置设置卡片，可选 LaMa/OpenCV 去水印。

description.en: Local encrypted credential vault plus headless-browser login sessions for authenticated scraping of Tieba, NGA, Pixiv and book sites.
description.zh: 本地加密凭据库与无头浏览器登录态，支持贴吧、NGA、Pixiv、书屋等站点的带登录态抓取，并提供设置页管理。

description.en: Dynamic wallpaper and interface skin for DeepSeek Harness with ocean, space and local video backgrounds and per-scene saved settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态背景与界面皮肤，支持海洋、宇宙双视角和本地视频背景，每个场景单独保存参数。

description.en: Global system-prompt plugin for DeepSeek Harness that enforces Chinese chain-of-thought, faithful translation, and anti-cliché writing across all sessions and agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的全局系统提示词插件，所有会话与子 agent 统一启用中文思维链、内容保真与反八股规则。

description.en: Patches DeepSeek Harness client module to persist Chinese UI labels across upgrades.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 客户端模块界面的中文标签持久化，使升级后仍保留中文界面。

description.en: Chinese localization plugin for DSH that translates slash-command names and plugin-inventory cards with three display modes.
description.zh: DSH 中文增强插件，将斜杠命令名和插件清单卡片汉化，提供只显示中文、中英都显示、不翻译三种模式。

description.en: DSH plugin that provides 17 tools to fetch Zhihu data (hot, search, etc.) with local settings and browser cards.
description.zh: DSH插件，提供17个工具获取知乎数据（热榜、搜索等），含本地设置和浏览器卡片。

description.en: Adds a small solar-term dot above the composer that expands into today's jieqi, ganzhi and food tips, plus an I Ching coin-toss page.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一颗节气小圆点，展开可看今日节气、日柱时辰与饮食建议，卦页能铜钱摇卦并回看七天。

description.en: Read-only status bar for DSH Workspace-OS showing task counts, latest run event, and checkup date.
description.zh: 为DSH工作空间提供只读状态栏，显示任务数、最近运行事件和检查日期。

description.en: Lets the DeepSeek harness judge task difficulty automatically and pick a matching thinking chain, adapting reasoning depth per request.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek 框架自动判断任务难度并匹配相应的思考链，按需调整推理深度。

description.en: Multi-agent validation for any repository: independent theses, adversarial critics, and a verdict computed from real command exit codes, not agent prose.
description.zh: 多智能体验证任何代码库：独立论点、对抗性批评者，以及基于真实命令退出码（而非智能体文本）计算得出的裁决。

description.en: Plugin that adds free-first multi-model routing, automatic fallback, safe updates, and pt-BR support to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness添加免费优先多模型路由、自动回退、安全更新及巴西葡萄牙语支持的插件。

description.en: Fixes GitHub.com access from mainland China via hosts + dynamic IP selection with 30-min auto self-heal.
description.zh: Github-Road: 大陆稳定访问 GitHub 官网的网络路径修复技能（hosts 直连 + 动态 IP 择优 + 30 分钟自动自愈，免代理、零费用）——非 agent 专属，任意智能体可用，也可纯手动运行。A network-path fix skill (not agent-specific) for reliable github.com access from mainland C

description.en: Reuses previously decided tool actions in DeepSeek Harness to skip redundant paid reasoning requests.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中复用已决策的工具操作，跳过重复的付费推理请求。

description.en: Native DSH plugin for making HTTP requests with configurable credential whitelist and usage skill.
description.zh: 原生 DSH 插件，用于发起 HTTP 请求，支持配置凭证白名单并提供配套使用技能

description.en: DSH host plugin combining a jailbreak/red-team engine with an attack-defense drill bench for testing DeepSeek Harness model safety.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件，集破甲（越狱）引擎与攻防演练台于一体，用于 DeepSeek Harness 的红队安全测试。

description.en: Internal DSH backup plugin providing snapshot control, zip export/import recovery, and compatibility with mainstream backup files.
description.zh: DSH 内部备份插件，可关闭自动保存快照、开机确认，支持单 zip 备份导出导入恢复、隔离自动恢复及多主流备份插件文件兼容。

description.en: Routes LLM requests to backend providers based on complexity classification with context-aware session judging.
description.zh: 根据复杂度分类与上下文感知的会话判断，将 LLM 请求路由到不同的后端提供商。

description.en: Browse, link, and lint a Karpathy-style markdown wiki with wikilinks, backlinks, and an LLM agent skill.
description.zh: 浏览并检查Karpathy风格互链的Markdown wiki，支持wikilinks、反向链接和代理技能。

description.en: Mermaid visual editor browser plugin for dsh with bidirectional canvas-code sync and AI import for common diagram types.
description.zh: dsh 浏览器插件，右侧可关闭面板提供 Mermaid 画布与代码双向同步，并通过 AI 工具通道自动导入 flowchart、sequenceDiagram、classDiagram、erDiagram 图。

description.en: DSH plugin that speaks a short completion notice plus a two-sentence summary when a task ends, with a synced animated portrait and typing speech bubble.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，任务结束时用语音播报完成提示和两句话总结，同步显示会打字的头像气泡。

description.en: Native Minecraft MCP server letting an agent perceive its surroundings and act in-game, with a DSH launcher and optional livestream widgets.
description.zh: 原生 Minecraft MCP，让智能体感知游戏空间并执行受控动作，附带 DSH 启动器与可选直播组件。

description.en: MiniMax token-plan quota dock for DSH web showing 5h usage % with detail panel and auto-hide.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页上以水滴形状显示 MiniMax token 套餐的 5 小时用量百分比，点击展开详情面板，非 MiniMax 模型时自动隐藏。

description.en: Mirrors the current LLM context into plain files so the model can prune stale blocks itself.
description.zh: 把当前上下文镜像成普通文件，让模型自行删除过期的内容块，灵感来自 CLM harness。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that auto-compresses sessions past a custom absolute token threshold and offers one-click manual session compression.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话压缩插件：按自定义绝对 token 阈值自动压缩，并支持一键压缩当前会话。
