description.en: 哦鲸鲸会话管理插件
Bridges local dsh web to OneBox cloud relay, letting the OneBox Android app reach your computer's AI agent over the public internet.
description.zh: 把本地 dsh web 接入 OneBox 云端中继，使 OneBox 安卓应用能通过公网访问你电脑上的 AI agent。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) and reset countdowns as a badge in the dsh Web UI.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面显示 OpenCode Go 订阅额度徽章，包含滚动、每周、每月用量及重置倒计时。

description.en: Project-level change routing and reuse governance for AI coding agents, helping them avoid duplicates and respect write constraints.
description.zh: Project-level change routing and reuse governance for AI coding agents. Helps Codex and Claude Code find the right capability boundary, avoid duplicate implementations, respect write constraints, and

description.en: Markdown-based knowledge base for DSH agents with stable TIDs, transclusion, structure self-checks, and 9 kb_* tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 代理的 Markdown 知识库：稳定 TID、内容嵌入、结构自检，并提供 9 个 kb_* 工具。

description.en: A DSH plugin that halves repeated billing on long chats via context compression, externalized reasoning, and a read-only investigator sub-agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的上下文压缩与外置推理插件，减少长对话重复计费，并提供只读调查员子代理先核实再动手。

description.en: Linter/CLI for LLM instruction files detecting overly broad semantic wording with protected hooks and local rule injection.
description.zh: 一款面向 LLM 指令文件的插件和命令行工具，用于检测语义边界过宽的用词，并提供受保护的 Hook、项目级本地规则注入，以及针对 Skill、Prompt 和 Agent 的语义陷阱检查。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a left-edge turn rail for clicking to locate each conversation turn's user message.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在对话区左缘添加轮次图标列，点击可定位到每轮的用户输入文本。

description.en: ShotTagGo DSH - full-frame screenshot annotation for DeepSeek Harness
A DSH appearance plugin adding a GAL-style web dialogue view with character art and custom settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加 GAL 风格网页对话视图，含角色立绘和自定义设置的外观插件。

description.en: Packages Electron/Node source projects into double-clickable desktop apps, handling mirrors, long paths, cache cleanup and artifact verification.
description.zh: 把 Electron/Node 源码项目打包成可双击运行的桌面程序，自动处理镜像、长路径、缓存清理并校验产物内容。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness billing plugin showing balance, daily spend, per-step cost, and cost breakdown in a terminal-style UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 计费插件：终端风格界面显示余额、今日消费、每步费用与费用明细，官方价格自动同步。

description.en: Codex-inspired policy bundle that guides coding agents through structured planning and decision-making.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受 Codex 启发的决策与规划策略，引导编码代理进行结构化规划与决策。

description.en: Relays TRAE account model quotas into dsh with multi-account management, daily check-in, rotation, usage stats and reasoning levels.
description.zh: 将 TRAE 账号模型额度接入 dsh，支持多账号管理、每日签到、轮换、用量统计、推理等级和模型可见性。

description.en: Renders SVG, HTML, and Mermaid code blocks into styled chart cards with dark theme, lightbox, and export.
description.zh: 将 SVG/HTML/Mermaid 代码块渲染为图表卡片，支持深色主题、自适应文字、灯箱和导出保存。

description.en: WeChat Reading integration for DeepSeek Harness: provides bookshelf, highlights, reading stats, and flomo export via Skills API.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入微信读书 Skills API，可读取书架、划线想法和阅读统计，并导出到 flomo

description.en: Surfaces the live progress notes each subagent writes itself, so you see what every child agent is doing right now, read-only and non-shadowing.
description.zh: 实时展示每个子代理自己写下的进度笔记，让你看到子代理此刻在做什么；只读，不遮蔽上游工具。

description.en: Agent-neutral Windows computer-use plugin that lets AI agents drive the desktop via MCP, CLI, skills, and native host adapters.
description.zh: 面向智能体的 Windows 计算机使用插件，通过 MCP、CLI、技能和原生宿主适配器让 AI 操作桌面。

description.en: Automatically creates isolated git worktrees for tasks and manages their lifecycle (create, sync, cleanup).
description.zh: 为 DSH 任务自动创建隔离的 git 工作区，并管理其创建、同步和收尾的完整生命周期。

description.en: Opens a visible Edge browser so the AI can drive Xiumi's editor like a person to build, save and verify WeChat article layouts.
description.zh: 打开可见的 Edge 浏览器，让 AI 像人一样操作秀米编辑器，完成微信图文排版、保存并读回校验。

description.en: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions with the 1session CLI or DSH Web plugin. Raw files stay local; SQLite speeds search.
Windows system tray plugin for dsh that shows a whale icon while the service runs and creates a desktop launcher.
description.zh: dsh 的 Windows 系统托盘插件：dsh web 运行时显示鲸鱼图标，停止后 3 秒内消失，并自动维护静默桌面启动器 DSH.lnk，双击无窗口启动服务并打开浏览器。

description.en: Intent-fitting plugin for DSH that has the agent predict a few directions, ask in batches, and converge on one before acting, then propose for confirmation.
description.zh: DSH 的记忆拟合插件：让智能体先预测几个方向、批量提问并收敛为一个，再行动并提交待确认提案。

description.en: Adds a hover-expandable turn section outline (TOC) in the right gutter of the DSH Web and Desktop GUI for navigating long conversations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页与桌面 GUI 右侧边栏添加可悬停展开的轮次大纲（目录），方便在长对话中快速导航。

description.en: Adds a temporary task mode to DeepSeek Harness that spins up a one-click disposable working directory and session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加临时任务模式，一键创建一次性工作目录和会话。

description.en: Safe computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds approval prompts and local audit archives for desktop automation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的安全 computer-use 插件，为桌面自动化增加审批提示与本地审计归档。

description.en: DSH composer plugin that replaces the model menu with a provider-first two-column panel showing every provider and its models.
description.zh: DSH 输入框插件：把「模型」菜单换成供应商优先的双栏面板，所有供应商一级可见。

description.en: Routes an AI assistant's 'ask user' prompt to all claimable UI surfaces simultaneously; the first answer wins.
description.zh: 将 AI 的 ask-user 提问同时发给所有认领会话的交互面，先答先得。

description.en: dsh plugin that interactively switches named model profiles — default model, think level, and per-subagent models — via the host ask-user flow in TUI and web.
description.zh: dsh 插件：通过主机 ask-user 流程在 TUI 与 Web 中交互式切换命名模型配置（默认模型、思考等级、各子代理模型）。

description.en: Unattended task queue: drop .md files, AI executes them and produces reports.
description.zh: 把 .md 文件放入收件箱后由 AI 自动执行并生成报告的无人值守任务队列插件。

description.en: Manages out-of-tree MCP server connections for DeepSeek Harness with a settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理树外 MCP 服务器连接，并提供设置界面。

description.en: Literature search plugin for DeepSeek Harness that queries PubMed NCBI E-utilities and Google Scholar, returning unified paper results.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献检索插件，可查询 PubMed NCBI E-utilities 与 Google Scholar，并统一输出论文结果。

description.en: Mobile-responsive UI adaptation and WireGuard remote enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供手机响应式界面适配，并通过 WireGuard 远程访问文件管理、PTY 终端和设置。

description.en: Displays OpenCode Go usage in DeepSeek Harness web sidebar with auto-refresh and detail hover.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量，支持自动刷新和悬停查看详情。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows live DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar and the cost of each conversation turn with token details.
description.zh: DSH 插件：侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在每轮对话显示花费及 token 明细。

description.en: Brings the full Superpowers skill library to DeepSeek Harness, bootstrapping skills at session start with an optional workflow gate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 引入完整的 Superpowers 技能库，会话启动时自动加载技能，并可选启用工作流门禁。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style /reasoning slash command to DeepSeek Harness Web for switching AI reasoning effort via keyboard.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中添加 Codex 风格的 /reasoning 斜杠命令，通过键盘切换 AI 推理强度。

description.en: Shows the current model provider's wallet balance under the DSH input box and re-reads the matching usage API when you switch providers.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下显示当前模型供应商的钱包余额，切换供应商时立即切换到对应接口重新读取。

description.en: Validates every tool call against the schema the tool itself declared, blocking malformed or unsafe arguments before execution.
description.zh: 按照工具自身声明的模式校验每次工具调用，在执行前拦截格式错误或不安全的参数。

description.en: Select-text annotation pad for DSH documents: annotations are saved as sidecar files, and an Agent reads them to revise drafts and mark status.
description.zh: DSH 文档批注台：在文档中划词批注，批注会保存为 sidecar 文件，Agent 读取批注修改稿件并回标状态。

description.en: Awards 25 collectible rotating 3D medals based on local DSH session token usage and displays them in a medal gallery.
description.zh: 根据本机 DSH 会话的 token 用量颁发 25 枚可旋转查看的 3D 奖牌，并陈列在奖牌馆中。

description.en: Groups DSH skills into toggleable sets with drag-to-reorder and a per-group catalog cost preview.
description.zh: 将 DSH 技能分组并可任意组合开关，支持拖拽排序和每组技能目录成本预览。

description.en: Read-only, scriptable session replay for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI, letting you scrub through past conversation time.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供只读、可脚本化的会话回放，可回溯历史对话。

description.en: Auditable, restart-safe token accounting ledger for DeepSeek Harness, plus a CLI that recomputes usage from raw logs and diffs results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可审计、重启安全的 Token 记账账本，并附带可从原始日志重算并比对差异的 CLI。

description.en: DSH Web GUI popup chip showing plan spend for configured providers: DeepSeek balance and OpenCode Go 5h/7d/monthly quotas.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 弹窗插件，展示已配置服务商的套餐花销：DeepSeek 余额与 OpenCode Go 5小时/7天/月度配额。

description.en: DSH plugin that reviews C++ code against your project's real standard, covering RAII, moves, exception safety, performance and concurrency.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按工程真实 C++ 标准审查代码，覆盖 RAII、移动语义、异常安全、性能与并发安全。

description.en: Replaces static Deep diving status with rotating Claude Code style loading words in DSH web UI.
description.zh: 将 DSH 网页界面中静态的 Deep diving 状态替换为轮换显示的 Claude Code 风格加载提示词。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek-Harness that alert you when a task finishes or the agent needs your attention.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek-Harness 提供 Windows 通知，在任务完成或智能体需要你时提醒你。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a "No API key required" toggle to custom provider configuration.
description.zh: DSH 插件，为自定义提供商配置添加“无需 API 密钥”开关。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects the Docker Desktop MCP Toolkit gateway as an MCP server, with a profile picker in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 将 Docker Desktop MCP Toolkit 网关作为 MCP 服务器接入 DSH，并在 Web GUI 中提供 profile 选择器。

description.en: Enhances the DSH web UI session hover card with configurable metrics, copy ID/path icons, and extra document-preview copy buttons.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页版会话悬停卡片添加可配置指标块、复制 ID/路径图标以及文档预览复制按钮。

description.en: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness: model writes interface in DIL, host compiles it, sandboxed runtime renders as text + rich cards.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的智能 UI：模型用 DIL 编写界面，宿主编译，沙箱运行时渲染为文本和丰富卡片。

description.en: Connects Feishu (Lark) bot apps to the local DeepSeek Harness, one channel per bot with its own model, workspace and permissions.
description.zh: 将飞书机器人应用接入本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个频道独立配置模型、工作区与权限。

description.en: Syncs Codex and Claude Code project histories into DeepSeek Harness as a read-only mirror.
description.zh: 将 Codex 和 Claude Code 的项目历史同步到 DeepSeek Harness，作为只读镜像。

description.en: Security inspector plugin for DSH that checks untrusted skills before installation, with browser-local pre-check and optional LLM review.
description.zh: DSH 安全检查插件，在安装或使用不受信任的 Skill 前先做浏览器本地粗检，再由用户决定是否调用 DSH 已配置的大模型进行结构化复核。

description.en: Stage numbered quote-and-note cards on assistant messages and send aligned annotations to the agent.
description.zh: 在助手消息上暂存带编号的引用与备注卡片，并把对齐后的批注一并发送给 agent

description.en: Adds a button and /exit bash command to kill persistent bash sessions, allowing sandbox mode switching.
description.zh: 添加一个按钮和 /exit bash 命令，用于终止持久化 bash 会话，以便切换沙箱模式。

description.en: Falsification-driven correction loop that turns agent retry loops into auditable evidence for better development quality.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin (not MCP): a falsification-driven correction loop — explicit claims, deterministic gates, mutually exclusive hypotheses — that turns agent retry loops into auditable evidence f

description.en: Schedules message execution to a set time, with a one-click off-peak mode that uses cheaper pricing.
Routes image reading to a dedicated vision model so text-only agents can see images.
description.zh: 将图片读取请求转交给专用视觉模型（如 Kimi K3），让仅支持文本的 agent 也能查看图片。

description.en: Audit ledger that records every agent operation needing approval (tool, reason, risk, decision, outcome) and blocks high-risk actions in gate mode.
description.zh: 审批台账插件：记录 agent 每次需审批的操作（工具、理由、风险、决策、结果），gate 模式可直接拦截高危动作。

description.en: Skill plugin that audits a project's files against China's official AI-generated content labeling rules and flags missing disclosures.
description.zh: 该技能插件按官方规则逐条审计项目文件，检查 AI 生成合成内容标识是否落实并给出证据。

description.en: Preflight skill that audits Chinese app-store submission materials (filing, privacy policy, permissions, account deletion) and drafts listing skeletons.
description.zh: 面向国内应用市场上架的预检 skill：核查备案、隐私政策、权限、账号注销等材料，并生成上架材料骨架。

description.en: Skill plugin that pre-checks Chinese-mainland content for compliance red lines before publishing, flagging banned terms and filing risks.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合规审核技能插件，发布前主动排查中国大陆内容合规风险与备案隐患。

description.en: DSH skill plugin that typesets Chinese official documents to GB/T 9704-2012 and exports .docx/.pdf/.txt with a built-in compliance self-check.
description.zh: 该 DSH 插件按 GB/T 9704-2012 中文公文规范排版，输出 .docx/.pdf/.txt，并自带合规自检。

description.en: Skill plugin that audits an app's privacy policy against its actual code, permissions, SDKs and user-rights entries to flag mismatches.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 skill 插件，对照隐私政策与代码实现，核查权限、第三方 SDK、用户权利入口、敏感信息同意与数据出境等是否一致。

description.en: Audits consent checkboxes for PIPL violations like pre-ticked boxes, bundled consent, and missing withdrawal options.
description.zh: 审查用户同意勾选框，检测默认勾选、捆绑同意、缺少撤回入口等《个保法》违规项。

description.en: Audits whether an agent treats text from web pages, files or emails as trusted instructions, flagging indirect prompt injection risks.
description.zh: 检查 agent 是否把网页、文件或邮件中的外部内容当成指令执行，识别间接提示注入风险。

description.en: 数据分类分级：查数据有没有分级标注与资产清单（数据安全法 21 条）。
个人信息权利：查查阅/复制/删除权有没有真的实现（个保法 45/47/50 条）。
Scans code and config files for PII like ID numbers, bank cards and phone numbers, using checksum validation instead of plain regex to avoid false positives.
description.zh: 扫描代码与配置中的身份证、银行卡、手机号等敏感数据，用校验位验证而非纯正则，避免误报。

description.en: Audits your npm dependency tree for supply-chain risks: install-time scripts, loose version ranges, and non-registry sources.
description.zh: 审计 npm 依赖树的供应链风险：安装即执行的脚本、过宽版本范围和非 registry 来源。

description.en: Statically audits .env config files for git-commit risk, loose file permissions, plaintext secrets, and missing templates.
description.zh: 静态审计 .env 配置文件：是否会被提交进 git、文件权限是否过宽、是否存在明文密钥、有无模板文件。

description.en: Audits whether a project can actually produce evidence in an incident: emergency plan, contacts, log preservation and reporting flow.
description.zh: 自查项目出事时能否拿出证据：应急预案、应急联系人、日志保全与事件上报流程。

description.en: Audits key and certificate files for rotation: flags stale credentials, missing rotation policy docs, and cross-environment key reuse.
description.zh: 审计密钥与证书的轮换情况：检测长期未更新、缺少轮换制度文档以及跨环境复用同一密钥。

description.en: Scans deployments for least-privilege violations: root/privileged containers, wildcard IAM actions, open CORS, and admin token requests.
description.zh: 检查部署中的最小权限违规：容器以 root/privileged 运行、IAM 通配、CORS 全开、令牌申请 admin。

description.en: Scans your dependency tree for GPL/AGPL copyleft contagion, unknown licenses, and missing LICENSE files, with a CI-ready exit code.
description.zh: 扫描依赖树，检出 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知及缺失 LICENSE 等风险，退出码可挂 CI。

description.en: Audits MCP server configs to flag unpinned npx packages, plaintext http:// endpoints and risky local executables, scored by severity.
description.zh: 审计 MCP 配置，标记未锁版本的 npx 包、明文 http:// 端点与本地可执行脚本，并按风险等级分级。

description.en: Local ffmpeg batch video toolkit: compress, transcode, extract frames or audio, add watermarks and burn in subtitles, without uploading originals.
description.zh: 基于本机 ffmpeg 的视频批量处理：压缩、转码、抽帧、抽音轨、加水印、烧录字幕，不上传、不改原片。

description.en: Scans your app code for under-14 children's privacy compliance: guardian consent, age detection, and teen-mode defaults.
description.zh: 扫描应用代码，检查不满14周岁儿童个人信息合规：监护人同意、年龄识别与青少年模式默认开启问题。

description.en: Statically scans text destined for an agent — docs, knowledge bases, prompts, scraped pages — for injected instructions and social-engineering phrasing.
description.zh: 静态扫描准备喂给 agent 的文本（文档、知识库、提示词、抓取网页），查找其中的注入指令与社工话术。

description.en: Scans your codebase for evidence of PIPL-required personal information protection impact assessments and flags gaps.
description.zh: 扫描代码仓库，检查是否按《个人信息保护法》第55条做了个人信息保护影响评估并提示第56条三年留存要求。

description.en: Gives AI agents a pre-release self-check checklist that catches silent release mistakes like missing platform builds or wrong uploads.
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供发布前自检清单，捕获平台构建丢失、误传文件等“无报错但做错了”的发布事故。

description.en: Audits an existing SBOM: whether one exists, has real components, uses a valid CycloneDX/SPDX format, has purls, and is up to date — it never generates one.
description.zh: 审计项目已有的 SBOM：是否存在、是否为空壳、格式是否为标准 CycloneDX/SPDX、组件有无 purl、是否过期，且不负责生成清单。

description.en: Scans code and repositories for leaked secrets like private keys, cloud keys and tokens before you commit, publish or open-source.
description.zh: 在提交、发布或开源前扫描代码与仓库，找出私钥、云密钥和各种令牌等泄露的敏感信息。

description.en: Statically reviews third-party plugins before install, listing command execution, credential-path access, outbound network calls, and install-time hooks.
description.zh: 安装前静态审查第三方插件，列出命令执行、凭据路径访问、外网请求和安装时自动运行的钩子。

description.en: Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that pushes a message to QQ/Telegram/Feishu/WeChat whenever a session stops, so you don't watch the screen.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Cordis 插件：会话停止时把消息推送到 QQ/Telegram/飞书/微信，无需一直盯屏。

description.en: VS Code-style workbench with Preview, Files, and Git panels for DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 VS Code 风格的工作台，含预览、文件与 Git 面板。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music player for DeepSeek Harness with synced lyrics, QR sign-in, likes, and an AI DJ that keeps the queue stocked.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的网易云音乐播放器，支持歌词同步、扫码登录、喜欢列表，以及自动补歌的 AI DJ。

description.en: A lightweight knowledge base plugin for dsh that supports knowledge management and intelligent retrieval.
description.zh: 一个为 dsh 提供轻量级知识管理与智能检索能力的知识库插件。

description.en: Graceful, idle-aware restart of the DSH host from inside a session: waits for every agent to finish, logs the causes, and wakes the requesting sessions after the restart.
Registers the 12 canonical OpenSpec workflow skills and /opsx command aliases inside DeepSeek Harness for native spec-driven workflows.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中注册 12 个 OpenSpec 工作流技能及 /opsx 命令别名，实现原生规范驱动开发流程。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop rounds where the agent posts a decision in the right sidebar, you annotate and choose, and the tool waits.
description.zh: 人机协作决策回合：智能体在右侧边栏展示决策，你批注并选择，工具等待结果后继续。

description.en: RepoFlow is a DSH plugin for Git visualization and GitHub deployment, with settings, account config, repo management, and agent git tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Git 可视化与 GitHub 部署：设置页、全局账号配置、仓库管理、分支图及供智能体使用的 git_* 工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that keeps AI agents on-task by anchoring good first-round behavior, watching each step, and pulling the agent back when it drifts.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，通过锚定首轮良好行为、逐步监控并在智能体偏离时将其拉回，防止智能体跑偏任务。

description.en: Auto-summarizes, compresses and re-injects DSH's long context when the limit is hit, preventing lost conclusions and rising hallucinations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 长上下文达到上限时自动总结、压缩并把结论注入回上下文开头，避免结论丢失与幻觉升高。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness web chat send button icon with the official whale logo via CSS mask, preserving behavior.
description.zh: 用 CSS mask 将 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天发送按钮的图标替换为官方鲸鱼标志，保留原有按钮行为。

description.en: Enables CSS content-visibility:auto on chat list nodes to skip off-screen rendering and improve scrolling performance in long conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天列表消息节点启用 content-visibility:auto，跳过屏外节点的渲染与布局绘制，提升长对话滚动性能。

description.en: A pet plugin for dsh that adds a virtual pet companion to the desktop.
description.zh: 适用于dsh的pet插件

description.en: A pink and berry-purple HUD skin for the dsh web GUI with custom chat/sidebar backgrounds.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web GUI 提供粉与浆果紫 HUD 皮肤，并自定义聊天区和侧边栏背景。

description.en: Arknights-themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with Rhodes Island visuals, cyan HUD, particles, and breathing animations.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的明日方舟主题皮肤，含罗德岛视觉、青色 HUD、粒子与呼吸动效。

description.en: A DSH Web UI skin plugin offering dual-world backdrop themes with animations and optional custom standee images.
description.zh: DSH皮肤插件，提供月读·夜与昼双世界背景主题及动效，支持自定义立绘。

description.en: Scheduled tasks for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar jobs, isolated run history, cron/at schedules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务，在侧边栏管理作业，支持 cron 和 at 调度，运行历史相互隔离。

description.en: Configures Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, and Shift+Enter independently with newline, queue send, or interject send behaviors for DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
A floating file-explorer panel for DSH Web that lets you browse the workspace file tree, preview files, and extend previewers via plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供浮动文件浏览器面板，可浏览工作区文件树、预览文件，并支持通过插件扩展预览器。

description.en: Interactive 3D viewer for protein structures and molecular files in DSH Web's file explorer.
description.zh: DSH Web 文件浏览器插件，以内嵌交互式 3D 查看器预览 .cif、.pdb 蛋白质结构文件及小分子、对接文件。

description.en: File-explorer preview plugin that renders biological sequence files (FASTA/GenBank/SBOL) using SeqViz viewer.
description.zh: DSH Web 文件浏览器预览插件，用 SeqViz 查看器渲染 FASTA、GenBank、JBEI、SnapGene、SBOL 序列文件。

description.en: Lifts image-input restrictions in Web GUI and routes attachments to a vision skill for recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，解除 Web GUI 的图片输入限制，把图片附件文本化后交给 vision skill 识别。

description.en: Injects Mao Zedong thought methodology into AI agent prompts and provides analysis tools for reference, contradiction, practice, planning, and investigation.
description.zh: 向AI提示词注入五节毛泽东思想方法论，并提供原文检索、矛盾分析、调查研究、实践与规划等分析工具。

description.en: DSH web UI plugin that groups models by provider in the model selector and lets you collapse each group.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件：在模型选择器中按提供商分组，并支持折叠每组。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a tabbed, splittable multi-session workbench with native chat panes, saved layouts, artifacts sidebar and built-in browser.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话区变成 tab 化、可自由分栏的多会话工作台，布局持久化并内置浏览器。

description.en: One-click export, import, migrate and back up DSH plugins across profiles and machines, including full bundle and whole-machine migration.
description.zh: 一键导出、导入、迁移和备份 DSH 插件，支持跨 profile 与整机迁移，并提供全量整合包。

description.en: Hot-plug enable/disable switches for installed DSH plugins without restart, protecting core plugins.
description.zh: 为已安装的 DSH 插件提供热插拔开关，无需重启即可启用或禁用插件，并保护核心插件。

description.en: Enforces strict dsh harness policy: repeated-failure intervention, a glob-protected critical-path gate with diagnostics, and automatic post-write checks.
description.zh: 为 dsh 框架强制执行严格策略：重复失败干预、glob 保护的关键路径拦截与诊断，以及写入后的自动检查。

description.en: A DSH plugin that provides tiered, semantically recalled project memory with per-project isolation and hard-guards for critical memories.
description.zh: 北极星记忆：DSH 项目记忆插件，支持分层注入、语义召回、关键记忆硬保护及按项目隔离。

description.en: Adds a persistent pinned session menu to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar for quick access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加常驻的置顶会话菜单，便于快速访问已固定的会话。

description.en: Creates Claude Code-style away session summaries (goal, current task, next action) for DeepSeek Harness via a bounded LLM call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话在空闲后通过单次受控 LLM 调用生成简洁的离开摘要，包含总体目标、当前任务和下一步行动。

description.en: A lightweight DSH theme switcher that auto-detects installed skins, toggles them exclusively, and falls back to official default.
description.zh: 自动检测已安装的 DSH 皮肤，一键互斥切换主题外观，全部停用时回退官方默认，即时生效并在重启后保留设置。

description.en: Durable JSONL journal that records every abnormal dsh tool-call exit, folds entries by error signature, and lets the agent read them back.
description.zh: 持久化 JSONL 日志：记录每次异常的 dsh 工具调用退出，按错误签名归并，并可由智能体读回。

description.en: Strict verifier that checks dsh code and commands with real tools like the Lean 4 kernel, language compilers, and shell hazard rules.
description.zh: 严格校验插件，使用 Lean 4 内核、语言编译器和 shell 危险规则来检查 dsh 代码与命令。

description.en: Adds Codex-style folding to collapse reasoning chains and tool calls into disclosure groups in DSH web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加 Codex 风格折叠，将推理链和工具调用收进可展开折叠的分组中。

description.en: Provides local Ollama-based vision capabilities for DeepSeek Harness, enabling native image understanding without cloud dependency.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 通过本地 Ollama 请求层提供图片理解能力，孪生路由实现原生看图，无需云端依赖。

description.en: Virtual session folder grouping, drag & drop, and subproject manager for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供虚拟会话文件夹分组、拖拽排序和子项目管理功能。

description.en: Adds toolbar buttons (show in Finder, fullscreen, copy path/file) and a token usage card to DSH's right preview panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：右侧预览面板工具栏增强（访达显示/全屏/复制路径/复制文件）+ Token 用量卡

description.en: A Web3D energy orb that floats in the lower-right of the DSH Web GUI as decorative session-state visualization, pulsing while a turn runs.
description.zh: 一颗漂浮在 DSH Web GUI 右下角的 Web3D 能量球，以装饰方式可视化会话状态，回合运行时双拍心跳般涨缩。

description.en: DSH web interface plugin for daily token usage stats, showing charts, KPIs, and cost estimates from session logs.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面插件，从会话日志统计每日 token 用量，展示图表、关键指标和费用估算。

description.en: Login gate with account management for DeepSeek Harness web UI, storing credentials securely in a local file.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供登录验证入口和账号管理，凭据安全存储在本地文件。

description.en: Adds @ file/directory suggestions to chat composer, letting users reference project paths in prompts.
description.zh: 在聊天输入框中输入 @ 时提供文件与目录补全建议，方便在提示词中引用项目路径。

description.en: Adds a git branch selector to the DeepSeek Harness chat composer interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框添加 Git 分支选择器，可在界面中切换分支。

description.en: Adds a Skill management page to DeepSeek Harness Web Settings, organized by workspace, as an out-of-tree plugin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置添加按工作区组织的技能管理页面，作为树外插件。

description.en: Self-maintained pi-ai bridge for DeepSeek Harness, adding an LLM model selector plus provider quota, billing and settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自维护的 pi-ai 桥接，包含模型选择器、供应商额度/计费与设置界面。

description.en: Version-aware adapter registry that decouples third-party Cordis plugins from dsh's internal service names, paths, and RPC internals.
description.zh: 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh 的 Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。

description.en: Emotion-first encrypted diary plugin for DeepSeek Harness with templates, mood browsing, writing reminders and an MCP adapter.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的情绪优先加密日记插件，支持模板、心情浏览、写作提醒与 MCP 适配器。

description.en: Renders interactive 3D molecular structures from file paths or PDB/SDF/MOL2/MOL data in the chat interface.
description.zh: 在会话界面渲染交互式 3D 分子查看器，可传入分子文件路径或 PDB、SDF、MOL2、MOL 格式数据，基于 3Dmol.js 支持旋转、缩放、样式切换与着色。

description.en: Browse MUSE AV workspace assets, image libraries and generation history, and copy direct asset links.
description.zh: 按工作区浏览 MUSE AV 素材、图库与出图记录，并可复制素材直链。

description.en: Adds a real "delete session" button to the DSH web UI that permanently removes a session's workspace, archive entry, memory record and disk event log.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面新增真正的“删除会话”按钮，彻底清除该会话的工作区挂账、归档条目、内存记录与磁盘事件日志。

description.en: Automatically reorders DSH sidebar workspaces by latest user activity and persists the new order across restarts.
description.zh: 根据最新用户活动自动重排 DSH 侧边栏工作区顺序，并在重启后保留该排序。

description.en: Dota 2 The International themed skin for DeepSeek Harness web UI with light/dark variants and vector wings background.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 Dota 2 国际邀请赛主题皮肤，含明暗两套配色与矢量翅膀背景。

description.en: DSH Web plugin providing a dynamic AGENTS.md dropdown to select and inject context rules into chat system prompts.
description.zh: DSH Web插件，用下拉菜单选择AGENTS.md规则并注入聊天系统提示词

description.en: Enhances DSH Web chat with message indexing ruler and improved plan approval cards.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 聊天增加消息索引标尺并改进计划审批卡片

description.en: DSH plugin manager providing inventory, transactional profile management, and conflict engine for plugin lifecycle.
description.zh: DSH插件管理器，提供清单、事务式Profile管理和冲突引擎，用于插件生命周期控制。

description.en: DSH plugin that exposes the local DSH WebUI to the LAN and lets phones access it via QR code scanning with authorization.
description.zh: DSH插件，把本地DSH WebUI暴露到局域网，手机扫码授权后即可远程访问和操作。

description.en: Watch Claude Code and Codex work inside dsh with real terminal panes and tools to seat, hand work, and read screens.
description.zh: 在 dsh 会话工作区内为 Claude Code 和 Codex 各开一个可输入的真实终端窗格，并提供五个工具让 dsh 智能体安置它们、派发任务和读取屏幕内容。

description.en: A browser automation plugin for dsh that remembers site-specific tools, creates new scripts from successful ones, and lets users take control.
description.zh: ego lite browser automation for dsh that remembers — recall a site's learned tools, promote a working script into a new one, hand the user the keyboard for real. 7 tools, host-only, MIT.

description.en: Shows DeepSeek session cost, active time-of-use tariff, flip time, and balance as a line under the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 本次会话费用、当前分时电价档位、切换时间以及余额。

description.en: A DSH plugin that provides Git repository management through a web UI.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，通过Web界面提供Git仓库管理功能。

description.en: Git panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness sidebar with visual staging, commits, push, and branch switching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的 Git 面板插件，支持可视化暂存、提交、推送和切换分支。

description.en: DSH sidebar prompt library: save reusable prompt cards, attach them to your next message, or auto-inject per session every turn.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏提示词库插件：把常用指令存成卡片，一键带入下一条消息，也可按会话每轮自动注入。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns the composer into a one-click git/SVN commit tool, grouping changes by Angular type and scope and generating commit messages with the current model.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把输入框变成一键提交工具：按 Angular 类型与作用域分组暂存改动，并用当前模型生成提交信息后直接执行 git 提交。

description.en: Agent Bot provides multi-agent collaboration and a delivery pipeline for DeepSeek Harness, derived from AgentTeams and MIT licensed.
description.zh: Agent Bot 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体协作与交付流水线，衍生自 AgentTeams，采用 MIT 许可证。

description.en: Codex-style Settings panel for DeepSeek Harness showing cumulative token usage, a one-year activity heatmap, cache hit rate, and most-used models.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 DSH 设置面板：查看累计 token、年度活动热力图、缓存命中率与最常用模型。

description.en: Workaround that makes dsh's authenticated Web UI count as loopback so Host-restricted settings work behind a reverse proxy.
description.zh: 让 dsh 已认证 Web UI 被视为 loopback 的变通方案，使经反向代理访问时受 Host 限制的设置可用。

description.en: Per-conversation chat settings for DeepSeek Harness: custom system prompts, context folding by turn count, sampling overrides, and a low-token pure chat mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单对话级设置：独立系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数覆盖以及低 token 纯聊天模式。

description.en: Bridges an existing DSH session to a QQ account over OneBot/NapCat, waking on mentions and relaying replies back to QQ.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot/NapCat 把已有的 DSH 会话接到 QQ 个人号，被 @ 时唤醒回复并回传消息。

description.en: Tracks per-session and global API cost stats with peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 轻量级 DeepSeek Harness 插件，按会话和全局统计 API 费用，区分高峰与低谷时段定价。

description.en: Forks the current DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session into an ephemeral side chat that can edit files without polluting the main transcript.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供侧边聊天，将当前会话分叉为可实际编辑文件的临时对话，且不污染主记录。

description.en: A local dashboard for DSH token usage and costs, featuring breakdowns, cache savings, per-session drills, filters, and monthly budget tracking.
description.zh: DSH本地token用量与成本仪表板，提供分段明细、缓存节省、会话下钻、过滤与月度预算跟踪。

description.en: Widens Deepseek Harness chat view to full screen, reduces input box height, and adds other UI perks.
description.zh: 将 Deepseek Harness 聊天视图加宽至全屏，降低输入框高度，并添加其他 UI 改进。

description.en: Unofficial Windows 10/11 plugin giving DSH native background toast alerts and a taskbar unread badge counting distinct root sessions.
description.zh: 非官方 Windows 10/11 插件，为 DSH 提供原生后台吐司通知，并在任务栏显示按不同根会话计数的未读角标。

description.en: Manage archived sessions in the DSH Web GUI with show, unarchive, and permanent delete operations.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中管理已归档会话，支持查看、取消归档和永久删除，且不修改官方包。

description.en: Color-code user prompts and final assistant replies by conversation turn in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web UI中按对话轮次为用户提示和助手最终回复着色。

description.en: Orchestrates multi-agent work in DeepSeek Harness with task decomposition, DAG workflows, and prompt caching optimization.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体任务分解、DAG 工作流编排与提示缓存优化。

description.en: Adds a session cost chip in the conversation header showing live token usage by bucket, tariff rates, and countdown to next switch.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加成本芯片，显示按桶分类的实时令牌用量、峰谷费率与下次切换倒计时。

description.en: Manage chat sessions in DeepSeek Harness sidebar: pin chats, search content, access archives, reduce noise.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏中管理会话：固定对话、搜索内容、查看存档、减少干扰。

description.en: Adds a confirmation-guarded stop action to the session-header job list so a running background job can be cancelled on demand.
description.zh: 在会话头部的任务列表中新增带确认弹窗的停止操作，可随时取消正在运行的后台任务。

description.en: Backs up and restores your DSH workspace, byte-exact conversations, attachments, settings and dsh-mnemon memory as a single zip archive.
description.zh: 将 DSH 工作区、精确对话记录、附件、设置和 dsh-mnemon 记忆数据打包成单个 zip 并支持还原。

description.en: Scans local AI-tool skill folders, registers every skill as a DSH-callable /command, and installs skills from GitHub repos.
description.zh: 扫描本机各 AI 工具的技能目录，把每个技能注册成 DSH 可调用技能，并支持从 GitHub 仓库一键安装。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten built-in color schemes plus a custom theme editor supporting glass effects and per-token overrides.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：十款内置配色，支持自建主题编辑器、玻璃质感与逐 token 覆盖。

description.en: Adds progressive, on-demand tool discovery to DeepSeek Harness PTC using the official scoped registry.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness PTC 提供基于官方作用域注册表的渐进式工具发现能力。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores memories as YAML files, injects them into prompts, and gives models read/write tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的跨会话长期记忆插件，用 YAML 文件存储记忆并注入提示词，同时给模型读写工具。

description.en: Replaces DSH's two-level model menu with a searchable, provider-grouped model picker plus a separate thinking-level slider.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的两级模型菜单换成可搜索、按 provider 分组的一次点开列表，思考档位改为独立滑杆。

description.en: Adds terminal-style up/down arrow history navigation to the DSH prompt input, persisting recent prompts via localStorage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加上下方向键历史导航，可循环切换最近发送的消息，并用 localStorage 跨会话持久化。

description.en: Replaces the DSH WebUI chat running-status row with a PRTS neuron connection state, using an inlined compressed animated icon and swapped copy.
description.zh: 将 DSH WebUI 聊天运行状态行替换为 PRTS 神经元连接态，使用内联压缩动图图标并替换文案。

description.en: Web-UI panel that turns a requirement into a DSH skill: runs the official creator, streams stages and logs, scores it out of 10 and reworks until it passes.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面用完整面板创建技能：填写需求、调用官方 creator、实时查看阶段与日志、10 分制评测，未达标自动打回修复直到通过。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style left navigation rail to DeepSeek Harness conversation transcripts for scrolling and message jumping.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话记录添加 Codex 风格的左侧导航栏，用于滚动定位和跳转到指定消息。

description.en: Adds arbitrary file upload to DeepSeek Harness Web chat, storing files in workspace uploads for agent access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天添加任意文件上传，文件保存到工作区 uploads 目录供智能体访问。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会议记录插件：系统声音 + 麦克风混音录音、本地离线转写、一键生成会议纪要（不联网、不上传音频）
In-page task notifications for DeepSeek Harness with toasts, bell history, WebAudio cue, and flashing tab title.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供页面内任务通知：弹窗提示、铃铛历史、WebAudio 提示音和标签页标题闪烁。

description.en: A liquid-glass skin for DeepSeek Harness with layered glass surfaces, time-of-day wallpapers, theme color and per-layer controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供液态玻璃皮肤，支持分层玻璃表面、随时间变化的壁纸、主题色与逐层调节。

description.en: Turns mobilecli into a live screen panel in the DSH sidebar, giving one API to view and control iOS and Android devices, plus a bundled model skill.
description.zh: 把 mobilecli 封装为 DSH 右侧边栏实时画面面板，用一套 API 查看并操作 iOS 与 Android 设备，并注册内置 skill。

description.en: Adds a delete action to DSH session rows, moving sessions to a restorable trash can or purging them permanently.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话行添加删除操作，可将会话移入可恢复的回收站或彻底清除。

description.en: DSH plugin that tracks GitLab CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes cluster health in one place.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中集中跟踪 GitLab CI/CD 流水线与 Kubernetes 集群健康状态的插件。

description.en: Permanently deletes a DeepSeek Harness session from the sidebar menu, removing its conversation files and locally cached data.
description.zh: 从侧边栏菜单中永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并清除本地的对话文件与缓存数据。

description.en: Renders LaTeX formulas into images, draws math figures from a declarative spec, and converts formulas or SVG into embeddable images.
description.zh: 将 LaTeX 公式排版为图片，按声明式规范绘制数学图形，并把公式或 SVG 转换为可嵌入文档的图片。

description.en: Physically delete DeepSeek Harness sessions through an undoable recycle bin: move sessions to trash, restore them, or purge them permanently.
description.zh: 通过可撤销的回收站物理删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话：将会话移入回收站、恢复或彻底清除。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects SSH, WSL or Docker remote environments so the agent's file I/O, search and bash commands all run on the remote target.
description.zh: DSH 插件：接入 SSH/WSL/Docker 远程环境，agent 的文件读写、搜索与命令全部在远端执行。

description.en: Automatically rotates workspace background images from the backgrounds folder with a sidebar control panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 背景轮播插件，把工作区 backgrounds 目录中的图片设为背景并自动轮播，侧边栏提供控制面板。

description.en: Observe and steer a local OpenAI Codex session from DeepSeek Harness over the Codex app-server JSON-RPC protocol.
description.zh: 通过 Codex app-server 协议，在 DeepSeek Harness 中观察并操控本地 OpenAI Codex 会话。

description.en: Pure-host DSH plugin that keeps one up-to-date incremental backup per conversation, with previewed restore and rule-based cleanup via a recycle bin.
description.zh: 纯 host 的 DSH 插件：为每个对话增量备份成一份最新文件，支持先预览再恢复，并按规则清理（先入回收站留 7 天）。

description.en: A pixel-art arcade game that sits above the DSH composer, so you can play while waiting for the model to think.
description.zh: 一个位于输入框上方的像素街机小游戏，让你在等待模型思考时随手玩上一把。

description.en: Adds a GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap to the DSH new-session screen with year selection and totals.
description.zh: 在 DSH 新建会话界面添加 GitHub 风格每日 token 用量热力图，可按日历年查看，支持绿蓝配色与显示开关，并显示今日、本月和累计总量。

description.en: Read-only DSH ecosystem health panel showing bundle, patch, skill, upgrade, and decoupling diagnostics in one view.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 生态健康面板，一屏查看 bundle、patch、skill、升级与解耦等诊断。

description.en: Self-maintained kanban task board for the DSH web GUI, where each card is a real DSH session and a human confirms completion.
description.zh: 用于 DSH Web GUI 的自维护任务看板，每张卡对应一次真实 DSH 会话，完成需人工验收。

description.en: AI fishing assistant providing spot analysis, fish activity, and bait & lure recommendations.
description.zh: AI钓鱼助手，提供钓点分析、鱼情分析、钓点分享，并给出饵料与拟饵推荐。

description.en: Tracks prices, celebrity news, industry info, and custom metrics with automatic change alerts and scheduled push.
description.zh: 🎯 BigFocus 追踪管家 - 商品价格/明星动态/行业追踪 | Price tracking, monitoring, alerts

description.en: AI fridge manager that recognizes ingredients from photos, recommends recipes, and manages inventory.
description.zh: AI冰箱管家，可从照片识别食材、推荐菜谱并管理库存。

description.en: AI product research skill analyzing market, tech, and supply chain to output three-tier product spec proposals.
description.zh: AI产品调研技能，分析市场、技术与供应链，输出三套产品规格方案。

description.en: Global hotspot news monitor covering politics, economy, tech, military with market impact analysis and scheduled pushes.
description.zh: openclaw - skills : Eyes · 大眼看世界（全球热点·国际新闻·市场分析）- Global News Monitor

description.en: Global fruit price tracking tool with daily wholesale collection and RMB/kg conversion.
description.zh: openclaw - skills : Fruit Pi · 水果派（全球水果实时价格）

description.en: A Q-style kitten overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, showing a live peak/off-peak pricing badge and per-turn cost.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Q 版小猫悬浮挂件，实时显示峰谷价格标签与每轮对话费用。

description.en: DSH 左侧边栏「Skill 管理」：查看全局与项目级 skill 的调用频次与上下文占用，支持一键归档 / 还原。
A theme plugin named Ayaka for the dsh deepseek harness.
description.zh: 为 dsh deepseek harness 提供名为 Ayaka 的主题插件

description.en: Windows desktop notifications and sound alerts when an agent turn finishes or the harness is waiting for you.
description.zh: 当代理回合完成或 harness 等待你时，发送 Windows 桌面通知和声音提醒。

description.en: Adds recoverable session deletion by moving deleted DeepSeek Harness sessions to a trash folder for 7-day restoration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加可恢复的会话删除功能：删除的会话移入回收站，可在 7 天内恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the model answer with an operable interface instead of plain text, so users can interact with it directly.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，让模型直接返回可操作的界面而非纯文字回答，用户可与之直接交互。

description.en: Dual-model auto-routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness choosing between low-cost direct and high-cost upgrade with escape-learning closed loop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供双模型自动路由，在低成本直接处理与高成本升级之间选择，并包含逃逸学习闭环。

description.en: Annotate proxied web pages and insert structured prompts with full-page screenshots straight into the composer.
description.zh: 在代理网页上添加标注，并将带整页截图的结构化提示词直接写入输入框。

description.en: Groups related AI skills into lazy-loaded bundles to reduce context pollution in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将相关 AI 技能分组为懒加载技能包，减少 DeepSeek Harness 中的上下文污染。

description.en: Panel-style local terminal for DSH web GUI, providing real PTY shells via node-pty in a multi-tab xterm.js interface.
description.zh: 为DSH Web GUI提供的面板式本地终端，通过node-pty实现真实PTY shell，基于xterm.js多标签界面。

description.en: A DSH client plugin that floats an ordered, collapsible list of user questions and lets you click to jump to that question in the conversation.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 客户端插件，浮动显示按顺序排列、可折叠的用户提问列表，点击可跳转到对话中对应的提问。

description.en: A third-party DeepSeek Harness plugin that stores one custom prompt per workspace and auto-injects it into model context at every session start.
description.zh: 一个第三方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可为每个工作区保存一段专属提示词，并在该工作区每次会话启动时自动注入模型上下文。

description.en: Floating widget showing model account balance for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with a settings master switch.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中显示模型账户余额的悬浮窗，可在设置中通过总开关启用或关闭。

description.en: Plays a chime when tasks complete in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with volume control and custom audio support.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中任务完成时播放提示音，支持音量调节、自定义音频和插件设置页。

description.en: A DSH web GUI idea workbench with AI parsing/scoring and association graphs, storing data as a single JSON file.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的灵感工作台插件，支持想法池录入、孵化、计划和立项管理，提供 AI 解析评分与关联图谱，数据存于单个 JSON 文件。

description.en: Jarvis blue tech-style skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with HUD design and token remapping.
description.zh: 可兼容web-ui的贾维斯皮肤

description.en: A token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness showing model usage, costs, cache hit rate, and channel balances.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 token 用量统计面板，展示各模型使用量、费用、缓存命中率和渠道余额。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and today's spend in a DSH sidebar card with an expandable five-level cost breakdown and peak/off-peak status.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏常驻显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与今日花费，点击展开五层级成本明细并显示峰谷时段状态。

description.en: Image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness — Doubao Seedream 5.0 Pro / qwen-image-3.0-pro, watermark-free, verbatim in-image text, inline chat display.
description.zh: Image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness — Doubao Seedream 5.0 Pro / qwen-image-3.0-pro, watermark-free, verbatim in-image text, inline chat display.

description.en: Adds a balance button to the session header showing account balance, real-time token usage, and estimated costs for DeepSeek sessions.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加余额按钮，显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、实时 token 用量和预估费用。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek Harness billing balance display with auto-refresh and low-balance alerts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 左下角显示实时余额条并可手动或定时刷新，设置页可配刷新间隔与低余额告警阈值，低余额变红提示，也支持对话中通过 deepseek_balance 工具查询余额。

description.en: Tracks usage statistics and awards achievements for DeepSeek Harness, letting developers follow progress and level up their journey.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供使用统计与成就系统，帮助开发者跟踪进度、逐步升级。

description.en: Plays configurable start/done/error tones during DeepSeek Harness agent answer lifecycle.
description.zh: Agent answer sound effects for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: start/done/error tones following the answering lifecycle, per-kind volume, custom audio files, master switch.

description.en: Adds a "Delete Session" item to the DSH Web UI sidebar menu that truly removes session records, derived caches and sub-agent sessions from disk.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 侧栏会话菜单添加「删除会话」，真正从磁盘删除会话记录、派生缓存与子智能体会话。

description.en: DSH/Cordis plugin that lets you circle UI elements in chat and injects their selector, source location, box model and computed styles into the model prompt.
description.zh: DSH/Cordis 插件：在对话中圈选 UI 元素，把选择器、源码位置、盒模型与计算样式注入模型上下文。

description.en: Panel button that pushes a local project to GitHub: bind a token, pick or create a repo, choose files, and set visibility.
description.zh: 面板按钮可将本地项目推送到 GitHub：绑定令牌、选择或新建仓库、挑选文件并设置公开/私有。

description.en: DSH 运行时监察：工具调用 / 事件循环 / 错误风暴实时体检 + 按调用强制停止 + 右下角红绿灯挂件（0 token）
Material Design 3 Monet dynamic-color wallpaper theming for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, extracting seeds from wallpapers and mapping MD3 tokens.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供基于 Material Design 3 莫奈动态取色的壁纸主题，从壁纸提取种子色并映射 MD3 令牌。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows in-app toasts and macOS notifications when a session finishes a turn or needs your input.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话完成一轮对话或需要你处理时，弹出应用内提示和 macOS 系统通知。

description.en: A DSH workbench for multi-pane conversations and autonomous agent teams.
description.zh: DSH 超级工作台，支持多窗会话与自主智能体团队。

description.en: Shows the logged-in account's DeepSeek wallet balance in the Harness Web UI sidebar footer, with click-to-refresh and bilingual tooltips.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 侧边栏底部显示已登录账号的钱包余额，支持点击刷新与中英双语提示。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for DeepSeek Harness Web: ↑/↓ recalls current-session messages, /history opens searchable panel; pure client-side.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入历史插件：↑/↓ 翻查本会话消息，/history 搜索面板，纯客户端按会话隔离。

description.en: A DSH cost tab that shows token spend by day and by model, correctly pricing the same model across official, marketplace and reseller channels.
description.zh: DSH 的「费用」标签页，按天、按模型展示 token 花费，并能准确区分同一模型在官方、百炼和第三方转售渠道的不同价格。

description.en: Adds Codex-style dim ghost-text predictions for the next message in the DSH composer, accepted with Tab.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加 Codex 风格的暗色下一条消息预测（幽灵文本），按 Tab 接受。

description.en: DSH plugin that permanently deletes sessions from disk, with per-session delete and one-click bulk deletion of all archived sessions.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把会话从磁盘彻底删除，支持单条删除和一键删除全部已归档会话。

description.en: Scenario-card workbench that collects parameters via interactive forms and launches real DSH agent sessions with optional agent presets.
description.zh: 以场景卡片为入口、交互式表单收集参数，并通过宿主 sessionController 真实创建 DSH Agent 会话的工作台插件。

description.en: Live status badge for DSH session header plus non-interrupting in-flight guidance, with image attachments and interjection history.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话头添加实时状态徽标，并支持不打断的运行中指导，含图片附件与插话历史。

description.en: Ponytail adds six skills and an always-on anti-over-engineering ruleset to DeepSeek Harness, plus a Plugin configuration card.
description.zh: Ponytail 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六项技能、始终开启的防过度设计规则集，以及插件配置卡片。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek plan quota, wallet balance, OpenCode Go subscription windows and per-session cost estimates in the composer dock.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠区显示 DeepSeek 套餐配额、钱包余额、OpenCode Go 订阅窗口以及单次会话的成本估算。

description.en: Cross-session experience memory for DSH: lessons are kept only with a verifiable source, relevant ones are injected each turn, unused ones retire.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供跨会话经验记忆：经验必须有可验证来源，相关经验每轮注入，无人使用的会被淘汰。

description.en: Agent tools to read, search, export, fork and forward DSH session log slices for context reuse.
description.zh: 以智能体工具形式读取、搜索、导出、分叉和转发 DSH 会话日志片段，实现上下文复用。

description.en: Mission guardian for DeepSeek Harness with assertion rules, correction detection, and review queue.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供事件驱动的任务守护，包含断言规则、纠错检测和审查队列。

description.en: Self-learning habit engine for the DeepSeek Harness with correction signals, threshold judgment, and human gate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的自学习习惯引擎，依据纠正信号与阈值判断学习习惯，并设两级人工确认关卡。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness to browse, install, and update community plugins from the Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件中心，可在 Web 界面浏览、安装和更新社区插件。

description.en: DSH web client plugin that adds a button to collapse the settings navigation into a narrow icon rail on phones.
description.zh: DSH 网页客户端插件，一键将设置面板导航折叠为窄图标轨道，让手机窄屏下正文重新可读。

description.en: Turns DSH interface controls into draggable, resizable floating panels with an element picker and a screenshot-based panel manager.
description.zh: 把 DSH 界面控件变成可拖动、缩放的浮动面板，提供元素选择器与截图浮窗管理器。

description.en: Pick a local .md prompt template with / at conversation start; it binds the whole conversation with AGENTS.md-level authority.
description.zh: 在新建对话时用 / 选择本地 .md 提示词模板，并以 AGENTS.md 级权威绑定整个对话。

description.en: Manages long-session context water levels, handover-document checks, compaction and session succession inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理长会话上下文水位、交接文档体检、压缩续跑与会话换任登记。

description.en: LAN instant messaging plugin for DeepSeek Harness instances to discover each other and chat reliably with accounts, channels, and shared file spaces.
description.zh: 让局域网内的 DeepSeek Harness 实例以账号身份互相发现并可靠聊天，支持频道和共享文件空间。

description.en: Code-review pack for dsh adding a /review shortcut over the pinned Changes page and a Skill explaining rejected changes.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的代码审查插件包，提供基于 Changes 页面的 /review 快捷入口和解释变更被拒含义的 Skill。

description.en: Secret store for DSH Desktop: keeps API keys in one file, injects them as $DSH shell variables, and limits assistant access via a settings panel.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的密钥仓库：集中保存 API 密钥，以 $DSH 环境变量注入 shell，并可在设置面板限制助手的访问权限。

description.en: Adds a row of one-click model preset buttons above the DSH composer; left click switches the session model, right click edits the preset.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方添加一排模型预设按钮：左键切换会话模型，右键编辑预设。

description.en: Renders arbitrary HTML/CSS/JS in a sandboxed iframe within DeepSeek Harness sessions, in five placements, with POST+SSE messaging back to the model.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中用沙箱 iframe 渲染任意 HTML/CSS/JS，提供五种放置位置，并通过 POST + SSE 与模型通信。

description.en: Adds voice input and Edge-TTS read-aloud to DeepSeek Harness, requiring no API keys.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加语音输入和 Edge-TTS 朗读功能，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin to browse and edit AGENTS.md files directly inside DSH Web sessions.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，可在 DSH Web 会话中直接浏览和编辑 AGENTS.md 文件。

description.en: Adds permanent session deletion to the DSH sidebar menu, removing the session log and projection cache and cleaning up workspace bookkeeping failure-safely.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏会话菜单中新增永久删除功能，删除会话日志与投影缓存并清理工作区记账，失败时不留半删目录。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn checkpoints, in-place context truncation, and affected-file diff preview.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 TRAE 风格对话回滚：逐轮检查点、就地截断上下文并预览受影响文件差异。

description.en: Host plugin that creates stateful connections between DSH sessions and loads connection-level card plugins.
description.zh: 为主机插件，在 DSH 会话之间建立有状态连接，并加载连接级卡片插件。

description.en: Renders DSH conversation histories as a horizontal mind-map tree, auto-linking each turn by question similarity with fully local analysis.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话轨迹渲染成横向层级思维导图，按提问相似度自动续接分支，分析全部在浏览器本地完成。

description.en: Adds an instant search box to the DSH settings panel to filter setting pages and general items.
description.zh: 为DSH设置面板增加即时搜索框，筛选设置页和通用设置项。

description.en: Headless execution layer for DSH Hub with deterministic plan/apply, candidate generation, confirmation, and recovery.
description.zh: 为 DSH Hub 提供无头执行层，支持确定性的计划与执行、候选项生成、确认与恢复。

description.en: Session-mode system for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: registry, switch, and sidebar dot rendering.
description.zh: The session-mode system for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: the segment registry every mode plugin registers into, the switch that renders them, and the sidebar dots that colour their conversations

description.en: Left-sidebar session tree for DeepSeek Harness: nested subagent sessions, click-through conversations, and tree_send messaging across the tree.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加左侧会话树，展示嵌套子代理会话，支持点击查看对话，并可用 tree_send 向任意可续会话发消息。

description.en: Book real flights, hotels, and cars using the otto-travel MCP connector as a dsh plugin.
description.zh: 作为 dsh 插件接入 otto-travel MCP 连接器，用于预订真实的航班、酒店和租车。

description.en: Schedules drafted DSH chat messages to be sent automatically at a chosen time, with session isolation and offline catch-up delivery.
description.zh: 定时以你的身份发送已起草的DSH消息，支持会话隔离与断电补发。

description.en: Turns any selected reply snippet into an atomic reference chip you can delete as one unit, click to jump back to the source, and send as structured data.
description.zh: 将选中的回复片段转成原子引用标签，可整体删除、点击跳回来源，并在发送时结构化序列化。

description.en: Adds a floating right-side navigator to dsh conversation pages, listing user inputs and jumping to them on click.
description.zh: dsh quick view plugin

description.en: DSH web plugin that shows model-provider quota and usage for DeepSeek, GLM Coding Plan, OpenRouter, Kimi Coding and custom adapters.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：查看 DeepSeek、GLM Coding Plan、OpenRouter、Kimi Coding 及自定义适配器的模型额度与用量。

description.en: Provides agents with permission-controlled local Chrome browsing and integrates BrowserPilot admin and diagnostics.
description.zh: BrowserPilot 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，为 Agent 提供受权限策略控制的本机 Chrome 浏览能力，并集成 BrowserPilot 管理后台入口与连接状态诊断。

description.en: A desktop pet companion for DeepSeek Harness with local token and cost usage stats, budget alerts, and session management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌宠伴侣插件，提供本地 Token/费用统计、预算告警和会话管理。

description.en: Tree-sitter WASM symbol index, importance-ranked repo map and per-file F/R/A/S lines that give agents a checkable map of a codebase.
description.zh: 基于 tree-sitter WASM 的符号索引、按重要度排序的仓库地图与每文件一行 F/R/A/S，为 agent 提供可核对的代码库地图。

description.en: 十个零依赖确定性工具，一个包给 dsh：json / calculator / encoding / diff / time / csv / regex / stat / markdown / schema
DSH plugin that records and displays your online, active and task durations with daily/weekly/monthly dashboards, stored locally.
description.zh: DSH 插件，记录并展示在线、活跃与任务时长，提供日/周/月仪表盘，数据只存本机。

description.en: dsh web GUI settings page for editing MCP server configs as JSON and mounting live mcp-client instances from them.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器设置页：以 JSON 编辑服务器配置，并据此挂载实时 mcp-client 实例。

description.en: User rules settings page for the dsh web GUI: a list editor over a profile-config namespace whose rules are injected as a systemPrompt section
Renders LLM responses as live interactive mini-apps, calculators, and themed Mermaid diagrams inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将大模型回复渲染为可交互的迷你应用、计算器和主题化 Mermaid 图表，直接运行在 DeepSeek Harness 中。

description.en: Password-protected LAN gateway that lets phones on the same WiFi open the desktop DSH instance in a browser.
description.zh: 带密码认证的局域网网关，让同一 WiFi 下的手机用浏览器访问电脑上的 DSH 实例。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness Windows computer-use: screenshots, mouse, keyboard, window control and clipboard via a native Rust helper.
description.zh: 通过原生 Rust 助手为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 电脑操作能力：截图、鼠标、键盘、窗口控制与剪贴板。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar workspace file manager with context menus, drag-to-move, an editor, recoverable trash, and Agent change notices.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏添加工作区文件管理器，支持右键菜单、拖拽移动、编辑器、可恢复回收站和 Agent 变更提醒。

description.en: Per-workspace floating notepad in the DSH session view with drag, minimize, hide and one-click insert into the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话视图中为每个工作区提供浮动便签窗口，支持拖动、最小化、隐藏及一键插入输入框。

description.en: Mobile web access to DeepSeek Harness sessions with live output, tool calls, questions and approvals.
description.zh: 通过移动网页访问 DeepSeek Harness 会话，查看实时输出、工具调用、问题和审批。

description.en: Adds a right-click action menu in the Trajectory view, optional stop reasons for background jobs, and an in-place plugin updater.
description.zh: 在 Trajectory 视图中加入右键操作菜单、后台任务可选的停止原因，以及原地插件更新器。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness that swaps the preset's pwsh for Git for Windows or MSYS2 bash while keeping the official terminal contract.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Windows bash 工具，用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2 bash 替换预设的 pwsh，同时保留官方终端契约。

description.en: Bridges any SSH host into a persistent remote workspace for coding agents, with file editing, search, exec, terminals and port forwarding.
description.zh: 将任意 SSH 主机接入为持久远程工作区，让编码代理可像本地一样编辑文件、搜索、执行命令、开终端并转发端口。

description.en: Multi-model role group chat panel for the DSH Web GUI where each role binds its own provider/model and shares one group conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的多模型角色群聊面板：每个角色绑定各自的 provider/model，群内共享同一份对话记录。

description.en: Scrapes GitHub Trending (daily/weekly/monthly, language filters), analyzes each repo, and renders pageable, filterable card reports in the Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 抓取 GitHub Trending（日/周/月，支持按语言筛选），对每个仓库做结构化分析，并在 Harness Web UI 中渲染可分页、可筛选的卡片报告。

description.en: Manage multiple API keys per provider for DeepSeek Harness with pooling and one-click switching.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness管理每个提供商的多个API密钥，支持密钥池和一键切换。

description.en: Full-screen Markdown reader with GFM, outline, KaTeX, Mermaid, and resource navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全屏 Markdown 阅读器，支持 GFM、大纲、KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图表及相对资源跳转。

description.en: Token usage analytics tab for DeepSeek Harness conversation view with KPIs and charts.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web plugin — Token usage analytics tab for the conversation view (KPIs, context meter, donut, stacked per-turn bars, cumulative curve)

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop host when a change requires it, then hands the conversation back to the same session automatically.
description.zh: 当改动需要时自动重启 DSH 桌面宿主，并把对话无缝接回原来的会话。

description.en: Adds Cloudflare Zero Trust Access authentication, Tunnel and DNS configuration to DSH so a self-hosted instance can be reached without a public IP.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Cloudflare Zero Trust Access 认证、Tunnel 与 DNS 配置，无需公网 IP 即可安全远程访问自托管实例。

description.en: Lets the model control your existing Chrome tabs through a browser bridge while preserving your logged-in sessions.
description.zh: 通过浏览器桥接让模型操作你现有的 Chrome 标签页，并保留登录状态。

description.en: Harness-wide token usage dashboard that aggregates billed tokens and estimates peak/off-peak CNY costs.
description.zh: 全 Harness Token 用量看板，汇总计费 Token 并估算高峰/低谷时段人民币成本。

description.en: A Wandering Earth II movie-style theme for DSH Web GUI with deep space colors and HUD effects.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的流浪地球2电影风格主题，提供深空配色、发动机点火联动、MOSS 化发送按钮与星场 HUD 效果。

description.en: Adds a macOS sidebar rail that slides out on left-edge hover for quick access to projects, recent sessions, scheduled tasks and plugins.
description.zh: 为 macOS 桌面版添加侧栏图标轨，鼠标靠近窗口左缘即可滑出，快速切换项目、最近会话、定时任务和插件。

description.en: Adds an Appearance settings page to the DSH web UI for managing themes, presets, fonts, font sizes, session density and liquid glass.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加「外观」设置页，管理主题、预设、字体、字号、会话流密度与液态玻璃效果。

description.en: Lets the agent generate real .drawio diagram files in your workspace and edit them in a draw.io editor inside the sidebar.
description.zh: 让智能体直接在工作区生成真实的 .drawio 图表文件，并可在侧边栏的 draw.io 编辑器中打开编辑。

description.en: Packages J Space Cognition Suite V3.6 as a DeepSeek Harness agent preset with native runtime adaptation.
description.zh: 把 J Space Cognition Suite V3.6 打包为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体预设，并适配原生运行时

description.en: Evidence-based code review plugin: reviews diffs, verifies findings, logs noise so agents read first and humans read only conclusions.
description.zh: 以证据为准的代码审阅插件：审 diff、验证结论、记录噪音，让 agent 先读、人只读结论。

description.en: Message hub and butler framework for DSH with an event model, hot-reload rules, an event store, pluggable collectors, and an in-process system monitor.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的消息中枢与管家框架，提供事件模型、热重载规则、事件存储、可插拔采集器及内置系统监控。

description.en: Defensive agent coding workflow that writes, tests and audits code in an isolated workspace with a human merge gate.
description.zh: 防御式智能体编码工作流：在隔离工作区中写入、测试并审计代码，合并前需人工审核。

description.en: Shows the current DeepSeek session's API cost in rubles as a pill in the conversation dock, with a clickable price-list card.
description.zh: 在会话停靠栏以卢布显示当前 DeepSeek 会话的 API 费用，点击药丸可打开价格明细卡片。

description.en: Static agent roster and member-profile definitions that compile validated role files into dsh-agent-teams members for multi-agent setups.
description.zh: 静态智能体名册与成员配置插件，将校验后的角色文件编译为 dsh-agent-teams 成员。

description.en: A live floating token meter with three dials for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, draggable anywhere and remembering its position.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供的悬浮实时 token 仪表，三个表盘显示用量，可随意拖动并记忆位置。

description.en: A DSH sidebar word-book plugin that keeps one page per word with illustrations, phonetics, audio, phrases and examples, plus spelling drills, stored as local files.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏单词本插件，一个词一页，含插图、音标、发音、词组、例句和拼写练习，词库以本地文件保存。

description.en: Adds a header danger button and sidebar session-row menu item to delete DSH sessions with a risk-consent dialog and in-place list refresh.
description.zh: 在顶部添加危险按钮、侧边栏会话行添加菜单项，通过风险确认对话框删除 DSH 会话，并原地刷新列表。

description.en: Connects QQ official bots to dsh via WebSocket long connection, letting the AI chat, remember and schedule messages in QQ groups and DMs.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 长连接把 QQ 官方机器人接入 dsh，让 AI 在 QQ 群聊和单聊中对话、记忆并定时发消息。

description.en: Lets you authorize and manage a Codex (ChatGPT OAuth) subscription in DSH settings so you can use GPT models without an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中授权并管理 Codex（ChatGPT OAuth）订阅，无需 API key 即可使用 GPT 模型。

description.en: Session-level tool gate: lets you pick which plugins' tools the model can see, and blocks disabled tools from being injected or called.
description.zh: 会话级工具门控：在会话开始时选择哪些插件的工具可用，被关掉的工具不会注入上下文，强行调用也会被拒绝。

description.en: Enhances DSH chat UI with searchable model selector, multimodal image capability labels, and image upload.
description.zh: 增强DSH聊天界面：提供可搜索的模型选择器、多模态图片标签及图片上传。

description.en: dsh plugin that adds a checkbox whitelist in Settings → Models to hide unchecked models from the model selector menu.
description.zh: dsh 插件：在「设置 → 模型」里通过勾选白名单，把未勾选的模型从模型选择器菜单中隐藏。

description.en: Keeps DSH Web running when optional plugins fail, with diagnosis and repair.
description.zh: 在可选插件失败时保持 DSH Web 继续运行，并提供故障诊断与修复。

description.en: Embeds DeepSeek Chat as a DSH sidebar panel with full chat area, last-conversation memory, and crash containment.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Chat 嵌入为 DSH 侧边栏面板，支持完整聊天区、上次会话记忆与崩溃隔离。

description.en: A desktop pet companion that shows cute animated pets to warm up long agent runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个桌面动态萌宠，在智能体长时间运行时显示可爱的宠物动画。

description.en: A local-first plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness, providing a marketplace to discover and manage plugins.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 配置的本地优先插件管理器，提供插件市场用于发现和管理插件。

description.en: Provides global skins for DeepSeek Harness, turning it into a personalized workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局皮肤，把它变成个性化工作区的独立插件

description.en: Connects Tokener API models into DeepSeek Harness so you can add your key in Settings and pick a model in chat.
description.zh: 将 Tokener 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，在设置中填写 API Key 后即可在对话中选择模型。

description.en: Desktop whale widget that tracks your DeepSeek (DSH) balance and ledger, with shuffled random lines that auto-speak when idle.
description.zh: 桌面小鲸鱼挂件，展示 DeepSeek（DSH）余额与记账，空闲时自动说出不重复的随机语句。

description.en: Generate images with Qwen image models inside DSH: write prompts, attach references, batch four directions and save every result with its parameters to disk.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内用 Qwen 图像模型生成图片：写提示词、附加参考图、一次批量出四个方向，并把结果连同参数保存到本地。

description.en: Injects an x-opencode-session HTTP header per conversation so OpenCode Go routes keep session identity.
description.zh: 为每个会话注入 x-opencode-session HTTP 头，使 OpenCode Go 路由保持会话标识。

description.en: Adds an inline pinned-session group to the DSH sidebar with native metrics and in-place search for quick session access.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏内联添加置顶会话分组，提供原生度量与就地搜索，方便快速访问会话。

description.en: Adds CLI-style chat history to DSH input: ↑ recalls previous messages, ↓ moves forward; persists across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天输入框添加类似 CLI 的历史记忆，支持上下键翻查已发送消息，重启后不丢失。

description.en: Iteratively improves any artifact (docs, code, skills) with defined standards, automated refinement, independent review, and human oversight.
description.zh: 按既定标准让 agent 对任意产物（文档、代码、skill）进行多轮自动改进与独立评审，人类可随时查看、喊停和回滚。

description.en: Knowledge-base and memory switch for dsh web, adding two composer controls and two settings pages backed by 22 /dsh/kb/* routes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供知识库与记忆开关，包含两个输入栏控件和两个设置页，由 22 条 /dsh/kb/* 路由支撑。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: tree browse, preview, upload/download, folder ZIP export, and @-mention files for agents.
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理器：树形浏览、预览、上传下载、文件夹打包 ZIP，以及 @ 引用文件给 agent 处理。

description.en: Draws the current session's execution as a live three-swimlane flowchart with sub-agent fan-out, drill-down and SSE streaming.
description.zh: 把当前会话执行过程实时绘制成三泳道流程图，含子代理发散-收敛扇形与双击下钻，SSE 事件直播。

description.en: Arrow-key input history for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中通过方向键浏览和调取输入历史。

description.en: One panel listing recent sessions across every workspace, plus deferred notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation.
description.zh: 在一个面板中汇总所有工作区的最近会话，并让延后记录的笔记在重新打开对话时再次出现。

description.en: Rewrites bash commands into their RTK equivalents and compacts tool output before the model sees it, saving tokens in the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将 bash 命令重写为对应的 RTK 命令，并在模型看到结果前压缩工具输出，从而为 DeepSeek Harness 节省 token。

description.en: Windows desktop-control plugin for DSH: accessibility refs, SendInput pixel actions, GDI screenshots, browser DOM, clipboard, notifications and operator pause.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制插件：无障碍引用、SendInput 像素操作、GDI 截图、浏览器 DOM、剪贴板、通知与操作员暂停开关。

description.en: Create and manage skill experts (persona plus skills) in the sidebar and summon them in chat from the composer or @ menu.
description.zh: 在侧边栏创建和管理技能专家（角色设定与技能），并通过输入框按钮或 @ 菜单在对话中召唤使用。

description.en: Native Web GUI panel to search online skill marketplaces (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub) and one-click install, manage or create local skills.
description.zh: 原生 Web GUI 面板，可搜索网络技能市场（SkillHub、skills.sh、GitHub），一键安装、管理与创建本地技能。

description.en: Shows your live DeepSeek account balance in a capsule beside the model selector, with a click-to-expand detail panel.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁的胶囊中实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击可展开明细面板。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek usage panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI sidebar, showing a 'Usage / 用量' entry.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 左侧边栏底部添加一个用量入口，展示 DeepSeek 用量面板。

description.en: Adds Decision 3.0 calibrated-probability decision-model tools (choice, noul, score, box) to DSH agents, with a settings page and probability-bar card.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供 Decision 3.0 校准概率决策模型工具（choice、noul、score、box），并附带设置页与概率条卡片。

description.en: Injects a bounded, timestamped read-only snapshot of your local second brain into every DSH session prompt.
description.zh: 向每个 DSH 会话提示注入一份有硬上限、带时间戳的本地第二大脑只读快照。

description.en: Adds a mobile portrait layout to the DSH web client with a drawer sidebar and touch-friendly controls, leaving desktop layout unchanged.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端增加手机竖屏自适应布局：抽屉式侧边栏与触控按键，非竖屏保持官方默认布局。

description.en: Adds a conversation-turn navigation panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加对话轮次导航面板，可在各轮对话之间跳转。

description.en: Adds a workspace file tree beside DSH's native preview panel so you can browse folders and click files to preview them.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生预览面板添加工作区文件树，可浏览目录并点击文件直接预览。

description.en: Records project pitfalls and user coding habits, injecting them into conversations to make AI smarter over time.
description.zh: 记录项目踩坑和用户代码习惯，在后续对话中自动注入，使 AI 持续获得项目与用户的上下文。

description.en: DSH plugin for continued pretraining on real GPUs, with weight-fingerprint proofs and format-gate acceptance checks.
description.zh: DSH 继续预训练插件：在真实 GPU 上训练基座模型，并通过权重指纹与格式门禁验证真实效果。

description.en: DSH plugin for quantization-aware training on real GPUs, producing validated checkpoints and rejecting fake accuracy results.
description.zh: DSH 量化感知训练插件，在真实 GPU 上训练并产出可被量化流程消费的 checkpoint，拒绝假精度验收。

description.en: DSH plugin for RL fine-tuning on real GPUs with pluggable reward adapters, KL budget accounting, and audited validation gates.
description.zh: DSH 强化学习微调插件：在真实 GPU 上使用可替换奖励适配器训练，带 KL 预算记账与可审计验收门禁。

description.en: DSH plugin that runs real-GPU LoRA SFT on a base model, finger­printing weights and failing no-op or degenerate runs.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用真实 GPU 对基座模型做 LoRA 监督微调，并对权重取指纹，空操作或退化训练直接判失败。

description.en: Star DSH sessions and workspaces, filter to favourites only, hide the rest, pin with hover metadata, and inherit stars through forks.
description.zh: 收藏 DSH 会话与工作区，仅显示收藏、隐藏未收藏项，支持悬停元数据固定、星标颜色与分支继承。

description.en: Syncs DSH sessions across LAN devices: auto-discovers peers, browses, pulls and pushes sessions over HTTP with SHA-256 verification.
description.zh: 跨局域网同步 DSH 会话：自动发现设备，通过 HTTP 浏览、拉取、推送会话，并带 SHA-256 校验。

description.en: Puts a settled result before red-team AI experts who attack it from chosen dimensions, while the human adjudicates every defect found.
description.zh: 把已定稿的结果交给红队专家从选定维度发起攻击，由人类逐条裁定每个缺陷。

description.en: Lets DSH agents discover plugins by searching GitHub and curated community sources, with Chinese-language support and an offline fallback.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 GitHub 与社区精选多源搜索来发现插件，支持中文并具备离线兜底能力。

description.en: Local routing proxy that sends only blocked domains through the upstream proxy while all other traffic goes direct, configurable from a web settings page.
description.zh: 本地分流代理：仅被屏蔽的域名走上游代理，其余流量直连，参数在网页设置页修改并热生效。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness with hunk/line staging, side-by-side diffs, commit graph and conflict resolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工作台，支持按块/行暂存、并排差异、提交图和冲突解决。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin: a floating recent-sessions sheet that blends into the sidebar
Adds a sidebar button that restarts DeepSeek Harness itself, and keeps working after DSH application updates on Windows.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加重启按钮，Windows 上应用更新后依然可用。

description.en: Scores received documents for AI-slop and work-slop across expression, execution, and decision dimensions with traceable quote checks.
description.zh: 对收到的文档进行AI垃圾与工作空转评分，从表达、执行、决策三维加权，并逐条机器复核引文原文。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness input-area learning workspace that guides collecting, refining, linking, upgrading and reusing knowledge with presets and review.
description.zh: 一个运行在 DeepSeek Harness 输入区的学习工作台，通过交互引导完成收集、提炼、关联、升级与复用，并支持预设管理与审核入库。

description.en: Local egress proxy bridge that gives consumers a credential-free proxy URL and injects upstream auth on the hop that needs it, failing closed.
description.zh: 本地出口代理桥：为不接受凭据的消费方提供无凭据代理地址，在需要认证的上游跳注入账号密码，失败即断联。

description.en: Sends Windows native toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness events, letting you click a toast to focus the window and jump to the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 发送 Windows 原生通知，点击通知即可聚焦窗口并跳转到对应会话。

description.en: Automates testing of plugin pages inside the live DeepSeek Harness UI: reads layout and styles, clicks, fills forms, waits for async results and grabs console errors.
description.zh: 在真实运行的 DeepSeek Harness 界面中自动测试插件页面：读取布局样式、点击按钮、填写表单、等待异步结果并抓取控制台报错。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: installs the 'wsl' agent preset for Windows WSL
Command Code usage panel for DSH showing credits, 5-hour and weekly quota windows, request stats, plan tiers and an API key editor.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Command Code 用量面板，展示额度、5 小时/每周窗口、请求统计、套餐等级和 API 密钥编辑。

description.en: Adds login/password gate to DSH Web with 12-hour tokens; background tasks survive session expiry.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 加一道账号密码门：每次打开 DSH Web 都必须先登录；登录令牌有效期 12 小时；令牌过期被登出时，后台正在运行的任务完全不受影响，重新登录后一切还在。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style right-click context menu to the DSH Web UI with copy, paste and file actions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加 Codex 风格的右键菜单，支持复制、粘贴和文件操作。

description.en: Queues tasks in a chat with no model calls, then runs them automatically in the same conversation during DeepSeek off-peak half-price hours.
description.zh: 在对话中以零模型调用排队任务，并在 DeepSeek 低谷半价时段于同一会话中自动执行。

description.en: A lightweight dashboard for DeepSeek Harness that tracks model token usage and cache hit rates by model, provider, project and session, and estimates cost from OpenRouter pricing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Token 用量与缓存命中监控看板，可按模型、供应商、项目、会话统计调用，并用 OpenRouter 单价估算成本。

description.en: DSH本地视觉插件：粘贴截图或分析本地图片，OCR带像素坐标，ollama语义描述，全离线。
description.zh: DSH 本地视觉能力插件：macOS Vision OCR + ollama qwen3-vl 语义描述 + 上传图片桥接

description.en: ZenMux plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling browser OAuth login and routing 150 models via Anthropic or OpenAI APIs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ZenMux 插件，支持浏览器 OAuth 登录，并通过 Anthropic 或 OpenAI API 路由 150 个模型。

description.en: A desert-dusk theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that paints a poem-inspired desert scene and warm UI palette.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供的大漠落日主题，绘制诗意沙漠场景并搭配暖色界面配色。

description.en: Adds a chat-typography settings page to DSH Harness for font size, line spacing, per-role font families and text-to-window padding.
description.zh: 为 DSH Harness 增加「对话流排版」设置页，可调字号、行距、文字/代码/终端字体及对话留白。

description.en: Rate limiter for LLM agent loops that prevents TPM/RPM violations by adding adaptive delays between requests.
description.zh: 为 LLM agent 循环提供限流，通过在请求之间加入自适应延迟，防止触发 TPM/RPM 限制。

description.en: Merges multiple consecutive reasoning blocks in a single model response into one thinking area, leaving all other content untouched.
description.zh: 把一次模型响应中连续的多段推理合并为一个思考区域，其余内容原样通过。

description.en: Provides blazing fast file search on Windows using Everything search engine via es.exe.
description.zh: 通过 es.exe 调用 Everything 搜索引擎，在 Windows 上快速搜索文件

description.en: Identifies the provider behind the current model route and queries its API balance or subscription quota via official endpoints.
description.zh: 识别当前模型路由背后的提供商，并通过官方端点查询其 API 余额或订阅配额。

description.en: VS Code-style file explorer for DeepSeek Harness with sidebar tree, multi-tab previews, search, sort, and split view.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 VS Code 风格文件浏览器，含侧边栏文件树、代码/图片/PDF/音视频/压缩包多标签预览、搜索、排序和分屏视图。

description.en: Rick and Morty theme and desktop pet for dsh web GUI with skins, companions, and agent-driven moods.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供瑞克和莫蒂主题与桌面宠物，含三款皮肤、六个伙伴，情绪由 agent 驱动。

description.en: Send and receive email from DSH agents via agently-cli, with session and thread routing.
description.zh: 通过 agently-cli 让 DSH 代理收发电子邮件，并支持会话与线程路由。

description.en: Sends a Windows native notification when a DSH task truly finishes, showing session title, result status and last reply summary.
description.zh: 当 DSH 任务真正完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，显示会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复摘要。

description.en: Collapses long draft input into an attachment-style summary card once the draft exceeds a configurable character threshold.
description.zh: 当发送框草稿超过设定字符阈值时，自动折叠为一张附件式摘要卡。

description.en: Fully takes over DSH's model services with a self-maintained pi ai bridge, model selector, quota display and provider management UI.
description.zh: 全量接管 DSH 模型服务，提供自维护的 pi ai 桥接、模型选择器、额度查询与供应商管理界面。

description.en: Runs the JetBrains Junie CLI as a one-shot DSH subagent over ACP, with a settings page for picking the model and thinking depth.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 将 JetBrains Junie CLI 作为一次性 DSH 子代理运行，并提供模型与思考深度设置页。

description.en: Connects WeChat to DeepSeek Harness AI via official protocol with streaming replies, QR login, cron jobs, and web fetch.
description.zh: DSH 微信桥接插件 | DeepSeek Harness WeChat bridge plugin：把手机微信（腾讯官方 iLink/ClawBot 协议）接入 DSH AI 助手——流式回复、扫码登录、会话持久化、定时任务、网页抓取(MCP)。Connect WeChat to DeepSeek Harness AI via Tencent's official iLink/ClawBot p

description.en: Exposes DSH agents as standard A2A servers and adds tools to call remote A2A agents over JSON-RPC/SSE.
description.zh: 将 DSH 智能体暴露为标准 A2A 服务端，并提供调用远程 A2A 智能体的工具。

description.en: Read-only scans of local agent sessions produce reviewable evidence on token waste, loops, amnesia and idle assets, plus fixes.
description.zh: 只读扫描本地 Agent 会话，以可逐条复核的证据诊断 token 浪费、死循环、跨会话失忆与资产闲置，并开出可执行处方。

description.en: A multi-agent collaboration protocol for DeepSeek Harness with loop guards, handoff format, and review routing for dev workflows.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供与项目无关的多智能体协作协议：循环防护阻止失控智能体循环、六字段交接格式、按风险分级的评审路由，以及固定的验证→提交→推送→评审→关闭流程，用一个技能替代在每个智能体指令中重复粘贴规则。

description.en: A local-first pixel cultivation hall that manages durable multi-agent teams with dependency-aware tasks, quality gates and 15 progression realms.
description.zh: 一个本地优先的像素修炼堂，用于管理持久化多智能体团队，支持依赖任务、质量门禁与15个境界进阶。

description.en: Local voice studio for DeepSeek Harness with VoxCPM2 voice design and IndexTTS-2.5 emotional speech generation on your own machine.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地语音工作室，支持 VoxCPM2 音色设计与 IndexTTS-2.5 情感语音，在本机运行。

description.en: Orchestrates VectorCraft, PhotoCraft, EffectCraft and FilmCraft projects from a single creative brief.
description.zh: 通过一份创意简报统一编排 VectorCraft、PhotoCraft、EffectCraft 与 FilmCraft 项目。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin with 24 China A-share data tools - quotes, K-lines, financials, money flow, sectors, screening; free tools need no key.
description.zh: 官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 24 个 A股数据工具（行情、K线、财务、资金、龙虎榜、板块、因子选股），免费工具无需 Key。
