description.en: Web-UI plugin adding command-button glyph and attach button with separated uploads by type.
description.zh: 为 DSH web-ui 添加斜杠命令按钮图标和加号附件按钮，按图片、文档、其他三类分开上传

description.en: Smart DSH session notifications with completed/failed/question/permission events, main-line and side-line alerts, Web Audio sounds and browser notifications.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供智能通知：完成/失败/提问/权限四类事件、主线与支线提醒、Web Audio 音效和浏览器通知。

description.en: Free OCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness using GLM-4V-Flash for tile-based long-document recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页版的免费 OCR 插件，通过 GLM-4V-Flash 免费额度，用分块方式识别长文档图片文字。

description.en: Registers BabelDOC PDF translation as an agent tool, so you can ask in chat to translate a PDF and get layout-preserving bilingual or mono output files.
description.zh: 将 BabelDOC 的 PDF 翻译能力注册为 Agent 工具，在对话中即可把 PDF 翻译成保留原始排版的双语版或纯译文版。

description.en: Snapshots a file right before the coding agent rewrites it, enabling one-command restore if the change breaks things.
description.zh: 在编码代理重写文件前自动创建快照，若改动出问题可一键恢复原文件。

description.en: Offline LVGL 8.4 knowledge skill pack that teaches AI agents to write correct LVGL v8 code and avoid v9 API mixing.
description.zh: 离线 LVGL 8.4 知识技能包，教 AI 智能体写出正确的 LVGL v8 代码，避免混入 v9 API。

description.en: Turns a one-line prompt into a ready-to-use single-file HTML workbench with 20+ components, light/dark themes and responsive layout.
description.zh: 一句话生成可直接使用的单文件 HTML 工作台，内置 20+ 组件、明暗主题与响应式布局。

description.en: DSH host plugin that blocks prompt sends or archives sessions when the prompt cache likely expired, helping avoid uncached prompts.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：当提示缓存可能过期时阻止发送或归档会话，避免产生未缓存提示。

description.en: Sends Windows desktop notifications for Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness sessions; clicking a toast restores the session window.
description.zh: 为 Claude Code 和 DeepSeek Harness 会话发送 Windows 桌面通知，点击通知可恢复对应会话窗口，无外部 npm 依赖。

description.en: A Chobits Chii themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, adding warm neutral colours and a Polaroid photo wall.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的小叽主题皮肤，采用中性暖调配色并加入拍立得照片墙。

description.en: A 40-agent software delivery team for DeepSeek Harness that you can set loose to build and ship software at full throttle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 40 人 Agent 软件交付团队，可让它们火力全开地完成开发与交付。

description.en: Adds a colour-gradient animated whale favicon and rainbow brand styling to DSH web pages.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页替换彩色渐变流动的小鲸鱼 favicon，并把页面内品牌元素改为彩虹配色。

description.en: Generates images, video, audio, and 3D using local ComfyUI on your own GPU or Comfy Cloud.
description.zh: 使用本地 ComfyUI（自有 GPU）或 Comfy Cloud 生成图像、视频、音频和 3D 内容。

description.en: Skill for AI coding agents to generate, render, and visually review Mermaid diagrams in a portable Craft-style workflow.
description.zh: 让 AI 编程代理以可移植的 Craft 风格工作流生成、渲染并可视化审阅 Mermaid 图表

description.en: DSH widget showing DeepSeek balance, spend and peak-hour status with an animated opening, greeting voice and sticker bubbles.
description.zh: DSH 小组件：展示 DeepSeek 余额、消费与高峰时段状态，带开场动画、问候语音和贴纸气泡。

description.en: macOS/Windows sidebar disk-space tool with read-only scanning, undoable cleanup to trash/quarantine, space visualization and recovery center.
description.zh: macOS/Windows 侧边栏磁盘空间工具：只读扫描、可撤销清理（移入废纸篓/隔离区）、空间可视化与恢复中心。

description.en: Dependency-free local reverse proxy for the DeepInfra API that injects service_tier/fail_fast and auto-falls back between Standard and Flex tiers.
description.zh: 零依赖的 DeepInfra API 本地反向代理，注入 service_tier/fail_fast 并在 Standard 与 Flex 层级间自动回退。

description.en: DSH plugin to view DeepSeek API balance and local usage costs for Flash/Pro.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用于查看 DeepSeek API 余额以及本地 Flash/Pro 用量花费。

description.en: Adds a top banner to DeepSeek Harness showing USD/CNY balances, auto-refresh, peak/valley pricing and animated balance-change alerts.
description.zh: 💵 DeepSeek 余额横幅(dsh 插件):页面顶部右侧(主题切换按钮左侧)同时显示 USD/CNY 余额,负值高亮,60s 自动刷新,一条命令安装

description.en: Adds a night-and-moon themed sleep/shutdown button with a whale mascot and a cancellable countdown that powers off the machine after tasks finish.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加夜间月主题的睡眠/关机按钮，配鲸鱼吉祥物与可取消倒计时，任务完成后自动关机。

description.en: Collapsible panel to manage DeepSeek Files API uploads: list, copy, and clean images with zero key exposure.
description.zh: 在右侧提供可折叠面板，列出、复制和清理通过 DeepSeek Files API 上传的图片，密钥不暴露，一条命令安装。

description.en: Claude Code-style persistent memory plugin for dsh: cross-session storage, auto prompt injection, markdown files.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Claude Code 风格的持久记忆：跨会话存储、自动注入提示词，并以 Markdown 文件保存。

description.en: Creates a desktop shortcut to start or open the local DSH web UI with one click on Windows.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上创建桌面快捷方式，一键启动或打开本地 DSH Web 界面。

description.en: Run DeepSeek Harness sessions on a remote machine over SSH, using any remote folder as the workspace for shell, file and search tools.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 在远程机器上运行 DeepSeek Harness 会话，可选用远程任意文件夹作为工作区，并让 shell、文件与搜索工具都在远程执行。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek model calls by peak/off-peak pricing to balance cost and quality, with user override.
description.zh: 根据 DeepSeek 峰谷定价自动路由模型调用：高峰时段用 deepseek-v4-flash 省钱，空闲时段用 deepseek-v4-pro 提升质量，用户显式选择始终优先。

description.en: A local long-term memory notebook for AI, storing notes in up to 15 topic folders that gradually fade over time.
description.zh: 给 AI 用的本地长期记忆本，按主题分文件夹存放（最多 15 块），时间久了会自动淡忘。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows DeepSeek billing balance and per-day, per-model token usage from the official API, alongside locally aggregated session-log usage.
description.zh: DSH 用量插件：官方接口获取账单余额与逐日逐模型用量，并聚合本地会话日志，两种口径的 Token 与费用并排对账。

description.en: Select any passage in a DeepSeek Harness chat to open a bubble branch that shares full context while leaving the main transcript untouched.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中选中一段文字即可开启气泡分支追问，共享完整上下文且不改变主对话。

description.en: Gives the agent real desktop mouse and keyboard control plus policy-guarded file tools on Windows.
description.zh: 为智能体提供真实的桌面鼠标键盘操作能力，并附带受策略保护的文件工具（Windows）。

description.en: 中文优先：让滴答清单成为人类与 Agent 共享的 Todo 真源（Pi 扩展 + dsh 插件），双向同步、提醒、强制人类验收，dsh 会话中断自动续跑。
Bundle of three trusted office skills for credible consultation, search, and official document writing via MCP.
description.zh: 深知可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件包，含深知可信咨询、深知可信搜索、深知公文写作三项 skill，并通过 MCP 转接提供。

description.en: DSH plugin providing doubao_ask tools for dynamic search, image generation, multimodal vision, and paste-to-path.
description.zh: DSH 插件，经本地 Quicker 转发豆包 web2api，提供 doubao_ask 动态搜索、图片生成、多模态识图工具，并支持粘贴图片转本地路径。

description.en: Create and edit Dreamina images and videos with per-call approval and resumable tasks.
description.zh: 创建和编辑 Dreamina 图像与视频，支持逐次审批和可恢复任务。

description.en: Turns DSH workspace session history into drillable topic/question knowledge graphs with semantic organizing and HTML/SVG/Bluepin export.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区会话历史整理成可下钻的专题/问题图谱，支持语义整理并导出 HTML/SVG/Bluepin。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin showing balance badge, usage stats, recharge modal, and low-balance alerts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，显示余额徽章、用量统计、充值弹窗和低余额提醒。

description.en: Shows Windows desktop toast notifications when the main conversation finishes a turn in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主对话完成一轮回复时，弹出 Windows 桌面 Toast 通知。

description.en: Windows desktop automation plugin exposing 14 GUI tools for click, type, key, scroll and drag input, plus occlusion-proof screenshots and accessibility-tree reads.
description.zh: Windows 桌面自动化插件，提供 14 个 GUI 工具，支持点击、输入、按键、滚动、拖拽，并可截取防遮挡窗口截图和读取无障碍树。

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task status (failed / needs you / done) to the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island with a single status light for reminders only.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败/待你处理/完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛，仅用一枚状态灯做提醒。

description.en: Three.js-based STL and 3MF preview for the DSH better sidebar with orbit, zoom, slicer plate switching and per-object filament colours.
description.zh: 基于 Three.js 的 STL / 3MF 预览插件，支持轨道旋转、缩放、切片盘切换和逐对象耗材颜色显示。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that previews 3D models inside the chat, supporting FBX, OBJ, glTF/GLB and STL files.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，可在对话中预览 3D 模型，支持 FBX、OBJ、glTF/GLB 和 STL 文件。

description.en: DSH plugin that wires native web search and web fetch tools to 9router's /v1/search and /v1/web/fetch endpoints.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将原生网页搜索与网页抓取工具接入 9router 的 /v1/search 和 /v1/web/fetch 接口。

description.en: A DSH plugin embedding 47 A-share data endpoints with stock screening strategies and risk control.
description.zh: 将 a-stock-data 的 47 个 A 股数据端点内嵌，集成四大策略筛选、持仓诊断与风控纪律，以自包含 SKILL.md 提供，并可经 dsh 命令安装。

description.en: DSH usage ledger plugin showing a sidebar daily-usage card, per-conversation token counts, provider/model breakdowns, account balance and plan quota with low-balance alerts.
description.zh: DSH 用量台账插件：侧边栏今日用量卡片、当前对话 token 数、按供应商与模型的明细、账户余额与套餐额度及余量提醒。

description.en: Unofficial DSH port of the ARS academic-paper-reviewer, focused on the reviewer phase for producing peer-review feedback.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 移植的 ARS 学术论文审稿器，仅包含审稿人阶段，用于生成同行评审意见。

description.en: Toggles an academic mode that enforces three-pass source verification, logic review and a pre-delivery gate at max reasoning effort.
description.zh: 学术模式开关：启用三遍来源核查、三遍逻辑审校、交付前验证关卡并保持最高推理强度。

description.en: DSH sidebar glance card showing DeepSeek account balance, peak/off-peak billing countdown, and today's spend, tokens and calls.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏速览卡片，显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、峰谷计费倒计时以及今日消费、Token 与调用次数。

description.en: Resumable ACP subagent backend for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent chat pool, session/load reconnect and mid-turn steering.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的可恢复 ACP 子代理后端，支持持久会话池、session/load 重连与回合中干预。

description.en: Adds a sidebar activity bell that badges completed sessions and shows a recent-activity list with one click.
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话完成时显示角标，一键查看最近活动列表。

description.en: Session-only ADHD-friendly output shaping for DeepSeek Harness that reformats replies to stay focused, never applied globally.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 ADHD 友好输出风格插件，仅在当前会话生效，不会全局应用。

description.en: Deterministic multi-domain adjudication engine for DeepSeek Harness, running a gate/bundle/anchor/critique pipeline with on-demand domain packs ported from Alibaba open-code-review.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多领域裁决引擎，采用 gate/bundle/anchor/critique 确定性流水线，并内置按需加载的领域包（移植自阿里 open-code-review）。

description.en: Injects user-defined context entries as a standalone Remember row into DeepSeek Harness prompts per turn or session.
description.zh: 将用户自定义的上下文条目作为独立的Remember行注入DeepSeek Harness提示，可按轮次或会话添加。

description.en: Adds an Advanced Listening Settings section to the DSH Web GUI for exposing the web service to the LAN with per-NIC IP binding and port control.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 设置新增「高级监听设置」分区，可按网卡 IP 精确控制 Web 服务对局域网的暴露范围与端口。

description.en: A pixel-art Aemeath global theme for DeepSeek Harness with a starry background, pixel buttons, resonance-pillar settings and a custom slider.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的鸣潮·爱弥斯像素风全局主题，含星空背景、像素按钮、共鸣柱设置与专属滑块。

description.en: Runs fixed DSH agent test cases in isolated sandboxes and diffs two runs to catch regressions.
description.zh: 在隔离沙箱中运行固定的 DSH 智能体测试用例，并对比两次运行结果以发现回归。

description.en: Bridges Claude Code and Codex sessions into DSH: list, open, continue, pin, rename and archive them from the Workspace browser.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话接入 DSH,可在工作区浏览器中列出、打开、继续、固定、重命名和归档这些会话。

description.en: CLI tool that safely cleans DSH session logs by removing subagent entries, deleting orphaned projection caches and purging sessions, with dry-run and backups.
description.zh: 安全清理 DSH 会话日志的 CLI 工具：删除子代理条目与孤立投影缓存、清除整个会话，始终先试运行并自动备份。

description.en: DSH plugin that deletes a session or a single turn through one shared confirmation flow and a consistent set of failure codes.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过统一的确认流程和一致的失败码，删除整个会话或单轮对话。

description.en: Parent agent splits work into orders, assigns each to a chosen contractor agent with its own provider/model/effort, then reviews results.
description.zh: 父代理将工作拆分为任务，分派给选定承包商代理（可配置提供商、模型和投入强度），并审核结果。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with a fixed 2x4 board of eight agent seats showing status, tool calls, reasoning and results, with a switch to restore the stock sidebar.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏替换为固定 2x4 的八个智能体席位面板，显示状态、工具调用、推理与结果，并可通过设置开关恢复原侧边栏。

description.en: A group-chat-style multi-agent collaboration console for DeepSeek Harness that autonomously decomposes, dispatches, executes, verifies, and iterates on tasks.
description.zh: 群聊式多智能体协作控制台；需求进群，授权后AI团队自主决策、分派、执行、验收并迭代优化。

description.en: Edits global and project instruction files (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with byte budgets and save-conflict prompts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中编辑全局与项目指令文件（AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md），提供字节预算与保存冲突提示。

description.en: Agent mode picker for DSH that lets you choose an external Agent CLI as the session's default executor, auto-discovering installed CLIs.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：可选用外部 Agent CLI 作为会话默认执行器，并自动发现已安装的 CLI。

description.en: A product-manager-style review skill for Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness agent projects.
description.zh: 面向 Claude Code 与 DeepSeek Harness 智能体项目的产品经理式评审技能。

description.en: Gives DSH sessions agent profiles with persona, duties, avatar and long-term memory injected as a system-prompt section.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供智能体档案，将人设、职责、头像与长期记忆注入系统提示词。

description.en: Local JSONL plugin that records agent runs, model steps, tool calls, timings, outcomes, and token usage.
description.zh: 本地 JSONL 运行追踪插件，记录智能体运行、模型步骤、工具调用、耗时、结果和 token 用量。

description.en: Turns each agent-team role into an independent preset and lets you visually manage its tools, skills, MCP, groups, loops and AGENTS.md in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 把 agent team 的每个角色做成独立 preset，并在 Web GUI 中可视化管理其工具、技能、MCP、分组、loop 与 AGENTS.md。

description.en: A live agent lineage tree panel for DSH that maps Lead, member and grandchild agents with team focus, status dots and model routing.
description.zh: DSH 的代理代际树面板：把 Lead→成员→孙代理 画成实时组织树，含团队焦点、真状态点与模型路由中心。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中与 AI 或桌宠伙伴玩游戏，内置 21 点和双人吹牛骰。
Routes model requests to optimal tiers using expert recommenders and EXP3 meta-selection, learning from rewards and logging all decisions.
description.zh: 监听每次模型请求，按任务类型和复杂度路由到合适模型档位；四个专家并行推荐，EXP3 元选择器决定采用哪个，并按工具失败、重试、延迟等奖励信号持续学习，所有决策与奖励落盘可审计、可重放。

description.en: AI-driven group-chat game framework for DeepSeek Harness, plays SillyTavern cards with independent NPC reactions and JSON saves.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 群像聊天游戏框架，兼容 SillyTavern 卡牌，支持 NPC 独立反应与本地 JSON 存档。

description.en: Slack-style teamroom plugin for DSH where multiple agents share one chat timeline, with @Agent routing into separate persistent sessions.
description.zh: DSH 的 Slack 风格多智能体聊天室插件，多个 Agent 共享一条消息时间线，并通过 @Agent 路由到各自独立的持久会话。

description.en: Edit and generate AGENTS.md inside the DSH settings panel: manage global and project rules, merging or overwriting project-level rules.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中编辑与生成 AGENTS.md：管理全局与项目规则，可按合并或覆盖方式生成项目级规则。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a Settings row to open ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in your system editor.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件包，在设置中添加一行，用于在系统编辑器中打开 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md。

description.en: DSH plugin that lists, previews and edits AGENTS.md and other AI rule files from one settings page.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在设置页集中查看、预览和编辑 AGENTS.md 等各类 AI 规则文件。

description.en: Generates and edits images inside DeepSeek Harness via the Agnes AI free API, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 Agnes AI 免费 API 生成和编辑图片，支持文生图、图生图和多图合成。

description.en: Adds an Agnes Image 2.5 Flash tool so the AI can generate, edit and composite images inside DSH, with API keys kept local only.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 Agnes Image 2.5 Flash 生图工具，AI 可主动生成、编辑与合成图片，API Key 仅存本机。

description.en: Integrates Agnes AI model gateway into dsh and registers dsh as a Paseo provider via ACP bridge.
description.zh: 将 Agnes AI 模型网关接入 dsh，并通过 ACP 桥接把 dsh 注册为 Paseo 提供方。

description.en: Full-page multi-format book and paper reader with AI explanations for selected text, full-text search, and bilingual paper translation.
description.zh: 全页面多格式书籍与论文阅读器，支持选中文本 AI 解释、全文搜索以及论文翻译与中英对照。

description.en: Schedules an AI curfew that shortens replies by time of day and stops sending API requests entirely after hours.
description.zh: 给 AI 设定下班时间：按时段逐渐缩短回复，下班后完全不再发起 API 请求。

description.en: Indexes AI job boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever), ranks postings, mines hiring requirements and pushes a daily digest.
description.zh: 索引 AI 招聘平台（Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever）职位，排序岗位、挖掘招聘需求并推送每日摘要。

description.en: AI-native text editor for DSH with encoding-safe editing, selection AI and diff review, Markdown preview, and Windows file associations.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 AI 原生通用文本编辑器，支持编码安全编辑、选区 AI 与差异审阅、Markdown 预览及 Windows 文件关联。

description.en: Install-and-use AI Studio workbench for DeepSeek Harness with dashboards, roles, tasks, verification, decision desk, merge governance, and portable bundles.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI Studio 工作台：仪表盘、角色、任务、验证、决策台、合并治理与可移植项目包。

description.en: Roleplay plugin for DeepSeek Harness: enable a character card to instantly switch persona, with diary-style memory and a visual character manager panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 角色扮演插件：选一张角色卡即可启用人设，带日记式记忆与可视化角色管理器面板，随时可干净退出。

description.en: AIDD research workbench for drug discovery with ReAct loop, versioned artifacts, and 17 molecular modeling skills.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 药物发现研究台，提供 ReAct 研究循环、带来源记录的版本化产物，以及虚拟筛选、分子生成、ADMET 预测、DTI 建模和模型复现等 17 项技能。

description.en: Enhances DSH chat with arrow-key history recall, search, and a dockable side conversation panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天增加方向键历史回溯、搜索和可停靠侧边对话面板。

description.en: A gate in front of QQ group chats that decides whether a message is worth answering, so the AI stays silent and spends no reply tokens otherwise.
description.zh: 为 QQ 群 AI 加一道「读空气」闸门：判断消息是否值得回复，不值得就沉默、不浪费回复 token。

description.en: AiToEarn content creation suite: creative guidance, script/image-text/video generation, and Douyin publishing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供创意指导、脚本、图文与视频生成，并支持抖音发布的内容创作插件。

description.en: 给 DSH agent 一个"回答前会出声"的机制：目标锚点、似曾相识检索、重复检测、引用核对、按语境分块的警报判据。零第三方依赖，核心不调 LLM。
Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with automatic capture and tiered hybrid recall using vectors plus SQLite FTS5, zero dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件，支持自动捕获，并通过向量加 SQLite FTS5 进行分层混合召回，零依赖。

description.en: LLM extraction branch of alice-memory for DeepSeek Harness: idle-batched distillation by your main chat model, hybrid recall (vector + FTS5), zero dependencies.
Shows Aliyun coupon balance, used amount and expiry in the DSH sidebar footer via a read-only BSS OpenAPI query.
description.zh: 通过只读 BSS OpenAPI 在 DSH 侧栏页脚显示阿里云代金券余额、已用额度与到期时间。

description.en: View Aliyun account balance, coupons, billing trends and per-model token usage directly in the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接查看阿里云账户可用余额、代金券、账单趋势与按模型的 token 用量。

description.en: Enhancement plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) adding session deletion, model request headers, and fallback chain via web settings.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）功能增强插件，在Web设置中添加会话删除、模型请求头和模型回退链配置。

description.en: Connects Aloof enterprise team knowledge platform to dsh, offering read-only tools to verify connectivity and identity.
description.zh: 把 Aloof 企业团队知识平台接入 dsh，提供只读工具用于验证连通性和身份。

description.en: Policy-layer guard for DeepSeek Harness blocking read-whitelist violations, sensitive paths, dangerous commands and unapproved installs, plus a malware static audit.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的策略防护层：读取白名单、敏感路径拒止、危险命令拦截、子代理隔离、安装审批与恶意代码静态审计。

description.en: Tiny DSH Desktop plugin that adds a title-bar pin button to toggle keeping the app window always on top of other windows.
description.zh: 一个极小的 DSH Desktop 插件，在标题栏添加固定按钮，一键让窗口始终置顶。

description.en: Amadeus-inspired launch panel for the DSH Web UI with shortcuts to conversations, plugins and scheduled tasks, plus decorative terminal scenery.
description.zh: 灵感来自 Amadeus 的 DSH Web UI 启动面板，可快速打开会话、插件与定时任务，并配有装饰性终端场景。

description.en: Adds a left rail to DSH Web showing user questions and anchor names for quick navigation in the current session.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话添加左侧导轨，列出当前会话全部用户问题，悬浮显示与导轨对齐的锚点名称，点击可快速跳转。

description.en: Installs an agent preset that starts DeepSeek sessions in Minimal mode then unlocks full tool catalog.
description.zh: 安装一个代理预设，让 DeepSeek 会话先以 Minimal 模式启动，再解锁完整工具目录。

description.en: Zero-dependency CDP browser plugin that lets you click page elements, write notes, and insert the annotations into the chat.
description.zh: 零依赖 CDP 浏览器插件：点选页面元素、写备注并插入对话，实现可视化标注。

description.en: Click an Annotation chip in a reply to jump to the annotated passage, briefly highlight it, and get a clear message when it cannot be found.
description.zh: 点击回复中的 Annotation 标签可跳回被标注段落，短暂高亮，并在找不到时给出明确提示。

description.en: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions inside DeepSeek Harness so important text stands out.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中自动高亮重点、定义、警告与问题，让关键内容一目了然。

description.en: Breaks down DSH answer latency into model thinking, first-token, decode and per-tool timings for profiling and observability.
description.zh: 将 DSH 回答延迟拆解为模型思考、首字、解码及每个工具耗时，用于性能分析与可观测性。

description.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness input box with one-click prompt polishing, next-sentence prediction, and a gear-style model and reasoning-level selector.
description.zh: 增强 DeepSeek Harness 输入框：一键润色提示词、预测下一句，并用挡位滚轮切换模型与推理等级。

description.en: HTTP control-plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness exposing settings, workspace registry, and host bridge as JSON routes.
description.zh: HTTP control-plane plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — exposes settings/language, workspace registry and host-companion bridge as /dsh-api/* JSON routes

description.en: Floating web widget for DeepSeek Harness showing AI provider account balances and 30-day usage in the session header.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话标题栏悬浮显示多个 AI 服务商的账户余额和近30天用量。

description.en: Floating draggable acrylic badge for DSH Web GUI showing LLM API account balance with adaptive text color.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 上显示 LLM API 账户余额的悬浮徽章，可拖动缩放、亚克力质感，文字颜色随余额自适应。

description.en: Agent-native API client for DSH: Postman-grade HTTP debugging UI plus agent HTTP tools and Postman Collection import.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 DSH 原生 API 客户端：Postman 级 HTTP 调试界面、Agent 原生 HTTP 工具，并支持导入 Postman Collection。

description.en: Manage local API providers in DeepSeek Harness: probe endpoints, check balances, list models, and register them as DSH model routes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理本地 API 提供商：探测端点、查询余额、列出模型，并注册为 DSH 模型路由。

description.en: Turns DSH Web GUI into a standalone desktop app window; closing it gracefully exits all DSH processes.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 以独立桌面应用窗口打开，关闭该窗口时优雅退出全部 DSH 进程。

description.en: Detects installed Windows apps, checks vendor sites for newer versions, and silently installs the full installer in one click.
description.zh: 检测本机已安装的 Windows 应用是否更新，从厂商官网下载全量安装包并一键静默升级。

description.en: Adjusts DSH web UI transparency with four independently tunable zones and a built-in wallpaper, using plain alpha only.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 网页界面的透明度（四个分区可独立调节），并内置壁纸颜色，仅使用纯 alpha。

description.en: Appearance tuner plugin for DeepSeek Harness UI: adjust overlay/panel opacity, colors, blur, corner radius, font size and scrollbar width.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观调校插件：可调浮层/面板不透明度与配色、毛玻璃模糊、背景侧栏色、强调色、圆角、正文字号与滚动条宽度。

description.en: Adds a one-click control beside the composer's model picker that applies the current session's model to every other session.
description.zh: 在输入框模型选择器旁添加一键操作，将当前会话的模型应用到所有其他会话。

description.en: Approval assistant for DeepSeek Harness with configurable reminders and auto-approval rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供审批助理，支持自动审批规则，并在审批、问答或任务完成时通过浏览器、系统通知、弹窗和自定义音效提醒。

description.en: Adds an optional comment box to DSH web approval dialogs, enabling reject-with-feedback that stops the turn and injects comment into model context.
description.zh: DSH Web 审批增强插件：替代内置审批窗口，支持拒绝并附言，拒绝后终止当前回合并把附言注入模型上下文重新思考

description.en: Sends Edge/Windows desktop notifications when a DSH command awaits approval, the agent asks a question, or a session finishes.
description.zh: 当 DSH 命令等待审批、智能体提问或会话完成时，通过 Edge/Windows 桌面通知提醒你。

description.en: Adds an "Allow for this conversation" option to the DSH approval panel, remembering per-tool authorisation for the session and letting it be revoked.
description.zh: 为 DSH 审批面板增加「本对话均允许」选项，按工具记住本次会话授权，并可随时撤销。

description.en: Auto-allows DSH sandbox escalation requests only for plain single commands whose argv matches a configured prefix; pipes, chains and redirects still go to manual approval.
description.zh: 仅当提权请求是单条简单命令且 argv 命中配置前缀时自动放行, 管道、链式、重定向等一律转人工审批。

description.en: Multi-role architecture plugin that runs a fail-closed planning, execution, verification and receipt pipeline with fixed agent formations.
description.zh: 三省六部式多角色架构插件，以固定阵型运行规划、执行、校验与回执流水线，并由代码强制失败关闭约束。

description.en: Analyzes a codebase and generates architecture documentation covering modules, dependencies, entry points, and run methods.
description.zh: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation (module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points, run methods).

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that lists all archived sessions on one screen so you can batch-delete them.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件：把归档会话列成一屏，勾选后批量删除。

description.en: Adds an Archive page to DSH Settings for managing archived sessions grouped by workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置添加归档页，按工作区分组查看已归档会话，支持筛选排序、取消归档，以及二次确认后彻底删除单条或全部会话。

description.en: Sidebar archive manager for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: browse zip/rar/7z/tar, preview and edit inner files without extracting, open with default apps.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏压缩包管理器：浏览 zip/rar/7z/tar，无需解压即可预览和编辑内部文件，并可用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: Adds a "Delete Session" action to archived sessions in the Web GUI sidebar, permanently removing their local records after a confirmation dialog.
description.zh: 在 Web GUI 侧栏为已归档会话新增“删除会话”操作，二次确认后由 Host 永久删除其本地记录。

description.en: Displays Volcano Ark model free resource balances as a draggable web widget, sourced from official Ark CLI data.
description.zh: 以可拖拽网页小组件显示火山方舟模型免费资源余额，数据取自官方 Ark CLI。

description.en: Arknights lore memory for DeepSeek Harness: faction files, alias routing, in-world timeline, story archive and PRTS live lookup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供明日方舟剧情记忆：阵营档案、别名路由、世界观时间线、剧情全档与 PRTS 实时查询。

description.en: Activates DeepSeek v4 flash on Volcano Ark plan API via config injection and doctor self-check for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Correctly activate DeepSeek v4 flash on the Volcano Ark plan API for DeepSeek Harness: default config injection (reasoningEfforts + effort=max) + ark_plan_doctor self-check

description.en: Reviews Markdown manuscripts with annotations, revision proposals, version comparison, figures and BibTeX support.
description.zh: 审阅 Markdown 稿件，提供批注、修改建议、版本对比、图表与 BibTeX 参考文献支持。

description.en: Codex-style artifact preview plugin for DSH: file cards in chat and split-screen preview for Markdown, code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中生成文件卡片行，并以分屏侧栏预览 Markdown、代码、CSV、JSON、图片和 HTML 文件。

description.en: Eight interactive animated ASCII ambient scene themes for DeepSeek Harness, switchable with animation toggles and reading-friendly fades.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供八套可交互的动态字符场景主题，可一键切换、关闭动画，阅读时背景自动收敛。

description.en: A whole-page ASCII shark ocean overlay for DeepSeek Harness, with boid schools and hunting sharks behind a theme-aware frosted layer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供整页 ASCII 鲨鱼海洋视觉层，包含鱼群与捕猎鲨鱼，主题自适应并有磨砂透明背景。

description.en: An ASCII whale-school background plugin for DeepSeek Harness that swims animated art behind conversations at low cost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ASCII 鲸鱼群背景插件，以低耗方式在对话中呈现游动的鲸鱼动画。

description.en: Adds a composer button that asks a few clickable clarifying questions, then rewrites your vague draft prompt into a clear one.
description.zh: 在输入框添加一个按钮，先用可点选的追问弄清意图，再把模糊的草稿改写为清晰提示词。

description.en: Branches the current DeepSeek Harness conversation into a side chat docked on the right, so parallel threads stay open beside the main chat.
description.zh: 将当前 DeepSeek Harness 对话分支到右侧停靠的侧边聊天中，让并行话题与主对话同时保持打开。

description.en: A native macOS floating companion that shows real DSH session status in an always-on-top transparent window.
description.zh: 原生 macOS 悬浮伴侣，用透明置顶窗口实时显示 DSH 会话真实状态。

description.en: Adds a customizable bubble background (optional liquid-glass) behind DSH assistant replies so text stays readable over dark wallpapers.
description.zh: 为 DSH 助手回复添加可自定义的气泡底色（可选液态玻璃），让深色壁纸上的文字依然清晰可读。

description.en: macOS-only decorative DSH plugin that animates the conversation rail with a 12-band audio spectrum from whatever the Mac is playing.
description.zh: 仅限 macOS 的 DSH 装饰插件，让对话侧栏随 Mac 正在播放的音频显示 12 段频谱动画。

description.en: Probe and convert audio, extract tracks with ffmpeg, and transcribe speech via whisper.cpp or any OpenAI-compatible API.
description.zh: 使用 ffmpeg 探测与转换音频、提取音轨，并通过 whisper.cpp 或任意 OpenAI 兼容接口转写语音。

description.en: Dynamic aurora background plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with whale particle animation and mouse-driven parallax effects.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供动态极光背景，含鲸鱼粒子动画和鼠标视差，用 canvas、遮罩与模糊实现

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI background plugin adding drifting aurora backgrounds and soft frosted-glass panels that follow light/dark theme.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 背景美化插件，提供缓慢漂移的极光背景与柔和玻璃面板，并自动跟随深/浅色主题。

description.en: Removes the launch token check from the local DSH Web UI so the page, /api and WebSocket upgrades work without a cookie or token.
description.zh: 移除本地 DSH Web UI 的启动令牌校验，使页面、/api 与 WebSocket 升级无需 Cookie 或令牌即可访问。

description.en: Auto-archives DeepSeek Harness sessions that stay idle beyond a set threshold, plus a UI to manage archived sessions.
description.zh: 自动归档闲置超过阈值的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并提供归档会话管理界面。

description.en: Lightweight DSH Web plugin that adds a retry button on error and optional auto-CONTINUE for the main session with loop limits.
description.zh: 轻量 DSH Web 插件，在报错横幅提供重试按钮，并可选让主会话自动继续，带防循环上限。

description.en: Automatically continues DeepSeek conversations when responses truncate due to max-tokens, rate limits, or context compression.
description.zh: 当max-tokens截断、429限流或上下文压缩造成对话中断时，自动补发后续请求。

description.en: Routes per-turn thinking effort while keeping the current model, including Magpie and other third-party providers.
description.zh: 按轮次自动路由思考强度（reasoning effort），保留当前模型，兼容 Magpie 等第三方模型提供商。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin that automatically maximizes the main window on launch, as if clicking Maximize.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版插件：启动时自动最大化主窗口，等同于手动点击最大化按钮。

description.en: Automatically opens the DSH right sidebar for blank top-level chats.
Native security review plugin for DeepSeek Harness with pre-execution rule interception and subagent review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生安全审查插件：执行前按规则拦截，交付时由独立子代理复审，面向长时间运行的代理。

description.en: Automatically expands the assistant reasoning block while it streams and folds it back when finished, with animated transitions and a sidebar toggle for automation.
description.zh: 在助手推理块流式输出时自动展开，完成后自动折叠，双向带动画，侧边栏开关仅控制自动化。

description.en: Check, install, and roll back DeepSeek Harness CLI updates from the web settings page, with health-checked restarts and automatic rollback.
description.zh: 在网页设置页检查、安装并回滚 DeepSeek Harness CLI 更新，带健康检查重启与自动回滚。

description.en: Adds vision to text-only DeepSeek Harness models by auto-discovering multimodal models and returning image descriptions as text.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉桥：自动发现你已配置的多模态模型，给纯文本主模型装上 vision 工具，识别结果以纯文本返回。零配置，一条命令安装。

description.en: Adds a read-only Automations tab to the conversation view showing what runs automatically, last and next run times, and token usage.
description.zh: 在对话视图中添加只读的“自动化”标签页，展示自动运行的任务、上次与下次运行时间及 token 消耗。

description.en: Azure CLI plugin for dsh to query, display, deploy, and diagnose Azure resources with JSON output.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Azure CLI 插件，支持查询、展示、部署和诊断 Azure 资源，并以 JSON 格式输出结果。

description.en: Custom background wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness chat page with opacity and overlay controls.
description.zh: Custom background wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness chat page — upload local image or image link, tune opacity and dark overlay, scope to chat area or full screen.

description.en: Adds a custom background image to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with adjustable opacity and blur, without changing layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加自定义背景图片，可调节透明度和模糊度，不改变布局。

description.en: One-click full backup and rollback of your DSH environment: plugins, Skills, MCP servers, Agent Presets, config, credentials and external data.
description.zh: 一键完整备份与回滚 DSH 环境：插件、Skills、MCP 服务器、Agent 预设、配置、凭据及外部数据。

description.en: Blue Archive-style mouse click effects and cursor trails for DSH, with a vertical sidebar entry and popup settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加蔚蓝档案风格的鼠标点击特效与光标拖尾，带竖排侧栏入口和弹窗设置。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek API account balance in the DSH sidebar with refresh and usage link.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，支持手动刷新和跳转用量页面。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance and 5-day spending chart in the dsh web UI sidebar.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和近 5 天消费图表。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek API balance and model costs with official peak/off-peak pricing and per-model/per-session stats for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 查询 DeepSeek API 余额，并按官方高峰/低谷定价统计各模型和各会话的费用。

description.en: A DSH plugin that turns your DeepSeek balance into days left, burn rate, and top-up advice — computed from local session logs.
DSH Web GUI chip under the input box showing account balance, session total and per-turn spend using DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：在输入框下方显示账户总余额、会话累计与本轮消耗，按 DeepSeek 峰谷（含法定节假日）规则计价。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance below the conversation in DSH plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在对话下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: A DSH plugin showing a draggable balance pie chart with real spending and a monthly heatmap for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，以可拖拽饼图和月度热力图展示 DeepSeek Harness 的余额与真实消耗。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek Harness wallet balance and current session spend in a compact composer-dock pill.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框停靠区以紧凑药丸样式显示钱包余额和本次会话花费。

description.en: A draggable whale widget pinned to the DSH Web UI corner showing live DeepSeek account balance, work status and usage accounting.
description.zh: 一只常驻 DSH 网页界面右下角的可拖拽小鲸鱼挂件，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、工作状态并帮你记账。

description.en: Provides bash tool functionality on Windows, overcoming Git Bash limitations and disabled PowerShell.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上提供 bash 工具能力，绕过仅限 Git Bash 的限制并应对 PowerShell 被禁用的情况。

description.en: A beginner onboarding panel that routes plain-language requests into ready-to-use prompts, skills and DSH tips, fillable into a new session in one click.
description.zh: 面向DSH新手的需求路由面板：用大白话输入需求，本地规则引擎给出可直接用的话术、技能与进阶玩法，一键填入新会话。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder, six skills, and a /ponytail session command.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Ponytail 懒资深开发者规则集：七级最小代码阶梯、六项技能与 /ponytail 会话命令。

description.en: Optimizes DSH session loading speed and reduces disk read/write consumption.
description.zh: 优化 DSH 会话加载速度并减少磁盘读写消耗。

description.en: Adds right-click notes on answer options and in-card side questions to the model for DSH ask_user_question cards.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 ask_user_question 卡片增加右键备注选项与卡片内旁问模型后再作答的能力。

description.en: A cleaner left sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with a compact rail and support for plugin-defined widgets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供更整洁的左侧边栏，支持紧凑栏与插件自定义小组件。

description.en: Quote or forward whole messages in DeepSeek Harness Web with one-action quoting, right-sidebar multi-select and cross-session forwarding.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中一键引用或转发整条消息，支持右侧栏多选与跨会话转发。

description.en: Enhanced DSH stats strip with CNY pricing, real-time cost settlement, live timers, and subagent tree merge.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 输入框统计条：按模型显示官方人民币峰谷价格，实时结算费用，显示 LLM 与工具实时计时，并合并子代理树

description.en: Replaces text-form session statistics with an intuitive chart panel on the right side of the page.
description.zh: 将文本形式的会话统计（轮/步、LLM与工具耗时、首token、tok/s、缓存命中、输入输出token）替换为页面右侧直观的图表面板。

description.en: Floating todo panel for the DSH Web UI with edge-snapping drag, today/more grouping, pomodoro timer with Windows notifications, and five agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的浮动待办面板：可拖拽吸附边缘，按今天/更多分组，带 Windows 通知的番茄钟，以及五个智能体工具。

description.en: DSH web plugin that renders tool calls, MCP calls and thinking lines into a compact timeline UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，把工具调用（含 MCP）、流式工具行和 thinking 行渲染成紧凑时间线。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet with transparent floating window and WebM animations, driven by real Agent status, supports WSL and Electron.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面显示透明悬浮窗并用 WebM 动画呈现桌宠，动画由 Agent 真实状态驱动，支持 WSL 与 Electron 环境自动识别。

description.en: Reads a RequirementsPack and a bid document, then reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched, or unlocatable.
description.zh: 读取 RequirementsPack 与投标文件，逐条报告哪些要求看似有响应、哪些匹配较弱、哪些完全定位不到。

description.en: A trilingual Big Whale desktop companion avatar for DSH with lip sync, expressions, idle motions and context-compaction rice.
description.zh: 一个三语大鲸鱼桌面伴侣，具备口型同步、表情、待机动作和上下文压缩米饭提示。

description.en: Bilibili watch statistics plugin that compares your planned viewing with what you actually watched and reports it locally or via digest.
description.zh: B 站观看统计插件，把「计划」和「实际看了什么」对照呈现，支持本地报告与定时摘要推送。

description.en: Binds an AI character to a Bilibili account so she browses videos, replies to comments, sends danmaku, keeps memories and drafts scripts.
description.zh: 为 AI 角色绑定 B 站账号，让她逛视频、回评论、发弹幕、记录经历并撰写视频口播稿。

description.en: Adds a native-looking pill after the DeepSeek Harness cache-hit stat that shows billing season and account balance, with a panel on click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的缓存命中统计后添加原生风格药丸标签，显示计费时段与账户余额，点击可展开面板。

description.en: DSH plugin aftercare manager with todo overview, plugin search and status checks, restart reminders, changelogs, trials, and offline troubleshooting.
description.zh: DSH 插件善后管家：待办概览、插件搜索与状态检查、重启提醒、变更记录、临时试用与离线急救。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style strip at the bottom of the DSH Web GUI, with day/night cycle, bell, jumps and ride stats.
description.zh: 戴头盔的像素小鸡在 DSH Web GUI 底部的我的世界风格骑行带上骑车，带昼夜循环、铃声、跳跃、车灯与骑行统计。

description.en: Bisect bugs in code, boundaries, or commit history by halving the search space each round to find the root cause.
description.zh: 用二分法在代码、边界条件或提交历史中逐轮折半缩小范围，定位 bug 根因

description.en: A DSH compaction backend that compresses conversation history via remote Responses API or local compilation.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 压缩后端，通过远程 Responses API 或本地编译压缩对话历史。

description.en: Adds XP-style scenery wallpapers with a frosted-glass UI to DeepSeek Harness, working on desktop and mobile.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 XP 风格风景壁纸与毛玻璃界面，支持桌面端和移动端。

description.en: Bundles BMAD Method modules and skills into dsh with a controlled installer bridge for listing, toggling and updating modules.
description.zh: 将 BMAD Method 的模块与 skill 打包进 dsh，提供模块清单、开关与更新的受控安装桥接层。

description.en: A floating whale pet for the DSH Web GUI that sings while agents work, gets crushed by a pipe on errors, and hunts for rice when you bonk its bowl.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的悬浮小鲸鱼宠物：干活时唱歌，出错被钢管砸，敲铁盆就跑去找白饭吃。

description.en: EPUB reader for DSH with a bookshelf, saved excerpts, a list of every mentioned title, and an AI chapter guide with source-linked cards.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的 EPUB 阅读器，包含书架、摘录收藏、书中提到的书目列表，以及带来源链接卡片的 AI 章节导读。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that plays a skippable 8.6-second blue-toned boot animation and adds three matching wallpapers, switchable in settings.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：播放可跳过的 8.6 秒蓝调开机动画，并附带三张同主题壁纸，可在设置页切换。

description.en: Adds a configurable full-window boot animation video with sound to DSH, keeping sound separate from fullscreen.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加可配置的全窗口开机动画视频与声音，开声与全屏互不绑定。

description.en: Adds a configurable boot sequence that plays your own video or image phases before the DeepSeek Harness app UI appears.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可配置的开机启动序列，在应用界面出现前播放自定义视频或图片阶段。

description.en: Manages the DSH boot splash video playlist: add videos, reorder them, choose sequential/random/once playback, plus sound toggle and audio self-check.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 开屏动画播放列表：添加视频、调整顺序、按顺序/随机/单次播放，并提供声音开关与音频自检。

description.en: Onboarding plugin: recommends plugins by GitHub stars and npm downloads, installs them with a reviewable plan, and exports/imports profiles via env codes.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按 GitHub 星标与 npm 下载量推荐插件，提供可审阅方案的一键安装，并支持环境码导出/导入以克隆或切换配置。

description.en: Automates Boss Zhipin job browsing in a visible browser, writes a JD-specific self-intro for each role, and sends it to the recruiter.
description.zh: 在可见浏览器中逐条浏览 Boss 直聘岗位，为每条 JD 生成专属自我介绍并发送给 HR。

description.en: Adds a full-width conversation stats line and context occupancy progress bar to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加占满整行的对话统计信息栏，以及上下文占用进度条。

description.en: A bpmn-js powered BPMN 2.0 visual modeler panel in the DSH Web GUI that scans, edits and atomically saves diagram files in the workspace.
description.zh: 一个基于 bpmn-js 的 BPMN 2.0 可视化建模面板，嵌入 DSH Web GUI，可扫描、编辑并通过原子写入保存工作区文件。

description.en: AI brainstorming canvas for DSH Web UI that grows a vague idea into interview-aligned directions, an outline and confirmed research results.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的 AI 头脑风暴画布，通过访谈对齐问题，生成调研大纲并产出结果。

description.en: Easter-egg DSH plugin that plays a comedic six-press brake-pedal test when you stop a long task; purely cosmetic, never blocks stopping.
description.zh: DSH 彩蛋插件：停止长任务时上演一场六脚全力制动测试动画，纯表演，绝不拦截或延迟停止。

description.en: Branch map for long engineering chats: mainline/tree views, fork comparison, conclusion merge, context editing and derived sessions.
description.zh: 面向长工程对话的分支地图：主线/树状视图、分叉对比、结论合并、上下文编辑与派生会话。

description.en: Visualizes DeepSeek Harness session branches as round cards, forks, subagent forests and a minimap for easy navigation.
description.zh: 用圆形卡片、分叉、子代理森林和小地图展示 DeepSeek Harness 会话分支树，便于浏览。

description.en: Reads each DSH reply aloud with Breeze TTS 2, streaming raw PCM so the first sentence plays about 0.6s after it appears.
description.zh: 用 Breeze TTS 2 朗读每轮 DSH 回复，采用 PCM 流式播放，首句约 0.6 秒即出声。

description.en: Inline image preview for bridged images in dsh-tool-vision conversations.
description.zh: DSH 插件:为 dsh-tool-vision 图片桥接提供对话内联预览 (inline image preview for bridged pasted images)

description.en: 让AI通过Playwright驱动真实Edge浏览器，实现网页导航、点击、填表、截图等自动化操作。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的浏览器插件：AI 直接开真实的 Edge 浏览器逛网页、点击、填表、截图，无需 CDP 或 MCP。

description.en: Lets the model drive your real Chrome/Edge browser: tabs, snapshots, clicks, typing, drag, screenshots and JS eval, with iframe/Shadow DOM support.
description.zh: 让模型直接操控真实的 Chrome/Edge 浏览器：标签页、快照、点击、输入、拖拽、截图与 JS 执行，支持 iframe 和 Shadow DOM。

description.en: Adds a history dropdown to DSH's sidebar embedded browser, listing visited pages with click-to-return and persistence across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏内嵌浏览器添加历史记录下拉列表，可点击回跳，并跨重启与关标签保留。

description.en: 侧边栏浏览器搜索引擎以及书签功能补丁插件 (dsh-browser-hub): 给 DSH 自带浏览器加搜索引擎选择+书签收藏+多级文件夹+导入书签HTML
DSH host plugin exposing 17 Playwright browser tools with stable accessibility-tree uids for snapping, clicking, filling, dragging, and downloading.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件，提供 17 个 Playwright 浏览器工具，基于稳定的无障碍树 uid 进行快照、点击、填充、拖拽和下载。

description.en: Read, edit, run and save Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) directly inside the DSH Better Sidebar file tree.
description.zh: 在 DSH Better Sidebar 文件树中直接阅读、编辑、运行并保存 Jupyter 笔记本(.ipynb)。

description.en: Asks context-aware side questions inside DeepSeek Harness, reusing prompt cache and opening a native composer popover.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提出上下文感知的旁支问题，复用提示缓存并弹出原生编辑器浮层。

description.en: Adds a temporary side dialog that inherits your DSH session so you can ask one-off context questions and send a summary back.
description.zh: 添加一个继承 DSH 会话的临时侧边对话框，用于提出一次性上下文问题，并可将摘要发回主会话。

description.en: Adds per-task budget limits in DSH, capping spend by CNY or token count with auto-interception and burn-rate estimates to stop runaway costs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的每个任务设置预算线，按金额或 Token 限制消耗，自动拦截并估算消耗速率，防止 Agent 过度消费。

description.en: Meters every DSH session call against the official price table, halts the run when the budget runs out, and leaves a resumable handoff snapshot.
description.zh: 按官方价格表计量 DSH 会话的每次调用，预算耗尽时中止运行，并留下可恢复的交接快照。

description.en: Records browser bugs, pins expected behavior, and re-verifies fixes with Playwright for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 录制浏览器 Bug、固定预期行为，并用 Playwright 复核修复结果。

description.en: Guards the DSH plugin loader by catching duplicate loader entry IDs on every plugin load, preventing boot crashes.
description.zh: 在每次插件加载时检测重复的 loader entry id，防止启动时因重复条目崩溃

description.en: Gives agents one default workspace for miscellaneous files, via an AGENTS.md top-level rule and a default_workspace agent tool.
description.zh: 为智能体提供统一的默认工作区，通过 AGENTS.md 顶层规则和 default_workspace 工具管理零散文件。

description.en: Runtime mount manager for optional third-party plugins in DeepSeek Harness, enabling in-process load/unload without restart.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 Loader API 在进程内动态挂载和卸载可选第三方插件行，无需重启，也不修改 profile 清单，并支持命名预设与失败自愈回退。

description.en: A DSH writing-style layer that turns the '不烧心' meme into a Chinese tone plus a short-drama script rewrite engine, changing no code.
description.zh: 把「不烧心」梗做成 DSH 的文风层与短剧改写引擎，只改表达风格、不改代码。

description.en: Clean Architecture reference library with searchable repos, assertion rules, and a review ledger for architecture reviews.
description.zh: DSH 的整洁架构参考库，固定 8 个参考仓库，支持 FTS5 搜索、断言规则，并记录架构评审台账。

description.en: Refines the DSH Web composer stats row so the cache-hit rate is displayed in place with three-decimal precision.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 输入框统计行的缓存命中率原位精化显示为三位小数。

description.en: Gives DSH agents a zero-error calc tool so arithmetic is computed exactly instead of guessed, saving reasoning tokens.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供零误差计算器工具，算术直接精确求解，避免模型心算幻觉并节省推理 Token。

description.en: A ready-to-use calendar plugin for DSH that lets the agent help you create, view and manage your schedules.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打造的日历插件，开箱即用，让智能体帮你创建、查看和管理日程。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that audits file safety with a local calibrated CodeBERT gate plus cloud re-check, usable as an agent tool and sidebar panel.
description.zh: CalibGuard 是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的文件安全审计插件，采用本地校准 CodeBERT 门控加云端复核，支持 agent 工具与侧边栏面板两种形态。

description.en: Adds a five-mode tier bar to the DSH composer (thinking, loop, adversarial, retrieval, agent) plus agent_delegate backends and verify_claims.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框加入五档位条：思考、循环、对抗、检索、代理，并提供 agent_delegate 多后端委派与 verify_claims 校验。

description.en: Rate-limit resilience plugin for DeepSeek Harness that paces requests and retries on rate limits to keep tasks alive.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness免费模型提供可配置的限流恢复插件，控制请求节奏，在遇到限流时自动重试以保持任务继续运行。

description.en: 东南大学校园主题插件：校园配色、九龙湖与四牌楼风景、可选叮东，适配 DSH Web。
Canvas for DeepSeek Harness that maps conversation lineage and live agent swarms, with message-level forks and deterministic branch comparison.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话分支画布：会话谱系图、实时智能体集群、消息级分叉与确定性分支对比。

description.en: Writes all of each day's conversations into a four-section diary, auto-injects a yesterday recap card into new sessions, and tracks affinity with a sidebar trend panel.
description.zh: 把每天的全部对话写成四栏日记，次日新会话自动注入昨日速读卡，并以侧边栏展示好感度走势与加减原因。

description.en: DSH plugin that syncs CCF conference/journal deadlines, answers how many days until the next deadline by rank or field, and keeps the coming 30 days in the system prompt.
description.zh: DSH 插件：同步 CCF 会议/期刊截稿数据，按等级或方向查询距下一个截稿还有几天，并把最近 30 天截稿常驻进系统提示。

description.en: Adds a Channels sidebar tab to DSH for viewing session projections (RFC-0001).
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏注入 Channels 标签页，用于查看会话投影数据链（RFC-0001）

description.en: Discord-style channel IM layer for DeepSeek Harness with channels, immutable history, @mention wake-ups, HTTP/MCP bridge and a React web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Discord 风格频道 IM：频道、不可变历史、@提及唤醒、HTTP/MCP 桥接与 React 网页面板。

description.en: Switchable identity cards that inject persona, tone, code style, and hard constraints into each DSH session, with defaults, overrides, and a visual editor.
description.zh: 可切换的身份卡，为每个 DSH 会话注入角色、语气、代码风格与硬性约束，支持默认值、会话级覆盖和可视化编辑器。

description.en: Tracks live token costs for every dsh chat, subagent and session tree using bundled LLM price catalogs, logging costs to a JSONL file.
description.zh: 使用内置的 LLM 价格目录实时跟踪每个 dsh 聊天、子代理和会话树的 token 成本，并将成本记录到 JSONL 文件。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness conversations for copying text or images and opening or revealing files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话添加右键菜单，可复制文本或图片，并打开文件或在文件管理器中显示。

description.en: Keeps a panel of actions, applications and highlights distilled from your WeChat/QQ chats, with a resident agent re-reading them on a schedule.
description.zh: 从微信/QQ 聊天中提炼待办、可申请事项和值得关注的信息，形成面板，并由常驻智能体定时重新扫描更新。

description.en: Adds a compact per-turn resource panel in DSH chat to open, locate, and copy paths of referenced local files and web links.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话回复下显示紧凑的「本轮资源」面板，可打开、定位并复制本轮引用的本地文件与网页链接。

description.en: A web conversation plugin that folds runtime activity into expandable boxes and renders chat bubbles with deep customization.
description.zh: dsh web conversation plugin: fold runtime activity into expandable boxes, chat bubbles, deep customization (fork of dsh-client-ui-conversation)

description.en: Adds a session-independent floating window that embeds chat.deepseek.com inside DeepSeek Harness, with no API calls, stored credentials or script injection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中添加一个与会话无关的 chat.deepseek.com 浮窗，不调用接口、不存储凭据、不注入脚本。

description.en: Adds a per-session question index rail and chain panel to navigate main and branch chat sessions with click-to-jump and highlight.
description.zh: 为每个会话添加问题索引栏与链面板，支持主/分支会话点击跳转并高亮。

description.en: Adds turn-rail appearance settings to DSH Web: tick thickness, rail side, hover gradient, and a configurable plain-text hover preview.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加对话轮次导轨外观设置：刻度粗细、导轨位置、悬停渐变及可调文本悬停预览。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness chat plugin providing a ChatGPT-style hover slide-out quick navigation menu.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天提供 ChatGPT 式悬停滑出的快捷导航菜单。

description.en: ChatGPT Projects-style session organizer for DSH that moves chats between project workspaces and files ungrouped sessions into the right project.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 ChatGPT 项目式会话整理功能，可在项目工作区之间移动会话，并把未分组会话归入对应项目。

description.en: Automatically renders Persian conversation content right-to-left in DeepSeek Harness while keeping the app UI in its own language.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中自动将波斯语对话内容设为从右到左显示，应用界面保持原有语言。

description.en: Adds a locally stored background image to the DSH Web chat area, auto-adjusting brightness, contrast and opacity to keep text readable.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 聊天区添加本地背景图，自动校正亮度、对比度与不透明度以保证正文清晰可读。

description.en: Adds editable canvases, rich messages, interactive UI, math plots and music tools inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可编辑画布、富消息、交互式界面、数学绘图和音乐工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that checks npm for new versions, shows update popup, and performs verified upgrades.
description.zh: 首次打开时自动从 npm 查询实际最高版本并弹出更新提示，点击更新到按钮执行带盘校验的升级，界面使用 DSH 主题 token。

description.en: Checks for new versions of DSH core and plugins, shows red dot on navigation tab when updates are available, and provides update commands.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 核心与插件的新版本，有更新时在导航标签显示红点，并提供更新命令。

description.en: Toolbox to generate, validate, and detect check digits for Luhn, Verhoeff, Damm, ISBN, EAN, UPC, ISIN, CUSIP, IBAN.
description.zh: 用于生成、校验和识别 Luhn、Verhoeff、Damm、ISBN、EAN、UPC、ISIN、CUSIP、IBAN 校验位的数学工具库，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Deterministic chemistry math plugin for DeepSeek Harness: formula parsing, molar mass, conversions, concentration, and pH calculations.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供确定性化学计算：公式解析、摩尔质量、换算、浓度和pH计算。

description.en: Control an existing signed-in Chrome profile through a chrome_repl bridge for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 chrome_repl 桥接控制已登录的 Chrome 配置文件，供 DeepSeek Harness 使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin plus MV3 extension that drives the user's real Chrome via chrome.debugger (UIA refs, tab-group ACL, logs, iframes).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件与 MV3 扩展，通过 chrome.debugger 控制用户真实 Chrome（UIA 引用、标签组 ACL、日志、iframe）。

description.en: Loop guard for DeepSeek Harness that prevents repeated tool calls and caps per-agent calls outside the model.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的循环防护，防止重复工具调用并限制每个代理的调用次数。

description.en: Select text in an assistant reply and convert it into an atomic reference chip inside the DSH composer for inline citation.
description.zh: 在助手回复中选中文本，将其转换为 DSH 输入框中的原子引用芯片，实现行内引用。

description.en: Adds web evidence and sourced images to DeepSeek Harness, backed by a self-hosted retrieval (RAG) service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页证据与带来源的图片，依托自托管的检索（RAG）后端。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness's outbound network through Clash for LLM, web search/fetch, and shell commands.
description.zh: Route DeepSeek Harness's outbound network through Clash — LLM, web search/fetch and shell commands all use your local Clash proxy.

description.en: Read-only bridge importing Claude Code skills, rules, hooks, and agents into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Read-only Claude Code compatibility bridge for DeepSeek Harness: Skills, Rules, command Hooks, and Agents from .claude as SSOT.

description.en: Migrates Claude config (skills, rules, MCP, CLAUDE.md) into DeepSeek Harness with workspace isolation.
description.zh: 将 Claude 配置迁移到 DSH：识别主目录与项目根下的 skills、rules、.mcp.json 和 CLAUDE.md，skill 按工作区隔离唤醒，MCP 动态注册真实连接，并提供可折叠配置中心看板。

description.en: Loads Claude-style plugins into dsh by scanning plugin caches, registering skills, and bridging SessionStart hooks.
description.zh: 扫描插件缓存加载 Claude 风格插件到 dsh，注册技能并桥接 SessionStart 钩子。

description.en: Adds a clean-chat sidebar panel that talks straight to the model with a one-line system prompt — no tools, no context, no session files.
description.zh: 在侧栏新增「干净对话」面板，用一句话系统提示直连模型：不带工具、不带上下文、不写会话文件。

description.en: Delegates coding tasks to Claude Code and Codex CLIs, streaming runs live with autonomous control and git worktrees.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that delegates coding tasks to the Claude Code and Codex agent CLIs and streams the whole run live — autonomous control, multi-account, automatic install, git worktrees,

description.en: Plays Bilibili videos while agent works, pausing to alert the user when agent needs attention.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的插件，agent 工作时播放 B 站视频，agent 需操作时暂停视频并提醒用户

description.en: Ports the VS Code Dracula color scheme to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with programmer-oriented typography tweaks and easy one-click restore.
description.zh: 把 VS Code 的 Dracula 配色移植到 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，附带程序员向排版调优，可随时整页还原。

description.en: Adds local files to chat context with attach chip UI, supporting text and images.
description.zh: Add files to context

description.en: A model usage clock that shows current DeepSeek model pricing, off-peak windows and discounts on an all-day cost heatmap.
description.zh: 模型使用时钟：用全天成本热力图展示各模型当前价格、错峰时段与折扣活动。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek API pricing status indicator (peak/valley) to the DSH web client chat interface.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端插件，在模型选择按钮左侧显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷价状态，绿色表示谷价，橙色表示峰价。

description.en: Adds right-to-left text direction support for the DeepSeek Harness web client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端添加从右到左的文字方向支持。

description.en: Real Madrid-themed dual-mode skin (dark/light) for DeepSeek Harness UI.
description.zh: Real Madrid dual-mode skin for DeepSeek Harness: Bernabeu night stadium (dark) and white-kit pinstripes (light). Unofficial fan work.

description.en: A DSH desktop/web client theme remapping Solarized tokens with a grid-paper background and tuned chat bubbles.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端/Web 客户端提供的 Solarized 主题，包含网格纸背景与调优的对话气泡样式。

description.en: Russian (ru) locale pack that translates the Cline Pass plugin's interface strings inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 Cline Pass 插件提供俄语（ru）界面本地化的语言包。

description.en: Reads clipboard text or screenshots and writes generated text or images back to the clipboard, cross-platform with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 读取剪贴板中的文字或截图，并将生成的文字或图片写回剪贴板，跨平台且零依赖。

description.en: Provides a host-measured task_clock tool for DSH agents, timing tasks without modifying presets.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供主机侧 task_clock 计时工具，测量任务耗时且不改动预设。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Cloudflare's official Code Mode MCP so agents can search and execute 2,500+ Cloudflare APIs.
description.zh: 接入 Cloudflare 官方 Code Mode MCP，让 Harness 搜索并执行 2,500+ 个 Cloudflare API。

description.en: Connect to Cloudflare API via MCP with full OAuth 2.0 flow, enabling all Cloudflare tools in agent sessions.
description.zh: 通过完整OAuth 2.0连接Cloudflare API为MCP，使代理会话可用所有Cloudflare工具。

description.en: Adds Cloudflare Workers AI image generation, text-to-speech, and speech-to-text tools with per-capability model settings.
description.zh: 接入 Cloudflare Workers AI 的图像生成、文本转语音和语音转文本工具，并支持按能力选择模型。

description.en: Drives your local Edge to search CNKI for real, close-reads papers like a journal editor, then writes your paper step by step with a literature sidebar.
description.zh: 通过本机 Edge 真实检索知网，按核心期刊编辑视角精读文献，分步完成大纲、引言、正文与校订，并附文献库侧栏。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：按 DeepSeek 官方定价把会话 token 用量折算成理论人民币成本，在输入框下方和每个回合末尾显示，可展开按「模型 × 时段」的计价明细。
Folds pasted path:line + code snippets into one compact inline token in DSH chat, sending full code snapshots to the model for context.
description.zh: 将粘贴的“路径:行号+代码”自动折叠为一行紧凑引用，并向模型发送完整代码快照作为上下文。

description.en: AI-powered code review plugin detecting bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and style problems with line-level fix suggestions.
description.zh: AI驱动的多维度代码审查插件，检测bug、安全漏洞、性能与风格问题，提供行号定位和修复示例。

description.en: A Matrix-style digital rain boot animation plus a green semantic theme for dsh desktop.
description.zh: 为 dsh 桌面端提供数字雨开机动画与绿色语义主题。

description.en: Scopes CodeGraph MCP tools per project so each DSH session queries only the repository it is actually working in.
description.zh: 按项目隔离 CodeGraph MCP 工具，让每个 DSH 会话只查询当前实际工作的仓库。

description.en: Nine switchable code-art backgrounds and WebGL2 live wallpapers for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, including whales, Turing portraits, a 3D globe and an earth map.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供九款可切换的代码艺术背景与 WebGL2 动态壁纸，含鲸鱼、图灵肖像、3D 地球与地球大陆地图。

description.en: Turns a GitHub Codespace into a DSH workspace so the agent can read/write files and run commands inside it.
description.zh: 把 GitHub Codespace 直接当作 DSH 工作区，让 Agent 在其中读写文件并执行命令。

description.en: Adds an Appearance settings page and a Codex-style blue-gray dark theme to DeepSeek Harness, with light/dark/custom modes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「外观」设置页与 Codex 风格蓝灰深色主题，支持浅色/深色/自定义模式。

description.en: Codex-style windowed context management with live notes and cold history search for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供Codex风格的窗口化上下文管理、实时笔记和冷历史搜索。

description.en: Plugs ChatGPT / OpenAI Codex into DSH as an LLM provider and lets DeepSeek hand hard tasks to GPT, all on ChatGPT subscription OAuth with no API key.
description.zh: 将 ChatGPT / OpenAI Codex 接入 DSH：既作为模型选择器中的 LLM provider，也可让 DeepSeek 把难题转交 GPT 独立分析或构建，全程走订阅 OAuth 无需 API Key。

description.en: Discovers hooks.json from config, plugins, and projects, verifies each hook's SHA-256 trust fingerprint, and runs trusted Codex-compatible lifecycle hooks.
description.zh: 从配置、插件和项目中发现 hooks.json，校验每个钩子的 SHA-256 信任指纹，并运行可信的 Codex 兼容生命周期钩子。

description.en: A Codex-like WYSIWYG Markdown editor in the DSH right sidebar that renders documents you edit in place, including table cells.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的类 Codex Markdown 编辑器，文档直接渲染并可就地编辑，包括表格单元格。

description.en: Bundles the classic Codex UI 1.1.49 interface into one plugin and adds real conversation deletion for session cleanup.
description.zh: 将冻结在 1.1.49 的经典 Codex UI 界面打包为单个插件，并加入真正的会话删除功能。

description.en: Quota ring in the DSH composer bar tracking OpenCode Go and 14 other coding-plan quotas or balances, colouring itself by urgency.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入栏显示配额环，追踪 OpenCode Go 等 15 种编程套餐的额度或余额，并按紧迫程度变色。

description.en: Plays generative background music while the agent works and configurable chimes for completion, approval, thinking and tool steps, so you can follow progress by ear.
description.zh: 在 Agent 工作时播放生成式背景音乐，并为完成、审批等待、思考与工具执行提供可配置提示音，让你不看屏幕也能凭声音掌握进度。

description.en: A project memory for DeepSeek Harness agents to constrain, observe, remember, and verify.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供项目记忆，基于 DSH 原生原语实现约束、观察、记忆与验证四项能力。

description.en: Cognition HUD 是 DSH Web UI 上的一个实时「认知监视」浮层。 它把智能体正在做的事拆成三块同时呈现：一面会呼吸的方块墙——每段推理点亮格子、一道柔光横扫而过；一只在墙里游走、时不时起跳眨眼的小鲸鱼宠物；一组冷静的读数——工具意图、最近步骤、本轮用到的插件/技能/MCP，以及上下文与 token。
Color utility for hex/rgb/hsl conversion, complementary colors, light/dark calculation, and text contrast.
description.zh: 颜色工具，支持 hex、rgb、hsl 互转，计算补色、明暗调整和文本对比度。

description.en: Sidebar kanban task board that dispatches cards into separate Harness sessions, tracks live progress and collects results, with scheduled runs.
description.zh: 侧栏任务看板，把任务卡派发到独立会话执行，实时汇总进度并回收结果，支持定时自动执行。

description.en: Chat UI colour theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness with the Mariana palette, 18 adjustable colour slots, 9 Markdown prose roles, saved presets and light/dark modes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聊天界面配色主题插件，默认提供 Mariana 调色板，含 18 个可调色槽、9 个 Markdown 文本角色、预设保存及明暗模式。

description.en: Conversational text-to-image generation for DeepSeek Harness, powered by your local ComfyUI backend.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话式文生图能力，由本地 ComfyUI 后端驱动。

description.en: Sidebar album for dsh-comfyui-image output that lets you browse generated images and copy images or prompts, export workflows, or add them to the chat.
description.zh: 为 dsh-comfyui-image 提供侧边栏相册，浏览已生成图片并可复制图片/提示词、导出工作流或加入当前对话。

description.en: ComfyUI studio for DSH: run image-generation workflows, quick-edit prompts and LoRAs, with a node editor, native canvas and image lightbox.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 ComfyUI 工作室：运行图像生成工作流，快速编辑提示词与 LoRA，提供节点编辑器、原生画布和图片灯箱。

description.en: Embedded serial, TCP server/client, and UDP comms debug console with text/HEX send-receive, encoding switch, custom quick input, and log export.
description.zh: 内嵌串口、TCP 服务端/客户端与 UDP 的通信调试台，支持文本/HEX 收发、编码切换、自定义快捷输入及日志录制导出。

description.en: Adds a /context slash command that reports context-window usage, free space, and a per-category breakdown of what fills the prompt.
description.zh: 新增 /context 斜杠命令，显示上下文窗口用量、剩余空间以及按类别划分的提示词占用明细。

description.en: Floating draggable pill that monitors command and tool execution in the DSH Web GUI with a live log, copy and export.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中浮动显示命令与工具执行监控的可拖动胶囊，支持实时日志、复制和导出。

description.en: CommandCode usage and balance panel for DeepSeek Harness to view API consumption and credit.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 CommandCode 用量与余额面板，用于查看 API 消费和额度。

description.en: Inline Command Code usage badge for DSH composer, showing time-window usage and remaining credits with details popup and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 在DSH作曲工具条内联显示Command Code用量徽章，展示窗口用量和剩余额度，点击可看详情并自动刷新。

description.en: DSH plugin that makes the /compact command use the currently selected model instead of the model that finished the last turn.
description.zh: DSH 插件：让 /compact 使用当前选中的模型，而不是完成上一轮的模型。

description.en: Adds composer controls to tune per-conversation compaction trigger ratio and retained context tail in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在输入区添加控制项，按会话调整 DeepSeek Harness 的压缩触发比例和保留上下文尾部。

description.en: Inherits the session's routed request envelope for compaction summarization calls so the provider prefix cache keeps hitting (11.8% → 99.7%).
description.zh: 让压缩摘要调用继承会话的路由请求参数，使提供商前缀缓存持续命中（命中率从 11.8% 提升到 99.7%）。

description.en: Compaction middleware that trims prompts to real token counts, retries after shrinking on prompt-too-long, and repairs silent-overflow false positives.
description.zh: 压缩中间件：按真实 token 数裁剪提示词，超长时收缩并重试，并修复 pi-ai 静默溢出误报。

description.en: Lets an agent compact/edit its own context within DSH (meta-compaction, TODO).
description.zh: 允许 agent 在 DSH 中自行压缩或编辑自己的上下文，元压缩功能尚未实现

description.en: A lightweight UI companion for DeepSeek Harness Web that visualizes agent activity state and context-window pressure in a Living Data Orb.
description.zh: A friendly status and context-pressure companion for DeepSeek Harness Web

description.en: A macOS desktop pet companion that reads the frontmost window, captures it for the model, speaks in a bubble and keeps a local journal.
description.zh: 一只带记忆的 macOS 桌面宠物：读取前台窗口、截屏供模型查看、用气泡说话，并保存本地日志。

description.en: Bridges hooks and rules from Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, OpenCode and Copilot into DSH with explicit loss reporting and fail-closed behavior.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy、OpenCode、GitHub Copilot 的 hooks 与 rules 显式适配到 DSH，逐项列出损失并 fail-closed。

description.en: Plays a chime or short melody when an agent turn really finishes, with optional voice announcement and system notification.
description.zh: 当智能体回合真正结束时播放提示音或短旋律，可选语音播报与系统通知。

description.en: Adds a task contract layer to DeepSeek Harness, verifying requirements and restoring checklists across sessions before marking tasks complete.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加任务契约层，在任务完成前核对要求清单，并在会话恢复后复原同一清单。

description.en: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DeepSeek Harness chat composer so typing stays fast and error-free.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框中自动配对括号与引号，让输入更快、更少出错。

description.en: Adds upload and region screenshot buttons to DSH chat composer, injecting images into the draft.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天输入框添加图片上传和区域截图按钮，把图片注入草稿图片轨，纯客户端加 Electron 截屏实现。

description.en: Live Markdown rendering and typing enhancements for the DSH web composer, with syntax-highlighted code blocks, list/quote continuation and format toolbars.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页编辑器提供实时 Markdown 渲染与输入增强，支持代码高亮、列表/引用自动续写和格式工具栏。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT-style ghost-text predictions for your next message in the DeepSeek Harness composer, accepted with Tab and dismissed with Esc.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供 ChatGPT 风格的幽灵文本预测，按 Tab 接受、Esc 取消。

description.en: A resident prompt optimization / revert button for the DeepSeek Harness composer
Composition and upgrade preflight doctor for DeepSeek Harness that scans a selected profile and reports Cordis/plugin composition risks with evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的组合与升级预检医生，扫描所选配置并给出 Cordis/插件组合风险与证据。

description.en: Codex-style Windows computer-use plugin for DSH, combining UI Automation, screenshots, and SendInput with an overlay and ESC kill switch.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Codex 风格 Windows 电脑操作插件，结合 UI 自动化、截图和 SendInput，并提供屏幕浮层与 ESC 急停开关。

description.en: Native Win32 desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: 12 computer_* tools for screen capture, mouse, keyboard, windows, clipboard and app launch.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Win32 桌面控制：12 个 computer_* 工具，支持截屏、鼠标、键盘、窗口、剪贴板与应用启动。

description.en: Diagnoses silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and gives the exact patch that fixes each one.
description.zh: 诊断 DeepSeek Harness 中插件间的隐性冲突，并给出修复每个冲突的精确补丁。

description.en: Hosts connection cards that let DSH sessions establish and maintain stateful links through card plugins.
description.zh: 承载连接卡片，让 DSH 会话通过卡片插件建立并保持有状态连接。

description.en: Canvas-rendered force-directed map of a DSH workspace's files and their import relationships for visual exploration.
description.zh: 以画布渲染的力导向图展示 DSH 工作区文件及其导入关系，便于可视化探索。

description.en: DSH console plugin that opens a real PTY interactive terminal inside the web UI, with iTerm-style multi-tabs and full vim/top/Ctrl+C support.
description.zh: DSH 控制台插件，在 Web 界面中直接打开真 PTY 交互终端，支持 iTerm 风格多标签与 vim/top/Ctrl+C。

description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation, attach notes, and send the annotation batch with your next message.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中任意文本并添加备注，随后将整批标注随下一条消息一起发送。

description.en: Per-step context ledger for DeepSeek Harness that trims tool tables, externalizes long-tail data, and flags duplicate reads.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐步上下文账本，精简工具表、外置长尾数据并标记重复读取。

description.en: Inspects and trims DeepSeek Harness context: shows token breakdown, lazily loads skills/MCP/plugins per session, and compacts on demand or by threshold.
description.zh: 查看并管控 DeepSeek Harness 上下文：展示 token 构成，按会话懒加载技能/MCP/插件，支持按需或阈值自动压缩。

description.en: Summarizes long DSH sessions into self-contained Markdown handoff docs and resumes them in fresh sessions using token-economics planning.
description.zh: 将较长的 DSH 会话总结为独立的 Markdown 交接文档，并基于 token 成本评估在新会话中恢复继续。

description.en: Turns conversation context into a layered architecture map of goals, decisions and risks, exported as SVG, interactive HTML and Mermaid.
description.zh: 把对话上下文整理成分层的架构图，涵盖目标、决策与风险，可导出为 SVG、交互式 HTML 和 Mermaid。

description.en: Context-management tools for DeepSeek Harness: session handoff, compaction decisions, context diagnosis and pressure history.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文运维工具：会话交接、压缩决策、上下文诊断与压力历史记录。

description.en: Manages DSH agent context with a phase protocol, budget sentinel, controlled compaction and bounded handoffs to fresh sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体管理上下文：阶段协议、预算哨兵、受控压缩以及向新会话的有界交接。

description.en: Reusable trajectory-tree context, exact-turn forks, and bounded cross-session recall for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用的轨迹树上下文、按精确轮次分叉，以及有界的跨会话回忆。

description.en: Connects the Context7 hosted MCP server to DeepSeek Harness so the assistant can pull up-to-date library documentation on demand.
description.zh: 将 Context7 托管 MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，让助手可按需获取最新的库文档。

description.en: Reads a contract clause stance register and checks its completeness and self-consistency clause by clause.
description.zh: 读取合同条款立场登记表，逐条检查其完整性与自洽性。

description.en: GitHub-style contribution calendar in the DSH sidebar showing daily prompts, conversations, and token usage.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏用 GitHub 风格方格日历展示每日提示词、对话与 token 用量。

description.en: Shows live per-turn progress and ETA for DeepSeek Harness sessions, with click-to-open turn history docked under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中显示每轮实时进度和预估时间，并可点击打开停靠在输入框下方的轮次历史。

description.en: Browse, read and resume local Codex CLI conversation threads in a visual DSH conversation window.
description.zh: 在可视化会话窗口中浏览、阅读并继续本地 Codex CLI 的对话线程。

description.en: Adds Export Chat to DSH Web, downloading conversations as clean Markdown for reading, notes, Git, or AI handoff.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中添加导出聊天按钮，把 DeepSeek Harness 对话下载为整洁易读的 Markdown 文件，便于阅读、记笔记、存入 Git 或交给 AI 处理。

description.en: Reference and quote other DSH conversations inside the current chat via @ mentions, sidebar drag-and-drop, or picking individual messages.
description.zh: 通过 @ 提及、从侧边栏拖拽或勾选单条消息，在当前对话中引用和插入其他 DSH 对话的内容。

description.en: Live tree map of every DeepSeek Harness session in the workspace, showing subagent lineage and running state with one-click navigation.
description.zh: 工作区全部会话的实时树状图：展示子代理谱系与运行状态，双击即可跳转。

description.en: Adds a ChatGPT-style conversation minimap to DSH Web GUI with fish-eye hover, edge fade, and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加对话迷你地图，支持鱼眼悬停、边缘渐隐和点击跳转导航。

description.en: Adds a recycle bin for DSH conversations, with soft delete, audit trail, per-session rollback and an optional previewed memory cascade.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话增加回收站：软删除、审计记录、按会话回滚，并支持可预览的关联记忆级联清理。

description.en: Adds inline message editing and a visual branches tree to navigate and view conversation history in the DSH web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加消息内联编辑和可视化分支树，用于浏览和查看对话历史。

description.en: Adds a Codex-inspired vertical conversation-turn rail to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: Codex-inspired vertical conversation-turn rail for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

description.en: Organizes a workspace's conversations and branches into a zoomable tree canvas with fork, bring-back, archive, subtree delete and token usage.
description.zh: 将工作区对话及其分支绘制成可缩放管理的树，支持分叉、带回、归档、子树删除与 token 用量查看。

description.en: Web UI plugin adding a conversation minimap to DeepSeek Harness chat, with hover previews, click-to-jump, and auto-highlighting.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话区左缘添加对话地图刻度，每刻度对应一轮提问，悬停可展开预览该轮问答摘要，点击跳转并自动分页加载未渲染轮次，滚动时高亮当前轮次。

description.en: Patient auto-retry for DeepSeek Harness — reads the retry delay out of an upstream 429 capacity-cooldown message and waits it out, instead of giving up after two fast retries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供耐心自动重试：从上游 429 容量冷却响应中读取重试延迟并等待其结束，而不是两次快速重试后就放弃。

description.en: Displays current session ID in DSH web header and copies full ID to clipboard on click with localization.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页头部显示当前会话 ID，点击可复制完整 ID 到剪贴板，并支持本地化。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that shows a persistent COROS badge with watch model and total workout days, expanding to a one-line review and advice.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件：输入框左侧常驻高驰徽章，显示手表型号与累计运动天数，点击展开点评与建议。

description.en: OCR/ASR extraction bridge for DSH Cortex: Windows OCR, Tesseract, optional local PaddleOCR and whisper.cpp.
Layered temporal memory engine for DeepSeek Harness
Deploys ComfyUI (Z-Image-Turbo) with a self-test, then generates live-action cosplay photo sets from a character name, reference image or hot-character pick.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面部署带自检的 ComfyUI（Z-Image-Turbo），可通过角色名、参考图或热门角色生成真人 cosplay 写真集。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that estimates per-turn token cost and queries balance.
description.zh: 用于 deepseek harness 的插件，可预估每轮对话的 token 消费并查询账户余额。

description.en: A DSH plugin that displays a session cost/balance statistics bar under the input box with configurable settings and one-click reset.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，在输入框下方显示会话费用与余额统计栏，支持配置设置并一键重置。

description.en: Composer-bar cost pill showing estimated spend for the current turn and whole session, with a two-column breakdown on click.
description.zh: 输入栏成本条插件，显示本轮与会话的估算花费，点击可查看双栏明细。

description.en: Real-time tracker for your own local DeepSeek API spend, shown in the DSH status area with off-peak/peak RMB pricing.
description.zh: 实时统计本机 DeepSeek API 调用费用，并在 DSH 输入框下方状态区按闲时/忙时人民币价显示。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost in the dsh web GUI with official peak/off-peak pricing and per-model breakdown.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与单次会话费用，采用官方峰谷定价并按模型拆分。

description.en: Shows live conversation spend in CNY via a composer stats line and a per-turn footer chip, priced with DeepSeek's official peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框状态行和每轮对话页脚标签中实时显示以人民币计的对话花费，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷价目表计费。

description.en: Adds a per-reply cost and balance line in DeepSeek Harness, pricing token usage at official peak/off-peak rates and explaining any unpriceable case.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 每条回复下显示本次花费与账户余额（充值/礼金分列），按官方峰谷单价计算 token 费用，算不出价时说明原因。

description.en: A draggable floating widget for DSH Web GUI showing DeepSeek daily cost per million tokens, cache hit rate, and balance.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 可拖动悬浮面板，显示当天 V4-Flash/Pro 每百万 token 平均费用、缓存命中率和余额。

description.en: Injects up to 3 established conclusions from the model's latest thinking after each tool result, and aborts looping or fake tool calls mid-generation.
description.zh: 从模型最新思考中提取已成立结论，在工具结果后回流最多3条，并在生成中检测打转或伪工具调用即时软切。

description.en: Exports a DSH session's full model chain-of-thought to Markdown, JSON, JSONL or text, and builds supervised review packages for other agents.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话的完整模型思维链导出为 Markdown、JSON、JSONL 或纯文本，并为其他智能体生成可监督的审阅包。

description.en: Shows the official COT machine translation directly inside dsh-better-display's reading view for bilingual reading.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-display 阅读页中直接显示官方「思考过程机器翻译」译文，方便对照阅读。

description.en: Connects the CoThread remote MCP server to DeepSeek Harness so agents can read and write projects, iterations, tasks, docs and group chat.
description.zh: 连接共序 CoThread 远程 MCP 服务器，让 DeepSeek Harness 直接读写项目、迭代、任务、文档与群聊消息。

description.en: A persistent work-period countdown panel for DSH with a geometrically accurate draining hourglass and configurable time periods.
description.zh: 一个常驻 DSH 界面的工作时段倒计时面板，配有按真实时间精准漏沙的沙漏，并支持自定义时段。

description.en: DSH plugin that creates a one-line song cover using your own voice timbre, powered by RVC voice conversion.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用你自己的音色一句话生成一首翻唱歌曲，基于 RVC 音色转换。

description.en: CrabTodo is a persistent todo plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gives the model todo tools and adds a web sidebar page for tasks.
description.zh: CrabTodo 是 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化待办插件，为模型提供待办工具，并在网页侧边栏展示任务。

description.en: Provides conversation-local credential handoff for DSH, writing through the credential service without exposing secrets.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供会话内凭据交接，通过凭据服务写入而不暴露密钥。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-checks in daily for credits on Trae CN, WorkBuddy, Qoder CN/Intl and MiniMax Code, with catch-up sign-ins and one status panel.
description.zh: DSH 插件，定时为 Trae CN、WorkBuddy、Qoder 国内/国际版和 MiniMax Code 自动领取每日积分，支持补签并在统一面板查看结果。

description.en: DSH-native plugin for multi-platform account and AI model routing management with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and quota forecasts.
description.zh: DSH 原生插件，管理多平台账号与模型路由，支持错峰签到、事件通知与额度预测。

description.en: Enables top-level DSH sessions to message each other, hand off files, and search or read peer sessions without subagents.
description.zh: 让顶层 DSH 会话之间互相发消息、传递文件，并搜索或读取对等会话，无需子 agent。

description.en: A CRT terminal skin for DeepSeek Harness with a phosphor-green palette, scanline effects and monospace type.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 CRT 终端皮肤，采用荧光绿色调、扫描线与等宽字体。

description.en: Composer input plugin: Enter inserts a newline, while Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) sends the message.
description.zh: 输入框插件：Enter 插入换行，Ctrl+Enter（macOS 为 Cmd+Enter）发送消息。

description.en: Audits and trims the static context an agent pays for on every request, covering rules, memory, skills, tools, sessions, and KB.
description.zh: 审计并精简智能体每次请求都要支付的静态上下文，涵盖规则、记忆、技能、工具面、会话和知识库。
