description.en: Automatically syncs LLM context window settings with actual runtime limits of local llama.cpp/Ollama servers by probing n_ctx per request.
description.zh: 自动探测本地 llama.cpp/Ollama 服务器的实际上下文窗口，并同步 LLM 上下文设置，防止溢出。

description.en: Persists event-cue memory across sessions and re-injects remembered context on topic switches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话事件线索记忆，自动从对话中建立持久线索库，并在话题切换时重新注入已记住的上下文。

description.en: A decorative DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a glowing, fluid trail to your cursor as you move.
description.zh: 一个装饰性 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让光标移动时留下流畅的发光拖尾。

description.en: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript/TypeScript userscripts in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI without forking.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中加载、编辑、管理并热重载可信的 JavaScript/TypeScript 用户脚本，无需 Fork。

description.en: DSH web plugin to replace branding (favicon and sidebar logo) with custom images via an in-app upload panel.
description.zh: DSH网页插件，通过内置上传面板把网站图标和侧边栏标志替换为自定义图片。

description.en: A DSH startup-screen plugin that plays a custom local MP4 full screen during boot, then fades into the app.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 启动屏插件，开机时全屏播放自定义本地 MP4 视频，结束后淡入应用界面。

description.en: Plays a random DeepSeek Harness splash video on each startup, skippable with Esc, and hides the native Windows title bar buttons.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机播放一段开屏视频，可按 Esc 跳过，并隐藏 Windows 原生标题栏按钮。

description.en: A DSH Web skin manager that imports, previews, uses, and manages DSH skin packages from local paths or GitHub.
description.zh: DSH 网页皮肤管理器，可从本地路径或 GitHub 导入、预览、使用和管理 DSH 皮肤包。

description.en: Presents DSH Agent Teams as an interactive pixel office sidebar with member badges, a task board and team messaging.
description.zh: 把 DSH Agent Teams 显示为可交互像素办公室侧边栏，含成员工牌、任务看板和团队沟通。

description.en: Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse development assistant that lets an agent query metadata, solution layers and diffs, and make controlled writes.
description.zh: 面向 Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse 的开发助手，让智能体查询元数据、解决方案层与快照差异，并进行受控写入。

description.en: Automatically records tasks/sessions/errors and generates daily/weekly Markdown reports with a floating web summary card.
description.zh: 自动记录任务、会话和错误，一键生成日报/周报 Markdown，并提供网页悬浮摘要卡。

description.en: DSH Web UI tarot daily-fortune plugin: real ephemeris base luck plus a hand-drawn Major Arcana card, scored across five dimensions.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 塔罗每日运势插件：用真实星历算基础运势，再手抽一张大阿尔卡纳，给出五维评分与今日评语。

description.en: AI dashboard plugin for DSH that reads your database from one sentence and auto-builds interactive charts with drill-down to raw records.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 看板插件，一句话即可读取数据库并自动生成可下钻查看明细的交互式图表看板。

description.en: Extracts user-defined fields from unstructured text into JSON, CSV, or Markdown table output.
description.zh: 从非结构化文本中提取用户定义字段，输出JSON、CSV或Markdown表格。

description.en: Data analysis toolkit for CSV profiling, anomaly detection, and summarization.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的数据分析工具包，支持 CSV 数据概况分析、异常检测和数据摘要汇总。

description.en: Data-source panel for SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle with a bundled Python MCP server that exposes those databases to the agent.
description.zh: 为 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 Oracle 提供数据源面板，并附带 Python MCP 服务器将这些数据库暴露给智能体。

description.en: Connect to SQL databases from DSH and query or edit data directly within the conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中连接 SQL 数据库，并直接在对话里查询或编辑数据。

description.en: Adds multi-provider decision models to DSH, supporting TypeSafe Jev, TokenRhythm NeoHorse-Jev, OpenAI Decisions and local System One endpoints.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多供应商决策模型，支持 TypeSafe Jev、TokenRhythm NeoHorse-Jev、OpenAI Decisions 和本地 System One 端点。

description.en: Bridges OpenCode's free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness via a local opencode serve, so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 通过本地 opencode serve 将 OpenCode 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key。

description.en: A research engine with mechanically-verified citations and a compounding evidence graph to expose misinformation.
description.zh: 一个通过机械验证引用和累积证据图来揭露错误信息的研究引擎。

description.en: Extends DSH thinking status line with 13 rotating deep phrases every 3 seconds without modifying source.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 纯插件：思考状态行 'Deep diving...' 扩展为 13 条 deep 系短语随机轮换（每 3 秒换一条），不改 DSH 源码。

description.en: Connects DeepAI Code models to DeepSeek Harness via browser OAuth, with no desktop client or gateway process.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 OAuth 将 DeepAI Code 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需桌面客户端或网关进程。

description.en: Terminal-style idle game where you build an AI lab, generate compute, train models, and progress through tech tree.
description.zh: 终端风挂机游戏，作为 DSH Web GUI 插件，建造 AI 实验室、产出算力、训练模型并沿科技树推进。

description.en: Open-source zero-knowledge cloud protocol client plus a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin built on it for sharing.
description.zh: 开源的零知识云端协议客户端，以及基于它的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，用于共享。

description.en: An autonomous whale-girl pet that browses Bilibili on its own: searching videos, reading subtitles, commenting, posting, replying to DMs and writing daily reports.
description.zh: 一只自主摸鱼的鲸鱼娘：自动刷B站、搜视频、读字幕、发评论、发动态、回私信，还能写日报和做视频。

description.en: A dual-mode (deep-sea/clear-sea) theme for DSH Web with plankton animations and deep-dive states.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供深海深色与浅海亮色双模式主题，含浮游生物动画背景和深潜工作态增强。

description.en: Shows a live CNY cost estimate for the DeepSeek chat you are reading, using peak and off-peak rates.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 高峰/低谷费率，实时估算当前对话的人民币费用。

description.en: macOS desktop launcher that opens DeepSeek Harness in Chrome, with a custom transparent icon and an installation skill.
description.zh: macOS 桌面启动器，可在 Chrome 中打开 DeepSeek Harness，并提供自定义透明图标和安装技能。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar entry that embeds chat.deepseek.com in a central panel inside the app, keeping login across restarts.
description.zh: 在左侧栏加入入口，在应用中央面板内嵌 chat.deepseek.com，并跨重启保留登录。

description.en: Shows elapsed and budget progress bars with an animated picture and graphical settings page for blocking DSH tool calls.
description.zh: 为阻塞的 DSH 工具调用显示已用时间和预算进度条，并提供动画图片与图形设置页。

description.en: A royal-blue pixel whale companion that sits on the composer, reflects live agent state, and swims by every 30 seconds.
description.zh: 一只宝蓝色像素鲸鱼伙伴，停在输入区旁，跟随智能体实时状态，并每30秒巡游一次。

description.en: Detects repetitive reasoning loops in DeepSeek Harness, interrupts the generation, alerts you, and automatically resumes the next step.
description.zh: 检测 DeepSeek Harness 思考段的复读退化，自动打断生成并推送下一步续跑。

description.en: Adds two-step permanent deletion of archived sessions in DSH, stopping running work and removing logs and projection cache from disk.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中为已归档会话提供两步确认的永久删除，停止其运行任务并清除磁盘上的日志与投影缓存。

description.en: A design-system skill that audits rendered pages for type scale, contrast, spacing, and palette drift to enforce design standards for AI agents.
description.zh: 设计系统技能，附带 design_audit 工具，对渲染后的页面实测字体层级、对比度、间距网格与配色偏移，而不是凭观感判断

description.en: A design token naming convention reference, implemented in pure Node, offline and dependency-free.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的设计令牌命名规范参考，离线运行、无需依赖。

description.en: Desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI featuring Yami that reacts to agent status.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的桌面宠物插件，使用金色暗影（Yami）形象，会根据智能体运行状态做出反应。

description.en: Tokyo Night dark and light theme skins for DSH Desktop with acrylic frosted panels, material blur, and a monospace font picker.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的 Tokyo Night 暗色与亮色主题皮肤，含亚克力磨砂面板、材质模糊与等宽字体选择器。

description.en: Adds a restart-host tool and sidebar button to the Windows DSH desktop app, then auto-wakes the given session to keep working.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端添加重启宿主工具与侧边栏按钮，重启后自动唤醒指定会话继续工作。

description.en: macOS desktop automation plugin providing mouse, keyboard, app/window control, screenshots, and vision-based see+locate for closed-loop agent actions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 桌面自动化：鼠标、键盘、滚动、应用与窗口控制、截图，以及基于视觉的查看与定位闭环操作，运行于 GUI 会话，不随开机自启。

description.en: Adds a Windows Settings toggle and per-user startup entry so the DeepSeek Harness desktop app launches automatically at sign-in.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用添加 Windows 设置开关和当前用户启动项，实现登录时自动启动。

description.en: Installs a desktop double-click launcher for dsh on macOS (dsh.app) and Linux (.desktop entry).
description.zh: 为 dsh 安装桌面双击启动器：macOS 生成带鲸鱼图标的 dsh.app，Linux 生成 .desktop 入口，零依赖，约 147 KB。

description.en: Sends Windows toast notifications for dsh approvals, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, each led by the conversation name.
description.zh: 为 dsh 发送 Windows 吐司通知，覆盖审批、提问、运行完成、错误和登录提示，均以会话名称开头。

description.en: Windows desktop notification plugin for DSH: approval popups in the tray corner, taskbar badges and sounds when tasks finish.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版提供 Windows 通知增强：审批请求右下角弹窗、任务完成时任务栏角标与提示音。

description.en: Shows a native OS toast when the AI finishes its reply in dsh, with a toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 在 dsh 中当 AI 完成回复时弹出系统原生通知，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Live2D desktop pet overlay for DSH that stays always-on-top with click-through, multi-monitor and launch-at-startup support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供常驻置顶的 Live2D 桌面桌宠，支持鼠标穿透、多显示器与开机自启。

description.en: Adds a cute desktop pet cat to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, draggable with blinking and tail-wagging animations.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面右下角添加一只可拖拽、会眨眼摇尾的小猫桌宠。

description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into a real desktop app: WebView2 window, tray residency, silent start and debug console, with no Electron.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 变成真正的桌面应用：WebView2 独立窗口、托盘常驻、无痕启动与调试模式，零 Electron 依赖，载荷仅 1.2MB。

description.en: Wraps DeepSeek Harness Web GUI into a macOS/Windows desktop app with one-click launch, tray resident, and automatic child-process cleanup.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面封装为 macOS/Windows 桌面应用，支持一键启动、托盘常驻，并在退出时自动清理子进程。

description.en: DSH 桌面端自动识图插件：视觉模型原图直传，非视觉模型自动调用可插拔本地 OCR 或线上视觉模型；支持 nbocr、自定义命令与 OpenAI-compatible API。
One-click launcher that discovers dev projects, starts a backend plus frontends together, and streams all logs in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键启动整套开发栈：发现项目及其运行命令，同时启动后端与前端，并在侧边栏汇总所有日志。

description.en: Manages isolated DSH dev sandboxes so plugins can be tested in a clean, separate instance with its own HOME, profile, port and sessions.
description.zh: 为待测插件创建独立的 DSH 开发沙箱，拥有各自的 HOME、profile、端口和会话，可在面板中创建、查看、停止和销毁。

description.en: Generates a Spotify Wrapped-style annual report for developers' AI pair-programming activity from local DSH session data.
description.zh: 为开发者生成类 Spotify Wrapped 的 AI 结对编程年度报告，基于本地 DSH 会话数据，输出可分享卡片。

description.en: Mirror and control Android devices, emulators and iOS simulators from the Harness Web UI, with agent-driven device inspection.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中镜像并控制 Android 设备、模拟器和 iOS 模拟器，支持智能体检查与操作设备。

description.en: Sidebar plugin that opens your local DSH desktop app to LAN phones or EasyTier-networked remote devices via an authenticated relay gateway.
description.zh: 侧边栏插件：通过带鉴权的转发网关，把本机 DSH 桌面版开放给局域网手机或 EasyTier 组网的异地设备，关掉即收回。

description.en: Codex-style change review for DeepSeek Harness: a hover pill above the composer and a syntax-highlighted right-sidebar diff page with revert.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格变更审查：输入框上方的悬停胶囊按钮与右侧栏语法高亮 diff 页面，支持回滚。

description.en: A reusable two-text diff viewer with LCS line comparison, word highlights, split/unified views, and true line numbers for DSH plugins.
description.zh: 一个可复用的双文本差异查看器，适用于DSH插件，支持LCS行比较、单词高亮、分割/统一视图及准确行号。

description.en: Auto-replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account, letting the agent look answers up in a bound DSH workspace.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉账号自动回复私聊：agent 在你绑定的工作区查资料后直接代你答复对方。

description.en: A DSH floating workspace directory-tree plugin for browsing files, dragging paths into chat, with lazy-loading.
description.zh: DSH 浮动工作区目录树插件，可浏览文件、将路径拖入聊天、懒加载并自动跟随工作区切换。

description.en: Sets the default starting folder for DeepSeek Harness desktop's new-workspace folder picker on Windows.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框设置默认起始目录。

description.en: Pushes user-configurable DSH interaction states to local Discord as Rich Presence.
description.zh: 将用户可配置的 DSH 交互状态推送到本地 Discord，显示为 Rich Presence

description.en: Scans known-safe caches and temp data on disk, flags what cannot be cleaned, and produces a ranked cleanup plan.
description.zh: 扫描已知安全的缓存和临时文件，识别无法清理的内容，并生成排序的清理方案。

description.en: Windows disk cleanup plugin that scans drive usage with WizTree, removes regenerable junk, and relocates folders behind junctions.
description.zh: Windows 磁盘清理插件，使用 WizTree 扫描占用，清理可再生垃圾文件，并通过联接点迁移文件夹。

description.en: Customizes the DSH home sidebar layout with one/two columns, icon-only mode with tooltips, plus item ordering and hiding.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH 主页侧边栏布局：单/双列、纯图标加提示、排序与隐藏，无需改源码。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that keeps a per-session ledger of documents read, created or modified, with sorting, grouping, search, preview and a cross-session view.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，记录每个会话读取、创建或修改过的文档台账，支持时间排序、类型分组、搜索、预览与跨会话汇总。

description.en: Sniffs a file's true format and PDF layout, then routes it through the best extraction pipeline to produce clean Markdown or images.
description.zh: 识别文件的真实格式和 PDF 页面布局，再选择最合适的提取流程，输出干净的 Markdown 或图像。

description.en: Shows live CPU, memory and GPU readings in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar as a small clickable badge.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器状态栏以可点击小徽章显示实时 CPU、内存和 GPU 读数。

description.en: DocMate is an immersive reading desk that shows md, docx and pdf documents with a companion AI that has already read the whole file.
description.zh: DocMate 伴读提供一个沉浸式阅读台，中间显示 md、docx、pdf 文档，右侧是已通读全文的 AI 伴读。

description.en: Reads PDF, Word, PowerPoint, plain-text, and code files into the composer via upload or drag-and-drop.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，可通过上传或拖拽把 PDF、Word docx、PPT pptx、纯文本和代码文件读入编辑框。

description.en: Exports text generated in any DeepSeek Harness session as a real Word .docx file, with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 将任意 DeepSeek Harness 会话生成的文本导出为真正的 Word .docx 文件，零依赖。

description.en: Sets a deadline and auto-nudges the agent to keep iterating on its own whenever it stops early or hits an error.
description.zh: 设定截止时间，当智能体提前停下或遇到错误时自动督促其继续迭代，自主推进任务。

description.en: Dota 2 ranked draft assistant that suggests hero picks per round, pulls daily OpenDota stats and predicts draft win probability.
description.zh: Dota 2 天梯征召助手，按轮次推荐英雄、每日同步 OpenDota 数据并预测阵容胜率。

description.en: Turns a Doubao AI video SOP into machine-checked gates that validate style lock, scripts, character/scene cards, prompts and clips with PASS/FAIL.
description.zh: 把豆包视频制作 SOP 变成可机器校验的闸门，对风格锁、脚本、角色卡、场景卡、提示词和成片逐环判定 PASS/FAIL。

description.en: A three-player LAN Doudizhu card game plugin that runs in a DSH floating window with bidding and landlord rotation.
description.zh: 一个三人局域网斗地主插件，以 DSH 悬浮窗口运行，支持叫地主与地主轮换。

description.en: Automates the Douyin creator upload flow: opens the upload page, picks a local video, fills the title and visibility, then stops before publishing.
description.zh: 自动完成抖音创作者上传流程：打开上传页、选择本地视频、填写标题与可见范围，并在发布前停下等待确认。

description.en: A persistent session-header icon that auto-discovers running downloads and background tasks, showing a progress ring, animated bars, speed, ETA, and click-to-open finished files.
description.zh: 常驻会话头的下载指示器，自动发现正在运行的下载与后台任务，显示环形进度、动画进度条、速率与剩余时间，单击已完成文件即可打开。

description.en: Shows live download progress cards in DeepSeek Harness with percentage, speed, ETA, phases, and resume support.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中显示实时下载进度卡片，包含百分比、速度、预计剩余时间、阶段和断点续传。

description.en: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++/Qt sources: writes file headers, function docs and module groups, and flags stale comments.
description.zh: 面向 C/C++（含 Qt）源码的 Doxygen 注释工作流：生成文件头、函数注释、模块分组，并标记过期的注释。

description.en: Adds a ✦ button under the DSH input box that rewrites your prompt draft with the current default model in place, never auto-sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方添加 ✦ 按钮，用当前默认模型原地优化提示词草稿，绝不自动发送。

description.en: Drag a sidebar session row into the chat input to drop a native session-reference chip, then send one message carrying that conversation's context.
description.zh: 把侧边栏会话行拖入对话输入框，即可生成原生会话引用 chip，发送带其他对话上下文的消息。

description.en: A DSH plugin with limited information; description is 'dsh-plugin'.
description.zh: 名为 dsh-drag-path 的 DSH 插件，除描述为 dsh-plugin 外无更多信息，具体功能未说明。

description.en: DSH skill that turns official transit data, CSV or topology input into editable SVG/PNG transit network maps.
description.zh: DSH 技能，可将官方交通数据、CSV 或拓扑输入转换为可编辑的 SVG/PNG 线网图。

description.en: A self-hosted, fully offline draw.io editor embedded in the DSH Web GUI sidebar, saving diagrams as .drawio files in the workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 侧边栏中内嵌的自托管、完全离线 draw.io 编辑器，图纸以工作区 .drawio 文件保存。

description.en: A virtual desktop pet companion for DeepSeek Harness that reminds you, shows balance, and celebrates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加虚拟桌面宠物，可提醒事项、显示余额并庆祝。

description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat in a DSH Desktop panel, adding a sidebar entry, toolbar, and locally saved login state.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek 网页版聊天嵌入 DSH 桌面版面板，提供侧栏入口、工具栏和本地登录快照。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek official account balance and WorkBuddy credit balance together at the bottom of the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏底部同时显示 DeepSeek 官方余额与 WorkBuddy 积分余额。

description.en: Turns English academic papers into side-by-side bilingual PDFs (odd pages original, even pages Chinese) with in-place text translation and local rendering.
description.zh: 把英文论文制作成中英对照 PDF（奇数页原文、偶数页中文），正文、表格与图内文字原位替换并本地渲染。

description.en: Adds a quick restart action for the DeepSeek harness through a desktop tray menu.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek harness 添加通过桌面托盘菜单快速重启的方式。

description.en: E-commerce visual creation plugin with 25 scene templates, Campaign Style Lock consistency, conversion diagnosis and GPT-Image-2 prompt rules.
description.zh: 电商视觉创作插件，提供 25 个场景模板、Campaign Style Lock 一致性机制、转化诊断与 GPT-Image-2 提示词铁律。

description.en: Web GUI plugin that lets you edit an earlier prompt and re-run it in a forked conversation branch, keeping the original thread intact.
description.zh: Web GUI 插件：编辑之前的提示词，并在分叉的对话分支中重新运行，保留原始会话不变。

description.en: Lets DSH understand the user's current editor selection (file/line range) and focus conversation on it via @path line injection.
description.zh: 让 DSH 感知用户在编辑器里选中的文件或行区间，并通过 @path:10-25 形式的知会行将该选区注入后续对话上下文，使对话自动聚焦于此，而不塞入文件内容。

description.en: Auto-toggles reasoning_effort per request with model-adaptive effort ladders, heuristic scoring, session continuity, and a JSONL token ledger.
description.zh: 按请求自动切换 reasoning_effort，支持模型自适应档位、启发式评分、会话连续性和 JSONL Token 账本。

description.en: Configures reasoning-effort levels, default routing, and Anthropic token budgets for third-party models.
description.zh: 配置第三方模型的推理强度级别、默认路由与 Anthropic token 预算，选择时复用原生模型选择器的 Effort 面板。

description.en: Remembers each model's last chosen reasoning-effort setting and automatically restores it when you switch back to that model.
description.zh: 记住每个模型上次选择的推理强度设置，并在切换回该模型时自动恢复。

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a dark card slider, showing a distinct mascot illustration for each of the four effort levels.
description.zh: 用深色卡片滑块替换推理强度下拉菜单，为四个等级各配一张吉祥物插画。

description.en: Per-step thinking-effort pilot for DeepSeek Harness: cheap tool rounds stay cheap, failures and heavy work lift one step, agents can change their own depth without switching models.
Opens a local port for a single outbound target and forwards it through your local proxy, leaving all other traffic direct.
description.zh: 为单个外连目标开放本机端口并经本机代理转发，其余流量保持直连。

description.en: Checks an environmental impact assessment guideline applicability sheet for traceability, guideline numbering, status vocabulary, and leftovers.
description.zh: 检查环评导则适用性清单的可追溯性、导则编号、状态词表和模板占位符。

description.en: Sends an email notification via DeepSeek Harness when a task or conversation finishes.
description.zh: 任务或对话完成时，通过 DeepSeek Harness 自动发送邮件通知。

description.en: Composer enhancement that turns reasoning effort into a slider and highlights full-access mode in red.
description.zh: 将推理强度改为滑块，并以红色提示完全访问权限的编辑器增强插件。

description.en: A 44×44 always-on-top desktop emotion ball that changes expression with the agent's real working state and flags unread alerts.
description.zh: 一颗 44×44 的桌面置顶情绪小球，根据 agent 真实工作状态切换表情，并用角标提示未读消息。

description.en: Fixes garbled text on Windows by running commands with correct encoding and recovering mojibake output in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过在 Windows 上以正确编码运行命令并修复乱码，解决 DeepSeek Harness 的乱码问题。

description.en: DSH plugin that bundles Matt Pocock's 27 engineering and productivity skills — grilling, spec/ticket, TDD, code review, domain modelling and handoff — as a skill provider.
description.zh: DSH 插件，以技能 provider 形式打包 Matt Pocock 的 27 个工程与生产力技能：grilling、spec/ticket、TDD、代码审查、领域建模与 handoff。

description.en: Composer plugin for DeepSeek Harness that rewrites your chat draft into a clearer, more specific prompt using your own model, with one-click enhance and revert.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框插件，用你自己的模型把聊天草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词，支持一键增强与一键还原。

description.en: First Enter arms the composer, a second Enter sends, any other key cancels — preventing accidental sending of half-written drafts.
description.zh: 第一次按 Enter 仅激活输入框，第二次 Enter 才发送，按其他键则取消，避免误发未写完的草稿。

description.en: Collapses the DSH left sidebar entry list behind a single toggle so session history gets more vertical room.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧边栏的入口列表收纳到一个开关后面，为会话历史腾出更多空间。

description.en: Provides erhu (Chinese fiddle) basic learning plans based on parameters, pure Node implementation without network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数生成二胡基础学习计划，采用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Checks an essay rubric scoring sheet for completeness, arithmetic, and quotation evidence.
description.zh: 检查作文评分表的完整性、算术和引文证据。

description.en: An eight-plugin everyday toolbox that adds quick commands, conversation outlines, draft history and saved answer favorites to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 包含八个插件的日常工具箱，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供快捷指令、对话目录、草稿历史和回答收藏。

description.en: Adds Exa-powered web search and page fetching to DeepSeek Harness, with 10 extra exa tools and three switchable access modes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Exa 的联网搜索与网页抓取，新增 10 个 exa 工具，并支持三种可切换接入方式。

description.en: Injects relevant lessons from your local memory store into the next step when current work matches past experience, judged by a local small model.
description.zh: 当当前工作匹配到记忆库中已学到的经验时，在下一步之前自动注入相关经验；完全本地运行，由本地小模型判定。

description.en: File explorer plugin for DeepSeek Harness adding a workspace file tree and Monaco editor with VS Code grammars.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加工作区文件树，并用带 VS Code 语法高亮的 Monaco 编辑器打开文件

description.en: Gives text-only DeepSeek models on-demand vision by uploading images, answered via OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉能力：上传图片后，模型可通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉接口（默认 Qwen/DashScope）查看并回答。

description.en: Adds group-aware fail-fast behavior to DSH tool batches so unstarted calls are skipped after a failure.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工具批次增加分组感知的快速失败行为，失败后跳过尚未开始的调用。

description.en: Adds a capsule row above the DSH Web composer that splices saved snippets into the draft and keeps a local ledger of every press.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框上方添加胶囊行，点一下把存好的话插入草稿，每次点击都留下本机台账。

description.en: Adds a one-tap 👍/👎 rating UI plus host-side collection of those ratings to JSONL, injection of summaries into context, and query tools to close the feedback loop.
description.zh: 提供一键 👍/👎 评分 UI，并在宿主侧把评分采集为 JSONL、请求前注入摘要并提供查询工具，补齐反馈闭环。

description.en: Integrates a self-built Feishu app to receive messages via WebSocket, acknowledge with OK reactions, and reply in chat.
description.zh: DSH Feishu self-built app integration: WebSocket inbound messages, OK-reaction acknowledgement, and turn replies on the original chat.

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: drive DSH agents in chat with rich cards, approvals, and image sharing.
description.zh: 在飞书聊天中驱动 DSH agent，支持流式富卡片、一键审批、按模型能力传图，以及费用与峰谷计量。

description.en: Automatically sends a digest of every finished DSH turn to a Feishu (Lark) group via webhook.
description.zh: 通过 webhook 自动将每个已完成的 DSH 轮次摘要发送到飞书群。

description.en: A local DSH virtual pet wardrobe that turns token spend into fish food and unlocks 21 outfits plus a 1080×1440 care report card.
description.zh: 本地 DSH 虚拟宠物衣橱插件，把 token 花销变成鱼粮，解锁 21 件换装和 1080×1440 饲养报告卡。

description.en: A community music radio plugin for DSH that imports your songs, uses NetEase Cloud Music for candidates, and lets a model curate playlists.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的社区音乐电台插件：导入常听歌曲，由网易云提供候选、模型挑选歌单，并学习本地偏好。

description.en: Minimal offline indicator under the DeepSeek Harness input box showing Beijing-time peak/idle windows with brief non-blocking reminders.
description.zh: 极简离线的 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方指示器，按北京时间显示高峰/空闲时段，并在高峰进入时给出非阻塞短暂提醒。

description.en: Annotate figures (image, SVG, PDF, HTML) in the right-side preview and hand the marks to the agent as one user message.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览中圈画批注图片、SVG、PDF 或本机网页，并把批注作为一条消息交给智能体。

description.en: Authenticated browser download for DSH Web GUI: streams session-workspace files from deliverables, file cards, and the sidebar file tree.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的鉴权浏览器下载：从交付物行、已交付文件卡片和侧边栏文件树流式下载会话工作区文件，远程可用，无需主机桌面。

description.en: Indexes files generated in DeepSeek Harness by conversation, enabling cross-session keyword search and stable back-references to the source event.
description.zh: 按对话归档 DeepSeek Harness 生成的本地文件，支持跨会话关键词检索，并保留可回溯到来源事件的文件回指。

description.en: Makes file and directory paths in DSH chat clickable, previewing them in the right sidebar or opening them with the system default app.
description.zh: 让 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径可点击，在右侧边栏预览或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: Adds private local file attachments to DeepSeek Harness with native images and bounded document reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框的 + 菜单顶部添加 attach 入口，用分隔线与原生命令区分，支持私密本地文件附件、原生图片和有界文档读取。

description.en: Right-click a file-tree row or a preview text selection to append its path or line range into the DSH composer draft, with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 右键点击文件树行或预览中的文本选区，即可把其路径或行范围追加到 DSH 输入框草稿中，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Records AI agent file and folder operations (create, modify, delete, rename, move) with logs for quick review and monitoring.
description.zh: 记录 AI agent 对工作区内外文件/文件夹的新建、修改、删除、重命名、移动操作，并支持日志查看、保存与删除。

description.en: Adds right-click file menu and sidebar workspace/session menus to DSH web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加文件右键菜单，支持打开、在资源管理器中显示、用编辑器打开、复制路径，以及侧边栏工作区和会话菜单。

description.en: Adds a right-click context menu to the DSH workspace file tree to copy a file's path, relative path or name and reveal it in the file manager.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工作区文件树添加右键菜单，可复制文件路径、相对路径或名称，并在文件管理器中定位该文件。

description.en: Pre-delivery finalize pass that strips tool fingerprints from docx/pptx/xlsx/odf files, recomputes real stats, and flags what it won't fabricate.
description.zh: 交付前对 docx/pptx/xlsx/odf 文档做最终清理：去除工具指纹、重新计算真实统计，并说明不会编造的内容。

description.en: Money math toolbox for loan amortization, compound growth, and rate conversion with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供贷款分期还款、复利增长与利率换算的金融计算工具，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Financial analysis plugin that fetches company reports from public web sources and performs multi-statement analysis.
description.zh: 从网络公开源获取公司财报并进行多报表分析的 deepseek harness 插件

description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a Cmd/Ctrl+F find bar to the desktop Electron shell, enabling text search like a browser.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面 Electron 外壳添加 Cmd/Ctrl+F 查找栏，可像浏览器一样在页面内搜索文本。

description.en: Permission-wall-immune find_file agent tool for DSH that skips unreadable directories, reports errors with errno, and never returns a failed walk as empty.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 find_file 代理工具，可跳过无权限目录，用 errno 报告错误，绝不把失败的遍历当成空结果。

description.en: Captures 40-cell single-token LLM fingerprints through DSH and compares records to judge whether two providers serve the same model.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 采集 40 格单 token LLM 指纹记录，并对比任意两条记录判断是否为同一模型。

description.en: FinTax workbench plugin that answers tax-policy questions from an IMA knowledge base and runs cross-border e-commerce compliance checks and tax calculators.
description.zh: 财税工作台插件：基于 IMA 知识库做政策引证问答，提供跨境电商合规自查与确定性税额试算。

description.en: Gives the dsh-fish character dreams: after long silence it stitches real past events into a dream seed she finishes herself.
description.zh: 让 dsh fish 里的小鱼做梦：安静够久后从真实事件流中挑记忆拼成梦境种子，醒来由她自己把梦讲完。

description.en: Detects flaky tests by rerunning suites, with history and quarantine lists.
description.zh: 通过重复运行测试套件识别 flaky 用例，并提供历史记录与隔离清单，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds Apple Intelligence-style animated ambient light around the window and a colour-synced running light on the input box, each toggleable.
description.zh: 为窗口添加 Apple Intelligence 风格的环境流光，并在输入框上跑马灯效果，色彩同步且可各自独立开关。

description.en: A DSH plugin that began as a weekly report generator and grew into an agent context workspace for organising and reusing working context.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，最初用于生成周报，后来演变为整理与复用工作上下文的智能体上下文工作区。

description.en: DSH plugin for FOFA cyberspace mapping: check query credits, run FOFA search syntax, and export full result sets as a native Agent tool.
description.zh: DSH 的 FOFA 网络空间测绘插件：查询额度、执行 FOFA 检索语句、导出全量结果，并作为原生 Agent 工具使用。

description.en: Cline-style follow-along that opens the file the agent just edited in the right sidebar, jumps to the change and highlights the diff.
description.zh: 类 Cline 跟随编辑：在右侧栏打开代理刚修改的文件，跳转到改动处并高亮差异。

description.en: A DSH follow-through system with sidebar nudges, conversation-header controls and a ledger panel so every conversation gets a proper ending.
description.zh: DSH 对话收尾系统：通过侧边栏提醒、会话头部控制和台账面板，让每个对话都有始有终。

description.en: Adapter plugin that lets Neo MoFox call and manage local DeepSeek Harness via RPC, HTTP, CLI, and SSE.
description.zh: 适配插件，让 Neo MoFox 通过 RPC、HTTP、CLI 和 SSE 调用并管理本地 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to every DSH session menu that removes session files and data while preserving memory.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话菜单添加删除操作，清除会话文件与数据但保留记忆。

description.en: Randomly triggers a FNAF 2 Withered Foxy jumpscare with full-screen visuals and iconic scream.
description.zh: 每秒有千分之一概率触发《FNAF 2》凋零狐狸的全屏惊吓画面和标志性尖叫音效。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness workspace for tool progress and session outputs.
DeepSeek Harness plugin adding a Games button to play free premium web games from Spawnd.gg.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness插件，添加游戏按钮，可玩来自Spawnd.gg的免费网页游戏。

description.en: Free multimodal toolkit for DSH: keyless text-to-image, local ffmpeg video frame extraction for understanding, and free text/image-to-video.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供免费多模态工具：零 Key 文生图、本地 ffmpeg 抽帧视频理解，以及免费文生/图生视频。

description.en: Adds free web search to DeepSeek Harness via Bing page/RSS scraping with a local Chrome/Edge fallback and no API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免费联网搜索：抓取 Bing 页面/RSS，本地 Chrome/Edge 兜底，无需搜索 API 或密钥。

description.en: Lets write/edit tools and matching bash escalations modify whitelisted directories without approval, managed through a Settings GUI allowlist.
description.zh: 让写入/编辑工具及匹配的 bash 提权操作免审批修改白名单目录，并提供设置中的目录白名单图形界面。

description.en: Adds a Fudan-themed status bar showing DeepSeek Harness quota and weather, together with campus wallpapers.
description.zh: 复旦主题插件：状态栏显示 DeepSeek Harness 额度与天气，并提供校园壁纸。

description.en: Design-tokens UI plugin that renders page-level UI, applies inline per-item tweaks, and reviews screenshots against code standards.
description.zh: 设计令牌驱动的 UI 插件：渲染页面级界面、支持逐条就地微调，并按代码规范进行截图走查。

description.en: Pulls Fuulea teaching-cloud management dashboard data for any school and generates three versions of teaching data reports with auto-login.
description.zh: 从辅立码课智慧教学云拉取任意学校的管理看板数据，一键生成三届教学数据报告的正式版、简报版和交互版。

description.en: Live gallery for images, files and audio/video where a human verdict layer (final / redo / archive) overrides machine tags, with batch actions and region annotations.
description.zh: 实时画廊展示图片、文件与音视频，在机器标签之上提供人工表态（已定稿/要重做/留档），支持批量操作与圈选批注生成决策草稿。

description.en: A DSH panel plugin that bundles a mini-game library (Tetris and Cops & Robbers) playable inside the same window.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 面板插件，内置小游戏库（俄罗斯方块和警察抓小偷），可在同一窗口内直接游玩。

description.en: Preview Cocos/Godot/Unity games in the DSH sidebar with input forwarding, phone viewport, Web/APK packaging, bundle budgets and agent screenshots.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏预览 Cocos/Godot/Unity 游戏，支持输入转发、手机视口、Web/APK 打包、包体预算与智能体截图。

description.en: A Gemini-style Material 3 Expressive theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, shipped as a persistent client bundle.
description.zh: 面向DeepSeek Harness Web界面的Gemini风格Material 3 Expressive主题，以持久客户端捆绑包形式提供。

description.en: DSH 里的 Gemini 出图出片工作室：多账号轮换、原生语音、转场、字幕、成片核验
Geodesic math toolbox: great-circle distance, bearings, destination points, and DMS parsing with zero dependencies.
description.zh: Geodesic math toolbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): great-circle distance, bearings, destination points, and DMS coordinate parsing — zero runtime dependencies

description.en: Renders GitHub-style alert callouts (NOTE, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, CAUTION) from markdown blockquotes inside DSH replies.
description.zh: 将回复中 > [!NOTE]/[!TIP]/[!IMPORTANT]/[!WARNING]/[!CAUTION] 引用块渲染为 GitHub 风格提示框。

description.en: Custom background plugin for DSH Web GUI to set image/GIF animated wallpapers with a local asset library.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 设置图片或 GIF 动态壁纸的自定义背景插件，带开关和本地素材库，官方主题与皮肤中心皮肤分别采用不同显示机制。

description.en: Read-only Git workspace dashboard for dsh: branch summary, change counts, file diffs, and branch comparison.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的仓外只读 Git 工作区看板。显示分支与变更摘要，可展开查看文件列表、分支比较，并对小改动做 unified diff 预览。

description.en: Reads every Git repository in a DSH workspace and shows their commits as one merged timeline, each commit labelled by repo.
description.zh: 读取 DSH 工作区内所有 Git 仓库，将提交合并为一条时间线，并标注每条提交所属仓库。

description.en: Git workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness: slash commands and read-only git tools via subprocess.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git 工作流插件，含斜杠命令和通过子进程调用的只读 git 工具。

description.en: Adds a git-related sidebar for dsh.
Compact Git statusline for the DSH Web UI showing staged/unstaged line changes, ahead/behind counts and clean state.
description.zh: DSH Web 的紧凑 Git 状态栏，显示暂存/未暂存改动行数、领先/落后提交数与干净状态。

description.en: Adds an IntelliJ IDEA-style Git version control panel to the DSH Web GUI sidebar, covering changes, commits, history, branches, commands and stash.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 右侧栏新增参照 IntelliJ IDEA 的 Git 版本管理页，涵盖本地变更、提交、历史、分支、命令与贮藏。

description.en: Gitee enterprise project management for DSH: project board, repos & WIKI, knowledge base, and write-back via the bundled Gitee Ent MCP gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Gitee 企业项目管理：项目看板、代码仓库与 WIKI、知识库，并通过内置 Gitee 企业版 MCP 网关写回。

description.en: A DSH plugin that reads and reviews GitHub repositories through the authenticated gh CLI, using the signed-in account's rate limit instead of the anonymous REST API.
description.zh: 一个通过已认证的 gh CLI 读取和审查 GitHub 仓库的 DSH 插件，使用登录账户的速率限额而非匿名 REST API。

description.en: GitHub star-growth leaderboard for DSH: daily/weekly/monthly TOP20 cards with star-history curves and multi-project comparison charts.
description.zh: DSH 的 GitHub 涨星榜插件：日/周/月三榜切换展示 TOP20，含项目卡片、星数曲线与多项目对比图表。

description.en: Launches GitHub repositories inside the DSH Web client, offering mirror browsing plus accelerated clone and download routes.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 客户端中启动 GitHub 仓库，支持镜像浏览以及加速克隆和下载通道。

description.en: GitHub console plugin for DeepSeek Harness web sidebar: search, judge, clone, and Star/Fork repos in one panel.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页侧边栏提供 GitHub 控制台面板，可搜索、评估、克隆仓库并标星或复刻

description.en: Syncs local DeepSeek Harness sessions to your own private GitHub repo so you can resume the same chat on another machine.
description.zh: 把本地 DeepSeek Harness 会话同步到你自己的私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力继续聊天。

description.en: DSH plugin that fetches GitHub Trending daily/weekly/monthly boards as 50 analyzed repo cards with zero-config proxy detection.
description.zh: DSH 插件：抓取 GitHub Trending 日/周/月榜单，生成 50 条结构化仓库分析卡片，并自动识别系统代理实现零配置联网。

description.en: Git panel plugin for DSH Web GUI with commit timeline, branch/worktree management, and workspace status.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 GoLand 风格的 Git 工具窗口，含彩色泳道提交日志时间线、分支与 worktree 管理、工作区状态摘要及简单分支/worktree 操作。

description.en: Adds git history, AI-generated commit overviews, file-tree diffs and session-traced workflows to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git 历史、AI 提交概览、文件树差异和会话追踪工作流。

description.en: A glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a frozen material system where only the wallpaper changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供的玻璃拟态主题，材质体系固定不变，壁纸是唯一可变的输入。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness an acrylic frosted-glass look, adding translucent surfaces over the native window material on top of any active theme.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供亚克力磨砂玻璃外观，在原生窗口材质上叠加半透明表面，并可作用于任意当前主题之上。

description.en: A transparent glass skin for the DSH Web UI that adds frosted-glass controls over a clear aurora or custom wallpaper.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供透明玻璃皮肤，在清晰极光或自定义壁纸上叠加磨砂控件效果。

description.en: An elegant Gomoku game plugin for DSH with frosted-glass UI and built-in AI opponent.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供五子棋游戏，采用毛玻璃界面并内置 AI 对手可对弈。

description.en: Native dsh-go plugin that auto-discovers a phone's ADB TCP port and keeps the adb connection alive for the agent.
description.zh: DSH Go 原生插件：自动发现手机的 ADB TCP 端口并保持 adb 连接不中断。

description.en: Play and review Go (Weiqi) in DSH with a full rules engine, three AI levels, dead-stone estimation, LLM review, SGF files, and optional KataGo.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中下围棋并复盘：完整规则引擎、三级 AI、死子估算、LLM 复盘、SGF 文件与可选 KataGo 桥接。

description.en: Adds a confirmation modal before pausing a running DSH activity, warning that pausing immediately interrupts the current run and its subtasks.
description.zh: 在暂停正在运行的 DSH 活动前弹出确认框，提示暂停会立即中断当前运行及子任务。

description.en: Read-only MCP server that wraps the goofish CLI to expose Xianyu/Goofish listing search, item details, chats and account status.
description.zh: 只读 MCP 服务器，封装 goofish CLI，提供闲鱼商品搜索、详情、会话与账号状态查询能力。

description.en: Connects Google Drive accounts to DSH, browses Drive files in the sidebar and drags them into the conversation.
description.zh: 将 Google Drive 账户接入 DSH，可在侧边栏浏览云端文件并直接拖入对话。

description.en: DSH plugin that searches Google Scholar via SerpAPI, registering three LLM tools for papers, citations, and versions.
description.zh: 通过 SerpAPI 检索 Google Scholar 的 DSH 插件，注册论文检索、引用查询与版本查询三个 LLM 工具。

description.en: Adds a todo task manager to DSH with a sidebar entry, project grouping, in-chat task editing and one-click splitting of replies into tasks.
description.zh: 为 DSH 加入待办任务管理：侧栏入口、项目分类、对话内增删任务，并可一键把回答拆成待办。

description.en: Turns your own ChatGPT subscription credentials into a local OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, hosted and auto-managed by a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 把你自己拥有的 ChatGPT 订阅凭证在本机转换为 OpenAI 兼容的本地接口，并由 DSH 插件托管自动启停。

description.en: Configurable DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces file-reading discipline in selected GPT model prompts.
description.zh: 一个可配置的 dsh.so 插件，为选定的 GPT 模型提示词加入文件读取纪律约束。

description.en: A draggable, throwable desktop pet that naps and walks around, and opens a ChatGPT/Codex subscription quota bubble when clicked.
description.zh: 可拖拽、抛掷、散步和打瞌睡的桌宠，点开即可查看 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅额度气泡。

description.en: Live NVIDIA GPU monitor for the dsh web rightbar, showing multi-GPU utilization, VRAM, power, temperature and processes via NVML.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页右侧栏实时监控 NVIDIA GPU，通过 NVML 显示多卡利用率、显存、功耗、温度和进程。

description.en: Floating GPU monitor showing live per-GPU utilization, VRAM, temp, power and fan via nvidia-smi in a corner widget.
description.zh: 浮动的GPU监视器，通过nvidia-smi实时显示每GPU利用率、显存、温度、功耗和风扇。

description.en: Minimal dsh demo plugin adding a configurable greet tool the AI agent calls with a name.
description.zh: dsh 最小演示插件，提供一个可配置的问候工具，供 AI 智能体以名字调用。

description.en: Use a SuperGrok / X Premium Grok Build subscription inside DeepSeek Harness to pick models, ask with images, and check weekly quota.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 SuperGrok / X Premium 的 Grok Build 订阅，选择模型、带图提问并查看每周额度。

description.en: Adds aggregate status badges to collapsed sidebar group rows in DSH, showing running, pending-approval and scheduled sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏收起的分组行添加聚合状态徽标，显示进行中、待审批与定时任务数量。

description.en: A DSH right-sidebar tab that shows live agent activity as a group chat, including who is working, what they are doing, and time left.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 右侧边栏标签页，以群聊形式展示智能体实时活动，包括谁在工作、正在做什么以及剩余时间。

description.en: Exposes the running DSH Web GUI's authenticated URL as an agent tool so browser automation can open the GUI instead of failing with 401.
description.zh: 将运行中的 DSH Web GUI 带鉴权的 URL 作为 agent 工具暴露出来，让浏览器自动化能顺利打开界面而不再遇到 401。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer that probes window state and performs clicks and typing with correct coordinates and activation order.
description.zh: Windows GUI 自动化可靠性层，探测窗口状态并处理坐标空间与激活顺序后执行点击和输入。

description.en: A DSH skill that drives a GUI operation once, verifies it with ground truth, and hands back a self-contained illustrated tutorial.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 技能：将命令行验证过的操作交给用户 GUI 执行一次，用真实结果核验后，返回自包含的图文教程。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle that connects the GXWorks Agent MCP server and ships a skill for routing Mitsubishi PLC tasks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件包，连接 GXWorks Agent MCP 服务器，并附带用于路由三菱 PLC 任务的技能。

description.en: Adds a max-effort mode switch to DeepSeek Harness that maximizes per-step reasoning strength and output budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加豪霸模式开关，将每一步的推理强度与输出预算拉满。

description.en: Desktop reading enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: hides input box/top bar, resizes fonts, splits Chinese/English fonts, widens content, one-click fullscreen.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端阅读增强插件：隐藏输入框与上边栏、调整字号、中英分设字体、扩展内容宽度、一键全屏。

description.en: Turns your DeepSeek Harness activity into a GitHub-style contribution graph shown in a DSH dialog.
description.zh: 将你的 DeepSeek Harness 活跃度渲染成 GitHub 风格的贡献图，并在 DSH 弹窗中展示。

description.en: HarmonyOS/ArkTS native development knowledge plugin bundling 366 knowledge entries, 5 host tools and 22 executable rules inside DSH.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 的鸿蒙原生开发知识插件，内含 366 条内容、5 个工具与 22 条可执行规则。

description.en: DSH plugin adding HarmonyOS NEXT ArkTS/ArkUI development knowledge and code review skills.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 HarmonyOS NEXT 的 ArkTS/ArkUI 开发知识与代码审查技能。

description.en: DevDock manages GitHub multi-accounts, repositories, and workspace pushes, with pre-push agent reviews and planned Cloudflare/npm integrations.
description.zh: DevDock 提供 GitHub 多账号与仓库管理、工作区推送，并支持推送前 Agent 审查，后续接入 Cloudflare 与 npm。

description.en: A tool for precise file editing using unique 3-character content hashes per line, supporting read, replace, and undo.
description.zh: 使用每行唯一3字符内容哈希进行精确文件编辑的工具，支持读取、替换和撤销。

description.en: Session-header chip in DSH Web GUI showing DeepSeek account balance, fetched server-side via Remote, with recharge link and hover breakdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页会话页头部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额芯片，经宿主侧 Remote 查询，点击可充值，悬停查看赠送/充值拆分。

description.en: Adds a healthkit_report agent tool that analyses Apple Health/HealthKit data and produces a readable health report.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 healthkit_report 代理工具，可分析 Apple Health（HealthKit）数据并生成可读的健康报告。

description.en: Imports local Hermes Agent sessions into the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as bounded, untrusted background context.
description.zh: 将本地 Hermes Agent 会话导入当前 DeepSeek Harness 对话，作为有界且不可信的后台上下文。

description.en: Customizes the DSH Web GUI new-chat homepage title, badge, typography, light effects, and whale icon animation with live preview and autosave.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web GUI 新对话首页的标题、徽章、字体排版、光效和鲸鱼图标动画，支持实时预览与自动保存。

description.en: Hides the signed-in DeepSeek account model group in the model picker so all requests stay on the official API-key provider.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中隐藏已登录的 DeepSeek 账号模型组，使所有请求都走官方 API Key 提供方。

description.en: Offline viewer for DSH session history: search conversations within a project, read them as rendered Markdown, and export with one click.
description.zh: DSH 会话历史离线查看器：支持项目内检索对话、Markdown 渲染阅读与一键导出。

description.en: Skill bundle that guides Hearts of Iron IV 1.19.3 mod authoring — focus trees, events, decisions, GUI, DDS assets, plus verification and install.
description.zh: 面向《钢铁雄心4》1.19.3 的模组制作技能包：国策树、事件、决议、GUI、DDS 资源，并含校验与安装。

description.en: Adds a read-only Home Assistant panel to DSH showing entity status, prompt injection, ha_status and browser notifications.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加只读的 Home Assistant 面板，展示实体状态、提示注入、ha_status 与浏览器通知。

description.en: Git-based two-way sync and backup for DSH configuration and Mnemon memory data, with conflict detection and cross-device migration.
description.zh: 基于 Git 的 DSH 配置与 Mnemon 记忆数据双向同步与备份，支持冲突检测和跨设备迁移。

description.en: Adds one anchor follow-up question and 1–3 clickable user-voice quick replies under each chat turn.
description.zh: 在每轮对话后添加一个锚点追问和 1-3 个可点击的用户口吻快捷回复。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks for DeepSeek Harness that run shell commands on declared events with no code or dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供配置驱动的生命周期钩子，按声明事件执行 shell 命令，无需代码或依赖。

description.en: Drives stress, energy and reward hormone values from real session events and injects them into the agent system prompt only when out of range.
description.zh: 根据真实会话事件驱动压力、能量和奖励等激素值，仅在超出范围时写入智能体系统提示词。

description.en: Host-side macOS notifier for DeepSeek Harness that alerts on ask_user_question, approval requests, and finished replies via a signed app.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供宿主侧 macOS 通知，在提问、审批和回复完成时提醒，使用已签名应用避免丢通知。

description.en: Live-reload DeepSeek Harness plugins without restarting; failed reloads roll back and signal a restart is needed.
description.zh: 在不重启 dsh 的情况下热重载 DeepSeek Harness 插件，重载失败时原地回滚并提示需要重启。

description.en: Hot-reloads DSH plugin source code so edits take effect immediately without restarting the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 热重载 DSH 插件源码，修改后立即生效，无需重启 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Configurable VS Code style keyboard shortcuts and keybinding editor for DSH Desktop web GUI
description.zh: 为DSH桌面Web界面提供可配置的VS Code风格快捷键与可视化键位编辑器

description.en: Browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness to customize hotkeys for sending, newline, and answer submission via recording.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框、答案卡片和发送消息设置自定义热键，支持录制按键绑定。

description.en: Runtime hot-swap for DeepSeek Harness plugins: enable/disable/restart and auto hot-mount bundles from Web GUI, no restart needed.
description.zh: 在运行时热插拔 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可从 Web 界面启用、禁用、重启插件并自动热挂载插件包，无需重启 dsh。

description.en: Adds a hover Archive icon to sidebar session rows, archiving sessions via the official API.
description.zh: 悬停侧边栏会话行时右侧显示归档图标，点击即调用官方 workspaces.archiveSession API 归档该会话。

description.en: Auto-expands the left sidebar on hover and collapses it when the pointer leaves, keeping manually opened sidebars expanded.
description.zh: 悬停左栏自动展开，移开自动收起；手动打开的侧栏保持展开。

description.en: Raises Node's maxHeaderSize to 256 KB so accumulated dsh-auth-* cookies no longer crash the DSH desktop app on startup with HTTP 431.
description.zh: 将 Node 的 maxHeaderSize 提升至 256 KB，避免累积的 dsh-auth-* Cookie 触发 HTTP 431，导致 DSH 桌面版启动崩溃。

description.en: Connects already-logged-in Huawei Cloud CodeArts and OfficeAce desktop models into DeepSeek Harness, with quota display and model selection.
description.zh: 将华为云 CodeArts 与 OfficeAce 桌面客户端已登录的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持积分余量与模型勾选。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness persistent cross-session memory via HydraDB, recalling context and syncing workspace docs.
description.zh: 借助 HydraDB 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话持久记忆，自动召回上下文并同步工作区文档。

description.en: Syncs DSH profiles, plugin manifests and skills across Macs using iCloud Drive as shared storage.
description.zh: 通过 iCloud Drive 在多台 Mac 之间同步 DSH 配置、插件清单和技能。

description.en: DSH plugin that looks up MIIT ICP filings for websites, apps, mini programs and quick apps, plus the four violation blacklists.
description.zh: DSH 插件：查询工信部 ICP 备案信息，覆盖网站、APP、小程序、快应用及四类违规黑名单。

description.en: Covers the DSH page with a retro CRT screensaver overlay after ten minutes of inactivity, dismissed by a click or keypress.
description.zh: 当 DSH 闲置且十分钟无鼠标键盘操作时，用复古 CRT 显像管特效覆盖页面，点击或按键即可消失。

description.en: Adds a /if slash command where an LLM judges a condition from prior context and only then sends the instruction below it as a user message.
description.zh: 新增 /if 斜杠命令：由 LLM 依据上文判断条件是否成立，成立后才把其下方的指令作为用户消息发送。

description.en: Drag a rectangle in the right sidebar, annotate each region, and send all annotations as one message with a host-side freeze-frame.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏拖拽矩形选区，为每个区域添加标注，并通过宿主端冻结帧一次性发送所有标注。

description.en: Multi-source image search and download plugin with 19 engines that saves images to the session workspace and renders them inline.
description.zh: 多源图片搜索与下载插件，支持19个引擎，将图片保存到会话工作区并内联渲染。

description.en: Displays local image paths in dsh chat replies as inline images with clickable local address.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 对话正文直接显示本地图片的插件：本地路径自动内联为图片 + 可点击的本地地址行

description.en: Replaces large regions and corner stickers of the DSH web UI with your own images, GIFs, or videos via a settings submenu.
description.zh: 通过设置子菜单，用自定义图片、GIF 或视频替换 DSH 网页界面的大块区域和角落贴纸。

description.en: A full-featured image viewer for DSH chats with wheel zoom, drag pan, 90° rotate, download, copy, open in default app and gallery browsing.
description.zh: DSH 聊天图片查看器，支持滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、90° 旋转、下载、复制、用默认应用打开及画廊浏览。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for DSH that adds zoom, pan, gallery browsing, auto-named downloads and open-in-default-app actions.
description.zh: DSH 聊天内图片查看器，支持缩放、平移、图集浏览、自动命名下载及用系统默认应用打开。

description.en: Loads VSCode/Copilot AI config files such as copilot-instructions.md, instructions and skills into DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 将 VSCode/Copilot 的 AI 配置文件（copilot-instructions.md、instructions、skills）导入 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Imports WorkBuddy conversations into DeepSeek Harness (dsh), preserving tool calls and their results intact.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 对话导入 DeepSeek Harness (dsh)，完整保留工具调用及其结果。

description.en: In-app browser panel for DeepSeek Harness where you and the AI share the same web page with clicks, typing, scrolling and screenshots.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供内置浏览器面板，人与 AI 共享同一网页，可点击、输入、滚动并截图。

description.en: Handles file uploads in DeepSeek Harness: paste files, store in inbox, thumbnails, and vision reading.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件：在输入框粘贴文件，存入 inbox，生成缩略图，文本通过 read_inbox 读取，图片需配合视觉能力识别。

description.en: Adds an incognito mode to DeepSeek Harness so chats stay in memory only — never written to disk, history or sidebar caches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加无痕对话模式：会话只存在内存中，不写入磁盘、历史列表和侧栏缓存。

description.en: Decorative interactive Chinese ink-wash canvas backgrounds for DSH sessions, with ripples, ink drops and multiple switchable scenes.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话界面提供可交互的汉字水墨背景，支持涟漪落墨、多场景切换与明暗主题跟随。

description.en: DSH bundle of four plugins linking Zotero literature collection, Trilium notes archiving and Typst typesetting into one resumable pipeline.
description.zh: DSH 四插件包：串联 Zotero 文献收集、Trilium 笔记归档与 Typst 排版，并提供可断点续跑的联合流水线。

description.en: Drag files into the chat input to insert attachments inline at the cursor, keeping file and text positions together; hover a tag to preview images.
description.zh: 把文件拖进输入框即可在光标处插入行内附件，保留文件与文字的位置关系，悬停标签还能预览图片。

description.en: Renders SVG and sandboxed HTML cards inline inside the conversation instead of forcing file downloads.
description.zh: 在对话中直接内联渲染 SVG 与沙箱化 HTML 卡片，无需下载文件。

description.en: Renders 14 replayable inline visual kinds in chat — charts, tables, timelines, gantt, heatmaps, flows and KPI tiles.
description.zh: 在对话中渲染14种可重放的嵌入可视化,包括图表、表格、时间线、甘特图、热力图、流程图和KPI卡片。

description.en: AI ghost-text completion in the DSH composer (Tab to accept) plus 1-3 click-to-send follow-up suggestions after each reply.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框提供灰字 AI 续写（Tab 接受），并在每轮回复后给出 1-3 条可一键发送的候选消息。

description.en: Checks a DSH plugin before install to flag name collisions and missing dependencies so nothing breaks.
description.zh: 安装 DSH 插件前先行检查，提示重名冲突与缺失依赖，避免安装后出问题。

description.en: Audits what each DSH session installed on this machine: size, location, creation time, purpose and command evidence.
description.zh: 审计每个 DSH 会话在本机安装了什么：体积、位置、创建时间、用途与命令证据。

description.en: Maintains long-term instructions in the DSH settings UI and auto-injects them into every subsequent conversation's system prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护长期指令，并自动注入到之后每次对话的系统提示词中。

description.en: Renders assistant replies as adaptive, interactive generative-UI interfaces using 44 theme-native components and native OpenUI fences.
description.zh: 使用 44 个主题原生组件和原生 OpenUI 围栏，将助手回复渲染为自适应、可交互的生成式界面。

description.en: DSH plugin that renders DeepSeek Harness answers as interactive Paper Glass cards with 24 components, streaming and persistent turn cards.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 的回答渲染为可交互的 Paper Glass 卡片，包含 24 个组件，支持流式与持久化轮次卡片。

description.en: Shows three ready-to-send task suggestions above the input box as you type; tapping one fills it back into the box.
description.zh: 输入框上方实时给出三条可直接发送的任务候选，点一下即回填输入框。

description.en: Provides a local reference on interaction design theory for use in sessions.
DeepSeek Harness plugin enabling remote settings and auto HTTPS via Let's Encrypt IP certificates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供远程设置，并通过 Let's Encrypt IP 证书自动启用 HTTPS

description.en: IP & subnet math toolbox for IPv4/IPv6 parsing, CIDR summarization, and IANA classification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 IP 与子网计算工具箱：计算 IPv4 子网划分、CIDR 汇总，解析 IPv4/IPv6 并按 RFC 5952 规范化、做 IANA 分类，无依赖。

description.en: 隔离舱：在 DSH 主会话之外运行受沙箱约束的隔离任务；主会话默认完全无感，结果返回与文件导出都要手动确认。
description.zh: 在 DSH 主会话之外运行受沙箱约束的隔离任务，主会话默认无感，结果返回与文件导出均需手动确认。

description.en: A ledger of the AI's own state: a decaying tide-level curve that reacts to conversation and drives proactive, self-timed speech.
description.zh: 一份记录 AI 自身状态的账本：会随对话涨落的潮位曲线，并据此不定时主动开口。

description.en: Bundles the J Space Cognition Suite V3.6 as a DeepSeek Harness plugin skill, providing a model-agnostic reasoning, planning, verification, and task-ledger protocol.
Scans DeepSeek Harness session debris and returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for leftover artifacts.
description.zh: 扫描 DeepSeek Harness 会话残留物，返回确定性、可审查的清理计划。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that dispatches routine tasks to cheaper subagent models to cut LLM costs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，将常规任务分派给更便宜的子代理模型，以降低 LLM 成本。

description.en: Asks TypeSafe's Jev how deeply a prompt needs to be reasoned about, then applies that thinking level to the model request.
description.zh: 调用 TypeSafe 的 Jev 判断提示词所需的思考深度，并把该级别应用到模型请求中。

description.en: macOS notch companion for DeepSeek Harness that surfaces tool approvals, plan reviews, structured questions and multi-session activity.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 macOS 刘海伴侣，集中展示工具审批、计划审核、结构化提问与多会话活动。

description.en: A reader-first long-form novel pipeline for DeepSeek Harness, with a manuscript crew, 14 gate scripts and 12 genre libraries.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的长篇小说创作流水线，包含稿件团队、14 个关卡脚本和 12 个类型素材库。

description.en: Displays a list of open/reopened JIRA tasks assigned to the current user below the DSH input box.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话输入框下方展示当前 JIRA 项目中指派给当前用户的开启或重新开启任务列表，JIRA 地址与令牌从凭据读取，项目 Key 与 JQL 按工作区配置并持久化。

description.en: Jujutsu (jj) history panel for the DSH web GUI showing the change graph, change details and diffs read directly from jj.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 Jujutsu (jj) 历史面板，直接读取 jj，展示变更图、变更详情与差异。

description.en: Search, read, and optionally edit Joplin notes from DeepSeek Harness through the local Web Clipper API, with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 通过本地 Web Clipper API 在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索、读取并可选编辑 Joplin 笔记，零运行时依赖。

description.en: A configurable trigger that tells a DeepSeek Harness agent to load the J-Space Cognition Suite only when rules indicate it is worthwhile.
description.zh: 可配置的近场触发器，仅在规则判定值得时提醒 DeepSeek Harness 智能体加载 J-Space 认知套件

description.en: Blocks Git inside Jujutsu workspaces and hands the model native jj commands for version control instead.
description.zh: 在 Jujutsu 工作区中拒绝 Git 命令，改为向模型提供原生 jj 版本控制命令。

description.en: Adds two floating buttons to DSH Web chat: jump back to the start of the current question, or to the newest output.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 聊天区添加两个浮动按钮：一键回到本轮提问开头，或回到最新输出结尾。

description.en: Floating minimap jump bar for DSH web GUI to preview and jump to user messages in a conversation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供浮动小地图跳转栏，可预览并跳转到对话中的用户消息。

description.en: JupyterLab-style notebook plugin giving the agent a persistent Python kernel to read, edit and run code cells with .ipynb save/load.
description.zh: JupyterLab 风格笔记本插件，为智能体提供持久化 Python 内核，可读取、编辑并运行代码单元，支持 .ipynb 存取。

description.en: Adds a one-click Just Chat entry to DeepSeek Harness, opening a native session in its own working directory without manual workspace selection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加一键快速对话入口，直接在独立工作目录中开启原生会话，免去手动选择工作区。

description.en: Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with per-project boards, task drafts, agent/subagent and background-job cards, and agent tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供看板：每个项目独立看板，支持任务草稿、智能体/子智能体与后台任务卡片，并内置智能体工具。

description.en: Local DSH knowledge base that ingests Markdown, text and PDF files and returns cited passages via BM25 or optional dense search.
description.zh: 本地 DSH 知识库插件，可导入 Markdown、文本和 PDF 文件，并通过 BM25 或可选向量检索返回带引用的段落。

description.en: Connect Kingsoft Docs (WPS personal account) to DSH to browse, search, edit, quote, and download cloud documents.
description.zh: 通过网页登录连接金山文档（WPS个人账号），支持浏览、搜索、星标、共享云文档，引用到对话、浏览器下载及新建文档

description.en: Prevents the computer from sleeping automatically.
Minimal input history plugin for DSH Web: press up/down in empty input to recall previously sent messages.
description.zh: dsh-keyboard-history

description.en: Adds keyless Tavily and Firecrawl web search to the DeepSeek Harness web_search tool with no account or configuration needed.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 工具提供无需密钥的 Tavily 和 Firecrawl 网页搜索，无需账号或配置。

description.en: Bundles Kimi Computer Use's stdio MCP server into DSH via the MCP client bridge, plus a skill that drives it once connected.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 客户端桥把 Kimi Computer Use 的 stdio MCP 服务接入 DSH，并附带连接后驱动它的技能。

description.en: Shows your Kimi Code quota with a Composer badge and Settings card, including 5-hour and weekly progress bars and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 通过 Composer 徽章和设置卡片显示 Kimi Code 额度，含 5 小时与每周进度条及自动刷新。

description.en: Adds a Kiro (AWS CodeWhisperer/Amazon Q) model provider route to DeepSeek Harness, with an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible reverse proxy reusing existing Kiro sign-in.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Kiro（AWS CodeWhisperer/Amazon Q）模型提供方路由，并提供复用现有 Kiro 登录的 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容反向代理。

description.en: Menu manager for DeepSeek Harness that aggregates plugin menu entries with fold/collapse and pinning.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 收集各插件菜单项的第三方菜单管理器，支持折叠展开与固定项目。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: SQLite FTS5 index for markdown/text/code/web, cited retrieval, session library, web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地知识库，用零依赖 SQLite FTS5 索引 markdown、文本、代码和网页，支持带出处检索、会话经验库以及交互式 kbquery 面板和知识星系。

description.en: Local, model-readable knowledge-base plugin for DSH with vector search, text/PDF/Office import, multi-user access, encryption and MCP tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地可读知识库插件，支持向量检索、文本/PDF/Office 导入、多用户管理、内容加密及 MCP 工具接入。

description.en: Turns any source text into an AI knowledge graph with facts, inferences, concepts, definitions, examples, counter-examples, rules, and two-way text linking.
description.zh: 把任意源文本转为 AI 知识图谱，提取事实、推论、概念、定义、示例、反例和规则，并支持图谱与原文双向链接。

description.en: Obsidian-style local knowledge base for DSH: save selected text or whole answers as notes, auto-organize them into wiki pages, and explore a force-directed graph.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Obsidian 风格的本地知识库：把选中文字或整条回答存为笔记，自动整理成 wiki 页面，并用力导向图浏览关联关系。

description.en: Local Markdown knowledge base for DSH with full-text search, tags, folder hierarchy, attachments and zero-dependency Office text extraction.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 Markdown 知识库，支持全文搜索、标签、层级目录、附件与 Office 零依赖文本抽取。

description.en: Cross-session knowledge plugin for DeepSeek Harness with SQLite FTS5 trigram Chinese substring search.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话知识插件，使用 SQLite FTS5 trigram 支持中文子串检索。

description.en: DSH desktop pet plugin that puts a Kun-like virtual pet on your desktop.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加桌面宠物，在桌面上显示一个 Kun 风格的虚拟宠物

description.en: A black-themed whale-girl desktop pet for Windows that sits on your desktop and reacts to DSH Agent working status.
description.zh: 一款黑色系鲸鱼娘 Windows 桌宠，在桌面上陪伴你并响应 DSH Agent 的工作状态。

description.en: Adds a session-level LAA switch that halts DeepSeek runs during peak hours and auto-resumes them in off-peak windows.
description.zh: 为每个会话加 LAA 开关：DeepSeek 峰时停止运行、谷时自动续跑，被拦输入按原顺序重投。

description.en: Local proxy plugin that auto-discovers the lab AI gateway IP after DHCP changes and injects each member's API key.
description.zh: 本地代理插件，DHCP 变更后自动发现实验室 AI 网关 IP，并注入各成员的 API 密钥。

description.en: Schedules local LLM engines and models for DSH with a bundled console, model import, and an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 为 DSH 调度本地大模型引擎与模型，提供内置控制台、模型导入和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: Superagent ladder that dispatches tasks to LLM tiers and CLI coding agents like codex, claude and gemini.
description.zh: 超级代理阶梯，将任务分派给 LLM 层级和 codex、claude、gemini 等 CLI 编码代理。

description.en: Reading plugin for DSH that shelves WeRead and GitHub book repos, opens EPUB/PDF/Markdown for immersive reading, and turns highlighted passages into AI Q&A and saved notes.
description.zh: 灯下 Lamplit 是一个 DSH 阅读插件：把微信读书与 GitHub 书库收进同一个书架，支持 EPUB/PDF/Markdown 沉浸阅读，划词问 AI 并保存笔记。

description.en: A toggleable LAN proxy plugin that lets a phone browser control DSH over the computer's mobile hotspot via HTTP/WebSocket, with no app or password.
description.zh: 可开关的局域网代理插件，手机通过电脑热点用浏览器以 HTTP/WebSocket 直接操控 DSH，无需装 App 或密码。

description.en: LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or PC via QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free LAN access.
description.zh: DSH 的局域网远程访问：通过二维码或令牌配对手机或另一台电脑，打开同一 Web UI，可选局域网内免密钥访问。

description.en: Lets multiple devices reach the same dsh host through a browser over LAN or mesh VPNs like Tailscale.
description.zh: 让多台设备在局域网或 Tailscale 等组网环境中通过浏览器同时访问同一台 dsh 主机。

description.en: Sends Lark/Feishu notifications when DSH sessions stop due to errors, completion, or waiting for user.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话因错误停止、正常完成或等待用户输入时发送飞书通知。

description.en: Sidebar LaTeX formula editor for DSH with offline MathJax rendering, symbol tiles, templates, favourites, OCR and multi-format export.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 LaTeX 公式编辑器，支持离线 MathJax 渲染、符号面板、模板、收藏、图片/文档 OCR 与多格式导出。

description.en: Converts LaTeX math to native editable OMML equations or images, inserts into docx/pptx with batch atomic insertion and preview.
description.zh: 将 LaTeX 数学公式转为可编辑 OMML 公式或图片，批量原子插入 docx/pptx，并支持预览。

description.en: Single-file Rust launcher for dsh web UI; starts app and tears down process tree on browser close.
description.zh: 单文件 Rust 编写的 Windows dsh Web UI 启动器，双击即启动，关闭浏览器后自动结束整棵进程树，无需终端看管，也不会残留占用端口的 node 进程。

description.en: Layered long-term memory engine for DSH agents with append-only event logs, rebuildable indexes, knowledge graph and a Web panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供分层长期记忆引擎：追加式事件日志、可重建索引、离线知识图谱与 Web 面板。

description.en: Layout overlay for DeepSeek Harness Web to dock composer, hide chrome, and filter transcript nodes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面布局覆盖层，可停靠输入框、隐藏界面元素、过滤对话记录节点。

description.en: DSH 布局交换插件：文件/浏览器居中，聊天置于右侧，可拖动并记忆布局
Lazy-loading MCP gateway for DSH that connects servers on first use, releases them when idle, caches tool lists to disk, and redacts subprocess env vars.
description.zh: DSH 的惰性加载 MCP 网关：服务器首次使用时才连接，空闲后自动释放，工具列表缓存到磁盘，并自动脱敏子进程环境变量。

description.en: Adds a Lead panel to DSH: chat with a lead AI, switch its model, watch token/cost/ETA live, and let it dispatch tasks to worker AIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁新增「领导」面板：与领导 AI 对话、切换模型、实时查看 token/金额/预计剩余时间，并由它把任务派给工人 AI。

description.en: An eye-friendly green skin that layers a leafy emerald/mint palette over the official DSH web GUI theme.
description.zh: 一款护眼绿色皮肤，为 DSH 官方 Web 界面叠加清新的翠绿/薄荷配色主题。

description.en: CRAG-style self-correcting knowledge wiki: L1 Markdown wiki plus L2 Hindsight, fetching web sources when the agent keeps hitting the same wall.
description.zh: 边做边学知识库：CRAG 式纠错检索，L1 Markdown wiki 加 L2 Hindsight，agent 反复撞墙时后台限流联网补料。

description.en: LearnHarness 教学法的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：承诺答案键、依赖图计划、作答卡与历史（AGPL-3.0 衍生）
Local-first learning hub with branch trees, concept graphs, progress tracking and spaced review, plus a small dashboard.
description.zh: 本地优先的学习中心插件，提供分支树、概念图谱、进度追踪、间隔复习和小型仪表盘。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness sessions to check whether the lesson ledger was consulted and pitfalls were recorded.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 会话是否查阅经验账本并记录问题。

description.en: Lets an agent reflect after each task, save reusable lessons, and inject them into later tasks by scope.
description.zh: 让 Agent 在任务结束后复盘，沉淀可复用经验，并在后续任务中按作用域注入。

description.en: A local-first file library for DeepSeek Harness to upload, preview, favourite, batch export and attach files directly to chat.
description.zh: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地文件库，支持上传、预览、收藏、批量导出并将文件附加到对话中。

description.en: Turns local markdown life logs into a five-card dashboard covering health, tasks, assets, mood and bookshelf.
description.zh: 把本地 markdown 日志汇总成健康、任务、资产、情绪、书架五张卡片的人生看板。

description.en: DSH plugin for per-turn CNY cost and DeepSeek balance, native PDF/Word/Excel/CSV tools with previews, and a compiler/runtime run-build registry.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按轮次统计人民币花费与 DeepSeek 余额，原生读写 PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 并侧栏预览，内置编译器/运行时运行构建工具。

description.en: Lightweight wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness with Bing daily, Wikimedia art, Cleveland CC0 and local uploads.
description.zh: 轻量壁纸插件，支持必应每日、维基艺术、克利夫兰CC0及本地上传壁纸。

description.en: Resolves shared links from Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaoheihe, GitHub and general web pages into title, author, body, cover and direct video URLs, with local download.
description.zh: 把聊天中的B站、抖音、小黑盒、GitHub及通用网页分享链接解析为标题、作者、正文、封面和视频直链，并支持下载到本地媒体目录。

description.en: An anime-style Link Start splash screen shown at DSH startup, displaying your DSH status as an unofficial fan plugin.
description.zh: 一个动漫风格的 Link Start 启动画面插件，在 DSH 启动时显示并展示你的 DSH 状态，属非官方同人作品。

description.en: Lets the DSH agent control a real Linux X11 desktop: take screenshots, click, type, scroll and switch windows to drive GUI apps.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体直接操控本机 Linux X11 桌面：截图、点击、输入、滚动和切换窗口，从而操作图形界面应用。

description.en: Searches academic papers, downloads PDFs via Sci-Hub or Open Access sources, and generates batch download manifests.
description.zh: 搜索学术论文，通过 Sci-Hub 或开放获取渠道下载 PDF，并生成批量下载清单。

description.en: Saves named Crossref literature queries with time windows, filters out seen DOIs, and emits a Markdown digest plus SARIF report of new papers.
description.zh: 保存带时间窗口的命名 Crossref 文献查询，过滤已见 DOI，并输出新增论文的 Markdown 摘要与 SARIF 报告。

description.en: LittleStar Meeting Room gathers isolated AI sessions into one room where a host sets the topic, members speak in turn, and minutes are produced at the end.
description.zh: 星辰会议室把互不可见的 AI 会话聚到同一房间：主持人开房定题，成员按序轮流发言，轮次用满后自动生成会议纪要。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows a live meter of your account balance, token usage, and input/output/cache metrics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 余额监控插件，实时显示账户余额、Token 用量及输入/输出/缓存数据。

description.en: Shows live spend, account balance and peak/off-peak pricing above the input box, plus per-reply cost after each answer.
description.zh: 在输入框上方实时显示本次对话花费、账户余额与峰谷时段，并在每条回答末尾显示该轮消耗。

description.en: Live commerce breakdown tool that computes precise metrics from parameters and returns detailed results.
Adds a cute Live2D desktop pet character to the DeepSeek Harness web chat interface corner.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面添加一只可爱的 Live2D 桌宠角色。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-fetches version-pinned official docs for installed libraries before coding, killing hallucinated APIs.
description.zh: DSH 插件：写代码前自动拉取项目安装版本的官方文档，消灭幻觉 API。

description.en: Manages local llama.cpp GGUF model lifecycles, automatically loading and unloading models on demand via an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 管理本地 llama.cpp GGUF 模型的生命周期，通过 OpenAI 兼容网关按需自动加载和卸载模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that runs subagents on a local llama.cpp model via the OpenAI Responses protocol, acting as an LLM adapter and delegation skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 OpenAI Responses 协议在本地 llama.cpp 模型上运行子代理，提供 LLM 适配器与委派技能。

description.en: DSH plugin that uses a dedicated LLM review role to approve or deny sandbox permission upgrades for shell commands and file writes.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，通过专用LLM审查角色快速裁决沙箱权限升级（如Shell命令和文件写入），支持允许/拒绝/转人工。

description.en: Unofficial plugin to use Cursor subscription for login and chat within DeepSeek Harness, with provider route and settings namespace.
description.zh: 非官方插件，在 DeepSeek Harness 内用 Cursor 订阅登录并对话，提供 provider 路由和设置命名空间。

description.en: Community DSH plugin providing OpenAI-compatible gateway adapter and dialect fixes for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 社区 DSH 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供兼容 OpenAI 的网关适配和方言修正，非官方包。

description.en: LLM response-stream injection filter that blocks malicious Unicode, control characters, and spam keywords.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布流上过滤大模型响应：硬拦截罕见 Unicode 字符，并按评分处置控制字符、协议标记、脚本混用和垃圾关键词。

description.en: Per-vendor/per-model/per-session LLM latency and cache hit telemetry for DeepSeek Harness with failure classification.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供按厂商/模型/会话的LLM延迟与缓存命中遥测，并对失败进行分类。

description.en: Per-provider egress routing and client-fingerprint control for DeepSeek Harness, with per-host proxy or direct routing and client header rewrite at the fetch boundary.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按提供商出口路由与客户端指纹控制，支持按主机代理或直连路由，并在 fetch 边界重写客户端请求头。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Go as a DeepSeek Harness model provider with model discovery, three wire protocols, session affinity and sidebar quota.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Go 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方，支持模型发现、三种协议、会话亲和与侧边栏配额显示。

description.en: Transport-layer data masking for dsh: hides sensitive data from the model, restores real values live in the stream.
description.zh: Transport-layer data masking for deepseek-harness (dsh): the model sees placeholders, you see real values restored live in the stream.

description.en: Replaces the running status in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with rotating witty phrases and practical tips.
description.zh: 替换 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中“Deep diving...”运行状态，改为轮播俏皮短语和实用提示。

description.en: A dependency-free local dev toolkit for Harness: probes the exec environment, exposes git as tools, snapshots files before writes, and runs project checks.
description.zh: 为 Harness 补齐本地事实层的纯 Node 插件：探测执行环境、把 git 变成可调用工具、写文件前自动快照并能运行项目检查。

description.en: Host-owned long-horizon task board for local coding agents that queues next tasks, tracks in-flight work, and injects STATUS.md.
description.zh: 面向本地编码智能体的宿主级长周期任务看板，管理待办与进行中任务并注入 STATUS.md。

description.en: Discovers this machine's HTTP proxy from .env or the Windows system proxy and makes DeepSeek Harness use it for fetches and child processes.
description.zh: 自动发现本机 HTTP 代理（.env 配置或 Windows 系统代理），并让 DeepSeek Harness 的请求与子进程都走代理。

description.en: Local task board for DSH that dispatches tasks to isolated worker sessions with supervisor review and minimal human intervention.
description.zh: DSH 本地任务板插件：将任务分派到隔离的 worker 会话，由 supervisor 审核，尽量减少人工打断。

description.en: Local-first telemetry plugin for Harness runs recording request, model, tool, and lifecycle metrics (latency, tokens, cost, errors, cache) without content collection.
description.zh: 本地优先的 Harness 运行遥测插件，记录请求、模型、工具与插件生命周期指标（延迟、Token、成本、错误、缓存），默认不采集内容。

description.en: Speaks each DSH reply aloud through your local speaker using Style-Bert-VITS2 or Edge TTS, with multiple voices and language-based switching.
description.zh: 用本机 Style-Bert-VITS2 或 Edge TTS 把 DSH 每轮回复朗读出声，支持多音色与按语言自动切换。

description.en: Spanish (es) language pack that adds Espanol to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI under Settings > General > Language.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加西班牙语（es）语言包，可在“设置 > 通用 > 语言”中切换为 Espanol。

description.en: Spanish (Chile) language pack for the DSH web interface, translating 2603 strings via a client plugin with no app patching.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 界面的智利西班牙语语言包，通过客户端插件翻译 2603 条字符串，无需修改应用本身。

description.en: Korean language pack that switches the dsh web UI and desktop app interface into Korean.
description.zh: 韩语语言包，可将 dsh 网页界面和桌面应用的语言切换为韩语。

description.en: LocalForge is an MIT-licensed adapter that connects DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to local LLM servers such as LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM and llama.cpp.
description.zh: LocalForge 是一个 MIT 许可的适配器，让 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）连接 LM Studio、Ollama、vLLM、llama.cpp 等本地 LLM 服务器。

description.en: Password gate for DSH web: a lock screen appears on open, with manual and auto-lock and scrypt-hashed passwords.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页版加密码门禁：打开先显示锁定界面，支持手动与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 哈希存储。

description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness plugin logs visible via a /logs chat command and a stderr exporter for warnings/errors.
description.zh: 通过 /logs 聊天命令和 stderr 导出器，让 DeepSeek Harness 插件日志可见，默认输出警告和错误。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness users upload custom logos and adjust interface typography, with built-in image cleanup and a bilingual settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自定义 Logo 上传与界面字号设置，内置图片去背景与中英双语设置面板。

description.en: A DSH plugin that stores extra-long text in workspace .dsh-longtext/ markdown files, leaving only an @ reference in the input box to keep chat clean.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将超长正文保存到工作区 .dsh-longtext/ 下的 Markdown 文件，输入框只保留 @ 引用，保持聊天界面简洁。

description.en: Visualizes DSH agent loops and trajectories in the web UI with LOOP cards, phase rings, waterfall timing, token accounting and tool-call inspection.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中可视化 DSH 智能体循环与轨迹，提供 LOOP 卡片、阶段环、瀑布时序、Token 统计和工具调用检查。

description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation to get an instant explanation in a floating window, without polluting the main session.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中划词即弹出浮窗解释，不污染主会话，还可保存为正式会话。

description.en: Native macOS notifications for DeepSeek Harness with event-specific sounds, filtering, and a Web settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 macOS 通知，支持按事件设置提示音、过滤通知，并提供 Web 设置页面。

description.en: Reply to DeepSeek Harness notification emails to continue or stop a running task, turning your inbox into a remote task-control channel.
description.zh: 回复 DeepSeek Harness 的通知邮件即可让任务继续或停止，把邮箱变成远程任务控制通道。

description.en: DSH email guardian that fetches mail silently in the background and shows cache-first, dual-mailbox reports with clear sync failures, all processed locally.
description.zh: DSH 邮箱管家：后台静默收信，缓存优先双邮箱报告，明确同步失败，邮件仅在本机处理。

description.en: DSH web console for browsing, filtering, favoriting and bulk archiving/unarchiving/cleaning active and archived sessions, plus four session health checks.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话管理台：浏览、筛选、收藏并批量归档/取消归档/清理活跃与归档会话，并附四项会话体检。

description.en: Renders AI-written Manim Python code as playable animation cards directly in the chat stream, with no local Python install needed.
description.zh: 把 AI 在聊天里写的 Manim Python 代码直接渲染成可播放的动画卡片，本机无需安装 Python。

description.en: Live Markdown and KaTeX math preview above the composer in DSH, using official slot with no core patches.
description.zh: DSH插件：在输入框上方实时预览Markdown和KaTeX数学公式，通过官方槽集成，无需修改核心。

description.en: A dsh plugin that converts documents into Markdown so an LLM can read their contents.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 插件，可将文档转换为 Markdown，以便大语言模型读取其内容。

description.en: Market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: live A-share/HK/US quotes, K-lines, hot lists, news, local P&L, alerts, and one-click privacy mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 行情面板：免登录查看 A股/港股/美股实时行情、K线、热榜与快讯，本地持仓盈亏、价格提醒和一键行情隐身。

description.en: Backs up DSH profile configs to private GitHub Gists with manual or scheduled sync and merge-based restore.
description.zh: 将 DSH 配置备份到私有 GitHub Gist，支持手动/定时备份与合并恢复。

description.en: A-share intelligence radar panel combining CNINFO announcements, index heatmaps and fund-flow data to gauge how news moves stock prices.
description.zh: 一个 A 股情报雷达面板：整合巨潮公告、大盘云图与资金流数据，分析信息对个股股价的影响。

description.en: Embeds the dshmarket plugin market as a first-class panel in the DSH sidebar, just below the New Session button.
description.zh: 把 dshmarket 插件市场作为正式面板嵌入 DSH 侧边栏，位置就在「新会话」按钮正下方。

description.en: DSH sidebar card showing live prices and change for crypto, stocks, indices, futures, forex and metals, with cost-basis P&L.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏行情卡片，实时显示加密货币、股票、指数、期货、外汇与金银价格及涨跌幅，并可按成本价计算盈亏。

description.en: Annotate DeepSeek Harness replies in place, read them as documents with comment threads and revisions, then send a reading summary back to the main chat.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的模型回复添加原地批注、文档式阅读、评论线程与正文修订，并把阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: Collects folders, files and notes from a conversation into real tagged folders, and reopens any chat's output in one click.
description.zh: 从对话中收集文件夹、文件和笔记，按标签存入真实文件夹，并可一键重新打开某个聊天的产出。

description.en: Renders LaTeX math formulas inside your own DSH web chat message bubble and shows a live preview of the composer draft.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页聊天中渲染 LaTeX 公式，支持消息气泡内公式显示与输入框实时预览。

description.en: Expands LaTeX snippet triggers in the DSH web composer into formula templates, with Tab walking each input hole.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页输入框中将 LaTeX 片段触发词展开为公式模板，并用 Tab 依次切换填写位置。

description.en: Executes MATLAB code, captures stdout/stderr, and saves generated figures as PNGs.
description.zh: 执行 MATLAB 代码，捕获标准输出和错误输出，并把生成的图形保存为 PNG 图片。

description.en: Black-first Matrix hacker skin for DSH Web with live code rain and readable reasoning.
description.zh: Black-first Matrix hacker skin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web — live session-powered code rain and readable provider reasoning.

description.en: A six-stage gated development workflow preset (grill, spec, tickets, implement, review, wrap-up) with composer stage chips and decision cards.
description.zh: 六阶段带前置条件的开发工作流预设（拷问、规范、任务、实现、评审、收尾），在输入框加入阶段胶囊与决策卡片。

description.en: Bundles Matt Pocock skills and a visual pipeline sidebar for idea-to-review workflow in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供内置 Matt Pocock 技能集与可视化流水线侧边栏，覆盖 Idea、Triage、Grill、Spec、Tickets、Implement、Review 各阶段，并可一键把 /技能 发进会话。

description.en: Bundles Matt Pocock's 27 engineering skills into a DSH agent preset covering requirement grilling, spec/ticket splitting, TDD, code review and retros.
