description.zh: 将 Matt Pocock 的 27 个工程技能打包为 DSH Agent 预设，涵盖需求拷问、spec/工单拆分、TDD、代码评审与复盘。

description.en: Controls Minecraft Java clients and headless bots from DSH, with PCL2 window control, F3 info, and block probes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中控制 Minecraft Java 客户端与无窗口机器人，支持 PCL2 窗口控制、F3 信息和方块探测。

description.en: Auto-discovers project-level MCP servers from .agents/mcp.json and mounts them per DSH agent session, closing connections at session end.
description.zh: 从.agents/mcp.json自动发现项目级MCP服务器,按DSH会话挂载,会话结束即断开连接。

description.en: Bridge that exposes stdio MCP servers like Playwright and Chrome DevTools as native DeepSeek Harness tools.
description.zh: 将 Playwright、Chrome DevTools 等 stdio MCP 服务器暴露为 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具的桥接插件。

description.en: Imports MCP configs from Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, YAML, or web, reviews security risks, and applies them to DSH with one-click confirmation.
description.zh: 一键导入 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code、YAML 或网页中的 MCP 配置，写入前自动安全审查并支持在设置中管理。

description.en: Manage local MCP server configs in DSH: scan sources, import JSON, and graphically add, edit, or remove services for your profile.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中集中管理本机 MCP 配置，支持按来源扫描、JSON 导入及图形化新增、编辑和移除服务。

description.en: Marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness to browse, search, and install MCP servers into the running profile with one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索并一键将 MCP 服务器安装到当前运行配置的插件市场。

description.en: MCP market and management plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web, enabling adding and configuring MCP servers via templates or manual JSON.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 MCP 市场与管理插件，支持通过模板或手动填写 JSON 添加和配置 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Per-session MCP server picker for DeepSeek Harness with global/project catalogs, OAuth sign-in, and trust review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话级 MCP 服务器选择器，支持全局/项目目录、OAuth 登录与信任审查。

description.en: A minimal Settings page listing every MCP server DSH loads, showing each one's summary and live state, and letting you disable any server.
description.zh: 一个极简设置页，列出 DSH 当前装载的全部 MCP 服务器及其简介与实时状态，并可逐个停用。

description.en: Adds a native MCP Servers tab in DSH settings to add, edit, enable/disable and delete MCP servers, auto-registering discovered tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增原生 MCP 服务器管理选项卡，可新增、编辑、启停和删除 MCP 服务器，并自动注册发现的工具。

description.en: Adds a Settings panel to DeepSeek Harness for managing MCP servers and the skill library.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页中集中管理 MCP 服务器与技能库的管理面板。

description.en: Bridges Xcode headless MCP into DSH native tools for project creation, build, test, simulator interaction, and screenshots.
description.zh: 将 Xcode 无头 MCP 桥接为 DSH 原生工具，用于创建项目、构建、测试、模拟器交互和截图。

description.en: MCP management panel showing connection status, enabling server upgrades, pause/delete, and handshake probes.
description.zh: MCP 管理面板，显示连接状态，支持一键 pip/npx 升级、暂停或删除服务器、添加服务器表单与握手探测。

description.en: Minecraft-themed skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with pixel-art icons.
description.zh: Minecraft-themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. 6 themes (3 styles x 2 colorSchemes), MC pixel-art icons, biome sidebar gradient, top grass strip, bottom-right creeper, and chest / grass-block

description.en: DSH web plugin that lets you annotate Markdown previews in the right sidebar and send all review comments to the agent as one message.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：在右侧栏 Markdown 预览中直接批注、留修改意见，并把所有意见合并成一条消息发送给 Agent。

description.en: Markdown editing helper for DSH web input: adds list continuation, indent, and outdent key behaviors.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页输入框提供 Markdown 编辑辅助，支持列表续行、缩进和反缩进。

description.en: Serves workspace media files (images, screenshots) from the DeepSeek harness so the AI can display them directly, ending the need to read local files.
description.zh: 在DSH上直接提供工作区的媒体文件，使AI能直接显示图片和截图，解决无法展示图片的问题。

description.en: Packages MedXpert medical-device regulatory skills as a dsh profile bundle for use in the harness.
description.zh: 将 MedXpert 医疗器械法规技能打包为 dsh 配置包，供 Harness 使用。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting-room plugin: meeting membership, forked-context entry, host-led multi-round discussion, and post-meeting compressed notes.
description.zh: 多 Agent 会议室插件：会籍管理、fork 上下文入场、主持人控场多轮讨论，会后各自压缩纪要并回到工作区继续干活。

description.en: Generates structured meeting minutes from transcripts, extracting decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and risks.
description.zh: 从会议转写文本自动生成结构化纪要，提取决议、待办、负责人、截止时间和风险。

description.en: Adds a DSH meeting room where multiple AI/human sessions discuss one goal, relay turns, hand off files, and a recorder drafts a reviewable result.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加「会议室」：多个 AI 或人会话围绕同一目标讨论、接力发言、归档文件，记录员生成可审核的会议结果草稿。

description.en: Persistent memory framework for DeepSeek Harness giving agents seamless, project-scoped memory across sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久记忆框架，按项目隔离记忆，支持子任务自定义记忆上下文与技能自迭代，让智能体跨会话无缝续接。

description.en: Unified long-term memory hub for DSH: local persistent memory, L0-L3 layered distillation, compaction summaries, Hindsight bridge and a visual memory panel.
description.zh: DSH 统一长期记忆中枢插件：本地持久记忆、L0~L3 分层蒸馏、上下文压缩摘要、Hindsight 桥接与可视化记忆管理面板。

description.en: Persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness inspired by CC HAHA, storing memories as Markdown files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久记忆的插件，仿 CC HAHA 实现，将记忆以 Markdown 文件形式存储。

description.en: Local-only memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with Ebbinghaus decay, sleep consolidation, memory zones and hash-chain audit.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的本地记忆插件，具备艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线、睡眠巩固、记忆分区与哈希链审计。

description.en: Long-session capability memory that reads the handoff ledger of finished sessions and distills reusable skills and negative paths for later runs.
description.zh: 长会话能力记忆插件，读取已完成会话的交接账本，提炼可复用技能与负向路径供后续使用。

description.en: Adds long-term memory and source-attributed knowledge-base recall to DeepSeek Harness, using hybrid BM25 retrieval with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加长期记忆与带来源的知识库召回，采用 BM25 混合检索，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Per-model, per-session header gate for DeepSeek Harness pi-ai requests: stamps configurable headers on calls to trusted origins, pinning each session's first decision. TDAI memory proxy identity headers are the shipped default; names, values and origins are configurable.
Minimal long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with CJK-friendly substring search and hand-editable Markdown storage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的极简长期记忆插件，支持中日韩友好的子串搜索，使用可手动编辑的 Markdown 存储。

description.en: Adds neural-style memory to DSH: self-writing notes with topic-aware recall, visualised as an interactive star nebula canvas.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供类神经记忆：自动书写笔记并按主题召回，以可交互的星云画布呈现。

description.en: Move Claude & ChatGPT conversation history into DeepSeek Harness with machine-verified verbatim evidence and local approval.
description.zh: 把 Claude 和 ChatGPT 的历史记忆迁移到 DeepSeek Harness，逐字证据由代码回原文核对，用户逐条批准，全程本地

description.en: Four-layer long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness, ported from TencentDB Agent Memory, enabling cross-session recall and archival.
Three-tier (long/mid/short term) local memory store for DSH agents with per-tier TTL and capacity, relevance-based injection, lockable ground-truth entries and a settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供的三档记忆插件：长期/中期/短期分层存储，各自有周期与容量，本地检索按相关度注入，支持锁定底稿与设置面板。

description.en: Local 5GB long-term memory vault for DeepSeek Harness with SQLite/FTS5 auto-capture, per-turn recall injection, and a web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 5GB 本地长期记忆库，支持 SQLite/FTS5 自动捕获、每轮召回注入和 Web 面板。

description.en: DSH long-term memory plugin that injects a Markdown+git memory library into context and writes session conclusions back to files.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件：会话开始时注入 Markdown 记忆库，自动记录读过的文件，并在回合结束时把结论写回文件。

description.en: An external memory brain for DSH agents with full-text base, coordinate tracing, dynamic context assembly, retrieval, compression, and backups.
description.zh: 为大肥鱼提供不会遗忘的外接大脑：全原文底座、坐标溯源、动态上下文组装、跨区检索、截断指针、压缩摘要与备份恢复。

description.en: Injects MemVault core memory into the DSH system prompt each step, and hands every finished turn to MemVault's extraction/vector pipeline.
description.zh: 把 MemVault 核心记忆注入 DSH 系统提示词，并将每个完成的回合交给 MemVault 抽取与向量化管线。

description.en: Renders meow-memory's seven-layer SQLite memories as an interactive, draggable 3D star map with clickable details and filters.
description.zh: 把 meow-memory 的七层 SQLite 记忆实时绘制成可拖拽、可点击、分层旋转的 3D 星图面板。

description.en: DSH plugin that makes AI default to Mermaid diagrams in dev chats, with syntax validation and an output safety gate before rendering.
description.zh: DSH 插件让 AI 在开发对话中默认输出 Mermaid 图表，并在渲染前做语法校验与输出安全拦截。

description.en: Renders Mermaid diagrams in web chat with zoom and fullscreen viewer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天中渲染 Mermaid 图表，支持重复缩放和全屏查看，并提供美化默认样式。

description.en: Renders Mermaid code fences in dsh web chat as interactive SVG diagrams with zoom/pan, code toggle, and offline engine.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页聊天中默认将 Mermaid 代码块渲染为可缩放平移的 SVG 图表，支持代码/图表切换及离线引擎。

description.en: Adds a minimap to the left of the chat window for navigating user messages with hover preview, click-to-jump, and drag scanning.
description.zh: 用户消息导航条 · Message Minimap — DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件：聊天窗左侧 minimap 刻度定位每一条用户消息，悬停预览、点击跳转、拖动扫读

description.en: Adds visual meta-folders to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar so workspace folders can be grouped and rearranged by drag and drop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加可视化元文件夹，可通过拖放对工作区文件夹进行分组和重新排列。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: view micromamba environments and select one per workspace
Middle-click to close sessions or sidebar tabs in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a dedicated settings tab.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面中用鼠标中键关闭会话或侧边栏标签页，并提供独立设置页。

description.en: Lists your installed DeepSeek Harness plugins and exports them as a paste-ready note or a self-contained zip kit for migration.
description.zh: 列出已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，并导出为可直接粘贴的笔记或自包含的 zip 迁移包。

description.en: Makes each workspace a protocol-driven unit with preloaded AI sessions and change-triggered re-read reminders for current context.
description.zh: 让工作区成为协议化单位：预加载会话并在工作区变更超阈值时提醒重读，保证 AI 始终基于最新上下文工作。

description.en: Bridges MimaVault into DSH so the agent can search passwords, API keys and TOTP codes without leaking plaintext into model context.
description.zh: 将 MimaVault 接入 DSH，让智能体可搜索密码、API 密钥和 TOTP 验证码，且不会把明文泄露到模型上下文中。

description.en: A pure skin plugin that restyles the DSH Web GUI with a warm paper look, hairline dividers, serif reading text and orange accents.
description.zh: 纯皮肤插件，为 DSH Web GUI 换上一套暖白纸面、黑色发丝分隔线、衬线正文与橙色点缀的外观。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud inside DeepSeek Harness using Xiaomi MiMo TTS, with 9 preset voices, voice cloning and an Edge TTS fallback.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中用小米 MiMo TTS 朗读助手回复，支持 9 种预设音色、声音克隆和 Edge TTS 备用方案。

description.en: DSH plugin that dispatches image-recognition tasks to an opencode-go mimo-v2.5 subagent via system-prompt injection.
description.zh: 通过系统提示注入，将图像识别任务分派给 opencode-go mimo-v2.5 子代理的 DSH 插件。

description.en: Unofficial Minecraft fan theme for the DSH web GUI with blocky pixel UI, photo wallpapers, MC sound samples, and a BGM player.
description.zh: 非官方 Minecraft 粉丝主题，为 DSH 网页界面提供方块像素 UI、照片壁纸、MC 音效和 BGM 播放器。

description.en: Pops the current DSH session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with screenshots, a selection pill and global hotkeys.
description.zh: 将当前 DSH 会话弹出为置顶的 WebView2 迷你窗口，支持截图、选择浮标和全局快捷键。

description.en: A three-column desktop RSS reader for Miniflux inside DeepSeek Harness, with AI-generated daily digests and article insights.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内的 Miniflux 三栏桌面阅读器，支持 AI 生成每日摘要与文章洞察。

description.en: Fixes persistent bash tool delay in DSH minimal mode and adds a minimal-fast preset.
description.zh: 修复 DSH 极简模式预设中 persistent bash 工具约 3.5 秒延迟返回的问题，并提供 minimal-fast 预设

description.en: Four right-Sidebar panels for the DeepSeek Harness web client — artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes — paired two per tab with a draggable split.
MiniMax ASR (asr-1.0) plugin for DeepSeek Harness adding a transcribe_audio tool, settings card, and voice input in the input box.
description.zh: MiniMax 语音识别（asr-1.0）插件，为 DSH 提供 transcribe_audio 工具、设置卡片和输入框语音输入。

description.en: MiniMax multimodal tools for DeepSeek Harness: image understanding, image generation, speech synthesis, and transcription.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的MiniMax多模态工具：图像理解、图像生成、语音合成和转录。

description.en: MiniMax voice studio for DeepSeek Harness: clone voices, preview without the per-voice fee, synthesize text to mp3, and transcribe audio to text.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MiniMax 语音工作室：克隆音色、免费试听预览、文本合成 mp3、音频转文字。

description.en: Mist Ink is a softer graphite dark theme with frosted-glass styling for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: Mist Ink 是一款柔和石墨深色主题，为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面带来磨砂玻璃质感。

description.en: Connects an on-device MNN Chat small model to DeepSeek Harness as an OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
description.zh: 将手机端 MNN Chat 的端侧小模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 提供方。

description.en: A task-first mobile workspace for DeepSeek Harness that offers session overviews, compact input, and full-record access.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的任务优先移动工作区，提供会话概览、紧凑输入与完整记录访问。

description.en: Lets iPhone or iPad access DeepSeek Harness Web on a Mac or Windows PC via Safari over the local network, with no app install required.
description.zh: 让 iPhone 或 iPad 通过 Safari 在局域网内安全访问 Mac 或 Windows 电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness Web，无需安装 App。

description.en: Rotates the DSH Web GUI 90° so sidebar, conversation and right panel each fill a phone screen for mobile remote viewing.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 旋转 90°，侧栏、对话与右栏各自占满手机一屏，方便手机远程查看桌面。

description.en: Mobile shell for DSH Web: drawer navigation, touch-sized controls, safe-area insets and full-screen chat on viewports ≤767px, desktop unchanged.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端外壳插件：抽屉式导航、触控尺寸控件、安全区适配、对话区占满整屏，桌面端行为不变。

description.en: Provider folded model selector for DeepSeek Harness Web composer with grouped providers and effort controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框提供按服务商分组、可折叠的模型选择器，并带推理强度控制。

description.en: Sidebar panel showing account balance and 5-hour, weekly and monthly quotas for every configured model provider.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板，显示所有已配置模型提供商的账户余额以及5小时、每周、每月额度。

description.en: Model center plugin for DSH: free model catalog, real free trials, price/balance, one-click switch, usage stats.
description.zh: DSH 模型中心插件，提供免费模型目录与真实免费实测、价格与余额查询、一键切换模型以及用量统计。

description.en: A floating DSH widget that runs joint AI model fingerprint checks, routes responses, keeps session history and offers three DSH-themed skins.
description.zh: 一个轻量浮窗插件，联合检测AI模型指纹、进行响应路由、记录会话历史，并提供三款跟随DSH主题的皮肤。

description.en: DSH plugin to switch AI providers and models, tune per-model reasoning effort, star favorites and reorder providers.
description.zh: DSH 插件：切换供应商与模型、按模型单独记忆思考强度、收藏常用模型并调整供应商顺序。

description.en: Automatically retries failed LLM calls with the next untried model from selected providers' pools on rate limits, quota, or timeouts.
description.zh: 当遇到限流、配额或超时时，自动从所选提供商的模型池中切换至下一个未尝试的模型重试。

description.en: Adds a model picker, reasoning-effort slider, and three-gear Lightning orchestration switch to the DeepSeek Harness composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加模型选择器、推理强度滑块和三档 Lightning 编排开关。

description.en: Adds a hierarchical provider/key/model picker with multi-key management and precise model routing to the DSH web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供“供应商→密钥配置→模型”的分层选择器，支持多密钥管理与精确模型路由。

description.en: Model hub plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a dual-column provider/model picker, capability cards, and in-panel add, refresh, and delete actions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型中心插件，提供双栏提供商/模型选择器、悬浮能力卡，并可在面板内添加、刷新和删除模型。

description.en: Unifies WorkBuddy and Qoder CN models into DeepSeek Harness with account pools, credential takeover, request logs and diagnostics.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 与 Qoder CN 的模型统一接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持多账号池、凭据自动接管、请求记录与诊断。

description.en: Adds a live search box to the DSH model dropdown so users can filter models by name, vendor or abbreviation and select by keyboard.
description.zh: 为 DSH 模型下拉菜单添加实时搜索框，可按名称、供应商或缩写过滤模型，并支持键盘选择。

description.en: Desktop model picker for DeepSeek Harness with global search, favorites, recents, family navigation and reasoning-effort control.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端模型选择器，支持全局搜索、收藏、最近使用、模型家族导航与推理强度设置。

description.en: Two-level LLM router for DSH that picks a model then a channel, failing over channel-first, with health panel and usage stats.
description.zh: DSH 的两级模型调度插件：先选模型再选渠道，失败先换渠道再换模型，并显示渠道健康与用量面板。

description.en: Adds coloured provider logos and model IDs to the DSH model picker via a label-slot decorator, with light/dark theme adaptation.
description.zh: 通过标签插槽装饰器在 DSH 模型选择器中显示提供商彩色 logo 与模型 ID，并适配明暗主题。

description.en: Restricts model requests to an allowed set per provider, redirecting or refusing others and warning before llama.cpp reloads.
description.zh: 将模型请求限制在每提供者的允许集合内，重定向或拒绝其他请求，并在llama.cpp重载前发出警告。

description.en: Provider-level model pool for DSH that adds a virtual ModelPool provider with Auto and named pools, chain failover and per-source cooldown.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供者级模型池插件，新增虚拟 ModelPool 提供者，支持 Auto 与命名池、链式故障转移和按来源冷却。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you drag-and-drop reorder models/providers in Settings, persisting the order to JSON with a settings.yaml backup.
description.zh: 自定义模型/提供方顺序的 DSH 插件：在设置页拖拽排序，宿主模型列表按此顺序返回，并在写盘前自动备份配置。

description.en: Routes only the named DeepSeek Harness models through an outbound proxy, falling back to a direct connection when the proxy is unavailable.
description.zh: 仅将指定名称的模型流量走代理，代理不可用时自动回退直连。

description.en: Sidebar LLM leaderboard merging LMArena, Artificial Analysis, LiveBench and OpenRouter rankings with a local token-usage dashboard and CSV export.
description.zh: 侧栏模型排行榜，聚合 LMArena、Artificial Analysis、LiveBench 与 OpenRouter 数据，附带本机用量仪表盘与 CSV 导出。

description.en: Ranks discovered DeepSeek Harness models and transparently fails over to the next candidate when the current one returns no output.
description.zh: 对 DeepSeek Harness 发现的模型自动排名，并在当前模型无输出时透明切换到下一个候选模型。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness between flash and pro models based on conversation/plan vs implementation phases, triggered by file writes or subagent calls.
Adds find_models and switch_model tools so the agent can list available models and switch between them on its own.
description.zh: 提供 find_models 与 switch_model 工具，让模型能自行查询可用模型列表并切换当前模型。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows the current model provider's account usage—balance, plan window, spent quota and credit—in the session header.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在会话头部显示当前所用模型供应商账户的余额、套餐窗口、已用额度与信用余额。

description.en: Displays the vendor logo for the current model in the DSH web composer, sourced live from the session's ModelDirectory.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框中显示当前模型所属厂商的 logo，数据实时取自会话的官方 ModelDirectory。

description.en: Model menu for the dsh web GUI that lets you pick the main model, its reasoning effort, and your subagents' models from the composer.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web GUI 的模型菜单，可在输入框处选择主模型、推理层级以及子代理所用模型。

description.en: Adds CC Switch-style drag-and-drop sorting and row hiding to the DSH settings model-provider list, saving order to cordis.patch.yml with automatic backup.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页的模型供应商列表增加 CC Switch 式拖拽排序与整行隐藏，松手即生效并写回 cordis.patch.yml（自动备份）。

description.en: Multi-engine vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling image reading via Gemini, Ark/Doubao, and Claude with per-call selection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加多引擎图像读取能力，支持 Gemini、火山引擎方舟/豆包和 Claude，并可按调用选择引擎。

description.en: DSH and opencode plugin that counts tokens used in the current calendar month from local data only, resetting at 00:00 on the 1st.
description.zh: DSH 与 opencode 插件：仅基于本地数据统计本自然月的 token 用量，每月 1 日 00:00 自动重置。

description.en: Code-generated math and science animations for DeepSeek Harness: render Manim clips, probe frames, and verify formulas.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码生成的数学与科学动画:渲染 Manim 视频、抽帧检查并验证公式。

description.en: Adds liquid-glass popup and overlay motion to DeepSeek Harness, with spring clip-morph entrances, hover bubbles, image-zoom FLIP and a live-preview settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加液态玻璃弹窗与浮层动效，包括弹簧裁切变形入场、悬停气泡、图片缩放 FLIP 及实时预览设置页。

description.en: Read-only panel that shows your DeepSeek Harness instructions, skills, MCP servers and Agent Presets at a glance.
description.zh: 只读面板，一览 DeepSeek Harness 的指令、技能、MCP 服务器与 Agent 预设。

description.en: MQTT client plus embedded MQTT broker for DeepSeek Harness, with one control panel and nine mqtt_* agent tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MQTT 客户端与内嵌 MQTT Broker，含一个控制面板和九个 mqtt_* 智能体工具。

description.en: Connects DSH to the MT Manager MCP server on your phone, exposing mobile file, APK and ZIP tools via a configurable, hot-swappable address.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到手机上的 MT 管理器 MCP 服务，通过可随时修改的地址提供手机文件、APK 与 ZIP 操作工具。

description.en: Lets a DSH session be driven by an external ACP agent CLI as its root agent, with config-defined engine routing and MCP injection.
description.zh: 让 DSH 会话由外部 ACP agent CLI 作为根 agent 驱动，引擎以配置行方式路由并支持 MCP 注入。

description.en: Side-by-side session grid for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: click sessions in the sidebar, get an equal-cell grid of live conversations (max 3 per row), drag the top-right handle to reorder, each pane
Connects DSH workspaces and sessions on other machines over SSH into one native DSH interface, so chats run where they live.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把其他机器上的 DSH 工作区与会话接入同一个原生 DSH 界面，对话在哪里就在哪里运行。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace explorer with a multi-root conversation tree and a read-only resource browser.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏工作区浏览器，提供多根对话树与只读资源浏览。

description.en: An overview panel plus up to three pinned side-by-side session streams, so you can watch and message many sessions from one view.
description.zh: 总览面板加最多三列并排钉住的会话对话流，在一个会话里查看并直接给多个会话发消息或打断。

description.en: Opens any DSH session in its own native OS window so you can watch multiple sessions side by side.
description.zh: 将任意 DSH 会话放入独立原生窗口，可同时查看多个会话。

description.en: Multi-workspace sandbox for DSH, enabling immediate file write access to all registered workspaces without config.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多工作区沙箱，无需配置即可立即对所有已注册工作区进行文件写入。

description.en: Adds a Muse Code sidebar panel in DeepSeek Harness that shares one session with chat tools and caps spending at $10 by default.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加入 Muse Code 右侧边栏面板，与聊天工具共享同一会话，默认硬性花费上限为 10 美元。

description.en: Reads Windows system media sessions to detect song changes and prompts your DSH companion to react in its own voice, logging a listening diary.
description.zh: 读取 Windows 系统媒体会话，换歌时让 DSH 里的她用自己的话接一句感受，并记录听歌流水与口味。

description.en: A modified local music and podcast plugin for DeepSeek Harness with spectrum visualization and playlists, based on dsh-music-player.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-music-player 修改的本地音乐与播客插件，保留本地播放、频谱和歌单，新增播客 RSS。

description.en: Music theory math toolbox for note parsing, frequency/MIDI conversion, and chord/scale spelling with zero dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的音乐理论数学工具箱，支持音符解析、频率与 MIDI 转换，以及 26 种和弦和 17 种音阶的正确拼写，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Structured table editor for UpdateVariable blocks in DeepSeek Harness tavern plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 酒馆插件的 UpdateVariable 块提供结构化表格编辑界面

description.en: Manage custom Agent presets in DSH Settings: persona prompts, runtime-context snapshot selection, injected skills and per-preset tool scope.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理自定义 Agent 预设：人格提示词、运行上下文快照选择、注入技能与各预设的工具范围。

description.en: Nailong desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness, a transparent AppKit companion on macOS.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供奶龙桌面宠物插件，在 macOS 上以透明 AppKit 窗口显示陪伴形象。

description.en: Adds plain-language narration of agent work, an uncertainty gate, and mid-run interruption policy to DSH agents.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供通俗语言旁白、不确定性门控和中途打断策略。

description.en: Bridges DSH to Codex CLI so DSH keeps the chat UI while Codex executes coding tasks with native thread history.
description.zh: 将 DSH 与 Codex CLI 打通：DSH 负责聊天界面，Codex 负责任务执行并保留原生线程历史。

description.en: Hides any dsh Web sidebar panel entry, via a checkbox panel under the More menu or a console API, without disabling the plugin.
description.zh: 通过侧边栏 More 菜单下的复选框面板或控制台 API 隐藏任意 dsh Web 侧边栏面板入口，且无需禁用对应插件。

description.en: Network diagnostics toolbox for dsh: DNS, ping, port check, TLS, traceroute, public IP.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供网络诊断工具，含 DNS 查询、ICMP ping、TCP 端口检测、TLS 证书检查、路由追踪和公网 IP 查询六项只读探测，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Neuron-inspired memory framework for DeepSeek Harness with a 3D neuron star-ring panel for storing and recalling memories.
description.zh: 受神经元启发的 DeepSeek Harness 记忆框架，配有 3D 神经元星环面板用于存储与检索记忆。

description.en: Predicts your next chat message and shows clickable sentence suggestions above the DSH Web input box.
description.zh: 预测你在 DSH Web 输入框中下一句要说什么，并在上方给出可点击的候选句子。

description.en: Adds one-click suggested follow-up prompts beneath each completed agent turn to keep the conversation moving.
description.zh: 在每个已完成的智能体回合下方添加一键建议的后续提示，让对话持续进行。

description.en: Adds a ☽ Nightwatch button to the composer that keeps a session auto-continuing until a chosen clock deadline, then stops.
description.zh: 在输入框加一颗「☽ 守夜」按钮，选好截止时间后会话每轮自动续跑，到点自动停止。

description.en: Provides no-setup mode for DeepSeek Harness, automatically applying the best configuration out of the box.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免设置模式，安装后自动应用最佳配置，开箱即用。

description.en: Right-column Jupyter notebook panel with CodeMirror 6 editing, SSE streaming events and nb_* cell tools for a VS Code-like feel.
description.zh: 右栏 Jupyter notebook 面板，支持 CodeMirror 6 编辑、SSE 流式事件和 nb_* 单元格工具，手感对齐 VS Code。

description.en: Windows notification cards for DeepSeek Harness that alert you when a turn finishes or an approval or question is pending, without stealing focus.
description.zh: 适用于 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 通知卡片，在回合结束、等待批准或等待提问时提醒，且不抢占焦点。

description.en: Turns the tab icon into a green/amber status light and sends browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits input, with 47 selectable sounds.
description.zh: 将标签页图标变为绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话结束或等待输入时发送浏览器通知，提供 47 种可选提示音。

description.en: System notifier plugin for DSH Web GUI, written in plain JavaScript with no build step.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供系统通知功能的插件，用纯 JavaScript 编写，无需构建步骤。

description.en: HTTP notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness that sends POST requests when the agent finishes a round or needs user interaction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 HTTP 通知插件，在智能体完成一轮对话或需要用户交互时发送 POST 请求。

description.en: Sends real OS desktop notifications when a DSH agent turn finishes, fails, or waits for your confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 智能体回合完成、失败或等待确认时发送真实的操作系统桌面通知。

description.en: Sends native Windows toast notifications for DSH events like task completion, failures, approvals, questions, context pressure and token budget.
description.zh: 为 DSH 事件发送原生 Windows 弹窗通知，如任务完成、失败、审批、提问、上下文压力和令牌预算。

description.en: Adds top-right alert banners and sound cues when an approval or question awaits your input in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中，当审批或提问等待你处理时，显示右上角提醒卡片并播放提示音。

description.en: Desktop notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness that alerts on task completion, user action needed, or errors via notify-send/D-Bus.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面通知插件，在任务完成、需要用户操作或出错时通过 notify-send/D-Bus 发送提醒。

description.en: Sends browser desktop notifications when model starts, finishes, or needs user action.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面通知插件，在模型开始输出、完成整轮或需要你处理（权限审批、提问、计划评审）时发送浏览器桌面通知。

description.en: Plays semantic notification sounds (complete/approval/question/block/error) via BEL or WAV with a Web UI bell toggle.
description.zh: 通过 BEL 或 WAV 播放完成、审批、提问、受阻、错误等语义化提示音，并可在 Web 界面用铃铛开关控制。

description.en: Sends native desktop notifications and forwards alerts to a Discord bot for approvals, scheduled tasks, todo digests, goal notices and token usage.
description.zh: 发送原生桌面通知，并通过 Discord 机器人转发审批、定时任务、待办摘要、目标提醒和 token 用量提醒。

description.en: Email notification plugin for DSH: sends mail on task completion, waiting for answers or authorization, plus a send_email tool with attachments.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 邮件通知插件：任务结束、等待回答或授权时自动发邮件，并提供带附件的 send_email 工具。

description.en: Interactive DSH reminders for approvals, questions, plan reviews and turn completion, with sound, an always-on-top popup and Windows notifications.
description.zh: 交互式 DSH 提醒插件：审批、提问、计划评审与回合完成时通过声音、置顶弹窗和 Windows 通知提醒。

description.en: Sends Windows system notifications when a DSH agent completes tasks or requires user input, approval, or plan review.
description.zh: 当DSH智能体完成任务或需要用户输入、批准或审阅计划时，发送Windows系统通知。

description.en: DSH novel-writing assistant plugin with a work catalog, skill library, platform rank scanning, and cached LLM analysis.
description.zh: DSH 小说辅助插件，提供作品目录、技能库、平台扫榜与 LLM 分析缓存。

description.en: Leisure novel reader plugin that displays txt novels in a draggable, resizable floating window in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中以可拖动、可缩放的悬浮窗显示 txt 小说文本，供休闲阅读。

description.en: Reads local txt novels inside the DSH chat window, streaming one auto-detected chapter per message with jump-by-number and saved progress.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话窗口阅读本地 txt 小说：自动识别章节，每条消息读一章，发数字跳章并记住进度。

description.en: Reads local txt novels in DSH's right sidebar, with a bookshelf, chapter splitting, full-text search, reading progress, and five color themes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏阅读本地 txt 小说，支持书架、章节切分、全书搜索、阅读进度和五套配色。

description.en: Novel-writing workbench with templates, an outline-to-manuscript pipeline, 32 parallel reviewer sub-agents, AI-style scanning and a story graph.
description.zh: 小说创作工作台：创作模板与「设定卡→大纲→章纲→正文→审稿→改写」流水线，32 个子智能体并行审稿、AI 味扫描，并以故事图谱回看全书结构。

description.en: A novel-writing workspace for DeepSeek Harness with books, characters, worldbuilding, outlines, chapters, auto-wired relationship graphs and an AI pane.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的小说创作分区：书籍、人物、世界观、大纲、章节、自动关系图谱，以及能读取真实设定的 AI 面板。

description.en: A DSH plugin for long-form novel writing that pairs an author-facing UI with AI skills, both reading and writing the same novel/ project data.
description.zh: 面向长篇小说创作的 DSH 插件，把作者界面与 AI 技能通过同一份 novel/ 作品数据双向打通。

description.en: Manage npm packages from the agent: query metadata, list versions, search the registry, publish and deprecate packages.
description.zh: 在智能体中管理 npm 包：查询元数据、列出版本、搜索仓库、发布和标记弃用包。

description.en: Unified observability plugin for deepseek-harness providing OpenTelemetry trace/log/metric export and session telemetry bridging.
description.zh: Unified plugin-dimension observability (trace/log/metric) for deepseek-harness: registers global OTel providers + OTLP export, bridges dsh session telemetry, GenAI semconv ready

description.en: Enables GitHub Copilot OAuth sign-in and LLM route for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub Copilot 的 OAuth 登录，并接入其模型路由。

description.en: DSH agent-infra plugin offering a 'secondary brain' observer layer meant to incubate the main agent brain.
description.zh: DSH 智能体基础设施插件，提供“副脑”观察层，用于孵化主脑。

description.en: Cleans up the DSH Web UI by hiding unused official menu entries and forcing off the official-model Session Log upload.
description.zh: 清理 DSH Web 界面中无用的官方入口，并强制关闭使用官方模型 API 时上传 Session Log。

description.en: Olympiad informatics coach plugin for DeepSeek Harness with prompts, roadmaps, knowledge points, problem sets, real C++ judging, and ima KB retrieval/archiving.
description.zh: 面向 GESP、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI 教学的信奥教练插件，提供教练提示词、学习路线图、知识点、命题、C++ 真评测及 ima 知识库检索与归档。

description.en: Rewrites each prompt into an Adeptus Mechanicus prayer before it reaches the model, letting you send either the prayer or the original.
description.zh: 在提示词送达模型前，把它改写为机械神教祷文，再由你决定发送祷文还是原文。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness panel for managing ontology space, declarations, agents, memory, and per-chat context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本体空间面板，管理声明、代理、记忆和每聊天上下文。

description.en: Double-click any of your own messages to rewrite and resend the conversation from that point, leaving the original thread untouched.
description.zh: 双击自己发送的消息即可修改并从该处重新发送，原对话内容保持不变。

description.en: Registers a CodeBuddy CN target so DSH's open-in-app base can launch the CodeBuddy CLI with the current directory path.
description.zh: 注册 CodeBuddy CN 目标，让 DSH 的 open-in-app 底座能把当前目录路径传给 CodeBuddy CLI 打开。

description.en: dsh-TUI /open command: open files and folders by path or fuzzy workspace search (v0.15 manifest, MIT)
Adds a generate_image tool to DSH that reuses your OpenAI API key for text-to-image, transparent backgrounds and QQ image delivery.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加 generate_image 工具，复用 OpenAI API Key 实现文字生图、透明背景与 QQ 发图。

description.en: Integrates DeepSeek Harness with OpenClaw and WeChat via Agent Client Protocol (ACP) transport.
description.zh: 通过 Agent Client Protocol（ACP）传输，把 DeepSeek Harness 与 OpenClaw 和微信对接集成。

description.en: Run opencode as an ACP subagent in DeepSeek Harness with a delegation tool, settings page, and run history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将 opencode 作为 ACP 子代理运行，提供委派工具、设置页和运行历史。

description.en: Web UI plugin for dsh that displays OpenCode Go subscription usage and spend in the chat input area, with popup login and credential config.
description.zh: dsh 的 Web UI 插件，在聊天输入区显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量和花费，支持弹窗登录与凭据配置。

description.en: Sidebar panel showing OpenCode Go subscription status, model allowance, token usage meter and per-million-token rates.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示 OpenCode Go 订阅、模型额度、用量仪表和每百万 Token 费率。

description.en: Monitors OpenCode GO plan quota and displays usage bars and countdowns in DSH sidebar and chat.
description.zh: 监控 OpenCode GO 套餐配额，并在 DSH 侧边栏和聊天中显示用量条与倒计时。

description.en: Floating widget showing OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) with reset countdown in DSH WebUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量的悬浮小部件，含滚动、周、月用量及重置倒计时。

description.en: Connects models from your locally installed OpenCode client into DeepSeek Harness, including free-tier models, with no spoofing.
description.zh: 将本地安装的 OpenCode 客户端中的模型（含免费额度模型）接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需任何伪装。

description.en: DSH plugin to monitor OpenCode Go usage and DeepSeek balance across providers, with anomaly alerts and a sidebar UI.
description.zh: 监控 OpenCode Go 用量和 DeepSeek 余额，支持多 provider、用量突增与深夜盗刷告警，通过环境变量管理密钥，并提供侧边栏界面。

description.en: Adds a sidebar dashboard for OpenCode Go subscription quota, spending, forecasts and usage trends, with multi-account filtering and bilingual UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏卡片中查看 OpenCode Go 订阅额度、花费、预测与用量趋势，支持多账户筛选和中英双语。

description.en: Plays a full-screen splash animation — image animation or video — each time the dsh web page loads, then transitions back to the main UI.
description.zh: 每次加载 dsh web 页面时，在全屏遮罩上播放图片动画或视频开场，结束后以过渡效果交还主界面。

description.en: DSH web plugin showing real-time OpenCode Go plan quota usage in a draggable, collapsible floating capsule.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，以可拖拽、可收缩的浮动胶囊实时显示 OpenCode Go 套餐额度，展示滚动、本周和本月窗口的已用与剩余额度。

description.en: Measures per-request context size in long DeepSeek Harness sessions, warns at thresholds, compacts over budget, and hides offscreen chat rows.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 长会话中每次请求的上下文体积，超阈值时告警并执行压缩，还可折叠隐藏屏外聊天行。

description.en: Monitors token usage, truncates context, and lets you customize task instructions to keep DSH sessions efficient.
description.zh: 监控 Token 用量、截断上下文并支持自定义任务指令，让 DSH 会话更高效。

description.en: An always-on 3D WebGL HUD that visualizes agent status and execution progress in real time inside the harness.
description.zh: 一个常驻的 3D WebGL HUD，实时可视化智能体状态与执行进度。

description.en: Dispatch Grok/Codex/Claude/Cursor/Antigravity into local Orca to execute tasks and notify DSH when done.
description.zh: 调度 Grok/Codex/Claude/Cursor/Antigravity 到本地 Orca 执行任务，并在完成后通知 DSH。

description.en: On each task, assigns subagents a different model and routes their work through an independent reviewer before the main agent sees it.
description.zh: 每次任务时为子代理选择不同模型，并让独立审查者先验证子代理工作，再交由主代理处理。

description.en: DSH web plugin that searches, reads and safely writes Outline knowledge-base documents, with whitelist-guarded approval for every write.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：在对话中搜索、读取并安全写入 Outline 知识库，每次写入都需白名单授权确认。

description.en: Opens Outlook mail and calendar in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to read mail, manage unread messages, and schedule events.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏打开 Outlook，集中查看邮件、处理未读消息并管理日程。

description.en: DSH output settings plugin that auto-expands reasoning/tool nodes, adjusts code block font size and line height, and sets model output language.
description.zh: DSH 输出设置插件：自动展开推理/工具节点，调整代码块字体大小与行高，并设置模型输出语言（自动/中文/英文）。

description.en: Computes running training plans from pace parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据配速参数计算跑步训练计划，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Adds PaddleOCR visual recognition to text-only LLMs, enabling local and URL image processing via DSH plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件为纯文本大模型添加 PaddleOCR 视觉识别能力，可处理本地和 URL 图片

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that extracts page structure, including table coordinates, shadow DOM fields, code blocks, and confidence labels.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 插件，用于提取页面结构，包括表格坐标、Shadow DOM 字段、代码块和置信度标签。

description.en: Adds a floating zoom bar and hotkeys to scale the DSH web UI from 25% to 300%, persisted in localStorage.
description.zh: 为DSH网页界面提供悬浮缩放条与快捷键，范围25%-300%，缩放持久化在localStorage。

description.en: A draggable blue-whale-onesie pet that clings to window edges, squashes, blinks, sleeps and shows agent status in a thought cloud.
description.zh: 一只可拖拽的蓝鲸连体衣宠物，会吸附窗口边缘、压扁、眨眼、睡觉，并在思考气泡中显示代理状态。

description.en: A token-free Chinese calendar & weather plugin for DSH, covering lunar, solar terms, festivals, holidays, and multi-city weather.
description.zh: 无令牌的中文日历与天气插件，提供农历节气、节日、法定节假日（含调休）及多城市天气。

description.en: Keeps three plugin panels pinned in the DSH sidebar, lets you drag to reorder them, and tucks the rest into a More menu.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏中固定显示三个插件面板，可拖动排序，其余面板收进“更多”菜单。

description.en: Manage the global panel navigation at the top of the DSH sidebar with drag-or-arrow reordering, per-entry hiding and named groups.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 侧栏顶部的全局面板导航：拖拽或方向键排序、逐项隐藏、命名分组分隔线，本地持久化。

description.en: Reorganizes the sidebar panel menu with button-row or list layouts, row caps, drag-to-reorder, and a More overflow that absorbs Settings, Feedback and Sign in.
description.zh: 重新布局侧边栏面板菜单：按钮行或列表切换、行数上限、拖动排序，溢出项收进「更多」，并并入设置/反馈/登录。

description.en: 侧栏面板自由拖动：长按拖到任意位置排序，拖进「更多」即收纳、拖出即放回
Settings-tab plugin that lets users control which DSH Panel rail entries appear, their order, names, icons, and grouping.
description.zh: 通过设置标签页自定义 DSH 左侧面板栏条目的显示、排序、名称、图标与分组。

description.en: Zotero-style paper reading desk for DeepSeek Harness with PDF highlights, AI notes, co-reading chat and per-project mind maps.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Zotero 风格论文阅读台，支持 PDF 高亮、AI 笔记、共读对话与项目思维导图。

description.en: DSHA paper reader plugin: three-column reading (workspace docs, PDF body, live sub-agent chat) with pdf.js rendering and text extraction.
description.zh: DSHA 论文阅读器插件：三栏阅读（工作区目录、PDF 正文、实时子代理对话），支持 pdf.js 渲染与文字抽取。

description.en: Creates academic slide decks from papers, with venue-aware budgeting and speaker notes.
description.zh: Paper → academic talk for DeepSeek Harness: reads the real full text, budgets the slot per venue (组会汇报/会议报告/答辩/开题/文献汇报), builds the deck around the figures and writes the speaker notes as the script.

description.en: Wraps BabelDOC as a DSH tool that translates whole PDF papers into Chinese bilingual versions, quoting the cost before it runs.
description.zh: 把 BabelDOC 封装成 DSH 工具，整篇 PDF 文献翻译成中文双语对照版，并且先报成本再动手。

description.en: dsh academic literature copilot: multi-source paper search, citation formatting, DOI import, and a local SQLite library.
description.zh: dsh 文献检索科研副驾驶：多源学术检索、引文格式化、DOI 导入与本地 SQLite 文献库。

description.en: Adds a /worktree command, worktree create/list/status tools and a composer-dock panel for managing parallel Git worktrees in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 /worktree 命令、worktree_create/list/status 工具和输入框停靠面板，用于并行管理 Git worktree。

description.en: Folds long pasted text in the composer into expandable chips, with hover/click preview and inline expansion on send.
description.zh: 将输入框中的长文本粘贴自动折叠为可展开胶囊，悬停或点击预览，发送时按原位展开。

description.en: Paste images into dsh web chat with thumbnail previews, rerouting them as file attachments for text-only models.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页聊天中粘贴图片并显示缩略图预览，将其作为文件附件转发给纯文本模型。

description.en: Makes Windows absolute paths in DSH messages clickable to open their folder in Explorer.
description.zh: 让 DSH 消息中的 Windows 绝对路径可点击，在资源管理器中打开所在文件夹，文件会定位选中，目录则直接打开。

description.en: Converts 2D engineering-drawing PDFs into SolidWorks parts with callouts, DWG/DXF parsing, banded extrudes and SLDPRT/STEP export.
description.zh: 将二维工程图纸 PDF 转换为 SolidWorks 零件，支持标注、DWG/DXF、分段拉伸及 SLDPRT/STEP 导出。

description.en: Navigate PDF outlines and keep local reading bookmarks in the DSH right sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏中浏览 PDF 大纲并保存本地阅读书签。

description.en: Right-sidebar PDF reader for DSH: drag in a PDF to preview, then right-click selected text to interpret or translate straight into the chat input.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 PDF 阅读插件：拖入即预览，选中文字右键「解读/翻译」，原文加提示词直达会话输入框。

description.en: DSH sidebar translation panel that converts English PDFs into layout-preserving Chinese PDFs and Markdown, plus a pdf_translate tool.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏翻译面板：把英文 PDF 转换为保版式的中文 PDF 与 Markdown，并提供 pdf_translate 工具。

description.en: A frontend plugin for DSH Web that alerts DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing via colored chips and input card highlighting.
description.zh: DSH Web 纯前端插件，用彩色标签和输入卡高亮提示 DeepSeek 峰谷定价时段。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing windows plus token usage and spend indicators in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段以及 token 用量和费用指示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness host plugin that pauses and asks before model calls during DeepSeek API peak hours, plus auto-updates holiday data.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地插件：在 API 高峰时段先暂停并询问是否继续，跨峰再询问，并自动更新节假日数据。

description.en: Run-window switch for DeepSeek Harness that pauses tasks during China peak-price windows and resumes them at the boundary.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的运行时段开关：高峰时段自动暂停任务，边界时恢复执行。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak times in the DSH web GUI with live status, timezone detection, and countdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面显示 DeepSeek 高峰与低谷时段，含实时状态、时区自动检测、倒计时、SVG 图标和折扣时段表

description.en: Automatically detects DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing windows and lets you run prompts now or queue them until off-peak pricing starts.
description.zh: 自动识别 DeepSeek 峰价/谷价时段，可一键选择立即执行或推迟到谷价时段运行。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek peak/off-peak countdown badge in the composer dock, ticking every second on Beijing time with weekend and holiday awareness.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 峰谷倒计时徽章，按北京时间每秒刷新，自动计算周末与法定节假日天数。

description.en: Peak/valley cross-provider router that runs cheap models off-peak and premium ones at peak to cut API costs.
description.zh: 跨 provider 的峰谷路由插件：谷时用低价模型，峰时切换到高价模型，降低 API 账单。

description.en: Aggregates multiple dsh hosts into one sidebar, so local and remote workspaces/sessions can be opened and driven over direct HTTP/TLS.
description.zh: 把多台 dsh 主机聚合到一个侧栏，本机与远端工作区/会话统一显示，并通过 HTTP/TLS 直连交互。

description.en: Makes each turn independent: only current input plus long-term rules reach the model, folding history to keep context and cost flat.
description.zh: 让每轮对话互相独立：模型只看到本轮输入与长期规则，历史自动折叠，上下文占用与费用基本恒定。

description.en: Sidebar performance monitor for DSH on Windows with live CPU/memory readouts, trends, and process breakdowns.
description.zh: Windows 版 DSH 的侧栏运行监控：实时 CPU/内存读数、趋势与进程占用明细。

description.en: UI-level access gate plus a process-wide agent tool brake for dsh, with a shared 60-minute idle lock.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供界面级访问门禁与进程级 agent 工具刹车，并共享 60 分钟空闲锁定。

description.en: Permission matrix plugin for DeepSeek Harness combining 3 sandbox modes and 4 approval strategies into 9 presets with risk policies, audit log and git checkpoint.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供权限矩阵插件：3 种沙箱模式与 4 种审批策略组合出 9 个预设，含风险策略、审计日志与 git 检查点。

description.en: A DSH workspace permission panel that lists all session permissions in one searchable table, with grouping, filtering, and batch editing.
description.zh: DSH 工作区权限面板：以一张可搜索的表格展示所有会话权限，支持分组、筛选和批量修改。

description.en: Adds switchable, persistent personas (built-in and user-defined) to a DeepSeek Harness agent.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供可切换的持久人设，内置安若彤、言观、老姐三种人设，并支持用户自定义人设。

description.en: Distills daily collected raw material into a self-growing AI persona, rewriting a single persona weekly instead of stacking versions.
description.zh: 把每天收集的原料蒸馏成会自我成长的人格，每周覆盖式重写一份人格而非堆叠版本。

description.en: Per-workspace persona and user profile with event and diary memory, plus a panel to review and retract every stored entry.
description.zh: 为每个工作区管理角色、用户档案、事件与日记记忆，并提供面板查看和撤回每条记录。

description.en: Create, share, and switch AI personality presets globally or per conversation in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、分享并全局或按对话切换 AI 人格预设。

description.en: Switch the system-prompt persona of a running dsh session via TUI, Web UI, or headless mode without restarting.
description.zh: 在运行中的 dsh 会话里通过 TUI、Web UI 或无头模式实时切换系统提示词人格，无需重启。

description.en: A chibi Frieren desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 图形界面添加一个 Q 版芙莉莲桌面宠物。

description.en: Desktop pet fish that reminds you to take breaks via the RestNow app, adding pomodoro focus timers and a browser control console.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼联动「歇会儿 RestNow」提醒休息，内置番茄钟专注计时和浏览器控制台。

description.en: Speaks dsh-pet speech bubbles aloud using Microsoft Edge neural TTS voices inside the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 使用微软 Edge 神经网络语音，将 dsh-pet 的对话气泡朗读出来。

description.en: Pins running, finished-but-unopened, and currently open DSH sessions to the top of the Web sidebar workspace list.
description.zh: 将运行中、已完成未打开及当前打开的 DSH 会话固定在 Web 侧边栏工作区列表顶部，方便快速访问。

description.en: Detaches the DeepSeek Harness web GUI into a floating picture-in-picture window.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 网页图形界面分离到文档画中画浮窗中显示，作为 dsh 插件包提供。

description.en: A skill plugin that teaches agents to hand-write pixel-by-pixel drawing scripts for any image, fully offline and deterministic.
description.zh: 一个教 agent 手写逐像素绘图脚本的技能插件，可画任意图，离线运行且同参数必然复现。

description.en: A fixed-pixel office tower visual for DeepSeek Harness that maps workspaces to floors, sessions to offices, and agent teams to people.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的固定像素办公楼视觉：工作区是楼层，会话是办公室，智能体团队是其中的人。

description.en: DSH plugin with a bundled HID toolkit that drives the Halo PixelBar desktop pixel display: text, scenes, colors, ambient light and volume.
description.zh: DSH 插件，内置 HID 工具包，用于驱动 Halo PixelBar 桌面像素屏：文字、场景、颜色、氛围灯与音量。

description.en: Pixiv skill for AI assistants: search works, browse rankings, view details, and download illustrations, manga, GIFs and novels with PDF/GIF conversion.
description.zh: 面向 AI 助手的 Pixiv 技能：支持搜索作品、查看排行与详情，并下载插画、漫画、动图和小说（多页转 PDF、动图转 GIF、小说系列合并）。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it and marks the results on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在批准前检查计划的每个步骤，并将检查结果标注在计划审阅卡片上。

description.en: Renders PlantUML fenced code blocks in chat messages as inline SVG diagrams.
description.zh: 在对话消息中将 PlantUML 围栏代码块渲染为内联 SVG 图表。

description.en: Playmate plugin that captures your screen, takes hotkey voice input and reads replies aloud through your own local TTS service.
description.zh: 陪玩插件：抓取屏幕画面、热键语音输入，并通过你自建的 TTS 服务把回答念出来。

description.en: Reuse-first workbench for authoring DSH plugins: search existing plugins, decide, decompose gaps, verify, then build.
description.zh: 以复用为先的 DSH 插件开发工作台：先搜索可复用插件、做决策、拆解缺口、验证，再动手开发。

description.en: Edits global AGENTS.md memory file directly in DeepSeek Harness Web settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置中直接编辑全局 AGENTS.md 记忆文件。

description.en: Auto-splits AI-generated videos or screen recordings into shot segments for character-replacement tools, cropping player UI overlays and measuring per-shot motion.
description.zh: 自动把 AI 生成视频或录屏切成可直接投喂人物替换工具的片段，裁掉播放器 UI 覆盖层并按镜头测量运动量。

description.en: DSH Host plugin that instantly crashes the Host process, with a crash report, when a forbidden plugin is loaded, enabled, or installed.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：当禁用插件被加载、启用或即将安装时，立即让宿主进程崩溃并生成崩溃报告。

description.en: Monitors API balance, daily costs, and token usage for DeepSeek Harness, with pricing indicators and refresh/restart.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 的 API 余额、每日成本与 token 用量，显示峰谷计价，支持刷新充值信息和一键重启。

description.en: Shows native system notifications for approvals/decisions in DeepSeek Harness, with workspace name and click-through.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的审批和选择请求发送系统级通知，显示工作区名并支持点击跳转，提供多语言界面。

description.en: Manage archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: list, restore, and permanently delete them with instant sidebar sync.
description.zh: 管理已归档的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：列出、恢复并永久删除，侧边栏即时同步。

description.en: Generates project documentation: READMEs, API docs, changelogs, and JSDoc comments.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 项目自动生成 README、API 文档、更新日志和 JSDoc 注释。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that takes over failed model requests after built-in retries give up, continuing the backoff curve and showing full errors.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置重试放弃后接管失败的模型请求，延续退避曲线并显示被丢弃的完整错误。

description.en: Integrates Axolotl Launcher into DSH, collapsing 269 MCP tools into 11 domain tools with real screenshots and token auth.
description.zh: 将美西螈启动器接入 DSH：把 269 个 MCP 工具折叠为 11 个领域工具，支持真实截图与令牌认证。

description.en: Provides a run_command utility with a 10s sync window, auto background promotion, and completion reports for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 run_command 工具，同步等待 10 秒，超时自动转为后台任务，并在完成时生成报告。

description.en: Parses tenders, builds score-aligned outlines, drafts fact-anchored bid responses, reviews compliance and exports pure-JS .docx.
description.zh: 解析招标文件、生成对齐评分的大纲、撰写有事实依据的长文标书、合规审查并纯 JS 导出 .docx。

description.en: Plugin marketplace in DeepSeek Harness web client to browse GitHub community plugins, sort by stars, and copy install commands.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端中浏览 GitHub 社区插件，查看中文简介、按 star 排序并复制安装命令。

description.en: Monitors LLM prefix-cache health, separating real prefix rewrites from normal context growth and pricing the wasted tokens.
description.zh: 监控 LLM 前缀缓存健康度，区分真实的 prefix 重写与普通上下文增长，并计算浪费的 token 成本。

description.en: Infinite-canvas plugin composer that drags DSH plugins out of global scope into bundles and re-enables them globally with one toggle.
description.zh: 无限画布插件仓库：把第三方插件拖出全局范围组装成组合，一键开关让组合重新加入全局响应。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds settings cards and conversation nodes to the dsh UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加设置卡片与对话节点的 dsh 插件。

description.en: Upgrades the DeepSeek Harness plugin page into a catalog with badges, mount aggregation, and bilingual editable descriptions.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 插件页面升级为插件目录，提供徽章、挂载聚合以及可双语编辑的描述。

description.en: Diagnoses and fixes ChatGPT/Codex desktop app crashes on Windows after 60-90s, targeting proxy interference and Store issues.
description.zh: 诊断并修复 Windows 上 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面应用启动 60 至 90 秒后崩溃的问题，针对代理干扰和 Store 相关问题。

description.en: Adds 'regenerate options' and 'more options' buttons to DeepSeek Harness choice selections.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的选项选择添加重新生成选项和更多选项两个按钮。

description.en: Structured code review skill for DeepSeek Harness covering correctness, security, performance, style, and testing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化代码审查技能，检查正确性、安全性、性能、代码风格和测试。

description.en: Compiles a code repository into a source-grounded code map with path:line citations, an interactive knowledge graph and model tools — fully offline.
description.zh: 把代码仓库编译成带 path:line 源码引用的代码地图，附交互式知识图谱与模型工具，全程离线可跑。

description.en: Bridges DSH to Codex's built-in app server so you can switch sessions, send prompts, watch live output and dispatch isolated sub-agent tasks.
description.zh: 将 DSH 接入 Codex 自带的 app server，可切换会话、发送指令、实时读取过程并派遣隔离子智能体任务。

description.en: A prank one-click context cleaner for DSH that scans recent sessions' real token usage, clears the floating ball and opens a brand-new session.
description.zh: DSH 整蛊插件：一键清理悬浮球，扫描近期会话真实 token 消耗并立即开启全新会话。

description.en: Teaches agent to compress long conversations into structured summaries, keeping key info and dropping repetition.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文压缩技能，教智能体把长对话压缩成结构化摘要，保留关键信息并去除重复内容。

description.en: A live cryptocurrency ticker card in the DSH sidebar showing BTC, ETH, SOL, and JUP prices, 24h change, and mini sparklines with zero dependencies.
description.zh: DSH侧边栏的实时加密货币行情卡片，显示BTC、ETH、SOL、JUP的价格、24小时涨跌幅和迷你走势图，零依赖。

description.en: Lets you set your own display name and avatar for the DSH sidebar account row, stored locally per device with no uploads.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏账户行显示自定义名称和头像，仅保存在本机、按设备生效，不上传任何数据。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset for figure-by-figure, experiment-by-experiment close reading of a single biomedical paper.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 智能体预设，用于逐图、逐实验精读单篇生物医学论文。

description.en: Iterative GitHub deep search plugin running exact-phrase, broad-match, README-body and topic-expansion channels with a diminishing-returns stop rule.
description.zh: 迭代式 GitHub 深度搜索插件，涵盖精确短语、宽泛匹配、README 正文与主题扩展通道，并采用收益递减停止规则。

description.en: Adds DeepSeek Search and Fetch API tools so DSH models can search the web and fetch pages as Markdown.
description.zh: 接入 DeepSeek 官方 Search / Fetch API，让 DSH 模型可检索网页并以 Markdown 抓取正文。

description.en: Adds bilingual (zh/en) descriptions to plugin cards on the Web Settings plugin list page and publishes a service for other plugins to register descriptions.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置插件列表页为每个插件卡片添加中英双语描述，并发布 pluginDescriptions 服务，供其他插件注册自己的描述。

description.en: Adds a 插件管家 tab to DSH Settings → Plugins that explains each plugin and skill in plain language and enables one-click enable, disable, and uninstall.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness「设置 → 插件」页新增插件管家标签页，用中文说明每个插件和技能的作用，支持一键停用/启用（热生效）与安全卸载。

description.en: Discord bridge for DeepSeek Harness lets you chat with any workspace session, approve tool calls, and answer model questions from Discord.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 桥接插件，可在 Discord 中与任意工作区会话聊天、批准工具调用并回答模型提问。

description.en: Adds DIT.ai as a native model provider in DeepSeek Harness, keeping runtime and tools unchanged.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 DIT.ai 作为原生模型提供商，运行时和工具保持不变。

description.en: Dot for DeepSeek Harness: a personal chief-of-staff agent with memory, tasks, safety rules, a session dispatch desk and an on-screen pet. DSH 个人总管插件
DSH client plugin that turns a folder dropped into the input box into its local absolute path @reference block instead of a failed attachment.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件：把拖入输入框的文件夹转成本机绝对路径 @引用块，而不是上传失败的附件。

description.en: Scans the DSH plugin ecosystem, collecting stars, npm downloads and release assets to surface high-growth plugins and market niches.
description.zh: 扫描 DSH 插件生态，采集星标、npm 下载量和发布资源数据，发现高增长插件与细分领域。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style single panel to the DSH composer for picking the model and its reasoning effort level.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加 Codex 风格的单面板，用于选择模型及其推理强度。

description.en: Scans tool traces to report tool reliability: error rate, failure streaks and p95 latency, served through the /radar command.
description.zh: 分析工具调用轨迹，报告错误率、连续失败次数与 p95 延迟，通过 /radar 命令查看。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects to the local voidtools Everything index to search files across the whole disk instantly.
description.zh: DSH 插件接入本机 voidtools Everything 索引，实现全盘文件秒级搜索。

description.en: Cross-session fact notepad that saves, finds, lists and removes facts with keyword recall via /fact commands and a fact_find tool.
description.zh: 跨会话事实记事本，通过 /fact 命令与 fact_find 工具保存、检索、列出和删除事实。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds rich per-tool cards by registering renderers in the tool.call.toolview slot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件，通过在 tool.call.toolview 插槽注册渲染器，为工具调用提供丰富的卡片视图。

description.en: Adds a floating FC/NES emulator ball to DSH Web, opening a fullscreen arcade with local .nes uploads and a GitHub-based ROM library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂一颗 FC/NES 悬浮球，点开全屏游戏厅，支持本地上传 .nes 与从 GitHub 在线库下载 ROM。

description.en: Annotatable file editor for the DSH right sidebar: lazy file tree, inline notes, cross-file annotation navigation, Markdown preview, notes sent to chat draft.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏可批注文件编辑器：懒加载文件树、行内批注、跨文件批注导航、Markdown 预览，批注可加入对话草稿。

description.en: Select text in an assistant reply, right-click to ask a follow-up; the Q&A stays in a per-session right panel while that turn is hidden from the main chat.
description.zh: 选中助手回答中的文字右键追问，问答保留在按会话独立的右侧面板，主对话中该轮被自动隐藏。

description.en: Generates diverse LLM answers via multi-temperature sampling and selects the best with a judge call.
Plays the Genshin Impact launch video centered with white fill on startup before entering the Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在进入 Harness 网页界面前，启动时居中播放以白色填充背景的原神启动视频。

description.en: One-call Conventional-Commits git workflow for DSH: survey changes, commit, optionally tag and push, plus a /commit-push slash command with no model involvement.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供一键式 Conventional Commits Git 工作流：检查改动、提交、可选打标签并推送，并附带无需模型参与的 /commit-push 斜杠命令。

description.en: A Git workbench plugin for DSH that brings branch switching, diff review, commit history, stash, worktrees and AI draft assistance into the chat workspace.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Git 工作台插件，在对话工作区中提供分支切换、差异审查、提交记录、储藏、工作树与 AI 草稿协作。

description.en: Isolates broken plugins to keep DSH web UI stable, with one-click npm self-update.
description.zh: 隔离故障插件保持DSH Web UI稳定，支持一键npm自更新。

description.en: Read-only health-check tool for DSH plugins that inspects profiles, bundles, patches, version compatibility and MCP conflicts before install.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件的只读体检工具，检查 profile、bundle、patch、版本兼容性与 MCP 冲突，支持安装前候选检查。

description.en: Capture ideas anywhere and bring your idea backlog straight into the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 随时随地记录灵感，把点子待办库直接搬进 DSH Web 界面。

description.en: Bridges QQ, WeChat and other IM apps into DSH so you can message a bot on your phone while the desktop agent does the work.
description.zh: 把 QQ / 微信等 IM 接入 DSH：手机上给机器人发消息，电脑上的 agent 干活。

description.en: A pixel-art INFJ-A companion pet that lives inside the DSH window and reacts with quiet animations to agent states.
description.zh: 像素风 INFJ-A 桌面宠物，常驻 DSH 窗口，会根据代理状态做出安静的小动画反应。

description.en: Ships the full 474-tool it-tools (sharevb fork) inside a DSH panel via a Chinese categorized shell and same-origin iframe, with no extra deployment.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板内集成 it-tools（sharevb fork）全部 474 个工具，中文分类壳 + 同源 iframe，无需额外部署服务。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin exposing TypeSafe Jev's System One decision model as a callable jev_decide tool.
description.zh: 将 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）以原生 jev_decide 工具形式接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件。

description.en: Gives every installed DSH plugin a Chinese name and one-line description, showing them inline on the official Plugins page and auto-translating new plugins at startup.
description.zh: 为已安装的 DSH 插件提供中文名与一句话说明，在官方「插件」页原地显示，并在启动时自动翻译新插件。

description.en: A DSH client plugin that lets you drag plugin buttons into your preferred order, add dividers, and stash rarely used ones.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 客户端插件，可拖拽调整插件按钮顺序、添加分隔线并把不常用按钮收进收纳包。

description.en: Community plugin leaderboard for DeepSeek Harness showing hottest, newest, and on-fire Top 10 plugin lists in the Web UI sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件排行榜，在 Web 界面侧边栏展示最热、最新和最火 Top 10 插件列表。

description.en: Adds a plugin library search tab in DSH settings to browse, search, and install official GitHub plugins.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在设置页搜索 GitHub 官方插件库 (topic:dsh-plugin)，瀑布流浏览 + 一键安装 + AI 可调用

description.en: Syncs your DeepSeek Harness plugin lists across clients through any S3-compatible endpoint like AWS S3, MinIO, RustFS, R2 or OSS.
description.zh: 通过任意兼容 S3 的端点（AWS S3、MinIO、RustFS、R2、OSS）在不同客户端间同步 DeepSeek Harness 插件列表。

description.en: Read-only live plugin catalog for DSH Web settings, grouping plugins by source and module category with search/filter.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置中的只读插件目录，每次打开时读取当前 Loader 与插件包元数据，按来源和模块类别分组，并支持搜索筛选。

description.en: Installs and manages local inference providers such as Strata, Ninfer, vLLM and llama.cpp for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装和管理 Strata、Ninfer、vLLM、llama.cpp 等本地推理服务提供商。

description.en: DSH adapter that plugs a local experience knowledge base into DSH via five tools, per-turn index injection, a corner widget and MCP.
description.zh: 把本地经验库接入 DSH 的适配器：五个工具、每轮索引注入、右下角挂件与 MCP 支持。

description.en: Unofficial Korean language pack that localizes the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) interface into Korean.
description.zh: 非官方韩语语言包，将 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 界面本地化为韩语。

description.en: Adds password login gate and HTTPS reverse proxy to dsh Web UI for secure LAN access.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web UI 添加密码登录验证和 HTTPS 反向代理，以便在局域网内安全访问。

description.en: QQ assistant plugin for LoL ARAM Mayhem: 13 tools covering Top6 augments, builds, trios, tier lists and PNG cards via aramgg API data.
description.zh: 英雄联盟海克斯大乱斗QQ助手插件：13个工具，提供T0六件海克斯、出装、三合一、梯度榜及PNG卡片，数据来自aramgg官方客户端API。

description.en: Connects LRC long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness so decisions, constraints and conclusions persist and get recalled on demand instead of being lost to context compression.
description.zh: 把 LRC 长期记忆接入 DeepSeek Harness，将决策、约束与结论持续沉淀并按需召回，避免上下文压缩丢失信息。

description.en: Lite manager for third-party DeepSeek Harness plugins: list, enable/disable, uninstall, update via npm.
description.zh: DSH 第三方插件管理器（lite）：在设置页「插件 → 第三方插件」列出非官方插件，提供启用/停用（状态持久化、重启后保持）、卸载、检查更新、npm 一键安装/升级。A lite manager for third-party DeepSeek Harness plugins: list / enable / disable / uninstall / update.

description.en: Outlines and lints Markdown document structure: heading tree, level skips, duplicate headings, unclosed code fences.
description.zh: 提取 Markdown 标题树并检查文档结构，包括标题层级跳级、重复标题和未闭合代码围栏。

description.en: Adds Codex-style message timeline navigation to DSH web clients, with hover preview, click-to-jump, and highlighted current turn.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端添加 Codex 风格的消息时间线导航，悬停可预览消息、点击可跳转，并高亮当前阅读的轮次。

description.en: Hatsune Miku and Rose Queen theme pack for DeepSeek Harness Web with light/dark modes, mobile layouts and launch videos.
description.zh: 初音未来与玫瑰女王主题套装，支持浅色/深色、手机布局与启动视频。

description.en: A draggable mini dashboard showing live session activity and token costs for DSH web.
description.zh: 为 DSH web 在侧边栏设置项上方提供可拖动的迷你面板，汇总当前各会话的活动状态和今日 token 消耗。

description.en: DSH plugin for module-driven development: decomposes requirements into module tree, generates each module with independent agents, regenerates from design on any change.
description.zh: DSH插件，用于模块驱动开发：将需求分解为模块树，每个模块由独立代理生成，并在变更时从设计完全重新生成。

description.en: Controls MuMu Android emulator through mumu_* tools for screenshots, taps, swipes, keys, OCR, waits, APK installs, and multi-instance management.
description.zh: 通过 mumu_* 工具控制 MuMu 安卓模拟器，支持截图、点击、滑动、按键、OCR、等待、装包和多开管理。

description.en: A playful 3D electronic wooden-fish tapping widget with sutra chanting, TTS voices and a persistent token-to-merit ledger inside DSH sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中敲击 3D 电子木鱼的禅修挂件，支持经文诵念、语音合成，并将 Token 自动转化为持久化功德簿。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents a Mynah realtime digital human face for speaking, interruption, sessions, channels, and knowledge-base access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 Mynah 实时数字人，支持说话、打断、会话、频道和知识库。

description.en: Syncs the currently playing NetEase Cloud Music lyric line into the DSH status bar, with hover translation and automatic fallback endpoints.
description.zh: 把网易云音乐当前播放的歌词实时同步到 DSH 状态栏，支持悬停查看翻译与限流自动切换备用端点。

description.en: A local-first DSH memory plugin with its own vector engine, dedupe, provenance, a memory graph and 11-channel RRF recall.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 记忆插件，自带向量引擎，支持去重、溯源、记忆图谱与 11 路 RRF 召回。

description.en: Displays hover timestamps for DSH chat nodes showing start/end time and duration.
description.zh: 为DSH聊天节点行显示悬停时间戳，展示开始/结束时间和耗时。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications or updates the tab title when DSH needs user attention, such as approval prompts or question cards, while the page is in the background.
description.zh: 当DSH需要用户注意时（如审批提示或提问卡片），在页面后台时通过桌面通知或标签页标题变化提醒用户。

description.en: A slacking-off novel reader for DeepSeek Harness with a status-bar hover preview and a sidebar for full reading.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的摸鱼小说阅读器：状态栏悬停速览，侧边栏沉浸阅读。

description.en: Adds workspace-less (ungrouped) sessions to DeepSeek Harness by temporarily mounting each one so the native input area stays usable.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加未分组会话，通过临时挂载工作区让原生输入区可用，首条消息后自动回到未分组。

description.en: A keyless web search provider that plugs into DeepSeek Harness's built-in search tool and answers queries by scraping real search engines.
description.zh: 一个无需密钥的网页搜索提供方，接入 DSH 内置搜索工具，通过抓取真实搜索引擎来返回结果。

description.en: dsh plugin: pushes archived session transcripts into an Obsidian vault as Markdown with YAML frontmatter, deduped by content hash (/obsidian-push)
Opens DSH sidebar files (HTML, PDF, images, etc.) in your system default browser from a tab chip's context menu.
description.zh: 从标签页右键菜单一键将 DSH 侧边栏文件（HTML/PDF/图片等）在系统默认浏览器中打开。

description.en: Bridges your local OpenCode CLI into DSH so all your OpenCode providers and models can be used as the chat model.
description.zh: 将本地 OpenCode CLI 接入 DSH，让你所有 OpenCode 提供商与模型都能直接在对话中使用。

description.en: Backs up workspace folders to S3-compatible object storage (RustFS, MinIO, Aliyun OSS, AWS S3) with credentials read only from environment variables.
description.zh: 把工作区文件备份到 S3 兼容对象存储（RustFS、MinIO、阿里云 OSS、AWS S3），凭证只从环境变量读取。

description.en: A QQ bot plugin for The Outlast Trials that answers level, enemy, item and mechanic queries with guides and image cards.
description.zh: 《逃生：试炼》QQ 查询机器人插件，提供关卡攻略、敌人图鉴、道具与机制查询并生成图文卡片。

description.en: Cross-session pinboard that stores pinned notes and injects them into every session's system prompt via /pin, /unpin, /pins and pin_add.
description.zh: 跨会话置顶板，保存置顶笔记并通过 /pin、/unpin、/pins 和 pin_add 注入每个会话的系统提示。

description.en: Texas Hold'em poker table for DeepSeek Harness with model-callable tools, six heuristic opponents, and an optional coach.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的德州扑克牌桌，支持模型调用工具、六个启发式对手和可选教练。

description.en: Shared project discussion board that turns defects into kanban issue cards an agent reproduces and fixes.
description.zh: 共享项目讨论板，将缺陷转化为看板问题卡片，由智能体复现并修复。

description.en: Adds a ✨ button to the DSH chat input that rewrites your draft into a fuller, more actionable prompt, with undo and cost estimates.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话输入框加一个 ✨ 增强按钮，把草稿改写为更完整可执行的提示词，支持撤销与费用估算。

description.en: One-click prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness that rewrites your composer draft into a clear, verifiable prompt, with zero dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一键提示词优化插件，可将输入框草稿改写为清晰、可验证的提示词，且零依赖。

description.en: Personal prompt library plugin that imports tagged prompt templates, lets you browse them, and fires one into the current session via /pv.
description.zh: 个人提示词库插件，可导入带标签的提示词模板、浏览并一键发送到当前会话（/pv）。

description.en: Shows provider brand logos beside model names in DeepSeek Harness's model selector, with 24 inline icons, prefix matching and a grey-dot fallback.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器中，于模型名左侧显示供应商品牌 logo，内置 24 个内联图标、前缀匹配与灰点兜底。

description.en: A local, offline seven-day (shichiyo) calendar that tells you which day it is, its traditional symbol, and gentle activity inspiration.
description.zh: 一个纯本地的七曜日历：告诉你今天是七曜中的哪一天、其传统象征，并给出一点安排灵感，不算吉凶。

description.en: Live usage meter tracking per-session tokens, turns, and cost, injected into the system prompt with /qm panel and quota_meter card tool; also a plugin-dev test template.
description.zh: 实时会话用量计量器，追踪 token、轮次和成本，注入系统提示，提供 /qm 面板与 quota_meter 卡片工具，也作为插件开发测试模板。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek account balance in the composer usage row, with click-to-expand balance and gift-quota details.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的用量行左侧显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击可原地展开普通余额与赠送额度明细。

description.en: Find DSH plugins via natural language queries and security-scan them before installation.
description.zh: 用自然语言搜索查找 DSH 插件，并在安装前对插件进行安全扫描。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin that full-text searches past sessions and injects relevant excerpts into current context.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆插件，用 SQLite FTS5 全文检索所有历史会话，把最匹配的片段（此前的决定、命令、错误）注入当前上下文。

description.en: Adds a "Recently Viewed" sidebar section to DSH that lists recently opened file artifacts for quick reopening.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏新增“最近浏览”入口，列出最近打开的文件产物，方便快速重新打开。

description.en: Reads remaining quota and usage from any OpenAI-compatible relay's billing surface via /quota and quota_check.
description.zh: 从任意 OpenAI 兼容中转站的计费接口（/quota、quota_check）读取剩余额度与用量。

description.en: Reverse-proxies the full DSH desktop Web UI to a phone browser over LAN, adding device pairing, a read-only policy and approval routing.
description.zh: 通过局域网把 DSH 桌面版完整 Web UI 反代到手机浏览器，并提供设备配对、只读策略与审批路由。

description.en: Adds a sidebar-footer restart button and a detached supervisor that relaunches the DeepSeek Harness desktop app so rebuilt plugins or profile changes take effect immediately.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用添加侧边栏一键重启按钮与独立守护进程，重启整个应用，让重建的插件或配置更改立即生效。

description.en: Adds a draggable floating button to the dsh Web GUI that confirms and then restarts the app and host process.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面添加可拖动的悬浮按钮,确认后可重启应用与宿主进程。

description.en: Builds a Jupyter-style DAG of an agent's whole session, showing real file data flow with rerun and explanation.
description.zh: 构建 agent 会话的 Jupyter 式数据流 DAG，含 git 提交出处节点、子 agent 交接边、持久账本、悬停重跑与 LLM 解释。

description.en: Rewrites the DSH sidebar's relative session timestamps as WeChat-style absolute times so session history reads chronologically.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏中会话的相对时间改写为微信风格的绝对时间，使历史会话按时间清晰排列。

description.en: Adds a confirmed delete-session action to DSH's session row menu with a 5-second undo restore window and permanent log removal after.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话行菜单添加带确认弹窗的删除会话操作，提供 5 秒撤销恢复窗口，超时后永久删除日志。

description.en: Bypass-captures every DeepSeek Harness session event and exports polished Markdown/HTML retrospective reports with a web stats panel.
description.zh: 旁路采集 DeepSeek Harness 会话全量事件，一键导出美化 Markdown/HTML 复盘报告，并内置 Web 统计面板。

description.en: CJK-friendly full-text search for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with click-to-reveal results and previous/next match navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的 CJK 友好全文搜索，支持点击定位结果及上一个/下一个匹配导航。

description.en: Moves a conversation to another workspace via a sidebar menu, migrating the full session log and workspace data.
description.zh: 通过侧边栏菜单将对话移动到另一个工作区，并完整迁移会话日志与工作区数据。

description.en: Adds a Cmd+K Spotlight-style palette for switching sessions, with inline renaming and up to three tags per session.
description.zh: 通过 Cmd+K 打开 Spotlight 风格会话面板，支持快速切换、就地重命名及每个会话最多三个标签。

description.en: Deletes DeepSeek Harness sessions via a recycle bin: move, restore, then purge logs, caches, spill files and workspace accounting on next start.
description.zh: 通过回收站彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话：先移动、可恢复，下次启动时清除日志、投影缓存、溢出文件与工作区账目。

description.en: Adds the owning workspace name as a second line under each session title in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar session list.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话列表中，为每个会话标题下方第二行显示其所属工作区名称。

description.en: Adds a Sirchmunk section to DSH settings for inspecting knowledge graphs, managing clusters, reviewing shared history and monitoring metrics.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面新增 Sirchmunk 板块，用于查看知识图谱、管理集群、回顾共享历史并监控运行指标。

description.en: Desktop console to browse, search, and install Agent Skills, with a built-in marketplace, auto Chinese translation, trash, and update checks.
description.zh: 桌面技能管理台：浏览、搜索、安装全部 Agent Skills，内置市场、自动中文翻译、回收站与更新检查。

description.en: Skin Studio changes the DeepSeek Harness UI with preset/custom colour schemes plus image, gradient and video chat wallpapers, saved in your browser.
description.zh: 皮肤与壁纸插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设/自定义配色，以及渐变、图片和视频聊天壁纸，选择保存在当前浏览器。

description.en: Groups Settings plugin list by origin, shows version, upstream repo link, and local-dev marker. Read-only, zero network.
description.zh: 按来源（官方/社区）对设置插件列表分组，显示版本、上游仓库链接和本地开发标记。只读，零网络。

description.en: Adds standalone DSH sessions that belong to no workspace, reuse the native input area, and appear in their own sidebar panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加不隶属任何工作区的独立会话，复用原生输入区，并提供独立侧边栏面板。

description.en: Adds a freely arrangeable sticky-note wall in the sidebar plus four sticky_wall_* model tools for working with the notes.
description.zh: 在侧栏添加可自由摆放的便签墙，并提供 4 个 sticky_wall_* 模型工具来操作便签。

description.en: A web console that auto-categorises, explains, audits by last-used time, batch-deletes and packages DeepSeek Harness plugins and skills.
description.zh: 一个网页控制台，可自动分类、大白话讲解、按最后使用时间审计、批量删除并一键打包 DeepSeek Harness 的插件与技能。

description.en: Deletes DSH subagent sessions and retires their leftover catalog lines in the parent session log, with a one-click web panel.
description.zh: 删除 DSH 子代理会话，并把父会话日志里残留的目录行原位退休，附带网页端一键清理面板。

description.en: DSH client plugin that annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on, in parent-catalog rows and the child session header.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件，在父目录行和子会话标题中标注每个子代理实际使用的模型路由。

description.en: Defines DSH subagent roles as Markdown files whose YAML frontmatter sets display name, routing, LLM route and tool policy.
description.zh: 将 DSH 子代理角色定义为 Markdown 文件，通过 YAML frontmatter 配置名称、路由、LLM 路由与工具策略。

description.en: Chat plugin that floats wide/long markdown tables into a scrollable popup and copies them as Markdown.
description.zh: DSH 聊天表格浮窗插件，可将过长或过宽的 Markdown 表格一键弹出为可滚动浮窗查看，并支持复制为 Markdown。

description.en: Audits repository maturity across 8 dimensions, then generates tailored READMEs, bilingual drafts, brand assets and pre-release checks.
description.zh: 从8个维度审计仓库成熟度，并生成定制 README、双语草稿、品牌素材与发布前检查。

description.en: Expose your DeepSeek Harness desktop Web UI to your phone over a private Tailscale tailnet, with no port forwarding or public exposure.
description.zh: 通过私人 Tailscale tailnet 在手机上打开 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI，无需端口转发或公网暴露。

description.en: Compiles a rough need into a versioned task book and hands it to any AI window losslessly via a read-back handshake.
description.zh: 把粗略需求编译成带版本的任务书，并通过回读握手无损交给任意 AI 窗口。

description.en: Play Tetris in the DSH Web GUI while the agent works, with a floating panel that pops up during agent runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中趁 agent 干活时玩俄罗斯方块，agent 工作时浮动面板会自动弹出。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness enabling messaging, approvals, session/model switching, and permission management.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) ↔️ Telegram bridge: message, approve, ask, switch sessions/models/modes, manage permissions from Telegram. Cordis profile plugin, bilingual.

description.en: Picks the right reasoning level for each turn from your draft and recent messages, switches it in one click, and suggests a fresh session when chats get long.
description.zh: 根据当前草稿和最近对话判断合适的推理等级，一键切换；对话过长时提示开启新会话，简单任务少思考、复杂任务够推理。

description.en: Adds a live badge to DSH web showing the token count of reasoning/thinking disclosures as they update.
description.zh: 在DSH网页上实时显示推理/思考内容的令牌数量徽章。

description.en: Three.js workbench with live scene preview and a project inspector for revision, WebGL/WebGPU usage, API changes and GLB weights.
description.zh: Three.js 工作台：提供实时场景预览和项目检查器，查看版本、WebGL/WebGPU 使用、废弃 API 与 GLB 权重。

description.en: Adds plugin tiles beside the chat title: left-click toggles a plugin, right-click renames it, scroll resizes the tile.
description.zh: 在会话标题旁显示插件方块：左键开关插件，右键改名，滚轮调节大小。

description.en: DSH plugin manager to list, enable/disable, and delete plugins via a Web GUI settings tab.
description.zh: 在 Web GUI 设置标签页中列出、启用/禁用和删除 DeepSeek Harness 插件，host 与 client 一体包

description.en: Adds an Enable/Disable tab in DSH Settings to toggle plugins live and persist changes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置→插件中增加启用/停用标签页，可实时停止或启动加载器条目，并在重启后保留更改。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一只「费率表 + 缓存哨兵 + 输出压缩器」：真实 ¥ 账单、缓存失效告警与自动回滚、工具输出无损压缩、交接新会话（单请求 −94%）。
GitHub-style token usage heat map for DeepSeek Harness with day/week/month granularity and per-model breakdown.
description.zh: 以 GitHub 风格热力图展示 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量，支持按天、周、月粒度查看和按模型细分，悬停显示今日徽章，只读且数据全在本地。

description.en: Sidebar plugin radar for DeepSeek Harness to browse 3900+ plugin catalog with search, 22 categories, and rankings, plus agent-callable tools.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供侧边栏插件雷达，可浏览3900+插件目录，支持搜索、22分类、榜单及智能体工具。

description.en: Full-text search across archived DSH session transcripts by reading the JSONL sidecar files written by dsh-plugin-transcript.
description.zh: 通过读取 dsh-plugin-transcript 写入的 JSONL 附属文件，对已归档的会话记录进行全文搜索。

description.en: Shows the current workspace's active Trellis task in the dsh web chat statusline, with parent/subtask roles and a clickable task tree.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 聊天状态栏中显示当前工作空间的活跃 Trellis 任务，标明父任务/子任务角色并提供可点击任务树。

description.en: Read-only security auditor for DSH plugins that scans for malicious patterns and uses the session model for semantic review.
description.zh: 只读DSH插件安全审计器，扫描恶意模式并用当前会话模型做语义审查。

description.en: TTS voice synthesis plugin for DeepSeek Harness with MiMo/Breeze protocols, voice cloning, singing and QQ voice via OneBot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TTS 语音合成插件，支持 MiMo 与 Breeze 双协议、音色克隆与唱歌，并可通过 OneBot 发送 QQ 语音。

description.en: Web UI toggle to enable/disable dsh plugins instantly, persisted in cordis.patch.yml, no restart needed.
description.zh: 在 Web 页面直接开关 dsh 插件，无需重启，改动写入 cordis.patch.yml 持久保存。

description.en: HUD plugin for DeepSeek Harness that shows live per-turn/session token usage, account balance, daily spend, and estimated API costs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话用量与费用 HUD 插件，实时显示本轮/本会话 token 消耗、账户余额、今日消耗及按官方价目估算的费用。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into the DSH agent's long-term memory and workspace for search, memory injection, capture and vault inspection.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 知识库变成 DSH agent 的长期记忆与工作台，支持检索、记忆注入、一键捕获与巡检。

description.en: Parses vLLM-Ascend / Ascend NPU profiling artifacts, visualizes Host/Device swimlanes and cost shares, and exports phase-aware optimization advice.
description.zh: 解析 vLLM-Ascend / Ascend NPU 性能分析产物，可视化 Host/Device 泳道与耗时占比，并输出分阶段优化建议。

description.en: Filters fetched web pages by keyword relevance, strips navigation, and caches original text to cut token usage.
description.zh: 按关键词对抓取网页做相关度筛选、过滤导航并缓存原文，降低 web_fetch 的 token 消耗。

description.en: 微信会话互通聚合包：桌面弹窗 / 系统通知 + 提示音，30/60 秒超时后经 dsh-im 微信机器人把带问题原文与编号选项的清单发到微信，可直接在微信里回复选择。
