Windows environment guard skill providing preventive rules for encoding, escaping, paths, and process pitfalls for dsh agents.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Windows 环境防坑规则的纯数据 skill 插件，涵盖编码、转义、路径、进程等预防条目，不含修复工具。

description.en: Hover over any English word in DeepSeek Harness replies to instantly see phonetics, part of speech, Chinese/English definitions and bilingual examples.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中悬停任意英文单词，即可弹出音标、词性、中英释义与双语例句。

description.en: Sidebar sticky-note panel with free placement, resize snapping, start/end dates, and drag-to-reschedule calendar and Gantt views; data stays local.
description.zh: 侧边栏工作便签面板，便签可自由摆放并吸附缩放，带起止日期，可在月历与甘特图中拖拽改期，数据仅存本地浏览器。

description.en: Automates daily WorkBuddy check-in and point collection through a saved Chrome login, so you can just ask the agent to claim rewards.
description.zh: 通过保存的 Chrome 登录态自动完成 WorkBuddy 每日签到与积分领取，直接对 Agent 说一句即可。

description.en: Adds folders to the DSH Plugins page for grouping installed plugins, with group toggles, search, drag reorder, batch undo, reinstall and Harness restart.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页用文件夹对已安装插件分组，支持组开关、搜索、拖动排序、批量撤销、重装与一键重启 Harness。

description.en: Organizes DSH's top-left plugin sidebar entries into nested categories and lets you hide or show any entry.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左上角的插件侧栏入口按自定义的一级/二级分类整理，并可隐藏或显示任意入口。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar plugin marketplace for DSH with search, usage ranking, tag filters and one-click install command copying.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加左侧栏插件市场，支持搜索、按使用人数排序、标签筛选和一键复制安装命令。

description.en: Switch pnpm proxies and registries via a DSH Settings tab, host plugin, or standalone CLI.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置页、宿主插件或独立 CLI 切换 pnpm 代理与 registry。

description.en: Watch and control a DSH AI agent from a phone browser: approve tool calls, send messages, stop turns.
description.zh: 在手机浏览器上观看和操控DSH智能体：批准工具调用、发送消息、停止当前回合。

description.en: Pick DOM elements in the DSH HTML preview and hand the agent exact selectors plus source line numbers so front-end fixes need no vague description.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的 HTML 预览里圈选 DOM 元素，把选择器和源码行号精确交给 agent，修前端代码无需再用文字描述元素。

description.en: Always-on lazy senior dev rules and six ponytail skills for making the smallest complete change in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的懒资深开发者规则和六项技能，帮助以最小完整改动完成任务。

description.en: Registers 11 curated pg-aiguide PostgreSQL skills in DSH plus the pg-aiguide MCP server for version-exact manual search.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生注册 11 个精选的 pg-aiguide PostgreSQL 技能，并接入 pg-aiguide MCP 服务器进行版本精确的手册检索。

description.en: A draggable power button for DSH Desktop that latches to the window edge and lets you restart or quit DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版添加可拖动电源按钮，贴边自动收起，点击可重启或退出 DSH。

description.en: Adds decorative power-mode typing effects to the DSH composer: caret particles, heat and embers, combo counter, and synthesized key ticks.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加装饰性的强力打字效果:光标粒子、热量余烬、连击计数和合成的按键音效。

description.en: Adds a power button in the DSH Web UI title bar to restart or exit the app, with confirmation dialogs before each action.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面标题栏添加电源按钮，可重启或退出 DSH，并在操作前弹出确认对话框。

description.en: Turns a one-line description into a full deck with charts, layout audits, animations, and live browser preview.
description.zh: 将一句话描述生成完整演示文稿，包含图表、布局审计、动画和实时预览。

description.en: Left-sidebar PPT workbench for DSH with live 16:9 deck preview, in-place editing, element-faithful PPTX import and an AI chat column.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏 PPT 工作台：16:9 实时预览、就地编辑、原样导入 PPTX，并配有 AI 对话栏。

description.en: Adds a status-bar cell and a dialog showing the DeepSeek Harness session's average prefill speed and a recent-window view.
description.zh: 在状态栏新增一格，并弹出对话框，显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话的平均 prefill 速度及最近若干步的窗口数据。

description.en: Compact OMP-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness with native controls, light/dark themes, and an author-maintained Discover index.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供紧凑的 OMP 风格界面，包含原生控件、明暗主题及作者维护的 Discover 索引。

description.en: A vertical preview marketplace for DeepSeek Harness that catalogs preview plugins, tracks installed inventory, and provides install/update entry points.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的垂直预览插件市场，提供目录、已安装清单以及预览插件的安装/更新入口。

description.en: Live preview tab for DeepSeek Harness that embeds any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供实时预览标签页，通过iframe嵌入任意开发服务器并透明代理SPA。

description.en: Provides color themes for DeepSeek Harness document previews, covering PDF, Office, and spreadsheet previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的文档预览提供配色主题，涵盖 PDF、Office 和表格预览。

description.en: DSH file preview & editor plugin providing an in-browser file tree, multi-format preview, online editing, version history, and search.
description.zh: DSH 文件预览与编辑插件，提供浏览器内工作区文件树、多格式预览、在线编辑、版本历史和搜索功能。

description.en: Web GUI badge showing whether DeepSeek API is in peak or off-peak pricing now, with a countdown to the next switch.
description.zh: Web GUI 徽标显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于高峰还是空闲时段，并含距下次切换的倒计时。

description.en: Sidebar DSH widget showing whether DeepSeek API is in off-peak or peak pricing hours, a countdown to the next switch, and the current price list.
description.zh: 侧栏 DSH 插件：显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于空闲还是高峰价格时段、距下次切换的倒计时，以及当前生效价目表。

description.en: DSH Web UI badge showing DeepSeek API peak/off-peak pricing periods, current model output price, and account balance, with a click-through price reference.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 徽章，显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷时段、当前模型输出价格与账户余额，点击可查看 DeepSeek 及第三方模型价格参考。

description.en: Prism Theme Studio brings 24 paired light/dark palettes, six moods, custom accents, favorites and a live editor to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Prism 主题工作室为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 24 组明暗配对配色、六种氛围、自定义强调色、收藏与实时主题编辑。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin that masks PII in outgoing prompts and guards sensitive topics with induced-lock protection.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端隐私保护插件，发送前对提示中的 PII 进行伪名化脱敏，并带诱导锁定机制守护敏感话题。

description.en: Deterministic probability & statistics library: distribution calculator, z-scores, confidence intervals, event-probability identities, zero-dependency.
description.zh: 确定性概率与统计库：分布计算、z分数、置信区间、事件概率恒等式，零依赖。

description.en: Fold DSH Web execution steps into compact expandable process boxes.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 的执行步骤折叠为紧凑的可展开过程框

description.en: File-state-machine dev process plugin for any repo, with 7 role subagents, gate scripts and a GUI status board.
description.zh: 面向任意仓库的开发流程插件：文件状态机驱动，内置 7 个角色 Subagent、门禁脚本与 GUI 状态看板。

description.en: A lightweight widget above the DSH input box showing a processing timer plus rotating fun hints while the reply is generated.
description.zh: 一个轻量插件，在 DSH 输入框上方显示处理中计时，并轮换趣味提示陪伴等待。

description.en: Verifies that a DSH profile declaration, pnpm lockfile, and installed bundles match via content-addressed proof.
description.zh: 通过内容寻址校验 DSH profile 声明、pnpm 锁文件与已安装依赖包三者是否一致

description.en: A personal profile vault for DSH that stores user info by name and lets AI read it only after the user consents in the current session.
description.zh: 一个DSH个人资料库，以姓名为索引存储用户信息，AI读取前必须获得当前会话的用户授权。

description.en: Nudges the DSH main agent to report progress at a configurable interval during long runs, with backoff, stuck detection and a /progress command.
description.zh: 按可配置间隔提醒 DSH 主智能体在长任务中播报进度，支持指数退避、卡死检测和 /progress 手动命令。

description.en: Permission guard for DeepSeek Harness: workspace actions run freely while extra permissions are judged, asked about, or refused.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 权限守卫：工作区内操作不被打断，额外权限按风险放行、询问或拒绝。

description.en: Project inbox for DeepSeek Harness that gathers questions, deliverables and interrupted turns from every session so you can act on them in one place.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的项目收件箱，汇总所有会话中的问题、交付物和中断回合，让你能在一处集中处理。

description.en: Adds a project kanban board to the dsh web GUI sidebar, grouping tasks by project across four fixed columns: To Do, In Progress, Feedback, Done.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页 GUI 侧边栏添加项目看板，按项目分组，含四个固定列：待办、进行中、待反馈、已完成。

description.en: Declares per-project MCP servers for DeepSeek Harness, mounting them only in sessions scoped to that project.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按项目声明的 MCP 服务器，仅在对应项目的会话中挂载。

description.en: A DSH plugin that summarizes a user profile from past sessions and injects it into the system prompt so each new chat already knows your preferences.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件：从历史会话归纳用户画像，按预算裁剪后注入系统提示，让新会话自动了解你的偏好。

description.en: Adds a persistent first-prompt bar above the DSH conversation with a panel of every prompt you sent and one-click jump-back navigation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话上方添加常驻的首条提示栏，并提供包含所有已发送提示的面板，点击即可跳回。

description.en: Enhances short prompt drafts into structured prompts in the DSH Web GUI, with streaming preview, one-click fill-back, undo, and a settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中把简短草稿扩写为结构化提示词，支持流式预览、一键回填、撤销和设置页。

description.en: A composer button that rewrites and polishes your prompt draft in place, with selectable boost modes, editable templates and model choice.
description.zh: 输入框旁的按钮，可就地润色并增强提示词草稿，支持多种增强模式、模板编辑与模型选择。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button to the composer that enhances your prompt, showing a line diff with per-hunk accept plus clarifying questions and a refine loop.
description.zh: 在输入框添加闪光按钮来增强提示词，显示可按块接受的逐行差异，并支持澄清提问与迭代优化。

description.en: A prompt workbench for DSH that inspects system prompt segments, lets you write rules, checks duplication and contradictions, and logs changes.
description.zh: DSH 提示词工作台：查看 system prompt 各段、编写家规、检查重复与矛盾，并记录每次改动。

description.en: Rewrites your raw prompt into a clearer, more specific one via a composer ✦ Enhance button and an enhance_prompt host tool, returning only the rewritten prompt.
description.zh: 通过输入框「✦ 增强」按钮和 enhance_prompt 工具，把原始提示词改写为更清晰具体的版本，仅返回改写结果。

description.en: Turns a composer draft into an executable prompt, with code mode reading the workspace and auditing security and creative mode enriching prose.
description.zh: 将输入框草稿转化为可执行提示词：代码模式读取工作区并审计安全性，创意模式润色文案。

description.en: Inspect, view and trim every system-prompt section, context block and tool schema injected into a DSH conversation, with token estimates.
description.zh: 查看并裁剪 DSH 对话前注入的每个系统提示段落、上下文块和工具 schema，并提供 token 估算。

description.en: Reusable prompts in DeepSeek Harness Settings, with standalone SQLite storage or an existing Augmentor service.
Reads your past sessions to find recurring prompt mistakes and hands back paste-ready rewrites, plus a one-click draft tightener.
description.zh: 读取历史会话，找出反复出现的提问漏洞并给出可直接粘贴的改写，输入框旁一键生成更短的带约束版本。

description.en: Adds a ✨ button to the chat input right slot that writes a prompt-polishing template into the draft without sending or calling any model.
description.zh: 在会话输入框右座渲染 ✨ 按钮，点击即把「打磨提示词」模板写入草稿，不发送、不联网、不调模型。

description.en: DSH web plugin that rewrites a vague natural-language prompt into a clear, structured, professional prompt in one click, with undo.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：一键把含糊的自然语言提示词改写为任务明确、结构清晰的专业提示词，并可一键撤回原文。

description.en: Adds a one-click prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites your unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加一键提示词增强按钮，将未发送的草稿改写为更清晰具体的提示词，并支持一键还原。

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites your draft prompt in place, showing scene detection and self-check diagnostics.
description.zh: 在输入框旁添加按钮，就地改写你的草稿提示词，并弹出场景判断与自检诊断面板。

description.en: Prompt template library for DSH with categories, search, favorites, AI auto-tagging and 34 built-in templates.
description.zh: DSH 提示词模板库：分类折叠、搜索筛选、收藏、AI 智能归类，内置 34 条模板（含 9 条 AI Coding 思维快捷键），Liquid Glass 材质。

description.en: Prompt building and enhancement toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with Studio and QuickEnhancer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Prompt 构建与增强的工具包，包含 Studio 和 QuickEnhancer 两个组件。

description.en: Automatically verifies code after every edit — types, quality and tests — and forces the AI agent to fix errors before finishing.
description.zh: 在每次修改后自动校验代码（类型、质量和测试），并强制 AI 代理在完成任务前修复所有错误。

description.en: Automatically adds reasoning-level controls to compatible DeepSeek Harness provider models.
description.zh: 为兼容的 DeepSeek Harness 提供者模型自动添加推理等级控制。

description.en: Read-only diagnostics plugin that reports host, registration, credential and catalog evidence for model connections in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 只读诊断插件，汇总 DeepSeek Harness 模型连接的主机、插件、注册、凭据与目录证据并生成报告。

description.en: Shows remaining OpenRouter credit balance and OpenCode Go quota windows in the DSH sidebar footer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部显示 OpenRouter 剩余余额和 OpenCode Go 配额窗口。

description.en: DSH plugin that routes each AI account's API requests through its own proxy or direct connection, identified by the request's API key, with GUI hot-reload config.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供按账号分流的代理路由插件：依据请求携带的 API 密钥识别账号，分别走代理或直连，设置页图形化配置且保存即热生效。

description.en: Normalizes an omitted or undefined first argument in PTC run_code tool bindings so tools.foo() and tools.foo(undefined) no longer throw errors.
description.zh: 修复 PTC run_code 工具绑定中首个参数缺失或为 undefined 的问题，使 tools.foo() 与 tools.foo(undefined) 不再报错。

description.en: Market-gap radar for DSH plugin developers that ranks 6,000+ plugins by category and flags empty, sparse, competitive or saturated niches.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发者的市场空白雷达，按大类拆解 6,000+ 插件并标注空位、稀少、有竞争与红海方向，空位最多的排在最前。

description.en: Right-column control panel for dsh bundling cfsmcp2 contexts, LM Studio models, MCP servers and sessions in one place.
description.zh: dsh 的右侧控制面板，将 cfsmcp2 上下文、LM Studio 模型、MCP 服务器与会话集中在一处管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：提示词注入 + 引擎层补丁，适配 dsh 0.2.2-rc.2。上游 MIT 原作 by @YuJunZhiXue
Plays a PV video as DeepSeek Harness's default home page and screensaver, with Esc to return and volume controls.
description.zh: 把一支 PV 作为 DeepSeek Harness 的默认主页与屏保全屏循环播放，按 Esc 返回，并带音量控制。

description.en: DSH plugin that swaps the pwsh shell executor for an rtk rewrite subclass, transparently compacting every command to save tokens.
description.zh: DSH 插件：将 pwsh 执行器替换为 rtk 改写子类，所有命令执行前透明改写以节省 token。

description.en: DSH plugin for Qizhou CNC CAM with NC toolpath recognition, 3D preview and a full G-code editor.
description.zh: DSH 插件：启舟 CNC CAM，支持 NC 刀路识别、3D 预览与完整 G 代码编辑器。

description.en: Connects the official Qoder CLI (international and China editions) to DSH as a model provider via native ACP stdio, reusing existing CLI logins.
description.zh: 通过原生 ACP stdio 将官方 Qoder CLI（国际版与中国版）接入 DSH，作为模型提供商并复用 CLI 已有登录态。

description.en: A DSH settings panel that displays the QQ bridge bot's proactive dice-roll progress and hit statistics, and lets you edit the dice parameters live.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 设置面板插件，展示 QQ 桥接机器人主动投骰进度与命中统计，并支持在设置里实时修改投骰参数。

description.en: Listens to specified QQ groups via NapCat, batch-summarizes messages with a configured DSH model, and privately pushes per-group digests to chosen friends.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat 监听指定 QQ 群，按阈值分批调用 DSH 已配置模型生成群总结，并按群私聊推送给指定好友。

description.en: Sends a session summary to a QQ mailbox over SMTP whenever a work round stops, plus progress alerts for long-running tasks.
description.zh: 每轮工作真正停下后通过 SMTP 把会话摘要发到 QQ 邮箱，长任务运行过久时先发进度通报。

description.en: QQ双向桥插件，将QQ私聊接入DeepSeek Harness，支持驱动会话、推送通知。
description.zh: QQ双向桥插件，将QQ私聊接入DeepSeek Harness，可驱动会话并推送通知。

description.en: Extends the DSH QQ channel with group-chat support so you can remotely drive DeepSeek Harness from QQ groups and private chats.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 QQ 渠道增加群聊能力，可通过 QQ 群和私聊远程操控 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to QQ bots via OneBot 11/NapCat, relaying messages, media, commands and proactive pushes.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot 11/NapCat 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 机器人，实现消息、媒体、命令与主动推送的双向桥接。

description.en: Bridges DSH to QQ chat rooms via OneBot, mapping each chat to a room with whitelist/blacklist access control and group @-mentions.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot 将 DSH 接入 QQ 聊天室，每个聊天映射为一个房间，支持白/黑名单访问控制与群内 @ 提及。

description.en: QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with light/dark themes.
description.zh: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Light and dark share one QQ NT language.

description.en: Maintained QQ bot fork for DSH that merges consecutive messages into one agent turn and revises a single reply instead of spamming.
description.zh: DSH 的 QQ 机器人维护分支，可合并连续消息为一次对话，并只修订同一条回复而非重复发送。

description.en: A DSH QQ bot extension adding unified two-layer memory, per-group isolation, token saving, sticker packs and Bilibili sharing.
description.zh: DSH QQ 机器人扩展：统一双层记忆、按群隔离、省 token、表情包与 B 站分享。

description.en: Decodes QR codes from images, pasted screenshots and image URLs, and renders text into downloadable QR codes in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中从图片、粘贴截图和图片网址解码二维码，并把文本生成可下载的二维码。

description.en: A second model judges the assistant's reply before it is sent and sends it back for a rewrite when it fails the semantic criteria.
description.zh: 在发送前用第二个模型审查助手回复，不合判据就打回重写，并提供可视化质检面板。

description.en: Search your Quberi knowledge base from DeepSeek Harness with OAuth sign-in and read-only access.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 OAuth 登录，以只读方式搜索你的 Quberi 知识库。

description.en: DSH WebUI plugin: hoverable history query list to jump back to past questions in long conversations.
description.zh: DSH WebUI 插件：右缘短横线悬停显示历史提问列表，可一键跳回，支持同步提问、删除会话、长上下文加载更早

description.en: Adds a one-click archive button to every sidebar session row in DSH, placed beside the existing session menu.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏每个会话行旁添加一键归档按钮，紧邻会话菜单。

description.en: DSH plugin adding a persistent 9-grid quick-phrase pad beside the composer that inserts preset text at the cursor.
description.zh: DSH 插件：输入框左侧常驻九宫格快捷短语面板，点一格即把预设文字插入光标处。

description.en: VSCode-style Ctrl+P quick open for the DSH Web GUI: search indexed workspace files, open them in the sidebar editor, and insert references into the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 VSCode 风格 Ctrl+P 快速打开：搜索工作区索引文件、在侧边栏编辑器中打开并插入对话引用。

description.en: Adds slash-command shortcuts to the DSH composer that expand preset prompt text, with a config card to manage commands and call counts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加斜杠快捷指令，敲 /缩写 即可展开预设提示词，并在配置卡中管理指令与调用统计。

description.en: Adds a quick-reply panel and send button to the DSH composer so saved phrases can be sent to the session in one click.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加快捷回复面板和发送按钮，一键将保存的常用语句发送到当前会话。

description.en: Global-hotkey desktop assistant for DeepSeek Harness: in-app settings page, completion-first protocol, hard step budget.
DSH Desktop 随手记：flomo 风格随手记录，邮箱文件夹跨设备同步。
Adds a quiet dot-matrix whale backdrop and a blur-to-clear streaming text effect to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加安静的点阵鲸鱼背景，以及流式文本由模糊到清晰的显示效果。

description.en: Edit agent-written Markdown in place and send your inline comments back to the agent.
description.zh: 就地编辑智能体写入的 Markdown，并将你的批注回传给智能体。

description.en: DSH plugin for monitoring AI API balance/quota with DeepSeek peak/valley countdown, OpenCode Go quota, terminal-style panel, and persistent config.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，监控 AI API 余额与额度，支持 DeepSeek 峰谷倒计时、OpenCode Go 额度、Key 主机侧隔离、终端风格面板和配置持久化。

description.en: Floating ring in the DSH Web UI showing DeepSeek balance, today's spend, GPT Codex 5h/weekly limits and Gemini Antigravity pool quotas.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 中的悬浮配额环，显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日消费、GPT Codex 5小时/每周额度以及 Gemini Antigravity 三个池的用量。

description.en: Adds a failover layer over free-model routing that switches platforms and model tiers on quota exhaustion and auto-sends 「continue」 to resume interrupted tasks.
description.zh: 在免费模型之上加一层额度接力：按设定顺序切换平台与模型档，额度或限流中断后自动补发「继续」恢复任务。

description.en: Quote conversation text with optional annotations and send it to the model as structured reference context in DSH.
description.zh: 在DSH中引用对话文本并添加注释，将其作为结构化参考上下文发送给模型。

description.en: Archives group-chat quotes into a local SQLite library with search and recall, plus a OneBot v11 QQ channel and AstrBot management page.
description.zh: 将群聊语录归档到本地 SQLite 库并支持搜索与召回，附带 OneBot v11 QQ 通道和 AstrBot 管理页面。

description.en: Select text in DSH Web chat to quote it into the current conversation or dispatch it to a sub-agent conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话中划词，把选中内容引用到当前对话，或分派到子智能体对话。

description.en: Lets the model post to QQ Zone on its own via a silent headless Chrome session, with sticker images and configurable daily posting cadence.
description.zh: 通过静默无头 Chrome 让模型自主发布 QQ 空间说说，可配表情包图片，并自定每天条数、间隔与可见范围。

description.en: DSH plugin for QQ Zone: post image statuses, read recent feeds, edit nickname/signature/gender and change avatar via protocol-side APIs.
description.zh: DSH 的 QQ 空间插件：发带图说说、看最近动态、改昵称签名性别、换头像，默认走协议端接口。

description.en: Brings SenseTime xiaohuanxiong desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness as an LLM provider, with support for DSH 0.2.x and its forks.
description.zh: 将商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持 DSH 0.2.x 内核及其 fork。

description.en: Raindrop.io dashboard for DSH with collection, tag, domain and type analytics, monthly trends, cleanup backlog, and two agent tools.
description.zh: Raindrop.io 收藏库仪表盘：提供分类、标签、域名与类型分析、月度趋势、待清理项，并内置两个 Agent 工具。

description.en: DSH plugin leaderboard inside DeepSeek Harness settings, ranking community plugins by real npm download counts with daily, weekly and monthly views.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页查看 DSH 插件排行榜，按 npm 真实下载量提供日榜、周榜和月榜。

description.en: DSH plugin that periodically collects novel ranking lists from multiple sites, computes local changes, and shows them in a panel; zero runtime deps.
description.zh: DSH 扫榜插件：定时按需采集多站小说榜单，本地计算变化并在面板中查看，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Per-model rate limiting for DeepSeek Harness: rolling request/token budgets with FIFO queuing and automatic retry so agents avoid HTTP 429s.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按模型的速率限制：滚动窗口内的请求与令牌预算、FIFO 排队与自动重试，让智能体避免 HTTP 429。

description.en: Resident multi-connection download engine with agent tools and a sidebar panel for resumable, verifiable file transfers.
description.zh: 常驻多连接下载引擎，提供 rdm_* 智能体工具和侧边栏下载面板，支持可恢复且可校验的文件传输。

description.en: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar that reloads the UI without restarting the app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面标题栏添加刷新按钮，无需重启应用即可重新加载界面。

description.en: Lazy-loads 207 reverse-engineering tools into the DSH agent tool table, with runtime unpacking, an environment sidebar and one-click Ghidra/JADX/Apktool setup.
description.zh: 把 207 个逆向工具延迟加载进 DSH Agent 工具表，自带运行时解包、环境侧栏和一键准备 Ghidra/JADX/Apktool。

description.en: Agent watches a video segment by segment, accumulates plot, reacts or pauses to comment, then composites original video, voice, subtitles and Live2D into a finished video.
description.zh: Agent 分段观看影片、积累剧情后自主反应或暂停解说，再把原片、语音、字幕和 Live2D 合成为成品视频。

description.en: Adds a speaker button next to the Like button that reads any DSH reply aloud using the browser's built-in speech engine.
description.zh: 在点赞按钮旁添加小喇叭按钮，用浏览器自带语音引擎朗读 DSH 的任意回复。

description.en: Immersive read-only reading panel for DeepSeek Harness with low-blue-light themes, progress bar, and chapter browsing.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的沉浸式只读阅读面板，支持低蓝光主题、进度条和章节浏览。

description.en: Turns DSH into a reading workbench with a bookshelf, paginated reader, highlight annotations, and agent tools that read the text you are currently reading.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成阅读工作台：书架、分页阅读器、划线批注，并让 Agent 直接读取你正在阅读的正文。

description.en: Frugal tool layer that reads files precisely and exposes a self-serve tool catalog, cutting token re-billing in long sessions.
description.zh: 精简工具层：精确读取文件并提供自助工具目录，避免长会话重复计费整份文件。

description.en: 3D whale pet for dsh web UI; swims, reacts to attention, and calls on task events.
description.zh: 为dsh网页界面提供3D鲸鱼宠物：自由游泳、互动动画，并在任务事件时发出鲸鸣。

description.en: Adds a polished per-session slider to DeepSeek Harness for adjusting reasoning effort on models that declare reasoning levels.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加会话级滑动条，可调节声明推理等级的模型的推理强度。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style glowing slider to the DSH composer for adjusting model reasoning effort.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加 Codex 风格发光推理强度滑块，用于调节推理强度。

description.en: Auto-adds a reasoning-effort picker to every pi-ai model in dsh (DeepSeek Harness) for easy adjustment.
description.zh: 自动为dsh（DeepSeek Harness）中的每个pi-ai模型添加推理强度选择器，方便调整。

description.en: A Codex-style four-tier reasoning-effort slider and model selector for DeepSeek Harness with particle transitions and aurora styling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的类 Codex 四档推理强度滑块与模型选择器，带粒子过渡和极光渐变效果。

description.en: Offloads oversized tool results to disk, keeps a short head inline, and lets the model recall the rest on demand to save tokens.
description.zh: 将过大的工具结果转存到磁盘，仅在上下文中保留开头，模型可按需用 recall(id) 取回其余内容以节省 token。

description.en: Floating panel that gathers your recent deliverables (PDF, Office, images, text, web) for quick preview, renaming, organizing, or opening in a system app.
description.zh: 成品浮窗集中收纳最近的 PDF、Office、图片、文本和网页，可直接预览、改名、整理或用系统应用打开。

description.en: Adds a frosted-glass animated recharge button to the DSH sidebar that opens the official top-up page in a native view.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加毛玻璃启动动画充值按钮，并以原生视图打开官方充值页面。

description.en: Auto-resumes DSH turns interrupted by a host restart, enqueuing a continuation that requires the agent to verify real state first.
description.zh: DSH 宿主重启后自动恢复被中断的任务，并要求 Agent 先核对真实状态再继续。

description.en: Point at any page element, tweak it live, and send structured visual feedback to your DeepSeek Harness agent.
description.zh: 指向页面上任意元素，实时调整并把结构化视觉反馈发送给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。

description.en: 域中立的结构化引用渲染：行内 chip、悬浮预览、打开官方右侧栏。｜ Domain-neutral structured reference chips, hover preview, and host sidebar open for DeepSeek Harness.
A UI theme plugin that adds Obsidian Border-style Markdown styling and multiple color themes to the DeepSeek Harness frontend.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 前端注入 Obsidian Border 风格的 Markdown 美化与多主题配色。

description.en: One-click hot reload for DSH plugins: reload changed plugin code without restarting DSH, or restart the host when required.
description.zh: 一键热重载 DSH 插件：改动代码后无需重启即可生效，必要时也能安全重启整个 DSH。

description.en: Adds two top-left DSH buttons: smart UI refresh (re-syncs plugins when the manifest is stale) and full app restart without manual relaunch.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左上角添加两个按钮：智能刷新界面（清单过期时就地重同步插件）和一键重启应用，无需手动关闭重开。

description.en: Generates a browser session URL via link or QR code for remote access to dsh web, no log digging.
description.zh: 通过链接或二维码生成浏览器会话URL，供远程设备访问dsh web，无需翻日志。

description.en: Runs scheduled automation scripts on a remote Aliyun ECS via Cloud Assistant, with a dedicated sidebar page and agent tools.
description.zh: 通过云助手在远程阿里云ECS上运行定时自动化脚本，并提供独立侧边栏页面与智能体工具。

description.en: A remote multi-server GPU status board for DeepSeek Harness showing SSH-accessible GPU metrics in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板中显示可通过 SSH 访问的多台远程服务器 GPU 状态指标。

description.en: SSH session management plugin for DeepSeek Harness letting agents run remote commands, open interactive terminals, and transfer files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的 SSH 会话管理插件，让 Agent 可执行远程命令、打开交互终端并传输文件。

description.en: Dispatch tasks from a local DSH session to a DSH on another machine over SSH, stream its run events, and continue the same remote conversation.
description.zh: 从本地 DSH 会话通过 SSH 将任务派发到另一台机器上的 DSH，流式接收其运行事件，并继续同一远程对话。

description.en: Remote shell, file browsing and transfer over OpenSSH or WSL for DeepSeek Harness, with per-server environment notes and no server-side agent.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 OpenSSH 或 WSL 的远程 shell、文件浏览与传输，支持按服务器记录环境说明，服务器端无需安装 agent。

description.en: Open remote folders over SSH as workspaces, running all file and shell operations on the remote host in real time.
description.zh: 通过SSH将远程文件夹作为工作区打开，所有文件和Shell操作实时在远程主机上执行。

description.en: Adds a one-click "reset old replay" action in the original session to clear stale upstream resource bindings while keeping chat history.
description.zh: 在原会话中提供"重置旧回放"按钮，清除过期的上游资源绑定状态，同时保留原有聊天记录。

description.en: Turns chat into a per-session feature-requirements list, auto-merging repeat discussions into clear, editable entries.
description.zh: 把会话内容整理成每会话独立的功能需求清单，重复讨论自动合并成易懂且可编辑的条目。

description.en: Re-runs any earlier turn in a DSH session in place, regenerating its reply from the same prompt while every later turn survives untouched.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中就地重跑任意更早的一轮：用相同提示重新生成回复，后续所有轮次保持不变。

description.en: Turns DSH requirements into an executable spec, tracing every number to a provenance ledger and auditing PDF/OOXML metadata and archive manifests.
description.zh: 把 DSH 需求转为可执行规范，将每个数字追溯到来源账本，并审计 PDF/OOXML 元数据与归档清单。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you edit an already-sent message — text, image order, add or delete images — and resend it, plus @-mention image references.
description.zh: DSH 插件：编辑已发出的消息（改文字、增删图片、拖动排序）后重新发送，并支持用 @ 引用图片。

description.en: Displays always-visible metadata for DeepSeek Harness replies: model, reasoning, throughput, timestamp, runtime, and TTFT.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每条回复常驻显示模型、推理、吞吐量、时间戳、运行时长和首字延迟（TTFT）等元数据。

description.en: Schedules a self-restart of DeepSeek Harness via a countdown card with cancel button and an out-of-process watchdog that kills and relaunches DSH.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自助重启：倒计时卡片、取消按钮，以及进程外看守程序负责结束并重新拉起 DSH。

description.en: Adds process controls to DSH web settings: restart the dsh web host process and enable start-on-boot via launchd, systemd, or Windows services.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页设置中加入进程控制：手动重启 dsh web 宿主进程，并可通过 launchd/systemd/Windows 服务实现开机自启与崩溃自动重启。

description.en: Adds a Windows-only restart button at the bottom of the DSH sidebar that relaunches the app after a confirm click, with no leftover console window.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏底部添加仅限 Windows 的「重新启动」按钮，二次点击确认后一键重启，且不残留控制台窗口。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button that fully quits and relaunches DeepSeek Harness Desktop with a single click.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加重启按钮，一键完全退出并重新启动 DeepSeek Harness Desktop。

description.en: Two-step confirmed restart of the DeepSeek Harness that saves a handoff record, then resumes sessions, sub-agents and Agent Team teammates on its own.
description.zh: 通过带确认令牌的两步工具重启 DeepSeek Harness，写入交接记录，重启后自动恢复会话、子代理与 Agent Team 队友继续工作。

description.en: Adds a one-click force-restart button so you can relaunch the DeepSeek Harness desktop app without leaving it.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用添加一键强制重启按钮，无需离开应用即可重新启动。

description.en: Adds composer-toolbar controls to reload the Cordis kernel or fully relaunch the DeepSeek Harness app.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏添加重启开关，可重载 Cordis 内核或完整重启 DeepSeek Harness 应用。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button and /restart command to one-click restart the dsh-web service via systemd, with WSL/Linux and Windows support.
description.zh: 在侧栏添加按钮和 /restart 命令，通过 systemd 一键重启 dsh-web 服务，支持 WSL/Linux 与 Windows，重启后会话自动续接。

description.en: One-click cross-platform restart button for DeepSeek Harness Web UI
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供一键重启按钮，支持跨平台使用。

description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness via a sidebar button, /restart command and harness_restart tool sharing one restart implementation.
description.zh: 一键重启 DeepSeek Harness：侧栏按钮、/restart 指令与 harness_restart 工具共用同一套重启实现。

description.en: Paste a job description and your resume; the AI rewrites your resume to fit the role using only real experience, never fabricating.
description.zh: 粘贴岗位描述与简历原文，AI 按岗位重写简历，只基于真实经历，绝不编造。

description.en: Automatically wakes up agent after restart and sends an informational message; agent decides whether to resume work.
description.zh: 重启后自动唤醒 agent 并投递信息性消息，由 agent 自行决定是否恢复工作

description.en: Retro instrument-dial dock for DeepSeek Harness that displays live tokens/sec, context pressure and cache hit rate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供复古仪表盘，实时显示每秒 token 数、上下文压力和缓存命中率。

description.en: A DSH plugin that replaces hardcoded model retries with a settings-page policy for retry budget, backoff curve and failure codes.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用设置页可配置的重试策略替代写死重试，可调重试次数、退避曲线与失败码，保存即生效。

description.en: Packages 23 reverse-engineering and Mac-app-building agent skills, plus an optional REA MCP server, as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 将 23 个逆向工程与 Mac 应用开发智能体技能及可选 REA MCP 服务打包为 DSH 插件。

description.en: Adds a folder icon next to the Produces row to reveal files in DSH.
description.zh: 在 Produces 行旁添加一个文件夹图标，用于在 DSH 中显示对应文件。

description.en: DSH approval hub: hard risks always ask you, repeated safe commands auto-allow via memory, the rest get a small-model pre-review with honest attribution.
description.zh: DSH 审批中枢:硬风险必问人,重复无害命令按记忆自动放行,其余交给小模型预审,并如实记录每道审批的归属。

description.en: Lets dsh edit AI answers in place, adds model/provider attribution and a floating outline sidebar for the conversation.
description.zh: 让 dsh 可以就地修改 AI 回答正文，并在时间行补上模型/提供方署名，同时显示对话大纲悬浮栏。

description.en: Adds a session replay view that streams playback turn by turn, re-runs the session into a fresh one, and records the playback as WebM video.
description.zh: 新增 DSH 会话回放视图：逐轮流式重放、一键复刻到新会话，并能把回放录制成 WebM 视频。

description.en: Rhine Lab style theme for DeepSeek Harness web client, restyling sidebar, sessions, and details with lab-inspired colors.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端提供明日方舟莱茵生命实验室风格主题，重绘侧边栏、会话列表与详情区的配色外观。

description.en: RingCentral Team Messaging IM channel plugin for dsh, letting users chat with an AI agent via threaded posts.
description.zh: dsh 的 RingCentral 团队消息 IM 频道插件，让用户通过主题帖与 AI 智能体对话。

description.en: RIS IDE is a local dev panel inside the DSH web GUI for tailing logs, running workspace programs, debugging Java via JDWP, and editing files.
description.zh: RIS IDE 是 DSH Web GUI 内的本地开发面板，可查看日志、启停工作区程序、通过 JDWP 调试 Java 并浏览编辑文件。

description.en: A human-in-the-loop confirmation gate that intercepts high-risk actions like git push, registry edits and global installs before they run.
description.zh: 为高危操作增加人工确认闸门，在执行 git push、改注册表、装全局包等动作前先请求批准。

description.en: Adds a local-first mobile web access layer to DeepSeek Harness, letting you scan a QR code and continue sessions from your phone.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加本地优先的移动网页接入层，扫码即可在手机上继续会话。

description.en: Context-aware skill cockpit for DSH that recommends from 6,399 skills, remembers experience, and safely updates or rolls back the archive.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的上下文感知技能驾驶舱：从 6,399 个技能中推荐，记忆经验，并安全更新或回滚技能库。

description.en: DSH router plugin adding Loomy (iFlyTek) as an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions supplier for dsh.
description.zh: 将讯飞 Loomy 作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商接入 dsh router 的插件。

description.en: Adds Qoder model providers (China and international editions) to the DSH router so requests can be routed to Qoder models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 路由添加 Qoder 模型供应商（国内版与国际版），使请求可以路由到 Qoder 模型。

description.en: Shows your RouterAI balance and per-request LLM costs inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, including subagent usage.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中显示 RouterAI 余额和每次请求的 LLM 费用，包括子代理用量。

description.en: RSS feed monitoring plugin with multi-source subscribe, keyword filtering, scheduled dedup, and email notifications.
description.zh: 多源 RSS 订阅监控插件，支持关键词过滤、定时检查去重，新条目按 HTML 模板邮件通知，SMTP 密码存凭据库，附四页签原生设置页。

description.en: DSH plugin that builds a scheduled daily RSS news briefing with an LLM summary plus a full side-panel reader, tunable ranking and custom feeds.
description.zh: DSH 插件：定时生成 RSS 每日要闻简报（LLM 总结 + 重要条目），并有右侧栏全量阅读器、可调教排序与自定义源。

description.en: Adds a /rst command that restarts DSH through an external launcher and writes the restart receipt back to the originating session.
description.zh: 提供 /rst 命令，通过进程外启动器重启 DSH，并把重启回执写回发起重启的会话。

description.en: DSH plugin for Chinese Soft Exam system-analyst essays: question-bank index, 10-section writing/rewriting guidance, per-paragraph self-review and Word delivery.
description.zh: 软考系统分析师论文 DSH 插件：题库速查、10 段式写作与改写规范、逐段自评建议，并支持 Word 交付。

description.en: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in DSH replies, executing commands on the host and streaming output to a dock or bottom panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 回复中的命令行代码块添加「运行」按钮，在宿主机执行命令并将输出流式显示在浮动面板或底部面板标签页。

description.en: Adds vendor badges to the DeepSeek Harness model picker and keeps the model list in sync with the provider.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器中显示厂商标识，并让模型列表与提供商保持同步。

description.en: 三合一工具台 · Skills / MCP / CLI 管理器：一个设置页统一管理 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）agent 的三类工具，MCP 走真实连接。 / Skills, MCP and CLI manager for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — one page, real connections.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中用一个页面集中管理 Skills、MCP 和 CLI，并建立真实连接。

description.en: Unofficial Windows guard that snapshots old file bytes and blocks destructive file operations during unattended DSH workflows.
description.zh: 非官方 Windows 插件，在无人值守 DSH 工作流中先备份旧文件字节，并拦截永久删除等危险文件操作。

description.en: Self-protection guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: intercepts protected paths, backs up before destroy, and enforces sandbox defaults.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自我保护机制：拦截受保护路径、删除前备份、提供命令行自恢复，并默认启用严格沙箱。

description.en: Manages SakuraFrp intranet tunneling inside dsh: hosts frpc, aligns ports in one click, shows traffic/remaining percent and a public password gate.
description.zh: 在 dsh 内管理 SakuraFrp 内网穿透：托管 frpc、一键对齐端口、显示流量与剩余百分比，并提供公网密码门。

description.en: Adds an animated mascot GIF to the bottom-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with draggable positioning.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面右下角添加可拖拽的动画月薪猫吉祥物 GIF。

description.en: Lets your DSH speak and report content aloud using a voice you choose, with OS built-in TTS by default.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 用你喜欢的声音开口说话并汇报内容，默认使用系统自带语音。

description.en: Sidebar schedule assistant combining today's plan, calendar, to-dos, reminders, multi-city weather, almanac, horoscope and auto daily/weekly reports.
description.zh: 侧边栏日程助手：今日安排、日历、待办提醒、多城市天气、黄历星座，并自动生成日报周报。

description.en: Write a message in the DeepSeek Harness composer and have it auto-delivered into the same conversation later as a normal user message.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器中写好消息，设定时间后自动作为普通用户消息发送到同一会话。

description.en: Academic research preset for DeepSeek Harness with a download-paper skill: multi-source literature search, CNKI link mapping and HTML/XLSX/BibTeX/RIS/arXiv exports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 学术研究预设与 download-paper 技能：多源文献检索、知网链接映射，并输出 HTML/XLSX/BibTeX/RIS/arXiv 五种格式。

description.en: A browsable, categorized skill wall for DeepSeek Harness that manages skills and inserts their /command into the current session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可浏览、可分类的技能墙，并支持用 /命令 在当前会话调用技能。

description.en: Shows SCNet Token Plan remaining credits, daily burn and token breakdown inside DeepSeek Harness, plus per-message credit estimates.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看 SCNet Token Plan 剩余额度、每日消耗与 token 构成，并估算每条消息消耗的 Credits。

description.en: Built-in Windows screenshot tool for DeepSeek Harness: instant region capture, annotations and a colour picker, all processed locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内置的 Windows 截图工具，支持即时框选、标注与取色，全部本地处理。

description.en: Iterative screenshot review loop: agent captures a page, views it, revises code, and re-screenshots until UI matches requirements.
description.zh: 截屏审阅循环：智能体截取页面、看图识别问题、修改代码并重复，直到界面符合要求。

description.en: Windows screenshot plugin adding a camera button to the chat input plus an agent-callable tool for region, window, and full-screen captures.
description.zh: Windows 截图插件：聊天输入框相机按钮 + Agent 可调用的截图工具，支持框选区域、指定窗口与整屏截图。

description.en: Full-screen screenshot panel for DSH with marquee capture, annotation, insert/copy/save, plus offline OCR and translation.
description.zh: DSH 全屏截图面板：框选截图、标注、插入/复制/保存，并支持离线 OCR 与翻译。

description.en: Sidebar picker that lets you switch the DSH web search provider between DeepSeek Messages, DeepSeek Search API, OpenCode Go, Tavily and Exa.
description.zh: 侧边栏搜索提供商选择器，可在 DeepSeek Messages、DeepSeek Search API、OpenCode Go、Tavily 和 Exa 之间切换 DSH 的网页搜索后端。

description.en: Adds a search engine switcher dropdown next to the model picker in DeepSeek Harness composer, changing the preferred search provider without settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器的模型选择器旁添加搜索引擎切换下拉菜单，无需进入设置即可更改首选搜索服务商。

description.en: Sends a stuck question to an independent advisor session and returns its plan inline as a tool result, with no user relaying.
description.zh: 将卡住的问题交给独立的顾问会话单独分析，并作为工具结果直接返回方案，无需用户转述。

description.en: Lets DSH watch your screen during an IM-style chat with token-efficient sampling, a floating chat window, mid-turn messages and listen-only mode.
description.zh: 让 DSH 在观看屏幕的同时以即时通讯方式聊天，支持高效采样、浮动聊天窗、回合中消息和只听模式。

description.en: Adds selection actions in the DSH Web GUI to quote a chat fragment into your message or open it in a parallel side chat.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中为选中对话片段添加操作：引用到当前消息，或在并行侧聊中打开。

description.en: Cross-session self-improvement plugin for DeepSeek Harness with persistent weighted memory, retrospectives, SOP skills and improvement proposals.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话自我改进插件，提供持久加权记忆、复盘、SOP 技能与改进建议。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a self-narrative memory where the model writes notes to itself, persisted across sessions and injected back each turn.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自我叙述记忆：模型写下给自己的笔记，跨会话保留并在每回合注入。

description.en: A versioned vocabulary of project business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and consistent naming rules injected into agent prompts.
description.zh: 为项目业务概念提供版本化词汇表，支持只读漂移扫描，并将统一命名规则注入每个 agent 提示词。

description.en: Semantic versioning toolbox for parsing, comparing, and range-checking semver strings with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供语义化版本工具箱，解析、比较并判断版本是否满足 ^、~、>=、<=、x 范围、连字符和 || 等范围条件，零运行时依赖。

description.en: DSH plugin that schedules a delayed or timed message (default "continue") into the current session from beside the input box.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在输入框旁设置延时或指定时间，向当前会话发送一条消息（默认「继续」）。

description.en: Changes Enter to insert a newline in DSH Web. Use Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to send messages.
Redacts secrets, tokens and passwords into <SG_> placeholders before they reach the model, keeping real values in an AES-256-GCM encrypted local vault.
description.zh: 在敏感信息进入模型上下文前将其替换为 <SG_> 占位符，真值以 AES-256-GCM 加密保存在本地保管库中。

description.en: Deepseek Harness 敏感字符自动替换插件，用于替换模型读取的敏感字符从而避免官方 API 400 错误。
Generates SEO-friendly full articles from keywords and language, with structured output and adjustable length.
description.zh: 关键词驱动生成SEO友好的完整文章，支持多语言、多种语气和字数调整。

description.en: Adds a persistent persona, emotion state, and file-based memory to DSH so your AI character remembers you across sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入持久人格、情绪状态与基于文件的记忆，让 AI 角色在会话之间记住你。

description.en: Windows serial debug console in the DSH right sidebar with COM ports, ANSI logs, an in-log Linux terminal, command buttons and multi-port tabs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏提供 Windows 串口调试控制台，支持 COM 端口、ANSI 日志、日志内 Linux 终端、命令按钮和多端口标签页。

description.en: Sends ServerChan3 push notifications when an agent turn finishes an answer.
description.zh: 在 agent 每轮回答结束时通过 ServerChan3（Server酱）发送推送通知的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，对应 codex Stop 钩子行为。

description.en: Organizes DSH sidebar sessions by activity tiers (Hot, Warm, Cool, Cold) with Focus mode.
description.zh: 按活跃度把 DSH 侧边栏会话分为 Hot、Warm、Cool、Cold 四档，并提供 Focus 专注模式

description.en: Manages archived sessions from DeepSeek Harness Settings: view, unarchive, delete, batch delete, delete all.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中查看并管理归档会话，支持取消归档、删除、批量删除和全部删除。

description.en: Deletes a DSH session along with its workspace artifacts, previewing the reconstructed file list and total size.
description.zh: 删除 DSH 会话及其产生的工作区文件，并从会话日志重建文件清单、预览总大小。

description.en: Backs up every DSH session before deletion, supports batch session selection in the Web GUI, and restores backups in one click.
description.zh: 在删除前备份每个 DSH 会话，支持在 Web GUI 中批量选择会话，并可一键恢复备份。

description.en: Batch-delete DeepSeek Harness session chat records, optionally removing the files each conversation produced, with running vs in-memory status shown.
description.zh: 批量删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话聊天记录，可选择同时删除每个对话产生的文件，并显示运行中与内存中的状态。

description.en: Adds a persistent multi-session split view to the DSH main window so you can view several sessions side by side.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主窗口中提供持久化的多会话分屏视图，可并排查看多个会话。

description.en: List, read and message every DSH session from one CLI or as a plugin, letting you chat across sessions with a per-turn menu.
description.zh: 通过一个 CLI 或插件列出、读取并向任意 DSH 会话发消息，以逐轮菜单实现跨会话聊天。

description.en: DSH plugin whose /bundle command exports a session's transcript, raw log, attachments and produced files into a ZIP on disk.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 /bundle 命令将可读对话、原始日志、附件和会话产出文件导出为本地 ZIP 包。

description.en: Organizes workspace sessions into categories with drag-and-drop ordering and activity indicators in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区会话提供分类、拖拽排序和活动指示功能。

description.en: Share a selected range of session chat messages as Markdown, HTML, TXT, or PNG in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将选定范围的会话聊天消息导出分享为 Markdown、HTML、TXT 或 PNG 格式。

description.en: Sidebar panel for DSH that sorts sessions by size, archives or deletes them into an undoable recycle bin, and cleans orphan cache entries.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件：按体积排序会话，支持归档与删除到可撤销回收站，并清理孤立投影缓存与失效归档项。

description.en: Injects a per-session clock and tracks durable idle gaps across turns and sessions for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话注入时钟信号，并持久记录跨轮次、跨会话的空闲间隔。

description.en: Right-click any session row in the DSH sidebar to color-tag it with ten palette colors or a custom picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏会话行上右键即可标色，支持十种预设颜色和自定义取色器。

description.en: DSH session manager: archive/restore, AI auto-rename, auto-resume interrupted runs, workspace grouping, full-text search, and log repair.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档恢复、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、全文搜索与损坏日志修复。

description.en: Adds one button to the DSH session header that copies a deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, or the working directory.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏添加一键复制按钮，可复制深度链接、整段对话 Markdown 或工作目录。

description.en: Shows cumulative API cost for current session and per-reply cost in DeepSeek Harness UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面显示当前会话的累计 API 费用以及每次回复的花费。

description.en: Adds a session recycle bin and permanent delete workflow to DeepSeek Harness, with one-click restore and batch removal.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加会话回收站与永久删除功能，支持一键恢复和批量清除。

description.en: Permanently deletes a DSH session — chat log, projection cache, spill files, and spawned subagent sessions — via a sidebar menu with confirmation.
description.zh: 通过侧边栏菜单和确认对话框，永久删除 DSH 会话的聊天记录、投影缓存、溢出文件及其创建的子代理会话。

description.en: Adds a destructive Delete session action that removes a session and its subagent sessions' logs, cache and workspace data from disk.
description.zh: 添加真正的“删除会话”操作，可从磁盘彻底删除会话及其子智能体会话的日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

description.en: Adds a 3-day recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness sessions, letting you soft-delete sessions and later restore or permanently purge them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话增加 3 天回收站：可软删除会话，并在侧边栏底部恢复或彻底清除。

description.en: 给 DSH 会话列表加一个能真删除的按钮：让宿主 registry 遗忘、清掉正文与投影缓存。零依赖小插件，附说明与免责声明。
给DSH工作区对话加上“删除”“多选”功能 Right-click delete + multi-select batch archive/delete for the DSH sidebar session list. Self-contained, no third-party plugin.
Delete stored DSH sessions and individual messages from the web UI, with recycle bin and reversible per-message removal.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中删除已存储的 DSH 会话与单条消息，默认进回收站，支持可逆的逐条删除与截断。

description.en: Adds a "Files" tab in each DSH session header listing session deliverables with one-click attachment download.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个会话顶栏新增「文件」视图，列出本会话交付的文件，并支持一键按附件下载。

description.en: Shows session-scoped git-style diff decoration in the DeepSeek Harness web right sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页右侧边栏中展示会话级的 git 风格差异装饰。

description.en: Full-text search across every DSH chat session with one-click jump to the matched message.
description.zh: 对全部 DSH 聊天记录做全文搜索，并一键跳转到命中的那条消息。

description.en: Scans and repairs DSH session records with broken tool_use/tool_result pairing by reordering assistant content blocks.
description.zh: 扫描并修复 DSH 中 tool_use/tool_result 配对损坏的会话记录，通过调整助手消息块顺序解决。

description.en: Adds right-click context menus to session rows and conversation files for opening folders in File Explorer, launching VS Code, revealing files, and copying paths.
description.zh: 为会话行和对话文件添加右键菜单，可打开文件资源管理器、启动 VS Code、定位文件及复制路径。

description.en: Adds a Git tab to every DSH session, showing branch lanes, commits, diffs, refs and working-tree actions for that session's own repository.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话添加 Git 标签页，展示该会话独立仓库的分支泳道、提交、差异、引用及工作区操作。

description.en: A draggable, resizable, always-on-top WinUI 3 HUD window showing what running DSH sessions are doing and any pending approvals.
description.zh: 一个可拖动缩放、置顶的 WinUI 3 悬浮窗，实时显示运行中 DSH 会话的当前工作与待批准提示。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar kanban board to the DeepSeek Harness for tracking sessions, current work, todos, progress and a searchable activity heatmap.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 左侧边栏添加看板，用于跟踪会话、当前工作、待办、进度以及可搜索的活动热力图。

description.en: Adds workspace and Git branch labels beneath each session row in the flat session list for quick context.
description.zh: 在扁平会话列表中为每个会话行显示所属工作区和 Git 分支，便于快速辨识上下文。

description.en: Permanently deletes archived DSH sessions and scans away ghost rows and orphaned session records, explaining any refusal.
description.zh: 永久删除已归档的 DSH 会话，并扫描清理幽灵行与失联的孤儿会话记录，拒绝时给出依据。

description.en: Manage archived DSH sessions: list, restore, permanently delete, with settings page and context menu delete.
description.zh: 管理DSH已归档会话：列出、恢复、永久删除，设置页和右键菜单删除。

description.en: Manage DSH sessions with recoverable trash, force delete, stats, continue/pause, unread marks, workspace grouping, and compaction thresholds.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 会话：可恢复回收站、强制删除、统计、继续/暂停、未读标记、工作区分组与上下文压缩阈值。

description.en: Adds a sidebar session manager to DeepSeek Harness for sorting, filtering, and bulk hard-deleting sessions and workspaces.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加会话管理，可排序、筛选并批量硬删除会话与工作区。

description.en: Adds a gradient or a hand-drawn line pattern to sessions in the left session list so they are easier to tell apart.
Exports a DeepSeek Harness session as a readable Markdown file containing only the dialogue.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话一键导出为只含对话内容的可读 Markdown 文件。

description.en: Enhances DSH sessions with one-click workspace opening, provider header menu, and adding selected text to conversation.
description.zh: DSH 会话增强插件：一键打开工作区、在模型提供商菜单顶部显示头部、将选中文本加入对话。

description.en: Injects a user-configurable prompt at the top of every session's system prompt, editable from settings.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可在每个会话系统提示最顶部注入用户自定义提示词，并可在设置页编辑。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-injects custom system prompts into new sessions, with persistent storage and UI editing.
description.zh: DSH插件，自动向新会话注入自定义系统提示词，并支持提示词的持久化存储与界面编辑。

description.en: Session Rail adds a session guide rail to DSH so you can see and move between your sessions more easily.
description.zh: 会话引导栏为 DSH 增加一条会话导航栏，方便查看并快速切换各个会话。

description.en: Adds a session recycle bin to DSH so deleted sessions are archived and restorable, with a settings page to permanently delete logs or bulk-clean them.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加会话回收站：删除会话先归档并可还原，设置页可集中管理、彻底删除磁盘日志并批量清理。

description.en: Session and file rewind plugin using a shadow git repo for checkpoint and rollback.
description.zh: 使用影子Git仓库实现会话与文件回退的插件，支持检查点与回滚。

description.en: Automatically splits long chat sessions into volumes with handoff snapshots, keeping old volumes as read-only archives so long tasks continue.
description.zh: 长会话按轮次自动分卷，新卷携带待办与步骤交接摘要继续工作，旧卷保留为只读归档。

description.en: Global search across all DeepSeek Harness session content, with results ordered by content time.
description.zh: 在全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话内容中进行全局搜索，结果按内容时间排序。

description.en: A persistent search bar that keyword-searches message bodies across all past DeepSeek Harness sessions and jumps to the matched text.
description.zh: 常驻会话页顶部的搜索栏，可按关键词搜索所有历史会话的消息正文，并直接跳转到命中文字。

description.en: DSH session manager: preview, archive, unarchive, and permanently delete chat sessions with Markdown preview.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理插件，支持只读 Markdown 预览会话内容，并可归档、取消归档或彻底删除会话（移入系统回收站），零依赖且不修改官方代码。

description.en: DSH session communication plugin: copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view token usage, billing tokens, and cache hit rate.
description.zh: DSH 会话通信插件：复制会话 ID，向在线或已保存会话发送消息，并查看 token 用量、计费 token 与缓存命中率。

description.en: Moves DeepSeek Harness sessions to a recoverable 7-day trash and lets you edit already-sent requests by branching the conversation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话移入可恢复的 7 天回收站，并支持通过分支方式编辑已发送的请求。

description.en: AI-regenerates a session's title from its last 10 user prompts using the same model the session last used.
description.zh: 使用会话最后使用的模型，根据最近10条用户提示词用AI重新生成会话标题。

description.en: Adds two conversation-header buttons that move a session into another workspace (optionally archiving it) and switch the session's agent preset.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加两个按钮，可将当前会话迁移到其他工作区（可选归档）并切换该会话的 Agent 预设。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that mirrors the main-view session into the URL fragment and reopens the linked conversation on load — browser half only, no dependencies, no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：将主视图会话同步到 URL 片段，并在加载时打开链接的对话；仅含浏览器端，无依赖、无遥测。

description.en: Move cold DeepSeek Harness sessions between registered workspaces without changing ID or history.
description.zh: 在已注册工作区之间迁移冷置的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，保持会话 ID 与历史记录不变。

description.en: Gives every new conversation its own isolated workspace folder and sandbox, so files stay invisible across chats, with a runtime toggle by the input box.
description.zh: 为每个新对话自动分配独立工作区文件夹与独立沙箱，跨对话文件互不可见，输入框旁提供运行时开关。

description.en: Adds an About page to dsh Settings showing runtime version, environment, and installed plugins.
description.zh: dsh Settings → About plugin: runtime version, env, installed plugins (requires @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1)

description.en: A DSH plugin for arranging and organizing the DSH settings panel, based on its name and package metadata.
description.zh: 一个用于整理和排列 DSH 设置面板的插件（依据名称与包信息）。

description.en: Adds a gear button to DeepSeek Harness that opens the Settings dialog in one click, from desktop or a phone over the LAN.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中新增齿轮按钮，一键打开设置对话框，桌面端或通过局域网在手机上均可使用。

description.en: Adds vertical scrolling to DSH Web settings navigation when sections exceed viewport.
description.zh: 为DSH Web设置导航在区块超出视口时添加垂直滚动。

description.en: Centrally manages host-injected environment variables in one YAML file and hot-reloads whitelisted plugins so new values apply without restarting DSH.
description.zh: 在一个 YAML 文件中集中管理注入宿主的环境变量，并可热重载白名单插件，无需重启 DSH 即可读取新值。

description.en: A unified settings page UI kit and floating panel kit for DeepSeek Harness plugins, exposing ctx.settingsUi.
description.zh: DSH Web 统一设置页 UI kit：ctx.settingsUi 客户端服务（原子组件 + 设置状态机 + 浮层面板），供其它插件接入设置页与浮层

description.en: Parallel cognitive runtime for DeepSeek Harness running shadow agents for independent reviews and fact checking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供并行认知运行时，运行影子智能体进行独立评审和事实核查。

description.en: A hand-drawn mountain-lake pastoral DSH theme that shifts from dawn to night with local time and animates farmers based on task activity.
description.zh: 一套手绘山湖田园 DSH 主题，随本机时间呈现晨昏昼夜，并让农人随对话任务状态进出田间。

description.en: Import public DeepSeek and Doubao chat share links into DSH as static, resumable sessions.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek 和豆包的公开聊天分享链接导入 DSH，保存为可恢复的静态会话。

description.en: Read-only diff review for CSV/XLSX files that aligns business keys, inspects values and formulas, and exports review comments.
description.zh: 只读比对 CSV/XLSX 文件，按业务主键对齐，检查数值与公式，并导出评审意见。

description.en: Enhances DSH Web bash/pwsh command cards: wraps long commands with line numbers, adds copy command/output buttons, and shows exit codes on failures.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web 的 bash/pwsh 命令卡片：长命令自动折行并显示行号，增加复制命令/输出按钮，失败时显示退出码。

description.en: DSH hands-off mode safety net: sends deleted directories to recycle bin, never follows links, zero approval.
description.zh: DSH 脱手模式安全网：删除目录先移入回收站，删除链接时不跟随，且无需审批。

description.en: Top-down arena shooter panel for the DSH sidebar with autopilot watch mode, bosses, combos, upgrades, a leaderboard, skins and a floating desk fish.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的俯视竞技场射击游戏面板，支持自动巡航观战、Boss、连击、升级、排行榜、皮肤和漂浮桌面鱼。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek account wallet balance in the harness status bar, with a panel for recharge, granted and total figures.
description.zh: 在 harness 状态栏显示 DeepSeek 账户钱包余额，并提供充值、赠送与总额面板。

description.en: Adds a shutdown button to DSH Web GUI sidebar; confirms and safely exits the process.
description.zh: 在DSH Web界面侧栏添加关机按钮，确认后安全结束进程。

description.en: Adds a sidebar card that monitors task status and automatically shuts down the machine once all tasks finish, with customizable visuals and rules.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加卡片，实时监控任务状态，并在所有任务完成后自动关机，支持多样化视觉效果与个性化规则。

description.en: DSH closing-animation plugin that plays a video and end card when you exit the web UI, pairing with dsh-startup-screen.
description.zh: DSH 关闭动画插件，退出 Web UI 时播放视频与结束卡，与 dsh-startup-screen 启动动画配套使用。

description.en: Select text in the main session and get a read-only sidebar branch that inherits context, streams answers, and never pollutes the main session.
description.zh: 在主会话中选中文本即可打开只读侧边分支会话，继承上下文并流式回答，不污染主会话上下文。

description.en: A read-only system monitor sidebar for DSH showing live host overview, process list, and Docker container status.
description.zh: DSH 系统监控侧边栏插件，只读显示主机概览、进程列表和 Docker 容器状态。

description.en: DSH plugin that gives the agent native control of the right-sidebar browser: read, click, type, scroll, eval JS and screenshot real pages via Electron webview.
description.zh: DSH 插件，让智能体原生操控右侧栏浏览器：通过 Electron webview 读取、点击、输入、滚动、执行 JS 并截图真实页面。

description.en: Agent control for the DSH built-in sidebar browser with element refs, batch actions, queries, reads and diffs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏浏览器提供智能体控制，支持元素引用、批量操作、查询、读取和差异对比。

description.en: Adds a sidebar density control centre to DSH with five fold switches plus three density and three width presets.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加侧边栏密度控制中心，包含五个折叠开关以及三种密度和三种宽度预设。

description.en: Adds an editor view to DSH's right-sidebar document preview: CodeMirror source editing plus direct Markdown editing in the rendered view.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏文档预览新增「编辑器」视图：CodeMirror 源码编辑，并可在渲染视图中直接编辑 Markdown。

description.en: Adds a one-click expand-all control to the DSH sidebar session list, with a strict collapse-to-5 behaviour.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏会话列表添加一键展开全部按钮，并严格折叠至 5 条。

description.en: Stacks sidebar footer slot entries vertically, unifies their card chrome, and lets you drag them to reorder.
description.zh: 将侧边栏页脚槽位条目垂直堆叠，统一卡片外观，并支持拖拽重新排序。

description.en: Adds a mobile/tablet device-preview browser tab to the DSH right sidebar with device presets, and lets you insert the current page URL via @ or /url.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏新增「移动端预览」标签页，按手机/平板尺寸打开网页，并可用 @ 或 /url 把当前页面地址插入输入框。

description.en: Adds sidebar layout modes to DeepSeek Harness: compact mode, right sidebar, and collapsible rail.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加侧边栏布局模式：紧凑模式、右侧边栏和可折叠侧栏。

description.en: Folds third-party plugin entries in the dsh left sidebar into a More menu, and remembers your choice across reloads.
description.zh: 将 dsh 左侧边栏中的第三方插件入口收纳进 More 菜单，并在重载后保留选择。

description.en: Theme-adaptive TODO list and sticky-note board for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with agent read/write tools.
Open and edit .docx/.xlsx/.pptx in a sidebar editor via self-hosted ONLYOFFICE Document Server with JWT security and atomic save-back.
description.zh: 通过自托管ONLYOFFICE文档服务器，在侧边栏编辑器中打开和编辑.docx/.xlsx/.pptx文件，支持JWT安全与原子保存。

description.en: Floating sidebar overlay that renders an independent workspace/session browser in the official shell.overlay seat, leaving the default sidebar and grid untouched.
description.zh: 在官方 shell.overlay 位置独立渲染工作区/会话浏览器的浮动侧边栏，不影响原生侧边栏与网格布局。

description.en: Adds a one-click chevron toggle that collapses the sidebar panel list so the workspace regains vertical height.
description.zh: 添加一个折叠箭头按钮，可一键收起侧边栏面板列表，为工作区腾出更多垂直空间。

description.en: Adds right-click context menus to DSH sidebar workspace and session rows for opening folders in VS Code or Explorer and copying paths and session links.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏的工作区与会话行添加右键菜单，可在 VS Code 或资源管理器中打开文件夹，并复制路径与会话链接。

description.en: Splits the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks, and Inactive sections while preserving search, menus, drag-and-drop, and one-click revert.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏工作区列表拆分为活跃、会话任务和非活跃分区，保留搜索、菜单和拖拽，并可一键恢复。

description.en: Recent-first session sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: groups, workspace tree, archive, status dots, drag reorder.
DSH client plugin that places a settings button at the bottom of the sidebar so the settings page opens in one click.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件：在侧边栏底部添加设置按钮，一键打开设置页。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and the live peak/off-peak billing period in a fixed sidebar footer status area, with a one-click top-up link.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部固定状态区显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与实时高峰/低谷计费时段，并提供一键官方充值链接。

description.en: Frosted-glass sidebar skin for DeepSeek Harness with an activity pill and a token usage panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供磨砂玻璃侧边栏皮肤，附带活动状态胶囊和令牌用量面板。

description.en: Switches the DSH sidebar between three layouts — tabs, floating overlay and the official default (the host's built-in collapsed sidebar) — with a graphical setting for the default mode, plus always-expanded session lists and temp sessions that are deleted on exit.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏的三种布局之间一键切换：标签页、浮层、官方默认（宿主原生的折叠侧栏），可在详情页直接设置默认布局；另含会话列表默认全展开、临时会话退出即删等设置。

description.en: Open and edit .docx documents in the DSH sidebar via SuperDoc, self-hosted, offline-capable with atomic saves.
description.zh: 在DSH侧边栏中通过SuperDoc打开和编辑.docx文档，支持自托管、离线能力和原子保存。

description.en: Adds colored tags to DeepSeek Harness sidebar sessions so you can label sessions, spot them at a glance, and filter history by tag.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话添加彩色标签，可标记会话、一眼识别并按标签筛选历史记录。

description.en: Embeds VS Code web workbench in a sidebar tab, turning editor selections and explorer files into atomic reference chips.
description.zh: 在侧边栏标签页嵌入 VS Code Web 工作台，把编辑器选中内容和资源管理器文件转为原子引用芯片

description.en: Adds native sidebar conversations to DeepSeek Harness so you can fork turns, start independent side chats and follow source references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加原生侧边栏对话:可分叉对话轮次、开启独立聊天并追溯引用来源。

description.en: Right-sidebar browser for DSH Web with CDP rendering, local/dev proxying, device emulation, and element-pick annotations into chat.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供右侧边栏浏览器，支持 CDP 渲染、本地/开发代理、设备模拟，并可将元素标注插入聊天。

description.en: DSH animated-UI plugin adding a dithered signal-field backdrop, blueprint headline and frosted-glass composer, toggleable per item in settings.
description.zh: DSH 动效界面插件，提供抖动信号场背景、蓝图标题与毛玻璃输入框，可在设置中逐项开关。

description.en: Windows plugin that hides black console windows flashing when DeepSeek-Harness runs sandboxed pwsh/bash commands.
description.zh: Windows 插件，隐藏 DeepSeek-Harness 执行沙箱 pwsh/bash 命令时闪现的黑色控制台窗口。

description.en: Saves selected DeepSeek Harness conversations into SiYuan notes with AI summaries, native formulas and mermaid diagrams kept intact.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话挑段存入思源笔记，保留公式与 mermaid 图表，并支持 AI 摘要。

description.en: A DSH skill library browser UI with a floating ball panel, categorized browsing, Chinese descriptions, and an auto skill-failure ledger.
description.zh: DSH技能浏览器：悬浮球面板，分类浏览，中文简介，自动登记技能失效台账。

description.en: A skill that guides AI coding agents to make minimal, scoped, safe code changes in existing projects.
description.zh: 面向各类 AI 编程代理的代码修改守则，约束其做最小必要改动、避免无关重构、保护公共基础代码，优先使用动态颜色资源

description.en: A skill family of 10 session skills that enforce development delivery rules: requirement clarification, minimal changes, evidence-based debugging and tiered verification.
description.zh: 一套由10个会话技能组成的开发交付规则技能家族，强制执行需求澄清、最小变更、证据调试与分级验证等全流程规则。

description.en: Gates tool availability behind skills, so loading a skill reveals its tools on demand in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过技能门控工具可用性，加载技能后按需显示对应工具。

description.en: DSH panel for browsing, grouping, previewing, exporting, installing, and renaming skills, with a multi-select skill menu in the composer.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理面板：可浏览、分组、预览、导出、安装和重命名技能，并在编辑器中提供多选技能菜单。

description.en: Search GitHub repos or paste a URL, pick SKILL.md skills, and install them to a target directory that takes effect immediately.
description.zh: 按名称搜索 GitHub 仓库或粘贴仓库地址，勾选 SKILL.md 技能并安装到目标目录，立即生效无需重启。

description.en: A DSH study coach that tracks where you get stuck, keeps a roadmap and on-disk state, and rates mastery by unprompted output.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 学习陪练插件，记录你卡住的环节，在设置中维护路线图，把状态存到磁盘，并按主动输出评估掌握程度。

description.en: A settings-page plugin to search GitHub for DSH skills and install them with one click.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页提供技能市场，可从 GitHub 搜索技能并一键安装到 ~/.dsh/skills 目录。

description.en: DSH plugin that unifies Skills and MCP management with hot-reload enable/disable and Git-based skill install/update.
description.zh: DSH 插件，统一管理 Skills 与 MCP，支持热重载启停和基于 Git 的技能安装与更新。

description.en: Adds a searchable Chinese skill panel beside the composer and recommends skills from the draft you are typing.
description.zh: 在输入框旁添加可搜索的中文技能面板，并根据正在输入的草稿实时推荐技能。

description.en: Three-layer skill control for DSH: a per-turn LLM-ranked skill shortlist, a hard gate that enforces it, and an opt-in policy binding managed commands.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供三层技能管控：每轮由 LLM 排序的技能候选清单、强制执行的硬性门禁，以及可选绑定受管命令的策略。

description.en: Tracks DSH skill loads per session, ranks them in a sidebar scoreboard, and injects the standings into the AI prompt.
description.zh: 按会话自动统计 DSH skill 加载次数，在侧边栏记分板中排名，并把记分榜注入 AI 提示。

description.en: Skill manager for DeepSeek Harness to scan, import, and manage AI coding skills via a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏面板中扫描 Claude、Codex、Cursor、Gemini 技能库，支持一键导入、全局或项目级技能管理和拖拽安装。

description.en: A DSH skill plugin that makes the agent write a structured implementation plan before coding, then execute simple tasks inline or offer a choice for complex work.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 技能插件，让 Agent 在写代码前先生成结构化实现计划，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: Agent skill that syncs subscribed 知识星球 posts and attachments into a local Markdown knowledge base with enrichment, indexing and search.
description.zh: 把订阅的知识星球帖子与附件同步为本地 Markdown 知识库，并完成分类摘要富化、索引重建与检索的 Agent 技能。

description.en: Browse, search, filter, download and manage Skillhub skills directly inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索、筛选、下载和管理 Skillhub 技能。

description.en: Locks, verifies and governs AI agent skills, warning you what a skill can do before install and if it gains capabilities later.
description.zh: 锁定、验证并管控 AI 代理技能，安装前告知技能能力，并在其事后悄然新增能力时发出警告。

description.en: A searchable panel in the DSH Web GUI that lists skills and MCP servers grouped by origin and lets you hot-toggle them on or off.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中的技能与 MCP 面板，按来源分组、可搜索，并支持即时热切换开关。

description.en: Skills manager for DeepSeek Harness that imports Agent Skills from Git repos or local folders and lets you group, enable, disable and inspect them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Skills 管理器，可从 Git 仓库或本地目录导入技能，按仓库分组并随时启用、停用、补齐和查看内容。

description.en: Plugin for safely discovering, auditing, and adopting external Agent Skills with defense against prompt-injection and AgentBaiting.
description.zh: 用于安全发现、审计和采用外部 Agent Skills 的插件，可防御提示注入与 AgentBaiting 攻击。

description.en: A digital arcade HUD skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with neon colors, pixel fonts, and animated sprites.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供数字街机 HUD 皮肤，含霓虹青紫品红配色、像素字体、动画 HUD 精灵和自定义光标。

description.en: Unofficial cinematic space-opera dark skin bundle for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 非官方的DSH Web界面电影式太空歌剧暗色皮肤包

description.en: A Galaxy skin for DeepSeek Harness that renders a real-time purple-blue nebula and starfield background with native WebGPU/WGSL.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的星河皮肤，用原生 WebGPU/WGSL 实时渲染紫蓝星云与星空背景。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for DeepSeek Harness that spreads the skin across the full window, including the sidebar and all panels, with pure font-color accents.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 壁纸皮肤，全窗铺开（侧栏与所有面板一起透出皮肤），并提供纯字体颜色标注。

description.en: Pixel-anime skin plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, adding palettes, pixel fonts, corner presets and a pixel clock.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的像素动漫皮肤插件，提供配色、像素字体、圆角预设和像素时钟。

description.en: PRTS skin for DSH: Rhodes Island terminal style with cut corners, hairline borders, yellow-black warning stripes and paper/terminal backgrounds.
description.zh: PRTS —— DSH 罗德岛终端风格皮肤，直角切角、黑色发丝线、黄黑警示条，提供纸面与终端两套底色。

description.en: Randomly applies a different installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch, with an on/off switch in Settings → Skins.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机应用一个已安装皮肤，并可在设置 → 皮肤中开关。

description.en: A skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns the workspace background into a living sky with sun movement, clouds and stars.
description.zh: 一款为 DeepSeek Harness 换肤的插件，把工作区变成会流动的天空，太阳沿轨迹移动，云朵与星光缓慢变化。

description.en: A playful DSH widget in the bottom-right corner: drag the character along a ruler to reveal status labels and boundary easter eggs, with position remembered.
description.zh: DSH 右下角滑动测量仪挂件：拖动角色在标尺上移动以显示不同状态，拖到边界触发彩蛋，并记住上次位置。

description.en: Generates short, content-based names for DSH sessions and workspaces, with one-click rename for quick organization.
description.zh: 根据内容为 DSH 会话和工作区生成简短名称，支持一键重命名，便于快速整理。

description.en: Monitors Weibo and Xueqiu bloggers on a schedule and archives posts, reposts and images locally with search, export and IM push alerts.
description.zh: 定时监控微博与雪球博主动态，把正文、转发原文和配图完整归档到本机，支持本地检索、导出与 IM 推送提醒。

description.en: DSH plugin that scrapes JD sofa product pages, AI-verifies detail images, and auto-archives 1920×1080 spec cards as PNG and editable PPTX.
description.zh: DSH 插件：采集京东沙发商品页信息，用 AI 逐张核对详情图，自动生成并归档 1920×1080 规格卡（PNG + 可编辑 PPTX）。

description.en: Song search and download plugin for DSH: searches Bilibili/YouTube, downloads MP3, fetches LRC lyrics.
description.zh: DSH歌曲下载插件：支持B站/YouTube搜索、MP3下载及LRC歌词获取。

description.en: Web GUI sound lab to assign voice lines to trigger events, manage sound library, and customize floating ball.
description.zh: 提供 Web 图形界面，将语音台词分配到触发事件、管理音效库，并可自定义悬浮球

description.en: Plays built-in or custom sound effects in DeepSeek Harness to notify you of events, with live preview.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供声音提示：九种内置音效、支持自定义音频并实时预览。

description.en: VSCode-like source control page in the DSH Web GUI sidebar showing the current workspace's repos, commit graph, changes, and commit box.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 侧栏提供类 VSCode 源代码管理页，展示当前工作区的仓库、提交图、变更列表与提交框。

description.en: Lets DSH read the on-screen window you point to directly, with no screenshots or file uploads needed.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接读取你指定的屏幕窗口内容，无需截图或上传文件。

description.en: Turns the DSH conversation rail into an audio spectrum visualizer driven by WASAPI loopback or microphone input.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话栏变成由 WASAPI 回环或麦克风输入驱动的音频频谱可视化效果。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness with live microphone metering and stop/cancel controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音输入，支持实时麦克风音量显示，以及手动停止和取消控制。

description.en: Speech plugin for DeepSeek Harness: TTS voice playback, auto-announce, and mic dictation via cloud APIs.
description.zh: Speech plugin for DeepSeek Harness: per-message voice playback, auto-announce, and dictation via mic — cloud TTS/ASR on Alibaba DashScope or Volcengine (freely combinable), with Web Speech API fallbac

description.en: A DSH header gauge that shows live generation speed with a 0-500 tok/s half-circle dial and a scrolling 30-second trend curve, sampled 50 times a second.
description.zh: 在 DSH 标题栏显示生成速度的仪表盘：0-500 tok/s 半圆表盘配 30 秒流动曲线，每秒采样 50 次。

description.en: Adds a self-calibrating tok/s speed pill to the composer dock, showing exact per-call output rates for the current session.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠区添加自校准的 tok/s 速度胶囊，按当前会话显示每次调用的精确输出速率。

description.en: Adds a draggable DSH panel showing live DeepSeek balance, per-turn charge and today's total spend down to 1e-8 CNY.
description.zh: 新增可拖拽 DSH 面板，实时显示 DeepSeek 余额、每轮扣费与今日总花费，精度达 1e-8 元。

description.en: Shows conversation spend and account balance as a composer pill, plus a ledger panel with per-model, per-turn, cache-savings and peak/off-peak cost breakdowns.
description.zh: 在输入框显示对话花费与账户余额，并提供账单面板，按模型、轮次、缓存节省及峰谷定价拆分成本。

description.en: Swaps DeepSeek Harness's thinking status line wording with 287 rotating bilingual spinner phrases, editable from the frontend.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 思考状态行的流光词换成 287 条双语轮换短语，词池可在前端编辑。

description.en: Adds split-screen workspace layouts to DSH Desktop with unlimited native panes, side-by-side, stacked and 2x2 grids, plus drag-to-rearrange.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供分屏工作区：无限原生窗格、并排/堆叠/2x2 网格布局，并支持拖拽重排。

description.en: Spotlight-style command palette for DeepSeek Harness that searches settings, plugins, sessions, themes and registered commands.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Spotlight 式命令面板，可搜索设置、插件、会话、主题和已注册命令。

description.en: DSH plugin that launches and manages Maven Spring Boot projects via Agent tools and a web panel for start/stop, status and logs.
description.zh: 该 DSH 插件通过 Agent 工具和 Web 面板启动并管理 Maven Spring Boot 项目，支持启停、状态查询与日志查看。

description.en: Manual budget-targeted context compression for DeepSeek Harness: the model selects ranges and cheap flash-tier writes summaries.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供手动预算定向的上下文压缩：模型选择范围，廉价flash层生成摘要。

description.en: SSH ops plugin extending dsh-ssh with connection testing, remote directory, ssh-config import, fingerprint check, and multi-host batch.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 扩展 dsh-ssh 的 SSH 运维插件，支持连接测试、远程目录、ssh-config 导入、指纹检查和多主机批量操作。

description.en: SSH remote workspace plugin for multi-machine parallel access; lets agents view, edit, and execute remote files via DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: SSH远程工作区插件，支持多机并行，Agent可查看/编辑/执行远程文件。

description.en: Connects remote hosts via SSH terminal in DSH sidebar, showing agent commands/output with persistent logs.
description.zh: 在DSH侧边栏通过SSH连接远程主机，查看agent命令输出并持久化记录。

description.en: SSH server view plugin that lets you browse and edit files, inspect processes, and tail logs on a headless Linux server over SSH.
description.zh: SSH 服务器查看插件，可通过 SSH 浏览和编辑文件、检查进程并实时查看日志。

description.en: Appends the rules defined in AGENTS.md to every incoming user message so the agent keeps project instructions in mind.
description.zh: 将 AGENTS.md 中的规则附加到每条用户消息前，提醒模型始终遵守项目约定。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web on macOS with terminal scripts and a Dock app.
description.zh: macOS 上一键启停 DeepSeek Harness Web：提供终端脚本执行启动、停止、状态查询与守护进程，并附带可停靠 Dock 的 DSH.app。

description.en: One-click installer that sets up a curated, version-pinned bundle of tested community DSH plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一键安装经过测试、锁定版本的 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件整合包。

description.en: A ~9.4s deep-sea dive splash screen for DeepSeek Harness with depth gauge, character reveal video, coral reef and bioluminescent particles.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的约 9.4 秒深海下潜启动开屏：深度尺、角色出场视频、珊瑚礁与生物荧光粒子。

description.en: Cold-start splash animation and frosted-glass skin pack for DeepSeek Harness, with HUD boot sequence and four theme tiers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 冷启动动画＋毛玻璃皮肤插件，含 HUD 冷启动、交接转场与四档皮肤。

description.en: Boot-time guard that repairs logs, preflights plugin composition, smoke-tests host apply(), and quarantines bad bundles to ensure safe startup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 启动时守护：修复损坏的会话日志、预检插件组合、对宿主 apply() 做冒烟测试，并隔离导致崩溃的插件包，防止启动被破坏。

description.en: Keychain plugin that registers external data resources, gates fetching, holds credentials, and logs only fetch fingerprints.
description.zh: 为 DSH 登记外部资源库、门禁控制取数、托管凭据并只记录取数指纹的钥匙串插件。

description.en: Control Stata from DSH with a persistent GUI session: run commands and .do files and read console output without COM, admin rights, or batch mode.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中控制 Stata：常驻 GUI 会话，执行命令与 .do 文件并回读控制台输出，无需 COM、管理员权限或批处理模式。

description.en: Notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness that alerts on task completion, approval requests, questions, blockers, and errors.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务完成、审批、提问、受阻和错误五类提醒的通知插件。

description.en: Sci-fi HUD for DeepSeek Harness displaying session stats as game-style level bars in the web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中以科幻风格 HUD 和游戏式等级条显示会话统计。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：左侧栏 Steam 游戏库面板，展示游戏、游玩时长与成就进度，并为模型提供 get_my_steam_games 工具。
Adds mid-turn steering to DeepSeek Harness so you can send text, images, and files while the agent is still working.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加轮次中途引导，可在智能体工作时发送文本、图片和文件。

description.en: Responsive steering during model output in DeepSeek Harness; preserves queued follow-ups and running tools.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型输出过程中进行响应式引导，并保留已排队的后续消息和正在运行的工具。

description.en: Locally archives group-chat stickers, counts repeats and auto-files frequent memes with author, context and tags for context-based recall.
description.zh: 本地存档群聊表情包，按重复次数自动入库，记录作者、语境和标签，需要时按语境捞图发送。

description.en: Sticky-note board for DSH Web: save chat selections as notes, organize by category, and reuse them across sessions with priorities, todos and comments.
description.zh: DSH Web 便签板插件：把对话内容随手存成便签，分区整理并可跨会话复用，支持优先级、待办清单与便签评论。

description.en: Sticky notes plugin for DSH with a draggable floating panel, full sidebar page, Markdown preview, image pasting and settings.
description.zh: DSH 便签插件，提供可拖拽浮动面板、侧边栏完整页面、Markdown 预览、粘贴图片和设置功能。

description.en: Sidebar sticky-note wall with nine paper colors, category filters, archiving and to-do lists; the agent can read and write notes stored in local JSON.
description.zh: 侧边栏便签墙：九种纸色、分类筛选、归档与待办清单，agent 可通过工具读写便签，数据仅存本机 JSON。

description.en: Integrates Google Stitch via MCP so the assistant can list, create, edit and generate Stitch projects, interfaces and design systems.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 集成 Google Stitch，让助手能够列出、创建、编辑和生成 Stitch 项目、界面与设计系统。

description.en: Lightweight multi-market stock monitor with a floating capsule, grouped watchlists (A-shares, HK, US, crypto), holdings P&L, target prices and intraday/daily K-lines.
description.zh: 轻量多市场盯盘插件：悬浮胶囊展示行情，支持A股/港股/美股/加密货币分组自选、持仓盈亏、目标价与分时/日周月K线。

description.en: Adds a neutral sidebar panel for A-share, Hong Kong, and US stock quotes, plus a stock_quote tool the agent can call.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加中性侧边栏面板，展示A股、港股和美股行情，并提供可供智能体调用的 stock_quote 工具。

description.en: Adds a stock-surf web panel plus agent tools to DSH for evaluating A-share, Hong Kong and US stocks with local 6-factor technical scoring.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加「股票冲浪」面板与 Agent 工具，用本地 6 因子技术面给 A 股、港股、美股打分评估。

description.en: Provides US stock quotes, financial statements, SEC filings, earnings, and economic data via a remote MCP server.
description.zh: 通过远程 MCP 服务器获取美股行情、财务报表、SEC 文件、财报和经济数据。
