description.en: A service control panel for DeepSeek Harness Web that shows live host info and provides a guarded stop button for graceful shutdown.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 的服务控制面板，展示实时服务信息并提供确认后停止服务的按钮。

description.en: Shows how much disk space dsh occupies on this machine and lets you reclaim only rebuildable caches, safely.
description.zh: 查看 dsh 在本机占用的磁盘空间，并仅清理可重建的缓存以安全释放空间。

description.en: Multiplayer AI-hosted story rooms for galgame, turtle soup and mystery, with story packs, sub-agents and maps.
description.zh: 多人联机 AI 主持剧情房间，支持 Galgame、海龟汤与剧本杀，可导入剧情包、子代理和地图。

description.en: Adds a Study Plan tab to DSH sessions for AI-generated daily plans, exercises, and local check-in progress tracking.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中新增「学习计划」标签页，展示对话生成的每日计划、课后题与本地打卡进度。

description.en: ACP sub-agent layer for DSH: configure ACP agent targets, run handshake/connectivity tests, and route subagent calls via a skill.
description.zh: DSH 的 ACP 子智能体体验层：可配置 ACP agent 目标、执行握手连通性检测，并通过 skill 路由子智能体调用。

description.en: Provides lifecycle-safe routing and role controls for subagents in DSH Web's LLM harness.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的 LLM 工具集提供生命周期安全的子代理路由与角色控制。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that shows subagent token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：在输入框工具条上按父级 turn 分组显示子智能体的 token 用量与人民币花费。

description.en: DSH plugin that manages subagent model selection and routes tasks to Jev subagents intelligently.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用于管控子代理模型选择并将任务智能分流至 Jev 子代理。

description.en: DSH Web UI bundle that orders sub-agent directories newest-first and auto-opens/closes their sidebar panels while they run.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件：将子智能体目录按创建时间倒序排列，并在子智能体运行时自动开合右侧栏面板。

description.en: Adds bidirectional subagent messaging in DSH: children can message their parent session, and parents can reach direct continuable children.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供子 agent 双向通信：子会话可向父会话发消息，父会话也可联系可直接续接的子 agent。

description.en: Routes DSH subagents to models per role (explore/plan/patch) with multi-model rotation, cross-provider failover, and fork active-window slicing.
description.zh: 按角色（探索/规划/修改）将 DSH 子代理路由到不同模型，支持多模型轮换、跨供应商故障转移与分叉活跃窗口切片。

description.en: Configures default provider, model, and reasoning effort for subagents via the DeepSeek Harness web settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置页中配置子代理默认使用的提供方、模型和推理强度。

description.en: Named subagent templates for DeepSeek Harness that bundle a starting route or route pool, an agent preset, and an optional persona for pick-by-name delegation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供命名子代理模板，每套模板绑定起始路由（或路由池）、代理预设与可选人设，委派代理按名称选取。

description.en: Auto-continues a DSH subagent once when it ends due to max-tokens, then stops.
description.zh: 当 DSH 子代理因达到最大 token 数而结束时，自动让它继续一次，之后不再继续。

description.en: DSH subpage host that reuses DSH's port to serve a /subpages gateway and unified portal, mounting independent web apps as git submodules.
description.zh: DSH 子页面宿主插件，复用 DSH 端口提供 /subpages 网关与统一门户，把独立小网页应用以 git submodule 一键挂载。

description.en: A settings console that lists every OAuth subscription sign-in the DeepSeek Harness can offer, read from the authorization seam.
description.zh: 一个设置页面，集中展示 DeepSeek Harness 可提供的所有 OAuth 订阅登录方式，信息来自授权接缝。

description.en: Select text in a DSH chat and get an inline streaming answer card with a follow-up tree and drag-to-quote reference chips.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中文字即可生成内联子主题卡片，提供流式回答、追问树和拖拽引用标签。

description.en: Sidebar tab that generates candidate replies to the latest AI response using a custom system prompt, with click-to-fill.
description.zh: 基于 DSH-better-sidebar 的侧边栏标签页，用自定义 system prompt 针对主对话最新一条 AI 回复生成候选回复，点击即可填入输入框。

description.en: Desktop pixel-art character widget that shows the agent's state, plays waiting and completion sounds, and lets you answer questions and approvals inline.
description.zh: 桌面像素角色挂件，显示智能体状态，播放等待与完成音效，并可直接回答提问与审批。

description.en: Adds a summary popup and sidebar with file tree, terminal, browser, and image viewer to DeepSeek Harness web.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加摘要弹窗和侧边栏，侧边栏包含文件树、终端、浏览器和图片查看器。

description.en: Open-source Sunder bundle for DeepSeek Harness with an unrestricted prompt pack, release announcements, and update control.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 Sunder 套件,提供无限制提示词包、版本发布通告与更新控制。

description.en: <Wuthering Waves Suoming theme> third-party DeepSeek Harness Web GUI theme bundle
Dual-backend image generation plugin that runs OpenAI-compatible and ComfyUI backends in parallel, compares results, and can fuse them.
description.zh: 双后端图像生成插件，可并行调用 OpenAI 兼容接口与 ComfyUI，对比结果并可选融合。

description.en: Super PM product-thinking skill packaged as a DSH plugin, helping models analyze requirements, separate facts from assumptions, and converge to validated product directions.
description.zh: 以 DSH 插件形式打包 Super PM 产品思考技能，帮助模型分析需求、区分事实与假设并收敛到可验证的产品方向。

description.en: Manages multiple dsh-superagent projects in one DSH client: create repos, clone, register workspaces, launch and proxy instances in tab panels.
description.zh: 在同一个 DSH 客户端管理多个 dsh-superagent 项目：一键建仓、克隆、注册工作区、启动实例并在标签面板内代理运行。

description.en: Provides content-addressed conformance proofs for DSH ToolRuntime, MCP JSON-RPC, and CLI JSON interfaces.
description.zh: 为 DSH ToolRuntime、MCP JSON-RPC 和 CLI JSON 三类接口生成内容寻址的一致性证明

description.en: Gamifies DSH with a global shared hunger and health bar: every model step burns food, and empty health freezes all tools until you feed it.
description.zh: 为 DSH 加入全局共享的饱食度与生命值：模型每思考一步消耗饱食度，血量归零则冻结全局工具，喂食后才能复活。

description.en: Collects and aggregates trending topics from Baidu, Toutiao, Douyin, and Weibo for content creation.
description.zh: 聚合采集百度热搜、头条热榜、抖音热点和微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），一次调用返回热门话题，供内容创作借势。

description.en: HUD plugin for DeepSeek Harness showing live session cost in RMB, account balance, peak/off-peak markers, and an @ button to quote replies as context.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供读数层：实时显示会话花费（人民币）、账户余额、峰谷时段，并可用 @ 按钮引用回复作为上下文。

description.en: Syncs open session tabs across all your devices in the DSH Web GUI, with workspace grouping, status dots and a phone-first bottom bar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中跨设备同步打开的会话标签，支持工作区分组、状态圆点与手机优先底栏。

description.en: Shows a model checkpoint badge in the session header by probing system_fingerprint, with gateway request tracing and response metadata attestation.
description.zh: 在会话头部显示模型检查点徽标：探测 system_fingerprint 并映射检查点名，附网关请求级溯源与响应元数据存证。

description.en: DSH sidebar hardware monitor showing live CPU, GPU, memory and disk usage with per-app drill-down, alerts and NDJSON export.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏硬件监控插件，实时显示 CPU、GPU、内存与磁盘使用率，可下钻到具体应用，支持阈值告警与 NDJSON 导出。

description.en: Adds a composer dock monitor showing context brick usage, per-turn upload/download tokens, and native macOS CPU/GPU/MEM charts.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠栏添加监控：上下文砖块矩阵、每轮上传/下载 Token，以及原生 macOS CPU/GPU/内存条形图。

description.en: Adds a live status line inside the DSH input card showing CPU load, CPU temperature, memory, disk, and real-time upload/download speeds.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框卡片内常驻显示 CPU 占用、CPU 温度、内存、磁盘和实时上传/下载速率的系统状态行。

description.en: Extends DSH composer to accept pasted/dropped non-image files (e.g., xlsx, csv, pdf), saving to workspace and inserting an @reference for the agent.
description.zh: 扩展DSH编辑器，支持粘贴或拖放非图片文件（如xlsx、csv等），保存到工作区并插入@引用供智能体使用。

description.en: Route only Harness traffic through a Tailscale exit node; the rest of the machine keeps its own routes.
Right-click any session to hand its context off to a fresh, clean-context session while the original stays untouched, with a cleanup page for handoff docs.
description.zh: 右键任意会话即可移交：新建一个上下文干净的新会话接手，老会话原样保留，并提供交接文档清理页。

description.en: Adds a per-workspace conversation whiteboard where chats become free-placed cards connected by links and boxes.
description.zh: 为每个工作区提供对话白板，可自由摆放卡片、连线与方框来梳理会话结构。

description.en: Personal bookkeeping plugin: record income/expenses, view stats, budgets, and export reports.
description.zh: Personal bookkeeping for DeepSeek Harness: record expenses/income (single or batch), list, monthly/annual stats with trends, budgets with progress/over-limit alerts, soft-delete restore, CSV & self-co

description.en: Adds durable task checkpoints, bounded recovery and optional hierarchical concept memory so DSH agents survive interruptions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供持久化任务检查点、有界恢复以及可选的分层概念记忆，避免任务中断丢失进度。

description.en: Shows a topmost dark toast card in the bottom-right corner when an agent task truly finishes, no audio.
description.zh: 当 DSH 智能体任务真正完成时，在屏幕右下角弹出置顶深色卡片提示，不播放声音。

description.en: DSH plugin for live task time, token and cost estimation in session header with PERT.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏实时显示任务完成时间、token 用量与各模型花费估算，并用 LLM 生成 PERT 估算。

description.en: Adds color-coded custom task groups with drag-and-drop ordering and an activity bell showing progress across open sessions in the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏添加可自定义配色的任务分组（支持拖拽排序）和查看多会话进展的活动铃铛。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stores completed tasks as workspace-level memory cards and retrieves them with a two-stage index-then-body lookup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，把做过的任务存成工作区级记忆卡，并用先索引后正文的两段式方式检索。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: sends system notifications when tasks finish and tracks token usage per API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：任务完成时发送系统通知，并按 API Key 统计 token 消耗。

description.en: Sends OS notifications when DeepSeek Harness turns, agents, or workflows finish.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness community plugin: OS notification when a turn, subagent, background job, goal, or workflow finishes. Localized wording, per-source switches, custom delivery command. npm: dsh-task-not

description.en: A DSH plugin providing a six-column kanban board and dual-queue task queue for serial execution of requirements by agents.
description.zh: DSH 插件，提供六列看板和双队列任务队列，供代理串行执行需求。

description.en: Ranks a profile's enabled, disabled and marketplace DSH plugins for a given task and prints the exact next step for each candidate.
description.zh: 按任务对本机已启用、未启用及市场可安装的 DSH 插件排序，并给出每个候选的确切下一步。

description.en: Sends native desktop reminders when agent todo tasks complete, start, or all finish, with an on-demand notify tool.
description.zh: No description provided.

description.en: Sidebar task panel for DeepSeek Harness with a to-do list, history calendar and scheduled Feishu reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏任务面板，提供待办清单、历史月历与飞书到点提醒。

description.en: A DSH native skill that proposes researched frontend design directions, verifies each one in a real browser, and scores screenshots to drive rework.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 原生技能：给出经过研究的前端设计方向，用真实浏览器逐条校验，并对截图打分以驱动返工。

description.en: DSH Tauri plugin that emails or pushplus-notifies you when a task completes or stops abnormally, but only when the window isn't focused.
description.zh: DSH Tauri 插件：任务完成或异常停止时通过邮件(SMTP)或 pushplus 推送通知，且仅当窗口不在前台时发送。

description.en: Connects Tavily's hosted MCP server to DeepSeek Harness, registering its search, extract, crawl, map and research tools.
description.zh: 将 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，注册其搜索、提取、爬取、站点地图与研究工具。

description.en: Tencent Agent Mail client for DeepSeek Harness with a sidebar panel to read, send and search mail plus mail_* agent tools.
description.zh: 腾讯智能体邮箱的 DeepSeek Harness 客户端，提供侧边栏面板读写、发送与搜索邮件，并附带 mail_* 智能体工具。

description.en: Teacher-focused preset for DeepSeek Harness that generates lesson plans, rubrics, quizzes, and teaching materials.
description.zh: 面向教师的 DeepSeek Harness 预设，用于生成教案、评分量规、测验题和教学材料。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into an AI tutor: one mini-topic per turn, an immediate quiz, and progress that survives session switches.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 AI 教学助手：每轮只讲一个小知识点并即时测验，学习进度跨会话保留。

description.en: Telegram bridge for Paean Harness that lets you chat with your agent and manage sessions, models, workspaces, and goals from your phone.
description.zh: Paean Harness 的原生 Telegram 桥接插件，让你在手机上与智能体对话并管理会话、模型、工作区和目标。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Telegram, with forum topics per session for prompts, reviews, approvals and media delivery.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入 Telegram，按会话创建论坛话题，支持提示词、评审、审批与媒体发送。

description.en: A dsh plugin that makes workspace optional and provides temporary session functionality, generated entirely by AI.
description.zh: 让 dsh 的工作区变为可选，并提供临时会话功能，完全由 AI 生成。

description.en: One-click plugin that spins up a temporary task zone in DeepSeek Harness: a folder, a workspace and a matching conversation.
description.zh: 一键在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建临时任务区：自动生成文件夹、工作区和对应对话。

description.en: Read-only panel in the session header that aggregates live bash, background-task and persistent terminal output from the current session, subagents and Agent Team teammates.
description.zh: 会话头部只读面板，聚合当前会话、子代理与 Agent Team 队友的 bash、后台任务和持久终端实时输出。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing Terraform IaC: plan/apply gating, state/output queries, and config validation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Terraform 插件，支持 plan/apply 门控、state 与 output 查询、配置校验。

description.en: On-screen progress HUD for automated tests in DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, plus the test_hud tool that drives it.
Compare two texts with AI to identify differences, semantic changes, and potential risk points; supports semantic, line, and word modes.
description.zh: 用AI对比两段文字，找出差异性、语义变化和潜在风险点；支持语义、逐行、逐词三种模式。

description.en: Appearance plugin for the DSH web client: background images, dimming, frosted glass, fonts, rounded corners, and draggable image layers.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端外观插件：背景图、压暗、毛玻璃、字体、圆角，以及可拖动缩放旋转翻转的图片层。

description.en: A luxury gold/pink theme plugin for DSH, adding floating card layout and deep sidebar customization.
description.zh: DSH鎏金主题插件,提供金粉奢华配色、浮动卡片布局和侧栏深度定制。

description.en: A black hole theme for dsh Web UI with WebGL ray-traced background and glass panel styling.
description.zh: dsh Web UI 的黑洞主题插件，用 WebGL 实时光线追踪渲染史瓦西黑洞作为应用背景，搭配深空玻璃面板配色，可在设置 > 通用 > 主题 - 黑洞中切换。

description.en: Dodger-blue ballpark theme for DeepSeek Harness with day/night palettes and baseball-stitch red accents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供道奇蓝球场主题，含日间和夜间两套配色，并以棒球缝线红色作点缀。

description.en: A Doubao-themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness web client, replacing the logo, name and new-session hero art with Doubao branding.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端提供豆包主题皮肤，替换标志、名称和新会话页面插画。

description.en: A paper-and-ink client-side theme for DeepSeek Harness with Balanced and Immersive modes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供纸墨风格的客户端主题，包含均衡与沉浸两种模式。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns an image folder into a frosted-glass global wallpaper while keeping the official palette.
description.zh: DSH 插件：将图片文件夹转换为磨砂玻璃风格的全局壁纸，并保留官方配色。

description.en: A JSON-driven theme gallery plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages all desktop skins in one place, with built-in themes.
description.zh: 一个 JSON 数据驱动的 DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤画廊插件，一个插件管理全部桌面皮肤，内置多套主题。

description.en: An independent monochrome DSH community theme inspired by minimal e-ink design, giving the interface a clean ink-and-white look.
description.zh: 一个独立的黑白DSH社区主题，灵感来自极简电子墨水风格，为界面带来清爽的墨白外观。

description.en: An Honor of Kings 'Jing · Blazing Sunlight' animated theme for DSH, adding gold-toned colour tokens, a full-screen dynamic background and a shattering-mirror intro.
description.zh: 王者荣耀「镜·炽阳神光」动态主题，为 DSH 提供金曜配色、全屏动态背景和镜面破碎开场动画。

description.en: A Person-of-Interest surveillance-terminal theme for deepseek-harness.
description.zh: 为 deepseek-harness 提供疑犯追踪风格的监控终端界面主题。

description.en: Classic Macintosh System 7 pixel-art theme plugin for the DSH web GUI, with retro fonts and Finder-like styling.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面打造的经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风格主题插件，复古字体与 Finder 式界面。

description.en: Neo-Brutalist theme for the DSH Web UI with paper-and-ink palettes, hard rules, offset shadows and instant apply with factory restore.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供的 Neo-Brutalist 主题：纸墨配色、硬边框、偏移阴影，支持即时应用与恢复默认。

description.en: A neon pixel-arcade theme for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, with an optional starfield air-combat background you can drag and play.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端提供霓虹像素街机主题，附带可开关、可拖动操作与无限复活的像素空战背景。

description.en: Provides theme palette infrastructure for DSH with built-in palettes and a client-side registration API.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供主题调色板基础设施，包含内置调色板与客户端注册 API。

description.en: DSH theme and appearance manager with an image theme market, one-click compatible install, failure recovery, and AI repair guidance.
description.zh: DSH 主题与外观管理插件，提供图片主题市场、一键兼容安装、故障恢复与 AI 修复说明。

description.en: A retro theme pack for DeepSeek Harness offering twelve vintage palettes, each with paper-grain or scanline textures, typography and dark-mode glow.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的复古主题包：十二套怀旧配色，各配纸纹/扫描线质感、字体重排与深色磷光代码块。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a Stardew Valley pixel-farm full skin featuring Junimo dialogs, quest HUD, calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 替换为星露谷物语像素农场完整主题，包含 Junimo 对话框、任务 HUD、日历、芯片音乐音效和桌面宠物。

description.en: DSH theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web/desktop clients: customize background, wallpaper, text, composer and sidebar colours live in Settings with no restart.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web/桌面客户端的主题插件：在设置页实时自定义背景色/背景图、字体、输入框与边栏颜色，无需重启。

description.en: Taojian (陶笺) is an unofficial Claude-inspired DSH Web theme with warm paper colors, Source Han Serif, and Cascadia Mono.
description.zh: 陶笺是受Claude启发的非官方DSH Web主题，采用暖纸色、思源宋体和Cascadia等宽字体。

description.en: Terraria pixel-art theme that replaces the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a self-contained page featuring a guide companion, sound feedback and easter eggs.
description.zh: 泰拉瑞亚像素主题，用一个自包含页面替换 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI，附带向导同伴、音效反馈与隐藏彩蛋。

description.en: A Theresa-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with ivory/ink/rose colors, full-page background, frosted-glass sidebar, and splash animation, all configurable in settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的「特蕾西娅」主题：象牙白/墨/淡玫瑰配色，整页背景图、毛玻璃侧栏、开屏动画等均可在设置中调整。

description.en: Whale Girl theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with token remap and wallpaper.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供鲸鱼娘主题，重映射全部 --dsw-* 样式变量并附带氛围壁纸。

description.en: A Windows 98 classic theme for DeepSeek Harness web UI with desktop mode.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web提供Windows 98经典主题，默认桌面模式。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel showing live CPU, memory, GPU and SSD temperatures on Windows, with automatic fallback if elevation fails.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏硬件温度看板，实时显示 Windows 上 CPU、内存、GPU 与固态硬盘温度，提权失败时自动降级。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin that auto-expands Think rows in conversations, with a session toggle.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，在对话中自动展开 Think 行，并提供会话级开关。

description.en: Auto-expands the running Think row and tool cards while active, then folds them when settled and merges finished turns into the built-in process header.
description.zh: 运行时自动展开 Think 行与工具卡片，完成后自动折叠，并把已完成的轮次合并进内置流程标题。

description.en: Independent supervisor plugin that audits the main agent's reasoning and final replies, auto-reviews tool permission requests, and inspects docs and images.
description.zh: 独立监察插件，用单独配置的模型审查主 Agent 的思考过程与最终回复，自动审核工具权限申请，并支持文档与图片审阅。

description.en: Restyles DSH's thinking chain like the DeepSeek app: language-matched reasoning, 5-line scroll preview, expandable full reasoning.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的思考链看起来像 DeepSeek 官方 App：思考跟随提问语言，5 行滚动预览，可展开查看完整推理。

description.en: Adds a per-session ask-first clarification gate and turns each session review into a deduplicated long-term experience library.
description.zh: 为每个会话提供先追问澄清的开关，并把每次复盘沉淀为去重的长期经验库。

description.en: Replaces the DSH composer model picker with a combined model + reasoning-effort slider, with gradient particle visuals and three switchable modes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 编辑器里的模型选择器换成「模型 + 推理强度」滑块，带渐变粒子轨道与三种可切换模式。

description.en: Adds model thinking token usage stats to the bottom dock and end of each conversation.
description.zh: 在底部Dock和每次对话末尾添加模型思考token统计。

description.en: Registers a DSH system-prompt section that forces the model's internal reasoning to Simplified Chinese while code, commands and final replies stay unchanged.
description.zh: 向 DSH 系统提示词注册固定段落，强制模型内部思考使用简体中文，代码、命令与最终回复保持不变。

description.en: A DSH plugin that queries account balance from third-party APIs.
description.zh: 通过第三方 API 接入 DSH，用于查询账户余额的插件。

description.en: Adds long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness with five memory kinds, relevance-filtered injection, a review inbox and a local SQLite store.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆：五种记忆类型、按相关性过滤注入、审阅收件箱以及本地 SQLite 存储。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding Codex-style visible execution progress and native collapsible thinking/process display.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 Codex 风格可见执行进度与原生思考过程折叠显示。

description.en: Adds side-thread reply panels to DeepSeek Harness conversations, with persistent drafts and an optional Slack-style interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边线程回复面板，支持草稿持久化与可选 Slack 风格界面。

description.en: A phone shell for dsh web GUI that adapts layout for mobile screens.
description.zh: A phone shell for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI — sidebar becomes an overlay drawer, settings goes full-screen single column. Zero hardcoded host class hashes.

description.en: A conversation navigator with tick marks and hover previews for jumping through chat history.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话导航，用刻度标记显示峰值衰减，悬停预览并可点击跳转到聊天记录位置。

description.en: Floating stock ticker widget for Japanese equities showing TOPIX ETFs and Nikkei 225, with custom Yahoo symbols.
description.zh: 日股悬浮行情小窗，实时展示日经225与TOPIX联动ETF，支持自定义Yahoo代码。

description.en: Two-way task sync with TickTick/Dida365 via OAuth 2.0 API for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.0 API 实现 DeepSeek Harness 与滴答清单 TickTick/Dida365 的双向任务同步。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores conclusions — not chatter — with a five-question gate, per-workspace isolation and DPAPI-encrypted keys.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期记忆的插件，只记住结论而非闲聊，具备五问门控、按工作区隔离与 DPAPI 加密密钥。

description.en: Checks npm for new DSH releases, upgrades in place and restarts the service from the Settings panel with duplicate-process protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中检测 npm 新版本、一键原地升级并重启服务，带防双进程保护与存活诊断。

description.en: Time-based chat memory plugin for DSH that archives conversations by period and recalls them in widening layers before giving up.
description.zh: DSH 的按时间归档聊天记忆插件：先定位时间段，再两次扩大范围回忆，最后才说“我忘了”。

description.en: Schedules timed reminders for the DSH agent, auto-waking it to check tasks, with a web UI panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体安排定时提醒并自动唤醒其检查任务，支持定时任务列表与网页界面面板显示

description.en: TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — $0 SERP and page extraction, direct or via Monid.
Brings tmon's long-command workbench into DSH: a terminal tab, a tmon_tasks tool for the model, a bundled skill and a system-prompt section.
description.zh: 将 tmon 的长命令工作台带入 DSH：命令终端标签页、供模型使用的 tmon_tasks 工具、内置技能及系统提示词段落。

description.en: Adds a mini table of contents and rewind feature for long conversations in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 添加一个迷你目录在对话旁，适合长程对话导航，还可以直接rewind到选定对话，支持恢复代码变更和总结，暂不稳定

description.en: Plugin for DeepSeek Harness that detects todo markers in assistant messages and displays them as an interactive checkbox table.
Floating progress ball for DSH that displays the AI agent's todo checklist with live status colors.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮进度球，实时显示 AI 代理的待办清单状态。

description.en: A draggable per-session sticky note for short-term todos and a long-term plan with phase progress, shared with the agent via three todo_note_* tools.
description.zh: 可拖拽的会话级待办便签，管理短期任务与带阶段进度的长期计划，并通过三个 todo_note_* 工具与智能体共享同一份便签。

description.en: Sidebar task-progress panel for DSH Web that shows todo completion, the current step, filtering and snapshot export.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧栏任务进度面板，实时显示待办完成比例、当前步骤，并支持筛选、快照与导出。

description.en: Keeps todo_write progress in sync by nudging the agent mid-turn and auto-completing stranded tasks when a turn ends normally.
description.zh: 通过在回合中提醒智能体并在回合正常结束时自动完成滞留任务，保持 todo_write 进度同步。

description.en: Turns the session's todo list into a persistent, animated progress bar above the input box so every agent step stays visible.
description.zh: 把会话的任务清单变成输入框上方一条常驻动态进度条，让 agent 的每一步都看得见。

description.en: Global personal todo plugin for DSH with a shared panel, edge dock, and real-time due-date reminders via toast or native notifications.
description.zh: DSH 全局个人待办插件，提供全局面板、右侧待办条，以及通过 toast 或系统通知推送的到期提醒。

description.en: Adds a 365-day daily token usage heatmap to DeepSeek Harness with per-model hover details.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中显示最近365天的每日 Token 使用热力图，悬停日期可查看当天各模型的 Token 用量。

description.en: Shows cost per task for DeepSeek harness, supports multiple currencies and subagents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek harness (dsh) 显示每任务成本，支持多种货币和子代理。

description.en: Adds a per-turn token usage bar and legend to every reply's icon row, showing uncached input, cache read, and output split.
description.zh: 在每条回复的图标行显示每轮 token 用量条与图例，展示未缓存输入、缓存读取和输出的拆分。

description.en: DSH token-cost panel showing daily/7-day/monthly spend, cache savings, budgets, per-model breakdowns, CSV/JSON export and CLI reports.
description.zh: DSH Token 花费面板：展示今日/7天/月度花费、缓存节省、预算进度、按模型明细，并支持 CSV/JSON 导出与 CLI 报表。

description.en: Token usage & cost report for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): composer spend chip, per-day × per-model usage page, peak/off-peak pricing, date ranges, CSV export. Data stays local.
DeepSeek Harness token usage dashboard: green daily heatmap plus pie/bar charts for input, output, cache-read and cache-write buckets per model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量看板：绿色按天热力图，配饼图/柱状图切换展示输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写四大桶及各模型占比。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing cache, context, request efficiency, and cross-session stats in DSH Web.
description.zh: Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness 用量仪表盘：查看缓存、上下文、请求效率、逐步骤和跨会话统计。

description.en: Local-first token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, with an AI install guide and a companion Android app.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 Token 用量仪表盘，提供 AI 安装指南和配套 Android 应用。

description.en: Composer readout showing CJK-weighted draft token counts, session spend at peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and equivalent cost on pricier models.
description.zh: 在输入框中显示CJK加权token计数、按高峰/空闲费率的会话花费、上下文占用以及其他更贵模型的等效成本。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel showing today's token spend, budget progress, cost breakdown by input/output type, and cache savings.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏面板：显示今日 Token 花费、预算进度、成本构成与缓存节省金额。

description.en: Shows live token quota/usage in DeepSeek Harness UI, auto-switching official vs measured by supplier, with draggable panels.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness界面显示令牌额度和用量，按供应商自动切换官方或实测，支持悬浮窗。

description.en: Monitors DSH provider usage quotas (DeepSeek/OpenCode/Command Code) and auto-detects added providers to fill in their API keys.
description.zh: 监控 DSH 各供应商（DeepSeek/OpenCode/Command Code）的周期用量限额，并自动探测已添加供应商并填入 API Key。

description.en: DSH plugin that cuts LLM token usage by trimming oversized tool output, folding grep results, and compacting context.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过裁剪过大的工具输出、折叠 grep 结果并压缩上下文来降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DSH that parses session logs and shows cumulative, daily, peak usage, streaks, and a 12-month heatmap in the web GUI.
description.zh: 解析 DSH 会话日志的 token 用量统计插件，在网页界面显示累计、每日、峰值用量、连续天数与 12 个月热力图。

description.en: Tracks and stores DeepSeek Harness token usage with cost estimation and a dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局 Token 用量统计插件 | Real usage tracking, durable ledger, cost estimation (OpenRouter pricing), draggable FAB & detail dashboard.

description.en: Cross-session token usage statistics panel with monthly stacked cost charts by provider and model.
description.zh: 跨会话统计 token 用量，按服务商和模型展示月度堆叠费用图表的面板。

description.en: DSH web plugin that adds a token-usage dashboard plus per-session usage analysis covering main and sub-agents, drawn with hand-written SVG charts.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，提供 Token 用量统计看板和单会话（含子智能体）用量分析，图表全部由手写 SVG 绘制。

description.en: Tracks provider token usage, computes costs with peak/off-peak pricing, and displays totals in GUI with overview page and JSON API.
description.zh: dsh.so 插件，统计服务商 token 用量，按峰谷价格表计算费用，在 GUI 中显示总计，并提供独立概览页和 JSON API。

description.en: Displays token usage for DeepSeek Harness sessions with per-session and global daily/per-model views.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI Token 用量展示插件：单会话胶囊 + 全局每日/按模型消耗面板（只读日志，零配置）| Token usage display plugin: per-session pill + global daily/per-model consumption panel

description.en: Displays per-turn and session token usage costs for DSH web conversations.
description.zh: 显示 DSH 网页对话中每轮及整个会话的 token 用量与费用。

description.en: Collects and summarizes token usage/costs from DeepSeek Harness, Codex, and OpenCode logs via a plugin, agent tool, and WebUI dashboard.
Real-time token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness with live totals, model/day/month/project filters and trend charts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时 Token 用量仪表盘，支持实时总量、按模型/日/月/项目筛选及平滑趋势图。

description.en: Adds manual pre-approval to tool calls in Deepseek Harness, enabling 'Manual Mode' or 'Ask Mode'.
description.zh: 为 Deepseek Harness 的工具调用添加执行前人工审批，启用“手动模式”或“询问模式”。

description.en: Limits DeepSeek Harness tool calls per session, blocking after 80 tracked calls to prevent API quota burn.
description.zh: 限制DeepSeek Harness每会话工具调用次数，默认80次后拒绝以节省API配额。

description.en: Neutralizes tool calls with invalid JSON arguments to prevent AI session failures on strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
description.zh: 在网络上中和具有无效JSON参数的工具调用，防止在严格的OpenAI兼容服务器上导致AI会话失败。

description.en: Limits DSH ToolRuntime tool calls per agent, turn, step, and tool name, configurable via profile patch.
description.zh: 限制 DSH ToolRuntime 工具调用：按 Agent、轮次、步骤和工具名分别配置配额。

description.en: Zero-dependency host-layer tool set giving DSH creation-mode agents runtime read/write access via Cordis services, so presets can be copied.
description.zh: 把读写自身运行时的能力做成宿主层普通插件，不注册进程级 inspect provider，让创造模式预设可被复制。

description.en: Collapses the DSH tool catalog into two meta-tools, find_tools and call_tool, so the model looks up tools before calling them.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的工具目录收成 find_tools 与 call_tool 两个元工具，让模型先查再调。

description.en: WeChat Official Account pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: validates a draft against the publish gate, then pushes it to the draft box.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的微信公众号流水线：先按发布门禁校验草稿，再推送到草稿箱。

description.en: Indents every tool call in the DSH web UI, with a settings panel to tune indent, dim level and line spacing.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 的所有工具调用添加缩进，并在设置面板中调整缩进、灰度与行间距。

description.en: Extract text from PDF files using PDF.js (unpdf) for AI agents and LLM tools.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 read_pdf 工具，基于 PDF.js（unpdf）从 PDF 文件提取文本，供 AI 智能体和 LLM 工具读取。

description.en: Prunes oversized tool results in DSH by spilling to file and showing head/tail preview with recoverable middle.
description.zh: 将 DSH 中超大的工具结果裁剪，溢出内容写入文件，只显示首尾预览，中间部分可恢复。

description.en: Connects DSH agents to Tonghuashun (同花顺) market data for realtime quotes, K lines, fundamentals, announcements and code conversion.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体接入同花顺行情数据，获取实时报价、K 线、基本面、公告及代码转换。

description.en: Provides image description (识图) via DashScope vision API using qwen3.7-flash model.
description.zh: 通过 DashScope 兼容 OpenAI 的视觉 API（qwen3.7-flash 模型）提供 image_describe 识图工具，需自备 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY。

description.en: DSH web personal toolbox: desktop task-done alert, GitHub version check, one-click restart, and chat/session management with disk usage.
description.zh: DSH web个人通用工具箱：任务完成桌面通知、GitHub版本检查、一键重启、会话管理与占用空间展示。

description.en: A small plugin set that makes room in the DSH Web sidebar when too many plugins crowd it.
description.zh: 一个小型插件集，在 DSH 网页侧栏插件过多时为其腾出空间。

description.en: System monitoring panel for dsh web GUI showing CPU, RAM, disk, network, and top processes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 界面提供可折叠的系统监控浮动面板，实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络和占用最高的进程。

description.en: GNOME Shell extension that shows each DSH session's running status as chips in the GNOME top bar.
description.zh: GNOME Shell 扩展，将每个 DSH 会话的运行状态以状态标签形式显示在 GNOME 顶栏。

description.en: Live tokens-per-second card for DeepSeek Harness sessions that docks to the sidebar or floats as a draggable card.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供实时每秒令牌数卡片，可停靠侧边栏或作为可拖动浮窗。

description.en: Draggable floating widget in the DSH web UI showing real-time and average session token throughput (tok/s).
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中的可拖动悬浮窗，实时显示会话的实时与平均 Token 输出速率（tok/s）。

description.en: A pure skin plugin that restyles the DSH Web GUI with a near-black paper look, mint-green accents and subtle shadows.
description.zh: 纯皮肤插件，为 DSH Web GUI 换装：近黑纸面、薄荷绿强调色与细腻投影效果。

description.en: Visualizes DeepSeek Harness AI session execution as a replayable timeline with search and export.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话的 AI 执行流程渲染为可回放横向时间轴，支持小地图、搜索、回放、步骤与子调用详情、原始请求分析及 Markdown 导出。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows an inline Simplified Chinese translation below any non-Chinese text you select with the mouse.
description.zh: DSH 插件：鼠标选中非中文内容后，在选区下方就地浮出简体中文译文。

description.en: AI-powered professional translation plugin with domain-specific terminology, tone control, and multi-language support.
description.zh: 专业AI翻译插件，支持多领域术语一致、语气调整与多语言互译。

description.en: Automatically translates dsh approval dialogs into Chinese using DeepSeek.
description.zh: 使用 DeepSeek 将 dsh 审批弹窗内容自动翻译为中文。

description.en: Restart the DeepSeek Harness desktop app and its host process from a session header button or the Windows system tray.
description.zh: 通过会话头部按钮或 Windows 系统托盘重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用及其宿主进程。

description.en: Browser automation bridge sub-plugin for dsh-tui, enabling terminal-based control.
description.zh: 为dsh-tui提供的浏览器自动化桥接子插件，支持终端控制。

description.en: Reports dsh TUI lifecycle status (working/blocked/done) to Herdr multiplexer sidebar in real time.
description.zh: 将 dsh TUI 的运行状态（工作/阻塞/完成）实时上报到 Herdr 多路复用器侧边栏。

description.en: ds​h-tui plugin that provides full-screen masked secret entry so credentials never reach agents, logs, or conversations.
description.zh: dsh-tui 插件，提供全屏掩码密钥输入，使凭据不会进入代理、日志或对话中。

description.en: TUI plugin adding a /sessions scene to browse, filter and permanently delete saved dsh-TUI sessions, cleaning up host delete leftovers.
description.zh: 为 dsh-TUI 提供 /sessions 场景，可浏览、筛选并彻底删除已保存会话，并清理宿主删除后残留的状态。

description.en: Turkish language pack for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, translating 2,910 strings across 64 namespaces.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的土耳其语语言包，翻译覆盖 64 个命名空间、共 2,910 条字符串。

description.en: Shows the real cost of each AI turn in CNY under every assistant reply, using official DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在每条 AI 回复下显示该轮实际花费，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷价以人民币计价。

description.en: Diagnostic plugin for DeepSeek Harness that pinpoints which timeout or setting caused a failed turn.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的诊断插件，可指出导致回合失败的特定超时或设置。

description.en: 手动筛选并移除 DSH 会话中的低价值问答或单条消息：在回复旁原位选中、✓ 确认、内容随即从对话中消失，可撤销；液态玻璃面板。
Adds a Turns tab that tracks and prices the cost of each step and turn in DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Turns 标签页，按步骤和轮次统计并计价成本。

description.en: Turns imported study material into small-step exercises with evidence-based feedback and scheduled spaced-repetition review.
description.zh: 把导入的学习资料变成小步练习,结合原文与作答给出反馈,并安排后续间隔复习。

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev build skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer so it is auto-available in every session; ships no API key.
description.zh: 将 TypeSafe/Jev 构建技能注册到 DeepSeek Harness 全局技能层，每个会话自动可用；不含任何密钥。

description.en: Provides independent interface and code fonts with online presets and local font library support for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的界面字体与代码字体设置，支持在线预设，并可直接使用本地字体库中的 woff2、ttf、otf 文件无需转换。

description.en: Live Typst preview rendered in the DSH Web UI's native right Sidebar by a per-file tinymist preview server proxied over the app origin.
description.zh: 通过按文件启动的 tinymist 预览服务器并经应用源代理，在 DSH Web UI 原生右侧边栏中实时预览 Typst 文档。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that changes the UI font family via theme token overrides.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件，通过主题令牌覆盖来更改界面字体。

description.en: LiteGlass is a lightweight UI skin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with wallpaper, glass transparency, and accent color, featuring server-side settings.
description.zh: LiteGlass 是为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 打造的轻量外观皮肤，提供壁纸、玻璃透明度和强调色，支持服务端设置。

description.en: Adds a sidebar identity row to DeepSeek Harness with your own avatar, nickname and account balance plus small client UI tweaks.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加侧边栏身份栏，显示自定义头像、昵称和账户余额，并附带少量客户端界面微调。

description.en: Pick any UI control on a page and write its CSS selector, XPath, component name, and styles into DeepSeek Harness so AI can target precise edits.
description.zh: 点选页面任意 UI 控件，自动将 CSS 选择器、XPath、组件名和样式写入 DeepSeek Harness 输入框，帮助 AI 精准定位并修改界面元素。

description.en: Browser-injected DSH UI polish: fixes frosted-glass overlays, swaps reasoning-level radios for a draggable slider, and smooths model selection.
description.zh: 浏览器注入的 DSH 界面打磨层：修复浮层毛玻璃、把推理等级换成可拖动滑杆，并优化模型选择流程。

description.en: DSH 视觉风格锁：10 种可切换的页面风格，用提示段 + 契约工具 + 自动校验强约束生成结果
DSH web plugin adding a two-button provider/model selector with reasoning level, sidebar workspace collapse/expand, and a session workspace badge, without touching DSH source.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：供应商/模型双按钮选择器（含推理等级）、侧边栏工作区折叠展开、会话工作区徽章，不改动 DSH 源码。

description.en: Unofficial plugin adding per-viewport (desktop/mobile) visibility rules for DeepSeek Harness Web UI elements, plus a settings page.
description.zh: 非官方插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 元素提供按视口（桌面/移动端）的可见性规则，并附带设置页面。

description.en: Adds per-region UI zoom for the header, both sidebars and the conversation body, plus a draggable header bottom edge.
description.zh: 为顶部栏、两侧边栏和对话主体分别提供独立缩放，并支持可拖动的顶部栏下边缘。

description.en: Generate and edit images inside DeepSeek Harness via Jinan University's Qwen Image platform, saving results as PNG and feeding them back to the model.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中调用济南大学大模型平台（Qwen Image）生成和编辑图片，结果存为 PNG 并回传给模型查看。

description.en: A Resident Evil Umbrella Corporation themed splash and boot animation for DeepSeek Harness, with two color themes and audio.
description.zh: 生化危机保护伞公司主题的 DeepSeek Harness 启动动画插件，含深色与浅色两套配色和音效素材。

description.en: Configurable undici keep-alive Agent for DeepSeek Harness LLM egress with tunable timeouts, IPv4 forcing, proxy stand-down and a read-only status route.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 大模型出网提供可配置的 undici keep-alive Agent，支持超时调优、强制 IPv4、代理自动退让及只读状态路由。

description.en: Adds a composer infinity toggle that injects an unlimited-token-budget notice into the system prompt when top reasoning effort is chosen.
description.zh: 在输入框添加“无限”开关，选用最高推理强度时向系统提示词注入无限 token 预算声明。

description.en: DSH 插件：模型正常结束但任务没做完时自动续跑，回复以「完成」收尾才算真完成。
Adds an About section to DSH settings with one-click update checking.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页添加「关于」栏位，并提供一键检测更新功能。

description.en: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: tracks core, bundles, and plugins, with changelog briefs and confirmed-only updates.
description.zh: 追踪 dsh 本体、bundle 与全部 profile 插件（npm 与 git 双通道），提供变更简报辅助升级决策，只执行确认过的更新。

description.en: Checks installed plugins for breakage before a DSH update installs, auto-disables incompatible ones in config, and self-heals failed startups via a launch wrapper.
description.zh: 在 DSH 更新安装前检查已装插件是否会被破坏，自动在配置中禁用不兼容插件，并通过启动包装器在启动失败时自愈。

description.en: Hourly checks npm for newer versions of installed dsh plugins and shows an approval bubble to upgrade.
description.zh: Hourly checks npm for newer versions of your installed dsh plugins and pops an approval bubble asking which to upgrade

description.en: One-click updates for DeepSeek Harness with incremental npm tarballs, backup, and rollback.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键更新，通过增量 npm 压缩包下载并支持备份与回滚，属社区插件，非官方软件。

description.en: Upload-image button plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI plus DashScope text-to-image helper.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加上传图片按钮，并提供 DashScope 文生图辅助功能。

description.en: DSH plugin that bundles ui-ux-pro-max skill data and adds native search plus design-system tools.
description.zh: 为 ui-ux-pro-max 提供内置技能数据、原生搜索与设计系统工具的 DSH 插件。

description.en: DSH web plugin that displays the model name the upstream endpoint actually returned beneath every assistant step for auditing.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在每个助手步骤下方显示上游实际返回的模型名称，便于审计。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that routes a single URL fragment so the address bar reflects the current conversation or main panel and links open it.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，用单个 URL 片段路由，使地址栏反映当前对话或主面板，并能通过链接打开。

description.en: Analytics dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: token totals, contribution heatmap, model share, and insights.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的用量分析仪表盘：令牌总数、贡献热图、模型份额与洞察。

description.en: Shows remaining coding plan quotas in sidebar with alerts, refresh, and DeepSeek peak/off-peak status.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示编程套餐剩余额度，支持额度告警、手动刷新，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰与低谷时段状态。

description.en: Usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with silent token tracking, cost analytics, and daily limit guard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 用量统计面板，静默跟踪 token，提供费用分析和每日限额防护。

description.en: Dashboard plugin showing DSH model token usage as 9 metric cards plus a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, with activity insights and archive-safe session deletion.
description.zh: DSH 模型用量统计面板：9 宫格指标卡 + GitHub 风格 Token 热力图（日/周/累计）+ 活动洞察，删除会话归档也不丢数据。

description.en: DSH plugin showing the usage panel for the provider behind the current model: quota windows, account balance and token usage, switching automatically with the model.
description.zh: DSH 插件：显示当前模型背后供应商的用量面板，包含额度窗口、账户余额与 token 用量，并随模型自动切换。

description.en: Adds a left-side navigation rail to DSH Web chat; each line marks a question, click to jump, with fisheye, scroll spy, and background preloading.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话区左侧提问导航轨：横线=提问，点击跳转+鱼眼+滚动跟随+后台预加载

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage stats dashboard by vendor with heatmap, trends, model drilldown, CSV export, and health cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness usage stats by vendor (subscription / official API) × KPI: 53-week heatmap, trend chart, model drilldown, CSV export, and health cards.

description.en: DSH plugin adding a collapsible sidebar widget that shows DeepSeek balance and Kimi usage quotas.
description.zh: DSH插件，在侧边栏添加可折叠组件，显示DeepSeek余额和Kimi用量配额。

description.en: Sidebar widget for DeepSeek Harness showing account balance, today's token usage and spend, and monthly totals in real time.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，实时显示账号余额、今日 token 消耗与花费以及本月累计数据。

description.en: Delegates focused tasks from DeepSeek Harness to a local Codex CLI, with sandboxing, path whitelisting, timeout cleanup and capped output.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的聚焦任务委派给本地 Codex CLI 执行，带沙箱、路径白名单、超时清理和输出上限。

description.en: Adds syntax highlighting, a copy button and monochrome mode to code blocks in DSH chat user messages, with no dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天用户消息中的代码块添加语法高亮、复制按钮和单色模式，无需依赖或构建步骤。

description.en: Adds a vertical strip to the DSH web client chat for quick jumping to user messages.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页客户端聊天界面添加一条垂直导航条，可快速跳转到用户消息。

description.en: Read-only task overview panel beside the conversation showing rounds, facts, verification status and a bounded history.
description.zh: 对话旁的只读任务总览面板，展示轮次、事实、验证状态和有限历史记录。

description.en: Replaces DSH web chat input with a Vditor Markdown editor featuring IR mode, slash commands, file references, and clipboard image paste.
description.zh: 用 Vditor 3.11.3 即时渲染模式替换 DSH Web 聊天输入框，支持斜杠命令、文件引用、粘贴图片，并把用户消息渲染为 Markdown

description.en: Right-sidebar paper workbench that renders PDFs, highlights and annotates selections, answers questions about them, and reuses notes across sessions.
description.zh: 右侧边栏论文工作台：原样渲染 PDF，选段高亮、笔记与提问，标注跨会话复用，内置 MinerU 解析。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that bundles vibeweaver engineering discipline: contract cards, mechanical gates, and round guards for coding agents.
description.zh: vibeweaver 的 DeepSeek Harness 专属发行版，为编码代理提供契约卡、机械门禁和轮次守卫等工程约束。

description.en: DSH plugin that loops a local video behind the chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在对话界面背景循环播放本地视频，支持播放/暂停、不透明度、遮罩与填充控制。

description.en: Video gate for DSH: accepts local video files by default, allows Bilibili only after approval, and runs ASR locally via whisper.cpp.
description.zh: DSH 的视频入口插件：默认只接受本地视频文件，B站来源需经你批准，并用 whisper.cpp 在本地运行语音识别。

description.en: 生视频提示词库：整理 Seedance 2.5 和 Wan3 的中文视频提示词，用图谱、时间线和 Wiki 找灵感，也可以直接让 AI 按需求查参考。
Gives DeepSeek Harness video understanding: ffmpeg frame sampling, subtitle track and container metadata reading, and Q&A about specific moments.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视频理解能力：用 ffmpeg 抽帧、读取字幕轨道与容器元数据，并回答关于特定片段的提问。

description.en: Adds route-preserving image understanding and OCR for text-only DeepSeek Harness models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中仅支持文本的模型添加保持路由的图像理解与 OCR 能力

description.en: Local-first vision for DeepSeek Harness: extracts structured JSON (OCR/layout/semantics) from images using local VLMs, zero API cost.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的视觉能力，调用 LM Studio 或 Ollama 的本地视觉模型，从图片提取 OCR、版面和语义结构化 JSON，无 API 费用，图片不离开本机。

description.en: Vision plugin for DSH: adds vision_analyze tool and automatic image transcription to text-only models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型提供视觉能力，新增 vision_analyze 工具，并自动转录图片。

description.en: Routes image understanding to free vision models with fallback and rate limiting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉扩展，将图片理解路由到智谱 GLM、硅基流动 Qwen 等免费视觉模型池，支持自动回退、限流、一键平台测试和实时状态显示，文本仍由 DeepSeek 处理。

description.en: Lets the model publish interactive HTML cards or flowcharts inline and blocks until the user submits comments, fields and state back as the tool result.
description.zh: 让模型在内联发布可交互的 HTML 卡片或流程图，工具会阻塞等待用户提交，并将评论、字段与状态作为结果返回。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that explains terms first, then renders visual PNG cards or an offline clickable mermaid diagram page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：先解释术语，再生成 PNG 视觉卡片或可离线点击的 mermaid 图表页面。

description.en: Live btop-style hardware monitor tab for the dsh web GUI, showing CPU, memory, temperature and NVIDIA GPU stats.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页界面提供 btop 风格的实时硬件监控面板，展示 CPU、内存、温度和 NVIDIA GPU 状态。

description.en: Offline vocabulary panel for DeepSeek Harness with a capsule beside the composer and a dedicated sidebar tab.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的离线词汇面板，在输入框旁提供胶囊入口并带侧边栏标签页。

description.en: Jarvis-style voice assistant plugin for DSH with a local wake word, Chinese speech-to-text, and spoken answers.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供贾维斯式语音助手：本地唤醒词、中文语音识别，并朗读回答。

description.en: Adds Fish Audio text-to-speech and optional speech recognition to DSH Web and OneBot/QQ voice conversations, with a bilingual setup guide.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与 OneBot/QQ 语音对话加入 Fish Audio 语音合成和可选语音识别，并提供双语配置指南。

description.en: Draggable usage monitor for Volcengine Coding Plan in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中可拖动的火山引擎 Coding Plan 用量监控插件

description.en: Run VS Code launch configurations, compounds and tasks from the DSH Web UI with live logs, stdin and Flutter device selection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中运行 VS Code 启动配置、复合配置和任务，支持实时日志、标准输入和 Flutter 设备选择。

description.en: Security plugin bridging VulnClaw and DeepSec for authorized pentest and code audit with a Web UI workbench.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 连接 VulnClaw 与 DeepSec，提供授权渗透测试和 Shield 代码审计工具及 Web UI 工作台。

description.en: Injects your home folder's identity, house rules, diary and ledger into every new session, keeping it writable so the agent can amend its persona.
description.zh: 在每次新会话开始前注入主目录中的身份、家规、近期日记和账本，并保持可写以便智能体修改自身人格。

description.en: Lets users customize DSH Web interface backgrounds with uploaded images, gradients, cropping, blur, and transparency effects.
description.zh: 让用户上传图片或使用渐变自定义 DSH Web 界面背景，并支持裁剪、模糊与透明度效果调整。

description.en: Uses your current desktop wallpaper as a semi-transparent live background for the DeepSeek Harness interface, synced every few seconds.
description.zh: 把当前桌面壁纸作为 DeepSeek Harness 界面的半透明实时背景，每几秒同步一次并跟随系统换图。

description.en: Custom full-window wallpaper plugin for DSH with gradient presets, image URLs, local uploads, frosted glass, and a theme-aware top gradient.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供自定义全窗口壁纸的插件，支持渐变预设、图片链接、本地上传、毛玻璃效果及跟随主题的顶部渐变。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for dsh web with static image or muted looping video background and translucent panels.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供持久壁纸皮肤，背景可用静态图片或静音循环视频，面板呈半透明。

description.en: Adds wallpaper backgrounds to DeepSeek Harness with transparent panels and manual Wallpaper Engine wallpaper sync.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加壁纸背景，支持透明界面和手动同步 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸。

description.en: Desktop plugin for DSH that applies full-window wallpapers plus layered frosted-glass effects and an appearance panel.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端插件：为整窗设置壁纸，并提供分级磨砂玻璃效果与外观设置面板。

description.en: 爆款视频复刻工作台 · DSH 插件：原片 → 角色图（审核门）→ 换人 → 质检 → 成片，支持接入任意 RunningHub 工作流
An experimental dsh agent preset that writes a warm-up first turn and lets real input start from the second turn.
description.zh: DSH 温暖极简模式：会话创建即写入一条高质量首轮轨迹（we/let's 风格），真实输入从第二轮开始，AGENTS.md 与技能目录自然注入

description.en: Pairs an Android watch app with your desktop DSH so you can browse sessions, send messages and read replies remotely over the LAN.
description.zh: 通过电脑端插件与 Android 手表应用配对，在手表上查看会话、发送消息并读取回复，实现远程访问。

description.en: DSH plugin that records content watched by the Agent in a local ledger and displays it as a card-wall history in settings.
description.zh: 跨平台观看历史 DSH 插件：将 Agent 看过的内容记入本地账本，并在设置页以卡片墙回看，支持元数据补全与本地 token 鉴权。

description.en: Losslessly strips watermarks from PDF and Word files at the structural level, leaving body text and image resolution untouched.
description.zh: 结构级无损移除 PDF 与 Word 水印，不改动正文内容与图片分辨率。

description.en: Bridges WorkBuddy SOUL, USER, MEMORY and topic files directly into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt from one Markdown source.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 的 SOUL、USER、MEMORY 与主题文件直接注入 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示词，单一 Markdown 源，无需副本。

description.en: Puts your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers (scene, video, web, image) behind the DSH interface with liquid-glass styling and audio visualisation.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸（场景/视频/网页/图片）放到 DSH 界面背后，并支持液态玻璃外观与音频可视化。

description.en: A soft weather card for DeepSeek Harness showing temperature, rain, an 8-day forecast, extreme-weather hints and outfit tips, plus a tiny theme API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的天气小卡片：显示温度、降雨、8 天预报、极端天气提示与穿衣建议，并带一个小主题 API。

description.en: Annotate web pages in the DSH right-sidebar Browser tab with element or region comments and screenshots, then merge them into your next message.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏浏览器标签页中为网页添加元素或区域评论并附带截图，然后合并到你的下一条消息中。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek API balance beside the input box, with a hover panel breaking down account balance and per-conversation token costs.
description.zh: 在输入框旁常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额，悬停可查看账户余额与本次对话的用量消耗明细。

description.en: Automatically opens the default browser when the dsh web command starts, across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在 dsh web 命令启动时自动打开默认浏览器，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。

description.en: Full-page browser panel for DeepSeek Harness Desktop with tabs, address bar, context menu, pinned homepage and IndexedDB history.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的整页浏览器面板，支持多标签、地址栏、右键菜单、主页常用网址与 IndexedDB 浏览历史。

description.en: Offline web plugin that renders Mermaid code blocks from DeepSeek Harness chat into SVG flowcharts.
description.zh: 离线网页插件，把 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中的 Mermaid 代码块渲染成 SVG 流程图。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications when the model finishes a reply in DeepSeek Harness Web UI, even if page is unfocused.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中，当模型回复完成时发送桌面通知，页面未聚焦时也能收到。

description.en: Adds a password gate to DSH web with cookie auth, first-run password setup, failure lockout, and privacy-safe IP-pseudonymized access logs.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加密码门禁：Cookie 认证、首次强制设密、登录失败锁定 60 秒，并内置对 IP 做化名处理的访问日志查看器，零依赖且集成设置页。

description.en: Sends Web Push notifications when DeepSeek Harness tasks complete, stop, or need your approval or response.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 任务完成、停止或需要审批/回复时，发送 Web 推送通知。

description.en: Web search and fetch plugin for both DSH and Pi, with anonymous-first provider routing, billing authorization, quota prechecks and bounded cancellation.
description.zh: 同时兼容 DSH 与 Pi 的网页搜索与抓取插件，优先匿名、需授权才计费，并支持额度预检与有界取消。

description.en: Zero-token DuckDuckGo search provider using a local headless browser, no API key or model billing.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 DuckDuckGo 搜索，通过本地无头浏览器抓取结果，无需 API key，也不消耗 token 或产生模型计费。

description.en: Keyless web search for DeepSeek Harness that aggregates DuckDuckGo, Bing, Baidu and 360 results and fetches page content.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免密钥联网搜索，聚合 DuckDuckGo、Bing、百度、360 结果并可读取网页正文。

description.en: DSH web search plugin that queries the web using the current session model against a self-hosted retrieval backend.
description.zh: 使用当前会话模型并配合自托管检索后端执行网页搜索的 DSH 插件。

description.en: Per-session toggle that forces an AI agent to search the web before answering queries.
description.zh: 为每个会话提供网页搜索开关，开启后强制 AI 代理在回答前先搜索网络。

description.en: Chat a plan in DeepSeek web, then one-click export the conversation as a context handoff package for DSH, with no credentials stored.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 网页版聊清方案，一键把整段对话导出成交接包交给 DSH 执行，只读设计、凭证零落盘。

description.en: Adds free split-screen to DSH Web with draggable panes, each rendering a full session conversation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加自由分屏，窗格可拖拽，每个窗格显示一个会话的完整对话。

description.en: Claude-styled visible terminal panel for the DSH web GUI that streams agent shell commands into the right sidebar via 17 live_terminal_* tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Claude 风格的可见终端面板，通过 17 个 live_terminal_* 工具把智能体的 shell 命令实时流式显示在右侧边栏。

description.en: Launches DSH web GUI in a separate Edge/Chrome app-mode window with auth token; closing it stops the server.
description.zh: 在 Edge/Chrome 应用模式下打开 DSH Web GUI 独立窗口，关闭窗口即优雅停止服务。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com in the DSH desktop app as one shared, persistent logged-in webview reachable from three panels; deepseek.com only, no injection.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端内嵌 chat.deepseek.com，三个入口共享同一已登录页面，切走不卸载、重启仍登录，仅放行 deepseek.com 且零注入。

description.en: DSH 插件 · 微博：按作息自动刷微博、写日记、定时发博（支持超话）、自动回评。纯 HTTP，无需浏览器。
Adds a white-box causal risk-control middleware to AI agents running on DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 上运行的 AI Agent 增加白箱因果风控中间件。

description.en: 🐋 A quietly alive DeepSeek whale for DeepSeek Harness Web: an inline thinking whale and a right-edge Whale Dock. 一只静谧灵动的 DeepSeek 小鲸鱼：行内思考伴随，侧边常驻交互。
A celebration UI plugin that shows a DeepSeek whale animation at the bottom of the DSH Web GUI when a root agent completes a task.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面底部，当根智能体完成任务时播放 DeepSeek 鲸鱼动画的庆祝界面插件。

description.en: A chibi whale-girl runner mini-game for DeepSeek Harness where you jump life's word burdens to reach the rice bowl.
description.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的Q版鲸鱼娘跑酷小游戏，跳过生活的文字负担冲向饭碗。

description.en: Adds rice-feeding, typing feedback and tool-call display to DSH's whale accounting widget, turning it into a companion fish.
description.zh: 为 DSH 小鲸鱼记账挂件增加喂白米饭、敲键盘干活反馈与工具调用显示，让鲸鱼娘成为陪伴伙伴。

description.en: Bridges QQ chats into DeepSeek Harness via OneBot 11, turning each group or private chat into a DSH workspace with a resident session.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot 11 将 QQ 群聊与私聊接入 DeepSeek Harness，每个会话对应一个 DSH 工作区与常驻对接会话。

description.en: A lightweight canvas endless-runner minigame docked under the chat in DeepSeek Harness to play while waiting for replies, fully local and offline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话流下方的 canvas 跑酷小游戏挂件，等回复时点开就能玩，纯本地、零依赖、不联网。

description.en: Plugin marketplace for DSH plugins: browse, search, install, and update plugins from GitHub.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置界面和 Agent 工具中浏览、搜索来自 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题的 DSH 插件，并一键安装和更新。

description.en: A Bilibili curation floating panel that learns your interests, forgets on a half-life and picks videos inside a daily budget, pinging you only when match scores pass.
description.zh: B站策展浮窗：按概率学习兴趣、按半衰期淡忘，把每日金额上限换算成 token 额度挑选视频，契合度达标才提醒你。

description.en: A draggable desktop pet for dsh Web GUI showing DeepSeek balance bubble, with position memory and secure API key handling.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 右下角的鲸鱼娘桌宠,实时气泡显示 DeepSeek 余额,支持拖动、点击刷新和双击打开用量页。

description.en: Companion plugin for dsh-whale-widget that docks the desktop pet to the right edge of the sidebar.
description.zh: dsh-whale-widget 的配套插件，将桌面宠物停靠在右侧边栏边缘。

description.en: Unofficial fork of the dsh-whale-widget balance pet that shows DeepSeek Harness balance and adds petting, sounds, stats, and feeding.
description.zh: dsh-whale-widget 余额小鲸鱼挂件的非官方衍生版，新增摸头、音效、互动统计和投喂按钮。

description.en: DSH writing-enhancement plugin adding style/rigor gears, project memory, and de-AI post-processing to AI writing.
description.zh: DSH写作增强插件：提供风格/严谨度档位、项目记忆与去AI味后处理。

description.en: Whalegirl (鲸鱼娘) skin pack for the DSH Web GUI, discoverable and tunable through the skin manager with light, dark and system themes.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘主题包，可被 DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器发现与切换，支持浅色、深色和跟随系统三态。

description.en: Shows realtime token-usage badges beside the deep-thinking indicator, with in/out counts, auto K/M/G/T units and per-step operation counts.
description.zh: 在深度思考指示器旁实时显示 token 用量徽章，支持输入/输出合并或分开展示、自动 K/M/G/T 单位与每步操作计数。

description.en: Personal DeepSeek Harness agent with persistent chat, goal tracking, multi-session task coordination, and self-evolution via plugin discovery.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的个人智能体，支持持久聊天、目标管理、多会话任务协调及插件发现式自我进化。

description.en: Connects a WHOOP account to DeepSeek Harness with automatic health data sync and a dashboard for recovery, strain, sleep and workouts.
description.zh: 将 WHOOP 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness，自动同步健康数据，并提供恢复、负荷、睡眠和训练的看板。

description.en: Adds an optional reject-reason input to DSH's permission approval popup and passes that reason to the model as the rejected tool's result.
description.zh: 为 DSH 权限审批弹窗增加可选的拒绝原因输入框，并把原因作为被拒绝工具的 tool result 交给模型。

description.en: Adds a wide reading mode and a floating multi-tab task panel to the DSH desktop UI, with hotkeys and local storage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面界面添加宽屏阅读模式和可切换标签的悬浮任务面板，支持快捷键与本地存储。

description.en: Removes width clamp on DeepSeek Harness composer stats footer so long stats lines span full width instead of truncating.
description.zh: 移除 DeepSeek Harness 输入框统计页脚宽度限制，使较长的轮次与 token 统计行占满整个输入框宽度而不再被截断。

description.en: Read-only retrieval over a folder of local Markdown notes, exposing one wiki_recall tool with four modes and page-level citations.
description.zh: 面向本地 Markdown 笔记文件夹的只读检索插件，提供单一 wiki_recall 工具、四种模式并附带页面级引用。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that fires Windows native toast notifications when approval is needed, a question awaits you, or a task round finishes.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版插件：在需要授权、等待回答/审阅或一轮任务结束时发送 Windows 原生 Toast 通知。

description.en: Windows-only plugin showing native toasts for DeepSeek Harness events: finished, needs input, needs approval.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在通知中心弹出原生系统通知，提示任务完成、需要输入或需要审批三类事件。

description.en: Windows 11 notification bridge for DeepSeek Harness, showing branded toasts on confirmation and completion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 11 系统通知桥接插件，在需要用户确认以及模型运行结束时弹出带名称、鲸鱼图标和声音的品牌化提示。

description.en: Remembers the DeepSeek Harness desktop window's size and position between launches so it reopens where you left it.
description.zh: 记住 DeepSeek Harness 桌面窗口的大小和位置，下次启动时恢复到上次状态。

description.en: Window control for DeepSeek Harness: maximize or true fullscreen on launch, minimize, keep the window always on top, and quit with a native confirmation dialog (Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q).
Remembers DeepSeek Harness desktop window position, size and maximized state, restoring them on the next launch via a version-independent script.
description.zh: 记住 DeepSeek Harness 桌面窗口的位置、大小和最大化状态，下次启动时自动还原，脚本不依赖客户端版本。

description.en: Remembers your DSH desktop window size and position so the app reopens exactly how you left it, plus a settings-page section.
description.zh: 记住 DSH 桌面窗口的大小和位置，下次打开时恢复原样，并在设置页提供配置区。

description.en: Native Windows toast notifications for DSH with smart turn summaries and inline approval or question answering.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供原生 Windows 吐司通知，支持智能回合摘要及在通知内直接审批或回答问题。

description.en: Windows-native notifications for DeepSeek Harness: toasts, sounds, and tray badge.
description.zh: Windows-grade notifications for DeepSeek Harness: system toasts, custom sounds, and a taskbar tray badge — a native DSH profile plugin (zero patching).

description.en: Generates content-addressed readiness proof for sanitized DeepSeek Harness observations on Windows hosts.
description.zh: 为托管 Windows 主机上经净化处理的 DeepSeek Harness 观测结果生成内容寻址就绪证明。

description.en: A slim dock beside the DSH conversation for saving snippets and notes, running selection actions, and checking recap and status.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话旁提供轻量停靠栏，用于片段与笔记、选区操作、回顾与状态查看。

description.en: Turns a photo into the DeepSeek Harness GUI's background and restyles panels with a matching glass-texture theme.
description.zh: 将一张照片设为 DeepSeek Harness 界面的底色，并把面板调成配套的玻璃质感主题。

description.en: A WinUI 3 / Fluent 2 (Windows 11) skin plugin that reskins the DeepSeek Harness web client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端提供 Windows 11 / WinUI 3（Fluent 2）风格的皮肤插件。

description.en: Edit or regenerate DSH chat prompts and replies (reasoning included), archive/delete sessions, and move or migrate workspaces.
description.zh: 编辑或重新生成 DSH 对话提问与回复（含思考过程），归档/删除会话，并支持跨工作区移动与工作区迁移。

description.en: Sidebar DOCX editor panel for DeepSeek Harness with live Word document editing synced to agent tool calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏 DOCX 编辑器，支持实时 Word 文档编辑并与智能体工具调用同步。

description.en: Manage WordPress and WooCommerce sites from DSH: create and edit posts, pages, products, media, themes, plugins, templates and menus via the REST API.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 WordPress 与 WooCommerce 站点：通过 REST API 创建和编辑文章、页面、商品、媒体、主题、插件、模板与菜单。

description.en: Tiny click-through badge showing whether Beijing time (UTC+8) is in the DeepSeek peak window or off-peak, with Chinese and English UI text.
description.zh: 小巧的点击穿透徽章，显示北京时间（UTC+8）是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰时段，支持中英文界面。

description.en: Neural Ledger turning DSH collaboration sessions into a visual work ledger with token analytics, insights, forecasting, and one-click Markdown reports.
description.zh: 神经账本将DSH协作会话转化为可视化工作账本，提供令牌分析、智能洞察、趋势预测及一键Markdown报告。

description.en: Shows WorkBuddy credits and DeepSeek CNY balance in one DSH sidebar line, with the credit-to-CNY rate derived from real token usage.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏一行中同时显示 WorkBuddy 积分与 DeepSeek 人民币余额，汇率由真实 token 用量测算得出。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel that lets you view WorkBuddy credit details quickly and intuitively.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，可快速直观地查看 WorkBuddy 积分详情。

description.en: Companion plugin that adds multi-account support on top of dsh-workbuddy-connect for the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem.
description.zh: 为 dsh-workbuddy-connect 增加多账号支持的伴侣插件，属于 DeepSeek Harness 生态。

description.en: Connects a local workbuddy2api hub gateway into DSH, syncing its models into the model list and showing a credit/usage badge.
description.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api hub 网关接入 DSH，同步模型列表并在侧边栏显示积分余额与用量徽标。

description.en: ZCode-style workflow timeline panel that visualizes workflow stage progress, sub-agent spawning and completion in real time, with per-stage config and saved history.
description.zh: ZCode 风格工作流时间线面板，实时可视化工作流阶段推进、子代理派生与完成状态，支持阶段级配置与历史持久化。

description.en: Turns DSH session logs into daily, weekly and monthly Markdown work reports, grouped by working directory.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话日志整理为按工作目录分组的每日、每周和每月 Markdown 工作报告。

description.en: DSH Web UI panel that maps registered workspaces, edits AGENTS.md instruction files, and manages project skills.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 面板，用于浏览工作区图谱、编辑 AGENTS.md 指令文件并管理项目技能。

description.en: Lists every DSH workspace and conversation, then bulk-deletes selected ones along with their logs, caches and registrations.
description.zh: 列出所有 DSH 工作区和会话，并批量删除所选项目及其日志、缓存和注册信息。

description.en: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog that makes a folder from a typed name or a native folder chooser that remembers where you were.
description.zh: Codex 风格的创建工作区对话框：输入名称即可自动创建文件夹，或用记忆上次位置的原生选择器挑选文件夹。

description.en: Forks a DSH conversation into another workspace, keeping its history and switching the branch's working directory to the target workspace.
description.zh: 把一个工作区中的对话分叉到另一个工作区，保留原历史，并把分支的工作目录切换到目标工作区。

description.en: Sidebar plugin that adds a draggable session tab bar with four drag animations and a live 1:1 preview settings page.
description.zh: 侧边栏插件：提供可拖拽的会话标签栏，内置 4 种拖拽动效，并支持设置页 1:1 实时预览。

description.en: DSH plugin that recreates deleted workspace folders still owning sessions and imports stranded session context as a reusable summary without rewriting logs.
description.zh: DSH 插件：自动重建仍归属会话的已删除工作区目录，并把孤立会话折叠成摘要导入新会话，且从不改写会话日志。

description.en: Project-level MCP plugin for DeepSeek Harness that auto-mounts each project's MCP servers per session and disconnects them on session end.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的项目级 MCP 插件：开会话时自动挂载该项目声明的 MCP 服务器，会话结束自动断开。

description.en: Workspace-scoped durable memory for DeepSeek Harness
Adds labeled multi-directory support to DSH workspaces, injecting a label-to-absolute-path map into agent context via @-mentions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工作区增加带标签的多目录支持，并通过 @ 引用把标签到绝对路径的映射注入 agent 上下文。

description.en: DSH plugin that saves session defaults per workspace so each workspace keeps and restores its own settings.
description.zh: DSH 插件，按工作区保存会话默认设置，使每个工作区各自保留并恢复自己的配置。

description.en: Adds colored status marks to DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows, showing when a workspace is waiting for you, running, or recently finished.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区行上添加彩色状态标记，显示等待你处理、正在运行或刚刚完成。

description.en: Workspace file browser and code viewer with session diff and per-hunk partial revert for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: workspace file browser + code viewer + session change diff + per-hunk partial revert (Trae-style). Windows verified only; Linux/macOS untested — use with caution.

description.en: Manages and uploads workspace files for DeepSeek Harness deployments in the cloud.
description.zh: 用于在云端部署 DeepSeek Harness 时管理和上传工作区文件。

description.en: Compiles a described world into declarative rules so agents, subjectivity, and emotion emerge from simulation.
description.zh: 把描述的世界编译为声明式规则，让智能体、主体性与情感在模拟中自然涌现。

description.en: Blocks task completion until three consecutive clean full checks pass, forcing a check, fix, re-check loop before notifying the user.
description.zh: 在任务收尾时强制「检查 → 修复 → 再检查」循环，连续三次全面检查无问题才判定完成并通知用户。

description.en: Local-first writing workbench for DSH: manages Markdown notes as material and provides a chapter/volume editor.
description.zh: DSH 的本地优先写作工作台，把 Markdown 笔记作为素材管理，并提供章节与卷编辑器。

description.en: DSH writing tool plugin offering long-form writing workflows, style control, templates, and persistent project state.
description.zh: DSH 写作工具插件，提供长文写作工作流、风格控制与 8 套写作模板，进度落盘、跨轮次续写。

description.en: Workspace file browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tree navigation, search, inline editing in tabs.
Opens http(s) URLs in the Windows default browser from WSL via DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过DeepSeek Harness在WSL中打开HTTP(S)链接到Windows默认浏览器。

description.en: Read-only WSL calendar plugin that exposes khal status, today and upcoming-day schedule via CLI commands.
description.zh: 只读 WSL 日历插件，通过命令行查看 khal 状态、今日日程与未来若干天日程。

description.en: Read or write the Windows clipboard from WSL, bridging an AI agent with Windows applications.
description.zh: 在WSL中读取或写入Windows剪贴板，将AI代理与Windows应用打通。

description.en: WSL plugin exposing docker compose tools (ps, logs, up, down) with allowMutate and confirm gating for safe container control.
description.zh: WSL 插件，提供 docker compose 工具（ps、logs、up、down），通过 allowMutate 与 confirm 双重确认保证安全。

description.en: Reports git credential.helper and safe guidance for Windows Git Credential Manager from WSL, without exposing secrets.
description.zh: 安全报告 git credential.helper 配置并从 WSL 指导使用 Windows GCM，不泄露秘密。

description.en: Read-only psql and redis CLI probes for WSL, with named connections, URL/redis-host allowlists and timeouts.
description.zh: 面向 WSL 的 psql 与 redis 只读探测插件，支持命名连接、URL 与主机白名单及超时配置。

description.en: Configurable system-prompt router that makes the WSL tool the default command executor in DSH instead of PowerShell.
description.zh: 可配置的系统提示路由器，让 DSH 默认使用 WSL 而非 PowerShell 执行命令。

description.en: Adds WSL directories as DSH workspaces via the Add workspace button, with sidebar terminals opening inside the chosen distribution.
description.zh: 通过“添加工作区”按钮将 WSL 目录添加为 DSH 工作区，侧边栏终端会在所选发行版内打开。

description.en: Bridges Feishu, WeCom aibot, DingTalk Stream and QQ gateways into dsh agents running on WSL.
description.zh: 将飞书、企业微信机器人、钉钉 Stream 和 QQ 网关桥接到在 WSL 上运行的 dsh 智能体。

description.en: DSH WSL plugin exposing TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One tools — jev_ask, check and rank — to the harness.
description.zh: DSH WSL 插件，向 harness 暴露 TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One 的 jev_ask、check、rank 工具。

description.en: Read-only kubectl tools for WSL that let you inspect Kubernetes cluster state with get, describe and logs.
description.zh: 面向 WSL 的只读 kubectl 工具，可通过 get、describe 和 logs 查看 Kubernetes 集群状态。

description.en: Controlled launcher that starts allowlisted Windows applications from WSL for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 受控启动器，从 WSL 启动白名单 Windows 应用，供 DeepSeek Harness 代理使用。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher that starts DeepSeek Harness Web UI in WSL with a single double-click.
description.zh: Windows 桌面启动器，双击即可在 WSL 中启动 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。

description.en: Connects DSH to a local llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop OpenAI-compatible endpoint for model status checks and chat.
description.zh: 对接本机 llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop 的 OpenAI 兼容接口，提供模型状态查询与对话功能。

description.en: Read-only email plugin for DSH on WSL: check mail status and list or search messages via himalaya and notmuch.
description.zh: 适用于 WSL 上 DSH 的只读邮件插件：通过 himalaya 与 notmuch 检查邮件状态、列出或搜索邮件。

description.en: WSL plugin offering a local media/document pipeline: ffprobe, audio extraction, thumbnails, PDF text, ASR, pandoc, OCR and EXIF.
description.zh: WSL 插件，提供本地媒体/文档处理管线：ffprobe、抽音轨、缩略图、PDF、ASR、pandoc、OCR、exif。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness tool that displays a Windows MessageBox notification from WSL when a long-running task finishes.
description.zh: 用于在WSL中长时间任务完成时显示Windows消息框通知的DeepSeek Harness工具。

description.en: WSL bridge that lets a DSH agent check status and open, read, write, and search a Windows Obsidian vault.
description.zh: WSL 桥接插件，让 DSH 代理查看状态并打开、读取、写入和搜索 Windows 上的 Obsidian 仓库。

description.en: Adds ollama status/list/chat/embed tools so DeepSeek Harness on WSL can use a locally running Ollama server.
description.zh: 为 WSL 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ollama status/list/chat/embed 工具，接入本地 Ollama 服务。

description.en: Convert between WSL Linux and Windows paths with /mnt/c handling.
description.zh: 在WSL Linux和Windows路径之间转换，处理/mnt/c。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that reports Windows host CPU, memory, disk and top-process counters from inside WSL.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 WSL 中读取 Windows 主机的 CPU、内存、磁盘占用及进程排行。

description.en: WSL plugin that uses headless Playwright to open a URL and fetch its page title and body text.
description.zh: WSL 插件，用无头 Playwright 打开 URL 并抓取页面标题与正文。

description.en: War Thunder user-skin studio for DSH: quad picker, declarative layers, 4K DDS textures and .blk file export.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的《战争雷霆》自定义涂装工作室：四边形拾取器、声明式图层、4K DDS 纹理与 .blk 文件导出。

description.en: Turns the Xiaomi Bluetooth Remote 2 Pro (RC003) into push-to-talk voice input and a one-key shortcut console on Windows, with no native deps or admin rights.
description.zh: 把小米蓝牙遥控器 2 Pro（RC003）变成 Windows 上的按住说话语音输入与一键快捷控制台，复用 DSH 本地语音识别，零原生依赖、免管理员权限。

description.en: Xiaoqi Desk Pet is a DSH companion that puts a real macOS desktop pet on screen with task progress, checklist steps and notices.
description.zh: 小奇桌宠是一款 DSH 伴侣插件，在 macOS 桌面放置真实桌宠，并展示任务进度、清单步骤与提醒。

description.en: Nebula Core deep-space theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with designed light and dark palettes, a cross-dissolve nebula wallpaper, and a model probe.
description.zh: Nebula Core 是 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的深空主题，提供明暗双色板、无缝渐变星云壁纸，并附带模型连通性与上下文窗口探测。

description.en: Automates XIUMI article layout in an already-logged-in browser via Playwright/CDP: batch formatting, image sliders, image swaps, saving and review checks.
description.zh: 通过 Playwright/CDP 驱动已登录浏览器自动完成秀米图文排版：批量排版、滑动图集、换图、保存与审核核对。

description.en: A Windows XP Luna skin for DeepSeek Harness featuring the Bliss desktop, blue taskbar sidebar, glass windows and Luna titlebars.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows XP Luna 皮肤，包含 Bliss 桌面、蓝色任务栏侧边栏、玻璃窗口和 Luna 标题栏。

description.en: Bridge plugin to use newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding models (glm-5.3) in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桥接，使其能在内置 pi-ai 目录更新前使用智谱/Z.AI 最新编码套餐模型（如 glm-5.3）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides cross-network access to ZSpace NAS files via the desktop client's relay, without LAN, WebDAV, or SSH.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨网络访问极空间 NAS 文件的插件，通过桌面客户端中继，无需局域网、WebDAV 或 SSH。

description.en: One-click persona-based plugin bundles for DeepSeek Harness: pick a workflow, review included community plugins, install or uninstall the whole toolkit.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的一键式角色插件包：选择工作方式、查看内含社区插件，并整包安装或卸载。

description.en: Local voice input plugin for DSH Desktop using SenseVoiceSmall; transcribes speech into the input draft and shows language/emotion tags.
description.zh: 基于 SenseVoiceSmall 的 DSH Desktop 本地语音输入插件，点击🎤说话，文本自动写入草稿并显示语言/情感标签。

description.en: A virtual smoking widget for the DSH corner that simulates cigarettes to help curb cravings and cut real smoking and secondhand smoke.
description.zh: DSH 右下角的虚拟抽烟挂件，用模拟烟顶替真烟，帮助缓解烟瘾、减少真实吸烟与二手烟。

description.en: AI English reading plugin that imports articles, analyzes vocabulary and phrases, and keeps a local knowledge base and review queue.
description.zh: 一款 AI 英语阅读插件：导入文章，解析词汇与短语，并维护本地个人知识库和复习队列。

description.en: An error knowledge base for LLM tools that records failures once, stores the fixes in PostgreSQL, and serves them back via MCP and DSH/Codex/Claude connectors.
description.zh: 面向 LLM 工具的错误知识库：记录一次失败并保存修复方案，通过 MCP 及 DSH/Codex/Claude 连接器在模型重新诊断前返回。

description.en: Tracks daily study goals, streaks and XP for Exameow in DeepSeek Harness, with durable DSH reminders.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中为 Exameow 跟踪每日学习目标、连续打卡和 XP，并提供持久化 DSH 提醒。

description.en: Puts a multi-role expert team into a DSH session: each expert works in a parallel sub-session while the main session aggregates the deliverable.
description.zh: 把多角色专家团装进 DSH 会话，每位专家在独立子会话并行工作，主会话汇总成统一交付物。

description.en: Generates a file/directory tree for visualizing project structures.
Read-only Figma tools for DSH: inspect design file structure, colors and typography, and export design images as native tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的只读 Figma 工具：查看设计文件结构、颜色与字体，并导出设计图片。

description.en: AI-callable computational chemistry pipeline that builds 3D molecules, runs Gaussian jobs serially, parses outputs, and renders Multiwfn/VMD images.
description.zh: 一个可被 AI 调用的计算化学流水线：生成三维分子、串行运行 Gaussian、解析输出并用 Multiwfn/VMD 出图。

description.en: Generates design images and single-file HTML demos via a ChatGPT Pro web session or OpenAI-compatible image API, with a local sidebar gallery preview.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中通过真实的 ChatGPT Pro 网页会话或任意 OpenAI 兼容生图 API 生成设计图与单文件 HTML demo，本地保存并在侧边栏画廊预览。

description.en: Token usage and cost ledger tracking input, output, cached and reasoning tokens per provider, model and session with heatmaps.
description.zh: Token 用量与成本账本，按提供商、模型和会话统计各类 token，并提供月度热力图与成本估算。

description.en: Imports skills installed in a local Hermes Agent into DeepSeek Harness with profile grouping, batch import and conflict handling.
description.zh: 把本机 Hermes Agent 已安装的技能导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持多源发现、Profile 分组、批量导入与冲突处理。

description.en: Enables dsh-chat/dsh-weave cross-machine group chat with adaptation patches and sanitized ops docs.
description.zh: 支持dsh-chat/dsh-weave跨机器群聊，附带适配补丁和脱敏运维文档。

description.en: Cross-session clipboard that refills copied content into any session and saves sessions as presets for branching, via a docked sidebar with folder tree and tags.
description.zh: 跨会话剪贴板：复制内容可随时回填任意会话，并将会话存为预设以便分支下一步，配有右侧停靠侧栏、文件夹树与标签体系。

description.en: Calls Kling AI from DeepSeek Harness to generate images and videos via natural language, with preview, tracking, and OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中调用可灵 AI，通过自然语言生成图片和视频，支持预览、任务跟踪和授权。

description.en: Analyzes a link to produce AI summary, highlights, glossary, rating, knowledge graph, then imports to knowledge base.
description.zh: 输入一个链接，自动采集并生成AI总结、亮点、术语、评分与知识图谱，并导入知识库。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-installs lgtm, reuses the Jev config already set in DSH, and has the agent call lgtm during the testing phase.
description.zh: 自动安装 lgtm，复用 DSH 中已配置的 Jev，并让智能体在测试阶段自动调用 lgtm。

description.en: Adds accessible copy interaction for KaTeX math formulas in DSH web chat.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 聊天中为 KaTeX 数学公式添加可访问的复制交互，便于直接复制公式。

description.en: Packages Matt Pocock's 27 engineering and productivity agent skills verbatim as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 将 Matt Pocock 的 27 个工程与效率类智能体技能原样打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: DSH agent-team lead skill plus member-model routing plugin that assigns and verifies a model for each fresh teammate by task.
description.zh: DSH 智能体团队队长 skill 与队员模型路由插件，按任务为每位新队员分配并核实模型。

description.en: Local-first private memory store for DSH with vector semantic recall, retention lifecycles, on-device LLM summaries and encrypted incremental backups.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地优先私密记忆库，支持向量语义召回、记忆生命周期与保留策略、端侧 LLM 摘要及加密增量备份。

description.en: Agent skills that drive the Meshy CLI to turn text or images into 3D models, textures, rigs and print-ready files.
description.zh: 通过 Meshy CLI 将文本或图片生成 3D 模型、贴图、绑定动画与可打印文件的智能体技能。

description.en: Detects Minecraft mod projects in the workspace and runs their Gradle client, server, data and test tasks with live logs.
description.zh: 识别工作区中的 Minecraft 模组工程，并运行其 Gradle 客户端、服务端、数据与测试任务，实时输出日志。

description.en: Local-first memory governance layer for AI agents that captures, distills, governs and packs memories into a SQLite-backed kernel with a governance panel.
