description.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的本地优先记忆治理层，通过 SQLite 记忆内核与治理面板完成记忆采集、提炼、治理与打包。

description.en: Turns a novel into a single offline HTML atlas with a reader, world map, character relationship graph and growth curves.
description.zh: 把一本小说一键生成离线 HTML 互动看板：阅读器、世界地图、人物关系网络与成长曲线。

description.en: Runs AI-issued commands in real NyaTerm terminal sessions, gated by a per-workspace allowlist of NyaTerm groups and hosts.
description.zh: 让 AI 指令在真实的 NyaTerm 终端会话中执行，并按工作区对 NyaTerm 分组和主机设置允许列表。

description.en: A scholarly journal-desk skin for DeepSeek Harness with Nature, Science, IEEE and Elsevier covers, manuscript stages, and an editorial letter backdrop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的学术期刊桌面皮肤，包含 Nature、Science、IEEE、Elsevier 封面、稿件阶段和编辑信背景。

description.en: Windows privacy shield that auto-blacks sensitive windows during screenshots, screen recording, remote control or screen sharing while staying usable locally.
description.zh: Windows 一键隐私防护：在截屏、录屏、远控或屏幕共享时自动让敏感窗口变黑，本机仍可正常使用。

description.en: Pushes videos and photos into Android apps that cannot find folders, and pulls the originals back out, using ADB plus UI automation.
description.zh: 用 ADB 加界面自动化，把视频图片送进找不到文件夹的安卓 App，并把原文件原样取出。

description.en: Optimizes a casual requirement into a structured high-quality prompt and auto-fills it into DSH chat input.
description.zh: 将一句口语化需求优化成结构化高质量提示词，并自动填入会话输入框。

description.en: A Raven desktop pet that floats in the DSH Web UI, reacting to clicks and showing agent activity bubbles and account balance.
description.zh: 将 Raven 桌宠以悬浮层形式显示在 DSH Web 界面中，支持点击互动、随 Agent 活动显示气泡并查看余额。

description.en: Turns a single JSON spec into a self-contained HTML diagram page with a machine-checked readability gate so readers understand it at a glance.
description.zh: 将单个 JSON 规格转换为自包含的 HTML 图表页面，并通过机器校验的可读性门槛确保读者一眼看懂。

description.en: Redfox skill gallery web plugin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a sidebar entry to switch to a card-based gallery of community skills.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的Redfox技能画廊Web插件，在侧边栏添加入口，切换到卡片式社区技能展示。

description.en: Chat-driven control of the RoboCasa kitchen simulation: open scenes, capture camera frames, move the gripper, and check task success.
description.zh: 通过对话控制 RoboCasa 厨房仿真：打开场景、截取相机画面、移动夹爪并检查任务是否成功。

description.en: A zero-dependency vanilla DOM desktop widget suite with three draggable, resizable cards for daily schedule, goal tracking, and date planning.
description.zh: 零依赖的纯 DOM 桌面小组件，提供三张可拖动缩放的卡片，用于每日时间安排、目标追踪和日期规划。

description.en: A pixel-animated DeepSeek whale desktop pet for dsh web that reacts to Harness session state.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 右下角显示像素风 DeepSeek 小鲸鱼，随 Harness 会话状态做出反应。

description.en: Pairs tasks with minimal required skills for DeepSeek Harness, preferring workflow skills and requiring human approval before install.
description.zh: Task-to-skill pairing for DeepSeek Harness — pours the minimal set (usually one; zero when plain tools suffice), prefers workflow skills over hand-composed atomics. Laziness ladder, quarantine → Skill

description.en: Closed-loop skill self-evolution engine for AI coding agents with post-turn review, safety gates, and ledger rollback.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的闭环技能自进化引擎，支持回合后审查、安全校验与账本回滚。

description.en: Lets a dsh agent compact its own context at a safe point via compact_now and inspect real token usage with context_status.
description.zh: 让 dsh 智能体通过 compact_now 在安全时机压缩自身上下文，并用 context_status 查看真实 token 用量。

description.en: Adds a native DSH interface with motion, bounded context recall, scoped skills, and agent collaboration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加原生界面、动效、有界上下文回忆、限定技能和智能体协作。

description.en: TangSan mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, adding a chat wallpaper with opacity, blur and scrim controls, an avatar brand mark and a Settings section.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加 TangSan 吉祥物外观层，包含可调节透明度、模糊与遮罩的聊天壁纸、头像品牌标识及设置面板。

description.en: Turns a TapTap Maker game design brief into a playable, publishable UrhoX + Lua project.
description.zh: 将 TapTap Maker 游戏设计简报转化为可玩、可发布的 UrhoX + Lua 项目。

description.en: Plays a 12-second original chime automatically when the agent finishes a task, with zero-dependency Windows playback and swappable audio.
description.zh: Agent 完成任务时自动播放 12 秒原创提示音，Windows 零依赖播放，可替换为自己的音频。

description.en: Annotates English technical terms with Chinese glosses inside Chinese software-development explanations, keeping terms consistent across each answer.
description.zh: 在中文软件开发讲解中为英文专业术语标注中文释义，并在同一条回答内保持术语表达一致。

description.en: Enables bidirectional RPC and events between DSH Host and Client peers over native Connection sockets and the Typert Gateway.
description.zh: 通过原生 Connection 与 Typert Gateway 实现 DSH 主机与客户端之间的双向 RPC 与事件通信。

description.en: Compiles coding-agent execution transcripts into sliced, guard-checked L0/L1/L2 memory playbooks stored in project and global .tmem/ folders.
description.zh: 将编程 Agent 的执行轨迹编译为经切片与预检探针加固的 L0/L1/L2 三层记忆手册，存于项目级与全局级 .tmem/ 目录。

description.en: Drops a bowl of rice from the top of the DSH window every N tokens you spend, with usage saved to a durable ledger.
description.zh: 每消耗一定量 token 就从 DSH 窗口顶端掉下一碗米饭，用量持久化保存到本地账本。

description.en: Adds an animated, draggable desktop cat named Toto to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中加入一只可拖拽的动画桌宠小猫托托。

description.en: Interactive SVG desktop pet for DSH Web GUI with feeding, petting, playing, and sleeping mechanics.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的桌宠插件，以悬浮 SVG 龙猫提供喂食、抚摸、玩耍和睡觉互动养成。

description.en: Visual tree-based conversation context manager for DeepSeek Harness: branch from history nodes, switch branches, and prune turns to steer replies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的可视化树状上下文管理插件：可从历史节点开新枝、在分支间切换、移除不需要的轮次以调整后续回复的上下文。

description.en: DSH WebUI display enhancer adding realtime balance, context ring, cache hit rate, provider icons, and plugin management.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 增强显示：实时余额、上下文环、缓存命中率、供应商图标，以及额外插件管理。

description.en: A UN-style theme skin for DeepSeek Harness WebUI and desktop GUI, with a searchable native-name switcher for 1,000+ languages.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 WebUI 与桌面 GUI 提供联合国风格主题皮肤，内置可搜索的 1000+ 语言母语名称切换器。

description.en: Keeps project design docs in sync via an append-only decision log, an auto-derived design snapshot, and a hook that refreshes it.
description.zh: 通过追加式决策日志、自动生成的设计快照和自动刷新钩子，让项目设计文档与决策保持同步。

description.en: 角色扮演插件，让 AI 化身酒馆老板娘，与你互动、记住你并陪你聊天。
description.zh: 玩 · 酒馆模式 — 为 deepseek-harness (DSH) 打造的角色扮演插件，让 AI 化身「老板娘」，在虚拟酒馆中与你互动、记住你、陪你聊天。

description.en: Full-screen business app framework on DeepSeek Harness with RAG knowledge base, SQL query, log analysis and metadata management.
description.zh: 基于DeepSeek Harness的全屏业务应用框架，支持知识库RAG、SQL查询、日志分析与元数据管理。

description.en: A Werewolf game where AI players evolve and improve strategies across games via accumulated knowledge.
description.zh: 基于 deepseek harness 插件实现的狼人杀小游戏，AI 玩家在多局对战中积累知识、进化并改进自身策略。

description.en: Desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with random actions, outfits, and configurable behavior.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供桌面宠物鲸鱼娘，支持随机休闲动作、多套服饰切换、工作节奏动画及可配置行为。

description.en: A whale-girl pet for DSH that monitors DeepSeek balance, daily usage, and session costs, with drag-and-drop and task reminders.
description.zh: DSH 鲸鱼娘桌宠，显示 DeepSeek 余额、每日用量和会话花费，可拖拽并做任务提醒。

description.en: No description available for this plugin.
description.zh: 用于搜索 Apple 文档的插件，未提供更具体的功能说明。

description.en: Dockable XEChat chat sidebar for the DSH Web UI: Markdown chat, server switching, online lists and games over one keep-alive WebSocket.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的可停靠 XEChat 聊天侧边栏：基于单条保活 WebSocket 提供 Markdown 聊天、切服、在线列表与游戏。

description.en: Generates songs from a one-line prompt by combining AI lyric writing with Suno V6 music generation, delivered as a DSH plugin and Agent Skill.
description.zh: 一句话生成歌曲：AI 写词配合 Suno V6 出曲，以 DSH 插件与 Agent Skill 形式提供，需自备虾盘云 Key。

description.en: Runs Bazi, Qimen, Ziwei, Fengshui, and Tarot readings with script-verified charts for entertainment.
description.zh: 提供八字、奇门、紫微、风水与塔罗占卜，并通过脚本校验排盘，适合娱乐用途。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek Chat icon and HARNESS/Chat tabs to the sidebar so DeepSeek Chat and other web LLMs open embedded in the main panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加 DeepSeek Chat 图标和 HARNESS/Chat 切换标签，让 DeepSeek Chat 等网页版大模型嵌入主面板打开。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DSH settings with trends, model dashboard, and activity heatmap.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中统计 Token 用量，提供用量趋势图、模型仪表盘和活跃热力图。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects a top-priority native Simplified-Chinese reasoning instruction so the model thinks in Chinese, letting you read and interrupt its chain of thought.
description.zh: DSH 原生插件，在系统提示词顶层注入最高优先级简体中文思考指令，让模型全程用中文推理，方便实时看懂并随时打断纠错。

description.en: Read-only DSH web viewer that lists sessions via stat-only metadata and peeks at the last N zstd frames without full decompression.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 网页会话查看器：通过 stat 元数据列出会话，并在不完整解压的情况下查看最后 N 个 zstd 帧。

description.en: DSH web plugin that builds an incremental index of all session logs for cross-session full-text search, with a fenced API, an agent session_search tool, and a standalone panel.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，为全部会话日志建立增量索引，实现跨会话全文搜索，并提供信任围栏 API、agent 工具 session_search 与独立面板。

description.en: WeChat channel plugin letting DeepSeek Harness send and receive personal WeChat text and media via Tencent's iLink Bot API.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过个人微信收发消息的渠道插件，基于腾讯 iLink Bot API。

description.en: Adds a plugin market to the DeepSeek Harness settings panel so users can browse and one-click install community plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板中加入插件市场，可浏览并一键安装社区插件。

description.en: OpenViking long-term memory integration for DeepSeek Harness, injecting relevant memories as context per user query.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenViking 长期记忆，按用户每次提问注入相关记忆作为上下文。

description.en: Adds an options plate to the composer's + button for attaching files, folders, device uploads, or slash commands, with draft preview.
description.zh: Options plate on the DeepSeek Harness composer's + button — add workspace files, folders, device uploads, or a slash command — with a Claude Code-style draft attachment preview.

description.en: Advanced sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: git changes, terminal, file browser, dev-server preview, background tasks, and more.
description.zh: Advanced sidebar operations for the DeepSeek Harness Web Client: git changes, a terminal, a file browser, a dev-server preview, background tasks, Open in, Archive and Delete.

description.en: Persistent, searchable per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness, stored in DuckDB with a management UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按项目持久化、可搜索的记忆，将决策、规则和会话上下文存入可查询的 DuckDB 文件，规则集注入每次模型请求，并在 Web 客户端提供完整管理界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin fixing dsh-ui tables so cells no longer paint text over the next column and long cells wrap instead of scrolling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，修复 dsh-ui 表格单元格文字溢出到下一列的问题，并让长单元格自动换行而非横向滚动。

description.en: Memo plugin for DeepSeek Harness with sidebar quick capture, local SQLite storage, GitHub private repo sync, and screenshot images.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 备忘录插件：侧边栏快速记录、本地 SQLite 存储、GitHub 私有仓库同步与图片截图。

description.en: Hides chosen workspaces and their sessions from the DSH sidebar via a Show hidden workspaces switch in view options; display-only, no data changed.
description.zh: 通过视图选项中的“显示隐藏工作区”开关，将选定的工作区及其会话从 DSH 侧边栏中隐藏；仅影响显示，不修改任何数据。

description.en: Adds a Settings → Workspace defaults page so each workspace auto-applies a chosen Agent preset and permission preset to new root sessions.
description.zh: 新增“设置 → 工作区默认值”页面，让每个工作区的新根会话自动套用指定的 Agent 预设与权限预设。

description.en: Lets a DSH agent run SSH operations on remote hosts: list hosts, probe, execute commands, and edit or transfer files via SFTP with risk review.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体在远程服务器上执行 SSH 操作：列出主机、探测、运行命令，并通过 SFTP 读写与传输文件，附带风险审查。

description.en: Jev-guided dispatch advice for DSH that judges whether to delegate to a registered agent before each turn.
description.zh: Jev 引导的 DSH 调度建议：在每轮前判断是否委派以及委派给哪个已注册代理。

description.en: Bounded retry for gateway network_error failures that the stock retry policy cannot classify.
description.zh: 为网关 network_error 失败提供有限次数重试，处理内置重试策略无法分类的错误。

description.en: A lightweight DSH plugin that locally records AI token usage, splits it by provider and model, and shows trend charts and yearly heatmaps.
description.zh: 轻量 DSH 插件，本地记录 AI Token 用量，按 Provider 与模型拆分，并提供趋势图和年度热力图。

description.en: Enforces a delegate-first policy at the tool-call layer, blocking pwsh/write/edit until the session dispatches work to another model.
description.zh: 在工具调用层强制「先委派给其他模型」，未派发的会话无法执行 pwsh/write/edit。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin that lists every session failure (turn, tool, command, sub-agent errors) as copyable cards and flags unread alerts on sidebar sessions.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web 插件，把本会话的每次失败（回合、工具、命令、子智能体报错）列成可复制卡片，并在侧栏会话行显示未读告警。

description.en: Opens dsh workspace and file paths directly in VSCode from the browser GUI, with line:column precision and fallback.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面中一键用 VSCode 打开工作区，并支持点击对话里的文件路径跳转到 VSCode 对应行列。

description.en: Provides aflare workflow tools for DeepSeek Harness to generate, validate, and run deterministic workflows locally.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 aflare 工作流工具，可生成、校验并在本地运行确定性的工作流

description.en: Lets agents read and control the web page open in the right Sidebar Browser tab of DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让智能体读取并控制 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏浏览器标签页中打开的网页。

description.en: Displays Qwen Token Plan, Z.ai GLM Coding Plan and MiniMax Coding Plan usage quotas inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中显示 Qwen Token 计划、Z.ai GLM 编程计划和 MiniMax 编程计划的用量额度。

description.en: Persian RTL bundle for the DSH Web GUI adding RTL chat and queue with IranYekanX font, a sidebar terminal, and an auto-opening todo dock.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的波斯语 RTL 捆绑包：使用 IranYekanX 字体的 RTL 聊天与队列、侧边栏终端，以及自动展开的待办停靠栏。

description.en: Adds prompt enhancement to the DSH Web GUI, with a selectable enhancement model configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加提示词增强功能，可在设置中选择所使用的增强模型。

description.en: Adds session-menu shortcuts that open a session's workspace or log folder, plus a Settings archive manager to search, unarchive or permanently delete archived sessions.
description.zh: 在会话菜单中添加快捷入口以打开会话工作区或日志文件夹，并在设置中提供归档管理，可搜索、取消归档或永久删除已归档会话。

description.en: Provider-aware balance chip for the DSH web sidebar showing DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM and MiniMax account balances.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页面板提供多供应商余额指示，显示 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、智谱/GLM 与 MiniMax 的账户余额。

description.en: Adds a delete button for archived DSH sessions, removing the session log, workspace membership and archive mark.
description.zh: 为已归档的 DSH 会话提供删除按钮，清除会话日志、工作区归属和归档标记。

description.en: Mounts Superpowers skills and injects bootstrap guidance for DeepSeek Harness agent on profile load.
description.zh: 在配置加载时为 DeepSeek Harness 代理挂载 Superpowers 技能并注入启动引导。

description.en: A conflict-resolution substrate for the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem, together with the measurements it is built on.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件生态提供冲突解决基础层，并附带其所依据的度量数据。

description.en: DSH in-session panel that projects agent-generated self-contained HTML into a sandboxed iframe teaching board with drawing and screenshot-to-chat.
description.zh: DSH 会话内教学平面：把 agent 生成的自包含 HTML 投影到沙箱 iframe 板面，支持圈画并把截图发回对话。

description.en: Adds deployment-level deadlines to dsh tool calls that lack them, turning silently wedged calls into model-visible TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED errors.
description.zh: 为未声明超时的 dsh 工具调用添加部署级截止时间，将静默卡死的调用转为模型可见的 TOOL_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED 错误。

description.en: Agent computer-use plugin adding Windows UIA desktop automation, a browser web lane, and a human takeover UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH/AryaCode 提供计算机使用能力的插件，包含 Windows UIA 桌面自动化、浏览器网页通道和人工接管界面。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek Harness account balance, token usage, three-tier cost breakdown, yearly heatmap, and grouped trend curves.
description.zh: 展示 DeepSeek Harness 账户余额、Token 使用量、三档成本拆分、全年热力图和分组趋势曲线。

description.en: Adds Elasticsearch configuration and a log query tool for searching logs by trace ID or natural language.
description.zh: 添加 Elasticsearch 配置和日志查询工具，支持按 trace ID 或自然语言搜索日志。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that opens interactive agent-switch terminals with tab and grid layouts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供带标签页与网格布局的交互式 agent 切换终端。

description.en: Plugin for Deepseek Harness that swaps built-in web search for synthetic.new's search service.
description.zh: Deepseek Harness 插件，用 synthetic.new 的网页搜索替换内置的 Deepseek 网页搜索。

description.en: Custom wallpaper engine for DeepSeek Harness with image compression and glass effects.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自定义壁纸，支持图片压缩、毛玻璃、面板透明度、自适应文字颜色和可选余额显示。

description.en: Local development dashboard for DeepSeek Harness plugins with project registration and GitHub workflow safety.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供本地开发仪表盘，支持显式项目注册和需安全确认的 GitHub 工作流。

description.en: DSH plugin that forks a workspace row into a git worktree or deletes the workspace folder.
description.zh: DSH 插件：将工作区行派生为 git worktree，或删除该工作区文件夹。

description.en: Tracks a domain portfolio with registrar, expiry, auto-renewal and yearly renewal costs, plus availability checks, all stored in a local JSON file.
description.zh: 管理域名资产：记录注册商、到期日、自动续费和年度续费成本，并提供域名可用性查询，数据保存在本地 JSON 文件。

description.en: DSH session-menu plugin that fully deletes sessions, including leftover projection-cache records, and truly moves them across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话菜单插件，彻底删除会话（含残留的投影缓存记录），并实现真正的跨工作区移动。

description.en: Registers a login route that trades the process login token for a browser session cookie, so first visits no longer need ?token=.
description.zh: 注册登录入口路由，把进程内的登录 token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，首次访问无需再带 ?token=。

description.en: Pure-frontend plugin that lets you zoom each of the DSH Web-UI's three columns (left, main, right) independently from 75% to 150%.
description.zh: 纯前端插件，可对 DSH Web 界面的三栏（左栏、主窗口、右栏）分别独立缩放，范围 75%–150%。

description.en: Groups resumable Codex chats by project under the DSH input box, inserts a draft without sending, and auto-archives sessions with resume hints.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方按项目分组列出可接续的 Codex 会话，仅插入草稿不自动发送，并自动存档会话、给出中断恢复提示。

description.en: Lets you control dsh remotely over your own private network set up with Tailscale or ZeroTier.
description.zh: 通过 Tailscale 或 ZeroTier 搭建的私有网络远程控制 dsh。

description.en: Desktop-only DSH keyboard enhancement adding a Codex-style hold-to-preview session switcher and the desktop keymap DSH never applies.
description.zh: 仅限 DSH 桌面端的键盘增强插件，提供 Codex 风格按住预览的会话切换器，并补上 DSH 未应用的桌面快捷键映射。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses the DeepSeek account's DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model for image recognition with any main model, no API key required.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，使用 DeepSeek 账户的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 模型进行图像识别，可搭配任意主模型，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Floating task panel for DeepSeek Harness chats that collects model-suggested and user-added tasks and hands them to the model to execute.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天提供悬浮任务面板，汇总模型建议与手动添加的任务，并可一键交给模型执行。

description.en: Live SEO data for AI agents over MCP: Google/Bing SERP, keyword difficulty, competitor gaps, backlinks and page audits.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 为 AI 代理提供实时 SEO 数据：谷歌/必应 SERP、关键词难度、竞品差距、外链与页面审计。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT models to DeepSeek Harness through the Codex app-server.
description.zh: 通过Codex应用服务器将ChatGPT模型连接到DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Mobile and PWA interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness, inside your existing web UI.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供移动端和PWA界面增强，集成在现有Web UI中。

description.en: Queues your sends during peak hours and automatically delivers them once DeepSeek's off-peak half-price window opens.
description.zh: 高峰时段发送自动排队，DeepSeek 谷时（半价）开始后自动投递消息。

description.en: Out-of-tree plugin suite for deepseek-harness providing markdown tooling, relational table utilities, and review/evals dispatch.
description.zh: 为 deepseek-harness 提供的第三方插件套件，包含 Markdown 工具、关系表工具和审查/评估调度。

description.en: Saves frequently used prompts as a row of shortcut buttons above the chat input; click to fill, with pinning, search and overflow handling.
description.zh: 把常用提示词存成输入框上方的一排快捷按钮，点击即填入，支持置顶、搜索与自动收纳溢出。

description.en: A Wishadel-themed UI plugin for DSH Web GUI adding an integrated task board.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供维什戴尔风格的界面主题，并内置集成任务看板。

description.en: Adds a Web UI telemetry strip showing current-session stats, token usage, and context-window occupancy.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中添加遥测条，显示当前会话统计、Token 用量和上下文窗口占用情况。

description.en: A persistent DSH plugin that shows everything about the current device on one bilingual page and lets you control apps, processes, network and system settings.
description.zh: 一个持久化 DSH 插件：用一页中英双语界面展示设备硬件、系统、软件、网络与进程信息，并可直接操作应用、进程与系统设置。

description.en: Turns a Quarto Book into a readable, searchable, publishable Chinese technical book with nine-step writing, structure/link/figure checks, unified theming, and render verification.
description.zh: 把一份 Quarto Book 写成可读、可查、可发布的中文技术书：九步写作、结构/链接/图表检查、统一主题与渲染验收。

description.en: A dsh web-fetch provider that keeps web_fetch working when hosts-file accelerators route GitHub to a local reverse proxy.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 网页抓取提供器，在 hosts 加速器将 GitHub 解析到本地反向代理时仍保持 web_fetch 可用。

description.en: Adds a live per-step elapsed-time bar to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, showing how long the current step has run and keeping the final duration on screen.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加实时单步计时条，显示当前步骤已运行时长，并在结束后保留结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that queries SearXNG first for web search and automatically falls back to DeepSeek's built-in search.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：优先使用 SearXNG 进行网页搜索，失败时自动回退到 DeepSeek 内置搜索。

description.en: DSH Web completion notifier that pops a clickable dafeiyu mascot when sessions finish, queuing finished sessions and switching back on click.
description.zh: DSH Web 完成提醒插件：任务完成后弹出大肥鱼，多个会话按队列排队，点击即可切回对应会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that creates spec-compliant skills from the Web UI, with a 10-point evaluation loop.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可从 Web UI 创建符合规范的技能，并带有 10 点评测循环。

description.en: Two-level model picker for DSH that splits model selection into a provider page and a model page, with search and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的两级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，并支持搜索与思考强度选择。

description.en: Adds archive session management with rename, restore, and delete to DSH web GUI.
description.zh: 为DSH Web GUI添加归档会话管理，支持重命名、还原和删除。

description.en: Bundle for scoring, validating, and cost-estimating AI skills with Cromus.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 打包插件，用 Cromus 对 AI 技能进行评分、验证与成本估算

description.en: Adds a one-click restart button in the DSH sidebar footer that closes and relaunches the app after a single confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部添加一键重启按钮，确认一次即可自动关闭并重新启动应用。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DSH session header and an optional system tray entry to relaunch the desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏添加重启按钮，并提供可选托盘入口以重新启动桌面应用。

description.en: A system panel for DeepSeek Harness showing machine, runtime, working repositories and Kubernetes cluster health.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的系统面板，展示机器、运行时、工作仓库与 Kubernetes 集群健康状态。

description.en: Opens and edits docx/xlsx/pptx files from the DSH sidebar using a client-side OnlyOffice static SDK, saving changes back with no Document Server.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中打开并编辑 docx/xlsx/pptx 文件，使用客户端 OnlyOffice 静态 SDK，编辑后保存回原文件，无需文档服务器。

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool and in-composer settings button for live text-to-image endpoint, model and API key configuration without restarting DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加 generate_image 文生图工具，并提供输入框按钮实时修改端点、模型和 API 密钥，无需重启。

description.en: Adds two tabs to DeepSeek Harness web settings: grouped plugin list and plugin marketplace with install command copy.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置新增分组插件清单和插件市场两个标签页，市场内可复制安装命令。

description.en: Cordis plugin that opens the dsh Web UI in a browser without an address bar (app mode).
description.zh: Cordis 插件，以无地址栏的应用模式在浏览器中打开 dsh Web UI。

description.en: Audits installed DSH plugins and agent presets: compares declared permissions with tool calls found in local session logs, listing out-of-declaration and unused grants.
description.zh: 审计已安装插件与预设：将声明的权限与会话日志中实际发生的工具调用对比，列出声明外调用与未使用的声明项。

description.en: Statically compares a project's policy declarations (policy.yml/agent.yml) against its actual code to flag mismatches such as promised no-egress or missing human confirmation.
description.zh: 静态比对项目的策略声明（policy.yml/agent.yml）与实际代码，指出「声明不许却做了」或「做了却没声明」的不一致。

description.en: Audits agent MCP configs to check whether tool, file and network permissions are declared and whether they are overly broad.
description.zh: 检查 Agent 的 MCP 配置：工具、文件、网络权限是否声明、是否过宽。

description.en: Scans code for direct execution of AI output (eval, shell, SQL, file paths) to block LLM05 improper output handling.
description.zh: 扫描代码中是否直接执行 AI 输出（eval、shell、SQL、路径），防止 LLM05 不当输出处理风险。

description.en: Audits your alerting pipeline: whether alerts exist, where they are sent, and whether sensitive data leaks into them.
description.zh: 审计告警链路：是否真的有告警、发到哪里、是否把敏感信息一并外发。

description.en: 算法备案与告知：查算法推荐服务有没有关闭选项、告知、备案。
A DSH skill that appends a "powered by dwh" attribution badge to documents and PRs/MRs produced with DeepWhale Desktop.
description.zh: 一个 DSH skill 插件，为用深鲸桌面产出的文档和 PR/MR 添加「powered by dwh」署名徽章。

description.en: Statically scans a project's code to list the capabilities it actually uses (shell, network, file writes, credential reads) and flags high-risk files.
description.zh: 静态扫描项目代码，列出实际用到的能力（执行命令、网络请求、写文件、读凭据、读用户目录、常驻进程）并标出高风险文件。

description.en: Generates user-facing changelogs from git commit history, grouping by conventional commits and writing CHANGELOG files via CLI or sidebar panel.
description.zh: 从 git 提交历史自动生成面向用户的更新日志，按约定式提交归类，支持命令行与侧栏面板写入 CHANGELOG。

description.en: Scans GitHub Actions workflows to flag exploitable CI configs like unpinned actions, write-all permissions, and script injection.
description.zh: 扫描 GitHub Actions 工作流，找出未锁版本、权限过大、密钥泄露等可被利用的配置。

description.en: Conditionally flags cryptography code that should use Chinese SM algorithms (SM2/SM3/SM4) but still uses international algorithms or unsafe parameters like ECB and MD5.
description.zh: 条件性检查密码学代码：该用国密 SM2/SM3/SM4 的地方是否仍在用国际算法或不安全参数（如 ECB、MD5）。

description.en: Scans code and config for cross-border data exports, PII sent to overseas endpoints, hardcoded foreign keys, and missing compliance notes.
description.zh: 扫描代码与配置中的数据出境风险：个人信息外发境外端点、境外密钥硬编码，以及缺少数据出境说明。

description.en: Scans a web or mobile project for missing ICP/APP filing numbers, privacy-policy links and operator info before launch.
description.zh: 上线前自查项目是否缺少 ICP/APP 备案号、隐私政策入口和运营者主体信息。

description.en: Checks whether logging is enabled, records the right events, avoids secrets, and retains logs for China's legally required 180 days.
description.zh: 检查日志是否开启、是否记录了应记内容、是否泄露口令，以及留存是否满足法定 180 天要求。

description.en: Statically scans code and configs for fixable GB/T 22239-2019 (MLPS/等保) issues before an official assessment.
description.zh: 按 GB/T 22239-2019 静态扫描代码与配置，找出上线前开发者可自行修复的等保问题。

description.en: Turns a local static security check report into three deliverable docs: a self-check CSV, a remediation note, and a compliance certificate with boundary statements.
description.zh: 把本地静态安全检查报告整理成三份可直接交付的文件：自查表 CSV、整改说明和带边界声明的合规证明。

description.en: Scans contract text against 10 essential clauses and flags any that are missing, shown in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 扫描合同文本，检查 10 项必备条款是否缺失，并在侧栏面板中展示结果。

description.en: Turns a code repo plus a software name into local drafts for software copyright registration: source-code DOCX, manual skeleton, screenshots and form fields.
description.zh: 把一个代码仓库和软件名，在本机生成软件著作权登记材料草稿：源程序文档、说明书骨架、界面截图和申请表字段。

description.en: Read-only health check for local cron and launchd jobs that flags stalled, commented-out or misconfigured scheduled tasks with red/yellow verdicts.
description.zh: 只读体检本机 cron 与 launchd 定时任务，用红/黄结论标出停摆、被注释或配置错误的计划任务。

description.en: Compares two CSV files by key columns and lists rows that were added, deleted or modified, all parsed locally.
description.zh: 按关键列对比两份 CSV，列出新增、删除和修改的行，全部本地解析不上传。

description.en: Local CSV toolbox that sniffs encoding/delimiters, splits, dedupes, validates, cleans, merges files and converts between CSV and Excel.
description.zh: 本地 CSV 工具箱：自动识别编码与分隔符，支持切分、去重、字段校验、清洗、合并以及 CSV 与 Excel 互转。

description.en: Turns an approval ledger into a review-ready report with key decisions, rejection reasons, pending re-reviews, and a review question checklist.
description.zh: 把审批台账整理成可复盘的报告，包含关键决策、被拒原因、待复审项与复盘问题清单。

description.en: Bundles output files into a verifiable, traceable deliverable package: zip plus file manifest and SHA256 checksums.
description.zh: 把产出物打包成可核对、可追溯的交付物：zip + 文件清单 + SHA256 校验。

description.en: Verifies a delivered zip or directory against MANIFEST.json and SHA256 checksums to confirm completeness and detect tampering.
description.zh: 按 MANIFEST.json 与 SHA256 校验交付包（zip 或目录）是否完整、是否被篡改。

description.en: Batch process Word, Excel and PDF documents in a directory: replace, extract, merge, split and export, all locally via a panel or CLI.
description.zh: 批量处理目录中的 Word、Excel、PDF 文档：替换、提取、合并、拆分与导出，全部在本机通过面板或命令行完成。

description.en: Compares two Word, Markdown or text files paragraph by paragraph and produces a readable before-to-after difference report, fully offline.
description.zh: 按段落比对两份 Word / Markdown / 文本文件，生成「改前 → 改后」的可读差异报告，全程本机完成。

description.en: Merges multiple Word, Markdown and text files into one .docx with an auto-generated table of contents, locally and offline.
description.zh: 将多份 Word、Markdown、文本文件在本机离线合并为一份带自动目录的 .docx 文档。

description.en: Scans Markdown/TXT docs for heading level jumps, duplicate or empty headings and unstructured files, reporting issues without editing them.
description.zh: 扫描 Markdown/TXT 文档，检查标题层级跳跃、重复标题、空标题和无结构文档，仅提示不改文件。

description.en: Pre-delivery document QA plugin that flags leftover placeholders, duplicate or over-long paragraphs, half-width punctuation and broken numbering.
description.zh: 交付前文档质检插件，检查占位符残留、重复或超长段落、半角标点混用和编号断档。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel that surfaces DSH plugin-ecosystem radar snapshots: 7-day new plugins, supply-density gaps and daily reports.
description.zh: 在侧栏添加生态雷达面板，展示近7天新增插件、行业供给密度空位与每日增量报告，并可一键刷新快照。

description.en: Enterprise audit suite with approval ledger, decision retrospectives, audit reports, and scheduled reviews, sold as a commercial license with a 14-day trial.
description.zh: 企业审计套件：审批台账、决策复盘、审计报告与定时复盘，商业授权含14天试用。

description.en: A local file organizer panel that archives loose files by type or year-month, renames duplicates, finds duplicates and clears directories, dry-run by default.
description.zh: 本地文件整理面板：按类型或年月归档散文件、同名自动加序号、查找重复、清空目录，默认只看不动。

description.en: Batch-renames files by replace, prefix, suffix or numbering rules, with a dry-run preview by default and no overwriting.
description.zh: 按替换、前缀、后缀或编号规则批量重命名文件，默认先预览再执行，且不覆盖已有文件。

description.en: Runs the same security rules on before/after code snapshots and reports which findings are fixed, still open, or newly regressed.
description.zh: 对改前和改后的代码快照运行同一套安全规则，按规则逐条对比，说明哪些已修复、仍遗留或新增回归。

description.en: Pre-commit guard that blocks secrets, large files, conflict markers, debug residue, tracked .env files and non-conforming commit messages before they reach the repo.
description.zh: 提交前检查闸门：在密钥、大文件、冲突标记、调试残留、被跟踪的 .env 和不规范 commit message 进入仓库前拦截。

description.en: Runs every installed guard plugin's checks in one command and outputs a single report grouped by module, showing issues, counts, rules and file lines.
description.zh: 一条命令跑完已安装的全部守卫插件检查，输出按模块分组的单份报告，列出问题数、依据与文件行号。

description.en: Batch-processes whole image folders: compress, resize, add text watermarks, convert formats (e.g. WebP) and strip EXIF, writing results to a separate output dir.
description.zh: 批量处理整个图片目录：压缩、等比缩放、加文字水印、转格式（如 WebP）、去 EXIF，产物写入独立输出目录，不动原图。

description.en: Local compliance audit for archive records covering retention periods, four-property checks, destruction approval and migration traceability.
description.zh: 面向档案行业的本地合规体检：保管期限、电子档案四性检测、销毁审批与迁移留痕，逐条给出法规出处与修复建议。

description.en: A sidebar panel that runs industry compliance checks on a project directory across medical, tax, recruiting, manufacturing and real-estate rules.
description.zh: 侧栏面板，按医疗、财税、招聘、制造、房产五套行业规则对项目目录做合规体检。

description.en: Audits construction project records for archive, acceptance sign-off, special-worker certification and material retest gaps, citing regulation clauses.
description.zh: 对工程项目的施工资料归档、验收签认、特种作业持证与材料复检做合规体检，每条问题给出法规条款与修复建议。

description.en: Static compliance scanner for education apps: checks filing numbers, age ratings, ad SDKs, student ID exposure and child-data protection.
description.zh: 面向教育 App 的静态合规检查插件，扫描备案号、适龄提示、广告 SDK、学籍号明文与儿童信息保护等规则。

description.en: Scans code for seven financial-compliance risks: stored payment data, plaintext passwords, unmasked card numbers, short retention, and prod links from test.
description.zh: 扫描代码中的七类金融合规风险：支付敏感信息留存、口令明文、卡号裸展示、留存不足十年、客户端存卡、明文传输、测试环境连生产。

description.en: Local CLI/agent skill that scans recruitment project files for HR compliance risks like resume consent, discriminatory wording and background-check authorization.
description.zh: 本地 CLI/Agent 技能，扫描招聘项目文件中的简历授权、歧视性用语与背景调查授权等合规风险。

description.en: Locally scans a project directory for manufacturing compliance gaps in safety training, special equipment, product labels and hazmat storage, citing rules and fixes.
description.zh: 本地扫描项目目录，检查安全生产培训学时、特种设备登记、产品标识与危化品存储等制造合规缺口，并给出法规出处与修复建议。

description.en: Static self-check for medical-industry compliance gaps like record retention, audit trails, ethics approvals and security budget rules before assessments.
description.zh: 面向医疗行业合规要求的静态自查插件，在测评前检查病历保存年限、留痕、伦理批件与安全预算等易漏项。

description.en: Scans a real estate project directory locally for compliance risks such as ad promises, school-district claims, price disclosure and presale fund supervision.
description.zh: 本地扫描房产项目目录，检查广告承诺、学区表述、明码标价与预售资金监管等合规风险。

description.en: Scans a project locally for tax and finance compliance gaps: voucher retention, invoice details, cross-border tax data and e-invoice checks.
description.zh: 本地扫描项目，检查会计凭证保存期、发票抬头税号、税务数据出境与电子发票验真等财税合规问题。

description.en: A local vault that stores your own multiple API keys on-device, showing only masked values with 0600 file permissions and no uploads.
description.zh: 本地密钥保险箱：保存你自己的多个 API Key，只显示掩码、文件权限 0600、绝不上传。

description.en: Offline checker that scans Chinese legal documents for repealed statutes, out-of-range article numbers and superseded judicial interpretations, exporting reports.
description.zh: 离线核验中文法律文书中的法条引用，标出失效旧法、条号越界与被取代的司法解释，并导出报告。

description.en: Legal damages calculator with four form types (personal injury, labor disputes, loan interest, penalties) that shows each formula and substituted values for manual verification.
description.zh: 法律赔偿计算器，涵盖人身损害、劳动争议、借款利息与违约金四类表单，逐项展示公式与代入值，方便手算复核。

description.en: DSH sidebar hub panel that groups four legal tools into one entry and jumps straight to each tool's panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏法律工具集中入口，一个面板汇总四个法律工具，点击即可跳转到对应面板。

description.en: Turns case and evidence JSON into printable timeline, relationship diagram, evidence matrix and issue-comparison views exported as a single offline HTML file.
description.zh: 把案情与证据 JSON 渲染成时间轴、法律关系图、证据矩阵与争点对照，并导出可打印的单文件离线 HTML。

description.en: Statically scans your codebase against 7 checkable extra requirements from Shanghai and Shenzhen data regulations before delivery.
description.zh: 静态扫描代码库，对照《上海市数据条例》和《深圳经济特区数据条例》的7条可检测要求，交付前发现遗漏。

description.en: Markdown toolbox that batch-converts .md files to Word, builds TOCs, extracts links, and merges files into one output folder.
description.zh: Markdown 工具箱：批量把 .md 转成 Word、生成目录、提取链接并按文件名合并，产物单独输出。

description.en: Local PDF toolbox plugin that merges, splits, compresses, watermarks PDFs and extracts text and embedded images in one command.
description.zh: 本地 PDF 工具箱插件，一条命令完成合并、拆分、压缩、加水印以及提取文本与图片。

description.en: Batch-process PowerPoint files: fill template placeholders, swap images by shape name, extract slide text and report structure, without opening PowerPoint.
description.zh: 批量处理 PPT：填充模板占位符、按形状名替换图片、提取每页文本并统计结构，无需打开 PowerPoint。

description.en: 深鲸 QQ 桥接：QQ 官方机器人 / OneBot v11 双通道 + 关键词规则自动回复 + 全量审计（DSH 插件）
A read-only pre-release guard that checks version consistency, changelog, tags and CI hardcoded versions, then reports via text, JSON or exit code.
description.zh: 只读的发版守卫，检查版本一致性、CHANGELOG、tag 与流水线硬编码版本，并用文本、JSON 或退出码给出结论。

description.en: Reads your existing audit/compliance check report and turns each finding into concrete remediation steps, before/after values and verification methods.
description.zh: 读取已有的检查报告，把每条问题翻译成具体整改步骤、改前改后取值和改完后的验证方法。

description.en: Scans local config and text files for remote-exposure risks like 0.0.0.0 binding, disabled auth, wildcard CORS and default passwords before going online.
description.zh: 上线前扫描本地配置与文本文件中的远程暴露风险，如监听 0.0.0.0、鉴权关闭、CORS 通配、默认口令与调试模式。

description.en: Gives each AI coding session its own artifact folder, renames it by actual content at wrap-up, and refreshes the index.
description.zh: 为每个 AI 编程会话建立专属产物文件夹，收尾时按实际内容改名并刷新索引，解决产物散落与命名不符问题。

description.en: Turns a script plus local images or video into ready-to-publish horizontal and vertical videos entirely offline on your own machine.
description.zh: 把一段稿子配合本机素材，离线生成可直接发布的横版与竖版成片。

description.en: Caps the sidebar global-panels list height with internal scrolling and a faded bottom edge to reduce clutter.
description.zh: 为侧栏全局面板列表限高并启用内部滚动，底部渐隐，缓解侧栏拥挤。

description.en: Audits a site's links, image sizes, SEO tags, robots/sitemap, mixed content and redirect chains, via a sidebar panel and CLI.
description.zh: 对站点做体检：内部链接、图片体积、SEO 标签、robots/sitemap、混合内容与重定向链，支持侧栏面板与 CLI。

description.en: Sidebar SSH console that lists ~/.ssh/config hosts, runs remote commands with whitelist and key-only auth, and audits every attempt.
description.zh: 侧栏 SSH 控制台：读取 ~/.ssh/config 主机，白名单加仅密钥认证执行远程命令，每次执行与拒绝均写入审计。

description.en: Sidebar panel that turns DeepSeek Harness session logs into token-usage and cost analytics with budgets, trends and CSV/JSON export.
description.zh: 侧栏面板：把 DeepSeek Harness 会话日志统计成 token 用量与花费分析，含预算进度、趋势图和 CSV/JSON 导出。

description.en: Generates a day-grouped weekly report Markdown skeleton automatically from git commit history.
description.zh: 从 git 提交记录自动生成按天分组的周报 Markdown 骨架。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped Standard/Fast mode toggle and a compact draggable model picker to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加会话级标准/快速模式切换和可拖动的紧凑模型选择器。

description.en: Serves the loopback DSH Web UI over the machine's private, CGNAT and tunnel IPv4 addresses, mirroring the listener's port.
description.zh: 将仅监听本机的 DSH Web UI 暴露到本机私有、CGNAT 与隧道 IPv4 地址上，并跟随监听端口。

description.en: Search field for DSH Web Settings panel: lists candidates, navigates to section and focuses the setting.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 设置面板提供搜索框，显示独立候选项列表，点击后跳转到所属分区并聚焦该设置项。

description.en: Jupyter notebook support for dsh better sidebar: open .ipynb files inline, run cells with a Python kernel, stream outputs, and save back.
description.zh: 为 dsh 侧边栏提供 Jupyter 支持：内联打开 .ipynb，用 Python 内核运行单元格、流式输出并保存回文件。

description.en: Bridges MCPHub's aggregated MCP server tools into DSH, registering them as native agent tools for direct invocation.
description.zh: 将 MCPHub 聚合的 MCP 服务器工具接入 DSH，注册为原生 agent 工具供直接调用。

description.en: Adds an editable file editor and file-tree sidebar tool to the DSH Web GUI, so workspace files can be changed, saved, renamed or deleted in place.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中加入可编辑的文件编辑器与右侧栏文件树工具，可直接修改、保存、重命名或删除工作区文件。

description.en: Enlarges DSH Web's settings dialog to a configurable size and adds host controls: restart dsh, idle restart, last start time, version hints and a custom machine name.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 设置弹窗放大为可配置尺寸，并在高级设置中加入重启 dsh、空闲后重启、最后启动时间、版本更新提示和自定义机器名。

description.en: Drives your already-running Chromium browser over CDP to navigate, click, type, screenshot and inspect DOM, console and network logs.
description.zh: 通过 CDP 驱动你本机已开启的 Chromium 浏览器，可导航、点击、输入、截图并读取 DOM、控制台与网络日志。

description.en: Lets a model request secrets through a one-time web form and stores the entered value in the credential store or a file.
description.zh: 让模型通过一次性网页表单请求密钥，并将输入值存入凭据库或文件。

description.en: Adds a Skills page to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI for inspecting, downloading, uploading and editing SKILL.md skill files.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中新增技能页面，可查看、下载、上传和编辑 SKILL.md 技能文件。

description.en: Displays Codex-style bullet summaries of each reasoning step in the chat, with the full thinking chain one click away.
description.zh: 在对话中以 Codex 风格显示每步推理的要点摘要，一键即可展开完整思考链。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DSH agents: four tools write conclusions to a human-readable NDJSON file and recall them on demand.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供跨会话长期记忆：四个工具把结论写入人类可读的 NDJSON 文件，并按需显式召回。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-fills reasoning-effort metadata for third-party pi-ai models and turns the model picker into a Codex-style two-level vertical panel.
description.zh: DSH 插件：为第三方 pi ai 模型自动补齐思考等级元数据，并把模型选择器改成 Codex 式竖向两级面板。

description.en: Protein structure prediction and design plugin: ProteinMPNN sequence design, ESMFold folding, interface analysis, consensus ranking and budget scheduling.
description.zh: 蛋白结构预测与设计插件：ProteinMPNN 序列设计与区域重设计、ESMFold 折叠/复折叠、界面分析与共识排序。

description.en: 基因编辑设计域插件（dsh-bio-genie 生态）：sgRNA 候选/评分向量/切割位点 + 声明式排名 + Cas-OFFinder 脱靶语义层 + 碱基编辑（CBE/ABE）+ EditPlan 可审计账本
description.zh: 基因编辑设计域插件（dsh-bio-genie 生态）：sgRNA 候选/评分向量/切割位点 + 声明式排名 + Cas-OFFinder 脱靶语义层 + 碱基编辑（CBE/ABE）+ EditPlan 可审计账本 | CRISPR / gene-editing design plugin for dsh (dsh-bio family)

description.en: Mines human-microbiome functional dark matter, turning target enzymes/EC/reactions into candidate proteins with sequence, structure and literature evidence.
description.zh: 挖掘人体微生物功能暗物质：把目标酶、EC 号或底物-产物反应转化为候选蛋白，并提供序列、结构与文献证据链及可验证实验方案。

description.en: Adds persistent approval and question reminders to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI so you never miss a pending request.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web界面添加持续的审批与提问提醒，避免遗漏待处理请求。

description.en: Cross-platform Bilibili floating video mini-widget for DSH, using Node native fetch.
description.zh: DSH 的 B 站悬浮看片小窗，作为 dsh-bili-widget 的跨平台分支，使用 Node 原生 fetch，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows。

description.en: Brings Bitwarden/Vaultwarden credentials into every DSH session with vault tools, proactive prompt guidance, and a master-password settings card.
description.zh: 在每个 DSH 会话中接入 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 凭据：保险库工具、主动提示引导，以及主密码设置卡片。

description.en: ARIA snapshot-first browser toolkit for navigate, click, type, screenshot and multi-tab, with live sidebar screencast and user takeover.
description.zh: 以 ARIA 快照为核心的浏览器操作工具集，支持导航、点击、输入、截图、多标签，并带侧边栏实时投屏与用户接管。

description.en: Adds a live clock, analog dial, and month calendar widget to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面侧边栏添加实时时钟、模拟表盘和月历组件。

description.en: Panel for DeepSeek Harness that lists running background jobs, tells long silence apart from a hang, and flags when the agent awaits you.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的命令中心面板：集中查看后台任务，区分长时间静默与卡死，并提示智能体何时在等待你。

description.en: Steins;Gate 0 / Amadeus themed skin for DeepSeek Harness Web, adding visual customization.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供命运石之门0 Amadeus 主题皮肤，添加视觉外观自定义。

description.en: Doro-themed fan-made skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI, adding background art, accent colors, and favicon.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 Doro 主题的粉丝自制皮肤，添加背景图、强调色和网站图标。

description.en: A Wukong Zenfire skin theme for DeepSeek Harness WebUI and Desktop, featuring local offline styling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 WebUI 和桌面端提供悟空禅火主题皮肤，样式资源在本地离线加载。

description.en: Manages system clipboard history with searchable persisted entries, a web panel, and agent tools.
description.zh: 监测系统剪贴板并持久保存可搜索的历史记录，提供 Web 面板和 agent 工具进行查看与检索。

description.en: DSH host bundle that fixes manual /compact model selection by rewriting summarization to the frontend current model.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将手动 /compact 的摘要请求重写到前端当前模型，修正其模型选择。

description.en: Dual-palette CRT terminal theme that transforms DSH Web into a readable 1990s sci-fi instrument terminal.
description.zh: 双色CRT终端主题，将DSH Web变成可读的90年代科幻仪表终端。

description.en: Offline evaluation and guarded self-evolution loop for DeepSeek Harness with versioned rollback.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线评估和带版本回滚的受控自进化循环

description.en: Code preview & editor plugin for DSH Web file explorer with syntax highlighting, autosave editing, and themes.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 文件浏览器提供代码预览与编辑：按语言语法高亮、就地编辑并自动保存，支持深色/浅色主题，覆盖原有的纯文本预览。

description.en: Expose Herdr terminal workspaces, panes, and coding agents as DeepSeek Harness tools via local herdr CLI.
description.zh: 通过本地 herdr CLI，把 Herdr 终端工作区、窗格和编码代理暴露为 DeepSeek Harness 可调用的工具。

description.en: A DSH plugin adding a persistent note bar with resident session cards, global/workspace notes, and todo lists.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，添加常驻便签栏，支持常驻会话卡片、全局与工作区笔记及待办列表。

description.en: Sends mobile push notifications via Bark, Server酱, or webhook when dsh tasks complete.
description.zh: dsh 插件：当 dsh 任务完成时通过 Bark、Server酱或 webhook 推送手机通知。

description.en: Searchable model manager for OmniRoute/OpenAI-compatible gateways with provider directory and modality discovery.
description.zh: DSH plugin: searchable/filterable model manager for OmniRoute (or any OpenAI-compatible gateway) — provider directory, modality discovery, multi-select enable.

description.en: Local PaddleOCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness with /ocr command and agent tool for OCR on workspace files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 PaddleOCR 插件，包含 /ocr 命令和代理工具，可对工作区文件进行文字识别。

description.en: Shows current DeepSeek API peak/off-peak discount status to help time API calls
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于高峰还是低谷时段及是否享受五折优惠，帮助安排调用时间。

description.en: DSH Web prompt workbench that turns an input-box draft into a single directly executable command.
description.zh: DSH Web 提示词工作台，可把输入框中的草稿优化成一条可直接执行的命令。

description.en: Session folders for the DSH Web sidebar: nest sessions into colored, icon-tagged folders with drag-and-drop, right-click and batch move.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏会话分组插件：把会话整理进可嵌套、可自定义颜色图标的文件夹，支持拖拽、右键与批量移动。

description.en: Manages user skills via a web GUI: browse, preview, import, add, and batch-delete.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面管理用户技能，支持浏览、预览、导入、添加和批量删除技能

description.en: Cumulative token usage ledger for DeepSeek Harness with live capture, historical backfill, a draggable panel and an HTTP API.
description.zh: DSH 全局累积 token 用量账本：实时捕获与历史回填，提供可拖拽悬浮面板和 HTTP API。

description.en: Token usage statistics panel for DSH, showing a floating ball and minimalist dashboard that aggregates model usage across sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 token 用量统计面板，通过悬浮球和极简仪表盘汇总跨会话的模型使用情况。

description.en: DSH web focus plugin: ?focus=<slot> shows one top-level slot full-width via pure CSS, includes design trail.
description.zh: DSH 网页聚焦插件，用 ?focus=插槽名 让任意顶层插槽全宽显示，纯 CSS 实现，并附需求到关账的完整 intent-flow 设计决策轨迹。

description.en: Provides a Russian locale (ru) translation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, covering 26 namespaces and ~690 lines.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供俄语界面（ru）翻译插件，覆盖26个命名空间，约690行。

description.en: Adds a VSCode-style file explorer tab to DeepSeek Harness conversation window, showing workspace file tree and viewer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话窗口添加类 VSCode 的文件浏览标签页，展示工作区文件树与文件查看器。

description.en: Desktop plugin linking DeepSeek Harness to computer sessions, with device pairing, access control, and synchronized chat.
description.zh: 桌面插件，将 DeepSeek Harness (DSHM) 连接至电脑会话，支持设备配对、访问控制与聊天同步。

description.en: Adds interactive Learning Mode with non-blocking visual explanations and checkpoints to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加交互式学习模式，提供非阻塞的可视化讲解与检查点

description.en: WeChat↔DSH bidirectional bridge: inbound dispatch to agents and outbound push via Hermes, with persistent session reuse.
description.zh: 微信与 DSH 双向桥接：入站消息分发给 agent，经 Hermes 出站推送，并复用持久会话。

description.en: Security audit plugin for DSH with two layers: an always-on process-level Gate and sessions that scan code entering your profile.
description.zh: DSH 安全审计插件，包含始终开启的进程级 Gate 与扫描代码进入配置的会话两层。

description.en: Runs the built-in Anthropic provider on your Claude Code (Pro/Max/Team) subscription login instead of a separate API key.
description.zh: 让内置 Anthropic 提供商使用 Claude Code（Pro/Max/Team）订阅凭证运行，无需单独的 API Key。

description.en: Browse and install DeepSeek Harness plugins and share usage feedback with the community.
description.zh: 浏览并安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在 Harness 内收集插件评分、FAQ 与踩坑记录并分享到社区。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin to search Minecraft Wiki via MediaWiki API and return cleaned, AI-readable text.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，通过MediaWiki API搜索Minecraft Wiki，并返回清洗后可供AI直接阅读的文本。

description.en: Manage archived sessions for DeepSeek Harness: restore, delete all, overview, and inline preview.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理插件，可恢复或删除归档会话、总览全部会话并预览会话内容。

description.en: Groups DSH sessions by workspace with archive, unarchive, delete and batch cleanup, plus automatic ghost-session removal.
description.zh: 按工作区分组管理 DSH 会话，支持归档、取消归档、删除与批量清理，并自动清除幽灵会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops users from blindly approving the model's privilege-escalation requests.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，防止用户盲目批准模型的提权请求。

description.en: A Material Design 3 glassmorphism theme with frosted glass, transparent surfaces, and backdrop blur for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供基于 Material Design 3 的磨砂玻璃主题，包含半透明表面与背景模糊效果。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek API balance in the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar footer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 开放平台 API 的剩余余额。

description.en: Adds configurable one-click or /restart commands to restart the DSH process, and automatically resumes the interrupted task after restart.
description.zh: 提供可配置的一键或 /restart 命令重启 DSH 进程，并在重启后自动接续中断的任务提示。

description.en: Mobile-first overlay for DeepSeek Harness web UI with touch-friendly design.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供移动端优先的覆盖层，包括全宽聊天、抽屉式侧边栏、适合拇指输入的编辑器和触屏安全区域优化。

description.en: Enables file-based slash commands auto-discovered from Markdown files with hot reload for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Markdown 文件的斜杠命令，自动发现并支持热重载。

description.en: Evolver for DeepSeek Harness recalls a proven strategy before each prompt, grades it on evidence, and reports results back to the EvoMap network.
description.zh: Evolver 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自进化能力：每次提示前召回已验证策略，依据证据打分，并将结果回报 EvoMap 网络。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness for drafting prompts, with drafts saved to a JSON file in DSH storage.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏新增标签页，用于起草提示词，草稿保存到 DSH 存储中的 JSON 文件。

description.en: A right-sidebar tab for DeepSeek Harness that lists running subagents and lets you open any of them in one click.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的右侧栏标签页，列出所有子代理并可一键打开查看。

description.en: Displays streaming code diffs in DSH web GUI conversation, with per-round summaries and git fallback.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面会话中显示流式代码差异，提供每轮摘要，并支持 git 回退。

description.en: Annotate replies and sidebar documents inline, collect notes above the composer, and hand them to the agent.
description.zh: 在回复和侧边栏文档中添加行内批注，在输入框上方汇总笔记，并发送给智能体。

description.en: Adds two global skins for DeepSeek Harness (ink charcoal and warm paper) with a switcher in Settings → General.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供两套全局皮肤（墨炭黑与暖纸白），可在设置 → 通用中切换。

description.en: Adds a quick-select button beside the model dropdown that opens a searchable, provider-grouped picker and writes the choice back to the native dropdown.
description.zh: 在模型下拉框左侧添加速选按钮，弹出按提供商分组、可实时搜索并带能力标签与推理徽章的模型选择窗口，选完即回写原生下拉框。

description.en: Read-only DSH web plugin for viewing Git/SVN file changes, diffs, commit history, blame and file history.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中只读查看 Git/SVN 文件变更、差异、提交历史、Blame 与文件历史的插件。

description.en: Adds a Git tab beside Chat/Trace in the DSH Web GUI for viewing changes, staging, committing, diffs, history, branches and push/pull.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 标签栏「对话/轨迹」旁新增 Git 页，可查看改动、暂存、提交、看 diff、翻历史、切分支和推拉。

description.en: Adds a status-bar pill in DeepSeek Harness showing your API balance, this session's cost, and token usage.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 状态栏添加「余额 · 本次」胶囊，显示 API 余额、本次会话费用与 Token 用量。

description.en: Adds an uploadable, host-persisted background image to the DSH Web UI with four display effects that adapt to light and dark themes.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供可上传并由主机保存的背景图片，含四档显示效果并自动适配浅色/深色主题。

description.en: Compiles LaTeX, renders pages, maps issues to source lines with SyncTeX, diffs edits and audits whole books for AI agents.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体编译 LaTeX、渲染页面、用 SyncTeX 定位源码行、对比修改并审计整本书。

description.en: Tracks workspace activity and intentions, then schedules bounded autonomous wake-ups for the DSH agent.
description.zh: 跟踪工作区活动与意图，并为 DSH 智能体安排受预算约束的自主唤醒。

description.en: DSH host plugin that adds two independent System Prompt sections for a trusted workspace's core persona and reusable scene styles, plus an owner-only JSON API and web console.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 宿主插件，为可信工作区添加两个独立的系统提示词分区（核心人格与可复用场景风格），并提供仅限所有者的 JSON API 和五页 Web 控制台。

description.en: Persists DSH workspace state, interests and evolution history so context survives across sessions.
description.zh: 持久保存 DSH 工作区状态、兴趣与演化历史，使上下文跨会话延续。

description.en: Host-side TTS bridge for DeepSeek Harness that synthesizes text to MP3 via edge-tts and serves it over a same-origin webServer route.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的宿主侧语音合成桥，用 edge-tts 把文字合成 MP3 并通过同源 webServer 路由提供给页面播放。

description.en: Integrates Foggy's Java data analysis engine into DeepSeek Harness with on-demand runtime and CLI setup.
description.zh: 将Foggy的Java数据分析引擎集成到DeepSeek Harness，按需初始化运行时和CLI环境。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness slash command that opens the current workspace or a specified path in VS Code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 斜杠命令，用 VS Code 打开当前工作区或指定路径。

description.en: Monitors AI quota and token usage for DeepSeek Harness tools like Codex, Cursor.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 中 Codex、Cursor、Antigravity、OpenCode-Go 等工具的 AI 配额与 token 使用量。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a "Delete conversation…" sidebar action to permanently remove a chat and all its local data.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在侧边栏添加“删除会话…”入口，永久删除该会话及其全部本地数据。

description.en: Declare shell commands in DSH Settings and each one automatically becomes a tool the model can call directly.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中声明 shell 命令，每条命令都会自动成为模型可直接调用的工具。

description.en: Adds one-click force-delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, removing logs, cache, and registry entries with no ghost rows left behind.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏会话菜单添加一键强制删除功能，清理日志、缓存和注册表条目，不留幽灵行。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that lets you play 90+ classic open-source HTML5 browser games instantly, with 1000+ games planned.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，可即点即玩 90 多款经典开源浏览器游戏，计划扩充至 1000+。

description.en: Adds a Claude Code-style Tab shortcut and toolbar switcher to toggle Plan/Build modes, applying per-mode model presets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加类似 Claude Code 的 Tab 快捷键和工具栏切换器，在 Plan 与 Build 模式间切换，并按模式应用模型预设。

description.en: Model-facing tool that copies a session's full history into another workspace together with a written handoff brief.
description.zh: 面向模型工具：把当前会话的完整历史连同书面简报一起交接给另一个工作区。

description.en: Tiered cold storage that moves idle DSH sessions off the live root into a searchable on-disk archive instead of deleting them.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供分层冷存储：空闲会话迁出实时目录，进入可全文搜索的磁盘冷层而非被删除。

description.en: A native command approval gate that intercepts commands in DeepSeek Harness for user review before they run.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生命令审批关卡，在执行前拦截命令并交由用户确认。

description.en: GitHub operations for DeepSeek Harness: releases, tags, a guarded API pass-through, sanitized mirror publishing, workflow runs and repo settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 操作：发布、标签、受控 API 透传、镜像发布、工作流运行与仓库设置。

description.en: Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns, and agent sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的看板插件，支持Gitea任务、工作流列和代理会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness agent tool that adds session_search, enabling full-text search across historical sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 智能体工具，提供 session_search，可对历史会话进行全文检索。

description.en: Portuguese (Brazil) language pack for DeepSeek Harness web GUI; adds live translated UI via profile settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的巴西葡萄牙语语言包，通过配置文件实时翻译界面。

description.en: Adds an archive center to DeepSeek Harness for browsing, restoring and auto-cleaning archived conversations that the sidebar hides.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加归档会话中心，可按日期浏览、一键恢复并自动清理被侧栏隐藏的归档会话。

description.en: Standalone DSH plugin that previews .drawio (mxGraph XML) diagrams inside the Web Sidebar without bundling DeepSeek packages.
description.zh: 独立 DSH 插件，可在 Web 侧边栏中预览 .drawio（mxGraph XML）图表，不打包任何 DeepSeek 包。

description.en: Claude-compatible memory for DeepSeek Harness, storing notes in a user-chosen directory with a MEMORY.md index and topic files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供兼容 Claude 的记忆功能，将笔记存入用户指定目录，含 MEMORY.md 索引与主题文件。

description.en: Previews .html pages in the DSH Sidebar and lets you visually edit styles, text, position and elements, writing changes back to the source file.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏预览 .html 页面，可视化编辑样式、文字、位置并删除元素，改动写回源文件。

description.en: Generate images and videos inside DSH chat and post them to the session, with inline gallery, downloads and background tasks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中生成图片/视频并发送到会话，支持内联画廊、下载与后台任务。

description.en: DSH plugin that reads finalized assistant replies aloud via Xiaomi MiMo TTS, adding a settings page, per-reply volume button and inline player.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用小米 MiMo TTS 朗读已定稿的助手回复，附带设置页、每条回复的音量按钮和内联播放器。

description.en: Inject custom text into the DSH system prompt or session context from a Settings page, with independent file storage and history backups.
description.zh: 在官方设置页把自定义文字注入 DSH 系统提示词或会话上下文，独立文件存储，支持热加载与历史备份。

description.en: Adds a per-workspace popup to toggle MCP servers and skills on or off in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中为每个工作区行添加弹窗，用于开关 MCP 服务和技能。

description.en: Provides an extension center with sidebar nav and GitHub plugin catalog for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供扩展中心，含侧边栏导航和 GitHub 插件目录。

description.en: A2A protocol plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling multi inbound/outbound agent-to-agent servers with GUI management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 A2A 协议插件，支持多入站/出站智能体服务器及 GUI 管理。

description.en: Routes overseas model/file downloads in DeepSeek Harness through a built-in proxy kernel with sha256 checks, size limits and stall detection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供下载代理：境外文件自动走内置代理内核，境内直连，支持 sha256 校验、大小上限与停滞检测。

description.en: Adds a sidebar menu action that permanently deletes a session, stopping running work first, refusing forked parents, and clearing all local storage.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单中新增永久删除会话功能，先停止运行中的任务，拒绝派生父会话，并清理所有本地存储。

description.en: Left-sidebar radar board ranking now-showing and upcoming Chinese, US, European, Japanese and Korean films and series by global buzz and site ratings.
description.zh: 左侧边栏影视雷达面板，按全球热度与各大网站评分排序推荐正在上映或一个月内待映的中美欧日韩电影与剧集。

description.en: Adds an Insights tab to DSH session view that lists per-turn tool-call counts and lets the current model generate a written analysis of each turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话视图新增「解读」标签，按轮次统计工具调用次数、失败数与提示词摘要，并可让当前模型生成每轮解读。

description.en: Bridge that lets you drive a local DeepSeek Harness from Feishu/Lark chat, with identical session transcripts on both sides and no public IP.
description.zh: 通过飞书远程驱动本机 DeepSeek Harness 的桥接插件，双端会话记录一致，无需公网 IP 或内网穿透。

description.en: Adds /simplify and /code-review (alias /review) commands: behavior-preserving cleanup plus multi-angle bug hunting with independent verification.
description.zh: 为 / 菜单添加 /simplify 与 /code-review（别名 /review）命令，实现不改行为的代码清理与多角度查 bug 并独立验证。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that sends a desktop notification each time a turn ends.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在每轮回答结束时发送桌面通知。

description.en: Task-completion notification chime for DSH web GUI, beeping on agent turn finish even in background tabs, with sounds and volume options.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面任务完成提示音：代理回合结束时发声，后台标签页也能响，内置 10 种音效并支持导入自定义音频和调节音量。

description.en: Provides configurable multi-provider web search for DeepSeek Harness, replacing the default backend with a fallback chain of search providers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的多提供商网络搜索，用后备链替换默认后端。

description.en: Assign a colour to any DSH session so you can spot it at a glance in the sidebar.
description.zh: 为任意 DSH 会话设置颜色，在侧边栏中一眼即可识别。

description.en: Long-term associative memory for DeepSeek Harness: raw episodes, typed memory cards and entity pages kept in a plain-text vault you own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期联想记忆：原始片段、分类记忆卡与实体页面，全部保存在你自有的纯文本库中。

description.en: Adds workspace-scoped MCP server management so each project directory gets its own set of MCP tools.
description.zh: 为每个项目目录提供独立的 MCP 服务器管理，使各工作区拥有自己的 MCP 工具集。

description.en: Adds a single data line each turn showing context-window usage so the agent itself decides what to do.
description.zh: 每轮对话附加一行上下文窗口用量数据，由模型自行决定如何处理。

description.en: Full-text search across all DSH desktop conversations from the sidebar, plus an in-chat Cmd+F find bar that jumps to the hit.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端侧栏全文搜索所有会话，并提供会话内 Cmd+F 查找条，命中可直接跳转到那句话。

description.en: Records why code changed and what was abandoned as machine-verifiable repository decision notes, with skills, session toggles and merge gates.
description.zh: 把「为什么这样改、放弃了什么」沉淀为可机械校验的仓库决策笔记，含技能、会话开关、门禁与上游合并。

description.en: Estimates and displays DeepSeek Harness web session API costs per turn and cumulatively, with expandable details.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话统计每轮与整场 API 花费，并可展开查看明细。

description.en: Shows the current DeepSeek API Peak or Off-Peak pricing period in the sidebar footer, with a click-to-view countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于高峰还是低谷计费时段，点击可查看下次切换的倒计时。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek Platform topped-up and granted balance per currency right in the composer, with a click-open details panel and zero setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入区直接显示 DeepSeek 平台各币种的充值余额与赠送余额，点击可展开详情面板，无需任何配置。

description.en: Shows a DeepSeek peak/off-peak rate clock in the composer with a live 24-hour tariff bar, local windows, countdown and official prices.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入区显示峰谷计费时钟，包含实时 24 小时资费条、本地时段、倒计时和官方价格。

description.en: Embeds the real chat.deepseek.com page in a DSH Desktop sidebar panel, with a session that survives restarts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 侧边栏中嵌入真实的 chat.deepseek.com 页面，会话可在重启后保留。

description.en: Remembers the DeepSeek Harness desktop window's size, position and maximized state and restores it before the first frame.
description.zh: 记住 DeepSeek Harness 桌面主窗口的大小、位置和最大化状态，并在首帧渲染前恢复。

description.en: Displays OpenCode Go subscription usage windows in the DSH composer with a click-open details panel and zero configuration.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入区显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量窗口，点击可打开详情面板，无需配置。

description.en: Local-first sticky notes for DeepSeek Harness Desktop with focus-mode WYSIWYG editing, rich attachments and inline media embeds.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的本地优先便利贴，支持专注模式所见即所得编辑、富媒体附件与内嵌媒体。

description.en: Allows choosing which provider/model powers a subagent in DeepSeek Harness, with configurable reuse and nested inheritance.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中，当 AI 派遣子代理时可让用户选择模型，支持可配置复用与嵌套继承。

description.en: 为deepseek harness的A2A插件，实现dsh和openclaw及hermes的多方a2a互通和工具调用等功能
A GUI card plugin showing DeepSeek account balance and live per-conversation token usage/cost with peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面中显示账户余额（按颜色分级）以及当前对话的实时 token 用量和费用，费用区分高峰与非高峰时段计价。

description.en: Experiment harness for DeepSeek Harness with isolated adapters, measured comparisons, native experiment views, and evidence-linked lessons.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供隔离适配器、量化对比、原生实验视图和证据关联经验的实验工具。

description.en: Provides CSV and image preview capabilities for the dsh plugin system.
description.zh: 为 dsh 插件系统提供 CSV 表格和图片文件的预览能力。

description.en: Syncs and backs up DeepSeek Harness settings and API keys across devices via your own WebDAV storage, with snapshots and restore preview.
description.zh: 通过自有 WebDAV 存储跨设备同步备份 DeepSeek Harness 的常用配置与 API Key，支持快照预览与恢复。

description.en: Lets you define per-conversation context profiles that choose which tools and which system prompt each new DSH chat receives.
description.zh: 为每个新对话创建上下文配置，选择该对话可用的工具和系统提示词。

description.en: Local secret management plugin for DSH that stores passwords, API tokens and encrypted text and exposes only secret-free references to agents.
description.zh: DSH 本地密钥管理插件，用于保存账号密码、API Token 和加密文本，并只向 Agent 暴露不含明文的引用。

description.en: A DSH sidebar footer card that shows account balance, live per-token prices, and a peak/idle pricing countdown.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏底部卡片，显示账户余额、实时单价以及高峰/空闲计费倒计时。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness dashboard showing all sessions, task progress, waiting states, background jobs, and token KPIs in one web GUI page.
description.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 仪表盘，在一个网页中集中展示所有会话、任务进度、等待状态、后台任务和 Token KPI。

description.en: Zen Mode view tab plus a foreground time tracker with daily/weekly zen scores for DeepSeek Harness, all pure frontend.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供禅模式视图标签页与前台专注时间跟踪，并给出每日/每周禅意评分，纯前端实现。

description.en: Contract-first API studio for DSH: author OpenAPI contracts, review breaking changes, version and document APIs via 7 skills.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的契约优先 API 工作台：通过 7 个技能编写 OpenAPI 契约、审查破坏性变更、管理版本与文档。

description.en: Blender production pack for DeepSeek Harness with a headless bpy runner, render/export workflows, a modeling cookbook, and Blender 5.x pitfalls.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Blender 生产工具包，提供无头 bpy 运行器、渲染导出流程、建模手册和 Blender 5.x 避坑指南。

description.en: ComfyUI production pack for DSH: environment health checks, a zero-dependency API client, workflow rework, tested parameter matrices, broken-image troubleshooting and batch runs.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 ComfyUI 生产包：环境体检、零依赖 API 客户端、工作流改造、实测参数矩阵、崩图排查与批量生成。

description.en: Git workflow studio for DeepSeek Harness with 7 skills covering branch models, commit conventions, PR review, history surgery, recovery and release versioning.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作流套件，含 7 项技能：分支模型、提交规范、PR 审查、历史改写、灾难恢复与发布版本管理。

description.en: One-person-company operations SOP plugin that runs a daily morning-to-evening cycle and keeps ledgers, quotes, contracts and reports on file.
description.zh: 一人公司运营 SOP 插件：按晨报→上午档→下午档→晚报跑日循环，台账、报价、合同、日报全部落档留痕。

description.en: A Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for DeepSeek Harness, registering into ctx.web for keyless or API-key web search.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Tavily 的网页搜索，注册到 ctx.web，支持免密钥或 API 密钥搜索。

description.en: Searchable Cmd+K palette for switching models in the DeepSeek Harness composer, with provider rail, capability badges and cached icons.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的可搜索模型切换面板，支持 Cmd+K 呼出、提供商分组、能力徽章与图标缓存。

description.en: A DSH Web front-end plugin that keeps recently opened session histories in a browser LRU cache so switching sessions no longer re-fetches them.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web 前端插件，在浏览器中用 LRU 缓存最近打开的会话历史，切换会话时无需重新向后端拉取。

description.en: Registers Linear issue-tracking tools for the harness via 20 GraphQL tools plus a bridge to Linear's hosted MCP server.
description.zh: 通过20个GraphQL工具和对Linear托管MCP服务器的桥接，为框架注册Linear问题追踪工具。

description.en: Points DeepSeek Harness's built-in web search and web fetch tools at Keenable's keyless public endpoints for ranked results and page reading.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 内置的网页搜索与网页抓取工具指向 Keenable 免密钥公共接口，实现搜索与页面读取。

description.en: macOS app control for DeepSeek Harness via an MCP adapter, with an approval dialog for actions.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 适配器为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 应用控制，并在操作前弹出审批对话框。

description.en: Connects DSH to the DSH Mobile Android app with QR pairing, on-phone access, and approval actions from notifications.
description.zh: 通过二维码配对将 DSH 连接到 DSH Mobile Android 应用，支持手机端使用并从通知中处理审批。

description.en: A console for managing DSH sessions: permanently purging sessions via a five-step deletion flow plus bulk cleanup with force and interrupt safeguards.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理控制台：通过五步删除流程彻底清除会话，并支持带强制/中断保护的批量清理。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar tab to browse all loaded DSH skills organized into your own custom categories.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏标签页中按自定义分类浏览所有已加载的 DSH 技能。

description.en: An isolated, read-only experiment that generates open-ended associations across your own persisted DSH session history, with a model-free mock mode.
description.zh: 在隔离只读环境中，对已保存的 DSH 会话历史进行开放式联想实验，模拟模式无需模型调用。

description.en: Adds a side panel listing session questions; click to scroll to corresponding answers in DeepSeek Harness web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件：在右侧面板列出当前会话的全部提问，点击某条即可滚动定位到对应回答。

description.en: Adds KnyazevAI API models as a model provider for DeepSeek Harness and DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 和 DSH Desktop 添加 KnyazevAI API 模型提供方。

description.en: Scheduled task and message push manager for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 提供的定时任务与消息推送管理器。

description.en: Adds a toolbar button that rewrites your current draft into a clearer, executable prompt, with undo, cancellation and configurable prompt/model settings.
description.zh: 添加工具栏按钮，将当前草稿改写为更清晰、可执行的提示词，支持撤销、取消以及自定义提示词和模型设置。

description.en: Adds a composer control to set auto-compaction thresholds in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中添加自動壓縮門檻的輸入控制。

description.en: Personal-edition Superagent plugin for DSH Desktop: sidebar panel skeleton plus a domain core, SQLite store, persistent effects queue and personal policy.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端打造的个人版 Superagent 插件：侧边栏面板骨架已验收，领域核心、SQLite 存储、持久化 Effects 队列与个人策略正在接入。

description.en: Operations layer for DSH plugins: dependency drift radar, failure brake, and token/latency attribution. ｜ DSH 插件运维层：依赖漂移雷达、失败刹车、Token 与耗时归因。
Durable agent memory for DeepSeek Harness — global + per-project memories, written by the agent and fully editable in Settings → Memory.
Adds a "Delete Session" item under Archive in the session menu that removes a session and all of its data in one tap.
description.zh: 在会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增「删除会话」选项，一键删除该会话及其全部数据。

description.en: Tracks real-time per-session token costs in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with per-provider pricing and peak/off-peak tariffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中实时显示每个会话的 token 成本，支持按服务商定价和峰谷时段费率配置。

description.en: Desktop add-on that lets you choose close behaviour (background or quit) and open sessions or workspaces in child windows.
description.zh: 桌面附加组件：可选择关闭行为（后台或退出），并在子窗口中打开会话或工作区。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin with 15 tools for managing GetNote notes, tags, and knowledge bases.
description.zh: 面向得到大脑(GetNote)的原生DeepSeek Harness插件，提供15个工具管理笔记、标签和知识库。

description.en: A Web UI skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness that changes the interface to a 1945 historical theme with oil painting background and imperial edict sidebar.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面换肤为 1945 年历史主题，使用油画背景与圣旨样式侧边栏。

description.en: DSH plugin that routes and rewrites outbound HTTP requests by host and path, with a native right-sidebar monitor.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按主机和路径路由并重写对外 HTTP 请求，并配有原生右侧栏监控面板。

description.en: Surfaces DeepSeek model pricing and specs plus DSH plugin search with sandbox install test results inside the harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内提供 DeepSeek 价格、模型规格与插件搜索，并展示沙箱安装测试结果。

description.en: Adds a read-only cadpop.com CAD workspace to DSH with parametric templates, drawing tools, a DFM entry and a help center.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加只读的 cadpop.com CAD 工作区，包含参数化模板、绘图工具、DFM 入口和帮助中心。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that fetches mfgabc.com manufacturing standards, industrial city, process cluster and compliance information.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件，用于获取 mfgabc.com 的制造业标准、工业城市、工艺集群与合规信息。

description.en: Read-only plugin for mj7.cn trade data: standards and product search, HS code lookup, Incoterms, trade docs and FX rates.
description.zh: 只读的 mj7.cn 贸易数据插件：标准与产品搜索、HS 编码查询、国际贸易术语、贸易文档和汇率。

description.en: Portable Agent Notes toolkit providing verification gates, scaffolding CLI, and a dsh preset/bundle.
description.zh: 可移植的Agent Notes工具包，包含验证门、脚手架CLI和dsh预设/捆绑包。

description.en: Background long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness, ported from the Codex two-phase memory pipeline.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台长期记忆的插件，移植自 Codex 的两阶段记忆流水线。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you select text in a conversation and quote it straight into the composer input box with one click.
description.zh: DSH 插件：划选会话中的文字，一键引用到输入框。

description.en: Layered, restorable context management for DSH with tool-output cards, three-tier model folds, a local archive, decompress and search.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供分层可恢复的上下文管理：工具输出卡片、三级模型折叠、本地归档、解压与搜索。

description.en: Pushes Bark alerts to your iPhone/Apple Watch when a DSH agent task finishes, needs authorization, or errors out.
description.zh: DSH 任务完成、需要授权或运行出错时，通过 Bark 推送通知到 iPhone／Apple Watch。

description.en: Encrypted full backup and restore for DSH: config, sessions, plugins, workspace and Hindsight memory packed into rolling encrypted volumes.
description.zh: DSH 加密全量备份与恢复：将配置、会话、插件、工作区与 Hindsight 记忆打包为加密分卷，支持 GFS 滚动保留。

description.en: Dual-engine DSH plugin that enhances prompts by rewriting drafts with direction options and adds a strategic advisor engine with situation models.
description.zh: 双引擎 DSH 插件：提示词增强（草稿改写+方向选项）与参谋方向引擎（以局势模型为核心）。

description.en: Lightweight cross-session reflection cards for DeepSeek Harness: 3-5 reusable facts per turn, last 3 cards injected into new sessions.
Loads MCP tools on demand so only core tools sit in the prompt prefix, cutting context and token usage.
description.zh: 按需加载 MCP 工具，提示词前缀只保留核心工具，从而降低上下文与 token 占用。

description.en: Gates agent tools by session stage (explore/edit/debug) and emits throttled followup hints with a status-bar stage indicator.
description.zh: 按会话阶段（探索/编辑/调试）动态限制可用工具，并发送节流的后续提示和状态栏阶段指示。

description.en: Adds grouping to the dsh plugin list, separating official and third-party plugins for easier management.
description.zh: 为 dsh 插件列表添加分组，区分官方与第三方插件，便于管理。

description.en: dsh web plugin that uses the Window Controls Overlay API so installed web apps get a native-feeling title bar from the app's own header.
description.zh: dsh Web 插件，基于 Window Controls Overlay API，让已安装的 Web 应用用自己的顶部栏当原生窗口标题栏。

description.en: Pins workspaces with running or awaiting-reply sessions to the top of the DSH sidebar so active chats stay visible.
description.zh: 将正在运行或等待回复的会话所在工作区置顶显示在 DSH 侧边栏顶部，方便快速查看活跃会话。

description.en: Listens on a fixed local port inside DSH and forwards connections to DSH's randomly assigned web port, giving clients one stable address.
description.zh: 在 DSH 进程内监听固定本地端口，把连接原样转发到每次启动随机分配的 web 端口，客户端只需记住一个地址。

description.en: DSH plugin that collapses or expands the sidebar tools and workspace areas separately, remembers each state, and pins projects in saved order.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可分别展开或收起侧边栏功能区与工作区并各自记住状态，还支持置顶项目并按原生排序保存顺序。

description.en: Localizes the DSH approval panel into Chinese by taking over conversation.composer to redraw approval cards, translating authorization reasons and command details.
description.zh: 将 DSH 审批面板中文化的插件：接管 conversation.composer 用中文重绘审批卡片，翻译授权原因与命令明细。

description.en: Adds a sidebar "Archived Sessions" page that lists archived sessions and permanently deletes them from disk.
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增「已归档会话」页面，列出归档会话并可将其彻底删除。

description.en: A branch-map plugin for dsh that visually manages fork sessions in a tree, with per-branch annotations and persistent layouts.
description.zh: 一个dsh分支图谱插件，用树状视图管理fork会话，支持每分支注解与布局持久化。

description.en: DSH settings panel that lists all archived sessions on your machine, restoring each back into its workspace or permanently deleting logs and projection cache.
description.zh: DSH 设置面板：列出本机全部已归档会话，可逐条复原回工作区，或连同日志与投影缓存永久删除。

description.en: Animates the quick-jump turn-rail anchors on the right edge of the DSH conversation page in sync with system audio.
description.zh: 让 DSH 对话页面右侧快速跳转锚点（turn rail）随系统播放的音乐一起律动。

description.en: Adds a /context slash command and panel showing context-window usage, token cost, turns/steps, output speed, and account balance.
description.zh: 提供 /context 斜杠命令与上下文用量面板，展示占用构成、计费用量、轮数/步数、输出速度及账户余额。

description.en: Adds a persistent pill under the composer showing per-answer and per-session token cost at official DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示每条回答与每次会话的费用，按 DeepSeek 官方高峰/低谷费率计价。

description.en: Previews .dwg/.dxf CAD drawings in the DSH sidebar document preview, decoded by LibreDWG (WASM) and rendered as vector SVG.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏文档预览中直接查看 .dwg/.dxf 工程图纸，用 LibreDWG(WASM) 解码并渲染为矢量 SVG。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that parses JLC EDA .enet netlists and audits schematics for broken nets, floating pins and rule errors.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件，解析嘉立创 EDA .enet 网表并校对原理图，检查断链、悬空脚与规则异常。

description.en: Local-first paper reader for DSH: sidebar reader panel plus paper_read/paper_list/paper_scan tools with a zero-dependency PDF text extractor.
description.zh: DSH 本地论文阅读插件：侧边栏阅读面板，提供 paper_read/paper_list/paper_scan 工具，内置零依赖纯 Node PDF 文本提取器。

description.en: Peak-hour reminder plugin for DeepSeek Harness with mode indicator, pre-peak notifications, and API balance card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 高峰时段提醒插件，提供模式指示灯、高峰前提醒和余额卡片。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness a resizable drawing canvas with composable brushes, an editable stroke list, PNG export and screenshot review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供尺寸可控的画布、可组合笔刷、可编辑笔触列表、PNG 导出与截图回看能力。

description.en: Masks sensitive values at paste time so secrets never reach the DSH composer, keeping prompts and logs free of private data.
description.zh: 粘贴时自动遮蔽敏感数据，确保私密信息不会进入 DSH 输入框。

description.en: Predicts your next prompt as ghost text in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer and accepts it with Tab.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框中以幽灵文本预测下一条提示词，按 Tab 采纳。

description.en: Rewrites assistant replies in the persisted DSH session log in place, so later turns read the edited version.
description.zh: 就地改写 DSH 会话日志中已保存的助手回复，让后续轮次读到改写后的版本。

description.en: Archives, views, restores, and deletes DSH conversation sessions without restart.
