description.zh: DSH 会话管理插件，可归档或保留活跃会话、查看归档对话内容、恢复和删除会话，无需重启。

description.en: DSH client plugin that adds a session telemetry pill to the composer dock, expanding into a token, performance and context panel.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件，在输入框停靠栏添加会话遥测胶囊，可展开查看 token、性能与上下文面板。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music player that lives in the DSH right sidebar, with login, multi-account sessions and full playlist playback.
description.zh: 网易云音乐 DSH 右侧栏播放器，支持登录、多账号切换与歌单播放。

description.en: Xiaoyaoyou adds a flowing glyph-water canvas background with light text, ripples, and sparse accents to new DSH conversations.
description.zh: 逍遥游为 DSH 新会话添加流动的字水画布背景，带文字光效、涟漪和稀疏点缀。

description.en: LLM-decoupled crypto trading engine that runs any strategy with deterministic execution and risk controls; LLM only gives whitelist-checked advice.
description.zh: 将 LLM 剥离出交易层的加密交易引擎，可承载任意策略，负责下单、风控与账本，LLM 仅提供经白名单校验的建议。

description.en: A DSH chat plugin that auto-detects mermaid code blocks and renders them as diagrams with a source/diagram toggle and theme following.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 聊天插件，自动识别 mermaid 代码块并渲染为图形，支持源码/图形切换与明暗主题跟随。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the three OpenCode Go quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly) in the composer dock.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在输入框停靠区显示 OpenCode Go 的三个配额窗口（5 小时、每周、每月）。

description.en: DSH settings-panel plugin to browse, create, edit and safely delete local skills, with invocation-policy toggles and search.
description.zh: DSH 设置页技能管理插件：集中查看、新建、编辑与安全删除本地技能，并可切换调用策略与搜索。

description.en: Replaces the DSH composer model selector with a starfield reasoning-effort slider, mapping effort per model with reliable model switching.
description.zh: 用星空轨道式推理强度滑块取代 DSH 输入框模型选择器，按模型映射强度并保证切换稳定。

description.en: DSH plugin that displays real-time AI service usage/balance in a corner card and provides offline local token statistics.
description.zh: DSH 插件：右下角常驻卡片实时显示 AI 用量/余额，并支持离线本地 Token 统计。

description.en: Enhances slash command menu with separator-transparent, abbreviation-aware candidate ranking for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness的斜杠命令菜单提供分隔符透明且支持缩写匹配的候选排序。

description.en: Adds a one-click restart button in the settings page to reboot the entire DeepSeek Harness app from the browser.
description.zh: 在设置页面添加一键重启按钮，可直接从浏览器重启整个 DeepSeek Harness 应用。

description.en: Browser plugin that opens source file locations in an IDE by Shift+Option clicking page elements.
description.zh: 浏览器插件，按住 Shift+Option 点击页面元素，即可在 IDE 中打开该元素对应的源文件位置

description.en: Injects an extra system-prompt section into a DeepSeek Harness agent via configurable bundle.
description.zh: 通过可配置的 bundle 向 DeepSeek Harness 代理注入额外的系统提示词段落。

description.en: Search-enabled composer model seat for DeepSeek Harness with sticky fuzzy search.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带固定模糊搜索的模型选择器。

description.en: Local bookshelf plugin that scans EPUB/TXT/PDF/DOCX folders and lets you read them offline in a dsh panel.
description.zh: 本地书架插件：扫描本地 EPUB/TXT/PDF/DOCX 文件夹，在 dsh 面板中离线阅读。

description.en: Manages long DeepSeek Harness chats with fresh context, prompt rewinds, automatic compaction and turn recovery, all in one sidebar tab.
description.zh: 在一个侧边栏标签中管理长对话：同聊天内刷新上下文、回退到任意提示（含文件）、自动压缩、失败回合恢复。

description.en: Refreshes file observations after an agent's own bash or shell command so FS_STALE_VERSION only fires on writes by others.
description.zh: 在代理自身的 bash 或 shell 命令后刷新文件观察状态，使 FS_STALE_VERSION 仅在他人写入时触发。

description.en: DSH plugin giving agents email tools: send, CSV-personalised mass send, scheduled queue, inbox reading, across multiple providers.
description.zh: 为智能体提供邮件工具的 DSH 插件：发送、CSV 个性化群发、定时队列、收件箱读取，支持多家服务商。

description.en: Orchestrates multi-agent swarms and tasks in DeepSeek Harness with an Orchestrate tab, orch_* tools and runners.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中编排多智能体集群与任务，提供 Orchestrate 标签页、orch_* 工具和运行器。

description.en: Softphone for the DSH web GUI: SMS, browser calls, live voicemail with pick-up, DND, local voicemail transcripts and phone_* agent tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供电话功能：短信、浏览器通话、可接听的实时语音信箱、免打扰、本地语音转写和 phone_* 智能体工具。

description.en: Notify-only update checker that surfaces only plugin releases compatible with your running DSH core, matching plugins by specifier.
description.zh: 仅通知的更新检查器，只提示与当前 DSH 核心兼容的插件发布，并按说明符而非名称匹配插件。

description.en: Clamps every image sent to the model to a per-side pixel cap (default 2000 px) to fix Anthropic many-image request errors.
description.zh: 将发送给模型的每张图片按单边像素上限（默认 2000 px）进行缩放，修复 Anthropic 多图请求报错。

description.en: Routes subagents to a cheaper sibling of the parent model (Opus to Sonnet, Qwen max to flash) unless a route is named.
description.zh: 将子代理默认降级到父模型的廉价同级模型（Opus 到 Sonnet、Qwen max 到 flash），除非显式指定路由。

description.en: Read-aloud, dictation and language-aware speech for the DSH web UI with 23 TTS/STT providers and word highlighting.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供朗读、听写和语言感知语音功能，支持 23 家 TTS/STT 服务商和逐词高亮。

description.en: Workspace-first sidebar rail for the DSH web GUI, grouping chats into project folders with pinning, live recents, search and unread markers.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供以工作区为核心的侧边栏：按项目文件夹整理会话，支持置顶、实时最近记录、搜索和未读标记。

description.en: Adds a per-workspace session tree to the Web UI, mapping sessions, turns and fork branches for easy navigation.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中为每个工作区添加会话树，映射会话、轮次和分叉分支，便于导航。

description.en: File-based long-term memory for DSH agents with two-stage extraction, a consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt injection, and memory tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供基于文件的长期记忆：两阶段提取、整合式 MEMORY.md 手册、提示注入及记忆工具。

description.en: An always-on-top desktop floating washing machine that shows your DSH agent's session status and alerts you when it's done, stuck, or waiting on you.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话状态渲染成永远置顶的桌面滚筒洗衣机悬浮窗，洗完、卡住、待确认时主动提醒你。

description.en: Gives each session an isolated Playwright browser with tabs, in-chat screenshots and per-site proxy support.
description.zh: 为每个会话提供隔离的 Playwright 浏览器，支持多标签页、聊天内截图和按站点配置代理。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so agent presets using complete:true personas can still receive an injected text block.
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的提示变量，使使用 complete:true 人设的智能体预设仍能接收注入的文本块。

description.en: Sidebar badge widget that shows DeepSeek account balance, bonus credit, current model and a platform usage shortcut, highlighting low balances.
description.zh: 侧边栏徽章小部件，显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、赠送额度、当前模型及平台用量快捷入口，余额偏低时会高亮提醒。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in the DSH sidebar where an AI hosts and plays up to five other seats, leaving one for you.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏单人玩剧本杀：AI 担任主持人并扮演其余最多五个角色，只留一个座位给你。

description.en: Shows this session's token usage and RMB cost, converted with DeepSeek's official pricing, beside the context-usage bar in the DSH web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的上下文用量右侧，显示本会话的 token 用量与按官方价目折算的人民币费用。

description.en: DSH Web插件：在AI生成时按Ctrl+C即可中断当前回合，等效于点击停止按钮。
description.zh: DSH Web插件，在AI生成回复时按Ctrl+C可中断当前回合，效果等同于点击停止按钮。

description.en: Adds a permanent "Delete Session" action to the DSH Web GUI sidebar menu, archiving the session and removing its log directory.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 侧边栏菜单添加「删除会话」操作，归档会话并移除其日志目录。

description.en: Mobile viewport lock, overscroll containment, virtual keyboard resizing and sidebar auto-retraction for DSH on phones.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供移动端视口锁定、滚动回弹抑制、虚拟键盘自适应和侧边栏自动收起。

description.en: A maintained DSH plugin that lets users switch the outbound proxy at runtime and configure it through a web settings card.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件（维护分支），支持运行时切换出站代理，并通过网页设置卡片进行配置。

description.en: A draggable, collapsible Minesweeper board that floats over the chat area so you can play while the agent works.
description.zh: 一个可拖动、可折叠的扫雷棋盘，悬浮在对话区域左侧，让你在智能体工作时也能玩。

description.en: Hold-to-open overlay that shows DeepSeek Harness Desktop keyboard shortcuts with keycap search, temporary pinning and light/dark themes.
description.zh: 长按唤出快捷键指南浮层，支持键位搜索、临时固定快捷键，并提供明暗主题与双语界面。

description.en: DSH Desktop sidebar add-on that checks for app updates, shows DeepSeek balance and API key, and imports chats from other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强插件：侧边栏检查更新、显示 DeepSeek 余额与 API Key，并导入其他 AI 工具的对话记录。

description.en: Adds a translate button beside each DSH AI reply segment (excluding chain-of-thought) and shows the translation in your chosen language below the original.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每条 AI 回复段落（不含思维链）旁添加翻译按钮，用已配置模型译成所选语言并显示在原文下方。

description.en: Shows an animated character card beside the chat input whenever you switch provider or model, with stat bars, quota status, quotes and a built-in art gallery.
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁弹出一张带动画的角色卡，含六轴数值、额度状态、台词和内置素材图鉴。

description.en: Discovers scoped project tasks inside DeepSeek Harness and records execution receipts for each task run.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按范围发现项目任务，并为每次执行生成回执记录。

description.en: An independent Missher DSH plugin distributed as source, an installable bundle and documentation, aimed at configuring reasoning effort.
description.zh: 独立的 Missher DSH 插件，提供源码、可安装包和文档，用于配置推理强度（reasoning effort）。

description.en: Independent Missher DSH plugin offering source, installable bundle, documentation, and homepage links to desktop entry and other plugins.
description.zh: 独立的 Missher DSH 插件，提供源码、可安装包和文档，主页链接桌面入口及其他插件。

description.en: Localhost-first HTTP debugging tool for DSH that blocks remote hosts and sensitive headers by default.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地优先 HTTP 调试工具，默认阻止远程主机和敏感请求头。

description.en: Version-aware documentation query with excerpt bounding for DSH agents, using host-supplied lookup.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供带版本感知的文档查询，按版本匹配并限制返回摘录长度，查询由宿主提供，不内置固定网络提供商。

description.en: Parses Python, Node.js, Rust, and Java stack traces into structured error frames with bounded metadata for DSH debugging.
description.zh: 将 Python、Node.js、Rust 和 Java 堆栈跟踪解析为带有限定元数据的结构化错误帧，供 DSH 调试使用。

description.en: Provides a lightweight read-only repository structure and symbol map for DSH, complementing dsh-context-pack.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供轻量、只读的仓库结构与符号映射，可与 dsh-context-pack 配合使用。

description.en: Adds theme-matched typing effects, pet companions, combo animations and typing sounds to DSH, with per-effect toggles and light/dark support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打字过程添加主题特效、萌宠陪伴、连击动画和打字音效，支持独立开关与浅色/深色界面。

description.en: Adds Reload UI and Restart App buttons to the sidebar footer of the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows.
description.zh: 为 Windows 版 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用的侧边栏底部添加“重新加载界面”和“重启应用”按钮。

description.en: Adds shutdown and restart power controls to the DSH sidebar plus a Windows system-tray launcher with start-at-logon support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏添加关机/重启电源控制，并提供支持开机自启的 Windows 托盘启动器。

description.en: Checks installed third-party DSH plugins against npm and updates them in place, with a sidebar page, Plugins tab and update badge.
description.zh: 检查已安装的第三方 DSH 插件在 npm 上的版本并就地更新，提供右侧栏页面、插件标签页和左侧更新徽标。

description.en: Adds a "Delete session" item to the sidebar context menu so sessions can be permanently removed from the harness.
description.zh: 在侧边栏右键菜单中增加“删除会话”选项，可永久删除会话。

description.en: Secure, opt-in phone access for DeepSeek Harness Web on macOS.
description.zh: 允许手机在用户同意后安全访问macOS上的DeepSeek Harness Web界面。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the DeepSeek Harness Desktop (Windows) title bar that confirms, then closes and relaunches the app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop（Windows）标题栏添加「重启」按钮，确认后关闭并重新启动应用。

description.en: Windows dev environment doctor for DSH: audits 30 dev tools, one-click installs missing ones, manages PATH, and shares setups via an 8-char code.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 开发环境体检插件：扫描 30 种工具、一键安装缺失项、自动管理 PATH，并用 8 位短码分享整套环境。

description.en: Interactive 3D atlas of crystal structures, Bravais lattices, atomic orbitals, symmetry operations and lattice dynamics, with guided lessons, quizzes, notes and CIF import.
description.zh: 交互式固体物理与原子物理3D图鉴：晶体结构、布拉维格子、原子轨道、对称操作与晶格动力学，含分步讲解、测验、笔记和CIF导入。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Git graph and guarded Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness, staying inside the session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区级 Git 图谱与安全 Git 工作台，无需离开会话。

description.en: Adds a type-to-search filter field to the model picker in DeepSeek Harness composer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器的模型选择列表中增加输入即筛选的搜索框，可边打字边过滤模型。

description.en: Keeps the virtuoso-bridge-lite SSH tunnel and side daemon running as managed runtimes so the agent can drive Virtuoso via its Python API.
description.zh: 将 virtuoso-bridge-lite 的 SSH 隧道与守护进程托管为常驻运行时，让智能体通过 Python API 驱动 Virtuoso。

description.en: Sidebar panel for selecting configured LLM provider/model routes with automatic failover on quota errors and optional multi-key rotation.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板可选择已配置的 LLM 提供商/模型路由，并在配额错误时自动故障转移，支持可选的多密钥轮换。

description.en: A local dashboard for DeepSeek Harness that tracks token usage, API calls, and cache statistics.
description.zh: 一个本地仪表盘，用于统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量、API 调用和缓存情况。

description.en: Injects Ponytail lazy senior engineer specs into DeepSeek Harness, storing 5 companion skills as callable skills.
description.zh: 向 DeepSeek Harness 注入 Ponytail 懒高级工程师规范，并将 5 个同伴技能保存为可调用技能。

description.en: Detects agent turns that only produce reasoning with no text or tool calls, then steers a prompt into the same turn so the loop continues.
description.zh: 识别只产生思考、既无正文也无工具调用的空回合，并在同一轮内注入提示让 agent 循环继续执行。

description.en: Continuously logs your local Harness LLM calls — prompts, skills, tool calls, file I/O and web fetches — into readable Markdown per session.
description.zh: 持续记录本地 Harness 调用 LLM 的全过程：提示词、技能加载、工具调用、文件读写与联网抓取，按会话生成易读的 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Touch-device comfort fixes for DeepSeek Harness web client, suppressing ghost tooltips and controlling touch actions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端在触屏设备上修复悬停残留提示框，并设置 touch-action 策略以改善触摸操作。

description.en: Run shell commands from DeepSeek Harness Web composer with leading '!'; results appear as command cards without model tokens.
Adds a chat mode to DeepSeek Harness web GUI with Chat/Work switch, session-intent surface, and managed Chat workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加聊天模式，在对话上方提供 Chat/Work 切换、无需工作区的会话意图界面，并用受管理的 Chat 工作区保存其对话。

description.en: A Settings tab that installs, removes, and configures omdsh plugins from a configurable upstream.
description.zh: The omdsh plugin hub: a Settings tab that installs and removes omdsh plugins from a configurable upstream, and configures every installed one from the settings schema it already registers

description.en: Evidence-based code review for DeepSeek Harness: two-pass verification, code citations, and incremental rechecks.
Verifiable authorization and execution evidence for DeepSeek AI agents, with offline delivery verification.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek AI代理提供可验证的授权与执行证据，并支持离线交付验证。

description.en: Sidebar panel showing daily token usage, cache-hit ratio, 30-day trends, a heatmap and model share, read only from local session logs.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示每日 token 用量、缓存命中率、近 30 日趋势、热力图与模型占比，仅只读本机会话日志。

description.en: Generates one index skill for the DSH catalog so member skills stay user-invocable but leave the model catalog, cutting context usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 技能合集生成单一索引技能：成员技能仍可被用户调用，但移出模型目录，减少上下文占用。

description.en: Disables chosen built-in plugins inside native DSH agent presets via a cordis.patch.yml config, without creating new presets.
description.zh: 通过 cordis.patch.yml 配置在 DSH 原生 Agent 预设中禁用指定内置插件，无需新建预设。

description.en: Shared research evidence protocol: JSON schemas, canonical hashing, a content-addressed evidence store, SARIF export and an independent verifier CLI.
description.zh: 共享研究证据协议：提供 JSON Schema、规范化哈希、内容寻址证据库、SARIF 导出与独立校验 CLI。

description.en: One-command research suite bundle + research_doctor for DeepSeek Harness
Local-first HTML review, editing, and annotation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生插件，在本地对 HTML 进行审阅、编辑和批注。

description.en: Codex-style left session manager for DSH that groups sessions by project, supports pinning, and shows status dots.
description.zh: DSH 的 Codex 风格左侧会话管理器，可按项目分组会话、支持置顶并显示状态圆点。

description.en: Pins DSH workspaces and sidebar plugin panels to the top of the sidebar, restoring the exact original order when unpinned.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏提供真正的置顶功能：置顶工作区和插件面板，取消时精确还原原有顺序。

description.en: Adds a completion chime plus system and browser notifications, with a Tasks panel to filter running and unread-completed sessions.
description.zh: 提供任务完成提示音、系统与浏览器通知，并附带可筛选运行中及未读已完成会话的任务面板。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that shows live local CPU, memory, disk, network, I/O and temperature in three native UI spots plus a System detail panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：在界面三个原生位置显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、I/O 和温度，并提供右侧「系统」详情面板。

description.en: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to your Tailscale tailnet and exposes tailnet devices plus TCP reachability as a ctx.tailscale service for other plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 发布到 Tailscale tailnet，并将 tailnet 设备与 TCP 可达性作为 ctx.tailscale 服务提供给其他插件。

description.en: A per-layer 3D architecture microscope that visualizes frontier LLM paper internals such as MLA and MoE inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以逐层 3D 显微镜方式可视化 MLA、MoE 等前沿 LLM 论文内部结构。

description.en: GitHub plugin for DeepSeek Harness: sign in via settings to give agents 12 real GitHub tools with cloud-compute cost guardrails; token stays out of context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GitHub 接入插件：在设置中登录账号，为 agent 提供 12 个真实 GitHub 工具，带云计算与成本护栏，token 不进入模型上下文。

description.en: Adds sidebar panel management to DSH: a grouped panel launcher, persistent pin/unpin, compact footer, and a full settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加侧边栏面板管理：分组面板启动器、持久化固定/取消固定、紧凑页脚和完整设置页。

description.en: Pasting an image into the DSH Web GUI inserts an auto-numbered inline capsule like image-1.png, with a hover thumbnail preview.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中粘贴图片，会在文字里插入自动编号的内联胶囊（如 image-1.png），悬浮可预览缩略图。

description.en: Injects git status and repository rules into DSH system prompt, including branch, dirty files, recent commits.
description.zh: 把当前分支、未提交改动和最近提交等 git 状态与仓库规范动态注入 DSH 的 system prompt。

description.en: Tracks your AI usage in DSH and lets you opt into an anonymous global Token Race ranking.
description.zh: 在DSH中统计你的AI使用量，并可选择加入匿名全球Token竞赛排名。

description.en: Automatically resumes model responses that were cut off at the max-tokens limit, so long answers continue seamlessly.
description.zh: 自动续写因达到最大 token 限制而被截断的模型回复，让长回答无缝接续。

description.en: User-confirmed todo list plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a panel, model tools, and a /todo command.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的用户确认式待办清单插件，提供面板、模型工具和 /todo 命令。

description.en: Blocks credential reads and outbound secrets, redacting secrets, tokens, and PII before they reach the model, logs, or spill files.
description.zh: 拦截凭据读取与外发密钥，在敏感信息进入模型、日志或溢出文件前完成脱敏处理。

description.en: Diagnostics for DSH plugins that finds failed plugin loads, leftover rows from failed updates, unmanaged entries, and orphaned files on disk.
description.zh: 诊断 DSH 插件：查找加载失败、更新残留行、未托管条目，并扫描磁盘上的更新遗留文件。

description.en: Adds two persistent top-bar buttons to the DSH desktop app: reload the web client, or restart the whole Electron app while keeping your session.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版顶栏添加两个常驻按钮：重新加载 Web 客户端，或一键重启整个 Electron 应用并保留当前会话。

description.en: Lets you switch the model's context window per session from the DeepSeek Harness model picker, restoring the default for new sessions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择弹窗中按会话切换上下文窗口，新会话自动恢复默认设置。

description.en: Select text in the DSH desktop window and translate it in place with a floating button using built-in free Bing/Google translation, no API key needed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面窗口中划选文字，点击浮动「翻译」按钮，即可用内置免费的 Bing/Google 翻译接口就地翻译，无需 API key。

description.en: Spec-driven development skills for DeepSeek Harness: write requirements, design, tasks, then implement and validate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供规格驱动开发技能：编写需求、设计与任务，然后实施并验证。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness persistent memory plugin that stores conversation memory as a causal tree via @rsrsai/memlite, data-compatible with Rust memlite.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 持久记忆插件，通过 @rsrsai/memlite 以因果树结构存储记忆，数据与 Rust memlite 兼容。

description.en: Right-click a file or folder in the DSH sidebar file tree to insert it into the conversation as an @ reference, with multi-select batch adding.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏文件树中右键点击文件或文件夹，即可作为 @ 引用插入对话，支持多选批量添加。

description.en: A dsh web plugin to set background images and inject custom CSS/JS, including local image support.
description.zh: 用于dsh web设置背景图，简单的设置背景图片的功能

description.en: ClickHouse query plugin for DSH: explore schemas and run guarded read-only SQL against ClickHouse databases.
description.zh: DSH 的 ClickHouse 查询插件：浏览表结构并执行带只读护栏的 SQL 查询。

description.en: A sidebar workbench for local Git, GitHub/GitLab merge requests and issues, Aliyun approvals, PingCode, and skills.
description.zh: 一个侧边栏工作台，集成本地 Git、GitHub/GitLab 合并请求与议题、阿里云审批、PingCode 和技能。

description.en: Registers QwenWork desktop chat models as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, adding a QwenWork group to the model picker.
description.zh: 把本机千问办公桌面端的对话模型注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 provider，模型选择器里多出「千问办公」分组。

description.en: Windows-only WeChat-style screenshot button that freezes the screen, lets you drag-select and annotate, then drops the image straight into the DSH composer.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 的微信群式截图按钮：冻结屏幕、拖框选区并就地标注，图片直接进入 DSH 输入框。

description.en: Loads project-level .dsh/AGENTS.md (and custom paths) into the DeepSeek Harness agent system prompt, with a settings page.
description.zh: 将项目级 .dsh/AGENTS.md（及自定义路径）注入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体系统提示词，并提供设置页面。

description.en: Adds a Git tab to the conversation view for reviewing, editing, staging, committing and pushing repository changes with AI-generated commit messages.
description.zh: 在对话视图中加入 Git 标签页，用于查看、编辑、暂存、提交和推送仓库改动，并可用已配置模型生成提交信息。

description.en: Embeds a persistent stock index bar and draggable quote window in the DSH chat UI, showing real-time quotes, charts and holding P&L.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面嵌入常驻大盘指数栏与可拖动行情悬浮窗，实时显示行情、分时/K线与持仓盈亏。

description.en: sshfs mount manager for Linux/macOS that mounts and unmounts remote directories from a sidebar panel and an Agent tool.
description.zh: 面向 Linux/macOS 的 sshfs 挂载管理插件，可通过侧栏面板和 Agent 工具挂载与卸载远端目录。

description.en: Guardian for DeepSeek Harness: read-only health check plus an explicitly authorized action layer (plan, fingerprint, confirm, audit).
Unified @ mention picker for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with five built-in categories, bundled @git, and per-plugin categories.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 GUI 提供统一的 @ 提及选择器，含五个内置分类、内置 @git 以及插件自带分类。

description.en: Selectively overrides DSH's AGENTS.md instruction injection per preset using configurable directory scanning.
description.zh: 按预设选择性覆盖 DSH 的 AGENTS.md 指令注入，支持可配置目录扫描。

description.en: Injects Chrome/Edge login cookies into DSH's built-in browser via a local CDP bridge, so you stay signed in without logging in again.
description.zh: 通过本机 CDP 调试桥把 Chrome/Edge 的登录 Cookie 注入 DSH 内置浏览器，免去重复登录且不会挤掉原有会话。

description.en: Adds an @ mention picker to the DSH input box that fuzzy-searches Feishu users, groups and departments and inserts atomic name blocks with IDs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框加入 @ 提及选择器，可模糊搜索飞书用户、群聊与部门，并插入带 ID 信息的原子名称块。

description.en: 四个动词的分层记事本：醒来/干活/遇坑/收工。不给参数，给习惯。
DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a standalone-API-key DeepSeek web search panel in the left sidebar plus a deepseek_search tool for all models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，支持独立 API Key 的 DeepSeek 网页搜索，在左侧边栏提供搜索面板，并为所有模型提供 deepseek_search 工具。

description.en: DSH settings plugin for managing skills: install and search public skills, track sources, verify and update versions, and back up or safely remove skills.
description.zh: DSH 设置内的技能管理插件：安装与检索公共技能、追踪来源、校验并更新版本，并支持备份与安全删除技能。

description.en: Tavily search and Firecrawl fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness web seam, using a rotating multi-key credential pool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网络层提供 Tavily 搜索与 Firecrawl 抓取能力，并支持多密钥轮换池。

description.en: Renders mermaid diagrams in DSH chat via fenced code blocks, with a generic renderer registry.
description.zh: 通过围栏代码块在 DSH 聊天中渲染 mermaid 图表，并提供通用渲染器注册表。

description.en: Registers fffind and ffgrep as fuzzy file path search and content grep tools for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 fffind 和 ffgrep 两个工具，分别用于模糊搜索文件路径和按内容检索。

description.en: Workspace-aware direnv support that injects each workspace's .envrc environment into every agent-owned shell command.
description.zh: 工作区感知的 direnv 支持，自动把所在工作区的 .envrc 环境注入每个 agent 拥有的 shell 命令。

description.en: Japanese language plugin that translates the DSH Web UI into Japanese with friendly fallback fonts.
description.zh: 将 DSH 网页界面翻译为日语的本地化插件，并提供友好的日文回退字体。

description.en: Runs one daily check-in round across all installed AI clients and registers their local models as DSH providers, with a loopback-only dashboard.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中一次性完成所有已安装 AI 客户端的每日签到，并把本地客户端模型注册为 DSH 模型提供方，还提供仅本机访问的面板。

description.en: A dsh web plugin that automatically archives finished, idle sessions once a night after 21 days of inactivity.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 网页插件，每晚自动归档已完成且闲置三周的会话。

description.en: Retired dsh plugin that cached session/list responses; a controlled benchmark found no measurable CPU gain, so do not install.
description.zh: 已退役的 dsh 插件，用于缓存会话列表；对照基准测试未发现明显收益，请勿安装。

description.en: AI-host-driven multi-role group chat: dynamically schedules experts, supports subagent deep reasoning, and exports Markdown conclusions.
description.zh: AI主持人驱动的多角色群聊：动态调度专家，支持子代理深度推理，并导出Markdown结论。

description.en: Links a DeepSeek Harness profile to a Stuga workspace with Stuga MCP tools, workspace conventions, and review-focused playbook skills.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 配置档接入 Stuga 工作区，提供 Stuga MCP 工具、工作区约定与审查用 playbook 技能。

description.en: Adds a Settings page in the DSH Web UI to manage skills, MCP servers, and AGENTS.md instruction files, with real MCP connections.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 设置页新增「技能与 MCP」页面，统一管理技能、MCP 服务器与 AGENTS.md 指令文件，并真实建立连接。

description.en: Unofficial responsive remote Web UI bundle for DeepSeek Harness, keeping the native desktop app isolated.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的非官方响应式远程 Web UI 插件包，与原生桌面端保持隔离。

description.en: Bottom-right widget that shows remaining balance and quota across your configured AI providers like DeepSeek, OpenRouter and Moonshot.
description.zh: 右下角小部件，实时显示已配置的 AI 服务商（如 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot 等）的余额与配额剩余情况。

description.en: Input-history plugin for DeepSeek Harness web UI: records every sent prompt to global localStorage and enables ↑/↓ navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面记录每次发送的提示到全局 localStorage，并支持用上下方向键浏览历史记录。

description.en: Manages MCP servers in DSH via a floating panel and tiered config, JSON import, plus four model tools to list, inspect, search and call MCP tools.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器管理插件：浮窗分级面板、粘贴 JSON 导入，并提供 list/detail/search/call 四个模型可见工具。

description.en: Adds a recycle bin for DSH sessions: archive the current session from the conversation header, then restore or permanently delete archived sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话增加回收站：可从对话头部归档当前会话，并可恢复或永久删除已归档会话。

description.en: Author, parameterize and run repeatable DSH workflows with staged sub-agents, run history, resumable sessions and re-runs.
description.zh: 以参数表单定义并运行可重复的 DSH 工作流，支持分阶段子代理、运行历史、恢复与再次运行。

description.en: Agent skill that extracts data from JS single-page apps using curl, grep and Python when WebFetch fails due to timeouts or obfuscated JS.
description.zh: 当 WebFetch 因超时或混淆 JS 失败时，用 curl、grep 和 Python 从 JS 单页应用中提取数据的技能。

description.en: Adds whole-interface zoom (50%–200%) to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, scaling sidebar, buttons, icons, spacing and text together with saved preferences.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供整页缩放（50%–200%），侧边栏、按钮、图标、间距与文字一起缩放，并记住偏好设置。

description.en: Visual settings panel and six agent tools for configuring a OneAPI/OpenAI-compatible model gateway in DSH, with per-model connectivity tests.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的 OneAPI/OpenAI 兼容网关配置做成可视化设置页与侧边栏面板，并提供 6 个 agent 工具和逐模型连通性测试。

description.en: Interactive slingshot toy for the dsh web GUI that shatters UI elements and lets them tumble off screen, then recovers.
description.zh: Interactive slingshot toy for the dsh web GUI: shatter UI elements, watch them tumble off screen, then recover. dsh.client plugin, zero deps.

description.en: Adds a Git tab to DSH chat interface showing repo status, history, branches, contribution calendar, and git operations.
description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天界面添加 Git 标签页，显示仓库状态、提交历史、分支和贡献日历，并可执行 Git 操作。

description.en: Governs AI agent tool calls against business rules via TapPass /v1/govern as an authority layer.
description.zh: The authority layer for agentic AI, as a DeepSeek Harness plugin. Governs every tool call against your business rules via TapPass /v1/govern.

description.en: Embeds ChatGPT Dots inside DSH with a native toolbar, refresh, external-browser fallback and theme-adaptive icons.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生页面中嵌入 ChatGPT Dots，提供工具栏、刷新、外部浏览器打开和明暗主题自适应图标。

description.en: Sends native Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness run finishes, needs approval, or awaits an answer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 运行结束、需要审批或等待回答时发送原生 Windows 吐司通知。

description.en: Adds a collapsible compact mode to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI left sidebar, narrowing it and folding panel lists into icons.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页版左侧栏添加可收起的紧凑模式：侧栏变窄、行距收紧，面板列表可折成图标。

description.en: Feishu/Lark document design and layout skill for DeepSeek Harness, producing management-readable, brand-consistent, evidence-traceable long-form docs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供飞书文档设计与排版技能，生成管理层易浏览、品牌统一、证据可追溯的长文排版。

description.en: Generates structured Feishu/Lark bid-proposal documents with cover, background, solution, pricing, team and cases.
description.zh: Feishu/Lark bid-proposal document generator skill for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — structured pitch docs with cover, background, solution, pricing, team & cases. 飞书讲标方案文档生成器（DeepSeek Harness 技能插件）：封面/背景/需

description.en: Generates Feishu/Lark spreadsheet quotations with auto cost, headcount, margin, payment milestones, and ROI calculations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 生成飞书电子表格报价单，自动计算成本、人力、利润率、付款节点和 ROI。

description.en: Turns business material into verified, structured Feishu/Lark documents with conclusions, evidence & actions.
description.zh: Evidence-driven Feishu/Lark document writing skill for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — turn business material into verified, structured docs with conclusions, evidence & actions. 飞书文档证据化编写技能（DeepSeek Harness

description.en: DSH smart-home plugin (HA business tools)
Local-first notebook plugin that clips and quotes DSH chat snippets into a searchable, taggable, exportable personal knowledge base.
description.zh: 本地优先的笔记插件,把 DSH 对话片段划线引用,整理成可搜索、可打标签、可导出的个人知识库。

description.en: Renders a normalized session view that displays every turn, message and tool call in one consistent, copyable transcript format.
description.zh: 提供规范化会话视图，将每个回合、消息和工具调用以统一、可复制的格式呈现。

description.en: Optional DSH Web profile bundle offering six selectable wallpaper themes with palettes, previews, gold accents, glass surfaces, and a licensed display font.
description.zh: 可选的 DSH Web 配置包，提供六种可选壁纸主题，含配色、预览、金色点缀、玻璃质感与授权显示字体。

description.en: Adds Hypatia knowledge-graph query skill and automatic conversation-memory bridge to DeepSeek Harness via CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Hypatia 知识图谱查询技能和自动对话记忆桥接，需在 PATH 中安装 hypatia CLI。

description.en: Persistent per-project jargon glossary shared by humans and agents, with a sidebar tab for CRUD and three agent tools.
description.zh: 按项目持久化的黑话/术语表，人和 agent 共用一份数据，右侧栏页签可增删改查，并提供三个 agent 工具。

description.en: Local-first management console for notes, tasks, flashcards, health checks, cost guard, cleanup and workspace value.
description.zh: 本地优先的管理控制台，集笔记、任务、闪卡、健康检查、成本防护、清理与工作区价值于一体。

description.en: Preview, develop, and debug WeChat Mini Games inside the dsh Web GUI using logs and screenshots.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面中通过日志和截图预览、开发并调试微信小游戏。

description.en: Renders interactive HTML artifacts that the AI writes in chat as sandboxed, fully client-side iframe cards.
description.zh: 将 AI 在对话中写出的交互式 HTML 组件渲染为沙箱 iframe 卡片，纯客户端运行。

description.en: Replaces DSH message body text with meow speech in the UI, display-only, original conversation unchanged.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面将消息正文文本替换为喵语的显示层插件，仅改变显示，不改动真实对话内容。

description.en: A resident DSH Web GUI right-sidebar git panel for reviewing, staging, committing, and syncing the current session workspace.
description.zh: 常驻 DSH Web GUI 右侧栏的 Git 面板，可查看、暂存、提交并同步当前会话工作区。

description.en: Browser chime plugin for DeepSeek Harness that plays a synthetic ding when the model completes a turn, requests approval, or asks a question.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的浏览器提示音插件，在模型完成一轮回复、请求批准或提出问题时会播放合成的叮声。

description.en: Adds a floating button and drawer to navigate through user messages in DeepSeek Harness conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话添加右侧悬浮按钮和抽屉，列出全部用户消息并自动加载完整历史，点击即可跳转到该消息。

description.en: DSH Web plugin: copy a DSH session id, or hand the whole session over to codex so `codex resume <id>` restores it.
DSH Web UI plugin embedding Live2D desktop pet Vivi with interactive petting, feeding, and bond progression.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件，嵌入 Live2D 桌面宠物 Vivi，支持抚摸、喂食互动和亲密度成长。

description.en: Composer-level usage capsule showing per-session tokens, cost, remaining balance and official peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 输入框下方的会话用量胶囊，显示 Tokens、消费金额、剩余余额与官方峰谷价目。

description.en: Adds Chrome-style tabs, tab groups, and split panes to organize multiple DSH web chat sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页聊天会话添加 Chrome 风格标签页、标签组和分屏，便于管理多个会话。

description.en: Keeps an agent round from closing mid-sentence or after only a plan, with layered guards and a fenced-block completion marker.
description.zh: 防止智能体在话没说完或只列了计划时就结束回合，采用三层防护与 fenced block 收尾标记。

description.en: Manages DSH skills with multi-source installation from GitHub, local folders, ZIP or Markdown, plus updates that keep local edits and support rollback.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：支持 GitHub、本地文件夹、ZIP/Markdown 多来源安装，保留本地修改的更新与回退。

description.en: VS Code-style file explorer for DeepSeek Harness with a sidebar entry, lazy-loading file tree and text, Markdown and image previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 VS Code 风格的文件夹与文件浏览器，含侧边栏入口、懒加载文件树及文本、Markdown、图片预览。

description.en: Adds structured web search, page fetching and one-call research to DeepSeek Harness via the official DeepSeek Search/Fetch API.
description.zh: 通过官方 DeepSeek Search/Fetch API，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化网页搜索、页面抓取与一键研究能力。

description.en: Adds a sidebar sticky-notes panel with auto-save plus note_create, note_list, note_update and note_delete tools for the agent.
description.zh: 在侧边栏提供便签面板，支持自动保存，并附带 note_create、note_list、note_update、note_delete 四个工具供智能体读写便签。

description.en: Lets the Agent write motion-graphics scenes as code and render them into frame-accurate, reproducible MP4 animations.
description.zh: 让 Agent 用代码编写镜头动画，并逐帧渲染出可复现的 MP4 视频。

description.en: DSH web plugin that lets you quote selected text into the composer as a markdown blockquote.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：可将选中的文本以 Markdown 引用块形式插入输入框。

description.en: Draggable dashboard for monitoring OpenRouter and DeepSeek API balances and spend.
description.zh: Draggable quota/cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness web GUI: OpenRouter + DeepSeek balances & spend (official APIs + session-log pricing)

description.en: Audits DSH disk usage across sessions, attachments and caches, then moves reclaimable files into a restorable quarantine instead of deleting them.
description.zh: 审计 DSH 的会话、附件与缓存占用，并把可清理文件移入可还原的隔离区而非直接删除。

description.en: White-noise player plugin: scenes are defined purely by folders, AI downloads CC0/CC-BY ambient audio in the background, with four play modes and a sleep timer.
description.zh: 白噪音播放器插件：场景完全由文件夹决定，AI 后台分门别类下载 CC0/CC BY 氛围音，支持四种播放模式与定时关闭。

description.en: Animated kite overlay that flies higher as agent token and event activity grows, with Weifang-style frame decks and custom textures.
description.zh: 在 agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝,token 与事件越多飞得越高,内置潍坊谱系卡组并支持自定义贴图。

description.en: Matrix-style digital rain background for the chat window, with live agent tokens mixed into the falling characters and adjustable look.
description.zh: 为对话窗口铺上黑客帝国数字雨背景，agent 实时 token 掺入雨中，透明度、速度、密度、字号、配色均可调。

description.en: Collapses the plugin entry rows below "New Session" into one sidebar menu button with grouped submenu, whitelist pins and theme-aware styling.
description.zh: 把「新会话」下方的各插件入口收纳进一个侧栏菜单按钮，二级菜单分组、支持白名单常驻与明暗主题自动跟随。

description.en: Adds Git repo/branch status, a header button, and a sidebar tab for changes and commit history in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git 仓库/分支状态、顶部按钮，以及显示变更和提交历史的侧边栏标签页。

description.en: DSH bundle that shows JetBrains file-type icons before file paths in tool-call rows, with switchable icon themes in Settings.
description.zh: 在工具调用行的文件路径前显示 JetBrains 文件类型图标的 DSH 插件，并可在设置中切换图标主题。

description.en: Adds an AnySearch-backed web search provider to DeepSeek Harness, toggleable via settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 AnySearch 支持的网页搜索提供器，可在设置中切换。

description.en: DSH approval, question, and completion notifier using native browser notifications with toast fallback.
description.zh: 在 DSH 审批、提问和任务完成时发出提醒，优先使用浏览器原生通知，不支持时回退为页面 toast 提示。

description.en: Sidebar overlay plugin that groups DSH workspace sessions into emoji folders with filtering, drag sorting, batch archive and safe permanent delete.
description.zh: 侧边栏叠加插件：将 DSH 工作区会话按 emoji 分组文件夹整理，支持筛选、三级拖拽排序、批量归档与安全永久删除。

description.en: Embeds a Cesium-based God's Eye View map in DeepSeek Harness with DSH agent control, process management and China/international map modes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入基于 Cesium 的上帝视角地图，支持 DSH 智能体控制、进程管理以及中国/国际地图模式。

description.en: Local memory engine for DSH agents that saves, recalls and manages cross-session memories, with an interactive knowledge-graph visualisation and import of existing memory files.
description.zh: DSH 插件的本地记忆引擎，让 agent 保存、召回和管理跨会话记忆，并提供交互式知识图谱可视化与已有记忆文件导入。

description.en: A minimal DSH agent preset that translates Japanese to Chinese with no tools loaded and no chat history sent.
description.zh: 一个极简的 DSH agent 预设，只做日译中，不加载任何工具，也不携带历史消息。

description.en: Gateway that normalizes Telegram and WeChat provider traffic into one message contract, authorizes it at the transport boundary, and replies via the carried route.
description.zh: 网关将 Telegram 与微信的提供商流量统一为单一消息契约，在传输边界完成鉴权，并按消息携带的路由回复。

description.en: Adds a Restart Backend button to the DSH web sidebar to restart the dsh backend process in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 页面左下角添加“重启后端”按钮，一键重启 dsh 后端进程。

description.en: A web plugin manager for DSH to enable or disable installed plugins from the Settings page.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件管理器，可在设置页启用或停用已安装的插件。

description.en: Adds custom background images and a frosted-glass mask to DeepSeek Harness without touching the theme service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加自定义背景图和毛玻璃蒙版，不修改原有主题服务。

description.en: Lets each DeepSeek Harness teammate (continuable subagent) session pick its own model, so a stalled teammate can switch models without changing the Lead or global default.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 teammate（可续接子代理）会话提供独立模型选择器，可在不影响 Lead 会话或全局默认模型的情况下切换模型。

description.en: Adds a Projects sidebar to DeepSeek Harness Desktop for grouping conversations with per-conversation working directories and drag-and-drop migration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 添加项目侧边栏，可将对话分组、为每个对话设置工作目录，并支持拖拽迁移与空对话清理。

description.en: Sonification plugin that converts agent heartbeat into beeps for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 中智能体的心跳转为提示音的声化插件。

description.en: Automatically resumes interrupted model turns after transient failures, coalesces gateway outages, and always respects manual stops.
description.zh: 模型请求临时失败导致轮次中断后自动续行，合并同一次网关故障，并始终优先手动停止。

description.en: DSH bundle that supervises the BrowserSkill (bsk) bridge daemon as a child process, starting and stopping with DSH and auto-restarting after crashes.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将 BrowserSkill（bsk）桥接守护进程作为子进程托管：随 DSH 启停，崩溃后自动重启。

description.en: Turns your most-used prompts into a row of capsules above the DSH input box; click one to fill it in, with placeholders, search and local editing.
description.zh: 把常用提示词做成 DSH 输入框上方的一排胶囊，点一下即可填入，支持占位符、搜索和本地编辑。

description.en: Host-only DSH bundle that appends a Simplified-Chinese reasoning and response policy to the end of the system prompt.
description.zh: 仅宿主端运行的 DSH 捆绑包，在系统提示词末尾追加简体中文推理与回复策略。

description.en: DSH plugin that reuses your QwenWorkCN desktop login as a zero-config model provider with streaming, tool calls, image input and live credits.
description.zh: DSH 插件：零配置复用千问办公桌面 App 登录态，将其注册为模型 Provider，支持流式对话、工具调用、图片输入与实时积分读数。

description.en: Forgetting engine for AI agents with memory TTL, decay, eviction, and audit.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供记忆遗忘引擎，支持记忆 TTL、衰减、淘汰和审计，包含 DSH 插件、本地技能与 CLI。

description.en: Installs Roboto Mono for DSH code blocks and SSH terminal, with DejaVu and Nerd Font glyphs for box drawing and Oh My Posh icons.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代码块与 SSH 终端安装 Roboto Mono 字体，并用 DejaVu 与 Nerd Font 字形补齐框线和 Oh My Posh 图标。

description.en: A conversation graph canvas for Agent Chat that shows branching, rollback, and inheritance between sessions at a glance.
description.zh: Agent Chat 的会话图谱画布，让分叉、回退与继承关系一目了然。

description.en: Cordis / DeepSeek Harness plugin providing normalized GitHub API tools for AI agents, using gh CLI with HTTP fallback.
description.zh: Cordis / DeepSeek Harness plugin — normalized GitHub API tools for AI agents (gh CLI by default, native HTTP fallback)

description.en: Cordis/DeepSeek Harness plugin that drives the Android Local Dream Stable Diffusion app over HTTP with automatic device connections.
description.zh: Cordis/DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 HTTP 驱动安卓 Local Dream Stable Diffusion 应用并自动管理设备连接。

description.en: Adds a DSH right-sidebar panel with live CPU, memory and swap gauges plus a sortable host process table.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏提供实时 CPU、内存、交换分区仪表与可排序主机进程表。

description.en: Client-side voice gateway UI for DSH web client with mic status, six-state machine, voiceprint enrollment, and auto-speak controls.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端的语音网关界面插件：麦克风状态指示、六状态机、声纹录入和自动朗读控制。

description.en: Adds a temporary side-chat panel beside the main conversation that silently injects recent main-chat history as hidden context.
description.zh: 在主对话旁新增临时侧边聊天面板，并自动把主对话最近历史作为隐藏上下文注入。

description.en: Git Worktree management plugin for DSH that adds deletion policies and per-workspace management for multi-branch tasks.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Git Worktree 管理插件，新增删除策略与按工作区管理，便于多分支任务与清理。

description.en: Adds a one-click Restart DSH button to Settings → General in DSH Desktop using the official requestRestart() facade.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 的设置→通用页面添加一键重启 DSH 按钮，通过官方 requestRestart() 接口触发重启。

description.en: One-install DSH QQ bot bundle that mounts the QQ gateway plus image understanding/OCR, Edge TTS voice and Bilibili video tools.
description.zh: 一键安装的 DSH QQ 机器人整合包，挂载 QQ 网关，并附带识图/OCR、Edge TTS 语音和 B 站视频工具。

description.en: Adds a persistent top-right button that gracefully restarts the DSH Electron desktop shell and host, warning you when sessions are running.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右上角常驻一个按钮，优雅重启 Electron 桌面外壳与后台 Host，有会话在跑时先提示确认。

description.en: Filters DSH's @-mention file completion using a workspace-root .dshignore file, hiding ignored files and directories from candidates without restricting access.
description.zh: 通过工作区根目录的 .dshignore 文件过滤 DSH 的 @ 文件补全候选，隐藏被忽略的文件与目录，但不限制实际访问。

description.en: Integrates Mint issue tracking into DSH sessions with context injection, reminders, plan binding, and a query tool.
description.zh: 将Mint问题跟踪集成到DSH会话，提供上下文注入、事件提醒、计划绑定和查询工具。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete conversation action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar so session records are wiped from disk instead of only archived.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏新增「删除对话」操作，将会话记录从磁盘永久清除，而非仅归档。

description.en: Translation workbench with a sidebar pane, Bing/Google failover, caching and rate limiting, plus a translate_text agent tool.
description.zh: 翻译工作台插件，提供侧边栏面板、Bing/Google 故障转移、缓存与限流，并为智能体提供 translate_text 工具。

description.en: Windows tray monitor plugin that deploys and manages the DshTaskWatcher app with a settings toggle.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中部署和管理独立的 DshTaskWatcher 托盘应用，并在设置-插件中提供启动/停止开关。

description.en: Expands file and web preview panels to full view while keeping the chat in a movable, resizable floating mini-window.
description.zh: 将文件和网页预览展开为完整视图，同时把聊天保留为可移动、可缩放、可收起的悬浮小窗。

description.en: Jarvis blue-tech UI skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with neon dark design and breathing HUD effects.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供贾维斯蓝色科技风皮肤，采用霓虹暗色设计与呼吸式 HUD 动效。

description.en: Adds two session-header switches that block an agent from writing to your local git repository or pushing/pulling to a remote before the command runs.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加两个开关，在命令执行前阻止代理写入本地 git 仓库或向远程推送/拉取。

description.en: Pomodoro timer for DSH with 25/5/15 cycles, task association, a year-heatmap stats panel, local persistence, and CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 番茄钟插件，支持 25/5/15 周期、任务关联、年度热力图统计面板、本地持久化与 CSV 导出。

description.en: Permanently delete a Session from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with an in-app confirmation and safe directory validation.永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏中的会话，包含应用内确认和安全目录验证。
Unfolds every conversation in the DSH Web UI into a simple tiled card layout so you can view all sessions without switching between them.
description.zh: 将所有会话在 DSH 网页界面中展开为简洁的卡片平铺布局，无需在多个会话之间来回切换。

description.en: Wraps local ffmpeg into 6 structured dsh tools to probe, transcode, thumbnail, extract audio and compress media to a byte budget.
description.zh: 把本机 ffmpeg 封装成 6 个结构化 dsh 工具，用于探测、转码、抽帧、抽音轨并按字节预算压缩媒体。

description.en: Extracts text from images and PDFs in DeepSeek Harness, reading born-digital text layers or OCR-ing scans with any engine you configure.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中从图片和 PDF 提取文字，可读取原生文本层或用你配置的任意引擎对扫描件做 OCR。

description.en: Adds a sidebar power button to DeepSeek Harness to restart or shutdown the engine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加侧边栏电源按钮，可重启或关闭引擎。

description.en: Aggregates local AI agent session logs and displays per-request latency, tokens, cache hits, context usage and tool calls in the browser.
description.zh: 聚合本地 AI agent 会话日志，在浏览器中查看每轮请求的耗时、token、缓存命中、上下文占用与工具调用明细。

description.en: Read-only sidebar monitor showing which Agents are active, which Skill each is calling, plus status and elapsed time.
description.zh: 只读侧边栏监控，实时展示活动 Agent 正在调用的 Skill、状态与耗时。

description.en: Secure credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: store and inject API tokens into CLI commands without leaking secrets.
description.zh: Secure credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: store GitHub/npm/API tokens in DSH's encrypted credential store (secrets never leave the host), run gh/npm/npx/node/git with the token injected in the env

description.en: On-device Apple Vision OCR for DSH that extracts text with coordinates from scans, screenshots and PDFs and hands it to the model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的本地 Apple Vision OCR 插件，可从扫描件、截图和 PDF 中提取带坐标的文字并交给模型。

description.en: Inspect, probe and manage MCP servers across every AI client on your machine from one settings page, with real handshake tests.
description.zh: 在一个设置页中检查、探测并管理本机所有 AI 客户端的 MCP 服务器，并通过真实握手测试验证连通性。

description.en: Plays sound cues on the host machine when tasks finish, context compacts, or a question awaits your answer.
description.zh: 在主机上播放声音提示：任务完成、上下文压缩或有待回答的问题时提醒。

description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort slider to the chat input, with Auto ranges, model routing, and animated whale-girl canvas effects.
description.zh: 在输入框添加推理强度滑杆，支持 Auto 区间、模型路由，并带有鲸鱼娘 canvas 辐射动画特效。

description.en: Adds a global instructions panel to the dsh web UI, as a fixed and installable fork of couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页端提供全局指令面板，是 couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt 的修复后可安装分支。

description.en: Manage secondary working directories from the composer + menu, reference their files with @, and give the agent equal write/exec access.
description.zh: 在输入框「+」菜单管理副工作目录，用 @ 引用其中的文件，并让 Agent 获得同等读写与执行权限。

description.en: Adds a dropdown in session header to open current workspace in a locally installed editor.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：会话头部「在编辑器中打开」下拉框，自动扫描本地编辑器

description.en: Spec-driven development toolkit for DeepSeek Harness, exposing /speckit slash commands to manage specs, plans, tasks, implementation, and quality checks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Spec-Kit 规范驱动开发技能套件（/speckit-* 斜杠命令）

description.en: Manage MCP servers in DSH: add, edit, enable and test stdio or Streamable HTTP servers from the web settings page or agent tools, no restart needed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 MCP 服务器：可通过网页设置页或 agent 工具添加、编辑、启用和测试 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP 服务器，无需重启。

description.en: Adds QQ Mail or any IMAP/SMTP mailbox to DeepSeek Harness via qqmail_* agent tools, a CLI, an MCP server, and a web settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 QQ 邮箱（或任意 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱），提供代理工具、CLI、MCP 服务器与网页设置面板。

description.en: One-click restart button and dsh_restart tool relaunch DeepSeek Harness via a detached helper, with auto-reconnect and a boot-error recovery console.
description.zh: 一键重启 DeepSeek Harness:网页按钮与 dsh_restart 工具通过独立辅助进程重启宿主,页面自动重连,失败时用恢复控制台显示启动错误。

description.en: Scheduled agent that scans Bilibili and Douyin by keyword, filters picks with reasons, and writes a daily Markdown report.
description.zh: 定时巡览 B站与抖音，按关键词筛选并写明入选理由，输出每日 Markdown 日报的采集插件。

description.en: Adds a Settings → Left Menu section that lists every sidebar panel entry and lets you hide or show each one individually.
description.zh: 在设置中新增「左栏菜单」分区，列出所有侧边栏面板入口，可逐项隐藏或显示。

description.en: Manage all configured MCP servers in one DSH page: view connection status and tools, add, edit, enable/disable, or delete services.
description.zh: 在一个 DSH 页面中管理所有已配置的 MCP 服务：查看连接状态与工具，新增、编辑、启停或删除服务。

description.en: Manage third-party plugins for DeepSeek Harness via Web UI: list, enable/disable, and hot-reload changes.
description.zh: 通过 Web 界面管理 DeepSeek Harness 第三方插件，可列出插件、启用或停用，并热重载更改。

description.en: Adds recent and active session blocks to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar so you can jump back into conversations and see which sessions need you.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏添加最近会话和活跃会话区块，方便快速回到对话并查看待处理的会话。

description.en: Schedules messages to be sent automatically at a chosen time by the Host, with one-click DeepSeek peak/off-peak slot picking.
description.zh: 定时发送插件：到点由 Host 真正发出消息，支持排入当前对话或新建会话，并可一键选择 DeepSeek 峰谷时段。

description.en: Distills exported chat logs into a playable persona and lets the AI reply in that person's voice.
description.zh: 把导出的聊天记录蒸馏成可扮演的人设，并让 AI 用该人设的口吻回复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness desktop pet whale girl that swims while the agent works, taps glass at approvals, celebrates on completion, plus a whale_say tool.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 鲸鱼女孩桌宠：Agent 干活时游泳、等待审批时敲玻璃、完成时庆祝，附 whale_say 工具。

description.en: Intercepts image blocks in DeepSeek Harness and substitutes vision model transcriptions so text-only models can read images.
description.zh: 拦截 DeepSeek Harness 中的图片块，用视觉模型转录结果替换，让纯文本模型也能读取图片。

description.en: Shows live DeepSeek API balance and time-to-empty in the composer dock, estimating spend from local token usage at peak/off-peak prices.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额与预计耗尽时间，按本地 token 用量与峰谷价估算花费。

description.en: A VS Code-style code editor that runs inside DeepSeek Harness and ACRYL Web/Desktop; this web fork is deprecated.
description.zh: 一个运行在 DeepSeek Harness 和 ACRYL Web/Desktop 内的 VS Code 风格代码编辑器；该 web 分支已弃用。

description.en: Cordis plugin adding a top-bar Quick Notes list to ACRYL/DeepSeek Harness, storing each note as a .txt file in host plugin data.
description.zh: 为 ACRYL 与 DeepSeek Harness 提供顶栏速记列表的 Cordis 插件，每条笔记以 .txt 文件保存在宿主插件数据目录。

description.en: DSH plugin and portable Agent Skill that drives the AsterFire Go platform for protein design, MD, bioinformatics and DFT job submission.
description.zh: DSH 插件兼通用 Agent 技能，接入星使智算平台，用于蛋白质设计、分子动力学、生物信息学与 DFT 计算任务的提交与管理。

description.en: A dsh plugin providing a Chinese AI expert library with 268 roles and 20 departments as native skills.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供中文 AI 专家库插件，将 268 个角色、20 个部门以原生技能形式接入。

description.en: A self-evolving constraint system that turns mistakes hit during AI-assisted development into rules enforced on the next run.
description.zh: 一个自我演进的约束系统，把 AI 辅助开发中实际踩过的坑转成下次自动生效的规则。

description.en: Draggable Web-UI panel that switches a dsh session's system prompt between the harness prompt and 13 archived coding-agent CLI prompts.
description.zh: 可拖拽的 Web-UI 面板，在 harness 提示词与 13 个已归档的编码智能体 CLI 提示词之间切换会话系统提示词。

description.en: AGPA (Agent Player Achievements) for DeepSeek Harness: native achievement_* tools bridging the AGPA engine, plus automatic event tracking from dsh session events.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AGPA 成就引擎的原生 achievement_* 工具，并根据 dsh 会话事件自动追踪成就事件。

description.en: Unofficial DSH model provider that connects locally installed Google Antigravity accounts and Gemini models into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 模型提供插件，将本地安装的 Google Antigravity 账户与 Gemini 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A DSH plugin that restyles the input box as analog liquid glass with specular highlights, edge glow, bubbles while thinking, and smooth theme transitions.
description.zh: 一个把 DSH 输入框变成模拟液态玻璃外观的插件：镜面高光、边缘柔光、思考时冒泡，并带 1.7 秒主题过渡。

description.en: Adds image recognition to text-only DeepSeek Harness models by forwarding images to OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 模型提供 analyze_image 工具，把图片转发到任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点以获取识别结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for AI search across web, images, videos, and structured data like weather, stocks, and exchange rates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供网页、图片、视频的 AI 搜索，并查询天气、股票、汇率等结构化数据。

description.en: Adds AnySearch web search and fetch tools to DSH, plus an API-key settings card that falls back to anonymous quota when left blank.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 AnySearch 搜索与抓取工具，并提供 API Key 设置卡片，留空即使用匿名额度。

description.en: Persistent API usage monitoring for DeepSeek and others, showing balances, quotas, token usage and costs in sidebar and floating window.
description.zh: 常驻监控 DeepSeek、SiliconFlow、OpenCode Go、火山引擎的 API 余额与配额，统计会话树 token 用量和花费，提供侧边栏入口和浮动窗。

description.en: Left-sidebar panel that scans the workspace for APKs, builds the first mt MCP analysis call, and appends each analysis record to a note file.
description.zh: 左侧栏面板：扫描工作区中的 APK，构造首个 mt MCP 分析调用，并将分析记录追加到工作区笔记文件。

description.en: Connects Volcengine Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and post-paid providers (incl. BytePlus) into DSH's native model selector with only an API key.
description.zh: 把火山方舟 Ark 的 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费服务（含 BytePlus 海外）接入 DSH 原生模型选择器，只需填 API Key。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-resumes active goal sessions after restart without manual continue prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，重启后自动恢复并继续运行仍带活跃目标的会话，无需人工输入继续指令。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets users paste images in chat without errors and auto-invokes free vision models to read them.
description.zh: DSH 图片插件：贴图不报错，自动判断是否调用智谱或魔搭免费视觉模型读图，图片在聊天窗口正常显示。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance in the status bar with auto-refresh and manual refresh.
description.zh: 在状态栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并支持自动刷新与手动刷新。

description.en: Compresses large tool outputs before they enter the model context and keeps originals retrievable by hash.
description.zh: 在大型工具输出进入模型上下文前进行压缩，并按哈希保留原文以便随时取回。

description.en: Native DSH workspace UI for paged read-only browsing of plugins, skills, memory, storage, settings, and files.
description.zh: DSH默认工作区界面，分页只读浏览插件、技能、记忆、存储、设置和文件。

description.en: Dynamic background plugin for DeepSeek Harness: upload GIF/static images or use 12-color palette, with timed crossfade transitions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态背景：可上传 GIF 或静态图，或用内置 12 色纯色调色板，定时交叉淡入淡出切换页面背景，聊天区自动叠加主题色保护层。

description.en: Adds a Monaco workspace file editor to the DeepSeek Harness desktop sidebar with file tree, Markdown preview, autosave and @-reference drag-insert.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端右栏添加 Monaco 工作区文件编辑器，含文件树、Markdown 预览、自动保存与 @ 引用拖入。

description.en: Connects Bilibili collection and search to A-Memorix shared memory, with task status, QQ allowlist management and Windows deployment.
description.zh: 将Bilibili收藏与搜索接入A-Memorix共享记忆，并提供任务状态、QQ白名单管理和Windows一键部署。

description.en: Lets DSH agents explicitly export or delete their own context to relieve context-window pressure, as a companion to billion-context-dsh (ACP).
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体显式导出或删除自身上下文以缓解上下文窗口压力，是 billion-context-dsh（ACP）的配套插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web search plugin that uses Tavily with API key or falls back to free Bing with zero config.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页搜索插件：有 Tavily 密钥时用 Tavily，没有则自动退回无需密钥的免费 Bing，零配置即可搜索。

description.en: Adds Alt+drag rectangular text selection and copy inside the conversation view for precise text capture.
description.zh: 在对话视图中支持按住 Alt 拖拽进行矩形文本选择并复制，便于精确提取文本。

description.en: Pre-boot rescue toolkit for DeepSeek Harness that validates profiles, detects broken plugins, and offers one-click recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 预启动救援工具，在不启动 DSH 的情况下校验配置组合、检测损坏插件并提供一键恢复。

description.en: Draw, inspect, and export 2D CAD drawings, with an automatic DXF re-open check before delivery.
description.zh: 绘制、检查并导出 2D CAD 图纸，交付前自动重新打开 DXF 文件进行校验。

description.en: Toggles a terse 'caveman' reply style in DSH terminal and web via bundled skills, a /caveman command and a TUI badge.
description.zh: 通过内置技能、/caveman 命令和 TUI 徽标，在 DSH 终端与网页中切换简洁的“穴居人”回复风格。

description.en: Video and audio file viewers for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with byte-range seeking and file-tree integration.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的视频和音频文件查看器，支持字节范围跳转和文件树集成。

description.en: Startup command panel for DeepSeek Harness showing project pick, machine health, backups and fleet status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 启动命令面板，展示项目选择、机器健康、备份和集群状态。

description.en: Windows-only utility that closes orphaned DeepSeek Harness runner processes left alive after a shell command finishes, reclaiming ~140 MB each.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 的工具，用于关闭 shell 命令结束后仍残留的 DeepSeek Harness 运行进程，每个可回收约 140 MB 内存。

description.en: A sidebar Changes view plugin for DeepSeek Harness that shows git/jj changes in the dsh panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏变更视图的插件，展示 git/jj 变更。

description.en: Configurable chat auto-scroll modes, controls, hotkeys, settings, and per-session reading position memory for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web界面提供可配置聊天自动滚动模式、控件、热键、设置及会话阅读位置记忆。

description.en: A warm-paper theme skin for DSH inspired by Claude Desktop, with warm white paper colors and a two-layer Chinese/Western font stack.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供仿 Claude Desktop 的暖纸外观皮肤，采用暖白纸配色与中西文两层字体栈。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that imports and browses local Claude Code and Codex session files with search and agent tools.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，导入并浏览本地 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话文件，支持搜索与智能体工具。

description.en: Audits Python code via local AST analysis to determine if it is original or derivative work, offline and dependency-free.
description.zh: 通过本地AST分析审计Python代码，判断其是原创还是演绎作品，离线且无依赖。

description.en: Runs animated pets in DSH Web using the Codex pet.json protocol, with fallback asset and interactive behaviors.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中按 Codex pet.json 协议运行动画宠物，支持备用资源与交互行为。

description.en: Collaborative Markdown canvas for DSH where humans and AI co-write via canvas_* tools, with undo history, version checks and file persistence.
description.zh: DSH 协作画布：人和 AI 共写的 Markdown 文档面，AI 通过 canvas_* 工具读写，带撤销历史、版本冲突检测与文件持久化。

description.en: A color scheme plugin for the DSH web GUI, offering seven built-in themes and persistent selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供配色方案的插件，内置七款主题，并保存用户所选主题。

description.en: Enables Codex-style conversation rollback and edit-and-resend in DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中提供 Codex 风格的对话回滚，并支持编辑历史消息后重新发送。

description.en: DSH/Cordis Web plugin: a zoomable relation graph of every loaded plugin (dependencies, resolved providers, Loader-tree nesting) as a Settings tab next to 'Plugin list'.
Provides 119 verified computer-science sources with source-finding and citation-audit tools for CS teaching.
description.zh: 为计算机教学提供119个经过验证的信源，并附带信源查找与引用审核工具。

description.en: Unofficial Mole CLI panel for DeepSeek Harness with system health checks, cleanup previews, disk analysis, app inventory and maintenance history.
description.zh: 大肥鱼 clean 是 DeepSeek Harness 的非官方 Mole CLI 面板，提供系统健康检查、清理预览、磁盘分析、应用清单和维护历史。

description.en: DAYS（Days-Are-Yours）是一个运行在 DeepSeek Harness 里的个人生活时间助手：退休倒计时、法定假期、请假与拼假、月历、下班/发薪倒计时、每日小乐趣、愿望清单和时间胶囊，收在同一个侧边栏面板里。
Local Xiaohongshu/Douyin workbench that collects notes and creator data, breaks down viral structure, and drafts topics and scripts.
description.zh: 本地运行的小红书/抖音工作台，采集笔记与创作者数据，拆解爆款结构并生成选题和脚本。

description.en: Author, inspect, and export editable slide decks with masters, layouts, and speaker notes that stay editable after export.
description.zh: 逐页创作、检查并导出可编辑演示文稿，母版、版式与讲稿同源，导出后仍可修改。

description.en: Seven Gruvbox themes for DeepSeek Harness with a preview picker, persisted selection, and system light/dark following.
Community DeepSeek Harness plugin for live HTML prototypes, element selection, and revision comparison.
description.zh: 社区 DeepSeek Harness 插件，支持实时 HTML 原型、元素选择与版本对比。

description.en: A personification suite for DeepSeek Harness that adds persona, memory, skills, self-evolution, and dreaming behind a native web workbench.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人格化套件，通过原生 Web 工作台提供角色、记忆、技能、自我进化与做梦功能。

description.en: Adds right-to-left (Persian/Arabic/Hebrew) bidi support to the Web UI, with per-block direction, LTR code blocks, and correct list/quote layout.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 增加波斯语/阿拉伯语/希伯来语等从右到左文本支持，支持按块设置方向、代码保持 LTR，并修正列表和引用的逻辑布局。

description.en: Provides customizable anime backgrounds and translucent glass-style UI effects for DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可更换的动漫背景和毛玻璃半透明界面效果。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin that brings Codex-Skins wallpaper + translucent-panel themes to Harness, with import, AI design and a skin_theme tool.
description.zh: 一个把 Codex-Skins 的壁纸与半透明面板主题系统搬到 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的插件，提供主题管理、导入与 AI 生成，并暴露 skin_theme 工具。

description.en: A warm neutral theme for the DSH Web GUI with warmer surfaces, rounder corners, sharper fonts, and its own settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的暖中性主题：更温暖的表面、更圆润的圆角、更锐利的默认字体，并带有独立设置页。

description.en: Patched fork of the DeepSeek Harness wallet/control center with peak-clock billing for deepseek-flash and model-pool pricing sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 钱包/控制中心的补丁分支，为 deepseek-flash 增加峰时计费与模型池驱动的价格同步。

description.en: Translates images in user messages and tool results into text descriptions for text-only LLMs like DeepSeek.
description.zh: 将用户消息和工具结果中的图片转换为文字描述，供 DeepSeek 等纯文本模型使用。

description.en: Imports DeepSeek web chat history into DSH while preserving images and document attachments that upstream drops.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 网页端历史对话导入 DSH，并保留上游会丢失的图片与文档附件。

description.en: Shared collaboration board for stations, workflows and projects in DeepSeek Harness, gated by GitHub access with no server or database.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中共享站点、工作流与项目的协作看板，以 GitHub 作为访问入口，无需服务器或数据库。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of a Claude Code dual-Agent delivery collaboration workflow plugin, distributed as a bundle.
description.zh: delivery-review-plugin（Claude Code 双 Agent 交付协作工作流插件）的 DeepSeek Harness 移植版。基于 DSH 的 Cordis 插件系统，以 bundle 方式分发，不改动 DSH 源码，全部能力由插件行在配置层挂载。

description.en: Double-tap Control to start or stop DSH's voice dictation mic, with audible cues and automatic language detection.
description.zh: 双击 Control 键开始或停止 DSH 语音听写，带提示音反馈并自动判断语言。

description.en: A warm paper-style shared pinboard for pinning ideas, to-dos and anonymous notes with a team pulse view.
description.zh: 一个温暖的纸张风格共享便签墙，可钉住想法、待办和匿名留言，并展示团队动态。

description.en: Extensible quick-control panel for DSH Web offering registry switching and a skin manager, usable standalone or with dock-base.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的可扩展快捷控制面板，支持切换注册表与皮肤管理，可独立使用或配合 dock-base。

description.en: Knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling search, reading, outlining, and draft-saving with block-level addressing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Doco 知识库原生插件，支持搜索、阅读、大纲和保存草稿，并可按块级地址定位内容。

description.en: Cute desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness with custom name and AI-generated or uploaded pet image.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加桌面宠物，可自定义名称，并上传自己的宠物图片或用 AI 生成宠物形象。

description.en: DSH skill pack for building web UIs with shadcn/ui, Canvas UI and ThreeUI, including layered architecture, performance budgets and acceptance checklists.
description.zh: DSH 技能包，指导使用 shadcn/ui、Canvas UI 与 ThreeUI 进行网页设计，包含三层架构、性能预算与验收清单。

description.en: Searches Dragonfly official help and local Python files to answer technical questions with cited, evidence-based responses.
description.zh: 搜索 Dragonfly 官方帮助文档和本地 Python 文件，为技术问题提供带引用的答案。

description.en: Builds Dreamina canvas node graphs and timelines with quoted runs and verified assets.
description.zh: 构建 Dreamina 画布节点图和时间线，支持引用运行与已验证素材。

description.en: Pairs a self-hosted DS Bot with its native mobile client, issuing scoped authorization and relaying messages over WebSocket.
description.zh: 为自托管的 DS Bot 原生移动客户端提供设备配对、范围授权，并通过 WebSocket 转发消息。

description.en: Collaborative kanban board for DeepSeek Harness where humans, DS Bot and ordinary sessions plan and track tasks together.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的协作看板，让人、DS Bot 与普通会话共同规划并跟踪任务。

description.en: DSH web session background reminder plugin that shows desktop alerts and plays sounds when a turn completes or permission is requested.
description.zh: DSH 网页会话后台提醒插件，在一轮对话完成或请求权限时弹出桌面通知并播放提示音。

description.en: Drag/paste any local file into DSH; plugin resolves real disk path and inserts path into chat input, no content copy.
description.zh: 将任意本地文件拖拽或粘贴进 DSH，解析其真实磁盘路径并写入聊天输入框，不复制文件内容。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek API account balance and peak/off-peak pricing periods in the DeepSeek Harness WebUI sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额及高峰/闲时价格时段。

description.en: Plays 1024/2048 inside the DSH Web GUI via a sidebar entry and fullscreen panel, with arrow-key/WASD/swipe controls and local saves.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中玩 1024/2048：侧边栏入口与全屏面板，支持方向键/WASD/滑动操作，本地存档。

description.en: Play the 2048 puzzle game inside DeepSeek Harness to pass the time while waiting for AI replies.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内游玩 2048 数字合并拼图游戏，可在等待 AI 回复时打发时间。

description.en: Split-pane file browser for the DSH right sidebar, showing a directory tree and file preview side by side for quick navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏提供分栏文件浏览器，左侧目录树与右侧文件内容并排显示，方便快速浏览与预览文件。

description.en: Wake-word voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness: say "你好Fairy" or "Fairy", dictate with local SenseVoice STT, and send directly.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供唤醒词语音输入：说「你好Fairy」或「Fairy」后用本地 SenseVoice 听写并直接发送。

description.en: Accessibility layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: coordinated announcements, keyboard navigation, and accessibility settings.
Watches the Agents Anywhere bridge for DeepSeek Harness, detecting permanently offline mobile devices and automatically recovering the connection.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agents Anywhere 桥接，检测永久离线的手机设备并自动恢复连接。

description.en: A/B test sample size calculator, computes precise sample sizes from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算A/B测试所需样本量并返回详细结果。

description.en: Adds a password-protected two-person chat panel in the right sidebar whose messages are never written to disk.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏提供受密码保护的双人聊天面板，消息绝不写入磁盘。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin that computes the absolute value of a number, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，用于计算数字的绝对值，且不依赖网络。

description.en: A curated, editorially judged index of absurd DSH plugins with a published rubric and native install from the catalog.
description.zh: 一份带有公开评分标准与编辑点评的抽象 DSH 插件名录，支持从名录直接原生安装。

description.en: Provides air conditioning energy-saving usage tips and safety points.
description.zh: 提供空调节能使用技巧及安全要点。

description.en: Calculate air conditioner size (匹数) from parameters using industry empirical estimation.
A tool to troubleshoot air conditioner faults by returning step-by-step procedures based on parameters.
Chinese-first academic skill pack for DSH: literature cards, citation formatting, journal polishing and review outlines.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的中文学术技能包：文献卡片、引用格式、期刊润色与审稿提纲。

description.en: Academic mode for DeepSeek Harness: research persona, anti-fabrication citation/data rules, bilingual conventions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 启用学术模式，切换研究型人格，并加入引用与数据反编造规则及双语规范。

description.en: A DSH plugin turning AI-coding delivery acceptance into a task-level evidence workbench that maps each requirement to addressable, version-bound evidence.
description.zh: DSH 插件：任务级交付验收凭证工作台，把每条原始需求映射到可寻址、版本绑定的证据，并管理契约与返修轮次。

description.en: Session access-mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness with Default, No Edit, and Auto modes for access control.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供 Default、No Edit、Auto 三种访问模式控制。

description.en: Verifies access review campaigns cover entitlements, risk stages, and decisions, producing redacted content-addressed evidence.
description.zh: 验证访问审查活动涵盖权限、风险阶段与决策，生成脱敏

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek API account balance in a dashboard above the chat window.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 聊天窗口上方显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额的面板插件。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek account balance and per-model spending in a compact widget under the chat composer.
description.zh: 在聊天输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和各模型消费金额的小组件。

description.en: Displays your DeepSeek account balance in the DSH left sidebar and lets you top up without leaving the app.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧边栏常驻显示 DeepSeek 账号余额，并支持在应用内直接充值。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows the DeepSeek account's remaining balance right in the composer bottom bar.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在编辑器底部输入栏显示 DeepSeek 账户的剩余余额。

description.en: Encrypted site account manager for DeepSeek Harness with a Settings page and Edge-based authenticated search/fetch tools for agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供加密站点账号管理、设置页面，以及基于 Edge 的认证搜索/抓取工具。

description.en: Encrypted local account and password vault for DSH with search, password generation, multiple vaults and encrypted backups, no cloud sync.
description.zh: DSH 内的加密账号密码保险库，支持搜索、密码生成、多套保险库和加密备份，无云同步。

description.en: Calculates accounting certificate requirements based on parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算会计凭证要求并返回详细结果

description.en: DSH plugin that adds an "Accounts" section to the dsh-accounts settings panel using native UI components.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用原生 UI 组件为 dsh-accounts 在设置面板中新增「账号」区块。

description.en: AI next-move advisor for DeepSeek Harness that suggests a better next step; press Tab to accept it.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AI 下一步建议，按 Tab 即可采纳更优操作。

description.en: A personal achievement plugin for DSH that turns real usage into themed achievements, badges and collectible character cards stored locally.
description.zh: 一个轻量的 DSH 个人成就插件，把真实使用经历转化为主题成就、勋章和本地保存的角色收藏。

description.en: A Node-based acne care tool that returns clear advice based on input parameters; no network dependencies.
description.zh: 基于 Node 的痘痘护理工具，根据输入参数返回明确的护理建议，不依赖网络。

description.en: Acne mark fading tool that returns clear advice based on parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回痘印淡化建议的纯 Node 工具，不联网。

description.en: Converts acres to hectares for land area.
description.zh: 将英亩转换为公顷以计算土地面积。

description.en: A translucent Windows Acrylic theme for DeepSeek Harness desktop, letting the wallpaper show through with layered frosted panels for readability.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的透明亚克力主题，让壁纸透出并分层雾面，保证文字清晰可读。

description.en: A plugin named dsh-actinium with description 'Actinium element' and no other details.
description.zh: dsh.so 插件，名为 dsh-actinium，描述为锕元素，无其他功能说明。

description.en: GitHub Action that runs a cost-capped headless DSH PR review and writes a Markdown review, optionally posting it.
description.zh: 一个 GitHub Action，用带成本上限的无头 DSH 运行审查 PR，生成 Markdown 审查结果并可选择发布。

description.en: Provides structured active-listening methods by scenario, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 按场景提供结构化的有效倾听方法，以纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds a bell to the workspace header showing active and recent sessions, with live running-task indicators and session filters.
description.zh: 在工作区标题栏添加会话铃铛，展示活跃与最近会话，并提供运行中任务指示和会话筛选。

description.en: Adds a time-based heat score to DSH sessions, shown as a sidebar heat ring, title underline and panel so recent conversations stay visible.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话增加基于时间的活跃热度评分，通过侧边栏热力环、标题下划线和面板让最近的对话保持可见。

description.en: GitHub-style heatmap that visualizes your daily DeepSeek Harness usage, built from local session logs, with shapes, palettes and calendar layouts.
description.zh: GitHub 风格的活跃度热力图，基于本地会话日志可视化你每天的 DeepSeek Harness 使用情况，支持多种形状、配色与日历布局。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a live activity line under the composer to show what the agent is doing in real time.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，在输入框下方显示实时活动行，反馈智能体当前动作。

description.en: Adds a bell in the DSH web sidebar that swaps the sessions list for Needs attention, Working and Today activity views.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页侧边栏添加铃铛按钮，将会话列表切换为“需关注”“进行中”“今天”的活动视图。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar session list with a flat activity-sorted view showing workspace names and pinning running sessions on top.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧栏会话列表替换为按活跃度排序的扁平视图，每行显示所属项目名，运行中的会话置顶。

description.en: Provides Traditional Chinese Medicine acupoint health care plans based on parameters, implemented in Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数提供中医穴位保健方案，用 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Calculates the maximum ad bid from input parameters and returns detailed results, pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算广告出价上限并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Ad ROI calculator that computes advertising return on investment from parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数计算广告投资回报率（ROI）并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Automatically adjusts AI reasoning effort per turn based on complexity, tracks token usage, and labels replies.
description.zh: 根据复杂度自动调整每轮AI推理努力级别（低/高/最大），跟踪令牌使用并标记回复。

description.en: Deterministic per-turn adaptive model routing for DeepSeek Harness, using economy models for simple work and quality models for complexity.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性的逐轮自适应模型路由，简单任务用经济模型，复杂任务用高质量模型。

description.en: Windows-native agent preset for DeepSeek Harness, offering Standard and Minimal adaptive presets with PowerShell and Git Bash tool routing.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体预设包，提供 Standard 与 Minimal 两种自适应预设，含 PowerShell/Git Bash 工具路由。

description.en: Android Studio-style live ADB logcat viewer with device list, filtering, and color-coded levels for DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供类似 Android Studio 的 ADB logcat 实时查看，支持设备列表、日志过滤和按级别着色显示。

description.en: Browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that lets you select conversation text and add it as a quoted block to your next message.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的浏览器插件，可选中对话中的文字，将其作为引用块添加到下一条消息中。

description.en: Adds selected chat text to the composer as an annotation so you can reference it while writing a reply.
description.zh: 将选中的聊天文本作为注释添加到输入框，方便在撰写回复时引用。

description.en: ADHD-friendly focus soundscape plugin with five procedurally synthesised noise colours, a live-waveform orb and a fade-out timer.
description.zh: 面向ADHD用户的专注音景插件，提供五种程序合成噪声音色、实时波形球和淡出计时器。

description.en: A warm parchment theme for DeepSeek Harness that restyles semantic color tokens and typography across the whole client UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的暖色羊皮纸主题，重定义语义色彩变量与全局字体排版。

description.en: Web GUI admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing manual restart and automatic version checking via header button and settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面管理插件，提供手动重启，并在顶栏按钮和设置页中自动检查版本更新。

description.en: Turns one DeepSeek Harness session into a group-work room with a chair and member agents that message each other and share a task list.
description.zh: 把一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话变成群组工作房间，设有主持人和多个成员智能体，彼此通信并共享任务列表。

description.en: Tool that calculates precise adult vaccine recommendations based on input parameters, returning health advice (follow doctor's orders).
Keyword-search all DSH sessions plus local Claude Code/Codex/ZCode histories, with a sidebar search button and built-in MCP for agents.
description.zh: 按关键字搜索所有 DSH 会话标题与内容，并可选搜索本机 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 历史记录，内置 MCP 让 agent 自行检索。

description.en: Runs an adversarial, devil's-advocate dry run that stress-tests your files, copy, or scripts before you publish them.
description.zh: 发布前对你的文件、文案或脚本进行对抗式魔鬼代言人压力测试，提前暴露风险。

description.en: Standalone DSH client plugin that adds a Japanese (日本語) interface for the dsh-advisor settings page.
description.zh: 独立的 DSH 客户端插件，为 dsh-advisor 设置页面提供日语（日本語）界面。

description.en: Gives an agent an external emotion state machine with drifting 0-100 axes that inject per-turn mood bands and allowed tags.
description.zh: 为智能体提供外部情绪状态机：多条0-100情绪轴随时间漂移，每轮注入情绪区间和可用标签。

description.en: A plugin described as Afghanistan country.
A novelty plugin that locally simulates anti-cheat-style scan stutter in the dsh web UI, with pointer lag and stalled text.
description.zh: 一个无聊插件，在 dsh 网页界面本地模拟反作弊安全组件扫描时的卡顿，如鼠标延滞、文字停滞。

description.en: A simple age calculator plugin implemented in pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现且无网络依赖的年龄计算插件。

description.en: Age-based parenting education tool that returns customized education plans based on parameters, pure Node with no network.
description.zh: 分龄育儿教育工具，按传入参数返回定制教育方案，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Adds a marketplace of 273 expert AI agent personas to DeepSeek Harness, with one-click install and use in conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 273 位专家 AI 人格市场，可一键安装并在对话中使用。

description.en: Agensi (skill marketplace) as native mcp__agensi__* tools in DeepSeek Harness: a direct Streamable HTTP MCP connection whose credential comes from an OAuth 2.1 sign-in, never a pasted token.
Docks a live done-now-next card above the DSH composer showing every tool call of the current turn as the agent works.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方固定一张实时的“已完成-进行中-下一步”卡片，实时展示当前轮次的每次工具调用。
