description.en: Desktop alert plugin for DeepSeek Harness that pops a Windows browser notification and plays a sound when agent tasks finish, error, or await approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 智能体任务状态提醒插件，在任务完成、出错或等待审批时弹出浏览器通知并播放提示音。

description.en: Shows a live two-column card board of the current session's main and sub agents in the DSH right sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏以实时双列卡片看板展示当前会话的主代理与子代理。

description.en: Bridge bundle that lets a Feishu bot post tasks to a local DSH instance, which runs a real session in a matched workspace and returns the result.
description.zh: 飞书机器人到 DSH 的会话桥：把任务投递到指定工作区开真会话执行，跑完回传结论给机器人。

description.en: Gives DSH agents a user-visible sidebar browser they can see and control through 15 browser_* tools, including a CDP deep mode.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供一个用户可见的侧边栏浏览器，通过 15 个 browser_* 工具进行查看与操作，并支持 CDP 深度模式。

description.en: Message channel that lets DSH agents on two machines send each other turn-injection messages, logged and re-injected as context at the next agent step.
description.zh: 让两台机器上的 DSH 代理互相发送轮次注入消息，消息写入日志并在下一步作为上下文注入。

description.en: A multi-agent contract workflow engine that injects work agreements into sub-agents, delegates by role, and audits deliverables, ledgers and docs.
description.zh: 多智能体契约工作流引擎：向子代理注入工作契约、按角色委派，并审计交付物、台账与文档。

description.en: Lets the user tune each agent in the Web GUI: per-agent Instructions in the system prompt, and the deployment default model.
A playful isometric live office that visualizes read-only per-agent telemetry, radar and network activity for DSH multi-agent runs.
description.zh: 一个有趣的等距实时办公室，用只读遥测、雷达与网络活动可视化 DSH 多智能体运行状态。

description.en: deepseek harness 的computer-use 插件
Gives the agent native computer use through the agent-desktop CLI: the binary installs itself, updates itself on every launch, and answers through first-class tools and a Settings page.
Monitors DeepSeek Harness agent runtime health with loop detection, a runtime_health tool, a health panel, and per-turn summaries.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 代理的运行时健康，提供循环检测、runtime_health 工具、健康面板与逐轮摘要。

description.en: Graph orchestration for DeepSeek Harness agents: scoped agent nodes, structured handoffs, bounded rework, and a layered global ledger.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图式智能体编排：作用域智能体节点、结构化交接、有界返工与分层全局账本。

description.en: DSH local console for a Feishu three-persona bot: floating button to start, stop and reconnect the daemon, with status lights, recent activity and a shortcut to the task workspace.
description.zh: 飞书三人格机器人的 DSH 本地控制台：悬浮按钮开启/关闭/重连守护进程，含状态指示灯、最近动态与任务工作区直达入口。

description.en: DSH guardrail plugin adding evidence-first inspection, write governance, and per-turn rollback points, with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 护栏插件：提供证据优先的检查、写入治理与逐轮回滚点，零运行时依赖。

description.en: A pre-execute gate for DSH tool calls that asks for confirmation before a call leaks credentials, stops a service, or rewrites host network or registry state.
description.zh: DSH 工具调用前置拦截器:在调用泄露凭据、停止服务或改写主机网络/注册表状态之前先向用户确认。

description.en: Long-term memory plugin for DSH agents that captures conversation evidence in real time, with a read-only browser CLI and in-session status panel.
description.zh: DSH 智能体长期记忆插件：实时采集对话证据，配套只读数据浏览 CLI 与会话内工作状态面板。

description.en: Adds a lean right-click context menu to DeepSeek Harness chat and sidebar: copy, open file location, workspace menu reordering, session deletion and Chinese localization.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的对话区与侧栏增加精简右键菜单：复制、打开文件位置、工作区菜单重排、会话删除与汉化。

description.en: Switch the current session's agent preset (mode) after the model answers and keep chatting.
description.zh: 在模型回答完后切换当前会话的 agent 预设（模式），并继续当前对话。

description.en: DSH plugin that sends real Windows WinRT toast notifications when the agent finishes a run, needs approval, or asks a question.
description.zh: DSH 插件：当智能体完成运行、需要批准或向你提问时，发送真实的 Windows WinRT 弹窗通知。

description.en: DSH plugin for agent observability and security evaluation, using DSH Web's evaluation center and cached security test datasets.
description.zh: DSH plugin for agent observability and security evaluation

description.en: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, document previews, file chips.
description.zh: 代理输出文件的覆盖式阅读器：支持Markdown渲染、文档预览和文件标签。

description.en: A pet in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that changes pose with your agent, featuring an AI-generatable eight-pose sprite sheet.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中的宠物，随代理状态变化姿势，含可由一句话生成的八姿势精灵图。

description.en: Ask the user for approval, then wake and deliver an @ message to another DSH session for cross-session multi-agent collaboration.
description.zh: 先经用户当场授权，再唤醒并向另一个 DSH 会话投递 @ 消息，实现跨会话多智能体协作。

description.en: Agent tool bridge for researching and installing DSH community plugins with version pinning, risk checks, and user confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 提供调查与安装社区插件的工具桥，支持版本锁定、风险检查和用户确认。

description.en: Branch a completed conversation into a new session using a different Agent preset, migrating the existing dialogue.
description.zh: 从任意已完成轮次将会话分支到新的 Agent 预设，并迁移现有对话。

description.en: Auto-routes DeepSeek Harness sessions to the best agent preset, judging and running without confirmation.
description.zh: Auto Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a flash-model router that auto-picks the best agent preset (standard/code/minimal/cordis) for each new session — judge and run, no confirmation

description.en: Hot-switch agent presets (working modes) inside a running DSH session without restarting.
description.zh: 在运行中的 DSH 会话内热切换 agent 预设（工作模式），无需重启会话。

description.en: Host-owned process and port lifecycle manager for local DSH agents with start/stop/list/logs/wait-ready and a Processes panel.
description.zh: 为本地 DSH agent 提供宿主级进程与端口生命周期管理，支持 start/stop/list/logs/wait-ready 及进程面板。

description.en: Adds a persistent, draggable progress bar to DeepSeek Harness showing real task progress for the current chat and all other chats, including background jobs and sub-agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加常驻可拖动进度条，实时显示当前对话及所有对话的任务进度，含后台命令与子代理。

description.en: Gives DSH agents one-command internet reach across web, YouTube, GitHub, Twitter/X, Reddit, RSS and Exa search via the Agent Reach CLI.
description.zh: 通过 Agent Reach CLI，让 DSH 智能体用一条命令访问网页、YouTube、GitHub、Twitter/X、Reddit、RSS 和 Exa 搜索。

description.en: DSH settings page for managing long-lived agent rules and memory stored in ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md.
description.zh: DSH 设置页面，用于管理存储在 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 中的长期智能体规则与记忆。

description.en: Adds an agent selector next to the chat input to delegate tasks to external AI agents and stream results back.
description.zh: 在对话输入框旁添加智能体选择器，可委派任务给外部AI代理并将结果流回对话。

description.en: Gives DSH agents tools to create new sessions and deliver messages into any running session via the host session controller.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供会话工具，可新建会话或向任意正在运行的会话投递消息，直接走宿主 sessionController 的真实投递路径。

description.en: Speeds up agent tool execution with a read-only cache, in-flight request coalescing, speculative prefetch and concurrent read-only shell commands.
description.zh: 通过只读缓存、请求合并、推测性预取和并发只读 shell 命令，加速智能体的工具执行。

description.en: Sticky-note plugin for DeepSeek Harness to display agent notices and pending decisions in the web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供便签插件，在 Web 界面中显示智能体通知与待定决策，便于通过 Tailscale 访问查看。

description.en: Read-only Agent Team console for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI showing live roster, shared task board, and collaboration activity.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的只读 Agent Team 控制台，展示实时成员名单、共享任务板和协作动态。

description.en: Policy plugin that governs when an agent may spawn subagents or teammates, limiting it to adversarial review and one-shot context reading.
description.zh: 策略插件，规定智能体何时可以派生子代理或队友，仅限对抗性审查和一次性上下文读取。

description.en: Dashboard for DSH agent teams showing teams, token spend in USD/RUB, work time, and archives.
description.zh: DSH 代理团队仪表盘，展示团队、代币费用（美元/卢布）、工作时间和归档。

description.en: Turns a DSH session into an animated character stage where a pet reacts to tool events, messages become comic bubbles and results appear as subtitles.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话变成动画角色舞台，宠物响应工具事件，消息变成漫画气泡，结果以字幕呈现。

description.en: 四个入口，不用离开会话 —— Agent-ToDo 多项目工作台装进 DeepSeek Harness
Aggregates local token-usage logs from Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor and DSH into a ledger with cache-hit and cost analytics.
description.zh: 汇总 Claude Code、OpenCode、Cursor、DSH 等本地 token 日志，生成账本并提供缓存命中与成本分析。

description.en: Per-agent tool filter for DeepSeek Harness that gives the orchestrator a minimal toolset while subagents keep the full toolset.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按代理过滤工具的能力，使编排器仅使用最小工具集，而子代理保留完整工具集。

description.en: Unofficial whale-girl companion for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar brand mark plus a draggable, collapsible floating mascot showing live token usage.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH Web GUI 鲸鱼娘伴侣：侧边栏品牌图标，以及可拖动、可折叠并显示实时 token 用量的悬浮吉祥物。

description.en: Toggleable plugin that applies mobile and small-screen layout fixes to the DeepSeek Harness web shell.
description.zh: 可开关插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 网页外壳提供移动端与小屏幕布局修复。

description.en: Agentic Tool Catalog for DeepSeek Harness: an agent builds and maintains the tool catalog; schemas stay out of context and tools load on demand.
Runs the AGENTS.md authoring workflow inside a subagent so instruction content stays out of the main conversation.
description.zh: 在子代理中运行 AGENTS.md 编写工作流，使指令内容不进入主对话。

description.en: Restricts DSH to reading only AGENTS.md and AGENTS.local.md instruction files, ignoring CLAUDE.md.
description.zh: 让 DSH 只读取 AGENTS.md 和 AGENTS.local.md 指令文件，不读取 CLAUDE.md。

description.en: DSH plugin that searches agentswarm.space via read-only MCP to surface paid tasks for your agent, plus a /agentswarm-work skill.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过只读 MCP 在 agentswarm.space 上搜索可接的有偿任务，并提供 /agentswarm-work 技能。

description.en: Returns behavior correction suggestions for aggressive behavior based on input parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回针对攻击行为的纠正建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Agnes AI tools for generating images and videos in DeepSeek Harness, with optional image recognition and local artifact saving.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Agnes AI 图像与视频生成工具，可选图像识别，产物保存到本地文件夹。

description.en: Agnes omni-modal plugin for image understanding and generation via DSH credentials.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解、文生图与图生图，并能在聊天中发送图片，API 密钥经 DSH 凭证读取。

description.en: Provides a local knowledge base of agricultural terms with list and detail lookup functions.
Enhances DeepSeek Harness agy UI with model list cleanup, quota badges, glassy quota overlays, and responsive mobile drawer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 agy 提供非侵入式 UI 增强：模型列表净化、配额徽章、毛玻璃额度浮层和移动端抽屉自适应。

description.en: An AI arcade for DeepSeek Harness where the model only plans and comments while a local engine plays snake and Chinese chess.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 AI 街机厅：模型只负责想和说，本地引擎负责实际下棋与操作贪吃蛇。

description.en: Two-way prompt relay that lets another AI send prompts into a DSH session over local HTTP and read the replies back from an outbox.
description.zh: 双向提示词中继：让其他 AI 通过本机 HTTP 把提示词递进 DSH 会话，并从 outbox 读回回复。

description.en: DSH plugin exposing typed cq tools that run the cq CLI for deterministic Python code-quality scans, baselines, gates and fix plans.
description.zh: DSH 插件提供类型化 cq 工具，调用 cq CLI 对 Python 仓库完成确定性代码质量扫描、基线、质量门与修复规划。

description.en: A role-driven enterprise AI deliberation plugin that creates a temporary corporate decision board with multiple AI models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供角色驱动的企业 AI 审议插件，用多个 AI 模型组建临时公司决策董事会

description.en: Exports DSH conversations to TXT, Markdown, and searchable PDF files using a native Windows destination picker.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为 TXT、Markdown 和可搜索 PDF 文件，并使用原生 Windows 目录选择器。

description.en: Turns local DSH session logs into a daily/weekly work report panel showing goals, actions, deliverables and unfinished todos, fully offline.
description.zh: 读取本机 DSH 会话日志，离线生成每日/每周工作报告面板，按目标展示行动、交付物与未完成待办。

description.en: Modular local AI model hub exposing text, image, 3D, audio and video models to DSH through a simple capability interface.
description.zh: 模块化本地AI模型中枢，通过能力接口向DSH提供文本、图像、3D、音频和视频模型。

description.en: AI 模型工具插件，提供列出和按 id/名称查询模型条目的功能，纯 Node 实现无网络依赖。
description.zh: 提供列出 AI 模型条目以及按 id 或名称查询模型条目的工具，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A Hao123-style AI navigation page for DeepSeek Harness, linking 95 verified AI sites and knowledge bases across 8 categories.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Hao123 风格的 AI 导航页，收录 8 大类共 95 个已验证的 AI 站点与知识库。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with model release radar, benchmark and community reports, and AI news digest.

description.en: Finds the cheapest legitimate AI/SaaS purchase option by analyzing region, eligibility, payments, taxes, and policies.
description.zh: 根据地区、资格、支付方式、税费和服务政策，查找最便宜的合法AI/SaaS购买选项。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 购物助手插件，支持商品对比、价格分析，并核查商家与评价证据及来源质量。

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 7-7-7 执行循环：计划、运行、记录、收尾、复利，并设有人工把关环节。

description.en: AI teaching agent that reads PDFs and helps you master them with explanations and quizzes.
description.zh: AI 老师阅读 PDF 并讲解内容、出题测验，帮助你吃透一本书

description.en: Provides a list of AI terminology entries and detailed lookups by id or name, implemented in pure Node.
description.zh: 提供 AI 术语条目列表，可按 id 或名称查询术语详情，纯 Node 实现。

description.en: Aggregates multi-source AI news into one daily digest covering embodied AI, large models, industry and papers, output as Markdown and HTML.
description.zh: 聚合多源 AI 资讯，生成涵盖具身智能、大模型、行业与论文的每日摘要，输出 Markdown 与 HTML。

description.en: AI-powered visual editor for web apps in DSH: preview, drag-edit elements, and apply style changes via natural language.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中预览网页应用、拖拽编辑页面元素，并通过自然语言描述来应用样式修改的可视化编辑器。

description.en: AI tool-use plugin that returns suggestions based on parameters, pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: AI工具使用插件，根据参数返回建议，纯Node实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A pixel-art floating AI worker widget in the DSH Web corner that animates and celebrates based on live session status.

description.en: Live DSH taskboard showing what Claude Code, Codex, DSH and Open Design agents are doing right now, with a list plus swimlane timeline.
description.zh: DSH 实时任务看板，以列表和泳道时间线展示 Claude Code、Codex、DSH 与 Open Design 代理当前正在做什么。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects an Aimy relay station as a model source, switching groups in place and refreshing model lists and billing rates.

description.en: AionUi-style two-column right sidebar for the DSH Web GUI, adding preview and files/changes panels with no build step.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 AionUi 风格的双栏右侧边栏，内置预览与文件/变更面板，无需构建步骤。

description.zh: 室内绿植工具，根据输入参数返回家庭空气质量解决方案，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: 按参数返回家居空气质量方案，辅助空气净化器选购。
Computes precise airport advance time based on parameters returns detailed results. Pure Node no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数计算精确的机场提前时间并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: AI test-design plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns requirements into test PRDs, test points, test cases, and review, all in-process.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 测试设计插件，把需求转化为测试 PRD、测试点、测试用例并完成质检评审。

description.en: Plugin providing basic information about the country of Albania.
description.zh: 提供阿尔巴尼亚国家基本信息的插件。

description.zh: 甲醛治理计算器，可根据输入参数计算并返回明确建议。

description.en: Sends a push alert to your phone when the AI finishes, errors out, or waits for your approval, via 7 free channels.

description.en: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline shortcut in the dsh web input box, matching other AI clients' habits.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页输入框添加 Alt+Enter 换行快捷键，与其他 AI 客户端习惯保持一致。

description.en: Altitude sickness (高反) tool: calculates from parameters and gives clear advice, pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算高原反应情况并给出明确建议，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Altitude sickness prevention tool that returns hiking and mountaineering plans based on parameters.

description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏浏览器添加元素与区域标注，通过同源代理把笔记发送到对话中。

description.zh: 根据输入参数计算家用电器使用寿命，并返回明确的建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Calculates the recommended order for bringing home appliances into a space based on input parameters.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算家电搬入空间的推荐顺序。

description.en: Logs DSH approvals and tool calls to local JSONL audit files and can switch a session to a full-permission preset.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批与工具调用记录写入本地 JSONL 审计文件，并可将会话切换到完全权限预设。

description.en: Consults both the executing AI and the auto-review AI while a DSH tool approval is pending, supporting human review.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工具审批挂起时，同时询问执行 AI 与自动审查 AI 的意见，辅助人工决策。

description.en: Fail-safe auto-approval pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: routine sandbox escapes auto-pass, risky, uncertain or failed requests go to humans.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批决策管道：例行沙箱越界自动放行，危险、拿不准或失败一律转人工（fail-safe）。

description.en: Replaces approval prompts with a real diff review showing line diffs, word highlights, and disk-sourced context per file.
description.zh: DSH plugin: replace file-change approval prompts with a real diff review (line diffs, word highlights, disk-sourced context, one file per card)

description.en: Adds an AI-written explanation and risk note to DSH's approval dialog, generated from the model's own reasoning.
description.zh: 在 DSH 审批弹窗旁用模型自身推理解释命令含义、意图与风险。

description.en: Approval-first edit/write for DeepSeek Harness, prompting users before out-of-policy file mutations.
description.zh: Approval-first edit/write for DeepSeek Harness: shadow tools ask the user BEFORE a mutation the standing sandbox policy would deny, so the model never has to repeat a tool call with sandbox_permission

description.en: Renders DeepSeek Harness approval requests as article-style cards with safe Markdown, code details, risk badges, raw/copy views and keyboard decisions.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的审批请求渲染为文章式卡片，支持安全 Markdown、代码详情、风险徽章、原始/复制视图和键盘决策。

description.en: Turns blocking agent approvals into a background inbox so the agent keeps working and you approve queued requests whenever you are free.
description.zh: 把阻塞式审批变成后台收件箱：Agent 将请求排队后继续干活，你有空再批，批完自动继续。

description.en: Windows toast and sound notifications when a session requests elevation approval.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 会话请求提权审批时，用 Windows 通知弹窗和声音提醒用户。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification when DSH is waiting for your tool-call approval, with click-to-focus on the DSH window.
description.zh: 当 DSH 等待你批准工具调用时发送桌面通知，点击即可聚焦 DSH 窗口。

description.en: Adds an optional rejection reason box to DeepSeek Harness approval prompts, steering your reason into the running turn before the rejection is answered.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的审批提示添加可选的拒绝理由输入框，在提交拒绝前将理由注入当前运行的回合。

description.en: Plays an audible alert in the DSH Web GUI whenever an approval or ask-user-question panel is waiting for your response.
description.zh: 当 DSH Web GUI 出现审批或提问面板等待响应时，播放声音提醒。

description.en: Plays a Windows notification sound whenever DeepSeek Harness requests approval or asks you a question.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 请求批准或提问时，播放 Windows 通知提示音。

description.en: Floating overlay that shows pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session, with click-through to the session.
description.zh: 浮动覆盖层显示任意会话中的待审批、计划审核和用户提问，可点击跳转到该会话。

description.en: Adds an "ask why" button plus risk and denial notes to DSH tool-approval cards, explaining the requested permissions from the call's own arguments.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工具审批卡片加上「追问为什么」按钮，以及风险与不授权的常驻提示，依据调用参数当场说明所请求的权限。

description.en: Auto-approves LLM requests in DeepSeek Harness while requiring user confirmation for high-risk destructive commands.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动批准模式，由 LLM 安全审核批准请求，高风险破坏性命令仍会询问用户。

description.en: DSH sidebar AI product radar that fetches GitHub releases, npm packages and RSS feeds, detects version-to-version changes and keeps original evidence.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏 AI 产品雷达：抓取 GitHub Releases、npm 包与 RSS 源，识别版本间变化并留存原始证据。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for DeepSeek Harness, adapted for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and tested only on that version.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的水蓝玻璃拟态主题，适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，仅在该版本测试。

description.en: Reads an aquaculture input register and checks row completeness, vocabulary, unique batch numbers, and withdrawal-period date arithmetic.
description.zh: 读取水产养殖投入品记录，校验字段完整性、词表、批号唯一性及休药期日期计算。

description.en: An in-chat architecture advisor for DSH that queries an offline knowledge base of architecture tutorials/templates and guides engineering documentation.
description.zh: DSH 的架构顾问，离线查询架构教程/模板知识库，辅助编写工程文档。

description.en: Browse archived DSH sessions, view transcripts, restore them to the sidebar, inject them into the current chat, or fork a new session.
description.zh: 浏览已归档的 DSH 会话，查看记录、恢复到侧边栏、注入当前对话或派生新会话。

description.en: Mechanically checks 归档登记表 registers: required description fields, unique 档号, gapless 件号, valid 保管期限 terms, date/year match, overdue transfers.
description.zh: 对归档登记表做机械核对：必填著录项、档号唯一、件号连续、保管期限合规、形成日期与年度一致、超期未移交提示。

description.en: A DSH Web panel for permanently deleting selected archived conversations from the default workspace.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web 面板，用于永久删除默认工作区中选定的已归档会话。

description.en: Browse, preview, restore, recycle, or permanently delete archived DeepSeek Harness conversations with batch actions and an Agent-callable tool.
description.zh: 浏览、预览、恢复、回收或彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 归档会话，支持批量操作与 Agent 调用。

description.en: A plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lists archived sessions and restores them to the sidebar with one click.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供归档会话列表，并一键恢复到侧边栏，无需重启。

description.en: Codex-style manager for archived DSH chat sessions: search, filter, unarchive and permanently delete archived sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 DSH 已归档会话管理器：可搜索、筛选、取消归档并永久删除已归档会话。

description.en: Adds a sidebar archive panel listing all archived DSH conversations so you can bulk-select and unarchive them or permanently delete their session files.
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增归档面板，列出全部已归档对话，可批量勾选后一起取消归档或永久删除会话存档。

description.en: A web GUI archive manager for DSH that lists archived sessions and enables one-click restore.
description.zh: DSH 的 Web 图形界面归档管理器，可列出已归档的会话并支持一键恢复。

description.en: Keeps archived DSH sessions out of the conversation list and adds a panel to restore or permanently delete them.
description.zh: 将已归档会话从对话列表中隐藏，并提供面板以恢复或永久删除它们。

description.en: Adds delete/batch-cleanup and repair tools for archived DSH sessions, including reclaiming disk space and fixing orphaned records.
description.zh: 为已归档的 DSH 会话补上删除与批量清理入口，并提供磁盘占用回收与失效记账修复等维护工具。

description.en: Read-only viewer for archived DSH sessions: browse the archive list and read full conversations and tool calls without unarchiving.
description.zh: 已归档 DSH 会话的只读查看器：无需取消归档即可浏览归档列表、阅读完整对话与工具调用。

description.en: Adds delete, batch-delete and a 30-day recycle bin for archived DSH sessions, showing per-session disk usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 已归档会话补上删除、批量删除与 30 天回收站，并显示每条会话的磁盘占用。

description.en: Deletes archived chat sessions and safely garbage-collects unreferenced attachments as one reversible transaction.
description.zh: 以单个可逆事务删除已归档会话，并安全回收未被引用的附件。

description.en: DSH plugin that batch-deletes all local traces of archived sessions and automatically sweeps orphaned data from DSH HOME.
description.zh: DSH 插件：批量删除已归档会话在本地的全部痕迹，并自动清扫 DSH HOME 下的孤儿数据。

description.en: Shows archived conversations in the DSH Web sidebar footer with read-only previews.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部显示已归档会话，并提供只读的消息预览。

description.en: Compresses archived DSH sessions into reusable memories and skills as markdown, then optionally deletes the bulky logs to reclaim disk space.
description.zh: 把已归档的 DSH 会话提炼成可复用的记忆与技能 markdown，并可选地删除臃肿日志以回收磁盘空间。

description.en: View and restore archived sessions from a dedicated page in the web Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置的专用页面查看并恢复已归档的会话。

description.en: DSH plugin for managing archived sessions: unarchive natively, quarantine recoverably, purge permanently, plus search, filter, sort and retention rules.
description.zh: DSH 归档会话管理插件：原生取消归档、可恢复隔离区、永久清除，并支持搜索、筛选、排序与保留策略。

description.en: Adds a select-all cleanup action that fully purges archived DSH sessions, removing session logs, projection caches, workspace accounting and archive markers together.
description.zh: 提供全选清理功能，彻底清除已归档的 DSH 会话，同时删除会话日志、投影缓存、工作区统计和归档标记。

description.en: Adds a Settings page to browse, search, and one-click restore archived conversations back to their original workspace.
description.zh: 在设置中新增归档会话页面，可浏览、搜索并一键恢复到原工作区。

description.en: Manage archived DSH sessions: fast list, restore to original workspace, and permanently delete with confirmation.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档会话：快速列出、恢复到原工作区、经确认后永久删除。

description.en: Unofficial DSH web UI plugin that shows the balance and spending of an arckep.ru account.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 网页界面插件，用于展示 arckep.ru 账户的余额与支出。

description.en: Read-only DSH viewer that shows task progress across workspaces with overview, per-region details, and anomaly/todo scans.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 跨工作区任务进度查看器，提供全区概览、跨区进度详情以及异常与待办扫描。

description.en: A plugin about Argentina country.
A plugin whose description is simply 'Argon element', with no additional functionality described.
Node plugin for computing arithmetic series, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 用于计算等差数列的 Node 插件，无网络依赖。

description.en: DSH plugin that generates images from text prompts using Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao), with zero dependencies and no build step.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，基于火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）实现文生图，零依赖、无需构建。

description.en: Quota monitoring plugin for Volcengine Ark coding plans with a side widget and settings page.
description.zh: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan / Agent Plan quota plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: side float widget + settings page, persistent credentials, periodic auto-refresh, ark_coding_plan_usage model t

description.en: Connects DSH agents to the ArkStronghold web game server with tools to start, view, act in, look up and finish matches.
description.zh: 让DSH Agent接入ArkStronghold网页对局服务器，提供开局、查看局面、行动、查询与结束对局的工具。

description.en: Provides information about the country of Armenia.
A plugin without README, described only as 'arsenic element' in Chinese.
description.zh: dsh.so 插件，无 README，仅标注为砷元素，未说明具体功能。

description.en: Lists and retrieves art terminology entries from a local knowledge base.
Backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab that serves the artifact index JSON and the raw artifact bytes.
description.zh: 为 dsh-artifacts 侧边栏标签提供后端，负责输出制品索引 JSON 与制品原始字节。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to artifact cards and file links so you can copy files, copy paths, open the containing folder or open with the default app.
description.zh: 为产物卡片和正文文件链接添加右键菜单，可复制文件、复制路径、打开所在文件夹或用默认程序打开。

description.en: arXiv research-inspiration plugin with KB-filtered surveys, a paper library and deep-read notes for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 arXiv 科研灵感插件，包含知识库过滤综述、论文库和精读笔记。

description.en: Searches arXiv for machine learning papers and retrieves full metadata/abstracts to verify claims against published literature.
description.zh: 搜索 arXiv 上的机器学习论文，获取完整元数据和摘要，用于对照已发表文献核实论断。

description.en: Exposes DSH as an MCP server with streaming thinking/tool/file notifications, shared intent, a write-denying floor lock, mid-turn alerts, and review delegation.
description.zh: 将 DSH 暴露为 MCP 服务器，提供流式思考/工具/文件通知、共享意图、禁止写入的楼层锁、回合中提醒注入和评审委派。

description.en: Bridges Asa's self-learning research agent into DeepSeek Harness via MCP tools for research, messaging, status checks, and diagnostics.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 工具将 Asa 自学习研究智能体桥接到 DeepSeek Harness，支持研究、消息、状态检查和诊断。

description.en: ASCII conversion utility, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的 ASCII 转换工具，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Live ASCII character-video wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness, with a bundled default clip and a Settings page for your own videos.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时 ASCII 字符视频壁纸，内置默认视频并支持在设置页上传自己的片段。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的旁问卡片：问你不会的专业术语，答案不进主对话
Auto-answers unanswered ask_user_question prompts after a configurable deadline, prioritizing the recommended option, and plays a sound on new questions.
description.zh: 在可配置的截止时间后自动回答未处理的 ask_user_question（优先推荐选项），并在出现新问题时播放提示音。

description.en: Injects ask-first prompt discipline, change reminders and a hard gate so the agent asks before deciding or making irreversible changes.
description.zh: 通过提示词纪律、连续变更提醒和不可逆操作硬闸，让 Agent 在替用户做决定前先提问。

description.en: Adds a sidebar assistant that answers questions about selected text using current conversation context.
description.zh: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text using the current DeepSeek Harness conversation context, without touching the main conversation.

description.en: Provides structured methods for upward communication with leaders, based on parameters.
Shows a bottom-right reminder card, desktop notification, and flashing tab title when the agent is blocked waiting for your answer.
description.zh: 当智能体等待你回答而被阻塞时，显示右下角提醒卡片、桌面通知并闪烁标签页标题。

description.en: Generates self-contained prompts to hand hard coding tasks to strong external models without polluting the main DSH context.
description.zh: 生成自包含提示词，把难搞的编程任务交给外部强模型，且不污染主对话上下文。

description.en: Right-click any selected text in the dsh Web UI to ask the model about it or request an edit, in chat answers or document previews.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 中右键任意选中文本，即可向模型提问或请求改写，支持聊天回答与侧边栏文档预览。

description.en: DSH client plugin whose /ask command writes a five-section blank template straight into the chat input draft with zero model calls.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件，/ask 命令把五段结构化空白模板直接写入输入框草稿，全程零模型调用。

description.en: DSH host plugin that files a notify-hub to-do and pushes Feishu/webhook/email alerts when ask_user_question goes unanswered past a threshold (default 60 min).
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：当 ask_user_question 超过阈值（默认 60 分钟）无人回答时，向 notify-hub 投递待办，并通过飞书/webhook/email 推送提醒。

description.en: Aspect ratio calculator for image/video dimensions, pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 在 Node 环境中计算图像或视频的宽高比，根据宽高比推算尺寸。

description.en: Asset allocation tool that returns household financial planning solutions based on parameters.
DSH plugin that saves and auto-collects session content into a local Markdown asset library organized by time, type, session and project.
description.zh: DSH 插件：将会话内容一键保存并自动采集，按时间/类型/会话/项目四轴归纳为本地 Markdown 素材库。

description.en: Asset allocation tool that precisely calculates splits from parameters and returns detailed results; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 按参数精确计算资产分配比例并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Adds a usage panel to the chat header showing provider balance, balance trends, token cost estimates and configurable system notifications.
description.zh: 在会话头部显示供应商余额、余额趋势与 Token 成本估算，并提供可配置的系统提醒。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin whose description only references the chemical element astatine.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，描述仅提及化学元素砹，未说明任何具体功能。

description.en: Provides astronomy terminology entries with list and detail lookup tools.
Adds a row of category tabs to the top of the @ mention menu so you can filter candidates by files, sub-agents, conversations or plugins.
description.zh: 在 @ 引用菜单顶部加一排类别标签，点击即可只显示文件、子智能体、会话或插件等某一类候选。

description.en: @-mention picker for installed DSH plugins with system/user groups, plus folder-based session grouping and collapsible headers.
description.zh: 通过 @ 提及选择已安装的 DSH 插件（系统/用户分组），并按文件夹归类会话、分组标题可折叠。

description.en: Enhances the native sidebar file tree with @file reference buttons, size/modified-time columns, sorting, and workspace search.
description.zh: 为原生侧边栏文件树补充 @文件 引用按钮、大小/修改时间列、排序与全工作区搜索。

description.en: Atbash cipher implemented in pure Node.js without network dependencies.
description.zh: 用纯 Node.js 实现 Atbash 密码的加密与解密，不依赖网络

description.en: Adds theme-aware click effects like gold ripples and stars to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加跟随主题的点击特效，如金色涟漪和星光。

description.en: Local-first DeepSeek Harness workbench for compact usage/cost metrics, a prompt library, activity text, and opt-in request auditing.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DeepSeek Harness 工作台，提供紧凑的用量/成本指标、提示词库、活动文本和可选请求审计。

description.en: Adds a toolbar picture button to DSH Web composer for picking images via OS file dialog, no drag-and-drop.
description.zh: 为DSH Web编辑器添加工具栏图片按钮，通过系统文件对话框选择图片，无需拖放。

description.en: Browse, prune and relocate the durable attachment store that DeepSeek Harness keeps under ~/.dsh/attachments.
description.zh: 浏览、清理并迁移 DeepSeek Harness 存放在 ~/.dsh/attachments 下的持久附件存储。

description.en: DSH panel that indexes sent attachments, @-referenced local paths and Taildrop transfers by device and time, and can send files directly.
description.zh: DSH 投送面板：按设备与时间汇总已发送附件、@ 引用路径和 Taildrop 收发记录，并可在面板内直接发送文件。

description.en: Desktop attention alerts for DeepSeek Harness Web using tab title, favicon, sound, and native OS notifications.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供桌面提醒，通过标签页标题、图标、声音和系统原生通知提示。

description.en: Windows-only DSH watchdog that beeps or speaks when tasks finish or commands hang, kills stuck pwsh calls, and blocks bad patterns.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 的 DSH 看门狗：任务结束或命令卡死时鸣叫/人声提醒，自动中断卡住的 pwsh 调用，并在 spawn 前拦截已知性能陷阱写法。

description.en: Collects pending items from every DSH session and workspace — approvals, questions, plan reviews, blocked goals — into one attention queue.
description.zh: 把所有 DSH 会话与工作区中的待处理事项（审批、问题、计划审阅、受阻目标等）汇总到一个注意力收件箱队列。

description.en: Shows native browser notifications for DSH events needing user attention, such as approvals, questions, and job status.
description.zh: 为需要用户关注的 DSH 事件显示浏览器原生通知，包括审批、提问和任务状态。

description.en: Sends native desktop notifications when a tool approval or user question is waiting, and clicking the alert jumps back to the terminal.
description.zh: 当工具审批或用户提问等待处理时发送系统桌面通知，点击通知即可跳回终端。

description.en: Plays a chime, raises the window and shows a floating card when DeepSeek Harness needs approval or confirmation, with independent sound and popup toggles.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 需要审批或确认时，播放提示音、提升窗口并浮出卡片，声音与弹窗开关相互独立。

description.en: Routes agent messages into alert, decide, and inform tiers so DeepSeek Harness agents stop over-notifying.
description.zh: 将代理消息按 alert、decide、inform 分级路由，避免 DeepSeek Harness 代理过度通知。

description.en: A DSH skill defining attention-scheduling and memory-retrieval rules to curb context hallucination via retrieval triggers, injection budgets and write-back whitelists.
description.zh: 一套 DSH 技能，用检索触发、注入预算与写回白名单等规则调度注意力与记忆检索，减轻上下文幻觉。

description.en: Provides tamper-evident, hash-chained and ed25519-signed chain-of-custody records of what a DSH agent did, with git commits bound into the chain.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供防篡改的哈希链与 ed25519 签名存证记录，追踪智能体实际操作并将提交绑定入链。

description.en: Offline DSSE/in-toto attestation proof for DeepSeek Harness, verifying manifest and emitting JSON verdict.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线的内容寻址 DSSE/in-toto 证明，校验清单并输出 JSON 裁定结果。

description.en: Linux audio alert plugin for DSH that plays synthesized sounds on the host machine when a turn ends, errors, or needs approval.
description.zh: 适用于 Linux 的 DSH 提示音插件，在回合结束、出错或等待审批/回答时通过宿主机的音箱播放合成提示音。

description.en: Audio bitrate tool that calculates precisely from parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算音频比特率并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: DSH host plugin that plays a sound cue when an approval is requested and when a conversation turn ends, with no external dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：在审批询问时与一轮对话结束时播放声音提示，零外部依赖。

description.en: Adds macOS native speech-to-text input to the DSH web composer using Apple's Speech framework.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页输入框添加 macOS 原生语音转文字输入，基于 Apple Speech 框架，通过远程辅助程序实现。

description.en: Draggable 48-band spectrum chip plus frame-wide bass glow that visualizes system audio inside dsh web and DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 可拖动的 48 段频谱芯片与全窗口低频辉光，在 dsh web 和 DSH Desktop 中可视化系统音频。

description.en: Audit console for DSH plugins: pre-install static audit with S–D grading plus a runtime monitor of sensitive plugin operations.
description.zh: DSH 插件审计控制台：安装前静态审计并给出 S–D 评级，运行时监控插件的敏感操作。

description.en: Runtime audit log for DeepSeek Harness tracking data mutations with per-plugin and per-fiber attribution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 记录运行时数据变更的审计日志，按插件与纤程归属，标明谁以何种顺序改动了哪些数据。

description.en: Localizes DSH plugin titles/descriptions into Chinese via locale files and audits installed plugins and skills for versions, updates and conflicts.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件英文标题与说明精炼成中文并写入 locale，同时一页审查已装插件与技能的版本、更新与冲突。

description.en: Turns the DSH reasoning-effort row into a draggable aurora starfield slider with particle warp and MAX charging glow.
description.zh: 把 DSH 推理等级一栏换成可拖动的极光星河滑轨，带粒子曲速与 MAX 蓄能光环。

description.en: Plugin about Australia as a country.
description.zh: 关于澳大利亚这个国家的插件

description.en: A plugin about Austria (Austrian country) with minimal description and no detailed capabilities listed.
Automatically prunes the accumulated dsh-auth-* cookies in the DSH desktop app so oversized request headers no longer break web authentication at startup.
description.zh: 自动清理 DSH 桌面版累积的 dsh-auth-* 认证 Cookie，避免请求头超限导致 Web 认证失败、启动失败。

description.en: Expires stale dsh-auth-* cookies left behind by stopped hosts, preventing cookie pile-up and HTTP 431 errors on random localhost ports.
description.zh: 为已停止主机的 dsh-auth-* Cookie 下发过期头，避免随机本地端口下 Cookie 堆积与 HTTP 431 错误。

description.en: Adds password protection to DeepSeek Harness Web before exposing it to LAN, remote devices, reverse proxies, or shared environments.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加密码保护，适用于将其开放到局域网、远程设备、反向代理或共享环境之前。

description.en: Interception and audit frame for DeepSeek Harness with a tiered approval ladder, hash-chained audit trail and result redaction.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供拦截与审计框架，包含分级审批、哈希链审计和结果脱敏。

description.en: Auto-approval plugin for DeepSeek Harness that intercepts approval requests and applies configurable allow/deny policies with audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的自动批准插件，拦截审批请求并按允许/拒绝策略自动回复，附审计日志。

description.en: Adds a dedicated reviewer model to DeepSeek Harness auto-review, with Qwen3Guard safety checks.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 自动审核提供独立评审模型，并支持 Qwen3Guard 安全检测。

description.en: Adds sidebar file gestures to the DSH Web GUI: left-click preview, Ctrl+click open in default app, right-click menu for open/save-as/copy/reveal.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 侧边栏文件添加手势操作：左键预览、Ctrl+左键用系统默认应用打开、右键菜单支持打开/另存为/复制/定位。

description.en: Auto-resumes DSH turns that ended on a 429 rate limit, exhausted quota, empty response, or custom error codes.
description.zh: 自动恢复因 429 限流、配额耗尽、空响应或自定义错误码而中断的 DSH 回合。

description.en: Automatically repairs corrupted session logs and resumes interrupted tasks after restart, with web UI and system notifications.
DSH Web plugin that auto-expands collapsed thinking blocks in chat so the model's reasoning and task progress stay visible.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，自动展开聊天中折叠的「思考」块，让模型的推理过程和任务进度始终可见。

description.en: DSH profile bundle that git-inits every newly registered workspace with one empty commit, giving git-aware plugins a repo to attach to.
description.zh: DSH 配置包：为每个新注册的工作区执行 git init 并创建一次空提交，让依赖 git 的插件有仓库可用。

description.en: Auto-accepts approval prompts in DeepSeek Harness with a persistent composer status chip.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中自动通过审批提示，并在输入框显示常驻状态标签。

description.en: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the DSH Web UI that auto-approves only actions passing a single-shot model review, otherwise deferring to the normal approval chain.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加“自动审批”权限预设：仅自动批准通过单次模型审查的操作，未通过则交回常规审批流程。

description.en: Keeps the DSH Auto approval preset across restarts, preventing it from being rewritten to full permissions when the app exits.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的“自动审批”权限预设跨重启保留，避免应用退出时被改写为完全权限。

description.en: Turns a plain-language idea into a professional image/video prompt and, with the generation switch on, calls your own model or API to produce the actual file.
description.zh: 把人话描述改写成专业图片/视频提示词，打开生成开关后调用你自己配置的模型或 API 直接产出图片或视频文件。

description.en: Auto-detects the system proxy and gives independent on/off switches for search, LLM and web traffic in DSH.
description.zh: 自动识别系统代理，并在 DSH 中为搜索、LLM 和网页三类流量提供独立开关。

description.en: Forces every new DeepSeek Harness session to start in the built-in Auto review permission preset instead of the configured default.
description.zh: 让每个新建的 DeepSeek Harness 会话都使用内置的自动审查权限预设，而非所配置的默认预设。

description.en: Makes the shipped Auto review permission preset the default for new DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 将内置的自动审查权限预设设为 DeepSeek Harness 新会话的默认选项。

description.en: DSH plugin that routes @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review requests to a model you specify.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review 的请求路由到用户指定的模型。

description.en: Classifies each turn and automatically switches DeepSeek Harness provider, model and reasoning effort, showing the tier in the composer.
description.zh: 对每轮对话进行分类，自动切换 DeepSeek Harness 的提供商、模型与推理强度，并在输入框显示当前档位。

description.en: Adds a per-session toggle in the DSH title bar that shuts down the computer after all running turns, jobs, subagents and scheduled tasks finish.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话在标题栏添加开关：所有会话的对话、后台任务、子代理与定时任务全部跑完后倒计时自动关机。

description.en: Automatically condenses each session into a title of up to 12 characters, stops after manual renaming, and allows one-click re-titling from the sidebar menu.
description.zh: 自动将会话标题提炼为最多12个字，用户手动改名后自动停手，侧栏菜单可一键重新提炼。

description.en: On-demand translation for the DSH Web GUI: hover a block or drag-select text to translate in place, locally, with zero LLM tokens.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的按需翻译插件：悬停区块或框选文本即可就地翻译，本地运行、零 token。

description.en: Scans, stages, and switches DSH plugin upgrades with a reversible two-rename rollback.
description.zh: 扫描、暂存并切换 DSH 插件升级，支持可逆的双重命名回滚。

description.en: Persistent, concurrent node-graph workflows for DeepSeek Harness, with a GitHub-project local development example.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可持久化、并发执行的节点图工作流，并附带 GitHub 项目本地开发示例。

description.en: Gives project-less DSH chats their own local working directory while preserving the harness's native new-chat screen.
description.zh: 为无项目的 DSH 新会话自动分配独立的本地工作目录，同时保留原生新建会话界面。

description.en: Automatically continues DeepSeek Harness sessions, retries with backoff, revives goals, and recovers after restarts.
description.zh: 自动延续 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持退避重试、目标恢复和重启恢复。

description.en: Root-level automation center for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled tasks, fresh Result Sessions, and cross-workspace run history.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的根级自动化中心，支持定时任务、创建新的结果会话以及跨工作区运行历史。

description.en: Event-driven automations for DSH: run commands, HTTP requests or log entries on boot, session start/idle/end, messages, tool results and schedules.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供事件驱动的自动化：在启动、会话开始/空闲/结束、消息、工具结果及定时触发时执行命令、HTTP 请求或写日志。

description.en: Lets the agent restart the harness itself: countdown, whole-machine idle check, then automatically wakes the original session.
description.zh: 让 agent 自己发起重启：倒计时、确认整机空闲后重启，并自动唤醒原会话。

description.en: dsh-autopilot
Shows your DeepSeek account balance beside the sidebar account avatar, with an amber/green threshold indicator that refreshes when a task finishes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账户头像旁显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，用琥珀色/绿色标记和可调阈值提示，并在任务完成后自动刷新。

description.en: Adds per-side avatars with left/right chat bubbles plus adjustable fonts, sizes, line height and text colour for the DSH interface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话双方各配头像、消息左右分列，并可更换界面与代码字体、字号、行距、加粗和字色。

description.en: Adds a character avatar and editable ID beside each reply, with TTS playback, voice/tone/speed controls, and one-click local voice service launch.
description.zh: 在每轮回复左侧显示角色头像与可编辑 ID，并支持系统或本地 TTS 朗读、语气语速与播放控制，一键启动语音服务。

description.en: Computes average values via a pure Node.js plugin with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 通过纯 Node.js 插件计算平均值，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds a Model Capabilities settings page to DeepSeek Harness for graphically editing each model's modalities, context window, output limits and image quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板新增「模型能力」页面，用图形界面编辑各模型的输入模态、上下文窗口、输出上限和图像配额。

description.en: Bundles 25 AWS skills with an AWS MCP Server connection, giving DSH agents ready-made AWS cloud capabilities.
description.zh: 打包25个AWS技能并接入AWS MCP服务器，为DSH智能体提供开箱即用的AWS云能力。

description.en: A plugin providing information about the country of Azerbaijan.
Azure Maid is a DSH Web GUI theme skin with blue-and-lace palettes, 90 semantic tokens, and light/dark/system modes.
description.zh: 蓝瓷女仆是一款 DSH Web GUI 主题皮肤，采用深蓝与蕾丝冷白配色，覆盖 90 个语义 token，支持亮色、暗色与跟随系统三种模式。

description.en: Returns baby clothing size recommendations based on input parameters; pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回婴儿衣物尺码推荐，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Provides clear advice for baby fever based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数为宝宝发烧提供清晰的应对建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Estimates baby milk intake based on parameters, returning detailed results (estimate, not medical advice). Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数估算宝宝奶量并返回详细结果，仅为估算而非医疗建议，纯 Node 实现无需联网

description.en: Tool that returns baby weight standard suggestions based on input parameters.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回婴儿体重标准建议的工具

description.en: Provides parameter-based back care advice in a Node.js plugin, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: Node.js 插件，根据传入参数给出腰背护理建议，运行时不需要联网。

description.en: Adds a '← Back to current chat' button on the Plugins, Schedules and Context Insights pages, restoring the conversation and keeping your input draft.
description.zh: 在插件管理、自动化任务和上下文洞察页面添加「← 返回当前会话」按钮，点击即可回到会话并保留输入草稿。

description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness Web background with local wallpapers (single image or folder rotation) and adds adjustable transparency, blur, and effects.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 更换本地壁纸（单图/文件夹轮播），支持透明度、模糊、遮罩等特效。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you replace the plain background with your own local image, with live blur, mask, and opacity controls that auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可用本地图片替换纯色背景，支持实时调整模糊、遮罩与界面不透明度并自动保存。

description.en: Automatically summarizes conversation context before the threshold and swaps the compacted summary in on the next turn.
description.zh: 在达到阈值前自动总结对话上下文，并在下一轮替换为压缩摘要。

description.en: Gives DSH agents a persistent interactive PTY shell that survives across tool calls and model turns, with incremental reads and interrupts.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供一个可跨工具调用、跨回合续用的持久交互式 PTY shell，支持增量读取与中断。

description.en: Read-only host diagnostics with log tailing, service reachability checks and crash attribution, plus a key-gated session channel that is closed by default.
description.zh: 只读主机诊断插件：日志跟踪、服务可达性检查、崩溃归因，并提供默认关闭、需密钥解锁的会话通道。

description.en: Floating button to backup DSH data (localStorage, session config) to GitHub Gist.
description.zh: 悬浮按钮，将 DSH 数据（localStorage 和会话配置）一键备份到 GitHub Gist。

description.en: Backs up and restores your DeepSeek Harness plugin environment through a GitHub git repo, syncing manifests, configs and local plugins.
description.zh: 通过 GitHub 上的 Git 仓库备份与恢复 DeepSeek Harness 插件环境，同步清单、配置与本地插件。

description.en: Computes backup strategies based on parameters and returns clear recommendations.
description.zh: 根据参数计算备份策略并返回明确建议。

description.en: Whole-$DSH_HOME backup and restore for DeepSeek Harness, with scheduled archives, a settings page, agent tools and a standalone restorer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供整个 $DSH_HOME 的备份与恢复，支持定时归档、设置页面、智能体工具和独立恢复器。

description.en: Backup capacity planning tool that calculates storage requirements from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 备份容量规划工具，根据参数计算存储需求并返回详细结果。

description.en: Adds a ChatGPT-style badge to the DSH taskbar button showing unread completion counts and attention dots for questions or permission prompts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务栏按钮上添加 ChatGPT 风格徽标，显示未读完成数量和提问/权限提示的注意力圆点。

description.en: Plugin described as 'Bahamas country' (Chinese), with no further details available.
Provides information about Bahrain (巴林国) as a Node-based plugin with no network dependencies.
Baidu cloud OCR plugin: drag images/PDFs, OCR to Markdown, and write to local files.
description.zh: 百度云 OCR 插件：拖入图片或 PDF，用 PaddleOCR-VL 或 Unlimited-OCR 识别为 Markdown 并写入本地文件。

description.en: Selects baijiu (Chinese liquor) based on parameters and returns clear recommendations.
Browse every Bailian (DashScope) model your API key can reach, add or remove models in the provider route, and check session context quota.
description.zh: 浏览 API Key 可访问的全部百炼（DashScope）模型，在供应商路由中增删模型，并查看当前会话的上下文配额。

description.en: Shows Alibaba Cloud Bailian (Model Studio) coupon balance in the DSH sidebar with a detail panel, auto-refresh and per-session spend tracking.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏常驻显示阿里云百炼代金券剩余余额，提供详情面板、自动刷新与本会话消耗统计。

description.en: Selects fishing bait and returns a practical fishing plan based on input parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数选择鱼饵并返回实用的钓鱼方案，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Troubleshoots baking failures and returns practical baking operation plans based on the provided parameters.
A dsh plugin with no available description.
description.zh: 名为 dsh-balance 的 dsh 插件，目前没有可用的功能描述。

description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a /balance command so you can check your DeepSeek account balance inside a session.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，通过 /balance 命令在会话中查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Shows a persistent DeepSeek API balance badge next to Settings in the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏「设置」旁常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额徽章。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows live DeepSeek account balance and token usage in a chat-window badge, with in-UI credential setup and auto-refresh.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在聊天窗口右上角徽章实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与 token 用量，支持界面内配置凭据与自动刷新。

description.en: Shows a persistent DeepSeek account balance badge in the bottom-right corner of the DSH main UI, auto-refreshing every 60 seconds.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主界面右下角常驻显示账户余额角标，每 60 秒自动刷新。

description.en: Floating ball overlay for DeepSeek Harness that shows signed-in account balance, live pricing, today's price curve and token-consumption estimates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮球插件，显示已登录账号余额、实时价格、当日价格曲线和 token 消耗估算。

description.en: A floating, draggable bubble showing DeepSeek account balance with low-balance alerts, dark-mode ready.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面悬浮显示 DeepSeek 账户余额的可拖动气泡，支持低余额提醒与深色模式。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API balance in the DSH sidebar footer with a live status dot and 60s refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额，带状态圆点与金额，每 60 秒刷新，API 密钥保存在本地凭据库

description.en: Displays real-time DeepSeek account balance in the Harness Web GUI and alerts you when the balance runs low.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web GUI 中实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在余额偏低时发出提醒。

description.en: Minimal sidebar widget showing DeepSeek account balance, today's spend, and peak/off-peak pricing status in two lines.
description.zh: 极简侧边栏插件，两行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、今日消费与峰谷时段状态。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows your DeepSeek account model balance in the web UI, with status indicators.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在网页界面实时展示 DeepSeek 账户的模型余额，并显示状态指示。

description.en: Adds an always-visible DeepSeek balance bar to the DSH Web client with low-balance reminders when credit runs low.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端添加常驻的 DeepSeek 余额条，并在余额不足时发出提醒。

description.en: Adds a compact DSH sidebar widget showing DeepSeek API balance, usage, and a peak/off-peak pricing countdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加简洁小组件，显示 DeepSeek 余额、用量以及峰谷时段倒计时。

description.en: Appends a DeepSeek account balance readout to the DSH web status bar, with a click-to-open usage details panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面底部状态行追加 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击可弹出用量详情面板。

description.en: Adds a persistent capsule to the DSH session tab bar showing balance, today's estimated spend, and peak/off-peak pricing status.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话页标签行右侧常驻一枚胶囊，显示余额、今日估算已用金额以及峰谷时段状态。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and peak/off-peak phase in the sidebar and estimates per-session and per-turn usage cost from local logs.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与峰谷时段，并依据本地日志估算每个会话与每一轮的花费。

description.en: Composer-dock widget showing provider-following balance, cumulative session cost with per-model breakdown, and a 90-day usage heatmap.
description.zh: 输入框停靠栏小部件，显示跟随所选提供商的余额、含各模型明细的会话累计花费，以及90天用量热力图。

description.en: Shows current DeepSeek API key account balance in a persistent, auto-refreshing panel.
description.zh: 在常驻面板中显示当前 DeepSeek API 密钥账户的余额，并自动刷新。

description.en: Displays your DeepSeek account balance and current peak/off-peak pricing status as a whale in the DSH sidebar footer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部以鲸鱼形式显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和峰谷计费状态。

description.en: A DSH Web widget showing live wallet balance, real token usage and per-turn costs, with sound alerts and EN/Simplified Chinese UI.

description.en: Floating widget displaying DeepSeek account balance in the Web GUI with live polling and drag support.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面悬浮显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，实时轮询刷新、可拖动，密钥保留在服务端。

description.en: Draggable floating window for dsh showing live DeepSeek API balance and estimated token usage with auto-refresh.
description.zh: 在 dsh 左下角显示可拖动的悬浮窗，实时展示 DeepSeek 官方 API 余额与预计剩余 token，并自动刷新。

description.zh: DSH 的逐条上下文窗口归因面板，查看每条消息占用窗口的情况。

description.en: Crash protection plugin for DeepSeek Harness that makes plugin faults visible, attributable, and recoverable via inspection, isolation, and telemetry.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的崩溃保护插件，通过检查、隔离和遥测让插件故障变得可见、可归因并可恢复。

description.en: Bandwidth requirement estimation tool that calculates based on parameters and returns detailed results.

description.zh: 一个 Node.js 插件，用于返回曼谷市的静态信息。

description.zh: 导入 CAMT.053 和 MT940 格式的银行对账单，完成交易核对，并生成三表工作底稿。

description.en: A pure Node tool that returns dough food steaming plans based on input parameters, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 工具，根据输入参数返回面食蒸制计划，无网络依赖。

description.zh: 注册一个「裸模模式」智能体预设：空系统提示词、零工具、零运行时上下文，同时剪掉宿主强加的开销。

Plugin that provides clear barking-correction suggestions based on input parameters, pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数给出吠叫纠正建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Base conversion tool implemented in pure Node.js, no network or external services.

description.zh: 用纯 Node.js 实现的 Base62 编码工具，不依赖网络。

description.en: Base64 encoding/decoding tool implemented in pure Node.js with no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的 Base64 编解码工具，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.zh: 在文件与 base64 或 data URL 之间相互转换。

description.en: Base64URL encoder/decoder utility for encoding and decoding data.
description.zh: 提供 Base64URL 编码与解码功能，用于在数据与 Base64URL 字符串之间相互转换。

description.en: Calculates baseboard (踢脚线) usage from user parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据用户参数计算踢脚线用量并返回详细结果。

description.en: Fail-closed DSH security baseline: policy-gated network egress, subagent permission ceilings, and a tamper-evident hash-chained audit log.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的失败关闭式安全基线：策略化网络出口管控、子代理权限上限，以及防篡改的哈希链审计日志。

description.en: Adds workspace-aware BaseMind MCP code-intelligence tools to every DSH session with no MCP configuration.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话自动接入 BaseMind MCP 代码智能工具，按工作区提供仓库能力且无需配置 MCP。

description.en: Publishes an ops_bash tool that runs shell commands through a resolved bash binary with host sandbox, output spill and job semantics.
description.zh: 发布 ops_bash 工具，通过解析出的 bash 执行命令，支持宿主沙箱、输出落盘与作业语义。

Runs a command N times and uses median/distribution for reliable regression conclusions.
description.zh: 将同一条命令重复运行 N 次，按中位数或分布判定结果，用于批量回归统计。

description.en: Adds a batch_review tool plus a panel above the input box so agents can collect many of the user's approvals in one pass.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 batch_review 工具，并在输入框上方弹出面板，一次性收集 agent 的多条批复。

description.en: Rule-based prefilter triages every ticket and sends anything it cannot classify to needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 基于规则的预过滤器会分拣每张工单，无法分类的工单会进入 needs_review，而不是猜测处理。

description.en: Provides aging-friendly bathroom renovation suggestions as a pure Node plugin with no network dependency.
description.zh: 以纯 Node 插件形式提供适老化卫生间改造建议，无网络依赖

description.en: Calculates battery lifespan based on parameters and returns clear recommendations. Pure Node.js, no network dependencies.

description.en: Computes battery health from parameters and returns clear recommendations, pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数计算电池健康度并给出明确的处理建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Battery life estimation tool that calculates precise results from parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算电池续航时间，纯 Node 实现，无需联网。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bazaar that discovers plugins on GitHub and installs official ones.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件集市，支持从 GitHub 发现插件并安装官方插件。

description.en: Converts barrels to liters (桶转升), a simple unit conversion plugin.
description.zh: 将桶（barrel）换算为升（liter）的单位转换插件。

description.en: Pure Node password hashing plugin providing PBKDF2/scrypt tools, no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 密码哈希插件，提供 PBKDF2 与 scrypt 工具，无需网络或外部服务。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel to the DeepSeek Harness for browsing, creating, claiming and closing beads from a local list.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加 Beads 面板，可在列表中浏览、创建、领取和关闭 beads。

description.en: A Beads issue viewer that shows Beads issues in the DSH right sidebar, the browser counterpart of the terminal bv viewer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏中查看 Beads 议题的浏览器端查看器，对应终端的 bv 查看器。

description.en: Selects bean choices by returning clear recommendations based on input parameters, pure Node without network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回明确的选豆建议，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: A beautification plugin for DeepSeek Harness that customizes fonts, colors, backgrounds, and per-element styles in real time.
description.zh: 为DeepseekHarness类DevTools提供实时美化，可自定义字体、颜色、背景和逐元素样式。

description.en: Provides bedtime ritual suggestions based on input parameters; a pure Node tool with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数提供睡前仪式建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A beer selection tool that returns clear recommendations based on parameters, implemented in pure Node without network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回明确的啤酒推荐，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.zh: 根据参数计算最佳发布时间并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Renders inline charts, cards, and interactive answers in DeepSeek Harness, with saved state and revision history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中内联渲染图表、卡片和交互式回答，并支持状态保存与修订历史。

description.en: Caches @ file/session references for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI to avoid per-keystroke round trips.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面的 @ 引用菜单缓存文件与会话引用，避免每次按键都往返服务器查询。

description.en: Turns anti-stuck rules into a code gate that detects repeated edits, repeated errors and unverified changes, then injects a reminder.
description.zh: 把防卡死规则变成代码闸门：检测同一文件反复修改、同一报错反复出现、改完不验证，并注入提醒。

description.en: Renders sent user messages as Markdown and adds a live syntax-highlighted preview inside the composer.
description.zh: 将已发送的用户消息渲染为 Markdown，并在输入框中提供实时语法高亮预览。

description.en: DSH plugin that updates the model selection list in real time from provider APIs and shows usage badges for supported providers.
description.zh: DSH插件：根据Provider API实时更新模型列表，并显示各服务商的用量徽标。

description.en: Adds per-model reasoning-effort options and a context-length switcher to the DSH model selector, aligned with the official pi-ai catalog.
description.zh: 为 DSH 模型选择器增加按模型配置推理强度和上下文长度切换功能，与官方 pi-ai 目录对齐。

description.zh: 取代官方模型设置页，提供提供商管理、逐模型推理强度、重试覆盖、拖拽排序、DeepSeek官方添加及凭据状态。

description.en: Native macOS notification banners for DeepSeek Harness events like finished turns, pending approvals, questions, background jobs, subagents and workflows; click to open the session.

description.zh: 为 DSH 添加背景图设置：上传图片，可调布局裁剪、不透明度、模糊、暗化，并让界面半透明透出壁纸。

description.en: DSH web background skin plugin: replaces white background with a local image, centered and fixed, keeping AI cards opaque.
description.zh: DSH web 背景皮肤插件，用本地图片替换界面白色背景，图片半屏居中固定，AI 输出卡片保持不透明

description.en: DSH web mini-game plugin bundling Texas Hold'em, Blackjack, Gomoku and UNO, playable against the computer or configured models.
description.zh: DSH Web 小游戏插件，包含德州扑克、21 点、五子棋和 UNO，可与电脑或已配置的模型对战。

description.zh: 一个根据其描述所示关于不丹国的插件。

description.zh: 依据版本化规则包预检投标符合性响应台账与招标要求的差异,仅提示差异,不作定性结论。

description.en: Checks a bidder qualification condition register row by row, flagging missing requirements, evidence, verdicts and other gaps without judging outcomes.
description.zh: 逐条核对投标人资格条件核对表,仅提示缺失的要求、证明材料、结论等差异,不作出定性结论。

description.zh: 基于输入参数生成家庭节日准备与大扫除计划，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.zh: 定时用最小请求探测 DeepSeek 官方模型的系统指纹，一旦变化就弹出随机表情包。

description.zh: 一款大额

description.zh: 为 DSH 桌宠添加视线跟随：带透视的 3D 转头、视差位移和闲置时的东张西望，独立插件不改动本体。

description.en: Shows real-time remaining Zhipu GLM CodingPlan usage, including 5-hour and weekly quotas, in the chat input area.
description.zh: 在对话输入区实时显示智谱 GLM CodingPlan 的 5 小时与每周剩余用量。

description.zh: 根据输入参数生成骑行锻炼计划，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.zh: 自行车 fitting 工具，根据输入参数生成骑行训练计划，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Cycling gear tool that generates exercise plans from input parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成骑行训练计划，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.zh: 一个由 agent 驱动的视频工坊：自动构思并写分镜、配音与逐帧渲染、代码自审，最后把成片投稿到 B 站。

description.zh: 将B站直播间和视频流设为 DSH Web GUI 的动态壁纸，支持扫码登录、画质选择与模糊/蒙层调节。

description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加 Niri 风格水平滚动的 B 站直播多窗口页面，支持上下分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避。

description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用中，将助手回复以双语逐段对照的形式展示，方便阅读。

description.zh: 在输入框上方显示峰谷计费条与账户余额，并按模型统计今日、7 天与 30 天的花费。

description.en: DSH agent-loop engine providing a host-LLM adapter and loop skeleton over host context, framed as a capability rather than codex style.
description.zh: DSH 智能体循环引擎，提供宿主 LLM 适配器和基于宿主上下文的循环骨架，定位为能力而非 codex 风格。

description.en: Adds editable quick-action buttons to the DSH composer to send 「继续」 or saved text, resend your last message, and hide/restore presets.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加可编辑快捷按钮，可发送「继续」或自定义文本、重发上一条消息，并隐藏/恢复预设。

description.en: Private local-first Markdown memory library for DSH: three-layer memory plus an on-demand workshop that only reads and writes when you ask.
description.zh: 不忘是为 DSH 打造的私人记忆库：三层记忆加按需加载的工坊，只在你开口时才写、才读，纯本机 Markdown 不联网。

description.en: Zero-dependency rule injector for DeepSeek Harness that publishes three-scope rules as system reminders, with dedupe, loop-breaking and session persistence.
description.zh: 零依赖的 DeepSeek Harness 规则注入器，将三层级规则以系统提醒发布，支持去重、防循环与会话持久化。

description.en: Moves the DSH temp cache to a configurable directory and cleans it with an allowlist while managing archived sessions and workspace temp folders.
description.zh: 将 DSH 临时缓存迁移到可配置目录，并按允许列表清理，同时管理归档会话与工作区临时文件夹。

description.en: Intercepts automatic context rewrites, prices the cold re-read in k tokens, and asks for confirmation before applying.
description.zh: 在自动上下文重写生效前估算冷重读的 k token 成本，并先询问确认。

description.en: DSH sidebar cache monitor for the current conversation, with per-request cache and token details.
Test page that measures prompt-cache hit rate and streaming speed for a DSH channel.
description.zh: 用于测试 DSH 通道提示缓存命中率与流式速度的测试页面。

description.en: Reports prompt-cache hit rate and tool-block token cost for DSH, showing what consumed your cache — zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH 生成提示缓存命中率与工具区块 token 成本报告，直观展示缓存消耗来源，零依赖。

description.en: Cuts the prompt payload re-sent every request by slimming oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas, attributing tool-result volume, and showing token cost.
description.zh: 通过精简过大的 MCP 工具 JSON Schema、归因工具结果体积并展示 token 成本，减少每次请求重复发送的提示负载。

description.en: Replays local DSH sessions and prices every DeepSeek call at official peak/off-peak rates to show prefix-cache savings.
description.zh: 回放本地 DSH 会话，按官方峰谷价计算每次 DeepSeek 调用，展示前缀缓存节省的费用。

description.en: CAD 3D model preview for the DSH sidebar, rendering STEP/IGES/BREP plus STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY with orbit camera and wireframe views.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏提供 CAD 3D 模型预览，支持 STEP/IGES/BREP 与 STL/3MF/OBJ/PLY，并带轨道相机与线框视图。

description.en: Persists task checkpoints across context compaction and re-injects them into the system prompt so work continues without losing state.
description.zh: 在上下文压缩时保存任务检查点，并在压缩后自动重新注入系统提示词，使任务状态得以延续。

description.en: Computer-aided translation workbench for DSH with translation memory, glossary, segment editor, MT assistance and Office/subtitle/localization document tabs.
description.zh: DSH 内的计算机辅助翻译工作台，提供翻译记忆、术语库、句段编辑器、机器翻译辅助以及 Office/字幕/本地化格式的文档标签页。

description.en: Converts calories to joules.
description.zh: 将卡路里转换为焦耳。

description.en: A minimal plugin named dsh-calcium with the Chinese description 'calcium element' (钙元素).
description.zh: 名为 dsh-calcium 的极简插件，中文描述为钙元素。

description.en: A general calendar panel for the DSH right sidebar with month view, today's events, and upcoming list, stored locally and editable by agents.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏通用日历面板：月视图、当天事件与接下来一览，事件本地存储，Agent 也能增删勾选。

description.en: Per-folder calendar and todo app with iCal import and conversation tools for DSH web.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，为每个文件夹提供日历和待办事项，支持导入 iCal 并可在对话中使用相关工具。

description.en: Plugin named after the element californium (锎), with no functional description given.
description.zh: dsh-californium 是以化学元素锎（californium）命名的插件，除名称外未提供任何功能说明。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 需要你本人回到电脑前时弹窗并出声喊你，提示音一直响到你亲手关掉。 | DSH plugin: pops a card and rings on loop until you dismiss it.
DSH sidebar calorie diary with ~90 built-in foods; pick food + grams to auto-calc kcal, track daily goal progress and 7-day trend.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏卡路里日记：内置约 90 条食物热量表，选食物加克数自动算 kcal，查看当日目标进度与近 7 天趋势。

description.en: A plugin about Cambodia (country).
A pure Node utility to convert text to camelCase naming.
description.zh: 纯 Node 工具，用于把文本转换为 camelCase 驼峰命名。

description.en: Provides camping safety response and practical plans based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数提供露营安全应对和实用方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Camp site selection tool that returns practical camping plans based on parameters, pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 营地选址工具，根据输入参数返回实用露营方案，纯 Node 实现，无需网络。

description.en: Auto-logs into the campus network with status checks, on-demand login, local settings, and an optional autostart daemon.
description.zh: 自动登录校园网：支持状态查看、按需登录、本地设置页和可选开机自启守护进程。

description.en: A plugin about the country of Canada.
Verifies recorded canary promote/abort/pause decisions against a hash-only policy using offline evidence.
Scented candle recipe tool returning fragrance oil formulas based on input parameters.
Checks a canteen food-retention ledger for the four required record elements, the 125 g minimum, the 48-hour cold-storage window, and leftover template placeholders.
description.zh: 核对食堂留样台账：四项记录要素是否齐全、留样量是否达125克、冷藏是否满48小时，以及是否残留模板占位符。

description.en: A DSH Web GUI desktop pet llama that lives in the corner and changes behavior with the current agent's working state.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 桌宠草泥马，住在屏幕角落，随当前 Agent 的工作状态改变行为。

description.en: Adds a Doubao-style capability center page to manage skills, plugins, bundles and MCP connectors with toggles, search and one-click insert into chat.
description.zh: 添加豆包式能力中心页面，集中管理技能、插件、组合包和 MCP 连接器，支持开关、搜索与一键插入对话。

description.en: DSH 1.5 plugin that composes tools, skills and MCP per session or workspace to shrink the system prompt on demand.
description.zh: DSH 1.5 插件：按会话或工作区组合工具、技能与 MCP，按需精简系统提示。

description.en: Declares semantic capabilities for DeepSeek Harness, generating typed model-facing operations that execute deterministic tool pipelines.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness声明语义能力，生成类型化模型操作以运行确定性工具流水线。

description.en: On-demand gateway for enabling opt-in third-party skills and MCP tools inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按需接入可选第三方技能与 MCP 工具的网关。

description.en: Folds durable session logs into a capability ledger showing real skill/tool usage, per-request tool-schema cost, and a read-only safety audit of installed bundles.
description.zh: 从持久会话日志生成能力账本，展示真实的技能/工具使用情况、每次请求的工具模式开销，并对已安装包做只读安全审计。

description.en: DSH workbench capability pack bundling experts, skills and connectors with lazy loading and a boot-safety guard.
description.zh: DSH 工作台能力包，整合专家、技能与连接器，支持懒加载和启动安全保护。

description.en: Matches a natural-language need to installed skills, plugins and MCP servers, returning the best capability with match reasons.
description.zh: 根据自然语言需求匹配已安装的技能、插件和 MCP 服务器，返回最佳能力及匹配理由。

description.en: Runtime-toggleable tool allowlist that limits which tools the DSH Captain agent can see, shrinking its attack surface.
description.zh: 为 DSH Captain 智能体提供运行时可切换的工具白名单，限制可见工具以缩减攻击面。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance, today's spend and peak/off-peak pricing in the desktop title bar, with low-balance colour alerts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端标题栏显示账户余额、今日花费与峰谷计价时段，余额偏低时自动变色提醒。

description.en: Capture window to toss ideas into a separate quiet session without interrupting main context, with /recall engine.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 旁路捕获插件，把想法丢进独立安静的新会话而不打断主线上下文，并提供 /recall 引擎。

description.en: An always-on-top capybara desktop pet that reports task status inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 一只始终置顶的水豚桌面宠物，在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中报告任务状态。

description.en: Car seat selection tool that calculates precise recommendations based on parameters, pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入的参数计算并给出精确的安全座椅选购推荐，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络

description.en: Read-only memory-catalog plugin that projects your own memory ledger into context as title cards, optional markdown excerpts and staleness nudges — no storage, no retrieval.
description.zh: 只读记忆目录投影插件：把你自己的记忆账本渲染成标题级目录卡、可选 markdown 摘录与近况提醒，不存储、不检索。

description.en: A personal career knowledge base plugin for DSH with audit logging, JD-based resume tailoring, interview prep/review, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: 一款 DSH 个人职业生涯知识库插件，支持审计记录、按 JD 定制简历、面试准备与复盘，并可对接飞书。

description.en: Career skill pack for DSH that helps with job fit analysis, resume tailoring, interview preparation and career planning.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的职业技能包，提供岗位匹配分析、简历定制、面试准备与职业规划。

description.en: Warms DSH session discovery in the background so the history list is populated and ready before your first request.
description.zh: 在后台预热 DSH 会话发现流程，让历史列表在首次请求前就已就绪。

description.en: Summarizes a dsh session into a note, then deletes the old transcript only after the note is read back from disk.
description.zh: 先把上一段会话摘要成笔记并落盘，确认写入成功后才允许删除旧轨迹。

description.en: Tool to convert cat age to human-equivalent years with detailed results.
description.zh: 将猫龄换算为人类等效年龄并显示详细结果的工具

description.en: Computes cat food feeding amount based on parameters and returns detailed results.
An animated cat companion that lives over the DeepSeek Harness web interface, draggable, remembers its position and reacts to agent activity.
description.zh: 一只动画猫咪伴侣，悬浮于 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面之上，可拖动、记忆位置，并随智能体状态做出反应。

description.en: 小爪同伴 · Windows 桌宠、DeepSeek 余额、任务用量与峰谷倒计时
Pure Node.js implementation of Catalan numbers, no network dependencies, callable as a plugin tool.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的卡塔兰数计算插件，无网络依赖，可作为插件工具调用。

description.en: Automatically rebuilds model catalogues for OpenRouter, OpenCode, Fireworks and other AI providers.
description.zh: 自动重建OpenRouter、OpenCode、Fireworks等AI提供商的模型目录。

description.en: Calculates the conversion value of convertible bonds (可转债转股价值) with precise parameters and detailed results.
Auto memory consolidation plugin that periodically reviews sessions and integrates/deduplicates memories.
description.zh: DSH 自动做梦插件，后台定期回顾会话并整合、去重记忆。

description.en: Reads cc-switch's provider database and registers each model provider as a DSH llm-pi-ai route, with API keys stored and connectivity checks.
description.zh: 读取 cc-switch 数据库，把每个模型供应商转成 DSH 的 llm-pi-ai 路由，保存密钥并做连通性体检。

description.en: Loads every skill found in the user's .cc-switch/skills folder into DeepSeek Harness automatically at startup.
description.zh: 启动时自动把用户 .cc-switch/skills 目录中的全部技能加载进 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Dark theme for DSH Web GUI with rose/purple colors, custom fonts, and liquid glass effects.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供深色主题，包含玫瑰紫配色、自定义字体和液态玻璃效果。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for CET-4 English training: vocabulary drills, listening, timed mock tests, translation and essay writing, with progress kept locally.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于四级英语训练：背单词、听力、限时模拟题、翻译与作文练习，进度仅保存在本机。

description.en: CET-6 exam trainer plugin: vocabulary drills, listening sets, cloze/reading tests, translation and writing practice in a sidebar panel, with local-only progress.
description.zh: 大学英语六级训练插件：左侧栏内提供背单词、听力套题、选词填空/阅读、翻译与写作练习，进度只保存在本机。

description.en: A Sajo Yukimi (Idolmaster Cinderella Girls) theme skin for the DSH web UI and Windows desktop app, with a draggable mascot.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面和 Windows 桌面版提供的佐城雪美（偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩）主题皮肤，含可拖动小人。

description.en: Multi-chain crypto wallet plugin for DSH agents: HD wallet creation/import, balances, transactions, signing, and broadcasting.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供多链加密钱包功能：创建或导入 HD 钱包、查询余额、发起交易、签名并广播。

description.en: Pure-entertainment DSH toggle that makes the AI reply in a fictional Chiang Kai-shek (Chang Kaishen) persona when switched on.
description.zh: 纯娱乐向的 DSH 开关，开启后 AI 会以蒋介石（常凯申）的口吻与你交谈。

description.en: Analyzes the impact of code changes and produces evidence-backed verification plans for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 项目分析代码变更影响，并生成有证据支撑的验证计划。

description.en: Offline deterministic proof that a change ledger settles within a declared UTC maintenance window, bound to receipt, artifact, environment, policy, and plan.
description.zh: Offline content-addressed DSH proof for change-window settlement evidence

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin that manages accounts, model catalogs, quotas and usage across 9 model channels, logging every call to local SQLite.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 插件：在侧边栏集中管理 9 家模型渠道的账号、模型目录、额度与请求记录，并把每次调用写入本地 SQLite。

description.en: DSH plugin that gives agents a dedicated WeChat-channel workspace plus shared long-term memory that persists across sessions, via 5 tools with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 插件，为智能体提供专属微信频道工作区，并跨会话共享长期记忆，包含 5 个工具且零运行时依赖。

description.en: Visualizes DSH agent teams as an imperial court, with agent cards, glowing links, a live task scroll and a context meter.
description.zh: 将 DSH 智能体团队以“朝廷”形式可视化，包含成员卡片、连线、实时任务卷轴与上下文用量表。

description.en: 人物情报库：dsh 插件。人物资料库 + 画像库 + 后台调研 + 1080×1440 克莱因蓝画像卡，内置 person-dossier / governance-portrait 两个 skill。
Skill launcher for DeepSeek Harness that recommends skills in-chat and one-click loads them from Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini libraries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能启动器：对话内实时推荐技能，授权后一键加载，只读挂载 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能库。

description.en: Renders mermaid code blocks in DSH replies as chart cards with chart, table and source views, fully offline.
description.zh: 把 DSH 回复中的 mermaid 代码块渲染成图表卡片，支持图/表/原文三视图，完全离线可用。

description.en: Adds chat message avatars to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with global defaults, per-workspace overrides, cropping, animated avatars, preview and poke.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 聊天消息添加头像，支持全局默认、按工作区覆盖、裁剪、动图头像、大图预览与拍一拍。

description.en: Gives the DSH desktop chat a custom background image with rotation groups, per-column masks, input-bar strip, progress bar and token usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端聊天界面更换背景：支持背景图与轮换分组、三栏遮罩、输入栏背景条、任务进度条和 Token 用量显示。

description.en: Adds three switchable visual presets (soft-glow, paper, compact) plus off to the DSH web chat interface, with light and dark mode variants.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话界面提供柔光、纸感、紧凑三套可切换视觉预设及关闭选项，并分别适配深色与浅色模式。

description.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that collapses the chat composer with one click and offers a floating ball to restore it, all purely client-side.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：聊天输入框一键收缩，并提供悬浮球快速还原，纯浏览器侧实现。

description.en: Conservative style tweaks for DSH Desktop chat that improve bubble styling, line spacing and reading area without touching input, data or permissions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 聊天的保守样式优化，改善气泡、行距与阅读区域，不接管输入、数据或权限。

description.en: Shows a per-turn diff stats bar above the input box listing which files changed and how many lines were added or removed.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示本轮对话的改动统计条，列出变更文件及新增/删除行数。

description.en: Floating right-sidebar dock that embeds DeepSeek Chat in a browser tab, mirrors the latest reply and inserts text into the composer.
description.zh: 可浮动的右侧边栏浏览器标签页，内嵌 DeepSeek Chat，同步最新回复并可插入输入框。

description.en: Embeds multiple AI chat services as tabs inside the desktop app, with a left panel and a right sidebar tab and one login per service.
description.zh: 在桌面应用中以内嵌多标签页方式集成多个 AI 聊天服务，左侧面板与右侧标签页并存，每个服务只需登录一次。

description.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness Web chat with zoomable fullscreen Mermaid diagrams.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天增加可缩放的全屏 Mermaid 图表查看功能。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you delete chats inside a workspace and edit prompts you have already submitted.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可删除工作区内的聊天记录，并编辑已输入的提示词。

description.en: Renders figure, tree and quiz code blocks in DSH chat as theme-adaptive HTML diagrams and quizzes, with no images or Mermaid.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中把 figure、tree、quiz 代码块渲染成随主题自适应的 HTML 图解与练习，无需图片或 Mermaid。

description.en: Chinese-safe literal find for the DSH chat transcript that scrolls to each match with pixel-accurate positioning across nested scrollports.
description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天记录提供中文安全的字面查找，并在嵌套滚动区域中精准滚动定位每一处匹配。

description.en: Restores compact folding of completed turns in DeepSeek Harness Web for long sessions where default folding is disabled.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web中恢复长会话中已完成回合的紧凑折叠，当默认折叠不可用时。

description.en: Renders chat Markdown image references as a gallery in the DSH web GUI, serving local files and http(s) URLs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中将聊天 Markdown 图片引用渲染为画廊，支持本地文件和 http(s) 链接。

description.en: Adds a right-side floating rail indexing each user message; hover to preview, click to jump, active bar follows scroll.
description.zh: Chat input index rail for DeepSeek Harness Web UI

description.en: Channel-agnostic interaction layer bridging DSH and IM platforms like Feishu and WeCom with dedupe, instant ack and routing patterns.
description.zh: DSH 与飞书、企业微信等 IM 平台之间的通用交互层，内置去重、即时确认与模型路由等模式。

description.en: Adds WorkBuddy-style session operations to DSH: message editing, regeneration, reply version switching, rollback, soft delete and a session recycle bin.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话带来 WorkBuddy 式操作：消息编辑、重新生成、回复版本切换、回滚、软删除以及会话回收站。

description.en: Blurs questions and answers in the DSH Web conversation by default and reveals them only while the pointer hovers, for privacy.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话中默认模糊提问与回答，仅在鼠标悬停时显示，保护隐私。

description.en: A chat navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness that displays Q&A rounds as colored nodes, enables quick jumping, and shows status on hover.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天右侧显示按提问回答轮次排列的彩色节点拉条，点击可跳转到对应段落，悬停展开状态面板。
