description.en: Double-click any message you sent to edit it in place, branch the conversation at that point and regenerate the following replies; files are not rolled back.
description.zh: 双击自己发出的任意消息即可就地修改，在该消息处切分会话分支并重新生成后续回答；工作目录文件不会回退。

description.en: Adds Ctrl+F search inside the open conversation with in-text highlights, previous/next navigation, a match list and a live match count.
description.zh: 在打开的对话中提供 Ctrl+F 搜索，支持正文高亮、上一个/下一个跳转、匹配列表和实时匹配计数。

description.en: Copies a finished assistant reply as a long PNG screenshot, re-laying-out tables, keeping images full-size and splitting overlong replies.
description.zh: 将一条已完成的助手回复导出为长图 PNG 截图，表格重新排版、图片保持原尺寸、过长内容自动分段。

description.en: Traces AI answers back to their chat sources, searches across sessions, and saves quotable excerpts for cited follow-up questions.
description.zh: 追溯 AI 回答的原文依据，支持跨会话搜索历史对话，并可保存摘录、引用原文继续追问。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry opening a 1–4 pane split-screen grid so you can view and drag between multiple conversations side by side.
description.zh: 侧栏新增入口，打开最多四屏的对话分屏网格，可并排查看、拖拽切换多个对话。

description.en: Customizes chat font, width, line height, and paragraph spacing for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可调整聊天界面的字体、宽度、行高和段间距。

description.en: Adds manual unread marks to DSH desktop session lists with a blue dot, menu/hover toggles, a host-side ledger that survives restarts, and auto-clear on open.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端会话列表增加手动未读标记：蓝点提示、菜单/悬浮切换、宿主账本跨重启保留，打开会话自动清除。

description.en: Puts an image wallpaper behind the DSH chat UI with frosted composer and bubbles, auto-blur when a conversation has content, and frosted backdrops behind overlays.
description.zh: 为 DSH 聊天界面添加图片壁纸，输入框与气泡呈磨砂效果，对话有内容时自动模糊，设置类浮层后方也有磨砂背景。

description.en: Adjusts chat content and user bubble widths in DSH Web GUI with sliders, instantly applied.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中通过滑块调节聊天内容区和用户气泡的宽度，调整即时生效

description.en: DSH web GUI plugin that auto folds/expands chat window, hiding old pages at bottom and expanding earlier messages on top scroll.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：自动折叠或展开聊天窗口，底部隐藏较早内容，向上滚动时锚定视口并展开更早的消息。

description.en: Connects your ChatGPT subscription to DeepSeek Harness with Codex models, GPT Image, quota tracking, recovery and a per-plugin HTTP(S) proxy.
description.zh: 将你的 ChatGPT 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 Codex 模型、GPT Image、额度查询、恢复机制和按插件隔离的 HTTP(S) 代理。

description.en: Sign in to a ChatGPT account via Codex OAuth inside DSH model settings and view Codex usage limits and credits.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型设置中通过 Codex OAuth 登录 ChatGPT 账号，并查看 Codex 用量限额与 Credits。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT-style prompt autocomplete to the DSH composer: a candidate panel updates as you type, Tab accepts, arrows switch, Esc closes.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供 ChatGPT 风格的提示词自动补全：候选面板随输入更新，Tab 采纳，↑/↓ 切换，Esc 关闭。

description.en: Connects DingTalk and Feishu (plus Feishu Project) to DeepSeek Harness as MCP tool servers with a one-click connect panel.
description.zh: 将钉钉、飞书(含飞书项目)作为 MCP 工具服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供一键连接面板。

description.en: Injects a standing interaction protocol into model system prompts to encourage narrating work, asking for help when stuck, and scoped verification.
description.zh: 向模型系统提示注入常驻互动协议，让模型边做边说、卡住时开口求助，并按预算进行验证。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that does one-click daily check-ins and shows credit overviews for WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder accounts.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，为 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 账号提供一键每日签到与积分概览。

description.en: Session-scoped checklists let the agent track work as a tree, keep a compact digest visible to the model, and mirror it in a read-only sidebar tab.
description.zh: 会话级清单让智能体以树状结构跟踪工作，模型始终能看到精简摘要，并在只读侧边栏中同步显示。

description.en: Per-turn git checkpoints that let you undo one turn's changes or roll the workspace back to an earlier turn, file by file, with a diff preview.
description.zh: 按对话轮次生成 Git 检查点，可撤销某一轮改动，或按文件将工作区回滚到更早轮次，并提供 diff 预览。

description.en: Zero-cost local Python tools that give a DSH companion a body: screenshot capture, now-playing plus lyrics, battery/CPU/memory stats, dream notes and process stop.
description.zh: 琛琛的身体层：零成本本地 Python 工具，让陪伴人格能截屏、读歌名歌词、量电量内存 CPU、生成梦境笔记并叫停后台服务。

description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation, right-click to quote it into a blue composer block that is sent to the model as a blockquote.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中划选文字并右键「引用」，原文会以蓝色引用块插入输入框，发送后作为引用交给模型。

description.en: A DSH custom-mode fork whose install defaults are Minimal base mode and an editable Chinese system prompt 你是一个中文助手.
description.zh: DSH 自定义模式分支，安装默认使用 Minimal 基础模式并预设可编辑的中文系统提示词“你是一个中文助手”。

description.en: Injects a system-prompt language policy so the main session and all subagents reason and reply in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 在主系统提示中注入语言策略，让主会话和所有子代理都用简体中文推理和回复。

description.en: Attaches your current Chrome tab to a DSH draft as a screenshot, inserting the page title and URL into the composer.
description.zh: 将当前 Chrome 标签页以截图形式附加到 DSH 草稿，并把页面标题和 URL 写入输入框。

description.en: Harness plugin plus an MV3 Chrome extension that lets the agent read and operate your real Chrome tabs with trusted clicks, typing and drags.
description.zh: Harness 插件加 MV3 Chrome 扩展，让 Agent 读取并操作用户真实的 Chrome 标签页，发出可信的点击、输入与拖拽事件。

description.en: Routes all DeepSeek Harness browser navigation to Google Chrome, with guard and prompt rules so dsh web never opens the OS default browser.
description.zh: 将所有 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器导航统一交给 Google Chrome，并通过守卫和提示规则确保 dsh web 不打开系统默认浏览器。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness conversations into an auditable, searchable Markdown chronicle and fact base, exported as a standalone Obsidian vault.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话整理成可审计、可检索的 Markdown 编年史与事实库，输出为独立的 Obsidian vault。

description.en: A draggable blue-haired whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH web UI that blinks, chats by voice, recites poems and stories, and reminds you of meals.
description.zh: 一个常驻 DSH 网页的蓝发鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，可拖拽、会眨眼、能语音对话、说书念诗，还会提醒饭点。

description.en: HTTP Range chunked downloader for AI agents with multi-connection concurrency, resume, pause/resume, speed limits and queues, cross-platform.
description.zh: 给 AI Agent 用的 HTTP Range 分片下载器，支持多连接并发、断点续传、暂停/恢复、限速与队列，跨平台可用。

description.en: Brings each project's CI/CD pipelines into DSH sessions: list, trigger, track, read logs, cancel runs, and view merge conflicts (Aliyun Yunxiao Flow).
description.zh: 将各项目的 CI/CD 流水线接入 DSH 会话：列出、触发、跟踪、读取日志、取消运行并查看合并冲突（当前支持阿里云云效 Flow）。

description.en: DSH lexicon plugin that auto-captures the user's profanity and aggressive slang as banter ammunition and re-injects it each round.
description.zh: DSH 词库插件：自动收录用户的脏话与攻击性口气词作斗嘴弹药，每轮自动注入。

description.en: Adds a Cinema panel with a TMDB poster wall, CMS source management, search, episode picking and in-panel HLS/FLV playback.
description.zh: 新增影音工作室面板：TMDB 海报墙、CMS 片源管理、搜索选集，并在面板内播放 HLS/FLV。

description.en: A reference plugin for film camera movement and cinematic language.
description.zh: @{name=dsh-cinematography; version=0.1.0; description=电影运镜与镜头语言参考; type=module; main=lib/index.js; exports=; files=System.Object[]; dsh=; keywords=System.Object[]; author=istone <ad571@qq.com>; licens

description.en: Circle calculation plugin implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的圆计算插件，无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides precise circuit loop planning calculations with detailed results based on industry experience.
Lets you select PDF text in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in chat, and turns model citations into links that open and highlight the PDF passage.
description.zh: 在文件标签页选中 PDF 文本即可引用或提问，并把模型的引用转为可打开并高亮原文段落的链接。

description.en: Cited for DeepSeek Harness searches your documents and answers questions with inline citations via RAG.
description.zh: Cited 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文档检索，并基于 RAG 给出带引用的回答。

description.en: Adds a default rule forcing every web-search-based answer to carry checkable per-claim citations, stated conditions and opposing findings.
description.zh: 添加一条默认规则，要求每个基于网页搜索的回答都为每条论断附上可核查的链接、说明成立条件并列出相反发现。

description.en: Tool for calculating civil service exam answering pace based on parameters, returning detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
Backs up all installed dsh plugins and their config into one folder, then restores them on a new machine.
description.zh: 将 dsh 配置中所有已安装插件及其配置备份到一个文件夹，并可在新机器上完整还原。

description.en: A claims process plugin that returns family insurance planning plans based on parameters, pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 理赔流程插件，根据传入参数返回家庭保险规划方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Turn-boundary gate for DSH agents: intercepts false completion claims lacking verification output, prompts coverage audit, and runs synchronously with zero LLM/network calls.
description.zh: DSH代理回合边界声明门：无验证输出时拦截完成声明，有验证时提示覆盖审计。纯同步，零LLM零网络。

description.en: Guards DSH file tool writes by inspecting text against JSON rules and triggering approval for blocked phrases.
description.zh: 为 DSH 文件工具提供写前守卫，按 JSON 规则检查文本并对命中词条触发审批。

description.en: Runs your real project checks, pins results to the working-tree fingerprint, expires stale evidence and gates turn completion until proof exists.
description.zh: 自动执行项目验收命令，将结果绑定到工作区指纹，证据随代码变化失效，未取证前不允许宣称完成。

description.en: Pure Node plugin for clamping numeric values, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 插件，用于把数值限制在指定的最小值和最大值之间，不依赖网络。

description.en: Injects a one-shot ~200-token prompt so the model asks 2-4 clarifying questions before starting an underspecified task.
description.zh: 注入约 200 token 的一次性提示，让模型在开始模糊任务前先问清 2-4 个关键决策点。

description.en: Adds a requirements-clarification mode to DeepSeek Harness that asks one question at a time and locks file writes until you approve a spec.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加需求澄清模式：一次一问梳理需求，确认验收清单前禁止写文件。

description.en: Calculates interest class budgets based on parameters and returns clear suggestions.
description.zh: 根据参数计算兴趣班预算并返回明确建议。

description.en: Claude Agent provider for DeepSeek Harness that routes requests through Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK with high prompt-cache hit rates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Agent 模型接入，基于 Anthropic Claude Agent SDK，并具备高提示词缓存命中率。

description.en: Compatibility plugin that keeps dsh-claude-ux enabled while neutralizing its negative effects.
description.zh: 兼容性插件：让 dsh-claude-ux 保持可见的启用状态，同时中和其实际产生的负面影响。

description.en: Use a Claude Pro or Max subscription as a DeepSeek Harness model provider via Claude Code CLI.
description.zh: 通过Claude Code CLI，将Claude Pro或Max订阅用作DeepSeek Harness的模型提供方。

description.en: Bridges Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness so both agent brains exchange turn events, with an event-driven wait CLI and acpx/mcacp setup helpers.
description.zh: 连接 Claude Code 与 DeepSeek Harness，使两个智能体大脑交换轮次事件，并提供事件驱动等待 CLI 与 acpx/mcacp 配置工具。

description.en: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to local Claude Code via the official Agent SDK, with background jobs, live output and a monitor panel.
description.zh: 通过官方 Agent SDK 将自包含编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code，支持后台作业、实时输出与监控面板。

description.en: Replaces the DSH composer Effort switch with a Claude Desktop-style draggable Low→Ultracode slider that sets the model's maximum thinking effort.
description.zh: 用 Claude 桌面风格的 Low→Ultracode 可拖动滑块替换 DSH 输入框的 Effort 开关，映射模型最高思考强度。

description.en: Loads Claude Code skills, commands, and agents as native dsh skills from projects or marketplaces.
description.zh: 从项目或市场加载 Claude Code 的技能、命令和代理，并将其作为 dsh 原生技能使用。

description.en: Claude Code-style interaction layer for DSH: dual themes, command palette, chat search, read-aloud, completion chime, keyboard-first controls.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打造的 Claude Code 风格交互层：双主题、命令面板、聊天搜索、回复朗读、完成提示音与键盘优先操作。

description.en: A Claude-inspired DSH Web UI skin with warm-black canvas, terracotta accents, Anthropic font switching, and light/dark theme support.
description.zh: Claude 风格的 DSH Web 界面皮肤，暖黑画布配陶橙点缀，内置 Anthropic 字体切换并跟随亮/暗主题。

description.en: Connects a Claude Pro/Max subscription to DSH with OAuth login, multi-account vault, quota cards, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中接入 Claude Pro/Max 订阅，支持 OAuth 登录、多账号保管库、配额卡片和设置面板。

description.en: Macaron clay/neumorphism theme for DeepSeek Harness with cream light mode and dark-chocolate dark mode, injected via pure CSS.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的马卡龙软陶（Neumorphism）主题，奶油浅色与黑巧深色双模式，纯 CSS 注入。

description.en: Play DOOM Shareware in a draggable floating window inside DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的可拖动浮动窗口中运行 DOOM Shareware 游戏。

description.en: Adds browser-style Back/Forward/Refresh controls to the DSH client title bar, with a shared history stack for sessions and plugin panels.
description.zh: 为 DSH 客户端标题栏添加浏览器式后退/前进/刷新按钮，会话与插件面板共用一条历史栈。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar tab to DeepSeek Harness that accumulates statistics for every background task run in the session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏添加一个标签页，累计记录本会话跑过的每一个后台任务统计。

description.en: Enhances dsh web markdown rendering with customizable color highlighting and a draggable floating window for thinking chains.
description.zh: 增强 dsh 网页的 Markdown 渲染，支持自定义颜色高亮，并为思考链提供可拖动的浮动窗口。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web GUI: phone layout, overlay sidebar drawer, bottom navigation, and a manual Desktop/Mobile switch.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供移动端适配：手机布局、抽屉式侧边栏、底部导航，以及手动桌面/移动切换。

description.en: Merges two conflicting DSH model-seat plugins into one control with dual-column provider/model cards, cross-provider search, thinking-strength slider and theme panel.
description.zh: 把两个抢占同一模型座位、同时安装会冲突的 DSH 插件合并为一个控件：供应商/模型双列卡片、跨供应商搜索、思考强度粒子滑块与双主题外观面板。

description.en: One-click provider/model switcher client plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, enabling quick model changes from the chat session header.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的一键供应商/模型切换客户端插件，可从聊天会话顶部快速切换模型。

description.en: A fantasy glassmorphic theme for the DSH Web UI with moonlight forest art, dual light/blue styles and 3 built-in songs.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态主题，含月光森林画面、淡雅/蓝色双风格与 3 首内置背景音乐。

description.en: Adds a draggable companion pet to DeepSeek Harness Web UI that reacts to session states and supports petting, feeding, playing, with settings panel and dev API.
Client-side UI plugin for DSH Web that injects a live Route Log panel showing which backend model actually served each request.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端 UI 插件，在对话视图中注入实时路由日志面板，显示每次请求实际使用的后端模型。

description.en: Adds a session cost estimate pill to the DSH composer statistics dock, pricing durable token usage and updating live as the session streams.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框统计栏添加会话费用估算小药丸，基于持久化 token 用量计费并随会话流式更新。

description.en: DSH Web client plugin showing active sessions as vertical bars in the collapsed 56px sidebar rail, with hover detail cards and click-to-open.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端插件:侧边栏收起时在左侧 56px 轨道空白区竖排显示活跃会话横条,悬停出详情卡,点击跳转会话。

description.en: In-session full-text search for DeepSeek Harness web GUI with full-history coverage, kind filters, multi-term AND, and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供会话内全文搜索，覆盖全部历史，支持类型过滤、多词与匹配和键盘导航。

description.en: Bayern Munich themed skin for the dsh web GUI with red/white canvases, match-photo backdrops, and squad imagery.
description.zh: 为dsh网页界面提供的拜仁慕尼黑主题皮肤，含红白画布、真实比赛照片背景和球队元素。

description.en: Saber dual day/night wallpaper skin for DSH Web/desktop, with layered translucency and frosted glass; follows light/dark/system settings.
description.zh: Saber 昼夜双壁纸皮肤，为 DSH Web/桌面端提供壁纸、分层半透明与磨砂效果，自动跟随亮色/暗色/系统设置。

description.en: Visual theme manager for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with import/export, backgrounds, and persistence.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可视化主题管理，支持主题导入导出、背景设置与配置持久化。

description.en: Adjustable global scrollbar thickness for the DSH client, letting you set width from 4-20px (default 8px) via an inline CSS variable.
description.zh: 可全局调节 DSH 客户端滚动条粗细，宽度可在 4–20px 间调整（默认 8px）。

description.en: DSH Web GUI navigation bar for chat session questions: scroll highlighting, hover previews, and click-to-scroll with auto-pagination.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话问题导航条：滚动高亮、悬停预览、点击平滑滚动，自动加载更早历史。

description.en: Plays a two-tone chime when AI reply completes, letting you multitask without watching the screen.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端插件，在 AI 回复完成时播放双音提示音，方便你分心处理其他事而无需盯着屏幕。

description.en: DSH Desktop UI tweaks: edit-and-resend with forked branches, sidebar branch-family grouping, and auto summary titles with a pixel shimmer.
description.zh: DSH 桌面 UI 增强：编辑重发并生成分支、侧边栏分支族分组，以及带像素微光效果的自动摘要标题。

description.en: Sidebar HUD for DeepSeek Harness showing account balance, gifted balance, cumulative spend, and token usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏 HUD，显示账户余额、赠送余额、累计消费和 token 使用量。

description.en: A browser-side dsh plugin that changes the wallpaper of the dsh Web GUI with configurable size, position, and tint.
description.zh: 一个浏览器端 dsh 插件，可更换 dsh Web GUI 的壁纸，并支持尺寸、位置和底色浓度配置。

description.en: Explorer-style picker that lets you switch between workspaces, browse a nested workspace tree, and view a per-workspace overview.
description.zh: 资源管理器风格的工作区选择器，可切换工作区、浏览嵌套工作区树并查看每个工作区的概览。

description.en: Shows Cline/ClinePass subscription quota, credits balance and token spend in the DSH session header, with multi-account switching.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话页头显示 Cline/ClinePass 订阅额度、Credits 余额与 token 消耗，并支持多账号切换。

description.en: Adds a right-click cut, copy, paste and select-all context menu to DeepSeek Harness composer inputs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加右键剪切、复制、粘贴和全选的上下文菜单。

description.en: A clipbook panel for DeepSeek Harness that saves assistant replies with one click and lets you browse, search, copy, delete and export them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的剪藏面板，一键收藏助手回复，并可浏览、搜索、复制、删除和导出。

description.en: A draggable Clippy or Doomguy sprite companion that lives inside the DSH chat column, with switchable sprite packs.
description.zh: 一个可拖拽的 Clippy 或 Doomguy 精灵伴侣，存在于 DSH 聊天区域中，可切换精灵包。

description.en: Adds a native wishlist panel to the DSH sidebar, backed by a zero-dependency Bun web app for tracking closet items.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏添加原生愿望清单面板，由零依赖 Bun Web 应用提供支持，用于追踪衣橱物品。

description.en: Provides household storage and organization plans for closets based on input parameters.
Tool that returns home anti-mold and dehumidification solutions based on parameters; pure Node and offline.
description.zh: 根据参数返回家庭衣物防霉与除湿方案，纯 Node 实现、离线运行。

description.en: Adds Chinese titles, Chinese search, hover details and drag-to-reorder to the DSH skills and commands menu.
description.zh: 为 DSH 技能与命令菜单添加中文标题、中文搜索、悬浮详情和拖拽排序。

description.en: Deployment-local adapter that republishes dsh-cockpit-bridge ports into the dsh-memex browse-address registry so services stay discoverable.
description.zh: 部署本地适配器，将 dsh-cockpit-bridge 发布的端口转发登记到 dsh-memex 浏览地址注册表。

description.en: Deployment-local adapter linking dsh-cockpit-bridge remote editor opening to the Worktree Session open-handler registry.
description.zh: 将 dsh-cockpit-bridge 远程编辑器打开请求连接到 Worktree Session 打开处理器注册表的部署本地适配器。

description.en: Collects all code blocks from the current DeepSeek Harness session, grouped by language, with copy, download-all, and jump-to-turn actions.
description.zh: 收集当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话中模型生成的所有代码块，按语言分组，支持复制、全部下载和跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Codebase context engine for AI agents that indexes a repo in 0.5s and retrieves the top-k most relevant files in 6ms to cut context usage.
description.zh: 为 AI agent 打造的代码库上下文引擎，0.5 秒建索引、6 毫秒检索 top-k 相关文件，大幅节省上下文。

description.en: Code editor and PyCharm-style Git workbench that adds Code and Git pages to the DSH Web UI sidebar for editing, diffs and branch operations.
description.zh: 代码编辑器与 PyCharm 风格 Git 工作台，在 DSH Web UI 侧边栏新增代码和 Git 页面，支持编辑、差异对比与分支操作。

description.en: Read-only semantic code navigation for DeepSeek Harness using local language servers: definitions, references, symbols, diagnostics, hover and rename preview.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于本地语言服务器的只读语义代码导航：定义、引用、符号、诊断、悬停与重命名预览。

description.en: Provides observability into hidden tool calls made by run_code in DeepSeek Harness code-mode.
description.zh: 观测 DeepSeek Harness 代码模式下 run_code 程序发起的子调度，即模型看不到的那些工具调用。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness AI agents, storing facts/episodes/procedures as Markdown with auto-retrieval.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness AI 智能体提供跨会话记忆，把事实、情景与流程以 Markdown 存储并自动检索。

description.en: Composite code-development pipeline for DSH that routes tasks across Sol, Opus and DeepSeek in stages, with independent acceptance and per-stage model settings.
description.zh: 挂载于 DSH 的复合代码开发流水线：分阶段调度 Sol、Opus、DeepSeek 协作，含独立验收与逐环节模型设置。

description.en: Codex-style code review panel for DSH that reviews local diffs, commits and GitHub PRs, reporting P0-P3 findings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的 Codex 风格代码审查面板，可审查本地差异、提交和 GitHub PR，并按 P0-P3 分级报告问题。

description.en: Runs Python, R, Node.js and other scripts from a DSH sidebar panel with streaming live output.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏面板中直接运行 Python、R、Node.js 等脚本，并实时流式查看输出。

description.en: Scans a project and returns code statistics by language: file counts, lines of code, and largest file list.
description.zh: @{name=dsh-code-stats; version=0.1.0; description=代码统计：扫描项目，按语言统计文件数与代码行数，返回语言分布与最大文件清单; type=module; main=lib/index.js; exports=; files=System.Object[]; dsh=; keywords=System.Object[]; author=istone

description.en: AI-powered code workbench: upload code, get modifications/review, download diff and report. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 上传代码后由 AI 修改、优化或审查，可下载改动后的代码，并查看差异对比和审查报告，无外部依赖。

description.en: An elegant, extensible code editor plugin for DSH with LSP-backed intelligent coding assistance.
description.zh: 一个优雅、可扩展的 DSH 代码编辑器插件，内置基于 LSP 的智能编码辅助。

description.en: Adds keyword file/content search plus codegraph symbol lookup with caller/callee expansion to the dsh Web GUI sidebar, with click-to-jump results.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web GUI 右侧栏提供文件名与内容关键词搜索，并用 codegraph 查符号与调用方/被调方，点击跳转到对应行。

description.en: Read-only CODEOWNERS matcher for DSH that routes files to owners using GitHub-style last-match-wins glob patterns.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供只读的 CODEOWNERS 匹配，按 GitHub 风格的“最后匹配优先”通配符模式将文件路由到负责人。

description.en: CodeQuest for DeepSeek Harness: 把真实 Token 流量与会话内容变成成就游戏，带自建排行榜
Persistent, incrementally updated code wiki for DeepSeek Harness that reports an honest four-state outcome.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久、增量更新的代码 Wiki，并给出诚实的四态结果。

description.en: Companion plugin for dsh-codex-subscription that imports, previews and exports Codex account JSON files without touching the subscription plugin's source.
description.zh: 作为 dsh-codex-subscription 的配套插件，提供 Codex 账号 JSON 的导入、预览与导出，且不修改订阅插件源码。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness users sign in with ChatGPT for coding chats, image generation and web search from one settings page.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用户通过 ChatGPT 账号登录，在统一设置页中使用编程对话、图像生成和网页搜索。

description.en: Bridges DSH sessions to the Codex app-server so you can keep persistent Codex advisor threads for ongoing guidance.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话桥接到 Codex app-server，保持持久的 Codex 顾问线程以提供持续指导。

description.en: Bridges Codex into DSH as an architect and read-only reviewer with ChatGPT sign-in, model choice, file approval and checkpoints.
description.zh: 将 Codex 接入 DSH，作为架构师与只读评审者，支持 ChatGPT 登录、模型选择、文件审批与检查点。

description.en: Reuses Codex CLI's ChatGPT OAuth login in DeepSeek Harness, refreshing and syncing tokens.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT OAuth 登录，并刷新和同步令牌。

description.en: Bridges local Codex and DeepSeek Harness so both agents collaborate through shared, readable discussion threads.
description.zh: 同舟在本地打通 Codex 与 DeepSeek Harness，让两个智能体通过共享且可读的讨论记录协作。

description.en: Quota-aware DSH bundle that delegates tasks to Codex CLI and picks ChatGPT-plan models based on remaining 5-hour and weekly quotas.
description.zh: 配额感知的 DSH 插件包，根据 ChatGPT 套餐的 5 小时和每周剩余额度委托 Codex CLI 并选择模型。

description.en: Bridge for local Codex threads: list threads, dispatch headless turns, read transcripts, and monitor goal state and liveness.
description.zh: 连接本地 Codex 线程的桥接插件：列出线程、派发无头回合、读取对话记录并监控目标状态与存活状态。

description.en: Use the Codex desktop app's ChatGPT models in DeepSeek Harness via a first-class LLM provider and conversation-access tools with existing sign-in.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 Codex 桌面应用的 ChatGPT 模型：提供一等 LLM 提供商和对话访问工具，并复用桌面应用登录。

description.en: DSH plugin that migrates Codex's bundled Chrome control into native mcp__chrome__* tools for driving your own browser tabs, sessions and screenshots.
description.zh: 将 Codex 内置的 Chrome 控制插件迁移为 DSH 原生 mcp__chrome__* 工具，可驱动自己的浏览器标签页、登录会话与截图。

description.en: Codex-style composer for the DSH Web GUI with prompt history, Tab completion and context-aware next-prompt suggestions.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Codex 风格输入框：提示历史、Tab 补全与上下文感知的下一步提示建议。

description.en: Read local OpenAI Codex sessions and continue them in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 读取本机 OpenAI Codex 会話并一键在 DSH 中继续。

description.en: Delegates tasks to the local Codex CLI via a codex exec tool, with per-session model, effort and role selectors.
description.zh: 通过 codex exec 工具把任务委派给本机 Codex CLI，并提供按会话隔离的模型、努力等级与角色选择器。

description.en: Bridges your local Codex CLI sessions into DSH: view conversation turns in a side drawer, resume persisted sessions, and switch model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex CLI 的多轮会话接入 DSH：侧栏抽屉查看往来、会话落库支持 resume 续接，并可切换模型与推理强度。

description.en: Turns DSH into a sidecar for Codex threads by browsing ~/.codex, binding a thread, and reading its history, live activity, stats and workspace files.
description.zh: 将 DSH 变为 Codex 线程的侧车：浏览 ~/.codex、绑定线程，并查看其历史、实时活动、统计信息与工作区文件。

description.en: Adds Codex-powered image recognition, generation, and editing to DeepSeek Harness, with paste-to-upload support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Codex 图片识别、生成与编辑能力，支持粘贴上传，由本机 Codex CLI 子代理执行

description.en: Turns a Vaydeer 9-key keypad into a DSH Codex Micro by mapping its unique HID key combinations to DSH actions.
description.zh: 将 Vaydeer 9 键小键盘变为 DSH Codex Micro，把其独特的 HID 按键组合映射为 DSH 操作。

description.en: Chat-input model picker for DSH that ranks your most-used models and manages model redirect rules.
description.zh: DSH 聊天输入框的模型选择器，按常用度排序模型并管理模型重定向规则。

description.en: Floating DSH control panel that approves git & GitHub write tools with one tap and restores toggles after restart.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮控制面板：一键批准 git / GitHub 写工具，重启后自动恢复免审批开关。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style Git panel to DSH Desktop with a Git button in the session header for committing, pushing, switching branches and initializing repos.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 添加 Codex 风格的 Git 面板，在会话头部提供 Git 按钮，可提交、推送、切换分支和初始化仓库。

description.en: macOS always-on-top desktop pet for DSH Desktop with swappable whale/Codex skins, a session ball, and a shortcut new-session ask box.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH Desktop 的 macOS 桌面置顶宠物，支持 DeepSeek 鲸鱼与 Codex 皮肤、会话球和快捷新建会话对话框。

description.en: Turns the DSH sidebar into a dual-column Codex-style workspace with an integrated Activity Bar for quick section switching.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏改造为双栏 Codex 风格工作区，并集成活动栏以便快速切换分区。

description.en: Adds a deterministic /review command to DeepSeek Harness that spawns a Codex-model reviewer subagent, one session per chat, resettable via /review reset.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性的 /review 命令，启动绑定 Codex 模型的评审子代理，每个会话一个，可用 /review reset 重置。

description.en: Read-only DSH web panel that lists recent Codex CLI runs with status, duration, token usage, and last message.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 网页面板，列出最近的 Codex CLI 运行记录，含状态、耗时、Token 用量和最后一条消息。

description.en: Adds Codex-style code selection to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with a workspace file tree and read-only viewer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加 Codex 风格的代码选择功能，并提供工作区文件树和只读文件查看器。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style sidebar to DSH with Files, Review, Browser, and Terminal tabs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 主会话添加 Codex 风格侧边栏，包含文件、审查、浏览器和终端四个标签页。

description.en: Optional DSH output style plugin that makes assistant replies conclusion-first, concise, and explicitly verified without modifying host code.
description.zh: 可选的 DSH 输出风格插件，让回答结论先行、简洁并明确验证，且不修改宿主源码。

description.en: Shows ChatGPT Codex 5-hour and weekly remaining quota in the DSH sidebar and status bar, with auto-refresh and toggle settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏与底栏显示 ChatGPT Codex 的 5 小时与每周剩余额度，支持自动刷新和开关设置。

description.en: Read-only sidebar/floating dashboard listing every Codex job with directory, task, elapsed time, tokens, state and produced files.
description.zh: 只读 ~/.codex/sessions，在浮卡与右栏集中展示每个 Codex 任务的目录、原话、耗时、token 用量、状态与产物。

description.en: Always-on coding discipline layer that injects rules into every step so the model keeps constraints, proves work with builds or tests, and avoids guess-and-patch loops.
description.zh: 常驻编码纪律层，在每一步注入规则，让模型牢记约束、用构建或测试证明结果，避免猜测式修补循环。

description.en: Displays Coding Plan quota usage in the DSH Web composer dock, showing monthly USD spend and the rolling 5-hour window.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页编辑器停靠栏显示 Coding Plan 配额用量，含月度美元花费与滚动 5 小时窗口。

description.en: Calculates coffee powder-to-water ratio by parameters and returns detailed results based on experience reference.
Calculates coffee water temperature from input parameters and returns detailed empirical results. Pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算咖啡冲煮水温并返回详细的经验结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A zero-dependency sidebar card for the DSH Web GUI that shows live BTC, ETH and SOL prices, 24h change and mini sparkline charts.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供零依赖的侧边栏加密行情卡片，实时显示 BTC、ETH、SOL 价格、24 小时涨跌和迷你走势图。

description.en: Adds a right-click "Paste image" menu that inserts clipboard images into the DSH Desktop composer draft and saves a dated copy.
description.zh: 在右键菜单中添加“粘贴图片”功能，将剪贴板图片粘贴到 DSH Desktop 编辑器草稿，并按日期保存副本。

description.en: Plays an Arknights-style HUD boot animation when DSH Desktop cold-starts, theming the app's launch sequence.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 冷启动时播放明日方舟风格 HUD 开机动画，为主题化启动过程。

description.en: Pure Node implementation of the Collatz sequence (考拉兹序列), no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的考拉兹序列计算，无网络依赖。

description.en: A plugin about Colombia with minimal documentation.
Simulates color blindness and generates colorblind-safe color palettes for accessible design.
WCAG color contrast calculator to compute contrast ratios and find accessible color combinations.
description.zh: 按 WCAG 计算颜色对比度比值，并查找符合可访问性要求的颜色组合。

description.en: Maps a hex color code to a common Chinese/English color name (color lookup tool for DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: @{name=dsh-color-name; version=0.1.0; description=颜色名称识别：输入十六进制颜色，返回常见中文/英文颜色名称（Color name lookup tool for DeepSeek Harness）; type=module; main=lib/index.js; exports=; files=System.Object[]; dsh=; key

description.en: Generates color palette schemes; pure Node, offline, with no external services.
description.zh: 用纯 Node 离线生成配色方案，不调用外部服务

description.en: Offline color psychology reference implemented in pure Node with no external dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的离线色彩心理学参考插件，无外部依赖，可查询颜色对应的心理含义。

description.en: Color theory and color scheme reference with harmony tips, implemented in pure Node.
description.zh: 提供色彩理论与配色方案参考，包含配色和谐建议，纯 Node 实现。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with 22 light palettes, 14 composable surface effects, workspace colour binding and clock rotation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供 22 种浅色配色、14 种可组合界面效果及工作区配色绑定。

description.en: Formats text into aligned columns using pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 将文本整理为对齐的列，基于纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Computes combination numbers (nCr) for mathematical and statistical use.
description.zh: 计算组合数 nCr，用于数学与统计计算。

description.en: ComfyUI text-to-image panel with Krea 2 Turbo, artist-style illustration and LoRA presets, pixel game assets, prompt optimization and a gallery.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ComfyUI 文生图面板，含 Krea 2 Turbo、插画风格与 LoRA 预设、像素游戏素材、提示词优化和画廊。

description.en: Adds a /btw slash command to ask side questions about the current session without adding the exchange to conversation history.
description.zh: 新增 /btw 斜杠命令，可就当前会话提出旁支问题，且不写入对话历史。

description.en: Queues slash commands like /compact while the agent is busy and runs them automatically once it becomes idle.
description.zh: 当 agent 忙碌时，将 /compact 等斜杠命令排入队列，待其空闲后自动执行。

description.en: DSH plugin that registers a Command Code Go LLM provider plus a draggable usage floating window in the Web UI.
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 Command Code Go 的 LLM 模型提供方，并在 Web 界面提供可拖动的用量悬浮窗。

description.en: Read-only commit review sidebar tab that groups commits by repository and expands each commit into its per-file diff.
description.zh: 只读的提交审查侧边栏标签页，按仓库分组展示提交，并可展开查看每个提交的逐文件差异。

description.en: Adds an in-app Community Bench tab that shows the public task-conditioned benchmark registry without local scoring.
description.zh: 在应用内新增 Community Bench 标签页，展示公开的任务条件基准注册表，不进行本地评分。

description.en: Native community plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness to discover, install, update, and manage community plugins from settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生社区插件管理器，在设置中搜索、安装、更新和管理社区插件。

description.en: Provides static Comoros country info: capital, population, currency, and continent.
A compact conversation view for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the answer in focus and expands the work behind it on demand.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供紧凑对话视图，让答案保持聚焦，需要时可展开背后的工作过程。

description.en: Compacts the DeepSeek Harness sidebar by merging Plugins, Automations and More into one row and turning New Session into a brand-row icon.
description.zh: 精简 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏：将插件、自动化、更多合并为一行，并把新建会话变为品牌行图标。

description.en: Audits DeepSeek Harness context compaction to show which of your instructions were dropped, recording and guarding sessions; optional verbatim-preserving takeover (experimental).
description.zh: 审计 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩，显示哪些要求被丢弃，并记录与守护会话；可实验性接管压缩以逐字保留。

description.en: Compacts the DSH sidebar navigation into a two-column grid and repairs dsh-resource:// records the browser URL parser misreads.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏导航压缩为双列网格布局，并修复浏览器 URL 解析器误判的 dsh-resource:// 记录。

description.en: Turns the DSH NEXT Windows desktop app into a compact, always-on-top sticky-note-style window.
description.zh: 将 DSH NEXT Windows 桌面应用切换为置顶的便签式小窗模式。

description.en: Codex-style window-swap compaction engine that replaces LLM-summary compaction with deterministic pointer-template summaries and no LLM calls.
description.zh: Codex 风格的窗口交换压缩引擎，用确定性指针模板摘要替代默认的 LLM 摘要压缩，全程无需调用大模型。

description.en: Makes compaction summary requests reuse the session's reasoning effort so DeepSeek prefix-cache buckets stay warm instead of recomputing context at full price.
description.zh: 让上下文压缩的摘要请求沿用会话思考档位，避免 DeepSeek 前缀缓存换桶导致整段上下文按未缓存价重算。

description.en: Verifies that constraints from compacted agent context appear in the summary and loudly reports any instructions silently forgotten.
description.zh: 校验智能体上下文压缩后摘要是否保留压缩范围内的约束，并高调报告被静默遗忘的指令。

description.en: Adds a Web settings page to choose the DeepSeek Harness conversation-compaction summarizer model and give it a fallback model.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置页中选择 DeepSeek Harness 会话压缩摘要模型，并为其配置备用模型。

description.en: Compacts an explicitly chosen span of finished conversation turns into a single summary, with a mandatory approval prompt before applying.
description.zh: 把用户明确指定的一段已完成对话轮次压缩为一条摘要，执行前强制弹出确认提示。

description.en: Indexes local folders into a manually-synced SQLite FTS5 knowledge base with Chinese hybrid retrieval and a Web panel.
description.zh: 将本地文件夹手动同步为 SQLite FTS5 知识库，提供中文混合检索与 Web 面板。

description.en: Compatibility layer for dsh plugins: isolates broken plugin loads, fixes mobile UI glitches, and pre-checks installability with doctor.
description.zh: dsh 插件兼容层：隔离坏插件加载避免白屏，修复移动端弹层透明与动画卡顿，并提供安装前 doctor 体检。

description.en: DSH plugin compatibility vet that warns which plugins will be rejected at next startup and offers one-click isolate/uninstall with backup and rollback.
description.zh: DSH插件兼容性体检：预警下次启动会被拒绝加载的插件，一键隔离或卸载修复，改前自动备份、失败自动回滚。

description.en: Sends native macOS completion notification banners and sound alerts when DSH tasks finish, configured through a Settings UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务完成时发送 macOS 原生通知横幅与声音提醒，并可通过设置界面配置。

description.en: Plays a chime and shows a Windows toast notification whenever a conversation turn finishes in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中，每当一轮对话结束时播放提示音并弹出 Windows 通知。

description.en: Complex-number math toolbox for parsing, arithmetic, polar conversion, principal branches, and roots.
description.zh: 复数数学工具箱，支持解析、运算、极坐标转换、主分支与开方。

description.en: Claude-style element picker for the dsh built-in browser: hover-highlight, pick, and send element props/source with your message.
description.zh: 为 dsh 内置浏览器提供 Claude 风格元素选择器：悬停高亮、拾取元素，并将组件属性与源码随消息一起发送。

description.en: Returns photography composition schemes based on parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数返回摄影构图方案，纯 Node 实现，无需网络。

description.en: UI plugin for DSH that lets the composer scroll to an iPhone home-indicator pill and dock to side gutters via corner arcs.
description.zh: 让 DSH 输入框下滑收起为 iPhone Home 条，拖动左右弧线可将原输入框停靠到两侧留白。

description.en: Adds Tab autocomplete to the DeepSeek Harness composer with inline ghost text, next-message suggestions and early candidate acceptance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加 Tab 自动补全，支持行内幽灵文本、下一条消息建议和提前接受候选。

description.en: A minimal composer chip for DSH that shows your DeepSeek account balance and current-session spend in the host's own visual style.
description.zh: 一个极简的输入框余额标签插件，用宿主原生视觉风格显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话花费。

description.en: Adds a "⋯" button to the DSH composer toolbar that toggles visibility of every plugin-installed control, persisting the choices without uninstalling anything.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏添加「⋯」按钮，逐项勾选显示或隐藏各插件控件，状态自动持久化，仅隐藏不卸载且可一键恢复。

description.en: Manages the DSH Web composer input height with three modes: auto, pinned open, and pinned collapsed.
description.zh: 管理DSH Web输入框高度，支持自动、固定展开、固定收起三种模式。

description.en: Adds auto-pairing, selection wrapping, closer skipping, empty-pair deletion, and a source-labeled autocomplete popup to the DSH web composer.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页输入框增加括号引号自动配对、选中环绕、跳过闭符、删除空对，以及标注词表来源的补全弹层。

description.en: Adds a composer button that grounds your draft in session context, asks about ambiguity, rewrites it with a change list, and refines it in a second pass.
description.zh: 在编辑器中添加 ✨ 按钮，结合会话上下文润色草稿，仅询问真正模糊之处，原地重写并列出修改，再进行第二轮优化。

description.en: Changes the DSH 0.1.5 web composer so Enter inserts a newline and Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter submits the message.
description.zh: 让 DSH 0.1.5 Web 输入框用 Enter 换行，Cmd+Enter 或 Ctrl+Enter 提交消息。

description.en: Portable DSH Web plugin that switches Enter/Shift+Enter behavior in composer textarea, with IME-safe handling.
description.zh: 便携式 DSH Web 插件，用于切换输入框内 Enter 与 Shift+Enter 的按键行为，并兼容输入法组合状态。

description.en: Fixes DSH web GUI composer layout so message scroll region stops above input bar and scrollbar doesn't cover it.
description.zh: 修复 DSH Web GUI 布局，使消息滚动区域止于输入栏上方，滚动条不再覆盖输入区

description.en: Increases the DSH Web composer's minimum text height from two lines (52px) to three lines (76px).
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 输入框的最小高度从两行 52px 提高到三行 76px。

description.en: Adds shell-style input history to the DSH Web composer: ArrowUp recalls sent session messages, ArrowDown restores your draft.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框添加终端风格历史记录：上箭头召回已发送消息，下箭头恢复草稿。

description.en: Lets you freely remap the send and newline keys in the chat input box, with dual presets, saved user settings and theme-aware UI.
description.zh: 为聊天输入框自由自定义「发送」与「换行」键位，支持双预设一键切换、设置持久化与深浅色主题自适应。

description.en: A pure client-side DSH Web plugin adding Markdown editing aids (list continuation, code styling, fence auto-close) to the composer.
description.zh: 纯客户端 DSH Web 插件，为对话编辑器添加 Markdown 编辑辅助功能。

description.en: DSH composer add-on that adds a direct model picker, a draggable reasoning-effort rail, and a toggle to hide the DeepSeek account.
description.zh: DSH 输入框增强插件：提供模型选择、可拖动推理强度条，并可隐藏 DeepSeek 账号。

description.en: Adds a polish button to the composer that rewrites your draft prompt, and lets you cancel back to the original text.
description.zh: 为输入框添加润色按钮，可改写草稿提示词，并可取消恢复原文。

description.en: Adds four persistent composer toolbar buttons (file, goal, plan, feedback) so common actions need no menu expansion.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏常驻文件、目标、计划、反馈四个快捷按钮，免去每次展开菜单的操作。

description.en: Adds a drag handle to resize the DSH web composer taller or shorter, keeping the view bottom-anchored.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页输入框添加拖拽手柄，向上拖动可增高、向下拖动可缩短，并保持视图底部对齐。

description.en: Adds composer input history to the DSH Web UI, restoring earlier text, attachments, references, commands and setup state.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 的输入框增加历史记录，可恢复此前的文本、附件、引用、命令与配置状态。

description.en: Adds a one-box scratchpad pinned to the DSH composer so you can jot down an idea without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁固定一个单框便签，让你随手记录想法而无需发送。

description.en: Adds a screenshot button to the DSH composer that captures the full screen, the screen without this window, or a hand-picked area straight into the message draft.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加截图按钮，可截取全屏、隐藏本窗口的屏幕或手选区域，并直接插入消息草稿。

description.en: Real-time token counter for DSH web GUI composer that shows token usage, estimates, and context breakdowns.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 输入框实时 token 计数插件，显示token用量与估算。

description.en: Composer enhancements for DeepSeek Harness: mixed file/folder picker, GenUI prompt toggle, Markdown source/view switch and user-message Markdown rendering.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框增强：文件/文件夹混合选择器、GenUI 提示词开关、Markdown 源码/预览切换及用户消息 Markdown 渲染。

description.en: Provides a knowledge base of composition rules (rule of thirds, symmetry, leading lines) to assist visual and interface design decisions.
description.zh: @{name=dsh-composition; version=0.1.0; description=构图法则参考：摄影、绘画与界面布局通用的构图知识库（三分法、对称、引导线等），辅助画面与界面设计决策; type=module; main=lib/index.js; exports=; files=System.Object[]; dsh=; keywords=System.Object[];

description.en: Records solved project issues for DeepSeek Harness, enables Chinese search over them, and flags entries to re-verify when related code changes.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的轻量级 Compound Engineering 插件，记录项目解决经验，支持中文检索，并在相关代码变化时提示重新核验。

description.en: Provides image compression, conversion, optimization, and inspection MCP tools for DeepSeek Harness via api.compressio.cc.
description.zh: Image compression & conversion MCP tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Compress/convert/optimize/inspect images via api.compressio.cc — free 20 calls/day, pro key on Ko-fi.

description.en: Provides Linux X11 computer-use (screenshot, mouse, keyboard) for DeepSeek Harness via a zero-dependency Python XTest helper.
description.zh: 通过零依赖Python XTest助手，为DeepSeek Harness提供Linux X11计算机操作能力（截屏、鼠标、键盘）。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness native Windows GUI control via one `computer` tool for screen capture, UIA tree inspection, mouse/keyboard input and app launching.
description.zh: 通过单个 `computer` 工具为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Windows GUI 控制，支持屏幕截图、UIA 树读取、鼠标键盘输入与启动应用。

description.en: Windows computer-use agent that observes screen and UI state, plans and executes actions, confirms risky steps, and keeps an undoable audit trail.
description.zh: Windows 电脑操作智能体：观察屏幕与控件状态、规划并执行操作，高危动作弹窗确认，并保留可撤销的审计记录。

description.en: Community-fix fork of dsh-computer-use adding an independent virtual cursor, Chromium CDP channel, persistent MCP engine channel and element-first clicking across 13 tools.
description.zh: dsh-computer-use 的社区修复分支，提供独立虚拟光标、Chromium CDP 通道、常驻 MCP 引擎通道与元素优先点击，共 13 个工具。

description.en: Background-first macOS cross-application desktop tools for DeepSeek Harness, with hidden agent cursor and post-action observations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 后台优先跨应用桌面工具，支持隐藏代理光标并在操作后提供观察结果。

description.en: Estimates concurrency demand: calculates requirements based on parameters and returns detailed results; pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数计算并返回详细的并发需求估算结果，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Calculates cone geometry (volume, surface area) with a pure Node implementation, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 用纯 Node 实现、无网络依赖的圆锥几何计算，可计算体积和表面积。

description.en: Sidebar plugin to export/import ~/.dsh configuration backups with sensitive-field redaction and pre-restore snapshots.
description.zh: 侧边栏插件，可一键导出或导入 ~/.dsh 配置备份，涵盖设置、profile、SSH、预设、皮肤和看板，支持敏感字段脱敏及恢复前自动快照

description.en: Exports selected DSH configuration to a zip and restores it on a new machine with a conflict preview.
description.zh: 将选定的 DSH 配置导出为 zip 压缩包，并在新机器上恢复，同时提供冲突预览。

description.en: An evidence layer for DSH configuration provenance, verifying redacted source ownership and precedence to produce a reproducible receipt.
description.zh: 为 DSH 配置溯源提供证据层，校验脱敏后的来源归属与优先级，并生成可复现的回执。

description.en: Export and import a DSH Desktop configuration — plugins, settings, MCP entries and user skills — with credentials excluded.
description.zh: 导出和导入 DSH Desktop 配置，包括插件、设置、MCP 条目和用户技能，凭据不会被导出。

description.en: Creates snapshots, diffs and safe rollbacks for DSH configuration, with automatic pre-restore snapshots and credentials excluded by default.
description.zh: 为 DSH 配置创建快照、对比差异并安全回滚，恢复前自动生成安全快照，默认排除凭据。

description.en: Records environment config changes over time by snapshotting DSH profile and plugin files, providing an audit timeline.
description.zh: 对 DSH 的配置文件和插件状态生成快照并记录变化，提供配置漂移审计时间线。

description.en: Syncs DSH config, model providers, plugin inventory and configs, secrets and MCP servers across devices via Git, WebDAV or S3-compatible storage, without storing plugin code.
description.zh: 通过 Git、WebDAV 或 S3 兼容存储跨设备同步 DSH 配置、模型 provider、插件清单与配置、密钥和 MCP，且不存储插件代码。

description.en: Confirm mode for dsh: user approves task-level permission grants; background observer detects and reports drift.
Detects DeepSeek Harness plugin conflicts and internal issues; manage plugins from a settings page.
description.zh: 检测 DeepSeek Harness 插件冲突与内部问题，并可在设置页启用、禁用或卸载插件。

description.en: A conflict resolution tool that returns structured methods based on the scenario, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据冲突场景返回结构化化解方法的工具，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Provides country data for the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a pure Node implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 提供刚果民主共和国国家数据，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Connects a locally logged-in AtomCode CLI to DSH as an independent second opinion that reviews your code with a different model and context.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 AtomCode CLI 接入 DSH，用另一套模型和上下文为代码提供独立的第二意见审核。

description.en: Connect a locally signed-in MiniMax Code account to DeepSeek Harness through a loopback reverse proxy, with no API key storage or sign-out.
description.zh: 通过本地回环反向代理，将已登录的 MiniMax Code 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需存储 API 密钥或退出登录。

description.en: ModelScope provider for DeepSeek Harness: registers models via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, shows remaining Magicubes balance, and stores tokens securely.
description.zh: 魔搭社区（ModelScope）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件：注册模型路由、对话栏显示剩余魔粒、令牌安全存储。

description.en: Connects the locally logged-in Qoder CN desktop app to DeepSeek Harness, making its models available with zero configuration.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 Qoder 国内版桌面 App 接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置即可使用其模型。

description.en: Connects the QPCM OpenAI-compatible gateway (ai.qpcmqam.cn) as a DSH model source, with a panel for Base URL, API key, and model choice.
description.zh: 将 QPCM 的 OpenAI 兼容网关（ai.qpcmqam.cn）接入为 DSH 模型源，并提供 Base URL、API Key 和模型选择设置面板。

description.en: Connects locally logged-in SCNet supercomputing-client models into DeepSeek Harness, with per-model toggles, image history replay and built-in diagnostics.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的超算互联网（SCNet）客户端模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持逐模型勾选启用、图片历史回放与内置诊断。

description.en: Turns Tabbit browser model quota into a built-in local model gateway for DeepSeek Harness, with CN/Global accounts, 20+ models and token stats.
description.zh: 把 Tabbit 浏览器的模型额度变成 DSH 内置网关，支持国内版/国际版账号池、20+ 模型、额度与 Token 统计。

description.en: Connects China Telecom TeleAI's Xingchen super-agent as an LLM provider in DSH using a corrected v1 HMAC-SHA256 cloud gateway signature.
description.zh: 将中国电信天翼AI「星辰超级智能体」作为模型提供方接入DSH，使用已修正的v1两轮HMAC-SHA256云网关签名。

description.en: Walks a construction project's document archive, reading filenames only, to report missing required document types, stale revisions, and empty files.
description.zh: 扫描施工项目资料目录，仅读取文件名，报告缺失的规定资料类型、疑似过期版本以及空文件。

description.en: Consumer loan monthly payment calculator that computes exact payments from parameters and returns detailed results.
Model-driven archiving of long tool results into session folders, leaving recoverable stubs in context.
description.zh: 模型驱动的工具结果归档：将长结果存入会话文件夹，并在上下文中保留可恢复存根。

description.en: Local-first context notes and todos for DeepSeek Harness, with optional macOS foreground-window companion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的上下文笔记与待办事项，并可选配 macOS 前台窗口伴侣。

description.en: Sidebar dashboard showing live context-window usage, per-session spend, account balance and token-plan quota across LLM channels.
description.zh: 侧边栏仪表盘，实时显示上下文用量、每会话花费、账户余额及各渠道的套餐配额。

description.en: Adds a settings page to set a model's context window, applied on the next DSH start.
description.zh: 添加设置页面以配置模型的上下文窗口，并在下次启动 DSH 时生效。

description.en: Elides stale, oversized tool results from the model-visible session context and shows the token savings in the composer footer.
description.zh: 从模型可见的会话上下文中剔除过期、过大的工具结果，并在输入框底栏显示节省的 token。

description.en: Groups skills and tools into toggleable domains, with a bar under the session header to switch whole domains on or off at once.
description.zh: 把 skill 和 tool 归为一个「领域」，在会话头下方的一条横条里一键整块开关。

description.en: Archives older conversation messages into per-conversation folders once context usage hits a threshold, freeing model-visible context.
description.zh: 当上下文占用达到阈值时，把较早的消息归档到该对话对应的文件夹，并释放模型可见的上下文。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a composer context meter and a one-click reasoning effort switcher to the chat UI.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在聊天界面添加输入框上下文用量指示器和一键推理强度切换器。

description.en: Context management plugin for DeepSeek Harness that compresses long AI coding sessions and persists task state to avoid information loss after /compact.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定制，压缩长时编程会话上下文并持久化任务状态，避免 /compact 后信息丢失。

description.en: Visualizes the context a Session sends to its model in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — system prompt, tool schemas and every message — as a token grid.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中以 token 方格网格展示会话发送给模型的上下文：系统提示词、工具 schema 与全部消息。

description.en: Turns long raw documents like financial reports, contracts and ledgers into dense structured Markdown and JSON with key metrics, tables, clauses and entities.
description.zh: 将财报、合同、账本等长篇原始文档提取压缩为结构化 Markdown 与 JSON，包含关键指标、表格、条款与实体。

description.en: Token-efficient tool-result pruning for DeepSeek Harness with compact previews and targeted recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 精简工具调用结果以节省 token，提供紧凑预览、定向召回和长会话上下文控制。

description.en: Helps a DeepSeek Harness agent reason well, monitor its context budget, and hand off long sessions, with an offline trace analyzer.
description.zh: 帮助 DeepSeek Harness 智能体更好地推理、监控上下文预算并交接长会话，附带离线轨迹分析器。

description.en: Profiles request context changes and cache reuse between model requests in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的请求上下文分析工具，查看模型请求之间上下文的变化，以及缓存复用随之发生的变化。

description.en: Read-only sidebar timeline that shows what context the model carried each turn, where it came from, and whether history was kept verbatim or compacted.
description.zh: 只读上下文侧栏，用时间线与来源展示模型每轮携带了什么上下文、来自何处，以及历史以原文还是摘要保留。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows a context panel with skills, rules, and files used in the current conversation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在布局左/右区域展示当前对话使用的技能、规则和文件

description.en: Rescues DSH sessions that overflow the model context window by folding the oldest history into a durable digest and retrying the same step.
description.zh: 为上下文爆窗的 DSH 会话叫救护车：识别溢出、把最老历史折叠成结构化摘要，并原步重试，让会话继续。

description.en: Adds per-row context checkboxes and right-click 'Ask AI' on documents or selections to control what context is sent.
description.zh: 为每行上下文添加勾选框，并支持右键对文档或选中内容“Ask AI”，以控制发送的上下文。

description.en: Adds a one-click sidebar action that compresses a long DSH conversation into a durable summary, freeing up context window space.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏提供一键归纳功能，把过长的对话压缩成一段可长期保存的摘要，释放上下文占用。

description.en: Colors the DSH context meter ring and percentage by occupancy tier, adds a tier emoji, and lets you edit thresholds, colors and emoji in settings.
description.zh: 按上下文占用档位为上下文胶囊的圆环和百分比改色，右侧显示档位 emoji，并可在配置页修改分界值、颜色与 emoji。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets an agent read its own context usage: a context_usage tool, a per-turn readout line, and a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 插件，让 Agent 读到自己的上下文占用：context_usage 工具、每轮读数行与设置页。

description.en: Gives one session-level verdict on whether compacting a DeepSeek Harness context would discard unlanded state.
description.zh: 给出单一会话级判定：压缩 DeepSeek Harness 上下文是否会丢失未落盘状态。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped context window selector to DSH's model picker, letting users temporarily switch contextWindow per session.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型选择弹窗中为当前会话临时切换上下文窗口大小，新建会话自动恢复默认值。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that resumes every session halted by an unexpected exit in a single click.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件，一键恢复所有因意外退出而中断的会话。

description.en: Adds an editable one-click send button beside the DSH composer that immediately submits its preset text, defaulting to “继续”.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框右侧添加可编辑的一键发送按钮，点击即发送其文本，默认为「继续」。

description.en: Adds a /continue command and an action-row button that manually resume an interrupted DSH conversation right where it stopped.
description.zh: 提供 /continue 命令和操作栏按钮，可手动从中断处继续被中断的 DSH 对话。

description.en: Warn-only checker that validates DSH plugin contracts, verifying output.render() and session-event vocabulary at zero token cost.
description.zh: 零 token 成本的只告警检查器，校验 DSH 插件的 output.render() 与 session-event 词汇契约。

description.en: Shows per-conversation DeepSeek API cost as a badge in the dsh conversation header.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页对话头部显示当前对话的 DeepSeek API 费用徽章，按高峰与低谷时段定价计算，悬停可看明细。

description.en: Tracks model pricing and shows estimated per-answer and per-conversation costs inside DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 自动获取模型定价，并在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 中显示每条回答与会话的费用估算。

description.en: Estimates DeepSeek model API costs per conversation and per turn, showing token usage and spend inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按对话和轮次估算 DeepSeek 模型费用，展示 token 用量与花费。

description.en: Adds a browser-style Ctrl+F find bar to the DSH main window that highlights all matches and jumps between them.
description.zh: 为 DSH 主界面添加类似浏览器 Ctrl+F 的查找条，高亮全部匹配并逐条跳转。

description.en: Turns the Conversation view into a draggable floating panel that can be stowed in the sidebar drawer, centred, or docked in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 将会话视图变为可拖拽的浮动面板，可拖至左侧收纳、居中显示或停靠到右侧边栏。

description.en: Adds a folder hierarchy, search, and archiving for conversations in the DeepSeek harness sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek 侧边栏的对话添加文件夹层级、搜索和归档功能。

description.en: Adds a History tab to DeepSeek Harness for cross-session keyword search of past conversations with in-place context reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加历史标签页，可跨会话关键词搜索过往对话并在原位阅读上下文。

description.en: Imports local Codex conversation threads into a DSH Session, preserving the original working directory with optional auto-sync.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex 对话线程导入 DSH 会话，保留原始工作目录并可选自动同步。

description.en: Adds four floating circular buttons to the DSH Web conversation for jumping to top, previous/next user message, and bottom, auto-handling older history paging.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 对话区添加四个悬浮圆形按钮，可回到顶部、上一条/下一条用户消息、回到底部，并自动处理更早历史分页。

description.en: Adds a floating right-side navigation rail for DSH conversations, showing user question timeline with jump-to-message and auto-highlight.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话添加右侧浮动导航条，显示用户提问时间线，支持跳转到对应消息并自动高亮。

description.en: Reflows conversation text and Markdown table cells to fit the available width between sidebars while keeping font size and scrolling.
description.zh: 让会话文字与 Markdown 表格单元格适应侧栏之间的可用宽度，并保留原字号与滚动。

description.en: DSH web plugin that adds keyboard shortcuts for conversation interactions.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，为会话交互添加键盘快捷键。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar switch that toggles the assistant between entertainment and professional conversation styles.
description.zh: 在左侧边栏添加开关，可在娱乐与专业两种对话风格之间切换助手。

description.en: Adds in-conversation search, up-arrow recall with attachments, plus regenerate and continue controls for DeepSeek Harness chats.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话增加会话内搜索、带附件的上箭头历史召回，以及重新生成和继续生成功能。

description.en: Adds reversible conversation deletion with a 30-day trash, undo and restore for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可恢复的对话删除功能，包含 30 天回收站、撤销与恢复。

description.en: Organises DSH conversations into a collapsible workspace/topic tree and opens the real sessions in place.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话按工作区与主题组织成可折叠的对话树，并就地打开真实会话。

description.en: Locks the DSH Web UI conversation column width to a fixed pixel value or a percentage of the window, with a mode selector in Settings → General.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 界面对话框内容列宽度锁定为固定像素值或窗口比例，设置项位于 设置 → 通用。

description.en: Real-time token usage and cost tracking for current DeepSeek conversation, shown in the chat status line.
description.zh: 在聊天状态栏实时显示当前 DeepSeek 对话的 token 用量与费用。

description.en: Tracks today's and cumulative per-conversation spending in CNY and USD using official peak/off-peak pricing.
description.zh: 按官方峰谷价目逐次统计每个对话的今日和累计花费，支持人民币与美元双币。

description.en: 菜谱盒子 · 373 道家常菜谱（HowToCook 数据，Unlicense），DeepSeek Harness 插件：Web 面板 + recipe_* 工具，按食材反查、每日推荐、收藏与做过标记。
Caps DeepSeek Harness desktop auth session cookies at 3 so random-port buildup no longer triggers HTTP 431 on startup.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的 dsh auth 会话 cookie 限制在 3 条以内，避免随机端口累积后启动时报 HTTP 431 错误。

description.en: Clears accumulated DSH login cookies so oversized request headers stop locking the Web UI out with 431 errors.
description.zh: 清理 DSH 累积的登录 Cookie，避免请求头超过 16KB 后 Web UI 因 431 错误永久打不开。

description.en: Expires stale dsh auth sign-in cookies so the Cookie request header stays under Node's 16 KiB limit and avoids HTTP 431 errors.
description.zh: 清理过期的 dsh 登录 Cookie，使 Cookie 请求头不超过 Node 的 16 KiB 限制，避免出现 HTTP 431 错误。

description.en: Keeps the DSH web UI browser session alive by sliding-renewing its session cookie, shipped as a DSH host plugin bundle.
description.zh: 通过滑动续期会话 Cookie 保持 DSH Web UI 浏览器会话不过期，以 DSH 宿主插件包形式发布。

description.en: Syncs cookies from Microsoft Edge to the DSH sidebar browser so supported sites keep you logged in.
description.zh: 将 Microsoft Edge 的 Cookie 同步到 DSH 侧边栏浏览器，让支持的网站保持登录状态，避免重复登录。

description.en: Adds Git management to the DSH session tab bar, covering commit, pull, push, branch, and diff operations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标签栏中加入 Git 管理，支持提交、拉取、推送、分支和差异查看。

description.en: Terminal plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stays in sync with the Workspace in real time, with isolated terminals sharing no history.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端插件，与工作区实时同步，各终端相互隔离并保留独立命令历史。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin centered on the chemical element Copernicium.
description.zh: 一个以化学元素鎶（Copernicium）为主题的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Adds Copilot-style inline diffs to every file edit, with per-turn Keep/Undo summaries and single-edit undo.
description.zh: 为每次文件编辑添加 Copilot 风格的行内差异，并提供按轮次的保留/撤销摘要和单次编辑撤销。

description.en: Turns the laptop's Copilot hardware key into a launch/wake shortcut for DeepSeek Harness using a custom key hook plus a DSH manager plugin.
description.zh: 通过自研按键钩子与 DSH 管理器插件，把笔记本 Copilot 硬件键变成启动/唤起 DeepSeek Harness 的快捷键。

description.en: Shows the signed-in account's remaining GitHub Copilot chat, completion and AI-credit quota next to the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁显示已登录账号的 GitHub Copilot 剩余聊天、补全与 AI 额度。

description.en: Enhances DSH computer-use agents with pure-JS visual diffing, grid position encoding, long-range task closure, and human-in-the-loop authorization.
description.zh: 为 DSH 计算机使用代理提供纯 JS 视觉差分、网格位置编码、长程任务闭环与人机共驾授权增强。

description.en: Plugin for the copper element (铜元素), with no README details.
description.zh: 铜元素插件，无README详情。

description.en: Adds a one-click whole-document copy button to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar editor header, placed right of Save.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏编辑器标题栏的保存按钮右侧添加一键复制整篇文档的按钮。

description.en: Adds a one-click copy button to the DSH sidebar document preview that copies a file's text, or its path for binary files.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏文档预览中添加一键复制按钮，复制文件文本，二进制文件则复制其路径。

description.en: Fixes DSH Desktop copy buttons by bridging clipboard writes to the Electron main process.
description.zh: 修复 DSH Desktop 的复制按钮，将剪贴板写入桥接到 Electron 主进程。

description.en: Replaces the built-in lightbox with an image viewer that can copy images to the clipboard, save them, zoom and page through them.
description.zh: 用带复制、保存、缩放和翻页功能的图片查看器替换内置灯箱，可将对话中的任意图片直接复制到剪贴板。

description.en: Returns calligraphy learning plans based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回对应的书法字帖学习计划，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: DSH line-copy plugin that copies selected line ranges and supports insert/replace with preview.
description.zh: DSH 行选择复制插件，支持范围复制、插入/替换与预览。

description.en: A Cornell-style notebook theme for DSH web UI with local-first notes panel and task lists.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供康奈尔笔记风格主题，自带本地优先的笔记面板与任务列表。

description.en: Bridges the official COROS MCP server with a built-in stdio-to-HTTP bridge and on-device OAuth, exposing 34 fitness and training tools.
description.zh: 通过内置 stdio 转 HTTP 桥接与本地 OAuth 登录，接入官方 COROS MCP 服务，提供 34 个运动与训练数据工具。

description.en: Logs into your COROS account inside the DSH desktop app to show devices, workouts, recovery, fitness and daily health data, and can create a 4-week plan.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端内登录高驰（COROS）账号，查看设备、运动记录、恢复与体能状态和每日健康数据，并可创建四周跑步计划。

description.en: Correlation coefficient plugin for dsh.
description.zh: 用于 dsh 的相关系数插件

description.en: Provides cosmetic shelf-life recommendations based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数给出化妆品保质期建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: DSH Web GUI theme plugin that derives a whole color scheme from one picked color, with per-region recoloring and image/stardust backgrounds.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 打造的主题插件：选一个颜色即可自动推导整套同色系配色，支持分区换色、图片背景与星尘装饰。

description.en: Shows per-segment session cost in the composer statistics strip, priced from the harness model catalog (41 providers, ~1495 models).
description.zh: 在编辑器统计栏中按会话分段显示成本，价格来自包含 41 个提供商、约 1495 个模型的模型目录。

description.en: Adds a composer chip showing conversation spend and account balance, plus a token-usage breakdown panel.
description.zh: 在输入框添加显示会话花费与账户余额的芯片，并提供令牌用量明细面板。

description.en: DSH session cost billing plugin showing account balance, peak/off-peak pricing, and per-session spend breakdown in the input bar and sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 会话费用账单插件：展示账号余额、峰谷计价，以及每个会话（含子代理衍生会话）的消耗构成，输入框与侧栏双入口。

description.en: Compact chip showing this session's and today's DeepSeek spend, cost breakdown by cache hit/miss and output tokens, plus account balance.
description.zh: 一个紧凑药丸，显示本会话和今日的 DeepSeek 花费、缓存命中/未命中与输出 token 的成本构成，以及账户余额。

description.en: Adds a per-session RMB cost readout to the DSH composer, priced with DeepSeek peak/off-peak tariffs and a click-open detail panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入栏加上按会话记账的人民币成本读数，按 DeepSeek 峰谷定价计费，点击可看明细面板。

description.en: Estimates the CNY cost of DSH token usage per turn and per session, with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing and a subagent cost breakdown.
description.zh: 估算 DSH token 用量的人民币成本，支持按回合和会话统计，包含 DeepSeek 峰谷定价与子代理成本明细。

description.en: Displays real-time DeepSeek session cost estimates and account balance in the DSH Web GUI status bar.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 底部状态栏显示 DeepSeek 会话费用估算和账户余额，按官方实时定价按会话与模型计费。

description.en: Displays the session's estimated DeepSeek API cost in the composer token-usage pill and prices usage-dialog buckets at peak/off-peak CNY rates.
description.zh: 在输入框用量胶囊中显示会话预估费用，并按 DeepSeek 峰谷人民币价格标注用量对话框中的各桶费用。

description.en: Shows the current DSH session's estimated cost in CNY in the composer dock, with a receipt-style breakdown and account balance.
description.zh: 在输入区显示当前 DSH 会话的预估人民币费用，并提供收据式明细和账户余额。

description.en: Local DeepSeek Harness panel that estimates token cost with real BPE and shows streaming TPS, first-token latency and context usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地计费与速度面板，按真实 BPE 估算 token 成本，并显示流式 TPS、首字延迟与上下文占用。

description.en: Shows per-turn USD costs in DeepSeek Harness chat, with a Cost tab of charts, ratings, interactive spend timeline, and a local editable price table.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness聊天中显示每轮对话的美元成本，并提供成本标签页，包含图表、评分、交互式支出时间线和可编辑的本地价格表。

description.en: DSH sidebar cost tracker showing total/project spend, token details, and auto-updated DeepSeek RMB pricing.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏显示任务总花费、当前项目花费和 token 明细，按 DeepSeek 官方人民币单价自动更新，重启后恢复数据。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API cost tracking plugin with floating panel, balance management, and persistence.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek API 费用的插件，带悬浮面板、余额管理和数据持久化。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance and per-session usage cost, priced from provider-reported token usage, in the composer dock.
description.zh: 在编辑器停靠栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和每次会话的用量费用，按供应商上报的 token 用量计价。

description.en: Plays a bundled "payment received" voice clip announcing each round's estimated AI cost, with queueing, mute hours and amount thresholds.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束用内置「大白饭到账」语音播报本轮估算花费，支持排队播放、静音时段和金额阈值。

description.en: Provides a pure Node implementation of Costa Rica country data without network dependencies.
description.zh: 用纯 Node 实现提供哥斯达黎加国家数据，无需网络依赖

description.en: Appends a per-turn ¥ token cost estimate to assistant message metadata, using DSH token usage and DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在助手消息元数据行追加本轮 token 费用估算（¥），基于 DSH 记录的用量和 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲两档单价。

description.en: Improves streaming reasoning (thinking) text display with incremental segmentation, finalized-paragraph memoization and light typographic cleanup.
description.zh: 通过增量分段、已完成段落记忆化和轻量排版清理，优化流式推理（思考）文本的显示效果。

description.en: Translates expanded chain-of-thought reasoning into your interface language using HTTP translation site templates or DSH/OpenAI-compatible model providers.
description.zh: 把展开的思维链内容翻译成界面语言，支持任意 HTTP 翻译站点模板或 DSH/OpenAI 兼容模型提供商。

description.en: A pure Node.js countdown timer plugin with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的倒计时定时器插件，不依赖网络。

description.en: Keeps track of birthdays, anniversaries and repayment days inside DSH with Gregorian/lunar dates, repeats, categories, pinning and reminders.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内记录生日、纪念日和还款日的倒数日插件，支持公历/农历、重复、分类、置顶和提醒。

description.en: Calculates counter height from parameters and returns detailed results.
A couple communication tool that returns structured methods for different scenarios.
description.zh: 情侣沟通工具，针对不同场景返回结构化方法。

description.en: A Node.js tool that judges/optimizes coupons by exact parameter calculation, returning detailed results offline.
description.zh: 基于精确参数计算判断和优化优惠券的 Node.js 工具，可离线返回详细结果。

description.en: Calculates after-coupon gross profit based on provided parameters, returns detailed results, pure Node implementation, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据传入参数计算使用优惠券后的毛利并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: DSH plugin packaging the courseware skill and pptxgen engine to build template-styled .pptx lesson decks from an outline file.
description.zh: 将 courseware 技能与 pptxgen 引擎打包为 DSH 插件，用自有 .pptx 模板和大纲文件生成套用模板样式的课件。

description.en: Imperial-court-style multi-agent pipeline for DSH: decree triage, drafting, review, parallel ministry dispatch and audit, with resumable runs and token budgets.
description.zh: 朝堂式多智能体流水线：圣旨分拣、中书拟敕、门下审覆、六部并行办案、御史按劾，支持断点续跑与 token 计度。

description.en: Computes the covariance between two datasets.
description.zh: 计算两个数据集之间的协方差。

description.en: Calculates insurance coverage and generates a family insurance plan based on input parameters.
Cyberpunk 2077 theme for DeepSeek Harness with NIGHT CITY palette, chamfered HUD panels, CRT scanlines, cyberpunk cursors and Wallpaper Engine backdrops.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的赛博朋克 2077 主题，包含夜之城配色、切角 HUD 面板、CRT 扫描线、赛博光标与壁纸引擎动态背景。

description.en: CPR tool that returns home first-aid plans based on parameters. Pure Node, no network needed.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回家庭心肺复苏急救方案的纯 Node 工具，无需联网

description.en: CPR first-aid tool that returns scenario-specific emergency steps; pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 心肺复苏急救工具，根据具体场景返回相应的紧急处置步骤，纯 Node 实现，可离线运行。

description.en: Startup crash guard for DSH that isolates broken frontend plugins, prevents white-screen launch crashes, and recovers via revision-bound quarantine.
description.zh: DSH 启动崩溃防护插件，隔离损坏的前端插件，避免白屏启动崩溃，并通过版本绑定的隔离区干净恢复。

description.en: Turns an MLIR crash into a reproducible command, minimal IR, failing pass, sanitizer stack and a handoff report.
description.zh: 把一次 MLIR 崩溃转化为可复现命令、最小 IR、出错 pass、sanitizer 栈和可转交报告。

description.en: A decorative DSH overlay where 1111-form crawler bugs crawl across the interface, eat words, grow and spin silk — purely visual, no content changes.
description.zh: 一个纯视觉的 DSH 装饰插件：1111 种形态的小虫在界面上爬行、吃词、长大、结丝，不会修改任何内容。

description.en: DSH browser automation plugin with API-first web operations, live preview, human takeover, uploads/downloads, verification, and reusable workflows.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的独立浏览器自动化插件，支持 API 优先网页操作、实时预览、人工接管、上传下载、业务核验与可复用工作流。

description.en: Preview and clean CSV, Excel, and JSON files in DSH with overviews, filtering, deduplication, sorting, conversion, and export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中预览和清洗 CSV、Excel、JSON 文件，支持数据概览、筛选去重、排序转换与表格导出。

description.en: Generates Word/PowerPoint files, extracts text and validates OOXML, running standalone without Python or a backend.
description.zh: 生成 Word/PowerPoint 文档、提取文本并校验 OOXML，独立运行，无需 Python 或后端。

description.en: Launches a throwaway clean DSH clone, installs the plugin under test, then verifies its frontend boots in a headless browser before touching the main client.
description.zh: 在临时纯净 DSH 分身中安装待测插件，用无头浏览器验证前端能否正常启动，确认后再装入本体，避免弄崩客户端。

description.en: Adds a DSH settings panel that lists credential refs with their status and lets you add, overwrite or delete them via token-guarded writes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增凭据面板，列出凭据引用名及状态，并支持经令牌校验的新增、覆盖与删除。

description.en: Recomputes redacted settlement verdicts from receipts to prove credential retirement without exposing secrets.
description.zh: Evidence-only DSH plugin for credential retirement settlement

description.en: Local AES-256-GCM encrypted vault for passwords and API tokens, unlocked by master password in the Web UI or read by agents via vaultctl.
description.zh: 本地 AES-256-GCM 加密凭证库，保存密码与 API Token，网页端用主密码解锁，Agent 可通过 vaultctl 读取。

description.en: DSH settings-page plugin to list, add, overwrite and delete long-term credential refs in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml, write-only values.
description.zh: DSH 设置页插件：列出、新增、覆盖、删除 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 中的长期凭据 refs，值只进不出。

description.en: Credit card installment calculator: computes installment details precisely from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 信用卡分期计算器：根据参数精确计算分期详情并返回详细结果。

description.en: A plugin entry for Croatia with no detailed functionality described.
Provides crochet basics and handmade DIY solutions based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node.js.
description.zh: 基于输入参数提供钩针基础针法与手工 DIY 方案，使用纯 Node.js 实现。

description.en: Calculates equivalent focal length based on crop factor parameters; pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据裁切系数参数计算等效焦距，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Lets two DSH agents on the same LAN message each other, issue commands and transfer files, gated by peer allowlists and permissions.
description.zh: 让同一局域网内两台 DSH agent 互相通信、互相下达指令并互传文件，受对端放行与权限控制。

description.en: Incremental DSH memory plugin that injects one shared cross-instance RULES.md and repairs broken anchor entries in memory files.
description.zh: 增量式 DSH 记忆插件：跨实例全文注入共用 RULES.md，并修复记忆文件中的锚点结构问题。

description.en: Lets separate DSH conversations message each other at step boundaries, query their master agent, and share read-only context.
description.zh: 让不同的 DSH 会话在步骤边界互相发消息、向主会话提问，并共享只读上下文。

description.en: Drag Q&A cards between DeepSeek Harness sessions and inject them as prompt context when asking.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间拖拽问答卡片，并在提问时将其注入为提示上下文。

description.en: Cross-team collaboration tool that returns structured methods based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 跨部门协作工具，按参数返回结构化方法，纯 Node 实现且无网络依赖。

description.en: Applies CSDN blog color and typography styling to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 CSDN 博文配色与正文排版主题。

description.en: Robust CSV parser in pure Node with no network or external services.
description.zh: 健壮 CSV 解析器

description.en: Converts CSV files to Markdown tables using pure Node.js with no network or external services.
description.zh: 将 CSV 文件转换为 Markdown 表格，纯 Node.js 实现，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.en: A web-based CSV/TSV table viewer for DSH with search, sorting, raw-text mode, and virtualized rows for large files.
description.zh: DSH 网页版 CSV/TSV 表格查看器，支持搜索、排序、原始模式和虚拟滚动行。

description.en: Control plugin for dsh web: restart/shutdown the web process from Settings, plus a pet treat top-up feature.
description.zh: dsh 系统控制插件：可在设置页重启或关闭 dsh web 进程，并为鲸鱼娘宠物补给小鱼干。

description.en: Turns the model context into a visible, editable, effectiveness-scored bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的模型上下文转为可见、可编辑、带效果评分的上下文包。

description.en: Calculates statistical significance of conversion rates from parameters, returning detailed results as a pure Node tool.
description.zh: 根据参数计算转化率的统计显著性，并以纯 Node 工具返回详细结果。

description.en: Click-through rate (CTR) split tool that calculates by parameters and returns detailed results, pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 点击率拆解工具，按参数计算并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Adds Ctrl+wheel page zoom to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with an on-screen zoom chip and a General settings row.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增加 Ctrl+滚轮页面缩放功能，并带有屏幕缩放指示与通用设置项。

description.en: Adds Ctrl/⌘ + mouse-wheel zoom (50%–200%, 10% steps) with keyboard shortcuts and a level chip to the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 Ctrl/⌘ + 滚轮缩放（50%–200%，10% 一档），并配有快捷键和缩放比例提示条。

description.en: Persists a task checkpoint across context compaction and re-injects it into the system prompt so the model keeps working state after each compaction.
description.zh: 在上下文压缩前后保存任务检查点，并在每次压缩后将其重新注入系统提示，让模型保留工作状态。

description.en: Adds a header button to manually compact DSH session context in two levels using local summaries, with no model calls.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加「上下文」按钮，用本地摘要实现两档手动上下文压缩，不调用模型。

description.en: Adds a visible banner, pointer halo and physical Esc kill-switch to DSH's built-in CUA Driver channel, without performing any control actions itself.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置的 Cua Driver 通道增加可见横幅、指针光环和物理 Esc 急停提示层，本身不执行任何控制动作。

description.en: Plugin related to the country of Cuba; no detailed README available.
Calculates cube (立方体) properties in pure Node, no network dependencies, usable via plugin tools.
description.zh: 在纯 Node 中计算立方体属性，无网络依赖，可通过插件工具调用。

description.en: Syncs Cubox bookmarks to Obsidian with scheduled sync, AI daily briefs, and markdown export via DeepSeek Harness CLI.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 的 /c/api/cli 接口把 Cubox 收藏同步到 Obsidian，支持定时同步、按提示模板生成 AI 每日简报，以及单条卡片 Markdown 导出。

description.en: Bisects git history over a failing predicate to find the culprit commit, its diff, and each probe's evidence.
description.zh: 在 Git 历史中二分查找导致失败的提交，并给出该提交的 diff 与每次探测证据。

description.en: Provides tools to list board game entries and look up details by ID or name, with no network dependency.
description.zh: 提供桌游条目列表，可按 ID 或名称查询桌游详情，无需网络连接。

description.en: Provides tools to list and query world festival entries by id or name, offline in Node.
description.zh: 提供按 id 或名称列出和查询世界节日条目的工具，在 Node 中离线运行。

description.en: A DSH mistake-notebook plugin that pins pitfalls, root causes, fixes and prevention rules into prompts so errors aren't repeated.
description.zh: DSH 错题本插件：把坑、根因、解法与预防守则钉进提示词，避免重复犯错。

description.en: Converts cups to milliliters.
description.zh: 将杯（cup）换算为毫升的插件。

description.en: Coffee cupping tool: generates a brewing recipe from parameters, offline pure Node utility.
description.zh: 咖啡杯测工具，可根据参数生成冲煮配方，是离线运行的纯 Node 工具。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop workbench to triage turns, rewrite messages, and compress DeepSeek Harness session history with local backups.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的人类在环上下文整理工作台：分拣轮次、改写消息并压缩会话历史，且本地备份。

description.en: Plugin named dsh-curium; description only says '锔元素' (Curium element), with no README or capability details.
description.zh: 名为 dsh-curium 的插件，描述仅为“锔元素”，未提供 README 或具体功能说明。

description.en: Returns hairstyle management plans based on input parameters, pure Node implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回卷发造型管理方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Currency formatting and conversion, pure Node implementation with no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的货币格式化与换算插件，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.en: Currency usage tips tool that returns clear advice based on parameters, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回货币使用提示的纯 Node 工具，无网络依赖。

description.en: Calculates electrical current from parameters and returns detailed results; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算电流并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Cursor-style chat session management for DSH with live draft titles, empty-draft reuse, and one-click discard.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Cursor 风格会话管理：草稿标题实时预览、空白草稿复用、一键丢弃。

description.en: Cursor-style coding surface for DSH: a pending-files card, side Monaco editor, diff review, and AI-driven edits inside the harness.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Cursor 风格编码界面：待处理文件卡片、侧边 Monaco 编辑器、差异审阅与 AI 编辑。

description.en: 窗帘用量计算工具，按参数精确计算并返回详细结果（行业经验估算）。
Curtain selection tool that returns home furnishing matching schemes based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回家居窗帘搭配方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness sidebar brand slot with your own icon and text via a JSON config file and a page refresh.
description.zh: 通过修改一个 JSON 文件并刷新页面，将 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏品牌位替换为你自己的图标和文字。

description.en: Adds a Connectors page to DSH where you paste MCP JSON to add, disable, reconnect or delete MCP servers and view status and tool counts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏新增“连接器”页面，粘贴标准 MCP JSON 即可添加、停用、重连或删除 MCP 服务器，并查看连接状态与工具数量。
