description.en: DSH web settings extension that adds a Model capabilities section for editing per-model image input support and reasoning effort mapping.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页扩展，在 Models 之后新增「模型能力」分区，可逐模型编辑图片输入支持与 reasoning effort 映射。

description.en: A DSH web GUI style customization plugin with live CSS editing, click-to-style element picker, design tokens, density controls and shareable presets.
description.zh: DSH 网页端界面样式自定义插件，支持实时 CSS 编辑、点选元素改样式、设计令牌、界面密度调节与配置分享。

description.en: Imports tweakcn CSS themes into DeepSeek Harness, adding light/dark palettes, wallpapers and an optional liquid-glass input style.
description.zh: 将 tweakcn CSS 主题引入 DeepSeek Harness，提供明暗配色、壁纸以及可选的液态玻璃输入框效果。

description.en: Author Python tools in the Web UI or via agent tools, register them as first-class DSH tools, and gate dangerous runs with approval.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 或通过智能体工具编写 Python 工具，将其注册为一流 DSH 工具，并用审批机制管控危险运行。

description.en: Uses a custom OpenAI-compatible vision model to describe images and understand charts, screenshots, UI and OCR within DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用自定义 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型描述图片，并理解图表、截图、UI 和 OCR 内容。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness patch plugin for small independent fixes, starting with a guard against currency dollars being parsed as inline math.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 小型独立修复插件，首个功能是防止货币美元符号被误解析为行内数学公式。

description.en: Provides plant care and cutting propagation plans based on input parameters.
A fully local DeepSeek Harness plugin that awards merit for each agent tool call, counts failures as tribulations, and adds I-Ching coin divination.
description.zh: 一个完全本地的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：每次智能体工具调用积累功德，失败记为劫难，并提供金钱卦占卜与功德账本。

description.en: CyberOps runtime for DeepSeek Harness adding per-chat masked /cyber and authorized /cyber-2 routes with a Red Team toggle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 CyberOps 运行时，按会话启用遮罩的 /cyber 与授权的 /cyber-2 路由，并带红队开关。

description.en: Syncs DSH memory, skills, plugin settings, tasks and workspaces across devices via a folder or WebDAV, with optional AES-256-GCM passphrase encryption.
description.zh: 通过文件夹或 WebDAV 在设备间同步 DSH 的记忆、技能、插件设置、任务与工作区，可选 AES-256-GCM 口令加密。

description.en: Water cycling tool for aquariums: returns maintenance plans based on parameters.
description.zh: 水族箱水循环工具：根据参数返回维护计划。

description.en: Calculates cylinder geometry (volume, surface area) with a pure Node.js implementation, requiring no network.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现，无需联网，计算圆柱的体积和表面积。

description.en: Plugin described only as 'Cyprus country'; purpose is unspecified.
A plugin related to the Czech Republic (Czechia).
description.zh: 与捷克（Czechia）相关的插件，提供与捷克有关的信息或功能。

description.en: Cloudflare D1 database tools for dsh: read-only first, approval-gated writes, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为dsh提供Cloudflare D1数据库工具：默认只读，写入需审批，零运行时依赖。

description.en: A standalone blue-whale desktop pet for DSH with 104 animations and TTS voice that reacts to your DSH activity.
description.zh: 独立的蓝色鲸鱼娘桌宠，自带 104 个动作与语音，会跟随 DSH 的工作状态切换动画。

description.en: Connects your Agent to the 搭个伴 collaboration platform: email login, browse categories and hot posts, search listings, save drafts and publish posts.
description.zh: 将 Agent 接入「搭个伴」合作平台：邮箱登录、查看类别与热帖、搜索帖子、保存草稿并发布。

description.en: Aggregates feeds, social, media, game servers, mail and calendars into persona-rendered daily briefs with a scheduled Windows popup.
description.zh: 聚合社媒、RSS、视频、游戏、邮箱和日历，按人格生成每日简报并定时在 Windows 桌面弹窗。

description.en: Calculates daily calorie requirements from parameters, returning detailed estimates (not medical advice).
Monitors the DSH marketplace registry and watched pages on a schedule, reporting only newly added plugins and new activity periods after a baseline run.
description.zh: 定时监控 DSH 插件市场与关注页面，首次运行建立基线，之后仅报告新增插件和新活动时段。

description.en: Tracks daily check-ins and per-model token/cost usage with a durable ledger for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每日签到，并按天、按模型持久记录 token 用量与费用。

description.en: Returns a calligraphy learning plan for daily practice based on parameters; pure Node.js implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回每日书法练习计划，纯 Node.js 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Daily tarot plugin for DeepSeek Harness: real Waite cards, 3D flip animation, random upright/reversed, up to 10 draws a day.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 每日塔罗插件：真实韦特牌面、3D 翻牌、随机正逆位，每天最多抽 10 次。

description.en: Daily todo board for DeepSeek Harness with Work and Life sections, checkbox completion and automatic midnight archiving.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的每日待办看板，分工作/生活两段，支持勾选完成并在零点自动归档。

description.en: Provides dance training plans based on input parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成舞蹈基本功训练计划，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Selects a dance style and returns a structured dance learning plan based on input parameters.
Dance learning planner that generates a dance study plan based on input parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成学舞计划的纯 Node 工具，不联网。

description.en: Dance warmup tool that provides dance learning plans based on parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数生成舞蹈学习与热身计划的工具，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness permission preset where the conversation's own model reviews each sandbox-escalation request instead of asking you.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 权限预设，由对话自身的模型审查每次沙箱提权请求，而非询问你。

description.en: Persistent self-evolving memory for DeepSeek Harness with diary, facts, concerns, and audit ledger.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化自我演进记忆，含日记、事实、关切和审计账本。

description.en: Turns any decision into 384 quantifiable checkpoints, aggregated through a six-layer Yijing framework into an auditable verdict.
description.zh: 将任意决策拆解为384个可量化检查点，经六层加权聚合输出可追溯的结构化结论。

description.en: Applies VS Code Dark+ syntax colors and font-size control to DeepSeek Harness code blocks.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 代码块应用 VS Code Dark+ 语法配色与字号控制。

description.en: A dsh plugin with minimal description referencing the chemical element darmstadtium.
description.zh: dsh 插件，简介仅提及化学元素𫟼（darmstadtium），未说明任何具体功能。

description.en: Contract-driven data curation mode that verifies and cleans records in a single SQLite workspace with dual-channel agreement and a ledger.
description.zh: 契约驱动的数据核对与清洗模式，在单一 SQLite 工作区内通过双通道一致性校验与账本记录完成数据整理。

description.en: Converts network data rates (网速换算) with precise parameter-based calculations, returning detailed results.
Provides a local tool to list and query data structure knowledge entries by name or id.
description.zh: 提供本地工具，可按名称或ID列出并查询数据结构知识条目。

description.en: Snapshots your DSH config, plugin stack, long-term memory and skills to a private git repo, with path remapping on restore, backup scheduling and one-click rollback.
description.zh: 把配置、插件栈、长期记忆和技能打包成快照推送到私有 git 仓库，拉取时自动重映射绝对路径，支持定时备份与一键回滚。

description.en: Data usage management tool: calculates traffic use precisely from parameters and returns clear recommendations. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算流量使用量并给出明确建议的流量管理工具，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides a chart type selection reference for data visualization, implemented in pure Node without network.
description.zh: 提供数据可视化的图表类型选择参考，纯 Node 实现，无需联网。

description.en: Adds a right-column database tool with a connection tree, SQL console and editable result grid for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle and Redis.
description.zh: 在右侧栏提供数据库工具，含连接树、SQL 控制台和可编辑结果表格，支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、Oracle 和 Redis。

description.en: Calculates date differences, adds or subtracts days, and finds the day of week for dates.
description.zh: 计算日期差、加减天数，并查找日期对应的星期几。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin for formatting dates with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 日期格式化插件，不依赖网络即可使用

description.en: Long-term personality and memory brain for DSH: layered persona, personality evolution, persistent cross-session memory, skills and safe degradation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供长期人格与记忆的“大脑”插件：人格分层、性格演化、跨会话长期记忆、技能反射与安全降级。

description.en: Calculates the day of year (1-366) for a given date, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 计算给定日期是当年的第几天，返回 1 到 366 之间的数值，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Connects DSH to intranet databases and provides a metadata browser, including Oracle 11.2 Thick support.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到内网数据库，并提供元数据浏览器，支持 Oracle 11.2 Thick。

description.en: Configure named MySQL connections in a DeepSeek Harness settings page and query them by name in chat, read-only unless writes are enabled.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页配置具名 MySQL 连接，在对话中按名称查询，默认只读，可按连接开启写入。

description.en: Compares two SQL DDL files, detects table/column differences, and generates ALTER TABLE migration SQL.
description.zh: 对比两个 SQL DDL 文件，检测表与列的结构差异，并生成 ALTER TABLE 迁移 SQL。

description.en: In-process death black box for DeepSeek Harness hosts: heartbeat windows, crash stacks, end-kind self-check, and death_forensics_report tool.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 进程内崩溃黑盒：心跳窗口、崩溃堆栈、结束类型自检及死亡取证报告工具。

description.en: Runs multi-agent Chinese debate simulations with AI judges, archived transcripts, training drills, and ZIP/Word export.
description.zh: 运行多智能体中文辩论模拟，含 AI 评委、辩论存档、训练模式及 ZIP/Word 导出。

description.en: Debt management tool that returns family financial planning plans based on specified parameters.
description.zh: 债务管理工具，根据指定参数返回家庭财务规划方案。

description.en: Debt snowball calculator that computes detailed repayment plans from input parameters, pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算债务雪球式详细还款计划，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Decay-based agent memory for DeepSeek Harness: entries gain weight when mentioned, fade when forgotten, and pinned entries never decay.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供衰减式智能体记忆：被提及的条目权重上升，被遗忘的条目逐渐淡出，固定条目永不衰减。

description.en: A System 1 decision guard that asks the model four questions (risk, reversibility, relevance, injection) before each tool call, then allows, asks, or blocks.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 System 1 决策守卫：每次工具调用前先问模型四个问题（风险、可逆性、任务相关性、注入嫌疑），据此放行、询问或拦截。

description.en: Structured decision layer for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop, backed by a pluggable dev/laya adjudication model.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体循环提供结构化决策层，由可插拔 dev/laya 裁决模型支持。

description.en: Adds OpenAI Decisions API classifiers to DeepSeek Harness for typed predicate, choice, and score questions about text and images.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenAI Decisions API 分类器，可对文本和图像提出谓词、选择与评分等类型化问题。

description.en: Adds optional bounded Decision API support to DeepSeek Harness, including tool discovery, per-session DecisionBoost, and search-source prefetch.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可选的有界 Decision API 支持，包括工具发现、按会话 DecisionBoost 和搜索源预取。

description.en: A decluttering decision tool that returns minimalist solutions based on parameters, pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 断舍离决策工具，根据参数返回极简方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Declutters the DeepSeek Harness web UI by expanding the session list, folding long tool-call runs into one toggle, and fixing the mobile sidebar drawer.
description.zh: 精简 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面：展开会话列表、将冗长的工具调用折叠为一个开关，并修复移动端侧边栏抽屉。

description.en: Generates interior soft-decoration color palettes via parameter-based calculation; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 通过参数化计算生成室内软装配色方案，纯 Node 实现，无需联网。

description.en: Calculates deed tax (契税) from input parameters with detailed results. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算契税并给出详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A DSH plugin that opens http(s) pages in a right sidebar beside the conversation.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，可在会话右侧边栏中浏览 http(s) 网页。

description.en: Deep cleaning tool that calculates precise suggestions based on input parameters.
description.zh: 深度清洁工具，可根据输入参数计算精准建议。

description.en: A pure Node, zero-network dependency plugin that deep-clones objects via a session tool.
description.zh: 一个纯 Node、不依赖网络的插件，通过会话工具深拷贝对象。

description.en: Permanently purges DSH sessions by wiping logs, projection caches, workspace accounting, and reference-counted attachments.
description.zh: 彻底清除 DSH 会话：删除日志、投影缓存、工作区记账，并按引用计数回收附件。

description.en: Deletes DSH sessions completely across all six on-disk locations, with dry run, backup, rollback and automatic DSH restart.
description.zh: 彻底删除 DSH 会话，覆盖全部六个磁盘位置，支持试运行、备份、回滚和自动重启 DSH。

description.en: Deep research plugin for DSH: runs multi-query web searches, fetches sources, extracts evidence and produces a cited evidence report.
description.zh: DSH 深度研究插件：执行多查询检索、抓取正文、提取证据并交叉印证，产出可引用的证据报告。

description.en: DeepArchi methodology skills for DeepSeek Harness that run enterprise-architecture gap analysis against BIAN and TOGAF.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 DeepArchi 方法论技能，基于 BIAN/TOGAF 开展企业架构差距分析。

description.en: Adds a tiny DeepSeek account balance pill to the DSH composer dock; hover for recharge/bonus breakdown, click to refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方添加一枚极小的 DeepSeek 账号余额标签，悬停查看充值与赠送余额明细，点击即可刷新。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek API usage metrics (balance, spend, requests, tokens) in a persistent sidebar strip with expandable details.
description.zh: 在持久侧边栏条中显示 DeepSeek API 用量指标，包括余额、消费、请求数和 Token，并支持展开查看详情。

description.en: Displays your DeepSeek API key account balance directly in the DSH composer dock for quick cost monitoring.
description.zh: 在 DSH 编辑器停靠栏中直接显示 DeepSeek API 密钥账户余额，便于快速监控费用。

description.en: Shows a DeepSeek account balance badge in the DSH sidebar footer, with a settings card to set the refresh period; the API key stays server-side.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章，并提供设置卡片调整刷新周期，API 密钥不会下发到浏览器。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button to query DeepSeek API key balance in the Web UI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 侧边栏添加一个按钮，用于查询 DeepSeek API 密钥的余额。

description.en: Shows whether DeepSeek API pricing is currently peak or off-peak, with a countdown to the next switch below the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于高峰还是低谷计费时段，并倒计时到下次切换。

description.en: Reads local session logs from every coding harness on the machine, prices their DeepSeek token usage at list rates, and reports spend vs. budget.
description.zh: 读取本机所有编码工具的本地会话日志，按 DeepSeek 官方价格计算 token 花费，并对比预算显示已用额度。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 聊天气泡皮肤，能够对DeepSeek输出内容以及自己的内容进行聊天气泡替换，进行一系列的美化ovo
Adds DeepSeek-official cost accounting (session total plus current turn) to the built-in Token usage panel in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置 Token 用量面板中加入 DeepSeek 官方费用统计（会话总计与当前轮次）。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek costs for ollama-pro using official pricing, with a shared multi-instance log and Ollama Cloud quota display.
description.zh: 使用 DeepSeek 官方定价为 ollama-pro 追踪成本，并提供多实例共享日志和 Ollama Cloud 配额显示。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API balance and daily spend display for DSH web with badge and dashboard.
description.zh: 实时显示DeepSeek API余额和每日花费，集成于DSH web的角标和仪表盘。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance, off-peak alerts and live session cost estimates in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、错峰提醒和实时会话费用估算。

description.en: Edge extension captures DeepSeek web chats as JSON, and a CLI importer rebuilds them as resumable DSH sessions.
description.zh: Edge 扩展抓取 DeepSeek 网页对话并导出为 JSON，再用 CLI 导入器重建为可继续的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Sidebar status line that probes DeepSeek API endpoints for latency and reachability and shows official DeepSeek component status.
description.zh: 侧边栏状态行：探测 DeepSeek 各接口的延迟与可达性，并显示官方组件状态。

description.en: Auto-switches DeepSeek models based on conversation content for DeepSeek Harness, with manual override.
description.zh: 根据对话内容自动切换 DeepSeek 模型，并支持手动指定覆盖。

description.en: Shows a colored dot in the DSH Web GUI input toolbar marking DeepSeek API peak (yellow) or off-peak half-price (green) billing hours.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 输入框工具行显示小圆点，标示 DeepSeek API 当前为高峰（黄）或空闲半价（绿）计费时段。

description.en: Shows in the composer HUD whether the DeepSeek API is in its peak or off-peak billing window, with a live countdown and per-1M-token rates.
description.zh: 在输入区 HUD 显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于高峰还是低谷计费时段，附实时倒计时与每百万 token 价格。

description.en: Adds DeepSeek account-backed web search to DSH sessions whose chat model runs through a third-party subscription or gateway, so web_search works without a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
description.zh: 为通过第三方订阅或网关运行聊天模型的 DSH 会话提供基于 DeepSeek 账号的网页搜索，无需 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 即可使用 web_search。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin showing peak/off-peak billing status and live account balance beside the composer, self-updating and credential-free.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在输入框旁显示高峰/低谷计费状态与实时账户余额，自动更新且无需凭据。

description.en: Adds a glowing live DeepSeek service-status lamp to the DSH sidebar, with a hover card breaking down status.deepseek.com health.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加发光的 DeepSeek 服务状态指示灯，悬停可查看 status.deepseek.com 的详细健康状态。

description.en: Periodically reads DeepSeek's official status feed and shows outage, degradation and recovery notices plus a persistent health pill in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 定期读取 DeepSeek 官方服务状态源（RSS/Atom），在 DSH Web UI 中显示故障、降级与恢复通知，并常驻展示当前健康状态。

description.en: DSH Web GUI theme plugin applying DeepSeek's visual language with frosted glass, fluid and quantised effects and 100 adjustable parameters.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题插件，采用 DeepSeek 视觉语言，提供毛玻璃、流体与量化效果，含 100 项可调参数。

description.en: DeepSeek usage monitor for Harness: queries account balance and aggregates token usage per session as callable tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可调用工具，查询账户余额，并按会话汇总 token 用量

description.en: DeepSeek API plugin to view real-time balance and aggregate local token usage from DSH session logs.
description.zh: DeepSeek API 用量与余额查询插件，通过 /usage 命令实时查看余额，并汇总本机 DSH 会话日志中的 token 用量。

description.en: A clean DeepSeek usage and balance panel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供显示 DeepSeek 用量与余额的面板。

description.en: Adds a persistent indicator to the DSH input-bar stats strip showing DeepSeek session cost, balance and peak/off-peak billing status.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入栏统计条中常驻显示 DeepSeek 会话开销、账户余额与高峰/空闲计费状态。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek token usage and account balance with a live status card in DSH Web.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中统计 DeepSeek token 用量与账户余额，并显示实时状态卡片。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek account balance and harness-observed token usage with a sidebar panel, agent tool, alerts and local history.
description.zh: 跟踪 DeepSeek 账户余额与 Harness 观测的 token 用量，提供侧边栏面板、代理工具、告警和本地历史记录。

description.en: Adds an in-app DeepSeek Platform usage page to the Web GUI with balance, total spend, per-key spend/token filters and a spend chart.
description.zh: 在 Web GUI 中内置 DeepSeek 平台用量页面，展示余额、总支出、按 Key 的支出/Token 筛选和支出图表。

description.en: DeepSeek web chat sidebar in DSH with drag-and-drop file sending and a web_review tool that acts as a code-review subagent.
description.zh: DSH 内置 DeepSeek 网页聊天侧边栏，支持拖拽发送文件，并通过 web_review 工具充当代码审查子代理。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com inside DeepSeek Harness via a local loopback reverse proxy and iframe, so you can chat without opening a browser.
description.zh: 通过本机回环反向代理和独立站点 iframe 把 chat.deepseek.com 原样嵌入 DSH，登录一次即可在界面内直接对话，无需再开浏览器。

description.en: Adds a sidebar shortcut that opens chat.deepseek.com in the built-in right-side browser or your system browser, with no proxying or API usage.
description.zh: 在左侧栏添加快捷入口，一键在内置右侧浏览器或系统浏览器打开 chat.deepseek.com，不代理、不注入、不消耗 API 额度。

description.en: Embeds the real chat.deepseek.com website as a full-window panel inside DSH, with quote-to-compose and right-click conversation deletion.
description.zh: 把真正的 chat.deepseek.com 网页以全窗口面板形式嵌入 DSH，支持划选引用到输入框和右键删除对话。

description.en: CSS-only Claude-style dark and light skin for the DeepSeek panel embedded by dsh-webchat, with no DOM, network or login access.
description.zh: 纯 CSS 的 Claude 风格深色与浅色皮肤，用于 dsh-webchat 嵌入的 DeepSeek 面板，不访问 DOM、网络或登录状态。

description.en: Parody reskin giving DeepSeek Harness web UI a Pornhub-style orange/black theme with entry gate and badges.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness网页界面提供Pornhub风格橙黑主题的恶搞换肤，含入场门和徽章。

description.en: Adds one-click session controls, notes, summaries, search, focus lock and workspace command buttons to turn DSH into an immersive workbench.
description.zh: 为 DSH 集成一键会话操作、笔记、摘要、查找、专注锁与工作区命令按钮，打造沉浸式工作台。

description.en: Pins the DeepSeek Harness default model via settings so new chats, restarts and in-chat model switches keep it unchanged.
description.zh: 通过设置固定 DeepSeek Harness 默认模型，新对话、重启和会话内切换模型都不会改变它。

description.en: Provides home anti-mold dehumidification recommendations based on input parameters.
Selects dehumidifiers and returns home anti-mold dehumidification plans based on input parameters.
Dehumidifier selection tool that computes precise recommendations from parameters.
Checks if a similar dsh plugin already exists by searching the awesome-dsh-plugin registry and GitHub topic.
description.zh: 在构建 dsh 插件前，搜索 awesome-dsh-plugin 注册表和 dsh-plugin GitHub 话题，检查是否已有类似插件。

description.en: Adds HTTP routes and an agent tool to permanently delete archived DeepSeek Harness conversations and their stored session data.
description.zh: 提供 HTTP 路由与智能体工具，用于永久删除已归档的对话及其会话存储数据。

description.en: Adds real session deletion to DSH Web: a row context-menu action and a Workspaces-header batch dialog that remove log directories and projection caches.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 侧栏补上真正的会话删除：会话行右键菜单删单条，区头批量删多条，并删除日志目录与投影缓存。

description.en: Adds a permanent, irreversible "delete session" action to the sidebar session row's ⋯ menu without taking over any official rows.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行的 ⋯ 菜单中新增「删除会话」（永久不可恢复）操作，且不接管任何官方插件行。

description.en: Adds a sidebar menu item that permanently deletes DSH sessions from disk, with an optional confirmation dialog and safe cleanup.
description.zh: 在侧栏菜单中增加“删除会话”，把会话从磁盘彻底删除，可关闭删除前确认，并安全清理相关文件。

description.en: Adds a bilingual delete action to the DSH sidebar that removes a session log, cleans the workspace registry, and drops the row from every client.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加中英双语删除入口，移除会话日志、清理工作区注册表，并在所有客户端同步删除该行。

description.en: Returns information about Delhi city (德里市). Pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 返回德里市相关信息，使用纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Adds expand/collapse controls to the deliverables file list in DeepSeek Harness chat UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面的产物文件列表添加展开与收起控制。

description.en: Collects every finished file into one inbox folder, grouped by project and conversation, with inline preview, clipboard copy and Explorer reveal.
description.zh: 把每个成品文件统一收纳到取件箱，按项目和对话分组，支持内联预览、一键复制与资源管理器定位。

description.en: Adds a "delivered files" view to the DSH chat window that collects every presented, written or edited file into one searchable per-session library.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话窗新增「交付文件」视图，把当前会话中所有 present 交付与 write/edit 产出汇总成可检索的会话文件库。

description.en: Reads a demurrage and detention ledger and checks each container row's completeness and arithmetic consistency.
description.zh: 读取滞箱费台账,核对每行集装箱记录的完整性与算术自洽性。

description.en: A plugin for Denmark country information based on limited description.
description.zh: 一个基于有限描述的丹麦国家

description.en: Compresses tool outputs into structured summaries for DSH, with on-demand recall and a per-window ledger.
description.zh: 为 DSH 将工具输出压缩为结构化摘要，支持按需召回并提供逐窗口账本。

description.en: Dental self-check tool that returns clear advice based on input parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回口腔自检建议，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Dependency security audit plugin scanning known OSV vulnerabilities and outdated npm packages.
description.zh: 依赖安全审计插件：用 OSV.dev 扫描漏洞、检测 npm 过期依赖，返回严重级别、修复版本与升级幅度。

description.en: DSH plugin that ensures an nginx site base config, checks TLS status, and safely reloads nginx for an ops portal.
description.zh: DSH 插件：为运维门户确保 nginx 站点基础配置、检查 TLS 状态并安全重载 nginx。

description.en: Offline deterministic evidence that deployment targets converged to last known good digest after a failed artifact, via hash-only manifest verification.
Calculates deposit interest precisely from parameters, returning detailed results and explanations. Pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算存款利息，返回详细结果与计算说明，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Depth of field calculator that precisely computes and returns detailed results based on input parameters.
description.zh: 景深计算器，可根据输入参数精确计算并返回详细结果。

description.en: Semantic watcher for DSH that keeps a journey ledger, summarizes activity, scores novelty, folds milestones, injects context, and handles stalls.
description.zh: DSH 语义监视器：维护旅程账本、快速摘要、MinHash 新颖度评分、里程碑折叠、上下文注入与三级停滞响应。

description.en: Clickable HTML prototype canvas for designing UI prototypes inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供可点击的 HTML 原型画布，用于设计并交互查看 UI 原型。

description.en: Adds element-level annotations and click-flow recording to HTML prototypes, exporting shareable annotation bundles and flowcharts.
description.zh: 为 HTML 原型提供点选元素标注与点击流程录制，可导出可分享的标注包与流程图。

description.en: UI/UX audit and fix loop for DeepSeek Harness: headless Chrome forensics, WCAG 2.2 checks, pasteable fixes, then re-test diff verification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 UI/UX 审查与优化闭环：无头 Chrome 取证、WCAG 2.2 判据、可粘贴修复并复测验证。

description.en: Turns design documents into a live development progress tree and injects it into DSH session context so new sessions resume where the last left off.
description.zh: 将设计文档转为实时开发进度树并注入 DSH 会话上下文，让新会话可续接上次进度。

description.en: UI design pattern reference plugin providing tools for in-chat lookup, pure Node, fully offline.
description.zh: UI设计模式参考插件，提供在聊天中查询设计模式的工具，纯Node实现，完全离线。

description.en: A Claude Design-style studio that generates graded HTML design variants with a Figma-class editor, inline comments, tweaks and multi-format export.
description.zh: 一个设计工作室插件：通过向导生成多档 HTML 设计稿，提供类 Figma 编辑器、行内评论、微调与多种格式导出。

description.en: Provides a design style reference tool for use in conversations.
A design-symposium plugin where multiple stance-holding sages debate one topic over rounds, then a chair condenses it into a design decision minute.
description.zh: 设计研讨会插件：多位持不同立场的贤者围绕同一议题多轮研讨，由主席收敛成设计纪要（一致点/分歧/否决方案/建议决策）。

description.en: A Tauri desktop app wrapper for DeepSeek Harness, with China mirror setup and Windows no-admin build tooling.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 桌面应用，附带国内镜像配置和 Windows 免管理员权限的构建工具

description.en: Draggable floating clock widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with analog and digital faces, a focus timer, four themes and saved placement.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供的可拖动悬浮时钟，支持指针与数字表盘、专注计时器、四套主题及位置持久保存。

description.en: A desktop pet companion that lives in the DSH web interface, levels up with your coding activity, and can generate a custom AI avatar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中养一只桌宠，随编码活动升级进化、语音打气，并可用 AI 生成专属透明动画形象。

description.en: Windows desktop control plugin that captures screenshots and simulates mouse and keyboard input for automation.
description.zh: Windows 桌面控制插件，可截屏并模拟鼠标键盘操作，用于自动化。

description.en: Drag files into DSH desktop composer to insert their absolute file paths instead of uploading.
description.zh: 将文件拖入DSH桌面编辑器以插入其绝对路径而非上传。

description.en: Windows-only DSH plugin exposing six agent-callable tools to control the desktop and capture occluded windows via PrintWindow.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DSH 插件，提供六个可由智能体调用的工具，用于控制桌面并通过 PrintWindow 抓取被遮挡窗口。

description.en: Provides shutdown and restart buttons for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web apps on Windows.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端和 Web 端提供关闭与重启按钮，适用于 Windows。

description.en: Patch plugin that enables hidden Refresh Page / Restart App & Host items in the DSH desktop app's native Application menu via an 11-byte equal-length app.asar rewrite.
description.zh: 补丁插件：通过等长改写 app.asar（11 字节）把「刷新页面 / 重启应用与 Host」两项加进 DSH 桌面端原生「应用」菜单。

description.en: Windows desktop toast and question popups for DSH: completion and error cards, plus native choice dialogs that auto-fall back to the Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面右下角通知与选择弹窗：完成/出错卡片，以及原生选项卡片，无法显示时自动回落到 Web UI。

description.en: Sends desktop toast notifications in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI when a tool needs authorization, a review waits, or a turn finishes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中发送桌面通知，提示工具待授权、问题或计划待审阅、或回合已完成。

description.en: Windows-native desktop notifications for DSH sessions when a task completes, awaits approval, or errors; clicking a toast focuses the window and reopens that session.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端（Windows）系统通知插件：会话完成、等待批准或出错时弹出原生通知，点击可聚焦窗口并跳回对应会话。

description.en: A tiny animated desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that idles, bounces while the agent works, and calls out when a task finishes.
description.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 设计的桌宠，空闲时静静待着，代理工作时蹦跳，任务完成时出声提醒。

description.en: Adds two round sidebar buttons that restart the DSH desktop app without a console window and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面侧边栏底部添加两个圆形按钮：无需控制台窗口即可重启应用，并在浏览器中打开 DeepSeek 充值页面。

description.en: Shows a desktop toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness task is interrupted or finishes.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 任务中断或完成时，弹出桌面通知提醒。

description.en: Local-only DSH Desktop token usage dashboard: aggregates session logs under $DSH_HOME and renders them in the sidebar.
Adds F11 fullscreen toggling and Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V copy-paste inside the DSH desktop terminal, each with an independent on/off switch.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端添加 F11 全屏切换，并在终端内用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，两个功能各有独立开关。

description.en: Adds a per-model reasoning-effort panel in DSH settings, with recommended presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中为每个模型补充思考强度配置，并为 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM、MiMo 提供推荐预设。

description.en: Adds a permanent "Check for updates" entry to the DSH desktop sidebar so users can always trigger an update check manually.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版侧栏添加常驻「检查更新」入口，让用户随时手动检查更新。

description.en: Adds a 「升级 DSH」 tray command and a dsh_upgrade model tool so DSH Desktop can check and install official updates in-app.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端添加「升级 DSH」托盘命令与 dsh_upgrade 模型工具，可在应用内检查并安装官方更新。

description.en: Adds a pseudo-3D blue Refresh button to the DSH Desktop title bar that reloads the page only when no conversations are running.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 标题栏「编辑」右侧新增伪 3D「刷新」按钮，仅在无对话运行时才允许重载页面。

description.en: A destination checklist tool that returns travel planning schemes based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 目的地清单工具，根据输入参数返回出行方案，使用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Long-term memory bank plugin that injects stored memories into every session's system prompt, with settings-page and HTTP API editing.
description.zh: 长期记忆库插件，将记忆注入每个会话的系统提示，并支持设置页与 HTTP API 增删改。

description.en: Returns a laundry cleaning management plan with detergent dosage based on parameters. Pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 根据参数返回洗衣清洁管理方案及洗涤剂用量，纯Node离线运行。

description.en: Calculates laundry detergent dosage recommendations from input parameters.
Offline, deterministic DSH toolkit of 29 bounded JSON, YAML, CSV, text, encoding and inspection tools, each returning a byte receipt.
description.zh: 离线、确定性的 DSH 工具集，提供 29 个有界的 JSON、YAML、CSV、文本、编码与检查工具，每个都返回字节回执。

description.en: Provides tools to list and query cloud service entries by id or name. Pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 提供按 id 或名称列出和查询云服务条目的工具，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Lists and queries database entries by id or name; pure Node implementation, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 按 id 或名称列出并查询数据库条目，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Provides tools to list and query programming framework entries with no network dependency.
Lists and queries web technology entries via local Node tools.
description.zh: 通过本地 Node 工具列出并查询 Web 技术条目。

description.en: Launches workspace dev-server scripts with one click and captures their logs so the conversation can read them.
description.zh: 一键启动当前工作区的开发服务脚本，并捕获日志供对话读取。

description.en: Query programming paradigms: list all entries or get details by ID/name.
description.zh: 查询编程范式，可列出全部条目，或按 ID 或名称获取详情。

description.en: Serves the dsh Web UI over a non-localhost authority using trusted hosts, loopback page parity and a pinned launch token, with no patching.
description.zh: 通过可信主机、回环页面一致性和固定启动令牌，在非本地地址上安全提供 dsh Web UI，无需打补丁。

description.en: A local developer toolkit for JSON, URL, Base64, timestamp, and UUID conversion inside the dsh web composer.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页编辑器中提供本地开发者工具箱，支持 JSON、URL、Base64、时间戳和 UUID 转换。

description.en: Timestamp converter, Gson-style JSON formatter/validator, AES encrypt/decrypt and random string generator for DeepSeek Harness.
A DSH sidebar workbench that aggregates requirements, project docs, Git commits, AI commit messages, code review, worktrees, background tasks and weekly reports.
description.zh: DSH 的项目与工程管理侧边栏工作台，聚合需求、项目文档、Git 提交、AI 提交信息、代码评审、工作树、后台任务与周报。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds Devin-backed web_search and code_search tools with Devin login, zero runtime dependencies and no version gate.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 Devin 登录提供 Devin 版 web_search 与 code_search，零运行时依赖、无版本闸门。

description.en: One-click start/stop of a project's frontend/backend services in DSH, with console logs, port conflict detection, and auto-restart.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中一键启停项目前后端服务，支持控制台日志、端口冲突检测和自动重启。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns each agent turn's context into a first-person dev log and appends it to local Markdown files.
description.zh: DSH 插件：每轮工作结束时自动把上下文加工成第一人称开发日志，追加写入本地 Markdown 文件。

description.en: Returns clear recommendations based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回驱虫计划建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds Android phone screen mirroring to DSH using native scrcpy windows, with a top capsule panel for mirroring, pin-on-top and navigation controls (Windows only).
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加安卓手机投屏：用 scrcpy 原生窗口显示画面，顶部胶囊面板提供投屏、置顶和导航控制（仅 Windows）。

description.en: Switches AI personas/characters in DeepSeek Harness with tools like switch role, list roles, and get current role.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中切换 AI 角色面具，提供切换角色、列出角色和获取当前角色的工具。

description.en: Provides watch and jewelry care plans based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数生成手表和珠宝的保养方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Diaper size tool that returns clear size recommendations based on input parameters, implemented in Node with no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回明确的纸尿裤尺码推荐，用 Node 实现且无需网络。

description.en: Read-only plugin that gives DSH a compact git diff context: changed files, addition/removal counts and hunks.
description.zh: 只读插件，为 DSH 提供紧凑的 git diff 上下文：变更文件、增删行数与代码块。

description.en: Intercepts write/edit tool calls to render git-style file diffs inline in DSH conversations, with side-by-side and unified views.
description.zh: 拦截 DSH 对话中的 write/edit 工具调用，在工具卡片位置直接渲染 git 风格文件差异，支持上下对比与左右对比并逐行高亮。

description.en: Set difference operation implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 用纯 Node 实现集合差集运算，无网络依赖。

description.en: Computes aromatherapy diffuser oil plans based on input parameters, pure Node implementation without network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算香薰机精油使用计划，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Computes the digital root of a number.
DSH plugin that pushes DingTalk group messages when AI needs your approval or a task round finishes, with an in-DSH settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 插件：当 AI 需要你审批或一轮任务完成时，向钉钉群推送通知，并自带 DSH 设置面板。

description.en: DSH skin plugin adding dual character skins, stickers, and editable decoration board with import/export.
description.zh: DSH 皮肤插件，添加双角色皮肤和贴纸，并提供可编辑、支持导入导出的装饰板。

description.en: Dipping sauce pairing tool that returns hotpot meal plans based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回火锅蘸料搭配方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Opens DSH-delivered files, changed-file rows and file mentions in the system default app, with right-click takeover and a settings page.
description.zh: 在系统默认应用中打开 DSH 交付文件、变更文件行和文件提及，支持右键接管与设置页。

description.en: Loads each workspace's direnv environment into every DeepSeek Harness command automatically.
description.zh: 自动将每个工作区的 direnv 环境加载到所有 DeepSeek Harness 命令中。

description.en: Adds a button on the DSH Plugins page that opens a checklist to bulk toggle unofficial plugins on or off, never uninstalling them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页面添加一个按钮，通过清单批量启用或停用非官方插件，永不卸载。

description.en: Real-time snapshots of DSH_HOME with content-addressed deduplication, one-click rollback, quarantine-safe restore and encrypted offsite copies.
description.zh: 实时快照整个 DSH_HOME，内容寻址去重，支持一键回滚、缺块拒绝恢复和异地加密副本的灾备插件。

description.en: Read-only Discord integration with 29 tools for searching messages, archives, context, inbox and attachments, reusing the browser login token.
description.zh: 只读 Discord 集成，提供 29 个工具用于搜索消息、归档、上下文、收件箱与附件，并复用浏览器登录令牌。

description.en: Calculates dish gross profit margin based on parameters, returning detailed results. Pure Node implementation, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数计算菜品毛利率并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Windows disk cleanup workspace for DSH that scans read-only, explains cleanup candidates and moves files to a reversible quarantine instead of deleting them.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Windows 磁盘清理工作区：只读扫描、解释候选项，并将文件移入可恢复的隔离区而非直接删除。

description.en: macOS desktop plugin that visualizes disk usage as a treemap and suggests cleanup actions with a reviewed trash plan.
description.zh: macOS 桌面插件，以矩形树图显示磁盘占用，提供关联清理建议并可在确认后执行回收站计划。

description.en: Read-only disk usage scanner for Windows and macOS that reports what is consuming space and offers an interactive cleanup report.
description.zh: 适用于 Windows 和 macOS 的只读磁盘占用扫描插件，报告空间占用情况并提供交互式清理报告。

description.en: Manages sidebar folding and which plugin entries appear in the sidebar, header/footer, tabs and Settings — display only, never enabling plugins.
description.zh: 管理侧边栏折叠以及哪些插件条目显示在侧边栏、会话页眉页脚、标签页和设置中，仅控制显示，不启用或禁用插件。

description.en: A lightweight plugin to compute the distance between two points using pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 用纯 Node.js 计算两点之间距离的轻量插件，无网络依赖。

description.en: Computes the number of divisors (factor count) of an integer with a pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 用纯 Node 实现计算给定整数的因子个数。

description.en: Returns DIY home tool repair solutions based on input parameters, with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回 DIY 家用工具维修方案，无需网络。

description.en: Returns basic facts about Djibouti: capital, population, currency, and continent, with no network dependency.
Download task panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: real percentage, transfer rate and ETA.
Scaffolds ten-section data-management plans with prompts, consistency checks for datasets, privacy, retention and licensing, plus Markdown/JSON/SARIF export.
description.zh: 提供十节数据管理计划脚手架，含提示词与数据集、隐私、保存期限、许可等一致性检查，并支持 Markdown/JSON/SARIF 导出。

description.en: DNS query tool in pure Node, no external services; install and use in dsh sessions.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的 DNS 查询工具，无需外部服务，安装后可在 dsh 会话中使用。

description.en: Open files in a sidebar, annotate text or regions, and send annotations directly to the Agent conversation.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏打开文件，标注文本选区或区域，并将标注发送到Agent对话。

description.en: Returns family document/certificate management plans based on parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数返回家庭文件与证件管理方案，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: DSH plugin that locally converts Markdown, DOCX and DOC files to styled DOCX with versioned style presets and a normalization report.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在本地把 Markdown、DOCX、DOC 转换为带样式预设的 DOCX，并输出规范化报告和样式版本快照。

description.en: Provides family archive document validity management plans based on input parameters.
Fullscreens right-sidebar docs or browser tabs while keeping the main chat in a draggable floating card that collapses to a corner widget.
description.zh: 让右侧栏文档或浏览器全屏显示，同时以可拖动的悬浮卡片保留主会话，收起后缩为右下角挂件。

description.en: For DeepSeek Harness: enforces documentation sync by linking code changes to affected docs.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness：将代码变更关联到受影响文档，强制文档随代码更新同步。

description.en: Returns a family document management plan based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回家庭证件管理方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Conversation-scoped document browser that groups every document your conversations produce, searchable and previewable in one panel.
description.zh: 按会话归类的文档浏览器，将对话产出的所有文档分组，并支持搜索与预览。

description.en: Returns a family archive document management plan for document reissue based on parameters. Pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 根据参数生成家庭档案证件补办的文档管理方案，纯 Node 实现，可离线运行。

description.en: Returns a family archive management plan based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数返回家庭档案管理方案，使用纯 Node 实现且不依赖网络。

description.en: Results workbench that organizes, stars, versions and reuses DSH artifacts through a visual desktop with Dock and Finder-style windows.
description.zh: 成果工作台：通过可视化桌面与 Dock，自动整理、星标、保存版本并复用 DeepSeek Harness 成果。

description.en: Bounces the macOS Dock icon when DeepSeek Harness needs attention while its window is in the background.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 需要关注且窗口处于后台时，弹跳 macOS 程序坞图标提醒你。

description.en: Provides Docker container, image, log, and Compose management tools via the local Docker CLI.
description.zh: 通过本地 Docker CLI 为代理提供容器、镜像、日志和 Compose 管理工具。

description.en: Static heuristic linter for Dockerfiles that flags risky base tags, root users, remote shell pipes, apt hygiene issues and leaked secrets.
description.zh: 静态 Dockerfile 启发式检查工具，可发现高风险基础镜像标签、root 用户、远程 shell 管道、apt 卫生问题与泄露的密钥。

description.en: DSH dev-docs reader plugin adding a sidebar entry with doc tree, Markdown reading, search, and an offline knowledge graph.
description.zh: DSH 开发文档阅读器插件，在侧边栏提供目录树、Markdown 阅读、检索与离线知识图谱。

description.en: Diagnoses the DSH runtime, installs, profile config, plugins, workspace, logs and network endpoints, then applies user-confirmed repairs with backup, recheck and rollback.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的运行时、安装、profile 配置、插件、工作区、日志与网络接入点体检工具，修复需用户确认，并支持备份、复检与回滚。

description.en: Zero-dependency AI code judge core for DeepSeek Harness, adding a diagnostic agent preset and Socratic review skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的零依赖 AI 代码评审核心，附带诊断模式 agent 预设与苏格拉底式技能。

description.en: Diagnostic plugin that bundles DeepSeek Harness home, leftover processes, ports, oversized sessions, and version issues into one paste-ready report.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 诊断插件：把 home、残留进程、端口、超大 session 和版本问题汇总成一份可直接粘贴的报告。

description.en: Inspect DOCX structure, perform byte-exact roundtrip reads/writes, and replace exact text runs with limited precision.
description.zh: 检查 DOCX 文档结构，进行字节级精确往返读写，并支持有限范围的精确文本替换。

description.en: Converts dog age to human equivalent with precise calculation, pure Node implementation without network dependencies.
description.zh: 按精确算法把狗的年龄换算为对应的人类年龄，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Calculates dog food feeding amount from parameters and returns detailed feeding results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算狗粮喂食量并返回详细喂食结果。

description.en: DokuWiki plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reads, searches and writes wiki pages and uploads media through native tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 DokuWiki 集成，可通过原生工具读取、搜索、写入维基页面并上传媒体文件。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin for domain name resolution with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 用于域名解析的纯 Node.js 插件，不依赖网络。

description.en: Routes selected DeepSeek Harness API domains through a local proxy and lets you inspect model-call performance.
description.zh: 将选定的 DeepSeek Harness API 域名通过本地代理路由，并可检查模型调用性能。

description.en: Windows desktop plugin that plays alert sounds and draws a taskbar badge on the DSH icon when a session finishes or needs attention.
description.zh: Windows 桌面插件：会话完成或需要处理时播放提示音，并在 DSH 任务栏图标上叠加未读角标。

description.en: Displays a Windows taskbar badge counting completed tasks while the DSH window is unfocused, auto-clearing on return.
description.zh: 在 DSH 窗口失去焦点时，通过 Windows 任务栏显示已完成任务的数量徽标，窗口恢复焦点后自动清除，不包含子代理会话。

description.en: Executable acceptance checklists for DeepSeek Harness that back every 'done' with a recorded check result and flag items for re-check when code changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可执行的验收清单：每个“完成”都有检查结果记录，代码变更时自动标记需重新检查。

description.en: Notifies you on macOS when DeepSeek Harness finishes a response, with a playful voice alert.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型完成回复并等待输入时，弹出 macOS 通知并播放童声提示音提醒用户。

description.en: Detects repetitive reasoning loops in DSH and responds with a nudge, a cut, or an audible chime.
description.zh: 检测 DSH 中重复的推理循环，并通过提醒、截断或提示音进行干预。

description.en: Splits long projects into volumes and generates a handoff document so state carries over without replaying context.
description.zh: 将长项目拆分为多个分卷，并生成交接文档来传递状态，无需重放上下文。

description.en: A Dota 2 hero desktop pet that bakes real animations from local game model files offline and appears based on your recently played heroes.
description.zh: Dota 2 英雄桌宠：从本机游戏模型离线烘焙真实动作，并按你最近常用的英雄出场。

description.en: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude assets in DeepSeek Harness, expanding slash-command arguments and enforcing permissions.deny rules.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude 资源，支持斜杠命令参数展开并执行 permissions.deny 规则。

description.en: Parses and serializes .env files with pure Node, no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 解析与序列化 .env 文件，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.en: Drives the Doubao web app in your local browser (ego lite or Chrome) to generate AI images, then saves the hi-res originals and attaches them to the chat.
description.zh: 用本机浏览器（ego lite 优先、Chrome 回落）操控豆包网页版生成 AI 图片，自动保存高清原图并注入对话附件。

description.en: Self-management and self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness with snapshots, config checks, blue-green updates, and auto-rollback.
description.zh: dsh-double: self-management & self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness — snapshot, config pre-check, blue-green evolve with auto-rollback, standby supervisor. 让 dsh 自己管理自己/自我进化/故障自愈。

description.en: Calculates dough hydration by parameters, returning detailed results with empirical references.
description.zh: 根据参数计算面团含水量，返回详细结果及经验参考。

description.en: A pure Node tool that returns dough-making plans for noodle dishes based on input parameters, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 工具，根据输入参数返回面条类面食的和面配比方案，不依赖网络。

description.en: macOS DSH plugin that browses Douyin in a dedicated Chrome window, auto-watching videos and updating persona-based interests from real screen samples.
description.zh: macOS 版 DSH 抖音插件：在专用 Chrome 窗口中自主观看抖音电脑版，采样真实画面并结合人格记忆更新兴趣。

description.en: Douyin CLI toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: reads content via an Edge XHR fallback, runs a QR/SMS login state machine, tracks account fingerprints, and posts guarded comments.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的抖音工具集：通过 Edge XHR 回退读取内容，支持扫码/短信登录状态机、账号指纹与受保护的评论发送。

description.en: A down payment calculator that computes precise results from parameters, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 首付计算器，依据参数精确计算，无需联网。

description.en: Adds a Download link to delivered file cards in dsh web so files can be saved straight from the browser.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 的交付物文件卡片添加下载链接，可直接从浏览器保存文件。

description.en: Floating DSH dashboard that tracks downloads over 300MB across sessions, sub-agents and terminals with progress, speed and ETA.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮下载看板，跨会话、跨子代理、跨终端实时显示 300MB 以上下载的进度、速度与剩余时间。

description.en: Autonomous Android agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness that drives a real phone over adb using an LLM decision loop, running key-free via the host model channel.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自主 Android 智能体插件，通过 adb 驱动真实手机，使用大模型决策循环，并借助宿主模型通道免密钥运行。

description.en: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh with live-preview editing and local persistence.
description.zh: 一个基于Markdown的dsh草稿板插件，支持实时预览编辑和本地持久化。

description.en: DSH web GUI plugin that stops browser page translation from clearing typed text in the message composer draft.
description.zh: DSH网页GUI插件，防止浏览器页面翻译清除消息编辑器草稿中已输入的文字。

description.en: Drag a conversation row from the DSH web sidebar onto the chat area to insert it as a session-reference chip in the composer draft.
description.zh: 将 DSH 网页侧边栏的对话行拖拽到聊天区域，即可作为会话引用标签插入输入框草稿。

description.en: Windows x64-only DSH plugin providing self-contained DOM/CDP browser control and UI Automation for desktop interaction.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows x64 的 DSH 插件，提供独立的 DOM/CDP 浏览器控制与 UI 自动化桌面交互能力。

description.en: A dragon-maid desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that sits in the chat corner and changes form with the current model's thinking effort.
description.zh: 一个龙女仆桌宠插件，待在对角落，并根据当前模型的思考强度变换形态与形象。

description.en: Chat-first draw.io plugin: the model creates, inspects and edits native .drawio diagrams that render in a sandboxed in-chat viewer.
description.zh: 聊天优先的 draw.io 插件：模型可创建、检查并编辑原生 .drawio 图表，并在沙箱 iframe 中直接渲染查看。

description.zh: 拖拽整理 DSH 侧边栏面板条目与对话标签页，并可在面板之间移动条目。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shapes LLM context at the entry, keeping outbound payload prefixes monotonic to shrink context without adding breakpoints.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在入口处定型上下文，使出网前缀保持单调，从而在不引入断点的前提下缩小上下文。

description.en: Adds a one-time workspace entry transition animation (letter-by-letter write-on, color-block sweep) plus a dark industrial theme to the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加一次性入场过渡动画（逐笔写字、色块横扫）和简约深色工业风皮肤。

description.en: Automatically backs up the dsh web profile directory when plugin install/update causes changes, using fingerprint checks and graph events with rotating retention.
description.zh: 在插件安装/更新导致变化时，通过指纹比对和图事件自动备份 web 配置目录，并轮转保留。

description.en: Windows/DSH environment doctor: zero-side-effect health checks with raw evidence and copy-paste fixes, plus 4 opt-in auto-repairs.
description.zh: Windows/DSH 环境体检：零副作用排查 PATH、git 凭据、bash、沙箱等问题，给出原始证据、可粘贴命令和 4 项确认后修复。

description.en: Runs local first-run diagnostics for DSH, checking Node, DSH_HOME, profiles, writability, sessions and API-key presence.
description.zh: 在本地运行 DSH 首次启动环境诊断，检查 Node、DSH_HOME、配置文件、可写性、会话及 API 密钥是否存在。

description.en: Converts between .env files and JSON using pure Node.js, offline with no external services.
description.zh: 在 .env 文件与 JSON 之间相互转换，使用纯 Node.js 实现，完全离线，无需外部服务。

description.en: Scans code references to environment variables and compares with .env to detect missing/unused vars, and generates sanitized .env.example.
description.zh: 扫描代码中的环境变量引用并与 .env 比对，检测缺失或未使用的变量，生成脱敏的 .env.example

description.en: DSH plugin that gives every session a shared, queryable registry of enterprise environments, services, deployments, layered rules and Skill bindings.
description.zh: 这是一个 DSH 插件，让每个会话都能查询企业运行环境、服务目录、部署实例、分层规则以及操作与 Skill 的绑定关系。

description.en: Probes local machine environment and injects it into every session's system prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 零依赖插件，探测本机环境信息并注入每个会话的系统提示。

description.en: Creates local private backups, exports conservative DSH config, and verifies restoration into a fresh compatible home.
description.zh: 创建本地私有备份、保守导出 DSH 配置，并验证恢复到全新的兼容主目录。

description.en: View and edit environment variables, .env files and secrets in the DSH desktop app, including Windows user and system scopes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版中查看和编辑环境变量、.env 文件与密钥，支持 Windows 用户级和系统级变量。

description.en: Essential oil dilution calculator that returns aromatherapy formulas based on parameters.
Adds a Sakura-themed boot splash animation to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with falling petals and mascot, auto-fading out.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加樱花主题启动动画：飘落花瓣、薄荷色吉祥物和 Sakura, walk slower. 文字，自动淡出，纯客户端实现。

description.en: Adds a Chinese gloss line plus expandable cause/impact/fix details under every DeepSeek Harness error, keeping the original English text intact.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每条报错附加一行中文释义，并附可展开的原因、影响与建议，原文完整保留。

description.en: DSH plugin using Everything (es.exe) for NTFS full-disk search with POSIX-style paths compatible with MSYS/git bash.
description.zh: DSH 插件，使用 Everything (es.exe) 进行 NTFS 全盘搜索，支持 POSIX 风格路径，兼容 MSYS(git bash)。

description.en: Adds opencode-style Esc keybinding to cancel the running turn in DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加 opencode 风格的 Esc 快捷键，按下 Esc 即可取消当前正在进行的对话轮次。

description.en: DSH-only advisor that keeps agent runs on cheaper models and escalates to stronger ones only when needed.
description.zh: DSH 专用顾问插件，让智能体大多数时间使用更便宜的模型，仅在需要时升级到更强的模型。

description.en: Adds Spanish locale support to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with translations for all UI namespaces.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加西班牙语语言环境支持，覆盖所有界面命名空间的翻译。

description.en: Returns an espresso brewing plan based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回意式浓缩咖啡萃取方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A DSH panel that monitors national-team ETF intraday market data from Eastmoney, built in pure Node with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 面板，纯 Node 零依赖实现，用于盘中监控国家队 ETF 行情（数据来自东方财富）。

description.en: Computes Euler's totient function in pure Node.js without external network calls.
description.zh: 在纯 Node.js 中计算欧拉函数，不进行外部网络调用。

description.en: Estimates electric vehicle range based on input parameters, returning detailed results in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数估算电动车续航里程，纯 Node 运行无需网络，返回详细计算结果。

description.en: Compare costs between electric vehicles and fuel vehicles with precise calculations.
A pure-CSS EVA cel-shade skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, adding ink outlines, hard shadows, scanlines and session status rails via design-token overrides.
description.zh: 纯 CSS 的 EVA 赛璐璐风格皮肤，通过覆盖设计令牌为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 加上墨线描边、硬投影、扫描线与会话状态轨。

description.en: EVA Unit-01 launch-console skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with a seven-scene boot sequence, NERV-style HUD and berserk mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 打造的 EVA 初号机发射控制台皮肤，包含七幕启动序列、NERV 风格 HUD 与暴走模式。

description.en: Lints public/synthetic DSH eval packs and grades JSON answers deterministically; explicitly not a validated benchmark.
description.zh: 对公开/合成评测包进行规范校验，并以确定性方式对 JSON 答案评分；明确说明并非经过验证的基准测试。

description.en: Event-driven trigger plugin that watches files and receives local webhooks to wake a target DSH session and inject a rendered prompt.
description.zh: 事件驱动触发器插件，通过文件监听和本地 webhook 唤醒目标会话并注入渲染后的提示词。

description.en: Sends DSH task-completion, interruption, approval and question alerts to Ntfy, Gotify or a generic webhook.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的任务完成、任务中断、需要审批、需要回答等事件推送到 Ntfy、Gotify 或通用 Webhook。

description.en: Provides an SSE event relay pushing host-side notifications to subscribed browser surfaces with topic filtering.
description.zh: 提供一条 SSE 通道，将宿主端通知推送给已订阅的浏览器界面，服务端按主题前缀过滤，并发送 __relay/open 重连信号。

description.en: Append-only shared event log that DSH, QQ, Bilibili and a desktop pet all write to and read back, so every entry point remembers one identity.
description.zh: 四端共用的只追加事件线：DSH、QQ、B站、桌宠都往里写一笔，醒来先读回同一份记忆。

description.en: Reads a court exhibit list and checks its completeness and internal consistency, flagging differences only without drawing legal conclusions.
description.zh: 读取法庭证据清单，核对完整性与内部一致性，仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: Local append-only evidence ledger plugin for DeepSeek Harness to record facts, test results, decisions, and failure paths.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地只追加证据账本，记录事实、测试结果、决策和失败路径。

description.en: Real-time visualization dashboard for DeepSeek Harness activities, turning component events into an evolving underwater biosphere.
description.zh: 实时可视化 DeepSeek Harness 活动，将组件事件转化为不断演化的水下生物圈。

description.en: Calculates optimal time allocation for exam questions based on parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算考试

description.en: Joins two Excel/CSV sheets on a declared key, compares fields with tolerances, and outputs a Markdown report, JSON result and diff workbook.
description.zh: 按指定主键对齐两份 Excel/CSV 表，按容差逐字段比较，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿。

description.en: Translates an agent's English execution narration into Simplified Chinese in place using the official DSH translator service.
description.zh: 使用官方 DSH 翻译服务，将智能体的英文执行叙述就地翻译为简体中文。

description.en: Calculates exercise calorie expenditure based on parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算运动消耗的卡路里并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无需网络。

description.en: Connects ExoMind's server-side knowledge flywheel to DeepSeek Harness, giving agents search, entity lookup and deep Q&A over your personal knowledge base.
description.zh: 把 ExoMind 知识飞轮接入 DeepSeek Harness,为 agent 提供检索、实体查询与深度问答三个工具,直接调用个人知识库。

description.en: Cross-session experience memory plugin with dual-acceptance gates for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: dsh-experience-flywheel · DSH 经验飞轮插件 — cross-session experience memory + dual-acceptance gates for DeepSeek Harness. Auto query/inject via agent/pre-step middleware; exit-1 gate scripts (plan-gate/clo

description.en: Configures per-model reasoning levels for custom API models with family presets and a settings editor.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型按模型分别配置推理等级，提供系列预设，并在官方设置页面内提供编辑界面。

description.en: Browse, import, AI-create, edit and skill-manage DSH experts in one hub, then switch experts per conversation from the chat input.
description.zh: 在统一的专家库中浏览、导入、AI 创建、编辑和管理 DSH 专家，并可在会话输入框旁按会话一键切换。

description.en: Orchestrates a multi-model adversarial review panel with hard budget and closure contracts, outputting an executable assignment order when the main model stalls.
description.zh: 多模型对抗式评审专家团，带硬性预算与收口契约，主力模型卡壳时产出可执行的指派单。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin adding a read-only '?' popup where a separate model explains in plain Chinese what the main agent is doing, without interrupting it.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件：主对话右上角「?」弹出独立浮窗，用白话中文解释主 agent 正在做什么，只读、不打扰主 agent。

description.en: Select text in a DSH answer to pop up an in-place streaming LLM explanation card that never enters the main chat context, with nested follow-ups.
description.zh: 在 DSH 回答中选中文本即可就地弹出流式解释卡片，解释不进入主对话上下文，卡片内还能继续选中追问并多级嵌套。

description.en: Select text in chat, code, rendered HTML or the sidebar editor to get a fast, isolated one-shot explanation with no main-session writes.
description.zh: 在聊天、代码、渲染 HTML 或右侧编辑器中选择文本，即可获得快速、隔离的一次性解释，且不写入主会话。

description.en: Native workspace file explorer for DSH with drag-and-drop chat insertion, git status badges, compact folders and tab integration.
description.zh: DSH 原生工作区文件浏览器，支持拖拽插入聊天、Git 状态徽章、紧凑文件夹和标签页集成。

description.en: Reads an export control item register and cross-checks the register's own completeness and licence closure, item by item.
description.zh: 读取出出口管制物项登记表，逐项交叉检查登记表自身的完整性与许可证闭环情况。

description.en: Calculates photography exposure combinations from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算摄影曝光组合并返回详细结果。

description.en: Local HTTP bridge for DeepSeek Harness Desktop that lets external processes create real sessions, send prompts and long-poll for replies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 提供的本地 HTTP 桥接服务，让外部进程创建真实会话、发送提示并长轮询获取回复。

description.en: Opens http/https/mailto/tel/file links in default browser/app, fixing broken shell.open-external bridge for DSH desktop.
description.zh: 在默认浏览器/应用中打开http/https/mailto/tel/file链接，绕过损坏的shell.open-external桥接。

description.en: Configures extra writable roots so fs tools and the sandboxed shell can write on the first try without approval prompts.
description.zh: 配置额外可写根目录，让文件工具与沙箱终端首次写入即成功，无需审批。

description.en: Returns a pet grooming care plan based on parameters; pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回宠物美容护理方案；纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Adds a warm paper eye-care palette to DeepSeek Harness as a third theme beside light and dark, with a Settings switch and sidebar toggle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加护眼暖纸配色，作为浅色/深色之外的第三种主题，并提供设置开关与侧边栏一键切换。

description.en: Returns daily eye makeup plan based on parameters. Pure Node implementation, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回每日眼妆方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: DSH plugin that swaps in an eye-care green background by overriding 31 background tokens, with a built-in settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 换上护眼绿背景的插件，覆盖 31 个背景 token，自带设置面板并注册进 DSH 设置页。

description.en: Fabric care tool that returns clear care recommendations based on input parameters.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回清晰护理建议的面料护理工具。

description.en: Pure Node implementation of factorial calculation, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的阶乘计算，无网络依赖。

description.en: Explains Windows sandbox process spawn EPERM failures with contextual diagnostics.
description.zh: Deterministic DeepSeek Harness plugin that explains Windows sandbox spawn EPERM failures in context

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness web_fetch accept fake-IP DNS answers while keeping the SSRF guard intact.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_fetch 接受 fake-IP DNS 解析结果，同时保持 SSRF 防护不变。

description.en: fal.ai image generation and editing for DSH via FAL_KEY settings and Agent tools that call queue.fal.run.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 fal.ai 图像生成与编辑，含 FAL_KEY 设置卡和 Agent 工具，直接调用 queue.fal.run。

description.en: Adds a fallback model chain to DeepSeek Harness so requests keep working on the next model when one keeps failing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加备用模型链，当某个模型请求持续失败时自动切换到列表中的下一个模型继续工作。

description.en: A family monthly budget planner in the DSH Web UI sidebar for income, expenses, savings, emergency fund and debt tracking.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 侧边栏中规划家庭月度预算：收入、固定与可变支出、储蓄、应急金和债务跟踪。

description.en: Audits source text for logic risks, decides each fix, then generates parallel rewrite drafts and exports them with a per-draft audit report.
description.zh: 改写前先审查源文本的逻辑风险，逐项决定修改方案，并行生成多份草稿，并随稿导出逐稿审查报告。

description.en: Manage long-running project services: register, start, stop, restart, and watch via agent tools and UI, with farm.yaml config.
description.zh: 管理长运行项目服务：通过farm.yaml配置，注册、启动、停止、重启和监视，并提供代理工具与概览界面。

description.en: Mobile-first DSH Web history loader with tail-first first paint, bounded prefetch and touch/fling handling; display-only, no context change.
description.zh: 面向手机/小屏的 DSH Web 历史渐进加载插件：尾部优先首屏、有界预取、触摸/快速滑动停稳，只影响显示，不改变模型上下文。

description.en: Low-latency terminal panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, using a dedicated PTY websocket with persistent sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏提供低延迟终端面板，使用专用 PTY websocket 并保持会话持久。

description.en: Unofficial Fate-inspired Archer × Rin skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with light/dark modes, offline and reversible.
description.zh: 非官方 Fate 主题的 Archer 与 Rin 皮肤，用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，支持浅色和深色模式，可离线使用并能还原。

description.en: Animated fat-fish mascot in the DSH input-box corner that switches among 29 expressions across 9 session states.
description.zh: DSH 输入框右上角的大肥鱼桌宠，按 9 种会话状态在 29 张表情间自动切换。

description.en: Adds a favicon status indicator to browser tabs showing session status: green done, amber waiting, blue running, spinning during execution.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 浏览器标签页图标显示会话状态：绿色表示完成、琥珀色表示等待、蓝色表示运行中，任务执行时图标旋转。

description.en: Exports your own Douyin and Xiaohongshu web favorites into Markdown by topic group, with an optional LLM digest.
description.zh: 将你自己的抖音和小红书网页收藏导出为按主题分组的 Markdown，并可选生成 LLM 摘要。

description.en: FC/NES game library and in-browser emulator for the DSH Web right sidebar, with multi-source search, ZIP support, saves and gamepad input.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页右侧栏提供 FC/NES 游戏库与模拟器，支持多源搜索、ZIP、存档与手柄操作。

description.en: Startup self-check that compares the current DSH install against the last healthy baseline and reports missing loader entries, client modules and skipped plugins.
description.zh: 启动自检：将当前 DSH 安装与上次健康基线对比，报告缺失的加载器条目、客户端模块及被兼容性检查跳过的插件。

description.en: Curated marketplace plugin for DSH that lets you compare plugins, verify engines.dsh compatibility and install with bilingual notes.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的精选插件市场插件，可对比插件、校验 engines.dsh 兼容性，并参考双语说明安心安装。

description.en: Lets the agent browse Bilibili, Zhihu, Juejin, Hacker News and other feeds, sharing interesting videos and posts into chat.
description.zh: 让 agent 自动刷 B站、知乎、掘金、贴吧、Hacker News 等信息源,把有意思的视频和贴文分享进群。

description.en: Feedly/RSS reader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a global reader panel and an agent tool supporting RSS 2.0, Atom, RDF, JSON Feed and OPML.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Feedly/RSS 阅读器插件，提供全局阅读面板和代理工具，支持 RSS 2.0、Atom、RDF、JSON Feed 与 OPML。

description.en: Viewer plugin for DSH Web that shows private Feishu bot chat history via a header button, using OpenClaw agent session files.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，在会话头部添加按钮，展示与飞书机器人的私聊记录，数据来自 OpenClaw 独立网关的 agent 会话文件。

description.en: Feishu/Lark CLI for DeepSeek Harness with QR sign-in panel, command console and agent tools covering 200+ commands and the full OpenAPI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 命令行工具，提供扫码登录面板、命令控制台和覆盖 200+ 命令与完整 OpenAPI 的智能体工具。

description.en: Spawns Feishu/Lark's official MCP server so DSH agents can send IM messages and work with docs, Bitable tables, calendar, and drive.
description.zh: 启动飞书/Lark 官方 MCP 服务器，让 DSH 智能体可发送 IM 消息并操作文档、多维表格、日历和云盘。

description.en: Poll Feishu (Lark) chats to extract candidate tasks and two-way sync them with a task-board plugin via a floating browser panel.
description.zh: 轮询飞书（Lark）会话提取任务，并通过悬浮浏览器面板与任务看板插件双向同步。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown knowledge base into tools every model can call: search, read, write, related entries and index rebuild, fed by web/file/RSS ingestion.
description.zh: 把本地纯 Markdown 知识库变成所有模型都能调用的工具：搜索、读全文、写入、相关推荐与重建索引，并支持网页/文件/目录/RSS 进料。

description.en: Injects two lines of persona life context per prompt, computed from an academic calendar, class timetable and daily routine, with a six-tab settings page.
description.zh: 每轮提示词注入两行角色生活上下文，按校历、课表与作息推算此刻在做什么，并带六页签设置页。

description.en: Synthesizes text into WAV speech via Alibaba Bailian TTS WebSocket, with audio preview and optional QQ voice message delivery.
description.zh: 通过阿里百炼 TTS WebSocket 接口把文本合成为 WAV 语音，支持试听并可选用 QQ 语音条发送。

description.en: A DSH desktop theme inspired by Fellow Moon's Control Bureau, with orange-black-white palettes, light/dark modes and a boot animation.
description.zh: 以《新月同行》超管局橙黑白配色重构的 DSH 桌面主题，含明暗两套配色与 CPO 开机动画。

description.en: A toggleable, editable system-prompt persona that makes DSH's AI chat in the style of Fengge, reverting to factual answers for real work.
description.zh: 可一键开关、可编辑的系统提示词人设插件，让 DSH 的 AI 以「峰哥亡命天涯」的语体聊天，做正事时自动退回按事实回答。

description.en: DSH agent tool that queries Riskbird for Chinese company records — registration, shareholders, executives, investments, legal and penalty data.
description.zh: DSH 智能体工具，通过风鸟（Riskbird）查询中国企业工商、股东、高管、对外投资、变更及司法处罚等记录。

description.en: Returns a dough-making plan based on fermentation parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据发酵参数返回制面团方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Fertilizer planning tool that returns plant care plans based on parameters, pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 肥料规划工具，根据参数返回植物养护计划，纯Node无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides NPK fertilizer ratio recommendations based on input parameters, pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 根据输入参数给出氮磷钾肥料配比建议，纯 Node 实现。

description.en: Structured data extractor that intercepts a page's XHR/fetch JSON APIs to return precise fields like counts, rankings, prices, and tables.
description.zh: 拦截页面的 XHR/fetch JSON 接口，提取计数、排名、价格、表格等结构化字段的数据提取器。

description.en: Adds a search filter box to the 'Fetch available models' candidate dialog in DSH settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置中「获取可用模型」候选弹窗添加搜索过滤框，可在浏览器端筛选模型候选列表。

description.en: Adds a deselect-all button to DSH Settings models fetch dialog.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中模型的获取可用模型对话框里添加全部取消选择按钮，为纯客户端插件。

description.en: feyagate dsh plugin
FGO Chaldea-inspired skin pack for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 5 themes, generated backdrops, gold trim.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web UI提供的FGO迦勒底主题皮肤包，含5个主题、生成背景和金色装饰。

description.en: A minimal Fibonacci plugin as pure Node code with no network dependencies, exposing a tool for session use.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的极简斐波那契插件，无网络依赖，暴露一个可供会话调用的工具。

description.en: Annotate text, PDF regions and images in the file preview, review the notes above the composer and send them along with your message.
description.zh: 在文件预览中为文字、PDF 区域和图片添加批注，在输入框上方检查后随消息一起发送。

description.en: Drag files into the web composer, resolve absolute paths, and inject hidden path info to the agent.
description.zh: dsh-file-beam - DSH plugin: drag files into the web composer, resolve real absolute paths, hidden path injection for the agent (no copy, no path in composer).

description.en: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness with saving, listing and navigation, plus quick creation of common projects.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用文件书签，支持保存、列表与跳转，并可快速创建常用项目。

description.en: Adds a confirmation step for file changes in dsh, displaying diff before write/edit is allowed.
Adds a right-click context menu to file links in chat, with open-with, save-as, copy path, copy content and reveal-in-file-manager actions.
description.zh: 为聊天中的文件链接添加右键菜单，支持打开方式、另存为、复制路径、复制内容和在访达/资源管理器中显示。

description.en: DSH plugin that finds duplicate files via SHA-256 content hashing, with a visual panel, chat tools and a restorable quarantine.
description.zh: DSH 文件查重插件，按 SHA-256 内容哈希找出重复文件，带可视化面板、对话工具和可恢复隔离区。

description.en: Adds an authenticated /api/dl route to the DSH Host so downloads keep their real filenames via Content-Disposition.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 新增已鉴权的 /api/dl 下载路由，通过 Content-Disposition 交付真实文件名。

description.en: Drag files and folders from the Sidebar Files pane into the composer and insert them as @ mentions.
description.zh: 从侧边栏文件面板拖动文件或文件夹到输入框，并以 @ 提及形式插入。

description.en: Expands folders dropped onto the DSH web composer into individual files, reusing the built-in upload intake unchanged.
description.zh: 将拖入 DSH 网页编辑器的文件夹展开为单个文件，并复用内置上传流程。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds native image previews and persistent file-drop attachment cards for dropped files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，为拖入的文件提供原生图片预览和持久化的非图片附件卡片。

description.en: File browser for reviewing agent changes with accept/reject, undo, inline editing, diff view, and markdown rendering.
description.zh: DSH WebUI workspace file browser: agent-change review (accept/reject + undo), inline editing, diff view and rendered markdown

description.en: A text editor for the DSH right sidebar with line numbers, syntax highlighting, folding, Git marks, autosave, find/replace and Markdown preview.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏中的文本编辑器，支持行号、语法高亮、代码折叠、Git 标记、自动保存、查找替换和 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Trae-style context-menu actions for DSH sidebar files: reveal in file manager, add to chat, save as, new file/folder, copy path, rename, recycle-bin delete.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏文件条目提供 Trae 风格右键菜单：在文件管理器中显示、添加到对话、另存为、新建文件/文件夹、复制路径、重命名、回收站删除。

description.en: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with right-click menus, inline size/date metadata, multi-select, confirm-guarded delete, and @-to-chat file references.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 文件页增强右键菜单、行内大小与日期元数据、多选与二次确认删除，并支持 @ 到对话。

description.en: Hands a local file to any program's native Open dialog via clipboard paste, verifies the path character by character, then confirms.
description.zh: 通过剪贴板粘贴将本地文件交给任意程序的本地打开对话框，逐字符校验路径后确认。

description.en: Windows-only DSH sidebar plugin that scans a workspace for leftover Low integrity labels, clears them to Medium, and verifies the fix.
description.zh: Windows 专用 DSH 右侧栏插件：扫描工作区残留的 Low 完整性标签，一键恢复为 Medium 并复扫验证。

description.en: Renders file references in DSH assistant replies as clickable chips with preview, auto-extracted from tool outputs and code.
description.zh: 将 DSH 助手回复中的文件引用从工具输出和代码里自动提取，渲染成可点击、带预览的标签

description.en: Adds a full file manager to the DSH sidebar for browsing, downloading, renaming, copying, moving and trashing files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏添加完整文件管理器，可浏览、下载、重命名、复制、移动和回收站式删除文件。

description.en: Full workspace file manager in the DSH web sidebar to browse, preview, edit, rename, copy, move, delete, compress, extract, upload and download files.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏中提供完整的工作区文件管理器，可浏览、预览、编辑、重命名、复制、移动、删除、压缩、解压、上传和下载文件。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin to insert @ relative file paths by fuzzy searching workspace, without injecting file contents.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，通过模糊搜索工作区来插入 @ 相对文件路径，不注入文件内容。

description.en: Web GUI bundle to select files anywhere on the local host and make paths available to the active conversation.
description.zh: 提供 Web GUI，用于选择本地主机上任意文件并将路径提供给当前对话。

description.en: Adds an in-chat modal to preview local files, images, PDFs, Office documents, and website links inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中添加聊天内预览弹窗，可查看本地文件、图片、PDF、Office 文档和网站链接。

description.en: Workspace file preview column for Markdown/PDF/image/CSV, with drag-and-drop file paths into conversation.
description.zh: DSH 插件：提供工作区文件预览栏，支持 Markdown、PDF、图片和 CSV 预览，展示会话生成的文件，并可拖拽文件或文件夹到对话中作为纯路径。

description.en: Adds a right-click action to the workspace file tree that inserts the selected file or folder as a native @ reference chip in the composer.
description.zh: 为工作区文件树添加右键操作，可将选中的文件或文件夹以原生 @ 引用标签插入输入框。

description.en: Caches file state on disk so coding agents explore once, remember reads, and get diffs on edit instead of full re-reads.
description.zh: 将文件状态缓存到磁盘，让编码助手只需一次探查、记住已读内容，编辑时直接返回 diff 而无需重读全文。

description.en: Manages uploaded files in DeepSeek Harness: list, inspect, delete, reference by @path, and read paths from clipboard.
description.zh: 管理DeepSeek Harness中上传的文件：列表、查看、删除、@path引用，以及从剪贴板读取路径。

description.en: Attach any file via drag, paste or upload; files are saved to disk and referenced by @absolute path, with vision-model image descriptions.
description.zh: 通过拖拽、粘贴或上传附加任意文件，统一落盘并用 @绝对路径 引用，非多模态模型的图片由视觉模型生成描述。

description.en: File manager for DSH Web with a sortable tree, multi-select, ZIP folder downloads and chunked drag-and-drop uploads.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH Web 的文件管理器，提供可排序目录树、多选、ZIP 文件夹下载和分块拖拽上传。

description.en: Adds a Files tab to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that browses the host's directories and reads files in place.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加「文件」标签，可浏览主机目录并就地阅读文件。

description.en: Adds a workspace file context menu to DeepSeek Harness with copy, cut, paste and keyboard shortcuts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区文件添加右键菜单，支持复制、剪切、粘贴和键盘快捷键。

description.en: In-GUI file viewer/editor for remote browsers with same-origin fencing and path allowlisting.
description.zh: 在 GUI 内查看和编辑远程浏览器中的文件，带同源隔离与路径白名单限制

description.en: DSH right-sidebar finance terminal with cross-asset quotes, 3D globe, risk gauge, glossary, bilingual news, and a finance_panel agent tool.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏金融终端：跨资产行情、3D 地球、风险偏好仪表、术语表、双语新闻，并提供 finance_panel 工具。

description.en: Search the full DSH session history, highlight every match in the transcript, and jump between hits with Enter.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话内搜索完整历史日志，逐处高亮正文并用回车在命中项之间跳转。

description.en: Search everything you've typed across every workspace and jump back to forgotten conversations from a sidebar lookup.
description.zh: 在所有工作区中搜索你输入过的内容，并通过侧边栏快速找回遗忘的对话。

description.en: Adds a find bar to DSH sidebar text previews with whole-file match counts, highlighted hits, and jump navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏文本预览添加查找栏，支持全文件匹配计数、高亮结果与跳转导航。

description.en: Visualizes Finesse 3 KatScript and offers a drag-and-drop optical bench designer for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Finesse 3 KatScript 可视化与拖拽式光学平台设计功能。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that plays a sound cue when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent asks a question, with mute, preview and volume controls.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件：回合结束时播放提示音，代理提问时播放另一种提示音，并提供静音、试听和音量控制。

description.en: An ambient firefly-forest theme that layers a living summer night behind the DSH Web UI, with fireflies, wind and phase-driven night cycles.
description.zh: 一款萤火森林氛围主题，在 DSH Web UI 背后铺一层会呼吸的夏夜：萤火虫、风场与随时相变化的夜色。

description.en: Maintains a first-principles decision ledger that cites real file:line facts, marks assumptions as falsifiable, and adds review dates to conclusions.
description.zh: 维护第一性原理决策账本：事实引用真实文件行号，假设可证伪，结论带复核日期。

description.en: Gives the agent a decaying 36-emotion mood model, injected as prompt segments that shape tone and reply length per group and person.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供带半衰期的 36 种情绪模型，以提示词段注入，按群和人物影响回复语气与长度。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that scores a Bilibili video's comment section for AI-comment "fish density" from 0 to 100 with metrics and evidence.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件，为 B 站视频评论区做「AI 鱼浓度」体检，输出 0–100 分、指标与匿名证据。

description.en: Pushes a "done" notification to your phone (Feishu/ntfy/Web Push) and plays a cute in-page animation when a DSH session finishes a turn.
description.zh: DSH 顶层会话完成一轮任务时，通过飞书/ntfy/Web Push 向手机推送「做好啦」提醒，并在页面内播放可爱动效弹窗。

description.en: Track workouts locally: agent fitness_log tools plus a left-rail dashboard for training history, weekly reports and plans, stored in SQLite.
description.zh: 本地撸铁打卡插件：提供 fitness_log 智能体工具和左侧栏面板，记录训练、查看历史、生成周报与训练计划，数据存于 SQLite。

description.en: Self-healing DSH plugin that repairs sessions broken by deleted attachment objects, downgrading unreadable images to placeholder text so the turn continues.
description.zh: 自愈型 DSH 插件：修复因附件对象被删而永久失败的会话，把读不出的图片降级为占位文本让该轮继续执行。

description.en: Sets default agent preset and model for new DSH sessions, with global defaults and per-workspace overrides.
description.zh: 为 DSH 新会话固定默认 Agent 预设与模型，支持全局默认和工作区独立配置。

description.en: Intentionally broken DSH plugin used only as a negative test fixture for plugin contract validation; not for real use.
description.zh: 故意编写的问题 DSH 插件，仅作为插件契约校验的负向测试样例，请勿实际使用。

description.en: Two-tier search failover plugin: tries Tavily first, then DeepSeek Search API, with quota-aware circuit breaking and automatic layer switching.
description.zh: 两级搜索故障转移插件：优先 Tavily，失败后自动切换到 DeepSeek Search API，并带额度感知熔断机制。

description.en: Core quick-control panel for the DSH web UI: floating/docked panel, extensible switch registry, skin system, zh/en i18n and alert surfaces.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的快捷控制面板核心：悬浮/停靠面板、可扩展开关注册表、皮肤系统、中英文 i18n 与提示浮层。

description.en: Local full-text search across all DSH sessions, chain-of-thought, tool calls and files, with click-to-jump to the exact matching block.
description.zh: 纯本地全文搜索所有DSH会话、思维链、工具调用与文件，点击结果直接跳转到命中的段落或卡片。

description.en: Companion plugin for dsh flash that turns session context-token pressure into tiered alerts and shows loaded skills in a header chip.
description.zh: dsh flash 配套插件：将会话上下文令牌压力转为分级告警，并在会话头部显示已加载技能。

description.en: Registers a host memory alert provider for dsh flash with RSS thresholds, growth-rate and Major GC alerts, plus a /memory trend view.
description.zh: 为 dsh flash 注册主机内存告警提供器，支持 RSS 阈值、增长速率和 Major GC 告警，并提供 /memory 趋势图。

description.en: Network monitor for dock-flash that audits outbound traffic and provides network alerts.
description.zh: 为 dock-flash 提供网络监控、出站流量审计和网络告警能力。

description.en: Controls system proxy settings for dsh with a global toggle, proxy modes, NO_PROXY policy, connection tests and proxy env inventory.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供系统代理控制：总开关、代理模式、NO_PROXY 策略、连接诊断与代理环境变量清单。
