description.en: Persists task checkpoints across context compaction and re-injects them into the system prompt so the model keeps continuity.
description.zh: 在上下文压缩时保存任务检查点，并在压缩后将其重新注入系统提示，让模型保持任务连续性。

description.en: Flavor-preserving long-term memory for character chat, stored as local JSON with retrieval-first recall and no vector DB.
description.zh: 为角色聊天提供保留风格的长期记忆，使用本地 JSON 存储、检索优先，无需向量数据库。

description.en: Session-aware mesh relay for DSH agents with Ed25519-signed receive routes, delivery policies, and outbound/registry libraries.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 代理的会话感知网格中继，提供 Ed25519 签名接收路由、投递策略以及出站与注册库。

description.en: Provides precise luggage allowance calculations based on parameters, returning detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算行李额度，返回详细结果。

description.en: Flight selection tool that returns travel planning solutions based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回航班出行方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Floating always-on-top lamp window that shows DeepSeek Harness task status by color: green running, orange approval, blue question, grey idle.
description.zh: 悬浮置顶状态灯窗口，用颜色显示 DeepSeek Harness 任务状态：绿运行、橙待批准、蓝提问、灰空闲。

description.en: Floating glass or invisible TXT/EPUB reader window in the Web UI, with rich text, images, dragging, resizing and collapse to a bar.
description.zh: Web UI 中的悬浮 TXT/EPUB 阅读窗口，支持玻璃/隐形外观、富文本与图片、拖动、缩放及收起为横条。

description.en: Fishing float setup tool that generates practical fishing plans based on input parameters.
A frosted-glass Windows desktop widget that shows live DSH task status, pending approvals, daily token usage and off-peak pricing countdown.
description.zh: 一块磨砂玻璃桌面小窗，实时显示 DSH 任务状态、待审批事项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时。

description.en: Send notes and memos to flomo from DeepSeek Harness via agent tools.
description.zh: 通过 flomo_send、flomo_config、flomo_status 三个代理工具，从 DeepSeek Harness 向浮墨笔记发送笔记和备忘。

description.en: A local Node tool that calculates flour substitution ratios and returns detailed results based on input parameters.
description.zh: 本地 Node 工具，根据输入的参数计算面粉替代比例并返回详细结果。

description.en: Visual flow-graph editor for DeepSeek Harness that chains prompts, model switches, commands, branches and loops, run only at turn boundaries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的可视化流程图编辑器，将提示词、模型切换、命令、分支与循环串成一张图，仅在轮次边界执行。

description.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks in DeepSeek Harness as interactive diagrams with zoom, fit, fullscreen, and PNG/SVG export.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将 Mermaid 代码块渲染为可交互图表，支持缩放、适配、全屏及 PNG/SVG 导出。

description.en: Provides flower care and floral arrangement schemes based on input parameters, pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数输出鲜花养护与插花方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Returns floral arrangement color schemes based on parameters; pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回花艺插花的配色方案，纯 Node 实现。

description.en: Selects flower materials and returns flower arrangement schemes based on parameters; pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 根据参数选择花材并返回插花方案，纯 Node 实现，可离线运行。

description.en: Reads an FMEA worksheet by its own column names and mechanically checks element completeness and RPN score consistency, flagging only discrepancies.
description.zh: 按表格自身列名读取 FMEA 分析表，机械核对要素齐备性与风险顺序数一致性，仅提示差异。

description.en: Adds a Service Control sidebar panel to fnOS dsh web with reload-page and restart-DSH-web buttons, so mobile users skip keyboard shortcuts.
description.zh: 为飞牛 NAS 上的 dsh 网页添加侧边栏“服务控制”面板，提供刷新页面和重启 DSH 网页两个操作，方便手机用户免找快捷键。

description.en: Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH into grouped expandable bars.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中自动折叠上下文和系统消息，将思考块、工具调用和工具结果收起为可展开的分组条。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：折叠较早消息 + 彻底删除会话
DSH Web plugin that force-collapses every chat turn's work process into one line, keeping answers visible and restoring full history folding.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：强制折叠每一轮的工作过程为一行，答案照常显示，历史轮次与上下文注入行一并折叠。

description.en: Folds thinking and tool steps into two collapsible layers in the DeepSeek Harness chat view.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天视图中把思考内容和工具调用步骤折叠成两个可展开收起的层级。

description.en: Adds an 'Open Folder' action to the workspace context menu in DeepSeek Harness between Rename and Delete.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness的工作区右键菜单中添加'打开文件夹'操作，位于重命名和删除之间。

description.en: Adds folder references to the DeepSeek Harness web composer via a host folder dialog, /folder command, and folder drag/paste as @path mentions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框添加文件夹引用：宿主文件夹对话框、/folder 命令，以及拖拽/粘贴文件夹解析为 @path 提及。

description.en: Drag a folder into the DSH Desktop composer and have its real absolute path written straight into the draft, no copy or upload.
description.zh: 把文件夹拖进 DSH Desktop 编辑器，直接得到它的原生绝对路径写入草稿，无需复制或上传。

description.en: VSCode-like folder explorer for DSH with a file tree, type icons, file operations and Add to Chat actions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供类似 VSCode 的文件夹浏览器，含文件树、类型图标、文件操作和添加到聊天功能。

description.en: Receives folder paths from external sources and opens them directly as dsh workspaces.
description.zh: 从外部来源接收文件夹路径，并将其直接作为 dsh 工作区打开。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that turns each workspace folder row into one-click buttons opening that directory in Finder, Zed, or Ghostty on macOS.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件：把每个工作区文件夹行变成一键入口，可直接在访达、Zed 或 Ghostty 中打开该目录（macOS）。

description.en: Folder-style sidebar for DSH that shows workspaces as folders; click a folder to open its session list.
description.zh: DSH 文件夹式侧栏：将工作区显示为文件夹，点击文件夹即可进入其会话列表。

description.en: Folder time machine for DSH: auto-snapshots any folder (real-time or scheduled), dedupes by content, and lets you roll back anytime with an undoable restore.
description.zh: DSH 文件夹时光机：实时或定时自动为任意文件夹存档，按内容去重，随时回滚且恢复本身可撤销。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 照片壁纸轮播插件：读取本地文件夹照片作为界面背景，自动轮播 + 毛玻璃面板。
A right-sidebar file manager plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets you browse and manage files without leaving the chat.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的右侧栏文件管理插件，让你无需离开对话即可浏览和管理文件。

description.en: Wakes the agent when a watched directory changes, delivering the diff while filtering out echoes of its own writes.
description.zh: 当被监视目录发生变化时唤醒代理，提供差异内容并过滤掉自身写入产生的回显。

description.en: Tool for breaking down follower growth targets with precise calculations. Pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 把涨粉目标拆解为可计算的具体指标，纯 Node 实现，无需联网。

description.en: Adds clickable follow-up prompt chips under answers in DeepSeek Harness to help users continue the conversation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的每个回答下添加一排可点击的追问提示，帮助用户继续对话。

description.en: A user-owned, cross-session follow-up todo list for DeepSeek Harness where each todo carries handoff notes so new chats can start without re-reading old ones.
description.zh: 面向用户而非 agent 的跨会话待办清单，每条待办自带交接说明，让新会话无需回翻旧聊天即可直接开工。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets you customize Web GUI interface fonts, code fonts, and font sizes from Settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可在设置中自定义 Web GUI 的界面字体、代码字体和字体大小。

description.en: Customizes DSH Web UI fonts (interface, code, and size) with installed-font detection and persistent host-side config.
description.zh: 定制DSH Web UI的界面/代码字体与字号，支持本机字体探测，配置持久化保存。

description.en: DSH plugin to visually pick UI, code, and terminal fonts, edit fallback stacks, import custom fonts, preview live, and reset in one click via ctx.theme.
description.zh: DSH 插件：可视化选择界面/代码/终端字体，编辑回退字体栈，导入自定义字体，实时预览，并可一键重置（通过 ctx.theme 应用）。

description.en: DSH font plugin that lets you set CJK and Latin families separately across interface, content, and code areas.
description.zh: DSH 字体插件：可分别指定中西文字体，界面、内容与代码三处独立配置。

description.en: Adds font preference settings to DSH Web UI, including UI and code font selection with system font enumeration and CSS overrides.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加字体偏好设置，可选择界面与代码字体，支持枚举系统字体并通过 CSS 覆盖生效。

description.en: DSH Font Studio swaps the body and code fonts and font sizes in DeepSeek Harness, with a preset gallery, custom font stacks and live preview.
description.zh: DSH 字体工坊可为 DeepSeek Harness 更换正文/代码字体与字号，提供预设画廊、自定义字体栈与实时预览。

description.en: Hold Ctrl and scroll the mouse wheel to change the workspace font size by 1px per notch, persisting through the built-in theme API.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮，每格以 1px 为单位调整工作区字号，并通过内置主题接口持久化保存。

description.en: Sidebar-footer entry manager that lists every bottom-area plugin entry with per-entry show/hide toggles, persisted state and layout fixes.
description.zh: 侧栏底部入口管理器：列出底部区域全部插件入口，逐条开关显示或隐藏，状态可持久化，并修复底部拥挤布局。

description.en: Adds a skippable, configurable SVG boot intro (9.9s/30s/120s) with synthesized sound and Chinese narration to DSH cold start.
description.zh: 为 DSH 冷启动增加可跳过、可配置的 SVG 开屏动画（9.9/30/120 秒），配逐样本合成音效与中文旁白。

description.en: Turns videos into searchable knowledge: quick metadata scans, transcription, frame OCR, summaries, and local fuzzy retrieval.
description.zh: 把视频采集为可检索知识：快扫元数据、口播转写、抽帧OCR、摘要写回与本地模糊检索。

description.en: Reads a forecast-accuracy assessment register and verifies its completeness, field formatting and charge/accuracy arithmetic, flagging differences only.
description.zh: 读取预测准确率考核台账，校验其完整性、字段格式及准确率与考核费用的算式一致性，仅提示差异。

description.en: Real-time streaming display of foreground command output in DSH web UI, showing stdout/stderr incrementally during execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 中实时流式显示前台命令的 stdout 与 stderr，对话历史命令卡片和底部流条随执行过程更新，并提供相关设置。

description.en: Plugin lifecycle toolkit that statically checks a DSH plugin before install, diagnoses Skill folders, then re-verifies and rolls back with a ledger.
description.zh: 插件生命周期工具：安装前静态体检、Skill 目录诊断，安装后复验并通过回滚账本还原。

description.en: Adds a UI button to fork a DeepSeek Harness session into a different agent preset via a preset picker.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加按钮和预设选择器，把当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话分叉到另一个智能体预设。

description.en: Calculates baby formula stage from input parameters and returns clear recommendations. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算婴儿奶粉段位并返回明确的段位建议，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: DSH skill plus SymPy CLI that verifies paper formulas with symbolic checks, numeric samples and generated pytest cards.
description.zh: DSH 技能与 SymPy 命令行工具，用符号检查、数值采样和生成的 pytest 用例验证论文公式。

description.en: A draggable fox desktop pet in the DSH web corner that shows multi-project status cards, plays voice alerts on completion, and can be imported or hot-swapped.
description.zh: DSH 网页右下角可拖拽的小狐狸桌宠，用状态卡片监控多项目、完成时语音提醒，并支持宠物导入与热切换。

description.en: Foxy sub-plugin that autonomously browses Bilibili trending videos, reads subtitles, decides whether to comment, and saves notes to memory.
description.zh: Foxy 子插件：自主浏览 B 站热门视频、读取字幕、判断是否评论，并把有趣内容写入记忆。

description.en: Shows WorkBuddy/Qoder account credits, daily quota, check-in status and per-turn credit usage in the DSH sidebar, with one-click priority switching.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 WorkBuddy/Qoder 账号积分、每日额度、签到状态与每轮积分消耗，并支持一键切换优先消耗平台。

description.en: Keyless image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that needs no API key or paid account and handles rate limits.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的免密钥图像生成插件，无需 API 密钥或付费账户，并具备速率限制感知。

description.en: Free-model console for DSH that configures CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy account lanes, local service lanes with HTTP probes, and 21 keyless or BYO-key channels in one settings page.
description.zh: DSH 免费模型控制台：在同一个设置页中配置 CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy 账号通道、带 HTTP 探测的本地服务通道，以及 21 个免密钥或自带密钥通道。

description.en: Key-free Chinese/English web search plus static webpage text extraction for DeepSeek Harness via two native tools, no browser or subprocess needed.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供免密钥的中英文网页搜索和静态网页正文提取，两个原生工具，无需浏览器或子进程。

description.en: A DSH panel that aggregates 29 legitimate free LLM providers and routes requests with automatic failover between them.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 面板，聚合 29 个合法的免费 LLM 提供方，并在请求失败时自动切换。

description.en: DSH plugin that plugs free OpenCode Zen models into DeepSeek Harness as an LLM provider, with no API key required.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入免费 OpenCode Zen 模型的插件，无需 API key 即可使用。

description.en: Hermetic lockfile for DeepSeek Harness plugin compositions: fingerprints profiles and warns or fails when compositions drift.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件组合提供密闭锁定：生成配置指纹，出现漂移时警告或在严格模式下报错。

description.en: Versions freight ratecards, audits carrier bills against them, summarises recovery and exports variance reports.
description.zh: 对运费费率卡进行版本管理，据此审计承运商账单，汇总可追回金额并导出差异报表。

description.en: A fridge buying tool that returns kitchen appliance purchase recommendations based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回冰箱等厨房电器的购买推荐，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds public chat rooms and opt-in encrypted private text chat to DeepSeek Harness, powered by Nostr relays.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加公共聊天室和可选开启的加密私聊，基于 Nostr 中继实现。

description.en: Adds a floating, draggable friends list and multi-tab one-to-one chat inside DSH, with profiles, presence and device transfer codes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内提供可拖动的浮窗好友列表与多标签一对一聊天，含个人资料、在线状态和换机迁移码。

description.en: Frontend review canvas plugin + Skill for DeepSeek Harness: pin fixed page versions, annotate visually, and route feedback back into the bound conversation.
Zero-dependency HTML slides skill pack that creates animated presentations and converts PPT/PPTX to web pages.
description.zh: 零依赖 HTML 幻灯片技能包，可生成带丰富动画的演示文稿，并将 PPT/PPTX 转换为网页。

description.en: Evidence-gated frontier mathematics research workflow for DeepSeek Harness, focusing on rigorous novelty checks and independent verification.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供以前沿数学研究为目标的证据门控工作流，包含严格的新颖性检查与独立验证。

description.en: Makes the DeepSeek Harness Desktop window on macOS show real native frosted-glass vibrancy instead of opaque panes.
description.zh: 让 macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 窗口显示真正的原生毛玻璃效果，而非不透明面板。

description.en: Token-efficient filesystem tools (fs_read, fs_grep, fs_glob, fs_replace) for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供精简令牌的文件系统工具（读取、grep、glob、替换）。

description.en: Patches DSH's filesystem version guard to ignore macOS ctime-only metadata noise, removing false FS_STALE_VERSION errors after writes.
description.zh: 让 DSH 文件版本守卫忽略 macOS 上仅 ctime 变化的元数据噪声，消除写入后误报的 FS_STALE_VERSION 错误。

description.en: Adds missing filesystem delete, directory creation, and move tools to DSH, with in-process fs access and strict session sandbox levels.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补齐文件删除、建目录和移动工具，走进程内 fs 通路并严格遵守会话沙箱档位。

description.en: Enhances DSH's built-in glob and grep with symlink following, extra grep flags, and parallel scanning that keeps newest-first results.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 内置的 glob 与 grep：默认跟随符号链接、增加 grep 标志，并行扫描并保持按修改时间倒序。

description.en: Calculates fuel cost from given parameters and returns detailed results.
Configures and runs a local HTTP server for testing and development.
description.zh: 配置并启动本地 HTTP 服务器，用于测试与开发。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for plotting 2D functions (e.g., activation functions) and displaying SVG files from the workspace in chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供二维函数（如激活函数）绘图，并在聊天中显示工作区里的 SVG 文件。

description.en: Provides home anti-mold and dehumidification solutions for furniture care based on input parameters.
Provides furniture repair plans based on input parameters; pure Node implementation without network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成家具维修方案，采用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness Web GUI interface and code fonts with Fusion Pixel 12px pixel fonts.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面与代码字体替换为 Fusion Pixel 12px 像素字体

description.en: Provides tools to list and query digital human entries by ID or name, implemented in pure Node without network dependencies.
description.zh: 提供列出和查询数字人条目的工具，支持按 ID 或名称查询，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Provides tools to list and query quantum computing entries from a local dataset.
A local simulated FX trading arena against Whale-chan with K-line charts, 10-500x leverage, timed and goal modes, no network or real money.
description.zh: 本地模拟外汇交易竞技场，对战鲸酱，带K线图、10-500倍杠杆、限时与目标模式，无需联网也不涉及真钱。

description.en: 实时汇率换算工具，通过网络实时拉取最新汇率数据。
description.zh: 实时汇率换算工具，通过网络实时拉取最新汇率数据。

description.en: A live FX/market ticker strip above the dsh composer, with trend charts, market-timezone session labels and a 24-pair currency calculator.
description.zh: dsh 输入框上方的实时汇率/行情跑马灯，支持走势图、按市场时区标注交易时段和 24 个货币对的汇率计算器。

description.en: A dsh plugin whose description only identifies it as the element gadolinium.
description.zh: dsh 插件 dsh-gadolinium，其描述仅标明它是化学元素钆，未说明其他功能。

description.en: Converts gallons to liters (加仑转升), a simple unit conversion tool.
description.zh: 将加仑转换为升，简单实用的单位换算工具。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin with the sole description 'gallium element' and no documented functionality.
description.zh: 名为 dsh-gallium 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，描述仅为“镓元素”，未记载任何具体功能。

description.en: Provides static info about Gambia: capital, population, currency, and continent. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 提供冈比亚的静态信息，包括首都、人口、货币和所属大洲，纯 Node 实现且无需网络。

description.en: An idle text-adventure companion plugin that shows a small wooden door and world map, pairing your day's tool metadata with a character's story.
description.zh: 一个挂机文字冒险陪伴插件，右下角小木门通向世界地图，用你的工具元数据对照讲述他那一头的生活。

description.en: A thin DSH plugin plus local engine that gives DSH eyes (screen capture, OCR, world state) and hands (virtual gamepad and keyboard injection) for games.
description.zh: 一个轻量 DSH 插件加本地引擎，为 DSH 提供游戏的眼睛（截屏、OCR、世界状态）和手（虚拟手柄与键鼠注入）。

description.en: DSH plugin that looks up Genshin, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero character builds and panels by UID and reports them in Chinese.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按 UID 查询原神/星铁/绝区零的角色练度与汇总面板，并整理成中文报告。

description.en: Adds a /gamemode slash command to instantly switch your AI agent to Creative Mode.
description.zh: 添加 /gamemode 斜杠命令，可即时把 AI 智能体切换为创造模式。

description.en: Lets DSH agents build Scratch projects inside your running Gandi IDE: scripts, art, sounds, run it, screenshot, and iterate.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 agent 在你正在运行的 Gandi IDE 里制作 Scratch 项目：写脚本、画造型、加声音、运行并截图后继续修改。

description.en: 备考时间拆解工具，按参数精确计算备考时间分配，返回详细结果。
description.zh: 备考时间拆解工具，按参数精确计算备考时间

description.en: Adds an Interstellar-inspired animated Gargantua black hole as a decorative background for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加《星际穿越》风格的卡冈图雅黑洞动态背景装饰。

description.en: Garmin desktop dashboard for sleep, HRV, activity maps, FIT analysis and AI-assisted multi-day route planning.
description.zh: 佳明桌面插件：展示睡眠、HRV、活动地图与FIT分析，并支持AI多日路线规划。

description.en: Gas safety tool that returns key scenario-based response steps; pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 燃气安全工具，按场景返回关键应急处置步骤，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Play Game Boy Advance games inside DeepSeek Harness, with a 245-game store, your own ROMs, a floating player window, boss key and save states.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中玩 Game Boy Advance 游戏，内置 245 款社区游戏商店、自有卡带、悬浮播放窗口、老板键与即时存档。

description.en: A kitten-styled DSH Web UI widget that shows live Google Gemini free-tier quota per model, with a model switcher and color-coded warnings.
description.zh: 一个猫娘风格的 DSH 网页挂件，实时显示 Google Gemini 免费层各型号的额度使用情况，支持型号切换与变色预警。

description.en: Normalizes tool schemas before the model request, preventing Gemini functionDeclarations 400 errors from MCP or built-in tools.
description.zh: 在发送模型请求前规范化工具 schema，避免 MCP 或内置工具导致的 Gemini functionDeclarations 400 错误。

description.en: Generate and compare roadmap idea options via headless agent runs, select one, and export to goal.md.
description.zh: 通过无头代理运行生成和比较路线图方案，选定一个并导出为goal.md。

description.en: Launches GenOffice for GenOffice task-list skills or designates a Captain session to orchestrate first in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中启动 GenOffice 处理任务列表技能，或指定 Captain 会话优先进行编排。

description.en: Plays audio alerts when a DSH execution completes or when the agent waits for your input, with built-in Genshin Impact character voices and custom audio upload.
description.zh: 在 DSH 执行完成或 agent 等待你输入时播放音频提醒，内置多款原神角色语音并支持自定义音频上传。

description.en: Trims the GenUI card system prompt per global, workspace or session scope to keep model context lean.
description.zh: 按全局、工作区或会话范围裁剪 GenUI 卡片系统提示词，让模型上下文更精简。

description.en: GIS/CAD analysis toolkit that reads DXF, converts DWG to DXF, and produces styled maps with buffer and overlay analysis.
description.zh: GIS/CAD 分析工具包，可读取 DXF、将 DWG 转为 DXF，并生成带缓冲区与叠加分析的样式化地图。

description.en: Turns a model-written GeoGebra command list into real geometry figures, exporting PNG images or editable .ggb files headlessly.
description.zh: 把模型给出的 GeoGebra 命令列表画成真实几何图形，无窗口运行，可导出 PNG 或可用 GeoGebra 打开的 .ggb 文件。

description.en: Automates job applications on Boss直聘, 猎聘, 51job and 智联: filter postings, send AI greetings, auto-apply, and export records to Excel.
description.zh: 一个面板搞定 Boss直聘、猎聘、51job、智联的岗位筛选、AI 打招呼、自动投递，并可将投递记录导出为 Excel。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness agents publish HTML pages and Markdown documents as shareable artifacts on GitHub Pages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体把 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档发布为可分享的 GitHub Pages 构件。

description.en: Ingests electricity activity data, calculates location-based GHG emissions, verifies rows, and generates workpapers with a partial ESRS reporting pack.
description.zh: 导入电力活动数据，基于地点计算温室气体排放，校验数据行，并生成工作底稿和部分 ESRS 报告包。

description.en: Shows model-predicted next-message ghost text in the dsh composer; press the right arrow key to accept the suggestion.
description.zh: 在 dsh 输入框中以幽灵文字显示模型预测的下一句，按 → 键即可接受。

description.en: A friendly ghost drifts across your DeepSeek Harness web UI at random intervals to keep you awake and refreshed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中随机间隔飘过一个幽灵动画，提醒你保持清醒。

description.en: Host-only gate for DeepSeek Harness: the first animated-image read in a session is denied until the model has read a strategy document.
DSH Web plugin showing the session's current Git branch in the composer, a local/remote branch table with checkout, and a read-only commit graph.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：在输入框显示当前会话的 Git 分支，提供可切换的本地/远程分支表以及只读提交图。

description.en: Floating Git commit panel in the DSH web GUI that shows branch and diff stats and commits with AI-drafted messages.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面悬浮的 Git 提交面板：显示分支与改动统计，可由 AI 起草提交信息并一键提交或推送。

description.en: VSCode/IDEA-style Git source control panel for the DSH right sidebar with commit graph, branch switching, staging and hunk actions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏提供 VSCode/IDEA 风格的 Git 源码管理面板，包含提交图、分支切换、暂存与代码块操作。

description.en: Configurable Git commit and pull-request conventions for DeepSeek Harness, enforcing user-defined rules on commit messages and PR titles/descriptions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的 Git 提交与 PR 规范校验，按用户自定义规则检查提交信息及拉取请求标题和描述。

description.en: Turns AI chats into a Git-like conversation tree with branching, forking, archiving, and context inheritance.
description.zh: 将 AI 对话变成类似 Git 的树状结构，支持分支、Fork、归档和上下文继承。

description.en: Git graph in the DSH Web sidebar for browsing commits, branches, tags and stashes, inspecting diffs and running Git actions.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏展示 Git 图谱，可浏览提交、分支、标签与暂存，查看差异并执行 Git 操作。

description.en: Adds a read-only Git Graph tab to the DSH conversation view showing the commit DAG, branches, tags, remotes and commit details.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话视图添加只读 Git 图谱标签页，展示提交 DAG、分支、标签、远程引用与提交详情。

description.en: Renders a GitHub-style 53×7 heatmap of your own commits across many local git repos, optionally merging GitHub/Gitee remote contributions.
description.zh: 把本机多个 git 仓库中本人的提交渲染成 GitHub 风格 53×7 贡献热力图，可选合并 GitHub/Gitee 远程贡献。

description.en: A git panel inside the DSH session with repository chip, branch tree, commit graph, working tree and commit detail views, plus 8 git model tools.
description.zh: DSH 会话内的 Git 面板：仓库标签、分支树、提交图、工作区与提交详情，以及 8 个 git 模型工具。

description.en: DSH web GUI git panel for branch management and GitLens-style commit graph.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Git 面板，提供分支管理和 GitLens 风格的提交图谱。

description.en: Back up, restore and sync DSH session records across devices through your own private Git repository, with three-way merging and conflict prompts.
description.zh: 用你自己的私有 Git 仓库备份、恢复并跨设备同步 DSH 会话记录，支持三向合并并在冲突时停下来询问。

description.en: Real-time git status display and branch switching in DSH session views with badges and environment line.
description.zh: DSH 会话视图中实时显示 git 状态并支持分支切换，带徽标和环境行。

description.en: Provides configurable Git commit and pull request prompt instructions for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的 Git 提交与拉取请求提示指令。

description.en: Syncs Git config to GitHub with conflict self-healing and adapters for multiple AI coding tools.
description.zh: 将Git配置同步到GitHub，具有冲突自愈功能，并支持多种AI编程工具的适配器。

description.en: A git development workbench for managing branches, worktrees, and git commands with context injection.
description.zh: DSH git development workbench: branch/worktree environment picker, git context injection, /git commands, worktree manager, merge & cleanup policy

description.en: A Git workbench for DSH adding a sidebar repo switcher plus per-chat Git, Tickets and local Kanban Board tabs for daily Git work.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Git 工作台：侧边栏仓库切换，以及每个会话独立的 Git、工单和本地看板视图标签页。

description.en: Connects your GitHub account inside DSH so the AI can create repos, upload files, edit code, open issues/PRs and read Actions logs as you.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内连接 GitHub 账号，让 AI 以你的身份建仓库、传文件、改代码、提 issue/PR 并读取 Actions 日志。

description.en: GitHub tools for DeepSeek Harness: REST API calls, multi-file commits in one commit, and repository creation with token kept in settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 工具：REST API 调用、单次提交多文件、创建仓库，令牌仅保存在插件设置中。

description.en: Publishes a workspace or project directory to GitHub with read-only preflight, secret scanning, .gitignore generation, repo creation, commit, divergence handling and push.
description.zh: 将工作区或项目目录发布到 GitHub：只读预检、密钥扫描、生成 .gitignore、创建仓库、提交、处理分支分歧并推送。

description.en: GitHub Actions CI manager with live pipeline dashboard, repo browser, run controls, and failure logs.
description.zh: GitHub Actions CI管理器，提供实时流水线仪表板、仓库浏览、运行控制和失败日志。

description.en: Provides 9 typed GitHub tools with 58 actions, gating every write behind confirm:true and human approval, plus self-update and settings.
description.zh: 提供 9 个类型化 GitHub 工具（58 个操作），所有写操作需 confirm:true 并经人工审批，支持自更新与设置页。

description.en: DSH plugin named github-link; its README contains only npm, license and star badges, so functionality beyond the name is undocumented.
description.zh: 名为 github-link 的 DSH 插件；README 仅含 npm、许可证和 star 徽章，除名称外未说明具体功能。

description.en: Polls GitHub read-only via the local gh CLI and turns pending PR reviews, new issues and @mentions into superagent signals or on-page alerts.
description.zh: 通过本机 gh 只读轮询 GitHub，把待评审 PR、新 Issue 和 @我 的消息转为 superagent 信号或页面提醒。

description.en: Adds a budgeted, cached, rate-limit-aware GitHub search that surfaces reusable open-source repositories before the model answers each request.
description.zh: 在模型每次回答前，通过带预算、缓存和限流保护的 GitHub 搜索，列出可复用的开源仓库。

description.en: GitHub panel for the DSH Web UI showing connection status, a repository dashboard, profile checklist and safe metadata actions.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供 GitHub 面板：连接状态、仓库仪表盘、个人资料检查清单和安全元数据操作。

description.en: One-click publisher that pushes local DSH plugins to GitHub: token validation, repo init/creation, commit, push and optional Release.
description.zh: 一键把本地 DSH 插件推送到 GitHub：令牌校验、建仓、提交、推送，可选发布 Release。

description.en: One-click GitHub publishing for local DSH plugins: fills metadata, scaffolds files, creates the repo, commits, pushes, tags and releases.
description.zh: 一键把本地 DSH 插件发布到 GitHub：自动补全元数据、生成基础文件、建仓、提交、推送、打 tag 并发布 Release。

description.en: Browse GitHub Trending daily, weekly and monthly boards in a masonry card panel, with AI-written project intros and one-click starring.
description.zh: 以瀑布流卡片面板浏览 GitHub Trending 日榜、周榜和月榜，附 AI 撰写的项目简介并可一键 Star。

description.en: Structured Git tools for DeepSeek Harness with status, diff, log, commit, and branch commands plus path validation and shell-free execution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化 Git 工具，支持 status、diff、log、commit、branch，并带路径校验与免 shell 执行。

description.en: Adds partial git submodule management to DeepSeek Harness, allowing add, clone, and manage submodules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加部分 git 子模块管理能力，支持添加、克隆和管理子模块。

description.en: GitNexus code-graph plugin for DeepSeek Harness that ships 17 MCP graph tools, one-command install and Chinese skills.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 GitNexus 代码图谱插件，内置 17 个 MCP 图谱工具、一键安装与中文技能。

description.en: Git management panel for the DSH web client that browses workspaces, branches, changes and commit history, and performs commits, pushes and branch operations.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端的 Git 管理面板，可浏览工作区、分支、改动与提交历史，并直接完成提交、推送与分支操作。

description.en: Visual Git graph and repository control plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with branch operations, commit inspection, diffs, and staging in the sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化 Git 图谱与仓库操作，支持分支管理、提交查看、差异对比和暂存控制。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar Git panel for working-tree changes, staging, commits, diffs, commit graph, blame, reflog, and GitHub/GitLab/Gitea CI status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏 Git 面板，支持工作区更改、暂存、提交、差异对比、提交图、blame、reflog 以及 GitHub/GitLab/Gitea 的 CI 状态。

description.en: Provides glass care recommendations based on parameter calculations, pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数计算给出玻璃养护建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: A glass-material skin for DSH that makes the composer, dialogs, menus and code blocks translucent, toggled from Settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供玻璃质感外观，让输入框、对话框、菜单和代码块呈现半透明效果，可在设置中一键开关。

description.en: Acrylic glass skin for the DSH desktop UI: translucent canvas and sidebar over a heavy-blur cold gray-blue background.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端亚克力玻璃皮肤：半透明会话画布与侧栏，叠加冷灰蓝重模糊背景。

description.en: An Apple Liquid Glass skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with token-level re-keying, glass chrome, a grouped model picker and a merged usage panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供的 Apple Liquid Glass 皮肤，包含令牌级换肤、玻璃质感界面、分组模型选择器和合并的用量面板。

description.en: Liquid-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: frosted translucency, adjustable tint, dynamic image/video wallpapers, font injection, and custom CSS.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造液态玻璃主题：磨砂半透明、可调色调、动态壁纸、字体注入和自定义 CSS。

description.en: Shows real-time GLM Coding Plan quota usage as a pill in the DSH web GUI composer stats row.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面的编辑器统计行中以胶囊形式实时显示 GLM 编码套餐配额用量。

description.en: Adds Z.AI (GLM) web search, web reader and vision tools to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated via Z.AI email OAuth instead of an API key.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供Z.AI(GLM)网页搜索、网页阅读与视觉能力，通过Z.AI邮箱OAuth登录而非API密钥鉴权。

description.en: A macOS global hotkey opens a small prompt bar anywhere and instantly starts a DeepSeek Harness session with the text you type.
description.zh: 一个 macOS 全局快捷键，可在任意位置呼出小输入框，输入内容后立即启动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Pins conversations globally across DeepSeek Harness workspaces, with drag-to-reorder and recent-first sorting.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 各工作区之间全局置顶会话，支持拖拽排序和最近优先排序。

description.en: GUI for editing global and per-workspace AGENTS.md prompts in DeepSeek Harness, with instant apply, two-way sync and a session-compress button.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图形化提示词管理：可视化编辑全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，改完即生效，并附带会话压缩按钮。

description.en: Global internet radio plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a NetEase-style discovery page, 20 Chinese city stations, FM/AM tuning and spectrum visualizer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全球电台插件：网易云风格发现页、20 个国内城市台、FM/AM 频率、全屏频谱可视化与底部大播放条。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel to write long-term global rules that are automatically attached to every request, subagent run and new session.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板，写一次长期全局规则，之后每次请求、子代理和新会话都会自动附带。

description.en: Adds one user-editable global system prompt injected into every dsh conversation and mirrored into each project's AGENTS.md.
description.zh: 提供一个用户可编辑的全局系统提示词，注入每个 dsh 会话并同步到各项目的 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Adds a global running and pending sessions panel above the native DeepSeek Harness workspace list.
description.zh: 在原生 DeepSeek Harness 工作区列表上方添加全局运行中和待处理会话面板。

description.en: Picks interfaces in a GME project, then generates and repairs tests via a local Python backend with progress polling and consent.
description.zh: 选择 GME 项目接口，通过本地 Python 后端生成与修复测试，支持进度轮询与授权确认。

description.en: A dsh-go shopping research plugin and methodology skill that gathers layered product evidence, queries support, and charts conclusions.
description.zh: 为 dsh-go 提供选品插件与方法论技能：分层查清商品信息、追问客服，并用证据图表给出结论。

description.en: OpenCode Go multi-account quota cards for DeepSeek Harness
Withdrawn DSH plugin preview that connected ChatGPT accounts via OAuth; build v0.2.1 is broken and installation is paused.
description.zh: 已撤回的 DSH 插件预览，曾通过 OAuth 接入 ChatGPT 账号；v0.2.1 版本存在缺陷，安装已暂停。

description.en: Cross-session goal board that organizes projects, goals and items, injects the current task into the agent each turn and archives finished work.
description.zh: 跨会话目标看板：按项目→目标→条目组织，每轮把当前任务注入给 agent，完成后自动归档。

description.en: Blocks DeepSeek Harness goals once their token or cost budget is exhausted, enforcing spend limits instead of just reporting usage.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 目标耗尽 token 或费用预算时直接阻断该目标，实现真正的花费限制而非仅报告用量。

description.en: Adds a bilingual phase-level goal progress board with current phase, key metrics, a focused Gantt timeline, and a collapsible phase list.
description.zh: 为中/英双语目标提供阶段进度看板，展示当前阶段、关键数字、聚焦甘特图和可折叠阶段列表。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that audits local session logs, clustering tool-call failures and ranking how far sessions drifted from their original goal.
description.zh: 只读分析本机会话日志的 DSH 插件，聚类工具调用失败并按目标漂移程度排序会话，结果展示在设置面板中。

description.en: Automatically re-arms and resumes in-flight session goals when the dsh service restarts, removing the need for manual /goal resume.
description.zh: 在dsh服务重启后自动重新挂起并恢复会话目标，无需手动执行/goal resume。

description.en: Adds a standing goal charter and a role-isolated reviewer that audits goal drift at turn boundaries for DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常设目标章程，并由角色隔离的审查者在回合边界审计目标漂移。

description.en: Long-horizon goal management for DeepSeek Harness, adding an evidence-gated verification pass after every round so goals run until met.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长周期目标管理，每轮后执行基于证据的验证，未达成则自动继续。

description.en: Adds a status badge to DeepSeek Harness showing whether the Godot MCP connection is active, so you can see the link state at a glance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Godot MCP 连接状态徽章，可一眼查看与 Godot 的 MCP 连接是否正常。

description.en: Build & play Godot Web exports in the DSH Web GUI with one click.
description.zh: 在DSH Web GUI中一键构建并试玩Godot Web导出。

description.en: A plugin described only as '金元素' (gold element) with no README details.
description.zh: 名为 dsh-gold 的插件，仅以金元素作为描述，无 README 等更多说明，具体功能未公开。

description.en: Returns jewelry and watch maintenance plans based on input parameters; pure Node.js, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回珠宝和手表的保养方案，纯 Node.js 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Draggable floating panel showing live China gold quotes (SGE Au99.99, Au T+D, 100g bar) plus London spot prices inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 可拖拽浮动面板，在 DeepSeek Harness 中实时显示中国黄金报价（上金所 Au99.99、Au T+D、100克金条）及伦敦现货价格。

description.en: DSH web sidebar plugin that shows live Chinese gold prices (Au99.99) with a real-time panel, quote cards and intraday chart.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端侧栏插件，常驻显示国内金价（Au99.99），并提供含行情卡与分时图的实时面板。

description.en: Checks an official-document circulation register for completeness and internal consistency, flagging only differences, not conclusions.
description.zh: 核对公文流转登记表的完整性与内部一致性，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style effort slider, live tokens/sec and turn-total metrics, and per-answer reports to the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加 Codex 风格努力度滑块、实时 tokens/秒与回合总量指标，以及逐答案报告。

description.en: Multi-agent operations workspace for DeepSeek Harness providing background jobs, waits, durable job groups, subagents, and agent teams.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供多智能体操作工作区，支持后台作业、等待、持久任务组、子智能体和智能体团队。

description.en: Connects a real Google Chrome browser to DeepSeek Harness so models can browse, click, fill forms and screenshot pages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 模型使用你电脑上真实的 Google Chrome，可打开网页、点击、填表、上传文件与截图。

description.en: Lists files a conversation turn produced or changed as plain text and reveals any file in the OS file manager on double-click.
description.zh: 以纯文本列出某轮对话生成或修改的文件，并可双击在操作系统文件管理器中显示文件。

description.en: Government-portal-style dsh plugin serving a standalone-port service hall UI wired directly to host sessions, models and permissions.
description.zh: 政务门户风格的 dsh 插件，在独立端口提供办事大厅界面，直接对接宿主的会话、模型与权限。

description.en: Governed long-term memory core for AI agents with DeepSeek Harness adapter contracts.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供受治理的长期记忆核心，并附带用于 DeepSeek Harness 集成的技术预览版适配器契约。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for GPT models and Codex instructions, skills, plugin resources, and MCP configuration.
A draggable GPT-mascot desktop widget for DSH that monitors Codex quota and supports editable replies.
description.zh: DSH 的可拖动 GPT 娘桌面挂件，可监控 Codex 额度并支持编辑回复。

description.en: DSH plugin that fixes GPT/Codex tool parameter conflicts when running under Full access, adding its own config layer to the profile.
description.zh: 修复 GPT/Codex 在 Full access 下的工具参数冲突，安装后向 profile 添加自己的配置层。

description.en: Runs DSH's stable web search tool through a GPT subscription account for GPT-powered online retrieval.
description.zh: 让 DSH 稳定的 web search 工具改由 GPT 订阅账户执行联网检索。

description.en: Finds GPU compute processes left behind by dead agents or terminals and kills their process trees — dry-run by default, optional watchdog.
description.zh: 查找因代理或终端已退出而残留的 GPU 计算进程并清理其进程树，默认仅演练，可选启用看门狗。

description.en: Windows sandbox plugin that repairs ACL permissions when grantWrite fails and silently retries the blocked command.
description.zh: Windows 沙箱插件，在 grantWrite 失败时修复 ACL 权限并无缝重试被阻止的命令。

description.en: Create, read and edit Excalidraw canvases in the workspace with agent tools and a sidebar editor, rendering PNGs the model can see.
description.zh: 在工作区创建、读取和编辑 Excalidraw 画布，提供智能体工具与侧边栏编辑器，并渲染模型可查看的 PNG。

description.en: Graphify integration for DeepSeek Harness: graphify_* agent tools + interactive code-graph sidebar tab
Adds configurable opening and closing lines to every AI reply, with per-line styling and a context-usage bar warning when to start a new session.
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复加上可自定义的开场语与收尾语，并用上下文占用进度条提醒何时开启新会话。

description.en: Adds a time-of-day greeting line (customizable tsundere-whale lines) under the DSH homepage hero title, switching every 30s.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主页/新会话 hero 标题下加一行按时段变化的问候语（可自定义傲娇鲸鱼娘台词），每 30 秒自动切换。

description.en: Adds two split composer controls to the DSH input box — tone and output switches with preset dropdowns — that steer each session's system prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框加入两个分体控件（基调与产出开关＋预设下拉），按当前会话选择注入系统提示词，并提供预设管理设置页。

description.en: Reference knowledge base for grid and spacing systems: 8-point grid, responsive breakpoints, and spacing guidelines for UI layout design.
description.zh: 提供栅格与间距系统参考知识库，涵盖8点栅格、响应式断点与间距规范，用于指导界面布局设计。

description.en: Generates family dinner grocery shopping plans based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数生成家庭晚餐的食材采购计划，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Normalizes undersized Grok image inputs on the OpenAI Responses HTTP/SSE path for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 规范化在DeepSeek Harness中通过OpenAI Responses HTTP/SSE路径传输的过小Grok图片。

description.en: Reuses Grok Build CLI login in DeepSeek Harness, syncing access tokens and provisioning a proxy route.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中复用 Grok Build CLI 的订阅登录，同步访问令牌并提供一个代理路由。

description.en: Adds an animated starfield background to the new-session tab in DSH Web, inspired by grok.com.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 的新会话页面添加动态星空背景，灵感来自 grok.com。

description.en: Calculates gross margin with precise parameters and returns detailed results, pure Node no network.
description.zh: 按精确参数计算毛利率并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现且不联网。

description.en: A Node.js plugin that provides array grouping functionality with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 提供数组分组功能的 Node.js 插件，运行时无需网络依赖。

description.en: Computes group-buy parameters precisely and returns detailed results; pure Node without network dependencies.
description.zh: 精确计算拼单团购参数并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin that groups data by a key, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 一个纯 Node.js 插件，按指定键对数据进行分组，不依赖网络。

description.en: Batches non-@ group-chat messages into a dsh agent's context at zero token cost and compresses them into daily digests.
description.zh: 把群里未被 @ 的消息攒批注入 dsh 代理上下文（零 token、不唤醒模型），并每天压缩成日结。

description.en: Calculates grout (美缝剂) usage based on parameters, returning detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算美缝剂用量，返回详细结果。

description.en: Integrates GROX Network into DeepSeek Harness to find, hire, and pay AI agents for tasks with escrow and dispute resolution.
description.zh: GROX Network for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): find agents on grox.life, hire one for a task, get the work back — escrowed, refunded on failure, disputable. Plus a grox subagent provider.

description.en: Infinite canvas in the DSH sidebar: annotate images and let GrsAI (gpt-image-2/nano-banana) edit them, with side-by-side results auto-saved.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏无限画布插件：在图上标注后用 GrsAI（gpt-image-2 / nano-banana）改图，结果与原图并排对比，画布自动保存到工作区。

description.en: Bundles eight official GSAP animation skills with documented corrections and verification gates so the agent writes correct GSAP code.
description.zh: 打包八个官方 GSAP 动画技能，含文档化纠错与校验关卡，让智能体写出正确的 GSAP 代码。

description.en: Bridges a local GPT-SoVITS engine into DSH: manages its lifecycle, exposes an OpenAI-compatible TTS endpoint, and speaks replies aloud.
description.zh: 把本机 GPT-SoVITS 接入 DSH：随启随停管理引擎，提供 OpenAI 兼容 TTS 端点，并在对话结束后朗读回复。

description.en: Returns Guangzhou city information; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 返回广州市信息，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Security guard for DSH that blocks or asks before dangerous commands and sensitive paths, redacts secrets in tool output, and writes a local JSONL audit log.
description.zh: DSH 安全护栏插件：拦截或询问危险命令与敏感路径，对工具输出中的密钥进行脱敏，并写入本地 JSONL 审计日志。

description.en: Intercepts runaway degenerate symbol streams at the model boundary and repairs corrupted artifacts and sessions.
description.zh: 在模型边界拦截失控的退化符号流，并修复被污染的工件与会话。

description.en: Deterministic, evidence-linked review of synthetic AI-agent claims for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性、证据关联的合成 AI 代理声明审查。

description.en: Reads a labour protection equipment configuration table and flags completeness and internal-consistency issues without drawing conclusions.
description.zh: 读取劳动防护用品配置表，检查其完整性与内部一致性，仅提示差异而不作定性结论。

description.en: A plugin providing information about the country of Guatemala.
description.zh: 提供危地马拉国家信息的插件。

description.en: Computes wedding banquet table counts based on parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算婚宴所需桌数并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents session-scoped Windows mouse and keyboard control with human-like input pacing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供会话级 Windows 鼠标键盘控制，并模拟真人输入节奏。

description.en: Windows desktop control plugin for DSH: accessibility-tree snapshots, clicking controls by name, delivery verdicts, and repeatable task files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面控制的插件：无障碍树快照、按控件名称点击、投递判定与可复用任务文件。

description.en: Windows desktop-control plugin for DSH: screenshots, OCR read-screen, and mouse/keyboard automation with an emergency stop hotkey.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面操作插件：截图、OCR 读屏并控制鼠标键盘，支持紧急停止热键。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: reopen the conversation you were last in after a restart, without patching engine files
Generates GUIDs using pure Node.js, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 使用纯 Node.js 生成 GUID，不依赖网络连接。

description.en: Returns capital, population, currency, and continent for Guinea-Bissau via a local Node tool.
description.zh: 通过本地 Node 工具返回几内亚比绍的首都、人口、货币和所属大洲。

description.en: Guitar chord tool that returns instrument practice plans based on parameters.
description.zh: 吉他和弦工具，根据参数返回乐器练习计划。

description.en: A DSH diary plugin that reads each day's session window, judges whether the day is worth writing about, and saves a personal journal entry to its own SQLite DB and Markdown file.
description.zh: 一个运行在 DSH 里的独立日记插件：读取每天的会话窗口，先判断这天是否值得记录，再把日记写入独立的 SQLite 数据库和 Markdown 文件。

description.en: Gundam Graphite is a black-grey mecha wallpaper theme for DSH, adding graphite glass panels, flowing particles and a mouse-reactive elastic grid.
description.zh: 高达·石墨是 DSH 的黑灰机甲壁纸主题，提供石墨玻璃面板、流动粒子以及随鼠标牵动的弹性网格。

description.en: Plugin about Guyana country information.
description.zh: 关于圭亚那国家信息的插件

description.en: Returns a guzheng (Chinese zither) learning plan based on parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回古筝学习计划，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Habit building tool that returns customized parenting education plans based on input parameters, implemented in Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 习惯培养工具：根据输入参数返回定制化的家庭教育计划，基于 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A full-frame animated HALOFLUX canvas halo background for the DSH Web GUI, driven live by the session's token flow and tool calls.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供全帧 HALOFLUX 光环背景动画，由当前会话的 token 流与工具调用实时驱动。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to compress AI chat sessions into structured summary documents in the workspace handoff/ directory.
description.zh: 添加一个交接按钮，将 AI 对话会话压缩为结构化摘要文档，保存到工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Simultaneous handoff-document sync for independent DeepSeek Harness sessions.
Adds per-session notes, a draggable key-info panel, workspace session groups and bulk actions for right-sidebar tabs in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加会话笔记、可拖动关键信息面板、工作区会话分组及右侧栏标签批量操作。

description.en: Adds ten animated backgrounds to the DSH conversation pane, including starfield, code rain, circuit, cat, snow, bubbles and more.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话面板提供十种动态背景，包括星空、代码雨、电路、猫、雪花、气泡等。

description.en: Reads local HAR captures offline, flags failed and slow browser requests, and produces a privacy-safe HTML triage report.
description.zh: 离线读取本地 HAR 文件，标记失败与缓慢请求，生成不泄露网址、Cookie 与正文的诊断报告。

description.en: Adds a one-click hard-delete entry to DSH's sidebar session menu, physically removing a session plus its projcache and workspace references.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏会话菜单中新增一键硬删除，物理删除会话目录并清理 projcache 与 workspace 引用。

description.en: DSH plugin named dsh-hardlink-publish-fallback; its README and description are missing, so its behavior is undocumented.
description.zh: 名为 dsh-hardlink-publish-fallback 的 DSH 插件，缺少 README 与描述，功能未记录。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness that starts it hidden, reopens the running UI, and adds Restart/Close to the Web sidebar.
description.zh: Windows 桌面启动器，可在停止时静默启动 DeepSeek Harness，运行时重新打开界面，并在 Web 侧边栏添加重启/关闭按钮。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button and an out-of-process helper to quit and relaunch the DeepSeek Harness desktop app in one click.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加侧边栏入口和进程外助手，一键退出并重新启动桌面应用。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DeepSeek Harness Desktop caption band that relaunches the app and its Host after confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 标题栏添加重启按钮，确认后重启应用及其 Host。

description.en: Switches model and harness inside native DSH sessions by embedding Kimi Code's execution core for prompts, tools, Skills, MCP and context compression.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中切换模型与 harness，内嵌 Kimi Code 执行核心，提供提示词、工具、Skills、MCP 与上下文压缩。

description.en: Checks a hazardous-chemical register for completeness and arithmetic, flagging mismatches between stored quantities, thresholds and major-hazard-source verdicts.
description.zh: 核对危险化学品台账的完整性与算术一致性,提示储存量、临界量与重大危险源判定之间的差异。

description.en: Checks a HAZOP worksheet for required-field completeness, node/guide-word validity, risk vocabulary, and deviation traceability.
description.zh: 检查 HAZOP 工作表的字段完整性、节点与引导词合规性、风险等级词表及偏差可追溯性。

description.en: Adds a » overflow drawer to the DSH Web session header so tucked-away items keep their individual state and order.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话头部添加 » 溢出抽屉，收纳的项目可保留各自状态和顺序。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin that auto-collapses overflow title-bar buttons into a More menu and lets you drag-reorder button priority in settings.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 插件：标题栏按钮放不下时自动收进「更多」菜单，并可在设置中拖动排序调整保留优先级。

description.en: Isolated headless virtual X11 display for agents: zero windows by default, live panel view/control, plus 9 tools and an HTTP API.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供隔离的 headless 虚拟 X11 显示器：默认零窗口，可在面板实时查看与操作，并提供 9 个工具和 HTTP API。

description.en: A proactive heartbeat plugin that wakes on a schedule, decides whether to message its owner, and keeps a persistent inner session.
description.zh: 一个主动心跳插件：定时醒来，自行判断是否要主动找主人说话，并持久化内心会话。

description.en: Gives AI a human-like memory of personality, emotion and events that naturally fades over time, delivering a curated memory document.
description.zh: 让 AI 拥有一套会自然淡忘的性格、情感与记忆，并按时间分层压缩，定期整理成一份记忆文档交付。

description.en: Provides cooking heat-control techniques and tips based on parameters, implemented in Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数给出烹饪火候控制的技巧与建议，使用 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Calculates heat index precisely from input parameters and returns detailed results; pure Node.js implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数精确计算热指数并返回详细结果，纯 Node.js 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Fire control tool that returns home-cooking recipes based on parameters, pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的火候控制工具，根据传入参数返回家常菜谱，不联网。

description.en: Heating safety tool that returns clear recommendations based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node.
description.zh: 取暖安全工具，根据输入参数返回明确建议，纯 Node 实现。

description.en: 中暑急救工具，按场景返回处置步骤。纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: 中暑急救工具，按场景返回对症处置步骤，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Returns complete and field-level information about the Helium element; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 返回氦元素的完整信息与各字段级信息，纯 Node 实现，无需联网。

description.en: DSH helper plugin adding WeChat file delivery from any session, cron-scheduled task sessions, activity breathing light, completion sound and one-click restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补充日常小功能的辅助插件：任意会话把文件发到微信、cron 定时任务会话、活动呼吸灯、完成提示音与一键重启。

description.en: DSH helper plugin for Windows that adds notification support to DeepSeek Harness workflows.
description.zh: 适用于 Windows 的 DSH 辅助插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 工作流提供通知支持。

description.en: A /ask mode for DSH that runs one read-only Q&A round, citing only what it actually reads and changing nothing.
description.zh: DSH 的 /ask 模式插件：单轮只读问答，只引用实读内容，不改动任何东西，该轮结束自动退出模式。

description.en: dsh-helper plugin that sends system notifications for DeepSeek Harness sessions only when you have switched away, staying silent while you watch.
description.zh: dsh-helper 插件：仅在离开 DeepSeek Harness 会话时发送系统提醒，正在查看会话时保持安静。

description.en: Feishu/Lark channel for DeepSeek Harness: long-connection messaging, native Markdown tables, 13 Feishu tools, web settings, voice and media.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 通道：长连接收发消息、Markdown 渲染为飞书原生表格、13 个飞书工具、Web 设置页、语音与媒体上传。

description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness hero headline with custom art text and Monet-style auto color from background.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 主视觉标题替换为自定义艺术文案，并根据背景自动取色，生成莫奈风格动态配色。

description.en: Computes pricing for marketing hero products based on input parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算营销主打产品的定价并返回详细结果。

description.en: Hex encoding/decoding plugin implemented in pure Node, no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的十六进制编解码插件，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.en: Blocks AI agent access to .env files, credentials, keys, and any hidden path across file tools, shell commands, search, and run_code.
description.zh: 阻止 AI 代理访问 .env 文件、凭据、密钥及任何被隐藏的路径，覆盖文件工具、Shell 命令、搜索与 run_code。

description.en: Reads a safety hazard ledger and keyword-maps each row onto candidate clauses of the major accident hazard determination standard, reporting its own gaps.
description.zh: 读取隐患台账，按关键词将每行映射到重大事故隐患判定标准的候选条款，并报告匹配缺口。

description.en: DSH plugin that hides chosen sessions from the sidebar for a cleaner view, restorable anytime, without touching history or data.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可把指定会话从侧边栏隐藏以保持整洁，随时恢复，不改动历史与磁盘数据。

description.en: Provides hidden-storage and space-utilization plans for small apartments based on parameters.
Auto-hides a DSH sidebar workspace row once its last unarchived session is archived, with a manual hide option and a restore entry; display-only.
description.zh: 当工作区最后一个未归档会话被归档时，自动隐藏侧栏该工作区行，并提供手动隐藏与恢复入口，仅改显示不改数据。

description.en: Mobile plugin for the DSH Web GUI that replaces the 56px collapsed sidebar rail with a top toggle button that slides the sidebar over content.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 移动端插件：把 56px 折叠侧边栏改为顶部切换按钮，侧边栏滑入覆盖内容。

description.en: A tiny unofficial DSH plugin that hides the relative timestamps next to session rows in the sidebar, leaving a clean title-only list.
description.zh: 一个小型非官方 DSH 插件，隐藏侧栏会话行右侧的相对时间戳，让列表只剩干净的标题。

description.en: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop “new version” update pill next to the account button using pure CSS and label rules.
description.zh: 使用纯 CSS 和标签规则隐藏 DSH 桌面版账户按钮旁的“新版本”更新角标。

description.en: Highlight selected text in DSH chats with yellow/green/blue marks that survive re-renders and restarts, saved per session.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中划选文字添加黄/绿/蓝高亮色块，覆盖层绘制不怕重渲染，按会话持久保存并可单独删除。

description.en: Hillstone/StoneOS device ops sidebar plugin with device management, SSH terminal, connection audit, execution policy, and 9 hillstone_* agent tools.
description.zh: 山石网科/StoneOS 设备运维插件：侧栏提供设备管理、SSH 终端、连接审计与执行策略，并向 agent 注册 9 个 hillstone_* 运维工具。

description.en: Connects the Hindsight memory service to DeepSeek Harness, sharing one memory bank and tag semantics with omp.
description.zh: 把 Hindsight 记忆服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，与 omp 共用同一记忆库和同一套标签语义。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for Hindsight that lets you switch the memory plugin's LLM provider/model and browse stored memories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Hindsight 侧边栏面板，可切换记忆插件的 LLM 服务商/模型并浏览已存储的记忆。

description.en: Adds a per-conversation toggle that makes the model answer in Classical Chinese with a vernacular translation and a playful fish persona.
description.zh: 为每个对话添加独立开关，开启后模型用文言文作答并附白话译注，同时扮演一条蓝色古风大肥鱼。

description.en: Recall messages, rewind to earlier replies, or edit AI responses in a copied DeepSeek Harness conversation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中回溯消息、回到更早的回复，或在对话副本中编辑 AI 回复。

description.en: Honkai: Star Rail fan-fiction DSH plugin that generates sci-fi ideas, short stories and news, backed by 12 incrementally scraped and cached Wiki sources.
description.zh: 基于《崩坏：星穹铁道》世界观的 DSH 二创插件，可生成科幻灵感、短篇故事与新闻播报，并增量抓取 12 个 Wiki 数据源。

description.en: Lets the agent search past Claude Code, Codex and DSH session transcripts to recall earlier conversations.
description.zh: 让智能体检索 Claude Code、Codex 和 DSH 的历史会话记录，以回忆此前的对话内容。

description.en: Lists and retrieves historical terms knowledge entries via plugin tools.
description.zh: 通过插件工具列出并检索历史术语知识条目。

description.en: Adds a human-in-the-loop approval gate for DSH tool calls, requiring approve, modify, or reject decisions in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工具调用添加人工审批关卡，任何工具调用都需在 DSH Web UI 中通过批准、修改或拒绝决策卡。

description.en: Hold-to-talk voice input for DeepSeek Harness with local SenseVoice or any OpenAI-compatible ASR, a user wordbank, draft context and live preview.
description.zh: 按住鼠标即可语音输入，支持本地 SenseVoice 或任意 OpenAI 兼容 ASR，并带用户词库、草稿上下文与实时预览。

description.en: An authorized-pentest skill pack with a legal-boundary guard, prompt assembly, vulnerability hunting and 14 report templates for red-team engagements.
description.zh: 授权渗透技能包：含法律边界门禁、提示词装配、漏洞挖掘与14套报告模板，用于红队测试。

description.en: Plugin named after the chemical element holmium; no documented functionality.
description.zh: 以化学元素钬命名的插件；无文档记录的功能。

description.en: Honcho memory explorer for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: peers, conclusions, sessions and a relationship graph, with semantic search.
Redacts secrets in DSH outbound messages by swapping them for structurally valid honey tokens before models, session files, or logs see them.
description.zh: DSH 蜜罐脱敏插件，在敏感值离开本机前替换为结构合法的假值，模型、会话文件与日志只见假凭证。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin with the description '香港国家' (Hong Kong country).
Calculates red envelope amounts based on parameters and returns detailed results.
Provides a pure Node.js tool to retrieve Hong Kong city information, with no network dependency, installable as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的香港城市信息查询工具，无需联网即可使用，可作为 DSH 插件安装。

description.en: Settings panel plugin for DSH lifecycle hooks covering 7 events, guard rules with live toggles, and run status.
description.zh: DSH 生命周期钩子设置面板插件：覆盖 7 种事件、带实时开关的守卫规则与运行状态。

description.en: A general-purpose hooks framework that drives DSH native events via Claude Code-style hooks.json files.
description.zh: 通用钩子框架，用 Claude Code 风格的 hooks.json 驱动 DSH 原生事件。

description.en: Discovers per-workspace .claude/settings.json to run workspace-specific Claude Code command hooks.
description.zh: 按工作区查找 .claude/settings.json，为每个工作区运行其自有的 Claude Code 命令钩子。

description.en: Sets up Claude Code and Codex hooks for DeepSeek Harness by auto-discovering existing hooks config.
description.zh: 一键为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Claude Code 与 Codex hooks，自动发现现有 hooks 配置并在官方桥接插件上运行。

description.en: Adds a host file explorer panel with a sidebar entry for browsing, previewing, downloading and uploading files.
description.zh: 提供主机文件浏览器面板，带侧边栏入口，可浏览、预览、下载和上传文件。

description.en: Gives DSH sessions file-system access through a Files settings tab, with per-session allowlists and allow/deny path lists.
description.zh: 通过 Files 设置标签为 DSH 会话提供文件系统访问，支持按会话白名单及允许/拒绝路径列表。

description.en: Host-side tools for DSH agents to manage workspaces, sessions, and governed configuration changes without any UI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供主机侧工具，用于管理工作区、会话和受控配置变更，不含界面。

description.en: Turns drag-and-dropped files and folders into @path references in the DSH composer instead of uploading them.
description.zh: 将拖放的文件和文件夹转换为 DSH 编辑器中的 @path 引用，而不是上传它们。

description.en: Adds a hot-restart row under Sign out in the account menu that replays the profile plugin tree and refreshes the page without killing the process.
description.zh: 在账号菜单“退出登录”下方新增热重启一行，原地重放 profile 插件树并刷新页面，不杀进程、对话不丢。

description.en: Resident hot-search service for DSH: fuzzy filename lookup, indexed grep, and CJK typo-tolerant content search with no per-query process spawn.
description.zh: DSH 常驻热搜服务：支持文件名模糊搜索、索引化 grep 与中日韩错别字容错内容搜索，无需每次查询启动新进程。

description.en: Converts horsepower to kilowatts.
Resume plugin where chat and a side panel edit the same draft, with template switching and PDF download.
description.zh: 简历插件：对话与右侧面板编辑同一份草稿，可切换模板并下载 PDF。

description.en: Suggests top-3 HS tariff candidates and checks 12-element completeness, RVC and tariff version before classification.
description.zh: 提供HS编码前三候选，并检查12项要素完整性、RVC和关税版本门槛。

description.en: Reads a commodity classification register and validates HS code formatting, prefix hierarchy consistency, tariff version and row completeness.
description.zh: 读取商品归类登记表，校验HS编码位数、章/品目/子目前缀层级一致性、税率版本声明及行内容完整性。

description.en: DSH plugin that looks up Honkai: Star Rail character, light cone and relic data with a team-building knowledge base.
description.zh: DSH 插件：查询《崩坏：星穹铁道》的角色、光锥与遗器数据，并附带配队知识库。

description.en: Preview a local HTML file in the right sidebar, click elements or box-select a region to annotate, then send it as one message to the current session so the AI edits it.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML 文件，点选元素或框选区域写批注，一键作为一条消息发进当前会话让 AI 修改。

description.en: Selects HTML/web page elements and passes structured references to AI agents for UI modifications.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中框选本地 HTML 或网页元素，把结构化引用交给 Agent 用于修改 UI

description.en: Renders generated HTML files in the DSH sidebar and lets you edit their text, formatting and layout in place, then saves back to the file.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中渲染生成的 HTML 文件，可直接就地编辑文字、格式与布局，并写回原文件。

description.en: Select text in DSH to add a quote or comment as a capsule in the chat input, with a fixed quote-box clipping bug.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中选中文字即可添加引用或评论，并以胶囊形式放入输入框，同时修复引用框裁字问题。

description.en: Publishes your local DSH to LAN or public internet with password login, QR codes, a device navigation page and cloudflared tunnels, all managed from settings.
description.zh: 把本机 DSH 安全发布到局域网或公网：访问密码、二维码、设备导航页与 cloudflared 隧道，全部在设置页管理。

description.en: Electron screen-edge floating bubble HUD that streams THINKING / WORKING / STEP DONE / COMPLETED task progress as a Cappella-style glass chat.
description.zh: Electron 桌面贴边浮窗 HUD，以群唱风格毛玻璃气泡实时汇报 THINKING / WORKING / STEP DONE / COMPLETED 四类任务进度。

description.en: A recycle bin for DSH Desktop sessions: deleted chats go to a searchable trash where they can be restored or permanently removed.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供回收站：删除的会话进入可搜索的回收站，可随时恢复或彻底删除。

description.en: Cryptographically binds a human's authorization to the exact action an AI agent is about to run, using WebAuthn-style verification.
description.zh: 通过密码学方式将人类授权与 AI 代理即将执行的确切操作绑定，用于人工确认环节。

description.en: Lets the agent mark steps only a human can do and pauses on a native DSH card until you confirm, skip or cancel.
description.zh: 让 agent 预先标出必须由人完成的步骤，执行到该步时弹出 DSH 原生卡片，等你确认、跳过或取消后才继续。

description.en: A DSH boot animation plugin that plays a HUST LANGYA RoboMaster 550C tactical startup sequence with mecha emblem, classes and popups.
description.zh: 一款 DSH 开机动画插件，播放华中科技大学狼牙战队 RoboMaster 550C 战术开机动画，含机甲徽章、机甲职业与工程师弹窗。

description.en: DSH plugin that translates HWP/HWPX Korean documents into Chinese while preserving the original layout.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可将 HWP/HWPX 韩文文档翻译为中文，并保留原始排版布局。

description.en: Manages a GitHub Pages blog by browsing, writing, and publishing content/*.md files without a local clone.
description.zh: 无需本地克隆即可浏览、编写并发布 GitHub Pages 博客的 content/*.md 文件。

description.en: Adds three-tier long-term memory (session, project, personal) to DSH so preferences and conventions persist across sessions automatically.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加会话、项目、个人三层长期记忆，让偏好和约定跨会话自动沉淀与召回。

description.en: Sidebar panel to maintain global and per-project dev rules, auto-injected into each agent session's system prompt.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板可视化维护全局与项目级开发规则，并自动注入每个会话的系统提示词。

description.en: DSH bundle wiring the official IAR C-SPY MCP server so the agent can build, debug and inspect Embedded Workbench projects.
description.zh: DSH 插件包，接入官方 IAR C-SPY MCP 服务，让智能体可构建、调试和检查 Embedded Workbench 工程。

description.en: Validates one coded inpatient episode's ICD-10 diagnoses and ICD-9-CM procedures against coding rules such as code form, duplicates and dagger/asterisk pairing.
description.zh: 校验单个住院病案的 ICD-10 诊断与 ICD-9-CM 手术编码是否符合编码规则，如编码格式、重复编码及剑号/星号配对。

description.en: Adds a DSH sidebar panel that plays an ice sound when an approval appears and re-alerts at 5, 10 and 15 minutes, with toggle and volume.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件：审批出现时播放“冰冰冰”音效，并在 5/10/15 分钟再次提醒，附开关与音量滑杆。

description.en: Cosmetic DSH plugin that appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included.
description.zh: 一个装饰性 DSH 插件，在模型写出的每句话末尾（包括思维链）追加一个小小的冰块标记。

description.en: Minimal plugin description indicating Iceland, with no further details.
description.zh: 极简插件描述，仅标明冰岛，无其他详细信息。

description.en: Swaps the DeepSeek Harness desktop exe's embedded icon for your own .ico, with one-click rollback to the official default.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端 exe 内嵌图标替换成你的 .ico，并可一键回退官方默认图标。

description.en: Pick a preset or upload a PNG; the backdrop is auto-removed, packed into a multi-size ICO, and written to your desktop in one click.
description.zh: 选择预设或上传 PNG，自动去除背景并打包为多尺寸 ICO，一键写入桌面。

description.en: Provides Chinese ID card renewal process and key points as an offline tool.
JetBrains-style database tool window in the DSH sidebar plus agent tools to query and operate JDBC and Redis data sources.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏提供 JetBrains 风格的数据库工具窗，并给 Agent 一组查询/操作 JDBC 与 Redis 数据源的工具。

description.en: A minimal IDE in the DeepSeek Harness right column, with file browsing, an editor, navigation and multi-repo Git side by side with the agent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右栏内置迷你 IDE，提供文件浏览、编辑器、导航与多仓库 Git，与智能体同屏协作。

description.en: Floating lightbulb box in the DSH web UI that saves quick one-line notes and screenshots as plain Markdown files in a folder you choose.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面上的悬浮灯泡小框，输入一行文字或拖入截图后回车，即可保存为你指定文件夹中的纯 Markdown 文件。

description.en: A sidebar idea workbench for DeepSeek Harness that captures quick notes with local-first storage and optional cloud sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧栏灵感池工作台：随手记录灵感，本机优先存储，可选云端同步。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that carries an AI persona's identity and memory across sessions for companion-style chats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在会话之间延续 AI 角色的身份与记忆，支持陪伴式对话。

description.en: Automatically compacts long DSH sessions after user idle time, keeping context within KV cache limits before it expires.
description.zh: 在用户空闲后自动压缩长时间运行的 DSH 会话，在 KV 缓存过期前保持上下文在限制内。

description.en: Sends idle-chat nudges to opted-in chats and exposes an authenticated HTTP API to post prompts into any chat.
description.zh: 向已选择加入的聊天发送空闲提醒，并提供经过身份验证的 HTTP API 向任意聊天发送提示词。

description.en: Inventories elements and quantities from IFC building models and exports them as CSV takeoffs.
description.zh: 从 IFC 建筑模型中统计构件与工程量，并导出为 CSV 工程量清单。

description.en: Adds one button per DSH IM channel to the sidebar workspace header and filters the session list to the selected channel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏工作区标题栏为每个 DSH IM 频道添加入口，并按所选频道筛选会话列表。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds an ima knowledge-base sidebar panel plus six read-only chat tools for searching and paging through notes and KB files.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在侧边栏提供 ima 知识库面板，并在对话中提供六个只读工具，用于检索笔记与知识库文件、按字符偏移分页读取。

description.en: Annotate pasted screenshots in the DSH web GUI with pen, arrow, rectangle, ellipse and text stamps, exporting a flattened PNG at native resolution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中为粘贴的截图添加画笔、箭头、矩形、椭圆和文字标注，并按原始分辨率导出扁平化 PNG 附件。

description.en: Recognizes images through a dedicated vision subagent that can use its own independently configurable model.
description.zh: 通过专用视觉子代理识别图像，该子代理可使用独立配置的模型。

description.en: Bridges image attachments to text-only AI models by saving images to workspace and exposing paths for vision tools.
description.zh: 把图片附件保存到工作区，并将消息转为仅模型可见的路径文本，使纯文本模型可调用视觉或 MCP 工具识别图片。

description.en: Converts images attached in Web GUI messages into text descriptions via vision models, enabling text-only LLMs like DeepSeek to understand them.
description.zh: 将 Web GUI 消息中附带的图片经视觉模型转换为文字描述，使 DeepSeek 等纯文本模型也能理解图片内容。

description.en: Compare multiple images side by side in DeepSeek Harness with per-image zoom/pan and synchronized views, without sending image bytes to the model.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中并排比较多张图片，支持单图缩放平移与视图同步，且不向模型上下文传入图片数据。

description.en: Offloads the oldest images to placeholder text and retries when an upstream gateway rejects a DSH vision session for too many images.
description.zh: 当上游网关因图片张数超限拒绝请求时，把最旧的图片卸载为占位文本并重试，恢复卡死的视觉模型会话。

description.en: Connects Shenhuo AI image designers to DSH via MCP: OAuth login, design proposals with credit quotes, then image generation and delivery.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 接入神火 AI 图像设计师：个人 OAuth 登录、方案与点数报价，随后生成并交付图片。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you configure image providers in Settings and generate images via the image_generate tool.
description.zh: DSH 插件：可在设置中配置图像提供方，并通过 image_generate 生成图像。

description.en: Trims historical images to the provider's image budget before sending, learns the image cap from HTTP 400 errors, and retries with fewer images.
description.zh: 发送前按提供商图片预算裁剪历史图片，从 HTTP 400 响应学习图片上限，并用更少图片重试。

description.en: Adds numbered pins and short comments to image previews in dsh, inserting the original image plus coordinate notes into the draft.
description.zh: 在 dsh 图片预览上点钉编号图钉并写评论，将原图与带坐标的说明一并插入草稿。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that routes prompt images through a vision model and exposes a describe_image tool without changing the session's model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：将提示中的图片交由视觉模型解析，并暴露 describe_image 工具，且不会更改会话所用模型。

description.en: Adds live pixel-coordinate readout and one adjustable measuring rectangle to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar image preview.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的图片预览添加实时像素坐标显示和一个可调节的测量矩形。

description.en: Pins a local image de-watermarking proxy to the DSH host lifecycle so it starts with DSH and is auto-restarted if it dies.
description.zh: 把本地图像去水印代理绑定到 DSH 宿主生命周期：DSH 启动它就在，挂掉后自动重新拉起。

description.en: Tiles oversized images before model admission so vision models can read them at a usable resolution.
description.zh: 在图片送入模型前将其分块，让视觉模型能以可读分辨率查看超大图片。

description.en: Copy or download any image from a DeepSeek Harness conversation, including model-read screenshots, keeping the original bytes intact.
description.zh: 一键复制或下载 DeepSeek Harness 对话中的任意图片（含模型读取的截图），完整保留原始字节。

description.en: Image processing plugin that reads image dimensions/format, resizes, and converts formats using built-in ffmpeg, cross-platform.
description.zh: 图片处理插件，可读取图片尺寸和格式，并借助内置 ffmpeg 进行缩放与格式转换，支持跨平台。

description.en: Enables text-only models to understand pasted/dropped and Feishu/Lark images via a configurable vision model.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型借助可配置的视觉模型理解粘贴、拖入的图片以及飞书/Lark 图片。

description.en: Adds wheel zoom without Ctrl and left-drag panning to images in the DSH right sidebar file preview.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏文件预览中的图片增加免按 Ctrl 的滚轮缩放和按住左键拖动平移。

description.en: Adds image generation and understanding to agents; create/edit images and describe/analyze pictures.
description.zh: 为 agent 补上图像生成与理解能力，可创建和编辑图片、描述和分析图片。

description.en: A Plugin for DeepSeek Harness
One-shot, read-only import of project folders remembered by other AI tools into the DSH sidebar, with dry-run support.
description.zh: 一次性只读扫描其他 AI 工具记住的项目文件夹并导入 DSH 侧边栏，支持试运行预览。

description.en: Records screen frames and log lines on one millisecond timeline, letting you mark and box incidents, then export a keyframe strip, GIF, and aligned log slice for your agent.
description.zh: 在毫秒级时间线上同步录制屏幕帧与日志，支持标记和框选事件，并导出关键帧条、GIF 与对齐日志片段交给智能体。

description.en: Bookmarks every question you asked, enabling indexing, searching, and one-click jump back to conversation points.
description.zh: 为DSH中每个提问建立书签，支持索引、搜索并一键跳回任意对话位置。

description.en: Inference toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with semantic caching, draft-cascade speculative decoding and JSON output validation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的推理工具包，提供语义缓存、草稿级联投机解码和 JSON 输出校验。

description.en: InfluxDB 2.x plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 6 agent tools and a side panel for Flux queries, buckets, connections and line-protocol writes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 InfluxDB 2.x 插件，提供 6 个智能体工具和侧边面板，支持 Flux 查询、bucket 与 schema 查看、连接管理和 line protocol 写入。

description.en: Encrypted local credential vault for DeepSeek Harness that stores site logins in a sidebar panel and lets the agent look up the right account before signing in.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的本机加密账密库，在侧边栏集中管理站点账号密码，智能体登录前可按站点取用。

description.en: Cross-source research search over arXiv, Crossref, GitHub, Hacker News and Hugging Face plus A-share stock quotes, klines and announcements, with no API key.
description.zh: 跨源检索 arXiv、Crossref、GitHub、Hacker News 与 Hugging Face，并提供 A 股行情、K 线与公告，无需任何 API Key。

description.en: Sends OS-level notifications when DSH finishes a task, needs approval, or needs an answer.
description.zh: 当 DSH 完成任务、需要批准或需要回答时，自动发出系统通知提醒。

description.en: An additive project-governance layer for DeepSeek Harness that governs the information environment; a verifiable prototype.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的附加项目治理层，用于治理信息环境；属于可验证原型。

description.en: INI to JSON conversion plugin built with pure Node.js, no network, no external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的 INI 与 JSON 双向转换插件，不联网、不依赖外部服务。

description.en: Generates CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it, adapting Claude Code /init for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 生成CLAUDE.md并将AGENTS.md链接到它，为DeepSeek Harness适配Claude Code的/init命令。

description.en: A lightweight Node plugin that provides a tool for handling initialisms/acronyms in the dsh session, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 一个轻量 Node 插件，在 dsh 会话中提供处理首字母缩写与缩略词的工具，无需网络。

description.en: Plays a full-screen WebGL2 particle boot animation (flower → moon → ghost text → solid logo) with HUD layer and procedural sound on every launch.
description.zh: 每次启动全屏播放 WebGL2 实时粒子开机动画（花→月球→虚影文字→实体 LOGO），带 HUD 终端层与程序化音效，参数可在设置中调节。

description.en: A Chinese ink-wash theme for DeepSeek Harness with cinnabar accents, paper-and-ink palettes, and a matching wallpaper companion.
description.zh: 一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的中国水墨主题，含朱砂点缀、纸墨配色，以及配套壁纸。

description.en: Plays a brief ink-wash whale-leap splash overlay over the DeepSeek Harness web UI on page load, then auto-fades and removes itself.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页加载时播放一段水墨鲸跃启动动画覆盖层，随后自动淡出并移除。

description.en: Obsidian bridge for DeepSeek Harness that writes notes to a chosen vault folder and uses Obsidian as long-term memory with recall and consolidation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Obsidian 桥接插件：把笔记写入指定库文件夹，并用 Obsidian 做长期记忆的召回与沉淀。

description.en: Turns images dragged or pasted into the DSH composer into @path file-reference pills at the cursor, with hover previews of the original.
description.zh: 把拖入或粘贴进输入框的图片变成光标处的 @路径 文件引用胶囊，悬停可预览原图。

description.en: Lets you select text in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and turn it into a native composer quote-reference chip.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中选中文本，即可生成原生输入框引用芯片。

description.en: Adds inline / command and @ mention menus to the DSH Web composer, even when text is already present.
description.zh: 让 DSH Web 输入框在已有内容时也能弹出 / 指令菜单和 @ 对话/文件引用菜单。

description.en: Moves the Chat and Trajectory View tabs into the header row, placing them left of the right-side controls.
description.zh: 将 Chat 与 Trajectory View 标签移到顶部标题行，位于右侧控件左边。

description.en: Local-first interoception plugin that records personal events and metrics in SQLite and returns reality-based feedback insights.
description.zh: 本地优先的内感知插件，用 SQLite 记录个人事件与指标，并提供现实反馈洞察。

description.en: Injects a translate button into the current page, translating visible text in place and restoring it on click, with chunking and deduplication.
description.zh: 在当前页面注入翻译按钮，一键就地翻译所有可见文本，再次点击恢复原文；长页面分块处理并复用重复内容。

description.en: Adds inline AI completion (FIM) and Chinese-friendly typo checking to DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加行内 AI 补全（FIM）和针对中文的拼写错误检查。

description.en: Enhances the DeepSeek Harness chat input box with lock-send, enlarged editing, character count, and draft swap.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框增加锁定发送、放大编辑、字数统计和草稿互换功能。

description.en: Persistent input history for DSH with Arrow Up/Down recall, unsent draft recovery, deduplication and local storage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持久化输入历史，支持上下方向键切换记录、恢复未发送草稿、去重与本地存储。

description.en: Adds a chip in the dsh web composer showing the current model's input limit (context window) and letting you change it on the spot.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页对话输入栏添加输入上限标记，显示当前模型上下文窗口并可就地修改。

description.en: Turns the chat composer into an auto-playing mini-game arcade while a task is running, so waiting becomes playful.
description.zh: 任务执行期间把对话输入框变成自动运行的小游戏娱乐场，让等待变得有趣。

description.en: A tool that returns family insurance planning plans based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数返回家庭保险规划方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Generates family insurance planning plans based on input parameters.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成家庭保险规划方案

description.en: Auto insurance claim decision tool that calculates claim outcomes precisely based on input parameters.
description.zh: 汽车保险理赔决策工具，根据输入参数精确计算理赔结果。

description.en: Insurance configuration tool that calculates recommendations based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算保险配置建议的纯 Node 工具，不依赖网络

description.en: Guards DeepSeek Harness intake by flagging external materials and blocking unauthorized authority-path and memory writes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供材料摄入防护：标记外部材料并拦截未授权的权限路径与记忆写入。

description.en: Runs question-bank quality checks on DSH models, saves responses, supports human review, and attributes which model family a model resembles.
description.zh: 对 DSH 中的模型跑题库质量检测，保存回答、支持人工评审，并推测它像哪个模型家族。

description.en: Renders adaptive charts, diagrams, math and interactive controls inside DeepSeek Harness answers.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的回答按需呈现图表、结构图、公式与交互控件。

description.en: Model writes small interface programs that the chat renders as native interactive cards, with controls recomputing locally without extra model calls.
description.zh: 模型编写小型界面程序，聊天将其渲染为原生交互卡片，控件在本地重新计算，无需再次调用模型。

description.en: Tracks promises a conversation quietly drops—deferrals, unanswered questions, shelved decisions and agent commitments—in a ranked cross-session ledger.
description.zh: 追踪对话中悄然遗漏的承诺——推迟事项、未答问题、搁置决定与代理承诺——并整理为跨会话的排序清单。

description.en: Lets independent dsh sessions on one machine discover each other and exchange messages via send, ask, and reply.
description.zh: 让同一台机器上相互独立的 dsh 会话发现彼此，并通过 send、ask、reply 交换消息。

description.en: Browse internal harness folders with native file icons, thumbnails, and eight switchable view modes.
description.zh: 内置文件浏览插件，支持原生文件图标、缩略图和八种视图模式，方便浏览内部文件夹。

description.en: After a restart, detects sessions whose last turn was force-interrupted and re-injects a safe continue prompt with state-verification steps.
description.zh: 重启后检测上一轮被强制中断的会话，并重新注入带状态校验说明的安全继续提示。

description.en: A quick-practice plugin for DeepSeek Harness that generates questions, overlays a quiz UI, analyzes answers, and shows radar reports.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供快速练习：自动出题、叠加答题界面、分析作答并生成雷达图报告。

description.en: Investment research bundle with 10 tools and 23 skills that runs a six-phase, four-agent value-investing workflow and produces a chart-rich PDF report.
description.zh: 投资研究插件包：含10个工具和23项技能，运行六阶段四智能体价值投资工作流，并生成图表丰富的PDF报告。

description.en: Checks an invoice ledger for duplicate reimbursements, tax/amount consistency, payer and date anomalies, and leftover template placeholders, then outputs an anomaly list plus a normalized workbook.
description.zh: 核对发票台账中的重复报销、价税勾稽、抬头与日期异常及模板占位符，输出异常清单与规范化工作簿。

description.en: Mirror your iPhone screen live in the DSH right sidebar and let the agent tap, swipe and type on it over USB on Windows, no Xcode needed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏实时显示 iPhone 屏幕，并让 agent 通过 USB 在 Windows 上点击、滑动和输入，无需 Xcode。

description.en: iOS plugin that lets you scan a QR code to remotely control a computer agent, with persistent sessions and home screen support.
