description.zh: 通过手机扫码遥控电脑上的 agent，支持会话持久化和 iOS 主屏图标。

description.en: Public IP geolocation tool that fetches live location data for an IP address.
description.zh: 查询公网IP的实时归属地，返回指定IP地址的所在地位置数据。

description.en: Plugin named dsh-iphone-mode; no README or description available.
description.zh: 名为 dsh-iphone-mode 的插件，未提供 README 或功能描述，具体能力暂无法确认。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar IRC client with direct node tls or HTTP CONNECT tunnel, SASL PLAIN auth, self-signed cert support and limited auto-reconnect.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 IRC 客户端，支持 node tls 直连或 HTTP CONNECT 隧道、SASL PLAIN 认证、自签证书与限次自动重连。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin with minimal description: 铱元素 (Iridium element). No capabilities documented.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，仅标注为铱元素，未记录任何具体功能。

description.en: Provides ironing temperature recommendations based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数给出熨烫温度建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Determines whether two numbers are coprime using a pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 使用纯 Node 实现判断两个数是否互质，不依赖网络

description.en: Determines whether a given number is a perfect number.
description.zh: 判断给定数是否为完全数。

description.en: A fan-made transparent Isaac desktop pet that lives in the corner of DSH Web/Desktop with click sounds and themed speech bubbles.
description.zh: 一个粉丝自制的透明以撒桌面挂件，住在 DSH Web/桌面端右下角，带点击音效和以撒主题泡泡。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness session status and pending approvals onto the macOS Dynamic Island notch panel for in-place approval and jump-back.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话状态与待审批操作投影到 macOS 灵动岛刘海面板，可就地裁决并跳回对应会话。

description.en: 悬浮岛屿式界面皮肤：圆角面板、常驻左侧导航栏、独立的工作区列表岛屿，以及统一的首页、账号与设置外观。
A New Ithkuil (Ithkuil IV) translation workbench with offline grammar/lexicon lookup, formative assembly, and phonotactic checks.
description.zh: 用于新伊特库伊尔（Ithkuil IV）的翻译工作台，提供离线语法/词典查询、构形组装和音位配列检查。

description.en: Installs a J-Space First V3 warm agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with bootstrap and protocol injection.
description.zh: J-Space First V3 Warm agent preset plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): anchored two-phase bootstrap + warm-up round + J-Space protocol injection. Installable bundle that syncs the preset into ~/.dsh/.a

description.en: Unofficial Golden Spatula fan theme for DSH Web with a Hextech arena backdrop, golden spatula motif, four accent palettes and ambient glow.
description.zh: 金铲铲同人风格的 DSH Web 主题，含原创海克斯竞技场背景、金色铲影、四套强化色与氛围光效。

description.en: A judgment kernel for coding agents: routine judgments go to a small Jev judge, and every verdict is recorded in a ledger.
description.zh: 面向编码代理的判断内核：常规判断交由小型 Jev 法官处理，所有裁决记录在账本中。

description.en: Jev (TypeSafe System One) judgments applied at DeepSeek Harness agent-loop gates, with no UI dependency.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 智能体循环关卡上应用 Jev（TypeSafe System One）判定，不依赖 UI。

description.en: Lets you ask Jev (TypeSafe System One) typed questions from DeepSeek Harness, returning batch judgements with probabilities per user settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中向 Jev(TypeSafe System One)提出类型化问题,按用户设置批量返回带概率的判断结果。

description.en: DSH 窗口里的今汐形象体：图生视频生成四组动作、透明循环动画、自动漫游 / 尺寸随远近变化 / 点击敲碗音效与余额播报
A Jinhsi (Wuthering Waves) themed skin that restyles the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供今汐（鸣潮）主题外观的皮肤插件。

description.en: Adds a factory-assembly-line board tab that shows, in real time, how the dsh superagent dispatches tickets to worker agents.
description.zh: 在会话工作区新增一个工厂流水线看板标签页，实时展示超级 agent 向各 worker 派单与工位执行状态。

description.en: Provides Jujutsu (jj) version control tools via a zero-dependency MCP stdio server for DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex.
description.zh: 通过零依赖 MCP stdio 服务器，为 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code 和 Codex 提供 Jujutsu (jj) 版本控制工具 mcp__jj__*。

description.en: Jujutsu version-control plugin and skill for DeepSeek Harness agent teams.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 多智能体团队提供 Jujutsu 版本控制插件与技能。

description.en: Draggable floating ball showing live per-session progress, done/total count, speed and ETA for long-running background jobs in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 可拖拽悬浮球，实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 中长时间后台任务的进度、完成数/总数、速度与预计剩余时间。

description.en: Floating card that shows live progress for background jobs, including a progress bar, percentage, speed, ETA and the latest output line.
description.zh: 悬浮卡片实时显示后台任务的进度，包括进度条、百分比、速度、预计剩余时间和最新输出行。

description.en: A dsh plugin for composing dialogs based on Johari cognition quadrants.
A plugin about the country of Jordan.
JSON Schema validation implemented in pure Node, offline, no external services.
description.zh: 基于纯 Node 实现的 JSON Schema 校验，离线运行，不依赖任何外部服务。

description.en: A pure Node plugin that computes statistics on JSON data without network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 插件，用于计算 JSON 数据的统计信息，无需网络或外部服务。

description.en: Keyboard jump navigation for the DSH Web GUI: press a chord, type a letter label, and the labelled element is clicked or focused.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供键盘跳转导航：按下快捷键后输入字母标签，即可点击或聚焦对应元素。

description.en: Conversationally query and manage JumpServer assets, users, permissions and audit logs via signed API calls, with mandatory approval for writes.
description.zh: 通过对话查询和管理 JumpServer 资产、用户、权限与审计日志，写操作强制用户审批。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar's More account menu with a single Settings button that opens the settings panel in one click.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏底部的“更多”账户菜单替换为单个设置按钮，一键直达设置面板。

description.en: Connects dsh to the JuzPost MCP server and registers a posting skill so agents can schedule social media posts.
description.zh: 将 dsh 连接到 JuzPost MCP 服务器并注册发布技能，让智能体可以安排社交媒体帖子。

description.en: Parses jstack/cmd thread dumps, GC logs, Maven/Gradle dependency conflicts, stack traces and Spring config diffs into structured JVM diagnoses.
description.zh: 将 jstack/cmd 线程转储、GC 日志、Maven/Gradle 依赖冲突、堆栈跟踪和 Spring 配置差异解析为结构化 JVM 诊断报告。

description.en: Kanban task board plugin for DeepSeek Harness with columns, draggable cards, session todo sync, and agent read/write tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加任务看板插件：列与卡片拖拽、会话 todo 同步，agent 可通过工具读写看板。

description.en: Tints the DSH web UI using the KDE system accent color so the interface matches the desktop theme.
description.zh: 使用 KDE 系统强调色为 DSH 网页界面着色，使其与桌面主题保持一致。

description.en: Windows-only DSH watchdog that checks heartbeats, auto-restarts the app, restores plugin config, backs up daily, cleans disk and sends QQ alerts.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 的 DSH 保活守护：心跳检查、自动重启、插件配置恢复、每日备份、磁盘清理与 QQ 通知。

description.en: Per-provider API key pool for DSH with manual key switching, background reachability probing and provider plan-usage display.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的分提供商 API 密钥池插件，支持手动切换生效密钥、后台可达性探测与套餐用量展示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that pools multiple API keys, switches the active key in one click, and shows each key's live balance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多把 API Key 放进一个池子，一键切换当前生效的 key，并实时显示每把 key 各自的余额。

description.en: Adds a keyboard shortcuts settings page to DSH for permission modes, reasoning effort, prompt navigation, status, task list, and composer remaps.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加键盘快捷键设置页，可配置权限模式、推理强度、提示导航、状态页、任务列表和输入框重映射。

description.en: Read-only scanner that builds a knowledge graph of project modules and files to help understand architecture.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）组合包插件：只读扫描任意项目目录，自动构建**模块级 + 文件级知识图谱**，帮助快速理解项目整体架构与设计思路，为后续进化、优化提供依据。

description.en: One-click kill button for DSH Web GUI to terminate the server process without taskkill.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供一键结束按钮，无需 taskkill 即可终止服务器进程

description.en: Read-only plugin that turns kiln's git commit-trailer issue history into three linked, clickable views: timeline, issues and relationships.
description.zh: 只读插件，把 kiln 通过 git 提交 trailer 记录的 issue 历史转成时间线、issue、关系三页可点击界面。

description.en: Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba) skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a token-based palette, rotating wallpapers and a flame band.
description.zh: 《鬼灭之刃》风格的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 主题，包含 token 调色板、轮换壁纸和火焰装饰条。

description.en: Compatibility patch that splits Kimi reasoning, answer text and tool-call channels in DSH Subscriptions, with source checks, backups and hash-based rollback.
description.zh: Kimi 分流卫士：为 DSH Subscriptions 隔离思考、正文与工具调用通道的兼容补丁，支持源码检查、备份与哈希回滚。

description.en: DSH plugin that signs in to a Kimi Code subscription via device-code OAuth and routes requests with Bearer auth.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过设备码 OAuth 登录 Kimi Code 订阅，并使用 Bearer 认证转发请求。

description.en: Shows Kimi Code subscription quota as a colour-coded badge in the DSH Web UI, with progress bars, reset times and API key management.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中以彩色徽章显示 Kimi Code 订阅额度，并提供进度条、重置时间与 API 密钥管理。

description.en: Right-sidebar voice dictation panel that transcribes speech live into the composer and saves per-session text blocks with timestamps.
description.zh: 右侧栏语音听写面板，边说边把识别文字写入输入框，并按会话保存带时间戳的文本块。

description.en: Returns kitchen appliance (range hood/stove) purchase recommendations based on parameters. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回抽油烟机和灶具的选购推荐，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Returns home storage/organization plans based on input parameters for kitchen optimization.
DSH Host plugin that queries offline Wikipedia from local kiwix-serve ZIM files, giving air-gapped agents fact retrieval.
description.zh: DSH Host 插件：通过本地 kiwix-serve 与 ZIM 文件离线查询维基百科，为无网环境的 Agent 提供事实检索。

description.en: Converts kilometers to miles.
description.zh: 将公里转换为英里。

description.en: Converts speed from knots to kilometers per hour.
description.zh: 将速度从节转换为公里/小时

description.en: Returns home-style cooking plans based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回家常菜烹饪方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Returns handcraft DIY knitting/craft plans based on parameters. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回手工DIY编织与手工艺制作方案，纯Node实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: DSH skill center plugin: browse by region, install from zip, enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore, search.
description.zh: DSH技能中心插件：按地区浏览、从zip安装、启用/禁用、卸载、恢复回收站、搜索。

description.en: Prompt-scenario picker for DeepSeek Harness to select pre-configured prompts.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供提示场景选择器，用于选择预配置的提示。

description.en: A Git version-control workbench for DSH covering local changes, per-file or multi-file staging, confirmed commit/update/push, and readable Git error output.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 版本控制工作台，支持查看本地改动、单文件或多文件暂存、确认后提交/更新/推送，并输出易读的 Git 失败信息。

description.en: Converts speed values from knots to kilometers per hour.
Unified code graph and knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness, indexing AST symbols, refactor blast radius, clones and spec-to-code links in FalkorDB.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一代码图谱与知识库，用 FalkorDB 索引 AST 符号、重构影响范围、克隆检测与规格到代码的追溯。

description.en: Adds a sidebar knowledge-base page for uploading cross-border sourcing docs, which the agent retrieves from and cites before answering.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加左侧栏「我的知识库」页面，可上传跨境选品文档，Agent 回答前先检索知识库并引用文档标题。

description.en: Personal knowledge dashboard aggregating Obsidian, Notion and Feishu docs plus Dida365 tasks with stats, storage map, Markdown preview and deep links.
description.zh: 个人知识仪表盘，聚合 Obsidian、Notion、飞书文档与滴答清单任务，提供统计、存储映射、Markdown 预览与深链跳转。

description.en: A personal knowledge-management system that collects scattered notes from AI chats and auto-sorts them into a growing knowledge tree.
description.zh: 一个个人知识管理系统，从与AI的对话中收集零散知识，自动归类成长期积累的知识树。

description.en: Hosted MCP vault skills for storing and retrieving knowledge in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供托管 MCP 与轻量 vault 技能，用于存储和检索知识。

description.en: KnowzCode TDD / quality-gate workflow for DeepSeek Harness, no MCP.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 KnowzCode 测试驱动开发与质量门禁工作流，不依赖 MCP。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin named dsh-krypton with description '氪元素' (Krypton element); no further documentation.
description.zh: 一个名为 dsh-krypton 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，描述为氪元素，无更多功能说明。

description.en: Read-only Kubernetes cluster browser panel with agent tools for inspecting workloads and resources inside DSH.
description.zh: 只读的 Kubernetes 集群浏览面板与代理工具，可在 DSH 中查看工作负载与资源。

description.en: Search and play Kugou Music inside DeepSeek Harness, with local playlist decryption, word-by-word lyrics and translations, two UI layouts and custom hotkeys.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内搜索并播放酷狗音乐，支持本机歌单解密、逐字歌词与翻译、两套界面布局和自定义热键。

description.en: A plugin representing Kuwait country with minimal descriptive information only.
Converts kilowatt-hours (千瓦时) to megajoules (兆焦).
description.zh: 将千瓦时转换为兆焦。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin providing data about Kyrgyzstan with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，本地提供吉尔吉斯斯坦的国家数据，无需网络请求。

description.en: Tones down over-bright text in the DSH web GUI dark theme with softer label tokens, relaxed bold weight and lighter headings.
description.zh: 柔化 DSH Web GUI 深色主题中过亮的文字，提供更柔和的标签色、加粗字重与更淡的标题。

description.en: Second DSH plugin project (planning stage)
Opens password-protected LabVIEW VI/CTL block diagrams directly inside DSH, with no LabVIEW or Python install required.
description.zh: 无需安装 LabVIEW 或 Python，即可在 DSH 中打开受密码保护的 LabVIEW VI/CTL 程序框图。

description.en: A local AI-practice plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets you play board games, card games and mahjong solo against the computer.
description.zh: 来一桌是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地棋牌麻将人机陪练插件，一个人也能开棋桌、牌桌或麻将桌与电脑对弈。

description.en: Visualises a meow-memory store as concentric ripples with importance-based decay and injects a layered persona distilled from memories.
description.zh: 把 meow-memory 记忆库可视化为同心涟漪，按重要性与时间分层淡化，并注入从记忆中蒸馏的多层人格。

description.en: Fully offline LAN instant-messaging plugin with one-to-one and group chat, file transfer, and subnet scanning to auto-discover colleagues.
description.zh: 完全离线的内网即时通讯插件，支持单聊、群聊、文件传输与按网段扫描自动发现同事。

description.en: Password-gated LAN access to DSH Web UI with real-time session sync and randomUUID polyfill.
description.zh: 通过密钥门禁让手机或平板在局域网访问 DSH Web UI，会话实时同步，并内置 randomUUID polyfill。

description.en: Discovers other DSH installs on the same LAN and enables opt-in cross-device ask/tell messaging, off by default.
description.zh: 在同一局域网内发现其他 DSH 实例，并支持按需跨设备 ask/tell 通信，默认关闭。

description.en: Remote access proxy for dsh, exposing HTTP/HTTPS with IP whitelist, Basic Auth, and logging.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供远程访问代理，把界面暴露到公网或局域网，支持 IP 白名单、密码登录、HTTPS 和 IPv6 直连。

description.en: LAN relay plugin that lets one machine host an in-process hub so cross-machine agents can exchange messages with offline queueing and wake-on-message.
description.zh: 局域网中继插件：一台机器运行进程内 Hub，其他机器粘贴加入码接入，实现跨机器智能体消息传递、离线队列与消息唤醒。

description.en: Host or join LAN rooms with one-time invite codes so agents can ask each other questions.
description.zh: 通过一次性邀请码在局域网创建或加入房间，让智能体互相提问协作。

description.en: Shares text and files over the LAN with automatic peer discovery and an accept-or-ask policy for incoming transfers.
description.zh: 通过局域网发现同伴并收发文本与文件，支持接收前询问策略。

description.en: Ships 14 community translations (ru, es, pt-BR, de, fr, it, pl, tr, ja, ko, zh-TW, id, vi, hi) for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 14 种社区翻译语言包：ru、es、pt-BR、de、fr、it、pl、tr、ja、ko、zh-TW、id、vi、hi。

description.en: A ledger for agent skills: records each lesson, rejects vague or unverified entries, and retires skills that have gone stale or misleading.
description.zh: 给 agent 技能做的一本账册：记录每条经验，驳回笼统或未验证的条目，并核销过期或误导人的技能。

description.en: Plugin for Laos country, part of DeepSeek Harness registry.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件注册表中的老挝国家插件。

description.en: Packages agent skills for the Lark/Feishu CLI so DSH agents can run Lark workspace commands; lark-im is excluded to pair with an IM bridge.
description.zh: 为 Lark/飞书 CLI 打包智能体技能，让 DSH 智能体执行 Lark 工作区命令；不含 lark-im，可与 IM 桥接插件配合。

description.en: Watches Feishu (Lark) conversations under your own user identity and forwards new messages as prompts into a chosen DSH session.
description.zh: 以你本人的用户身份监听飞书会话，并把新消息作为提示投递到指定的 DSH 会话中。

description.en: LaTeX workspace plugin that edits .tex files in the sidebar, compiles them with local TeX Live latexmk, and shows a live PDF preview refreshed on save.
description.zh: LaTeX 工作区插件：在侧边栏编辑 .tex 文件，调用本地 TeX Live 的 latexmk 编译，并在保存后自动刷新实时 PDF 预览。

description.en: Adds named launch buttons to the DSH composer: left-click runs the default target, right-click opens the full target list.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入区添加多个命名启动按钮：左键启动默认目标，右键打开目标列表。

description.en: Laundry room planning tool that generates laundry cleaning management plans based on parameters.
description.zh: 洗衣房规划工具，可根据参数生成洗衣清洁管理方案。

description.en: Provides laundry sorting and cleaning management plans based on parameters, implemented in pure Node without network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数提供衣物分类与清洗管理方案，使用纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Returns clear laundry water temperature recommendations based on input parameters.
Provides a local Node-based tool to list and query legal term entries by ID or name.
description.zh: 提供本地 Node 工具，可按 ID 或名称列出并查询法律术语条目。

description.en: Reads a statute citation inventory and checks each citation's law/article format, quotation transcription, power status, and document header elements.
description.zh: 读取法条引注清单，校验每条引注的法律与条款编号格式、引文转录、效力状态及文档要素。

description.en: No functional description available; plugin named after lawrencium.
description.zh: 以化学元素铹（Lawrencium）命名的插件，暂无功能描述信息。

description.en: A product selection tool that returns personalized facial skincare plans based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回个性化面部护肤方案的产品选择工具，用纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: VSCode-style layout manager: activity bar, left/right plugin panes, drag dividers, collapsible regions, and persisted presets.
Checks a letter of credit presentation checklist for completeness and internal date consistency, flagging missing or invalid entries.
description.zh: 检查信用证交单清单的完整性与内部日期一致性，标记缺失或不合规的条目。

description.en: Pre-publish credential leak scanner for DSH that flags API keys, tokens, private keys, connection strings and plaintext passwords before you push or publish.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的发布前凭据泄漏扫描插件，在 git push 或发包前检查 API key、token、私钥、连接串和明文密码。

description.en: Checks a competency gap and development plan register: row identity, level arithmetic, thresholds, owners, dates and status vocabulary.
description.zh: 校验能力差距与发展计划登记表：核对行标识、等级算术、阈值、责任人、日期与状态词表。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar ledger with add/summary/list/remove, showing monthly income, expense, balance and category bar stats in integer cents.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏记账本，支持记一笔、本月收支结余、分类条形统计，金额一律以整数“分”存储，工具含 add/summary/list/remove。

description.en: White kitten accountant that tracks per-answer cost, prompt-cache savings, context size, live balance, and plays synthesized sounds in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 白色小猫会计，为 DeepSeek Harness 跟踪每次回答费用、提示缓存节省、上下文大小与实时余额，并播放合成音效。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏刷题台：题库实时从 leetcode.cn 拉取，Java 编辑器（补全/缩进），一键提交看判题结果。
DSH legal research plugin that retrieves Chinese statutes, court cases and judgment documents directly from official government websites.
description.zh: DSH 法治检索插件，直接从国家法律法规数据库、人民法院案例库与中国裁判文书网检索法规条文和案例。

description.en: Builds a hierarchical legal clause tree, maps clauses onto a 12-key playbook and reports unresolved items.
description.zh: 构建层级化法律条款树，将条款映射到12键剧本，并生成未解决项报告。

description.en: Turns EML email into a deduplicated legal request intake list and exports it as a ledger.
description.zh: 将 EML 邮件整理为去重后的法律请求受理清单，并导出为台账。

description.en: Lets a DSH agent actually watch a whole film by aligning continuous frames, audio shape and cut rhythm locally with ffmpeg, no cloud.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 真正看完一整部片子：用本地 ffmpeg 对齐连续画面、声音形状与剪辑节奏，无需云依赖。

description.en: Annotate web UI elements with Shift box selection, inspect live style changes, and send cross-page review feedback to DeepSeek Harness in one message.
description.zh: 通过 Shift 框选标注网页元素，查看实时样式变化，并将跨页面评审反馈一次性发送给 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness's model and reasoning-level selectors into a 31-position sliding rheostat that switches both at once.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择与推理等级控件换成 31 档滑动变阻器，拖动滑片即可同时切换模型与思考强度。

description.en: Adds a peak/off-peak pricing tide indicator and today's used amount for DSH's Web GUI, tracking DeepSeek pricing.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加峰谷定价指示器与当日已用金额显示，并跟随 DeepSeek 官方定价。

description.en: Manage local GitHub CLI accounts, web authorization, SSH identities, and repository permissions inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理本地 GitHub CLI 账户、网页授权、SSH 身份和仓库权限。

description.en: Organizes DSH's model picker: folds by provider, slides out a panel with search, favorites, recents, aliases and hiding.
description.zh: 整理 DSH 模型选择菜单：按厂商折叠、悬浮滑出面板，并支持搜索、置顶、最近、别名与隐藏。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing status and an hh:mm countdown directly in the DSH model name, with live preview and compact settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型名称中直接显示 DeepSeek 峰谷状态与小时:分钟倒计时，支持实时预览与紧凑设置页。

description.en: Shows session token usage, per-request DeepSeek cost estimates by request time and model tier, plus account balance in a pill below the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方徽标中显示会话 token 用量、按每笔请求时刻与模型档位估算的 DeepSeek 费用，以及账户余额。

description.en: Scans reference corpora, drives absorption-report batches, validates file:line evidence, and builds a searchable per-library knowledge base.
description.zh: 扫描参考语料库，驱动吸收报告批次，校验 file:line 证据，并建立可搜索的逐库知识库。

description.en: Provides Liberia's capital, population, currency, and continent. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 提供利比里亚的首都、人口、货币和所属大洲信息，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin representing Libya (利比亚国家).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于表示利比亚国家。

description.en: Statically inventories licenses of DSH plugin packages and installed dependencies, flagging strong copyleft and unknown licenses.
description.zh: 静态盘点 DSH 插件包及已安装依赖的许可证，标记强著佐权和未知许可证。

description.en: Scans node_modules licenses, normalizes SPDX, classifies copyleft types, and performs pre-release license compliance checks.
description.zh: 扫描 node_modules 中的依赖许可证，归一化 SPDX 标识，按 copyleft 类型分类，并在发布前进行许可证合规校验。

description.en: Provides evidence-only support for license obligation delivery closure in DSH plugins.
description.zh: Evidence-only DSH plugin for license obligation delivery closure

description.en: A global DSH sidebar planner with todos, reminders, countdowns, a calendar, focus timer and GitHub-style heatmap statistics.
description.zh: 拾光笺：DSH 侧边栏生活时间管理插件，集待办提醒、倒计时、日历、专注计时与热力图统计于一体。

description.en: A glassmorphic personal workbench panel combining KPI overview, kanban boards, daily tasks, notes and a file/image library.
description.zh: 玻璃拟态个人工作台面板，整合总览统计、看板、每日事项、随手记与资料文件库。

description.en: Out-of-process safe boot, failure isolation, and recovery UI for DeepSeek Harness profiles.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置提供进程外安全启动、故障隔离和恢复界面。

description.en: Returns strength training plans based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回力量训练计划并作动作教学，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A light-green color theme for the DSH client that overrides dsw tokens and bolds selected menu items and session rows.
description.zh: DSH 客户端的浅绿配色主题，覆盖 dsw 令牌并加粗选中的菜单项与会话行。

description.en: Lighting requirement reference tool that returns clear suggestions based on input parameters. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入的参数返回光照需求建议的参考工具，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Dashboard for shipped projects: local facts, GitHub stars and last push, plugin-market adoption and downloads, plus pending PR wait times vs upstream median.
description.zh: 为已发布项目提供一屏概览：本地信息、GitHub 星标与最近推送、插件市场采纳与下载量，以及待处理 PR 等待时间对比上游中位数。

description.en: DSH plugin that registers the LightVela OpenAI-compatible gateway as a model provider with model discovery, streaming and multi-key failover.
description.zh: 把 LightVela（OpenAI 兼容网关）注册为 DSH 模型 provider 的插件，支持模型发现、流式转发与多 key 自动切换。

description.en: Durable cross-session memory for DSH agents, with ranked fact search, fact saving, stats, and a four-rung resilient fetch ladder that reports which rung answered.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供跨会话持久记忆：按排名检索事实、保存事实、查看统计，并提供四级弹性抓取阶梯并报告哪一级成功。

description.en: Floating A-share limit-up card for DeepSeek Harness showing counts, break rate, board height, themes and a watchlist.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浮动 A 股涨停卡片，展示涨停数、炸板率、连板高度、题材与自选股。

description.en: Zero-dependency linear algebra toolbox for dsh: matrix ops, determinants, inverses, RREF, linear system solving, vector utilities.
description.zh: 零依赖线性代数工具箱：提供矩阵运算、行列式、逆矩阵、RREF、线性方程组求解和向量运算。

description.en: Offline Chinese-English dictionary plugin with literary corpus, prosody data, and related-word lookups for DSH.
description.zh: 离线的中英词典插件，提供文学语料、韵律数据和相关词查询。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu on links in the DSH desktop client to open them in your default browser or copy the URL.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面客户端中为链接添加右键菜单，可用默认浏览器打开或复制链接。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web UI sidebar brand mark and the composer mascot with your own illustrated character, including 18 hand-drawn animated states.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 界面的侧栏品牌标记和输入框吉祥物替换为你的插画角色，并提供 18 个手绘动画状态。

description.en: Returns daily makeup plans and lipstick selection based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回每日妆容方案和口红选择，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Brings the lit + FileCheck test loop into a DSH session with run, rerun-failed and single-file FileCheck tools.
description.zh: 将 lit + FileCheck 测试循环引入 DSH 会话，提供运行、重跑失败用例和单文件 FileCheck 三个工具。

description.en: Deterministic multi-source literature harvesting for DeepSeek Harness
A governed literature library for DSH: import papers, extract their text, keep one index row per entry, and verify quotes.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的受治理文献库：导入论文、提取正文、每条记录保留一行索引，并可核验引文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Litefuse Plugin for agent observability and evals, tracing every turn with model calls, tools, and subagents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能体可观测性与评估的 Litefuse 插件，追踪每一轮的模型调用、工具调用和子智能体。

description.en: Injects body-level extra_headers into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests so listed providers and upstream hosts receive them through a LiteLLM relay.
description.zh: 向兼容 OpenAI 的 chat/completions 请求体注入 extra_headers，使指定提供商和上游主机能穿透 LiteLLM 中继收到这些头部。

description.en: Open your litman literature libraries from a sidebar panel, with the agent installing litman automatically when it is missing.
description.zh: 从侧边栏打开你的 litman 文献库，缺少 litman 时智能体会自动安装。

description.en: Local-first AI literature desk that parses PDFs, supports bilingual reading, in-page AI answers and knowledge graphs.
description.zh: 本地优先的 AI 文献工作台，支持 PDF 解析、双语阅读、页内 AI 问答与知识图谱。

description.en: Six-line (liuyao) divination plugin: one-click casting, eight-palace najia chart, AI interpretation, chart card and case archive.
description.zh: 六爻起卦插件：一键起卦、纳甲装卦、AI 解卦，并支持卦盘卡片与案例存档。

description.en: Liuyao divination plugin: casts hexagrams, computes charts with a rules engine, and has the model interpret them with classical citations.
description.zh: 六爻算卦插件：支持手工与电脑摇卦排盘，规则引擎算出盘面事实，模型依典籍断卦并标注出处。

description.en: A live cockpit panel showing what the current session is doing, what needs your attention, and its running costs.
description.zh: 实时驾驶舱面板，展示当前会话正在做什么、哪些事项需要你处理，以及运行成本。

description.en: Adds live Markdown and KaTeX LaTeX rendering inside DSH's native Lexical input box, with no toggle needed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生 Lexical 输入框中实时渲染 Markdown 与 KaTeX 公式，无需任何开关。

description.en: Live-preview panel that shows your workspace pages beside the chat and auto-reloads them whenever you save a change.
description.zh: 实时预览面板，在聊天旁展示工作区页面，保存后自动刷新。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel that live-previews the app you are building: web dev server in an iframe, Windows window capture, and Android emulator mirroring.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏插件，边写代码边实时预览应用：iframe 加载本地网页、捕获 Windows 窗口画面、安卓真机/模拟器高清镜像，并一键安装安卓模拟器。

description.en: Persistent bar under DSH's input showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, Chinese holidays, current unit price, and session spend.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方常驻显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段、中国法定节假日、当前单价与会话花费的实时价格条。

description.en: A visible terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness that streams agent shell commands live and lets the agent capture terminal output as text.
description.zh: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视终端面板，可实时显示智能体的 shell 命令，并让智能体以文本形式捕获终端屏幕内容。

description.en: Adds a live tokens-per-second badge under the DSH input box, with an expandable speed sparkline and per-turn stats.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方显示实时 tok/s 徽标，可展开速度折线与本轮统计。

description.en: Live2D desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a transparent floating stage where the AI character talks, glances and changes expressions, with size/opacity settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Live2D 桌面宠物：透明浮窗舞台，AI 可让它说话、抬眼、换表情，设置页可调大小、透明度、头像与动作节奏。

description.en: DSH web plugin adding a LiveBench tab to the Trajectory view that runs LiveBench evaluations on every configured DeepSeek Harness model and shows scores in place.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在 Trajectory 视图中新增 LiveBench 标签页，对 DeepSeek Harness 中配置的所有模型运行 LiveBench 评测并就地显示分数。

description.en: Live wallpaper layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with procedural presets, images, GIF and video behind a translucent shell.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供动态壁纸层，支持程序化预设、图片、GIF 和视频，并置于半透明外壳之后。

description.en: Manages multiple LLM API subscriptions: usage tracking, balances, and automatic hot-switching.
description.zh: 管理多个 LLM API 订阅，统计用量与余额，并在需要时自动热切换。

description.en: Arena API provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness adding Arena Router credits, OpenAI Responses support and a Windows Cloudflare fallback.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Arena API 提供方插件，支持 Arena Router 额度、OpenAI Responses 以及 Windows 下的 Cloudflare 备用通道。

description.en: Reads each configured LLM provider's remaining balance or subscription quota and shows it in an always-visible card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 读取每个已配置 LLM 服务商的剩余余额或订阅配额，并在网页界面的常驻卡片中显示。

description.en: Bridges cc-switch accounts into DeepSeek Harness as live model categories by reading the CC Switch SQLite database on every operation.
description.zh: 将 cc-switch 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为实时模型类别，并在每次操作时读取 CC Switch SQLite 数据库。

description.en: Shows per-turn and whole-session LLM cost estimates (model price × tokens, local) inline in DeepSeek Harness, with a clickable breakdown popup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中内联显示每轮与整个会话的 LLM 费用估算（模型单价×token 本地计算），点击可查看明细。

description.en: Captures every complete LLM request — messages, tools and sampling settings — into folded JSONL dump files for inspection.
description.zh: 把每次完整的 LLM 请求（消息、工具、采样参数）记录为折叠式 JSONL 转储文件，便于查看。

description.en: DSH middleware that auto-fixes rejected model parameters (400/422) and retries, keeping agent conversations alive with honest usage stats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：模型服务拒绝参数（400/422）时自动修正并重发，对话不中断，用量统计防清零、防重复。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible gateway that exposes every model configured in DeepSeek Harness on a local port
DSH plugin for local MLX-LM models, loopback-only defaults, optional managed server startup.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入本地 MLX-LM 模型，默认仅回环访问，并可选自动启动托管服务器。

description.en: Adds per-model reasoning-effort levels and multimodal input settings for custom providers in the DSH Models settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型设置页为自定义提供商配置每个模型的推理强度等级与多模态输入选项。

description.en: Unified LLM provider pools for DeepSeek Harness with session-sticky global balancing, capability-aware model mapping and automatic failover.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的 LLM 提供商池，支持会话粘性全局均衡、按能力映射模型以及自动故障转移。

description.en: A dsh provider that registers a virtual "auto" model, routing each request to a suitable backend model with fallback on failure.
description.zh: 一个 dsh provider，注册虚拟模型 auto，按请求内容自动选择后端模型，失败时按链回退。

description.en: Token usage and cost analytics panel for DeepSeek Harness with daily charts, rankings, sortable table, CSV export and balance tracking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Token 用量与费用分析面板,包含每日图表、排名、可排序表格、CSV 导出与余额查询。

description.en: Wire-level LLM inspector capturing raw HTTP request/response bodies of every provider call, per session, in a Conversation View tab and loopback viewer.
description.zh: 逐会话捕获每次 LLM 模型调用的原始 HTTP 请求与响应体，并在对话视图标签与回环查看页中展示。

description.en: Adds vision and OCR capabilities to text-only models with image description, text extraction, and caching.
description.zh: Reliable vision + OCR for text-only models on DeepSeek Harness: describe_image (normal/critical) + extract_text tools, auto-preprocessing, retries, and a persistent answer cache.

description.en: DSH plugin that keeps a small core toolset resident, hides the rest in groups, and activates them on demand to cut context bloat.
description.zh: DSH 插件：只常驻少量核心工具，其余按组默认隐藏，需要时一句话激活，避免上下文膨胀。

description.en: Overrides the DeepSeek Harness sidebar and settings account avatar with a local image, saved only on your machine without changing account data.
description.zh: 用本地图片覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏与设置中的账户头像，仅保存在本机，不修改账户资料。

description.en: Local Todo/Doing/Done kanban board in the left sidebar, stored as your own Markdown file, with macOS due-date reminders.
description.zh: 左侧导航的本地 Todo/Doing/Done 三列看板，数据存于自选 Markdown 文件，macOS 支持到期提醒。

description.en: Uploads local files from the Web composer into the current DeepSeek Harness workspace.
description.zh: 从网页输入框把本地文件上传到当前 DeepSeek Harness 工作区。

description.en: Browse, preview, upload, download, edit, rename, and delete host files from the browser via an authenticated DSH web server.
description.zh: 通过已认证的 DSH Web 服务器，在浏览器中浏览、预览、上传、下载、编辑、重命名和删除主机文件。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base plugin that indexes full-disk documents into SQLite FTS5 trigram and exposes them via a sidebar search panel and a kb agent tool.
description.zh: 本地优先知识库插件，将全盘文档索引到 SQLite FTS5 三元组，并提供侧边栏搜索面板和高效的 kb 智能体工具。

description.en: Local-first document library for DSH Desktop that keeps files on your machine and lets every conversation search, read and download them via four agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的本地资料库，文件只存本机，任何会话都能通过 4 个工具搜索、读取和下载这些文件。

description.en: File-based memory plugin for local agents: a ME.md plus project MEMORY.md vault with cache-stable injection, plain-line inbox and a Memory rightbar.
description.zh: 面向本地 agent 的文件式记忆插件：以 ME.md 与项目 MEMORY.md 构成记忆库，支持缓存稳定注入、纯文本收件箱与 Memory 侧边栏。

description.en: Monitors CPU and GPU temperature, clock frequency and memory usage on Windows to keep local AI workloads in check.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上监控 CPU 与 GPU 的温度、频率和内存占用，保障本地 AI 负载稳定运行。

description.en: A local-first music player and playlist manager plugin embedded in the DSH Web UI sidebar.
description.zh: 一个面向 DSH Web UI 的本地优先音乐播放器与歌单管理插件，入口位于左侧栏。

description.en: Low-VRAM resource scheduling runtime that budgets GPU/VRAM across local LLMs, ComfyUI workflows and scripts with a resumable task state machine.
description.zh: 低显存资源调度运行时，为本地 LLM、ComfyUI 工作流和脚本统一分配显存预算，并提供可恢复的任务状态机。

description.en: Adds a 'local plugin switch' section to the DSH settings page to list and toggle locally installed plugins in real-time and persistently.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页添加本地插件开关区块，列出本地已安装插件，并实时、持久地启用或禁用。

description.en: Controls a LAN AMD inference server over a single persistent SSH connection: GPU power limits, Radiance docker service, image updates, reboot and live metrics.
description.zh: 通过一条常驻 SSH 连接远程控制局域网 AMD 推理服务器：GPU 功耗限制、Radiance 服务、镜像更新、重启及实时指标。

description.en: Read-only visibility into local task metadata on macOS and DeepSeek Harness, with no task control or model calls.
description.zh: 在 macOS 和 DeepSeek Harness 上只读查看本地任务元数据，不提供任务控制或模型调用。

description.en: Fully-local speech-to-text DSH plugin powered by whisper.cpp, with a drag-and-drop panel and a transcribe_audio agent tool.
description.zh: 基于 whisper.cpp 的完全本地语音转文字 DSH 插件，提供拖拽面板与 transcribe_audio 智能体工具。

description.en: Belarusian (be) language pack that localizes the DeepSeek Harness web UI with 60 namespaces and 2713 translated strings.
description.zh: 白俄罗斯语（be）语言包，通过 60 个命名空间和 2713 条翻译字符串本地化 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面。

description.en: Spanish (es) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness interface, with 2603 keys across 57 namespaces and automatic fallback to English.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面的西班牙语（es）语言包，含 57 个命名空间的 2603 个键，缺失时自动回退英语。

description.en: French locale pack that adds Français to the DeepSeek Harness UI language selector, covering 58 namespaces and 2614 keys with English fallback.
description.zh: 法语语言包，在 DeepSeek Harness 界面语言选择器中加入 Français，覆盖 58 个命名空间、2614 个键，未翻译项自动回退英文。

description.en: Adds four offline UI locales (zh-TW, ja, ko, fr) to DeepSeek Harness with no API calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加四种离线界面语言（繁体中文、日语、韩语、法语），无需调用 API。

description.en: Polish language pack that adds Polski (pl) to the DeepSeek Harness web UI language settings.
description.zh: 波兰语语言包，为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端界面在语言设置中添加 Polski (pl) 选项。

description.en: Turkish (tr) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, covering 42 namespaces and 1278 strings translated from the English dictionaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的土耳其语（tr）语言包，包含 42 个命名空间、1278 条来自英文词典的译文。

description.en: Vietnamese language pack that adds a 'Tiếng Việt' UI language and provides dictionaries for every DSH client plugin exposing strings via ctx.locale.
description.zh: 越南语语言包，为 DeepSeek Harness 添加“Tiếng Việt”界面语言，并为所有通过 ctx.locale 发布字符串的客户端插件提供词典。

description.en: Notification center plugin for DSH: sidebar entry, full-screen viewer, notify_add agent tool & CLI, JSON persistence, live refresh.
description.zh: DSH本地通知中心插件：侧边栏通知入口与全屏通知中心，支持notify_add工具和CLI，JSON持久化，实时刷新。

description.en: Send files across the LAN via LocalSend v2, share a temporary HTTP download link, or push to an SMB share with no receiver client needed.
description.zh: 通过 LocalSend v2 在局域网发送文件，生成临时 HTTP 下载链接，或推送到 SMB 共享，接收端无需安装客户端。

description.en: Whole-disk, millisecond file search with a self-built cross-platform index, agent tools and a Web search panel.
description.zh: 全盘毫秒级文件搜索，自建跨平台索引，提供智能体工具与网页搜索面板。

description.en: Adds a macOS lock screen requiring password or Touch ID after restart or 48 hours idle, configurable in settings with Liquid Glass styling.
description.zh: 为 macOS 添加锁屏：重启或 48 小时未验证后需密码或 Touch ID 解锁，设置页可配置，采用 Liquid Glass 风格。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button that locks the DSH interface behind your current Windows wallpaper, unlocked by pressing Esc twice.
description.zh: 侧边栏一键锁屏插件，用当前 Windows 壁纸遮盖整个 DSH 界面，连按两次 Esc 解锁。

description.en: Pin-aware updater for DeepSeek Harness that checks lockfile drift and plans pin bumps without floating to latest.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的固定版本更新器，检查 lockfile 漂移并规划锁定版本升级，不会漂移到最新版本。

description.en: Read-only SSH log inspection that pulls docker logs, clusters error fingerprints and returns only root-cause summaries.
description.zh: 只读 SSH 日志巡检：拉取 docker 日志、聚类错误指纹，仅返回根因摘要，全量日志不进入上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 品牌自定义插件：替换侧栏 Logo、品牌字标、对话页 Logo、欢迎语标语，控制预览版徽章显示。纯前端注入，不修改安装文件。
Adds a split-pane Markdown editing modal to the DSH input box with live preview and one-click write-back.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框增加左右分栏的 Markdown 长内容编辑弹窗，实时预览并一键写回。

description.en: Turns 64 graded population studies into three daily longevity actions, with a sidebar page and five evidence tools for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将64项分级人群研究转化为每日三项长寿行动，并提供侧边栏页面和五个证据查询工具。

description.en: Long-press and drag to capture a screen region as PNG, then preview it and insert it directly into the DSH composer.
description.zh: 长按鼠标左键拖拽选区截取屏幕并生成 PNG，预览后可直接插入 DSH 输入框。

description.en: Adds a reversible "Collapse history" toggle that shrinks the rendered page history window to keep long sessions fast.
description.zh: 提供可逆的“折叠历史”开关，缩小页面历史窗口渲染范围，让长会话保持流畅。

description.en: DSH plugin that automatically splits over-long screenshots into overlapping, prompt-acceptable slices before they are admitted to the model.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在提示词提交前自动将超长截图切分为带重叠、可被接受的图片切片。

description.en: Independent-model supervisor that reviews agent reasoning and tool calls in real time, flagging loops, idling or laziness with WARN/BLOCK/STOP.
description.zh: 多智能体监工插件：用独立模型实时审阅推理与工具调用，检测死循环、空转和偷懒，并按 WARN/BLOCK/STOP 三档处置。

description.en: Detects model repetition loops mid-stream, cuts them out, prunes the looped text from the session log, and resumes generation automatically.
description.zh: 在流式输出中检测模型重复循环，实时截断并从会话日志中清除重复内容，然后自动恢复生成。

description.en: dsh插件，模仿酒馆世界书设计的分层提示词注入。DSH 的声明式提示词注入层：分层锚点、蓝绿灯、可复现概率、三面正则替换。类酒馆世界书，但不是角色扮演前端，而是提示词工程工具。
Generates placeholder (lorem ipsum) text in pure Node with no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的占位文本（lorem ipsum）生成器，无需网络或外部服务。

description.en: Preserves exact user-authored message text hidden by context compaction and re-injects it as a budgeted runtime-context snapshot.
description.zh: 保留因上下文压缩而被遮蔽的用户消息原文，并以受预算限制的运行时上下文快照重新注入。

description.en: Watches chosen folders, indexes new files into a local SQLite database, and lets you search by keyword, time, type or folder — fully read-only.
description.zh: 监视指定文件夹,把新出现的文件索引进本地 SQLite 数据库,可按关键词、时间、类型或目录快速寻回,全程只读。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that presents lot2 backend database metrics snapshots via two agent tools, /status and /snapshot endpoints, and a session tab.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件，通过两个 agent 工具、/status 与 /snapshot 端点及会话标签页呈现 lot2 后端数据库指标快照。

description.en: Local-first quick-capture plugin that saves selected quotes, sticky notes and images from DSH chats to one local JSON file, with optional cloud sync.
description.zh: 乱记：本地优先的随手记录插件，可在 DSH 对话中划选引用、保存便签和图片，默认存于本地单个 JSON 文件，并可选云端同步。

description.en: Pure Node.js plugin that computes relative luminance (brightness) for colors, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，根据颜色计算相对亮度，不依赖网络。

description.en: Displays a Lu Xun GIF desktop pet on the web UI that reacts to agent work status, plays audio on completion, and supports drag/click interactions.
description.zh: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 桌宠插件：鲁迅先生桌宠，按 Agent 工作状态切换动作，任务完成播放语音，支持全屏拖拽/点击互动/静音开关

description.en: Keeps macOS from idle-sleeping while a DeepSeek Harness session is running, releasing the wake lock when the session ends.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话运行期间阻止 Mac 空闲休眠，会话结束后自动释放。

description.en: Bridge Apple on-device Vision framework into DeepSeek Harness for local OCR, image classification, face detection, document layout.
description.zh: 把苹果 Vision 框架接入 dsh，本地提供 OCR、图像分类、人脸检测和文档版面分析工具，无需网络和 API 密钥。

description.en: Compact macOS-style sidebar chrome for DeepSeek Harness: one control row replaces the brand row, with a New Session bar and stacked panel list.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 紧凑侧边栏外观：用一行控件替代品牌行，并加入新会话栏和堆叠面板列表。

description.en: Posts native macOS Notification Center alerts when an agent turn finishes, fails, hits the token limit, or needs approval.
description.zh: 通过 macOS 通知中心，在智能体回合完成、失败、达到 token 上限或需要审批时发送原生通知。

description.en: Posts a macOS notification titled with the session name when a session finishes a turn; clicking it returns to that session.
DSH plugin that sends macOS notifications when a turn completes and shows an unread dot while the app is unfocused.
description.zh: DSH 插件：回合完成时发送 macOS 通知，并在应用失焦时显示未读圆点。

description.en: macOS-only one-click restart plugin for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, so plugins that cannot hot reload load on the next launch.
description.zh: 仅限 macOS 的一键重启插件，用于重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用，让无法热重载的插件在下次启动时生效。

description.en: Adds a one-click restart entry for the macOS desktop DeepSeek Harness, via a Settings button and an agent tool, with remote-safe fallbacks.
description.zh: 为 macOS 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键重启：设置页按钮与 agent 工具两个入口，并带远程可用的强制退出兜底。

description.en: A local DSH Desktop profile bundle that makes Cmd+, open the built-in Settings dialog without patching the signed macOS app.
description.zh: 一个本地 DSH Desktop 配置包，让 Cmd+, 打开应用自带的设置对话框，且不修改已签名的 macOS 应用。

description.en: WYSIWYG Markdown notes editor in the DSH right sidebar with tabs, tables, code blocks, images and local file export.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏中的所见即所得 Markdown 笔记编辑器，支持标签页、表格、代码块、图片及本地文件导出。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for MaaEnd (MXU) adding agent tools, a dashboard panel, and startup-mute plus success-gated close-game hooks.
description.zh: 适用于 MaaEnd (MXU) 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供代理工具、仪表盘面板，以及启动静音和成功后关闭游戏的钩子。

description.en: Shows Magpie gateway quotas in the composer, including subscription windows, prepaid balances and relay stations.
description.zh: 在输入框里显示 Magpie 网关额度，包括订阅周期、预付余额和中转站。

description.en: Lets DSH generate, validate and install MaiBot plugins via 5 maibot_* tools plus a bundled skill.
description.zh: 让 DSH 通过 5 个 maibot_* 工具和随包 skill 自动生成、校验并安装麦麦（MaiBot）插件。

description.en: Emails a concise Chinese summary of every DSH answer and lets you reply by email to instruct, approve, or continue the chat.
description.zh: 把每轮回答压成一条中文摘要发到邮箱，并支持用邮件回信下达指令、批准操作或续接对话。

description.en: DSh plugin that emails you the answer text and a subject-line summary each time an agent finishes a turn, with zero deps and a config helper tool.
description.zh: DSH 插件：agent 每结束一轮回答就自动发通知邮件，正文为该轮回答，标题附带摘要；零依赖并自带配置工具。

description.en: Emails you via any SMTP account when dsh tasks finish or approvals stall, deleting the previous mail so your inbox keeps only one notice.
description.zh: 通过任意 SMTP 邮箱推送 dsh 任务完成与审批卡住提醒，每次发送前自动删除上一封，邮箱始终只留一封通知。

description.en: Opens sidebar files as tabs in the main workspace with live two-way text editing and synchronized Markdown preview.
description.zh: 把侧边栏文件以页签在主工作区打开，支持文本双向实时编辑与 Markdown 分屏预览同步。

description.en: Returns daily makeup plans based on input parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回每日妆容步骤计划，使用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Brings ManageAPI natively into DSH: daemon lifecycle hosting, site price comparison, smart routing decisions, probes, real usage writeback and budget circuit breaking.
description.zh: 把 ManageAPI 原生接入 DSH：守护进程托管、站点比价、智能决策、探针、真实用量回写与预算熔断。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions safely: optionally remove files they wrote, restore from a recycle bin, batch select, and block running sessions.
description.zh: 安全删除 DSH 会话：可选一并删除其写过的文件，删除进回收站可批量还原，正在运行的会话拒绝删除。

description.en: Read-only DSH ops plugin that summarizes server inventory, surfaces alerts, and checks a security baseline.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 运维插件：汇总服务器清单、呈现告警并检查安全基线。

description.en: A tool that accurately calculates Mandarin grade from parameters and returns detailed results, with pure Node implementation and no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数计算普通话等级并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: DSH skill hub for AI short-drama projects: lists local skills, finds GitHub open-source skills, installs, updates and rolls back with daily reminders.
description.zh: DSH 漫剧技能中枢：总览本机技能，从 GitHub 发现开源短剧技能，支持一键安装、更新与回滚，并每日提醒。

description.en: Adds a permission layer to DeepSeek Harness so every tool call opens an approval card before it runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加权限层，每次工具调用前都会弹出审批卡片等待确认。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar plugin showing Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures and results with local timezone support.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏插件，显示曼联 2026/27 赛季赛程和战绩，支持本地时区。

description.en: Marathon pace calculator that computes detailed results from user parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据用户参数计算马拉松配速及详细结果的纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: A pluggable March 7th (Honkai Star Rail) skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, replacing theme tokens and adding visuals.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web GUI提供可插拔的三月七（崩坏星穹铁道）皮肤，替换主题令牌并添加视觉元素。

description.en: Lets you mark assistant replies in a DSH conversation and keep them as marginal notes for later reference.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中标记助手回复，并将其保存为边注笔记，便于日后参考。

description.en: Turns any DSH conversation turn into a named task card you can jump back to or quote into the composer, with marks saved in your browser.
description.zh: 把任意一轮 DSH 对话标记成命名的任务卡，可一键跳回原处或把结论填入输入框，标记保存在本机浏览器。

description.en: Copy selected DSH conversation text as reconstructable Markdown source, preserving headings, lists, code fences, tables, links and formulas.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中选中对话内容并复制时，把选区还原为 Markdown 源码写入剪贴板，保留标题、列表、代码块、表格、链接和公式。

description.en: A dsh web UI plugin that enhances users' Markdown input experience when writing in the harness.
description.zh: 一个用于增强用户 Markdown 输入体验的 dsh Web UI 插件。

description.en: Lints Markdown files to check for style and formatting issues.
description.zh: 检查 Markdown 文件的样式和格式问题

description.en: Local Markdown note plugin for DSH desktop: read/edit notes saved as plain .md files with formulas, diagrams, drag-drop import and folder migration.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面端的本地 Markdown 笔记插件：笔记以普通 .md 文件保存，支持公式图表、拖拽导入与目录迁移。

description.en: Generates Markdown tables from JSON arrays or 2D arrays in pure Node.js.
description.zh: 将 JSON 数组或二维数组转换为 Markdown 表格，纯 Node.js 实现。

description.en: Converts Markdown to HTML using pure Node, with no network or external services.
description.zh: 使用纯 Node 将 Markdown 文本转换为 HTML，不依赖网络或任何外部服务

description.en: Generates a table of contents for Markdown documents using pure Node, with no network or external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 Markdown 文档生成目录，使用纯 Node 实现，无需网络或外部依赖。

description.en: Automatically writes short plain-Chinese notes for installed dshmarket plugins that are missing one.
description.zh: 为缺少简介的已安装 dshmarket 插件自动生成简短白话中文说明。

description.en: Adds a Stars sort option to the DSH Web plugin Discover tab, ordering market plugins by GitHub star count.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 插件「发现」页的排序菜单增加 Star 排序项，按 GitHub Star 数降序排列市场插件。

description.en: A live quote board for A-shares, HK/US stocks, FX, commodity futures and global indices with custom watchlists and auto refresh.
description.zh: 实时行情看板，覆盖A股、港股、美股、外汇、国内外商品期货与全球指数，支持自定义分组与自动刷新。

description.en: A DSH marketing skill pack porting 8 MIT-licensed marketing skills plus a router for copywriting and CRO work.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 营销技能包，移植了 8 个 MIT 许可的营销技能及一个路由技能，用于文案与转化率优化工作。

description.en: Pure Node tool returning clear mask frequency recommendations based on parameters, no network dependency.
description.zh: 纯 Node 工具，根据参数返回明确的面膜使用频率建议，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Master Duel deck-building panel with card lookup, AI-assisted effect search, related-card discovery and drag-and-drop deck building.
description.zh: Master Duel 组卡面板，支持卡片查询、AI 辅助效果检索、相关卡片发现与拖拽组卡。

description.en: Searches your local material-notes library and inserts a finished card (definition, key points, provenance) straight into the message box.
description.zh: 从本地材料笔记库中检索，并把一张含定义、要点和出处的成品卡直接插入输入框。

description.en: Material Icon Theme file & folder icons for DeepSeek Harness web GUI sidebar.
description.zh: Material Icon Theme file & folder icons for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI (dsh-better-sidebar) - 349 authentic SVGs, named folders with open variants, zero patching required

description.en: Material Design theme plugin for DSH Desktop, mapping 32 official Material Theme color palettes and 33 accent colors onto DSH client theme tokens.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供 Material Design 主题插件，将 32 套官方 Material Theme 调色板与 33 种强调色映射到 DSH 客户端主题令牌。

description.en: Hover or copy math formulas in DSH answers to get re-renderable TeX source for Obsidian, LaTeX, or plain TeX instead of Unicode glyphs.
description.zh: 悬停或复制 DSH 回答中的数学公式，输出可在 Obsidian / LaTeX 中重新渲染的 TeX 源码，而非 Unicode 字形。

description.en: Local stdio MCP server with 23 tools and a workflow skill for auditable math proofs via SymPy/Z3, never conflating proven, refuted, inconclusive.
description.zh: 本地 stdio MCP 服务器，含 23 个工具与工作流技能，借助 SymPy/Z3 做可审计数学证明，严格区分已证、已驳与不确定。

description.en: DSH plugin that validates every KaTeX math region with the client's own renderer so streamed answers never contain broken red math.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用客户端渲染器校验每个 KaTeX 数学区域，避免流式回答中出现红色报错的公式。

description.en: Graduate-level mathematics research workbench with SymPy/Lean computation, abstract algebra, category theory, logic, plots, and an interactive Live Stage.
description.zh: 面向研究生的数学研究工作台，集成 SymPy/Lean 计算、抽象代数、范畴论、逻辑、绘图与交互式 Live Stage。

description.en: Captures live MATLAB/DPABI/DPARSF/SPM QC window screenshots and command-window text directly into the DSH conversation.
description.zh: 将 MATLAB/DPABI/DPARSF/SPM 质量控制窗口的实时截图和命令行文本直接捕获到 DSH 对话中。

description.en: A phosphor-green CRT terminal skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with monospace type, scanlines, a prompt line and a right-side work log.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供的磷光绿 CRT 终端皮肤，含等宽字体、扫描线、提示行和右侧工作日志。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek balance route to the dsh-matrix-terminal prompt line, keeping the API key inside the host process.
description.zh: 为 dsh-matrix-terminal 提示行添加 DeepSeek 余额显示路由，API 密钥始终保留在宿主进程中。

description.en: Puts a DSH-powered AI companion inside Minecraft with her own inventory, crafting table and autonomous tree-chopping, mining and tool-making.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 AI 伙伴住进 Minecraft：自带背包与合成台，能自主砍树、下矿、攒材料做工具。

description.en: Manages local Minecraft Paper servers from a DSH sidebar panel plus agent tools: create, start/stop, install plugins, back up worlds.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏管理本机 Minecraft Paper 服务器：建服、启停、装插件、备份世界，并提供 Agent 工具。

description.en: Manage a Minecraft server from a QQ group chat: check TPS/players, start or stop the server, bind whitelists and relay game chat to QQ.
description.zh: 在 QQ 群内管理 Minecraft 服务器：查看 TPS 与在线玩家、启停服务器、绑定白名单，并把游戏聊天同步到群里。

description.en: Connects McDonald's China MCP to DSH, auto-registering remote ordering and coupon tools as native mcd tools with your own token.
description.zh: 将麦当劳中国 MCP 接入 DSH，用自备 Token 把远端下单、查券等工具自动注册为原生 mcd 工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows Mchose mouse battery level and connection mode (2.4G/USB) in the sidebar via WebHID.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过 WebHID 在侧边栏实时显示迈从鼠标电量与连接模式（2.4G/USB）。

description.en: Sidebar MCP center with a marketplace to install, scope and invoke MCP servers per workspace or session, plus a model-facing manager tool.
description.zh: 侧边栏 MCP 管理中心与市场，可按工作区/会话安装、限定作用域并调用 MCP 服务器，还提供面向模型的 mcp_manager 工具。

description.en: Manages MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness with status dots, OAuth login, JSON import/export and a diagnostics log.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理 MCP 服务器：状态指示、OAuth 登录、JSON 导入导出与诊断日志。

description.en: Control panel to toggle DSH MCP client servers live, inspect their context-token cost, and persist each choice.
description.zh: 用于实时开关 DSH MCP 客户端服务器、查看其上下文 token 开销并持久化选择的面板。

description.en: Statically validates a local MCP JSON config for command/URL presence, command availability, URL syntax, and args/env types.
description.zh: 静态校验本地 MCP JSON 配置，检查 command/url 是否存在、命令是否可用、URL 语法及 args/env 类型。

description.en: A dsh plugin that adds an MCP management panel to view, edit, and hot-reload MCP server configurations.
description.zh: dsh 插件，提供 MCP 标签页集中查看、编辑并热重载 MCP 服务器配置。

description.en: Adds an MCP servers panel to the DSH Web UI showing live status, configuration, methods, and a per-server on/off toggle.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 MCP 服务器面板，展示实时状态、配置、方法，并提供每个服务器的开关。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects JetBrains IDE built-in MCP servers as tools, giving agents diagnostics, builds, file reads, database, terminal and debugging.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将 JetBrains IDE 内置的 MCP 服务接入为工具，让智能体可用诊断、构建、读文件、数据库、终端与调试能力。

description.en: Adds a Settings page to list MCP servers and tools in DeepSeek Harness, with call counts and config shortcut.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中新增设置页，列出所有 MCP 服务器与工具，显示各工具调用次数并提供配置快捷入口。

description.en: Lazy-loads MCP tools into DeepSeek Harness with per-agent tool masking and description presets.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness懒加载MCP工具，支持按代理屏蔽工具和描述预设。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the DSH desktop settings page: add, edit, delete, enable/disable, with running status written to cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端设置页管理 MCP 服务器：新增、编辑、删除、启停并查看运行状态，直接读写 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Lightweight zero-dependency MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: list, enable/disable, add, edit, probe, import and export local MCP servers.
description.zh: 轻量级零依赖的 DeepSeek Harness MCP 服务管理器：查看、启停、增删、探测、导入导出本机 MCP 服务。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from a DSH left sidebar panel: add stdio or HTTP servers, test connections and toggle them without editing YAML.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧边栏面板管理 MCP 服务器：添加 stdio 或 HTTP 服务器、测试连接并开关，无需手改 YAML。

description.en: Manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agent tools from one DSH sidebar page.
description.zh: 通过一个 DSH 侧边栏页面，跨 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等代理工具统一管理代理技能和 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Adds two settings pages to DSH web UI for managing local skills (browse, import, delete, toggle) and MCP server configs with connection tests.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页设置中新增两个管理页面：管理本地技能（浏览、导入、删除、开关）和 MCP 服务器配置（增删改与连接测试）。

description.en: Aggregated MCP marketplace for DSH with 26 curated presets, official MCP Registry search and one-click install.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供聚合 MCP 市场，内置 26 个精选预设、官方 MCP Registry 与自定义源，支持搜索和一键安装。

description.en: Sidebar panel listing every MCP server with live connection state, tool count and config, plus in-place enable, disable and reconnect.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板列出所有 MCP 服务器及其实时连接状态、工具数量和配置，并支持就地启用、禁用与重连。

description.en: Dormant-by-default MCP client: one mcp_summon tool summons servers on demand, exposing their tools as native tools until you release them.
description.zh: 默认休眠的 MCP 客户端：通过单一 mcp_summon 工具按需召唤服务器，把其工具注册为原生工具，释放后即可收回。

description.en: Sync MCP configs from Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor Agent into DSH with dedupe and centralized management.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 Cursor Agent 同步 MCP 配置到 DSH，支持去重与集中管理。

description.en: Wires the Tavily remote MCP server into DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as a plugin bundle, giving agents Tavily web search.
description.zh: 将 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务器作为插件包接入 DeepSeek Harness（dsh），为智能体提供 Tavily 联网搜索。

description.en: Baselines every visible tool surface (including MCP) for DeepSeek Harness and fails loudly when tool schemas silently drift.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的所有可见工具（含 MCP）建立基线快照，工具面静默漂移时立即报错。

description.en: Adds a settings-page MCP manager that validates a pasted JSON snippet, writes servers into cordis.patch.yml and echoes the list.
description.zh: 在设置页提供 MCP 管理器，校验粘贴的 JSON 片段，将服务器写入 cordis.patch.yml 并回显列表。

description.en: Opens Markdown and image links from a DSH session in a right-side three-pane reader with TOC, live disk sync and inline image preview.
description.zh: 在浏览器右侧以三栏布局直接阅读会话中的 Markdown 与图片链接，支持目录、磁盘变更自动跟随与图片内联预览。

description.en: A safe markdown-to-React renderer for DSH client plugins using GitHub-subset markdown with no HTML injection.
description.zh: 用于DSH客户端插件的安全Markdown转React渲染器，支持GitHub风格的Markdown子集，无HTML注入风险。

description.en: Renders Markdown files as rich previews in the DSH better sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中将 Markdown 文件渲染为富文本预览。

description.en: A fat-loss meal planning tool that precisely computes meal combinations based on parameters and returns detailed results.
Generate images and videos inside DSH chat via OpenRouter, with per-conversation models, input images, and background video jobs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中通过 OpenRouter 生成图片和视频，支持按会话选择模型、输入图片与后台视频任务。

description.en: Renders images, videos, and audio inline in DSH chat messages, supporting 36 local media formats with Lightbox and native players.
description.zh: 在DSH聊天中内联显示图片、视频和音频，支持36种本地媒体格式，提供灯箱和原生播放器。

description.en: Plays mp4/mov/mkv/webm video and mp3/flac/wav audio inside the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览中播放 mp4/mov/mkv/webm 视频和 mp3/flac/wav 音频，通过带鉴权的 HTTP Range 路由流式传输。

description.en: Reads local images, audio and video inside DeepSeek Harness, even on text-only model routes, with drag-and-drop input and timecoded transcripts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中读取本地图片、音频和视频，即使文本专用模型路由也可用，支持拖拽输入与时间码转录。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar media tab to DSH for inline playback of local audio and video, with HTTP Range and ffmpeg transcoding for unsupported formats.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加右侧媒体标签页，支持本地音视频内联播放，原生格式用 HTTP Range，mkv/avi/flv/wmv 由 ffmpeg 转码。

description.en: Adds inline and tabbed video/audio playback to DeepSeek Harness with zero dependencies and no ffmpeg.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加内联和标签页式视频/音频播放，零依赖且无需 ffmpeg。

description.en: Plays audio and video previews in the DSH right Sidebar, streaming files over an authenticated HTTP Range route so remote browsers can play and seek large media without a native app.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏中预览音频和视频，通过带鉴权的 HTTP Range 路由流式传输文件，让远程浏览器无需本机应用即可播放和拖动大文件。

description.en: Pure Node.js tool to compute the median of numbers, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 工具，用于计算一组数字的中位数，无网络依赖。

description.en: Offline DSH desktop pet that shows per-turn token usage bubbles, daily stats, tasks, badges and sedentary/water reminders.
description.zh: 离线的 DSH 本地用量桌宠，逐轮显示 token 气泡，含每日统计、任务、勋章与久坐喝水提醒。

description.en: HL7 FHIR R4 conversion for de-identified medical records — DeepSeek Harness plugin
临床本体构建 · Clinical Ontology Builder for DeepSeek Harness (WIP): patient-level disease-course ontology with treatment decisions as nodes
A DSH skill that makes AI coding assistants build hospital desktop workbench UIs to one fixed medical design system.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 技能，让 AI 编码助手按统一的医院工作台设计规范生成医疗桌面界面。

description.en: Reads inpatient medical-record front-sheet exports and flags form-completeness gaps, arithmetic errors and coding contradictions.
description.zh: 读取住院病案首页导出数据,检查表单完整性、内部算术与编码逻辑矛盾并给出问题提示。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Feishu Project (Meego) to find projects, query work items, and check personal todos.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书项目（Meego）插件，用于查找项目、查询工作项和查看个人待办。

description.en: Computes meeting cost from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算会议成本并返回详细结果

description.en: Meeting preparation tool that precisely calculates results based on parameters, pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 会前准备工具，根据参数精确计算结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides structured meeting-speaking methods and suggestions by scenario. Pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 按场景提供结构化会议发言方法与建议，纯 Node 实现且无网络依赖。

description.en: Centralized settings hub for DSH plugins: gathers entries, custom groups, drag-drop, collect and fold modes.
description.zh: DSH 插件统一设置中心：集中入口、自定义分组、拖拽排序，支持收纳与折叠两种模式。

description.en: Takeout-ordering assistant that browses nearby JD/Miaosong merchants, picks food by taste and drives the order to the checkout page.
description.zh: 外卖点餐助手：自动浏览附近京东秒送/美团商家，按口味挑店并把餐点到结算页，付款留给你自己。

description.en: Gives a dsh AI agent persistent long-term memory by recalling and storing facts via a self-hosted Mem0 server.
description.zh: 为 dsh AI 智能体提供持久长期记忆，通过自建的 mem0-graph 服务器自动回忆并回写事实。

description.en: Runnable company org for DSH: departments, employee codes, dual M/P channels, DAG task dispatch, audit and cost attribution.
description.zh: 可运行的 DSH 公司组织：部门、员工编号、双 M/P 通道、DAG 任务派发、审计与成本归因。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that turns conversation selections into searchable memos and a reusable experience library with SQLite FTS5 Chinese search and jump-back-to-source.
description.zh: DSH 桌面插件：把对话划词保存为备忘录/经验库，支持 SQLite FTS5 中文全局检索并一键跳回原文。

description.en: A drop-in DSH memo fork with Markdown rendering, a notebook tab for long-form notes, long-text folding and touch-friendly drag.
description.zh: @adamcjm/dsh-memo 的直接替换分支：支持 Markdown 渲染、长篇笔记的笔记本标签页、长文本折叠与触摸友好拖拽。

description.en: Memorix memory panel for the DSH Web GUI: browse projects and memories, read details, and archive, restore, or create memories via the memorix CLI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Memorix 记忆面板：浏览所有项目与记忆、查看完整详情，并通过 memorix CLI 归档、恢复和创建记忆。

description.en: Session memory archive + prompt viewer for DeepSeek Harness: read back what compaction folded away, inspect the prompt each turn actually sent, and (optionally) install the bundled RP preset.
description.zh: 归档 DeepSeek Harness 会话记忆并查看提示词，可回读被压缩折叠掉的内容，检查每轮实际发送的提示词

description.en: Approval-free memory archiving for DSH: backs up memory files before overwrite, offers one-call supersede, and auto-prunes backups after 30 days.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供免审批的记忆归档：覆写前自动备份、一次调用完成取代、默认 30 天自动清理旧备份。

description.en: Bounded long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: two Markdown files with character budgets, merged when over limit and injected into the system prompt each session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供有字符上限的长期记忆：两个 Markdown 文件存储项目事实与用户偏好，超限需合并，每次会话注入系统提示。

description.en: Local long-term memory store for DSH with a visual panel to edit, organize, control injection per session, and sync to Git or WebDAV.
description.zh: DSH 本地长期记忆库面板：可视化编辑整理、逐会话控制是否注入、模型写入需确认，可选同步到 Git 或 WebDAV。

description.en: Five-layer persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with on-disk library, session bridge, Ebbinghaus recall and artifact index.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五层持久记忆：磁盘知识库、会话桥接、艾宾浩斯回忆与产物索引。

description.en: Aggregates all DSH session memories from session logs into an interactive 3D nebula graph with weighted topic links and two skins.
description.zh: 将全部 DSH 会话记忆聚合为可交互的 3D 星云图，带加权关联边并支持两种皮肤切换。

description.en: A console for DeepSeek Harness that shows what the model holds in context by task phase and lets you collapse, evict, and restore it with preview and undo.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的上下文记忆控制台：按任务阶段查看模型上下文，并可预览、撤销地收起、移出与恢复。

description.en: A Web UI console to browse, edit, search and health-check Markdown memory files, with a required-files list injected into the system prompt.
description.zh: 一个 Web UI 记忆控制台，可浏览、编辑、搜索和健康检查 Markdown 记忆文件，并将必需文件列表注入系统提示词。

description.en: A four-layer memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that scores, summarizes and archives conversation memories, then injects the relevant layers each turn.
description.zh: 一款为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的四层记忆插件，对对话内容打分、摘要与归档，并每轮按需注入相关记忆层。

description.en: Embedded read-only dashboard for viewing TencentDB Agent Memory's four-layer local memory.
description.zh: 嵌入式只读面板，用于查看腾讯云数据库 Agent Memory 的四层本地记忆内容。

description.en: Cross-session hot memory: injects MEMORY.md/USER.md into the prompt, plus memory checkup, dedupe, slimming and portable memory packs — local plaintext.
description.zh: 跨会话热记忆：每轮自动注入 MEMORY.md/USER.md，并提供记忆体检、去重瘦身与可移植记忆包，全程本地明文、零依赖。

description.en: DSH plugin that pulls long-term facts out of completed turns and appends them to a Markdown memory inbox.
description.zh: DSH 插件，从已完成的对话轮次中提取长期事实并追加到 Markdown 记忆收件箱。

description.en: File-backed memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that keeps agent memory in Markdown files with verifiable constraints.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Markdown 文件的记忆存储插件，并支持可验证约束。

description.en: A traceable, forgetful, sleep-consolidating long-term memory graph for AI agents, with source anchors, four-layer decay and nightly JSONL archiving.
description.zh: 给 AI agent 用的长期记忆图：原话锚点可回溯、四层衰减会遗忘、夜间自动归档噪声并强化重要记忆，JSONL 本地存储。

description.en: Local-only memory guard that monitors heap and session logs, intercepts oversized tool arguments, and vacuums sessions in dry-run mode.
description.zh: 本地内存守护插件，监控堆内存与会话日志，拦截超大工具参数，并支持演练模式清理会话。

description.en: Local-first, file-native long-term memory hub for DeepSeek Harness that persists memories as plain files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先、以文件为原生的长期记忆中心，将记忆持久化为纯文件。

description.en: Indexes an existing Markdown memory tree with SQLite FTS5 so DeepSeek Harness can run fast full-text memory searches.
description.zh: 使用 SQLite FTS5 为现有 Markdown 记忆库建立全文索引，让 DeepSeek Harness 能快速全文检索记忆。

description.en: Gives DSH bots a five-layer memory (persona, style rules, diary, session archive, unfinished promises) so they remember you after a reset.
description.zh: 为 DSH 机器人装上五层记忆（人设、规矩、日记、会话存档、未了结的约定），重置后依然记得你。

description.en: Tiered sleep-compaction backend that halves older context tiers and replaces shadowed history with one model-written ladder.
description.zh: 分层“睡眠”压缩后端：较新轮次占 T/3，越旧层级逐级减半，并用模型生成的阶梯摘要替换被遮蔽的历史。

description.en: Loads global and project MEMORY.md plus today's notes into context at session start.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在会话开始时确定性地注入两级记忆：全局与项目的 MEMORY.md 以及当天笔记。

description.en: Read-only enhancer for a markdown + git long-term memory library in DeepSeek Harness, with zero-dependency search, dashboard and /memory command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 markdown + git 长期记忆库提供只读增强：零依赖搜索、治理面板、/memory 命令与内置技能。

description.en: A 3D Dyson-sphere visualization that renders your long-term memories as stars, sessions as satellites and their relationships as light.
description.zh: 一个3D戴森球记忆可视化插件，将长期记忆呈现为星辰、会话为卫星、关系为光芒。

description.en: Provides background observational memory for DeepSeek Harness, condensing long sessions into observations and reflections.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台观察式记忆，将长会话压缩为观察与反思。

description.en: DSH 记忆本自动整理插件
Persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness adding durable searchable memory with tools, API routes, and admin UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可搜索的持久记忆，提供工具、API 路由和管理界面。

description.en: DSH profile bundle that injects persistent memory and rules into every turn and adds memory_* / rule_* tools with a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 记忆/规则插件包：每轮注入记忆与规则，提供 memory_* / rule_* 工具，并带有设置页面。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with project, global, and habit stores plus progressive disclosure.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层长期记忆，包含项目、全局与习惯存储，并支持渐进式披露。

description.en: Long-term semantic RAG memory for DeepSeek Harness, storing memories in a local vector store with on-demand search via any OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint or offline BM25.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期语义记忆：本地向量库存储，按需语义检索，支持任意 OpenAI 兼容嵌入端点或完全离线 BM25 模式。

description.en: Persistent memory plugin for dsh that injects a user profile and model notes into every new chat and searches past sessions with approval.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供持久记忆：每次新对话自动注入用户画像与模型笔记，并在审批后支持检索历史会话。

description.en: Gives agents passive recall of forgotten memories by keyword-matching notes, session history and memory cards into a small injected context block.
description.zh: 通过关键词匹配笔记、会话历史与记忆卡，将遗忘的记忆以小段候选片段被动注入上下文，让 Agent 重新想起旧事。

description.en: S3-backed cross-session memory with semantic recall and vector search for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 S3 的跨会话记忆，支持语义召回、向量检索以及带附件的结构化条目存储。

description.en: DSH preset-level memory shield that blocks other memory plugins from injecting context and tools, giving the session a clean context.
description.zh: DSH preset 级记忆遮蔽插件，挡住其他记忆插件注入的上下文与工具，让会话保持干净上下文。

description.en: Memory steward for dsh-memory-evolve: budget watchdog, due-date cleanup reminders, approval queue with tab, and backed-up execution over read-only memory files.
description.zh: 为 dsh-memory-evolve 补上记忆入库后的生命周期闭环：预算看门狗、整理到期提醒、待审批队列与审批 Tab、带备份执行，只读观测记忆文件。

description.en: Automatically bidirectional-syncs a git-backed memory folder with a peer machine every time DeepSeek Harness starts.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时，自动将 git 记忆目录与对端机器双向同步。

description.en: Adds global memory and user-level system prompts to DeepSeek Harness, storing cross-session facts with a per-turn index that costs no context.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加全局记忆和用户级系统提示，以不占用上下文的每轮索引存储跨会话事实。

description.en: Automatically triages AI agent memory: retains/archives entries, routes to project/overall buckets, merges duplicates, with LLM fallback.
description.zh: 自动分拣AI代理记忆：保留或归档条目，按项目与全局分桶，合并重复项，必要时回退到LLM处理。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that recalls earlier workspace history through the official session-query service.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过官方会话查询服务回溯此前的工作区历史。

description.en: Knowledge and memory vault for DSH with memory groups, auto-summarization, priorities, a base-prompt layer and AI curation.
description.zh: DSH 知识与记忆库：记忆分组自动摘要、会话记忆与知识库自由互转，支持优先级、基础提示词层与 AI 策展。

description.en: Knowledge base and todo manager for DSH; stores notes as local Markdown files in a user-selected Vault.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供知识库与待办管理，将笔记以本地 Markdown 文件存放到用户选定的 Vault 中。

description.en: DSH plugin that gives a visual interface to browse, edit, delete and disable your global DSH memory and per-project insights.
description.zh: DSH 插件：以可视化界面查看、编辑、删除、禁用全局记忆与各项目 insights 记忆。

description.en: Declutters the DSH UI by hiding duplicate menu items via 14 toggles, auto-filling model metadata, and adding refresh/restart with backup.
description.zh: 通过14个开关隐藏DSH界面中重复的菜单项，自动补全模型推理等级、上下文窗口与图片支持，并为应用菜单添加刷新/重启及备份还原。

description.en: Menu planning tool that returns family dinner hosting plans based on parameters. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回家庭晚餐待客菜单规划方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Menu pricing tool that calculates precise prices from parameters and returns detailed results, pure Node no network.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算菜单价格并返回详细结果的纯 Node 工具，不联网。

description.en: Plays a synthesized meow sound when the harness needs confirmation or input, hits an error, or finishes a turn, with a settings toggle.
description.zh: 当 harness 需要确认、需要输入、出错或完成一轮时播放合成喵声，并可在设置中开关。

description.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks inside DSH conversations as visual diagrams, with multiple install source options.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中把 Mermaid 代码块渲染成可视化图表，支持多种安装来源。

description.en: Renders settled mermaid fences in the dsh Web GUI chat as hardened SVG diagrams, with source toggle and a code-block fallback.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web GUI 聊天中将已完成的 mermaid 代码块渲染为加固的 SVG 图表，支持源码切换与代码块回退。

description.en: Web UI plugin for rendering Mermaid diagrams with zoom and fullscreen workspace
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 渲染 Mermaid 图表，支持缩放和全屏工作区。

description.en: Adds zoom, pan, reset, and PNG-copy controls to Mermaid diagrams in the DSH web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面中的 Mermaid 图表添加缩放、平移、重置和复制 PNG 控件。

description.en: LAN task mesh for DeepSeek Harness agents, coordinating DAG work through a shared-folder ledger with leases and crash recovery.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的局域网任务网格，通过共享文件夹账本协调 DAG 任务，支持租约与崩溃恢复。

description.en: Opens your desktop DSH instance in a phone browser — same instance, same sessions — over a mesh VPN, with no SSH needed.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器远程打开电脑上的同一个 DSH 实例与同一份会话，基于 mesh VPN，无需 SSH。

description.en: Message box for DeepSeek Harness that alerts on finished conversations and pending approvals, with jump-to-conversation and inline approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 消息框插件：当对话完成或出现待审批请求时发出通知，支持跳转到该对话并就地审批。

description.en: Adds an @ menu to cite a specific message from another conversation as a reference in the current chat.
description.zh: 通过 @ 菜单引用其他对话中某条具体消息，在当前对话中插入引用。

description.en: Auto-collapses user messages longer than 10 lines in DSH web chat, with expand/collapse button.
description.zh: 在DSH网页聊天中自动折叠超过10行的用户消息，可点击展开/收起。

description.en: Adds a pencil button to user messages in DSH Web to edit and resend a turn, archiving the old session while keeping an identical prompt-cache prefix.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 用户消息添加铅笔按钮，可编辑并重发某轮提问，旧会话被归档并保留逐字节相同前缀以保住 prompt 缓存。

description.en: Exports a single DSH assistant answer as PNG, PDF or HTML, preserving code highlighting, tables, formulas and inline images.
description.zh: 把 DSH 中某条助手回答导出为 PNG、PDF 或 HTML，完整保留代码高亮、表格、公式与内联图片。

description.en: Adds per-message session handoff in DeepSeek Harness, summarizing conversation and creating a fresh session with copied history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按消息进行会话交接，总结对话并创建带有复制历史的新会话。

description.en: DSH web sidebar plugin listing user instructions and smoothly scrolling to historical messages.
description.zh: DSH 网页侧栏插件，在会话页右侧列出用户指令，点击可平滑滚动定位到对应的历史消息。

description.en: Codex-style editing of already-sent messages: truncate later history and regenerate the reply in the same conversation.
description.zh: 以 Codex 风格编辑已发送消息：截断后续对话历史，并在同一会话中重新生成回复。

description.en: Shows a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and jumps back to the asking session when clicked.
description.zh: 当 DSH 向你提问时弹出 Windows 桌面通知卡片，点击卡片即可返回发起提问的会话。

description.en: Chat message in-place editor plugin for DeepSeek Harness: hover a past user message, edit it, truncate old replies and regenerate in same conversation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness聊天消息原地编辑插件：悬停编辑历史消息，截断旧回复并在同一会话中重新生成。

description.en: Dependency-free meta-analysis toolkit for effect-size conversion, fixed/random-effects pooling, heterogeneity stats, forest-plot data and reports.
description.zh: 无依赖的元分析工具包：效应量转换、固定/随机效应合并、异质性统计、森林图数据与报告生成。

description.en: A metronome practice plugin that generates instrument practice plans from parameters, pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 节拍练习插件：根据参数生成乐器练习计划，纯 Node 实现，可离线使用。

description.en: Adds a Windows 11 Mica material layer to the DSH web and desktop UI, sampling the real desktop wallpaper for authentic tinted-glass effects.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 Web 与桌面界面添加 Windows 11 云母（Mica）材质，采样真实桌面壁纸以呈现接近原生的着色玻璃效果。

description.en: Microwave time conversion tool that precisely calculates conversion results based on parameters.
description.zh: 微波炉时间换算工具，可根据参数精确计算换算结果

description.en: Provides microwave usage plans based on parameters, as a pure Node tool with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成微波炉使用方案，纯 Node 工具，无网络依赖。

description.en: Pure Node plugin that calculates the midpoint of given values without network dependency.
description.zh: 纯 Node 插件，用于计算给定数值的中点，不依赖网络。

description.en: Safely migrate a Codex environment between machines via /migrate-codex command and codex-migration skill.
description.zh: 通过 /migrate-codex 命令和 codex-migration 技能，在不同机器之间安全迁移 Codex 环境

description.en: Adds a one-click Mijia smart-home panel to the DSH sidebar, showing devices, properties and scenes via the local mijiaAPI CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏加入米家智能家居控制面板，通过本地 mijiaAPI CLI 直接查看和控制设备、属性与场景，无需模型往返。

description.en: Soft-enforcement guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness that nudges agents to produce milestone/phase conclusions on schedule.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供阶段性结论软强制守卫，提醒智能体按时产出里程碑总结。

description.en: Milk coffee recipe tool that returns brewing plans based on parameters; pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回奶咖冲煮方案，使用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Returns milk tea recipe plans based on input parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回奶茶配方方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: MIME type lookup plugin, pure Node, offline, no external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的 MIME 类型查询插件，离线运行，不依赖外部服务。

description.en: MiMo Code-style infinite context for DeepSeek Harness: threshold checkpoints, watermark writer, rebuild-context dump, session/project/global memory.
Adds a Xiaomi MiMo quota ring and a usage detail tab with billing type, usage stats, charges and predictions to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加小米 MiMo 额度环与用量详情页，展示计费类型、用量、收费与用量预测。

description.en: Xiaomi MiMo voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reads answers aloud, adds a click-to-talk composer mic, and supports voice cloning.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的小米 MiMo 语音插件，可自动朗读回答、点击说话输入，并支持声音克隆。
