description.en: A minimal Node.js plugin that computes the minimum value (最小值) with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 一个无网络依赖的最小 Node.js 插件，用于计算最小值。

description.en: AI 回答自动整理为可编辑思维导图，支持导出多种格式和图片。
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 思维导图插件，把 AI 回答自动整理成可编辑 Markdown 思维导图，支持导出文件和生成图片。

description.en: Converts screenshots and local images to text so DeepSeek can understand and answer questions about images via MindSee.
description.zh: 通过 MindSee 把截图和本地图片转成文字，让 DeepSeek 能根据图片内容回答问题。

description.en: MinerU-based PDF parsing plugin for DSH that extracts formulas, tables and text from PDFs into Markdown with smart chunking.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的 DSH PDF 解析插件，可将 PDF 中的公式、表格和文本提取为 Markdown，并支持智能分块。

description.en: Automatically calls a vision model to describe images for text-only LLMs in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 明眸 VisionBridge - 自研视觉桥：瞎子模型收图时自动调用视觉模型识别

description.en: Web mini-game collection for DeepSeek Harness: Tetris, Snake, 2048 and Minesweeper in one draggable frosted-glass floating window.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页小游戏合集：俄罗斯方块、贪吃蛇、2048、扫雷，集成在一个可拖动毛玻璃悬浮窗中。

description.en: Provides minimal decluttering and organization rules, returning simple plans based on parameters.
Local-only token usage stats for DeepSeek Harness: today's input/output totals, monthly cumulative, and a 12-week heatmap panel.
description.zh: 本地 DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计：今日输入/输出总量、本月累计与 12 周热力图面板。

description.en: Adds a quick-answer panel that makes a single model call over the last 10 turns, keeping the main conversation's context free of growth.
description.zh: 新增快速问答面板，仅发起一次模型调用并携带最近10轮对话，不创建会话，主对话上下文不增长。

description.en: Miniflux RSS integration for the DSH Web GUI with AI daily digest, picks, per-feed EPUB export and a sidebar settings panel.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 Miniflux RSS 集成，提供 AI 每日摘要、精选内容、按订阅源导出 EPUB 及侧边栏设置面板。

description.en: Minifies JS/CSS/HTML code using pure Node.js, offline with no external services.
description.zh: 使用纯 Node.js 离线压缩 JS、CSS 和 HTML 代码，无需外部服务。

description.en: Mini games box for the DSH Web right sidebar: Gomoku vs an easy/normal/hard AI, placement sounds and a victory celebration.
Adds a minimal DeepSeek account balance badge to the DSH Web sidebar with a peak/off-peak pricing indicator.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏添加极简的 DeepSeek 余额徽章,并显示高峰/低谷计费状态。

description.en: Minimal Windows launcher plugin for DeepSeek Harness that starts the DSH web UI via a desktop launcher.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的极简 Windows 启动器插件，通过桌面启动器启动 DSH 网页界面。

description.en: Adds VS Code-style minimap overlay for dsh file viewer, with text thumbnail and draggable viewport to navigate files.
description.zh: 为dsh文件查看器添加类似VS Code的缩略图导航，支持文本缩略图和可拖动视口。

description.en: DSH plugin that generates images from text via MiniMax image-01 API and saves PNGs to the workspace as an image-gen tool.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 文生图插件：调用 MiniMax image-01 接口按文本提示生成图片，并以 image-gen 工具将 PNG 保存到工作区。

description.en: Displays MiniMax Token Plan usage as a draggable bubble in DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中以可拖动的悬浮气泡显示 MiniMax Token Plan 的用量

description.en: Displays MiniMax Token Plan and Subscription usage in the DSH Settings panel via webServer routes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中通过 webServer 路由显示 MiniMax Token Plan 与订阅套餐的用量。

description.en: A desktop-only Budgie pet that floats above all windows, follows agent activity with a task bubble, and reacts to drags and flicks with gravity physics.
description.zh: 一个仅桌面显示的 Budgie 宠物，悬浮在所有窗口之上，用任务气泡展示智能体活动，并支持拖拽甩动的重力物理效果。

description.en: Provides a mist-blue frosted-glass theme with drifting cloud animations for DeepSeek Harness UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面提供雾蓝毛玻璃主题样式，含飘动云朵动画效果。

description.en: Adds web search to DeepSeek Harness by routing queries through Mistral's built-in web search tool with your own Mistral API key.
description.zh: 通过 Mistral 内置的网页搜索工具，使用你的 Mistral 密钥为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索能力。

description.en: Provides mite removal recommendations computed from user parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据用户输入的参数计算并给出除螨建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: DSH adapter for MLflow, Optuna and scikit-learn to track, tune, compare, predict and reproduce local CSV experiments.
description.zh: 用于 MLflow、Optuna 和 scikit-learn 的 DSH 适配器，可跟踪、调优、比较、预测并复现本地 CSV 实验。

description.en: Bridges MiniMax CLI into DSH for web search and image understanding with automatic fallback and setup guidance.
description.zh: 把 MiniMax CLI 接入 DSH，用于网页搜索和图像理解，并带自动回退和配置指引。

description.en: Adds cross-session long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness: rules and pitfalls are re-injected every turn, while other notes are recalled by keyword evidence and stored as editable plain JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆：规则与坑每轮注入，其余内容按关键词证据召回，数据存为可读可改的明文 JSON。

description.en: Provides cross-model continuity for DeepSeek Harness by keeping memory, skills, and rules in local files.
description.zh: 通过将记忆、技能和规则保存在本地文件中，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨模型连续性。

description.en: Lets phones on the same LAN reach DeepSeek Harness by QR code via a standalone HTTPS gateway with PIN auth and reverse proxy, leaving DSH Web on 127.0.0.1.
description.zh: 同一局域网内手机扫码即可通过独立 HTTPS 网关访问 DeepSeek Harness，含 PIN 认证与反向代理，DSH Web 仍留在 127.0.0.1。

description.en: Mobile-first patch for the DSH Web UI that adds a drawer, edge swipes, readable settings, and restores the right panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供移动端优先补丁：抽屉、边缘滑动、可读设置和可用的右侧面板。

description.en: Mobile adaptation plugin for DSH Web with glass UI, drawer navigation, and gesture support.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供移动端适配，含液态玻璃界面、可滑出抽屉、拖拽手势，并修复移动端输入框与页头样式，桌面端不受影响。

description.en: DSH 移动端热键模式插件：自动检测移动端，Ctrl+Enter 发送 / Enter 换行；设置面板开关。Mobile hotkey mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Mobile UX pack for dsh web: reading layout, aurora glass skin, file browser tab, abort self-healing.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供移动端体验：手机阅读布局、极光玻璃换肤并自动适配文字对比度、文件浏览器页签和 abort 自愈，零依赖。

description.en: Mirrors DSH desktop sessions to a phone browser over LAN: browse sessions, stream live output, send messages, stop turns, switch models.
description.zh: 在局域网内用手机浏览器镜像 DSH 桌面端会话：查看会话与实时输出、发消息、停止当前轮、切换模型与模式。

description.en: Mobile shell for DSH: a narrow-screen sidebar drawer with a title-bar button and global right-swipe, plus an installable PWA.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供一体化移动端外壳：窄屏侧边栏抽屉（标题前按钮 + 全局右滑唤出）以及可安装的 PWA。

description.en: Makes the DSH sidebar responsive: below 1024px it leaves the layout and opens as an overlay drawer from a header button.
description.zh: 让 DSH 侧边栏自适应窄屏：低于 1024px 时移出布局，并通过顶部按钮以浮层抽屉打开。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the sidebar into a compact top bar on mobile screens to save space.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在移动端将侧边栏变为紧凑顶栏，以节省屏幕空间。

description.en: Adds responsive mobile CSS to dsh's settings panel, converting it into a full-screen sheet with tab bar and close button on small screens.
description.zh: 为 dsh 设置面板添加响应式移动端 CSS，在小屏幕上将其变为带顶部标签栏和固定关闭按钮的全屏面板。

description.en: Zero-config plugin that polishes the DeepSeek Harness web UI for mobile screens with responsive layouts, touch targets, and safe-area handling.
description.zh: 零配置插件，优化 DeepSeek Harness 网页版在手机宽度下的体验：响应式抽屉布局、字号间距适配、≥44px 触控目标、按钮菜单表格交互与安全区适配，桌面宽度不受影响。

description.en: Pure Node implementation of the Möbius function for math computations.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的莫比乌斯函数，用于数学计算中求 μ(n)。

description.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness modals with draggable, resizable, maximizable windows and backdrop blur toggle.
description.zh: 增强 DeepSeek Harness 网页弹窗：标题栏可拖动、边缘可调整大小、可最大化，并可去除背景模糊，设置中提供开关。

description.en: Pure Node dsh plugin that registers tools for in-session use, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 的 dsh 插件，在会话中注册工具，不依赖网络。

description.en: Desktop plugin that switches between DeepSeek Harness and the official DeepSeek Chat, with optional persistent login on Windows.
description.zh: 桌面插件，可在 DeepSeek Harness 与官方 DeepSeek Chat 之间切换，并支持 Windows 上的可选持久登录。

description.en: Manage per-session tool profiles in DeepSeek Harness: pick which tools a session carries and edit profiles and their tool sets in a panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理按会话生效的工具配置：在面板中选择会话携带的工具，并编辑配置及其工具集。

description.en: Shows the remaining balance or allowance of the provider behind the current conversation model, with multi-vendor support.
description.zh: 显示当前对话模型所属服务商的余额或剩余额度，支持多家服务商。

description.en: Automatically switches to a vision model for image tasks, keeps default model otherwise, with zero extra tokens.
description.zh: 根据任务自动切换模型，图像任务用视觉模型，其余保持默认，零额外token。

description.en: Host plugin that keeps agents running through model rate limits (HTTP 429) by retrying in-loop, then sending an automatic 继续 follow-up.
description.zh: 宿主插件：遇到模型限流（HTTP 429）时在循环内重试，随后自动发送“继续”跟进消息，让智能体持续运行。

description.en: Probes each LLM with a minimal real request and reorders model-selector providers by how many of their models actually work.
description.zh: 用最小真实请求探测每个模型能否真正应答，并按可用模型数量重排模型选择器中的提供商。

description.en: Adds model ordering, three-tier token prices, and per-turn/session cost estimates to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加模型排序、三档 token 价格以及每轮/会话成本估算。

description.en: Replaces DSH's flat model list with a source-grouped, drill-down model picker while keeping search and reasoning-effort controls.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框的模型选择器改为按来源分块的卡片网格与两级下钻，并保留搜索与推理强度选择。

description.en: Fills in missing context windows, output caps, thinking levels, and thinking wire-format compat for custom DeepSeek Harness providers.
description.zh: 为自定义 DeepSeek Harness 供应商补全缺失的上下文窗口、输出上限、思考等级与线协议兼容信息。

description.en: Edits DSH model capability metadata: fetches the upstream /models list and reviews/saves context window, max output tokens and image support.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 模型能力元数据：拉取上游 /models 列表，审核并保存上下文窗口、最大输出 token 与图片支持。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns model picker into a provider→series→model cascading menu for chat input.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把聊天输入的模型选择器改为三级级联菜单，按供应商→系列→完整模型名逐级选择。

description.en: DSH web plugin that collapses the model picker by provider and adds a pinned quick bar for expand/collapse/filter/reset.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，按提供商折叠模型选择器，并提供固定快捷栏用于全部展开、全部折叠、聚焦当前、筛选和重置。

description.en: DSH plugin fixing reasoning-model compaction truncation, sandbox-escalation fail-close, and tool-description gaps for third-party models.
description.zh: DSH插件，修复推理模型压缩截断、沙盒升级失败关闭，及第三方模型工具描述缺失问题。

description.en: A DSH Web settings page plugin for managing model providers and catalogs, and configuring context capacity, text/image input types, and reasoning modes.
description.zh: DSH Web 模型设置页插件，用于管理提供方与模型目录，并配置上下文容量、文本/图片输入类型与思考能力。

description.en: Unified model control for DeepSeek Harness: pick models, manage channels and per-model capabilities, and get reasoning-effort advice in one settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 统一模型控制：在一个设置页中挑选模型、管理渠道与各模型能力，并获得推理强度建议。

description.en: Analyzes LLM model deployment across GPUs/NPUs: deployability, VRAM, TTFT, latency, throughput, power for 38 models×20 hardware.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的大模型选型与部署分析工具，针对 38 个模型与 20 种 GPU/NPU 组合，评估可部署性、显存、首字延迟、时延、吞吐与功耗。

description.en: Turns design and code claims into executable models (UML, state machines, data models, concurrency) and auto-reviews them, exporting to external checkers with report diffing.
description.zh: 把设计与代码中的断言抽成可执行模型（UML、状态机、数据模型、并发）并自动审查，可导出给外部检查器并对比报告差异。

description.en: Adds per-model reasoning-effort range and supported input modality settings to the dsh Models catalog.
description.zh: 为 dsh 模型目录中的每个模型单独设置思考强度范围与支持的输入模态。

description.en: Automatically reroutes requests to backup models when the primary hits rate limits, quota exhaustion, or 5xx timeouts, with a visual editor for fallback chains.
description.zh: 当主模型触发限流、额度耗尽或5xx超时时自动改派到备用模型，回合不中断，并提供可视化fallback链编排。

description.en: ZCode-style model picker for DeepSeek Harness with upward-opening provider submenus, reasoning-effort selection, and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ZCode 风格模型选择器，支持向上展开的提供商子菜单、推理强度选择与键盘导航。

description.en: Replaces the DSH composer model picker with a responsive card grid, delivered as a host-only plugin with no client bundle rebuild.
description.zh: 将 DSH 编辑器中的模型选择器替换为响应式卡片网格，纯宿主端插件，无需重新构建客户端包。

description.en: DSH tab that sends real raw HTTP requests to a selected provider/model and shows latency, TTFT, status, tokens and a 3-layer diagnostic chain.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话视图新增页签，手动选定供应商/协议/模型/路由后发送真实裸 HTTP 请求，一屏看耗时、TTFT、状态、token 与三层诊断链。

description.en: Routes model-API traffic per provider through HTTP proxies while all other requests stay direct.
description.zh: 按模型或提供方将模型 API 流量精准路由到代理，其余请求保持直连。

description.en: Two-level dropdown model picker for DeepSeek Harness that groups models by API channel, then by model family, with search.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的两级模型选择器：先按 API 通道、再按模型家族分组，支持搜索快速选模型。

description.en: Shows vendor logos next to models in the DeepSeek Harness model picker, served from a local loopback route and painted with a CSS mask.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器中显示厂商图标，图标由本地回环路由提供并用 CSS mask 绘制。

description.en: Enhances DSH's model menu by flagging models in use by other sessions and remembering each model's reasoning tier and group collapse state.
description.zh: 让 DSH 模型菜单显示被其他会话占用的模型，并记住每个模型的推理档位与分组折叠状态。

description.en: DSH plugin for managing LLM models and providers: browse available models, hide extras, track remaining credits/plan quota and real token usage by hour, day, week and month.
description.zh: DSH 模型与供应商管理插件：按供应商查看可用模型、屏蔽多余模型、追踪剩余积分与计划额度，并按小时/日/周/半月/月统计真实 token 消耗。

description.en: Matches custom-gateway models to the right metadata (context window, output cap, reasoning levels, vision) by bare model name, without touching your settings.
description.zh: 按裸模型名将自定义网关模型匹配到正确的元数据（上下文窗口、输出上限、推理等级、视觉），不改动你的设置。

description.en: Sidebar panel that shows ChatGPT subscription quotas, GLM/Kimi plans, and DeepSeek account or API balances.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板，显示 ChatGPT 订阅配额、GLM/Kimi 套餐以及 DeepSeek 账户/API 余额。

description.en: Display-only DSH plugin that maps enabled providers and models to readable names in the model selector and settings pages, without touching config or routing.
description.zh: 纯展示型 DSH 插件，为实际启用的 provider 与模型提供可读名称，美化模型选择器和设置页，不改配置与路由。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing a vertical model list and animated Three.js reasoning-effort control.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供垂直排列的模型列表，以及用 Three.js 粒子动画实现的推理强度调节控件。

description.en: Reorder the model list for any llm-pi-ai route from Settings > Models, with the composer model menu following the same order.
description.zh: 在“设置 > 模型”中重新排列任意 llm-pi-ai 路线的模型列表，输入框模型菜单同步采用该顺序。

description.en: Replaces DSH's native model picker with a provider-grouped, collapsible selector that inherits per-model thinking levels and vision labels.
description.zh: 用按渠道商分组、可折叠的模型选择器替换 DSH 原生选择器，并逐模型继承思考强度与视觉标签。

description.en: Searchable, provider-filterable model picker for DeepSeek Harness and DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 和 DSH Desktop 提供可搜索、可按服务商筛选的模型选择器。

description.en: Save and switch model and reasoning-effort presets in DeepSeek Harness with one click or keyboard shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中保存并切换模型与推理强度预设，可通过一键或快捷键完成切换。

description.en: Shows per-model API prices in USD or CNY, wallet balance, and live session spend for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 显示按模型计价的 API 价格（美元或人民币）、钱包余额和实时会话花费。

description.en: Persistent model-health monitoring for DSH Web UI that probes providers and tracks alive/dead status.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 持续探测各模型提供方并记录其存活或失效状态的常驻健康监控插件

description.en: DSH plugin replacing the default model selector with real brand logos for providers like DeepSeek, Zhipu, Xiaomi, and OpenCode Go to disambiguate same-name models.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用 DeepSeek、智谱、小米、OpenCode Go 等厂商的真实品牌标志替换默认模型选择器，以区分同名模型。

description.en: Displays which provider route a model comes from as a tag on the DSH composer model seat, distinguishing official DeepSeek from third-party providers.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框的模型位置上以标签显示模型来自哪条服务商路由，区分官方 DeepSeek 与第三方服务商。

description.en: Sidebar card and panel that show the current conversation model provider's account balance and quota usage.
description.zh: 侧边栏卡片与面板，显示当前对话所用模型提供商的账户余额与配额用量。

description.en: Adds a per-model reasoning-effort (thinking level) editor for custom pi-ai models in DSH's Models settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型设置页为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充逐模型推理强度（思考档位）编辑器。

description.en: DSH plugin that discovers new models from the pi-ai upstream catalog and safely applies them to your config with manual confirmation and rollback.
description.zh: DSH 插件：从 pi-ai 上游目录发现新模型，经人工确认后安全写入配置并支持回滚。

description.en: Rotates across grouped model sources with manual or auto ordering, preset reasoning effort, auto-failover when quota runs out, and shows which model answered.
description.zh: 按来源分组轮换模型，支持手动/自动排序、预设推理强度、额度耗尽自动切换，并显示实际应答的模型。

description.en: Suggests which model each native DSH subagent should use based on task type, without auto-authorizing or extra routing calls.
description.zh: 按任务类型为原生 DSH 子代理推荐合适的模型，不自动授权，也不额外调用路由模型。

description.en: Provides quick search and filtering across all configured model sources with one-click switch in chat.
description.zh: DSH 模型搜索插件 - 跨平台快速筛选模型

description.en: A plugin for searching models.
description.zh: 用于搜索模型的插件。

description.en: Adds a keyword search box to the DSH Web GUI model selector for real-time filtering.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 模型选择弹窗添加关键字搜索框，可实时筛选模型。

description.en: Replaces the model-selection input in DSH web with dual vendor/model buttons and inference-level control.
description.zh: 将 DSH web 输入框的模型选择控件改为供应商、模型两个按钮，两级联动并支持调节推理等级

description.en: Enhances DSH web UI model selection with quick slider, advanced picker, modality icons, and provider usage/balance.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面增强模型选择，提供低中高三档快捷滑块、高级选择器、模态图标以及服务商用量与余额显示。

description.en: Shows model usage and account balance (OpenCode Go plan usage, DeepSeek balance) in the DSH session header.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部显示模型用量与账户余额（OpenCode Go 套餐用量、DeepSeek 余额）。

description.en: Adds a Model Switchboard settings section to DSH where every provider and model can be toggled on or off, hiding disabled models from all pickers instantly.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页新增「模型开关」分区，可逐个或整组关闭 provider 与模型，被关闭的模型立即从所有模型选择器中消失。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds per-provider and per-model toggles to the composer model picker, hiding switched-off models without affecting routing or running sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在模型选择器中提供按提供商和按模型的开关，关闭后不再显示该模型，且不影响路由与正在运行的会话。

description.en: Auto-populates and keeps the llm-pi-ai provider model list up to date from your inference server, removing manual entry.
description.zh: 自动填充并持续更新 llm-pi-ai 提供商的模型列表，无需手动输入。

description.en: Monitors each provider's upstream /models endpoint, lists newly added models, and writes selected ones into DSH settings with backups.
description.zh: 监控各服务商上游 /models 端点，列出新增模型，勾选后写入 DSH 设置并自动备份。

description.en: Adds two-level tabs (provider + model family) to the DSH model picker, with family rules configurable on a settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 模型选择器增加两级 Tab（提供商 + 模型系列），族规则可在设置页配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for one-click model availability testing in the Models settings page, showing availability, TPS, first token, and elapsed time.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在模型设置页一键测试模型可用性，显示可用状态、TPS、首 token 和耗时。

description.en: DSH web plugin that shows model provider quota and local token usage in the sidebar, with a dual-column detail popup and usage stats.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：在侧栏底部常驻显示模型供应商额度与本机用量，点击打开双列详情弹窗查看统计。

description.en: Adds a status-area pill showing opencode-go subscription usage for 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows with reset countdowns.
description.zh: 在输入框下方状态区加一枚额度 pill，显示 opencode-go 订阅的 5 小时/本周/本月用量与重置倒计时。

description.en: Adds an input field to filter the models menu in DeepSeek Harness, with arrow up/down and Enter key support.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中添加一个输入框，用于过滤模型菜单，支持上下箭头和回车键。

description.en: Exports selected installed DSH plugins into a small .dshpack.zip with a one-click install command, and imports packs with preview then re-download.
description.zh: 将已勾选的 DSH 第三方插件导出为小体积 .dshpack.zip 并生成一键安装命令，导入时先预览再按 spec 重新下载安装。

description.en: Font size ladder (modular scale) calculator for generating typographic scales.
Embeds a Mol* 3D molecular structure viewer in the DSH sidebar with 22 agent tools to load, annotate and analyse PDB/mmCIF structures.
description.zh: 在DSH右侧边栏内嵌Mol* 3D分子结构查看器，提供22个agent工具用于加载、标注和分析PDB/mmCIF结构。

description.en: Interactive 3D molecular viewer for DeepSeek Harness that renders PDB, SDF, MOL, MOL2, XYZ and Gaussian files as ball-and-stick models.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式三维分子查看器，可将 PDB、SDF、MOL、MOL2、XYZ 和高斯文件渲染为球棍模型。

description.en: LaTeX workbench plugin for DSH with file tree, editing, compilation, logs, PDF preview, SyncTeX bidirectional lookup, plus 5 agent tools.
description.zh: 墨灵TeX 的 DSH 插件：右侧栏提供目录树、编辑、编译、日志、PDF 预览与 SyncTeX 双向定位，并附 5 个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Syncs your Maimemo vocabulary data into a local SQLite mirror and quizzes you daily with 20 generated multiple-choice questions via MCP.
description.zh: 把墨墨背单词账号的学习数据同步到本地 SQLite 镜像，通过 MCP 工具每天自动出 20 道选择题并生成学习日报。

description.en: A pure Node dsh plugin with no network dependencies, registering tools for in-session use.
description.zh: dsh-monaco 是纯 Node 编写的 dsh 插件，无网络依赖，用于注册会话内可用的工具。

description.en: Calculates display PPI from parameters and returns detailed results; pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 根据参数计算显示器PPI并返回详细结果，纯Node实现。

description.en: Monokai Pro theme bundle for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, offering six official filters plus syntax highlighting.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 Monokai Pro 主题插件，提供六种官方滤镜与语法高亮。

description.en: Provides a month-name tool, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现、无网络依赖的月份名称工具，用于获取月份名称。

description.en: A mood logging tool that returns clear suggestions based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 记录情绪日志，并根据参数返回明确建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A warm amber-on-midnight theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, selectable in Settings → Appearance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供暖琥珀配午夜蓝的配色主题，可在设置的外观选项中选用。

description.en: Morandi paper-and-ink colour theme bundle for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with light and dark palettes and original icons.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供莫兰迪“纸与墨”配色主题，含浅色与深色两套色板及原创图标。

description.en: Plugin for DSH Web GUI to edit, retry, advanced-retry, and delete chat messages without creating forks.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，可编辑、重试、高级重试和删除会话消息，且不创建分叉。

description.en: Adds session management actions to DeepSeek Harness web sidebar: copy ID, delete with confirmation, archive confirmation, recursive subagent deletion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页侧边栏的会话行菜单增加操作：复制会话 ID、确认后删除会话、确认归档，以及递归删除子代理会话。

description.en: Morse code encoder/decoder implemented in pure Node with no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的摩尔斯电码编解码插件，无需网络或外部服务即可完成编码与解码。

description.en: Calculates equal installment mortgage payments with detailed results and explanations.
description.zh: 计算等额本息房贷并附详细结果与说明

description.en: Equal principal mortgage calculator that computes detailed results from parameters with explanations.
description.zh: 等额本金房贷计算器，可根据参数计算详细结果并附说明。

description.en: Generates PNG images from a single chat sentence via the MOSS image API, with local dimension validation before sending.
description.zh: 在对话中用一句话调用 MOSS 图像接口生成 PNG 图片，并在本地先校验尺寸再发送。

description.en: Reference plugin for motion design principles, implemented in pure Node with no network or external services.
description.zh: 提供动效设计原则参考，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络或外部服务

description.en: Local memory management plugin for DeepSeek Harness, distilling conversation highlights into long-term local memory documents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的本地记忆管理插件，把对话要点提炼并存入本地长期记忆文档。

description.en: AI plugin for electric motor electromagnetic design: L0 millisecond-wide screening, then L1 RMxprt and L2 Motor-CAD verification.
description.zh: 面向电机电磁设计的 AI 插件：L0 毫秒级广筛，再用 L1 RMxprt 与 L2 Motor-CAD 逐级校核。

description.en: Calculates motor current from parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算电机电流并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，离线可用。

description.en: DSH plugin that routes AI-requested large-file downloads to the local Motrix engine with multi-threaded, resumable HTTP/FTP/magnet/torrent transfers.
description.zh: DSH 插件：让 AI 调用本机 Motrix 引擎下载大文件，支持多线程、断点续传以及 HTTP/FTP/磁力/.torrent。

description.en: Routes model download requests to the local Motrix (aria2) app, with a built-in direct HTTP fallback.
description.zh: 将模型下载请求转发到本地 Motrix (aria2) 应用，并内置直接 HTTP 下载作为回退。

description.en: DSH plugin that clears the themed background blur when the mouse is idle and restores a configurable blur on movement, clicks or scroll.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件：鼠标静止时背景模糊归零，移动、点击或滚动时恢复为可调百分比的模糊。

description.en: Makes the DSH settings dialog movable, resizable and maximizable, and remembers its window geometry.
description.zh: 让 DSH 设置对话框可移动、可缩放、可最大化，并自动记住窗口位置和尺寸。

description.en: Generates moving-day relocation plans based on input parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成搬家当天的搬迁计划，纯Node实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: 搬家入住清单工具：根据参数精确计算并返回明确的搬家入住建议。纯Node实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: 根据参数计算并返回搬家入住建议的纯 Node 工具，无网络依赖。

description.en: Generates moving/relocation plans based on parameters; pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数生成搬家或迁移计划，纯 Node.js 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds a menu action that moves a workspace to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar once — no pins, favorites, stars or automatic reordering.
description.zh: 在菜单中添加一个操作，可一次性把工作区移到 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏顶部，不含收藏、置顶或自动排序。

description.en: Generates moving/relocation plans based on input parameters; pure Node.js implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成搬家或搬迁计划，纯 Node.js 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Reads local .txt novels in the DSH web UI right sidebar, with a boss key to hide the reader or whole sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面右侧边栏中阅读本地 .txt 小说，并支持老板键一键隐藏阅读器或整个侧边栏。

description.en: A DSH Web corner widget that pretends to run a subagent while actually showing a live stock-market ticker.
description.zh: 一个装在 DSH 网页右上角的小组件，假装在跑 subagent，实际上是在看大盘行情。

description.en: Adds in-pane MP4, M4V and MOV video preview to the DSH right sidebar instead of an unsupported-file notice.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏内直接预览 MP4、M4V 和 MOV 视频，替代“无法预览该文件类型”的提示。

description.en: MATLAB GUI workbench plugin that drives DPABI/DPARSF resting-state fMRI preprocessing: dataset indexing, preflight checks, background runs, QC and head-motion analysis.
description.zh: 结合 MATLAB GUI 的插件，用于 DPABI/DPARSF 静息态 fMRI 预处理：数据索引、配置预检、后台运行、人工质检与头动分析。

description.en: Turns the DSH chat area and composer into a draggable, resizable floating panel that remembers its position and size.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话区与输入框变成可拖动、可缩放的浮窗，并自动记住位置与尺寸。

description.en: Adds a message index rail on the right edge of DeepSeek Harness conversations, with hover preview, click-to-jump, and auto-loading of older history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话右缘添加消息索引轨道，支持悬停预览、点击跳转和自动加载更早历史，纯插件实现且适配各皮肤。

description.en: Beautifies the DSH model selector with official vendor icons, pinned-first flat layout, and first-token-timeout automatic routing to fallback models.
description.zh: 为DSH模型选择器美化：官方厂商图标、四区平铺布局、置顶主力超时自动路由。

description.en: Multi-select clear/archive workspace conversations and bulk-delete empty workspaces in DSH sidebar with tri-state checkboxes and confirm dialogs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏多选清空（归档）工作区会话，并批量删除空工作区，支持三态复选框与确认对话框。

description.en: Returns space-utilization plans for small apartments based on input parameters.
Adds a split-view multi-session workspace for viewing and driving several DeepSeek Harness conversations side by side.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多会话分屏工作区，可并排查看和操作多个对话。

description.en: Adds a toggle between single-line and multi-line composer modes in DeepSeek Harness, with Cmd/Ctrl+E shortcut, tab hint, 4-line floor and Shift+Enter to send.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加单行/多行输入框切换，支持可编辑的 Cmd/Ctrl+E 快捷键、输入框提示标签、最少四行高度与 Shift+Enter 发送。

description.en: Registers an agent skill and tool to query model account balances across DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, Hunyuan and custom HTTP APIs.
description.zh: 向 Agent 注册技能与工具，用于查询 DeepSeek、豆包、千问、混元及自定义接口的账户余额。

description.en: Adds a multi-view layout that shows 2-4 real chat conversations side by side in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加多视图布局，可并排显示 2-4 个真实对话窗口。

description.en: Windows-only DSH plugin that controls the local MuMu Player 12 emulator through MuMuManager.exe and adb, exposing instance, app, and UI tools.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 的 DSH 插件，通过 MuMuManager.exe 和 adb 控制本地 MuMu 模拟器 12，提供实例、应用和界面操作工具。

description.en: Tool that returns strength training plans based on input parameters for muscle-building diet.
DSH music player card plugin that renders an interactive player inline in chat with NetEase/QQ backends, floating lyrics and multiple themes.
description.zh: DSH 音乐播放器卡片插件：在对话内渲染可交互播放器，支持网易云/QQ 双后端、悬浮歌词与多主题。

description.en: Provides music theory common knowledge and returns ethnic instrument learning plans based on parameters.
Music player plugin for Deepseek-Harness: plays local & NetEase music, unlocks VIP via cookie, AI-controllable.
description.zh: 为Deepseek-Harness开发的音乐播放插件。允许用户播放本地与网易云音乐。支持通过Cookie解锁VIP歌曲。提供了丰富全面的skill允许Agent控制音乐播放，自定义播放器CSS层叠样式表。允许队列结束后自动通知AI来挑选新的歌曲。

description.en: A local, offline music player for the workspace with playlists, an 18-band equalizer with foobar2000 presets, and DSD-to-PCM decoding.
description.zh: 工作区内的本地音乐播放器，支持播放列表、带 foobar2000 预设的 18 段均衡器，以及 DSD 软件解码为 PCM。

description.en: Alt+T panel searches and plays songs across NetEase, Kugou, QQ Music and Bilibili, plus an IIROSE room jukebox userscript.
description.zh: Alt+T 面板跨平台搜歌并在面板内播放（网易云/酷狗/QQ音乐/B站），另附 IIROSE 房间点歌用户脚本。

description.en: Adds a read-only 3D office view that visualizes a session's main agent, sub-agents, tool activity and reports.
description.zh: 以只读 3D 办公室场景可视化当前会话的主 Agent、子 Agent、工具活动与汇报过程。

description.en: Moves or renames sessions between old and new workspaces in Deepseek Harness.
description.zh: 用于 Deepseek Harness 的插件，可将会话从旧工作区移动或重命名到新工作区。

description.en: Local favorites plugin for DeepSeek Harness Desktop to save and switch sessions and URLs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 本地收藏夹插件，可收藏网址和会话，并支持用快捷键切换会话

description.en: Expose your home DSH to your phone via a web page and QR code, over LAN or a Cloudflare tunnel, with no app install.
description.zh: 通过网页和二维码把家里的 DSH 开放到手机，支持局域网直连或 Cloudflare 隧道，无需安装 App。

description.en: DSH plugin that QR-logs into Miyoushe and auto-checks in to HoYoverse games at a random time daily, with failure alerts.
description.zh: DSH 插件：扫码登录米游社，每天在随机时刻为已绑定的米哈游游戏自动签到，失败时给出提示。

description.en: Interactive MySQL learning assistant with 83 concepts, a clickable knowledge map, learning path, auto-graded SQL playground and AI Q&A.
description.zh: 交互式 MySQL 学习助手，包含 83 个知识点、可点击知识地图、学习路线、自动判题的 SQL 操练场和 AI 问答。

description.en: Provides personalized nail care plans based on parameters, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 基于参数提供个性化指甲护理方案，纯 Node 实现且无网络依赖。

description.en: A Node-based plugin that returns nail care plans based on nail shape parameters, with no network dependencies.
Returns nail care plans based on input parameters. Pure Node implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回美甲护理方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Tool that returns nail trimming cycle suggestions based on input parameters, pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回剪指甲周期建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Nanny calendar board for DeepSeek Harness that tracks onboarding, leave and salary payouts on a monthly calendar.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的保姆日历看板，在月历上跟踪入职、请假与薪资发放。

description.en: Generates crypto-safe random Nano IDs with a pure Node implementation, no network/external services.
description.zh: 用 Node 实现生成加密安全的随机 Nano ID，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.en: DSH plugin bundling NapCat so an AI bot chats with real people on QQ private and group chats, with image recognition, TTS voice, web search and proactive messaging.
description.zh: DSH 插件，内置 NapCat，让 AI 通过 QQ 私聊/群聊与真人对话，支持识图、智能语音、联网搜索与随缘主动发言。

description.en: Watchdog plugin that auto-launches and keeps NapCat (QQ protocol client) alive while DSH runs, restarting it when the port drops or scanning stalls.
description.zh: 看门狗插件：DSH 运行时自动拉起并守护 NapCat（QQ 协议端），端口不通、卡扫码或掉线时自动重启恢复。

description.en: Provides native Codex OAuth login and model access for DeepSeek Harness as a single installable plugin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Codex OAuth 登录和模型访问，以单个插件安装。

description.en: Adds native macOS vibrancy and live behind-window blur to DSH Desktop, giving chat surfaces a transparent glass look.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 添加原生 macOS 玻璃透明效果与实时背景模糊，让聊天界面呈现透明的玻璃质感。

description.en: Sends native desktop notification banners for DSH approval, question, completion, error and sign-in events, with a customisable synthesised chime.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的审批、提问、完成、错误和登录事件发送原生桌面通知横幅，并支持可自定义的合成提示音。

description.en: Lets a DeepSeek Harness agent hand work to locally installed Claude Code, Codex and ACP agents as follow-up threads.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体把任务交给本机已安装的 Claude Code、Codex 和 ACP 智能体，并以可续跟的线程形式管理。

description.en: Adds global back/forward navigation history across sessions and whole-page panels, with a configurable bottom strip and browser-style shortcuts.
description.zh: 为会话和整页面板提供全局前进/后退导航历史，配有可配置底部栏和浏览器式快捷键。

description.en: Adds a floating button and settings page with 22 toggles to show or hide DSH interface regions such as sidebar, chat panel and input area.
description.zh: 通过右侧浮动按钮和设置页提供 22 个开关，可逐项显示或隐藏 DSH 的侧边栏、会话面板、输入区等界面区域。

description.en: New Concept English Book 1 study panel with one-page lessons, SRS flashcards and a mistake notebook.
description.zh: 新概念英语第一册学习面板：单页课程、间隔重复（SRS）记忆卡片与错题本。

description.en: ND filter shutter speed calculator that returns precise detailed exposure results.
description.zh: ND滤镜快门速度计算器，输入滤镜档位与基础快门，返回精确详细的曝光结果。

description.en: Converts NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) data using a pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 使用纯 Node 实现转换 NDJSON（换行分隔 JSON）数据，无网络依赖。

description.en: Mines local DeepSeek Harness session logs offline to rank repeated tool failures and user corrections into redacted product briefs.
description.zh: 离线挖掘本地 DeepSeek Harness 会话日志，按稳定性排序重复的工具故障与用户纠正，生成脱敏产品简报。

description.en: Sends native macOS notifications for DSH approvals, questions and sign-ins, letting you click a banner to jump back to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的审批、提问与登录发送原生 macOS 通知，点击横幅即可跳回 DSH。

description.en: 谈判策略工具，按场景返回结构化谈判方法与建议
Returns complete neon element data and supports single-field queries for workflows.
Control how the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI is reachable: local only, Tailscale, all local networks, or off.
description.zh: 控制 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的可达方式：仅本地、Tailscale、所有本地网络或关闭。

description.en: Live sidebar dashboard showing local IP/MAC, traffic rates, session counts and latency curves, refreshed every 3 seconds.
description.zh: 侧边栏实时网络巡检看板，展示本机 IP/MAC、流量速率、会话数与延迟曲线，每 3 秒自动刷新。

description.en: Read-only plugin that shows which local apps connect to which domains and hosts, via a sidebar panel and an Agent tool.
description.zh: 只读插件，展示本机各软件正在连接哪些域名与对端主机，含侧栏面板与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Flips DeepSeek Harness's outbound traffic between a local Clash Verge proxy and direct/LAN at runtime via a status pill, agent tool and /net command.
description.zh: 通过状态胶囊、agent 工具和 /net 命令，在运行时切换 DeepSeek Harness 的出站流量（本地 Clash Verge 代理或直连/局域网）。

description.en: Generates long-form drafts with predefined structure for blogs, press releases, product and job content.
description.zh: Long-form drafts with the structure already decided. Blog posts, press releases, product and jo

description.en: A DSH web-based Netease Cloud Music player plugin with mini player, QR login, and AI control.
description.zh: DSH 网页版网易云音乐播放器插件，提供顶部条迷你播放器与展开面板，支持扫码登录并用 AI 对话控制播放

description.en: Egress guard for dsh that allows only public addresses, re-checks every redirect hop, and caps size while streaming to prevent SSRF.
description.zh: dsh 出网护栏：仅允许公网地址，逐跳复查重定向，流式读取时限制大小，防止 SSRF。

description.en: Windows-native per-process QoS guard that throttles or cuts bandwidth for chosen apps while you game, restoring automatically on exit.
description.zh: 基于 Windows 原生按进程 QoS 的限速插件：玩游戏时把指定软件带宽压到设定值或近乎断网，关闭后自动恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness preset for Netx network operations: netx REST tools, agent skills, and critical alarm push to sessions/IM.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Netx 网络运维代理预设：提供 netx REST 工具、技能，并支持关键告警推送。

description.en: A pure Node tool that returns clear sterilization timing recommendations based on input parameters.
description.zh: 一个纯 Node 工具，根据输入参数返回明确的绝育时机建议。

description.en: Generates moving/relocation plans based on input parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成搬家或搬迁计划，纯 Node 实现，不联网

description.en: Adds a /new command to the DSH Web input that starts and opens a new session in the current or most recent workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加 /new 命令，用于在当前或最近使用的工作区中新建并打开会话。

description.en: One-click creation of an isolated, timestamped workdir as a DSH workspace with a clean session and no pollution between outputs.
description.zh: 一键创建带时间戳的独立工作目录作为 DSH 工作区，并开启干净会话，产物互不污染。

description.en: Generates a New Year's Eve dinner menu and family holiday preparation plan based on user parameters.
Generates family New Year shopping and preparation plans based on input parameters, pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成家庭年货采购与过年准备计划，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Provides newborn care advice based on parameters, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数提供新生儿护理建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds ghost-text next-prompt suggestions to the DSH composer; press Tab to accept, with no automatic sending.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中以幽灵文本形式推荐下一句提示词，按 Tab 采纳，不会自动发送。

description.en: Predicts your next chat message as grey ghost text in an empty input box; press Tab to fill it in or Esc to dismiss.
description.zh: 在空输入框中以灰字预测你的下一句对话，按 Tab 填入、Esc 忽略。

description.en: Returns the next prime number after a given number, implemented in pure Node.js with no dependencies.
description.zh: 返回给定数字之后的下一个素数，纯 Node.js 实现且无依赖。

description.en: Prefills a gray next-sentence suggestion after each reply (Tab/→ accepts) and fills your last sent message with ↑ when the input is empty.
description.zh: 回答结束后在输入框预填灰色下一句建议（Tab/→采纳），输入框为空时按 ↑ 填入上次发送的内容。

description.en: Suggests your next message as ghost text in the chat input after each answer, inserted with Tab via host-side LLM generation.
description.zh: 每次回答后，在消息输入框中以幽灵文本形式建议下一条消息，按 Tab 插入，由宿主侧 LLM 生成。

description.en: Shows an AI-generated next-prompt suggestion as a dark watermark in the empty input box after each assistant turn; press Tab to fill, Esc to dismiss.
description.zh: 在每轮助手回复后，如果输入框为空，就用当前模型生成一条下一条用户消息的推荐，以暗色水印显示在输入框内，按 Tab 填入，按 Esc 关闭。

description.en: Adds 3 clickable follow-up suggestions after each completed answer and fills the input box when one is clicked.
description.zh: 每次回答完成后展示3条可点击的后续建议，点击后自动填入输入框。

description.en: Adds up to four clickable next-step suggestion buttons under each reply, scoped to that turn and theme-aware.
description.zh: 在每轮回复下方显示最多四个可点击的下一步建议按钮，按轮次独立、自动跟随主题配色。

description.en: Generates state-aware next-instruction drafts for DeepSeek DSH so AI-assisted work keeps moving.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek DSH 生成感知状态的下一步指令草稿，让 AI 辅助工作自然推进。

description.en: Sends macOS notification-center banners for DSH task events, with click-to-open and auto-clear when returning.
description.zh: macOS 通知插件，在异常终止、需要操作、正常完成三类场景弹出通知中心横幅，点击可直达指定应用。

description.en: AI-led long-form novel workbench plugin with cockpit, outline, pipeline, production, review and world-library pages.
description.zh: AI 主写、人类当导演的长篇小说工作台插件，含驾驶舱、大纲、流水线、生产台、验收台与世界库。

description.en: Manages local NInfer inference models and editable server profiles inside DSH, including a Qwen3.8 27B 262k reference config.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内管理本地 NInfer 推理模型和可编辑的服务器配置，并附带 Qwen3.8 27B 262k 参考配置。

description.en: Provides pickling plans based on parameters, ensuring nitrite safety; pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 根据参数生成腌渍方案，确保亚硝酸盐安全；纯 Node 实现，可离线运行。

description.en: Provides nitrogen element facts such as atomic number, mass, and electron configuration.
description.zh: 提供氮元素事实

description.en: Adds a hand-drawn card under the input box that live-tracks today's and monthly earnings, progress and clock-out countdown.
description.zh: 在输入框下方挂一张手帐风格卡片，实时显示今日与本月牛马费、进度条和下班倒计时。

description.en: Hides the DeepSeek account model group from the DSH model picker by disabling the built-in llm-deepseek-account route.
description.zh: 通过禁用内置 llm-deepseek-account 路由，在 DSH 模型选择器中隐藏 DeepSeek 账户模型分组。

description.en: Enter 只换行，只有点发送按钮才发送
A draggable DeepSeek Harness cat desktop pet that reminds you to stand up and drink water with four-state looping animation.
description.zh: 可拖动的 DeepSeek Harness 猫咪桌宠，通过四态循环动画提醒久坐站立与喝水。

description.en: DSH plugin that detects repetitive or self-referential reasoning in the token stream and truncates it before it re-enters context.
description.zh: DSH 插件，检测 token 流中的重复或自我指涉推理，并在写回上下文前截断该片段。

description.en: Generates no-main-light home lighting design plans based on parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数生成无主灯家居照明设计方案，纯 Node 实现，无需联网。

description.en: A minimal DSH client plugin that injects one CSS rule to hide the "preview" badge next to the home page logo, restoring it on uninstall.
description.zh: 一个极简的 DSH 客户端插件，注入一条 CSS 规则隐藏主页 Logo 旁的“预览版”小标，卸载即恢复原样。

description.en: Zero-token cron scheduler for DeepSeek Harness that runs host-side scripts on schedule with no model calls, plus wake-on-change.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的零令牌定时调度插件：在宿主侧按 cron 运行脚本，不调用模型，支持变更唤醒。

description.en: Adds a conversation node jump panel to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI for quick navigation between dialogue nodes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加对话节点跳转面板，可在会话内快速跳转到各个对话节点。

description.en: Computes non-compete compensation based on parameters, returning detailed results and legal citations.
Provides noodle preparation plans with timing based on input parameters.
A joke DeepSeek Harness plugin that fakes task runs with SIMULATED traces and zero-byte artifacts, never calling real models.
description.zh: 一个娱乐性质的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，只生成 SIMULATED 轨迹和 0 字节产物来假装执行任务，不调用真实模型。

description.en: A native macOS companion that lives in the MacBook notch and shows live DSH agent progress, current session and step, without opening a window.
description.zh: 一个驻留在 MacBook 刘海中的原生 macOS 伙伴，无需打开窗口即可显示 DSH 智能体实时进度、当前会话与步骤。

description.en: AI-powered sticky notes for DSH: capture by voice or text, auto title and classify with AI, and send notes into a chat.
description.zh: AI 驱动的 DSH 即时贴便签：语音或文字秒记，AI 自动起标题归类补要点，一键投递到对话。

description.en: A persistent cross-day notebook plugin for DSH that lets you append, list, search, and delete notes stored in notes.md.
description.zh: 一个用于 DSH 的持久化跨天笔记本插件，可追加、列出、搜索和删除保存在 notes.md 中的笔记。

description.en: Renders each workspace's .agents/notes engineering decision notes as a native DSH sidebar board with KPIs, timeline, pitfalls and decision list.
description.zh: 把各工作区 .agents/notes 中的工程决策笔记渲染成 DSH 侧边栏原生看板，含 KPI、时间线、避坑智库与决策清单。

description.en: Sticky-notes wall for DSH with rich text, images, freehand ink, alarms and one-click or scheduled delivery of notes into any session.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的便签墙，支持富文本、图片、手绘、定时提醒，并可一键或定时把便签投递到任意会话。

description.en: Nothing Phone style skin for DeepSeek Harness with dot-matrix background and monochrome + signal red theme.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Nothing Phone 风格皮肤，包含点阵背景、Space Grotesk/Mono 字体、单色加信号红配色，并可按功能在设置中开关。

description.en: Adds user- and project-scoped lifecycle command hooks to DeepSeek Harness with explicit authorization.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加带显式授权的用户级和项目级生命周期命令钩子。

description.en: Independent DSH host plugin that delivers DSH alerts as native macOS notifications via a Swift helper, without modifying DSH source or IPC.
description.zh: 独立的 DSH 宿主插件，通过 Swift 辅助程序将 DSH 提醒以原生 macOS 通知形式推送，无需修改 DSH 源码或内部 IPC。

description.en: DSH notification display layer plugin providing a global toast stack and session activation via bridge events, with fallback.
description.zh: DSH 通知显示层插件：全局 toast 栈，订阅桌面壳 __dshExo 桥事件，点击经官方 sessions runtime 程序化激活会话；无壳时降级订阅 sessions store 自绘。可插拔通知显示层的 web 侧。

description.en: A reminder bubble panel beside the input box where plugins/AI push reminders, with chat-style stacking, drag-resize, AI summarization, and restart.
description.zh: 输入框旁的提醒泡泡面板，插件或AI可推送提醒，支持聊天堆叠、拖拽调大小、AI总结和一键重启。

description.en: DSH Web GUI notification plugin that alerts on approvals, model questions, turn completion, background task end and session errors, with a full settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 通知插件：需要审批、模型提问、一轮指令结束、后台任务结束或会话出错时提醒，并带完整设置页。

description.en: Sends system notifications, sounds, and tab-title alerts when the model needs your input or finishes a reply while you're away.
description.zh: 当模型需要你操作或回复完成时,用系统通知、提示音和标签页标题提醒你。

description.en: Sends Windows 11 toast notifications for DSH approvals, questions, errors, finished turns, and stalled work.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的审批、提问、错误、已完成回合和停滞工作发送 Windows 11 Toast 通知。

description.en: Sends system-level desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness turn completion, workflow end, and approval alerts on macOS and Linux.
description.zh: 在 macOS 和 Linux 上通过系统桌面通知发送 DeepSeek Harness 轮次完成、工作流结束提示以及审批弹窗提醒。

description.en: Arabic-first actionable Windows toast notifications for dsh that approve permissions, continue, or stop the agent without opening the app.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的阿拉伯语优先可操作 Windows 通知，无需打开应用即可批准权限、继续或停止智能体。

description.en: Plays distinct chimes for turn finished, interrupted, error, agent question, approval and failed jobs, with optional Windows Toast notices.
description.zh: 回合完成、中断、出错、Agent 提问、等待审批或任务失败时播放不同提示音，可选弹出 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Replaces DSH Desktop's built-in notifications with native toasts showing the live conversation title and a short distillation of each turn.
description.zh: 用原生通知替换 DSH Desktop 内置通知：标题为实时会话标题，正文为每轮产出的简短浓缩。

description.en: Portuguese-language system notifications for DSH sessions: turn finished, error or interrupted, failed tool, goal done or blocked, workflow done, and pending approval.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供葡萄牙语系统通知：回合完成、出错或中断、工具失败、目标完成或受阻、工作流完成，以及等待批准的操作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness notification center that shows interactive Windows question and approval cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通知中心，提供可交互的 Windows 提问与审批卡片。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 小说工坊插件：并行候选、硬门闸门、连写台账
Floating ball in the DSH UI that opens your local book list and launches your own reader, auto-positioning its window.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面放一个悬浮球，打开本地书单并用你自己的阅读器打开，阅读器窗口自动归位。

description.en: DSH小说插件
Fetches the latest version of npm packages in real time from the npm registry.
description.zh: 从 npm registry 实时获取 npm 包的最新版本号

description.en: Reviews one NSFC proposal against a versioned rule pack, checking roster terms, document properties, length limits and required form items.
description.zh: 依据版本化规则包审查国自然申请书，检查名单术语、文档属性、篇幅限制与必备表单条目。

description.en: Computes the nth prime number, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 计算第 N 个素数，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that computes nth roots, implemented in pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的轻量插件，用于计算任意数的 N 次方根，不依赖网络。

description.en: Formats numbers with thousands separators, decimal places, currency symbols, and percentages.
description.zh: @{name=dsh-number-format; version=0.1.0; description=数字格式化：千分位、小数位、货币符号、百分比; type=module; main=lib/index.js; exports=; files=System.Object[]; dsh=; keywords=System.Object[]; author=istone <ad571@qq.co

description.en: Converts Arabic numerals to Chinese uppercase words for financial/invoice scenarios, supporting decimals and negatives.
description.zh: @{name=dsh-number-words; version=0.1.0; description=数字转大写：阿拉伯数字转中文大写（金额/票据场景），支持小数与负数（Number to Chinese uppercase words tool for DSH）; type=module; main=lib/index.js; exports=; files=System.Object[];

description.en: Checks a machine-readable inpatient export for nursing record timeliness, sign-off and assessment form completeness against cited clauses.
description.zh: 读取单次住院护理记录导出，按引用条款核查护理记录的及时性、签名与评估表完整性。

description.en: Nonviolent communication tool that returns structured advice for given scenarios; pure Node, offline, for dsh sessions.
description.zh: 非暴力沟通工具，针对给定情境返回结构化建议；纯 Node 实现，离线可用，适用于 dsh 会话。

description.en: Nyanko-sensei desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness Web: a round calico cat that idles, naps, wanders, reacts to clicks and follows agent activity.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的娘口三三桌宠插件：圆滚滚的三花猫会发呆、打盹、闲逛、点击回应语音并跟随智能体动态。

description.en: OAuth 2.1 client plugin that authorises DSH against remote MCP servers, stores and refreshes tokens, and registers their tools locally.
description.zh: OAuth 2.1 客户端插件，为 DSH 授权远程 MCP 服务器、保存并刷新令牌，并把远端工具注册为宿主工具。

description.en: Generates MongoDB-style ObjectIds with a pure Node implementation, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现生成 MongoDB 风格 ObjectId，不依赖网络

description.en: Tool that returns structured methods and suggestions for handling objections by scenario.
DeepSeek Harness settings-page plugin that starts and health-checks the Obscura MCP server and keeps your profile's mcp-obscura entry in sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 设置页插件，负责启动并健康检查 Obscura MCP 服务器，并同步配置中的 mcp-obscura 条目。

description.en: Indexes local Obsidian vault into SQLite for full-text search to give AI agent searchable memory.
description.zh: 将本地 Obsidian 库索引到 SQLite，提供全文检索，为 AI 智能体提供可搜索的记忆。

description.en: Plain-click Obsidian vault file references in the DSH Web GUI to open them in the Obsidian app; Cmd/Ctrl-click keeps the in-app preview.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中单击 Obsidian 库文件引用即可用 Obsidian 应用打开，Cmd/Ctrl 单击则保留应用内预览。

description.en: Turns an Obsidian folder into a light-colored sticky-note wall with quick capture, AI comments and file opening, keeping notes as local Markdown.
description.zh: 把 Obsidian 文件夹变成淡色便签墙，支持快速记录、AI 评论与开档，笔记仍保存为本地 Markdown。

description.en: Obsidian-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with a sidebar panel, BM25 search, token-budgeted context and optional GitHub sync.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Obsidian 的长期记忆：侧边栏面板、BM25 搜索、按 token 预算裁剪上下文，并可选 GitHub 同步。

description.en: Agent skills bundle for Obsidian that lets the assistant read, write and organize Markdown notes, Bases and JSON canvases.
description.zh: 为 Obsidian 提供的智能体技能包，可读取、写入和整理 Markdown 笔记、Bases 及 JSON 画布。

description.en: Pauses DeepSeek Harness desktop rendering and animations when the window is fully occluded, then resumes instantly when visible.
description.zh: 当 DSH 桌面窗口被完全遮挡时暂停动画与渲染，重新可见后立即恢复，单核开销约 0.12%。

description.en: Self-healing guard that automatically reapplies OCR plugin seams and fixes after dsh upgrades.
description.zh: 在 dsh 升级清除 OCR 适配器缝合与插件修复后，自动重新应用这些改动，属于 dsh-ocr 的自愈守护。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin that registers an octal conversion tool for use in conversations.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，注册一个可在对话中调用的八进制转换工具。

description.en: Provides precise odor-removal suggestions based on input parameters, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数给出精确的异味去除建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Runs your kanban backlog during off-peak hours with per-card git worktrees, evidence-gated completion, and automatic merge-back.
description.zh: 在低谷时段运行看板积压任务：每张卡片独立 git worktree，证据门控完成并自动合并回主分支。

description.en: Provides workplace communication etiquette suggestions based on parameters, implemented in pure Node without network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数提供职场沟通礼仪建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖

description.en: Generates an HTML office-themed dashboard summarizing session work logs, deliverables, and token usage.
description.zh: 生成 HTML 办公风格仪表盘，汇总会话的工作日志、交付物和 token 用量。

description.en: A DSH plugin that replicates DeepSeek Web's right-side chat navigation with a minimap and quick jump to messages.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，在聊天界面右侧复制DeepSeek网页版的快速导航缩略图，支持点击跳转消息。

description.en: An unofficial DeepSeek Harness theme plugin: dark mode with aurora, particle whale and constellation grid, light mode with blue gradient and glass panels.
description.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：深色模式含流体极光、粒子鲸鱼与星座网格，浅色模式为蓝色渐变与琉璃玻璃面板，可跟随 DSH 深浅色切换。

description.en: Offloads quick "just think it through" sub-questions to web chat.deepseek.com to save local model thinking tokens, with a status/budget panel and ds_offload tool.
description.zh: 将简单的"想一想"式子问题外包给网页版 chat.deepseek.com，节省本地模型思考 token，并提供桥接状态面板、自检与预算设置及 ds_offload 工具。

description.en: Holds DeepSeek model calls made during peak pricing hours and sends them later at off-peak rates to cut API costs.
description.zh: 在高峰计价时段暂存 DeepSeek 模型调用，改到非高峰时段发送，以降低调用费用。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek API peak/off-peak badge to DSH desktop, showing the current pricing period and a live countdown to the next switch.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/低谷时段角标，并实时倒计时到下次时段切换。

description.en: Pauses DSH tasks during DeepSeek peak pricing and automatically resumes or schedules them for off-peak windows.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰定价时段暂停 DSH 任务，并在非高峰时段自动恢复或安排执行。

description.en: Off-work countdown clock with water-drinking reminders, income tracking and an animated draggable companion character inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 下班计时器：提供下班倒计时、喝水提醒、收入统计与可拖动的动态陪伴角色卡片。

description.en: A floating pill in the DSH Web UI corner that reminds you to clock in, counts down to clock-out, and alerts when it is time.
description.zh: 悬浮在 DSH Web 界面角落的小挂件，提醒上班打卡、倒计时下班，并在到点时发出提醒。

description.en: Auto-continues replies cut off at the output token limit and sets per-route request params (reasoning effort, max tokens, temperature, stop sequences).
description.zh: 自动续写因输出 token 上限被截断的回复，并为每条 Our Free Model 路由单独设置推理强度、最大 token、温度与停止序列。

description.en: A deepseek harness bundle that supplies a zsh-based child-process runtime environment on HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony devices.
description.zh: 面向 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 设备的 deepseek harness 捆绑包，用 zsh 补齐子进程运行环境。

description.en: Connects a DeepSeek Harness Agent to WeChat via the OpeniLink Hub so it can send and receive WeChat messages.
description.zh: 通过 OpeniLink Hub 将 DeepSeek Harness Agent 接入微信，实现微信消息的收发。

description.en: Calculates oil change periods from parameters and returns clear recommendations.
OKR目标拆解工具：按参数精确计算，返回详细拆解结果。纯Node实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: OKR目标拆解工具，按参数精确计算并返回详细拆解结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: OKX official market data skills for DeepSeek Harness: prices, K-lines, funding rates, and 70+ technical indicators.
description.zh: 将 OKX 官方 okx-cex-market 技能适配进 DSH，提供价格、K线、资金费率及 70 多种技术指标，支持技能目录与插件两种安装方式。

description.en: Automatically hides the DSH composer after a period of inactivity to protect OLED screens from burn-in.
description.zh: 在空闲一段时间后自动隐藏 DSH 输入框，防止 OLED 屏幕出现烧屏。

description.en: Bundles personal quality-of-life features for the DeepSeek Harness, including permanent session deletion and an Extend settings tab.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打包个人体验优化功能，包括永久删除会话和 Extend 设置标签页。

description.en: Shows Ollama Cloud remaining quota in the DSH Settings page and lets you enter or edit your API key in-page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页显示 Ollama Cloud 剩余额度，并支持在页面内填写和编辑 API Key。

description.en: Displays Ollama Cloud credit balance and recent usage in a DSH Settings section, with an in-page API key editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置区展示 Ollama Cloud 额度余额与近期用量，并内置 API 密钥编辑器。

description.en: Scores every DSH tool call with a local Ollama model before it runs, turning risky calls into approval prompts and halting execution when the model is unreachable.
description.zh: 在每次 DSH 工具调用执行前用本地 Ollama 模型打分，高风险调用转为审批提示，模型不可达时直接阻断执行。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin to ignore or omit specified fields from data, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，用于从数据中忽略或省略指定字段，不依赖网络。

description.en: Local image rendering, pasting, OCR, and pixel analysis for text-only DSH models.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型提供本地图像渲染、粘贴、OCR 识别和像素分析能力。

description.en: File adapter plugin for DSH to import local files via drag/drop/paste/multi-select/@, parse documents with anydoc, and recognize images with multimodal models.
description.zh: DSH 文件适配插件，支持拖拽、粘贴、多选或 @ 导入本地文件，用 anydoc 解析文档，用多模态模型识别图片。

description.en: Adds polish, expand and autopilot actions to the DSH composer, rewriting your draft with the model the session already uses.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加润色、扩写与自动驾驶动作，用当前会话已选模型改写草稿并直接写回输入框。

description.en: Estimates one-rep max (1RM) from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数估算一次最大重复重量（1RM）并返回详细结果。

description.en: Turns DSH into a Windows desktop app with a one-click launcher, tray controller, and a sidebar button that opens DSH and chat.deepseek.com side by side.
description.zh: 将 DSH 变成 Windows 桌面应用：一键启动器、托盘控制器，以及并排打开 DSH 和 chat.deepseek.com 的侧边栏按钮。

description.en: DSH plugin that exposes a OneDev Git/CI/CD server's REST API as MCP admin tools the model can call.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把 OneDev Git/CI/CD 服务器的 REST API 封装为可供模型调用的 MCP 管理工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that checks enabled plugins for newer versions at startup and upgrades them all with one click, cross-platform.
description.zh: DSH 插件：启动时检查已启用插件的新版本，并支持一键批量升级，跨平台可用。

description.en: DSH plugin that replaces built-in web search with a drag-sortable chain of search engines, each toggleable, auto-falling back to the next on failure.
description.zh: DSH 搜索插件：把内置网络搜索换成可拖动排序的搜索引擎链，每个引擎可单独开关，失败自动顺延到下一个。

description.en: Pixel-art desktop pet for the DSH Web UI that sits in the corner, shows emotion-based avatars and chats via any OpenAI-compatible API.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 打造的像素桌宠，坐在界面左下角，带 14 类表情头像，可接入任意 OpenAI 兼容接口聊天并支持人设卡与简单记忆。

description.en: Adds a DSH action that reads a conversation's session log, works out which folders it wrote artifacts to, and opens that folder in the file explorer.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加一个动作：读取会话日志，算出该对话把产物写到哪些目录，并用资源管理器直接打开。

description.en: Client plugin that opens a settled DeepSeek Harness session at your last message instead of the floor, so you resume where you left off.
description.zh: 客户端插件，重新打开已结束的会话时定位到你最后一条消息的位置，而不是会话底部，方便从上次中断处继续。

description.en: Persistent AI companion bots, each with its own name, photo, persona, memory, voice and model, configured just by talking to them.
description.zh: 持久化的 AI 伙伴机器人，各自拥有名字、头像、人设、记忆、语音和模型，只需对话即可完成配置。

description.en: Adds draggable, resizable borders to any Web UI panel with collapse, scroll, move and raise, remembering each panel's size across reloads.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 任意面板添加可拖拽边框，支持改长宽、收起、滚动、平移和置前，并自动记忆尺寸、刷新后恢复。

description.en: CLI tool that opens a specified directory as a workspace in DSH Desktop or Web and launches its session.
description.zh: 通过 CLI 在 DSH Desktop 或 Web 中打开指定目录对应的工作区并进入会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness intro/outro animation plugin with 5 code-drawn styles, swappable custom video/GIF, and adjustable speed, particles, color and text.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开场/退场动画插件：内置 5 套纯代码自绘样式，可换成自己的视频或动图，并可调节速度、粒子、主色与文案。

description.en: DSH plugin: make Open in VS Code and other Electron apps open a window by stripping the leaked ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE from detached GUI launches
Adds an Android Studio target to the session toolbar's "Open In..." button group, opening the current workspace folder in local Android Studio.
description.zh: 在会话工具栏的“Open In...”按钮组中注册 Android Studio，一键用本机 Android Studio 打开当前工作区目录。

description.en: A DSH plugin base that adds an extensible "Open In..." button group in the session toolbar, letting third-party plugins register their own target apps.
description.zh: DSH 插件底座，在会话工具栏提供可扩展的“Open In...”按钮组，允许第三方插件注册自己的目标应用。

description.en: Opens DSH Web produced files in a configurable local macOS IDE.
description.zh: 在可配置的本地 macOS 集成开发环境中打开 DSH Web 生成的文件。

description.en: A dynamic seaside theme for official macOS DeepSeek Harness with drifting clouds, animated waves, swaying plants, and Chinese settings.
description.zh: 适用于官方 macOS DeepSeek Harness 的动态海边主题，包含云层飘移、海浪动画、花草摆动及全中文设置。

description.en: Clicking a DSH delivered-file card opens the file in the system default app instead of the built-in sidebar preview.
description.zh: 点击 DSH 交付卡片时，改用系统默认程序打开文件，而不是跳进右侧内置预览。

description.en: Adds a 'Show in File Explorer' option to workspace overflow menu to open the workspace directory in the OS file manager.
Keeps a local OpenCLI daemon resident so DSH browser commands answer in 5–20 ms instead of paying Node cold-start per call.
description.zh: 让本地 OpenCLI 守护进程常驻，使 DSH 浏览命令在 5–20 毫秒内响应，避免每次调用都付 Node 冷启动开销。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to the local OpenCode CLI, letting agents use OpenCode-compatible models via native LlmAdapter passthrough with persistent sessions.
description.zh: 通过本机 OpenCode CLI 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode 兼容模型，提供原生 LlmAdapter 透传与持久会话续接。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects to remote opencode serve instances and registers OpenCode as a native subagent backend with session tools.
description.zh: DSH 插件：连接远程 opencode serve 实例，将 OpenCode 注册为原生子代理后端并暴露会话与工具。

description.en: Standalone OpenCode Zen compatibility bundle for DeepSeek Harness: session headers and Muse reasoning replay
DSH plugin that manages an OpenCode Go API-key pool, auto-switching keys based on quota, with a Settings tab and composer quota badge.
description.zh: DSH 插件：管理 OpenCode Go API 密钥池，按配额自动切换密钥，并提供设置页与输入框配额徽章。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription quota usage as a compact indicator in the DSH chat input stats bar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话输入框下方的统计条中，以简约指示器显示 OpenCode Go 订阅的额度使用情况。

description.en: Adds an OpenCode GO plan quota panel to DSH Settings, backed by a same-origin usage proxy and a /opencode-go-quota command.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页中显示 OpenCode GO 套餐配额，附带同源用量代理和 /opencode-go-quota 命令。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness display OpenCode Go subscription and Zen free model catalog with dynamic list and zero-config key discovery.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅与 Zen 免费模型目录，支持动态列表和零配置密钥发现。

description.en: Adds three threshold-coloured OpenCode Go quota rings next to DSH's composer meter, expanding on hover into a progress panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁显示三个带阈值的 OpenCode Go 配额圆环，悬停时展开为进度条面板。

description.en: Persistent OpenCode Go quota bar in the DSH Web GUI showing rolling, weekly and monthly remaining percentages with a pacing card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 底部常驻显示 OpenCode Go 额度的状态条，展示 rolling / weekly / monthly 剩余百分比，并可按需展开配速卡。

description.en: Displays OpenCode Go usage as a quota ring and expandable card for DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中以配额圆环和可展开卡片显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时、每周及每月用量

description.en: Keeps the DSH model picker in sync with the live OpenCode Go model catalog so new models appear without a DSH release.
description.zh: 让 DSH 模型选择器与 OpenCode Go 实时模型目录保持同步，新模型无需发布 DSH 新版本即可出现。

description.en: Pins an OpenCode Go upstream route in DeepSeek Harness via a stable x-opencode-session key, with an in-GUI route picker and drift checks.
description.zh: 通过稳定的 x-opencode-session 密钥在 DeepSeek Harness 中固定 OpenCode Go 上游路由，并提供界面内路由选择与漂移检测。

description.en: Patches DeepSeek Harness so opencode.ai routes send the x-opencode-session header, fixing HTTP 400 MissingSessionID errors.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 opencode 路由补发 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误。

description.en: Adds a per-session x-opencode-session header to custom OpenCode Go routes in DeepSeek Harness so upstream requests stay tied to the right session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的自定义 OpenCode Go 路由添加按会话区分的 x-opencode-session 请求头。

description.en: Adds a fallback sessionId on OpenCode/OpenCode Go routes so auto permission presets stop failing tool calls with 400 MissingSessionID.
description.zh: 在 OpenCode/OpenCode Go 路由上提供备用 sessionId，使自动权限预设不再因 400 MissingSessionID 报错。

description.en: Supplies an x-opencode-session header for opencode-go requests missing a session id, so Auto review stops failing with 400 MissingSessionID.
description.zh: 为缺少会话 ID 的 opencode-go 请求自动补上 x-opencode-session 头，避免 Auto review 因 400 MissingSessionID 失败。

description.en: Imports OpenCode desktop chat history from opencode.db into DeepSeek Harness as native sessions, filed by their original working directory.
description.zh: 从 opencode.db 导入 OpenCode 桌面端历史会话到 DeepSeek Harness，按原工作目录归档，并随会话增长保持同步。

description.en: Adds opencode's notification sound pack to the DSH Web UI, replacing default alert sounds with opencode-style audio cues.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 opencode 通知音效包，用 opencode 风格提示音替换默认提示音。

description.en: Adds CESP/OpenPeon sound packs and browser notifications to the dsh web client, playing per-moment audio with toasts and optional OS alerts.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页客户端添加 CESP/OpenPeon 音效包与浏览器通知，按会话状态播放声音并显示提示。

description.en: Live OpenRouter model catalog for DeepSeek Harness with price filters and one llm-pi-ai route per API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenRouter 实时模型目录、价格筛选，并为每个 API 密钥生成一条 llm-pi-ai 路由。

description.en: Self-contained voice dictation for DeepSeek Harness that routes speech recognition through OpenRouter and mirrors the built-in composer mic UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立语音输入，通过 OpenRouter 进行语音识别，并复刻内置输入框的麦克风界面。

description.en: Orders multiple OpenSpec changes into a dependency graph, runs each in its own conversation, and tracks status through to validated archive.
description.zh: 把多个 OpenSpec 变更排成依赖关系图，按顺序或并行在各自会话中执行，跟踪进度并校验后归档。

description.en: Adds an OpenViking status page inside DSH Settings showing connection, service health, memory and session counts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增 OpenViking 状态页，显示连接状态、服务健康度、记忆与会话计数。

description.en: Enhances DeepSeek Harness client UI with sidebar menus, timestamp display, and advanced settings panel.
description.zh: 增强DeepSeek Harness客户端界面：侧边栏菜单、时间戳显示、高级设置面板等。

description.en: Injects short operational-convention reminders into agent context only on action-like turns, once per session version, with injection logs.
description.zh: 仅在“像要动手”的轮次向上下文注入极短的操作约定提醒，同一会话同版本只注入一次，并记录注入日志。

description.en: Self-maintained dsh-ops port that packages a Linux/ARM64 (Android) runtime with DSH 0.2.2 support.
description.zh: 自行维护的 dsh-ops 移植版，为 Linux/ARM64（Android）打包运行时并支持 DSH 0.2.2。

description.en: Adds an input-box panel to DeepSeek Harness with five-tier reasoning protocols, token/cost tracking, a conclusion ledger and persistent PowerShell.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框增加面板，提供五档推理协议、Token 与花费统计、结论台账及持久 PowerShell。

description.en: A tool that precisely calculates option intrinsic value from parameters, returning detailed results. Pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算期权内在价值并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖

description.en: Turns task hand-off into a five-gate flow (Brief→Decompose→Dispatch→Verify→Accept) with a read-only orchestration canvas and run.json evidence.
description.zh: 把任务下达变成五道闸门流程（简报→拆解→派发→验证→验收），配只读编排画布，每步证据写入 run.json。

description.en: Provides a hot pot meal ordering plan (下菜顺序) based on parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数生成火锅下菜顺序计划，纯 Node 实现，无需网络。

description.en: A pure Node tool that precisely calculates amounts to reach order thresholds for discounts, with detailed results.
Origami tutorial tool that returns DIY paper-craft plans based on input parameters.
Validates a trade origin determination register: RVC arithmetic, configured thresholds, material origins, unique numbers and leftover placeholders.
description.zh: 校验原产地判定台账：区域价值成分计算、配置阈值、材料原产地、编号唯一性及残留占位符。

description.en: Scans for and terminates orphan processes like MCP stdio connectors, dev servers and stray process trees left behind after DSH restarts.
description.zh: 扫描并清理 DSH 重启后遗留的孤儿进程，如 MCP stdio 连接器、开发服务器和游离进程树。

description.en: Reads an online review and reply register and checks completeness: review content or score, reply date/author, deadlines, category vocabulary, unique IDs.
description.zh: 读取线上点评与回复登记表并检查完整性与闭环：点评内容或评分、回复日期与作者、时限、问题分类词表及编号唯一性。

description.en: Exports DSH token-audit JSON summaries as OTLP/JSON cost and token metrics for Grafana, Langfuse or any JSON collector.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的 token 审计 JSON 摘要导出为 OTLP/JSON 成本与 token 指标，可发送至 Grafana、Langfuse 或任意 JSON 采集器。

description.en: Generates one-time passwords (TOTP/HOTP) for authentication.
description.zh: 根据密钥生成用于身份验证的一次性密码，支持 TOTP 和 HOTP 两种算法。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt glossary so the model reads and writes custom terms like 「滚木」/「棍母」 naturally instead of swapping single tokens.
description.zh: 只添加一段系统提示词词汇表，让模型自然理解并写出「滚木」「棍母」等自定义词，而非机械替换单个词。

description.en: Registers reports, pages, docs, sheets, images and datasets into one searchable, previewable, recoverable deliverables list.
description.zh: 将报告、页面、文档、表格、图片和数据集登记到一个可搜索、可预览、可恢复的交付物列表。

description.en: Provides content-addressed proof for retaining DSH tool outputs and verifying spill custody with audit support.
description.zh: Content-addressed proof for body-free DSH tool-result retention and spill custody

description.en: Detects repetition degeneration loops in streamed model output, aborts the runaway turn, and sends the agent a corrective notice.
description.zh: 检测流式模型输出中的重复退化循环，中止失控回合并向智能体发出纠正提示。

description.en: Session-scoped output styles for DeepSeek Harness: /style command and web selector to change answer presentation (default/adhd/eli5/bluf).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话级输出风格插件：/style 命令和 Web 选择器改变答案呈现方式（默认/多动症友好/通俗/要点）。

description.en: Oven temperature conversion tool that precisely calculates and returns detailed results, pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 烤箱温度换算工具，精确计算并返回详细结果，基于纯 Node，可离线使用。

description.en: Oven temperature tool that returns practical baking plans based on input parameters.
description.zh: 烤箱温度工具，根据输入参数返回实用的烘焙方案。

description.en: Retries compaction when the context window overflows, then revives the dead session in a fresh one using a handoff.
description.zh: 上下文窗口溢出时重试压缩，并通过交接在新的会话中复活已终止的会话。

description.en: Verifies overtime hours against compliance rules, calculates precisely from parameters, and returns results with legal references.
Calculates overtime pay precisely from parameters and returns detailed results and explanations.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算加班费，并返回详细结果与说明。

description.en: Syncs DSH workspaces, session logs and chat attachments to your own Git server for manual upload/download and cross-computer continuation.
description.zh: 把自己的 Git 服务器当作 DSH 会话同步通道，手动上传/下载工作区、会话与聊天附件，换电脑接着聊。

description.en: A fan-made Persona 5 Royal style UI theme for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, using red-black colors, dynamic effects, and a custom whale watermark.
description.zh: 一个粉丝向的 Persona 5 Royal 风格 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 UI 主题，采用红黑配色、动态效果与自绘鲸鱼水印。

description.en: 打包就走。 把 DSH 的「对话 + 工作区」装进一个 .dshpack 文件，换台电脑（或换个平台）继续用。
Provides packing and moving/relocation plans based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数生成打包与搬家方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Generates packing list suggestions based on given parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据给定参数生成打包清单建议，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖

description.en: Annotate elements inside the DSH HTML preview and send the whole batch of annotations as one message so the model edits the page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的 HTML 预览中圈选元素并写批注，把整批批注作为一条消息发送，让模型按批注修改页面。

description.en: Adds browser-style whole-page zoom to the DSH desktop app: hold Ctrl and scroll or pinch to scale the entire interface, Ctrl+0 resets to 100%.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版带来浏览器式整页缩放：按住 Ctrl 滚动滚轮或双指捏合即可缩放整个界面，Ctrl+0 恢复 100%。

description.en: Floating-ball timer records toilet-break duration and computes paid-break earnings from monthly salary, work schedule and holidays, with stats and reminders.
description.zh: 悬浮球记录如厕时长，按月薪、排班与法定节假日结算带薪拉屎收益，附统计面板与提醒。

description.en: Provides paint care recommendations via precise calculation from parameters, with no network dependencies.
Computes precise scratch treatment outcomes from parameters and recommends actions.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算划

description.en: A pure Node tool for calculating latex paint tinting formulas from parameters, returning detailed results with no network dependency.
description.zh: 纯 Node 工具，根据参数计算乳胶漆调色配方并返回详细结果，无需网络依赖。

description.en: DSH front-door auth gateway: TOTP-authorized QR device pairing plus password login, then reverse-proxies requests (incl. WebSocket) to dsh with an admin panel.
description.zh: DSH 前台认证网关插件：TOTP 二维码设备配对与用户名密码登录，认证后反向代理（含 WebSocket）到 dsh，并提供管理面板与初始化向导。

description.en: Provides basic information about Pakistan as a country.
description.zh: 提供关于巴基斯坦作为国家的基本信息。

description.en: A dynamic Cordis plugin that themes the dsh Harness Web UI with Palenight dark and warm-neutral light modes.
description.zh: 一个 Cordis 插件，为 dsh Harness Web UI 提供 Palenight 深色与暖中性浅色两套主题。

description.en: ⌘K command palette for the DSH Web GUI, adding session switching, settings shortcuts, sidebar tabs and custom hotkeys.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 ⌘K 命令面板，支持会话切换、设置直达、侧边栏页签与自定义快捷键。

description.en: DSH host plugin that lets AI agents recall past session memories from the same working directory on demand, read-only and non-persistent.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：让 AI 智能体按需检索同一工作目录下的历史会话记忆，只读、不落盘、不注入。

description.en: Plugin named after the palladium element; no functional description provided.
description.zh: 以钯元素命名的插件；未提供功能描述。

description.en: Plugin with minimal description referencing Panama; purpose unclear.
Turns your disk into a reviewable treemap where an agent annotates each folder and you approve cleanup before anything is moved.
description.zh: 把磁盘变成可审查的树图盘面，Agent 为每个目录写入语义标注，清理前由你预览并确认后才执行。

description.en: Embeds a WebView2 browser in the DSH right column, with a self-drawn toolbar and native child-control rendering.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右栏内嵌 WebView2 浏览器，面板自绘工具条，画面由原生子控件渲染。

description.en: Adds a footer button to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar for collapsing or expanding the global panel list.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部添加按钮，用于折叠或展开全局面板列表。

description.en: Adds collapsible folder groups to the DSH sidebar launcher list, with assignments saved per browser in localStorage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 左侧栏的全局工具入口添加可折叠分组，分组归属与折叠状态保存在浏览器 localStorage 中。

description.en: Hides unused panels from the DeepSeek Harness left sidebar, groups them by origin, and restores them all via a More button.
description.zh: 隐藏 DeepSeek Harness 左侧边栏中未使用的面板，按来源分组，并通过“更多”按钮一键展开全部。

description.en: Patch that makes the DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel list scroll as a fixed 4-row area and turns clipped right-column panels into scrollable ones.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏打补丁：面板列表固定为 4 行并可滚动，右栏被裁切的面板改为可滚动。

description.en: Moves DeepSeek Harness sidebar global panels into the DSH Desktop Windows title bar, after the app/edit controls.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的全局面板移到 DSH 桌面版 Windows 标题栏（应用/编辑之后）。

description.en: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH with a project sidebar and per-project tabs for session, files, search, terminal, source control and notes.
description.zh: DSH 全屏工作台面板：左侧项目列表，右侧按项目切换会话、文件、搜索、终端、源代码管理和笔记等标签页。

description.en: Validates a parsed exam paper's structural self-consistency: question numbers, answers, score totals, types, difficulty, unique IDs and placeholders.
description.zh: 校验解析后试卷的结构自洽性：题号、答案、分值合计、题型、难度、唯一标识与残留占位符。

description.en: Academic paper library with PDF rendering, highlights, notes, AI reading Q&A and citation export that appends references to Word files.
description.zh: 面向学生与研究者的论文阅读与引用管理器：PDF 原样渲染、高亮笔记、AI 阅读问答，生成的参考文献可直接追加到 Word 文档。

description.en: DSH paper-mode plugin guiding academic writing with a five-stage method, intro/paragraph/conclusion formulas, and GB/T formatting and reference rules.
description.zh: DSH 论文模式插件：提供五阶段写作法、引言/段落/结论三公式、GB/T 论文版式与参考文献规范，并含 /paper 命令与界面徽标。

description.en: Paper reading studio with a paper library, outline navigation, KaTeX/PDF reader, selection-to-chat, notes, and review material.
description.zh: 论文阅读工作室：提供论文库、大纲导航、KaTeX/PDF 阅读器、选中内容发送到对话、笔记与复习资料。

description.en: Local Node plugin providing standard paper size reference (e.g., A-series, B-series) for session tools.
description.zh: 本地 Node 插件，为会话工具提供 A 系列、B 系列等标准纸张尺寸参考。

description.en: Literature survey agent for DeepSeek Harness: interprets papers with user confirmation and generates survey PPTs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文献综述 Agent，先解读论文并经用户确认，再用 A/B 两页结构生成综述 PPT，含三个技能且零依赖。

description.en: Converts arXiv papers or PDFs into shareable, interactive HTML reading pages without an API key.
description.zh: 将 arXiv 论文或 PDF 转换为可分享的交互式 HTML 阅读页面，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Turns PDF papers into a searchable, readable, linked Obsidian literature library with automatic metadata, LLM summaries and tags.
description.zh: 把 PDF 论文转成可检索、可阅读、可双链的 Obsidian 论文库，自动提取元数据并由大模型生成摘要与标签。

description.en: Turns local PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD papers and CSV/TSV/XLSX data into a Zotero-style library with a floating drawer for reading, note-taking, and spreadsheet editing.
description.zh: 将本地的论文(PDF/Word/TXT/MD)和数据(CSV/TSV/Excel)转换为Zotero风格库，以浮动抽屉提供阅读、笔记和表格编辑功能。

description.en: Provides country information about Papua New Guinea as a pure Node plugin with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 提供巴布亚新几内亚国家信息，作为无网络依赖的纯 Node 插件运行。

description.en: A plugin providing information about Paraguay.
description.zh: 提供巴拉圭信息的插件。

description.en: Returns undefined information about Paris city; pure Node implementation without network dependencies.
description.zh: 返回巴黎市的未定义信息，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Calculates parking fees based on parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node implementation, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数计算停车费并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Interactive partition board the AI opens when it needs a human to draw the boundaries (DSH plugin)
纯 Node 实现的帕斯卡命名（PascalCase）转换插件，无网络依赖，供会话调用。
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现、无网络依赖的帕斯卡命名（PascalCase）转换插件，可在会话中调用。

description.en: Password strength tool that calculates strength precisely from parameters and gives clear suggestions. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算密码强度并给出明确改进建议的纯 Node 工具，无需联网。

description.en: Generates strong random passwords and checks password strength/entropy with improvement suggestions.
Pastes long text into the DSH composer as a collapsible document citation; full text is sent as structured references.
description.zh: 将长文本粘贴到DSH输入框并转换为可折叠文档引用，全文作为结构化引用发送给模型。

description.en: Lets you paste or drop files into the DSH composer, saves them to the workspace, and inserts relative paths.
description.zh: 将粘贴或拖放的文件保存到当前工作区，并在 DSH 输入框中插入其相对路径。

description.en: Anonymizes workspace-external file paths before model requests, requiring user confirmation.
