description.zh: DSH plugin: anonymize workspace-external file paths before model requests, with user confirmation

description.en: Calculates small shop payback period based on input parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入的参数计算小店的回本周期，采用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Captures each upstream model API payload and saves it as JSON to disk.
description.zh: DSH 插件，捕捉每次上行模型 API 请求的 payload，并以 JSON 文件保存到磁盘。

description.en: Audits payroll sheets against published social insurance, housing fund and income tax parameters, reporting each difference with its source clause.
description.zh: 按已公布的社保、公积金和个税参数核对工资表，逐条报告差异及其依据条款，不代申报。

description.en: Calculates after-tax salary from parameters, returning detailed results and explanations.
Loopback HTTP bridge that lets a trusted peer ping this PC and run shell commands, with an optional SSH reverse tunnel.
description.zh: 回环 HTTP 桥，让可信对端探测本机并执行 shell 命令，可选 SSH 反向隧道。

description.en: DSH plugin that monitors PC system status with tools and a sidebar dashboard, cleans junk files, and uninstalls apps.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过模型工具与右侧栏面板监控系统状态，并清理垃圾文件、卸载应用。

description.en: PDF reader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bilingual academic translation, note-taking and AI-assisted reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PDF 阅读、学术双语翻译、笔记与 AI 辅助阅读的插件。

description.en: PDF compression and optimization tools for DeepSeek Harness using api.pdfslim.app.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PDF 压缩、优化和检查的 MCP 工具，通过 api.pdfslim.app 调用，免费版每天20次。

description.en: Live peak/off peak pricing indicator for DeepSeek Harness with browser pill and host status tool.
description.zh: 实时显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段计费状态，提供浏览器胶囊指示器和宿主状态工具。

description.en: Auto-switches DeepSeek models during peak hours to save costs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在高峰期自动切换模型以节省费用。

description.en: Floating badge for DeepSeek web GUI showing peak/off-peak token pricing status based on Beijing time.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 网页界面显示浮动徽章，按北京时间提示 token 计费处于高峰或低谷时段。

description.en: A centered title-bar capsule for DSH showing DeepSeek API peak/off-peak windows, switch countdown, account balance and today's usage.
description.zh: DSH 窗口标题栏居中的小胶囊，显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷时段、切换倒计时、账户余额与今日已用。

description.en: Shows live DeepSeek peak-hours status and estimated USD spend for the current session beneath the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 高峰时段状态和当前会话的预估美元花费。

description.en: DSH bundle that blocks peak-priced DeepSeek model calls, auto-detected from the provider catalog, until manually bypassed.
description.zh: DSH 插件包，根据提供商目录自动识别高峰时段，阻止 DeepSeek 高峰计费调用，直到手动绕过。

description.en: Pauses and resumes selected DSH sessions around DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing windows, with pre-peak alerts and holiday awareness.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价时段自动提醒、暂停并恢复所选 DSH 会话，支持法定节假日与调休。

description.en: Adds a sidebar badge showing DeepSeek peak-pricing windows with a 24h schedule bar, live now-cursor and countdown.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加徽章，用24小时时间轴、当前时刻指针和倒计时展示 DeepSeek 峰谷定价时段。

description.en: Adds a live composer badge counting down the time left in DeepSeek's current peak or off-peak pricing window, shown in your timezone.
description.zh: 在输入区显示实时徽章，按你的时区倒计时 DeepSeek 当前高峰或低谷定价窗口的剩余时间。

description.en: Asks for confirmation before sending during DeepSeek peak-price hours, using a built-in Chinese holiday calendar to spot off-peak days.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰时段发送前先弹窗确认，并内置中国节假日表自动识别非高峰日期。

description.en: Peak/off-peak price-aware task runner that batch-runs DeepSeek flash prompts when cheap and defers queued jobs to the next off-peak window.
description.zh: 感知 DeepSeek 峰谷计价的任务执行器：平价时段批量跑 flash 提示词，峰价时自动入队并推迟到下一个平价时段执行。

description.en: Recolors the DSH interface warm during DeepSeek peak-price hours and cool green during off-peak half-price hours, so billing state is visible at a glance.
description.zh: 根据 DeepSeek API 峰谷计费时段，把 DSH 界面在高峰染成暖色、空闲时段染成冷绿，界面颜色即计费状态。

description.en: Adds a live quota panel under the input box showing peak/off-peak status, session cost, token usage and DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示高峰/空闲时段、本会话消费金额、token 用量与 DeepSeek 账户余额的额度面板。

description.en: Adds a peak/off-peak status band above the DeepSeek Harness composer with remaining-time progress, holiday rules and six macaron themes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方加一条峰/谷状态带，显示剩余时长进度，支持节假日判定与六套马卡龙主题。

description.en: A corner clock widget for DeepSeek Harness web GUI showing peak pricing status with color and countdown.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的角落时钟，通过颜色和倒计时显示高峰定价状态。

description.en: Connects separate DSH instances over local ports so they can create sessions, exchange messages and steer running turns.
description.zh: 通过本地端口连接不同的 DSH 实例，可创建会话、互发消息并介入正在运行的对话轮次。

description.en: Renders Mermaid code blocks in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI as SVG using Pele, without a mermaid.js runtime.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中使用 Pele 将 Mermaid 代码块渲染为 SVG，无需 mermaid.js 运行时。

description.en: Adds a pelican cycling animation and task status notifications (idle/thinking/done) to the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加鹈鹕骑行动画和任务状态通知（空闲/思考中/已完成）。

description.en: A parody DeepSeek Harness plugin that routes work via genuine AI classification, local Pelican PRO inference, and transparent UI-only status.
description.zh: 一个恶搞风格的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过真实 AI 分类、本地 Pelican PRO 推理和透明的前端状态来路由任务。

description.en: Unofficial pen.dev integration linking the desktop app's MCP server to DSH so the model can design on the live canvas and inspect frames.
description.zh: 非官方 pen.dev 集成，将桌面应用的 MCP 服务器接入 DSH，让模型可在实时画布上设计并查看画板。

description.en: Adds an edit pencil to assistant replies so you can revise them and fork a new session version from that turn.
description.zh: 为助手回复添加编辑铅笔，可修改回复并从该回合分叉出新版本会话。

description.en: Colors sidebar session rows by state — pending approval, running, just finished — with animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色，并添加呼吸动效与同色状态点。

description.en: Keeps unsent chat drafts in the DSH sidebar as "pending" entries you can edit, rename, archive, send or delete anytime; drafts persist locally across restarts.
description.zh: 把未发送的会话草稿以「待执行」条目留在 DSH 侧边栏，可随时编辑、重命名、归档、发送或删除，本地保存且重启后仍在。

description.en: Lets a DSH agent read, export and import Penpot design files through Penpot's local HTTP RPC API.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体通过 Penpot 本地 HTTP RPC API 读取、导出和导入 Penpot 设计文件。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin that provides percent-encoding (URL encoding) for strings, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，为字符串提供百分号编码（URL 编码），不依赖任何网络。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin for percentage calculations with no network or external dependencies.
description.zh: 用于计算百分比的纯 Node.js 插件，无需网络或外部依赖。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for calculating percentile values.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于计算百分位数。

description.en: Sends webhook notifications for DeepSeek Harness sessions on approval requests and turn ends via ntfy, Bark, or generic JSON.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话的审批请求和回合结束时，通过 ntfy、Bark 或通用 JSON 发送 Webhook 通知。

description.en: Performance suite for DeepSeek Harness that profiles per-plugin cost, stores runs and generates agent-readable optimization reports.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的性能套件，可统计各插件开销、保存运行记录并生成可供代理阅读的优化报告。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD tracking FPS, long tasks, per-plugin callback rates, DOM/heap and event-loop RTT, with JSON export.
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD：监控帧率、长任务、插件回调速率与耗时、DOM/堆内存及事件循环 RTT，并支持一键导出 JSON。

description.en: Codex-style 6-level performance slider for dsh web that switches local cutout background frames.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供 Codex 风格六级性能滑块，每级对应模型与推理强度，并切换 31 个本地抠图背景帧。

description.en: A perfume layering tool that returns fragrance essential oil combinations based on input parameters.
description.zh: 一款香水叠香工具，根据输入参数返回香氛精油组合。

description.en: Adds a Permission Settings page to DSH so new sessions default to full access and existing sessions can be allowlisted individually.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供权限设置页面，可让新会话默认完全访问，并逐个将已有会话加入白名单。

description.en: Workspace write permission enhancement plugin with sleep guard for DeepSeek Harness, enabling system sleep/shutdown commands.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增强 workspace write 权限，带 sleep guard，允许执行系统睡眠和关机命令。

description.en: Validates an administrative licensing ledger for completeness and internal date/logic consistency.
description.zh: 校验行政许可办理台账的完整性与日期、字段间的一致性。

description.en: Calculates permutation numbers (排列数) for combinatorics calculations.
Binds an independent persona card to each DSH session, injecting structured self-cognition and letting the model refine it in chat.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话绑定独立人格卡，注入结构化自我认知，并支持在聊天中持续完善。

description.en: Multi-persona long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with a two-tier store (user profile plus agent notes) and per-turn review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多角色独立长期记忆，采用“用户画像 + 角色笔记”双层存储，并支持逐轮回顾。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects the CETACEA_LOLI whale-girl persona into every agent system prompt for a consistent character voice.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将 CETACEA_LOLI 鲸鱼少女人格注入每个智能体的系统提示词，保持统一角色语气。

description.en: Single-persona plugin bundling only the 大肥鱼 persona, whose text lives in an editable persona.md that takes effect on the next request.
description.zh: 单人设插件，只内置「大肥鱼」一条人设，正文独立放在可编辑的 persona.md 中，改完下一个请求即生效。

description.en: DSH plugin that rewrites your input draft in a chosen character card's voice using the session's model, then sends or lets you review it.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件：选择角色卡后，用当前会话模型把草稿改写成该角色口吻，可直接发送或先人工审查。

description.en: Framework-only DSH persona plugin: a four-layer structure with 83 modules, R1–R28 rules and 9 self-check tools, injected without editing persona files.
description.zh: 仅提供框架的 DSH 人格插件：四层结构、83 个模块、R1–R28 规则体与 9 个自检工具，外挂注入且不改写人格文件。

description.en: Binds an independent persona card to each DSH session, injected as first-person self-cognition and refined live in chat.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话绑定独立人格卡，编译成第一人称自我认知注入，并可在聊天中持续完善。

description.en: DSH persona-mode plugin that switches reply tone (catgirl, tsundere, etc.) via settings or /persona, changing expression only, not facts or code.
description.zh: DSH 人格模式插件，可在设置或 /persona 命令中一键切换猫娘、傲娇、毒舌等语气，只改表达，不改事实与代码。

description.en: 三个自定义 agent 预设，每个预设一张可编辑的角色卡（独立 dsh 插件）
Attaches a Markdown-driven "shaoxin" persona (system prompt) to DeepSeek Harness, hot-reloading on every file save.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 挂载由 Markdown 驱动的人格（系统提示词），保存文件即自动重载生效。

description.en: Proactive personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness that tracks preferences, knowledge, follow-through, and collection learning.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的主动式个人助理，跟踪偏好、知识、后续跟进与收藏学习。

description.en: Compact two-column model picker for DSH: hover a provider on the left to switch models on the right; the input trigger shows the current model and reasoning level.
description.zh: DSH 紧凑双栏模型选择器：悬停左栏供应商即切换右栏模型，输入框旁触发器显示当前模型与推理等级。

description.en: SQLite-backed personal todo tools with a Web panel for DeepSeek Harness, letting users manage todos or dispatch them to an agent.
description.zh: 基于 SQLite 的个人待办工具与 Web 面板，用户可自行管理待办，或按需交给 DSH Agent 执行。

description.en: Adds a Personalization section to DSH settings that injects your name, role, and chat reply preferences into every new conversation's system prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「个性化」分区，保存称呼、职业与回复偏好后自动注入每个新对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Plugin related to Peru country, described as '秘鲁国家' with no other details.
Plant pest and disease diagnosis tool that returns plant care plans based on parameters, in pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数诊断植物病虫害并返回养护方案，纯 Node 实现，无需联网

description.en: Returns a pet boarding/foster care plan based on input parameters, for when pets are left alone.
Sends DSH permission approval requests to the dsh-pet desktop pet, so you can approve or deny from a bubble above the pet without switching back to DSH.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的权限审批请求送到 dsh pet 桌宠的气泡上，无需切回 DSH 即可在宠物头顶点击批准或拒绝。

description.en: Right-click the dsh-pet desktop pet to open a lightweight session card for history, chatting, screenshot Q&A, workspaces and files.
description.zh: 右键 dsh-pet 桌宠即可弹出轻量会话卡片，查看历史、继续对话、框选截图提问、新建工作区并接收文件。

description.en: Provides pet bathing frequency recommendations based on user-provided parameters, implemented in pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据用户传入的参数给出宠物洗澡频率建议，纯 Node.js 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Returns pet bathing and grooming care plans based on input parameters.
Bridges the dsh-pet desktop pet plugin, publishing its live session events and work state to third-party plugins and external tools via token-authenticated webhook push and loopback HTTP pull.
description.zh: 桥接 dsh-pet 桌面宠物插件，通过 Token 鉴权的 webhook 推送与回环 HTTP 拉取，把实时会话事件与工作状态开放给第三方插件和外部工具。

description.en: Returns a pet grooming care plan based on input parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回宠物梳毛护理计划，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A desktop button that turns the dsh-pet desktop pet on or off and can launch Harness when it is closed.
description.zh: 一个桌面按钮，一键开关 dsh-pet 桌宠，并在 Harness 关闭时顺手启动它。

description.en: A floating desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that reacts to agent activity in a transparent window and loads pets from a folder-based library.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的悬浮桌面宠物，在透明窗口中响应智能体活动，并可从文件夹宠物库加载宠物。

description.en: A low-key desktop-pet companion panel for DSH with pomodoro timer, todo list, drink/stand-up reminders, lesson explanation and homework tutoring, all local at 0 tokens.
description.zh: 桌宠陪伴面板：提供番茄钟、待办清单、喝水与久坐提醒，并由桌面宠物讲解课程和辅导作业，本地功能不消耗 token。

description.en: A calm desktop pet companion for DeepSeek Harness with three chibi characters and quiet break, water, long-session and late-night reminders.
description.zh: 一款安静的 DSH 桌面宠物陪伴插件，内置三套 Q 版角色，提供久坐、喝水、连续工作和深夜关怀提醒。

description.en: A chibi desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with walk-cycle animation, blinking, idle scenes, Chinese voice lines, SFX and music toggles.
description.zh: 大肥鱼是 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的Q版桌面宠物，具备三帧走路、眨眼、待机小场景与掉落物理，并有中文语音、音效与音乐开关。

description.en: Provides custom pet health nutrition and weight-loss plans based on input parameters.
Provides common pet disease information and deworming plans based on parameters, pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 根据传入参数提供宠物常见病信息和驱虫方案，纯 Node 实现。

description.en: Tool that returns pet common diseases and deworming plans based on parameters.
description.zh: 根据参数返回宠物常见疾病和驱虫计划的工具

description.en: Always-on-top desktop pet ball that shows live DSH session status, thinking summaries and pending-question alerts, with one-click jump back to chat.
description.zh: 置顶桌面宠物球，实时显示 DSH 会话状态、思考摘要与待回答问题提醒，一键跳回对话。

description.en: Calculates daily pet food amount and returns a nutrition plan based on parameters.
Hides your dsh desktop pet's windows while a game or fullscreen app is in the foreground on Windows, then restores them afterwards.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上玩游戏或全屏应用时自动隐藏 dsh 桌面宠物窗口，结束后再恢复显示。

description.en: GujiGuji is a lightweight Codex-style desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that floats above windows and reacts while the agent works.
description.zh: GujiGuji 是一个轻量的 Codex 风格桌面宠物，浮于窗口之上并在智能体工作时显示项目与活动状态。

description.en: Provides pet heatstroke emergency care plans based on parameters, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数提供宠物中暑急救护理方案，无网络依赖。

description.en: A desktop pet overlay for DeepSeek Harness that reacts to agent activity in real time.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 上叠加桌面宠物，随智能体活动实时做出反应。

description.en: 梁子 desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: animated character with walk cycle, blinking, idle scenes, drop physics, Chinese voice and toggleable audio.
description.zh: 梁子桌面宠物：为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供三帧行走循环、眨眼、待机微场景与掉落物理，并支持中文语音、音效与音乐独立开关。

description.en: Companion-style long-term memory plugin for DSH with layered memory (dialogue, facts, scenes, persona), rule-based extraction, time-decay retrieval, and append-only local storage.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的陪伴型长期记忆插件：分层记忆（对话→事实→场景→人格）、规则抽取、时间衰减检索，全本地追加写入存储。

description.en: A companion notepad for the DSH desktop pet: right-click the pet for a floating plain-text note, also openable from the sidebar, saved as host-side JSON.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠伴生记事本：右键桌宠弹出悬浮纯文本记事本，左侧栏也可打开同一份内容，由 Host 侧 JSON 持久化保存。

description.en: Returns pet health nutrition plans based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回宠物健康营养方案，使用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: 宠物旅行清单工具，按参数返回宠物出行寄养方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: 按参数返回宠物出行寄养方案与旅行清单，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: 宠物喂药工具，根据参数返回宠物急救护理方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: 宠物喂药工具，根据参数返回宠物急救护理方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A Sayaka Miki desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with state-driven sprites, instant swaps and per-state voice lines.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供的美树沙耶香桌面宠物，支持状态驱动精灵、即时切换与分状态语音台词。

description.en: Generates pet sitting/boarding care plans based on input parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入的参数生成宠物寄养与看护计划，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Generates pet health and nutrition plans based on input parameters.
description.zh: 根据输入

description.en: A DSH desktop pet with a personality soul card, long-term memory, relationship timeline and WeChat/QQ chat bridges.
description.zh: 住在 DSH 里的桌面宠物：带人格灵魂卡、长期记忆、关系时间线与微信/QQ 原生接入。

description.en: Returns pet travel and boarding plans based on input parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回宠物出行与寄养方案，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Provides pet travel advice by returning clear suggestions based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回清晰的带宠出行建议，使用纯 Node 实现。

description.en: Provides pet travel boarding and care plans based on input parameters, pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入的参数生成宠物出行寄养与照护方案，纯 Node 实现，不访问网络。

description.en: 宠物伤口处理工具，按参数返回宠物急救护理方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: 按参数返回宠物伤口急救护理方案的纯 Node 工具，无网络依赖。

description.en: Lets agents understand videos by extracting frames and transcribing speech, aligning visuals, actions and dialogue on a timeline.
description.zh: 让智能体看懂视频：抽取关键帧并转写语音，将画面、动作与台词按时间轴对齐。

description.en: Native PostgreSQL workbench for visually filtering data, joining tables, adding computed columns, building pivots and saving reusable views.
description.zh: 原生 PostgreSQL 工作台，支持可视化筛选、同库联表、计算列、透视表和保存视图。

description.en: A plugin about the Philippines.
description.zh: 一个关于菲律宾的插件。

description.en: Provides tools to list and query philosophy terminology entries by ID or name.
description.zh: 提供按 ID 或名称列出和查询哲学术语条目的工具

description.en: Phocinae decision plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness adding a phocinae_ask decision tool plus an approval gate.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Phocinae 决策插件包，提供 phocinae_ask 决策工具与审批闸门。

description.en: Pairs your computer with OpenTandem via QR code so you can control DeepSeek Harness (dsh) from your phone.
description.zh: 通过二维码将电脑与 OpenTandem 配对，让你能用手机远程操控 DeepSeek Harness (dsh)。

description.en: A pure Node.js tool for phone number operations, with no network or external service dependencies.
Phone cleanup tool that computes precise cleanup suggestions from parameters in pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 手机清理工具，根据参数在纯 Node 环境中计算精确的清理建议，无需网络连接。

description.en: LAN-only phone-to-PC drop: scan a QR code, shoot or pick photos on your phone, and files land straight in a computer folder with no tunnel.
description.zh: 局域网手机直传：电脑出二维码，手机扫码拍照或选图后直接落进电脑文件夹，全程不走隧道。

description.en: A tool that returns phone etiquette recommendations based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回电话礼仪建议的纯 Node 工具，无网络依赖

description.en: Lets DSH agents see which inbound WeChat-bridge attachments a session received and pull a chosen one into the workspace.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 查看本会话通过微信桥收到的入站附件清单，并将选中文件取用到工作区。

description.en: Returns photography composition schemes based on parameters. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回手机摄影构图方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Scan a QR code to shoot or pick photos on your phone and drop them into a chosen DSH conversation as a pending message.
description.zh: 扫码用手机拍照或从相册选图，图片以待发送消息挂到你指定的 DSH 对话中，确认后再随消息发出。

description.en: Plugin with only description '磷元素' (phosphorus element); no README or functionality details.
description.zh: 该插件仅包含描述“磷元素”，无 README 或任何功能说明，未提供可用的具体能力。

description.en: DSH plugin that moves phone-taken photos to a configurable folder on this PC over the LAN in one tap.
description.zh: DSH 插件：手机拍照后经局域网一键传输到本机可配置的目标文件夹。

description.en: A local Node plugin providing basic photography reference knowledge tools, offline and no external services.
description.zh: 本地 Node 插件，离线提供摄影基础知识参考工具，不依赖外部服务

description.en: Adds a photo button to the composer, enabling users to pick and attach images as drafts.
description.zh: 在编辑器添加照片按钮，支持选取图片并附加为草稿。

description.en: Provides a knowledge base of physics formulas with tools to list and query entries.
description.zh: 提供物理公式知识库，以及列出和查询

description.en: Adds PI-Desktop style composer controls to DSH: a two-pane model picker, reasoning-effort slider, prompt history and prompt rewrite.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 PI-Desktop 风格输入框控件：双栏模型选择器、推理强度滑块、提示历史与提示重写。

description.en: Cross-session persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: facts, daily logs, todos in Markdown, with optional semantic search.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话持久记忆，用 Markdown 保存事实、每日日志和待办事项，并可选语义搜索。

description.en: An experimental plugin providing a TUI drop-in experience for compatibility between pi and dsh.
description.zh: 实验性插件，为 pi 与 dsh 的兼容提供 TUI 直接替换体验，聚焦作者常用部分。

description.en: Adds a glissando piano keyboard to the DeepSeek Harness UI, playing notes as the mouse or trackpad slides across the keys.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面中加入滑动钢琴键盘，鼠标或触控板滑过琴键即可像刮奏一样发声。

description.en: Advises which DSH plugin to install: describe your need, and it scores 2,250+ candidates with denoised npm metrics into pick/alternative/avoid.
description.zh: DSH 插件选购顾问：说出需求即可基于去噪 npm 指标从 2,250+ 候选插件中给出首选、备选与不推荐。

description.en: Returns pickling/preserving plans for vegetables based on input parameters; pure Node.js, no network dependencies.
Returns pickling recipes based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回泡菜配方，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Returns pickling/preserving plans for vegetables based on input parameters.
Returns pickling/curing plans based on input parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回腌制或腌渍方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Picky eating correction plugin that returns behavior suggestions based on parameters; pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 挑食纠正插件，根据输入参数返回对应的行为建议，纯 Node 实现，可离线运行。

description.en: Deterministic one-way PII anonymizer that runs at the start of the DeepSeek Harness agent loop before data is processed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 智能体循环入口处运行的确定性单向 PII 匿名化插件。

description.en: Sixteen sandboxed tools that drive the Pijul distributed version control CLI for status, log, diff, record, channel, push, and pull workflows.
description.zh: 十六个受沙箱策略约束的工具，用于驱动 Pijul 分布式版本控制 CLI，支持状态、日志、差异、记录、通道、推送和拉取等工作流。

description.en: A fan-made Pikachu desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI that changes pose and animation with the current agent's status.
description.zh: 一个给 DSH Web GUI 用的粉丝自制皮卡丘桌宠，会随当前 Agent 状态切换动作与动画。

description.en: Hands for DeepSeek Harness agent — autonomous browser operation via accessibility refs with session-based permissions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 代理提供浏览器自主操作能力，通过无障碍引用定位页面元素，权限模型跟随 dsh 会话。

description.en: Lints PIM product catalogs for missing required fields, duplicate SKUs, invalid GTIN check digits and price issues.
description.zh: 检查PIM产品目录中的必填字段缺失、重复SKU、GTIN校验位错误和价格问题。

description.en: A client-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that pins DSH sessions to the top of the sidebar and marks them unread/read, with state stored per browser profile.
description.zh: 一个DSH客户端插件，将会话固定到侧边栏顶部并标记未读/已读，状态保存在浏览器配置中。

description.en: A tiny perler-bead puzzle game for idle moments in DSH chats, with built-in patterns and photo-to-blueprint generation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天等待回复时玩的小拼豆游戏，内置图案，还能用照片生成图纸。

description.en: Sends Telegram pings when your DeepSeek Harness agent needs you: a question asked, an approval requested, or a turn finished.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 智能体需要你时通过 Telegram 推送提醒：提问、请求审批或回合结束。

description.en: Minimal macOS notification plugin for DSH: pops a system banner plus Glass sound when a reply finishes or your input is needed, and clicking it returns to that session.
description.zh: 极简的 macOS 通知插件：回复完成或需要你介入时弹出系统通知并播放提示音，点击通知可回到对应会话。

description.en: Adds a dedicated Pinned bar above the DSH Web GUI sidebar workspace list, gathering all pinned sessions with cross-container drag and drop.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 侧边栏工作区列表上方新增专用固定栏，汇集所有已固定会话并支持跨容器拖放。

description.en: Adds a pinyin-annotation skill to DeepSeek Harness, annotating Chinese text with GB/T 16159-2012 and HSK-aligned pinyin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供拼音标注技能，按 GB/T 16159-2012 与 HSK 等级为中文文本添加拼音。

description.en: Validates a project's whole-process document-chain register for completeness, stage order, dates, unique numbers and amounts.
description.zh: 校验项目全流程文档链登记表的完整性与内部一致性，包括阶段顺序、日期、编号与金额。

description.en: Pixel art studio plugin for DSH that opens a three-pane tools/canvas/palette editor inside the conversation tab with zoom, layers and PNG export.
description.zh: DSH 的像素画工作室插件，在对话标签内提供工具/画布/调色板三栏编辑器，支持缩放、图层与 PNG 导出。

description.en: Converts DeepSeek Harness Web GUI vector SVG icons to retro pixel-art style, matching pixel fonts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的矢量 SVG 图标转换成复古像素风格，以匹配像素字体

description.en: Floating pixel desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness; character tier follows performance slider, animations follow conversation state.
description.zh: 悬浮像素大头桌面宠物，角色档位跟随 6 档性能滑杆，动作随对话执行状态变化。

description.en: Pixel print size calculator that precisely computes dimensions from parameters and returns detailed results, built in pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数精确计算像素打印尺寸并返回详细结果的纯 Node 计算器，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Browser capability probe plugin that checks DOM APIs and reports SVG icon count to validate DOM rasterization feasibility.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 动态 Client 插件浏览器能力探测工具

description.en: Adds 21 original fruit-inspired pixel-art themes with custom color palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供 21 套原创水果主题，包含自绘像素水果和专属配色。

description.en: Text-mode pixel theme for the DSH Web UI with monospace type, square tiles, pixel scrollbars, and 12 live ASCII canvas wallpapers.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供文本模式像素主题：等宽字体、方形色块、像素滚动条，以及 12 种实时 ASCII 画布壁纸。

description.en: DSH plugin and bitmap/animation toolkit for displaying custom pixel art on the Edifier Halo PixelBar 256x32 dot-matrix screen.
description.zh: 用于在漫步者 Halo PixelBar 256x32 点阵屏上展示自定义像素画的 DSH 插件及位图/动画工具包。

description.en: 披萨尺寸换算工具，按参数精确计算并返回详细结果，纯Node实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: 披萨尺寸换算工具，按参数精确计算并返回详细结果，纯Node实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Persistent Plan|Build composer toggle with Tab-to-switch for DeepSeek Harness, driving the native /plan channel.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供持久的Plan|Build切换器，支持Tab切换，驱动原生/plan通道。

description.en: 先澄清、再出方案、用户批准后才执行：给 DeepSeek Harness 加一道执行前闸门
A DSH plugin that shows read-only permission as Plan mode and prevents permission upgrades while keeping web search functional.
description.zh: 把只读权限显示为 Plan 模式，禁止权限升级申请（审批永不通过），同时保持网络搜索可用。

description.en: DSH Web UI overlay plugin that shows a collapsible capsule with the session todo list, completed count and current task.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 覆盖层插件，用可折叠胶囊显示会话待办列表、已完成数量和当前任务。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness plans in Plannotator by annotating, approving, or sending them back.
description.zh: 在 Plannotator 中审阅 DeepSeek Harness 计划，可批注、批准或退回。

description.en: Drives Plasticity 3D CAD from AI through a loopback Electron CDP bridge with mm units, real undo, and STEP/STL export.
description.zh: 通过本地回环 Electron CDP 桥接，让 AI 驱动 Plasticity 3D CAD，支持毫米单位、真实撤销与 STEP/STL 导出。

description.en: Calculates fat loss plateau from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算减脂平台期并返回详细结果

description.en: Calculates food delivery platform commission fees based on parameters, returning detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算外卖平台抽成费用并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无需网络。

description.en: Plugin with minimal description referencing platinum element.
Estimates playback revenue based on input parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数估算播放收益并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Wraps microsoft/playwright-cli so the model can drive a real browser via one tool, plus a bundled skill that teaches the command vocabulary.
description.zh: 封装 microsoft/playwright-cli，提供一个可调用的浏览器工具，并附带按需加载、教会模型命令用法的技能包。

description.en: Validates a pleading element checklist for completeness and internal consistency, one row per claim.
description.zh: 逐条校验诉讼要素清单的完整性与内部一致性，每条诉讼请求一行。

description.en: A pure Node plugin to extract fields from data, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 插件，用于从数据中提取字段，无网络依赖。

description.en: MCP service manager for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: discover GitHub MCP servers, view details, and install/remove them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的 MCP 服务管理器，可发现 GitHub 上的 MCP 服务器、查看详情并安装或卸载。

description.en: Manages Agent Skills for DeepSeek Harness: discover, view, and install/remove SKILL.md packages from GitHub via Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Agent Skills：通过 Web UI 发现、查看并从 GitHub 安装或移除 SKILL.md 技能包。

description.en: Power plug type lookup tool that returns clear recommendations based on input parameters.
description.zh: 电源插头类型查询工具，可根据输入参数给出明确建议

description.en: A sidebar 2048 game for dsh with boards from 4×4 to 9×9, combo and morph animations, daily challenges, achievements and in-session reminders.
description.zh: dsh 侧边栏 2048 游戏：支持 4×4 至 9×9 棋盘、连击与形变动画、每日挑战、战绩成就，并在会话完成或卡点时游戏内提醒。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance, session spend and per-turn cost estimates in a pill on the composer dock.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠栏以胶囊组件显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、会话花费与每轮预估费用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows your remaining account balance next to the composer's cache-hit reading.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在输入框旁的缓存命中读数处显示账户剩余余额。

description.en: Hyprland-style drag-to-split tiling layout that arranges multiple DeepSeek Harness conversations into resizable panes.
description.zh: 仿 Hyprland 的拖拽分屏布局，将多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话排列为可调整大小的窗格。

description.en: Plays a desktop notification and sound when the agent finishes a task, asks a question, or needs your approval, with your own custom sounds.
description.zh: 当 agent 完成任务、提出问题或需要你批准时，弹出桌面通知并播放声音，还可自定义音效。

description.en: Groups multiple live DSH sessions into one collaboration channel and relays each session's final output onto a shared timeline.
description.zh: 将多个实时 DSH 会话聚合为一个协作组，并把各会话的最终输出转发到共享时间线。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that sends browser notifications when an agent task completes, needs input, or errors, each with its own sound.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：Agent 任务完成、需要操作或出错时发送浏览器通知，三种情况可分别设置提示音。

description.en: A floating corner mini agent tree that live-renders dsh → workspace → conversation → subagent status, plus todos, schedules and local claude/codex processes.
description.zh: 常驻右下角的迷你 agent 树，实时展示 dsh → workspace → 对话 → subagent 状态，以及待办、定时任务和本机 claude/codex 进程。

description.en: Agent tools for building agentcss-styled HTML report pages: component lookup, page scaffolding, validation and PDF export.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供 agentcss 报告页工具：查组件、生成骨架、交付前自检并导出 PDF。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds a mouse-following WebGL particle background recreated from antigravity.google.
description.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 WebGL 粒子背景的插件，粒子会跟随鼠标移动，复刻自 antigravity.google。

description.en: Adds a button beside source control that pins the DeepSeek Harness desktop window above all other apps.
description.zh: 在源代码管理旁添加按钮，可将 DeepSeek Harness 桌面窗口置顶于其他所有应用之上。

description.en: Inspect AMDGPU code objects and ISA, returning kernel metadata and instruction counts as structured JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 检查 AMDGPU 代码对象与 ISA，以结构化 JSON 返回内核元数据和指令数量。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of ZCode's android-emulator plugin, exposing 23 Android build, emulator, ADB and UI-Automator MCP tools plus the android-dev skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版的 ZCode android-emulator 插件，提供 23 个 Android 构建、模拟器、ADB 与 UI-Automator MCP 工具以及 android-dev 技能。

description.en: Adds a native Android preview tab to DeepSeek Harness with scrcpy-style device controls and Flutter hot reload.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加原生 Android 预览标签页，支持 scrcpy 风格设备控制和 Flutter 热重载。

description.en: Adds Codex-style selection quote replies to the DeepSeek Harness desktop client, letting users quote selected text in responses.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端添加 Codex 风格的选中引用回复，让用户可在回应中引用选中文本。

description.en: Compresses verbose tool error payloads before they reach model context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在冗长的工具错误内容进入模型上下文前先将其压缩。

description.en: Adds an archive shelf panel that lists archived DSH sessions, previews their content, and restores or reopens them in one click.
description.zh: 新增归档会话面板，一次列出所有已归档会话，可预览聊天内容并一键恢复或重新打开继续聊。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds Volcano Ark / Doubao Seedream text-to-image and image-to-image tools plus a built-in skill.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，提供火山方舟/豆包 Seedream 文生图与图生图工具及内置技能。

description.en: Hands a natural-language task to Google ARTEMIS, which drives an Android phone or emulator and returns the result, screenshots and a step-by-step trace.
description.zh: 把一句自然语言任务交给 Google ARTEMIS，在真机或模拟器上自动分步执行，并返回结果、截图与执行轨迹。

description.en: Artifacts manager for DSH: browse outputs in grid or list view, preview, rename, restore from trash, zip-archive and optionally upload to COS.
description.zh: DSH 产物管理工作台：网格/列表浏览、预览、重命名、回收站、zip 归档，并可选上传至 COS。

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion pet for dsh web UI that animates based on LLM session state and levels up with usage.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web UI 添加仙逆王林修炼伙伴，根据 LLM 会话状态播放动画，随使用累积升境，境界越高皮肤越华丽。

description.en: Action-State Memory Engine offering typed time-series memory with trend, anomaly, and causal analysis for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的动作-状态记忆引擎，提供带类型的时间序列记忆，支持趋势、异常与因果分析。

description.en: Notifies macOS with sound and system alerts when a dsh agent needs user input, and clicking opens the session in a browser tab.
description.zh: 当 dsh agent 需要用户回复、回答或批准时，通过 macOS 声音和系统通知提醒，点击通知可跳转到会话浏览器标签页。

description.en: Supply-chain-aware updater that installs only pnpm release-age-allowed plugin versions, with snapshots and one-step rollback.
description.zh: 供应链感知的插件更新器：只安装符合 pnpm 发布时长策略的版本，支持快照与一键回滚。

description.en: Always-visible sidebar pill that shows your DeepSeek account balance, auto-refreshing with the same numbers as Settings → Account.
description.zh: 侧边栏常驻的余额胶囊，自动刷新显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，与“设置 → 账户”数字一致。

description.en: Adds a live DeepSeek account balance chip to the session header, showing remaining credit and unused bonus, refreshed every 20 seconds.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加实时 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章，显示剩余额度与未使用赠送金额，每 20 秒刷新一次。

description.en: Draggable DeepSeek balance badge on the DSH web UI that auto-collapses at screen edges, with the API key kept only in the Node host.
description.zh: 常驻 DSH Web 界面的 DeepSeek 余额徽章，可拖动、靠边自动收缩，API Key 仅保留在 Node 进程内。

description.en: Replaces DSH built-in plan mode: writes plans to markdown files and shows them in a sidebar Plan panel for review and approval.
description.zh: 取代 DSH 内置计划模式：将计划写入 markdown 文件并在侧边栏计划面板中审阅批准。

description.en: Adds custom backgrounds and an animated wallpaper engine to DeepSeek Harness, with pictures, transparency, frosted glass and bundle support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加自定义背景与动态壁纸引擎，支持图片、透明、毛玻璃和壁纸包。

description.en: Converts Bilibili video links into b23.tv short links with cover images via an agent tool, /bili command and sidebar share panel.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频链接转换成 b23.tv 短链和封面图，提供 Agent 工具、/bili 斜杠命令和侧栏分享面板。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that reads a BMAD project and shows sprint progress, mismatches and next steps in the session sidebar.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 插件，读取 BMAD 项目并在会话侧边栏展示冲刺进度、不一致项和下一步操作。

description.en: Plays a video you choose as a boot animation when DSH opens, once per session, and lets you swap or upload clips in the plugin page.
description.zh: 打开 DSH 时播放你选的视频作为开机动画，同一会话只播一次，可在插件页上传或更换视频。

description.en: DSH plugin that labels forked sessions with their origin conversation via a title prefix and a persistent sidebar badge.
description.zh: DSH 插件，为分叉会话标注其来源对话，添加标题前缀和可持久显示的侧边栏徽章。

description.en: Forks the current DeepSeek Harness chat into a fresh branch with a compact digest for continued context.
description.zh: 将当前 DeepSeek Harness 聊天分叉为带精简摘要的新分支，便于继续上下文。

description.en: Brave Search tools for dsh: web, news, image and video search, page context, AI answers, places, suggestions and spellcheck.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Brave 搜索工具：网页/新闻/图片/视频搜索、页面上下文、AI 答案、本地地点、搜索建议与拼写检查。

description.en: A Claude Design System theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness that overrides 11 host design tokens with no network requests or DOM replacement.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude 设计系统主题插件，覆盖 11 条宿主设计令牌，无网络请求、无 DOM 替换。

description.en: DSH plugin that zooms only the chat message and input area from 80% to 200%, with shortcuts, settings and saved per-site preferences.
description.zh: DSH 插件，仅缩放聊天消息与输入区（80%–200%），支持快捷键、设置页与按站点保存倍率。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin checkup: lists installed plugins per profile, classifies by purpose, flags duplicates, disabled ones, updates and size.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 插件体检工具：按 profile 列出已装插件，自动分类，并检测重复、未启用、可更新与体积占用。

description.en: Automatically adds Chinese descriptions to every installed DSH plugin by generating locale/zh.json files, keeping plugin names unchanged.
description.zh: 为每个已安装的 DSH 插件自动补上中文简介，生成 locale/zh.json，插件名保持原样。

description.en: Sidebar and main-panel release console showing each repo's latest CI run, releases, and ahead-of-release status, with one-click build, release, and draft publish via gh CLI.
description.zh: 侧边栏与主面板发布台，展示各仓库最新 CI 运行、发布版本及本地是否领先，并支持一键构建、发布与草稿发布，复用 gh CLI。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: use your Claude subscription via the official Claude Agent SDK with persistent sessions
Configures a ClinePass model-provider route for DeepSeek Harness, including endpoint, protocol, credential reference, and a 12-model catalog.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 预置 ClinePass 模型提供商路由，包含端点、协议、凭据引用和 12 个模型目录。

description.en: Codex-style sidebar skin for the DSH Web GUI with a Projects/Recents browser, a standalone New chat row, and a draft-only composer.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Codex 风格侧边栏皮肤，含项目/最近会话浏览、独立新会话入口与仅草稿的输入框。

description.en: Governance plugin where a cloud planner delegates coding to a sandboxed local worker with hash-bound, fail-closed promotion checks.
description.zh: 一种治理插件：云端规划器把编码委派给受限的本地执行器，并以哈希绑定、失败即关闭的校验控制产出提升。

description.en: Generates images from chat by finding or starting your local ComfyUI and attaching the resulting image to the conversation.
description.zh: 在对话中通过查找或启动本地 ComfyUI 进行文生图，并把生成的图片附在会话里。

description.en: Read-only cyberpunk mission-control board that visualises each task's progress, subagent tree and output inside the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 只读的赛博朋克任务指挥中心面板，在 DSH Web UI 中展示每个任务的进度、子代理树与输出。

description.en: Pins the New Session composer to the same spot as the conversation composer so the input box stops jumping after the first message.
description.zh: 将新会话输入框固定在对话输入框的位置，避免首条消息后输入框跳动。

description.en: Shows session cost in CNY and live peak/off-peak DeepSeek rates beside composer token stats.
description.zh: 在输入框令牌统计旁显示以人民币计价的会话费用以及实时高峰/低谷费率。

description.en: Scheduled backup plugin for DeepSeek Harness config: sidebar panel, timed snapshots of ~/.dsh, retention policy, notifications, plus export/import and restore.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 配置定时备份插件：侧边栏面板，按周期把 ~/.dsh 配置复制成快照，支持保留策略、通知提醒与导入导出还原。

description.en: A tiny DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that shows a visible reconnect banner when a connected host becomes unavailable.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供重连提示横幅，当已连接的主机不可用时显示可见的重连通知。

description.en: Context Studio for DeepSeek Harness: start from sessions to see which ones form a chain and which are independent, which memories (instructions, skills) each session loaded and whether they are stale; then clean, transplant across projects and compose a starting context for a new session.
Automatically sends a next-turn "continue" follow-up when a turn ends by exhausting the output-token limit, with burst cap, interval and opt-out.
description.zh: 当某一轮因输出 token 耗尽而结束时，自动发送下一轮“继续”指令，支持突发上限、最小间隔与退出开关。

description.en: Permanently deletes a DSH conversation, removing its session log, projection cache, and sidebar entry.
description.zh: 永久删除DSH会话，同时清除会话日志、投影缓存和侧边栏条目。

description.en: DSH plugin that permanently deletes conversations, optionally removing the documents and attachments they created.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可永久删除对话，并可选择同时清除这些对话产生的文档与附件。

description.en: Adds one-click copying of a DeepSeek Harness session ID from the sidebar session menu or the open session header, with a toast confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏会话菜单或会话页头一键复制会话 ID，并弹出提示确认。

description.en: Estimates session cost in DSH Web UI by applying a configurable price table to token usage buckets, with manual price refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中按可配置的价格表对 token 用量分桶估算会话费用，并支持手动刷新价格。

description.en: Displays a live per-session cost badge in the top-right, using peak/off-peak time-of-day pricing.
description.zh: 在右上角实时显示每会话成本徽章，并按高峰/非高峰时段定价计算。

description.en: Cron scheduler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: schedule agent tasks via cron, natural language, or sidebar UI, then trigger agent turns by injecting user messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的定时任务插件：通过 cron 表达式、自然语言或侧边栏创建计划，按时间向会话注入消息以触发 agent 执行。

description.en: DSH Web Settings plugin control for starting and stopping Cordis loader plugins via the Qidong Kongzhi tab.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中提供插件控制，通过“启动控制”标签页启动或停止 Cordis 加载器插件。

description.en: Adds a Settings section to DeepSeek Harness with an on/off toggle and live textarea for injecting custom CSS themes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加设置区块，提供开关和实时文本框以注入自定义 CSS 主题。

description.en: Renders the dsh agent's reasoning, tool calls and task progress as scrolling danmu text inside the conversation area.
description.zh: 将 dsh 智能体的推理过程、工具调用和任务进度以滚动弹幕形式插入对话区域。

description.en: Command-line agent skill to create, inspect, update, delete, validate and compare CAN DBC databases, plus DBC-to-Excel conversion.
description.zh: 命令行智能体技能，可创建、查看、更新、删除、校验和比较 CAN DBC 数据库，并支持 DBC 与 Excel 互转。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows your DeepSeek account balance, balance breakdown, burn rate and balance trend in Settings → Balance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在「设置 → 余额」中查看账户余额、余额构成、消耗速度与余额趋势。

description.en: Adds a composer chip that shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing windows (Beijing time) and the topped-up balance, only when a DeepSeek route is active.
description.zh: 在编辑器输入区添加一个状态标签：仅当选中 DeepSeek 路由时，显示高峰/低谷价格时段（北京时间）与账户充值余额。

description.en: Displays your DeepSeek account balance in the DSH left sidebar, positioned above the More button.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧边栏的 More 按钮上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Permanently deletes a chat session and all of its stored data from the local device in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中永久删除聊天会话及其在本机存储的全部数据。

description.en: DSH plugin to delete sessions with confirmation, undo, and a 7-day recycle bin for safe recovery.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可经确认删除会话，支持撤销和 7 天回收站恢复。

description.en: Workbench for foreign-trade export documents and container-loading calculations inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中处理外贸出口单据与集装箱装柜计算的工作台。

description.en: Visualizes which DSH plugin provides each injected service by reading the live Cordis runtime dependency graph.
description.zh: 读取实时 Cordis 运行时，展示每个被注入的服务由哪个 DSH 插件提供。

description.en: Official companion plugin for DSH desktop on Linux; exposes state/usage endpoints and injects enhanced UI.
description.zh: DSH Linux 桌面版的官方配套插件，提供状态与用量接口，并注入增强界面。

description.en: Always-on-top desktop HUD card for DSH showing running tasks, approval requests and completed turns across sessions.
description.zh: 常驻桌面的 DSH 悬浮卡片，跨会话显示运行中任务、审批请求与已完成回合。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin manager: restart the app, install plugins from GitHub or npm, and manage third-party plugin enable/disable/uninstall.
description.zh: DSH 桌面插件管理器，可重启应用、从 GitHub 或 npm 安装插件，并管理第三方插件的启用、禁用与卸载。

description.en: DSH desktop notification plugin that pops toasts with sound on task completion, waiting-for-input or failure, plus mobile push.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：任务完成、等待输入或失败时弹出桌面通知与音效，并支持手机推送。

description.en: Sends Codex-style macOS notifications and a Dock unread badge for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, with banner clicks jumping back to the session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用提供 macOS 风格的横幅通知和 Dock 未读角标，点击横幅可跳回对应会话。

description.en: Adds a Windows desktop app sidebar entry, panel, and Settings section for managing updates and plugins via the native bridge.
description.zh: 为 Windows 桌面应用添加侧边栏入口、面板和设置区域，通过原生桥接管理更新与插件。

description.en: Three host tools for DSH bundles: scaffold a plugin, diagnose it before install, and audit a published package's supply chain.
description.zh: 为 DSH 插件包提供三个宿主工具：脚手架生成、安装前诊断，以及发布包的供应链审计。

description.en: Codex-style editing of sent DSH messages: change text in place and continue by forking a new session.
description.zh: 像 Codex 一样编辑已发送的 DSH 消息：就地修改文本，通过 fork 新会话继续对话。

description.en: Adds a sidebar plugin directory to DSH for browsing, searching, sorting and one-click installing community GitHub plugins.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏加入插件目录，可浏览、搜索、排序社区插件并一键安装 GitHub 插件。

description.en: Provides 16 agent tools to read, post in, moderate and administer a Discourse forum from the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 提供 16 个智能体工具，用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中读取、发帖、审核和管理 Discourse 论坛。

description.en: Adds a right-side plugin dock beside the chat plus a left-sidebar hub entry so all DSH plugins can be invoked without leaving the conversation.
description.zh: 在对话右侧新增插件坞，并在左侧边栏提供插件中心入口，让你无需离开聊天即可随时调用所有 DSH 插件。

description.en: Statically vets DSH plugins before install, scanning directories or packages for exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence, and risky lifecycle scripts.
description.zh: 在安装前静态审查 DSH 插件，扫描目录或已安装包中的数据外泄、凭据访问、混淆、持久化及生命周期脚本风险。

description.en: Static doctor that inspects DSH plugin profiles for missing dependencies, bundle patch problems and duplicate patch ids or names.
description.zh: 静态检查 DSH 插件配置档的诊断工具，可发现缺失依赖、bundle 补丁问题以及重复的补丁 ID 或名称。

description.en: DSH plugin adding read_document and write_document tools for Word (.docx), PDF and plain-text files.
description.zh: DSH 插件，提供 read_document 与 write_document 两个工具，读写 Word (.docx)、PDF 和纯文本文件。

description.en: Official Dracula color theme for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, covering design tokens and shiki syntax highlighting.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的官方 Dracula 配色主题，覆盖设计 token 与 shiki 语法高亮。

description.en: Measures what each agent skill really delivers, injects that verified capability data before use, and corrects skill descriptions overnight with backups and revert.
description.zh: 衡量每个技能的实际能力，在使用前注入经过验证的能力数据，并在夜间修正技能描述，支持备份与回滚。

description.en: Offline DeepSeek Harness plugin that converts Word .docx files to PDF via the Rust/Skia dxpdf engine, no Office or LibreOffice required.
description.zh: 离线 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用 Rust/Skia 的 dxpdf 引擎把 Word .docx 转成 PDF，无需 Office 或 LibreOffice。

description.en: A dsh plugin that assembles and loads plugin combinations from natural-language requests behind a mandatory security audit gate.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 插件：根据自然语言请求动态组装并加载插件组合，并强制经过安全审计门控。

description.en: Guards the DSH plugin ecosystem with read-only health scans, pre-install conflict checks, a cross-plugin permission gateway and user-confirmed fixes.
description.zh: 守护 DSH 插件生态：提供只读体检、安装前冲突预检、跨插件权限网关，以及需用户确认的修复与维护操作。

description.en: Legacy-compatible entry for the Ekko skin manager, now folded into the Hatsune Miku & Rose Queen theme pack with settings and startup videos.
description.zh: Ekko 皮肤管理器的旧版兼容入口，管理功能已整合进初音未来与玫瑰女王主题套装，含外观设置与启动视频。

description.en: A 70-line starter DSH plugin to copy from that adds one sidebar tab with bilingual labels and a behaviour test.
description.zh: 一个 70 行的 DSH 插件模板，演示新增一个侧边栏标签页、双语文案和一项行为测试，可直接复制使用。

description.en: Workspace file explorer docked in the DSH sidebar with a lazy-loading file tree, Settings toggle, and drag-to-resize.
description.zh: 停靠在 DSH 侧边栏的工作区文件浏览器，支持懒加载文件树、设置开关和拖拽调整宽度。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that lets you set separate text colors for body, code, terminal and work-step scopes, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版字体颜色插件，可为正文、代码、终端、工作步骤四个作用域分别设置文字颜色，并跨重启持久保存。

description.en: DSH plugin that switches Chinese and Latin fonts separately, offering system font lists plus custom TTF/OTF uploads for typography control.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可分别切换中文字体与拉丁字体，提供系统字体列表并支持上传 TTF/OTF 自定义字体。

description.en: Agent preset that generates original DSH plugins and maps, absorbs or forks other plugins' JS code, with a Chinese-first UI.
description.zh: 插件工坊 DSH 智能体预设：原创插件生成，并对他人插件进行测绘、代码吸收与改造分叉，中文界面优先。

description.en: Free web search and page-fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness with multi-engine racing, relevance gating and GitHub mirror fallback — no API key needed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的免费网页搜索与抓取插件，多引擎并行竞速、相关性闸门、GitHub 镜像回退，无需 API Key。

description.en: Lets the dsh main agent join YGOPro duels and chat in-game via native tools, reusing dsh's model, persona and context.
description.zh: 让 dsh 主智能体通过原生工具参加 YGOPro 对局并在游戏内聊天，复用 dsh 的模型、人格与上下文。

description.en: Pre-install security gate for DeepSeek Harness plugins, reviewing npm, Git, and local sources for supply-chain risks.
description.zh: 独立的 DeepSeek Harness 插件安装前安全闸门，审查 npm、Git 与本地来源的供应链风险。

description.en: A Gemini-styled skin for the DeepSeek Harness web client, changing only visual appearance via a stylesheet.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web客户端提供Gemini风格外观的主题皮肤，仅改变视觉效果。

description.en: Sidebar panel that tracks GitHub daily/weekly/monthly trending boards, cross-board overlap and first-seen repos via read-only GET.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板监控 GitHub 日/周/月热榜，记录变化、跨榜同现与本机首次见到的仓库（全程只读 GET）。

description.en: Registers /commit, /push and /commit push commands in DSH that queue a git instruction for the agent to run in the next turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中注册 /commit、/push 和 /commit push 命令,只登记 git 指令交由 Agent 在下一轮执行。

description.en: Syncs the third-party plugins installed in a DSH profile between machines using a GitHub or Gitee repository as the backup store.
description.zh: 通过 GitHub 或 Gitee 仓库在多台机器之间同步 DSH 配置中已安装的第三方插件。

description.en: Browse GitHub issues, milestones, labels, priorities and linked PR status inside DeepSeek Harness, then hand an issue to the agent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览 GitHub 议题、里程碑、标签、优先级和关联 PR 状态，并把议题交给智能体处理。

description.en: A DSH panel that shows GitHub trending repos, lets you star and favourite them, translate the README into Chinese, and shallow-clone them with one click.
description.zh: DSH 面板：查看 GitHub 趋势仓库，支持收藏、标星、README 一键机翻成中文，并可一键浅克隆。

description.en: Floating black liquid-glass schedule plugin for DSH with work/personal categories, time ranges, a two-lane timeline and mainland-China holidays.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的浮动黑色液态玻璃日程插件，支持工作/个人分类、时间段、双轨时间线和中国大陆节假日。

description.en: Adds a Zhipu GLM coding-plan quota bar next to the DSH web GUI input box, with click-to-refresh, a right-click menu and its own settings section.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 输入框旁显示智谱 GLM 套餐额度条，支持点击刷新、右键菜单，并自带设置分区。

description.en: Graphical DSH plugin that drives Gumeite ERP cloud MCP tools via a catalog tree, scenario cards and secure local token config.
description.zh: 以图形界面调用固美特 gmtMcp 云端 ERP 能力的 DSH 插件，含功能目录树、场景快捷卡与本地令牌安全配置。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that maps goals to plans and visualizes progress routes and session mindmaps.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件，将目标映射到计划，并可视化进度路线和会话思维导图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin exposing 30 tools for Google Calendar and Google Tasks with natural-language scheduling and OAuth2, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 30 个 Google 日历与任务工具，支持自然语言排程与 OAuth2，无运行时依赖。

description.en: GPUStack v2 cluster ops for DSH: deploy and inspect models, workers, GPUs, logs and usage.
description.zh: DSH 的 GPUStack v2 集群运维插件：部署与查看模型、worker、GPU、日志和用量。

description.en: Scans DSH plugins to build dependency graph, detect conflicts, circular dependencies, and version compatibility, with installation preflight.
description.zh: 扫描 DSH 插件并构建依赖图，检测冲突、循环依赖与版本兼容性，支持安装前预检。

description.en: Supervises a graphify watch process per project so code changes automatically rebuild your graphify knowledge graph from any source.
description.zh: 为每个项目监督一个 graphify watch 进程，让代码变更自动从任意来源重建 graphify 知识图谱。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill plugin that interviews you one question (frontier) at a time to sharpen an idea.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 技能插件，每次只针对一个前沿问题采访你，帮你厘清想法。

description.en: Adds a Groups view to the Installed plugins page, letting you group, tag, annotate, and lock plugins for better organization.
description.zh: 在已安装插件页面新增分组视图，可对插件进行分组、标签、备注和锁定，便于整理管理。

description.en: Ops console for DSH plugins: compatibility vetting, load-row repair, plan/apply/undo authorization gate, and install/verify ledgers.
description.zh: DSH 插件运维台：兼容性体检、装载行修复、plan/apply/undo 授权闸门，以及装前静态体检与装后复验账本。

description.en: New-media content studio that writes platform-specific drafts across 21 tracks, generates images paragraph by paragraph, and pushes WeChat drafts with video previews.
description.zh: 新媒体内容工作台：覆盖 21 条内容赛道，从写稿、逐段出图，到推送公众号草稿，并预览视频成片。

description.en: Turns the Harness spec (entry, environment, scope, status, gates) into generatable, validatable project config files, adding 11 tools and 10 slash commands.
description.zh: 把 Harness 规范（入口/环境/范围/状态/门禁）变成可生成、可校验的项目配置文件，附带 11 个工具与 10 条斜杠命令。

description.en: Annotate DeepSeek Harness answers: select text, right-click to highlight or add a note, then send the quote back to the input box.
description.zh: DSH 批注插件：在回答里选中文字右键高亮或写备注，一键把引用放回输入框。

description.en: Hot-toggle any installed plugin from DSH web settings with instant apply and persistence.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页热启用或停用任意已安装插件，立即生效、无需重启且状态持久化。

description.en: Runtime plugin inventory and hot-plug manager for DeepSeek Harness with source-aware UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 运行时列出插件清单并管理热插拔，界面会标出插件来源。

description.en: Left-sidebar plugin hub that browses GitHub repos, downloads ZIPs and one-click installs DSH plugins into the current profile.
description.zh: 左侧栏插件下载中心：粘贴 GitHub 仓库地址即可选版本下载 ZIP，并一键把 DSH 插件安装到当前 profile。

description.en: Control a DSH session remotely through a Lark bot: chat messages become prompts, replies and approval cards return to the chat.
description.zh: 通过飞书机器人远程控制 DSH 会话：聊天消息变成提示词，回合结果和审批卡片回到聊天。

description.en: Automatically uploads conversation progress to Tencent IMA as daily notes and knowledge base entries.
description.zh: 自动将会话进度上传到腾讯 IMA，保存为每日笔记和工作知识库条目。

description.en: Exposes a constrained read-only image route for the DSH web server so agents can embed workspace images directly in chat.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 服务器提供受限的只读图片路由，让智能体可在聊天中直接嵌入工作区图片。

description.en: Open many DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side as draggable, stackable cards on a free canvas.
Adds a plugin manager UI to DSH, letting users install/remove plugins via a command or package name.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加插件管理器界面，用户可通过命令或包名安装和卸载插件。

description.en: A DSH web plugin overlaying floating meme subtitles to visualize agent lifecycle events, with customizable themes and optional local sounds.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web添加漂浮热梗字幕，实时展示Agent事件，支持自定义主题与本地提示音。

description.en: Audits DeepSeek Harness plugins via static source scanning and LLM reasoning, plus post-install audit and model-switch review reminders.
description.zh: 对 DSH 插件做安装前源码静态扫描与 LLM 价值评审，并提供安装后审计和模型切换时的复核提醒。

description.en: Thin dsh plugin bundling the Kannaka MCP server for HRM memory, NATS swarm messaging, and KAX compute tools.
description.zh: 轻量 dsh 插件，打包 Kannaka MCP 服务器，提供 HRM 记忆、NATS 集群消息与 KAX 算力工具。

description.en: Adds a Chinese 'key info' panel to DSH Web GUI settings, showing environment, profile, plugin status, sessions, models, and errors.
description.zh: DSH插件

description.en: DSH plugin that scrapes web articles into clean text and packages them as downloadable EPUB/AZW3 books, via a sidebar page or an agent tool.
description.zh: 把网页文章抓取为纯净正文并打包成可下载的 EPUB/AZW3 电子书，支持侧栏页面与 Agent 工具两种方式。

description.en: Plays a greeting sound ('来了，老弟') after every assistant reply finishes in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在每次助手回复结束后播放「来了，老弟」提示音，先显示文本再响。

description.en: Hide, show, and reorder entries that other plugins register in DeepSeek Harness's sidebar, session header, and settings.
description.zh: 隐藏、显示并重新排序其他插件注册到 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏、会话头部和设置中的条目。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that drives the desktop and Chrome via LCU/Codex computer use, decoupled from the app.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 LCU（Codex 计算机使用）驱动桌面与 Chrome，并与应用解耦。

description.en: Developer-focused agent skill suite providing 11 workflow skills as a bundled provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向开发者的智能体技能套件，通过 ctx.skills 以捆绑提供者形式挂载 11 个工作流技能。

description.en: Windows screenshot plugin for DeepSeek Harness with live desktop selection, annotations, a global hotkey, and direct image insertion.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 截图插件，支持桌面实时选区、标注、全局快捷键和直接插入图片。

description.en: Windows llama.cpp manager for DeepSeek Harness with GGUF launch profiles, logs, and model picker integration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows llama.cpp 管理器，支持 GGUF 启动配置、日志与模型选择器集成。

description.en: Tencent CodeBuddy LLM adapter for dsh that registers a codebuddy chat route with model pricing, quota display and retry handling.
description.zh: 腾讯 CodeBuddy 的 dsh 大模型适配插件，注册 codebuddy 路由，支持流式对话、模型价格与额度展示及失败重试。

description.en: Integrates a local LM Studio model as a chat model in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 将本地 LM Studio 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，作为聊天模型使用。

description.en: Panel that lists localhost servers and static pages an agent started, showing port, directory, session, and a stop switch.
description.zh: 一个面板，列出代理在 localhost 启动的服务器和静态页面，显示端口、目录、会话，并提供停止开关。

description.en: Records the DeepSeek Harness's own runtime warnings and errors to stderr so failed boots can explain why.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 自身的运行时警告和错误记录到 stderr，让启动失败时能说明原因。

description.en: Real-time log forwarder for DeepSeek Harness streaming agent events to WebSocket, Loki, or local files with filtering and masking.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时日志转发插件，将 Agent 事件流式输出到 WebSocket/Loki/本地文件，支持过滤与脱敏。

description.en: LongPi is a longevity concierge plugin that ingests personal genome VCF files and builds multi-omics reports, routing work through s2f agents.
description.zh: LongPi 是长寿管家插件，可摄入个人基因组 VCF 文件、生成多组学报告，并通过 s2f 智能体路由任务。

description.en: Marks dsh web page connections as host-owning so Settings and Models pages load behind a reverse proxy on non-loopback hostnames.
description.zh: 将 dsh 网页连接标记为宿主所有，使非回环主机名在反向代理后也能加载设置与模型页面。

description.en: A native DSH companion plugin that renders the Lumi VRM avatar, reacting to conversation context with expressions, gestures and lip sync.
description.zh: 一个原生 DSH 陪伴插件，渲染 Lumi VRM 虚拟形象，并根据对话上下文做出表情、动作和口型同步反应。

description.en: External plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness that inventories a profile's third-party plugin packages and updates them with one click.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外部插件管理器，可列出某个配置下的第三方插件包并一键更新。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin manager that lists all non-native installed plugins with descriptions, category filters, and enable/disable/uninstall controls.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏插件管理器：集中列出全部非原生插件及描述，支持分类筛选与启用/停用/卸载。

description.en: Enhances the native DSH plugin page with tag filters, search, sorting, drag reorder, batch actions, and AI-generated names, icons and descriptions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生插件页增加标签筛选、搜索、排序拖拽、批量操作与 AI 改名/图标/简介等增强能力。

description.en: Sidebar plugin marketplace that browses the dsh-plugin.org community directory and installs, toggles or uninstalls plugins via the official manager.
description.zh: 侧栏插件市场，可浏览 dsh-plugin.org 社区插件目录，并通过官方插件管理器安装、启停或卸载插件。

description.en: A sidebar plugin market for DSH that lets you browse 7,557 plugins and install, update, enable, or remove them in one click.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的侧边栏插件市场，可浏览 7,557 个插件，并一键安装、更新、启用或卸载。

description.en: CaSee-powered DSH market-intelligence plugin with native intel tools, an expert persona, a bundled skill and a dark-dashboard HTML report contract.
description.zh: 基于 CaSee 平台的 DSH 市场情报插件，提供情报工具、专家人设、内置技能与暗色仪表盘 HTML 报告规范。

description.en: Self-hosted internal DSH plugin marketplace for publishing, discovering, distributing and recalling plugins with access control.
description.zh: 自托管的内网 DSH 插件市场，支持插件发布、发现、分发、访问控制与插件召回。

description.en: A plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness that turns GitHub dsh-plugin topic into a browsable, installable plugin store with agent tools.
description.zh: 专用于deepseek harness的插件市场和第三方插件管理工具

description.en: Markdown previewer and editor for web GUI sidebar with atomic save and conflict detection.
description.zh: 在 web GUI 侧栏浏览、渲染并编辑保存 Markdown 文件，保存时用原子写入并检测 mtime 冲突。

description.en: Searches PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, formats citations, and retrieves open-access full text.
description.zh: 检索 PubMed、Europe PMC、arXiv、bioRxiv 和 medRxiv，格式化引用并获取开放获取全文。

description.en: Records meetings inside DSH, transcribes speech live, and suggests follow-up questions and answers using project context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内录制会议、实时转写语音，并结合项目资料给出追问与回答建议。

description.en: Lightweight notes and todo panel for the DSH Web UI with work/personal columns, five autosaving memo windows, drag-to-reorder, inline editing, and local JSON storage.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供的轻量笔记与待办面板，支持工作/个人待办栏、五个自动保存备忘录窗口、拖拽排序、行内编辑和本地 JSON 存储。

description.en: Local-first cross-session memory for DSH: logs each turn, distills entries on demand, and injects relevant memories, all in local SQLite offline.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地优先的跨会话记忆：每轮自动沉淀、按需整理并注入相关记忆，数据全部存于本地 SQLite，不联网。

description.en: Renders your whole DSH conversation history as an explorable 3D star-sea, drilling from a session star down to each individual message.
description.zh: 把你和 AI 的全部对话渲染成一片可游走的 3D 星海，可从会话星一路深探到每一条消息。

description.en: DSH plugin that converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG with standard symbols and auto pagination.
description.zh: DSH 插件：将 Mermaid 流程图转换为符合 GB/T 1526-1989（ISO 5807）的 SVG，符号合规并自动分页。

description.en: Adds a badge in each message's action row showing which provider and model produced the reply, including subagent sessions.
description.zh: 在每条消息的操作栏中显示生成该回复的服务商与模型，包括子代理会话。

description.en: Disposable microVM sandbox tools for DSH agents to create, exec in, fork and destroy isolated VMs via any E2B-compatible API.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供一次性 microVM 沙箱工具，可通过任意 E2B 兼容 API 创建、执行命令、分叉和销毁隔离虚拟机。

description.en: Distills conversations into persistent storylines with an interactive mind map tab.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，将对话提炼为持久的故事线，并提供可交互的思维导图标签页。

description.en: Adds a narrow-viewport drawer shell with hamburger, scrim, swipe gestures, and dynamic browser tab title to the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加窄视口抽屉外壳，含汉堡按钮、遮罩层、滑动手势和动态浏览器标签标题。

description.en: Appends the provider or platform name after model names in the DeepSeek Harness model selector so users can tell providers apart.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器中，于模型名称后追加服务商/平台名称，方便区分不同来源的模型。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel that tracks newly listed OpenRouter models and weekly token-usage rankings, logging changes locally via read-only GET requests.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加面板，追踪 OpenRouter 新上模型与每周 token 用量榜单，只读 GET 请求并在本地记录变化流水。

description.en: A full-page NetEase Cloud Music player inside DeepSeek Harness with discovery, playlists, charts, search, lyrics, queue control and offline downloads.
description.zh: 内嵌于 DeepSeek Harness 的整页网易云音乐播放器,支持发现、歌单、排行榜、搜索、歌词、播放队列与下载落盘。

description.en: Rename installed third-party dsh plugins by writing your chosen name into each plugin's own locale metadata.
description.zh: 为已安装的第三方 dsh 插件改名，直接写入插件自身的语言元数据，让「已安装」列表显示你的名字。

description.en: Connects DSH to a New API gateway for browsing models, chatting, and managing tokens, channels, logs and site settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 New API 网关，支持查看模型、对话以及管理令牌、渠道、日志与站点设置。

description.en: A playful tan dog mascot for the DSH web GUI that floats, reacts to the harness, and performs many animations.
description.zh: 一个有趣的棕色狗狗吉祥物，漂浮在DSH网页界面中，响应互动并执行多种动画。

description.en: Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools that let DSH agents read, write, and edit .ipynb files safely via a structured API instead of raw JSON.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的单元格感知 Jupyter 笔记本工具，用结构化 API 安全读写和编辑 .ipynb 文件，而非直接操作原始 JSON。

description.en: Simple notepad plugin for DeepSeek Harness that records short notes at global ($DSH_HOME) or project (.dsh) level.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的简易记事本插件，可在全局（$DSH_HOME）或项目（.dsh）级别记录简短笔记。

description.en: Renders an Obsidian vault table of contents in a conversation view with folders, tags, word counts, headings and one-click @-path copying.
description.zh: 在对话视图中呈现 Obsidian 库目录，包含文件夹、标签、字数、标题及一键复制 @ 路径。

description.en: DSH plugin that batch-generates Excel and Word files from templates plus data ledgers and returns the generated file list.
description.zh: DSH 插件：根据 Excel/Word 模板和数据台账批量生成文件，并返回生成的文件列表。

description.en: Connects to Microsoft OneNote so the agent can read only the notebooks you explicitly allow, enforced before any Graph request.
description.zh: 连接 Microsoft OneNote，让智能体仅能读取你明确授权的笔记本，并在发起 Graph 请求前强制执行白名单。

description.en: DSH plugin showing live OpenCode Go subscription quota usage in the composer dock with 5h, weekly and monthly rings and a detail card.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在输入框停靠区实时显示 OpenCode Go 套餐额度用量，含 5 小时、每周、每月环形进度与详情卡片。

description.en: Shows your remaining OpenCode Go subscription quota as a live stat pill inside the DSH composer dock.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框停靠区以实时状态药丸显示 OpenCode Go 订阅剩余配额。

description.en: Patches opencode provider to stop it from always failing, enabling reliable operation.
description.zh: 修补 opencode 提供商，使其不再总是失败并可稳定运行。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel that breaks a session down by turn and step, showing Skill/MCP calls, file reads and writes, and failure details.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏面板，按轮次与步骤展开会话中的 Skill、MCP 调用与文件读写，并标注失败详情。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that scans AI replies for density, runs five-layer fact/strength/safety checks and rescans to tighten the output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：本地密度扫描 + 五层事实/力度/安全校验 + 闭环复扫，用于优化 AI 回复文本。

description.en: Read-only DSH sidebar panel showing the session project's task board, dependency graph, ideas and review timeline.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏只读面板，展示当前会话项目的任务板、依赖图、想法与评审时间线。

description.en: A chibi desktop pet that sits in the DSH corner and switches poses to reflect live session progress, plus petting, feeding and an affection level.
description.zh: 住在 DSH 窗口右下角的小桌宠，随会话进度切换待机、干活、等你、欢呼四种神态，并可摸头、投喂、累积好感度。

description.en: PACT governance plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gates whether an agent step may start or a tool may execute, without replacing DSH's ReactLoopAgent.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 PACT 治理插件，决定某一步能否开始、某个工具能否执行，但不替换 DSH 的 ReactLoopAgent。

description.en: A 2D palette board for the DeepSeek Harness web console to search, filter, and launch plugin pages from a floating customizable grid.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness web 控制台提供 2D 调色盘应用板，支持悬浮面板、即时搜索、分类过滤与全键盘导航。

description.en: Lets you select text inside PDFs, attach annotations, and send the collected comments to the agent as one batch.
description.zh: 支持在 PDF 中选中文字并添加批注，将多条批注一次性发送给 Agent 处理。

description.en: Reads text from local PDF files inside DeepSeek Harness page by page, with page statistics and scanned-PDF detection, no Python or network needed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中逐页读取本地 PDF 文本，提供页数统计与扫描件检测，无需 Python 或联网。

description.en: Connects Penpot to DSH via an MCP control plane plus a browser-free REST channel for reading and writing design files.
description.zh: 把 Penpot 接入 DSH：MCP 控制面加无需浏览器的 REST 通道，可直接读写设计稿。

description.en: Pi-web-inspired sidebar chrome for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, adding temporary sessions, a session list, a draft composer, and a file explorer tab.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 pi-web 风格的侧边栏界面，包含临时会话、会话列表、草稿编辑器与文件浏览器标签。

description.en: Pins sessions in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, grouping pinned items above the sidebar list.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中置顶会话，置顶项分组显示在侧边栏列表上方，会话行菜单可置顶或取消置顶。

description.en: Turns each DeepSeek Harness agent reply into a short, plain-language slide deck for people who don't read code.
description.zh: 把每条 DeepSeek Harness 智能体回复转成简短的通俗幻灯片，方便不读代码的用户理解。

description.en: A DSH plugin for viewing PlantUML diagrams inside the deepseek harness.
description.zh: 一个在 deepseek harness 中查看 PlantUML 图的 DSH 插件。

description.en: Floating Pomodoro focus timer overlay for DSH with break cycles, a Plugins-page config page, and desktop notifications.
description.zh: DSH 浮动番茄钟专注计时器插件，支持休息循环、插件页配置和桌面通知。

description.en: Native DSH plugin that adds per-project rules, skills and a /ponytail level command for a lazy senior-dev (YAGNI) coding mode.
description.zh: 原生 DSH 插件，提供按项目规则、技能与 /ponytail 等级命令，实现懒人资深开发（YAGNI）模式。

description.en: Cleans up temporary process files after a DSH task by deleting them or moving them into a .dsh-trash folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务结束后清理临时过程文件，可直接删除或移入 .dsh-trash 回收目录。

description.en: Sidebar prompt template library to browse, manage, and insert reusable prompts directly into the composer.
description.zh: 侧边栏提示词模板库，可浏览、管理并将可复用提示词插入输入框。

description.en: DSH Web plugin: recall previously sent prompts in the composer with a rebindable shortcut and a clickable history panel.
Publishes or updates a DSH plugin on GitHub in one command, validating the manifest and bundle IDs, then committing the tree and setting the required topic.
description.zh: 一条命令将 DSH 插件发布或更新到 GitHub：校验清单与包标识，提交代码树并设置所需主题。

description.en: QQ official bot channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets you talk to your DSH sessions from QQ groups and private chats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 官方机器人通道插件，可在 QQ 群和私聊中与 DSH 会话对话。

description.en: Lets you attach images and files when answering ask_user_question cards in DeepSeek Harness, feeding them into the human-in-the-loop reply.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中回答 ask_user_question 卡片时，可附上图片和文件，随人工回复一并提交。

description.en: A DSH Client UI plugin that shows an index of questions on the left edge of the chat and smooth-scrolls to a question on click.
description.zh: DSH客户端UI插件，在聊天区左缘显示问题索引，点击问题可平滑滚动定位到对应消息。

description.en: Adds quick-phrase buttons to the DSH web composer so one click sends 请继续 or any saved phrase to keep a stalled agent working.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页输入框旁添加快捷短语按钮，一键发送“请继续”或自定义短语，让卡住的智能体继续工作。

description.en: Paste a share link to parse articles locally into clean text and cached images, then sync chosen pieces to Obsidian as notes.
description.zh: 粘贴分享链接，在本机把图文解析成干净的正文与缓存图片，并可将选中的文章同步为 Obsidian 笔记。

description.en: Adds a settings card to configure input modalities and reasoning levels for models in the DSH conversation composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话编辑器中添加设置卡片，用于配置各模型的输入模态与推理等级。

description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort selector for dsh third-party relay models by auto-writing missing capability declarations into settings.yaml.
description.zh: 为 dsh 第三方中转模型自动补写推理等级能力声明，在聊天框中提供推理等级选择器。

description.en: Forces deletions to recycle bin, disables risky remove commands, and asks user when storage is full.
description.zh: 强制删除进回收站，禁用危险删除命令，存储满时询问用户。

description.en: Remote access gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: login auth and reverse proxy to loopback server.
description.zh: Remote access gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: login auth + HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback DSH server.

description.en: DSH plugin that lets the agent control remote hosts over SSH, with a Settings host manager, connection reuse and adaptive timeouts.
description.zh: DSH 插件，让智能体通过 SSH 控制远程主机，内置设置页主机管理、连接复用和自适应超时。

description.en: Adds a Restart section to DSH settings that reloads the kernel via HMR and restarts the app shell.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增「重启」分区，可通过 HMR 重载内核并重启应用外壳。

description.en: One-click restart for the DSH desktop (Electron) app, preserving window position, size, maximized state and monitor, and optionally resuming interrupted sessions.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版（Electron）一键重启插件，保留窗口位置、大小、最大化状态与所在显示器，可选重启后自动续上被打断的会话。

description.en: Fixes the DSH right sidebar drag handle drifting off the divider after page zoom by re-anchoring it to the panel's real layout edge.
description.zh: 修复页面缩放后 DSH 右侧栏拖拽手柄偏离分隔线的问题，将其重新锚定到面板的真实布局边缘。

description.en: A DSH plugin list manager providing table view, status filtering, hot enable/disable toggles, config viewing/copying, and bilingual UI.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件总览界面，支持表格视图、状态过滤、热生效启停开关、配置查看与复制，以及中英双语界面。

description.en: Drives a local Saber Translator install from DSH with natural-language tools for books, pages, translation jobs, progress and glossaries.
description.zh: 通过自然语言驱动本机 Saber Translator，完成查书、看页面、排翻译任务、查看进度、控制任务与读写术语表。

description.en: Safe plugin installation skill: audit, one-by-one install, five-level verification, clean uninstall.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装技能：先审查，逐个安装，五级验证，干净卸载。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin that keeps safe config history, guards upgrades, and automatically rolls back on failure.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 插件，提供安全的配置历史、受控升级与失败自动回滚。

description.en: Discover and verify DSH plugins from the GitHub dsh-plugin topic, with trust scores, peer compatibility, and one-click install.
description.zh: 从 GitHub 的 dsh-plugin 主题发现并验证 DSH 插件，提供信任评分、官方兼容性与一键安装。

description.en: 面向模型的「截图」工具插件（DeepSeek Harness，Windows 宿主）。  注册一个 screenshot 工具，让会话里的 AI 能真正「看见」并展示你的屏幕。
Remembers the scroll position of the DSH plugin list so returning from a plugin detail page lands back where you left off instead of jumping to the top.
description.zh: 记住 DSH 插件列表的滚动位置，从插件详情返回时回到原来的位置，不再跳回顶部。

description.en: Search the npm registry for DSH plugins by name fragment and install them directly from the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 npm 注册表中按名称片段搜索 DSH 插件，并可直接从插件页面安装。

description.en: Multi-engine web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness with free AI search rotation, cooldowns, and configurable search providers.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多引擎网页搜索插件，支持免费 AI 搜索轮换、冷却机制及可配置搜索服务商。

description.en: Autonomous virtual office for Amazon FBA and DTC e-commerce, run by a Chief Operator agent with 15 specialists across 7 business divisions.
description.zh: 面向亚马逊FBA与DTC电商的自主虚拟办公室，由首席运营官智能体带领7大部门15位专家协同工作。

description.en: Adds a batch-archive sidebar button to DeepSeek Harness Web, with checkboxes and double confirmation to archive multiple sessions safely.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏新增批量归档按钮，支持勾选多个会话并二次确认后安全归档。

description.en: Displays live DeepSeek Harness session spend in the composer dock, with per-request peak/off-peak pricing and no harness patches.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框停靠栏实时显示会话花费，按请求展示峰谷定价，无需修改 Harness。

description.en: Adds a destructive Session delete action to DSH that removes conversations from disk, plus bulk cleanup of empty Sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加删除会话的破坏性操作，可从磁盘移除对话，并支持批量清理空会话。

description.en: Manages DeepSeek Harness Web sessions with archiving, tagging, relationship graphs, and safe deletion.
description.zh: 管理DeepSeek Harness Web会话，提供归档、标签、关系图和安全删除功能。

description.en: Adds a native session_rename tool so the agent can rename sessions via the Cordis sessionTitle service.
description.zh: 添加原生 session_rename 工具，让智能体可通过 Cordis sessionTitle 服务重命名会话。

description.en: Adds session tags to name a session's state, tint its sidebar title, and show the tag on hover, synced live across windows and devices.
description.zh: 为会话添加标签，可命名会话状态、给侧边栏标题着色并悬停查看标签，支持跨窗口与设备实时同步。

description.en: Pick selected conversation messages and render them locally with Canvas into a PNG share card you can download or copy.
description.zh: 选择指定的对话消息，在本地用 Canvas 渲染成 PNG 分享卡片，可下载或复制。

description.en: A shelf panel to browse, sort, group, toggle and batch-update all your installed DSH plugins, with resumable updates.
description.zh: 一个插件架面板，可浏览、排序、分组、开关并批量更新已安装的 DSH 插件，更新可续传。

description.en: DSH browser skin plugin that adds an opening animation, custom wallpapers and adjustable panel transparency, with settings applied instantly.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器皮肤插件，提供开场动画、自定义壁纸与面板透明度调节，设置即时生效。

description.en: Provides a drawer-style workspace side panel similar to Codex for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供类似 Codex 的抽屉式工作区侧边面板。

description.en: Adds a sidebar manager to DSH that hides, reorders and groups plugin entries into collapsible folders, saved per profile.
description.zh: 为 DSH 左侧栏增加管理功能,可隐藏、排序并将插件入口分组为可折叠文件夹,设置持久保存到 profile。

description.en: Adds a Skills tab to the DSH web UI with enable/disable toggles for each skill.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 Skills 标签页，可对每个技能单独开启或关闭。

description.en: Translates a DSH skill's English description into Chinese with one click and restores the original text whenever needed.
description.zh: 一键将技能英文描述翻译为中文，并可随时还原原文。

description.en: DSH Web skin plugin with 13 colour themes, 12 illustration wallpapers and a desktop pet that can live on Windows.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的换肤插件：13 套配色皮肤、插画壁纸，以及可常驻 Windows 桌面的小桌宠。

description.en: Blocks foreground waiting in DSH agents by rejecting sleep, wait_agent and waiting job_output calls and retrying them as background jobs.
description.zh: 禁止 DSH Agent 前台等待：拒绝 sleep、wait_agent 与阻塞式 job_output，改为后台任务重试，避免会话冻结。

description.en: SSH fleet management for DSH: host inventory, remote command execution, sudo policy, SFTP transfer, approvals and encrypted credentials.
description.zh: DSH 的多服务器 SSH 管理插件：主机清单、远程执行、sudo 策略、SFTP 上传下载、审批与加密凭据。

description.en: Multi-host SSH toolbelt with server registry, /ssh command, remote run/put/get tools, destructive-command guard, secret redaction and audit log.
description.zh: 多主机 SSH 工具集，提供服务器注册表、/ssh 命令、远程 run/put/get、危险命令防护、密钥脱敏和审计日志。

description.en: Ranks DSH plugins by GitHub stars and npm 30-day downloads, showing a popularity leaderboard with resettable sorting and a retained delisted group.
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数与 npm 近 30 天下载量为 DSH 插件排名，提供热度榜单、可重排排序及已跌出插件的保留分组。
