description.en: Appearance kit for DeepSeek Harness: animated deep-space starfield background, Cyberpunk 2077 HUD theme, boot auth sequence, plus a sidebar toggle fix.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观套件：深空动态星幕背景、赛博朋克 2077 HUD 主题、开机鉴权序列，并修复无边框窗口下的侧栏折叠按钮。

description.en: DSH client plugin rendering a centered status bar above the input box that other plugins fill with their own status segments.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件，在输入框上方渲染一条居中状态条，供其它插件注册并展示各自的状态段。

description.en: Manages DSH plugins: update checks, auto-update with snapshot rollback, health checks, duplicate detection and cleanup via a panel and CLI.
description.zh: DSH 插件管家：检查更新、自动升级并支持快照回滚，还能体检、查重和清理垃圾，提供面板与命令行。

description.en: Runs an STM32 workbench inside DSH sessions: Keil AC5 builds, ST-Link/OpenOCD flashing, pin planning and serial monitoring.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话内提供 STM32 工作台：Keil AC5 编译、ST-Link/OpenOCD 烧录、引脚规划与串口调试。

description.en: Analyzes DeepSeek Harness local storage and provides read-only cross-project dependency governance checks.
description.zh: 分析 DeepSeek Harness 本地存储，并提供只读的跨项目依赖治理检查。

description.en: In-harness plugin store for DeepSeek Harness Web with curated catalog and GitHub discovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的内置插件商店，提供精选插件目录并支持从 GitHub 发现插件。

description.en: Adds per-component status dots on DSH plugin cards and shows provider npm package names in the plugin settings pages.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件卡片上直接显示组件子项状态，并在设置页标题下显示提供者 npm 包名。

description.en: Sign in to Kimi, Grok, Antigravity and GLM subscriptions via OAuth so DSH can use them as LLM providers without API keys.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 Kimi、Grok、Antigravity 和 GLM 订阅账号，让 DSH 无需 API Key 即可将其作为 LLM 提供方使用。

description.en: Run commands as root through a masked sudo prompt that keeps the password out of chat, tool arguments, and model context.
description.zh: 通过掩码 sudo 提示以 root 身份执行命令，密码不会进入聊天、工具参数或模型上下文。

description.en: Sidebar switchboard that toggles installed DSH plugins on or off, flags changes needing a Host restart, and relaunches the Host.
description.zh: 侧边栏插件开关面板：一键启停已安装的 DSH 插件，标出需要重启 Host 的改动，并可直接重启。

description.en: Syncs linked local DSH plugins through a secret GitHub gist, with manual push/pull buttons and optional auto-push every 15 seconds.
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub gist 同步本地已链接的 DSH 插件，支持手动推拉按钮和可选的每 15 秒自动推送。

description.en: Search and read take.hk's 1,400+ AI-film news items, daily briefings and topic archives inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索并阅读 take.hk 的 1400+ 条 AI 电影资讯、每日简报和专题档案。

description.en: Caps each DeepSeek Harness turn at a CNY spending limit (default ¥5) and stops the run before the next model request once reached.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 每一轮对话设置人民币花费上限（默认 5 元），达到上限即在下一个模型请求发出前停止本轮。

description.en: Audio reminders for long AI tasks in DeepSeek Harness: beep for subtask completion, ding for turn end.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness长任务提供音频提醒：子任务完成响“嘟”，整轮完成响“叮”。

description.en: Draggable task-radar widget and work panel showing sessions by workspace, sub-agent status, to-dos and token usage, with optional system notifications.
description.zh: 可拖动的任务雷达浮窗与工作面板，按工作区展示会话、子代理状态、待办与 Token 用量，并支持可选系统通知。

description.en: Decompose-and-dispatch preset for DeepSeek Harness: main agent splits tasks, subagents run in parallel then combine results.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness的任务拆解与分发预设：主代理拆解任务，子代理并行执行并汇总结果。

description.en: A liquid-glass task list for DeepSeek Harness with per-task summaries and per-turn digests.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供液态玻璃风格的任务列表，支持逐任务摘要和逐轮摘要。

description.en: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing for DSH Agent Teams, plus a tool letting the main chat delete teammate subagent instances.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体团队提供按成员指定模型与思考强度的路由能力，并允许主对话删除团队成员子智能体实例。

description.en: Auto-detects technical terms in DSH replies, builds a searchable personal dictionary, and shows inline explanations on hover or click.
description.zh: 在 DSH 回复中自动识别专业术语并建立可搜索词典，悬停或点击即可查看解释。

description.en: Adds Codex-style text annotations to DeepSeek Harness chat: select text, add a comment, and it appears as an annotation card in the message.
description.zh: Codex-style text annotation for DeepSeek Harness conversations / 对话文字批注插件

description.en: Adds five themes, each with light and dark palettes, to the DeepSeek Harness Web client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端添加五套主题，每套均含浅色与深色配色。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness plugin that fetches full Baidu Tieba threads with all pages, nested replies, and per-floor images into structured material.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可全量翻页抓取百度贴吧整栋楼，含楼中楼与按楼层取图，输出结构化材料。

description.en: Adds coordinated session and workspace checkpoints with safe rewind, DAG-based forks, and failure reflection to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供会话与工作区检查点、安全回滚、DAG 分支与失败反思能力。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel that renders a markdown todo list and writes checkbox, tag and delete edits back to the file.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 右侧栏待办面板，把 markdown 待办清单渲染成面板，并将勾选、打标签和删除操作写回文件。

description.en: Recursively scans local code for TODO markers and builds a structured checklist with status tracking, Markdown export and a side radar panel.
description.zh: 递归扫描本地代码中的 TODO 标记，生成结构化清单，支持状态管理、Markdown 导出与侧边「TODO 雷达」面板。

description.en: Floating token-audit card for DeepSeek Harness showing daily/monthly/yearly usage, top-5 costly tasks and remaining balance.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浮动 Token 审计卡片，展示日/月/年用量、Top5 高耗任务与账户余额。

description.en: Lightweight, non-intrusive DSH WebUI plugin that traces execution trajectories and shows real-time timing breakdowns of your wait time.
description.zh: 轻量零侵入的 DSH WebUI 插件，实时追踪执行轨迹并可视化等待耗时的时序分布。

description.en: Enforces the Trellis workflow in the DeepSeek Harness with per-turn workflow-state injection and a trellis-start entry gate.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中强制实施 Trellis 工作流：每轮注入工作流状态，并通过 trellis-start 入口门控。

description.en: Read-only audit that probes DSH plugin HTTP routes to check whether they actually enforce authentication fences.
description.zh: 只读审计工具，探测 DSH 插件 HTTP 路由是否真的实现了鉴权栅栏。

description.en: 在 DSH 每轮对话底部显示本轮与会话累计费用：预算/余额提醒、会话计费统计、Excel 导出，人民币/美元双币种。
Adds a searchable question index to DSH's session turn navigation: list all questions, fuzzy search with highlights, click to jump.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话右侧的轮次导航增加可搜索的提问索引：展开全部提问、模糊搜索高亮、点击跳转对应轮次。

description.en: Zooms the entire DSH Web UI from 70% to 160% via Ctrl+wheel, rebindable shortcuts and an inline composer pill, with layout compensation for zoomed-out text.
description.zh: 将整个 DSH Web UI 在 70%–160% 间缩放，支持 Ctrl+滚轮、可重绑定快捷键和输入框旁的百分比小按钮，并补偿布局以在缩小时显示更多每行文字。

description.en: Read-only tool that audits dsh Profile plugin dependencies against npm Registry and GitHub HEAD without modifying anything.
description.zh: 只读审计 dsh Profile 插件依赖的更新情况，对比 npm Registry 与 GitHub HEAD，不做任何改动。

description.en: Adds a Check-updates button to DSH Plugins settings that scans installed bundles for published updates and runtime compatibility.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件设置中新增“检查更新”按钮，扫描已安装插件的已发布更新与运行时兼容性。

description.en: 在 DSH 插件页的可更新卡片上提供就地更新入口：可选版本、悬停查看每个版本的更新说明。
Package-level plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness with update detection and GitHub marketplace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的包级插件管理器，支持更新检测与 GitHub 应用市场。

description.en: Scans your DSH profile for plugins installed from GitHub, compares their versions against upstream, and updates them individually or all at once.
description.zh: 扫描 DSH 配置文件中从 GitHub 安装的插件，对比其版本并支持单个或批量更新。

description.en: DSH web dashboard for API balance, daily/weekly/monthly spend, request counts, token details and trend charts, priced at DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: DSH 网页用量与费用看板：展示余额、今日/本周/本月/累计消费、API 请求次数、token 明细与趋势图，按官方峰谷价估算。

description.en: Zero-egress local usage analytics for DSH: aggregates session events (tool calls, turns, errors) into daily tables with a side panel and HTTP query API.
description.zh: 零出站的 DSH 本地用量分析插件：把会话事件（工具调用、回合、错误）聚合成日表，提供侧栏面板与本地 HTTP 查询接口。

description.en: Turns interview/survey notes into personas, pain points, and opportunity maps.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的垂直用户研究综合插件，通过工具与技能把访谈和问卷记录转成用户画像、痛点和机会地图。

description.en: Security circuit-breaker plugin for DSH providing deterministic runtime execution governance and guardrails.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供确定性运行时执行治理与防护的安全熔断插件。

description.en: Adds a Versions tab to the DSH Plugins page listing installed bundle versions, flagging which can update and linking to the official version section.
description.zh: 为 DSH 插件页新增「版本一览」标签页，列出已安装组合包版本、标出可更新项，并可跳转官方版本区块。

description.en: Adds browser voice dictation to the DSH Web GUI, transcribing speech via Web Speech API and auto-sending or drafting it for the Agent.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端加入浏览器语音听写，用 Web Speech API 转写语音并自动填入或发送给 Agent。

description.en: Minimal Chinese voice-input plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: click mic, speech-to-text appends to input, no auto-send.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的中文语音输入最简插件：点击麦克风识别语音并追加到输入框，不自动发送。

description.en: Upload and crop a local image to set as the web workspace desktop background wallpaper.
description.zh: 上传本地图片并裁剪后，设为 DeepSeek Harness Web 工作区桌面背景壁纸。

description.en: Lets you set your own images or videos as the DeepSeek Harness Web UI background with veil, blur, fill and opacity controls.
description.zh: 用自定义图片或视频作为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 背景，支持遮罩、模糊、填充与分层透明度调节。

description.en: Fetches global weather, multi-day forecasts and air-quality (AQI) data via Open-Meteo, no API key required.
description.zh: 通过 Open-Meteo 获取全球天气、多日预报和空气质量数据，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Registers a Tavily-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness, exposing the tavily-search web seam.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册基于 Tavily 的联网搜索 provider，提供 tavily-search 搜索能力。

description.en: DSH plugin that pushes a Markdown article plus cover image straight into a WeChat Official Account draft box via the official API.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把 Markdown 文章加封面图一键直推到微信公众号草稿箱。

description.en: Publishes single-screen content cards to WePre Next from a dsh agent session.
description.zh: 在 dsh 智能体会话中把单屏内容卡片发布到 WePre Next 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Beautifies the DSH chat UI with an animated whale status bar, a balance granary, peak/off-peak pricing waves, a mini-game and scheduled sending.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话界面添加游动蓝鲸状态条、余额粮仓、峰谷浪花、接零食小游戏与定时发送的美化插件。

description.en: Turns repeatable DSH workflows into reusable skills that are automatically discovered and loaded in each new session.
description.zh: 把重复的 DSH 流程固化为可复用技能，新会话自动发现并加载。

description.en: DSH plugin that archives workspace sessions when their folder disappears and restores them, grouping included, when the folder returns.
description.zh: DSH 插件：当工作区文件夹消失时归档其会话，文件夹恢复时连同分组一并还原。

description.en: Web UI plugin that shows several live DSH sessions at once in a rows-by-columns grid, each pane a fully usable conversation.
description.zh: Web UI 插件，用行列网格同时展示多个实时 DSH 会话，每个窗格都是可交互的真实对话。

description.en: A DSH web desktop pet: an original SVG rabbit-eared girl who changes animations with agent status and speaks a synthesized 'all done' via WebAudio.
description.zh: DSH 网页桌宠：原创 SVG 兔耳少女随 agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时用 WebAudio 实时合成甜美语音说「做完啦」。

description.en: Auto-translates installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions into Simplified Chinese using DSH's built-in LLM, cached locally.
description.zh: 使用 DSH 内置 LLM 将已安装插件的名称与描述自动翻译为简体中文，并缓存到本地。

description.en: Turns each .pluginlet file in the workspace into a sandboxed Conversation View tab, authorized by content hash with writes requiring confirmation.
description.zh: 将工作区中的每个 .pluginlet 文件变成独立的沙箱对话视图标签页，按内容哈希授权，写入需确认。

description.en: Backs up and syncs installed DSH plugins and configurations across devices through Git repositories.
description.zh: 通过 Git 仓库在多台设备间备份并同步已安装的 DSH 插件与配置。

description.en: Adds a 'Plugin Management' tab under DSH Settings → Plugins to browse, add, toggle, and uninstall official and installed plugin bundles.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置→插件中新增「插件管理」标签页，可浏览、添加、开关与卸载官方及已装的插件组合包。

description.en: Plugin titled 'Pluto' with no additional context or description of functionality.
description.zh: 名为 Pluto 的插件，除标题外没有提供任何功能说明或上下文描述。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin named Plutonium with no described functionality beyond its element-themed name.
description.zh: 名为 Plutonium 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件，除钚元素主题的命名外未描述任何具体功能。

description.en: Touch-first phone remote for a DSH host: pair via QR/PIN, browse sessions, send messages, stream replies, and approve tool permissions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 主机的触屏优先手机遥控插件：通过二维码/PIN 配对，查看会话与历史、发送消息、流式接收回复并审批工具权限。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件面板：把 Pocket · H5 预览工作台复用到 DSH（iPhone 17 尺寸/外观预览、真机物理尺寸、手机扫码）。
Save DSH host addresses and PINs once, then switch between hosts and log in automatically from your phone.
description.zh: 在手机上一次性保存多个 DSH 主机地址与 PIN，随时切换并自动登录。

description.en: Poison first aid tool that returns home emergency plans based on parameters.
Identifies pet poisoning and returns first aid care plans based on input parameters.
description.zh: 识别宠物中毒，并根据输入参数返回急救护理方案。

description.en: Provides the Poisson distribution for use in dsh.
Polaris is a capability aggregation layer that discovers, evaluates, and routes DeepSeek Harness skills and MCP tools for optimal execution.
description.zh: 聚合能力层，发现、评估并路由 DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 工具，选择最优执行方式。

description.en: Detects refusal responses inside streaming LLM output and automatically retries while keeping the live stream intact.
description.zh: 在流式 LLM 输出中检测拒答并自动重试，同时保持流式传输不中断。

description.en: Reads a policy brief outline and checks its completeness and internal consistency, covering sections, evidence, sources, data cutoff and figure freshness.
description.zh: 读取政策简报大纲并校验其完整性与内部一致性，涵盖各节要点、证据、来源、数据截止日期及图表时效。

description.en: Read-only install doctor that snapshots capabilities, asserts tarball integrity and diagnoses plugin installation issues.
description.zh: 只读安装诊断工具，可生成能力快照、校验 tarball 完整性并诊断插件安装问题。

description.en: Read-only linter that scans AGENTS.md, SKILL.md and plugin skills for conflicting, duplicated, vague or dangerous rules before they reach the model.
description.zh: 只读规则检查插件，在进入模型上下文前找出 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 与插件技能中冲突、重复、模糊或危险的规则。

description.en: Offline content-addressed proof that temporary DSH policy waivers stayed within approved bounds.
description.zh: 离线内容寻址证明，确认临时 DSH 策略豁免未超出批准范围

description.en: A Pomodoro timer plugin for the DSH Web GUI with a draggable floating window that persists without an open session, plus an optional dock pill.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web GUI 番茄钟插件，提供可拖动悬浮窗（无需打开会话也保持显示），并附带可选的停靠胶囊。

description.en: A distraction-free Pomodoro focus timer that lives in the DSH sidebar with focus/break rounds, goals, today's stats and a completion log.
description.zh: 一款免打扰的番茄钟专注计时器，位于 DSH 侧边栏，支持专注/休息轮次、每轮目标、今日统计与完成记录。

description.en: A pomodoro timer for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock that rewards each finished focus session with a collectible blind box.
description.zh: 一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 输入框停靠区的番茄钟，每次完成专注后开启一个可收集盲盒。

description.en: A pomodoro timer for the DSH right sidebar with a draggable edge handle, one-shot or cycle counting, and selectable WebAudio cues.
description.zh: 一个用于 DSH 右侧边栏的番茄钟，支持可拖动边缘把手、单次或循环计时，以及可选的 WebAudio 提示音。

description.en: A Pomodoro timer in the DSH right sidebar that runs configurable focus/break cycles and keeps counting across tab switches or app restarts.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏番茄闹钟：可配置专注/休息循环，切 tab 或重启应用后计时依然准确。

description.en: Pomodoro timer with four-quadrant task sorting and a pet that gains EXP as you complete focus rounds, stored locally.
description.zh: 番茄钟插件，支持四象限任务整理，专注完成后宠物获得经验值，数据保存在本地。

description.en: Pomodoro timer plugin for the DSH Web UI that adds a sidebar focus/short-break/long-break page and a countdown pill beside the composer.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟插件：在侧栏提供专注/短休息/长休息整页计时，并在输入框旁显示倒计时胶囊。

description.en: A persistent Pomodoro timer in the conversation composer dock with focus/short-break/long-break cycles, a countdown ring and daily stats.
description.zh: 在会话输入框下方的环境栏常驻一个番茄钟，提供专注/短休息/长休息循环、圆环倒计时和今日统计。

description.en: Adds session-completion reminders to DeepSeek Harness via a sidebar bell, system notification, in-app toast and chime.
description.zh: 通过侧边栏铃铛、系统通知、应用内提示和提示音，为 DeepSeek Harness 添加会话完成提醒。

description.en: Zero-dependency DSH plugin showing modal desktop popups for approvals, questions/plan reviews, and turn completion.
description.zh: 零依赖 DSH 插件，用模态桌面弹窗提示审批、提问/计划评审与回合完成。

description.en: Read-only map of listening ports, owning services, and Caddy routes so you can see what is exposed on a server.
description.zh: 只读的端口、服务与 Caddy 路由映射，帮助你查看服务器上暴露的内容。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin for a live A-share quote dashboard plus an OTC fund board with watchlist P&L, alerts and AI analysis.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，提供 A 股实时行情看板与场外基金看板，含自选股盈亏、预警与 AI 分析。

description.en: Remote portal for DeepSeek Harness that adds a unified authenticated entry point and forwarding layer over frps/EasyTier tunnels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的远程门户，在 frps/EasyTier 隧道之上提供统一入口、鉴权与转发。

description.en: Portrait photography tool that returns photographic composition plans based on parameters.
Plugin for Portugal country with no documented capabilities.
瑜伽体式选择工具，按参数返回拉伸方案，纯 Node 实现无网络依赖。
Suggests update/post frequency by precisely calculating from parameters and returning detailed results.
Poster workshop for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a copy/style editor with a live poster preview, four ratios, four palettes and PNG/SVG export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 海报工坊：左侧栏入口打开文案与样式编辑器，实时预览海报，支持 4 种画幅、4 套配色并导出 PNG/SVG。

description.en: Upload files and folders directly into a conversation, with images as message blocks and text into the composer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer, folders land by directory struct

description.en: Postman-style HTTP workbench for DSH with collections, environments, a request builder, response inspector, cURL import/export and an agent HTTP tool.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Postman 风格的 HTTP 工作台：集合、环境、请求构建器、响应检查器、cURL 导入导出，以及 agent 的 HTTP 工具。

description.en: Returns calligraphy learning plans based on writing posture parameters. Pure Node implementation, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据执笔坐姿参数返回书法学习计划，纯 Node 实现，无需网络连接。

description.en: Posture self-assessment tool that returns yoga stretching plans based on parameters.
description.zh: 体态自评工具，根据参数返回瑜伽拉伸计划。

description.en: Hot pot base selection tool that returns a hot pot gathering plan based on parameters, pure Node no network.
description.zh: 根据参数选择火锅锅底并返回火锅聚餐方案，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Returns balcony container gardening plan based on parameters. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回阳台容器种植方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds a power button to the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar to shut down or restart DSH.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏添加电源按钮，可一键关闭 DSH 或重启 Web 界面。

description.en: A draggable one-press button that stops the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI service directly from the interface.
description.zh: 一个可拖动的按钮，一键停止 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 服务。

description.en: Reload, restart, or shut down the DeepSeek Harness desktop app directly from inside its window.
description.zh: 在窗口内直接重载、重启或关闭 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用。

description.en: Adds Close and Restart buttons for DSH in Settings > General, plus an opt-out auto-close that waits until all browser pages stop beaconing.
description.zh: 在“设置 > 通用”中加入关闭/重启 DSH 的按钮，并提供可选的自动关闭，等待所有浏览器页面停止心跳后再退出。

description.en: Reads one metering period for a line or transformer district and checks energy balance, declared loss energy/rate, metering-point sums and phase unbalance.
description.zh: 读取一条线路或台区的一个计量周期，校验电量平衡、申报线损电量与线损率、计量点合计及三相不平衡。

description.en: Modular exponentiation (mod power) tool, pure Node.js implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 用纯 Node.js 实现模幂运算，计算底数的指数次幂对模数取余，无网络依赖。

description.en: Shows real-time power draw, temperature and fan speed for Apple Silicon Macs in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏实时显示 Apple Silicon Mac 的功耗、温度与风扇转速。

description.en: Power outage response tool: calculates based on parameters and returns clear advice, implemented in Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算停电应对方案并返回明确建议，用 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: A Node-based tool that calculates power-saving parameters and provides clear suggestions with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 基于 Node 的工具，用于计算省电参数并给出清晰的省电建议，运行时无需网络依赖。

description.en: Validates electrical power work tickets: required fields, ticket type, physically possible time order, exclusive roles, and safety/permit text terms.
description.zh: 校验电力工作票：必填字段、工作票种类、签发/许可/终结时间顺序、角色互斥及安全技术措施文本。

description.en: Batch-injects real PowerPoint entrance animations and slide transitions into .pptx files by writing OOXML timing trees directly.
description.zh: 直接写入 OOXML 时间轴，为 .pptx 批量注入真正的 PowerPoint 进入动画与幻灯片切换。

description.en: Displays GitHub Actions check status and progress for open pull requests in a sidebar footer.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示打开的拉取请求的 GitHub Actions 检查状态和进度。

description.en: Deterministic write gate for DeepSeek Harness that applies scope policy and residue scans at the moment of each write, moving the CI gate into the session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性写入闸门，在每次写入时执行范围策略与残留扫描，把 CI 闸门搬进会话内。

description.en: Read-only GitHub PR inbox in the DSH sidebar showing PRs you authored, need to review, or merged, reusing your local gh login.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏只读展示我提的、待我审的、我合并的 GitHub PR，绑定当前工作区仓库并复用本机 gh 登录。

description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a pull request panel for viewing PRs inside your workflow.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，提供拉取请求（PR）面板，方便在工作流中查看 PR。

description.en: Turns a rough idea into a clarified PRD, a ralph-compatible prd.json and an acceptance checklist inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中把粗略想法先澄清、再生成 PRD、ralph 兼容的 prd.json 与验收清单。

description.en: Evidence-backed working memory for agents: a cited ledger of what worked, built from existing session logs.
description.zh: Evidence-backed working memory for DeepSeek Harness: a cited ledger of what already worked in this workspace, built from the session log you already have. No index, no model, no capture step.

description.en: Deterministic pre-claim gate that checks git commit, push, or tag claims of verification against what the DeepSeek Harness session actually ran.
description.zh: 确定性的预声明门禁：将 git commit、push 或 tag 中声称已验证的内容，与 DeepSeek Harness 会话实际运行的操作进行核对。

description.en: Injects a three-stage delivery-quality rule set into the DSH agent system prompt: obligation intake, four-layer output discipline, pre-delivery self-check.
description.zh: 把“前置技能”的三段交付质量规则注入 DSH agent 系统提示：收单拆义务、四层输出纪律、交付前自检，本地生效零依赖。

description.en: Static preflight checks for DSH plugin packages that catch bundle, lifecycle-script and file-layout mistakes before review.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件包的静态预检工具，在送审前捕获打包补丁、生命周期脚本与文件布局等错误。

description.en: A DSH skill that traces how a situation came to be, what conditions hold it up now, and what it will turn into next.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 技能：回望一件事如何变成现在这样、现在靠什么条件成立、下一步会变成什么。

description.en: A dsh agent preset bundle that applies the GPT-6/Codex Astra persona to the standard toolset, plus a reference skill and slim subagent persona.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 智能体预设插件，将 GPT-6/Codex Astra 人格应用到标准工具集，并附带参考技能与精简子智能体人格。

description.en: DSH plugin that hot-switches a running session to another agent preset and remembers the choice across restarts.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在会话启动后热切换到另一个智能体预设，并在重启后保留该选择。

description.en: Regenerates dsh agent-preset patches from a small editable rule file on every start, so presets never go stale after updates.
description.zh: 每次启动依据可编辑的规则文件重新生成 dsh 代理预设补丁，升级后预设不再过期。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset that scaffolds standardized, runnable project skeletons with templates and a strict init flow.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Agent 预设，用架构师人设、六套模板资产和严格初始化流程，从零搭建标准化、可运行、可验证的项目骨架。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：按 Agent preset 限制每个 Agent 可见的工具，保留全局 provider 挂载；基于 agent/created 与 ctx.tools.restrict()。
Automatically archives blank zombie sessions in DeepSeek Harness, warns on non-blank ones, and audits dependencies before removal.
description.zh: 自动归档DeepSeek Harness中的空白僵尸会话，对非空白会话发出警告，并在删除前进行依赖审计。

description.en: Browser-side plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages preset visibility, ordering, and persistence in the UI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浏览器端插件，管理预设显示、排序和持久化。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents headless-browser verification tools to preview and fix what they build.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供无头浏览器验证工具与内置自检技能，用于打开、预览并修复其构建的页面。

description.en: Previews Blender .blend files in DSH via headless GLB export, cached WebGL viewport, and scene statistics.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中预览 Blender .blend 文件：无头导出 GLB、带缓存的 WebGL 视口并显示场景统计。

description.en: Adds video and audio preview to the DSH right-sidebar document preview, with HTTP Range streaming and desktop seek support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧边栏文档预览增加视频和音频预览，支持 HTTP Range 流式播放与桌面端进度拖动。

description.en: Circle a region of an image or PDF preview, or quote selected text, straight into the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在图片或 PDF 预览上圈选区域，或将选中文本引用到 DSH 输入框。

description.en: Renders STL 3D meshes in the browser with a dependency-free WebGL viewport, parsing binary and ASCII files and showing print statistics.
description.zh: 在浏览器中渲染 STL 三维网格，无依赖 WebGL 视口，支持二进制/ASCII 解析并显示打印统计信息。

description.en: Dark-mode reading theme for DSH's right-sidebar document previews (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel), with one-click light/dark toggle.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧边栏的文档预览（PDF、Word、PPT、Excel）提供深色阅读配色，支持一键浅/深切换。

description.en: A DSH header chip that shows whether the DeepSeek API is in peak or half-price billing, with a countdown to the next period flip.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 头部小组件，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于高峰期还是半价期，并倒计时到下次切换。

description.en: Offline content-addressed proof of pseudonymous authority binding across DSH execution surfaces
description.zh: 离线提供基于内容寻址的证明，用于跨 DSH 执行面绑定假名主体权限。

description.en: Audits a principle library for ID collisions, legacy IDs, missing causal statements/boundaries/evidence, duplicates, stale entries, and coverage gaps.
description.zh: 审计原则库：检查 ID 冲突、旧 ID、缺失因果陈述/边界/反例/证据、重复项、状态与置信度不一致、过期条目和维度覆盖缺口。

description.en: Adds a scissors button to the DSH input box that freezes all monitors, crops a dragged region, and inserts it into the prompt as an image.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框加一个剪刀按钮，冻结全部显示器的画面，拖框裁剪后作为图片插入提示词框并另存 PNG。

description.en: Provides two-level UI mode for DeepSeek Harness, switching between simplified and native views with plain-language tool cards.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简化与原生两档界面模式切换，工具卡片以白话显示，降低上手门槛。

description.en: Local privacy gateway that masks personal data in chat messages and builds redacted CSV/XLSX copies before anything reaches the AI.
description.zh: 本地隐私网关：在数据发送给 AI 前，对聊天内容做脱敏，并生成 CSV/XLSX 的脱敏副本。

description.en: Send-time privacy reminder for DeepSeek Harness that detects phone numbers, ID numbers, card numbers and API keys, offering one-click masking.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 发送前隐私提醒：检测手机号、身份证号、银行卡号和 API 密钥，并支持一键打码。

description.en: Local-first privacy shield that keeps sensitive plaintext on-device, sends placeholders to the model, and restores real values in transcripts.
description.zh: 本地优先的隐私护盾：明文保留在本地，仅向模型发送占位符，并在对话记录中还原真实值。

description.en: Custom wallpaper backgrounds for the DeepSeek Harness UI using local images, GIFs, videos, gradients or solid colors, all stored locally.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面提供自定义壁纸背景，支持本地图片、GIF、视频、渐变或纯色，所有内容均保存在本机。

description.en: Development source adding incognito conversations and reversible context selection to DeepSeek Harness; not installable on stock DSH yet.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加隐私会话与可逆上下文选择的开发源码，目前尚不能在原版 DSH 上安装使用。

description.en: A DSH skill bundle that makes AI coding assistants check official standards, match the scenario, and spot gaps before acting.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 技能包，让 AI 编码助手动手前先查正规做法、看清场景取舍、找出与标准的差距。

description.en: Returns a facial skin-care plan based on input parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回面部问题肌护理方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Backs up and restores DSH profile configuration only, excluding node_modules, with archive path checks and force-backup support.
description.zh: 仅备份和恢复 DSH 配置资料，排除 node_modules，支持归档路径检查与强制备份。

description.en: Backs up a DeepSeek Harness profile's configuration to a secret GitHub Gist and syncs it back, with a settings page and config_backup agent tool.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 配置文件备份到私有 GitHub Gist 并支持同步恢复，提供设置页与 config_backup 代理工具。

description.en: Batch-delete sessions from DSH sidebar with header button and row checkboxes, including a silent self-healing patch.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在侧边栏通过顶部按钮和每行复选框批量删除会话，并静默自愈槽位补丁。

description.en: Writes your profile nickname, bio and tagline from a persona prompt, picks an avatar, and fills your GitHub profile page with dry-run previews and confirmation.
description.zh: 根据人设需求生成昵称、简介和标语，挑选头像并填入你的 GitHub 资料页，支持试运行预览与写入前确认。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that shows estimated task progress and remaining time beside the input box, using multi-signal estimation with optional LLM refinement.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，在输入框左侧显示任务预估进度与剩余时间，采用三路融合估算并可选 LLM 精修。

description.en: Local-first visual workbench mapping DSH projects, skills, sessions, runtimes, and artifacts in one calm view.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 可视化工作台，将项目、技能、会话、运行时和产物集中在一张清晰地图中。

description.en: Adds a colorful sidebar tag wall of recent projects whose numbered tags unfold into date, summary, hours, cost and next steps on hover.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加彩色项目标签墙，编号标签悬停即可展开日期、摘要、工时、费用和下一步计划。

description.en: Registers and dashboards your repositories with auto-discovery, multi-node scanning and scheduled WeChat status reports.
description.zh: 为代码仓库提供登记与仪表盘，支持自动发现、多节点扫描和定时微信汇报。

description.en: Structured plugin to turn vague ideas into clear requirements and reusable project structure documents via guided Q&A.
description.zh: 通过持续问答，将模糊想法梳理为清晰需求与项目结构，生成可复用文档，助力项目初始化。

description.en: Jira-like agent-native project management plugin for DSH workspaces, managing work items, workflows, and task graphs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工作区提供类似 Jira 的智能体原生项目管理，管理工作项、工作流和任务图。

description.en: Provides long-term, cross-project memory for coding agents via a project-portfolio skill and markdown-based status/log tools.
description.zh: 为编码智能体提供长期跨项目记忆，基于项目档案技能和Markdown状态/日志工具。

description.en: Starts a project's services in a real PTY with one click, streams live output, and saves each run's log to disk for the agent.
description.zh: 一键在真实 PTY 中启动项目服务，实时流式输出，并将每次运行日志保存到磁盘供代理读取。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin for browsing, creating, editing and deleting project-level and global skill files, showing which skills are active per discovery tier.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏插件，可浏览、新建、编辑与删除项目级和全局技能文件，并按发现层级显示当前会话生效的技能。

description.en: Attach extra folders to a DSH workspace with aliases and shared read/write/exec permissions.
description.zh: 将额外文件夹附加到 DSH 工作区，支持别名和共享的读/写/执行权限。

description.en: Supervises DSH multi-agent projects with standing rules, parallel teammate dialogs, and a web supervisor panel.
description.zh: 通过常驻规则、并行队友对话和 Web 监管面板来管理 DSH 多智能体项目。

description.en: Warms up DSH projections via chunked live-session warmup and fork cache backfill to prevent event-loop stalls.
description.zh: 通过分块预热实时会话并回填 fork 缓存来预热 DSH 投影，避免事件循环阻塞导致 signal timed out 超时

description.en: Desktop plugin that runs a read-only review of execution contracts with a secondary model and ships a prompt/promote skill.
description.zh: 桌面插件：调用次要模型对执行契约进行只读审查，并提供 prompt/promote 技能。

description.en: Assigns per-model system prompts in DeepSeek Harness via the official system-prompt seam.
description.zh: 通过官方系统提示词接缝，为 DeepSeek Harness 中的每个模型设置独立系统提示词。

description.en: Sidebar prompt assistant that turns a one-line Chinese idea into ready-to-use text-to-image, image-editing or model-native English prompts.
description.zh: 侧边栏提示词助手：把一句中文变成可直接使用的文生图、图像编辑或模型原生英文提示词。

description.en: Measures the composition of your system prompt and reorders its sections so the operating protocol precedes the rule block.
description.zh: 分析系统提示词的组成，并将操作协议调整到规则块之前。

description.en: Save frequently used prompts in a prompt book and insert any of them into the composer with a single click from a round toolbar button.
description.zh: 把常用提示词保存到提示词簿，点击编辑器工具栏的圆形按钮即可一键插入。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button to the DSH web composer that rewrites your prompt in structured or light mode with an original-versus-enhanced preview.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加闪光按钮，可用结构化或轻量模式重写提示词，并对比原文与增强结果。

description.en: Hashes and baselines the system-prompt sections each plugin contributes to DeepSeek Harness, failing loudly on silent rewrites.
description.zh: 对每个插件向 DeepSeek Harness 贡献的系统提示词片段进行哈希与基线固化，静默改写会立即报错。

description.en: A chip beside the DSH model selector that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt using the session's own model.
description.zh: 位于 DSH 模型选择器旁的按钮，可用当前会话模型将草稿一键改写为结构化提示词。

description.en: Adds a Sparkle button to the DeepSeek Harness composer that rewrites drafts into executable prompts with undo and diff.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器中添加 Sparkle 按钮，通过 LLM 将草稿重写为可执行提示词，支持撤销与差异对比。

description.en: Adds an Enhance Prompt button to DeepSeek Harness that uses an auxiliary LLM call to rewrite drafts into structured prompts, with loading, retry and revert.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加「增强提示词」按钮，通过一次辅助 LLM 调用将草稿改写为结构化提示词，支持加载态、失败重试与一键回退。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement that runs on your already-configured DeepSeek model, keeping drafts private with no third-party service.
description.zh: 一键增强提示词，运行在你已配置的 DeepSeek 模型上，无需第三方服务，草稿不会离开本地环境。

description.en: Composer plugin that uses the harness LLM to rewrite prompt drafts, review the result, or replace the draft directly.
description.zh: Composer 提示词优化插件：通过 Harness LLM 重写草稿、审阅结果或直接替换草稿。

description.en: Prompt history plugin for dsh web — browse past prompts with arrow keys and fill back into the composer.
description.zh: dsh 网页的提示词历史插件：用上下键浏览历史提示词并回填输入框。

description.en: Voyager-style prompt library for DeepSeek Harness with reusable prompt formulas, one-click copying and conversation folders.
description.zh: Voyager 风格提示词库，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用提示词公式、一键复制和会话文件夹管理。

description.en: A curated prompt library for DeepSeek Harness offering reusable task prompts, Skill methods and draft-safe AI prompt optimization.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的精选提示词库，包含可复用任务提示词、Skill 方法与草稿安全的 AI 提示词优化。

description.en: Adds an "Optimize prompt" button left of the send button that rewrites the composer draft in place using the session's own model, undoable in one step.
description.zh: 在输入框发送按钮左侧添加「优化提示词」按钮，用当前会话自己的模型原地改写草稿，一次撤销即可还原。

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts it back in the input box, locally and without sending.
description.zh: 在输入框旁添加一个按钮，将草稿改写为结构化提示词并放回输入框，全程本地运行、不会发送。

description.en: Rewrites composer input into a precise prompt before the model sees it, using one cheap side call on the session's own route.
description.zh: 在模型看到之前，将输入框中的内容改写成精准提示词，仅通过会话自身路由发起一次低成本调用。

description.en: A magic-wand button beside the DSH input box rewrites your prompt draft and shows a side-by-side diff; nothing is written back until you click Apply.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁加一个魔法棒按钮，一键把草稿改写为更清晰的提示词，左右对比后点击「采用」才写回输入框。

description.en: Prompt picker that injects multiple selectable system prompts into the composer, with per-row scopes for both, main, and sub agents.
description.zh: 提示词选择器，可在输入框注入多条可选系统提示词，并支持 both/main/sub 分行作用域。

description.en: Rewrites rough prompts into polished, well-formed prompts, showing an overlay preview before writing the result into the input box (never auto-sends).
description.zh: 把粗糙提示词改写为规范提示词，浮层预览确认后写入输入框，全程不自动发送。

description.en: A DSH composer control that reforges a rough draft into a precise, well-engineered prompt with one-click revert.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 输入框控件，可将粗糙草稿重铸为精确的提示词，并支持一键还原。

description.en: Zero-token prompt lint that flags missing output format, constraints, acceptance criteria and context in your draft, then fills those gaps in one click.
description.zh: 零 token 的提示词检查：指出草稿缺失的输出格式、约束、验收标准和上下文，并一键补齐这些缺口。

description.en: Saves reusable prompts in the composer toolbar with search, {{variable}} filling, insert or whole-box replace, and a 3-day recycle bin.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行保存常用提示词，支持搜索、{{变量}}填充、插入或整框替换，并带默认保留3天的回收站。

description.en: Adds a star button to the DSH composer that optimizes prompts with two sliders, model switching, and 11 toggleable rules.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加星芒按钮，一键优化提示词，支持两个滑块、模型切换和 11 条可开关规则。

description.en: Adds ↑/↓ history recall, Ctrl+↑ search and ghost-text prompt predictions to the DSH composer, never auto-sending.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供 ↑/↓ 历史回滚、Ctrl+↑ 搜索和灰色幽灵文字预测下一句，绝不自动发送。

description.en: Adds a one-click button beside the DSH composer that rewrites rough drafts into structured, optimized prompts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁提供一键按钮，把草稿改写为结构化的优化提示词。

description.en: Prompt rewrite workbench for DeepSeek Harness with four rewrite modes, cancellable streaming output, and token-level before/after diff.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的提示词重写工作台，支持四种重写模式、可取消流式输出和令牌级前后对比。

description.en: DSH plugin that localizes the system prompt into Simplified Chinese and trims guidance to the session's visible tools, keeping tool schemas in English.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把系统提示词本地化为简体中文，并按会话当前可见工具裁剪指引，保留英文工具 schema。

description.en: Estimates property tax or property fees with parameter-based precise calculation, returns detailed results, pure Node without network.
description.zh: 根据参数精确估算物业费或房产税并返回详细结果，纯Node实现无需联网

description.en: Reads a query and complaint register and checks its dates, deadline compliance, status vocabulary and unique query numbers.
description.zh: 读取质疑与投诉台账，校验日期记录、答复期限、状态用语和编号唯一性。

description.en: Pick elements on your live prototype page in DSH Desktop and annotate them so the Agent makes precise frontend edits.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 中直接点选原型页面元素并写批注，让 Agent 精确修改前端代码。

description.en: Adds per-provider request headers to the DeepSeek Harness Models settings page, expanding ${sessionId} per conversation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型设置页为各提供商配置请求头，并按会话展开 ${sessionId}。

description.en: Sets up BharatCode and OpenAI-compatible model providers alongside ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中配置 BharatCode 与 OpenAI 兼容模型提供商，并接入 ChatGPT 和 GitHub Copilot 订阅。

description.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness model providers using Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscriptions.
description.zh: 使用Claude Pro/Max或ChatGPT Plus/Pro订阅登录DeepSeek Harness模型提供商。

description.en: Provider-grouped model picker for the DSH composer — shows "provider · model", and every provider row has an edit button that jumps to Settings → Models.
A preflight tool that detects and fixes request-dialect incompatibilities between custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在真实任务失败前，检测并修复自定义OpenAI兼容端点与DeepSeek Harness之间的请求方言差异。

description.en: Shows a DeepSeek peak/off-peak time badge in the DSH input toolbar, visible only when a DeepSeek model is selected.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段徽章，仅在选中 DeepSeek 模型时出现。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds official-channel capabilities (settings, RPC, module loading) to custom LLM providers without per-model config.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，为自定义 LLM 供应方补齐官方能力（设置、RPC、模块加载），开箱即用。

description.en: Adds a chip in the DSH composer showing which provider the current model belongs to, stepping aside for providers other plugins already own.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框右下角补充显示当前模型所属供应商的芯片；若供应商已被其他插件接管则自动让位。

description.en: Manages DeepSeek providers with on/off switches, model search, and inline renaming.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供供应商启用/停用开关、模型搜索和就地重命名功能。

description.en: Adds live model catalogs for OpenCode Go/Zen, OpenAI Codex and OpenDesign to DSH, with per-model switches, sign-in and subscription balances.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenCode Go/Zen、OpenAI Codex 与 OpenDesign 的实时模型目录，含逐模型开关、登录和订阅额度。

description.en: Injects HTTP/SOCKS proxy settings into process.env so DeepSeek Harness plugin installs use the proxy.
description.zh: 将 HTTP/SOCKS 代理设置注入 process.env，使 DeepSeek Harness 插件安装（pnpm/git）走代理。

description.en: Displays real-time mihomo/proxy status (node, latency, run state, port) in DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页实时显示本地 mihomo 代理的状态，包括当前节点、延迟、运行状态和端口。

description.en: Switches between proxy configurations inside DSH, based on the plugin name; README currently shows only badges and a title.
description.zh: 根据插件名称，用于在 DSH 中切换代理配置；README 目前只有标题和徽章。

description.en: Hot-switch dsh outbound proxy (direct/system/saved HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5) from settings instantly, no dsh restart needed.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置中即时热切换出站代理（直连/系统/已保存的 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS5），无需重启 dsh。

description.en: Provides plant pruning and care guidance based on parameters, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数提供植物修剪与养护指导，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Renders standard diff cards in the DSH Web GUI for edit/write calls made inside PTC run_code programs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中为 PTC 模式 run_code 内的 edit/write 调用渲染标准 diff 卡片。

description.en: Host plugin that restores line numbers and a caret code frame to DSH PTC run_code parse-error messages so models can see exactly where syntax failed.
description.zh: Host 插件，为 DSH PTC run_code 的解析错误补回行号与代码框，让模型能直接看到语法出错的位置。

description.en: Exposes DSH's owner-scoped PTY seam as four protocol-agnostic tools (pty_open/send/tail/close) plus a ctx.pty consumer facade.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的 owner 级 PTY 接口暴露为四个协议无关工具（pty_open/send/tail/close）以及 ctx.pty 消费门面。

description.en: DSH public-access plugin that toggles a Cloudflare tunnel from settings, copies a tokenized public link and QR code, and bridges LAN access.
description.zh: DSH 公网访问插件：在设置页一键启停 Cloudflare 隧道，复制带 token 的公网链接与二维码，并内置局域网桥。

description.en: Makes loopback-only DSH plugins (bili, reasoning-effort, skill-explorer) work behind a public domain and reverse proxy, gated by DSH login.
description.zh: 让仅支持回环地址的 DSH 插件（bili、reasoning-effort、skill-explorer）在公网域名和反向代理下正常工作，并由 DSH 登录保护。

description.en: Registers a user-only /publish skill to sequentially publish XDSP front-end npm modules.
description.zh: 注册仅用户可用的 /publish 技能，用于按顺序发布 XDSP 前端 npm 模块。

description.en: Adds a pull-up-to-send gesture to the DSH composer with drag-to-cancel, drag-away-to-void, and a FLIP flight animation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框增加上拉发送手势，支持拖回取消、拖离会话作废，并带有 FLIP 飞行动画。

description.en: Music visualiser for the DeepSeek Harness turn-navigation rail: bars grow and thicken with system audio (WASAPI loopback), geometry only, no admin rights.
Punycode conversion tool for encoding/decoding internationalized domain names
description.zh: 将国际化域名在 Unicode 与 Punycode 之间进行编码和解码转换。

description.en: Permanently deletes archived DeepSeek Harness conversations, removing the stored log, projection cache, archive mark and workspace membership.
description.zh: 永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 中已归档的对话，同时清除存储日志、投影缓存、归档标记和工作区归属。

description.en: Water purifier purchase advisor that returns kitchen appliance selection options based on parameters, pure Node no network.
description.zh: 根据参数返回净水器等厨房电器的选购方案，纯 Node 实现，无需联网。

description.en: Intercepts git commit/push to scan for privacy leaks and secrets, requesting approval and managing a whitelist before upload.
description.zh: 在 git 提交/推送前进行隐私与敏感信息检查，请求用户批准并管理白名单后再上传。

description.en: Hold a key to dictate into DSH and release to auto-transcribe, with a per-platform hotkey chosen in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 按住按键即可在 DSH 中说话，松手自动转写；可在插件设置页按平台选择快捷键。

description.en: Decorates the shell executor so every pwsh tool call pins the Windows console code page to UTF-8 (65001) and enables Python UTF-8 mode.
description.zh: 为 shell 执行器加装饰，让每次 pwsh 工具调用都把 Windows 控制台代码页固定为 UTF-8（65001），并启用 Python UTF-8 模式。

description.en: Guard plugin that rejects shell text I/O commands in pwsh, bash, and ops_bash, steering the agent to read/grep/glob tools instead.
description.zh: 守卫插件，在 pwsh、bash 和 ops_bash 中拒绝 shell 文本读写命令，引导代理改用 read/grep/glob 工具。

description.en: Persistent PowerShell (pwsh_run) session tool for DeepSeek Harness, plus a C shim giving the bash tool a real write boundary under WSL.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 PowerShell 会话工具（pwsh_run），并附带 C shim 在 WSL 下为 bash 工具建立真正的写入边界。

description.en: DSH plugin that guards pwsh_script and run_argv against PowerShell command-string quoting errors on Windows.
description.zh: DSH 插件，为 pwsh_script 和 run_argv 提供结构化防护，避免 Windows 上 PowerShell 命令字符串的引号转义错误。

description.en: Python/Django production-report doctor that parses tracebacks, pytest, migrations, N+1 SQL, django checks and celery output into structured diagnoses.
description.zh: 面向 Python/Django 的生产报错诊断工具，将 traceback、pytest、迁移、N+1 SQL、django checks 与 celery 输出解析为结构化诊断。

description.en: Fetches the latest version of PyPI packages in real time via a pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 通过纯 Node 实现实时获取 PyPI 包的最新版本号。

description.en: DSH plugin that forces the agent to run all code execution and data processing through the python tool, with a tool guard blocking bash without exception.
description.zh: DSH 插件：强制 Agent 所有代码执行与数据处理都走 python 工具，并由工具守卫无例外地拦截 bash。

description.en: Adds question/answer jump navigation and collapsible code blocks to the DeepSeek Harness web chat interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面添加问答双轴跳转与代码块折叠功能。

description.en: Adds a configurable timeout to DSH approval requests, auto-rejecting when no response to avoid blocking tasks.
description.zh: 为 DSH 审批请求添加可配置超时，超时未响应时自动拒绝，避免任务被阻塞。

description.en: Adds a comprehensive 'better config' settings page for DeepSeek Harness with centralized access to all configuration options.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加一个更完善的设置页面，集中访问所有配置选项。

description.en: Registers qBittorrent WebAPI v2 as native DSH tools to list and inspect torrents, triage stuck downloads, and apply guarded mutations.
description.zh: 将 qBittorrent WebAPI v2 注册为 DSH 原生工具，可列出与查看种子、排查卡住的下载，并执行受保护的小幅变更操作。

description.en: Links Harness AI to your Qingshi diary and family-tree account to look up identity, life records and relatives, and draft new entries.
description.zh: 让 Harness 中的 AI 现场查询青史小程序里的生涯记录与族谱，回答身份、经历和亲属关系，并起草新记录。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that shows Qiniu Cloud per-model token costs and monthly resource-pack quota usage in Settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供七牛云用量展示：各模型 token 花费与资源包剩余额度。

description.en: Adds a local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness with document CRUD, keyword search, and RPC/API access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加本地知识库，支持文档增删改查、关键词搜索以及 RPC/API 访问。

description.en: Ingests QMS non-conformance reports, resolves batch aliases, evaluates impact, and tracks CAPA and 8D corrective-action state.
description.zh: 接收QMS不合格报告，解析批次别名，评估影响，并跟踪CAPA与8D纠正措施状态。

description.en: Tool for estimating peak QPS (queries per second) with parameter-based precise calculation and detailed results.
description.zh: 根据参数精确估算峰值QPS（每秒查询数）并给出详细计算结果的工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that bridges DeepSeek Harness to a local QQ agent, so you can dispatch tasks, approve commands or file writes, and get progress reports inside QQ.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机 QQ agent，可在 QQ 里派活、审批命令或写文件并收到阶段进度报告。

description.en: Integrates Tencent QQ Agent Mail into DeepSeek Harness, enabling mail automation with tools for reading, sending, and managing messages and attachments.
description.zh: 将腾讯QQ Agent Mail接入DeepSeek Harness，提供读取、发送和管理邮件及附件的工具。

description.en: Sends the DSH owner a QQ private message via local NapCat whenever an approval or question needs attention, falling back to Windows notifications.
description.zh: 当 DSH 出现审批或需要用户回答时，通过本机 NapCat 向主人发送 QQ 私信，失败则回退到 Windows 通知。

description.en: Archives DSH session logs into a local SQLite chat library with full-text search, sync and stats tools, fully offline.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话日志归档到本地 SQLite 聊天库，支持搜索、同步与统计，完全离线运行。

description.en: Connects DSH to a real QQ account via NapCat/OneBot v11, replying in private chats, speaking selectively in groups, with zero-token self-check.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat/OneBot v11 让 DSH 接管真实 QQ 号：私聊必回、群聊择机发言，零 token 自检自愈。

description.en: Adds a qqEmail Cordis service and an agent tool so DSH can send QQ mail through the authorized agently CLI, only after user confirmation.
description.zh: 提供 qqEmail Cordis 服务与 Agent 工具，通过已授权的 agently CLI 在用户确认后发送 QQ 邮件。

description.en: A tiny isolated QQ memory: plain markdown notes with note/recall/forget tools, kept separate from the main memory library.
description.zh: QQ 端独立小记忆：用 markdown 记一条、搜一句、删一条，与正式记忆库完全隔离。

description.en: Settings panel for a QQ (OneBot v11) bridge on DSH: edit and hot-swap persona cards, manage stickers and remarks, tune proactive messaging, and view status and logs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 上的 QQ 桥接（OneBot v11）提供设置面板：人格卡编辑与热切换、表情包与备注管理、主动发言参数、运行状态与日志。

description.en: Adds persona memory, mood and affection scoring to a DSH OneBot QQ channel by summarizing chats and injecting impressions into the system prompt.
description.zh: 为 DSH OneBot QQ 通道增加人物记忆、画像、好感度与情绪层：滚动总结聊天并把印象注入系统提示词。

description.en: QQ-style screenshot tool for the DSH Web UI: press Ctrl+Alt+A, drag a region, annotate it and copy to the clipboard.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供 QQ 风格截图：按 Ctrl+Alt+A 框选区域、标注并复制到剪贴板。

description.en: Installs and manages LinuxQQ + NapCat, exposing a OneBot 11 WebSocket endpoint so QQ messaging clients can connect to the harness.
description.zh: 安装并管理 LinuxQQ 与 NapCat，对外提供标准 OneBot 11 WebSocket 接口，供兼容客户端接入 QQ。

description.en: Connects DSH to QQ via OneBot 11/SnowLuma to list groups, read chat history, send messages, faces, favorites and pokes.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot 11/SnowLuma 将 DSH 接入 QQ，支持群列表、聊天记录、发送消息、表情、收藏与拍一拍。

description.en: Integrates DeepSeek Harness AI agents with QQ bots via OneBot 11 or QQ Official Platform, enabling persistent chat sessions with full DSH toolchain.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness QQ bot plugin with OneBot 11 and QQ Official Platform support

description.en: Companion patch layer for the dsh QQ bot that unblocks keyword triggers, restores chat-history context and keeps attachment entries in history.
description.zh: dsh QQ 机器人的伴侣补丁层，让关键词触发不再被拦截，并补齐聊天历史上下文与附件条目。

description.en: Visual web settings panel for QQ bot plugin managing AppID/Secret, access lists, and workspace binding.
description.zh: QQ机器人插件的可视化网页设置面板，管理AppID/密钥、访问列表和工作区绑定。

description.en: Adds a governed QQ group-chat bot channel to DSH via NapCat/OneBot 11, with built-in persona, memory, emotions and approval-gated tools.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat/OneBot 11 为 DSH 增加可控的 QQ 群聊机器人通道，自带人设、记忆、情绪与需审批的工具调用。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds speech to QQ bots: auto-transcribes inbound voice to text, speaks replies with TTS, and supports walkie-talkie voice calls.
description.zh: 给 QQ 机器人增加语音能力的 DSH 插件：入站语音自动转写注入上下文，回复合成语音播报，并支持对讲机式连续语音通话。

description.en: DSH sidebar QQ Mail dock: read recent emails, view bodies, and send plain text with a credential file and double confirmation.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 QQ 邮箱插件：读取最近邮件、查看正文，并发送纯文本邮件，凭据只读私有文件且发送需二次确认。

description.en: Read, index, search and export NTQQ chat history via 16 model tools plus a local web UI, with OCR and voice transcription.
description.zh: 通过 16 个模型工具和本地网页界面读取、建索引、检索并导出 NTQQ 聊天记录，还支持截图识字与语音转写。

description.en: Enables QR-code phone login to a DeepSeek Harness through its configured public HTTPS origin.
description.zh: 通过已配置的公网 HTTPS 域名，实现用手机扫码登录 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Adds global and workspace rules that auto-inject into system prompt for DeepSeek Harness, with configurable storage and RPC API.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加全局与工作区规则，自动注入系统提示词，并支持可配置存储和 RPC API。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin that solves quadratic equations, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，用于求解一元二次方程，不依赖网络

description.en: Adds a local-first quality and topic-coverage radar to DeepSeek Harness answers, with evidence-backed reports and copy-ready prompt fixes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个回答提供本地优先的质量与主题覆盖雷达，生成有证据的报告和可直接复制的提示词修复建议。

description.en: Open-source local quality management platform plugin with real SQLite storage, SPC/Cpk analysis, 8D reports and Word/Excel export.
description.zh: 开源本地质量管理平台插件：真实 SQLite 存储、SPC/Cpk 过程能力分析与 8D 报告，支持 Word/Excel 导出。

description.en: Commodity futures CTA workbench: TqSdk real-market-data-driven backtesting and paper trading with cost models and risk control, no real orders.
description.zh: 商品期货 CTA 工作台：由天勤真实行情驱动的回测与模拟盘全链路，含成本模型与风控，不发真实委托。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin that computes quartiles with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，用于计算四分位数，无需网络依赖。

description.en: A space-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness featuring an ink black hole in the sidebar and a live accretion disk behind the app.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造太空主题皮肤：侧边栏墨色黑洞，应用背景实时吸积盘，含 53 个精确令牌。

description.en: Converts between query strings and objects in pure Node, no external dependencies.
description.zh: 在纯 Node 环境中实现查询字符串与对象之间的相互转换，无外部依赖。

description.en: Renders model-initiated questions as answer-in-place cards with single/multi choice, hover details and free-text input, then returns the answer to the model.
description.zh: 把模型发起的提问渲染成可就地作答的卡片：单选/多选、悬停查看说明或直接输入答案，提交后把答案回传给模型。

description.en: Provides structured methods and suggestions for workplace questioning by scenario, with a pure Node implementation and no network dependency.
description.zh: 按场景提供职场提问的结构化方法与建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Lets DSH agents ask humans questions mid-turn without blocking: the tool returns a pending batch ID, and answers arrive later as a user message.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 在回合中途非阻塞地向人提问：工具立即返回 pending 批次号，答案稍后以普通 user 消息回到会话。

description.en: Shows the questions the model never asked as bubbles during reasoning, so you can answer them inline and fold them into the chat.
description.zh: 在模型推理时把「没问出口的疑问」显示成气泡，可当场作答并温和并入会话。

description.en: Enhances the dsh ask_user_question popup: selecting an option reveals a per-option note input that is sent to the model with the choice.
description.zh: 增强 dsh 的 ask_user_question 弹窗：选择选项后显示该选项的备注输入框，备注随选择一起发送给模型。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that adds a chevron button to collapse/expand the question panel into a compact bar, preserving drafts.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，为问题面板添加箭头按钮，可将其折叠为紧凑条或展开，并保留草稿。

description.en: Adds a right-edge vertical question rail to the DeepSeek web interface, listing user questions for smooth-scroll navigation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 网页版界面右缘添加竖向问题栏，列出当前会话每一轮的用户提问，点击可平滑滚动定位到对应位置。

description.en: Recovers interrupted DSH ask-user-question prompts, showing valid single/multi/free-text cards and sending supplemental answers back to the original session.
description.zh: 恢复被中断的 DSH 提问：仅在问题参数有效时展示单选、多选或自由文本卡片，并把补充回答发送回原会话。

description.en: Tree-structured question notes for DSH Desktop that track unresolved points across long chats with selection quoting and a side panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供树形问题记录，支持划词引用与侧栏问题树，帮助在长对话中记住未解决的疑问。

description.en: Keyboard shortcut plugin for dsh web that lets Enter on an empty composer dispatch the first queued message to the ongoing turn.
description.zh: 用于dsh Web的键盘快捷键插件，在空白输入框按回车可将队列首条消息发送至当前回合。

description.en: Merges queued follow-up messages into one consolidated formal prompt for the next turn in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 中排队的多条后续消息合并成一条正式提示词，用于下一轮对话，而不是每轮逐条处理。

description.en: Drag-and-drop reordering of DeepSeek Harness pending message queue, so you can rearrange messages before they are sent.
description.zh: 通过拖拽对 DeepSeek Harness 待发送消息队列进行重新排序，在发送前调整消息顺序。

description.en: Keyboard shortcuts to pull the current workspace, run custom shell commands, and open an action menu from the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供键盘快捷键：拉取当前工作区、运行自定义 Shell 命令并从输入框打开操作菜单。

description.en: Floating side panel in the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that answers quick questions via a lightweight independent session without touching the main chat.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中的浮动侧边面板，通过独立的轻量会话回答小问题，不影响主对话。

description.en: Adds a row of click-to-send quick-phrase capsules to the DSH input toolbar, with up to 10 editable presets saved locally.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具条加入一排点击即发送的快捷语胶囊，最多 10 条可编辑预设并本地保存。

description.en: Select any fragment of a DeepSeek Harness chat and get an explanation in a temporary side conversation, leaving the main session untouched.
description.zh: 选中 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中的任意片段，在临时侧边会话中获得解释，完全不影响主会话。

description.en: Adds two input-box actions to DSH: /new starts a fresh conversation and Shift+Tab toggles plan mode.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框加两个操作：/new 新建对话，Shift+Tab 一键切换计划模式。

description.en: Ctrl+Space command palette for the DSH Web UI that finds sessions, invokes skills, jumps to plugins/panels/settings, and switches appearance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的 Ctrl+Space 命令面板，可查找会话、调用技能、跳转插件/面板/设置并切换外观。

description.en: A floating sticky-note pad in the DSH Web GUI with a note directory, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中提供悬浮便签面板，支持便签目录、文本编辑、粘贴图片与本地持久化。

description.en: macOS-only DSH quick panel: a floating island and panel inside DSH plus an always-on-desktop Electron companion app with todos, reminders and live messages.
description.zh: DSH 快捷面板 macOS 版：在 DSH 窗口内提供浮岛与面板，并附带可常驻桌面的 Electron 伴生应用，支持待办、提醒、实时消息与审批接管。

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites your current draft into a precise prompt in one click, with revert support.
description.zh: 在输入框添加按钮，一键将当前草稿改写为精准提示词，并支持撤回。

description.en: Adds quick prompt input to DSH web chat: a persistent two-bar shortcuts UI plus a lightning-pen for managing/importing prompts.
description.zh: 为DSH Web聊天输入框添加快捷提示条与闪电笔管理，支持提示词导入与持久化。

description.en: Provides home-style cooking recipes and cooking plans based on parameters, written in Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 基于参数提供家常菜谱和烹饪计划，用 Node 编写，无网络依赖。

description.en: One-click refresh button for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that reloads the page against the freshly published module graph to surface hot-injected client plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供一键刷新按钮，重新加载最新模块图，让热注入的客户端插件立即生效。

description.en: Adds a confirmed "Restart" item to the DSH desktop account menu that quits and relaunches the app, reporting progress and failure stage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版账号菜单添加「重启」项，二次确认后自动关闭并重启应用，并反馈进度与失败原因。

description.en: DSH Desktop quick restart plugin: one-click restart, profile switching, slash commands, tray menu.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 快速重启插件，提供一键重启、配置切换、斜杠命令与托盘菜单入口。

description.en: Adds a one-click resume button for interrupted DSH agents in the assistant message action row via host agent.followup.
description.zh: 在助手消息操作栏为中断的 DSH 智能体添加一键继续按钮，通过宿主 agent.followup 恢复该智能体运行。

description.en: Adds customizable quick-send shortcut buttons beside the chat input, letting you send preset text to the current conversation with one click.
description.zh: 在聊天输入框旁添加可自定义的快捷发送按钮，一键将预设文字发送到当前对话，免去重复输入。

description.en: Standalone Chinese-English translation page in DSH that uses your configured models with streaming output, custom prompts and local history.
description.zh: DSH 中独立的英中翻译页面，使用已配置模型，支持流式翻译、自定义提示词与本地历史记录。

description.en: Creates a named workspace directly in the browser, replacing the host OS folder chooser with a simpler in-app flow.
description.zh: 在浏览器中按名称创建工作区，用更简单的应用内流程替代主机操作系统的文件夹选择器。

description.en: Press Space on an active file tab to show an instant large preview overlay for images, PDFs, and text in DSH's better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH better-sidebar 的活动文件标签上按空格键，即可弹出图像、PDF 和文本的大图预览浮层。

description.en: Adds a Delete conversation action to archived DSH sessions that also removes the session log, projection cache and workspace booking.
description.zh: 为已归档的 DSH 对话在 ⋯ 菜单中新增「删除对话」，同时清除会话日志、投影缓存和工作区记账。

description.en: Capture quick notes straight from the DSH composer without breaking flow, then manage the whole list on one page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中随手记下笔记而不打断思路，并在一页中统一管理全部笔记。

description.en: Adds vision capability to text-only DeepSeek models via dual local OCR and visual model fallback.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型增加视觉能力，先用本地 OCR，失败时回退到视觉模型。

description.en: Sidebar video player for DeepSeek Harness with streaming playback, seeking, wheel zoom, drag pan and a custom control bar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏视频播放器，支持流式播放、进度跳转、滚轮缩放、拖拽平移和自定义控制栏。

description.en: Windows desktop plugin that watches your AI agent while you're away and only alerts you when it is blocked or has results.
description.zh: Windows 桌面插件：你离开时替你盯着 AI agent，只卡住或出结果时才提醒你。

description.en: Keeps DSH's built-in browser window in the background on Windows so it never steals focus or covers your active window.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上让 DSH 内置浏览器窗口保持后台运行，不抢焦点、不遮挡你正在使用的窗口。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped, manually armed, one-shot quiet mode for direct subagents.
description.zh: 为直接子代理提供会话级、手动启用、一次性的安静模式。

description.en: Adds a 'Quit dsh' entry to the DSHM sidebar account menu so users can confirm and close the app back to the desktop.
description.zh: 在 DSHM 侧栏账户菜单注入「退出 dsh」，确认后直接关闭应用并回到桌面。

description.en: Fixes a false quit warning in the DSH desktop app that treats idle informational notices as active running tasks.
description.zh: 修复 DSH 桌面版退出时的误报警告：把空闲的通知消息误判为正在运行的任务。

description.en: Runs a virtual multi-agent council for review and red-teaming with sandboxed context, weighted TTD scoring and a 3-round circuit breaker.
description.zh: 运行虚拟多智能体议会进行评审与红队测试，具备沙箱上下文、动态加权TTD评分与三轮熔断机制。

description.en: Shows ChatGPT, Gemini, Antigravity, Cursor quota percentages and DeepSeek balance in a DSH sidebar card with reset countdowns and color alerts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏卡片中显示 ChatGPT、Gemini、Antigravity、Cursor 的额度百分比与 DeepSeek 余额，含重置倒计时与颜色预警。

description.en: DSH web sidebar quota entry showing DeepSeek account balance and OpenCode Go usage, with a detail dialog, reset countdowns and inline API key setup.
description.zh: DSH 网页侧边栏额度入口，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与 OpenCode Go 用量，点击打开详情弹窗，含重置倒计时和内置 API Key 设置。

description.en: macOS sidebar ring for DeepSeek Harness showing live balance, estimated daily spend, and peak/off-peak usage.
description.zh: macOS 侧边栏余额圆环，实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 余额、预估每日花费及高峰/低谷用量。

description.en: Displays your DeepSeek account remaining balance (total + bonus credits) in the DSH sidebar above your username; click to refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏用户名上方显示 DeepSeek 账号剩余额度（总余额与赠金余额），点击即可刷新。

description.en: DSH sidebar quota panel showing DeepSeek balance and multi-provider usage windows with 90-day local history and trend charts.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏额度面板，展示 DeepSeek 官方余额及多平台用量窗口，含 90 天本地历史与趋势图。

description.en: Adds a text-selection menu to DeepSeek Harness Desktop that quotes passages into the chat or opens a side-panel follow-up Q&A.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加划词菜单，可将选中文字引用到对话，或直接在原生侧边栏追问解释。

description.en: DSH web plugin that lets you quote AI-generated chat content into the input box as a UI card, auto-injecting a > quote block on send.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：划选、整条或粘贴大段 AI 内容到输入框，发送时自动附加 > 引用块并以卡片形式显示。

description.en: Select any passage, annotate it in place, and send the quote with your comment alongside your message.
description.zh: 选中任意段落并就地添加批注，随消息一起发送引用原文和你的评论。

description.en: Turns selected text into anchored quote blocks that stay visible after sending and jump back to the source, numbering each annotation so the model replies point by point.
description.zh: 把划选的文字变成带锚点的引用块，发送后仍可见、点击可跳回原文，并按批注编号要求模型逐条回应。

description.en: Local MIT fork of dsh-quote-annotate-pro that adds the source file path to quote blocks created by selecting text in document previews.
description.zh: 本地 MIT 分支版：在文档预览中划词生成引用块时，额外标注来源文件路径。

description.en: Select text in DSH chat to quote or annotate it; the quote stays above the composer and becomes a clickable jump-back block once sent.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中选中文字即可引用或批注，引用常驻输入框上方，发送后生成可一键跳回原文并高亮的引用块。

description.en: Real-time stock watch panel with A-share & US quotes, K-lines, watchlist, and a draggable always-on-top overlay.
description.zh: 实时股票看盘面板，支持A股和美股行情、K线、自选股及可拖动置顶浮窗，数据来自腾讯财经公开接口，无需配置或API密钥。

description.en: Select text in the chat, reply to it in a popover, stack quote-answer blocks above the composer and send them all at once.
description.zh: 选中对话中的文字即可就地弹窗回复，问答以方块堆叠在输入框上方，一键全部发送。

description.en: Quote selected chat text into the composer as a Markdown blockquote in DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中把选中的会话文字以 Markdown 引用块插入输入框。

description.en: Quote text selected in the chat transcript and send it onward together with its source location.
description.zh: 引用聊天记录中选中的文本，并连同其来源位置一起发送。

description.en: Quotes a whole DSH message by reference: the composer holds only a message id and the model fetches the full text on demand.
description.zh: 通过引用方式引用整条 DSH 消息：输入框只保留消息 id，模型按需读取完整原文。

description.en: Select any text in DSH and quote it into the message input as a compact chip, so you can ask follow-up questions about that exact passage.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中选中任意文字，一键引用为输入框里的迷你引用条，方便针对该段内容追问。

description.en: Turn selected DSH chat text into a temporary annotation file attached to the composer as a quote chip; auto-deleted after the turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中文字，生成临时注释文件并以引用块附到输入框，模型读完本轮后自动删除。

description.en: Qwen speech-to-text plugin for DeepSeek Harness: async DashScope filetrans for long recordings and sync ASR for short clips, with raw API output preserved.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Qwen 语音转文字插件：长录音走异步 DashScope filetrans，短音频走同步 ASR，并保留原始 API 输出。

description.en: Qwen multimodal bridge for DeepSeek Harness, enabling vision, speech-to-text, and text-to-image generation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供通义千问多模态桥接，支持视觉理解、语音转文字和文生图。

description.en: Lets DSH call your local ComfyUI to generate images in chat, switching between Qwen-Image, MOSS-Image and Krea 2, fully offline.
description.zh: 让 DSH 在对话中直接调用本机 ComfyUI 绘图，支持千问/MOSS-Image/Krea 2 三模型一键切换，纯本地不出网。

description.en: Shows your Qwen Cloud Token Plan usage quota (monthly, 5-hour, weekly) in a card inside DeepSeek Harness Settings → Models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置→模型中显示 Qwen Cloud Token Plan 的用量配额（月度、5小时、每周）。

description.en: 千问办公（QwenWork）的 DSH 模型提供方：device flow 登录、官方网关、支持工具调用
Displays R4 Coder account plan balance, wallet, concurrency cap, expiry, today's spend and 7-day usage inside dsh settings.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置中显示 R4 Coder 账户的套餐余额、钱包、并发上限、到期时间、今日消费与最近 7 天用量。

description.en: A DSH skin that swaps the window into a cozy wooden cabin with a white rabbit whose weight you can adjust across five slider levels.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 皮肤：把窗口换成木屋场景，白兔站在深棕木板前，可用滑块调整五档体重。

description.en: DSH-native hook plugin that listens to session, submit, tool and turn events and applies RabiRoute automation rules to inject context, deny tools or continue a turn.
description.zh: DSH 原生钩子插件，监听会话、提交、工具与轮次事件，按 RabiRoute 自动化规则注入上下文、拒绝工具或决定继续处理。

description.en: Adds an AMD Radeon Cloud AI capacity readout to the DeepSeek Harness model picker, showing each model's concurrency headroom inline.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器中显示 AMD Radeon Cloud 的 AI 容量，按模型展示并发余量。

description.en: Narrow-rail sidebar redesign for DSH: panel icons collapse into a 40px column, clearer workspace/session hierarchy, plus a DeepSeek balance bar.
description.zh: 窄轨侧边栏插件：面板图标收进 40px 窄栏，工作区与会话分层更清晰，底部常驻 DeepSeek 余额条。

description.en: DSH web plugin that removes the 56px rail left by the collapsed left sidebar, using dsh-qol's hamburger with an official toggle fallback.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：将折叠后左侧边栏残留的 56px 竖条归零，复用 dsh-qol 的汉堡按钮，无则回退官方切换按钮。

description.en: Provides a Rail Fence cipher (栅栏密码) tool in pure Node.js for encoding and decoding messages.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的栅栏密码工具，可对消息进行编码和解码。

description.en: Reads a railway work window register and checks its time, duration, numbering and field self-consistency.
description.zh: 读取铁路天窗作业登记簿，校验其时间、时长、编号等字段的自洽性。

description.en: DSH plugin: a flowing rainbow gradient border around the message composer.
Monitors memory and CPU pressure, lowers host priority, blocks heavy tools before thrashing, and reports DSH's own resource usage.
description.zh: 监控内存与CPU压力，高负载时降低主机优先级、阻止重型工具，并显示DSH自身资源占用。

description.en: Manage multiple Rancher servers inside DSH: browse clusters, nodes, Pods and workloads, stream Pod logs, and run confirmed admin actions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理多个 Rancher 服务器：浏览集群、节点、Pod 与工作负载，实时查看 Pod 日志，并执行需确认的管理操作。

description.en: Provides cryptographic random integer/string generation, array sampling, and shuffling utilities.
description.zh: @{name=dsh-random; version=0.1.0; description=随机工具：安全随机整数/字符串、数组抽样与洗牌（crypto）; type=module; main=lib/index.js; exports=; files=System.Object[]; dsh=; keywords=System.Object[]; author=istone <ad571@qq.

description.en: Generates numeric ranges in pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 在纯 Node.js 中生成数字范围，无网络依赖。

description.en: Local text-only OCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness that extracts text from images offline.
description.zh: Local text-only OCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness: ocr_image tool extracts text from images locally — no vision model, no API key, no external upload.

description.en: DSH plugin bundle for REA that mounts an MCP server, a progressive-disclosure bridge, and a settings panel with a single shared config file.
description.zh: REA 的 DSH 插件包，同时挂载 MCP 服务器、渐进式披露桥接和设置面板，并共用一份配置文件。

description.en: Exposes 200+ REA MCP tools to DeepSeek Harness through three meta-calls (rea_tools, rea_help, rea_call) for Ghidra-based reverse engineering.
description.zh: 通过三个元调用（rea_tools、rea_help、rea_call）将 200 多个 REA MCP 工具接入 DeepSeek Harness，用于基于 Ghidra 的逆向工程。

description.en: DSH plugin: toggle the REA MCP server on/off from Settings → REA (and a composer-dock pill), without editing patches by hand.
Adds a per-conversation switch controlling whether the REA MCP server's 207 tool schemas and instructions block reach the model context.
description.zh: 为每个会话提供开关，决定 REA MCP 服务器的 207 个工具定义与说明块是否进入模型上下文。

description.en: Reads DSH replies aloud with natural neural voices, offering a sound-wave play button, sentence highlighting, pause/skip, custom highlight colours and auto-read.
description.zh: 用自然神经网络语音朗读 DSH 回复，提供声波播放按钮、句子高亮、暂停/跳过、自定义高亮颜色和自动朗读。

description.en: Scans everything the agent reads and quarantines credential files or injection-laden content before it enters model context.
description.zh: 在内容进入模型上下文前扫描代理读取的所有文件，隔离凭据文件与注入内容。

description.en: Converts PNG/WebP image attachments to JPEG for LM Studio compatibility in DSH.
description.zh: 将PNG/WebP图片附件转换为JPEG，以兼容LM Studio。

description.en: Adds a full-screen reading panel with adjustable zoom to enlarge any DeepSeek Harness answer, preserving KaTeX, tables and code.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的回答增加全屏阅读面板，可调节缩放放大内容，并保留公式、表格与代码。

description.en: Adds a read-side permission gate to DSH: readable-directory allowlists, three session read modes and per-request read approvals.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加读侧权限闸门：可读目录白名单、三种会话级读模式以及逐次读取审批。

description.en: Returns home lighting design solutions based on input parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回家居照明设计方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Calculates estimated reading time for text; pure Node, no network deps.
description.zh: 根据文本计算预计阅读时间，使用纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Scans project tech stack, directory structure, and scripts to auto-generate a structured README.md.
description.zh: 扫描项目的技术栈、目录结构和脚本，自动生成结构化的 README.md 文件。

description.en: Injects a designated text file into every agent's system prompt before first run, enforcing binding working constraints.
description.zh: 在每次代理首次运行前，将指定文本文件注入其系统提示词，作为强制工作约束。

description.en: AI-assisted reader for DeepSeek Harness that opens and reads TXT, Markdown, EPUB and PDF documents in one place.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 辅助阅读插件，可在一个界面中阅读 TXT、Markdown、EPUB 和 PDF 文档。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets models grab video frames or audio at a timestamp via HTTP Range and ffmpeg remote seek instead of downloading the whole file.
description.zh: DSH 插件：模型可按时间戳取帧或取音频，通过 HTTP Range 与 ffmpeg 远程 seek，无需下载整片。

description.en: A realistic humpback whale desktop pet for Windows: a transparent always-on-top whale with click ripples, whale songs and 121 lines, fully offline.
description.zh: 写实座头鲸 Windows 桌宠：透明置顶鲸鱼、点击触发水波折射、本地鲸歌与 121 条台词，完全离线运行。

description.en: Integrates realtimeavatar.ai with dsh: stores API key, turns docs into skills, and provides rta_* tools with /rta onboarding.
description.zh: 将realtimeavatar.ai集成到dsh：存储API密钥，将文档转为技能，并提供rta_*工具和/rta入门。

description.en: Finds and reclaims orphan dev servers and watchers left behind by agent sessions, helping free ports and resources.
description.zh: 查找并回收代理会话遗留的孤儿开发服务器和监听进程，帮助释放端口和资源。

description.en: Breaks a conclusion into a bottom-up argument tree and lets you jump straight to the source memory that supports each node.
description.zh: 将一个结论拆解为自底向上的论证树，并可跳转到支撑每个节点的来源记忆。

description.en: Detects model vendors by name and auto-fills valid reasoning-effort tiers and request fields for self-added models in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 根据模型名识别厂商，为自建路由模型自动填入正确的推理档位与请求字段，装好即用。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style continuous, level-snapping reasoning-effort slider to the DeepSeek Harness model menu.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 模型菜单添加 Codex 风格的连续、按档位吸附的推理强度滑块。

description.en: Codex-style folding for the DeepSeek Harness web transcript: a running turn keeps only its last actions visible, folded behind one expandable row.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话记录提供 Codex 式折叠：进行中的回合只显示最后几步操作，折叠在一行内可展开。

description.en: Adds a composer button that reads your draft and recommends which DeepSeek model and reasoning effort to use, with a one-line reason and manual apply.
description.zh: 在输入框旁添加按钮，读取草稿并推荐应使用的 DeepSeek 模型与推理强度，附一行理由，需手动点击应用。

description.en: Adds a slim reasoning-effort ruler to DSH web composer with per-model memory and a simplified model picker.
description.zh: 为DSH网页编辑器添加精简推理程度尺，支持按模型记忆设定及简化模型选择器。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that replaces the composer reasoning-effort picker with an inline slider card for quick adjustment.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件，将输入框的推理强度选择器替换为内联滑块卡片，便于快速调节。

description.en: Translates the model's reasoning into Chinese at display time: collapsed Chinese summary, expanded Chinese body plus original English, with no prompt injection.
description.zh: 在显示层把模型思考过程翻译成中文：折叠显示中文摘要，展开显示中文正文与英文原文，不注入提示词、不改变模型行为。

description.en: DSH workspace beautifier that turns the sidebar into workspace→group→session with drag grouping and context-usage rings, plus a bundled environment installer.
description.zh: DSH 工作区美化插件，把侧栏改为「工作区→分组→会话」并支持拖拽归组与上下文用量环，另附整套环境安装器。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style Recent section to the dsh web GUI sidebar listing each workspace's newest sessions, and folds the workspace list to the five most recent.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页侧边栏加入 Codex 风格的“最近”区域，汇总各工作区最新会话，并把工作区列表折叠为最近五个。

description.en: Browse, search, copy and hide every prompt you sent to the AI across all your DSH sessions in one place.
description.zh: 在一个地方浏览、搜索、复制和隐藏你在所有 DSH 会话中发送给 AI 的提示词。

description.en: Adds a persistent, collapsible recent-sessions panel to the DSH Web sidebar for quick switching between past conversations.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 左侧栏添加常驻、可折叠的「最近会话」面板，方便快速切换历史会话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that retries failed requests with exponential backoff and gateway recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 重试插件，采用指数退避并支持网关恢复。

description.en: Rectangle calculation plugin implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的矩形计算插件，无网络依赖，用于进行矩形相关计算。

description.en: Adds a recycle bin for DSH sessions: deleting moves whole session trees into a restorable bin, and only permanent delete erases data.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加会话回收站：删除会话即整树移入可恢复的回收站，只有彻底删除才真正销毁数据。

description.en: Adds a DSH recycle bin that holds deleted workspace sessions for 14 days, with restore or immediate permanent delete.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加回收站：删除的工作区会话保留 14 天，可随时恢复或立即永久删除。

description.en: Returns family festival preparation plans based on parameters for Chinese red packet etiquette.
description.zh: 根据中国红包礼仪参数返回家庭节日准备方案

description.en: Redacts PII and secrets from outbound model requests, restores responses locally, and keeps an encrypted mapping plus tamper-evident audit log.
description.zh: 在模型请求发出前遮蔽 PII 与密钥，本地还原响应，并保存加密映射与防篡改审计日志。

description.en: Edit an already-sent message and re-answer in place, even while the reply is still streaming.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息并原地重新回答，回答还在生成时也能修改。

description.en: Browse a Chinese AI reference-image library inside dsh web and one-click fill the high-res image plus an auto-generated prompt into the composer.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中浏览中文 AI 参考图库，一键把高清参考图与自动生成的提示词填入对话框。

description.en: Analyzes codebase for smells and generates a priority-ordered refactoring plan.
description.zh: 分析代码库中文件过长、嵌套过深、TODO 密度高等坏味道，生成按优先级排序的可执行重构计划。

description.en: Adds F5, Ctrl+F5 and Ctrl+Shift+R keyboard shortcuts to reliably reload the DeepSeek Harness page, with cache-bypassing variants.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 页面添加 F5、Ctrl+F5、Ctrl+Shift+R 快捷键，可靠刷新页面并支持强制刷新（绕过缓存）。

description.en: Binds F5 and Ctrl+R in the DSH desktop app to reload the page, since F5 is disabled in production builds by default.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面应用绑定 F5 / Ctrl+R 快捷键以重新加载页面，解决生产构建默认不支持 F5 的问题。

description.en: Provides structured, scenario-based methods and suggestions for politely refusing requests.
Adds a ChatGPT-style regenerate arrow to DeepSeek Harness that forks the turn and re-runs the same prompt in a new session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 ChatGPT 风格的重新生成按钮，派生新会话并重跑同一提示词。

description.en: Regex utility for testing matches, safe replacement, and character escaping, pure Node implementation.
description.zh: 正则工具：测试匹配、安全替换与字符转义，纯 Node 实现。

description.en: Adds off/low/medium/high/max reasoning-effort levels to every model on an OpenAI-compatible relay, selectable in the DSH model picker.
description.zh: 为任意 OpenAI 兼容中转站的每个模型提供关/低/中/高/max 五档推理等级，并可在 DSH 模型选择器中直接切换。

description.en: Declare a source-to-filters-to-actions flow and RelayDeck collects, narrows, stores and prepares content for publishing, with traceable runs and notifications.
description.zh: 声明“来源→筛选→动作”流程，RelayDeck 自动采集、过滤、存储并准备内容发布，全程可追溯并支持通知。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that joins a relay-hub station using a TOIP dynamic password and gets per-plugin log accounting on the station side.
description.zh: 用 TOIP 动态口令把 DSH 接入中转站，并在站点侧获得按插件统计的日志用量。

description.en: Guardrails for small local models in DeepSeek Harness that catch false successes, fix invented DOIs, approve destructive commands, and offer read-only /explain mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的小型本地模型提供可靠性护栏：纠正虚假成功与虚构 DOI、审批破坏性命令，并提供只读 /explain 模式。
