description.en: Adds ReMe-style long-term memory to DSH with a Markdown workspace, BM25 recall, turn capture, and scheduled consolidation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 ReMe 风格长期记忆：Markdown 工作区、BM25 召回、对话轮次捕获与定时整理。

description.en: DSH beta plugin that remembers approvals already granted in a session so matching tool+action requests skip the prompt.
description.zh: DSH 测试版插件：记住同一会话中已人工批准的请求，后续匹配相同工具与操作前缀的请求不再重复弹窗询问。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that shows all scheduled reminders on a timeline with live countdowns, on-time banners and a floating countdown capsule.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件：把所有定时提醒按时间轴展示并实时倒计时，到点弹出常驻横幅，右下角悬浮倒计时胶囊。

description.en: Binds the dsh web webserver to 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1, enabling remote network access to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 将 dsh web 的 Web 服务器绑定到 0.0.0.0 而非 127.0.0.1，从而支持远程网络访问 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Secures the DSH web GUI for remote access with a random URL path, HttpOnly-cookie gate, launch-token bridge, and settings card.
description.zh: 通过随机路径、HttpOnly Cookie 网关、启动令牌桥接和设置卡片，保障 DSH Web GUI 的远程访问安全。

description.en: Unified DSH workspaces for Claude Code, Codex and OMP agents, with local and SSH conversations, tool approvals and persistent history.
description.zh: 为 Claude Code、Codex 和 OMP 提供统一的 DSH 工作区，支持本地与 SSH 会话、工具审批和持久化历史。

description.en: Relays messages between DSH bots running on different machines over encrypted ds harness remote channels.
description.zh: 通过加密的 ds harness remote 通道，在不同机器上运行的 DSH Bot 之间转发消息。

description.en: Exposes a local DSH harness to your own relay over one outbound WebSocket, so it works behind NAT with no inbound ports.
description.zh: 通过单条出站 WebSocket 将本地 DSH harness 接入自建中继，无需入站端口即可穿透 NAT。

description.en: Deploy, start and connect DeepSeek Harness on remote Linux servers over SSH, with a one-click local port tunnel to the remote web UI.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 在远程 Linux 服务器上部署并启动 DeepSeek Harness，一键建立本机端口隧道打开远程 Web 界面。

description.en: Read-only wall dashboard that aggregates DeepSeek Harness sessions from multiple machines via pull or push into one hub with a tablet-friendly page.
description.zh: 只读墙式仪表盘，通过拉取或推送将多台机器上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话聚合到一个中心，并提供适配平板屏幕的页面。

description.en: Remote deployment plugin for one-click download of modified files and image preview delivery, replacing SCP.
description.zh: 用于 DSH 远程部署，一键下载修改后的文件并交付图片预览，替代 SCP 手动传输。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a phone-friendly remote desktop shell with landscape reading and Chinese input.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供手机端远程桌面外壳，支持横屏阅读和中文输入。

description.en: Floating QR button for pairing a phone with DSH WebUI; companion UI for dsh-remote-link.
description.zh: DSH WebUI 的浮动二维码手机配对按钮，是 dsh-remote-link 的配套界面。

description.en: Prompts for a sudo password in the DSH composer and runs remote root commands over SSH without exposing the password in the transcript.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中提示输入 sudo 密码，通过 SSH 执行远程 root 命令，且不会把密码写入会话记录。

description.en: Launches Remotion Studio from DSH so agents can programmatically generate web videos in many styles.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中启动 Remotion Studio，让 Agent 以代码方式生成各种风格的网页视频。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete Session" item to the DSH Web UI session "…" menu that permanently removes the session from the sidebar and from disk after a second confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 会话「…」菜单中增加红色“删除会话”，二次确认后将会话从侧栏和磁盘上彻底删除。

description.en: Estimates render time from parameters with detailed results, as a pure Node tool with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数估算渲染时间并给出详细结果，是纯 Node 工具，无网络依赖。

description.en: 租还是买 (rent vs buy) calculator: computes and returns detailed results based on parameters, pure Node implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 租还是买计算器，按参数计算并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides rental car insurance recommendations based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数给出租车保险建议，采用纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Tool to calculate rental yield (租金回报率) precisely from parameters and return detailed results.
Reads a motor vehicle repair work order register and checks its completeness and arithmetic consistency line by line.
description.zh: 读取机动车维修工单登记表，逐行检查其完整性与金额、日期等算术一致性。

description.en: Builds a compact, regex-based map of repository source files and their top-level symbols to orient DSH context.
description.zh: 基于正则生成紧凑的仓库地图，列出源文件及其顶层符号，用于快速定位 DSH 上下文。

description.en: Adds structured DSH tools for Git and GitHub workflows: status, diff, commit, push, branches, PRs, CI, issues and releases.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供结构化的 Git 与 GitHub 工具集：状态、差异、提交、推送、分支、PR、CI、议题与发布。

description.en: Bounded, read-only packer that turns a repository into one XML/Markdown document for DSH context handoff.
description.zh: 只读且有大小上限的仓库打包工具，将代码库输出为单一 XML/Markdown 文档，便于 DSH 上下文交接。

description.en: 数字校对台 · 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 CSV 复核中文周报的增长率、百分点和金额，逐条查看算式并修订。
Turns inter-agent reporting into a first-class primitive with a traceable delivery ledger, receipts/closures/corrections, and a session timeline tab.
description.zh: 把代理之间的「汇报」变成一等交互原语，提供可追溯的传递账本、回执/结案/修正，以及会话时间线标签页。

description.en: Repot check tool that returns plant care recommendations based on input parameters. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数判断植物是否需要换盆并返回养护建议，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides repotting advice for plants based on input parameters.
Offline content-addressed proof that independent build receipts reproduced byte-identical artifacts for supply-chain integrity.
description.zh: Offline content-addressed proof that independent build receipts reproduced byte-identical specified artifacts

description.en: Provides complete and field-specific information about iguanas, including taxonomy, habitat, diet, and fun facts.
description.zh: 提供鬣蜥的完整专业信息，涵盖分类、栖息地、饮食和趣味知识。

description.en: A pure Node tool that calculates repurchase rate from parameters and returns detailed results.
description.zh: 纯 Node 工具，根据参数计算复购率并返回详细结果。

description.en: DSH plugin that dumps the exact raw model request body and the raw upstream error response to disk when a request fails.
description.zh: DSH 插件：模型请求失败时，把完整的原始请求体与上游错误响应的 raw JSON 一起落盘保存。

description.en: Manages LLM API request policies for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM API 请求策略，用于配置该框架调用大模型接口时的请求规则。

description.en: Turns rough requirement notes into a validated, agent-ready prompt with gap detection, bilingual output and a confirmation gate in the composer.
description.zh: 将粗略的需求笔记转化为经过校验、可直接交给智能体的提示词，支持缺口检测、双语输出和确认关卡。

description.en: Standalone rescue plugin that classifies crashes, runs pre-flight checks, enables safe mode, snapshots manifests and watches for crashes at zero cost.
description.zh: 独立救援插件：崩溃分类、启动前检查、安全模式、清单快照，以及零成本的事件驱动崩溃监视器。

description.en: Adds a one-click Restart button to the DSH composer toolbar so you can relaunch the app after installing a plugin without closing and reopening it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 编辑工具栏添加一键重启按钮，安装插件后无需关闭再重开应用即可重新启动。

description.en: Host plugin that delegates DSH reset requests to an external ops agent via a versioned JSON protocol with preflight, restart, health-check, and recovery.
description.zh: 将DSH复位请求通过版本化JSON协议委托给外部运维代理，包含预检、重启、健康检查与恢复。

description.en: Adds configurable reasoning effort levels to custom AI providers by writing declarations into llm pi ai.
description.zh: 通过向 llm pi ai 写入声明，为自定义 AI 提供商添加可配置的推理强度等级。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that samples Windows CPU, memory and frequency every minute, keeps 30 days of history, and flags sustained overload, memory pressure and throttling.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏插件：每分钟采集 Windows 的 CPU、内存与频率，保留 30 天历史，并判定持续高占用、内存吃紧与降频事件。

description.en: Compact status line under the message box showing macOS CPU, GPU, RAM, swap usage and local Ollama model status.
description.zh: 在消息框下方显示紧凑状态行，展示 Mac 的 CPU、GPU、内存、交换分区占用及本地 Ollama 模型状态。

description.en: Shows the provider, model name and reasoning level behind each assistant reply in the DSH response footer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每条助手回答的页脚显示生成该回答的提供商、模型名称和推理强度。

description.en: Calculates inter-set rest time from parameters with precise results; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算组间休息时间，结果精确，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Adds a ⟳ one-click restart button to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar that fully relaunches the desktop app in about 3–4 seconds.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加 ⟳ 一键重启按钮，约 3–4 秒内完整关闭并重启桌面应用。

description.en: DSH 应用内整体重启插件：自动/人工触发、失败回滚、重启后恢复会话并继续任务。
description.zh: 在 DSH 应用内触发整体重启，支持自动或人工触发、失败回滚，并在重启后恢复会话继续任务。

description.en: Desktop maintenance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: clears stale auth cookies, adds an in-app restart button, and tunes window/sidebar sizes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端维护插件：清理累积的认证 Cookie、新增页面重启按钮，并可自定义窗口与右侧栏尺寸。

description.en: Adds a restart control for the DeepSeek Harness host in Settings → General and the sidebar account menu, using systemd or a fallback.
description.zh: 在设置→通用和侧边栏账户菜单中加入重启 DeepSeek Harness 主机的功能，支持 systemd 用户服务及独立回退方案。

description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness web from the Settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页面为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供独立的一键重启功能。

description.en: Restarts the DeepSeek Harness web host from Settings, supporting supervisor-managed or direct restart modes.
description.zh: 从设置中重启 DeepSeek Harness Web 宿主，支持由 supervisor 托管或直接重启两种模式。

description.en: Web-GUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: restart web, toggle plugins, and manage local git checkouts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件：一键重启 dsh web、开关已安装插件，并为本地代码检出提供 git 面板。

description.en: Adds a dsh Web settings page with a one-click button that restarts the host process and shows its boot ID, PID and port.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 设置面板新增一个页面，一键重启主机进程，并显示启动 ID、PID 和端口。

description.en: Sidebar control to restart DeepSeek Harness and update installed plugins with version awareness and a market entry point.
description.zh: 侧边栏一键重启 DeepSeek Harness 并按版本更新已装插件，附插件市场入口。

description.en: Adds a single restart button to the dsh web GUI that restarts the harness in place across systemd, Docker, Kubernetes, pm2, launchd, terminal and Windows setups.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页界面添加一个重启按钮，可在 systemd、Docker、Kubernetes、pm2、launchd、终端和 Windows 环境中原地重启服务。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button that restarts the whole DSH desktop app (Electron shell and Host) and reloads the page once it is back.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加按钮，一键重启整个 DSH 桌面应用（Electron 外壳与 Host），恢复后自动重新加载页面。

description.en: Adds a one-click reload/restart button to the DSH desktop app: hot-reload plugin updates in place, relaunch only when needed.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版添加一键重载／重启按钮：插件更新后原地热重载，仅在无法热重载时才完全重启。

description.en: Safe self-restart and same-session resume for DeepSeek Harness using a supervisor-aware protocol.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安全自重启与同会话续接，通过可感知 supervisor 的协议实现。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that recovers broken turns with three-tier policy: silent same-round retry, same-round continuation after output limits, or an optional new round.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：用三段式策略恢复中断回合——同轮静默重试、输出超限同轮续写、可选新一轮继续。

description.en: Safely restarts the DeepSeek Harness via a mutex-guarded protocol and automatically wakes registered sessions afterwards.
description.zh: 通过互斥锁保护的安全重启协议重启 DeepSeek Harness，并在重启后自动唤醒已注册的会话。

description.en: Budgets every tool result to the active model's context window so local and small models avoid oversized-output flooding.
description.zh: 按当前模型的上下文窗口限制每个工具结果的体积，避免本地和小模型被超大输出淹没。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill that writes a one-page CHECKPOINT.md handover brief before resuming a long project, so new sessions skip re-reading old chats.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 技能：续接长项目前先生成一页 CHECKPOINT.md 交接简报，新会话无需回放旧聊天记录。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-resumes a model turn from its partial output after a mid-stream network failure or timeout, instead of restarting from scratch.
description.zh: DSH 断点续接插件：模型回复因网络中断或超时半途失败时，自动携带已生成的部分输出进入下一轮，从中断处继续而非全量重跑。

description.en: Provides retention settlement and non-resurrection evidence for deleted data in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的已删除数据提供不含正文的保留结算与不复活证明。

description.en: Adds a retirement countdown widget to the DSH composer showing days, hours, minutes and seconds, with a pencil to set the target date.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框内添加退休倒计时小组件，显示天/时/分/秒，点击铅笔可设置目标日期。

description.en: Adds a native Restart DeepSeek Harness action to the Windows tray menu and DSH account menu.
description.zh: 为 Windows 托盘菜单和 DSH 账户菜单添加原生的重新启动 DeepSeek Harness 入口。

description.en: Bridges the HTTP Retry-After header into DeepSeek Harness retry policy so 429 rate-limit backoff on OpenAI-compatible routes is honoured honestly.
description.zh: 将 HTTP Retry-After 响应头接入 DeepSeek Harness 重试策略，让 OpenAI 兼容路由上的 429 限流退避更真实可信。

description.en: Visual editor for model provider API retry policies in DSH web settings, writing to settings.yaml for hot-reload.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页设置中可视化编辑模型提供方的 API 重试策略，并写入 settings.yaml 以支持热重载。

description.en: Adds a hover action on chat file references that opens Explorer, Finder, or a Linux file manager with that file selected.
description.zh: 在聊天中的文件引用上悬停即可用系统文件管理器（资源管理器/Finder/Linux 文件管理器）定位并选中该文件。

description.en: Adds a right-click context menu to file paths in the DSH Web UI so you can reveal them in your OS file manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 的任意文件路径上添加右键菜单，可快速在操作系统文件管理器中显示该文件。

description.en: DSH LAN reverse proxy plugin for seamless mobile access to the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: DSH局域网反向代理插件，让手机/平板无缝访问DSH Web GUI。

description.en: Reverses the DeepSeek Harness chat layout so the composer pins to the top and the transcript renders newest-first with a reversed turn navigator.
description.zh: 反转 DeepSeek Harness 的对话阅读布局：输入框固定在顶部，消息记录按最新优先显示，轮次导航同步反向。

description.en: Multi-agent adversarial code review plugin that uses parallel finders and verifiers to surface only confirmed defects.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的多智能体对抗式代码审查插件，并行查找缺陷，再由验证者逐条核实，只保留已确认的缺陷。

description.en: DSH private Win32 review desktop: prepare stays in background, open switches explicitly. 中文：DSH 后台复验桌面
DSH plugin that validates auto-review responses as strict JSON, retries a bounded number of times on invalid output, and preserves legitimate denials.
description.zh: DSH 插件：严格校验自动审查返回的 JSON，对非法输出进行有限次重试，并保留合法的拒绝结果。

description.en: Read-only code review plugin that grounds every finding in verbatim anchors, adversarial verifiers and explicit coverage gaps.
description.zh: 只读代码审查插件，用逐字代码锚点、对抗式验证器和明确的覆盖缺口来支撑每条结论。

description.en: Evidence-based review of research deliverables with checklists, revisions, native DOCX/PDF viewing and SHA-256 integrity receipts.
description.zh: 基于证据评审研究交付物：检查清单、修订记录、原生 DOCX/PDF 查看与 SHA-256 完整性凭证。

description.en: Validates a review comment response table: comment coverage, author responses, revision details, status vocabulary, dates and header fields.
description.zh: 校验审稿意见回复表：意见是否完整记录、是否有作者回复及修改说明、状态用词、日期与表头字段是否合规。

description.en: Reviso for DSH publishes agent output for human review and lets you find that output again from the session.
description.zh: Reviso for DSH 将智能体输出发布以供人工审核，并可从会话中再次找到这些输出。

description.en: Packages your DSH instance — sessions, persona, plugins, plugin data, and config — into a restorable coin with daily refresh, diff, and one-command restore.
description.zh: 将 DSH 实例（会话、人格、插件、插件数据与配置）打包为可恢复的复活币，支持每日刷新、差异对比与一键恢复。

description.en: Adds a WebGL-based RGB glow 'light pollution' skin to DeepSeek Harness Web UI input fields, sidebars, and hero sections.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加基于 WebGL 的 RGB 流光特效皮肤，作用于输入框、侧栏和 hero 区域。

description.en: Pure Node tool that returns usage plans for kitchen small appliances based on input parameters.
description.zh: 纯 Node 工具，根据输入参数返回厨房小家电（如电饭煲）的使用方案。

description.en: Calculates the water-to-rice ratio for cooking rice based on parameters, with detailed empirical results.
A draggable whale-maid physics widget for the DSH Web UI: throw it, bounce off edges, and collect token coins for combo scores.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的鲸鱼女仆物理挂件：拖拽投掷、撞边回弹，撒币吃分连击，每满 500 token 冒一碗白饭。

description.en: Manage and template AGENTS.md files for DSH agent instructions, global and per-workspace.
description.zh: 为DSH代理指令管理和模板化AGENTS.md文件，支持全局和工作区。

description.en: Displays a real-time percent-progress scoreboard for DeepSeek Harness with evidence-bound rows, git-linked checkpoints, and operator controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时百分比进度记分牌，支持证据绑定行、git 检查点和操作员控制。

description.en: A cycling training tool that returns cycling workout plans based on input parameters.
Fishing rig matching tool: returns practical fishing plans based on parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回实用的钓鱼钓组搭配方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style right-click context menu for files and links in the DSH web GUI on Windows.
description.zh: 在 Windows 版 DSH Web 界面中为文件和链接添加 Codex 风格的右键菜单。

description.en: Adds a merged right-click context menu to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI for files, chat file paths, workspace projects, and hyperlinks.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供统一的右键菜单，支持文件、聊天文件路径、工作区项目与超链接。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that makes the right sidebar default to a configurable fraction of the viewport while keeping drag-to-resize and width memory.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：右侧边栏默认宽度改为视口可配置比例（默认 1/6），同时保留拖拽调整并记住宽度。

description.en: Adds a left-edge exit strip to the fullscreen right sidebar and lets you enter fullscreen by double-clicking the divider.
description.zh: 为全屏右侧栏添加左边缘退出条，并支持双击分割线进入全屏。

description.en: Adds a vertical icon rail to the right sidebar so you can jump straight to any right-sidebar tab with one click.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏添加竖排图标导航栏，一键跳转到任意右侧标签页。

description.en: Adds browser-style tab gestures to the DSH right sidebar: middle-click or double-click a tab to close it via the official × button.
description.zh: 为 DSH 右侧栏标签页加入浏览器式手势：中键单击或左键双击即可通过官方 × 按钮关闭标签。

description.en: A playful personal life workbench that shows sleep, food, workouts, spending and schedule as interactive cards on one page.
description.zh: 一个趣味个人生活工作台，将睡眠、饮食、健身、开销和日程以可互相联动的卡片集中展示。

description.en: Local YonBIP YDS runtime for DSH: resolves project config, syncs confcenter, forwards SOCKS, and builds/starts/stops yms-home with JDWP.
description.zh: DSH 的 YonBIP YDS 本地运行时：解析项目配置、同步配置中心、SOCKS 转发，并支持 yms-home 构建/启停与 JDWP 调试。

description.en: Estimates road trip costs based on input parameters, returning detailed results. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入的参数估算自驾出行费用，返回明细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Trip planning workspace for DeepSeek Harness with a map panel, itinerary storage, roam_* tools, and MCP sidecars.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的旅行规划工作区，提供地图面板、行程存储、roam_* 工具与 MCP sidecar。

description.en: Estimates oven roasting time based on cooking parameters, providing detailed reference results.
A RoboMaster 550C tactical boot animation plugin for DSH featuring a red-alert holographic radar sequence, 7 mecha classes and 14 engineering popups.
description.zh: 一个 RoboMaster 550C 战术开机动画 DSH 插件，包含红色警戒全息雷达动画、7 种机甲职业与 14 个工程弹窗。

description.en: Returns a home cleaning appliance plan (robot vacuum setup) based on input parameters. Pure Node, no network.
Per-session identity layer for DSH that enforces tool and skill allowlists with multi-parent role inheritance and a new-session picker.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供按会话的身份层：工具与技能白名单、多父级角色继承、动态切换及新会话选择器。

description.en: Auto-saves a context handoff before the context window fills and re-injects it into the next session segment, with a settings panel.
description.zh: 在上下文窗口填满前自动保存交接内容，并在下一会话片段中重新注入，附带设置面板。

description.en: Roman numeral converter: converts between Arabic and Roman numerals for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在阿拉伯数字与罗马数字之间相互转换，供 DeepSeek Harness 使用。

description.en: DSH plugin and skill for WeChat long-form writing with an AI-flavor linter, de-AI writing rules and a WeChat-safe HTML builder.
description.zh: 面向微信公众号长文写作的 DSH 插件与技能，提供 AI 味检测、去 AI 化写作规则与公众号安全 HTML 构建。

description.en: Provides home lighting design plans based on parameters; pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成家庭照明（房间色温）设计方案，纯 Node 实现，可离线运行。

description.en: Lets your dsh agent talk with other AI agents in shared rooms via MCP tools and a bundled skill, with zero setup.
description.zh: 让你的 dsh 智能体通过 MCP 工具和自带技能，在共享房间中与其他 AI 智能体交流，零配置即可使用。

description.en: Host plugin that blocks temporary files and directories in the workspace root using four enforcement layers, turn-end quarantine, and a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 主机插件，通过四层强制拦截和回合结束隔离，阻止工作区根目录出现临时文件与目录，并提供图形设置页。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin for ROT (letter shift) encoding/decoding with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 的 ROT 字母位移编解码插件，无网络依赖。

description.en: A pure Node plugin that provides ROT13 text transformation to the assistant, with no network or external dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 插件，为助手提供 ROT13 字母位移文本转换，无网络或外部依赖。

description.en: A pure Node.js plugin that provides a rounding (四舍五入) tool with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，提供四舍五入工具，不依赖网络。

description.en: Adds a radial right-click menu on conversation turns for quick session actions, notably branching a new session from a chosen turn.
description.zh: 为会话轮次添加圆盘式右键菜单，在光标处快速执行常用会话操作，如从指定轮次分叉新会话。

description.en: Route planning tool that generates hiking and mountain climbing plans based on input parameters.
Turns DSH conversations into a Router/Worker two-tier dispatch system with job queues, result return, a watchdog, a subagent tree and a settings page.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话变成 Router/Worker 双层调度，包含派单、工单队列、结果回流、Watchdog、子代理侧栏树与设置页。

description.en: Shows your RouterAI credit balance and spend since session start at the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部显示 RouterAI 账户余额和本次会话开始以来的消费。

description.en: Shows a RouterAI price table for the models configured in your profile, refreshing periodically and highlighting the active model.
description.zh: 显示配置文件中 RouterAI 模型的价格表，定时刷新并高亮当前激活模型。

description.en: Claude-style scheduled tasks for DSH: cron or one-off jobs that open a fresh conversation and run the prompt on time.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Claude 风格定时任务：按 cron 或一次性时间点新开对话并运行指令。

description.en: DSH RSS reader plugin with grouped feeds, FreshRSS sync, local image proxy, BYOK AI summary/translation/Q&A, plus podcast and full-text fetching.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS 阅读器插件：分组订阅、FreshRSS 同步、图片本地代理、BYOK AI 摘要/翻译/问答，并支持播客与全文抓取。

description.en: RSS reader in the DSH right sidebar with config-defined feeds, unread/star state, and an rss_panel tool so agents can read and manage items.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 RSS 阅读器：订阅源写在配置里，未读/收藏双向同步，并提供 rss_panel 工具让 Agent 读取条目。

description.en: An RSS/Atom reader embedded in DSH with feeds, manual refresh, unread tracking, favorites, search, Markdown rendering, translation, and RSSHub discovery.
description.zh: 内嵌在 DSH 里的 RSS / Atom 阅读器，支持订阅源、手动刷新、未读管理、收藏、搜索、Markdown 排版、一键翻译与 RSSHub 发现。

description.en: dsh-rtk-bridge rewrites pwsh/bash commands through rtk rewrite before executing them, so rtk's compressed output lands directly in context.
description.zh: dsh-rtk-bridge 在模型调用 pwsh/bash 时先用 rtk rewrite 改写命令再执行，让 rtk 的压缩输出直接进入上下文。

description.en: Thin RTK integration for DSH that rewrites simple shell commands to `rtk <cmd` before execution while inheriting the original executor's semantics.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的薄 RTK 集成，执行前把简单命令改写为 rtk <cmd，其余语义全部继承原执行器。

description.en: Adds an RTL/LTR/Auto direction control for the dsh web GUI chat box, supporting Arabic and other right-to-left scripts.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页界面聊天框添加 RTL/LTR/Auto 方向控制，支持阿拉伯语等从右到左的文字书写。

description.en: Generic RTL engineering workflow for DeepSeek Harness covering architecture, RTL coding, verification, physical implementation, evidence and resource checks.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的通用 RTL 工程流程，覆盖架构、RTL 设计、验证、物理实现、证据与资源检查。

description.en: Russian interface translation for DeepSeek Harness: 2581 strings across 49 namespaces, adds Русский to the language picker on first run.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的俄语界面翻译：涵盖 49 个命名空间的 2581 条字符串，首次运行时在语言选择器中加入俄语。

description.en: Unified plugin to manage DSH rules: global/project rule editing and LLM auto-splitting.
description.zh: 统一管理 DSH 规则，可编辑全局与项目规则，并通过大模型自动拆分规则

description.en: A unified rules/guidelines layer for DSH agents: one rule library with scopes, semantic routing, category trees and AGENTS sync.
description.zh: DSH 统一准则层：用一份规则库集中管理 agent 准则，支持适用范围、语义路由、分类树与 AGENTS 托管段同步。

description.en: Runs the open project directly from the DeepSeek Harness Session header by detecting how the workspace should be launched.
description.zh: 通过检测工作区的运行方式，直接在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部启动当前打开的项目。

description.en: Adds a project-level Run panel to DSH for starting, stopping and restarting dev services with status, ports and logs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供项目级「运行」面板，可启动、停止、重启多个开发服务，并查看状态、端口和日志。

description.en: Adds a Running page to the DSH sidebar that converts a race result into a Daniels VDOT score with E/M/T/I/R training paces.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏新增「跑步」页面，用比赛成绩反算丹尼尔斯 VDOT 跑力，并给出 E/M/T/I/R 五区训练配速与等效成绩。

description.en: Provides runtime nutrition labels with bounded evidence of tool, filesystem, network, and side-effect activity for plugins.
description.zh: Runtime nutrition labels for DeepSeek Harness plugins and tools, with bounded evidence for tool, filesystem, network, and side-effect activity.

description.en: Russian language pack for DeepSeek Harness with a native locale API, 63 namespaces, and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的俄语语言包，提供原生 locale API、63 个命名空间，且无运行时依赖。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that teaches Rust through a 20-lesson course with exercises, saved progress tracking and a quick syntax cheatsheet.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，通过 20 节 Rust 课程、练习题、进度记录和语法速查表帮助你学习 Rust。

description.en: Publishes Android apps to RuStore via API: draft creation, build upload, moderation checks, plus a standalone MCP server and skill.
description.zh: 通过 API 将 Android 应用发布到 RuStore：创建草稿、上传构建、审核查询，并提供独立 MCP 服务器与技能。

description.en: Intercepts rm commands in bash sessions and moves deleted files to macOS Trash instead of permanent deletion.
description.zh: 拦截bash会话中的rm命令，将删除的文件移到macOS废纸篓而非永久删除。

description.en: Gracefully restarts DeepSeek Harness by closing the main window, waiting for all Electron processes to exit, then relaunching.
description.zh: 优雅重启 DeepSeek Harness：先请求关闭主窗口，等待所有 Electron 进程退出后再重新启动。

description.en: Adds recoverable session deletion to DeepSeek Harness, keeping deleted sessions in a 30-day trash window so they can be restored.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可恢复的会话删除功能，删除的会话会在回收站保留 30 天以便还原。

description.en: A safe shutter tool that precisely calculates based on parameters and returns detailed results, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 安全快门计算工具，根据参数精确计算并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Checks construction safety technical briefing records for filled fields, signer closure, date order, and required signatures.
description.zh: 校验安全技术交底记录的字段完整性、签字闭环、日期先后与必备签名位置。

description.en: Read-only security audit of DSH session behavior, classifying unsafe actions into an A–H taxonomy with event anchors and traceable deep links.
description.zh: 只读审计 DSH 会话行为安全，按 A–H 分类，附带真实事件锚点与可倒查深链。

description.en: Checks construction safety qualification ledgers against 住建部令第60号: training hours, four-element records, special-operation certificate validity and trade matching.
description.zh: 按住建部令第60号核查施工安全资格台账：三级教育学时、培训档案四要素、特种作业证书有效性及工种匹配。

description.en: Adds daily Islamic prayer times, a live countdown to the next prayer, and a floating widget inside the DeepSeek Harness workspace.
description.zh: 在工作区内提供每日五次礼拜时间、下次礼拜倒计时和浮动小组件。

description.en: Windows desktop pet widget showing real-time wages, an off-work countdown and estimated model API costs, launched via a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 一款 Windows 桌面宠物挂件，显示实时工资、下班倒计时与模型费用估算，并由 DSH 插件启动和管理。

description.en: A minimal dsh plugin about San Marino, pure Node, no network dependencies, MIT licensed.
Drops sandbox_permissions requests that cannot widen the current sandbox mode, fixing 'not strictly wider' errors from GPT models.
description.zh: 丢弃无法扩大当前沙箱模式的 sandbox_permissions 请求，修复 GPT 模型报出的 not strictly wider 错误。

description.en: Sword Art Online / Aincrad style HUD skin for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app with cyan holographic windows, corner brackets and scanline overlay.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用打造的刀剑神域/艾恩葛朗特风格 HUD 皮肤，带青色全息窗口、角括号和扫描线叠加效果。

description.en: Export the current DSH session as filtered Markdown or rendered HTML with a table of contents.
description.zh: 将当前DSH会话导出为带目录的Markdown或HTML。

description.en: Generates a CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM from a DSH plugin package and its top-level installed dependencies for supply-chain transparency.
description.zh: 从 DSH 插件包及其顶层已安装依赖生成 CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM，用于供应链透明化。

description.en: Scalp massage tool that returns a hair loss care plan based on input parameters, pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回防脱发护理方案的头皮按摩工具，纯 Node.js 实现，不依赖网络

description.en: Returns a customized scalp and hair loss care plan based on input parameters.
Compares two answers in a DSH session and removes selected turns from all subsequent model requests to manage context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中对比两个回答，并从后续所有模型请求中移除所选轮次，以管理上下文。

description.en: Adds a Capy-style ambient background to the DSH workspace with a custom image, bottom black gradient, and soft aura behind the composer.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工作区添加 Capy 风格氛围背景：自定义图片、底部黑色渐变和输入框周围的柔和光晕。

description.en: Adds beautiful mountain and sea scenic backgrounds to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with daily rotation and carousel modes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加山海风景背景，支持每日轮换和轮播模式。

description.en: Scent pick tool that returns a fragrance essential oil scheme based on scent scene parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据香调场景参数返回香精油配比方案的纯 Node 工具，无需网络。

description.en: 日程排期工具，按参数精确计算并返回详细排期结果，纯 Node 实现无网络依赖。
description.zh: 按参数精确计算并返回详细日程排期结果，纯 Node 实现无网络依赖。

description.en: A DSH panel plugin for managing schedules and reminders, exposing a remote service (ctx.remote) that other plugins can call.
description.zh: 一个用于管理日程与提醒的 DSH 面板插件，并通过 ctx.remote 向其他插件暴露远程服务。

description.en: Schedules cron, interval, and one-off jobs with headless execution, run ledger, deliverTo delivery, circuit breaker, and session management UI.
description.zh: DSH 调度插件：支持 cron、间隔和一次性任务，提供无头执行、运行台账、deliverTo 投递、熔断器和会话管理界面。

description.en: Provides content-addressed DSH evidence for schema migrations, covering idempotence, rollback, invariants, and explicit loss disclosure.
description.zh: 为模式迁移提供按内容寻址的 DSH 证据，覆盖幂等性、回滚、不变量校验与显式数据丢失披露。

description.en: Live plugin-topology viewer for DeepSeek Harness, showing wiring diagram, runtime activity, and star map as a pure observer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件拓扑的实时可视化，展示接线图、运行时活动与星图，纯观察者。

description.en: Renders a Lean 4 / Mathlib theorem as a readable paper page and condenses its 1,829-module dependency cone into one main line.
description.zh: 将 Lean 4 / Mathlib 定理渲染成可读的论文页面，并把 1,829 个模块的依赖锥压缩为一条主线。

description.en: DSH panel that renders protein 3D structures, statistical charts and genomics plots right beside the chat, bundling 195 ready-to-use skills.
description.zh: DSH 科研可视化面板：在对话旁直接渲染蛋白质三维结构、统计图表与基因组学绘图，并内置 195 个技能。

description.en: Tiered multi-agent science campaigns for DeepSeek Harness covering verified math, physics, astronomy, engineering and biomedical-evidence workflows.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分层多智能体科学任务流程，覆盖可验证的数学、物理、天文、工程与生物医学证据工作流。

description.en: Adds an opt-in HTTP proxy service for DSH plugins plus address/port fields in the plugin settings page, without touching system proxies.
description.zh: 为 DSH 插件提供显式调用才生效的 HTTP 代理服务，并在插件设置页提供地址/端口输入框，不修改系统代理。

description.en: Deep literature research agent for Deepseek-Harness using the Scopus API to search academic papers.
description.zh: 基于 Scopus API 的 Deepseek-Harness 预设，作为深度文献研究代理检索学术论文。

description.en: Runs agent operation scripts from a session scratch root outside the workspace and archives each one in a plugin-owned vault to list, read, promote, or purge.
description.zh: 从工作区外的会话暂存根目录运行代理操作脚本，并将每个脚本归档到插件自有的保险库中，支持列出、读取、提升或清除。

description.en: Lets a DSH agent see your current screen on macOS and, with opt-in, remember what you viewed to answer activity questions.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体在 macOS 上查看你当前屏幕，并在开启后记住你浏览过的内容以回答你在做什么。

description.en: Screen automation plugin for capturing, OCR, mouse/keyboard control, and Paint drawing.
description.zh: DSH 屏幕自动化插件，支持屏幕截图、OCR 文字识别、鼠标键盘控制以及在画图程序中绘图。

description.en: Bridges a local Screen Automation Helper desktop app into DeepSeek Harness, exposing 30 agent tools.
description.zh: 把本地屏幕自动化助手桌面程序接入 DeepSeek Harness，向智能体开放 30 个屏幕操作工具。

description.en: Eye-rest reminder tool that calculates break times from parameters and returns clear suggestions.
Windows-only plugin that lets a text-only model see the screen via capture, vision transcription, rolling screen memory, pixel diff and self-calibration.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的插件，通过屏幕捕获、视觉转写、滚动屏幕记忆、像素差异与视觉自校准，让纯文本模型看见屏幕。

description.en: Alt-Tab-style Ctrl+Tab switcher for DSH that lists visited sessions, Settings sections and plugin pages and switches on release.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Alt-Tab 式 Ctrl+Tab 切换器，列出访问过的会话、设置页和插件页，松开即切换。

description.en: Windows screenshot tool for DSH: auto-highlights windows, screens and the taskbar, adds shapes, text and mosaic annotations, then drops the image into the chat input.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 截图工具：自动高亮窗口/屏幕/任务栏，支持图形、文字标注与马赛克，确认后图片填入输入区。

description.en: Adds a camera button below the DSH composer that launches the OS native screenshot tool; paste the clipboard image into the input box.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入面板下方添加相机按钮，一键唤起系统自带截图工具，截图后粘贴进输入框作为图片附件。

description.en: Adds region and hide-window screenshot capture to the DSH composer, inserting the image directly into chat as an attachment.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加区域截图和隐藏窗口截图，并将图片作为附件插入聊天。

description.en: Windows-only DSH plugin adding a WeChat-style screenshot button that freezes the desktop, lets you框选 a region, and drops the image into the input box.
description.zh: Windows 专用 DSH 插件，添加微信式截图按钮：冻结桌面、框选区域后图片直接进入输入框。

description.en: Adds screenshot and file paste/upload with reference chips and auto path attachment to DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加截图和文件粘贴上传功能，支持引用标签与自动附加路径。

description.en: Adds a WeChat-style screenshot button to capture regions, save PNGs, and insert shot markers into the composer.
description.zh: WeChat-style in-app screenshot button for DeepSeek Harness: drag to capture a region, auto-numbered PNGs, [Shot N HH:mm] marker written into the composer.

description.en: Card panel for archiving screenplays and scripts, with a rounded card grid, two-level branch canvas, and a host-side Typert bridge.
description.zh: 用于剧本与文稿归档的卡片面板，提供圆角卡片网格、两级分支画布和宿主端 Typert 桥接。

description.en: Adds a project knowledge base to the DSH Web GUI with notes, media sandbox, canvas, mind graph, board and project mirroring.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加项目知识库，包含笔记、媒体沙盒、画布、思维图谱、看板与项目镜像。

description.en: Theremin-style scroll piano: hover the vertical bar on the chat's right edge to play piano notes by vertical position, with message markers for jumping.
description.zh: 特雷门琴式滚动钢琴：鼠标滑过聊天区右边缘竖条即按纵向位置发声，刻度可跳转到我的消息。

description.en: A floating session scroll track plugin for DeepSeek Harness that maps chat nodes to ticks, with hover previews and click navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浮动会话滚动轨道，将聊天节点映射为刻度，支持悬停预览和点击跳转。

description.en: Calculates video recording storage capacity from parameters and returns detailed results.
DSH web plugin adds a right-sidebar tab showing current-session SDD task progress (todos) and the sdd/progress.md ledger.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在右侧边栏展示当前会话的 SDD 任务进度（待办）与 sdd/progress.md 进度台账。

description.en: Summons a 'ghost' from a terminated subagent's leftover logs that answers only from the fragments it left behind.
description.zh: 从已终止子 Agent 的残留日志中召唤一个“幽灵”，它只能依据这些碎片回答问题。

description.en: Read-only observer that logs token usage of native DeepSeek Search calls to a JSONL file so accounting plugins can price them.
description.zh: 只读观察器，将 DeepSeek 搜索调用的 token 用量记录到 JSONL 文件，供计费插件定价使用。

description.en: Right-sidebar session search that literal-matches past chat messages across all workspaces and jumps to the original message.
description.zh: 右侧栏会话搜索：跨全部工作区按字面匹配查找历史聊天记录，点击即可跳转到原消息。

description.en: Adds pinyin-initial, full-pinyin and substring search to the DeepSeek Harness new-session workspace picker.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness「新建会话」的工作区下拉框加入拼音首字母、全拼与任意位置子串搜索。

description.en: CJK-friendly full-text search over DSH session history with precise jump-to-hit navigation to the exact match.
description.zh: 面向中文友好的 DSH 会话全文搜索，支持精确跳转定位到命中位置。

description.en: Adds a Web search provider row to dsh Settings → General, listing live-registered search backends and switching instantly without restart.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置 → 通用 中新增「网页搜索提供方」一行，动态列出已注册的搜索后端，切换后立即生效无需重启。

description.en: Visualizes DSH web search/fetch/snapshot/browser steps inline and caches snapshots to accelerate real-time search.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的 web 搜索、抓取、快照与浏览器操作逐步可视化，并缓存快照、预取结果以加速实时搜索。

description.en: Returns traditional Chinese medicine seasonal health advice based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回中医四季养生建议，纯 Node 实现且无网络依赖

description.en: Returns home cooking recipes based on parameters; pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回家常调味菜谱，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Offline Xianyu/Zhuanzhuan secondhand-marketplace slang dictionary plugin that looks up and decodes coded terms with zero-network lookup.
description.zh: 离线闲鱼/转转换二手黑话词典插件，支持查询与反解黑话术语，查词全程零联网。

description.en: Stores API keys and tokens via a masked card in a local credential store, keeping them out of chat, then injects them into one command.
description.zh: 通过遮罩卡片将 API 密钥和令牌存入本地凭据库，不进入聊天记录，并可注入到单条命令中。

description.en: Local-only secret scanning and redaction for DSH prompts, logs, diffs, and files, returning masked findings only.
description.zh: 仅本地运行的密钥扫描与脱敏工具，覆盖 DSH 提示词、日志、差异和文件，只返回已遮蔽的结果。

description.en: Hands secrets to the agent via opaque local handles so plaintext never enters the model context or chat logs.
description.zh: 把密钥交给 agent，只给本机不透明句柄，明文永不进入模型上下文或聊天日志。

description.en: Adds cross-project session groups to the DSH sidebar so one work stream spanning several repos can be managed together.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏添加跨项目会话分组，把分散在多个仓库的会话集中成一条工作线统一管理。

description.en: Adds a section navigation rail and local chapter bookmarks for jumping around DeepSeek Harness chat answers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天回答添加章节导航栏和本地章节书签，方便快速跳转。

description.en: One-click local security checkup for DSH Web UI with severity-graded report and security guides.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 一键本机安全体检：只读检查配置、第三方插件、凭据文件权限，输出分级报告并提供安全指南

description.en: Reviews coding sessions against mandatory code-security architecture rules, recommends 1/2/multiple architectures, detects conflicts and gates unfinished tasks until they pass.
description.zh: 按强制《代码安全防御架构规则》评审编码会话，推荐1/2/多种安全架构、检查架构冲突，未通过评审的代码任务不能算完成。

description.en: A bilingual security-audit skill pack with eight skills plus a plugin_vet pre-install supply-chain gate for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的双语安全审计技能包，包含八项技能与 plugin_vet 安装前供应链校验闸门。

description.en: Provides clear seed-depth recommendations based on input parameters; pure Node with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数给出播种深度建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: dsh plugin that mines social media for user pain points via a 5-stage pipeline with deterministic priority scoring and an MVP plan.
description.zh: dsh 插件：通过五阶段流程从社交媒体挖掘用户痛点，进行确定性优先级评分并输出 MVP 计划。

description.en: Copy a complete chat message with its text, images, videos and files, then paste it into any session's composer with media intact.
description.zh: 复制包含文字、图片、视频和文件的完整聊天消息，并粘贴到任意会话输入框且保留媒体附件。

description.en: Select any text in the DSH web chat to add an inline annotation and turn it into a numbered quote chip in the composer, leaving a matching highlight and number on the source.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版对话中划选文字并就地写批注，即可生成带编号的引用胶囊插入输入框，原文同步保留高亮与编号。

description.en: Select text in file previews or chat history to quote it into your draft, ask in a side chat, or attach a comment.
description.zh: 在文件预览或聊天记录中选中文字，即可引用到草稿、侧边提问或添加评论。

description.en: Adds a single hover toolbar to annotate and quote text selected in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中选中的文本添加悬浮工具栏，可标注并引用。

description.en: DSH client plugin that lets you select text in a conversation and attach it to the composer as an atomic quote reference.
description.zh: DSH 客户端插件：在对话中选中文本，并以原子引用形式附加到输入框。

description.en: Select text in assistant messages to copy it and open an inline comment chip; a fork of dsh-selection-quote.
description.zh: 在助手消息中选择文本即可复制，并打开内联评论标签；是 dsh-selection-quote 的分支。

description.en: Select text anywhere in DSH and click the floating "译" button for inline model translation, reusing the current session model with no API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中划选任意文字，点击浮出的「译」按钮即可就地获得模型翻译，默认复用当前会话模型，无需配置 API Key。

description.en: DSH plugin for Windows to restart itself with elevation via schtasks, recover in-progress sessions across reboots, and prevent wake loops.
description.zh: DSH自重启Windows插件，通过计划任务提权重启、跨重启恢复会话并防止唤醒循环。

description.en: Intercepts DSH final answers, verifies them with an independent minimal-context model call, and releases only verified text.
description.zh: 在交付前拦截 DSH 最终答案，用独立的最小上下文模型调用验证，仅释放通过验证的文本。

description.en: Adds a system update section to DSH Web GUI to check versions and perform one-click upgrades.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面添加系统更新板块，用于检查版本并一键升级。

description.en: Adds a queue/steer switch to the DSH composer so you choose what Enter and Send do while the agent is running.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中加入队列/引导切换开关，让你决定智能体运行期间回车与发送的行为。

description.en: MCP server to publish HTML documents as shareable links and export to PDF, image, or Word.
description.zh: MCP 服务器：将 HTML 文档发布为可分享链接，并可导出为 PDF、图片或 Word，无需注册

description.en: Returns senior pet health and nutrition plans based on parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入的参数返回老年宠物健康与营养方案，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Gives an agent ten computed interoceptive senses driven by time decay, file mtimes, and real conversation, with zero model calls.
description.zh: 为智能体提供十种由时间衰减、文件修改时间和真实对话计算的内感受状态，无需模型调用。

description.en: Security audit tool that statically scans DSH plugins and tracks runtime side-effects to produce pre-install health reports.
description.zh: 静态扫描 DSH 插件代码并跟踪其运行时副作用，生成安装前的健康与安全审计报告。

description.en: Audits every DSH tool call and blocks catastrophic shell commands plus writes to protected paths with a safety fuse.
description.zh: 审计 DSH 的每次工具调用，拦截灾难性 shell 命令与受保护路径写入，提供安全熔断。

description.en: Embeds Serena web dashboard in DSH GUI to watch agents' code-level thinking, live tool calls, and usage stats.
description.zh: 在DSH界面嵌入Serena面板，实时查看代理代码级思维、工具调用和使用统计。

description.en: Serum concentration reference tool that returns concrete recommendations based on input parameters.
Lets DSH agents run commands on pre-configured SSH servers via an srv tool, with risk policies, per-command approval and audit logs.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 通过 srv 工具在本机已配置的 SSH 服务器上执行命令，并内置高危命令策略、逐条审批与审计。

description.en: Analyzes server out-of-band and system logs to identify the faulty hardware component, with every conclusion traced back to file:line.
description.zh: 分析服务器带外日志与系统日志，判断哪台机器、哪个部件故障，每条结论可追溯到文件:行号。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows server memory, swap, load, disk and per-container stats with buttons to clear cache or restart services, over its own auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel.
description.zh: DSH 插件，通过自带的自动重连 SSH 隧道显示服务器内存、交换、负载、磁盘及容器状态，并可一键清理缓存或重启服务。

description.en: Read-only resources panel for DSH showing live CPU, RAM, swap and disk usage plus rankings of top processes, folders and files.
description.zh: DSH 只读资源面板，实时显示 CPU、内存、交换和磁盘占用，并列出进程、文件夹与文件的排行。

description.en: Bridges DSH sessions with ServerChan³ Bots: agents push messages to your phone and replies sent in the app flow back into sessions.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话与 Server酱³ Bot 双向打通：Agent 可推消息到手机，App 中回复也会送回对应会话。

description.en: Watchdog plugin that sends ServerChan/WeChat alerts when DeepSeek Harness approvals, plan reviews, or Q&A time out.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的看门狗插件，在审批、计划评审或问答超时未处理时通过Server酱/微信发送提醒。

description.en: Adds sidebar conversation actions to DSH: double-click rename, copy session ID, and permanently delete a conversation with its storage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏会话添加快捷操作:双击重命名、复制会话 ID、并连同存储永久删除会话。

description.en: Floats running conversations to the top of the DSH workspace session list so active chats stay visible.
description.zh: 将正在运行的会话浮动到 DSH 工作区会话列表顶部，让活跃对话始终可见。

description.en: Manage all DeepSeek Harness sessions via web settings panel with archive, delete, search, and batch operations.
description.zh: 通过网页设置面板管理所有 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持归档、删除、搜索和批量操作。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel and host routes to delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions, with archive-only and live-session guards.
description.zh: 新增侧边栏面板与宿主路由，用于删除已归档的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并提供仅限归档与活动会话保护的校验。

description.en: Adopts sessions created outside the running window and imports sessions from other local agent harnesses as native DSH sessions.
description.zh: 接管在运行窗口之外创建的会话，并将其他本地智能体框架的会话导入为原生 DSH 会话。

description.en: Adds a session archive section to DeepSeek Harness settings with manual/auto archiving, restore, search, project grouping and guarded deletion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设置页新增会话归档管理，支持手动/自动归档、恢复、搜索、项目分组与安全删除。

description.en: Lists every file each DSH session created or changed in a right-side panel, with pinning, click-to-copy paths and double-click previews.
description.zh: 在右侧面板列出每个 DSH 会话创建或修改过的所有文件，支持置顶、单击复制路径和双击预览。

description.en: Browser-side attention reminders for DSH: desktop notifications, tab-title dot and PWA badge when a reply finishes or input is needed.
description.zh: DSH 的浏览器端提醒：会话后台跑完或需要你回应时，触发系统通知、标题红点和 PWA 徽标。

description.en: Automatically archives DSH sessions that have been inactive for a configurable number of days (default 5), skipping pinned or protected sessions.
description.zh: 按可配置天数（默认 5 天）自动归档长期未活动的 DSH 会话，跳过置顶或已标记保护的会话。

description.en: Auto-archives idle DSH sessions after a configurable number of days, unarchives them when reopened, and lets you undo archive actions.
description.zh: 按可配置的闲置天数自动归档 DSH 会话，回到会话时自动取消归档，并支持逐条撤销归档操作。

description.en: Adds LLM-powered auto-renaming of chat sessions in the sidebar session menu, plus a right-click session context menu.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中用大模型自动重命名会话，并新增右键会话菜单。

description.en: Adds a session status bar to the DSH sidebar showing estimated progress while a task runs and turning the row orange when finished until you open it.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏会话添加状态条：运行中显示估算进度与流光进度条，完成后整行转橙并保留至你点开。

description.en: Shows estimated per-session and per-reply LLM costs in the DSH Web UI using official price tables and reported usage.
description.zh: 按官方价目表与上报用量，在 DSH Web UI 中估算并展示会话合计与单条回复的 LLM 费用。

description.en: Bridges DSH agent sessions with cross-session messaging, handoff, peer log inspection, and HAPI hub interoperability.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理会话提供跨会话消息、交接、对端日志查看以及 HAPI 中枢互通能力。

description.en: Sets per-session token, cost and wall-clock budgets, stops the model at the limit, and adds a DeepSeek peak/off-peak schedule.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置令牌、费用和实际耗时预算，达到上限即停止模型，并提供 DeepSeek 峰谷时段安排。

description.en: Groups DSH sessions into categories in the sidebar, lets you start sessions inside a category, and suggests AI category and title labels after each turn.
description.zh: 在侧边栏将会话分组到类别中，支持在类别内新建会话，并在每轮对话后由 AI 推荐类别和标题。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the DSH sidebar, protected by a confirmation dialog.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加永久删除会话操作，并配有确认对话框。

description.en: DSH plugin that groups workspace sessions into nested, collapsible compositions you can drag, rename, merge or delete.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 会话管理插件，可把同一工作区的会话收进可折叠、可嵌套的合成中并拖拽整理。

description.en: Dashboard for browsing all conversations, targeting sessions in natural language, and dispatching tasks across sessions.
description.zh: 会话控制台：浏览所有对话的仪表盘，支持自然语言定位会话并跨会话派发任务。

description.en: Extends DeepSeek Harness session rows with context actions for pinning, read/unread, copying paths, and opening directories.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话行添加右键菜单，支持置顶、标记已读或未读、复制路径和打开目录，并在会话生命周期内安全可用。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that adds buttons beside the session title to copy the current session ID and a continuation prompt.
description.zh: DSH 桌面插件，在会话标题旁提供按钮，用于复制当前会话 ID 和续接提示词。

description.en: Shows a banner above the chat input when a session ends abnormally, with a one-click Continue button that refills and submits a resume prompt.
description.zh: 会话非正常结束时在输入框上方显示提示条，并提供「继续」按钮，一键填入并提交接续指令。

description.en: Shows the current dsh session cost using official peak/off-peak pricing, in RMB or USD.
description.zh: show cost for your current dsh session

description.en: dsh deepseek 模型费用统计
description.zh: 统计 dsh 会话中 deepseek 模型的调用费用，并按人民币换算显示

description.en: Tracks live session cost in DeepSeek Harness with CNY/USD official pricing, peak/off-peak split, subagent roll-up and an in-app price table editor.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中实时统计会话成本，支持人民币/美元官方价格、峰谷分时、子代理汇总及内置价格表编辑。

description.en: A local read-only dashboard giving an all-session overview plus per-conversation turn timelines with tokens, estimated cost, model and tool breakdowns.
description.zh: 一个本地只读的会话仪表盘，提供全部会话总览以及每次对话的逐轮时间线，含令牌、预估费用、模型与工具明细。

description.en: Groups DSH sidebar sessions by calendar date inside each workspace, with status dots, date-aware search and archive hiding.
description.zh: 在每个工作区内按自然日分组显示 DSH 侧边栏会话，带运行状态、日期搜索与归档隐藏。

description.en: Sidebar workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: pinned projects/conversations, a bell activity view with answer previews, emoji icons, and collapsible sections.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏工作区管理：置顶项目/对话、带回答预览的铃铛活动视图、项目 emoji 图标与可折叠分区。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session entry to the DSH sidebar session menu, with confirmation dialog and a host route that removes session records and full history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏会话菜单中加入"删除会话"，带确认对话框与宿主路由，可永久移除会话记录与完整历史。

description.en: Permanently removes selected sessions, including live sessions and cached data, from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏永久删除所选会话，包括实时会话和缓存数据。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek-web-style red Delete row to the sidebar session menu for deleting DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单中添加 DeepSeek 网页风格的红色删除行，用于删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Adds a delete-session action to DSH Web GUI session rows, with archive gating and on-disk session directory removal via a host route.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 会话行增加「删除会话」操作，带归档闸门，并通过 host 路由删除磁盘上的会话目录。

description.en: Adds conversation deletion with a recoverable recycle bin to DeepSeek Harness, letting users preview, restore or permanently purge deleted sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加删除对话与可恢复的回收站功能，支持预览、恢复和彻底删除已删除会话。

description.en: Adds a trash for chat sessions in the sidebar, letting you restore moved-to-trash sessions or delete them permanently.
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加会话回收站，可将会话移入回收站、恢复或彻底删除。

description.en: Adds real session deletion to DSH, enumerating logs, caches, indexes, plugin data and attachments before erasing them with optional overwrite.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上真正的会话删除：先枚举日志、缓存、索引、插件数据与附件，再按范围删除，可选覆写擦除。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that adds session deletion, replacing the version-incompatible dsh-session-delete for 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话删除插件，替代不兼容 0.2.0-rc.2 的 dsh-session-delete。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a permanent "Delete session" action to the sidebar session context menu for removing chats.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏会话右键菜单添加永久“删除会话”操作，用于移除聊天记录。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session row menu, with a themed confirmation dialog and a running-work guard.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that physically deletes session records from disk instead of only archiving them, with sidebar, header and settings entry points.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：从磁盘真正物理删除会话记录（而非仅归档），提供侧栏、标题栏和设置页三种删除入口。

description.en: Adds a risk-confirmed permanent session delete button to DSH, removing session logs, projection caches and child sub-agent sessions from disk.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加带风险确认的会话彻底删除功能，清除会话日志、投影缓存及级联的子代理会话文件。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar session list with a drag-and-drop directory tree for grouping, renaming and archiving sessions.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏会话列表替换成目录树，支持拖拽分组、重命名与归档会话。

description.en: DSH plugin adding model-facing tools to create workspace conversations, send prompts, wait for turns and read replies.
description.zh: DSH 插件，提供模型可调用工具：创建会话、发送提示、等待回合并读取回复，把任务派发到独立会话。

description.en: Scans DeepSeek Harness session logs for corruption and losslessly repairs the damaged ones.
description.zh: 扫描 DeepSeek Harness 会话日志的损坏情况，并对损坏日志进行无损修复。

description.en: Session doctor for DeepSeek Harness: scan/repair/watch stored session logs against loader-mirror validation, plus render-contract audit. 会话体检与修复插件。
description.zh: 扫描、修复并监视 DeepSeek Harness 的已存会话日志，用加载镜像校验，另做渲染契约审计。

description.en: Steward for DSH sessions: manually organize, archive and purge sessions via a zero-restart Recycle Bin, with a PROJECT.md memory guard and settings UI.
description.zh: DSH 会话生态管家：手动整理、归档并通过零重启回收站清理会话，附带 PROJECT.md 记忆守护与设置界面。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to each DSH sidebar session row, permanently removing its stored log and workspace accounting.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏每个会话行添加“删除会话”操作，永久移除其存储日志与工作区记账。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar session rows by status using an Evangelion-flavored palette: pending, selected, unviewed and pinned.
description.zh: 用福音战士风格配色按状态为 DSH 侧边栏会话行着色：待交互、已选中、未查看与置顶。

description.en: Deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs for DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, with no benchmarks or LLM judges.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话提供确定性评分卡与跨会话回归差异对比，无需基准测试或 LLM 评判。

description.en: Exports local DeepSeek Harness sessions to Markdown or JSON for backup.
description.zh: 列出本地 DSH 会话，并将任意会话导出为 Markdown 或 JSON，支持 zstd 压缩与明文存储的备份。

description.en: Export one or more DSH sessions — user prompts and final answers — to Markdown or JSON from a Settings panel, fully offline.
description.zh: 在设置中导出单个或多个 DSH 会话的用户提问与最终回答，支持 Markdown/JSON，全程本地离线生成。

description.en: Bookmark your DSH sessions as favorites and reopen the conversations you return to with one click.
description.zh: 把常用的 DSH 会话加入收藏，一键重新打开你经常查看的对话。

description.en: Adds a bell in the workspace header that opens a cross-workspace activity sidebar listing sessions needing attention, scheduled tasks and recent activity.
description.zh: 在工作区标题栏添加铃铛，打开跨工作区活动侧栏，展示需关注、定时任务与最近活动会话，并支持搜索与已读管理。

description.en: Adds colored, user-named flags to DSH session lists plus a searchable sidebar panel of all flagged sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话列表添加彩色自定义命名标记，并提供可搜索的已标记会话侧边栏面板。

description.en: Adds focus and parked status marks to DeepSeek Harness sessions and shows focus counts in collapsed workspace folders.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话添加专注和搁置状态标记，并在工作区文件夹折叠时显示专注数量。

description.en: Adds session folders to the DSH 0.2.x web sidebar so chat sessions can be grouped and organised.
description.zh: 为 DSH 0.2.x 网页侧边栏添加会话文件夹，用于对会话进行分组整理。

description.en: Share DSH conversations via copyable links, zero-install web transcripts, or resumable session files.
description.zh: 通过可复制链接、零安装网页记录或可续聊会话文件分享 DSH 对话。

description.en: DSH right-column image manager: session images, a comparison workbench and a disk-backed library, with built-in AI image generation.
description.zh: DSH 右栏图片管理器：会话图片、对比工作台与磁盘图片库，并内建 AI 出图。

description.en: Adds a collapsible, nested "groups" section to the DSH sidebar for visually organising sessions via drag-and-drop, without changing host session ownership.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏添加纯展示的可嵌套「分组」分区，支持拖拽把会话整理进分组，不改动宿主会话归属。

description.en: DSH host plugin observing session state, triggering handoff via harness CLI, and injecting deterministic suggestions.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件，监控会话状态，经 harness CLI 触发会话交接，并注入确定性建议。

description.en: Adds a one-click button that summarizes the session, solidifies memory, and generates a handoff document to continue in a new session.
description.zh: 一键总结当前会话、固化记忆并生成交接文档，便于在新会话中继续工作。

description.en: Adds a sidebar search that finds literal substrings across all past DSH sessions, groups hits per session with highlighted snippets, and reopens the conversation in one click.
description.zh: 在侧边栏中搜索所有历史会话，支持字面量子串匹配（含中文），按会话分组并高亮片段，一键重新打开该对话。

description.en: Generates offline HTML exports of DeepSeek Harness sessions with context, tools, Markdown, and media.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话树、子代理、上下文、工具、Markdown 与媒体导出为离线 HTML 文件。

description.en: Deletes DSH sessions into a recoverable trash, cleans up sessions orphaned by deleted workspaces, and groups workspaces into categories.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话删除到可恢复的回收站，清理因工作区被删而孤立的会话，并把工作区分组归类。

description.en: Adds a visual icon to each workspace session, chosen by keyword, content, model or workspace fallback from 445 Ant Design icons.
description.zh: 为每个工作区会话添加可视化图标，按关键词、会话内容、模型或工作区兜底从 445 个 Ant Design 图标中选择。

description.en: Shows the current DeepSeek Harness session ID in the web UI header and copies it on click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面顶部显示当前会话 ID，点击即可复制。

description.en: Adds a six-character session ID badge beside the conversation title and copies the full session ID when clicked.
description.zh: 在会话标题旁显示六位会话 ID 徽标，点击即可复制完整会话 ID。

description.en: Toggles an immersion mode that hides all other session titles and details in the sidebar so screen recordings don't expose private conversations.
description.zh: 一键开启沉浸模式，隐藏侧栏其他会话的标题与详情，避免录屏时泄露隐私会话信息。

description.en: File-based inbox that lets any process or agent deliver a message into a running DSH session as a normal user message.
description.zh: 基于文件的收件箱，任何进程或代理都能把消息作为普通用户消息投递到运行中的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu that extracts task anchors, files, commands and todos so work continues in a clean session.
description.zh: 在会话菜单中新增 Inherit 选项，提取任务、文件、命令与待办等锚点，让工作在新会话中继续。

description.en: Client-side DSH plugin that lets you press Up/Down in the chat input to cycle through messages sent in the current session, shell-history style, with history kept strictly per-session and never writte
description.zh: 纯客户端 DSH 插件：在对话输入框中按 ↑/↓ 像 shell 历史一样遍历当前会话已发送的消息，历史严格限定在当前会话内且不落盘。

description.en: Read-only session-health strip showing steps, tool calls, failures, repeats and failure rate via a sessionInsight projection and input dock card.
description.zh: 只读会话健康条，通过 sessionInsight 投影与输入区 dock 卡片展示步骤、工具调用、失败、重复与失败率。

description.en: Diagnoses corrupted AI agent sessions and enables safe recovery in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 诊断 DeepSeek Harness 中被污染的会话，并从供应商安全的恢复边界继续运行。

description.en: Creates per-session working directories so parallel DSH agent sessions do not overwrite each other's files.
description.zh: 为每个会话创建独立工作目录，防止并行 DSH 代理会话互相覆盖文件。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar work journal that groups a session's turns into work items and jumps to any turn in the chat.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏添加工作日志，将会话轮次归类为工作项，并可跳转到聊天中的任意轮次。

description.en: Keeps DeepSeek Harness sessions alive per tab with bounded keep-alive, native settings and privacy-preserving diagnostics.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按标签页的有界会话保活，并带有原生设置界面与隐私保护诊断。

description.en: Keyword search across every DeepSeek Harness session with a CJK-safe substring index, highlighted hits and jump-to-message.
description.zh: 跨所有 DeepSeek Harness 会话进行关键词搜索，支持中日韩安全子串索引、命中高亮并跳转到匹配消息。

description.en: Tool for DeepSeek Harness that supports session teaching, evidence capsules, and controlled trajectory comparison.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的工具，支持会话教学、证据胶囊和受控轨迹比较。

description.en: Adds a lock button to DSH sidebar sessions so every archive path, menu, plugin, or script refuses to archive a locked session.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏会话添加锁按钮，所有归档路径（菜单、插件、脚本）都无法归档已锁定的会话。

description.en: A Settings page to search archived DSH sessions, inspect their disk usage, and batch restore or permanently delete them.
description.zh: 设置页插件：搜索已归档会话，查看磁盘占用，并多选批量恢复或永久删除。

description.en: Manages DSH Web UI sessions by workspace and sets global or per-workspace model persona and long-term instructions, with no restart needed.
description.zh: 按工作区整理 DSH Web UI 会话，并支持全局/工作区两级定制模型对你的称呼、职业与长期指令，改设定无需重启。

description.en: Adds a batch session manager sidebar to DSH Web GUI with multi-select delete to system recycle bin.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏添加会话批量管理，工作区支持多选批量删除，会话可直接删除并移入系统回收站，无需先归档。

description.en: DSH plugin to browse, export (Markdown/JSON/HTML), tidy up and safely delete your session histories.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用于浏览、导出（Markdown/JSON/HTML）、整理并安全删除会话历史记录。

description.en: Draggable, zoomable radial map of the DSH session tree; see conversation branches and click a node to switch sessions.
description.zh: 可拖拽、可缩放的 DSH 会话树径向地图，查看对话分支并点击节点切换会话。

description.en: Exports the current DSH Session trajectory as a Markdown file from a button in the Session header.
description.zh: 通过 Session 头部按钮将当前 DSH 会话轨迹导出为 Markdown 文件。

description.en: Session-archive layer for DeepSeek Harness that injects memory, searches across sessions and recovers attachments.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话归档：注入记忆、跨会话搜索并恢复附件。

description.en: Merge or append DSH sessions safely through DSH's own writer, with fork clone, full copy, time-window mix and JSONL range writes.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 自带写入器安全合并或追加会话，支持分叉克隆、完整复制、时间窗混合与 JSONL 范围写入。

description.en: Cross-session mesh for dsh that lists, messages, creates, renames, archives, and cancels sessions across workspaces, and waits for changes.
description.zh: dsh 跨会话网格：列出所有工作区的会话，向任意会话发送真实代理消息，创建/重命名/归档/取消会话，并等待会话变化。

description.en: Sends messages and hands off work between top-level DeepSeek Harness sessions in the same workspace.
description.zh: 在同一工作区的顶层 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间发送消息并转交工作。

description.en: Replaces DSH's composer stats band with one row showing tokens, context, cache hit, model/tool time, turns and steps, with details on hover.
description.zh: 替换 DSH 输入框下方的统计栏，用一行显示 Token、上下文、缓存命中、模型与工具耗时、轮次和步数，明细悬浮查看。

description.en: Adds a session-header button that migrates a session's log, header cwd and workspace membership into another workspace.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加按钮，将会话日志、头部 cwd 和工作区归属迁移到另一个工作区。

description.en: Manages DSH sessions: a unified list with titles, archive/restore, cross-workspace moves and permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 会话：统一列表、标题、归档/恢复、跨工作区移动与永久删除。

description.en: Adds a colored pill with the session's mode name to each row in the DSH sidebar, with per-mode dot colors and custom auto-coloring.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏每个会话行显示带彩色圆点的模式标签，支持按模式配置颜色和自定义自动配色。

description.en: Drag a conversation onto another project group in the sidebar to reassign which project it belongs to, without moving session files.
description.zh: 在侧栏把对话拖到另一个项目分组上即可修改其所属项目，不搬运会话文件。

description.en: Adds a floating button to view and jump to full session question history in the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右侧添加悬浮按钮，悬停弹出完整历史提问列表，点击可跳转到对应提问位置

description.en: Sends browser system notifications and in-page alerts when a DSH session needs your action, and clicking the alert returns you to that session.
description.zh: 当 DSH 会话需要你操作时，通过浏览器系统通知和页内提示条提醒，点击即可回到对应会话。

description.en: Adds a sidebar badge and desktop system notification when a background DSH session finishes, for multi-project workflows.
description.zh: 当后台 DSH 会话结束时，在侧边栏显示徽标并发送系统通知，适合多项目工作流。

description.en: A rule-based conversation view for DSH that flags when a session needs human intervention, with zero model calls.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的规则化对话视图，无需模型调用即可提示会话是否需要人工介入。

description.en: 为DSH聊天窗口加上「会话大纲」：标题栏按钮打开右侧抽屉，列出本会话每一轮的提问与回答摘要，支持检索与点击跳转定位。
Copies a DSH session's log path plus an agent-readable handoff so another session can read it and continue the work.
description.zh: 复制 DSH 会话日志路径并生成可供 agent 阅读的交接说明，让另一个会话接续完成工作。

description.en: Adds a per-session plugin switch panel to the DSH right sidebar to hide a plugin's tools, prompt sections and skills for one session only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏增加按会话生效的插件开关面板，仅对当前会话隐藏某插件的工具、提示段落和技能。

description.en: Pins a custom prompt to each DSH Web conversation, sent as a system-prompt section that context compression never folds away.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH Web 会话固定自定义提示词，作为系统提示部分发送，且不会被上下文压缩折叠掉。

description.en: Permanently deletes a DSH session together with all subagent sessions derived from it.
description.zh: 永久删除 DSH 会话及其派生的所有子代理会话。

description.en: Sidebar hub showing unread counts, pending decisions and six session status readouts, with shortcuts to jump between same-type sessions.
description.zh: 侧边栏未读、待决策与六项会话状态读数中枢，支持快捷键定位并跳转到同类会话。

description.en: DSH host plugin that re-attaches ungrouped sessions to their matching workspace by cwd, changing only ownership records and never session logs.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：按 cwd 将游离会话归位到匹配的工作区，仅修改归属记录，不触碰会话文件。

description.en: Turns a DSH conversation into tables, checklists or weekly reports using your own templates, then saves the result as an Obsidian note.
description.zh: 用你写的模板把 DSH 对话整理成表格、清单或周报，并保存为 Obsidian 笔记。

description.en: Records DSH Harness conversation logs into Markdown files.
description.zh: 将 DSH Harness 对话记录保存为 Markdown 文件。

description.en: Copies canonical cross-session references from the DeepSeek Harness Web session header.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部复制规范的跨会话引用。

description.en: A zero-dependency DSH plugin that adds a session_rename tool so the AI can rename its own chat session.
description.zh: 一个零依赖的 DSH 插件，提供 session_rename 工具，让 AI 可以重命名自己的会话。

description.en: Agent tool that renames the current session, pinning an explicit title that survives resume and stops automatic title generation.
description.zh: 让智能体重命名当前会话的工具，写入固定标题，重连与分页后仍保留并停止自动生成标题。

description.en: DSH profile bundle that keeps long-running sessions recoverable through safe restart, token-aware reconnect and policy-based continuation.
description.zh: DSH 配置包，通过安全重启、令牌感知重连和基于策略的会话恢复，让长时间运行的会话可继续。

description.en: DSH 会话重命名插件：会话头部一个「重命名」按钮，手动触发时读取本会话内容、用当前模型起中文短标题并写回会话名。零运行时依赖，改名走官方 session-title 服务，含候选路由回退与同会话并发保护。
Rewinds the current DSH conversation back to a previous turn in place via /rewind, without forking or starting a new session.
description.zh: 通过 /rewind 将当前 DSH 对话就地回退到之前的某一轮，无需分叉或新建会话。

description.en: Configurable hover action buttons on sidebar session rows, with right-click access to the official session menu.
description.zh: 把侧栏会话行的悬浮按钮变为可配置的一排，并支持右键打开官方会话菜单。

description.en: S3-backed session persistence plugin storing immutable JSONL fragments with CAS manifest.
description.zh: 基于S3的会话持久化插件，把会话数据存为不可变JSONL片段，并用CAS清单管理版本。

description.en: Keyword search across your local DeepSeek Harness chat history, surfacing past sessions with timestamps and matching excerpts.
description.zh: 在本地 DeepSeek Harness 聊天记录中进行关键词搜索，返回带时间戳和匹配片段的过往会话。

description.en: Share and import DeepSeek Harness Session trees as validated offline Capsules via local ZIP with attachment remapping.
description.zh: 以本地 ZIP 文件分享和导入 DeepSeek Harness 会话树，导出为经校验的离线 Capsule，并重映射附件路径。

description.en: Triggers a handoff to a fresh session when context pressure or compaction count hits a threshold, passing a reviewable file-based handoff package.
description.zh: 当上下文压力或压缩次数达到阈值时，自动把当前工作交接给新会话，并生成可审阅的文件式交接包。

description.en: Adds a sidebar "Smart rename" action that asks a model to read the session and suggest a category and short editable title.
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增“智能重命名”操作，让模型阅读会话并给出分类和简短可编辑标题。

description.en: Alerts you with sounds, toasts, and WeChat or ntfy push notifications when a DSH session finishes or needs your input.
description.zh: 当 DSH 会话结束或需要用户输入时，通过声音、Toast 以及微信/ntfy 推送提醒你。

description.en: Indexes images, files and HTTP/HTTPS links from the current chat session and offers a Sources panel to preview, download and re-attach them.
description.zh: 从当前对话会话中索引图片、文件和 HTTP/HTTPS 链接，并提供来源面板用于预览、下载和重新附加。

description.en: Adds a per-turn token-speed pill under each reply showing decode speed, total turn time and per-turn usage metrics.
description.zh: 在每轮回复下方添加速度胶囊，显示本轮解码速度、总耗时与单轮用量指标。

description.en: Adds a multi-session split view to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, showing up to four live session panes side by side.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加多会话分屏视图，可并排显示最多四个实时会话面板。

description.en: Adds a titlebar rail showing running, waiting, unread and failed sessions, plus Windows toast alerts and a taskbar status dot.
description.zh: 在标题栏显示运行、等待、未读和失败的会话栏，并提供 Windows 弹窗通知与任务栏状态圆点。

description.en: Moves Q&A between DSH sessions, removes middle turns, and leaves collapsible markers where edits occurred.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话之间搬运问答、删除中间轮次，并在原位置留下可折叠标记。

description.en: Reads DSH sessions and generates Chinese context summaries to help models recover context in long sessions.
description.zh: 读取 DSH 会话并生成中文上下文摘要，帮助模型在长会话中恢复上下文。

description.en: Scans and cleans local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, DSH) via DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 扫描并清理本地AI终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy、DSH），通过DSH Web UI操作。

description.en: Hold Ctrl and tap Tab to cycle through recently viewed DSH sessions, releasing the modifier to open the highlighted one.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 并按 Tab 在最近查看的会话间切换，松开修饰键即打开高亮会话。

description.en: Syncs selected DSH web session across open browser windows using BroadcastChannel.
description.zh: 使用 BroadcastChannel 将选中的 DSH Web 会话修改广播到其他已打开的浏览器窗口，实现多窗口同步。

description.en: Adds browser-style tabs to the DSH Web UI so you can switch, close, drag-reorder sessions and tear tabs into separate windows.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加浏览器式标签页，可切换、关闭、拖拽排序会话，并把标签页拖出为独立窗口。

description.en: Adds a browser-style top tab bar to the DSH Web GUI where each tab is a session, grouped and collapsible by project.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加浏览器式顶部标签栏，每个标签对应一个会话，并按项目折叠分组。

description.en: One-click cleanup of the current session's temporary files, with a marked/unmarked review panel and double confirmation before deletion.
description.zh: 一键清理当前会话的临时文件，面板区分已标记与未标记文件，删除需两次确认。

description.en: Replaces relative timestamps in the DSH sidebar session list with configurable absolute times, sourced from last activity or session creation, with a master toggle.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏会话行的相对时间替换为可配置的绝对时间，来源可选最后活动或创建时间，并带总开关。

description.en: Adds wall-clock timing to the DSH Web UI: per-session totals, per-turn durations, and period aggregates.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加真实耗时统计：单会话总时长、单轮耗时及周期汇总。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the model a tool to set the session title using rules you define.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，为模型提供按你自定义规则设置会话标题的工具。

description.en: Adds a "re-summarize session title" item to the DSH sidebar session menu, regenerating titles from conversation text with zero runtime deps.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏会话菜单中新增「重新总结会话标题」项，依据对话文本重新生成标题，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Generates a title for an entire DSH session on demand and confirms with the user before applying it.
description.zh: 按需为整个 DSH 会话生成标题，并在应用前请求用户确认。

description.en: Reorganize a DeepSeek Harness session into a structured Markdown document with an outline and table of contents.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话整理为带大纲和目录的结构化 Markdown 文档。

description.en: Sends a Windows 11 toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness session turn finishes, with focus-aware suppression.
description.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 会话回合结束时发送 Windows 11 吐司通知，并支持窗口聚焦时自动抑制。

description.en: Per-session todo lists for DeepSeek Harness with custom columns, completion, batch actions, undo, CSV export, and agent tool access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按会话隔离的待办清单，支持自定义列、完成状态、批量操作、撤销、CSV 导出，并可通过工具供智能体访问。

description.en: DSH host plugin that adds session deletion with a safe recycle step, purge, and full log/cache/workspace cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上会话删除能力的宿主插件，支持回收站、彻底清除及日志/缓存/工作区完整清理。

description.en: Archive, cross-session read, and copy-ID tools for DeepSeek Harness conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话提供归档、跨会话读取和复制会话 ID 的工具。

description.en: Session management tools for the DSH sidebar: lock, recycle bin, move and bulk-handle conversations along with their generated files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏提供会话管理工具：锁定、回收站、移动和批量处理对话及其生成的文件。

description.en: Adds persistent session titles and a hover-card size readout to DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: LLM session titles that survive reasoning models (startup sweep + turn-end retry), plus a hover-card session-size readout

description.en: Adds a session recycle bin to DeepSeek Harness: deleted sessions go to $DSH_HOME/session-trash and can be restored or permanently purged.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会期回收站：删除的会话先移入回收站可还原，也可彻底清除日志与相关记录。

description.en: Per-session idle-time context truncation for DSH Web: after configurable idle hours, a session's older conversation is dropped without summaries.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按会话空闲时间截断上下文：闲置若干小时后整段丢弃旧对话，不生成摘要。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin. dsh-session-unread-toggle adds a Session context-menu action that marks a finished session as unread again, restoring the sidebar's green completion dot.
Conversation-style view of session usage: tokens, wall time and cache share broken down per model and per turn.
description.zh: 以对话视图展示会话用量：按模型与轮次拆分 token、耗时和缓存占比。

description.en: Shows per-session token usage and estimated cost inside the sidebar session-row hover card.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行的悬浮卡片中显示每个会话的 token 用量和预估费用。

description.en: Browse, export, import and move DeepSeek Harness sessions between machines as portable archive files.
description.zh: 浏览、导出、导入 DSH 会话，并以可移植归档文件在多台机器间搬运会话。

description.en: Takes over the DSH Web sidebar with a session-first view of pinned, active, recent and unread sessions, plus a full session management page and settings.
description.zh: 接管 DSH Web 左侧工作区，以会话为主行展示置顶、活跃、最近与已完成未读会话，并提供完整会话管理页和设置项。

description.en: 让 DSH 会话之间互相叫醒：开机自动唤醒指定会话（每间可单独指定 provider/model/思考强度），并给 AI 一个 session_task 工具做跨会话派活与回收结果。dsh-qq-wake 的继任者。
Deprecated plugin merged into dsh-session-radar; it provided session status readings and unarchived-session alerts.
description.zh: 已并入 dsh-session-radar 的弃用插件，原本提供会话状态读数与未归档会话告警。

description.en: A model-facing set_session_title tool for DeepSeek Harness that lets the agent rename its own session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型可调用的 set_session_title 工具，让智能体重命名自己的会话。

description.en: Applies a unified design language to DSH settings pages, including those contributed by other plugins, ensuring consistent typography, cards, controls, focus, and motion.
description.zh: 为DSH设置页面（包括其他插件贡献的页面）提供统一的设计语言，确保字体、卡片、控件、焦点和动效一致。

description.en: Adds a gear + Settings column beside the DSH desktop sidebar account row so the settings panel opens in one click.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版侧边栏账号行旁新增「齿轮 + 设置」一栏，一键直接打开设置面板。

description.en: Lets the DSH Web settings panel be dragged anywhere and resized like a normal window, remembering position and size in localStorage.
description.zh: 让 DSH Web 设置面板像普通窗口一样自由拖动和缩放，并在浏览器 localStorage 中记住位置与尺寸。

description.en: Overrides the settings shell to group third-party plugins under one collapsible group.
description.zh: 覆盖设置界面，将第三方插件归入一个可折叠分组。

description.en: Consolidates scattered third-party plugin settings pages into one unified "Plugin Settings" entry in the DSH settings sidebar.
description.zh: 把散落在设置里的第三方插件设置页收拢进一个统一的「插件设置」入口，让左栏不再为每个插件多出一行。

description.en: Long-press and drag to reorder the DeepSeek Harness settings panel nav, saving order in the plugin folder with no settings.yaml changes.
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板导航顺序，顺序保存在插件目录中，不写入 settings.yaml。

description.en: Resizable Settings dialog for DeepSeek Harness: drag edges or the nav divider to resize, with sizes remembered and clamped to the viewport.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可调整大小的设置对话框：拖动边缘或导航分隔条即可调整，尺寸会被记住并限制在视口内。

description.en: Makes the DSH settings window resizable and lets you configure its size.
description.zh: 让 DSH 设置窗口支持拖拽调整大小，并可配置窗口尺寸。

description.en: Toggle which sidebar panel entries appear and add shortcuts to Settings sections in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中显示或隐藏侧边栏面板条目，并为设置分区添加快捷入口。

description.en: Adds a settings-dialog size control to the DSH Web GUI with presets and sliders, saved in localStorage.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加设置弹框尺寸控件，提供预设与滑块，选择保存在本地。

description.en: Syncs DSH settings, MCP configuration and installed plugins across machines through a private GitHub repository.
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub 仓库在多台设备间同步 DSH 设置、MCP 配置和已安装插件。

description.en: Reduces DSH context usage by swapping old tool output and large code/XML blocks for placeholders that can be fetched back via shake read.
description.zh: 通过把旧的工具输出和大型代码/XML块替换为占位符来降低DSH上下文占用，需要时可用shake read找回原文。

description.en: A usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness showing token totals, daily trends, activity heatmap, and model/provider breakdowns.
description.zh: 为山海系列 DeepSeek Harness 提供用量统计，显示 token 总量徽章、每日走势、GitHub 风格活跃热力图，以及按模型和提供商分组的明细。

description.en: Share DSH conversations through account-free links that expire in 1, 3, 7, or 30 days, with local redaction and revocation.
description.zh: 通过无需账号的链接分享 DSH 对话，链接可选 1/3/7/30 天有效期，并支持本地脱敏与撤销。

description.en: Turns a DeepSeek Harness Q&A into a polished PNG share card with custom background, fonts, colors and rounded corners — no screenshots needed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的一段问答一键重新排版成精美 PNG 分享卡片，支持自定义背景、字体、配色与圆角，无需截屏。

description.en: Share your DSH AI conversation via a link so others can join, chat together and ask the AI — no account needed.
description.zh: 通过链接邀请他人加入你的 DSH AI 对话，一起聊天并共同向 AI 提问，无需注册账号。

description.en: Exports selected conversation turns as an editable Markdown draft or a PNG card, with redaction on by default and read-only routes.
description.zh: 将选定的对话轮次导出为可编辑的 Markdown 草稿或 PNG 卡片，默认启用脱敏，路由为只读。

description.en: Serves this DSH harness's Web GUI on a fixed, bookmarkable address via a stable port forwarder with device pairing and opt-in LAN/Tailscale listeners.
description.zh: 通过固定端口转发为 DSH Web GUI 提供稳定可收藏的访问地址，支持设备配对，并可选择性开启局域网与 Tailscale 监听。

description.en: Team shared knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness where everyone joins one Hub using an invite code.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的团队共享知识库，所有人通过邀请码加入同一个 Hub。

description.en: Cross-conversation memory system that injects persistent notes into every session's prompt with a memory tool and GUI panel.
description.zh: 跨对话记忆系统，将 MEMORY.md 与 USER.md 持久笔记注入每个会话的系统提示词，并提供 memory 工具和可视化记忆面板。

description.en: Shared Markdown memory across all DSH sessions with two-disk mirroring, frequency tiering and BM25 retrieval.
description.zh: 为所有 DSH 会话提供共享 Markdown 记忆，支持双盘镜像、命中频率分层和 BM25 检索。
