description.en: Fills recurring Excel templates, flags reconciliation exceptions, and traces every value back to its source data.
description.zh: 自动填充重复使用的 Excel 模板,标记对账异常,并追溯每个数值的来源。

description.en: Shows a segmented progress bar inside the tool call card indicating which step of a multi-step shell command is currently running.
description.zh: 在工具调用卡片内用分段进度条显示多步 Shell 命令当前执行到哪一步。

description.en: A DSH wallpaper plugin that adds a bundled default background with a live control panel and translucent shell tokens.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 壁纸插件，内置默认背景，提供实时控制面板与半透明外壳样式变量。

description.en: Gives DSH agents multiple cross-platform persistent background shells (zsh, cmd, gitbash, pwsh) with a sidebar panel mirroring the PTY stream.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供多个跨平台持久后台 shell（zsh/cmd/gitbash/pwsh），侧边栏面板同步显示 PTY 输出流。

description.en: Upload an a cappella vocal take to get an acoustic profile — range, jitter/shimmer/HNR metrics, plus EQ and mixing suggestions.
description.zh: 上传清唱干声，生成音域、频段能量与 jitter/shimmer/HNR 等声学画像，并给出编曲混音与护嗓建议。

description.en: Freezes local snapshots of public URLs, reconstructs a reviewable timeline and reports conflicts, gaps and coverage.
description.zh: 冻结公开 URL 的本地快照，重建可复核的时间线，并报告冲突、缺口与覆盖范围。

description.en: Lets you compare, rebind and restore DeepSeek Harness keyboard shortcuts against their defaults.
description.zh: 可对比、重新绑定并恢复 DeepSeek Harness 的键盘快捷键默认设置。

description.en: Keyboard-driven quick switcher for DeepSeek Harness with model and session palettes, permission cycling, and a shortcut manager.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供键盘驱动的快速切换：模型与会话面板、权限循环切换以及快捷键管理器。

description.en: Capture, box-select and annotate screenshots inside DeepSeek Harness, with an option to hide the DSH window while capturing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内框选并标注截图，并可在捕获时选择隐藏 DSH 窗口。

description.en: One-click desktop region selection that drops the screenshot straight into the current DSH chat input, all handled in memory.
description.zh: 一键框选桌面任意区域，截图直接落入当前 DSH 会话输入框，全程内存完成无本地文件。

description.en: Calculate shower room dimensions based on parameters and return detailed measurement results.
description.zh: 根据参数计算淋浴间尺寸并返回详细测量结果。

description.en: Agent show/game engine for DeepSeek Harness: scenario packs, machine-adjudicated matches, replayable event logs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能体演出与对局引擎，包含剧本包、由机器裁判的对局（考古 MVP）和可回放的事件日志。

description.en: Adds a red "delete permanently" row to the native session menu, shown only for archived sessions, with no extra archive panel.
description.zh: 在原生会话菜单中为已归档会话添加红色「彻底删除」选项，无需额外的归档面板。

description.en: Shuffles arrays via a pure Node.js plugin with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 通过纯 Node.js 插件对数组进行洗牌，无网络依赖。

description.en: Adds a shutdown button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI to quickly close tabs and stop the dsh process.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness网页界面添加关闭按钮，快速关闭标签页和dsh进程。

description.en: Profile plugin that quiets DSH web: removes token auth, reverses --no-open, permits host 0.0.0.0.
description.zh: 使 DSH web 静默启动的插件：免 token、反转 --no-open、允许 host 0.0.0.0。

description.en: Calculates sick leave pay based on input parameters, providing detailed results and legal basis.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算病假工资，提供详细结果和法律依据。

description.en: Adds native side conversations with independent sessions, shared UI, and a focus-friendly sidebar to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加原生侧边对话，支持独立会话、共享界面和专注侧边栏。

description.en: Opens a temporary side conversation in the right sidebar so you can ask questions or try ideas without interrupting the main task.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏打开一个临时侧边对话，用于提问或尝试想法，不打断主任务。

description.en: A lightweight, toggleable right-side notes panel for DeepSeek Harness with text, images, labels, favorites and Excel import/export.
description.zh: 一个轻量可切换的右侧便签面板，支持文字、图片、标签、收藏以及 Excel 导入导出。

description.en: Sidebar reader for PDF, EPUB, Markdown and CSV files with select-to-translate, explain, summarize, annotate and send-to-input actions.
description.zh: 右侧栏文档阅读器，支持 PDF、EPUB、Markdown、CSV，划词后可翻译、解释、总结、批注或发到输入框。

description.en: Adds a sidebar and panel system to support full developer interaction in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加侧边栏和面板系统，支持开发者进行完整交互。

description.en: Adds reload, restart and quit buttons to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, with double-click confirmation and host-state awareness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏底部添加刷新、重启、退出三个按钮,支持连点确认并读取宿主状态自动禁用。

description.en: Annotate images in place in the DSH right sidebar with marks, arrows and shapes, then send the composited image plus numbered notes to chat.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏原地批注图片，支持画笔、箭头与形状，并把合成图和编号说明发回对话。

description.en: A minimal sidebar widget for DeepSeek Harness that shows balance and OpenCode Go usage with a frosted glass card and one-click restart.
description.zh: 在侧边栏常驻显示 DeepSeek 余额和 OpenCode Go 套餐消耗圆环，提供磨砂玻璃悬浮卡与一键重启。

description.en: Adds a sidebar browser panel that browses sites via a per-origin loopback proxy and lets users pick DOM elements into labeled references.
description.zh: 在侧边栏提供浏览器面板，通过按源回环代理浏览网站，并可将页面元素拾取为带标签的引用。

description.en: Adds a collapse button beside the workspace title that one-click folds the DSH sidebar's global plugin-button strip, freeing vertical space for sessions.
description.zh: 在工作区标题右侧添加折叠按钮，一键收起 DSH 侧边栏的全局插件按钮条，为工作区与会话列表腾出整列高度。

description.en: Compacts and customizes DSH's native sidebar with per-item toggles, with settings saved locally in the browser.
description.zh: 精简并自定义 DSH 原生侧边栏，可逐项开关功能，设置保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Moves DeepSeek Harness download progress out of the floating overlay and into a page in the dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的下载进度从悬浮窗移到 dsh-better-sidebar 插件页面中显示。

description.en: Lets the AI open DSH's built-in sidebar to display result files or web pages and run browser searches via a webview bridge.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接调用 DSH 官方侧栏，主动展示成果文件或网页，并通过浏览器桥在侧栏中搜索获取信息。

description.en: Enhances the DSH sidebar with drag-orderable panels, height caps, a pinned sessions area with live status, tab dragging, archive grouping and fork tracking.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 侧边栏：面板拖拽排序、高度上限、带实时状态的置顶会话区、顶部标签拖拽、归档会话归拢与分叉子会话跟进。

description.en: Adds a collapsible, resizable sidebar section for plugin entries plus a filterable picker to jump to any workspace or session.
description.zh: 提供可折叠、可拖动分隔条的侧边栏插件区，并带可筛选的跳转器，快速切换工作区或会话。

description.en: Reorders the DSH left sidebar by live activity, floating busy workspaces and active sessions to the top and folding idle ones, with five reversible switches.
description.zh: 根据实时活动调整 DSH 左侧边栏顺序，将忙碌工作区和活跃会话置顶，空闲工作区折叠，并提供五个可逆开关。

description.en: Folds the DSH sidebar's global panel icons into one collapsible header row and hides the dock's sidebar entry.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏的全局面板图标折叠进一个可收起的标题行，并隐藏停靠栏中的侧边栏入口。

description.en: Adds a one-click collapse/expand button that hides or restores the sidebar entries above the workspace area in DSH.
description.zh: 侧栏折叠：一键收起或展开 DSH 侧栏工作区上方的入口按钮。

description.en: Folds the DSH sidebar plugin entries into one collapsible 'plugin list' with groups, custom ordering and per-row display modes, freeing height for the workspace.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧那排插件入口折成一行可折叠的「插件列表」，支持分组、自定义排序与三态显示，为工作区腾出高度。

description.en: DSH sidebar enhancer that collapses the cost card from dsh-cost-meter, edits sidebar entries, and cleans up archived sessions.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-cost-meter 的 DSH 侧栏增强插件：折叠费用卡片、编辑侧栏入口、清理归档会话。

description.en: Popout sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: file tree plus offline previews for code, Markdown, PDF, Office and media, with CodeMirror editing and a Git slice.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可弹出侧边栏：文件树与离线预览（代码、Markdown、PDF、Office、音视频），支持 CodeMirror 编辑和只读 Git 视图。

description.en: Adds a Git sidebar tab that follows the session's repo to review diffs, stage/commit changes, switch branches, and push/pull.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏提供 Git 标签页，跟随会话仓库查看差异、暂存提交、切换分支并推送拉取。

description.en: Makes the right sidebar Start page scroll when its tool cards overflow, showing a scrollbar only when needed.
description.zh: 让右侧栏「开始」页的工具卡片溢出时可滚动，滚动条仅在需要时出现。

description.en: Adds a DSH sidebar with TODO progress, latest assistant reply previews and searchable chat history navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加历史侧栏，显示任务进度、最新回复预览并支持可搜索的会话历史导航。

description.en: Sidebar workspace home for DeepSeek Harness: pick a workspace, focus its chats, and restore the shipped sidebar on exit.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏工作区主页：选择工作区、聚焦其对话，退出时恢复默认侧边栏。

description.en: DSH plugin that converts sidebar entries into a compact icon row with adjustable icon size and per-entry visibility toggles.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将侧边栏条目转成紧凑的图标行，图标大小可调，并可逐项控制显示与隐藏。

description.en: Turns the DSH left sidebar's plugin list into a scrollable, drag-reorderable, height-resizable window with per-entry show/hide toggles.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏插件入口变成可滚动、可拖动排序、可拖动调高、可逐个显隐的窗口，把被挤占的高度还给会话列表。

description.en: Adds a draggable splitter between the workspace area and panel list in the left sidebar, with auto-scroll when the panel list is squeezed.
description.zh: 在左侧栏「工作区」与面板列表之间加入可拖动分隔条，面板列表被压小时自动显示滚动条。

description.en: Adds a toggle that shows or hides the DeepSeek Harness sidebar and lets you choose which global panels appear in it.
description.zh: 提供一个开关，用于显示或隐藏 DeepSeek Harness 左侧菜单，并可选择在侧边栏中显示哪些全局面板。

description.en: Caps the sidebar global-panel list height, makes it scrollable, and frees space for the workspace below.
description.zh: 限制侧边栏全局面板列表高度并使其可滚动，为下方工作区腾出更多空间。

description.en: Collapses the buttons and panels above and below the DSH left sidebar workspace into expandable groups, with manual reordering and per-item display modes.
description.zh: 将 DSH 左侧栏工作区上方和下方的按钮/面板折叠为可展开分组，支持手动排序，并可为特定条目设置显示、摘要或悬浮方式。

description.en: Adds a toggle menu in the DSH web sidebar to show or hide panel entries, saving the choice in localStorage so it survives restarts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 左侧栏「更多」菜单中加入面板入口显隐开关，选择存入 localStorage，重启后依然保持。

description.en: Pins frequently used workspaces and sessions to the top of the DSH sidebar, with live running/completed/waiting status on each session row.
description.zh: 把常用工作区与会话置顶在 DSH 侧边栏「工作区」上方，会话行实时显示运行中/完成/等待状态。

description.en: Adds a collapsible pinned-sessions panel to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with hover pin buttons on session rows and a session-header toggle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加可折叠的置顶会话面板，会话行支持悬停置顶按钮，并提供会话标题栏切换。

description.en: Adds a small arrow to the sidebar Plugins row that collapses or expands the plugin entries area, with the state saved across refreshes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏「插件」行右侧加一个小箭头，一键收起或展开插件区，折叠状态刷新后仍保留。

description.en: Sidebar widget showing 5h/7d subscription-quota rings for locally connected providers, plus official DeepSeek balance on the account row.
description.zh: 侧边栏小组件：为本地已连接的服务商显示 5 小时/7 天订阅额度圆环，并在账户行显示官方 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Sets DSH sidebar widths as a window ratio and shares one right-side panel across a parent session and its subagents.
description.zh: 按窗口比例设置 DSH 侧边栏宽度，并在父会话与其子代理间共享一个右侧面板。

description.en: Lets the model capture and read the current session's sidebar: active tab, right sidebar tabs, terminal screens and browser page text.
description.zh: 让模型按需抓取并读取当前会话侧边栏内容：活动标签、右侧边栏标签、终端画面与浏览器页面文本。

description.en: Adds shared scrolling behaviour to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar so navigation, projects and conversations scroll together.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的导航、项目和会话提供统一共享滚动行为。

description.en: Collapses all DSH left-sidebar panel entries into one clean, searchable shelf so panels open only when needed.
description.zh: 将 DSH 左侧栏所有面板入口收纳进一个整洁可搜索的置物架，按需展开面板。

description.en: Two-line session cards for the DSH sidebar with project icons, pinning, archiving, status markers, job counts and recency sorting.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏提供两行式会话卡片，支持项目图标、置顶、归档、状态标记、任务计数和按最近排序。

description.en: Renders DeepSeek Harness sidebar shortcuts as a compact two-column or icon-tile grid with per-entry visibility toggles and a native fallback mode.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏快捷入口显示为紧凑双列或图标宫格，支持逐项显示开关并可恢复原生布局。

description.en: Adds right-click batch-close actions (close left, close right, close all) to DSH web sidebar tabs, strictly scoped to the current pane.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页版右侧栏标签页增加右键批量关闭（关闭左侧、关闭右侧、关闭全部），范围严格限定在当前窗格内。

description.en: Makes Ctrl/Cmd+W close the current right-sidebar tab instead of the whole DSH window, and lets you double-click a tab to close it.
description.zh: 让 Ctrl/⌘+W 优先关闭右侧栏当前标签页而不是整个 DSH 窗口，并支持双击标签页直接关闭。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that tucks the plugins, automation, context-insight and skill-center panel icons into a collapsible '⋯ More' entry at the bottom.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏收纳插件：把插件、自动化任务、上下文洞察、技能中心等面板图标收进侧栏底部的「⋯ 更多」可折叠入口。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar todo plugin that manages daily checklists in a panel, with host-side persistence shared with the agent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏待办插件，在主面板管理日常清单，数据宿主侧持久化并与 agent 共用。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek balance and today's spend inline on the DSH sidebar account row, with hover details for requests, tokens and peak/off-peak countdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏账户行右侧单行显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费，悬停可查看请求数、Token 用量及高峰/低谷倒计时。

description.en: Adds VS Code-style sash dividers to the DSH left sidebar for dragging widths, compact rows, and collapsing blocks into icons.
description.zh: 为 DSH 左侧边栏添加 VS Code 风格的可拖拽分隔条、紧凑行模式，并可将区块折叠为头像上方的图标。

description.en: Runs background sidecar subagents with unique names, isolated cwd/git-worktree spaces, and review-on-demand results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 运行后台 sidecar 子代理，支持唯一名称、独立 cwd/git worktree 空间和按需查看结果。

description.en: A read-only sidecar that lets you ask questions about the current session's context without writing to or altering it.
description.zh: 只读旁路助手，可就当前会话的上下文提问，而不写入或改动会话内容。

description.en: Adds a side chat panel to DSH, shipped with source and prebuilt bundles so it can be installed directly from GitHub.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加侧边聊天面板，附带源码与预构建包，可直接从 GitHub 安装。

description.en: A Swiss-style colour theme for dsh built around the Signal Blue accent (#1B3BFF), with cool-paper light and deep-blue night dark variants.
description.zh: 为 dsh 设计的瑞士风配色主题，以信号蓝 #1B3BFF 为唯一强调色，提供冷白纸浅色与深蓝夜色深色两版。

description.en: DSH plugin that uses SiliconFlow vision models to analyze images from local files, URLs, or base64 data.
description.zh: DSH 插件，调用硅基流动视觉大模型分析图片，支持本地文件、URL 或 base64 数据输入。

description.en: Import, edit, and switch SillyTavern AI presets in DeepSeek Harness, with JSON import/export, prompt reordering, and archive/delete.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中导入、编辑和切换 SillyTavern AI 预设，支持 JSON 导入导出、提示词排序与归档删除。

description.en: F1 25 sim-racing telemetry plugin that captures game UDP data and produces per-corner race-engineer reports with time-loss attribution.
description.zh: F1 25 赛车遥测插件：抓取游戏 UDP 数据，在本地对齐多圈分析，逐弯定位慢在哪、为何慢并给出改进方向。

description.en: A minimalist sidebar calculator that evaluates hand-written-style expressions with units, percentages, currency, bases, big numbers and dates.
description.zh: 极简侧边栏计算器，像手写算式一样直接计算，支持单位、百分比、货币、进制、大数和日期。

description.en: Connects your own Markdown memory directory to DSH: a persistent index is injected each turn and full bodies are read on demand, read-only.
description.zh: 把你自己维护的 Markdown 记忆目录接入 DSH：每轮常驻索引，正文按需读取，插件只读不改。

description.en: A sidebar notebook for DeepSeek Harness that saves notes instantly and lets you browse them by date or custom tags, all stored locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏笔记本，随手记下想法，可按日期或自定义标签检索，笔记仅保存在本机。

description.en: Adds a fast selection-quote feature to DeepSeek Harness that preserves the original Markdown formatting when quoting text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供最简单的划词引用功能，引用时保留原始 Markdown 格式。

description.en: Zero-config plugin that reverse-proxies the DSH web GUI onto your Tailscale address so phones on the tailnet can open it in a browser.
description.zh: 零配置插件，把 DSH 网页界面反向代理到 Tailscale 网卡地址，同网手机打开浏览器即可使用。

description.en: Browser bridge plugin plus MV3 extension that gives DSH page markup, BFF traffic capture, trusted input and a virtual cursor in your own browser.
description.zh: 浏览器桥接插件与 MV3 扩展，让 DSH 在自有浏览器中获取页面结构与 BFF 流量、发送可信输入并显示虚拟光标。

description.en: Audits a construction project's supervision archive for log continuity, coverage gaps, and missing on-site supervision records against its rule pack.
description.zh: 按规则条款核查建设项目监理档案的日志连续性、覆盖缺口及现场监理记录缺失情况。

description.en: DSH plugin that archives conversation output into SiYuan notes, with connection, token, archive-path and notebook/document permission settings.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把对话产出归档到思源笔记，含连接、token、归档路径与「笔记本→文档」权限设置页。

description.en: Paces SJTU API requests, tracks token usage locally, and recovers from 429 rate limits with cancellable retries.
description.zh: 为 SJTU API 请求限速，本地统计 token 用量，并支持可取消的 429 限流恢复。

description.en: Edit DSH skill SKILL.md files directly in the web settings page; save writes to disk instantly.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置页直接编辑技能 SKILL.md 文件，保存即写盘。

description.en: Plugin for browsing, enabling/disabling, creating, and deleting DSH skills.
description.zh: DSH 技能中心插件，可按来源浏览已加载的技能，并启用、禁用、创建和删除技能。

description.en: DSH plugin that distills a solved conversation into a reusable SKILL.md in the official skills directory, plus a web panel to manage them.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把已解决的对话沉淀为官方技能目录下的 SKILL.md，并提供网页面板管理技能。

description.en: Adds fuzzy skill search to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI for quick skill discovery.
description.zh: Codex-style fuzzy skill search for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: /bug, /diag, /regression all find diagnosing-bugs in the / skill menu.

description.en: Adds a skill-picker button to the DSH Desktop input box that groups all skills into Chinese-labelled categories with search and one-click insert.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 输入框旁添加技能选择面板，按中文分类分组浏览全部技能，支持搜索与一键插入。

description.en: Rebuilds daily skill-usage counts from your local DSH session logs, with drill-down into the sessions that used each skill and watch groups.
description.zh: 从本地 DSH 会话日志重建每日技能使用次数，可下钻查看使用该技能的会话，并按分组持续关注。

description.en: Adds a short Chinese label before each skill's description in DSH's skill list; the label table is editable and AI can fill in unlabeled skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 技能列表中每项技能的描述前添加简短中文标签，标签表可随时修改，也能让 AI 补全未标注技能。

description.en: Installable DSH bundle of 100 practical checklist skills spanning coding, testing, security, data, DevOps, product, writing, research and operations.
description.zh: 可安装的 DSH 捆绑包，内含 100 个实用清单技能，覆盖编码、测试、安全、数据、DevOps、产品、写作、研究与运营。

description.en: DSH plugin adding a composer skill picker plus one panel to install, enable, organize and remove skills from four sources.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在输入框内选技能，并在同一面板安装、启用、整理和删除技能（四种安装来源）。

description.en: A DSH marketplace for browsing live sources and one-click installing SKILL.md skills and MCP connectors, effective immediately without restart.
description.zh: DSH 技能与 MCP 连接器市场：浏览实时技能源，一键安装 SKILL.md 技能和 MCP 连接器，装完即用、无需重启。

description.en: Reads every Xiaomi MiMo (MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode) skill into the DeepSeek Harness session skill catalog.
description.zh: 将每个小米 MiMo（MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode）技能读取到 DeepSeek Harness 会话技能目录中。

description.en: A DSH settings page that lists all installed skills with their descriptions, sources and sizes, and lets you remove them one by one.
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 skill 管理器页面，列出全部已安装 skill 的简介、来源与占用信息，并可逐个移除。

description.en: DSH plugin that lists skills on demand, records task-needed skills once, and loads only the chosen skill by name to keep the catalog out of every request.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按需列出技能，任务所需技能只记录一次，并仅按名称加载选中的技能，使技能目录不进入每次请求。

description.en: DSH 技能管家：排序、改名、自动规范，改完立刻生效。
Curated engineering skill pack for DSH covering handoff, grilling, teaching, spec and ticket workflows, writing, and the DESIGN.md format.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的精选工程技能包，涵盖交接、质询、教学、规格与工单流程、写作及 DESIGN.md 格式。

description.en: Sidebar skill panel that lists all local skills by category, supports search and multi-select, and writes /skill commands into the chat input.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧导航加入技能面板：按功能分类列出全部技能，可搜索、多选，一键把 /技能名 写入输入框。

description.en: Adds a Skills button to the DSH sidebar that lists every skill available in the current session with a Chinese one-liner, its source, and a click-to-copy /name invocation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加「技能」按钮，列出当前会话可用的全部 skill，附中文说明与来源，点击即可复制 /名字 调用。

description.en: Personal investment portfolio dashboard that aggregates holdings across Snowball, T-Invest, BCS, Sber and Intelinvest, with CSV support.
description.zh: 个人投资组合仪表盘，汇总 Snowball、T-Invest、BCS、Sber 和 Intelinvest 的持仓，并支持 CSV。

description.en: Recommends skills by profiling your local DSH, Codex and Claude session history and ranking an open-source skill catalog.
description.zh: 通过分析本地 DSH、Codex 与 Claude 会话记录生成用户画像，并对开源技能目录进行排序推荐。

description.en: Recursively discovers SKILL.md files in nested subfolders of the standard skill roots so deeply nested skills load in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 递归扫描标准技能根目录下的嵌套子文件夹，找到其中的 SKILL.md 文件，让深层嵌套的技能也能被 DeepSeek Harness 加载。

description.en: Retrieval-based skill router for DSH that indexes skills/MCP metadata and loads them on demand, cutting per-session context tokens.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供按需检索与加载的技能路由插件，将技能/MCP 元数据由常驻上下文改为渐进披露，大幅节省 token。

description.en: A static, read-only security first pass that scans DSH skills and plugin bundles for risky patterns without executing them.
description.zh: 一个静态只读的安全初筛工具，在不执行代码的前提下扫描 DSH 技能与插件包中的风险模式。

description.en: Turns your working sessions into draft SKILL.md proposals that stay inactive until a human reviews and accepts them.
description.zh: 将工作过程整理为 SKILL.md 技能草稿，只有经人工审核批准后才会生效。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness panel that shows usage statistics for every installed skill, including use counts, session coverage, and share of total skill use.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能使用统计面板，展示每个已安装技能的使用次数、会话覆盖率及占全部技能使用的比例。

description.en: Shows which skills a DSH session has loaded, whether their full bodies remain in context, plus versions and sources.
description.zh: 显示 DSH 会话已加载的技能数量、正文是否仍在上下文中，以及各次加载的版本与来源。

description.en: Codex-compatible skill studio for DSH: browse, search, create, edit and toggle SKILL.md skills from a sidebar page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Codex 兼容的技能工作室：在侧边栏页面浏览、搜索、创建、编辑和开关 SKILL.md 技能。

description.en: Manages AI agent skills in one place: create, install, and browse skills from Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok, Gemini and more.
description.zh: 统一管理 AI 智能体技能，支持创建、安装和浏览来自 Codex、Claude、Cursor、Grok、Gemini 等的技能。

description.en: Tag DSH skills and use boolean expressions to select which skills are sent to the model per workspace or conversation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 技能打标签，并用布尔表达式按工作区或对话筛选要下发给模型的技能子集。

description.en: DSH plugin that enables or disables skills by group using blacklist semantics, with a toolbar panel, search and source sections.
description.zh: DSH 技能开关插件：以黑名单语义按分组启用/禁用技能，并提供面板、搜索与来源分节管理。

description.en: A trigger-word gate that searches locally installed skills, forces a use-or-skip decision per candidate, and blocks tools until chosen skills load.
description.zh: 一个触发词门禁插件：检索本机已安装技能，强制对每个候选做采用或跳过判断，并在所选技能加载前阻塞其他工具。

description.en: Generates brand marketing diagnosis reports with the Five-Elements theory, flagging broken links and outputting visual HTML reports.
description.zh: 基于五行商业诊断理论生成品牌营销诊断报告，定位断链环节并输出可视化HTML报告。

description.en: Adds a Chinese explanation overlay above the English text on dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards for bilingual reading.
description.zh: 在 dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的技能卡片英文原文上方添加中文说明浮层，实现中英对照阅读。

description.en: Turns recurring prompts into reusable fill-in skill cards that you can run inside DeepSeek Harness to get answers back.
description.zh: 将重复使用的提示词转换为可填写的技能卡片，在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行并直接获取回答。

description.en: Keeps preset skill directories and links or unlinks their skills into the DSH user skill root, effective immediately without restarting.
description.zh: 维护预设技能目录，将其中技能链接或解除链接到 DSH 用户技能目录，无需重启即刻生效。

description.en: Installs and manages harness skills, shows how much each skill costs in model context, and lets you hide unused ones without deleting files.
description.zh: 安装和管理 harness 技能，显示每个技能在模型上下文中占用的开销，并可隐藏不需要的技能而无需删除文件。

description.en: Pick user-invocable DSH skills from the composer and insert the chosen skill's slash command into your draft.
description.zh: 在输入框中挑选可调用的 DSH 技能，并将其斜杠命令插入草稿。

description.en: Manage Agent Skills from the DSH sidebar: list, preview, create, edit, delete, validate, enable/disable, and install or update from GitHub for project and user roots.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中管理 Agent Skills：列出、预览、创建、编辑、删除、校验、启用/停用，并从 GitHub 安装或更新（项目与用户目录均支持）。

description.en: Skill workbench panel that lists, filters and invokes skills into the chat input, uninstalls to a recycle bin, and syncs skill directories.
description.zh: 技能工作台面板：浏览筛选技能并一键唤起进输入框，可卸载到回收站并恢复，并主动同步多个技能落地目录。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for the DeepSeek Harness UI supporting image URLs, local files and Wallpaper Engine libraries with opacity, blur and slideshow.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面提供壁纸皮肤，支持图片链接、本地文件和 Wallpaper Engine 库，并可调节透明度、模糊和幻灯片播放。

description.en: Abyssal is a near-black deep-sea DSH UI skin with a single bioluminescent light source and glass panels, manageable from the skin settings card wall.
description.zh: 深渊 ABYSSAL 是一款近黑深海底风格的 DSH 界面皮肤，带单一生物荧光光源与玻璃面板，可在皮肤管理卡片墙中切换。

description.en: Asuka-themed skin pack for DSH Harness with dual-character art, day/night city dome scenes and wine-red gold UI frames.
description.zh: 明日香主题 DSH Harness 皮肤包，含双人物立绘、城市穹顶日夜场景与酒红金饰界面框架。

description.en: A multi-style skin collection for the DSH web GUI offering 9 themes with scoped decoration CSS and a sidebar skin manager.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页 GUI 提供的多风格皮肤合集，包含 9 套主题、作用域装饰 CSS 以及侧边栏皮肤管理器。

description.en: An unofficial 2005-era QQ-style IM skin/theme for DeepSeek Harness, using only original artwork.
description.zh: 一款非官方的 2005 年 QQ 风格 IM 皮肤主题，适用于 DeepSeek Harness，仅使用原创美术素材。

description.en: A theme/skin for DeepSeek Harness web UI inspired by Genshin Impact's Kamisato Ayaka, changing colors and title fonts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供的《原神》神里绫华印象主题皮肤，可替换界面配色与标题字体。

description.en: A Koi Pond theme for DSH WebUI with light/dark modes, featuring animated koi and component-split CSS.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 设计的锦鲤池塘主题，支持亮暗双模式，含动画锦鲤与按部件拆分的 CSS。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with 10 built-in themes plus mix-and-match colors, backgrounds, custom images, and one-click restore of the official look.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，内置 10 套主题，可自由搭配配色、背景与自定义图片，并支持一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Five switchable visual skins for DeepSeek Harness, each bundled with its own animated boot sequence and sound design.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五套可切换皮肤，每套都配有专属动画启动序列与音效设计。

description.en: A switchable skin package manager for DeepSeek Harness, supporting discovery, activation, and ZIP import of skins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的可切换皮肤包管理器，支持皮肤发现、激活和ZIP导入。

description.en: A 3D study room skin for DeepSeek Harness Web with first-person walking and exploration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 3D 书房皮肤，可用第一人称行走探索。

description.en: Tomorrow Night Blue theme for the DSH Web GUI, mapping the classic deep-blue palette onto DSH design tokens and syntax colors.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供 Tomorrow Night Blue 主题，将经典深蓝配色映射到 DSH 设计令牌与语法颜色上。

description.en: Determines skin type from input parameters and returns clear skincare advice. Pure Node, zero network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数判断肤质并返回明确的护肤建议，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Cmd/Ctrl-click a file link in a DSH session to skip the sidebar preview and open it in your system default app.
description.zh: ⌘/Ctrl + 左键点击 DSH 会话中的文件链接，跳过侧边栏预览，直接用系统默认应用打开文件。

description.en: Adds a /new slash command that opens a blank session in the current workspace while inheriting the previous session's permission preset.
description.zh: 新增 /new 斜杠命令，在当前工作区开启全新会话，并沿用上一个会话的权限预设。

description.en: Suggests optimal bedtimes using sleep cycle theory, calculating from user parameters and returning detailed estimates.
Calculates sleep debt from parameters and returns clear advice; medical content follows doctor's guidance.
Provides sleep hygiene advice based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数提供睡眠卫生建议，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Generates self-contained HTML slides for offline fullscreen presentations with speaker notes and PDF printing.
description.zh: 把演讲写成单个自包含 HTML 文件，可离线全屏演示，讲者备注不显示在屏幕上，支持打印为 PDF，含五套主题。

description.en: Ship a local DSH plugin to GitHub and the market in one call with preflight checks, verified uploads, a registry PR, and byte-for-byte comparison.
description.zh: 一键将本地 DSH 插件发布到 GitHub 和插件市场，包含预检、逐文件上传验证、市场注册 PR 以及逐字节回传比对。

description.en: Shows live health of local LLM endpoints in the dsh web rightbar: llama.cpp slots (busy/TTFT/wedged) and Ollama loaded models.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页右侧栏实时显示本地 LLM 端点健康状况：llama.cpp 槽位（忙碌/TTFT/卡死）与 Ollama 已加载模型。

description.en: Slothy-style model picker for the DSH Web GUI, showing models grouped by provider plus a reasoning-effort slider.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供的 Slothy 风格模型选择器，按服务商分组列出模型并提供推理强度滑块。

description.en: SlowMist Agent Security guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis)
Generates URL slugs from text with a pure Node implementation, no network or external services.
description.zh: 将文本转换为 URL slug，使用纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.en: Provides home repair solutions for water and electrical issues based on input parameters.
Small macOS utilities for DSH: keeps the Mac awake while dsh runs and sends a clickable notification when a conversation finishes.
description.zh: DSH 的 macOS 小工具：运行时防止 Mac 休眠，并在对话完成任务时发送可点击通知。

description.en: Adds switchable proxy modes, startup connectivity self-checks and SSE timeout protection to DSH desktop, fixing Transport Failed and TLS interception errors.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版提供可切换代理模式、启动连通性自检与 SSE 超时保护，解决 Transport Failed 与 TLS 证书拦截问题。

description.en: Adds a Smart Prompt button under the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured, project-grounded prompt capped at 400 characters.
description.zh: 在输入框下方添加 Smart Prompt 按钮，将草稿重写为基于项目文档的结构化提示词，最多400字符。

description.en: Replaces DSH session bottom scroll jumps with smooth, velocity-based follow-scrolling during streaming content updates.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话滚底从瞬时跳变改为流式更新时的平滑跟随滚动。

description.en: Hangs a decorative clothesline of polaroid photos beneath the DeepSeek Harness message composer for a playful visual touch.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 消息输入框下方悬挂一条装饰性的宝丽来照片晾衣绳，增添俏皮的视觉效果。

description.en: Backs up, restores, and rotates sha256-verified snapshots of ~/.dsh for DeepSeek Harness, with path-traversal protection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 备份、恢复并轮换 ~/.dsh 的 sha256 校验快照，并防止路径遍历攻击。

description.en: A pure Node.js implementation of Snowflake ID generation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的雪花 ID 生成器，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Validates a state-owned enterprise "三重一大" decision register, checking each matter's proposal, pre-study, meeting, vote and numbering trail.
description.zh: 校验国有企业“三重一大”决策台账，检查每项议题的提议、前置研究、会议、表决及编号等程序留痕。

description.en: Sidebar manager that selects local WSL/Windows software tools and injects them into model system prompts.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏软件工具管理器：勾选本机 WSL/Windows 软件工具并注入模型系统提示，自带 add-software-tool 技能。

description.en: Reads a soil and groundwater monitoring register and checks its completeness and arithmetic consistency row by row.
description.zh: 读取土壤与地下水监测台账，逐行检查其完整性与算术一致性。

description.en: Give it a video link (Bilibili/YouTube); it extracts audio with yt-dlp, slices it, and identifies songs via Shazam plus NetEase Cloud Music.
description.zh: 给它一条视频链接（B站/YouTube），用 yt-dlp 提取音频并切片，再用 Shazam 和网易云双引擎识别歌曲。

description.en: Checks a works instruction register for consistency with its cited PFMEA and control plan: procedure numbers, revisions, tolerances and duplicates.
description.zh: 校验作业指导书台账与其引用的PFMEA和控制计划的一致性,涵盖工序号、版本、公差与重复项。

description.en: Pure Node array sorting plugin with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的数组排序插件，不依赖网络。

description.en: Sort and deduplicate data with a pure Node implementation that requires no network access.
description.zh: 使用纯 Node 实现，对数据进行排序和去重，无需网络访问。

description.en: Auditable plaintext Markdown memory ledger plugin for DSH with 14 soul_* tools, turn-start ledger injection, and zero-token self-maintenance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可审计明文 Markdown 记忆账本插件，含 14 个 soul_* 工具、轮首账本注入与零 token 自维护。

description.en: Portable long-term memory for AI plus a soul-forging persona workflow, stored in plain local markdown with zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 AI 提供可迁移的长期记忆，并附带一套「铸魂」人格养成流程，纯本地 markdown、零依赖。

description.en: Seeds a persistent agent persona: ten-question onboarding, mood that decays over time, per-person memory ledgers and solitary idle behaviour.
description.zh: 为智能体种下一枚持久人格种子：十问初始化、随时间衰减的情绪、按人分账的记忆，以及独处时的自发行为。

description.en: Plays short sound cues (dings) to alert when action is needed and when a task finishes, using Web Audio without popups.
description.zh: 在需要你操作和任务完成时用 Web Audio 播放简短提示音，不弹窗。

description.en: Plays short sound cues in the DSH Web UI when a turn finishes or when an approval, question or plan review needs your attention.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中，当回合结束或出现需要你处理的审批、提问、计划审核时播放提示音效。

description.en: Plays configurable sound effects for task completion and permission requests in DeepSeek Harness, with presets and custom audio.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中为任务完成和权限请求播放可选音效，支持预设与自定义音频。

description.en: DSH web plugin that plays a chime when a session's response finishes (rising tone) or a question/approval is asked (falling tone), with a click-to-mute badge.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：会话回复完成时播放上扬提示音，提问或审批时播放下降提示音，并有可点击静音徽章。

description.en: Plays distinct audio chimes in the DSH Web UI to notify users of agent activity: messages, thinking, tool calls, turn end.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在 Web 界面用不同提示音提示代理活动，包括消息、思考、工具调用和回合结束。

description.en: Plays a sound alert when a DSH task completes, fails, or waits for approval, with per-category switches to control each alert.
description.zh: 当 DSH 任务完成、失败或等待审批时播放提示音，并可按类别开关各类提醒。

description.en: A source-tagged assertion ledger for DeepSeek Harness that keeps inspectable source pointers and reproducible audit sampling of agent claims.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带来源标记的断言台账，保留可检视的来源指针并支持可复现的审计抽样。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects private-plugin-priority and official-code-preservation rules into the DSH profile as a config layer.
description.zh: 将“私有插件优先”和官方代码保护规则作为配置层注入 DSH 的开源插件。

description.en: DSH sidebar disk-space ledger showing what each task occupies on disk and reclaiming orphaned garbage per item, without ever trimming session logs.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏磁盘空间账本，展示每个任务的磁盘占用，按项回收无主垃圾，且绝不裁剪会话日志。

description.en: Hold Space to record your voice and release to auto-send transcribed speech as input in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 按住空格键说话，松开后自动发送语音输入内容到 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: AI self-media workbench with tabbed interface and intelligence command center for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AI 自媒体工作台，含 sparkos_run 命令、8/9 标签页界面和情报指挥所，可只读接入三条管道、查看健康看板与融合入口。

description.en: Interview-driven spec mode for DeepSeek Harness that captures requirements before work while keeping the working tree read-only.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的规范模式：通过访谈式提问捕获需求，并保持工作树只读。

description.en: Sidebar panel that benchmarks streaming speed and latency of DSH model endpoints, re-testing several models every minute.
description.zh: 侧栏面板，用于测试 DSH 各模型接口的流式速度与延迟，默认每分钟对多个模型自动重测一轮。

description.en: Adds Chrome-style local spell check to the dsh composer, showing a suggestion strip for the misspelled word under the caret so Tab accepts it.
description.zh: 为 dsh 输入框添加 Chrome 风格的本地拼写检查，在光标处显示拼写建议条，按 Tab 即可采纳建议。

description.en: Adds a cost pill to the composer status row that shows the actual spend of the previous turn in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框状态栏添加成本药丸，显示上一轮的实际花费。

description.en: A sphere calculation plugin implemented in pure Node.js with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的球体计算插件，无网络依赖。

description.en: Animated DSH launch splash whose frame doubles as a real startup-progress meter, then shrinks into a status marker beside the input box.
description.zh: DSH 启动开屏动画，取景框即真实启动进度计，结束后缩成输入框旁的常驻状态标记。

description.en: Splits the DSH panel into side-by-side live session columns with a minimal progress view for parallel tasks.
description.zh: 把 DSH 面板拆成并排的实时会话列，并提供极简进度视图以查看并行任务。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI into a quad-pane split view with up to four live conversations side by side, draggable from the sidebar.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面变为四分屏视图，最多同时显示四个实时会话，可从侧边栏拖入。

description.en: Adds a Spotlight/IntelliJ-style search dialog for quickly finding DSH sessions and chats.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话和聊天添加类似 Spotlight/IntelliJ 的快速搜索对话框。

description.en: DSH plugin adding IDEA-style top bar controls to manage Spring Boot services: source/Jar startup, stop/restart, and live logs.
description.zh: DSH 插件：顶栏 IDEA 式管理 Spring Boot 服务，支持源码/Jar启动、停止重启与实时日志。

description.en: SQL formatter that breaks clauses onto new lines and uppercases keywords.
description.zh: SQL 格式化工具，将子句换行并将关键字转为大写。

description.en: Opens an SSH terminal, SFTP file manager and live remote metrics in the DSH side panel, and lets the agent run remote commands and transfer files.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏中打开 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件管理器和远程实时指标，并允许 Agent 执行远程命令和传输文件。

description.en: DSH plugin for personal server operations with pooled SSH connections, log analysis, and a guard against destructive commands.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用于个人服务器运维：连接池化 SSH、日志分析，并拦截破坏性命令。

description.en: Stores SSH servers as a host inventory so agents can run commands and read/write remote files by hostname, managed in settings.
description.zh: 把多台 SSH 服务器存为主机清单，让 agent 按主机名执行命令并读写远端文件，支持在设置中管理。

description.en: Multi-server SSH terminal panel for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, providing multiple SSH terminals in a bottom panel.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面底部面板中提供多个 SSH 终端，可同时连接多台服务器。

description.en: Manage SSH hosts with key or password auth in Settings and expose ssh_list/ssh_exec agent tools for remote command execution.
description.zh: 在设置中管理 SSH 主机（密钥/密码认证），并提供 ssh_list / ssh_exec 代理工具用于远程命令执行。

description.en: SSH workbench plugin adding a remote terminal, local/remote file manager and @server command execution, with Windows host and target support.
description.zh: SSH 工作台插件，提供远程终端、本地/远程文件管理器和 @server 命令执行，支持 Windows 主机与目标端。

description.en: DSH pre-execute hook that denies write operations inside a read-only result zone of protected roots, blocking accidental overwrites.
description.zh: DSH 预执行钩子，拦截对受保护根目录下只读结果区的写入操作，防止意外覆盖。

description.en: Keeps DSH desktop in the first nightly staging cohort by maintaining a low .updaterId bucket value and auto-correcting it.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端稳定留在夜间版灰度第一批，自动维持并修正 .updaterId 的低位分桶值。

description.en: Computes custom homemade cleaning mixture recipes based on input parameters and returns clear recommendations.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算自制清洁混合配方，并返回明确建议。

description.en: Watches download commands and auto-aborts them when they stall past a threshold, then writes a source-switching hint the agent can read and retry with.
description.zh: 监控下载类命令，超时卡住时自动中止，并把可被智能体读取的换源重试提示写入工具结果。

description.en: Watchdog for DeepSeek Harness that monitors subprocess spawns, alerts on stalls, and provides forensics without killing processes.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness设计的轻量级停滞看门狗，自动监控子进程，在停滞时提醒并提供诊断，绝不杀进程。

description.en: Pixel-art desk worker living in DeepSeek Harness that nudges you to stand up and sip water every 30 minutes.
description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的像素风上班族，每 30 分钟提醒你起身活动并喝水。

description.en: Adds a standalone Settings button pinned to the sidebar bottom beside the account button in DeepSeek Harness desktop, so settings open in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏底部账号按钮右端固定一个独立设置按钮，一键直达设置。

description.en: Draggable star desktop pet that shows real-time per-second earnings, an off-work countdown and overtime pay.
description.zh: 可拖拽的困困星人桌宠，实时展示每秒收入、下班倒计时和加班工资。

description.en: An animated starlight ocean backdrop for DeepSeek Harness with a glass composer, gear settings and reasoning-linked meteors.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的星海动画背景，含玻璃质感输入框、齿轮设置与随推理联动的流星效果。

description.en: Bookmark conversation turns from the right-edge turn rail, with longer dashes so bookmarked turns stay easy to find.
description.zh: 在对话右侧的回合轨上收藏回合，收藏的短划线会变长，方便快速找到特定回合。

description.en: A dark-only starry sky theme for the DSH Web UI with a deep space palette, twinkling starfield, and faint constellations.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供的深空星空深色主题，包含深色调色板、闪烁星空与隐约星座图案。

description.en: Adds a Starsector mod-development skill and the starsector_moci CLI tool to the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Starsector 模组开发技能和 starsector_moci 命令行工具。

description.en: Pre-flight diagnostics for a DSH profile's plugin tree: static checks plus optional isolated real-boot and headless-browser smoke tests.
description.zh: 为 DSH 配置文件的插件树提供起飞前诊断：静态检查，以及可选的隔离真实启动与无头浏览器冒烟测试。

description.en: Plays a custom video intro at startup, with adjustable playback and cross-fade, adapting to light/dark appearance.
description.zh: 在启动时播放自定义视频开场，可调节播放与淡入工作台的过渡，并自动适配浅色/深色外观。

description.en: Remembers the model you selected before shutdown and restores it as the startup default in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 记住关闭前选择的模型，并在 DeepSeek Harness 启动时将其恢复为默认模型。

description.en: Plays an 8.8-second zero-click DSH startup animation with a whale backdrop, Dune gauge layer and 550W core, then auto-releases the host.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 8.8 秒零点击启动动画：大鲸鱼背景 + Dune 仪表层 + 550W 核心，播完自动释放宿主。

description.en: VYRON startup animation plus a "Star Sea Terminal" UI skin for DSH, with programmatic deep-space fallback when wallpapers are absent.
description.zh: VYRON 星海鲸航为 DSH 提供启动动画与「星海终端」UI 皮肤，缺少壁纸素材时自动降级为程序化深空渐变。

description.en: Sets a persistent static launch token for the DSH Web GUI so sessions survive restarts behind reverse proxies or on remote devices.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 配置持久化静态启动令牌，使反向代理或远程设备访问时重启不再导致会话失效。

description.en: Spoken status alerts for DeepSeek Harness that encode urgency in clip length, with eight scenes and no third-party dependencies on Windows.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音状态提示，用提示音时长编码紧急度，含八个场景且零第三方依赖。

description.en: Adds a live status layer to the DSH sidebar with a notification center, project and session states, and animated run steps.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏提供实时状态层，包含通知中心、项目与会话状态以及带动画的运行步骤。

description.en: Pure frontend DSH plugin that renders imported txt/epub novels as a fake streaming log inside the chat area, snapping back to work on mouse move.
description.zh: 纯前端 DSH 插件，把导入的 txt/epub 小说伪装成会话区里流式输出的日志流，鼠标一动即回到工作界面。

description.en: A Steam Big Picture style 6-second DSH Desktop startup animation that morphs a terminal into the DeepSeek whale, with optional startup audio and Esc skip.
description.zh: Steam 大屏幕风格的 DSH 桌面六秒开屏动画：终端画面流动成 DeepSeek 鲸鱼标志，可选原版启动音效并支持 Esc 跳过。

description.en: Frames mid-task steering messages so the agent keeps its running task instead of treating an interjection as a new instruction.
description.zh: 将任务中途的引导消息进行包装，让智能体继续执行当前任务，而不是把插话当作新指令。

description.en: Adds a slider above the composer that sets DSH's real reasoning-effort level, backed by a procedurally generated micro-universe.
description.zh: 在输入框上方用滑轨调节 DSH 的真实推理强度等级，滑轨背后是程序实时生成的微缩宇宙动画。

description.en: Chat sticker library for dsh that dedups images, tags them with vision, picks stickers by meaning, and rejects unsafe ones at ingest.
description.zh: dsh 聊天表情包库：图片入库去重、视觉打标、按含义挑图，并在入库时拦截脏话与烂梗。

description.en: A bilingual sticky-note TODO panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with sticky-board and list views plus AI planning help.
description.zh: 一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的双语便签式待办面板，支持便签墙与简洁列表视图，并提供 AI 规划建议。

description.en: Sticky notes plugin for DSH with color labels, reminders, pinning, and password protection.
description.zh: DSH的便签插件，支持彩色标签、定时提醒、置顶和密码保护。

description.en: A sidebar sticky-note wall for quick capture, image notes, pinning, search and local backups, with an agent tool for sessions or IM bots to add notes.
description.zh: 侧边栏便签墙，支持快速记录、图片便签、置顶搜索和本地备份，并提供智能体工具让会话或 IM 机器人添加便签。

description.en: Sticky-note wall for DSH with a sidebar wall, pasted images, due reminders, done states, skins and a pin-on-top floating window.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供便签墙：侧边栏便签墙、图片粘贴、到期提醒、完成状态、外观皮肤与置顶浮窗。

description.en: Adds a paper sticky-note wall to the DSH sidebar where notes are pinned, sized and stacked like real stationery.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加一面纸质便签墙，便签可固定、调整尺寸并像真实文具一样层叠。

description.en: Preview STL 3D meshes in the DSH right sidebar with a WebGL viewport plus size, volume, surface area, and watertightness stats.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏预览 STL 三维网格，提供 WebGL 视口以及尺寸、体积、表面积和水密性信息。

description.en: Renders stock candlestick charts with technical indicators via TradingView Lightweight Charts, with drawing annotations and SQLite persistence.
description.zh: 用TradingView Lightweight Charts渲染股票K线图，自动计算MA/BOLL/MACD/KDJ指标，支持绘图标注和SQLite持久化。

description.en: DSH sidebar stock ticker showing live watchlist quotes for A-share, HK and US markets with intraday and K-line charts and saved config presets.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏自选股行情插件，实时显示 A股/港股/美股报价，支持分时图与日K/周K/月K，并可保存配置方案一键切换。

description.en: Real-time A-share stock watchlist mini window for the DSH Web GUI, with intraday curve, hover detail card, and watchlist settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 A 股实时自选股迷你窗口，含分时曲线、悬停详情卡与自选股设置页。

description.en: A real-time stock quote floating plugin for DeepSeek Harness with quotes, K-lines, trends, and technical predictions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 股票实时行情悬浮插件，提供实时报价、K线、7日/30日走势和技术面看多看空预测。

description.en: Unofficial DSH adapter adding Stop That Shit guardrails: two skills, a /sts command, and a per-session tool-call deny/ask contract.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 适配器，接入 Stop That Shit 防护机制：两个技能、/sts 命令以及按会话生效的工具调用 deny/ask 契约。

description.en: Read-only DSH storage inspector that shows what occupies space in ~/.dsh, lists the largest files and suggests safe cleanups.
description.zh: 只读版 DSH 存储体检插件，按模块统计 ~/.dsh 磁盘占用、定位最大文件并给出安全清理建议。

description.en: Bundled restaurant store operations skills with a single-file local-data dashboard for store metrics and analytics.
description.zh: 内置餐厅门店运营技能，并提供单文件本地数据仪表盘，用于门店指标分析。

description.en: Strata local inference provider and model manager that lets DSH manage GGUF models, vision/projector files, MTP, profiles and Flash Next tuning.
description.zh: Strata 本地推理提供器与模型管理器，让 DSH 管理 GGUF 模型、视觉/投影文件、MTP、配置档案与 Flash Next 调优。

description.en: Runtime patch that clamps invalid chunk indices in LLM assistant streams, downgrading hard failures to dropped/merged chunks; ships a stats tool.
description.zh: 在运行时修补 LLM 助手流累加器，钳制非法分块索引，将硬性流失败降级为丢弃或合并分块，并提供统计工具。

description.en: Lets dsh take over Slay the Spire 2 over a local TCP bridge: reads state, plays cards, picks paths and auto-plays a full run.
description.zh: 通过本地 TCP 桥接让 dsh 接管《杀戮尖塔 2》：读取局面、出牌、选路，并能自动连续玩到本局结束。

description.en: Select text in a conversation and ask follow-up questions about it in a dedicated right-sidebar chat that keeps the session list clean.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本后，可在专属右侧边栏聊天中就此提问，且不会弄乱会话列表。

description.en: Creates opt-in Markdown study notes for each conversation and automatically manages an index of them.
description.zh: 为每个对话提供可选的 Markdown 学习笔记，并自动管理笔记索引。

description.en: Generates a standard Markdown study-notes library plus an offline local web learning portal with graded quizzes for any subject.
description.zh: 从零学习一门科目，生成标准 Markdown 学习笔记库与离线本地网页学习门户（含判分测试）。

description.en: Calculates study/exam time allocation based on parameters and returns detailed results.
Learn through a tree navigator where each knowledge node is a real forked DeepSeek Harness session with native Agent chat.
description.zh: 通过树形导航学习，每个知识节点都是一个真实的 DeepSeek Harness 会话分支，并配有原生 Agent 对话。

description.en: A DSH Web GUI theme skin with dark battle and light ink-wash styles, pure SVG/CSS, no external images.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供率土之滨风格皮肤，含暗色战争与浅色水墨两种主题，纯 SVG 与 CSS 实现，不用外部图片。

description.en: Adds native Antigravity ACP subagents to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1, mirroring the official Codex provider architecture, with a complete Windows x64 bundle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 添加原生 Antigravity ACP 子代理，遵循官方 Codex 提供者架构，含完整 Windows x64 打包。

description.en: Delegates tasks to your local Claude Code CLI as a subagent, with per-call model and effort settings, durable sessions, and multimodal input/output.
description.zh: 通过本地 Claude Code CLI 委派任务给子代理，支持按调用选择模型与推理强度、持久会话以及多模态输入输出。

description.en: DSH profile bundle that routes subagent delegations to the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP using a pinned model.
description.zh: DSH 配置包，通过 ACP 将子代理任务委派给本地 CodeBuddy CLI，并使用固定模型。

description.en: DSH plugin that delegates tasks to Codex as a subagent, letting each call specify its own model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: DSH 插件，将任务委派给 Codex 子代理，并支持每次调用单独指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: In-memory pub/sub and blackboard synchronization plugin that lets DSH subagents publish, read, await and broadcast peer messages.
description.zh: 内存中的发布/订阅与黑板同步插件，让 DSH 子代理可以发布、读取、等待和广播同伴消息。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing Cursor-as-subagent for one-shot local runs with summary-first results and unattended profile bundles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，将 Cursor 作为子代理，支持一次性本地运行、摘要优先结果和无人值守的配置包。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets you pick a subagent thinking effort level (low, high, or max) on each call.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可在每次调用时为子代理选择思考强度（low、high 或 max）。

description.en: Ask a human before a delegated subagent widens its sandbox — a DSH plugin that re-arms child approval to `ask` and routes the request to you.
WIP Gemini CLI subagent plugin for DeepSeek Harness; not yet published, and Gemini 4 requires dsh-subagent-antigravity instead.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 WIP Gemini CLI 子代理插件，尚未发布；Gemini 4 需改用 dsh-subagent-antigravity。

description.en: Adds guardrails for DSH subagents: sandbox capping, a destructive-command deny list, tool-surface restriction and cold-resume recovery.
description.zh: 为 DSH 子代理提供安全护栏:沙箱上限、危险命令拒绝列表、工具面限制与冷恢复机制。

description.en: Marks the composer in a subagent session so you can instantly tell which agent you are typing to.
description.zh: 在子代理会话中为输入框添加标记，让你一眼看出正在向哪个子代理输入。

description.en: Modifies the model and agent presets used by subagents.
description.zh: 通过模型插件修改子代理所使用的模型和 Agent 预设

description.en: Lets you pick the model and reasoning effort for DSH subagents, teammates and nested descendants, with one-click sync from the main session.
description.zh: 为 DSH 子智能体、团队队友及嵌套后代手动切换模型与思考强度，并支持主会话一键同步全部子代理。

description.en: DSH plugin that removes orphaned tool blocks from subagent messages so agent output stays clean.
description.zh: DSH 插件：清理子代理消息中的孤立工具块，让代理输出保持整洁。

description.en: Promotes settled subagent responses and relays coordinator messages to running children in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将已结束的子代理响应提升，并向运行中的子代理转发协调者消息。

description.en: Reuse Google Antigravity subscription via browser sign-in and OpenAI-compatible loopback proxy for multiple AI models.
description.zh: 通过浏览器登录和OpenAI兼容回环代理，复用Google Antigravity订阅以访问多种AI模型。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek, Kimi Code and OpenAI balance/quota per conversation plus local usage and priced estimates for configured providers.
description.zh: 按会话跟踪 DeepSeek、Kimi Code 和 OpenAI 的余额与配额，并为已配置的提供方提供本地用量与费用估算。

description.en: Manages ChatGPT/Grok subscription OAuth, routes models, and enables web-search fallback across multiple AI providers for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 管理ChatGPT/Grok订阅OAuth、模型路由，并为DeepSeek Harness提供跨多家AI提供商的网页搜索回退。

description.en: Simulates Claude/ChatGPT-style subscription quotas inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, showing usage limits and plan behaviour.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中模拟 Claude/ChatGPT 风格的订阅配额，展示用量上限与套餐行为。

description.en: Resumable mini-games (Sudoku, 2048, Minesweeper, Lights Out) shown inline in the conversation while the harness is thinking.
description.zh: 在对话中内联展示的可续玩游戏（数独、2048、扫雷、关灯），在模型思考时消磨等待时间。

description.en: Suggests follow-up tasks after each completed DSH turn and launches them as child sessions in isolated Git worktrees.
description.zh: 在每轮 DSH 对话结束后推荐后续任务，并在隔离的 Git worktree 中作为子会话启动。

description.en: Adds AI-generated follow-up prompt suggestions and draft rewriting to the DSH input box, with an MCP service for other clients.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供 AI 后续提示词建议与草稿优化，并提供配套 MCP 服务供其他客户端调用。

description.en: Three-layer memory for DSH — records, memories and feelings — with ACT-R activation, spaced repetition and a derived persona panel.
description.zh: 穗：为 DSH 提供记录/记忆/感觉三层记忆，按 ACT-R 激活与间隔复习衰减，并附带人格面板。

description.en: Non-invasive structured compaction index with deterministic anchor guard and probe tools for DeepSeek Harness context.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供非侵入式结构化压缩索引、确定性锚点守卫与探测工具。

description.en: Injects, hot-reloads, and uninstalls local plugin packages in a running dsh without restarts, with scaffolding, self-test, and a management panel.
description.zh: 在运行的 dsh 中注入、热重载和卸载本地插件包，无需重启，并提供脚手架、自测和管理面板。

description.en: Adds global search across DeepSeek Harness conversations, matching user questions and assistant answers only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供全局搜索，仅匹配用户提问与助手回答内容。

description.en: WeChat auto-reply bot: an independent bridge process OCR-reads chats and sends human-paced replies with safety tiers and rate limits.
description.zh: 微信代聊机器人：独立桥进程用 Windows OCR 读取微信消息，按拟人节奏自动回复，并带分级安全与限流。

description.en: Groups DSH sessions into teams: one main session dispatches tasks by session ID, collects results by rpcId, and self-reconciles after restarts.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话编成「整体」：主会话按会话 ID 派工、按 rpcId 回收结果，重启后自动对账自愈。

description.en: Registers eight core engineering skills (planning, debugging, TDD, code review) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册八项核心工程技能，涵盖规划、调试、测试驱动开发和代码审查。

description.en: Renders live, interactive HTML pages inside DeepSeekRuntime conversations, so previews, reports and forms can display and send answers back.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeekRuntime 对话中渲染可交互的实时 HTML 页面，让预览、报告和表单直接展示并能回传结果。

description.en: Renders SVG code fences in DeepSeek Harness chat as theme-aware inline figures.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中的 SVG 代码块渲染为随主题适配的内联图形。

description.en: Interactive waveform viewer for VCD/FST files with zoom, pan, markers, and radix selection in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和分析 VCD/FST 波形，支持缩放、平移、标记和进制选择。

description.en: Swaps Enter and Shift+Enter in the DeepSeek Harness composer so Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框中交换 Enter 与 Shift+Enter：Enter 换行，Shift+Enter 发送。

description.en: Swaps the case of letters in text (uppercase to lowercase and vice versa), a simple Node utility.
A DSH plugin where a parent agent splits a goal into slices and runs parallel sub-agents that write code, showing live per-sub-agent status.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件：母代理把目标拆成切片，并发驱动多个独立子代理写代码，并实时显示各子代理状态。

description.en: Calculates swim pace based on parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数计算游泳配速并返回详细结果。纯本地

description.en: Adds customizable switch buttons beside the DSH Web GUI chat composer that insert slash commands into the input box.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 聊天输入框左侧添加可自定义的 switch 按钮，点击即向输入框插入斜杠命令。

description.en: Bridges cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness, mirroring providers and models into DSH and showing each provider's quota or balance.
description.zh: 将 cc-switch 接入 DeepSeek Harness，把供应商与模型镜像到 DSH，并显示每个供应商的配额或余额。

description.en: Exports a portable dsh config bundle (settings, optional credentials, plugin sources, profile list) and generates a self-installing apply.ps1 for another machine.
description.zh: 把本机 dsh 配置打包成可移植 bundle（设置、可选凭据、插件源码、profile 清单），并生成可自安装的 apply.ps1 供另一台机器使用。

description.en: Syncs DSH sessions, attachments, config, and selected projects across devices via your own private HTTPS Git repo or SFTP server.
description.zh: 通过自有私有 HTTPS Git 仓库或 SFTP 服务器，在设备间同步 DSH 会话、附件、配置及选定工程。

description.en: Multi-device file sync plugin for DSH: sync selected local folders to local dirs, WebDAV or another DSH peer, plus .dshsync archive import/export.
description.zh: DSH 多设备文件同步插件：将选定本地目录同步到本地目录、WebDAV 或另一台 DSH，并支持 .dshsync 归档导入导出。

description.en: Inventories installed DSH skills and profile plugins, checks upstream sources for newer versions, and updates them in place.
description.zh: 清点已安装的 DSH 技能与配置插件，检查上游源是否有新版本，并就地完成更新。

description.en: AI-driven organic reaction prediction, retrosynthesis, and route planning with in-chat visualization for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Organic reaction prediction for DeepSeek Harness: retrosynthesis, forward prediction, route planning, SynScore, and multi-component evolution — with in-chat molecule, reaction, and route-tree visualis

description.en: Conservatively auto-cleans system caches and junk files on macOS/Linux/Windows, with dry run, recoverable deletion and whitelisting.
description.zh: 在macOS/Linux/Windows上保守自动清理系统缓存与垃圾文件，带预演、可恢复删除和白名单机制。

description.en: Classifies core system files versus junk, keeps a hidden backup, patrols file integrity and restores damaged files.
description.zh: 对系统核心文件与垃圾文件进行分类，保留隐藏备份，巡检文件完整性并恢复受损文件。

description.en: Floating one-line status bar for DeepSeek Harness showing CPU, memory, per-GPU temperature/usage and live network speed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮状态条：一行文字显示 CPU、内存、每块 GPU 的温度与占用率以及实时网速。

description.en: Desktop notifications for dsh Web sessions that alert you when a session needs approval or finishes, with click-to-jump back.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 会话提供桌面通知，在会话等待审批或完成时提醒，点击即可跳回该会话。

description.en: Codex-style desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering task completion, errors, questions and goals, with configurable events, sound, privacy and click-to-focus on Windows and Ubuntu.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的桌面通知，覆盖任务完成、错误、提问与目标，支持事件、声音、隐私与点击聚焦配置，适用于 Windows 和 Ubuntu。

description.en: Whitelisted Windows system snapshots of registry keys, hosts and user env vars, with before/after diffing and safe restore.
description.zh: 白名单式 Windows 系统快照：采集注册表指定键、hosts 与用户环境变量，支持改动前后对比与安全恢复。

description.en: System One foundation and Cordis plugin providing core capability for the DeepSeek Harness, written in typesafe TypeScript.
description.zh: System One 基础能力与 Cordis 插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供核心支撑，基于类型安全的 TypeScript。

description.en: Observes DSH agent sessions and lets agents gather rubrics and run system1 evaluations on part or all of a session.
description.zh: 观察 DSH 智能体会话，让代理收集评分标准并对部分或整体会话进行系统1评估。

description.en: A DSH plugin that turns the machine's vital signs into a live dashboard: CPU, memory, GPU, users, processes, energy and disk usage.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，将机器运行状态实时可视化：CPU、内存、GPU、登录用户、进程、能耗与磁盘占用。

description.en: Host plugin plus web client that surfaces sidecar hints for a running DSH task, gated by the host trust fence.
description.zh: 为主机插件与 Web 客户端提供运行中 DSH 任务的旁路提示，受主机信任栅栏控制。

description.en: T3 Code-style New Session screen for DSH with a project dropdown, reasoning-effort picker, and git branch picker.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 T3 Code 风格的新会话界面，含项目下拉框、推理强度选择器和 Git 分支选择器。

description.en: Ports T3 Code's session-context UX to DSH: session-row context block, provider chip, status pill, header context strip, and context-window meter.
description.zh: 将 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面移植到 DSH：会话行上下文块、提供商标识、状态胶囊、头部上下文条和上下文窗口仪表。

description.en: Browser-style conversation tabs for DSH: one tab per conversation with workspace badges, drag reorder, and pin, close or archive controls.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话区提供浏览器式标签页：每个会话一个标签，支持工作区徽标、拖拽排序，以及固定、关闭和归档操作。

description.en: Flashes the browser tab title with "New Message!" when an agent turn finishes in a background tab, stopping when you return.
description.zh: 当后台标签页中的智能体回合完成时，让标签页标题闪烁“New Message!”，返回标签页后立即停止。

description.en: Edge/Chrome extension that auto-groups every DSH Web GUI tab, plus a DSH plugin that mirrors it to a fixed path and drives it.
description.zh: Edge/Chrome 扩展自动将每个 DSH Web GUI 标签页分组，并有 DSH 插件将其镜像到固定路径并驱动它。

description.en: Paints the AI session state onto the browser tab icon: blinking gray while working, green done, yellow waiting, red interrupted.
description.zh: 把 AI 会话状态绘制到浏览器标签页图标上：工作灰闪、完成绿、等待黄、中断红。

description.en: Renders bar charts directly beneath Markdown tables in DeepSeek Harness chat, with no tool calls or server needed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天中为 Markdown 表格自动绘制柱状图，无需工具调用或服务器。

description.en: Adds a hover toolbar to every Markdown table in the DSH Web UI so you can copy the table as Markdown text or a PNG image.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面为每个 Markdown 表格添加悬停工具栏，可将表格复制为 Markdown 文本或 PNG 图片。

description.en: Converts docx/xlsx/xlsm/csv/tsv files into table JSON for rule checkers, with candidate tables, header detection, previews and confidence scores.
description.zh: 把 docx/xlsx/xlsm/csv/tsv 文件转换成规则检查器可用的表格 JSON，并提供候选表、表头识别、预览与置信度。

description.en: Table setup tool that returns family dinner hosting plans based on parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回家庭聚餐的餐桌布置与待客方案，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin that inspects Tableau .twb workbooks, showing 1:1 dashboard layout, field lineage, and data source metadata in the browser.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件，在浏览器中查看 Tableau .twb 文件的 1:1 仪表板布局、字段引用关系与数据源元数据。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding a project/session task board, floating session HUD, keyboard-first navigation and task notifications.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供项目/会话任务看板、浮动会话 HUD、键盘优先导航和任务通知。

description.en: Sends native desktop notifications when a turn completes, errors out, requests approval, or asks a question in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中，当回合完成、出错、请求批准或提问时发送原生桌面通知。

description.en: Authenticated reverse-proxy gateway that lets you control your local DeepSeek Harness from any device on your private Tailscale network.
description.zh: 带认证的反向代理网关，让你通过私有 Tailscale 网络中的任意设备控制本机 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A Taisho-era ink-and-crimson color theme that restyles the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 大正墨染风格的墨色与绯红配色主题，用于更换 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 外观。

description.en: Adds Tako models to the official DeepSeek Harness CLI as a ready-made provider with correct context windows and image input.
description.zh: 为官方 DeepSeek Harness CLI 提供 Tako 模型，自动配置正确的上下文窗口并支持图片输入。

description.en: Interactive three-card tarot draws with 78 face-down cards, source-linked meanings, and refined readings inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中进行三张塔罗牌抽牌，从 78 张背面牌中选择，查看带来源释义并 refine 解读。

description.en: Tarot page plugin with 78 public-domain Rider-Waite-Smith cards, four spreads, shuffle animation and an in-page AI reading.
description.zh: 塔罗牌页面插件，内置78张公有领域韦特塔罗牌、四种牌阵、洗牌动画和页面内AI解读。

description.en: DSH plugin that pops a corner card when a task finishes, fails, is truncated, or awaits approval, plus Windows system notifications when backgrounded.
description.zh: DSH 插件：任务完成、失败、输出截断或等待审批时在页面右上角弹卡片，窗口在后台时同步发送 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Kanban task board that turns each DSH session into a card across pending/in-progress/review, with a 16-colour priority palette and adaptive layout.
description.zh: 看板式任务板，把每个 DSH 会话变成待处理/处理中/待审阅的任务卡，配有 16 色优先级与自适应单页布局。

description.en: Left sidebar task-budget panel tracking per-task token spend and CNY cost, with a per-task cost cap and a live model-facing budget brief.
description.zh: 左侧栏任务预算面板：按任务统计 token 用量与人民币成本，设置单任务费用上限，并提供实时预算简报。

description.en: Schedules agent task runs with per-task models, workspaces, durable run history and saved artifacts.
description.zh: 按计划调度智能体任务执行，支持每任务独立模型、工作区、持久运行历史与产物。

description.en: Turns a single vague sentence into a precise task brief through a short guided Q&A in a sidebar panel, saving rounds and tokens.
description.zh: 通过侧边栏的简短引导问答，把一句话变成精准任务书，减少追问轮次和 token 消耗。

description.en: Sidebar mission-control panel that turns live DSH sessions into task cards grouped by running, blocked and review state.
description.zh: 侧边栏任务面板，将实时 DSH 会话转为任务卡片，按运行、阻塞与待审状态分组展示。

description.en: Dispatches tasks via HTTP to real DSH sessions by session id, optionally waiting for replies, with a persistent task ledger and read-only result queries.
description.zh: 通过 HTTP 按会话 ID 向真实 DSH 会话派发任务，可选等待回复，并提供持久任务台账与只读结果查询。

description.en: Auto-adjusts DeepSeek model reasoning effort per task with peak-pricing cost capping, effort markers, and countdown notices.
description.zh: 按任务自动调整DeepSeek模型推理强度，峰值计费时段成本封顶，附带强度标记和倒计时通知。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows real-time agent task status via a colored favicon dot in the browser tab.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于浏览器标签图标的实时会话状态反馈插件。

description.en: Adds task heartbeats to DeepSeek Harness so agent work emits progress beats and stalled jobs are detected, not just liveness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加任务心跳：发出进度节拍并检测任务停滞，而不仅是存活检测。

description.en: Lists your assigned TAPD and ZenTao tasks in the DSH sidebar and dispatches an agent on a branch you specify.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏展示 TAPD 与 ZenTao 的指派任务，并可在指定分支上派发智能体处理。

description.en: Adds a task-instructions button beside the input box that pins reusable requirements into the system prompt for the whole session, surviving context compaction.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加「任务指令」按钮，把可复用要求写入系统提示词，整场会话生效且压缩上下文也不丢失。

description.en: Injects a system-prompt protocol that makes the agent clarify and optimize every task before it starts working.
description.zh: 注入系统提示协议，让智能体在执行任务前先澄清并优化任务。

description.en: A DSH task list that tracks conversations across workspaces, keeps completed tasks and reminds you about unread completions.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 任务列表插件，跨工作区跟踪会话、保留已完成任务并对未读完成项进行提醒。

description.en: Replays a DeepSeek Harness session as an SVG task-flow graph and Gantt timeline with wait analysis and plan-vs-execution diffs.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话回放为 SVG 任务流程图与甘特时间线，并提供等待分析与计划-执行差异对比。

description.en: Notifies you via system push when DSH tasks finish, error, or block, across macOS, Windows, and phones.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务完成、出错或阻塞时，通过系统推送发送通知，支持 macOS、Windows 和手机。

description.en: Desktop overlay for DeepSeek Harness showing goal, todo progress and pending-confirmation alerts, with an in-app switch.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桌面浮层，显示目标、待办进度与待确认提醒，并可在应用内开关。

description.en: Adds configurable chat personas, emoji libraries, proactive chatting and autonomous Feishu group participation to DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的飞书会话添加可配置人格、表情库、主动聊天与自主参与群聊能力。

description.en: Alerts you when a DSH conversation turn ends via a desktop popup, a ducking chime and an email copy pushed to your phone.
description.zh: 对话结束时通过桌面弹窗、自动压低其他媒体的提示音和邮件推送三重提醒你。

description.en: Pops a notification card in the top-right corner when a DSH task finishes or awaits confirmation, plus a native system notification when available.
description.zh: 当 DSH 任务完成或等待确认时，在页面右上角弹出通知卡片，并在允许时补发系统原生通知。

description.en: Reports structured progress from long-running DSH tasks and shows it live in a floating overlay, sidebar tab, and settings page.
description.zh: 为长时间运行的 DSH 任务上报结构化进度，并在悬浮窗、侧边栏标签和设置页中实时展示。

description.en: Adds a floating live task-progress card above the composer that tracks pip, tqdm and training jobs with speed, ETA and one-click stop.
description.zh: 在输入框上方添加悬浮实时任务进度卡片，追踪 pip、tqdm 和训练任务，显示速度、预计剩余时间并支持一键停止。

description.en: Adds a conversation tab that displays the current session's task progress, listing completed items in the order they were finished.
description.zh: 新增会话标签页，展示当前会话的任务进度，并按完成顺序列出已完成项。

description.en: DSH task status + optional GitHub workbench: browse pinned source, follow check annotations, review Agent diffs and create draft PRs after confirmation.
Launches and guards DeepSeek Harness tasks with frozen acceptance, candidate-bound certificates, and 8-round/90-minute caps.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务启动与完成守卫，冻结验收、候选绑定证书，并限制 8 轮/90 分钟。

description.en: Plays a random chime when each DSH reply finishes, then a one-shot reminder sound if you stay idle for a set time; two independent switches, all persisted.
description.zh: 每次回复结束时随机播放一个任务完成音效并开始倒计时，若期间无新消息则补响一次提醒音效；两个独立开关，配置全部持久化。

description.en: DSH host plugin that detects long-output and multi-step tasks and auto-splits them into parts or a PLAN.md ledger for small-context local models.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：识别长输出与多步骤任务，自动拆分为分片或 PLAN.md 台账，适配小上下文本地模型。

description.en: Watches running DSH tasks for stalls, loops, forbidden commands and budget overruns, then records, reminds, blocks or stops per a fixed ladder.
description.zh: 监控运行中的 DSH 任务，检测停滞、无进展循环、禁用命令与预算超支，并按固定阶梯记录、提醒、阻断或停止。

description.en: Clock-led per-session working-time pill that subtracts answer-waiting time, with a session-span dialog and an all-conversation total by the sidebar account row.
description.zh: 以时钟驱动的按会话工作时长胶囊，自动扣除等待回答的时间，弹窗显示会话跨度，并在侧边栏账号行上方显示全部会话累计时长。

description.en: Local-first task workbench with today/week/all views, an idea pool and daily, weekly and monthly reviews shared by humans and agents.
description.zh: 本地优先的任务工作台，提供今日/本周/全部视图、想法池以及日/周/月复盘，人类与智能体共用一条写入路径。

description.en: A DSH task-workspace convention: one folder per task, a single overwritten PROGRESS.md per task, and per-task git for long runs.
description.zh: DSH 任务工作区约定：每个任务一个文件夹、一份每次更新即覆盖的 PROGRESS.md，长任务单独建 git。

description.en: Windows taskbar unread badge that counts finished DSH conversations and restores window size, position and maximized state on restart.
description.zh: Windows 任务栏未读角标，显示已完成的 DSH 会话数量，并在重启后恢复窗口大小、位置与最大化状态。

description.en: Flashes the Windows taskbar icon (native FlashWindowEx) when a DSH run finishes or needs your approval/answer.
description.zh: 当 DSH 一轮任务完成或需要你审批/回答时，用系统原生 FlashWindowEx 让 Windows 任务栏图标闪烁提醒。

description.en: Client-side Epic panel for dsh-taskboard that stacks epic cards in epic:children order and lets you reorder module arcs by drag or button.
description.zh: dsh-taskboard 的 Epic 面板客户端插件，按 epic:children 顺序堆叠史诗卡片，并支持拖拽或按钮重排模块弧。

description.en: Windows banner notifications when a DSH task finishes, the model awaits your choice, or it requests permission; click the banner to focus the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 任务完成、模型等待选择或申请权限时弹出 Windows 横幅通知，点击横幅即可把 DSH 窗口拉到前台。

description.en: A Tavily-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness's ctx.web seam, adding web search capability.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供程序，为 DeepSeek Harness 的 ctx.web 能力接缝添加网页搜索。

description.en: Evidence-gated pipeline for producing teaching materials with claim grounding, deterministic outlines, rights audits and reproducible outputs.
description.zh: 以证据门控的教学材料生产流水线，提供论断溯源、确定性大纲、版权审核与可复现输出。

description.en: Wires a team task board into DSH: 12 board tools, 4 shell tools, a sidebar board panel, plus host-side auto-dispatch.
description.zh: 把「团队·作业板」接入 DSH：12 个 board 工具、4 个 sh 工具、侧栏作业板面板，以及 Host 端自动派工。

description.en: Multi-agent collaboration kanban board that dispatches tasks to agent sessions and routes answers and human messages back into them.
description.zh: 多 agent 协作看板，将任务派发到指定 agent 会话，并把拍板答案与人的传话自动投回会话。

description.en: DSH plugin bundle adding a per-agent step-budget guard plus bundled team-dev and team-boot skills for agent teams.
description.zh: DSH 插件包，提供每代理步数预算守卫，并附带 team-dev 与 team-boot 团队技能。

description.en: DSH web client plugin for named agent teams with fallback model routing, group/private chat, sub-agent departments, searchable records, layered memory and voice input.
description.zh: DSH 网页客户端插件：具名智能体团队、可回退模型路由、私聊/群聊、部门子智能体并行汇总、记录检索、分层记忆与语音输入。

description.en: A pure black-and-white sci-fi boot splash for DeepSeek HARNESS with the whale logo, HUD boot sequence and synth sound effects.
description.zh: 纯黑白的 DeepSeek HARNESS 科幻启动屏，含官方鲸鱼徽标、HUD 启动序列与合成音效。

description.en: Scans the system temp folder for orphaned DSH workspace snapshot directories and safely deletes them after five checks, a dry run and explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 扫描系统临时目录中孤立的 DSH 工作区快照目录，经五项安全校验、试运行和明确确认后安全删除。

description.en: Reads a tender clause extract table, applies a versioned rule pack, and reports on source refs, raw text, categories and duplicate seq numbers.
description.zh: 读取招标条款抽取表，应用版本化规则包，校验来源、原文填写、类目与序号重复，并返回检查报告。

description.en: Reads a tender evaluation-factor scoring matrix and checks its arithmetic and completeness, flagging over-limit scores, wrong totals and placeholders.
description.zh: 读取评标因素评分矩阵，校验其算术与完整性，标记超限分数、合计错误、缺失依据及未替换的占位符。

description.en: Reads a tender document and reports front-appendix deadlines, deposit, validity, ceiling, bid composition and copy counts, marking each item found or not.
description.zh: 读取招标文件，逐项报告前附表时间、保证金、有效期、最高限价、投标文件组成与份数，并标明是否检索到。

description.en: Tent selection tool that calculates precise recommendations from input parameters; pure Node, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据输入参数计算并给出精确的帐篷选型推荐，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: A tent selection tool that returns camping practical solutions based on parameters.
Cross-session term dictionary that stores agreed definitions in files and auto-injects a term's meaning into model context on first use.
description.zh: 跨会话术语字典：把约定称谓存入文件，词语首次出现时自动将其口径注入模型上下文。

description.en: DSH web plugin that embeds real PTY terminals inside the DeepSeek Harness UI with sidebar entry, tabs, rename and theme-aware colors.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，在 DeepSeek Harness 界面内嵌入真实 PTY 终端，支持侧边栏入口、标签页、重命名和主题配色。

description.en: Install and run Android native CLI tools inside DSH by fetching Termux aarch64 bionic packages and executing them via linker64.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中安装并运行 Android 原生命令行工具：从 Termux 仓库获取 aarch64 bionic 包并通过 linker64 执行。

description.en: Sends Termux-based Android system notifications and TTS voice alerts when DSH needs your input or a task finishes.
description.zh: 在 Termux 中为 DSH 增加通知通道：需要你选择或任务完成时，通过 Termux:API 发送手机通知与语音提醒。

description.en: Parses LCOV/Cobertura/Istanbul/Go coverage reports and outputs structured coverage data and uncovered line ranges.
description.zh: 解析 LCOV、Cobertura、Istanbul 和 Go 覆盖率报告，输出结构化覆盖数据与未覆盖行区间

description.en: Lets you pick a monitor in settings so Agent-launched test windows (games, editors, previews) open there instead of covering DSH on Windows.
description.zh: 在设置中选择显示器，让 Agent 拉起的测试窗口（游戏、编辑器、预览）开在指定屏幕上，不再遮挡 DSH（Windows）。

description.en: Classic Tetris playable directly in DSH conversation flow using Canvas and Web Audio.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话流中用 Canvas 和 Web Audio 直接游玩的经典俄罗斯方块，支持 7-bag、SRS、Hold 和幽灵方块。

description.en: A pure Node plugin for rendering text templates with no network or external services.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，用于渲染文本模板，无需网络或外部服务。

description.en: String utilities for case conversion (camel/snake/kebab/slug) and text statistics, pure Node.
description.zh: 提供大小写、驼峰、蛇形、短横线和 slug 转换以及文本统计的纯 Node 字符串工具。

description.en: A local text-wrapping tool plugin for DeepSeek Harness sessions, implemented in pure Node with no dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中本地对文本进行换行的工具插件，纯 Node 实现，无需依赖。

description.en: Telegram Bot API tools for DSH sessions: send messages, photos and stickers, read cached history, members and reactions, with optional wake-up on new messages.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话用的 Telegram Bot API 工具：收发消息、发送图片与贴纸、读取缓存历史与成员，并可选消息唤醒。

description.en: Adds quiet hedgehog easter eggs after each finished turn, plus local water, meal and rest reminders — no model calls.
description.zh: 在回合结束后安静展示刺猬 Carl 彩蛋，并提供本地的喝水、用餐和休息提醒，不调用模型。

description.en: Usability-first cyber-editorial dark theme for DSH Web interface.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的可用性优先的赛博编辑暗色主题。

description.en: A tech-gothic "Forge-Cathedral" fan-made theme for DeepSeek Harness, featuring original SVG art and a gear-skull emblem.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的机械神教「铸炉圣殿」科技哥特外观主题，含原创 SVG 插画与齿轮骷髅徽记。

description.en: Azure Planet is a deep-blue themed skin for DeepSeek Harness featuring a CSS/SVG ringed planet scene, translucent panels and three animation modes.
description.zh: 蔚蓝星球是一个深空蓝主题皮肤，用 CSS/SVG 绘制带星环的行星场景，面板半透明，提供三档动效模式。

description.en: A token-only theme plugin for DSH web, with a warm plaster and fired-clay palette and no global CSS, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 网页的纯 token 主题插件，暖石膏与火烧黏土配色，无全局 CSS，可在设置中开关。

description.en: A pure color-theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web client, overlaying 119 dsw tokens with an inkstone-neutral, jade-accent palette.
description.zh: 一个纯配色主题插件，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端叠加 119 个 dsw token，采用砚石中性配青玉强调色。

description.en: Neumorphism (soft UI) theme for the DSH web UI with cool-grey surfaces, steel-blue accents and soft shadows in light and dark mode.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的新拟态（软 UI）主题，冷灰表面、钢蓝强调色与柔和阴影，浅色深色模式同时生效。

description.en: Adds a Themes page to DeepSeek Harness settings to manage app themes and theme plugins, with one active at a time.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中新增主题页面，管理应用主题与已安装主题插件，同一时间仅一个主题生效。

description.en: Four switchable DeepSeek Harness web UI theme skins applied via pure design-token overrides without touching host source code.
description.zh: 四套可切换的 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面皮肤，纯设计令牌覆盖，不改宿主源码。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, offering a token-override theme and a full-frontend variant with Junimo dialog and 8-bit sounds.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 打造的星露谷物语主题，包含令牌覆盖主题与带祝尼魔对话框和 8-bit 音效的完整前端版本。

description.en: A Strinova (卡拉彼丘) themed skin for DSH with light/dark palettes, rotating character cards, floating particles and custom sidebar logo.
description.zh: 一套卡拉彼丘主题皮肤，含浅色/深色配色、随机角色卡、漂浮粒子与自定义侧边栏 Logo。

description.en: A synthwave theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with neon glow, translucent panels, and background media.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供合成波风格主题，含霓虹光效、半透明面板与背景媒体。

description.en: A warm, low-saturation handwritten-journal theme for the DSH Web UI: paper-beige tones, Song serif typography, brick-red accents, and a daily date stamp.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 打造的暖纸手记风主题：米杏纸色、宋体排版、砖红点缀，并带一枚当日日期戳。

description.en: Turns DSH into Windows XP with a Luna blue skin, Bliss wallpaper, plus a chime and completion popup after each run.
description.zh: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤、Bliss 壁纸，并在每轮跑完时播放提示音与弹出完成弹窗。

description.en: A DSH Web GUI cosmetic plugin that keeps scrollbars thin by default and thickens them to 10px only while the pointer hovers the scroll trough, with no layout shift.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web GUI 外观插件：滚动条默认保持细条，仅在鼠标悬停滚动槽附近时临时加粗到 10px，且不会引起正文位移抖动。

description.en: Free web-search plugin for DeepSeek Harness that scrapes Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG with no API key or model calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的免费网页搜索插件，零成本，抓取 Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG 等，无需 API key 和模型调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives each thinking step a word budget and forces a visible conclusion within a few steps before continuing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：为单步思考设定字数预算，连续若干步没有可见结论时强制先给结论再继续。
