description.en: Floating overlay that streams the model's live thinking character by character, shows speed with a green light, and auto-translates English to Chinese.
description.zh: 悬浮窗实时逐字流式展示模型思考过程，绿灯跟随输出速度，并自动英译中。

description.en: Display-layer translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, covering thinking chain, task cards, and answers in 8 languages.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web UI提供显示层翻译，支持思考链、任务卡片和答案的8种语言。

description.en: Scores each turn by conversation drift and failures, then automatically selects the thinking effort and labels the finished turn.
description.zh: 根据对话偏离主目标和失败次数为每轮打分，自动选择思考强度并标注已完成的回合。

description.en: Adds a corner card in DeepSeek Harness that watches Tibo (@thsottiaux) on X and shows new posts translated into Chinese.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中添加角落卡片，监控 X 上 Tibo(@thsottiaux) 的新帖子并以中文显示。

description.en: Session-local scheduler for DeepSeek Harness that injects prompts after a delay, at a set time, or on a repeating interval, with a web panel and /schedule command.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的会话内定时任务插件，可按延迟、指定时间或重复间隔注入提示词，并提供网页管理面板与 /schedule 命令。

description.en: Auto-scrolls Baidu Tieba: crawls your followed forums, reads post bodies, judges what's worth it, and writes a daily Markdown digest.
description.zh: 自动刷贴吧：翻看你关注的吧，读取帖子正文并判断价值，生成每日 Markdown 日报。

description.en: A small capsule above the chat composer suggests a model tier and reasoning level for your next message — advice only, never changing the request.
description.zh: 在聊天输入框上方显示小胶囊，为下一条消息建议模型档位与推理等级，仅作建议，不修改请求。

description.en: Time-aware model router that switches each turn between peak and off-peak upstreams by Beijing time, with fallback, holiday calendar and JSONL logs.
description.zh: 按北京时间在每个回合于高峰期/非高峰期上游之间切换的感知时间模型路由器，支持回退、节假日日历和 JSONL 日志。

description.en: Turns English audiobooks (MP3) or documents into listening lessons with local sentence recognition, AI-read translations, and spaced review.
description.zh: 把英文有声书（MP3）或英文文档变成听力课：本机逐句识别、AI 朗读翻译、精听与间隔复习，练到一听就懂。

description.en: Visual WYSIWYG editing of HTML files in DeepSeek Harness's Better Sidebar, with byte-preserving saves and conflict detection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Better Sidebar 中用 TinyMCE 可视化编辑 HTML 文件，保存时保留原始结构并检测冲突。

description.en: Tip jar for DeepSeek Harness: contributors declare USDC / fiat / QR channels in sponsors.json; sponsor-center panel + TipJarEmbed. Pure P2P, privacy by default. 打赏罐
Adds a Windows-only Restart item to the DSH titlebar menu that ends the app and relaunches the same executable via a WMI-launched PowerShell script.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows：在 DSH 标题栏菜单添加「重启」项，双击后由 WMI 拉起 PowerShell 结束应用并重启同一可执行文件。

description.en: Adds a titlebar workspace switcher that shows the current project and jumps straight to the right conversation without opening the sidebar.
description.zh: 在顶栏添加工作区切换器，显示当前项目并直接跳转到对应对话，无需打开侧栏。

description.en: Adds a Settings trust-section so a host can skip TLS verification, letting private model gateways with self-signed certificates connect.
description.zh: 在设置中新增证书信任区，可标记某主机跳过 TLS 校验，让使用自签名证书的私有模型网关正常连接。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in Today AI models (DeepSeek V4.1, MiniMax, GLM) to DeepSeek Harness with folded reasoning chains and an auto-pump task engine.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 Today AI 模型（DeepSeek V4.1 / MiniMax / GLM）接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持折叠思考链、Auto-Pump 任务引擎与 DPAPI 零密钥安全。

description.en: A playful cyber-shrine plugin that lets you draw one daily fortune stick before spending tokens, with up/down tier hints from the heavens.
description.zh: 一个赛博小庙风格的每日运势插件，烧 Token 前摇一签，由天意提示升档还是降档。

description.en: Toddler height standard tool that returns clear suggestions based on parameters; medical advice should follow doctor's orders.
description.zh: 幼儿身高标准工具，可根据参数返回明确建议；医疗

description.en: A lightweight todo panel for the DSH right sidebar: one task per line, press enter to add, check to complete.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的轻量待办面板：一行一件、回车即加、勾掉即完成。

description.en: Persistent todo ledger that stores task state in a repo-local _todo/ directory and provides 11 native tools for cross-session task management.
description.zh: 持久化待办账本，将任务状态保存在仓库本地 _todo/ 目录，并提供 11 个原生工具实现跨会话任务管理。

description.en: Adds a three-level TODO sticky-note board (user, workspace, session) shown as a floating panel or right-sidebar tab, saved locally.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加三层 TODO 便签板（用户级、工作区级、会话级），可浮窗或右侧栏页签显示，数据仅存本机。

description.en: Serial TODO queue board for DeepSeek Harness that runs one session per queue, auto-dispatches the next task when idle, and adds a review popup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的串行 TODO 队列板：每个队列同时只跑一个会话，空闲自动派发下一条，并提供待验收浮窗。

description.en: Workspace-scoped todo lists and sticky notes for DeepSeek Harness, with a floating panel and an aggregate board grouped by workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按工作区隔离的待办清单与便签，含浮动面板和按工作区分组的汇总看板。

description.en: Returns basic facts about Togo (capital, population, currency, continent) with no network dependencies.
Shows your DeepSeek balance and token usage stats in the DSH composer status bar, with daily, weekly and monthly breakdowns by model provider.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框状态栏显示 DeepSeek 总余额和 token 用量统计，支持今日、本周、本月切换，并按模型厂商拆分对比。

description.en: 给DeepSeek Harness Web GUI用的会话token计费插件：在会话标题栏显示本次会话的实时花费，点开可以看输入 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出 / 推理的分项、按模型的账单，以及当前用的是高峰还是空闲时段价。
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话标题栏显示实时 token 花费，可展开查看输入、缓存命中、缓存写入、输出、推理分项及按模型账单和高峰或空闲时段价。

description.en: A read-only Token usage dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, showing daily, monthly and ranged consumption, heatmap calendar, source details, provider/model rankings and dual-axis trends.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供只读的 Token 用量看板，包含今日/本月/区间消耗、热力日历、来源明细、提供商与模型排行及双轴趋势。

description.en: A draggable capsule in the GUI that shows cumulative token usage across all workspaces and sessions, with per-session detail on click.
description.zh: 在 GUI 右下角放置可拖动胶囊，实时显示所有工作区所有会话累计消耗的 token，点击可展开会话级明细。

description.en: Adds a ¥ pill below the chat input showing DeepSeek account balance and this session's estimated token cost, with a detail panel.
description.zh: 在对话输入框下方添加一个 ¥ 胶囊，显示 DeepSeek 账户余额和本会话 token 费用估算，并可展开明细面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that collects local session token usage and shows it as KPI cards, trend charts and configurable dashboards.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，采集本机会话的 Token 用量，并以 KPI 卡片、趋势图和可配置图表形式展示。

description.en: A DSH plugin named token-control whose README is essentially empty, so its actual token-related capabilities cannot be determined.
description.zh: 一个名为 token-control 的 DSH 插件，README 基本为空，无法确定其具体的 token 相关功能。

description.en: Live token usage and estimated cost ledger in the DSH sidebar, showing per-session and total spend, cache hit rate and context usage.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏常驻显示 token 用量与预估费用，含逐会话明细、缓存命中率和上下文占用。

description.en: Estimates the current session's token cost using local pi-ai catalog prices, not a billed amount.
description.zh: 使用本地 pi-ai 目录价格估算当前会话的 token 费用，并非实际账单金额。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek account balance and, after every conversation turn, that turn's token usage and its cost.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在每轮对话后显示该轮的 Token 消耗量与花费。

description.en: Right-sidebar token curve and ledger: per-turn tokens and cost, monthly/weekly totals for all local sessions, Excel export, and live account balance.
description.zh: 右栏 Token 曲线与账本：逐轮 token 与费用、本机会话按月/周汇总、导出 Excel，并实时显示账户余额。

description.en: Records every DeepSeek Harness model call and shows token usage by day, model, purpose and project in a sidebar dashboard.
description.zh: 记录 DeepSeek Harness 中每次模型调用，并按日期、模型、用途和项目在侧边栏面板中展示 token 用量。

description.en: Adds a daily token-usage heatmap to the DSH settings page, aggregated from local session logs with no external requests.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页显示每日 Token 用量热力图，数据全部取自本机会话日志，不发起外部请求。

description.en: Live token HUD for DSH Web: draggable overlay showing real-time tok/s, cumulative output, and session status.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时 Token 悬浮窗：可拖动覆盖层，显示每秒 tok 数、累计输出和会话状态。

description.en: Tracks daily DeepSeek token usage from real provider-reported session logs, with a dashboard, heatmap, badge, chat command and model tool.
description.zh: 从会话日志中统计 provider 真实上报的每日 token 用量，提供仪表盘、热力图、输入框徽标、聊天命令和模型工具。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that keeps a local ledger of token usage with two independent books and exact per-bucket accounting plus week/month/day filters.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，本地记录 token 用量账本，包含两套独立账簿、精确的分桶统计以及周/月/日筛选。

description.en: DSH plugin: lifetime token counter in the conversation header, summed across every local session.
TokenLens reads local DSH session logs and renders a dashboard of token usage, requests, cost, cache hits and model speed.
description.zh: TokenLens 读取本地 DSH 会话日志，生成 Token 用量、请求数、费用、缓存命中与模型速度看板。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness token usage and call efficiency, and adds reversible caching of tool output to cut costs.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与调用效率，并提供可回滚的工具输出缓存以降低成本。

description.en: Adds a cute mascot overlay in the DSH corner showing live token use, speed, context usage, current task and daily session totals.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右下角添加 Q 版看板娘，实时显示本会话 token、速率、上下文占用、当前任务及今日会话合计。

description.en: Real-time token usage and DeepSeek account balance monitor widget for the DeepSeek Harness web shell.
description.zh: DSH 静态 Host 插件，在 Web 界面右下角实时显示 token 用量与 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Sidebar pill that tracks your DeepSeek token spend by day, applying peak/off-peak pricing with cache-hit breakdowns and a per-model ledger.
description.zh: 侧栏胶囊插件，按本地日期统计 DeepSeek token 花费，区分峰谷价、缓存命中，并按模型拆分账本。

description.en: Shows session token cost calculated from official regional DeepSeek tariffs, with peak/off-peak rates and local time.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方地区定价计算会话 token 成本，显示峰谷时段费率与本地时间。

description.en: Appends one inline number to the assistant action row showing the estimated CNY cost of each turn, with peak and off-peak rates applied.
description.zh: 在助手操作行内追加一个数字，显示本轮对话的预估人民币花费，并自动应用高峰与低谷时段价格。

description.en: A floating HUD for DSH Web GUI showing real-time token consumption, estimated cost, and balance, with orange-red alert during peak hours.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的悬浮仪表，实时显示 token 消耗、费用估算与账户余额，高峰时变橙红色。

description.en: Shows live per-conversation token usage and CNY cost in the DSH composer dock, priced with DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框停靠栏实时显示每次对话的 token 用量与人民币费用,按 DeepSeek 官方高峰/低谷价计费。

description.en: Cumulatively condenses a DSH session into an ever-growing Markdown handoff document every 500K new tokens, ready for another agent.
description.zh: 每累计约 50 万新增 token，就把 DSH 会话累积整理成一份可直接交接给其他 Agent 的 Markdown 长文档。

description.en: Local DeepSeek token usage and cost analytics for DSH with trends, per-model and per-API-key breakdowns, cache savings and spike detection.
description.zh: 本地 DeepSeek token 用量与成本分析插件，提供趋势、按模型/API Key 细分、缓存节省与用量突增检测。

description.en: Displays per-reply token usage, answer duration, and session cumulative tokens beneath every response.
description.zh: 在每条回答下方常驻显示本轮 Token 用量、回答耗时与会话累计 Token。

description.en: Token usage panel for the DSH web UI showing a 26-week heatmap, per-model bars and a header chip.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面中的 Token 用量面板，提供 26 周热力图、按模型柱状图和顶栏小挂件。

description.en: A DSH settings panel that tracks token usage with a daily heatmap, 30-day trend, per-session breakdown and cost estimates.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 设置面板，通过每日热力图、30 天趋势、按会话明细和费用估算来跟踪 Token 用量。

description.en: DSH token-usage dashboard that logs each model call's token consumption and visualizes cumulative usage as a block wall.
description.zh: DSH 的 Token 用量看板，记录每次模型调用的消耗，并用方块墙可视化累计用量。

description.en: A dsh settings page showing your tokens.ci usage: daily tokens, cost, token mix, model shares and leaderboard standing.
description.zh: 将 tokens.ci 用量面板接入 dsh 设置页：每日 token、费用、token 构成、模型占比与排行榜名次。

description.en: Converts between TOML and JSON data formats.
description.zh: 在 TOML 与 JSON 数据格式之间相互转换。

description.en: Safety and compatibility layer for non-DeepSeek models in DSH Web.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 非 DeepSeek 模型的安全兼容适配层。

description.en: Injects concise persistent guidance and portable skills so the agent picks the right tools and arguments on every call.
description.zh: 注入简洁的持久化指引与可移植技能，让智能体在每次调用时选择正确的工具与参数。

description.en: Lets the DeepSeek Harness agent capture a live webcam frame on demand, giving it visual input without any camera app.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体按需抓取实时摄像头画面，无需相机应用即可获得视觉输入。

description.en: Blocks repeated identical failed tool calls in DeepSeek Harness to save costs and prevent wasted operations.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中拦截重复的相同失败工具调用，避免无效操作并节省开销。

description.en: Adds a single toggle to fold or hide tool call cards and thinking blocks in DSH conversations, with state persisted in localStorage.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中添加一个开关，用于折叠或隐藏工具调用卡片与思考块，开关状态保存在 localStorage 中。

description.en: Preset-agnostic global tool masking for DeepSeek Harness: presentation-layer filtering, execution-layer guard veto, self-protection gate, and a WebUI editor.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的全局工具屏蔽插件：表现层过滤、执行层守卫否决、自我保护闸门以及 WebUI 编辑器。

description.en: 家庭工具清单：根据参数返回家庭工具维修方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。
description.zh: 根据传入参数返回家庭工具维修方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Observes agent tool-call failures, reflects on them, and auto-writes SKILL files so later sessions avoid repeating the same mistakes.
description.zh: 观测 agent 工具调用失败，反思并自动沉淀为 SKILL 文件，下次会话自动生效，避免重蹈覆辙。

description.en: Turns a raw recording into a podcast episode: finds silence-based segment breaks, cuts and loudness-normalizes with local ffmpeg/ffprobe, then publishes a client-valid RSS feed.
description.zh: 把一段录音做成播客：用本机 ffmpeg/ffprobe 从静音量出分段断点、切分并统一响度，最后生成客户端认的 RSS 源。

description.en: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions in DeepSeek Harness without installing protoc, via six built-in tools.
description.zh: 无需安装 protoc，即可在 DeepSeek Harness 中读取、审计与对比 Protocol Buffer 定义，提供六个工具。

description.en: Verifies that a deployment's recorded tool surface matches an approved lock across agent scopes and permission modes.
description.zh: 校验某部署记录的工具列表在各 agent 作用域和权限模式下是否与已批准的锁定清单一致

description.en: Metasearch DSH plugin that queries ~200 engines without API keys, aggregates and ranks results, and exposes web search tools and a result card.
description.zh: 免 API key 调用约 200 个搜索引擎的 DSH 元搜索插件，聚合去重并按权重排序，提供搜索工具和结果卡片。

description.en: Manages workspace registry records for DeepSeek Harness: view, create, rename, delete; no disk changes; destructive ops require approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工作区注册管理工具：查看、创建、重命名、删除工作区记录，不改动磁盘目录，删除或改路径等破坏性操作需用户审批。

description.en: Five-in-one DSH utility pack: QQ remote session driving, cross-session Q&A, a pause button, restart with auto-resume, and peak-hour prompt discipline.
description.zh: 五合一 DSH 小工具合集：QQ 远程驾驶会话、跨会话提问、界面暂停按钮、重启后自动续跑、贵时段注入省 token 提示。

description.en: dsh Web UI plugin that splits each session into turns and uses DeepSeek to cluster them into topics and stages, showing token, tool and time usage.
description.zh: dsh 网页界面插件，将会话按轮次切分并用 DeepSeek 增量聚合为话题与阶段，直观展示 token、工具与时间消耗。

description.en: Runs golden eval cases against the current DSH config vs a candidate prompt change, scores with rule checks plus an LLM judge, and keeps only improvements.
description.zh: 用同一批黄金用例对比当前 DSH 配置与候选提示词改动，结合规则校验和 LLM 评判打分，仅在变好时保留。

description.en: Live, searchable trace waterfall replacing the trajectory view, showing model, tool, waiting and handoff timing per turn.
description.zh: 实时可搜索的轨迹瀑布图，替换 trajectory 视图，按轮次展示模型、工具、等待与交接耗时。

description.en: Saves model-written task checkpoints and re-injects them into the system prompt after every context compaction so long tasks survive.
description.zh: 保存模型写入的任务检查点，并在每次上下文压缩后重新注入系统提示，让长任务状态不丢失。

description.en: Calculates house trade-in/replacement based on parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据传入参数计算房屋置换换房方案并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Read-only DSH session dashboard showing active book, token mix, context, tool time, idle-rate spend, and risk gates.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 会话仪表盘，展示活动账本、token 构成、上下文、工具耗时、空闲率开销与风险门禁。

description.en: Writes DSH final replies over 15 lines to a Markdown file in the workspace, leaving a short digest and file path in chat.
description.zh: 将超过15行的DSH最终回复写入工作区的Markdown文件，并在聊天中保留摘要和文件路径。

description.en: Adds local Parakeet Ultra voice transcription to DSH with live preview and a customizable hotkey for dictating prompts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加本地 Parakeet Ultra 语音转写，支持实时预览和自定义快捷键，用于语音输入。

description.en: Turns any conversation reply into a shareable document — clean Markdown, single-file HTML or JSON, with TOC and redacted secrets.
description.zh: 把任意一条回复导出为可分享的文档：干净的 Markdown、单文件 HTML 或 JSON，带目录且默认脱敏密钥。

description.en: Translates LLM API parameters across vendors and repairs broken JSON tool output without fabricating data.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨 11 家厂商的参数映射（temperature、top_p、max_tokens、stop、system），并在执行后修复损坏的 JSON 工具输出，不虚构数据。

description.en: A Chinese/English translation workbench with an always-on AI tutor, example sentences, corrections and neural read-aloud.
description.zh: 一个中英互译工作台，内置常驻 AI 导师、例句、纠错与神经网络朗读功能。

description.en: English translation and learning plugin for DSH with bilingual reasoning, selection translation, composer polish, offline dictionary, pronunciation and a vocabulary notebook.
description.zh: DSH 的英语翻译与学习插件，支持双语推理、划词翻译、输入框润色、离线词典、发音和生词本。

description.en: DSH selection and screenshot translator: DeepSeek vision OCRs a screen region and pastes the Chinese translation back in place.
description.zh: DSH 划词与截图翻译插件：DeepSeek 读图 OCR 后把中文译文原位贴回截图区域，支持表格模式与桌面钉住。

description.en: Computes the area of a trapezoid using a pure Node.js implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 使用纯 Node.js 计算梯形面积，无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides a recoverable trash store for delete operations, allowing restoration of accidentally deleted files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供可恢复的回收站存储，所有删除操作先进入回收站，误删的文件可通过还原找回。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions from the sidebar with logging, workspace accounting, and archive/pin set handling.
description.zh: 从侧边栏删除 DSH 会话，并记录日志、统计工作区、处理归档/固定集合。

description.en: Tool that gives clear travel document recommendations based on parameters; pure Node, offline.
description.zh: 根据参数给出明确的旅行证件推荐，纯 Node 实现，可离线运行。

description.en: Calculates travel insurance prices based on parameters, returning detailed results. Pure Node implementation, no network dependency.
description.zh: 根据参数估算旅行险价格并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Provides a travel medication checklist and clear recommendations based on input parameters.
Ingests travel orders, invoices and card charges, dedupes them, runs three-way matching, read-only policy checks and exports a ledger.
description.zh: 导入差旅订单、发票和银行卡消费，去重后进行三方匹配、只读政策校验并导出台账。

description.en: A tool to calculate treasury yields from parameters, returning detailed results with no network dependency.
Pure Node plugin for displaying tree structures with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的插件，用于展示树形结构，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Provides triangle calculation tools, pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 提供三角形计算工具，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Pure Node.js plugin that removes whitespace, no network dependencies, for session use.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 插件，用于去除字符串中的空白字符，无网络依赖，适合会话中使用。

description.en: Adds a Delete local files action to archived DSH sessions that lists what will be removed, then deletes transcript, cache and subagent sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 归档会话添加“删除本地文件”操作，先列出待删内容，再删除会话记录、投影缓存与子代理会话。

description.en: Read-only trust audit of MCP tools and Skills in DeepSeek Harness, flagging prompt injection, hidden Unicode, risky capabilities and context cost.
description.zh: 对 DeepSeek Harness 中的 MCP 工具与技能进行只读信任审计，检测提示注入、隐藏 Unicode、危险能力与上下文开销。

description.en: Unofficial DSH plugin that links Tsinghua SSO with Paratera to show balance, manage console API keys, import models and settings.
description.zh: 非官方 DSH 插件，将清华 SSO 与 Paratera 打通，可查看余额、管理控制台 API 密钥、导入模型并配置设置。

description.en: Turns YouTube transcripts into cited insights, product intel, PRD drafts and multi-video comparisons directly inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中直接将 YouTube 转录稿转化为带引用的洞察、产品情报、PRD 草稿和多视频对比。

description.en: Pins default model, reasoning effort, agent preset and permission mode for every new dsh-TUI conversation, with a /favors command to inspect or re-apply them.
description.zh: 为每个新的 dsh-TUI 对话固定默认模型、推理强度、agent 预设和权限模式，并提供 /favors 命令查看或重新应用。

description.en: Blocks high-confidence secrets in dsh-TUI before they are sent to a model, preventing leakage.
description.zh: 在 dsh-TUI 将内容发送给模型前拦截高置信度密钥，防止泄露，符合 dsh 生态清单 v0.15。

description.en: dsh TUI subagents view: list active subagents, follow their live traces, and interact with continuable ones.
description.zh: dsh TUI 子代理视图：列出活动子代理，跟踪其实时轨迹，并与可继续的子代理交互。

description.en: Right-side inbox sidebar for dsh-TUI that groups running, unread and recent conversations by workspace.
description.zh: dsh-TUI 的右侧收件箱侧边栏，按工作区分组展示运行中、未读与近期会话。

description.en: Provides instrument tuning practice plans based on parameters, pure Node implementation without network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数生成乐器调音练习计划，纯 Node 实现，无需网络依赖。

description.en: Analyzes your own DSH sessions per module and gives usage-driven tuning advice, with one-click per-model compaction thresholds.
description.zh: 按真实用量分析你自己的 DSH 会话并逐模块给出调优建议，支持一键设置各模型的压缩阈值。

description.en: Mobile remote control for DeepSeek Harness web GUI via TunnelMux, with QR pairing and secure tokens.
description.zh: Mobile remote control for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with TunnelMux as the tunnel backend: scan-to-pair QR, one-time tokens, revocable device sessions, mobile /m page.

description.en: Codex-style turn-finished alerts for DeepSeek Harness with native notifications, app-icon badges and a title dot on Windows and macOS.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的回合结束提醒，在 Windows 和 macOS 上显示原生通知、应用图标角标和标题圆点。

description.en: Plays a chime when a user-initiated task in DeepSeek Harness actually finishes, and stays silent on interruptions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中，用户发起的任务真正完成时播放提示音，被中断时不响。

description.en: Resumes an unfinished, interrupted DSH Web agent turn from its saved session context so work continues instead of restarting.
description.zh: 利用已保存的会话上下文继续被中断的 DSH Web 智能体回合，无需从头开始。

description.en: A read-only DSH plugin that shows this turn's and the whole conversation's token cost in CNY under the input box and at the end of each reply.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件，在输入框下方与每轮回复尾部显示本轮及整个对话消耗的人民币金额。

description.en: DSH plugin that deletes single or multiple conversation turns by masking them from the model-visible context, while the original session log stays untouched.
description.zh: DSH 会话清理插件：可删除单轮或多轮对话，将其从模型可见上下文遮蔽，原始会话日志一字不改。

description.en: DSH plugin that shows per-turn elapsed time, tokens, speed and countdown in the chat header, plus pre-send token/cost/time estimates.
description.zh: DSH 插件：对话头部实时显示本轮耗时、token、速度与倒计时，并在发送前预估产出 token、费用和时间。

description.en: Per-step timeout plugin for dsh agent turns, preventing infinite loops from model degradation.
description.zh: dsh turn-guard plugin: per-step timeout for agent turns (防模型退化死循环)

description.en: A floating jump bar for DeepSeek Harness to quickly navigate between conversation turns.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供悬浮跳转栏，可在对话轮次之间快速跳转导航。

description.en: Adds a single grey text line above each completed DeepSeek Harness turn showing which model answered it, with no badges or file writes.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 每个已完成回合上方加一行灰色小字，显示该轮由哪个模型作答。

description.en: Plays a chime/ringtone (bundled, local file, or uploaded audio) when the DSH agent finishes a turn, with a pause chip to stop it.
description.zh: DSH 回合结束自动播放铃声（内置、本地文件或上传音频），右下角浮标可随时暂停。

description.en: Web plugin for navigating conversation turns in DeepSeek Harness chat interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页聊天界面的对话轮次导航轨，用于在各轮对话之间跳转定位。

description.en: Sends Windows toast notification when an agent turn completes, with click-through to session in Web UI.
description.zh: 当智能体一轮对话完成时发送 Windows 通知，点击通知可跳回 Web UI 中对应会话。

description.en: Quote an earlier turn of the current conversation into the composer via an @ mention for easy reference and reuse.
description.zh: 通过 @ 提及把当前对话中较早的一轮引用到输入框，方便引用与复用。

description.en: Adds per-turn deliverable buttons and a turn-navigator dot rail to DSH conversation interface for easy file opening and turn jumping.
description.zh: 为DSH对话界面添加每轮交付按钮和轮次导航点轨，方便打开文件与跳转轮次。

description.en: Shows per-turn token cost in CNY plus 本轮/今日/会话 totals, pricing tokens by model, peak hours and holidays for dsh.
description.zh: 按模型与时段(高峰/节假日)计价,显示每轮对话的人民币花费及本轮/今日/会话总计。

description.en: Detects stuck turns in live DSH sessions and injects a quiet warning alert.
description.zh: 检测 DSH 实时会话中卡住的回合，并注入一条静默警告提醒。

description.en: Turtle health tool: returns pet care plans based on parameters, pure Node.js, no network.
description.zh: 龟健康工具，根据传入参数返回宠物龟护理方案，纯 Node.js 实现，无需联网。

description.en: Splits the DSH conversation header into two rows, keeping native actions and utilities separate with extra wrapping on narrow widths.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话顶栏的操作与工具拆成两行排列，窄宽度下继续自动换行。

description.en: A timed typing practice game for the DSH Web UI with live WPM and accuracy, 15/30/60-second modes, and locally saved best scores.
description.zh: 一个用于 DSH Web UI 的限时打字练习小游戏，实时显示 WPM 与准确率，支持 15/30/60 秒模式并本地保存最佳成绩。

description.en: Opens Markdown file links from the DSH conversation directly in Typora instead of the built-in in-app preview.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话中的 Markdown 文件链接直接在 Typora 中打开，而不是使用内置预览。

description.en: Preview UG/NX 3D models inside DSH: orbit the view, pick faces and features, and ask an AI about the geometry.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中预览 UG/NX 三维模型，可旋转视图、点选面与特征，并就地询问 AI。

description.en: Circle any region of the DSH UI, describe the change, and it lands in the composer as a structured improvement request.
description.zh: 圈选 DSH 界面上的任意区域并描述改动，自动整理成结构化改进请求填入输入框。

description.en: Adds a local image or video background layer plus full-interface frosted glass to the DeepSeek Harness web client, then needs a Host restart.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端添加本地图片/视频背景和全界面毛玻璃效果，安装后需重启一次 Host。

description.en: Customizes the DSH Web UI look with style presets, surface transparency, wallpaper, and font settings.
description.zh: 通过样式预设、界面透明度、壁纸和字体设置自定义 DSH Web UI 外观。

description.en: Renders ::dsh-ui block files as sandboxed canvases with element chips inside DSH pages.
description.zh: 将 ::dsh-ui 块文件渲染为带元素标签的沙箱画布，嵌入 DSH 页面。

description.en: Persistent DSH Web UI enhancement plugin adding RGB color tinting, tool-card collapsing, input status bar, and a floating beautify panel.
description.zh: DSH Web界面增强插件，提供RGB调色、工具卡片折叠、输入区状态条和悬浮美化面板。

description.en: Lets you control the look of the DSH GUI with a color spectrum, preset palettes, and border styling options.
description.zh: 让你通过色谱、预设配色和边框样式选项来控制 DSH 图形界面的外观。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness GUI plugin showing real-time session spend as a pill under the composer, priced from per-model token rates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness GUI 插件，按各模型 token 费率实时计算并在输入框下方以胶囊形式显示当前会话花费。

description.en: Adds a single Settings section with six live switches for toggling elements of the DSH WebUI chrome on and off.
description.zh: 在设置中提供六个实时开关，用于开启或关闭 DSH WebUI 界面元素。

description.en: Inspect live DSH Web UI elements to copy their component, selector and styles, or insert the picked context into the composer.
description.zh: 检查 DSH Web UI 实时元素，复制其组件、选择器和样式，或将所选上下文插入输入框。

description.en: UI Sketch to AI canvas editor plugin with sidebar toggle and fullscreen iframe overlay, ready to use.
description.zh: 通过侧栏开关打开全屏 iframe 浮层，内嵌 UI Sketch to AI 画板编辑器，开箱即用。

description.en: ULID generation and parsing in pure Node, time-sortable IDs, no network or external services.
description.zh: 在纯 Node 环境中生成和解析 ULID，产出可按时间排序的 ID，无需网络或外部服务。

description.en: DSH upgrade plugin for Linux/systemd that detects versions, pre-checks compatibility, backs up, upgrades via npm and restarts the service.
description.zh: 面向 Linux/systemd 的 DSH 升级插件：检测版本、兼容性预检、备份、npm 一键升级并重启服务。

description.en: Converts text to uppercase, pure Node.js implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 将文本转换为大写，纯 Node.js 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Interprets uric acid levels from parameters with reference advice (not a substitute for medical guidance).
Parses URLs into structured components and constructs URLs with parameters.
description.zh: 将 URL 解析为结构化组成部分，也可用参数构造 URL。

description.en: URL encode/decode utility implemented in pure Node with no network or external services.
description.zh: 用纯 Node 实现的 URL 编解码工具，不依赖网络或外部服务。

description.en: A pure Node.js URL decoder with no network dependencies, usable as a plugin tool.
description.zh: 纯 Node.js 实现的 URL 解码工具，无网络依赖，可作为插件使用。

description.en: A US-stock assistant embedded in DSH with quotes, knowledge base, earnings calendar, technical indicators, alerts and portfolio comparison.
description.zh: 内嵌于 DSH 的美股助手，提供行情、知识库、财报日历、技术指标、提醒与持仓组合对比。

description.en: Dashboard plugin showing DSH account balance and per-model quota usage inside the harness.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中展示账户余额与各模型配额用量的仪表盘插件。

description.en: Host-side tool that reports DSH session token usage — totals, input/output/cache hits, daily sparkline, top sessions and optional cost estimates.
description.zh: 主机侧工具，统计 DSH 会话 token 用量：总量、输入/输出/缓存命中、按天 sparkline、Top 会话与可选成本估算。

description.en: Adds a sidebar usage card to DeepSeek Harness showing 7d/30d token usage, spend, and remaining balance.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页侧边栏添加用量卡片，显示 7 天和 30 天的 token 用量、花费及 DeepSeek 剩余余额。

description.en: Tracks local API usage, balances and trend forecasts for OpenCode Go and DeepSeek models.
description.zh: 跟踪 OpenCode Go 与 DeepSeek 的本地 API 用量、余额和趋势预测。

description.en: Sidebar widget showing API balance, spend estimates and peak/off-peak pricing, plus a full usage dashboard and provider switching.
description.zh: 侧边栏显示 API 余额、消费估算与峰谷时段，并提供完整用量仪表盘与服务商切换。

description.en: Adds a persistent bottom status strip to the DSH Web UI showing DeepSeek account balance, gift credit, session spend and burn rate.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面底部添加常驻状态条，显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、赠送额度、本次打开消耗与消耗速度。

description.en: Tracks token usage, estimated cost, budget limits and live CPU metrics across real DSH sessions in one dashboard.
description.zh: 跨真实 DSH 会话追踪 token 用量、预估费用、预算上限与实时 CPU 指标。

description.en: Shows a usage window tracking Claude/Codex subscriptions and DeepSeek API usage in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness中显示使用情况窗口，跟踪Claude/Codex订阅和DeepSeek API用量。

description.en: Adds a sidebar dashboard tracking AI token usage, cost estimates, cache hit rates and per-session/per-model stats, plus live CPU/GPU/memory monitoring.
description.zh: 在侧边栏提供 AI 用量仪表盘：token 用量、成本估算、缓存命中率、分会话/分模型统计，并实时监控 CPU/GPU/内存。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel that tracks daily token usage from local sessions and shows your DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加面板，按天统计本机会话的 token 用量，并显示 DeepSeek 账号余额。

description.en: Floating whale-girl desktop pet that shows OpenCode Go quota windows, DeepSeek account spend/balance, and official API balance.
description.zh: 悬浮鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，展示 OpenCode Go 三窗口额度、DeepSeek 账户累计消费/余额及官方 API 余额。

description.en: Adds a sidebar receipt-machine widget that shows DeepSeek balance and peak/off-peak pricing as a dot-matrix display, expanding on hover into a cost breakdown.
description.zh: 侧栏小票机组件：点阵屏显示 DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格，悬停展开小票查看费用明细。

description.en: Replays every persisted session log and aggregates provider-reported token usage by model, day and workspace.
description.zh: 重放所有已保存的会话日志，按模型、日期和工作区汇总各模型的 token 用量。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin showing account balance, token usage and cost, using official usage data when signed in and local session logs otherwise.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，显示余额、Token 用量与费用；登录时用官方用量数据，否则读取本地会话日志。

description.en: Shows the session's token usage and estimated DeepSeek spend — peak and off-peak priced — in a composer pill and per-turn action.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示会话的 token 用量和按 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算的费用，并附加到每轮用量动作中。

description.en: DSH dashboard that tallies session token usage, estimates cost, tracks a monthly budget gauge, and monitors host CPU, memory and event-loop health.
description.zh: DSH 用量仪表盘：统计会话 token 消耗与预估成本，展示月度预算水位，并监控宿主 CPU、内存与事件循环状态。

description.en: Adds a usage statistics dashboard with token totals, activity heatmap, daily per-model trends and model share charts.
description.zh: 提供用量统计面板，展示 token 总量、活动热力图、按模型的每日趋势和模型占比。

description.en: Auto-marks files as read after commands like cat/grep/head/sed/awk run, avoiding DSH's "file has not been read" gate when writing or editing.
description.zh: 运行 cat/grep/head/sed/awk 等命令读取文件后自动标记为已读，避免原生 write/edit 报「file has not been read」拦截。

description.en: Sidebar card showing live 3h/12h/24h USTC token quota usage, limits, percentages and reset times in DSH and TokenWorks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 与词元工坊左侧栏实时显示 USTC 模型 3h/12h/24h 额度用量、上限、百分比与重置时间。

description.en: Validates checksummed identifiers (ID, USCC, bank card, VIN, ISBN, IMEI, IBAN, EAN/UPC) and computes financial/workday data.
description.zh: test

description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness Web brand logo with images that switch during Beijing peak hours.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 的品牌标识替换为图片，并按北京时间高峰时段自动切换。

description.en: VASP periodic table plugin providing PAW potentials, ZVAL/ENMAX, MAGMOM and POTCAR snippet generation for DFT setup.
description.zh: VASP 元素周期表插件，提供 PAW 势、ZVAL/ENMAX、MAGMOM 和 POTCAR 片段生成，便于 DFT 计算设置。

description.en: Reads, writes, exports, and validates Excel VBA project modules from DSH sessions via Excel COM/VBIDE.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中通过 Excel COM/VBIDE 读取、修改、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程模块。

description.en: Watches Guazi used-car listings in Xi'an for four models, alerting WeCom/Feishu on new listings or price drops and exporting Excel reports.
description.zh: 监控西安四款车型的瓜子二手车车源，新上架或降价时推送到企业微信/飞书，并导出 Excel 报表。

description.en: Adds a session-header menu to download chat logs, toggle Normal/Verbose display, and show per-turn metrics.
description.zh: 为会话头部添加三点菜单，可下载会话日志、切换普通/详细模式并显示每轮指标。

description.en: Emits per-turn receipts (todo counts, goal id, fail-closed plan verdict) that persist across turns and exposes a read-only veripipe_receipt tool.
description.zh: 生成可跨回合保留的每回合回执（待办计数、目标 id、失败即拒绝的计划裁决），并提供只读 veripipe_receipt 工具。

description.en: Adds macOS native vibrancy (frosted glass) material to the DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop main pane and third-party sidebars.
description.zh: 为 DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 主面板及第三方侧边栏添加 macOS 原生毛玻璃（vibrancy）材质效果。

description.en: Clones one video into N copies, each tagged with a unique container-level GUID so hashes differ while streams and frames stay identical; adds a provenance ledger, CLI and web panel.
description.zh: 把一支视频复制成 N 份，每份在容器层写入唯一 GUID，使哈希互异而媒体流与解码帧完全不变，并提供溯源账本、CLI 与 Web 面板。

description.en: Paste a link and download video, audio, subtitles or thumbnails from YouTube, Bilibili, X, TikTok and 1000+ sites via local yt-dlp.
description.zh: 粘贴链接，用本机 yt-dlp 从 YouTube、哔哩哔哩、X、TikTok 等上千站点下载视频、音频、字幕或封面。

description.en: DSH plugin that uses ffmpeg to merge all videos in each folder into a single file while preserving the source video specs.
description.zh: DSH 插件，使用 ffmpeg 将每个文件夹中的视频合并为一个文件，并保持源视频规格不变。

description.en: Calculates exact video file size from parameters, returning detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算视频文件的精确大小并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Paste a video link and it downloads the audio with yt-dlp/ffmpeg and transcribes it offline via SenseVoice, chunking long audio with no cloud API.
description.zh: 粘贴视频链接，用 yt-dlp/ffmpeg 下载音轨并通过 SenseVoice 离线转写为文稿，长音频自动分片，零云端 API。

description.en: Vietnamese UI language, Vietnamese color palettes, and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供越南语界面、越南配色方案以及轮播的越南风景背景图。

description.en: Vietnamese language pack that localizes DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with CI verification and upstream tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的越南语语言包，提供完整本地化、CI 校验与上游同步跟踪。

description.en: Vim-style keyboard navigation for the DSH Web UI: j/k scrolling, h/l panel focus, i to insert and session-scoped message jumps.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供 Vim 风格键盘导航：j/k 滚动、h/l 切换面板焦点、i 进入输入，并支持会话内消息跳转。

description.en: Checks Xiaohongshu virtual-goods listings for copyright and prohibited-word risk using local rule sets plus DeepSeek review of images and files.
description.zh: 用本地规则库加 DeepSeek 识图与文档复核，在小红书虚拟商品上架前检测版权与违规风险。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness AI real-time screen perception and a full desktop control tool family for computer-use automation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时屏幕感知与完整桌面操控工具，实现 AI 电脑操作自动化。

description.en: Pick, annotate, comment on and screenshot elements of a live Chrome/Edge page, then hand precise locators to the agent.
description.zh: 在真实 Chrome/Edge 页面上选取、标注、评论并截图元素，然后把精确定位器交给智能体。

description.en: Renders AI-generated HTML as interactive cards in DeepSeek Harness conversations, with full-screen view, copy, and download.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中将 AI 生成的 HTML 渲染为可交互卡片，支持全屏、复制和下载。

description.en: Provides a reference for visual hierarchy construction in UI, implemented in pure Node with no external services.
description.zh: 为界面提供视觉层级构建的参考，使用纯 Node 实现，不依赖任何外部服务。

description.en: Adds an annotatable responsive UI preview with four frames and element-level edit targets sent to the agent.
description.zh: 添加可标注的响应式 UI 预览，包含四个框架，并将元素级编辑目标发送给智能体。

description.en: Wallpaper-driven visual system for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that swaps the whole colour scheme and background via one preset.json.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的壁纸驱动视觉系统，通过一个 preset.json 即可整体更换配色与背景。

description.en: DSH session dashboard that draws the current session as a seven-ring chart with a turn timeline, tool calls, tasks and approvals, updating live.
description.zh: DSH 会话仪表盘：把当前会话画成七层环 + 轮次时间线，展示工具调用、后台任务、审批与文件变更，并实时更新。

description.en: Adds workspace profiles, team rule enforcement, commit message validation and session-scoped rule injection to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供工作区配置、团队规则约束、提交信息校验和会话级规则注入。

description.en: Renders data as charts (timeline, network, calendar, ECharts, gallery) inside DSH tool cards and a side panel for side-by-side comparison.
description.zh: 把数据渲染成会话内的图表（时间线、关系网、日历、ECharts、图册），工具卡与右栏双位置展示并可对比。

description.en: Adds a VNC client tab to the DSH right sidebar for connecting to any VNC/RFB remote desktop server.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏添加 VNC 客户端标签页，可连接任意 VNC/RFB 远程桌面服务器。

description.en: Voice dictation plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI composer using browser Web Speech API.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness Web GUI编辑器提供语音听写，使用浏览器语音API。

description.en: Local offline voice plugin with click-to-talk dictation via faster-whisper, spoken commands, and read-aloud using Piper.
description.zh: 本地离线语音插件：点击说话用 faster-whisper 听写、语音命令控制，并用 Piper 朗读，完全离线。

description.en: Local on-device Qwen3-ASR speech pipeline for DSH with auto language detection, live English→Chinese interpretation, crash-safe meeting records, minutes and Obsidian export.
description.zh: DSH 的本地语音管线：端侧 Qwen3-ASR 转写与自动语种识别、英译中实时同传、防崩溃会议记录、会议纪要与 Obsidian 导出（macOS/Apple Silicon）。

description.en: Adds voice input to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with microphone button and recording pill that transcribes speech into chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加语音输入，麦克风按钮和录音条可将语音转写为聊天文字。

description.en: Always-on voice chat mode for DeepSeek Harness with local SenseVoice speech-to-text, auto-submit and Edge TTS read-aloud.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常开语音聊天模式：本地 SenseVoice 语音转写、自动发送与 Edge TTS 朗读。

description.en: Voice control plugin for DeepSeek Harness web enabling speech-to-text input and spoken playback of AI replies, with zero dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness网页的语音控制插件：语音转文字输入并朗读AI回复，零依赖。

description.en: Continuous voice conversation for DSH: auto sentence splitting, a 2-second send confirmation window, and spoken replies you can interrupt by speaking.
description.zh: DSH 连续语音对话插件：自动断句、发送前 2 秒确认窗口，回复自动朗读且开口即打断。

description.en: Independent desktop TTS announcer for DSH that silently reads AI reply summaries with 14 Edge-TTS Chinese voices and per-chat toggles.
description.zh: DSH桌面端独立TTS语音播报插件，在后台静默朗读AI回复摘要，内置14个Edge-TTS中文音色，每个对话独立开关。

description.en: A DSH plugin that adds voice input with a mic button and local Qwen3 ASR, transcribing speech to text in the chat composer.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，添加麦克风按钮并通过本地Qwen3语音识别将语音转为聊天文本。

description.en: Xiaomi MiMo-powered voice plugin for DeepSeek Harness with mic/speaker browser UI and speech-to-text, understanding and text-to-speech tools.
description.zh: 基于小米 MiMo 的 DeepSeek Harness 语音插件，提供麦克风/扬声器浏览器界面及语音转写、理解与合成工具。

description.en: Offline voice-typing plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns speech into text in the input box and reads assistant replies aloud.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地离线语音输入插件，说话自动转文字填入输入框，并可自动朗读助手回复。

description.en: Local voice wake-word plugin that listens for a wake word, transcribes speech on-device, and auto-sends the command to a DSH session.
description.zh: 本地语音唤醒插件：先说唤醒词，听到提示音后说指令，停顿后自动识别并发送到 DSH 会话。

description.en: Writes a stable JSONL usage feed that Vorssaint tails to track DSH token spend, live runs, models, projects and API value.
description.zh: 生成稳定的 JSONL 用量数据流，供 Vorssaint 追踪 DSH 的 token 花费、实时运行、模型、项目与 API 价值。

description.en: Read-first VPS operations toolkit for systemd, Docker, disk, logs, backups and quiet-hours schedules.
description.zh: 只读优先的 VPS 运维工具，支持 systemd、Docker、磁盘、日志、备份和静默时段计划。

description.en: Monaco-based VS Code-like IDE workbench for DeepSeek Harness with floating windows, tabs, diff view, Git and SSH terminal.
description.zh: 基于 Monaco 的类 VS Code 集成工作台，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浮动窗口、标签页、差异对比、Git 与 SSH 终端。

description.en: Rearranges DSH web GUI columns into a VSCode-style layout with left tab rail for workspace and file explorer.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面的栏位重新排列成 VSCode 风格布局，左侧标签栏用于工作区和文件浏览器。

description.en: A VS Code-style workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web — activity bar, explorer file tree, Git panel, editor tabs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供 VS Code 风格工作台，包含活动栏、资源管理器文件树、Git 面板和编辑器标签页。

description.en: Official takeout/delivery coupon channel finder for Meituan, Ele.me, JD Delivery & Taobao Shanguo, commission-free.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，为美团、饿了么、京东外卖和淘宝闪购查找官方无佣金的外卖优惠券渠道。

description.en: Adds a confirmation dialog before a chat message is sent in the DSH Web UI, so unfinished drafts are never sent by accident.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 发送消息前弹出确认窗口，避免草稿未写完就误触发送。

description.en: A DSH session view for monitoring long-running agent tasks, with approval and failure alerts plus lightweight games.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 会话视图，用于监控长时间运行的 Agent 任务，提供审批与失败提醒，并内置轻量小游戏。

description.en: Keeps an Agent's turn open until every descendant subagent has settled, acting as a pure Host-plane completion gate for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在全部后代子代理结束前保持 Agent 回合不关闭，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供纯宿主层完成闸门。

description.en: External wake bridge for DeepSeek Harness: an out-of-host watcher wakes a session synchronously. 200 only after flush, 503 records nothing - so the caller owns retries and events survive host downtime.
Returns home furnishing matching schemes for wall art placement based on input parameters; pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回挂画摆放的家居搭配方案，纯 Node 实现，不联网。

description.en: Wall fix tool that returns household repair plans based on parameters. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据输入参数返回家庭墙面修补方案的纯 Node 工具，不联网

description.en: Provides home anti-mold and dehumidification solution plans based on input parameters. Pure Node tool.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成家庭防霉除湿方案，纯 Node 工具。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek account balance in a pill below the input box, with expandable peak/off-peak pricing and a switch countdown.
description.zh: 在输入框下方以胶囊形式显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展开可查看峰谷价目与切换倒计时。

description.en: Photo wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets a chosen image shine through the whole GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的照片壁纸插件，可让所选图片透显在整个界面中。

description.en: A wallpaper picker for DeepSeek Harness that lets you choose a local image as the window wallpaper at 70% opacity.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 壁纸选择器，可选择本地图片作为窗口壁纸并以 70% 不透明度显示。

description.en: Adds a wallpaper and frosted glass customization page to DSH settings, with image upload and persistence.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中添加壁纸与磨砂玻璃自定义页面，支持图片上传并持久保存。

description.en: Adds local wallpapers with adjustable opacity and blur plus a glassmorphism sidebar, top bar and dialogs to the DSH interface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 界面添加本地壁纸（可调透明度与模糊），以及玻璃拟态侧边栏、顶栏和对话框。

description.en: Enables Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as animated liquid glass backgrounds for the DSH web GUI, with video and web support.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸作为 DSH 网页界面的液态玻璃动态背景，支持视频和网页类型壁纸。

description.en: Wallpaper and intro plugin for DeepSeek Harness: local or Wallpaper Engine video wallpapers as the chat background, plus a skippable custom boot animation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的壁纸与片头插件：用本机或 Wallpaper Engine 视频做聊天背景，启动时播放可跳过的自定义片头。

description.en: Enhanced wallpaper rotator supporting video backgrounds and full-page neutralization, compatible with dsh rc.6.
description.zh: 增强版 dsh 壁纸轮换插件，支持视频背景与全页面壁纸中和，兼容 dsh rc.6

description.en: A DSH dynamic wallpaper skin plugin that sets mp4/webm videos or jpg/png/gif images as the DeepSeek Harness background, with in-settings controls and hot swapping.
description.zh: DSH 动态壁纸皮肤插件：用 mp4/webm 视频或 jpg/png/gif 图片作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景，支持设置页集成与热切换。

description.en: Wallpaper plus liquid-glass theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness: scan folders for image/video wallpapers and restyle the UI with adjustable frosted glass.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的壁纸加液态玻璃主题插件：扫描文件夹中的图片或视频壁纸，一键切换并自定义毛玻璃界面。

description.en: Adds a "New Wander Session" sidebar button that creates sessions without picking a local folder, grouping them in one fixed workspace.
description.zh: 在侧边栏新增「新建漫游会话」按钮，无需选择本地目录即可开会话，并统一归入一个固定工作区分组。

description.en: Adversary review gate that has an independent small model check destructive tool calls before they run and reports every verdict.
description.zh: 对抗式审查门：危险工具调用执行前由独立小模型复核，并报告每次判定结果。

description.en: Read-only pre-install security scanner for DSH plugins that audits scripts, dependencies, domains and dangerous APIs and rates risk out of 100.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件的只读安装前安全扫描器，检查安装脚本、原生依赖、外联域名和危险 API，并给出百分制风险评级。

description.en: Returns a minimalist wardrobe decluttering plan based on parameters. Pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回衣橱精简整理方案，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: A warm reminder plugin for DSH that tracks usage time and shows alerts for drinking water, eye care, rest, and special occasions.
description.zh: 一款基于DSH的温馨提醒插件，检测使用时长并提醒喝水、护眼、休息及深夜关怀和节日祝福。

description.en: An eye-care color pack for DSH offering 5 low-blue-light themes that override semantic tokens with zero layout changes and instant effect.
description.zh: DSH 护眼配色包，提供 5 套低蓝光主题，通过覆盖语义 token 实现零布局改动、热生效。

description.en: Cleans DeepSeek Harness session logs by stripping copied input envelopes, with automatic backups and one-click rollback.
description.zh: 清理 DeepSeek Harness 会话日志，剥离被模型复制回回复的输入信封，并支持自动备份与一键回滚。

description.en: Resident watchdog plugin that runs scheduled checkers and only wakes the DeepSeek Harness agent when a checker reports notify: true.
description.zh: 常驻巡检插件，按配置间隔运行 checker，仅在 checker 输出 notify: true 时唤醒 agent，其余时间零 token、零对话。

description.en: A read-only observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness that turns sessions into collapsible work paths and tracks model latency and estimated cost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 只读观测插件：将会话折叠成可展开的工作路径，统计模型耗时并估算费用。

description.en: DSH plugin that numbers sessions, queues pending answers and applies a pluggable judge for unattended agent runs.
description.zh: DSH 插件：为会话编号、排队待答问题，并用可插拔评判器处理无人值守会话。

description.en: DSH tool plugin that archives and reads Weibo posts as permanent Markdown snapshots via 2100laike Weibo Archive.
description.zh: DSH 工具插件，借助 2100laike 微博存档将微博帖子归档并读取为永久 Markdown 快照。

description.en: Auto-falls back to DeepSeek when WorkBuddy credits run out, switching the current session and persisting the new default model.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 积分耗尽时自动回落到 DeepSeek，切换当前会话并将默认模型永久改到 DeepSeek。

description.en: Gives DSH agents cross-session long-term memory stored as plain Markdown in the workspace, with no vector DB, external services, or runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供跨会话长期记忆，真值源是工作区里的纯 Markdown，无向量库、无外部服务、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Weather forecast plugin with a draggable floating weather card and model-callable weather tool for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面提供天气服务，包含可拖动的悬浮天气卡片和可供模型调用的天气工具。

description.en: Adds a loopback reverse-proxy auth gate with token login so DSH Web exposed via frp or tunnels requires authentication.
description.zh: 为经 frp/隧道暴露的 DSH Web 提供 loopback 反向代理鉴权门,通过 token 登录保护公网访问。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web/desktop background with image or solid-color wallpapers and makes sidebar, titlebar and composer show it through.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 及官方桌面端替换图片或纯色壁纸，并让侧边栏、标题栏与输入框一起透出壁纸。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com in a DSH panel, keeps the page alive across panel switches, and restores your last conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板中嵌入 chat.deepseek.com，切换面板时页面保持存活，并恢复上次的对话。

description.en: Starts, stops and restarts a LAN or Tailscale-reachable dsh web instance from inside DSH, with bind address and token URL control.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内部启动、停止和重启可通过局域网或 Tailscale 访问的 dsh web 实例，并设置绑定地址与令牌 URL。

description.en: Material 3 Expressive theme that overlays M3 colour and geometry tokens onto the dsh Web UI without touching layout.
description.zh: Material 3 Expressive 主题，为 dsh Web UI 叠加 M3 配色与几何令牌，不改动布局。

description.en: Preview local web servers inside the DSH GUI via a same-origin proxy with embed tab, floating window and Console/Network/Errors toolbox.
description.zh: 在 DSH GUI 内通过同源代理预览本地 Web 服务器，支持嵌入标签页、浮窗和 Console/Network/Errors 工具箱。

description.en: Wires DSH's native web search and web fetch tools to 9router's /v1/search and /v1/web/fetch endpoints, with no server-side search tool needed.
description.zh: 将 DSH 原生网页搜索与抓取工具接入 9router 的 /v1/search 和 /v1/web/fetch 接口，无需自建服务端搜索工具。

description.en: A DSH web search plugin that routes queries across multiple search backends and automatically fails over when one fails.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 网页搜索插件，可在多个搜索后端之间路由，并在某个后端失败时自动切换。

description.en: Brave Search provider that gives dsh models a model-agnostic web_search tool via the official ctx.web seam, using your own Brave API key.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Brave 搜索 provider，通过官方 ctx.web 接口让任意模型获得 web_search 能力，复用你自己的 Brave key，零依赖。

description.en: Adds native OpenAI Responses web search plus a desktop settings page to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 增加原生 OpenAI Responses 网页搜索能力和桌面设置页面。

description.en: Keyless DuckDuckGo HTML-scrape web_search provider for the DeepSeek Harness that needs no API key and no extra model turn.
description.zh: 无需 API 密钥的 DuckDuckGo 网页抓取搜索提供方，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 web_search，零额外模型调用。

description.en: Web search provider that bridges an OpenAI Responses-API-compatible endpoint using the web_search_preview tool into the dsh web seam.
description.zh: 一个网页搜索提供方，将使用 web_search_preview 工具的 OpenAI Responses API 兼容端点接入 dsh web 接缝。

description.en: Keyless web_search plugin for DeepSeek Harness that renders Shenma through any Chromium browser over CDP and reads Bing over HTTP, with no API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的免密钥 web_search 插件：通过 CDP 驱动任意 Chromium 浏览器渲染神马搜索，并以 HTTP 抓取必应结果，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: DSH plugin that swaps the default web search for a multi-engine provider (Bing, DuckDuckGo, Mojeek, Google, Brave) with merge/fallback modes and a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用 Bing、DuckDuckGo、Mojeek、Google、Brave 多引擎混合替代默认网络搜索，带可视化设置页。

description.en: A dsh web capability plugin that registers Keenable-backed search and fetch providers into the ctx.web seam.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 网页能力插件，以 ctx.web 提供方形式注册 Keenable 支持的搜索与抓取能力。

description.en: Routes web search queries through either the official DeepSeek search channel or your own Parallel-compatible endpoint, with clear failure reasons.
description.zh: 将网页搜索请求路由至官方 DeepSeek 搜索通道或你自己的 Parallel 兼容端点，并提供清晰的失败原因。

description.en: A dsh web capability plugin that registers TinyFish-backed search and fetch providers into the ctx.web seam, requiring an API key.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 网页能力插件，将 TinyFish 支持的搜索与抓取提供方注册到 ctx.web，需要配置 API Key。

description.en: Adds Tencent Yuanbao Search (SearchPro) to DeepSeek Harness as a ctx.web search provider plus a model-facing yuanbao_search tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入腾讯元宝搜索（SearchPro），提供 ctx.web 搜索服务与面向模型的 yuanbao_search 工具。

description.en: Zero-key web search aggregating Bing, HN, GitHub, arXiv, npm, CSDN and Juejin with automatic Chinese/English routing.
description.zh: 零 key 联网搜索，聚合 Bing、HN、GitHub、arXiv、npm、CSDN、掘金，并自动中英文路由。

description.en: 将智谱 GLM Coding Plan 的联网搜索 MCP 接入 DSH，让原生 web_search 走智谱搜索，支持设置页手动配置 API Key
Automatically searches the web before each agent turn and injects citable sources into the context.
description.zh: 每轮自动联网检索，并将可引用的来源注入上下文。

description.en: TinyFish search and fetch providers for dsh, powering the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 TinyFish 搜索与抓取能力，支持内置的 web_search 和 web_fetch 工具。

description.en: Routes DSH web_search and web_fetch calls through DeepSeek's native search and fetch tool APIs using a small Rust engine.
description.zh: 通过一个小型 Rust 引擎，将 DSH 的 web_search 和 web_fetch 调用路由到 DeepSeek 原生搜索与抓取工具 API。

description.en: Lets an agent open URLs in a sandboxed DSH sidebar panel instead of a system browser, making pages capturable by screenshots for verification.
description.zh: 让代理在DSH侧边栏内打开网页而非系统浏览器，使页面可被截图验证。

description.en: Annotate pages in DeepSeek Harness's built-in browser: click an element, add a comment, and send the batch with screenshots to the chat.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内置浏览器中标注网页：点击元素、留下评论，并把带截图的批次发送到对话中。

description.en: Adds a composer button and global hotkey palette to fire off one-liner questions to DeepSeek's web chat, saving DSH context, with history.
description.zh: 通过编辑器按钮和全局热键面板，把一句话问题发送到 DeepSeek 网页版聊天，节省 DSH 上下文，并保留历史记录。

description.en: Keeps the dsh-webchat guest overlay aligned to its panel using CSS anchor positioning so fullscreen and window toggles never leave stale geometry.
description.zh: 使用 CSS 锚点定位让 dsh-webchat 访客浮层紧贴其面板，全屏与窗口切换后不会残留错位几何。

description.en: Backs up DSH session logs and plugin environment to any WebDAV server, with versioned restore and conflict handling.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话日志与插件环境备份到任意 WebDAV 服务，并支持带版本与冲突处理的恢复。

description.en: Sends custom HTTP webhook notifications for 7 DSH events (AI turn completion, permission requests, errors) with GET/POST, custom fields, and send logs.
description.zh: 为DSH的7种事件（AI回合完成、权限申请、提问、出错等）发送HTTP自定义通知，支持GET/POST、自定义字段和发送日志。

description.en: Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as image/png so local OpenAI-compatible vision servers like LM Studio and llama.cpp accept them.
description.zh: 将 DSH 规范化后的 WebP 请求图片重新标记为 image/png，使 LM Studio、llama.cpp 等本地兼容 OpenAI 的视觉服务能正常接收。

description.en: Compresses web pages into token-budget summaries and filters search results to a few trustworthy links using real Chrome.
description.zh: 将网页压缩为预算内的摘要，并把搜索结果筛选为少数可信链接，基于真实 Chrome 渲染。

description.en: Converts DSH's native WebSocket realtime link to HTTP long polling so proxies that block WebSocket can still run the Web GUI.
description.zh: 把 DSH 原生 WebSocket 实时链路改为 HTTP 长轮询，让禁止 WebSocket 的代理网络也能正常使用 Web 界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness webview wrapper plugin in the everything-is-a-plugin spirit.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 webview 封装为插件，遵循一切皆插件的理念。

description.en: Bind DeepSeek Harness to WeChat by QR scan so you can dispatch agent tasks, view progress, approve risky actions and receive files from your phone.
description.zh: 扫码把 DeepSeek Harness 接入微信，在手机上给 Agent 派活、看进度、回审批并接收文件。

description.en: Bidirectional WeChat channel for DSH: send instructions from WeChat chats to drive an existing DSH session and receive results back.
description.zh: DSH 的微信双向通道插件：在微信单聊中发指令驱动已有 DSH 会话，并将结果回传微信。

description.en: A WeChat-inspired light theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop with green accents, dark icon rail and grey conversation list.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 打造的微信风格浅色主题，绿色点缀、深色图标栏与灰色会话列表。

description.en: Lets DSH agents analyze WeChat emoji, memes and chat screenshots with GLM-4V Flash to judge sentiment and suggest replies.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 用 GLM-4V Flash 看懂微信表情包、梗图和聊天截图，判断情绪并给出回复建议。

description.en: Turns markdown into a typeset WeChat Official Account draft.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 转换为已排版的微信公众号草稿

description.en: Bridges a personal WeChat account into DSH via a self-hosted iPad-protocol backend, so chats can reach the harness.
description.zh: 通过自托管的 iPad 协议后端，把个人微信接入 DSH，让微信消息可直接与 harness 交互。

description.en: Adds a WeChat-style region screenshot button to the DeepSeek Harness composer on Windows.
description.zh: 在 Windows 版 DeepSeek Harness 输入框中添加微信风格区域截图按钮。

description.en: Collaborative weed-image annotation plugin: it owns the data contract, visual review and export while the agent decides how to annotate.
description.zh: 杂草图像标注协作插件：由插件负责数据契约、可视化审核与导出，由智能体决定如何标注。

description.en: Track work items in a panel, export any ISO week as a weekly report, and let the configured model polish the wording.
description.zh: 在面板中记录工作事项，按 ISO 周导出周报，并用已配置模型润色措辞。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects an agent to WeChat private chats via Tencent's official iLink Bot API, with QR login, media messages and session mapping.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过腾讯官方 iLink Bot API 把 agent 接入微信单聊，支持扫码授权、文本/图片/语音/文件收发与会话映射。

description.en: DSH WeChat channel plugin bridging phone WeChat messages with DSH sessions, with a web settings panel and large-file delivery.
description.zh: DSH 微信通道增强插件，实现手机微信与 DSH 会话的双向消息桥接，内置 Web 设置面板与大文件投递。

description.en: Welcomes users back to today's active conversations after a configurable idle period.
description.zh: 在可配置的空闲时间后，欢迎用户回到当天活跃的会话中。

description.en: Plays a whale-maid splash animation when DSH starts, with options to use the built-in video or your own path, plus sound toggle and fade-out.
description.zh: 启动 DSH 时播放鲸鱼女仆开屏动画，可切换内置视频或自定义路径视频，支持声音开关与播完渐隐。

description.en: A read-only 10-skill manuscript review team for DSH: check settings consistency, give tiered suggestions, author picks, then verbatim re-check.
description.zh: 面向DSH的10技能只读文稿校验团队：校验设定一致性、三档建议、作者勾选定点替换与逐字复核，不自动改稿。

description.en: Logs into WeRead via QR code and renders the current book page as a low-contrast text layer behind the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 扫码登录微信读书，将当前书页正文以低对比度文字层垫在 DSH Web GUI 背后。

description.en: WeRead shelf plugin for DSH: browse your bookshelf, read in a standalone window, chat with an AI companion, and file highlights into Obsidian.
description.zh: 书屿插件把微信读书搬进 DSH：浏览书架、独立窗口阅读、AI 陪读提问，并把划线想法写入 Obsidian。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek account balance as water rising inside the whale mark, plus spend stats, low-balance alerts and top-up.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 账户余额显示为鲸鱼标志内上涨的水面，并提供消费统计、余额预警与充值入口。

description.en: A particle-whale background plugin for DeepSeek Harness with cursor lighting and theme support.
description.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供粒子鲸鱼背景动画，并支持光标光照与主题跟随

description.en: Offline zero-token scientific calculator panel for DeepSeek Harness, styled with whale and ocean-light visuals.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的离线零 token 科学计算器面板，配有鲸鱼与海洋光影视觉。

description.en: A care engine for DeepSeek Harness that reads the weather and sends feel-like/humidity, clothing and umbrella tips, daily check-ins and extreme-weather alerts, with local-only preferences.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的关心引擎：基于天气提供体感/湿度、穿衣带伞建议、每日关心与极端天气预警提醒，偏好仅存本地。

description.en: A fan-made mini-game for DSH Web: a corner button opens a hook-and-catch arcade game where fish carry token values you collect.
description.zh: DSH Web 的非官方粉丝小游戏：左下角按钮点开后进入抓鱼街机玩法，鱼身上的 token 数抓到即可累加。

description.en: A talking whale desktop pet for DSH with a configurable persona that autonomously browses the web and brings back messages.
description.zh: 会说话、可配置人设并自动上网带回消息的 DSH 鲸鱼桌宠。

description.en: DSH web widget showing API balance, cache and peak/off-peak status in a glass card with deep-blue billing danmaku.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：用毛玻璃卡片显示余额、缓存与峰谷状态，并以深蓝扣费弹幕提示消费。

description.en: Screenshot-free Windows screen awareness that tells the model the foreground app, window title, focused control and open windows in ~55-75 tokens.
description.zh: 无需截屏的 Windows 屏幕感知：以约 55～75 token 告知模型前台应用、窗口标题、焦点控件与窗口列表。

description.en: A game arcade plugin that starts a local browser game table where your DSH agent joins as an opponent via MCP.
description.zh: 一个游戏厅插件，一键启动本地浏览器牌桌，让 DSH 里的 Agent 通过 MCP 入座当对手。

description.en: A DSH Web community skin that plays a looping whale-girl wallpaper video as the full-screen background behind the DeepSeek Harness UI.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web 社区皮肤，将「DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘」循环壁纸视频设为界面全屏背景。

description.en: Adds whale mascot cards inside the DSH conversation area for greetings, task-completion reports, long-run companionship, and permission requests.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话区显示小鲸卡片：问候、任务完成报告、长跑陪伴与授权请示。

description.en: Adds Russian translations and responsive layout tweaks to DeepSeek Whale Widget 0.4.2, with no bundled artwork.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Whale Widget 0.4.2 提供俄语翻译与响应式布局适配，不附带内置美术资源。

description.en: Whale-chan mascot companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, offering friendly in-page chat, generated cards and proactive check-ins.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘（DeepSeek 娘）吉祥物伙伴，为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供友好的页内聊天、本地卡片生成与主动问候。

description.en: Adds an interactive dot-matrix background to DSH Web, forming a whale or uploaded PNG, with mouse response and screensaver mode.
description.zh: 为DSH Web添加互动点阵背景，可组成鲸鱼或上传透明PNG，支持鼠标扰动和屏保模式。

description.en: Animated whale particle background for the DSH Web UI that assembles, idles with breathing motion, and reacts to the pointer.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供动态鲸鱼粒子背景，可聚合成形、待机呼吸并跟随鼠标互动。

description.en: Animated DeepSeek whale pet for the Harness Web UI with live status, completion chime, and an interaction plus token/cost panel.
description.zh: 为 Harness Web UI 提供动画 DeepSeek 鲸鱼宠物，含实时状态、完成提示音及交互与 Token/费用面板。

description.en: A decorative corner widget pairing a whale balance display with a pig pet that eats, sleeps and auto-switches between work, nap and idle states.
description.zh: 右下角小鲸鱼余额挂件，内置会吃饭睡觉的小猪，可自动在干活、打盹、待机三态间切换。

description.en: A whale-pond animated wallpaper plugin for DSH Desktop that paints a living sea behind the interface, with 20 live console controls.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 打造的鲸鱼壁纸插件，在界面背后铺一片游动的海，控制台可实时调节 20 项参数。

description.en: DSH desktop whale widget with a persistent bar showing DeepSeek balance, bonus credit, top-up and daily usage, plus timeline and settings page.
description.zh: DSH 桌面小鲸鱼插件：常驻信息栏显示 DeepSeek 余额、赠金、充值余额与今日已用，并提供峰谷时间线和设置页。

description.en: Adds a rice-bowl feeding layer to the DSH whale widget: load rice (1 bowl = 1M tokens), it eats real per-round usage, shows the bill, and begs when empty.
description.zh: 给 DSH 小鲸鱼挂件加一层装饭喂鱼玩法：一碗=100万token，每轮按真实消耗吃米饭，自动报账，吃完会讨饭。

description.en: 🎣 鱼竿鲸鱼娘光标 —— DSH Web 的鱼竿光标：弹性绳吊着 Q 版鲸鱼娘，随鼠标甩飞/回弹，悬停变色，甩猛了尖叫，停下演「钓鱼佬又空军了」小剧场。A fishing-rod cursor companion for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 🎣 鱼竿鲸鱼娘光标 —— DSH Web 的鱼竿光标：弹性绳吊着 Q 版鲸鱼娘，随鼠标甩飞/回弹，悬停变色，甩猛了尖叫，停下演「钓鱼佬又空军了」小剧场。A fishing-rod cursor companion for the DSH Web UI.

description.en: Adds four whale-tail animations for the DSH thinking status line, replacing the single default animation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 思考模式的鲸鱼尾巴状态增加 4 种动画效果，替代原有的单一动画。

description.en: Schedules automatic agent wake-ups per workspace target, each with its own interval, quiet hours, daily cap, prompt and deny list.
description.zh: 为工作区中各目标安排自动唤醒，每个目标可设独立间隔、静默时段、每日上限、提示词和拒绝列表。

description.en: Adds a per-conversation 'Whale Whispers' quotes tab that captures, searches, renames, backs up and exports saved agent quotes.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加「鲸语」语录标签页，按对话收集、搜索、改名、备份和导出 agent 语录。

description.en: Dual-mode whale widget that shows a decorative whale overlay on the DSH web page and spawns an Electron desktop pet, with display modes web/desktop/both/none.
description.zh: 双模式小鲸鱼挂件：可在 DSH 网页上叠加装饰性小鲸鱼，并拉起 Electron 桌面桌宠，支持 web/desktop/both/none 显示模式。

description.en: Unofficial WhatsApp Web linked-device plugin for DSH with QR pairing, realtime message sync, encrypted session storage and file sharing.
description.zh: 非官方 WhatsApp Web 关联设备插件，支持二维码配对、实时消息同步、加密会话存储与文件分享。

description.en: Diagnoses command resolution: shows which executable a command actually runs, what it shadows, and whether duplicate copies agree.
description.zh: 诊断命令解析：显示命令实际运行的可执行文件、被遮蔽的副本，以及重复副本是否一致。

description.en: Turns AI waiting time into mini-games — Air Battle, Tank Battle and Snake — inside DeepSeek Harness with tool-triggered targets and step rewards.
description.zh: 把 AI 等待时间变成小游戏：在 DeepSeek Harness 中畅玩空战、坦克战与贪吃蛇，支持工具触发目标、步数奖励和悬浮窗。

description.en: A Node.js tool that returns whiskey cocktail recipes based on input parameters, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 一个根据输入参数返回威士忌鸡尾酒配方的 Node.js 工具，无需联网。

description.en: Returns whiskey/spirit scheme suggestions based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
A Node.js whiskey tasting tool that returns spirit recommendations based on parameters, with no network dependencies.
description.zh: Node.js 威士忌品鉴工具，根据参数返回烈酒推荐，无网络依赖。

description.en: Allow-lists specific CLIs so the DSH bash tool runs them in a home-writable sandbox instead of prompting for full access.
description.zh: 为 DSH bash 工具提供按命令的沙箱白名单，白名单内的 CLI 在可写 home 的沙箱中运行，避免危险全权限提示。

description.en: RDAP-backed whois plugin for domain registration lookups in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 RDAP 的 whois 查询插件，可作为模型工具查询域名注册信息。

description.en: Adds a widescreen mode toggle to the DeepSeek Harness web UI, expanding chat content to full browser width.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加宽屏模式开关，可将聊天内容展开至浏览器全宽显示。

description.en: Gives DSH a long-term memory about its owner — schedule, likes, dislikes, focus areas and promises — with a short digest injected into every prompt and proactive care in chat.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供关于主人的长期记忆：日程、喜好、厌恶、关注点和承诺，并在每次提示中注入简短摘要，在聊天中主动关怀。

description.en: Personal knowledge base system using DeepSeek Harness and Obsidian, with LLM compiling and maintaining markdown vaults.
Windows desktop control for DSH: window and UIA automation, local OCR, browser CDP reads, humanised mouse/keyboard input and a live control panel.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制插件：窗口与 UIA 自动化、本地 OCR、浏览器 CDP 读取、拟人化鼠标键盘输入与实时控制面板。

description.en: Windows correctness layer for DSH: encoding detection/conversion, path legality checks, netstat parsing, and bounded read-only disk inspection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 正确性层：编码检测与转换、路径合法性校验、netstat 解析与有界只读磁盘检查。

description.en: Toggles Windows system proxy plus git, npm and pip proxy settings with one command, so DSH commands can reach the network.
description.zh: 一条命令同时开关 Windows 系统代理和 git/npm/pip 代理设置，让 DSH 里的命令能正常联网。

description.en: DSH plugin that fires native Windows toast notifications from the host process when confirmation, a question, or a turn end needs your attention.
description.zh: DSH 插件：需要确认、提问或回合结束时，由宿主进程直接弹出 Windows 系统通知提醒你。

description.en: Routes a financial question to the right Wind data domain, runs it over the Wind meta-router MCP endpoint, and caches daily receipts to avoid duplicate quota use.
description.zh: 将金融问题路由到正确的Wind数据域，通过Wind元路由MCP端点执行，并保存每日回执以避免重复消耗配额。

description.en: Restores macOS window dragging in DSH Desktop with a 16px top drag band and adds an in-window diagnostic panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 恢复 macOS 窗口拖拽功能：顶部 16px 拖拽区域，并内置诊断面板。

description.en: Remembers the DSH Desktop main window's position and size and restores them on the next launch, with off-screen and maximized-state safeguards.
description.zh: 记住 DSH Desktop 主窗口的位置与尺寸，下次启动时还原，并处理最大化状态与窗口跑出屏幕的情况。

description.en: Adds an always-on-top toggle for the DSH desktop window, plus a model tool so the agent can pin the window for you.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面窗口添加置顶开关，并提供模型工具让 Agent 代为置顶窗口。

description.en: Takes a baseline window snapshot at task start and minimizes or closes only the windows the AI opened when the task ends.
description.zh: 任务开始时给已有窗口拍基线，任务收尾时只最小化或关闭 AI 新开的窗口，不影响你自己的窗口。

description.en: Corner-pill Windows system monitor for DSH showing live CPU, memory, disk, network, uptime and battery.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 的 Windows 系统监控角落悬浮条，实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、运行时间和电池状态。

description.en: Adds Windows system toast notifications when DSH needs your confirmation, you answer a question, or a task finishes, even if you switch windows.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加 Windows 系统通知：需要你确认、你已回答、任务结束时各弹一条，切到别的窗口也不会漏。

description.en: Offline content-addressed proof that approved Windows control-plane changes settled across required surfaces.
description.zh: 离线按内容寻址生成证明，确认已批准的 Windows 控制面变更在所需各界面均已生效落地。

description.en: Calculates wedding banquet liquor needs from parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算婚宴酒水需求量并返回详细结果，纯Node实现，不联网。

description.en: Adds a GitHub tab to workspace overview showing repo About, rendered README, and commit history with per-file patches.
description.zh: 在工作区概览中添加 GitHub 标签页，展示仓库简介、渲染后的 README 以及带文件补丁的提交历史。

description.en: Zero-dependency Word document plugin generating, editing, reading, accounting and converting .docx with Chinese official formatting.
description.zh: 零依赖的Word文档插件，支持生成、编辑、读取、统计及转PDF，自动处理中文字体和公文排版。

description.en: 词频统计插件，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖，用于统计文本中单词出现频率。
description.zh: 纯 Node 实现的词频统计插件，无网络依赖，统计文本中各单词出现的频率。

description.en: Right-click selected English text in the DSH Web UI for an offline dictionary, context-aware AI translation, speech playback, and saved history.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中右键选中英文即可查离线词典、获取上下文 AI 翻译与语音朗读，并保存可搜索的翻译记录。

description.en: WeChat bot channel that logs forwarded messages as work items, with a SQLite ledger, knowledge base, people graph, reminders and task delegation.
description.zh: 微信机器人通道，把转发的消息记成工作项，自带 SQLite 工作账本、知识库、人员关系图谱、定时提醒与任务委派。

description.en: A pixel desk buddy for the DSH Web GUI that idles, thinks and types during turns, celebrates finishes, and counts completed turns.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的像素桌面伙伴：空闲时摸鱼，回合运行时思考打字，完成时撒彩纸并统计回合数。

description.en: Adds a Chat/Work toggle to the DSH sidebar that swaps the main column between an embedded chat.deepseek.com webview and API-key sessions.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加入「聊天／工作」切换，将主区域在内嵌 chat.deepseek.com 网页与 API 密钥会话之间切换。

description.en: Reads the day's DSH sessions and turns them into a concise daily work diary summary.
description.zh: 读取当天的 DSH 会话记录，自动生成简洁的每日工作日记摘要。

description.en: DSH plugin that plays a Windows system sound when a DeepSeek Harness session is truly finished.
description.zh: DSH 插件：当 DeepSeek Harness 会话真正结束时播放 Windows 系统提示音。

description.en: Returns a calligraphy learning plan based on parameters; pure Node implementation, no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数返回书法学习计划，纯Node实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: Calculates work injury disability allowance by parameters, returning detailed results and legal citations.
Local-first rich-text work checklist sidebar plugin for DSH Web with categories, drag-sort, recycle bin, search, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH Web 侧边栏富文本工作清单插件，支持分类、拖拽排序、回收站、搜索与 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Tracks daily work time per project, writes model summaries of what got done, and shows wallet balance and spend in a floating pill.
description.zh: 按项目记录每日工作时长，自动生成当天完成事项的总结，并在常驻浮窗中显示余额与花费。

description.en: Conversation-level work index that remembers what you asked and produced, and replays spans lost to context compaction.
description.zh: 会话级工作索引，记住你提出的问题与产出，并能重放被上下文压缩丢弃的原始片段。

description.en: Adds a standing guardrail rule so the agent only answers questions unless you explicitly ask it to do work.
description.zh: 为模型加一条常驻护栏规则：默认只回答问题，只有你明确要求时才动手操作。

description.en: Turns a week of journals and Dream reports into an ISO-week routine report, displayed in a read-only Work Review sidebar.
description.zh: 将一周的日志与 Dream 报告汇总为 ISO 周报，并在只读的 Work Review 侧边栏中展示。

description.en: Shows the agent's live work status in a single title-bar line—what it's doing, how far along, whether it failed—with a click-through detail panel.
description.zh: 把 Agent 的工作状态收进标题栏一行——在做什么、做到哪、是否失败，点开可看目标、当前步与历史记录。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that turns AI-edited markdown → Word/PDF/Excel generation → version review into a visible timeline with skill library and doc pairing.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：将 AI 修改 Markdown → 生成 Word/PDF/Excel → 审阅版本的流程可视化为时间轴，含技能库与文档配对。

description.en: Connects WorkBuddy desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with quota cards, dashboard, multi-account rotation and daily check-in.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供额度卡、仪表盘、多账号轮换与每日签到。

description.en: Claims WorkBuddy daily check-in credits and benefit bonuses inside DeepSeek Harness via official web OAuth login, no desktop client required.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过官方网页 OAuth 登录领取 WorkBuddy 每日签到积分与福利奖励，无需桌面客户端。

description.en: Logs into WorkBuddy account pools and exposes their models to DeepSeek Harness via a built-in local gateway.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内登录并管理 WorkBuddy 账号池，通过内置本地网关自动发现并调用模型。

description.en: Syncs WorkBuddy2API gateway model catalogs (names, reasoning tiers, context limits, vision) into DeepSeek Harness via a visual route panel.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy2API 网关的模型目录（名称、思考档、上下文上限、图像能力）自动同步进 DeepSeek Harness，并配有可视化路由面板。

description.en: Workflow Studio launches DeepSeek Harness workflows via /workflow and shows every subagent's work and structure on a live board.
description.zh: Workflow Studio 通过 /workflow 启动 DeepSeek Harness 工作流，并在实时面板上展示每个子代理的工作与结构。

description.en: Replaces the stock workflow tool card in chat with a horizontal timeline showing phases, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands.
description.zh: 将聊天中默认的工作流工具卡片替换为横向时间线，展示阶段站点、Agent 标签、循环弧线与并行分支。

description.en: Git worktree isolation backend for DeepSeek Harness workflows: enables isolation: 'worktree'.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作流提供 Git worktree 隔离后端，实现 registerIsolationAdapter() 接口以支持 isolation: 'worktree'。

description.en: View files changed from HEAD in the current DSH workspace and inspect each diff in a native right sidebar.
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 工作区查看 HEAD 以来的改动文件，并在原生右侧栏中检查每个 diff。

description.en: Tracks effort and token usage by date and workspace, with calendar heatmaps, time-of-day analysis and exportable self-contained HTML reports.
description.zh: 按日期与工作区统计工作量与 Token 消耗，提供日历热力图、时段分析与可导出的独立 HTML 报告。

description.en: Manages durable workspace-owned long-running processes and provides a runtime center for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理工作区所有的持久化长期运行进程，并提供运行时中心。

description.en: Adds a cross-session development worklog to DSH agents via worklog_add and worklog_list tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供跨会话开发工作日志，支持 worklog_add 和 worklog_list 工具。

description.en: Provides precise workout split (training division) plan calculations based on parameters, returning detailed results.
Lightweight plugin toggle for DeepSeek Harness with identity badges, voice-style patch-layer switches, and risk labels.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供轻量插件开关，含身份徽章、语音风格补丁层开关和风险标签。

description.en: Renders the current DSH session as an animated construction site: engineer mascot, progress tower, stage track, tool-call feed and dashboard.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH 会话的持久事件、任务清单与运行状态可视化为一座施工现场：拟人工程师、施工塔、工序航线、现场动态与仪表盘。

description.en: Adds a workspace file manager to DSH Web UI's sidebar for creating, deleting, listing, and opening files/folders.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 侧边栏添加工作区文件管理器，可创建、删除、列出和打开文件与文件夹。

description.en: Groups sessions synced from other machines into the local workspace of the same project using cross-device path aliases with an editable alias table.
description.zh: 通过可编辑的路径别名表，把其他机器同步来的会话归入本地同一项目的工作区。

description.en: Adds an Archive-All action to every workspace folder menu in the DSH sidebar, skipping running, open, blank, and subagent sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏每个工作区文件夹菜单添加「全部归档」操作，自动跳过运行中、已打开、空白及子代理会话。

description.en: Adds a workspace badge to every session row in the flat, recency-sorted DSH sidebar so you can tell sessions apart at a glance.
description.zh: 在扁平按时间排序的 DSH 侧边栏中，为每个会话行添加工作区徽章，方便快速区分会话来源。

description.en: Batch-removes workspace entries from the DSH sidebar while keeping the underlying folders and session logs intact.
description.zh: 批量移除 DSH 侧边栏中的工作区条目，同时保留原始文件夹和会话日志。

description.en: Assigns one of six color labels to workspaces in DeepSeek Harness, saved locally in the browser with Chinese/English UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区分配六种颜色标签，保存在浏览器本地，支持中英文界面。

description.en: Remember the last used workspace directory for Add workspace and prefill it next time.
description.zh: 在添加工作区时记住上次使用的目录，并在下次打开时自动预填。

description.en: Runs DeepSeek Harness workspace and session navigation in an independent Windows window without patching DSH Core.
description.zh: 在独立 Windows 窗口中运行 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区与会话导航，无需修改 DSH Core。

description.en: Registers workspace_digest tool to list file names by directory in DeepSeek Harness workspaces.
description.zh: 注册 workspace_digest 工具，按目录列出 DeepSeek Harness 工作区中的文件名。

description.en: Workspace dock rail for DeepSeek Harness, showing workspace icons/status and providing management actions.
description.zh: DSH web plugin: workspace dock rail left of the sidebar

description.en: Opens native Windows Explorer folder picker instead of in-app browser when adding a workspace in DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 添加工作区时，调用 Windows 原生资源管理器文件夹选择器，而非应用内浏览器。

description.en: Adds an authenticated Download link to workspace file previews, exporting registered workspace files to local disk via a guarded API route.
description.zh: 在工作区文件预览标题栏添加「Download」链接，通过受认证保护的接口将已注册工作区内的文件下载到本地。

description.en: Adds an eye toggle to the DSH sidebar that hides every workspace except the one holding the current session.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏添加眼睛图标开关，隐藏除当前会话所在工作区之外的所有工作区。

description.en: Turns extra folders into real workspace roots, with a scan tool and approval-free file read, write, patch and move inside each root.
description.zh: 将额外文件夹变为真实工作区根目录，提供根目录扫描工具，并允许免审批读写、修改和移动文件。

description.en: Workspace-scoped gate that keeps unwanted plugins' tool schemas and prompt sections out of the model context to save tokens.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件，把不应占用的工具 schema 与提示词段移出模型上下文，以节省 token。

description.en: DSH Web sidebar plugin that organizes sessions into color-coded groups and projects, with search, pinning, drag-and-drop sorting and archiving.
