description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏插件：按分组/项目整理会话，支持搜索、置顶、拖拽排序与归档。

description.en: Read-only dashboard for the DSH Web UI showing workspace and session activity via overview stats, a month heat calendar and a date timeline matrix.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的只读仪表盘，通过总览统计、月度热力日历和连续日期时间线矩阵展示工作区与会话活动。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used workspace at the top of the DSH sidebar and remembers that order across restarts.
description.zh: 将最近使用的工作区置顶于 DSH 侧边栏，并在重启后保留该排序。

description.en: Adds named workspace groups so one DSH session can act on several local project roots with eight ws tools.
description.zh: 为单个 DSH 会话添加命名工作区分组，用八个 ws 工具同时操作多个本地项目根目录。

description.en: Workspace guard that blocks new artifact paths on a protected drive, gives each session scratch space, and keeps a restorable same-drive recycle bin.
description.zh: 工作區守衛：攔截寫入受保護磁碟的新產物路徑，為每個會話提供暫存區，並保留同盤可還原的回收站。

description.en: Wraps long workspace names inside the DSH sidebar so rows grow with their content while titles and directory names stay unchanged.
description.zh: 让 DSH 侧栏中的长工作区名称按可用宽度换行，行高随内容增长且标题和目录名保持不变。

description.en: Opens the workspace directory using the OS-native file manager.
description.zh: dsh plugin for native open workspace / 用于本地打开工作区目录的 dsh 插件

description.en: 侧边栏工作区多级树：任意一级新建子工作区与会话，会话可置顶到最近一级文件夹
DSH Web session organizer that adds tag-based grouping, archive/restore, and a browsable archive panel synced with DSH's native archive system.
description.zh: DSH 网页会话整理插件，提供标签分组、归档/恢复与已归档浏览面板，并与 DSH 原生归档体系实时联动。

description.en: Enhances DSH workspace directory picker with cross-drive browsing, breadcrumbs, manual path mode, and inaccessible folder indicators.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 工作区目录选择器，新增跨盘符浏览、面包屑导航、手动输入路径和不可访问文件夹提示。

description.en: Controls where DSH's Add-workspace directory picker opens, using a custom path or remembering your last selection.
description.zh: 控制 DSH 添加工作区目录选择器的打开位置，可设置自定义路径或记住上次选择。

description.en: Adds official-style pin buttons to DSH Web sidebar workspace rows, with a host-persisted pin set that survives browser changes and cache clears.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 侧栏工作区行添加与官方一致的置顶图钉按钮，置顶集合由宿主持久化，跨浏览器、清缓存不丢失。

description.en: Turns the sidebar plus button into a quick-create box: type a name and instantly get a folder plus a new workspace, no picker.
description.zh: 把侧边栏加号变成快速创建框：输入名称即可同时生成同名文件夹和新工作区，无需选择器。

description.en: Binds Agent presets to workspaces so every new session in that workspace automatically starts with the preset's capabilities.
description.zh: 将Agent预设绑定到工作区，使该工作区中的每个新会话自动启用预设的全部能力。

description.en: Promotes the workspace you just submitted a task in to the top of the DSH sidebar, once per submission only.
description.zh: 提交任务时把该工作区置顶到侧边栏顶部，每次提交仅触发一次。

description.en: Sidebar panel for DeepSeek Harness that lists running sessions, or all conversations when idle, with inline pin, rename, fork, stop and archive actions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏会话总览面板，运行中时只列活跃会话，否则列出全部对话，并支持置顶、重命名、分叉、停止和归档。

description.en: Host-side DSH plugin that auto-reorders the left workspace list by each workspace's latest session activity and persists the order.
description.zh: Host 侧 DSH 插件：按各工作区最新会话活动时间自动重排左侧工作区顺序并持久化保存。

description.en: Adds a draggable splitter between the sidebar navigation and the workspace list so the session list can be resized and the height persisted.
description.zh: 在侧边栏导航与工作区会话列表之间加一条可拖动分隔条，调整高度并记住设置。

description.en: Keeps one private set of workspace rules per project and automatically loads it into every new session.
description.zh: 为每个项目保存一份私有工作区约定，并在新会话中自动加载。

description.en: Reorders the DSH Workspace Tree sidebar so a workspace's own sessions appear above its nested workspace folders.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 工作区树侧边栏的排序，让工作区自身的会话显示在嵌套的工作区文件夹之上。

description.en: Shares one sidebar layout (tabs, split view, floating panels) across all conversations in the same DSH workspace, with a settings toggle.
description.zh: 让同一工作区里的所有对话共用一份侧边栏布局（标签、分屏、浮动面板等），可在设置中开关。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin that orders Workspaces by their newest conversation and makes the visible conversation count per Workspace configurable in Settings.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件，按最新对话排序工作区，并可在设置中配置每个工作区显示的对话数量（默认 5）。

description.en: Sorts DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspaces by last-used time, keeping ordering independent per workspace (experimental).
description.zh: 按最近使用时间为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏工作区排序，各工作区排序相互独立（实验性）。

description.en: Adds real nested sub-workspaces, hierarchy navigation, focus mode, health checks, and conversational plugin tuning to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供真实嵌套子工作区、层级导航、专注模式、健康检查与对话式插件调整。

description.en: Manages isolated workspaces in deepseek-harness with unified Skill/MCP/plugin toggles and global config fallback.
description.zh: 为 deepseek-harness 提供多工作区隔离管理，统一管控 Skill/MCP/插件启停，支持全局配置兜底。

description.en: Syncs workspaces, session history and automations to your own cloud-synced folder so a new machine picks up where you left off.
description.zh: 将工作区、会话历史和自动化同步到你自己的云同步文件夹，让新设备能接着上次的进度继续工作。

description.en: Adds quiet gradient tints per Workspace, a tree-like sidebar, and a green row marking chats that finished unread.
description.zh: 为每个工作区添加柔和的渐变色调，侧边栏呈现树状结构，并用绿色行标记未读完成的对话。

description.en: Adds aggregated session status dots (waiting for input, just finished, running) to workspace-tree folder rows, rolling up nested workspaces.
description.zh: 在工作区树目录行显示聚合会话状态点（等待输入/刚完成/运行中），父文件夹自动汇总嵌套工作区状态。

description.en: Pins workspaces and tasks in the sidebar with a password-protected hidden space, access lock, and cloud-sync exclusion for hidden items.
description.zh: 在侧边栏固定工作区和任务，提供密码保护的隐藏空间、工作区访问锁，并让隐藏项不参与云同步。

description.en: Host-only DSH bundle with two tools: read the Chrome workstation UI spec by section, and fetch starter template files.
description.zh: 纯 Host 的 DSH 组合包，注册两个工具：按章节读取 Chrome 工作站 UI 规范，并获取起步模板文件。

description.en: Read-only worktree listing inside DSH plus a CLI to create, remove and prune isolated git worktrees.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中只读列出工作树，并提供创建、删除和清理隔离 git 工作树的命令行工具。

description.en: Multi-repo feature workspace manager using git worktrees and shared branches for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 插件，按功能创建目录，为每个组件仓库建立 git worktree 并共用同一功能分支，自动注册为 DSH 工作区。

description.en: Git worktree guard for DeepSeek Harness that gives each session isolated worktrees with an always-on safety net and a human approval gate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git worktree 守卫，让每个会话隔离工作区，并自带常开安全网与人工确认关卡。

description.en: Adds git worktree management to the DSH task start window so you can list, create, and select worktrees for development.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务启动窗口中集成 Git worktree 管理，可列出、创建并选择 worktree 进行开发。

description.en: One-click git worktree launcher for DeepSeek Harness that starts a session in a fresh worktree and auto-cleans idle worktrees.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键 git worktree 启动器，在新工作树中开启会话并自动清理闲置工作树。

description.en: Adds a start-of-conversation gate that sizes the first task and asks whether a large project is worth doing now.
description.zh: 在新对话开始时判断首个任务规模，仅对大型项目询问“现在是否值得做”。

description.en: WPS/金山文档 cloud drive integration for DSH, enabling list/search/read/create/upload/download and content access for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs via official SkillHub MCP.
description.zh: 为DSH提供WPS/金山文档云盘集成，可列表/搜索/读取/创建/上传/下载云文档，并读写文字、表格、演示文稿和PDF内容。

description.en: WSL bridge plugin to run Linux commands, manage distributions, convert paths, and copy files between Windows and Linux.
description.zh: WSL 桥接插件，可在 Windows 上运行 Linux 命令、管理发行版、转换路径，并在两系统间复制文件。

description.en: Grants the WSL2 GPU device to the DSH Landlock sandbox so torch.cuda.is_available() is true in a confined agent bash session.
description.zh: 将 WSL2 GPU 设备授权给 DSH Landlock 沙箱，使受限 agent bash 会话中 torch.cuda.is_available() 为 True。

description.en: Searches live web sources for AI meetups near Wudaokou and Tsinghua in Beijing, extracting times, venues, fees and sign-up links, with search history kept.
description.zh: 实时搜索北京五道口、清华附近的 AI 线下活动，整理时间、地点、费用和报名链接，并保留检索历史与来源。

description.en: Adds an infinite canvas in the left sidebar with a local workbench lifecycle and DSH Agent canvas tools for visual creation.
description.zh: 在左侧边栏提供无限画布，管理本地工作台生命周期，并为 DSH Agent 提供画布工具。

description.en: A WuwaTappo desktop pet companion that shows your DeepSeek account balance right on the pet.
description.zh: 一只 WuwaTappo 桌宠,可直接在宠物上显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: An unofficial wuxia ink-wash visual theme for DeepSeek Harness inspired by Phantom Blade Zero.
description.zh: 一款受《影之刃零》启发的武侠水墨风格 DeepSeek Harness 非官方主题。

description.en: Adds a Delete Session action to the session menu that removes a session, its sub-sessions, disk records, caches and empty project folders.
description.zh: 在会话菜单中新增「删除会话」操作，可清除该会话及其子会话、磁盘记录、缓存和变空的项目文件夹。

description.en: Archives and reads X (Twitter) posts as permanent Markdown snapshots via 2100laike X Archive.
description.zh: 把 X（Twitter）帖子归档为永久 Markdown 快照并支持读取，由 2100laike X Archive 提供支持。

description.en: Adds xAI (Grok/X subscription) OAuth device-code login to DeepSeek Harness with automatic token refresh, so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 xAI（Grok/X 订阅）OAuth 设备码登录，支持令牌自动刷新，无需 API Key。

description.en: Turns Excel/PDF/Word materials into batches of Xiaohongshu posts: extracts topics, writes copy, and renders template-based covers and inner pages.
description.zh: 把 Excel/PDF/Word 资料批量做成小红书图文：提炼选题、撰写文案，并按模板生成封面与内页图。

description.en: Xiaohongshu multi-account content pipeline plugin that renders 12 image-text templates, schedules posts, and monitors comments and DMs.
description.zh: 小红书多账号内容流水线插件,提供12套图文模板渲染、定时发布、状态同步、合规自检与评论私信监测。

description.en: Runs a 5-stage Xiaohongshu business-validation pipeline — keywords, scraping, pain points, competitor analysis — with TikHub API note/comment data.
description.zh: 运行小红书商业验证五阶段流程（关键词生成、数据抓取、痛点分析、竞争分析、验证报告），并通过 TikHub API 获取真实笔记与评论数据。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents Windows screen control: screenshots, mouse and keyboard input, UI Automation and window management tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供 Windows 屏幕控制：截图、鼠标键盘输入、UI 自动化与窗口管理工具。

description.en: Xiao theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with selectable artwork, a draggable companion, and optional DeepSeek balance display.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页版与桌面版的 Xiao 主题，支持选择插画、可拖动伙伴形象及可选的 DeepSeek 余额显示。

description.en: Adds a toggleable tsundere whale-girl persona paragraph to DSH, giving the assistant a global character voice.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加可开关的傲娇鲸鱼娘全局人格段落，让助手以该角色口吻回应。

description.en: Golden retriever chat secretary that listens, extracts intent/keywords, and auto-writes persistent briefings.
description.zh: 金毛秘书插件：实时旁听对话，提取意图/关键词/链接，自动生成简报并持久化记忆。

description.en: A mood-diary plugin for DSH that writes the companion's feelings at natural pauses into a single Markdown journal you can browse later.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加心情日记插件，在对话自然停顿等时机把陪伴者的心情写进同一个 Markdown 文档，供你日后翻阅。

description.en: Generates a structured handoff card and auto-numbered new chat, with sidebar pinning and threshold auto-prepare so context carries across sessions.
description.zh: 生成结构化交接卡片并自动编号新会话，支持侧边栏置顶与阈值自动准备，让上下文跨会话延续。

description.en: Adds a six-step troubleshooting/delivery thought chain to DSH plus a zero-dependency boot self-check and 13 adjustable settings with rollback.
description.zh: 为 DSH 加入六步排障/交付思考链，附带零依赖开机自检、13 项可调设置与退回机制。

description.en: DSH plugin that gives the agent a persistent Yandex Browser profile plus CDP tools to read and drive web pages.
description.zh: 为智能体提供持久化 Yandex 浏览器配置文件，并通过 CDP 工具读取和操作网页。

description.en: Adds multi-character companion personas to DeepSeek Harness, each with its own chat sessions, editable persona and independent memory, plus WeChat/QQ QR linking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加多位陪伴角色，每位角色拥有独立会话、可编辑人设与独立记忆库，并支持扫码连接微信和 QQ。

description.en: Adds a Y✨ button to the DeepSeek Harness composer that rewrites fuzzy drafts into structured prompts via a host-configured yce MCP.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框添加 Y✨ 按钮，通过宿主配置的 yce MCP 将模糊草稿改写为结构化提示词。

description.en: Yeast dosage calculator that computes precise amounts from parameters and returns detailed results. Pure Node, no network.
description.zh: 根据参数计算酵母用量并返回详细结果，纯 Node 实现，无网络请求。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for controlling, managing, diagnosing, and lighting-designing Yeelight smart home devices via product knowledge and routing tools.
description.zh: 用于控制、管理、诊断和设计Yeelight智能家居照明的DeepSeek Harness插件，提供产品知识与路由工具。

description.en: Retrofuturist skin pack for DeepSeek Harness featuring dusk trains, neon hover taxis and a Space Age coast.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的复古未来主义皮肤包，包含黄昏列车、霓虹悬浮出租车与太空时代海岸主题。

description.en: 叶雪青主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤插件，提供两套独立设计、立绘分档与字体切换，并可一键开关回到原生外观。
description.zh: 叶雪青主题 DSH Web UI 皮肤插件，含两套独立设计、立绘分档与字体切换，一键开关即可回到原生外观。

description.en: Forwards DeepSeek Harness lifecycle events to the YierPet desktop-pet sentinel.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期事件以发后不理方式转发给 YierPet 桌宠哨兵。

description.en: Hides selected workspaces in the left sidebar and chosen files or directories in the right file tree, without affecting model access.
description.zh: 在左侧边栏选择性隐藏工作区，在右侧文件树中隐藏指定的文件或目录，不影响模型访问。

description.en: A desktop pet plugin for DSH Web GUI with wolf/rabbit/chick characters and 16 expressions reacting to agent task states, fully offline.
description.zh: DSH Web 桌面宠物插件，可切换狼、兔、一一三种角色，16 种表情随任务状态变化，离线可用。

description.en: Provides yoga stretching plans based on input parameters, implemented in pure Node with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据输入参数生成瑜伽拉伸计划，纯 Node 实现，不依赖网络。

description.en: Desktop floating-window bridge that relays messages between outbox/inbox JSONL files and a dedicated DSH session.
description.zh: 桌面悬浮窗桥接插件，通过 outbox/inbox JSONL 文件与专用 DSH 会话双向收发消息。

description.en: Adds a Japanese anime-style voice to dsh via a local GPT-SoVITS server, with manga speech bubbles and Chinese subtitles in the UI.
description.zh: 通过本地 GPT-SoVITS 为 dsh 添加日语二次元语音，并在界面显示漫画气泡与中文字幕。

description.en: Adds a JoJo-inspired "Za Warudo" time-stop transition animation when toggling the DeepSeek Harness light/dark appearance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 明暗主题切换加入 JoJo 风格的“砸瓦鲁多”时停过渡动画。

description.en: Adds a Z.AI coding-plan quota panel to the DSH sidebar so you can check your usage at a glance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中添加 Z.AI 编程套餐配额面板，方便随时查看用量。

description.en: Connects your hosted Zapier MCP server to DSH with a single token, turning Zapier app tools into agent tools in every session.
description.zh: 通过一个令牌把托管 Zapier MCP 服务器接入 DSH，让 Zapier 应用工具在每个会话中成为智能体工具。

description.en: Unofficial community port of ZCode's project-scoped long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness, giving projects persistent memory.
description.zh: ZCode 项目记忆的非官方社区移植版：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供项目级长效记忆能力。

description.en: Adapter that brings OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with live catalog discovery and zero dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenCode Zen 免费模型的适配器，支持实时目录发现且无需依赖。

description.en: Full-screen minimal zen countdown that hides the DSH interface while tasks run, helping you stay focused.
description.zh: 全屏极简禅模式倒计时，在任务运行时隐藏 DSH 界面，帮助你保持专注。

description.en: ZenTao bug ledger for DeepSeek Harness: triage, drafts, step evidence, and explicit submission with readback.
ZenTao workbench in the DSH sidebar to browse assigned tasks, bugs, and requirements and turn them into chat context with real image attachments.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏查看指派给我的禅道任务/Bug/需求，一键转为带真实图片附件的对话上下文。

description.en: Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language pack for DSH that registers a locale and 2,699 dictionaries covering every web GUI namespace.
description.zh: 為 DSH 提供繁體中文語言包，註冊 zh-Hant 地區設定及涵蓋所有 Web GUI 命名空間的 2,699 份字典。

description.en: Adds Taiwan Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) localization to DeepSeek Harness, translating the user interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加台湾繁体中文（zh-TW）语言包，翻译界面文字。

description.en: Localizes the DeepSeek Harness display to Chinese: 万/亿 number grouping instead of 3-digit sections, and renames "token" to "词元".
description.zh: 将 DSH 界面改为中文显示习惯：三位分节计数改为万/亿四位分级，并把 token 改称「词元」。

description.en: DSH bundle plugin that injects a system-prompt guard making internal reasoning user-reviewable and forcing all user-facing explanations into Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 该 DSH 插件向会话系统提示注入守卫，让内部推理可被用户审阅，并要求所有面向用户的说明使用简体中文。

description.en: Appends a system-prompt section that makes the DSH agent do its internal reasoning and replies in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 通过追加系统提示词 section，让 DSH 智能体用简体中文进行内部推理与回复。

description.en: Registers a persistent system prompt section forcing DeepSeek Harness models to think and answer in Simplified Chinese for all sessions and sub-agents.
description.zh: 注册常驻系统提示分区，强制 DeepSeek Harness 模型在所有会话、工作区与子代理中用简体中文思考与作答。

description.en: Translates the entire DeepSeek Harness Web UI into Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) at the DOM layer, including third-party plugin text.
description.zh: 在 DOM 层将整个 DeepSeek Harness Web UI（含第三方插件文案）转换为繁体中文（台湾）。

description.en: 庄方宜主题插件为 DSH 提供 4 套风格预设、浅色/深色适配、官方壁纸、强调色自选与启动动效。
description.zh: 庄方宜主题插件为 DSH 提供 4 套风格预设、浅深色适配、官方壁纸、强调色自选与启动动效。

description.en: Launches a local Zi Wei Dou Shu charting app and provides AI-powered astrology readings.
description.zh: 启动本地紫微斗数排盘应用，并提供 AI 解读。

description.en: Startup plugin that cleans up zombie agents in dsh registry to prevent input freeze after re-entering sessions.
description.zh: DSH 启动时清理注册表中已收尾但仍残留的僵尸 agent，避免退出重进会话后输入框卡死。

description.en: Generates home cleaning plans based on parameters; pure Node implementation with no network dependencies.
description.zh: 根据参数生成家庭分区清洁计划，纯 Node 实现，无网络依赖。

description.en: LAN desktop pets for DeepSeek Harness: neighbours' pets wander onto your desktop and yours can visit theirs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的局域网桌面宠物：邻居的宠物会来你的桌面串门，你的宠物也能去对方那里。

description.en: Adds a zoomable image viewer to the DSH sidebar with wheel zoom, drag-to-pan, fit/width/1:1 modes and fullscreen.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏添加可缩放图片查看器，支持滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、适应/宽度/1:1 及全屏查看。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to a local Zotero library: search and edit items, bulk-import papers by DOI/arXiv/PMID/ISBN/URL, and read PDF annotations, notes and indexed full text.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到本地 Zotero 文献库：检索与编辑条目、按 DOI/arXiv/PMID/ISBN/URL 批量导入论文，并读取 PDF 批注、笔记与索引全文。

description.en: Integrates Zotero Desktop with DSH to search libraries, read indexed full text, and import/export references.
description.zh: 将 Zotero 桌面版集成到 DSH，支持检索文献库、读取索引全文以及导入导出参考文献。

description.en: DSH plugin that fetches full-text papers through institutional login sessions and archives them with their Zotero items into chosen collections.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在机构登录会话下取回文献全文，并连同条目一起归档到指定的 Zotero 分类中。

description.en: Zotero library browser and PDF reading workspace for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Right-sidebar Zotero workspace with collection tree, rendered PDF/Markdown reading, and one-click citations into the conversation via read-only local API.
description.zh: 右侧栏 Zotero 工作区：合集树、PDF/Markdown 渲染阅读，并通过只读本地 API 一键引用到对话中。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes Knowledge Planet (zsxq) content via unofficial web API and Cookie auth as agent tools with QR login and web settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过非官方 Web API 与 Cookie 认证，把知识星球内容封装为 agent 工具，并支持扫码登录与 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Brings real SSH machine terminals into DSH with named credentials, JumpServer assets, local PTY sessions and 14 agent tools.
description.zh: 把真实 SSH 机器终端接入 DSH，支持命名凭证、JumpServer 资产、本地 PTY 会话与 14 个工具。

description.en: Holds a Screen Wake Lock in the ArkWeb page so HarmonyOS stays awake while agents or background tasks run, with a toggle in the usage bar.
description.zh: 有 agent 或后台任务运行时，通过 ArkWeb 页面持有 Screen Wake Lock，让 HarmonyOS 不自动熄屏，用量栏内可切换常亮模式。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek balance as a game-style HP bar in the DSH Web GUI, with multiple themes and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面把 DeepSeek 余额显示为游戏风格血条，支持多种主题和自动刷新。

description.en: On each DSH launch, automatically imports newly downloaded Hao Wallpaper wallpapers into the DSH wallpaper engine, incrementally and idempotently on macOS.
description.zh: 每次启动 DSH 时，自动将 Hao Wallpaper 新下载的壁纸增量导入 DSH 壁纸引擎，幂等且不阻塞启动（macOS）。

description.en: Search, browse, and compare DeepSeek Harness plugins directly inside DSH's Settings UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面中搜索、浏览并对比 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Sidebar panel for DeepSeek Harness listing curated plugins in eight languages with copyable install commands, fetched live from dshwiki.com.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏展示 12 个精选插件，支持八种语言，安装命令可一键复制，数据从 dshwiki.com 实时获取。

description.en: MCP client hub with web console for DeepSeek Harness to manage servers, skills, commands, memory, and prompts.
description.zh: MCP client hub (stdio / Streamable HTTP / SSE) with a web console for DeepSeek Harness — manage MCP servers, agent skills, slash commands, project & global memory, and prompt sections.

description.en: Adds an AI-approval permission preset to DSH that auto-reviews one-time sandbox escalations, escalating only rejected or failed cases to you.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加「由 AI 审批」权限预设：一次性沙箱提权先由 AI 审核，仅被拒或出错时再转人工审批。

description.en: Clamps every image sent to the model to a maximum side length, defaulting to 2000px, so Claude's many-image limit is never exceeded.
description.zh: 将发送给模型的每张图片限制在最大边长（默认 2000px）以内，避免超过 Claude 的多图限制。

description.en: Makes DSH always reply, including final reports, in the language of the user's latest prompt.
description.zh: 让 DSH 始终使用用户最新提示词的语言回复，包括最终报告。

description.en: Detects repeated identical tool calls and stops them, breaking agent loops that small local models often fall into.
description.zh: 检测重复的相同工具调用并中止，打断小型本地模型常见的智能体循环。

description.en: Shows and opens the session's real project directory from the header, with a set_project tool and durable local mapping.
description.zh: 从会话标题栏显示并打开会话的真实项目目录，并提供 set_project 工具和持久化本地映射。

description.en: Adds a sidebar menu item and a backend removal endpoint so DSH conversations can be permanently deleted.
description.zh: 新增侧边栏菜单项与后端删除端点，用于永久删除 DSH 会话。

description.en: Adds a DSH settings page that lists installed skills with short summaries and per-skill enable/disable switches.
description.zh: 添加 DSH 设置页面，列出已安装技能及其简短摘要，并提供每个技能的启用/禁用开关。

description.en: DSH settings page showing DeepSeek account balance, daily token usage by model, and the metered API cost incurred.
description.zh: DSH 设置页面，展示 DeepSeek 账户余额、按模型统计的每日 token 用量，以及相应的 API 计费成本。

description.en: Visual model adapter for Codex and DeepSeek Harness, using PaddleOCR-VL and Qwen for OCR and vision tasks.
description.zh: 为 Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉模型适配，基于 PaddleOCR-VL 和 Qwen 执行 OCR 与视觉任务。

description.en: 基于 Easy Ask AI Skill 改编的 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件：Prompt Ready 问清需求，Get Clear 问清改法，右栏跟踪讨论；其他 Agent 可安装原版 Skill。
Turns DeepSeek Harness into a QQ chatbot via one plugin, with budget control, long-term memory, context compression and sticker replies.
description.zh: 一个插件把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 QQ 机器人，支持预算控制、长期记忆、上下文压缩和表情包回复。

description.en: EmoFlow tracks a local emotion trajectory across the conversation and feeds that state back as guidance for DeepSeek Harness responses.
description.zh: EmoFlow 在本地追踪对话中的情绪轨迹，并将该状态作为响应引导回馈给 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Imports PDF exam papers, lets you box-select a question and returns its answer, knowledge points, step-by-step solution and similar practice questions.
description.zh: 导入PDF试卷，框选一道题即可得到答案、知识点、分步解析与相似练习题。

description.en: FairyGUI UI builder for DSH that builds components from layout specs, previews controller pages and generates/verifies C# view classes.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 FairyGUI UI 构建插件，可从布局规格构建组件、预览控制器页面，并生成与校验 C# 视图类。

description.en: Accelerates DSH's GitHub traffic transparently via a local FastGithub install or a custom HTTP(S) proxy, with a live status badge.
description.zh: 通过本地 FastGithub 或自定义 HTTP(S) 代理，透明加速 DSH 的 GitHub 流量，并显示实时状态徽标。

description.en: A DSH workspace file explorer in the left sidebar for browsing, previewing, and referencing files.
description.zh: DSH 左侧工作区文件浏览器，可浏览目录文件、预览文件、在系统资源管理器中打开，并把文件引用加入聊天。

description.en: Design and restructure interfaces as editable FigCraft documents: wireframes, design systems, light/dark theme tokens and prototypes.
description.zh: 以可编辑的 FigCraft 文档进行界面设计与重构：线框、设计系统、明暗主题令牌与原型流交付。

description.en: A DSH plugin that adds a one-click Open location button to delivered file cards so you can reveal files in the system file manager.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，在交付文件卡片上添加一键“打开所在位置”按钮，快速在系统文件管理器中定位文件。

description.en: Privacy-first task memory and adaptive local desktop observation for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供隐私优先的任务记忆与自适应本地桌面观察

description.en: A floating pomodoro timer card for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with work countdown, focus stats, rhythm reminders and system notifications.
description.zh: 一块悬浮在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的番茄钟卡片，含下班倒计时、专注统计、节律提醒与系统通知。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that freezes the conversation reading column on window resize, preserving your reading position so long answers stop re-wrapping.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，在窗口缩放时冻结对话阅读栏，保持阅读位置，让长回答不再重新换行。

description.en: Fontaine/Furina theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with three skins, switchable wallpapers, hydro-blue glass UI and an in-page switcher.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的枫丹/芙宁娜主题，包含三款皮肤、可切换壁纸、水蓝色玻璃质感界面和页内主题切换器。

description.en: dsh bundle registering one skill that inserts a real Word table of contents field into an existing .docx using only the Python standard library.
description.zh: 该 dsh 插件注册一个技能，仅用 Python 标准库即可为现有 .docx 插入真正的 Word 目录域。

description.en: Gemini model provider for DSH via Google Antigravity OAuth, with multi-account quotas and image, audio, video and PDF understanding.
description.zh: 通过 Google Antigravity OAuth 为 DSH 提供 Gemini 模型，支持多账号配额及图片、音频、视频和 PDF 理解。

description.en: Turns a text or image 2D math problem into a verified, interactive GeoGebra .ggb file with a report and screenshot.
description.zh: 将文字或图片形式的二维数学题转换为可交互的 GeoGebra .ggb 文件，并附验证报告与截图。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds GitHub OAuth login with an encrypted credential vault, 12 github_* agent tools, a sidebar panel and a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 插件，提供 GitHub OAuth 登录、AES-256-GCM 凭据保险库、12 个 github_* 智能体工具，以及侧边栏面板和设置页。

description.en: A local project map for AI coding agents: one lookup jumps straight to the authoritative file, cutting navigation cost by up to 99%.
description.zh: 给 AI 编码 agent 的本地项目地图：一次 lookup 直达权威文件，导航成本降低最高 99%。

description.en: Builds and audits editable spreadsheet deliverables with recalculable formulas, tables, charts, and export checks.
description.zh: 生成并审计可编辑电子表格成果，公式可重算，含表格、图表与导出核对。

description.en: HanaMesh core identity client plugin: device identity, consent/withdrawal, settings entry, health observation and Uint8Array signing.
description.zh: HanaMesh 核心身份客户端插件，提供设备身份、同意/撤回、设置入口、健康观察与签名能力。

description.en: Records HanaMesh activity usage events with signed provenance, consent/withdrawal tracking and bounded storage retention.
description.zh: 记录 HanaMesh 活动使用事件，提供签名溯源、同意/撤回跟踪与受限存储保留。

description.en: Bridges the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer to the HarnessMate platform so you can use it from your phone or browser.
description.zh: 将运行在你自己电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 HarnessMate 平台，让你可通过手机或浏览器远程使用。

description.en: Theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness adding a nebula wallpaper, Monet-style palette and liquid-glass translucent panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：星云壁纸 + 莫奈取色 + 液态玻璃半透明界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness browser plugin that shows 1→N glossary meanings when you hover a word in user or assistant chat text, all looked up locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件：鼠标悬停在对话正文的词上，即在本地显示该词的 1→N 条释义。

description.en: Makes a session behave as a mainland-China user with local locale, time zone, date/currency conventions and a consistent test persona.
description.zh: 让会话以中国大陆用户身份运行，提供本地化区域设置、时区、日期与货币格式以及自洽的测试人设。

description.en: An IntelliJ IDEA-style Git workbench inside the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with commit graph, branches, diffs, annotate, staging and stash.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中提供 IntelliJ IDEA 风格的 Git 工作台，支持提交图谱、分支、差异、注解、暂存与储藏。

description.en: Plan, batch-generate, and evaluate images with approved spend tracking and hash-verified receipts.
description.zh: 规划、批量生成和评估图像，支持已批准支出跟踪和哈希校验回执。

description.en: Inline local image preview for DeepSeek Harness, rendering various image formats directly in chat.
description.zh: Inline local image preview for DeepSeek Harness - img_serve tool + img fence, renders PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/AVIF/BMP/SVG/ICO directly in chat.

description.en: A-share influence-analysis plugin that accumulates research into a local influence network with a relationship canvas and eight-dimension radar.
description.zh: 面向 A 股的影响分析插件，将对话调研累积为本地影响网，并在右侧栏展示关系网与八维雷达。

description.en: A read-only web plugin for browsing a configured Skill Base catalog in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，用于浏览已配置的 Skill Base 技能目录。

description.en: DSH plugin that periodically injects a configurable text as a user message into the middle of the conversation history.
description.zh: DSH 外掛，按步數或時間間隔把自訂文字作為 user 訊息注入對話歷史中間。

description.en: Exposes read-only memory tools from memv2 and Javis for selected Bots, without needing a private MCP card per Bot.
description.zh: 为所选机器人提供来自 memv2 和 Javis 的只读记忆工具，无需为每个机器人配置私有 MCP 卡片。

description.en: A DSH toolkit for home-textile factories: OCR document field extraction, voice-to-text reporting, and natural-language-to-SQL queries.
description.zh: 面向家纺工厂的 DSH 工具包：单据 OCR 抽字段、语音转写报工、自然语言转 SQL 查询。

description.en: MCP server and DSH plugin giving AI agents exact, fail-loud math execution for fractions, finance, units and dates across 19 packs.
description.zh: 为 AI 代理提供精确数学执行能力的 MCP 服务器与 DSH 插件，覆盖分数、金融、单位与日期，共 19 个包。

description.en: Vision bridge plugin that gives text-only LLMs image understanding via a vision twin model and vision tool.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型提供视觉能力的 DeepSeek Harness 桥接插件：用 deepseek-v4-pro 作大脑、deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 作视觉孪生模型，提供 vision 工具，可直接贴图看图。

description.en: A three-state animated black-cat desktop pet for the DSH web UI corner, with hand-drawn SVG art, clickable states, motions and sound effects.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面右下角添加三状态动态黑猫桌面宠物，手绘 SVG 造型，可点击切换状态，配独立动效与音效。

description.en: Pins the chat reply language and the artifact language (code, docs, commits, PRs) in DSH via an enforced system prompt section.
description.zh: 通过强制系统提示词段落，固定 DSH 中聊天回复语言以及产物（代码、文档、提交、PR）语言。

description.en: Keeps the DSH sidebar empty and lazy-loads workspaces and their sessions only for the folders you explicitly add.
description.zh: 让 DSH 侧栏默认留空，仅按你添加的目录按需加载工作区及其会话。

description.en: DSH workbench that imports .docx screenplays, machine pre-checks them, runs multi-phase LLM script refinement and BGM scoring with cost budgets.
description.zh: DSH 炼本工作台：导入 .docx 剧本，机器前置质检后用多阶段 LLM 炼本并生成配乐，含成本账本与 token 预算。

description.en: Cull, develop, and export photos while keeping originals intact and edits reversible.
description.zh: 筛选、冲洗并导出照片，同时保留原始文件并支持可逆编辑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that nudges the agent to answer as soon as it can, with escalating reminders when tool calls pile up.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：催促代理一有答案就立即回复，当工具调用堆积时发出逐级升级的提醒。

description.en: Personal UX fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web client that let directory links open directly as browsable folder pages.
description.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的个人体验修复，让目录链接直接打开为可浏览的文件夹页。

description.en: Multi-level provider fallback for same-named models in DeepSeek Harness, with KV cache reuse and failover.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中同名模型提供多级提供者回退，支持 KV 缓存复用与故障转移。

description.en: A sidebar web plugin that searches, queries (RAG) and remembers entries in your local loci second-brain knowledge base.
description.zh: 侧边栏网页插件，可搜索、提问（RAG）并记录本地 loci 第二大脑知识库内容。

description.en: Photoshop automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness offering grading recipes, layered HDR, multi-zone masks and quality-first super-resolution.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Photoshop 自动化插件，提供调色配方、分层 HDR、多区域蒙版与画质优先的超分辨率。

description.en: Scripted browser demo tool with a scene-driven Electron stage, headless 1080p30 recording with evidence, a director console and a loopback control API.
description.zh: 脚本化浏览器演示工具，具备场景化 Electron 舞台、带证据的 1080p30 无头录制、导演控制台和回环控制 API。

description.en: Keeps DSH's native /compact manual compaction available while billion-context continues automatic compression.
description.zh: 在 billion-context 持续自动压缩的同时，保留 DSH 原生 /compact 手动压缩功能。

description.en: Aggregates several DSH plugin marketplaces into one Excel-like filterable table and uses npm metadata to flag runtime compatibility.
description.zh: 把多个 DSH 插件市场聚合为一张类 Excel 可筛选表格，并用 npm 元数据判断插件是否适配当前 DSH 运行时。

description.en: Inspects Maya scenes, captures reversible Playblasts, and restores every value it touches.
description.zh: 检查 Maya 场景、捕获可逆 Playblast，并恢复所有被修改的数值。

description.en: Chrome extension that gives DeepSeek Harness background browser control, local authorization and an activity panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Chrome 浏览器后台控制、本地授权与活动面板的扩展。

description.en: Minecraft-style HUD showing token speed, balance, cache rate, and session cost for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 以《我的世界》风格在界面显示 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 速度、余额、缓存命中率和会话花费

description.en: DSH plugin and probe suite that starts real Minecraft servers/clients and asserts world state and logs for Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge mods.
description.zh: 用于 Minecraft 模组开发的 DSH 插件与探针套件：启动真实服务器和客户端，通过 HTTP 驱动并断言世界状态与日志。

description.en: Adds a Model Test settings page that measures first-token latency (TTFT) for every configured model in the DSH Web GUI and Desktop.
description.zh: 新增“模型测试”设置页，为每个已配置模型测量首字延迟（TTFT），支持 DSH 网页版与桌面端。

description.en: Appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI adding a chat wallpaper with opacity, blur and scrim controls plus an avatar brand mark.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供外观层：聊天壁纸（支持透明度、模糊与遮罩调节）以及头像品牌标识。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns local/online media paths in chat messages into inline playable audio/video/image previews.
description.zh: DSH插件：将聊天中本地或在线音视频/图片路径自动渲染为内联可播放预览。

description.en: Records, indexes, and searches files, tools, environments, knowledge, and work records across workspaces for reuse.
description.zh: 跨工作区互操作库，用于记录、索引和搜索文件、工具、环境、知识和工作记录以便重用。

description.en: File-based cross-device memory for DeepSeek Harness, syncing Markdown notes via Syncthing and supporting remote DSH delegation.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨设备记忆插件，使用 Markdown 与 Syncthing 同步笔记，并支持 DSH 远程委派。

description.en: Plugin for tracking execution trajectories of AI agents for non-code work, starting with content production.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，追踪 AI 智能体在非代码工作（从内容生产开始）中的执行轨迹。

description.en: Provides Ascend NPU knowledge and remote-development tooling for DeepSeek Harness, composed from stable DSH plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供昇腾 NPU 知识与远程开发工具，由稳定的 DSH 插件组合而成。

description.en: MiniMax H3 plugin that generates video, music, speech, and images via MCP or CLI, with resumable tasks and verified downloads.
description.zh: MiniMax H3 插件，通过 MCP 或 CLI 生成视频、音乐、语音与图片，支持可恢复任务与校验下载。

description.en: Account-pool framework for DSH bot plugins: multi-platform accounts, session binding, inbound routing, message-ID dedup and token-bucket rate limiting.
description.zh: DSH 机器人插件的账号池框架：多平台账号、会话绑定、入站路由、消息 ID 去重与令牌桶限流。

description.en: Alarm-style self-activation plugin that steers a user message into a session on a schedule so the agent runs a turn on its own.
description.zh: 闹钟式自我激活插件：到点向指定会话 steer 注入一条用户消息，让智能体自行运行一轮。

description.en: Connects an ai_browser MCP server as DSH browser tools and lets DSH sessions message each other as collab peers.
description.zh: 把 ai_browser 的 MCP 服务端接成 DSH 浏览器工具，并让不同 DSH 会话作为对端互相收发消息。

description.en: Live2D mascot overlay for the DSH chat UI: hidden by default, toggle to keep on screen, menus for model/expression/motion/background, TTS speech and screenshots.
description.zh: DSH 会话界面的 Live2D 看板娘浮层：默认隐藏并可常驻，菜单切换模型/表情/动作/背景，支持 TTS 说话与截图落盘。

description.en: DSH reverse-proxy plugin that exposes the loopback-only DSH Web GUI to the LAN behind TLS with authentication, Host/Origin rewriting, signed session cookies and WebSocket passthrough.
description.zh: DSH 反向代理插件：将仅监听回环的 DSH Web GUI 通过 TLS 与认证暴露到局域网，支持 Host/Origin 改写、签名会话 Cookie 和 WebSocket 直通。

description.en: Miran Fann adds motion-graphics tools, a settings page, and DeepSeek motion skills to DSH, requiring the Miran Fann engine setup.
description.zh: Miran Fann 为 DSH 提供动态图形工具、设置页面和 DeepSeek 动态技能，需要安装 Miran Fann 引擎。

description.en: Sidebar panel ranking flagship and recommended LLMs by RMB price and capability across seven work scenarios, with per-model Chinese guides.
description.zh: 侧边栏价格面板：按七种工作场景推荐各家旗舰与十二款模型，给出人民币价格、能力评分，每款可展开一页中文说明书。

description.en: Production-grade engineering skills (25 skills) mirrored from addyosmani/agent-skills (MIT) — pluggable DSH skill repository
Minimal Windows desktop tools for DeepSeek Harness: model-chosen foreground windows, screen observation, mouse clicks and keyboard typing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的极简 Windows 桌面工具：模型自选前台窗口、屏幕观察、鼠标点击与键盘输入。

description.en: A DSH health clock that times 45-minute work sessions and pops up guided 12-15 minute break plans with voice prompts and daily stats.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 健康钟：45 分钟工作计时结束后弹窗带你做 12～15 分钟休息计划，支持语音播报与今日统计。

description.en: Browse Xiaohongshu recommendations, Baidu Tieba and NGA forums as text indexes inside the DeepSeek Harness workspace.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 工作区里用文字索引刷小红书推荐、逛百度贴吧和 NGA 论坛。

description.en: Adds a 墨阅 ebook-reader sidebar entry and panel to DSH, keeps the local reader alive, and proxies AI chapter guides.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入墨阅电子书阅读器入口与面板，自动保活本地服务并提供 AI 章节导读代理。

description.en: Publishes a local DSH plugin to multiple code forges (GitHub, Gitee, Codeberg) plus npm from one panel with preflight checks and per-platform results.
description.zh: 把本机 DSH 插件一次发布到多个代码平台（GitHub / Gitee / Codeberg）与 npm，带预检、按平台进度与结果、版本同步。

description.en: Decodes local files, network media and live streams (incl. Bilibili) into JPEG frames plus 16k PCM and feeds muse_vtuber's capture input.
description.zh: 把本地文件、网络资源与直播流（含 B 站视频与直播）解码为 JPEG 帧和 16k PCM，推送给 muse_vtuber 采集口。

description.en: A Muse Plush skin that gives the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI a powder-blue fuzzy look with beige bubbles and a plush on the composer.
description.zh: Muse Plush 皮肤为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 带来粉蓝色毛绒外观、米色气泡和输入框上的毛绒玩偶。

description.en: Drag-and-drop images into composer to save as temp file paths for text-only models.
description.zh: DSH plugin: drag-and-drop images to file paths for text-only models

description.en: Polish draft text in the main input box into clear, actionable prompts via multi-turn side-chat and fill back.
description.zh: 在主输入框一键把草稿润色为清晰、可执行的提示词，通过侧边栏多轮对话后回填。

description.en: NetEase Cloud Music floating-window player with playlists, lyrics and translations, play queue, login, and auto-skip of unavailable tracks.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器，支持歌单、歌词与翻译、播放队列、账号登录，并自动跳过无法播放的歌曲。

description.en: A local, searchable, groupable sticker library: import memes, AI-tag them by emotion, then let the model search and post the right one.
description.zh: 本地面部/表情库插件：可上传或导入表情、AI 按情绪打标签并分组，供模型检索并发送应景斗图。

description.en: NestJS assistant for DeepSeek Harness with a 165-page Chinese docs knowledge base, learning roadmap, and a playground that compiles and runs real NestJS projects.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 NestJS 助手：内置 165 页官方中文文档知识库、学习路线，以及可真实编译运行 NestJS 工程的操练场。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that fetches today's national news headlines as a daily briefing with one command.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，一键获取今日全国新闻热搜，生成每日新闻简报。

description.en: Adds a No workspace action so you can chat immediately; DSH auto-creates a dated folder under the data dir on your first message.
description.zh: 新增“无工作空间”选项，可直接开聊；DSH 会在首条消息时于数据目录自动创建带日期的文件夹作为工作空间。

description.en: Notification plugin for dsh that alerts you to approvals, questions, long tasks, errors and completions via desktop toasts.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供通知插件，通过桌面弹窗提醒审批、提问、长任务、错误和完成事件。

description.en: Extracts characters and their relationships from long Chinese narratives and renders them as an interactive, evidence-verified force-directed graph.
description.zh: 从中文长文本中抽取人物及其关系，逐字核对证据后绘制可点击拖拽的力导向关系图。

description.en: Load-shifting task queue plugin that defers non-urgent tasks to off-peak hours and auto-executes them, with a draggable floating panel.
description.zh: 错峰任务队列插件：高峰/任何时刻收到任务先确认细节并自动入队，空闲时段自动执行；右上角可拖拽悬浮面板（DeepSeek Harness web plugin）

description.en: Injects one global prompt section enforcing house rules (no check/cross glyphs, light kaomoji) on every DSH agent, preset and subagent.
description.zh: 通过一个全局提示词段落为所有 DSH 智能体、预设与子智能体设定统一规则：不使用对勾/叉号符号，并适度使用颜文字。

description.en: Ports the One Dark Pro color scheme to DeepSeek Harness as a theme pack covering Web GUI, DSH Desktop and dsh TUI.
description.zh: 将 One Dark Pro 配色移植到 DeepSeek Harness，一套主题覆盖 Web GUI、桌面端与 dsh TUI。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives one-click access to all 108 TokenDance models, with API support powered by TokenDance.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可一键接入全部 108 个 TokenDance 模型，API 由 TokenDance 提供支持。

description.en: Adds a browser-game planning and building skill to DeepSeek Harness, from idea to playable prototype.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加浏览器游戏策划与构建技能，支持从创意到可玩原型。

description.en: Scenario-based A/B model switching for orchestrator2: sidebar buttons swap primary/backup models of three sub-agent roles, with ordered auto-failover.
description.zh: 为 orchestrator2 提供场景化主备模型切换：侧边栏一键互换研究员/审核员/开发员三个子代理角色的主备模型，并支持失效自动切换。

description.en: Aggregates DSH session logs offline into output stats — generated code lines, document counts, adoption rates — shown in a Web settings panel.
description.zh: 读取 DSH 会话日志，离线统计生成代码行数、文档数量与采纳率，并在 Web 设置面板中按工作区和时间范围展示。

description.en: Agent skill and CLI to create designed documents or runnable single-page artifacts and publish them as a link or share code.
description.zh: Agent 技能和 CLI，可用 AI 智能体生成设计文档或可运行单页产物，并发布为链接或分享码。

description.en: DSH web plugin that turns oversized pasted text in the chat composer into a .txt attachment, leaving normal typing and short pastes untouched.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件，将聊天输入框中超出阈值的长文本粘贴转为 .txt 附件，不影响普通输入与短文本粘贴。

description.en: Inspect, edit, OCR, and deliver PDFs using 20 skills and pinned pdfcraft CLI tooling with per-page review gates.
description.zh: 使用 20 项技能和固定版本 pdfcraft CLI 检查、编辑、OCR 并交付 PDF，逐页核对并保留原件。

description.en: A floating pixel-art planet pomodoro timer for DSH with focus/break cycles, todos, reminders and optional always-on-top desktop window.
description.zh: 一个运行在DSH中的悬浮像素星球番茄钟，支持专注/休息循环、待办与提醒，可切换为桌面置顶窗口。

description.en: Opens a file, folder, or web page in the Plannotator browser UI for annotation, then returns your annotations as a message.
description.zh: 在 Plannotator 浏览器界面中打开文件、文件夹或网页进行标注，并将标注结果作为消息返回。

description.en: Universal plugin center and index source with one plugin protocol, adapted to any engine or agent tool; ships DeepSeek Harness adapters.
description.zh: 通用插件中心与插件索引源，统一插件协议，适配各类引擎/智能体工具，内置 DeepSeek Harness 适配器。

description.en: Provides privately maintained, harness-agnostic agent skills for routing software project lifecycle, construction planning, and long task planning.
description.zh: 提供私有、与harness无关的代理技能，用于软件项目生命周期路由、构建规划和长任务规划。

description.en: A DSH plugin that sends system-level browser notifications for tool approvals, permission denials, and task completion.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在工具审批、权限被拒和任务完成时发送系统级浏览器通知。

description.en: An open-source prompt-engineering tool that reverse-engineers AI works into reproducible prompts across image, video, copy, web code and music.
description.zh: 一个把 AI 作品逆向拆解成可复现提示词的开源工具，覆盖图像、视频、文案、网页代码和音乐五个品类。

description.en: Bilingual catalog of plugins and skills for DeepSeek Harness, supporting GitHub and local tarball installation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件与技能的双语目录，支持从 GitHub 或本地 tarball 安装。

description.en: Opens PDF/TXT/Markdown/HTML documents in a side-by-side sidebar beside the current chat for reading, translating and asking AI.
description.zh: 在当前对话侧边栏并排打开 PDF、TXT、Markdown、HTML 文档，边阅读、边翻译、边向 AI 提问。

description.en: Gives a DSH agent layered file-based memory, judgment cards, model handoff packs, compression review and A→B portability diffs, all in one command.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供分层记忆、判断卡、模型交接包、压缩审查与 A→B 可迁移差异，一条命令完成，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Adds long-term memory to DSH agents, recalling relevant context across sessions and fading old memories via an Ebbinghaus forgetting curve to save tokens.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理添加长期记忆，跨会话回忆相关上下文，并用艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线让旧记忆淡出以节省 token。

description.en: Registry of verified, agent-collectable data sources for quant finance and crypto trading, each with authority tier and freshness probes.
description.zh: 面向量化金融与加密交易的已验证数据源注册表，每条信源带权威分级与时效探测。

description.en: Queue, steer, and backlog for DSH, enabling diverse interaction with a running agent.
description.zh: Queue, Steer, and Backlog for DSH. More diverse way to interact with the agent while it's running.

description.en: Adds a compact model and reasoning quick switcher to the DSH Web composer, remembering last three choices in localStorage.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框中加入紧凑的模型与推理级别快捷切换器，并用 localStorage 记住最近三次选择。

description.en: Adds a research-sweep pipeline to DeepSeek Harness that opens a tuning ledger, expands a search space into planned trials, and caps each campaign's trial count.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加科研调参流水线：开调参账本、把搜索空间展开成 trial，并限制单个 campaign 的 trial 上限。

description.en: Adds playful combo scoring, points and round praise to DSH Web sessions, with themes, sounds and optional easter eggs.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话添加趣味连击、积分与轮次评价，支持主题、音效和可选彩蛋。

description.en: Generates and validates tour robot YAML from points.json and narration, enforcing schemas and rule sets.
description.zh: 根据points.json和叙述材料生成并校验机器人场景YAML，强制遵循schema和规则集。

description.en: Extensible workbench shell plugin for DeepSeek Harness with public side and bottom view contracts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的可扩展工作台外壳插件，包含公开的侧边视图和底部视图契约。

description.en: A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that animates based on session events like working, expecting, celebrating, waiting.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Remielle 桌面宠物，根据会话事件驱动工作、期待、庆祝、等待等动画。

description.en: Registers repo-autopilot's read-only checks (doctor / drill / acceptance / compare) as DeepSeek Harness tools.
description.zh: 把 repo-autopilot 的只读检查（doctor / drill / acceptance / compare）注册为 DeepSeek Harness 工具。

description.en: Preview and download the exact request frame (system prompt, tools_list, wire messages) sent by DeepSeek Harness to the model.
description.zh: 预览并下载 DeepSeek Harness 发送给模型的精确请求帧（系统提示词、工具列表、wire 消息）。

description.en: Adds a draggable ⟳ button to the DSH Web GUI that one-click force-restarts or closes the harness process, with no console window.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 顶部加一个可拖动的 ⟳ 按钮，一键强杀并重启或关闭 Harness 进程，全程无命令行黑窗。

description.en: Adds a one-click restart button for the DSH web backend, with a settings page to adjust button position.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面右上角添加一键重启服务按钮，并提供设置页调整按钮位置。

description.en: Turns spoken experience into an ATS-safe, one-page resume, then tailors it per job description and adds cover letters and interview prep.
description.zh: 把口述经历变成可通过 ATS 的一页简历，再按 JD 批量定制，并附求职信与面试准备清单。

description.en: Proactively wakes a roleplay agent to speak after the user has been idle for a set interval, with daily caps and quiet hours.
description.zh: 在用户沉默达到设定时长后主动唤醒角色扮演智能体发言，并支持每日上限与免打扰时段。

description.en: A self-contained routine task board for DSH with scheduled job cards, script execution, IO artifacts, and health indicators.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供自包含的例行任务板，含定时任务卡片、脚本执行、输入输出产物和健康状态指示。

description.en: Russian UI localization and 80–220% element scaling, plus pixel-art drawing and a proxy switcher with latency/exit-country checks.
description.zh: 俄语界面本地化、80–220% 元素缩放，附带像素画绘制与支持延迟/出口国家检测的代理切换。

description.en: DSH session-header time module showing current time, time since your last message, reminders and countdowns with in-session alerts.
description.zh: DSH 会话头部的时间模块，显示当前时间、距上次发言时长、提醒与倒计时，到点时给出会话内提示。

description.en: Adds a sakura pastel skin to DSH Web UI with light/dark palettes and petal effects.
description.zh: 为DSH Web UI添加樱花主题的柔和皮肤，支持亮暗色板和花瓣效果。

description.en: Interactive workbench for building publication-ready scientific figures: maps, charts, journal presets and generated Python code.
description.zh: 交互式科研图表工作台：支持地图投影切换、统计图表、期刊预设、33 种配色，并可生成 Python 代码。

description.en: Provider-agnostic, token-efficient web search and page reader exposing six retrieval capabilities as tools for AI agents; no API key required.
description.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的免费、提供商无关的网页搜索与页面阅读工具，按设计节省 token，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: DSH panel that groups handoff conversations into numbered chains, shows a context-usage HUD, warns near the limit, and can auto-start the next session.
description.zh: DSH 交接鏈面板：把互相交接的對話自動聚成編號鏈，顯示上下文用量 HUD，接近上限時提醒，並可自動開新對話交接。

description.en: Session manager for DeepSeek Harness that adds a session recycle bin, multi-select batch deletion, restoring and collapsing of sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话管理器，提供会话回收站、多选批量删除、折叠与恢复功能。

description.en: A CLI for the SF Intra-city open platform that lets people and AI agents resolve addresses, quote, place, pay for and cancel deliveries.
description.zh: 顺丰同城开放平台 CLI 工具，可让人和 AI 智能体解析地址、询价、下单、支付和取消同城配送订单。

description.en: Adds a speaker button to the composer toolbar that reads the latest assistant reply aloud and opens a volume mixer on drag.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行添加扬声器按钮，单击朗读最新助手回复，按住上拖调出音量混音台。

description.en: dsh plugin adding session handoff and task tracking skills for evidence-driven, cross-tool AI coding workflows.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加技能：支持跨工具会话交接与基于任务状态追踪的 AI 编码工作流。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that generates images via logged-in Grok/GPT accounts and videos with Grok.
description.zh: DSH 桌面插件，使用已登录的 Grok/GPT 账号生成图片，并用 Grok 生成视频。

description.en: A local ebook reader panel for DeepSeek Harness with bookshelf, immersive reading, highlights, bookmarks, search and stats.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 的本地阅读器：书架、沉浸式阅读、划线想法、书签、搜索与阅读统计集中在一个安静面板里。

description.en: Shuttle is a DSH plugin that transfers photos, videos and files from your phone to your computer over LAN by scanning a QR code, with no app or cloud.
description.zh: 文件穿梭机 Shuttle 是 DSH 插件，手机扫码即可通过局域网把照片、视频和文件传到电脑，无需装 App、不经云端。

description.en: Import and manage persona cards for AI chat sessions, with instant switching and persistence.
description.zh: 批量导入 .persona.md 与酒馆角色卡，自由加载更换人设，会话内即时生效并持久化到 Agent 预设。

description.en: Moves archived DSH sessions out of the load path into a separate archive folder, with tools to list, read, restore and delete them.
description.zh: 把已归档的 DSH 会话真正移出加载路径并放入独立归档目录，并提供列出、读取、还原与删除工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that simulates real users with personas and task cards to usability-test software designs, capturing screen evidence without input injection.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用人物画像和任务卡模拟真实用户对软件设计进行可用性测试，采集屏幕证据且不注入输入。

description.en: Cordis plugin bundle that ports the four efficiency mechanisms of NVlabs/SoL-Pi into DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 将 NVlabs/SoL-Pi 的四项效率机制移植到 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Cordis 插件包。

description.en: Edit and mix speech, music, and sound effects in one shared editor session, with loudness normalization and audio cutting.
description.zh: 在同一个编辑会话中剪辑与混合口播、音乐和音效，支持响度统一与音频剪辑。

description.en: DSH desktop search provider that runs web search and fetch through AnySearch, rotating API keys on HTTP 402 with DNS fallback.
description.zh: DSH 官方桌面端的搜索 Provider，通过 AnySearch 提供 web search/fetch，遇 HTTP 402 自动轮换 API Key。

description.zh: DSH 的文本转换插件，用于对文本执行转换处理。

description.zh: 此插件暂无描述。

description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，未提供功能描述或 README，具体能力未知。

description.en: Time zone related plugin for DSH, no description provided.
description.zh: DSH 的时区相关插件，未提供具体功能说明。

description.en: A knowledge graph of traditional Chinese medicine formulas.
description.zh: 中药方剂知识图谱。

description.en: A knowledge graph plugin for Traditional Chinese Medicine data.
Plugin for querying UK police data.
description.zh: 用于查询英国警方数据的插件

description.en: Plugin with no README or description; only identified by name and topic.
description.zh: 该插件没有 README 或功能描述，只能通过名称 xby-who-is 和主题来识别，无法确认其具体能力。

description.en: Searches for images on Wikimedia from keywords.
description.zh: 根据关键词在Wikimedia上搜索图片。

description.en: No README or description provided for this plugin.
description.zh: 该插件未提供 README 或说明。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding an `xl` CLI and agent tools that compile .xl.md specs into target-language files with plans, cache and validation.
description.zh: 把 xl md 编译器装进 DeepSeek Harness 的插件：提供 xl CLI，并让 agent 把需求与 .xl.md 编译成目标语言文件。

description.en: Quick-capture notes with ⌘⇧N, auto-archived by day as local Markdown files, plus a sidebar timeline with search, editing and notebooks.
description.zh: 用 ⌘⇧N 随手记一笔，按天归档成本地 Markdown 文件，侧栏提供时间线、搜索、编辑与笔记本管理。

description.en: Installable DeepSeek Harness bundle adding the Yanxu delivery workflow skill: an evidence-bound AI coding delivery process.
description.zh: 可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件包，新增 Yanxu 交付工作流技能，实现以证据为核心的 AI 编码交付流程。

description.en: Prices tokens with the official model price table, shows running cost next to the composer context meter, and blocks a turn once spend exceeds your ceiling.
description.zh: 使用官方模型价格表计算 token 费用，在输入框上下文计旁显示实时花费，并在超出预算上限时阻止该轮对话。

description.en: Adds an invisible draggable strip along the top edge of the macOS desktop window so the whole window can be moved by dragging there.
description.zh: 在 macOS 桌面窗口顶部边缘添加一条不可见的可拖动区域，按住拖动即可移动整个窗口。

description.en: Clock in and out, configure your work schedule, and review average working hours by calendar, year, or list.
description.zh: 打卡上下班、配置工作排班，并按日历、年份或列表查看平均工时。

description.en: A cyberpunk HUD skin for DeepSeek Harness with a constant night palette and a pure CSS/SVG zero-state radar sweep on empty conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的赛博朋克 HUD 皮肤，恒定夜间配色，并在空会话时呈现纯 CSS/SVG 实现的零态雷达扫描。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that shows this turn's newly saved images and videos inline in the conversation without adding them to model context.
description.zh: DSH 桌面插件：把本轮新保存的图片和视频直接内嵌显示在对话里，不写入模型上下文。

description.en: Connects to local Zotero, indexes full text of every PDF in your library, and lets you or the AI search it by collection.
description.zh: 连接本机 Zotero，为整个文库的 PDF 全文建立索引，可在面板或对话中按分类检索并阅读全文。

description.en: Manage Zuad digital signage media, programs, playback schedules and devices through conversation.
description.zh: 通过对话管理 Zuad 数字标牌的媒体、节目、播放排期与设备。
